text: Umthethonkambiso 5 ngeke usebenze uma umsebenzi wechweba enesizathu esizwakalayo. Uma lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezolwandle enikwa umyalo ngumsebenzi wechweba njengoba kushiwo kumthethonkambiso 3, lomyalo uthathwa njengokhishwe nguMqondisi -Jikelele. a msebenzi womkhumbi walowo mkhumbi; noma b induna yomkhumbi yalowo mkhumbi. Uma uMqondisi-Jikelele enika umsebenzi womkhumbi umyalo ngokomthethonkambiso 1 umsebenzi womkhumbi kufanele ngokushesha azise noma abikele induna yomkhumbi ethintekayo ngalowo myalo. Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi ehluleka ukwenza lokho okushiwo umthethonkambiso 2 wenza icala okuyothi uma elahlwa yicala ahlawulise imali noma avalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile izinyanga eziyi-12. Umthethonkambiso 3 ngeke usebenze uma umsebenzi wechweba enesizathu esizwakalayo. Umyalo wezokuvikela uqala ukusebenza ngesikhathi esinqunywe kulowo myalo. Kodwa-ke a Uma i isikhathi singanqunywanga; noma ii isikhathi esinqunyiwe singaphambi kokuba umyalo onikiwe uqale ukusebenza, uqala ukusebenza emahoreni angama-24 ngemuva kokuba ukhishiwe; noma b uma isikhathi esinqunyiwe singemuva kosuku lwesikhombisa ngemuva kokuba umyalo ukhishiwe, umyalo uqala ukusebenza ekuqaleni kwalolo suku. b umyalo ususebenze isikhathi esiyizinyanga ezintathu. UMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele achithe umyalo wezokuvikela uma ngabe lokho kugxambukela okungekho emthethweni kwezokuthutha zasolwandle kungasekho noma kungasenakwenzeka maduze. UMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele azise noma abikele lowo muntu ngokuchithwa.

Abafundi abavame ukuba izisulu balahlekelwa ithemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukuhlala ezikoleni, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphume esikoleni noma baphumelele kahle ezifundweni zabo. Othisha, njengabantu abaphethe izikole, bahlala bebalulekile ekuxazululeni le nkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi othisha bazi izimpawu zokuxhwanguxhwangu ukuze bakwazi ukusiza abafundi abathintekayo. Ukuhlonipha abafundi nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali kudinga ukuba kube yinxenye ebalulekile yokwakha isiko lokuhlalisana kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abafundi ukuze bazi ukuthi bangaxhumana nobani uma bebhekene nezinkinga. Mayelana nemiphumela, ubuxhwanguxhwangu bungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yesisulu. Abafundi abahlukunyezwayo bangase baphatheke kabi, bahlupheke ngokomoya, futhi bahlale bephoxekile. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izisulu zingase zibe nezinselelo zokuxhumana nabanye, zibe nezinselelo zokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi zibe nezinselelo zokuphumelela ezikoleni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuxhwanguxhwangu akukhona nje kuphela udlame phakathi kwabafundi, kodwa kungaba nemiphumela eminingi emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuze sithole isixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke uhlanganyele. Abazali, othisha, nabafundi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe isimo esiphephile nezindawo zokufunda. Ukukhuluma ngale nkinga, ukufundisa abafundi ngezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ubuxhwanguxhwangu.

Umthetho Wokwandisa Amaphoyisa, ogxile kulabo ababe yizisulu zobugebengu, uwumqulu wolwazi obhalwe ukuze uchaze amalungelo akho njengokunjalo mayelana nenqubomgomo ethinta izisulu zobugebengu eNingizimu Afrika, ukuze lawa malungelo akwaziwa. Inqubomgomo ethinta izisulu zobugebengu, kanye nemithetho yokwandisa, ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebanzi ethinta ukuzibophezela kuk governo ekuthuthukiseni izinga losizo kulabo ababe yizisulu zobugebengu. Umthetho wokwandisa uhlose ukuchaza umnikelo okumele wenziwe ukusiza labo ababe yizisulu zobugebengu. Umthetho wokwandisa awugxili kuphela ekugcineni amalungelo nezimiso, kodwa futhi uhlinzeka ngemininingwane ejulile ezokusiza uqonde ukuthi ungawasebenzisa kanjani amalungelo akho futhi usize labo abathintekayo kulo msebenzi ukuze balandele kahle izimiso zamalungelo ezisulu njengoba kuchaziwe enqubomgomeni, ngokucacisa izimiso okufanele zilandelwe yilabo abathintekayo kulo msebenzi. Uma ubika ubugebengu futhi uhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo, unendima ebalulekile ekusizeni umnyango wezobulungiswa ukuze ubhekane nezidingo zomphakathi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abasolwa babhekana nemiphumela yezenzo zabo. Ngemuva kwalokho, umnyango wezobulungiswa kumele uphendule kuwe ngokushesha nangokuhlonipha ukuze uhambisane nezidingo zakho. Izimiso ezibekwe zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngokukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo akho agcinwa. Izimiso ezibekwe zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukuhlola ukuthi umsebenzi uhamba kahle ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibekwe uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kanjani.

Noma yimuphi umuntu osebenzisa le-website kumele alandele nokuvuma ukulandela imibandela nezimo zokusebenzisa njengoba kubekwe kule nothisi yomthetho Uma umsebenzisi engafisi ukuphoqelelwa yile mibandela nezimo umsebenzisi akumela angene kwi-website, akhombise izinto ezikuyo, asebenzise, noma akhiphe izinto kuyo kanye/noma ukwenza ikhophi noma ukusabalalisa okuqukethwe kule website. Abasebenzisi bangabuka, benze amakhophi, bakhiphele kumakhompyutha abo, baprinte, basabalalise okuqukethwe kule website, noma ingxenye yayo ukusebenzisa ulwazi noma ukuchaza lapho abakuthole khona kuphela, kanti futhi lokhu bangakusebenziseli inzuzo ngezemali. Abasebenzisi abafisa ukusebenzisa okuqukethwe kule website ngenhloso yezokuzuza imali, ngeke bakwenza lokho ngaphandle kokuthi baqale bathole imvume ebhaliwe, etholakala kuWeb Manager kule nombolo yocingo ethi: +27 12 314 2140 noma ngokuthumela i-email ekhelini elithi electronic@gcis.gov.za. Ukukhiqiza futhi kanye/noma ukwenza amakhophi okuqukethwe kuyo noma ingxenye yayo, ngenhloso yezezimali kumele kuhambisana nale nothisi yelungelo lobunikazi ngokuphelele. Onke amalungelo obuqotho nokulunga kanye noma yimaphi amanye amalungelo ezokuXhumana koMbuso noma ezinye izinhlangano zomthetho maqondana nengqikithi emaqondana nakho kule website angabekwanga obala, kusho ukuthi agodliwe. Lolu lwazi kule website lunenhloso yokunikeza ngolwazi olunabile maqondana nesihloko esithile noma izihloko, kanti futhi alunikeze yonke injula ngalesi sihloko. Kungumsebenzi osemahlombe omsebenzisi ukuzenelisa yena ngaphambi kokuba angene kule website, ngokuthi le website izohlangabezana nezidingo zakhe siqu umsebenzisi, kanye nokuhambisana ne-hardware kanye/noma i-software yakhe.

Ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi we-bio-fuel lapha kuzosisiza ukukhiqiza ukudla okudingekayo. Abakhiqizi base-South Africa banolwazi nolwazi lokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi, kodwa akukho maphakathi lapho umkhiqizo ungathengiswa khona. Uma umsebenzi we-bio-fuel uqhubeka, imakethe enhle ingatholakala. Ngokufanayo, ulwazi oluningi luzokwakhiwa esingaludlulisela kwezinye izindawo e-Afrika. Izindleko zokwakha lo msebenzi emhlabeni jikelele ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, ngakho kufanele kwakhiwe izinsiza ezinhle ukuze kusekelwe ukuqhubeka kwalomsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umngcele udinga ukubheka ikusasa eliqhakazile ukuze uthole izikhuthazo ezifanele. Lokhu okukhuthazayo ukuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-USA kube inani elikhulu lokukhiqiza kanye nokushintshwa kwe-MTBE nge-bio-ethanol. Lokhu okukhuthazayo umsebenzi ophathelene ne-bio-fuel lapha e-South Africa ukuvumelanisa nokugcina izinsiza zemvelo noma ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu basemaphandleni. Uma sibheka ukukhuphuka kwezintengo zokudla, sihlangana nesimo esishintshashintshayo emhlabeni jikelele, futhi lokhu akukhuphuki kakhulu emandleni ezimali. Lokhu kuyakhathaza ngoba sidinga imvume yoHulumeni ukuze siqhubeke phambili ngesikhathi esifanele ngokuvota nokunye. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngoba abaholi abakhombisi kahle indlela yokuhamba phambili mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Kodwa kubalulekile ukucabangela lezi zinto ezingaba yingozi mayelana nekusasa elide - ingabe singacabanga kuphela ngezingozi ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo esiseduze?

Uma, kuthi nangaphezu kokuphendulwa ngencwadi ngesicelo sakhe serekhodi, ofake isicelo efuna ukutshelwa ngesinqumo ngenye indlela, isbl, ngocingo, kumele kucaciswe lokhu iSigaba 182e. Uma ofake isicelo ecelela omunye umuntu, kufanele atshengise ukuthi usifaka ngaliphi igunya leso sicelo Isigaba 182f. Uma abafaka izicelo bengakwazi ukubhala noma ukufunda, noma benokukhubazeka okuthile, bangakwazi ukufaka isicelo serekhodi ngomlomo. Umphathi wehhovisi kumele abagcwalisele ifomu bese ebanikeza ikhophi yayo iSigaba 183. Umphathi wehhovisi lolwazi uyobhekana nesicelo semininingwane ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ngemuva kokusithola noma ngokushesha kangangoba kungenzeka [iSigaba 25]. Kwezinye izimo lesi sikhathi sezinsuku ezingama-30 singengezwa ngezinye izinsuku ezingama-30 [iSigaba 26]. Ofake isicelo uyokwaziswa ngemali emisiwe ekhokhwa ngaphambi kokuthi sicutshungulwe isicelo semininingwane [Isigaba 22]. Ofake isicelo angafaka isikhalo sokukhokha imali emisiwe khona ngaphakathi [Izigaba 74 no-75] noma afake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi athole ukuxhaswa okufanele, ngemuva kokuthi le nqubo eseyishiwo seyiphothuliwe [Isigaba 78]. Ofake isicelo uyokwaziswa ukuthi uyovunyelwa yini ukuthola imininingwane [Isigaba 25]. Okuyiyona nhloso ye-NEMISA ukuthuthukisa ubuciko, ezokusakaza ezinobuchwepheshe kanye nezinhlelo zosakazo olwehlukahlukene ezizohlomisa abathwali beziqu ngobungoti bokusebenza kumazinga obuqhinga embonini.

Imoto emhlophe yohlobo lweToyota Tazz, enezinombolo zenjini ezicishiwe yabanjwa. Izinto ezehlukene ezebiwe ezitolo zatholwa ngesikhathi kuboshwa amasela. I-ABC ibika okuningi okungejwayelekile kwezinye izizinda namuhla ekuseni. Imoto esetshenziswe abasolwa kwabikwa ukuthi yadunwa ePort Edward. Ukushintsha lapho kuyiwa khona kwezinsingo kungenisa umoya ofudumele endlini. Kuvalwe ukuphathwa kwamabhomu, iSAVA ingeseka umkhankaso wamazwe onke ukuthi kuvalwe ukusetshenziswa kwamabhomu noma ukwakhiwa kwawo. Amaplaki anamazinyo amathathu asetshenziswa ezweni lonke, ngakho kumele uphathe i-adaptha. Ukumbiwa komlando wabantu nge-MPTT kwathola izinsalela kanti ukuhlolwa kolibofuzo kuyenziwa sikhuluma nje. Imithombo ekhiqiza ama-esidi e-ammonium sulphate kanye ne-ammonium sulphate nitrate, bese kuthi ene-esidi encane kube yi-limestone ammonium nitrate. Ngavele ngenza isitatimende esichaza izikhathi. Imithetho ye-Schemme, uma kukhulunywa ngempilo yendawo nemvelo. UDkt Wendy Orr uyokusiza ukuthi ukhulume ngokwethulile. Ibhilidi elidala linezimpawu zokuvimbela izimoto ezingenayo kanjalo nezigaxa zikakhonkolo. Ukuphenya kuyaqhubeka kanjalo nokuthi kungenzeka kuboshwe abanye akuphikiwe. Izimoto ziyokhishwa emgwaqweni zifakwe kuJan Smuts Highway ngezimpawu eziyizo zokubuyela emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka ku- Brickfield Road. Kubonakala kunobugwala obucacile kwabamhlophe abazuzayo kuhulumeni odlule, ukuthi babhekane ngqo nenzuzo yabo ngesikhathi okukhulunywa ngaso.

Uma umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu ehluphekile ngesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi noma izicelo zabo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi ziye zaphumelela, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kwesinqumo sokusikhalazo. Ikhaya elinethuba lokufaka lesi sicelo yikhaya eliphezulu noma enye inkantolo enezimfanelo ezifanayo. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahambisane nezimfuneko zokusebenza ezitholakala kuMthetho, eziphathelene nesicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu elibekiwe ku-1, bese elithumela, kanye nemali yesicelo kanye ne-deposit (uma kudingeka), kuMenenja Yolwazi kwikheli leposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhonjiswe ku-2 ngenhla. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yomfaki-sicelo. Uma isicelo sithunyelwa egameni lomunye umuntu, khona-ke umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthi unegunya lokwenza lesi sicelo egameni labo. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngokubhala ukuthi ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe noma kuhanjiswa. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna izizathu zesinqumo ngenye indlela, kumele akhombise indlela nemininingwane ezodingeka. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqedela ifomu ngenxa yokuthi akakwazi ukufunda noma ubuthakathaka, lowo muntu angafaka isicelo ngenkulumo. Umceli kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ngaphambi kokuthi kwenzeke noma yisiphi isenzo. Futhi imali yokufinyelela, ebaliwe ngokubheka izindleko zokuphrinta kabusha, ukukhangwa, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zesicelo kanye neposi.

Uma umuntu elahlwe yicala ngemuva kokushushiswa ngendlela echazwe yithebula elingenhla, uyokhokha inhlawulo okukhulunywa ngayo kumthethonkambiso 185.00. Uma kwenzeka elahlwa yicala lapho kade kumangalelwe umuntu ngokusho kwethebula elingenhla, kuyokhokhwa inhlawulo okukhulunywa ngayo kumthethonkambiso 185.00.344. a Isaziso seNhlawulo esikhishwe yisikhulu esinegunya ngokusho komthethonkambiso 185.00. v mema lowo osolwa ngecala ukuba akhokhe imali yokuvuma icala eyonqunywa yisikhulu kuSaziso seNhlawulo zingakapheli izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu sikhishiwe nokwethulwa kweSaziso seNhlawulo. nika umsolwa ithuba lokuba athole usizo lokummelwa; kanye viii nencazelo yezinyathelo ezingalandela. b Isikhulu esikhiphe Isaziso seNhlawulo ngokusho komthethonkambiso 185.00. mbandakanya umfanekiso weSaziso seNhlawulo enikwe lowo osolwa ngecala/ umsolwa v balule isizathu ngezinyathelo ezithathiwe; kanye v nobufakazi bokuthunyelwa kwesaziso seNhlawulo kumsolwa. a Isikhulu esiphoqelela ukugcinwa komthetho siyonika umuntu ngqo isaziso noma ngencwadi ebhaliswe eposini ngefomu emiswe wuMqulu SA-CATS-OFF&PEN, Isaziso soPhenyo oluhlosiwe kumsolwa ngaphambi kokukhipha nokwethula kuye Isaziso seNhlawulo yemali ngemuva kophenyo okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso 185.00. nika umsolwa ithuba lokuba athole azommela ngesikhathi uma kulalelwe udaba; kanye v nencazelo yezinyathelo okungenzeka ezingathathwa. b Iziphakamiso zingabhalwa phansi noma zethulwe ngomlomo emhlanganweni ohleliwe ngaphambi kwesikhulu esiqondene.

I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokufaka amanzi ezitshalweni, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengazo zonke izinsiza. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izinto okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza nalesi sikhali. Le mishini inikeza ithuba lokufaka amanzi ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, kanye nezinye izifo, nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezithombo. Le mishini ingafaka amanzi amancane njalo, kodwa lokhu kungaphindwa. Uma umlimi eqala ukufaka amanzi ngalesi sikhali, kufanele aguqule indlela yakhe yokufaka amanzi. Bangase babe used to ukufaka amanzi angu-30mm noma 50mm njalo, manje kufanele bafake leyo manzi kodwa hhayi konke ngasikhathi sinye - bangafaka leyo manzi ngokuphindaphinda noma ukuphindwe kathathu. Uma kufakwa amanzi amaningi ngasikhathi sinye, kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwamanzi futhi kwenze amawheels ahambe kanzima. Phinde ukhumbule ukuthi umlimi uphatha inani lamanzi ezimpandeni. Uma bethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukufaka amanzi, kuzoba nzima ukuvimbela umonakalo ezitshalweni. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga kulabo abalimayo abasha abafaka amanzi ngalolu hlobo ngoba abazi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze i-arm ijike futhi ifike lapho iqala khona. Ungaphuthelwa ukuhamba i-header ejikayo, izokuletha inzuzo. Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ithuba lokugcina amanzi uma ifakwe kahle. Njengazo zonke izindlela zokufaka amanzi, lapha futhi izinga lokumunca komhlabathi kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ufake amanzi kuphela uma kudingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukusindisa amanzi namandla ngenkathi izitshalo zikhula.

Inkinga Yokubhalisa Emanyuvesi: Indaba Yomlando Emhlabeni jikelele, ukubhaliswa emanyuvesi kube yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. ESouth Africa, le nkinga ibonakala ikakhulukazi phakathi neminyaka yezi-2000, lapho izinga lokufunda liphakamisa izinselelo eziningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kubalulekile ukubheka izizathu eziholela ekubeni kube nezinkinga zokubhaliswa, kanye nemiphumela ethinta abafundi, iminyango kahulumeni, kanye nemfundo jikelele. Ngonyaka ka-2000, iNyuvesi yaseCape Town yathola ukwanda okukhulu kwabafundi abafuna ukufunda. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokubhaliswa, njengoba izinsiza ezikhona zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Abafundi abaningi babebhekene nezithiyo eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezinsuku ezide zokulinda, izinhlelo eziphukile, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abafundi baphumelele ekubhaliseni, kanti abanye bahlala bengabhaliswanga, okwakuholela ekutheni baphuthelwe amathuba okuthola imfundo. Ngonyaka ka-2015, inkinga yokubhalisa yafinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, lapho izikole eziningi ziqala ukuveza izikhalazo ezinkulu. Abafundi baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisana nezinhlelo zokubhaliswa ezazibonakala zingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezazihlosiwe, kodwa izinkinga zaphinde zaphinda zaphakanyiswa. Abafundi baphinde baqhamuka nezindlela zokuxhumana, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Ngalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqala ukubona ubukhulu benkinga yokubhaliswa.

Ngokudlula kwabanye, imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ingathola ubungozi bezokuphepha, ukuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlonipha. Lokhu kungase kubangele ukungabi nempumelelo emiqhudelwaneni futhi kuthinte izinkolelo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukugwema lokhu ngokuhlela kahle imicimbi nezindlela zokuvikela, ukuze ukuziphatha kuhlonishwe. Ukwakha imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe akusitshali kuphela ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwana; kudala futhi ithuba lokuthi sabone ukuthi imidlalo iyisithombe esidala sokubumbana nokuhlonipha. Imidlalo ingaba umthombo onamandla wokuhola izifundo ezinqabile zokuphila, obonisa ukuthi noma ngabe sitholakala kuphi emhlabeni, kunomoya wokubambisana okhula njalo, okuyinto eveza amandla ethu njengezizwe ezihlangene.

Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi weSoweto Uprising waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo ayizange iphele. Ngemuva kokubulawa kwabantu abaningi, umphakathi wawudinga ukuvuka, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba izimo zazingezinhle, abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi lwesiBhunu ezikoleni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esiqinile sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo yayihlanganisa abantu bonke, ikakhulukazi intsha.

U-Ronaldo ube yisibonelo sokuthi ukuzinikela nobuqotho kungaholela empumelelweni. Uthole izindondo eziningi, futhi ubona impumelelo emhlabeni wobhola, okwenza kube khona umthelela omkhulu kulabo abalandela umdlalo. U-Zinedine Zidane: Umphakathi Wokuhola U-Zinedine Zidane, ongumdlali ophumelele, ubalulekile emlandweni wobhola. Njengomqeqeshi, uZidane ubonakale eqhuba izinkanyezi eziningi, futhi uphinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wobhola. UZidane, owaziwa ngama-goals akhe amahle, ubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eFrance. Uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi wobhola, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Isiphetho: Umhlaba Wokudlala Ubhola Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlala bephakamisa umhlaba wobhola. Njengoba bephakela izigigaba ezimnandi ezinkundleni, bahlanganisa abantu, benza umphakathi ube munye. UMaradona, uPele, uMessi, uRonaldo, noZidane bangabantu abavelele, futhi imisebenzi yabo ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, abadlali bebhola bazohlala bebalulekile, futhi bazokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele ezizohlala zikhumbuleka.

Enye ingxenye yeSikhwama samaKhono sikaZwelonke izobhekela izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kanye nokusiza abaswele imisebenzi nalabo abasebenza inciki-nciki. UMkhandlu obhekela amaKhono usuveze isidingo sokuba kubhekisiswe kukhethwe izinhlelo zomphakathi ezidinga ukuxhaswa ukuze ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kube yiyona nto ehamba phambili kulezo nhlelo. Ukufeza lenhloso kuzodinga ubambiswano phakathi kwemiNyango kaHulumeni, iziNhlangano zeNtuthuko, kanye nezinNhlangano ezingaphandle kukahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke, lezifundazwe, nelohulumeni basekhaya. Kuzodingeka futhi ubungoti bokuhlela izinhlelo zentuthuko yomphakathi ngendlela yokuthi zigxile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono kukho konke ukwenza kwazo nanokuthi abantu babe nethuba lokuthola izitifiketi uma sebeqeqeshekile kulezonhlelo okuwuhlobo lokuqeqeshwa oluzoba sezingeni lokuhlonishwa nokwemukeleka uHlaka lukaZwelonke olusingethe ukuQeqeshwa (NQF) bese lokho kuba isisekelo semfundo nokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Akhona namathuba okusebenzisana nezinhlelo ezisungulelwe ukuthuthukisa umphakathi, njengezinhlelo ezizinze emphakathini zokwakha izidingo zomphakathi, uhlelo lwamanzi okuthiwa yiWorking for Water, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa intsha ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzisebenza nokuziqasha. Noma lemizamo ingeke ibonakale njengeyokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane, iyisisekelo sokunombola labo bantu abanamathalente athize abangahle benze ngawo amabhizinisi baziphilise bafake nesandla emnothweni wezwe. Maningi amaqembu eNingizimu Afrika afuna ukuthi kucatshangwe ukuthi yiwona adinga lolusizo kunamanye.

Okwesithathu, bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele baqonde kahle okuqukethwe nenhloso yoMthethosisekelo njengendlela yokuvikela nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle. Isibonelo 1: Abasebenzi bomphakathi ezingeni elihlukahlukene bavunyelwe ukuhlela futhi benze iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo. Lezi ziphakamiso kumele zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphikisi umoya noma izigaba ezithile zoMthethosisekelo. UMthethosisekelo mayelana nokubambisana nomphakathi nokuvuleka ezisebenzelaneni kufanele kulandelwe kahle ekwakhiweni okuqhubekayo kwezinhlelo. Isibonelo 2: Ingxenye 33 yoMthethosisekelo iv

Izingxoxo zokuhwebelana namazwe omhlaba kusalele ngemuva ngeminyaka kanti noma yimuphi umphumela awufinyeleli emathembeni aphezulu omphumela ogxile entuthukweni. Ukuhlonza umuntu owulungele kakhulu umsebenzi kubantu abaningi abanethalente ngaphandle nangaphakathi kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Okwesibili, ukuhlonza indlela yokusebenza kwezinhlelo ezinjalo, lokho kufaka nezinhlelo zesikhungo kanye nokugada. Ingikholwa wukuthi kuyoba kubi kakhulu ukuba siyekele lolu daba ezandleni zabaPhethe kuphela. Lolo kwakuwuhlelo lwangaphakathi ezinkampanini kanti lokho ngakuthola ngesikhathi ngibona izincwadi ezaphuma emathrakhini. Ngicabanga ukuthi ngithe kuyodingeka izivumelwano phakathi kweligi kanye ne-Topsport. Ukungenelela kukahulumeni ekumaketheni okumbiwa phansi akugunyaziwe kanti kuyingozi kanti izinkampani zokumbiwa phansi zimelene nakho. Kwakunezindima ezehlukene ezichazwe ngumnikazi, u-webmaster, i-web author, kanye nezindima ezesekayo njengo-graphics designer. Amalungiselelo angenziwa ukuhlehlisa ukukhokha yonke imali kuze kube ngasekupheleni konyaka wezimali. Le brosha iveza izinkoleloze ngosherifu nokusthi isherifu ingubani namandla abanawo. Imiklomelo igubha indlela ephakeme ekhonjiswe abafundi asebekhulile kanjalo nezikhungo zokubafundisa nokuvuma ukubaluleka kohlelo lwemfundo yabadala. Ilungu lekomidi lingaholelwa njengokomyalelo kaNgqongqoshe, ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe wezeZimali. Uhlelo lokuphatha lusendaweni yokubhekana ngqo nezikhalazo uma nangesikhathi ezitholakala ngaso.

Le ndawo ayikathathi hlangothi ngaphansi kokulawula kukahulumeni ngaphansi komthetho wezihlonipho. Lokhu kusekela kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngezinye zezinhlelo lapho kukhona abaxhasi noma izinhlangano ezisizayo. Umamukeli unenketho yokukhetha ukuthi ukwesekwa kuzokwenza kube nezithakazelo. Uma kukhulunywa ngokuqashwa kwemali, noma ekwakheni indlu noma inhlanganisela yombili. Phambilini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezimnyama ezifana neSoweto, eMamelodi, nakwezinye, uhulumeni wangaphambili wakha izindlu zokuhlala. Abahlali ababeqashwe kulezi zindlu ngaphambi kukaMashi 15, 1991, bangafaka isicelo sokuthola isaphulelo ekuthengeni lezi zindlu kuze kube ngu-R7,500.00. Ngokuvamile lezi zindlu zinikezwa mahhala ngenxa yesaphulelo esingu-R7,500.00 esedlula inani langempela lendlu. Izinga langaphambilini lokwesekwa elingu-R579.00 lingasetshenziswa ezingeni eliphansi lobuchwepheshe bokwakha. Imali esele engu-R12,521.00 ingasetshenziswa ekwakheni okuphezulu, bese okungena ngaphansi kwemitha eyisikwele engama-30 (30m) yendawo ephelele yendlu. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu kumele bakhokhe kuqala imali engu-R2,479.00. Uhlelo lwezindlu ezizimele, uhlelo lokukhipha amanzi, kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kuyizidingo ezibalulekile. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu zabantu kumele bafake imali yabo. Abalingani bethu ohlelweni lokwakha izindlu nokuqhuba umsebenzi?

Kuyintokozo kimina ukwethula emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika uMthetho oHlongoziwe kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka obukeziwe. LoMthetho Ohlongoziwe umele izinkolelo zezemidlalo nezokungcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika zokuthi ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka zibambe iqhaza kwezenhlalakahle yabo bonke ebantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyindlela enhle kakhulu yokumbandakanya intsha emicimbini ezokwakha imiphakathi. Eminyakeni emihlanu eyedlule, inqubobomgomo yokuqala kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka yashicilelwa ngokokuqala eMthethweni Ohlongoziwe lapho izinselelo, izinqubomgomo nezandulelo kwabekwa kwacaca. Kuningi osekwenziwe ukuhlangabezana nalezo zinselelo nezandulelo, kodwa ngenxa yokusweleka kwesikhathi esanele nezinto zokusebenza iseyinde kakhulu indlela eya phambili. Ngokulandela isesekelo sezinqubomgomo namasu kahulumeni kuzwelonke, kuyadingeka ukuba izandulelo kwezemidlalo nokungcebelekwa kubuye kubhekisiswe futhi kushintshwe. Ukuze kufezwe inqubomgomo kahulumeni yempilo engcono kuwonke wonke, nokwenza isizwe sidlale, ukusungulwa kweKhomishani yezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka yaseNingizimu Afrika kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizoqinisekisa ukuthi ezemidlalo zifinyelela kuzo zonke izingxenye zeNingizimu Afrika.

a umsebenzi wechweba b umsebenzi wezinto ezisetshenziswa echwebweni. a lowo obambe iqhaza kudingeka ngokomthethonkambiso -35 uma abe nohlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle; futhi b lowo obambe iqhaza esebenza njengobambe iqhaza; futhi c kungekho hlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle okusetshenziswa yilowo obambe iqhaza. Icala okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso 1 linesijeziso uma likulahlile uhlawuliswa imali noma uvalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi -12. a lowo obambe iqhaza kudingeka ngokomthethonkambiso- 35 ukuba abe nohlelo lokuvikela olwandle; futhi b kukhona uhlelo lwezokuvikela zasolwandle olusetshenziswa yilowo obambe iqhaza ; futhi c lowo obambe iqhaza ehluleka ukulandela lolo hlelo. Umthethonkambiso 1 awusebenzi uma lowo obambe iqhaza enesizathu esizwakalayo. Lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle akufanele enze isenzo ezingathikameza noma sivimbele uhlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle lomunye umuntu naye obambe iqhaza kulemboni yezasolwandle. i akudingekile ukuba abe nohlelo lwezokuvikela lwasolwandle; futhi ii esenikezwe izingxenye ezifanele zohlelo oluchithekela komunye. Lona omunye obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze alandele uhlelo.

Usain Bolt: Umqeqeshi Wezimbangi Zokugijima Umbuzo: Ubani uUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli odumile waseJamaica, owaziwa kakhulu njengomgibeli ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wezimbangi zokugijima. Uzalwe ngomhla ka-21 kuNhlangulana 1986 eSherwood Content, eJamaica. Ubephakeme emqhudelwaneni wezimbangi zokugijima, ikakhulukazi emigqeni ye-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m relay. Umbuzo: Yini eyamkhumbuza uUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt wakhula enethemba lokudlala ibhola, kodwa wathola uthando lokugijima ngesikhathi esesikoleni. Uthole ukuqashelwa ngesikhathi enza kahle emqhudelwaneni wezokugijima, futhi lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphila kwakhe njengomgibeli. Wazithola esebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze afeze amaphupho akhe. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izimpumelelo ezinkulu zikaUsain Bolt? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ungumqeqeshi ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wezimbangi. Uthole amahlandla ama-8 eMidlalo ye-Olympic, lapho ahlula khona izimbangi zakhe emigqeni ye-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m relay. Ubuye waphumelela imiqhudelwano ye-World Championships, lapho athola khona izindondo eziningi. Uthole irekhodi lomhlaba emigqeni ye-100m no-200m, okuyizikhathi ezingu-9.58 seconds no-19.19 seconds, ngokulandelana. Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kanjani emlandweni wezokugijima? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezokugijima ngoba waguqula indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngale midlalwano. Waba isibonelo sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuphumelela.

ix uma iBhodi lithatha lesosinqumo, ilayisense yesitende noma amandla afanayo akhishwe ngaphansi komthetho kamasipala wendawo onika amandla okusethsenziswa kwesitende noma irenki, noma isincomo esiphuma kumasipala ofanele sokuthi indawo yerenki ikhona; noma x ezinye izimo okuthi, ngokombono we Bhodi, zingathinta ukulangaza ukuvuma noma ukuchitha isicelo. IBhodi alikwazi ukubhekela isicelo selayisense yokusebenza esifakwe ngumqashwa wesiphathimandla sezokuthutha, ummeli wesikhungo sezogcinomthetho noma ifemu yokubhekela ezokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi endaweni. nokuthi lesisicelo asidingi ukusakazwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 42. Ibhodi lingenqaba ukubheka isicelo sokukhishwa, ukuvuselelwa, ukushintshwa noma ukwedluliselwa kwelayisense uma selike labheka futhi lachitha isicelo esedlule, esasitholwe phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha ngaphambi kosuku okwatholwa ngalo lesisicelo okokuqala, okungukuthi, ngokubona kwe Bhodi sinezimo ezifanayo noma ezisondelene kakhulu nezesicelo esishiwo ekuqaleni. IBhodi lingakwazi, ekuvumeni isicelo, ukubeka imigomo engeke ingahambisani nalo Mthethi noma uMthetho ka Zwelonke. Ukwenzela lesisigaba izithuthi zizothathwa njengezisuka lapho umuntu egibela khona imoto ngenhloso yokuhanjiswa kwenye indawo, futhi agcine lapho. lapho kunokungabaza ukuthi izithuthi zizoqala kuphi, umfaki sicelo kumele afake isicelo kwisi fundazwe lapho imoto ekukhulunywa ngayo irejistwe khona.

Kulokhu, ihhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze lizohlinzeka ummangali ngerekhodi eqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sitholiwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD njengoba kuchazwe kuNgxenye -4.1.2 kanye -4.1.2 yale ncwadi kodwa ongakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yokungafundi noma ukungasebenzi, unelungelo lokwenza isicelo somlomo. a Emenenja Yolwazi echazwe; noma b KuMphathi wesifunda noma ehhovisi lesifunda elinikezwe lapho isicelo somlomo senziwa. Umenenja Yolwazi uzobhala isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze ummangali kopi yalolo suku. Uma ummangali efika kuMphathi wesifunda okukhulunywe kuNgxenye -4.1.4(b) yale ncwadi, uMphathi wesifunda ofanele uzobhalela isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze ummangali kopi yalolo suku. Uma ummangali ezisa uMenenja Yolwazi noma uMphathi wesifunda / umphathi osethekwini ngentshisekelo yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD, uMenenja Yolwazi uzohlinzeka ngalolu sizo mahhala ngoba kubalulekile ukuthi ummangali ahambisane ngokuphelele nezinhlinzeko -4.

NgeLawrence Luthango (oqale ukusebenza ngoMeyi 2008) eMpumalanga Kapa - kunabangu-14. Ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukusebenzisa i-auger, ukujula komhlabathi, ubunzima bomhlabathi obudala ngokulima, ukufaka umanyolo, umphumela wokuhlaziywa komhlabathi, ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, umkhiqizo wombhede, umanyolo, izidingo zokudla kwezitshalo, inani lokudla okukhona emhlabathini, izindlela zokulima, nokugcina amanzi omhlabathi. Imali engabolekwa abakhiqizi - konke okukhuluma ngokubolekwa kwemali, amasu okuphatha imali, izindleko zokukhiqiza, ukubala inani lokukhiqiza, izikhathi zokutshala, ukujula kokutshala, izinhlobo zezithelo, inani lezitshalo ngehektare, umthelela wezimo zezulu ekukhiqizeni, ukukala imvula nokushisa, ukujikeleza kwezithelo, ukusebenzisa ithrekhtha, ukuvuna, inani lokunwetshwa kokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, ukutshala u-mazayi, izindleko zokuthutha, ukuthenga izinto ezidingekayo ukuze uqale ukulima kahle, usizo ngezinto ezisele emasimini ngemuva kokuvuna, ukuhweba ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, izikhwama, nezisekelo ezivela kuhulumeni. Izindleko zokuzisebenzisa, inani lamakilowathi adingekayo ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi othile, izindleko zokulungisa izinto eziphukile, inani lamakilowathi adingekayo ngehektare, ukunciphisa ubukhulu bokulima ukuze kwehliswe izindleko, kanye nezivumelwano zokurenta imishini. Izindlela zokuthola umhlaba, ukukala nokunquma usayizi wemfuyo noma insimu, ukurenta ifamu, izinhlobo zomhlabathi, nezindlela zokuphatha izitshalo ezingafuneki endaweni yakho. Ukuphatha izilokazane ezinsimeni nasekuphatheleni izifo ezithinta izithelo.

a umsebenzi walowo mkhumbi; noma b induna yomkhumbi. Uma uMqondisiJikelele azisa umsebenzi womkhumbi njengoba kushiwo kumthethonkambiso 1 ngenhla, umsebenzi womkhumbi kufanele ngokushesha adlulisele leso saziso kwinduna yomkhumbi othintekayo. Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi ehluleka ukulandela lokho okushiwo kumthethonkambiso 2 ngenhla, uyobe esenze icala, okuyothi uma elahlwa yicala ahlawuliswe inhlawulo noma avalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12. Umthethonkambiso 3 awusebenzi uma umsebenzi womkhumbi enesizathu esizwakalayo. a lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle ophethe leyo ndawo; futhi b Uma lowo obambe iqhaza kungesiyena umsebenzi womkhumbi, azise naye umsebenzi womkhumbi. a lowo obambe iqhaza; kanti b uma lowo obambe iqhaza eqhuba umsebenzi othintwa isimemezelo ngaphakathi kwechweba elilawulwa ngezokuvikela futhi engeyena umsebenzi womkhumbi, kanye nomsebenzi womkhumbi. a UMqondisi-Jikelele azise umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kumthethonkambiso- 22, 23,24 noma- 25 ukuthi kusetshenziswa izinga lezokuvikela olwandle; futhi b UMqondisi-Jikelele echitha leso simemezelo, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele ngokushesha, azise lowo muntu ngokuchithwa lokho. a umsebenzi wechweba azise omunye umuntu ngokusho komthethonkambiso- 22 2 ukuthi kusebenza izinga lezokuvikela olwandle; futhi b uMqondisi-Jikelele echitha leso simemezelo, umsebenzi wechweba kufanele ngokushesha azise lowo muntu ngokuchithwa lokho.

Uma ubheka ukuthi amaqembu yiwona ayisisekelo kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka, iziphathimandla a ukumisa nokusentshenziswa kohlelo lwezemidlalo lukazwelonke nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zezemidlalo ziyathokala kubo bonke , nokuthi zikhona izingqalasizinda zokuqhudelana namaqembu, nokuthi ziphathwa ngobungcweti. Ukuqagula nokuqoqela ndawonye izinto nezindawo zokudlala, amaqembu nezidingo zezingqalasizinda zemiqhudelwano, bese idweba uhlelo lwesikhashana. Ukuthuthukisa nokunikezela ngamathuluzi noqeqesho ukuze kuqinisekwe ukuthi izinto zokudlala, nezigungu zamaqembu nemiqhudelwano kuphathwa ngobungcweti. b Ukuthuthukisa amazinga emicimbi yezemidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ebanjelwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Ukumisa noma ukudweba uhlelo nokuqinisekisa ukusentshenziswa kohlelo lokubhida nokubamba imicimbi yamazwe ngamazwe. Ukusiza lezo nhlangano ezinikwe imvume yokubamba imicimbi yamazwe ngamazwe. c Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izindlela zokuxazululwa kwezinkinga ezimisiwe ezamukelwe yizinhlangano, okuphepha, nokwesekelwa ngumphakathi. Ukusungula nokunikela ngezimfanelo zokusebenza izikhungo zezemidlalo ukuze kube yizona ezinikeza lolusizo. Ukuqagula ezemidlalo ezihamba phambili okuzobhekiswa kuzo izimfanelo/izidingo, ukuqaphela inqubekela-phambili yazo nokungenelela uma kudingeka. Ukutholwa, ukuphathwa nokusakaza ulwazi ngezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ukuze kakhiwe isizinda solwazi. Ukwakha ukuhlanganyela ukuze kwenziwa lula ukutholakala kwezimali nezinye izimfanelo kubaxhasi, kuhulumeni nemincintiswana kazwelonke. Ukunikeza usizo lwezimali ngokumisa izinhlelo zokusiza ama-athilethikhi.

Hlola inani lamanzi nowoyela. Thola irekhodi lokuseviswa kwalowo mshini. Bheka ukuthi amathaya anjani. Bheka ukuthi azikho izindawo lapho kuvuza uwoyela - azifuneki. Dumisa injini ulalele ukuthi iduma kanjani. Sebenzisa ikhlashi namageli - kuhamba kahle konke noma qha? Faka umshini (njengeskofela) bese uyawuphakamisa ukuhlola ukuthi uhlelo lamahayidroliki lusebenza kahle. IPTO lisebenza kahle? Onke amageji nezibanyana kusebenza kahle? Donsa umshini ukubona ukuthi ugandaganda unamandla. Isimo lo gandaganda usasebenza kahle? Bheka ukuthi kuyipulantela elisebenza kanjani - linamapuleti, lisebenza ngevakyumi (umoya) noma lisebenzisa iminwe? Ipulantela litshala amalayini amangaki? Bophela ipulantela kugandaganda. Faka izimbewu nomanyolo emabhakethini. Hambisa ugandaganda endaweni elingana na-10 meter bese uhlola ukuthi onke amalayini ayasebenza. Lapho izimbewu nomanyolo akuphumi ngokufanele, hlola izakhi ezifanele zihambe ufune ukuthi ikuphi inkinga. Bheka ukuthi akhona na amanye amapuleti (lapho lisebenzisa amapuleti). Ngaphambi kokubophela umshini kugandaganda, hlola ileveli likawoyela ephampini.

Iqembu lobuphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi kumele liqoqe konke okungubumelwana kunye namafomu nezinye izincwajana ezixhasa isicelo likuyise kwi Bhodi ukuze lithathe isinqumo. Lapho isithuthi esiphakanysiwe sizosebenzela nakwelinye idolobhakazi lelinye iqembu lezobuphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi, iqembu lokuqala labaphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi kumele lihambise isicelo kwelinye iqembu lobuphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi, ekumele lilandele izinyathelo ezikhonjwe kwizigatshana 3 kuya ku 6 bese lisibuyisa isicelo nezincomo ezifanele lisibuyisele kwiqembu lokuqala labaphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi. Lapho iBhodi lakwesinye isifundazwe lihambise isicelo saliyisa kwi Bhodi ukuthola uvo ngesicelo esiphuma kwesinye isifundazwe, iBhodi kumele lithumele lesosicelo kwiqembu labaphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi elifanele ukuze iBhodi lithole izincomo noluvo okukhonjwe kusigatshana 3. Izimvume zihlala zisemthethweni kuze kufike usuku olubekwe ngokukwesigaba 32 2 so Mthetho kaZwelonke. Izimvume kumele zishintshelwe kumalayisense okusebenza akhishwe ngaphansi komthetho ofanayo ngosuku olukhonjwe kusigatshana 1, okuthi uma kungenzeki iphelelwe yisikhathi. Izimvume ebezingasebenzi ngesikhathi esibekwe ngu MEC ngokumemezela kuSomqulu angeke zishintshelwe kumalayisense okusebenza futhi ziyophelelwa yisikhathi esiyoshiwo kulesi simemezelo. Mayelana nemvume ekhishelwe isikhathi esithile, ilayisense yokusebenza iyoba semthethweni ngesikhathi leso imvume iyobe isemthethweni ngaso.

Izikhathi eziningi, abanye abasebenzi bangenza izinqumo ezingalungile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olunembile. Izinqubo zokubhalisela izinhlelo zempilo kufanele zibe lula, futhi abaphathi bamasheya beGEMS kumele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bayazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze babhalisele izinhlelo zempilo. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezifana nezinsuku zokwazisa, kungaba usizo olukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi baqonda kahle izinqubo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, akufanele kube khona ukuphazamiseka ekudonsweni kwemali emholweni. I-GEMS kumele iqinisekise ukuthi le nqubo iyashesha futhi iyasebenza. Ukudonswa kwemali kumele kwenziwe ngokuqondile, ngaphandle kokubangela izinkinga ezinjengokwehluleka kokudlulisela imali ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kwababhalisile ukuthi bahlale beqaphe izindleko zempilo zabo. Kodwa-ke, kunobungozi bokuthi uma izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali zingasebenzi kahle, kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingalungile. Lokhu kungabavimbela abasebenzi ekutholeni ukunakekelwa okufanele, okubanga ukukhathazeka ngemiphumela empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinqubo, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zedijithali ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zokudonswa kwemali. Ukuba nezinqubo ezilungile zokudonswa kwemali akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isithunzi esihle seGEMS. Uma abasebenzi benelisekile ngemisebenzi yeGEMS, bazoba nesifiso sokuyisebenzisa futhi bazokhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlale bephakathi kwalezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela nokwethembana phakathi kweGEMS nabasebenzi.

Abasebenzi bahlala bejabulile, futhi umphakathi waMzimkhulu waqala ukuvuma izinguquko ezinhle. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa amakhono lwenza abantu babe namandla, futhi lokho kwaba yinsika yokukhula kwempumelelo. Umphakathi waqala ukubona izinzuzo, njengoba abantu behola kahle, futhi izinga lokusebenza lenyuka. Uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwaba yimpumelelo ngenxa yokubambisana. Abasebenzi, abaphathi, nabaholi bahlala bexhumana, behlanganyela izimvo, futhi bekwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga. Lokhu kwakwenza ukuthi kube nokwenyuka okuqhubekayo, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi ukufunda akupheli. Uhlelo lwaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Njengoba izinyanga zidlula, umphakathi waMzimkhulu waqala ukuhamba phambili. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulisa izimpumelelo zabo. UThandiwe noSipho, kanye nabanye abasebenzi, baqala ukukhuluma ngempumelelo yabo, futhi lokho kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ukufunda akupheli. Ekugcineni, umphakathi waMzimkhulu waba yisibonelo sokusebenza kahle. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabulile, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono zaba yinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi ukufunda kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuhamba phambili, nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. UMzimkhulu waba yindawo lapho abantu behlanganyela khona, bejabulela ukufunda, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi waMzimkhulu waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu benza imizamo yokuthuthukisa amakhono abo, bangakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsika yokukhula komphakathi.

Ukwandisa imithombo yokwakha ingqalasizinda yokusebenza ukuze amazwe ase-Afrikha aphucule izimpilo zawo kanye nokulawula. Impela, izincwadi eziqhamuka eTimbuktu zisihlinzeka ngethuba lokubuka umlando wethu kabusha. Iqoqo elinolwazi olucacile, olungacingeka lwamajenali atholakala ngekhompyutha eNingizimu Afrikha nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukufuywa izinhlanzi nezinye izilwane zasendle eNingizimu Afrikha bekuphelela ekufuyeni izimbaza eKnysna kumashumuminyaka amaningi. Bakwazi ukumelana nemizamo yama-British yokuzama ukwenza abantu babo babe amaNgisi nokubephuca amasiko abo. Cha, ngoba uChrista Stoman wakhethwa waba wumdidiyeli wejokhi. USinet unomfowabo ogama lakhe nguJabu kanti uJabu ulama uSinet. Sekucacile ukuthi izikhungo zezivumelwano zezingxenye eziningi zidinga ukuhlelwa kabusha njengoba zakhiwa ngesikhathi iningi lethu sasiphethwe njengamazwe enganyelwe ngamanye. Ezweni lonke, izinkulungwane zezigqoko zebhola ezingomakaraba ziyakhiwa. Ngakho-ke iphrojekthi yezikole ezinomlando ayenzelwe ukuthola lokho okwakulahlekile. Ingxube ehlukanisiwe engasasetshenziswa: ihlukanisa bonke osayizi abakhona emoyeni ovunguzayo. Abasolwa bavele enkantolo yemantshi yaseNigel lase lihlehliswa icala baphindela esitokisini. Umzamo wokufundisa kabusha abanamacala ukuba babe ngakubantu wawuyisisekelo senqubomgomo ye-ANC uma kukhulunywa ngezigelekeqe ezibanjiwe. Uhulumeni waseZimbabwe usugxile emumweni wawo ngodaba. Yilawo maphupho engiwezwe lapha okokuqala.

Lokhu kudala isimo sokuhlangana, sokwakha ubuhlobo obuyingxenye yezenzakalo ezinjalo. Umphakathi uhamba phambili, ubuthakathaka, bheka ukuthi abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bazithokozisa kanjani ngomqondo owodwa. Into ebalulekile ukuze ithenisi ibe njalo phambili ukwakha ikusasa lemidlalwano. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufaka izinhlelo zokufundisa eziphumelelayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iminyaka emisha iyakwazi ukuthola ithuba lokubona nokubamba iqhaza emidlalweni. Ukuze sishintshe izimpilo zomsebenzi wezokudlala, kufanele kwenziwe umsebenzi onzima othinta ukufundiswa nokufundela ababambiqhaza abancane. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo nowaziyo. Ithenisi ayigcini nje ngokuba umdlalo, kodwa ibuye ibe yindawo yokukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ukudlala ithenisi kudinga umzamo, kodwa akudingi ukuba kube ukuncintisana kuphela; kuyindlela yokuphila. Ukugijima, ukugxila nokusebenza endaweni udinga amandla okuphila. Ukukhuthaza abasha ukuthi baqhubele phambili amandla abo nokukhuluma ngesimo sezemidlalo sibe ngcono, kubalulekile ukuze kuvulele amathuba amasha. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukwaziwisa kokuhlala kahle emiphakathini yethu. Kodwa-ke, ukuze sibe neqhaza, kudinga ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Ithenisi, njengomgibeli, idinga ukuxhaswa ukuze iqhubeke nokukhula. Ukuze sikhulise ubuchwepheshe bethu, kufanele kube nezinsiza ezinengqondo ezisekelwe ezikhaleni zokudlala, izikole, nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, kugcinwa umphakathi kuphela engapheli, umphakathi omnyama kakhulu. Ukuxhaswa ngobuchwepheshe, ukukwazi ukwakha ithuba lokudala izindawo ezisemqoka kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze sikhulise ibhizinisi lethu elinempilo.

Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Imijondolo 1. Isingeniso Imijondolo iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhiqiza kakhulu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga eliphezulu lempilo nokuphila kwabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa imijondolo ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zesikhathi samanje nezesikhathi esizayo. Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Le nqqubo yokuthuthukisa imijondolo ibhekene nezinhlelo, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlinzekwe ukufinyelela ezimweni ezinhle zokuhlala. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zingoziwa ngezidingo zendawo, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimiso zokuhlala ezifanele. Izinjongo Zokuthuthukiswa Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zinezinto eziningi ezibalulekile: - Ukuhlinzeka indawo ephumelelayo yokuhlala. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imijondolo ihlangabezana nezidingo zokuphepha. - Ukukhuthaza izindlela zokuphila eziphusile nezokuhlala. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo. Uhlelo Lokusebenza Ukuze le nqobo ibe yimpumelelo, kudingeka uhlelo lokusebenza olunembile oluzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukubambisana nohulumeni, izinkampani, nemiphakathi. - Ukuhlelwa kwezinsiza zezimali ukuze kutholakale uxhaso lwezimali. - Ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu abahlala emijondolo ukuze bakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ukubandakanywa Kwemiphakathi Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibenengxenye ekuthuthukiseni imijondolo. Ukubandakanywa kwemiphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezintweni ezidingekayo, kuqinisekiswe ukwamukelwa kwezinhlelo, nokwakha umqondo wokubambisana. Lokhu kungahlanganisa: - Ukuhlanganiswa kwemibono yabantu abahlala emijondolo. - Ukusungulwa kwemihlangano yokubambisana.

b ongelungu orejistile kumele aziphathele amabhizinisi akhe. imigomo eyehlukene engaphansi kwalesisigaba ingasebenza ezindaweni ezehlukene e-Gauteng nakwizinhlangano ezintsha kunakulezo esezazinda. izinqubo ezivezwe kulesisigaba noma yikomuphi umThetho zingasho ukuthi umuntu owephula lokho okubekelwe wona noma ohluleka ukuwugcina uyotholwa enecala bese kufanela ukuthi ahlawuliswe noma avalelwe isikhathi esingeqile ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. noma yimiphi imigomo eyenziwe ngokomthetho ochithwe noma okhishwe yilo Mthetho bese usebenza ngaphambi kokuqala kwalo Mthetho ngokwezinto U MEC angakwazi ukuzibekela imigomo ngokwalesisigaba, ithathwa njengenqubomgomo eyenziwe ngokwalesisigaba, ukwenzela lo Mthetho, kuze kufike isikhathi lapho u MEC enza khona inqubomgomo eyengama inqubomgomo yalesisigaba. c ukwenqabela ukuthi lemoto Igibelise noma yehlise abagibeli kumagatsha athile ngezikhathi ezithile, bese ebeka izikhathi zokugibelisa nokwehlisa abagibeli. d ukuziphatha kwabashayeli bezimoto ezisetshenziselwa ukuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi, okungaba khona kuko ukuncenga nokuhutha ukuze kuheheke abagibeli. Umasipala angangena kwisivumelwano nabantu noma izikhungo mayelana nokubeka noma ukusebenzisa izinto zokusebenza ngokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi ezisezindaweni zabantu, ngokuhambisana nenqubo nemigomo eyenziwe nguMEC, uma ukubekwa noma ukusetshenziswa kuhambelana nezinhlelo zezokuthutha.

Lomsebenzi uyosayida ebhokisini elingaphansi kwengxenye B yefomu ukukhombisa ukuthi usitholile isikhalo. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola umfanekiso walelifomu uma ukufaka kwakho isicelo sekwamukelwe. Ingxenye C yefomu lesikhalo iyogcwaliswa umqashi nawe ezigabeni ezahlukene zokuzama ukuxazulula isikhalo. Izinhlamvu zamagama neSibongo:... Izinombolo ongathintwa kuzo : Inombolo Yocingo:... Igama lokumele (uma ekhona):... Izinombolo zenyunyana : Inombolo Yocingo:... Yini isikhalo sakho? Lengxenye yefomu iphathelene namazinga ahlukene eziphathimandla ukuzama ukuxazulula ingxabano. Kodwa-ke akunamazinga anqunyiwe okuxazulula isikhalo. Kungagcwaliswa elilodwa noma amaningi kulamakhasi alandelayo, kuyoya ngesimo. Uma isikhalo singaxazululeki kuze kufike ezingeni lenhloko yoMnyango , kufanele sithunyelwe kusiphathimandla esiphethe (ikhasi elingezansi eliqondene ngqo nokudlulisela kusiphathimandla esiphethe kufanele ligcwaliswe). Isikhalo kufanele sibhekwe kuwo wonke amazinga afanele (okumbandakanya nesiphathimandla) zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30, ngaphandle uma isikhathi seluliwe ngokuvumelana nomsebenzi onesikhalo. Ngabe isikhalo sixazululiwe? Ngabe isikhalo sixazululiwe? Ngabe kukhona ofisa ukukusho? Ngabe isikhalo sixazululiwe?

Inqubo yokuthola isisindo nalapho uyobhalwa khona umphumela wezibalo zokuthi ibhalanse kangakanani indiza kufanele inqunywe wuMqulu SA- CATS-GMR. Izivivinyo zempoqo nokuhlola kuyokwenziwa ngokulandisa kohlelo olwemukelwe lokulungisa leyo ndiza ngezikhathi ezithile noma ngezikhawu ezinqunyiwe. b noma iyiphi indiza ngaphandle kwaleyo eqondwe endimeni a kufanele kube nohlelo lokulungisa olwemukelwe isigaba esithile sezindiza okufanele zihlolwe ngezikhawu ezithile ezinqunyelwe kanjalo wuhlelo. Indiza eqondwe wumgonyana 2ai engakaqedi amahora angu 100 esikhathini esilingana nezinyanga eziyishumi nambili kusukela ekuhlolweni kokugcina iphoqelwe ukuhlolwa ngaphambi kokuba idedelwe iphindele emsebenzini. Indiza eqondwe wumgonyana 2aii engaqedile uhlelo lokuhlolwa singakapheli isikhathi esinqunywe ngumkhiqizi wayo noma yiKhomishani iyophoqelwa ukulandela uhlelo lokuhlolwa ngaphambi kokuba idedelwe iphindele emsebenzini. b uma ehlola ibanga lokusuka kwendiza emhlabathini abhale oqwembeni lwesikali sesivinini usuku nezinga lokugcina umshini okwazi ukufinyelela kulo ngesikhathi uhlolwa. Noma ngubani ovivinya noma ohlola ibhokisi lesimo esibucayi uyolivivinya noma alihlole ngendlela enqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-GMR.

Amakomidi adingida lezondaba eziphathelene nezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini noma ezikhungweni lezo ikomidi elisungulelwe wona. Ikomidi kumele lenze izincomo kubaqashi ngesimo sempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Uma izincomo zingaholeli ekuxazululekeni kwenkinga, ikomidi ingenza izincomo eziqondiswe kumhloli. Ikomidi kumele ixoxisane nomhloli ngazo zonke izehlakalo ezibandakanya ukulimala, ukugula noma ukufa kwesisebenzi kanti lokhu kumele kubhalwe phansi. Ikomidi kufanele ligcine ilekhodi lazo zonke izincomo eziqondiswe kubaqashi nayo yonke imibiko eqondiswe kumhloli. Amalunga ekomidi kumele enze neminye imisebenzi edingekayo ngaphansi komthetho. Akavunyelwe umqashi ukudonsa imali eholweni lesisebenzi ngesizathu esihlangene nokuqhuba impokophelelo yokuhlangabezana nalomthetho. Uma udokotela ehlola noma elapha umuntu osolwa sengathi uthole isifo ngenxa yomsebenzi, udokotela noma lowo owelaphayo kumele abike udaba kumqashi nakuMhloli omkhulu. Ukuhambisana nemilayelo, umlayelo wokuvela phambi kwenkantolo nezicelo. Abaqashi nabasebenzi kumele bahloniphe imilayelo, imilayelo yenkantolo, izicelo noma impoqo yabahloli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, akekho ovunyelwe ukuvimbela noma wubani ukuhambisana nalokhu. Imibuzo kamhloli kumele iphendulwe kodwa akekho ophoqwe ukuthi angaphendula ngendlela eyombophisa. Ukuphendula ngendlela yokuzibophisa ngechaza ukwemukela ukwephula umthetho noma ukuqondana ngqo nesimo sokwephula umthetho. Uma ebona kudingekile, umhloli angafuna usizo nokwesekwa okufanele ukuze aqalise uphenyo. Umhloli angabuye acele ukuthi kwethanyelwe lolophenyo.

Umculo wakhe uhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene, kusukela kumculo wezizukulwane zasemzini kuze kufike emculweni wezothando. Ungomunye wabaculi abahamba phambili beHouse Music eNingizimu Afrika, futhi uthanda ukusebenzisa izinsiza ze-melody nezithombe eziphilayo ukuze akhe imvamisa abazwanayo. Ukwazisa Umphakathi UBlack Coffee akagcini nje ngemculo, kodwa ube nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi. Uxhasa izinhlelo zezemidlalo, izikhungo zempilo, kanye nezifundo zabantwana emiphakathini ehluphekayo. Uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo, edlala indima yokwakha ikusasa elihle. UBlack Coffee futhi ubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, ezigqugquzela ukuhlonipha nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imifino Nezinhlelo Zesikhathi Esizayo Njengoba uBlack Coffee eqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe, ubufakazi bempumelelo yakhe buboniswa ngama-albhamu akhe amasha. Umculo wakhe ungumthombo wokuthokozisa, umqondo, kanye nezifundo kubantu abahlangabezana nezinselelo ezahlukene. UBlack Coffee udinga ukudlalwa ezindaweni ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, lapho athola khona ithuba lokwabelana ngempilo nekusasa elithokozisayo. Isiphetho UBlack Coffee uyisibonelo somsebenzi obalulekile emculweni wethu. Ufinyelele impumelelo enkulu, futhi ukuhamba phambili kwemicabango yakhe kukhombisa amandla omculo. Njengoba eqhubeka nokwakha umbono omkhulu, siphinde simfisele inhlanhla. UBlack Coffee uyasikhumbuza ngothando lwezwi, umculo, kanye nezifiso zethu, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono.

Uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi ukufunda kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuhamba phambili, nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. UMzimkhulu waba yindawo lapho abantu behlanganyela khona, bejabulela ukufunda, futhi bephila impilo enempilo.
