Ukuchazwa kwethenda yinkampani ehlela imicimbi kwahlangiswa kwaphinde kwashicilelwa. Uxhaso lwezimali okuhloswe ngalo ukulungisa okungenzeki ngendlela okwadalwa yizinqubomgomo zakuqala ezazibekwe wuhulumeni, okufaka nokuhlela uxhaso lwezimali okubhekelwe ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni owedlule. UMnyango wamaPhoyisa akwaMasipala asebe nempumelelo enkulu emacaleni ezehlakalo zokugqekeza nokuntshontsha izimoto okubhekise kubashayeli besifazane edolobheni.

Lezi zindlu zakhiwe ngababambiqhaza abaqashwe nguhulumeni wesifunda noma ohulumeni bendawo kulezi ziqembu ezivumelekile. Esifundazweni saseLimpopo, ukwesekwa okungama-5 okuqhubekayo kuvela kuhlelo lokweseka izindlu zendawo, kuhlukanisa abanikazi bezimali be-Angishana, okuhambisana nemali yokonga yomndeni obolekayo. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abafuna ukwakha izindlu zabo. Le nhlelo ihluke kulena ehambisana nezinye izinhlelo lapho abaqashi bakha izindlu zabantu abaningi, kuyilapho le nhlelo yabantu ivumela abantu ukuba bakhe noma balungise futhi bakhe izindlu zabo. Abantu banikezwa amathuba okwakha izindlu zabo, bese besizwa inhlangano esekelayo, ngokukhokha le nhlangano esekelayo ngokusekelwa. Uhulumeni uveze ukuthi umamukeli kumele akhokhe ukuze afinyelele kuhlelo lokwesekwa. Inhloso yale nto iwukuthi umamukeli naye abe nengxenye ekuxazululeni inkinga yezidingo zezindlu, ukukhuthaza isiko lokonga, nokuthi umamukeli akwazi ukuqonda le nsizakalo evumelekile kusukela ngomhlaka-1 kuMbasa 2002, abamukeli kulindeleke ukuthi babe nengxenye futhi. Abadala, abakhubazekile, kanye nalabo abanesimo sempilo esingesihle kodwa abahola ngaphansi kuka-R3,500 ngenyanga. Lokhu kusekela kuhlelwe kulabo abanamalungelo endawo abawasebenzisayo kodwa bengawatholi. Le ndawo ayikathathi hlangothi ngaphansi kokulawula kukahulumeni ngaphansi komthetho wezihlonipho. Lokhu kusekela kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngezinye zezinhlelo lapho kukhona abaxhasi noma izinhlangano ezisizayo. Umamukeli unenketho yokukhetha ukuthi ukwesekwa kuzokwenza kube nezithakazelo.

UMnyango Wezokulima waleyo ndawo usize abalimi ukutshalela iSAB ummbila obomvu. Ukuphumelela kwakhe ekulimeni kusuka ekwakheni kwasu alungileyo nangokusebenza ngokukhuthala. Kuyini okungaba usongelo oluzovimba ukuthuthuka nokuphumelela kwakhe? Ubona ukuthi nkinga enkulu evimba ukuthuthuka kwakhe ngukuthola imali ekwanele yokuphatha umvuno wakhe kahle uze ufike emakethe. Izindleko zabasebenzi zimhlupha kakhulu futhi. Yiziphi izinto ekulimeni kwakhe efuna ukuzenza zibengcono zithuthuke? UVictor uzothanda ukuthuthukisa ukufuya kwakhe kwezinkomo nezimbuzi ngoba ubona ukuthi kuzosekela ukutshala kwakhe. Amasu akhe okuphumelela lo nyaka ngukulima ngezinto ezinhlobonhlobo, ukuhlukanisa; ngokwamanje unenkontilaki kuNestle ukutshala ummbila, ubhontshisi owomile, amaveji ishikoli (chickory).

Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: Q&A Umbuzo: Yini imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi? Imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibandakanya izenzakalo ezihlosiwe ukwandisa ulwazi, ukuqwashisa, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Lezi zenzakalo zingaba yizinkundla zokuxhumana, imihlangano, noma imicimbi yokwenziwa kwesimo esithile, ezinjengokugqugquzela impilo engcono noma ukuphucula izinga lempilo emphakathini. Umbuzo: Kungani imicimbi yezempilo ibalulekile? Imicimbi yezempilo ibaluleke kakhulu ngoba ikhulisa ulwazi nokwaziswa kwabantu ngezinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo, njengezifo ezithathelwana, izindlela zokuphila ezinhle, nezinsiza ezitholakala ezindaweni zabo. Futhi, imicimbi enjalo inika abantu ithuba lokuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokuxhumana nabanye, okwakha umphakathi onempilo. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izibonelo zemicimbi yezempilo? Izibonelo zemicimbi yezempilo zifaka phakathi ama-workshops wempilo, izinsuku zempilo, imihlangano yokukhuluma ngezikhalazo ezithinta impilo, kanye nemikhankaso yokugoma. Ngokwesibonelo, izinsuku zempilo zingahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-screening nezinsiza zempilo mahhala, kanti imikhankaso yokugoma ingagqugquzela abantu ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zibhukha izigulane zazo. Umbuzo: Abantu bangayithola kanjani imicimbi yezempilo? Imicimbi yezempilo ivamise ukukhushulwa emiphakathini ngezindlela ezahlukene, njengezikhangiso ezisemaphandleni, izikhangiso eziphepheni, nakuma-social media.

Isikhulu esiphoqelela ukugcinwa komthetho siyothula impendulo ebhaliwe kuKhomishani zingakapheli izinsuku eziyishumi nane ngemuva kokuthola umfanekiso wesikhalo okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 12. Ukhomishani uyohlulela udaba bese ekhipha isinqumo sokugcina ngesikhalo ngefomu enqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-OFF&PEN, nalapho Isinqumo Sokugcina singaxuba khona Isaziso sokuhoxisa Inhlawulo noma Isaziso sokungaqhubeki nodaba, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Uma uKhomishani ehoxisa Isaziso seNhlawulo ngemuva kokuba umsolwa ekhokhe imali yenhlawulo, uKhomishani uyophindisela emuva leyo nhlawulo ekhokhwe ngokulandela umthethonkambiso 9. c okunciphisa noma imaphi amandla anikwe uKhomishani noma ikuphi kule Mithethonkambiso. b nokuthi inhlawulo ayikhokhwanga ngokusho kweSaziso seNhlawulo, Isinqumo Sokugcina noma Isinqumo esingujuqu esikhishiwe; futhi c nokuthi kwengezwe noma kwelulwe isikhathi sokukhokha inhlawulo echazwe yiSaziso seNhlawulo, Isinqumo Sokugcina noma Esingujuqu siluliwe kanjalo nenhlawulo ayikhokhiwe ngesikhathi , d nobufakazi obusobala bamaqiniso achazwe ngenhla. Odabeni oluqhubekayo oluqondene nomuntu noma nenhlangano maqondana nodaba oluchazwe kwiSaziso seNhlawulo, Isitifiketi sokuHoxisa ngefomu efanele enqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-OFF&PEN, esayinwe nguKhomishani lapho ichaza khona ukuthi isaziso sahoxiswa ngosuku oluchazwe esitifiketini, ngubufakazi obusobala balakho. Isitifiketi esizishaya sengathi sisayinwe nguKhomishani ngubufakazi obusobala bokuthi ngempela sisayinwe nguye.

Ukuhlola kweBhodi kubuye kubheke ukufaneleka kwezimo zokubhekisela kumaKomidi futhi izinguquko ezincane zadingeka. Abaphathi basebenza kumaKomidi ngo-2009 njengoba kubikwe ezicini 7 no-8 zeMibiko yeBhodi. IBhodi yamukela ekuhlolweni kokusebenza kweBhodi yonyaka ukuthi amaKomidi asebenza kahle nokuthi ukubika kwiBhodi kuhle kakhulu. Amalungu eKomidi ezimele babambe iqhaza ekuhloleni kweMihlangano, amaKomidi e-Ex Gratia kanye ne-Emergency aqashwe yiBhodi ukuze asebenze ehhovisi isikhathi esingamashumi amathathu eminyaka futhi isikhathi samalungu siphela ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa. IBhodi iphinde yaqasha wonke la malungu eKomidi ngasikhathi sinye futhi isikhathi sokusebenza siphela ngo-2012. Ukuhlolwa kokuphatha okuhle okuwenziwe yiMihlangano kwathuthukiswa ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa nokwethulwa kwenqubo yokuhlola abaphathi, amalungu eKomidi ezimele, nabasebenzi. Inqubo yokuhlola iyingxenye ye-framework yokuphatha okuhle kweMihlangano ethinta izakhiwo zokuphatha nezenhlalakahle, Ukuphathwa Kokuhola Abasebenzi, Ukuphathwa Kwabaphakeli, Uhlelo lwezokuphepha kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ubugebengu. Ukuhlolwa Kokusebenza Konyaka kweBhodi yeMihlangano kwenziwa kusukela kuSepthemba kuya ku-Okthoba 2009. IBhodi yathola ukuhlola kokuzihlola okuqhutshwa yinkampani ezimele ehlole izincwadi nezokusebenza zeBhodi kanye namaKomidi atholakele ukuthi kulungile. Ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibhalwe phansi ze-GEMS, isikhathi sokusebenza samaphesenti angama-50 abaphathi abakhonza kwiBhodi Yabaphathi yamanje sizophela ngoJulayi 2010. IBhodi entsha izokwakhiwa ukuze iqale ukusebenza ngoJulayi 21, 2010.

a Ngaphambi kokuqasha amalunga eBhodi, u MEC kumele akhiphe isaziso ngenhloso yokuqasha, futhi ameme izicelo zomsebenzi wobulunga, okungenani kanye kwiphephandaba lesi Fundazwe, ngolwimi lwesingisi nangolwimi okungenani olulodwa olusemthethweni olusetshenziswa kakhulu kwisi Fundazwe. b Ngaphambi kokuqasha noma yiliphi ilunga, u MEC kumele akhiphe isaziso, ngendlela efanayo, amagama abantu acabanga ukubaqashela iBhodi, bese emema izimvo nokumelana ngalokhu. c engowawa futhi engakavuki kwezamabhizinisi; noma d ake atholwa enecala elinokungathembeki noma esake wasuswa ehhovisi ngenxa yokungaziphathi kahle. Uma kucatshangelwa ukuqashwa kwanoma ngubani njengelunga le Bhodi, lowomuntu kumele abhalele u MEC, ambikele nanganoma iyiphi inzuzo angaba nayo kunoma iyiphi imboni yezokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi, ukwehluleka ukwenza lokhu kuyicala. Umphathisihlalo we Bhodi kumele aqashwe isikhathi esingevile eminyakeni emithathu, amanye amalunga eBhodi isikhathi esingevile kwiminyaka emibili, futhi, ngokulandela lo Mthetho, aphathe ihhovisi ngokomgomo wokuhola futhi uma u MEC engabeka lapho beqashwa. Uma kuzoba noma kukhona isikhala somsebenzi ehhovisi lomphathisihlalo we Bhodi noma ilunga le Bhodi, u MEC kumele athathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukugcwalisa lezozikhala ngokuqasha, ngokuya ngokwalesisigaba, umuntu ofanelekile ongeke ehliswe esikhundleni ngalendlela ebalwe kusigaba 5. Umuntu osephelelwe yisikhathi sokuba yilunga le Bhodi uvumelekile ukuthi aqashwe kabusha.

Lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa amandla amakhulu okwenza imisebenzi ethile, njengezincwadi, izifundo, nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Ababukeli babonisa intshisekelo enkulu, futhi kwaba nezikhathi zokuxoxa lapho abantu bebuza imibuzo ethokozisayo. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezinye izinkampani ezinkulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, okuhlanganisa iGoogle neMicrosoft, ezazikhuluma ngezindlela zokubambisana neOpenAI. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, futhi izinkampani zifuna ukuhamba phambili ngokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezifundo ezithokozisayo ezazihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezindlela zokusebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa emikhakheni ehlukene, njengezokwelapha, ezemfundo, nezokuthengisa. Abafundi baphinde bathola ithuba lokubona izibonelo eziphilayo zokuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bungasiza kanjani ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abesifazane abaphumelelayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokukhuthaza abesifazane ukuba baphumelele emikhakheni ethokozisayo, futhi kwavusa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi abantu baphuma bejabule, bejabulisa izinhlelo ezintsha ezitholakele. IOpenAI ibonakale iyinkampani ezimisele ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo, futhi abantu bahlala bejabule ngalezi zinhlelo ezintsha ezithuthukisa impilo yabo.

Imidlalo Yesikole: Ukuqala, Uhlelo, Nezinga Lemfundo Imidlalo yesikole ibalulekile empilweni yamanje, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni nasebusheni. Le midlalwano ayikhulisi kuphela amandla omzimba, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekuqeqesheni ubuntu nemisebenzi yokubambisana. Isifundo somzimba, esiphakathi kwemfundo yansuku zonke, sifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, kubalwa imidlalo ethokozisayo efana nebhola, ibhola lezinyawo, nezinye eziningi. Kulezi zinsuku, imidlalo yesikole ibalulekile ekwenzeni izingane zibe nekhono, uzwelo, nesimilo esihle. Isingeniso Emidlalweni Yesikole Ukwazi ukuthi imidlalo yesikole ibaluleke kangakanani, kufanele siqale sihlole izinzuzo ezitholakala kulokhu. Izinzuzo zomzimba zingabhekwa njengenye yezinzuzo eziyinhloko imidlalo yesikole. Izifundo zomzimba zingasiza ekwakheni amandla, ukujikeleza, nempilo yenhliziyo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umoya wokuncintisana ubalulekile ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Lapha, abantwana bayakwazi ukufunda ukuthi ukuphumelela kuncike ekusebenzisaneni, ukuzinikela, kanye neqiniso lokuthi akupheli yonke imidlalo. Imiphumela Emihle Yomqondo Nongqondongqondo Ngaphandle kokuba nomthelela omuhle emzimbeni, imidlalo yesikole nayo ibalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Izingane zithola ithuba lokufunda ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo, nokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu empilweni yazo yesikole, ngoba kubasiza ukuthi bafunde ukulawula ukucindezeleka, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi semiphakathi ethina. Ukuze uthole okuningi, imidlalo ibavumela ukuthi bazitholele izindlela ezintsha zokuqhamuka nezixazululo, okwakha ukucabanga okuthuthukile. Ubuciko Bokubambisana Nempumelelo Imidlalo yesikole ifundisa abantwana ukuthi basebenze ndawonye.

c i Uma isaziso sokuphikisa singakhishwanga noma impendulo efungelwe ngokulandisa kwendima aii ingafakwanga ngesikhathi esichazwe endimeni aii, Unobhala angedlulisa isicelo kuMphathimaJaji zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Uma impendulo efungelwe yethuliwe, Unobhala uyothula isicelo phambi koMphathimaJaji zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu kutholwe impendulo efungelwe noma uma ingekho impendulo efungelwe zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esinqunywe endimeni b. d Uma ekhipha imiyalelo ngaphansi komtheshwana- 4, UmphathimaJaji angavumela eminye imibiko efungelwe. Uma isicelo sethulwa phambi koMphathimaJaji ngaphansi komtheshwana- 3c, uyokhipha umyalelo wendlela okufanele isicelo sidingidwe ngayo, ikakhulu incazelo yokuthi udaba luyolalelwa noma iyodingidwa ngokwempikiswano ebhaliwe noma kuyobhekwa isifingqo sayo ngokuthathela elwazini oluqukethwe yimimbiko efungelwe. Ezimweni eziphuthumayo, UmphathimaJaji engachezukanga kancane emaphepheni nasendleleni yokusebenza ehlinzekwe kule mithetho, akhiphe nemiyalelo yodaba okufanele idingidwe ngesikhathi esithile nangendlela ehambisana naleyo nqubo eyohambisana ngokuyikho nale mithetho. Ngesaziso sokuthatha isinyathelo, isicelo esenziwe ngaphansi komtheshwana- 1 kufanele siphelezelwe wumbiko ofungelwe ochaza ngokucacile isimo esivuna ukuchezuka kwinqubo evamile. Impikiswano ebhaliwe iyothulwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Iyoqukatha ithebula lokuqukethwe nethebula lemikhandlu ethintekayo lapho iyochazwa khona ukuthi itholakala kumaphi amakhasi embhalweni lapho icashunwe khona.

Ukuthethelelwa okwenziwe yiqembu akusho ukuthi seliyawahoxisa amalungelo alo ngaphansi kwale SIVUMELWANO, ngakho-ke, lelo qembu angeke libe nesivimbezelo sokusebenzisa amalungelo alo ngenxa yokuthi esikhathini esidlule kade lixolelile noma ngoba kukhona okuqhamukayo. AMAQEMBU akule SIVUMELWANO ayavumelana ukuthi azokwenganyelwa amandla eNkantolo Enkulu yesiFundazwe saseTransvaal, yeNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika (noma iNkantolo Ephakeme leyo okungathi ukuhamba kwesikhathi kube yiyo esinamandla engamele iNkantolo yesifunda ePitoli), maqondana nanoma yisiphi isinyathelo noma ukubophana okungaqhamuka kule SIVUMELWANO. Inqobo nje uma le likheli elingenhla lingashintshwa ngokubhalwe phansi linikezwe leli elinye iqembu, bese liqala ukusebenza emva kwezinsuku eziyishumi sinikeziwe isaziso: Inqobo nje uma ikheli elisha elikhethiwe yiqembu lizobe nalo lingaphansi kwendawo lapho kunokuhanjiswa khona amaphepha. Noma yisiphi isaziso esinikeziwe maqondana nale SIVUMELWANO singahanjiswa ngesandla, noma sithunyelwe ngeposi elikhokhelwe: Inqobo nje uma noma yisiphi isaziso nomaamaphepha ahanjiswe kwiqembu maqondana nanoma yiluphi udaba noma isihloko kule SIVUMELWANO nanoma yisiphi isaziso siyothathwa njengesidlulisiwe uma sinikezwe umuntu omdala ekhelini lomthetho elikhethwe yinoma yiliphi lamaqembu futhi angeke kube nesidingo sokunikeza iqembu ngqo. ngosuku lwesikhombisa kusukela osukwini lokuyiposa, okubala usuku lokuyiposa, uma iposwe ngokurejistiwe; futhi ngosuku ethunyelwe ngalo uma ithunyelwe ngefeksi.

Lucky Mkhize wabona ukuthi iMnyango Wezemfundo kungenzeka udinge uxhaso olungeziwe. Ngiyethemba impendulo ekhombisa ukuthi izabelo zalezi zMnyango ezimbili zikhuphukile izobajabulisa. Siphinde sithole abantu ezindaweni ezahlukene bekhalaza ngokungatholi usizo ngesikhathi soktraining nangaleso sikhathi beqinisekisa izinhlelo zabo zebhizinisi. Wezindawo zonke esivakashele, sathola izinkinga ezifanayo. Lokhu kubonakala nakwamanye amapulazi aleli zwe. Impendulo yami ithi SITHOLILE! Ukubekwa kwezimali kwabantu ngo-2006/07 lapha esifundazweni nasemhlabeni jikelele kubeka izindlela ezicacile ezihlinzeka ngempendulo kulezi zicelo zomphakathi. Ngonyaka ka-2007, akekho ozosisebenzisa amabhakede njengama-toilets. Lesi sifundazwe asizukuhluleka ekufezeni lezi zinhloso zokuthuthukiswa. Yingakho kule bhajethi yalo nyaka kukhona izimali ezengeziwe kuzo zonke izinketho, ikakhulukazi kugcizelelwa uxhaso lwezokwakha. Lokhu kubekwa kwezimali kuzokhombisa izimali ezibekwe eceleni zephrojekthi ezithathwe njengezibalulekile nguMongameli ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezifundazwe ngesonto eledlule. Uma impilo yethu ibiyinhle, sizokwenza siphezu kwani ngoba unyaka udlule? Sethule uhlelo lokuguqula umnotho walesi sifundazwe ngonyaka owedlule ngenkathi sithumela ukwakhiwa kwezimali kuka-2005/06. Njengoba singena esikhathini esisha seminyaka emithathu yokwabiwa kwezimali, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngombiko wokuthi senze kanjani kulezi zabelo ezivela ngonyaka owedlule. Sibe nemiphumela emihle kakhulu ngonyaka owedlule emizamweni yokukhulisa umnotho nokwandisa utshalomali.

Laba ngabantu bomphakathi abaqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Bakhonza njengoxhumana phakathi kwesibhedlela nomphakathi. Banikeza izeluleko kubaphathi besibhedlela ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi kanye nezidingo ezingasiza umphakathi njengoba behlela isibhedlela. Baphakamisa ulwazi mayelana nesibhedlela, besebenzisa izakhiwo zomphakathi, futhi besebenzisa ulwazi abaluqoqayo kubaphathi besibhedlela; njengoba ibhodi iyisakhiwo esisemthethweni esixhumana nabaphathi besibhedlela. Uma umphakathi udinga ukucaciselwa ngezindaba ezithile ezithinta isibhedlela, lesi yisakhiwo esiqondile esizokwenza izincazelo njengoba sithola iningi lolwazi lwethu emihlanganweni eyenziwa njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu nabaphathi besibhedlela... Baphinde bahlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo ngaphansi kwemigomo yombuso nezifundazwe, bephakamisa ukubambisana kwezempilo nomphakathi. Qeqesha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi. Thuthukisa, uthuthukise izinga lethu, futhi uhlaziye njalo. Qinisekisa indawo ephephile kubo bonke. Igumbi lokuhlola nokweluleka kulabo abahamba ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV. Igumbi labanye amadoda. Igumbi lokugcina igazi. Omunye wemigomo nezinhlelo zomnyango wezempilo ukubring izinsizakalo zezempilo zibe seduze nomphakathi. Lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi uhulumeni uqeqeshe odokotela abahlinzeka ezikhungweni, ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga zezempilo ezilethwa abantu ezikhungweni; ikakhulukazi njengoba inqubo yamanje ibalula ukuthi umuntu kufanele aqale aye ezikhungweni ngaphambi kokuthi aye esibhedlela. Umdokotela osezikhungweni ngu-oyokhombisa umuntu esibhedlela uma ebona ukuthi udinga usizo oluphuthumayo.

"Ngabe lokhu kusho ukuthi ngizodinga ukudala izinhlelo ezithile zokuhlanganisa lezi zinkokhelo?" wabuza. U-Nkk. Mpofu wamkhumbuza ukuthi yebo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakwazi ukujabulisa izinhlelo zabo zezempilo. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana, uMnu. Dlamini wathola ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo kwakubalulekile, hhayi kuphela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imishwalense yokunakekelwa kwezempilo iyahamba kahle, kodwa futhi ukuze kube nokuxhumana okucacile phakathi kwabantu abahlinzekayo kanye nabathengi. Lokhu kwavula umqondo omusha kumphakathi, futhi uMnu. Dlamini wazizwa ethokozile ngokwazi ukuthi akahlanganyela kuphela ekwenzeni kahle kodwa futhi uthola umqondo wobumbano. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlanganiswa kweminikelo. Waqala ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakhe bazi kahle ukuthi iminikelo yabo iyahlanganiswa kanjani. Wabavumela ukuthi babuze imibuzo futhi banikeze imibono, okwakwenza kube lula ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komqashi nomsebenzi. Ngemuva kokwengeza izinhlelo ezihlukile, uMnu. Dlamini wanquma ukuba nezinye izifundo ezithile. Lezi zifundo zazihlanganisa indlela yokuphatha izimali, izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, kanye nokuthi kanjani izimali ezithile zingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bekwazi kakhulu futhi baguquka baziqhenya ngeminikelo yabo. Ukwengeza, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano nabanye abaqashi emzaneni. Waqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umphakathi uqonda kahle izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, futhi waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi.

Abafana sebegqokile bedamane begxumagxuma sebelindele unondweba ukuba ababize. Sekusele imizuzu eyishumi umdlalo uqale bangena unondweba nabasizi bakhe. Kwazwakala ngempempe isikhala asazi noma wayeyizwa noma wayebiza abadlali. "Hawu, nasiza nafika bantabami," usho unephika sengathi nguyena obesubatha umama Jali. "Uphi uMlobane? "Usuqalile-ke ngale politiki yakho," yimi lowo. "Uyabona, Mnguni, sicuphe okokugcina namhlanje. Amasela sizowagojelanobuqili bawo, ngibafung' abangasekho." Okwenzeke endabeni kunamthelela muni esiphethweni sendaba? "Kahleni kancane. Asikwazi ukuhamba sinje phela,"kwakhala uMalibongwe. "Asiqale siyoshintsha emakhaya." Akakutholi ukuphumula ngale ncwadi ebhalwe nguyise, uSithole. Asule izandla ngephinifa. Asondele ekhabetheni. Aphenye indwangu okubekwe kuyo isitsha. Isitsha esifake imbali yokuzenzela. Abuye nayo. Ayivule futhi. Useyifunda okwesithathu kusile. Ilokhu isamumethe okubhaliwe njengoba kunjalo. "Mnu. Benade,"kusho uWest eseqala ukuzibeka obala izimpawu zokunengwa,"Uthe usuka eKapa. UKwaZulu lapho ukhona njengamanje. Ngibuza ukuthi ubungaxolisi ngani kuzo zonke lezi zikole ozeqile wazoba yinkinga lapha? Ukuthukuthela ugane unwabu. Ukudinwa kakhulu. Imisho kumele ibhalwe iphelele. Imisho kumele ixube. Kungabakhona imisho eqondile, embaxa kanye nemagatshagatsha.

Uma lelisu kungelikazwelonke, kufanele ke ukuthi wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza, uhulumeni, abasebenzi, umphakathi, izinhlangano, nazo zonke ezinye izinhlaka ezimelekile kulelisu. Kanjalo nezinhloso kufanele ukuba zamukeleke nxazonke. Akwanele ukuthi abantu bazi ngazo nje kuphela. Kufanele bambandakanyeke futhi bazinikele ngokuhlanganyela ekuboneni ukuthi lezonhloso ziyagcwaliseka. Lokhu kuzophumelela uma laba abaqondene nokufundisa nokuqeqesha bebambisana noMnyango wonkana wezabaSebenzi, kuzwelonke nakuzifundazwe futhi basebenzele izinhloso ezifanayo. Impumelelo yabo izikubonakala ngokufezeka kwezinjongo. Intuthuko nenqubekela phambili ekufinyeleleni la ekuphokophelelwe khona izokuqashwa uMnyango wezabaSebenzi ubambisene noMkhandlu wokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono. Engqungqutheleni elandelayo ebanjwa minyaka yonke yamaKhono, kuzokwethulwa umbiko ngebanga eselihanjiwe ekufinyeleleni kwizinjongo ukuze wonke umuntu azi ukuthi izwe selithuthuke kangakanani. Isihloko somqulu weSu esithi - AmaKhono anembuyiselo kuzo zonke izakhamuzi - sichaza iphupho esinalo ngekusasa. amakhono: kufanele ukuba kwesekelwe kuxhaswe ngezimali nangezinye izindlela ukutholakala kwamakhono adingwa abasebenzi nomphakathi, okuzoyo ngokuya lawo makhono aveze izinga okufanele kufinyelelwe kulo oHlakeni lukaZwelonke lwamaKhono. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kumayelana nokukhuphula amandla nolwazi lomuntu ngamunye ngokumnikeza aamkhono athize nobungcweti obuthize obuyisidingo. Akusikhona ukunikeza abhluphekele imisebenzi into abazoyenza okwesikhashana kumbe ukunika laba abangabaqeqeshi imisebenzi ngoba benalezo zinhlelo.

Ngamagama ezinto ezisemhlabeni okungezemvelo, ezenziwe noma eziguqulwe ngabantu kanti zingaba nabahlali noma zingabi nalutho. ISAGNC yamiselwa nguMthetho wamaGama eMimo yeZwe waseNingizimu Afrika (unombolo 111 ka-1998) njengohlaka olubhekele ukumiselwa kabusha kwamagama emimo eNingizimu Afrika. Lumiselwe nguNgqongqoshe wezobuCiko namaSiko. ISAGNC ihlanganise ochwepheshe ngamagama ezindawo, izilimi ezisemthethweni, umlando wamasiko, isithunywa esisodwa esivela kuleso naleso sifundazwe, abamele zonke izifundazwe kanye nabamele uPhiko Olukhulu Lwezokuhlonzwa Kwezindawo Nokwedwetshwa, iPosi, iBhodi Yezilimi Zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo. Uhlaka oluphethe lweSAGNC lusebenza ngamaKomiti Ezifundazwe Amagama Emimo Yezwe kanti ezingeni likahulumeni wasekhaya lisebenza ngamaKomiti Endawo Nawezifunda. Kumele engabe uyakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinhlaka endaweni yangakini. Ukukubeka kalula nje, ngamagama emimo yezindawo azo zonke izinto ezweni. Ngamagama abhaliswe ngomthetho. Ngokwesibonelo, igama lezwe, amagama ezifundazwe kanye namagama omasipala bezindawo kanjalo nalezi zinto eziphethwe ngabaphathi bezindawo zasemakhaya njengemigwaqo, izakhiwo zomasipala, izikwele, amapaki namathuna. Bese kuba khona izakhiwo namapulazi okunabanikazi bangasese. Kanjalo futhi namagama ezindawo zemimo asetshenziselwa ukubhalisela ubunikazi bomhlaba naziwa ngamagama eCadastral. Nokho-ke wonke amagama angomthetho kufanele ahambisane nemigomo yokuqamba ye-SAGNC.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isinyathelo sokudlulisa icala ngokwezinhlelo zokusebenza akuphazamisi inqubo yomthetho. Lezi zisho nezindlela ziyizikhombisi kuphela futhi zingashintshwa ngokuya ngezimo ezifanele. Lokhu kusebenza kuyo yonke imiphakathi ephathelene nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, noma okukhuluma ngazo emthethweni noma ezinqubomgomo. Imithetho, imiyalelo, nezindinganiso zokuziphatha. Ukuziphatha okungafanele okungase kudinge ukuthi umphakathi abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala kuboniswa ku-Anexure A. Lezi zinto aziphelele. Umpheki angahola umphakathi mayelana nokuziphatha kwabo, uma nje beqonda, noma kufanele baqonde ukuthi lokho kuziphatha kudinga isinyathelo sokudlulisa icala. a. ukuveza izinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele kunomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini kahulumeni, emnyangweni wezabasebenzi, nasekukhulumeni. Izindlela zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele. Izeluleko zokulungisa ukuziphatha okungafanele. Ezimweni lapho kubalulekile ukusungula ukubaluleka kokuziphatha okungafanele, umphakathi kufanele akwenze lokhu. a. wazisa umphakathi ngokuqondile ngokuqhubeka kwakhe. b. Chaza kumphakathi icala elibhekene naye, bese umnika ithuba lokukhuluma ngaleso cala abhekene naso. d. Thatha isinyathelo sokulungisa esivumelwene ngaso. Isixwayiso somlomo. Uma umphakathi odabukile edinga isixwayiso, isixwayiso singanikezwa ngomlomo. Umphakathi kufanele wazise umphakathi ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokuziphatha kabi, angase abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala, futhi isixwayiso sizobhalwa phansi. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe.

Ukwenza ezakhe izincwadi noma incwadi yezinkondlo yekilasi. Ukuxoxisana nabanye ngombhalo wakhe nowabanye ngenhloso yokuthola noma ukunikeza uvo ngawo. Ukubhekisisa nokulungisa umbhalo wakhe (isib. ukukhipha nokufaka amagama athile ngenhloso yokuchaza, ukuhlela kabusha imisho, ukubhekisisa nokulungisa ubhalomagama nezimpawu zenkulumo). Ukubukeza akubhalile emva kokutholaimibono yabanye. Ukukhombisa abanye umsebenzi awubhalile ngokuwufunda bezwe bonke, noma ngokubabonisa bonke ekilasini. Ukunikeza labo bantu akade ebabhalela ukuba bawufunde umsebenzi wakhe njengomndeni noma abangane isib. Ukuzibhalela izincwadi zakhe nencwadi yasekilasini yezinkondlo namaculo. Umfundi uzokwazi ukubhala izinhlobo zemibhalo ezahlukehlukene eziyiqiniso nezicatshangwayo ngezinhloso ezahlukahlukene. Ukuhlola asebenzise amagama awaziyo. Ukupela amagama ajwayelekile ngendlela efanele. Ukusebenzisa isichazamazwi ukubhekaubhalomagama nezincazelo zamagama. Ukusebenzisa uhlaka lokubhala olukhombisa izinhlobo ezahlukehlukene zemisho neminye imibhalo. Ukuhlola ukusetshenziswa kezinye izimpawu zokukhuluma njengombabazi, nombuzi. Ukusebenzisa izakhiwo zezindaba ezilandisayo (isib. kwesukasukela, cosu, cosu cosu iyaphela). Ukusebenzisa imibhalo ekutholakala kuyo ulwazi olunhlobonhlobo (isib. indlela yokupheka,). Ukuzakhela inqolobane yamagama noma isichazamazwi sakhe. Ukusebenzisa isichaza-magama ukubheka upelomagama nencazelo yamagama. Ukusebenzisa izakhiwo zohlelo ezifanele nemithetho yokubhala eyamukelekile. Ukuqala ukuhlanganisa imisho yakhe izigaba. Ukusebenzisa izimpawu zenkulumo ngendlela efanele (isib. ufeleba, ungqi, umbuzi, ukhe-fana, i-aphostrofi, nombabazi).

kungavunyelwana Ukuthi imihlangano ibe nini. Misa umhlangano wokwakha uhlelo lonyaka. Lokhukungaba umhlangano ophuthumayo noma owekomotiolandelayo. Yaba izikhundla eg. Ezezindlu, ezempilo, ezenhlala kahle, intuthuko yezomnotho nokunye. Ukuthatha amaminithi ayo yonke imihlangano ibizweusihlalo nekomidi lesigceme. Abantu babuyela amaminithi ukubheka ngezinqumoezithathwe emhlanganweni. Nikeza isaziso ngomhlangano. Yazisa ngesikhathinangendawo isikhathi sisekhona. Njengoba sekushiwo, unobhala uyena owenza lokhu. Usihlalo uzovula umhlangano afunde I-ajendangokulandelana kwayo. Babhale bonke abakhona. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokubanerejista noma uhla lwabakhona. Bheka isijobelelo 13uthole isibonakaliso serejista yabakhona. Izincwadi: lezi izincwadi eziya ekomidini noma ilezoezithunyelwe ikomidi. Ileyo naleyincwadi kumele yaziweikomiti ngoba isuke ithunyelwe ngegunya lalo. Ilungu elilodwa kufanele lethule bese liqala ingxoxongephuzu elithile. Lokhu kungaba ukuthula iphuzu besekushiwo ukuthi zinyathelo zini esezithathiwe nokuthi yiniesisilele ukuthi yenziwe. Khumbula ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi wonke amalungu ekomidiakwazi ukuhlanganyela emhlanganweni. Usihlaloangawuqhoqhobali umhlangano. Umsebenzi kasihlalo ukuhola umhlangano nge-ajenda ukuzekutholakale lokhu okumele kwenziwe. Usihlalo ufana nombhidi webhendi hhayi umhlabeleli uhlabelela ngayedwana. Zama ukuthi kungabi uwena okhuluma kakhulu kodwaulalele ukuthi abanye bathini futhi ubheke ukuthi abaphumikwi-ajenda. Bhala phansi amaphuzu abalulekile ngesikhathi sezingxoxo.

Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo (GEMS health facility coordination) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-Green Endeavour for Medical Services, iyisinyathelo esakhiwe ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo ezisemqoka emiphakathini. Isebenza njengomphakathi ohlanganisayo, ihlanganisa izikhungo zezempilo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu basebenzelana kahle nemithombo yezempilo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo kubalulekile? Impendulo: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhweli besiwo sonke izinzuzo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo, ukuthuthwa kolwazi, kanye nokwabelana ngamasu okuheha izinsiza. Umgomo uwukuba abantu bathole imishanguzo kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ngaphandle kokwenza uhambo olude. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinga lezinsizakusebenza, amakhono, kanye noshintsho kumkhankaso wezempilo kuyizinselelo eziphambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele kanye nokwakhiwa komphakathi okukhuthazayo kubalulekile. I-GEMS idinga ukuphendula kulezi zinkinga ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izikhungo zithola ukwesekwa okuyisimanga. Umbuzo 4: Zithini izinzuzo zokuhlanganyela kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zibandakanya ukunciphisa izindleko, ukuhlinza izinsizakalo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, kanye nokwakha umphakathi osekelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kukhulisa ukwakhiwa komthwalo wezithuthi kanye nokuhambela phambili ngokuhlangana kwemininingwane nokwabelana ngolwazi.

Lokhu kunyuka kwentengo kawoyela sekube nomthelela omubi kumanani okudla kanye nokutholakala kwakho. Ukudla esingathi simele sikudle njalo ukuze sihlale siphilile sondlekile (basic staple food such as rice, flour and maize) njenge rice, imikhiqizo eyenziwa ngokolweni kanye nommbila kubiza ngendlela exakile. Kungagcini lapho, ngisho namafutha okupheka noma lokhu esithi ukalakateni namhlanje abiza into enganambithisiseki. Omama abaningi esinabo lana bazongifakazela kulokho engikushoyo njengoba kuyibo abathenga ukudla emakhaya. Namhlanjena imali engangezinkulungwane yamarandi (R1000) isithenga into ezimbalwa kabi uma wenza igrocer noma uthenga ukudla kwasendlini. Kungakho nathi singuMnyango wezoLimo nezeMvelo KwaZulu-Natali sihamba emazwini kaNgqongqoshe uManuel sithi bakwethu isimo ngeke sishintshe kulesi okuyisona njengamanje kepha siya siba simbi kakhulu njengoba sonke sizwile ukuthi intengo kapetrol iyenyuka ngoLwesithathu lolu esiya kulo. Ukunezezela kulokhu kunezinkulumo ezithi iBhange-Ngodla lakuleli lingahle lenyuse izinga lemali eyinzalo ngamaphesenti amabili (2% interest rate increase) uma kuhlangene ikomidi leli elibhekene nenqubo-mgomo wemali ngenyanga ezayo. Lokho kusho into eyodwa okungukuthi abantu abanezindlu abazithengelwe ngamabhangi noma izimoto ezisakhokhelwa bazothwala kanzima kugcine ngokuthi zidliwe zibuyele kuwo amabhange ngenxa yokuthi abantu abasakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo zanyangazonke njengesivumelwano.

Iziphathimandla zokuthutha, izinkaba zamadolobha nomasipala kumele benze isiqiniseko, ngokungangoba kungenzeka, ngezincomo ezifanelekile kwi Bhodi, ukuthi ukukhishwa kwamalayisense okusebenza kwenzeke ngendlela yokuthi abagibeli bemigudu efanele bathole izithuthi, ngokuya ngobukhona bezimali, nokuthi ukunikezela ngezithuthi ezingaphezu kokuba zidingeka kugwenywe,. b sibhalele iBhodi silicele ukuthi lingakhiphi amalayisense amasha okusebenza, futhi lingashintshi amalayisense okusebenza anikeza amandla okusebenza kulowomgudu; futhi c sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ngokugcizelela ukusebenza komthetho noma ngokuhoxisa amlayisense okusebenza ngokwesigaba 51 so Mthetho ka Zwelonke kwisifundwa nalo Mthetho, noma ngendlela ebekiwe ukwehlisa inani lezithuthi lifinyelele kulelo elidingekayo. Ekwenzeni uhlelo lwezesivumelwano, iziphathimandla kumele zibheke imigudu yonke, lokhu kusho ukuthi Zinake izithuthi ezithola uxhasomali nezingalutholi futhi, banikezele ngezivumelwano ezihlanganise ezokuthutha ezinoxhasomali nezingenalo lapho kufaneleke khona. Noma yimiphi imibhalo eqoshiwe yezokuthutha umphakathi elungiswe ngokwesigaba 3 so Mthetho wesikhashana wokuhlela wezithuthi ka Zwelonke, ka 1998 uMthetho 45 ka 1998 iyothathwa njengombhalo oqoshiwe ofuneka ngokukwesigaba 23 so Mthetho ka Zwelonke. Ukwenzela ukulungiselela okwenzekayo okuphuma kwisigatshana 1, U MEC, ngokokuvumelana, angazinika iziphathimandla ezithile noma omasipala imisebenzi ngokumemezela ku Somqulu.

Izifundo Zempilo: Ukubaluleka Kokunakekela Ngaphandle kwemfashini nobuhle, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yethu iyisisekelo. Ukudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokuphumula kahle kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isithombe esihle. Imfashini iyindlela yokukhombisa ubuhle bethu, kodwa impilo yethu ibalulekile kakhulu. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abahlala bephila kahle baveza ubuhle obungokwemvelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo ukuze sikwazi ukuveza ubuhle bethu ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho: Ukubheka Phambili Njengoba sithokozisa imfashini nobuhle, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemvelo, ukuthuthukisa ubuhle bethu, nokukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Imfashini ingaba yindlela yokukhombisa ubuhle, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bokuqala buvela ngaphakathi. Sihlanganyela ukwakha isithombe esihle esihambisana nemvelo, sikhuthaze ubuhle baphakathi. Imfashini nobuhle kuzohlala kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze izindlela ezilungile zokwakha isithombe esihle. Ubufakazi bokuthi imfashini nobuhle kungaba yindlela yokukhombisa ubunikazi bethu, kufanele sithokozise lezi zinto ezinhle empilweni yethu.

Iziphathimandla zePosi kufanele zifake isicelo semvume yokwemukelwa njengesithunywa esinegunya lokuthumela impahla ngokusho koMthethonkambiso 108.06.1. a zihlolwe ukuthi ziyahambisana nezokuphepha bese zivalisiswa kahle, futhi b ziphelezelwe wumbhalo weposi osemthethweni ochaza isibalo sezikhwama ezihlolelwe ukuphepha. Iziphathimandla zePosi kungumthwalo wazo ukuhlola ukuphepha nokuvalisisa izincwadi ngaphambi kokuzithumela endizeni ukuze zithwale ngomoya. b Uma kunokungabaza ngezokuphepha kwezincwadi, Iziphathimandla zePosi ngeke zinikele noma zemukele izincwadi ukuba zithwale ngomoya noma ngendiza. Izithunywa ezilawulwayo noma iziPhathimandla yePosi eziletha impahla nezincwadi eziphuthunyiswayo ukuba zithwale ngezithuthi zomoya ezihwebayo ziyoqinisekisa ukuthi leyo mpahla noma izincwadi eziphuthunyiswayo zihloliwe ngokufanele njengoba kusho nguMqulu SA-CATS- ACS. Impahla nezincwadi ezithwele ngendiza okufanele zidluliselwe kwenye noma kwezinye izindiza akudingeki ukuba zihlolisiswe, iqobo nje uma ilawulwa ngokulandela imithethonkambiso yezokuphepha ngesikhathi isuka endaweni yokuqala futhi ivikelwe kahle emikhubeni engekho emthethweni nalapho ishintsha khona indiza. Impahla ethuthwa ngendiza noma izincwadi ezifika ngendiza, ngesitimela noma ngomkhumbi edlulela phambili engazange ihlolelwe ezokuphepha ngesikhathi isuka noma idluliswa kufanele ithathwe njengempahla engaziwa bese iyahlolwa ukuthi iphephile. a nempahla eshintsha izandla njengoba kusho umthethonkambiso 108.03.

Okuqukethwe yile SIVUMELWANO kuyoba futhi iyona ngqokithi yesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokwesiGaba 13.2 ngenhla. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizoziphelela ngokwaso ekupheleni kwesikhathi esilingene (Bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi). Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela engakapheli amaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi yosuku olulodwa. Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela engakapheli amaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kepha ingakapheli inyanga eyodwa siqalile le SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi yamaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku. Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela eva kwenyanga eyodwa uma kubalwa usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi kwenyanga eyodwa . Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS engakwazi, kwizimo ezithile ezixolelekayo, ukuthi emukele inothisi yesikhathi esifishane. Noma yiliphi iqembu kule SIVUMELWANO lingasinqamula le SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula ingxenye yale SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo uma lelo qembu lokuqala elishiwo lilinikezile leli elinye iqembu inothisi ebhalwe phansi maqondana nalokhu kwephula futhi lokho kwephula kuhlale kungalungisiwe kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela osukwini elithole ngalo inothisi leyo.

Abantu abasha, ikakhulukazi, badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhokha intela ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baphumelele emisebenzini yabo nasemphakathini, futhi kube nethuba lokukhulisa izinga labo lemali. Naphezu kwazo zonke izinkinga ezikhona, umphakathi unokuthile okukhuthazayo. Imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nabantu ibalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana nezokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu baphila kahle zikhuthaza ukufunda nokwaziswa ngezinto ezibhekene nezinga lentela. Ekugcineni, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala linomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhokha intela akukhona nje ukwenziwa kwemali, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ohlanganyela. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kumele uqhubeke uvulelekile ekuxoxeni ngalezi zindaba, futhi usebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela eliphusile nelithuthukayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula nelibumbene eNingizimu Afrika.

Kungukwemukela ukuthi kunesidingo sokuba abantu banikezwe amathuba okuzithuthukisa noma kukusiphi isigaba sempilo yabo, noma ngabe baqashiwe noma ngabe basafesele umsebenzi okuqala. Ngokukhula nokuthuthuka komnotho, kanjalo nesidingo sabantu abanamakhono siya ngokukhula futhi kuzofanele ukuba baqeqeshwe ukubhekana nalesosimo. Ukunikezwa kwabantu amathuba okuqhubeka nemfundo noma kunini kubanikeza ithuba lesibili lokuzithuthukisa abangazange balithola esikhathini esiphambili ngezizathu ezithile. Ukugqugquzela isiko kusho ukujika indlela embi abantu ababuka ngayo impilo nomsebenzi nokukhuthaza abaqashi nabantu ukuba bemukele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono njengento engukubekela nokubhekela ikusasa kunokuba yinto echitha imali. Intela-sabelo esanda kusungulwa yamakhono yenzelwe ukuba ihehe ikhuthaze abaqashi ukuba bathuthukise amakhono ezindaweni zabo. Kanti amasu Amakhono aseMsebenzini asungulelwe ukuthi abaqashi kanye nabasebenzi balubuke njengolumqoka udaba lokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Yize imithetho yentuthuko ibekelwe ukuba isize ukujika imiqondo yabantu, okumqoka nakakhulu kunokuphoqwa umthetho ukuzinikela okujulile emzabalazweni wokuthuthukisa amakhono abantu futhi lokho kube yinhloso kazwelonke.

Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi izinhlinzeko zeMithetho yeMihlangano, iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kunoma yimuphi umhlangano wonyaka kufanele kube ngendlela yokuvota kwenani elikhulu lamalungu abukhoma futhi amelelwe ngu-proxy. UMongameli wazisa umhlangano ukuthi iMihlangano yamukela amafomu okhetho angama-207 asemthethweni avela kumalungu ngosuku lokugcina lukaJuni 19, 2009. Inani eliphelele lama-48 amafomu amelelayo adingeka ukuthi asuswe njengoba aqukethe izinombolo zokubhaliswa ezingalungile noma ezingafundeki noma abamenyiwe ngabantu abangamalungu eMihlangano njengabamele. Umhlangano uqaphele futhi ukuthi amalungu eMihlangano abamenye ezinye amalungu ukuze avote kubo bonke abaphathi nabalungu beQembu Eliphezulu leMihlangano. Abantu abakhethiweyo bakhombisa ngosuku lukaJuni 23, 2009, emhlanganweni weBhodi Yabaphathi ukuthi bafuna ukuvota kanjani kuzo zonke iziphakamiso ezethulwe emhlanganweni. Ngemuva kokwethulwa nokuxoxwa ngazo zonke iziphakamiso eziphakanyisiwe, uMongameli wazisa amalungu ukuthi abamele abathunywe bavote kanjani futhi wabe esethula iziphakamiso zokwamukelwa. UMongameli wethula imizuzu yokwamukelwa. Imizuzu yeMihlangano Yesibili Yonyaka yamukelwa ngemuva kokuthi uMnu. Manganyi Abraham uphakamise ukuthi umhlangano wamukele imizuzu, futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. Nxumalo Themba. UMongameli wemihlangano wethula izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2008, zokwamukelwa futhi wazisa umhlangano ukuthi amalungu anikezwa izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe ngaphambi komhlangano.

Uma isaziso noma isicelo esihlonzwe ngaphansi komtheshwana- 2 no- 4 ngokulandelana singethulwanga ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe, udaba lwesiqiniseko sesinqumo sokungahambisani kwesenzo nomthethosisekelo luyophethwa ngokulandela imiyalelo ekhishwe wuMphathimaJaji.

Zonke izingcingo ezingenayo kule ndawo zirekhodwa. Qaphela: Shaya le nombolo kuphela uma kukhona isimo esiphuthumayo. Uma ababamba iqhaza befuna ulwazi olunembile, kufanele babheke ezihlalweni abazithakaselayo. I-Integrated Development Plan iyinqubo lapho amamunicipality alungiselela isu lokuthuthukiswa leminyaka emihlanu. I-IDP iyithuluzi eliyinhloko lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa. I-IDP iyisikhumbuzo sokuqala sokuhlela inqubomgomo futhi ibonisa indlela phambili futhi ihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokuhlela, ukuhlukaniswa kwezabelomali, ukuphathwa, kanye nezinqumo ezithathwa kumakhansela noma kumamunicipality. Yini isimo somthetho se-IDPs? NgokweMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya ka-2000, wonke amamunicipality (lezo zedolobha ezinkulu, amamunicipality endawo, kanye nezifunda) kumele alandele inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ukuze akhe ama-IDPs. Njengoba i-IDP iyimfuneko yomthetho, inegunya lomthetho futhi idlula ezinye izindlela ezihola ukuthuthukiswa ezingeni lohulumeni bendawo. NgokweMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya, wonke amaKhansela amasha kanye nalabo abavula amahhovisi ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala kumele alungiselele i-IDP ezothatha iminyaka emihlanu. Ngakho-ke, i-IDP ixhunywe nesikhathi sokusebenza kwamakhansela. IKhansela elisha lingakhetha ukwamukela i-IDP eyakhelwe yibo abaphuma ezikhundleni uma ibona ifanele noma ingaqala i-IDP entsha kodwa kufanele icabangele imibhalo yezinhlelo ezikhona. iv. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda inqubo? Inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ibandakanya ukubambisana nokuxhumana futhi ifaka izakhiwo eziningi ezibamba iqhaza.

USibongile Victor Michael Mahlinza wazalwa eEstcourt ngo-14 July 1961 futhi wakhulela endaweni yaseNtabamhlophe (White Mountain). Waqala ukuya esikoleni sabancane ngo-1968 eCornfield Primary School. Ngo-1976 waqala ukuya ku-Mtshezi High School waze waqeda ugrayidi 11 ngo-1982. Ngo-1983 wasuka waya eGoli wasebenzela umkontilaki owakhayo waye ngusekrethari. Wasebenza lapho unyaka owodwa. Emva kwalokhu uVictor wasebenzela inkampani eyenza amakhemikeli eGoli, waye ngumphathisitolo. Wahamba lapho ng-1986. Ngokusuka kwa-1987 ukuya ku-1988 uVictor waye ngmshayeli weloli ku-M & L Distributors. Ngesikhathi esisuka ku-1989 esiya ku-1995 wayediliva izimpahla zeAMCA Construction. Ngo-1996 uVictor wafisa ukuba umkhiqizi wabuyela ekhaya. Waqala ukulima walima watshala ngezinkabi. Wathenga ugandaganda ngo-2003. UVictor ushade noLinah, banezingane ezinhlanu: amantombazane abathathu nabafana ababili. UFikile (26) unezingane ezimbili. USizwe (19) uqede grade 12 ePietermaritzburg kuZakhe Agricultural College, uqede futhi isifundo sokutshala amaveji kuBuhle College eDelmas, ngokwamanje usebenza noVictor epulazini labo. Zandile (15) uku-grade 9 kuAbantungwa High School noMpumelelo (11) uku-grade 4 kuMathamo Primary School. UVictor ungejiwe futhi noNorah, banezingane ezintathu: umfana oyedwa namantombazane amabili. UAyanda (24) uqede grade 12 kuMtshezi High School wathola futhi iN3 sithefikethi ngeCivil Engineering kuBerea Technical College eThekwini. UAyanda naye usebenza noyise epulazini.

Ngemuva kwalokho, umnyango wezobulungiswa kumele uphendule kuwe ngokushesha nangokuhlonipha ukuze uhambisane nezidingo zakho. Izimiso ezibekwe zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngokukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo akho agcinwa. Izimiso ezibekwe zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukuhlola ukuthi umsebenzi uhamba kahle ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibekwe uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kanjani. Izikhungo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezizathu, iminyango ethile, izobheka ukusetyenziswa kwamalungelo nokuthi kusebenza kanjani njengoba kuchaziwe ezimisweni ezibekwe, futhi, njengengxenye yokubheka nokubonisana, lezi zinhlangano zingase zixhumane nawe. Omunye wemiphumela yokubheka nokubonisana kungase kukhishwe. Izinhlelo ezitholakala ezimisweni ezibekwe zikhuluma ngazo zonke izisulu ngaphandle kokukhetha, ngaphandle kokwehlukanisa nganoma iyiphi indlela ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ukujula kokuthandana, ukukhulelwa, isimo sokushada, imvelaphi yakho, umbala, ubulili obukhethwe, ubudala, ukungakwazi, umqondo, loyalty, ukholo, isiko, ulimi, nendawo yokuzalwa, njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 9 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (UMTHETHO 108 ka-1996). Uma umuntu ebanjwa, icala lidluliselwa enkantolo lapho umphakathi uzokwenza imisebenzi yabo yokudlulisa icala. Umphakathi uzohlola ngokucophelela imininingwane yecala. Umphakathi angakwenza okukodwa kwezinto ezintathu: Bangakhetha ukuthi kukhona ubufakazi obanele ukuze baqhubeke nokudlulisa icala. Bangakhetha ukuthi kudingeka olunye ulwazi ukuze benze isinqumo esifanele bese beqondisa umphenyi ukuthi aqhubeke efuna ubufakazi.

Imithetho ethile ingavimbela ukuthola izindawo ezinhle zokuhweba, okwenza bahlale bezama ukuthola izindawo ezizimele, lapho bengahambisani nezidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, futhi abanye baphinde babe sengozini yokuthunjwa noma ukuxhaphazwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bavame ukuba sengozini yokulahlekelwa impilo ngenxa yokusebenza ezindaweni ezingaphephile. Izimo zokuhweba zingaba yingozi, futhi uma kwenzeka izenzakalo ezimbi, abathengisi bangase bahlushwe yizingozi eziningi, okudingeka ukuba kube nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesandla ekutholeni izixazululo ezithile zokuvikela abathengisi basemgwaqeni. Ngokuvamile, banamandla okwenza umphakathi ube ngcono, behlisa izindleko zokuphila futhi bekhuthaza ukusabalalisa ukudla okunesithako esihle. Izitsha zabo zihlala ziqhakambisa amasiko ahlukahlukene, zikhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zifunde ngempilo yasezindaweni. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile kumphakathi wonke. Ekugcineni, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bamele izidingo zabantu. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sithuthukise izisombululo eziphusile nezisebenzayo ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo zokuvikela ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokusebenza. Sidinga ukusiza abathengisi basemgwaqeni ukuba baqhubeke phambili, ngenkathi sikhuthaza amandla abathengisi nezinhlelo ezizovumela ukuba bahlanganyele nemithetho yendawo. Umphakathi, ohulumeni, nabathengisi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe indawo ehlanzekile, ekhuthazayo, nephephile kubo bonke.

Uma umkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe ungazisebenzisi izinyathelo zokuvikela ngokuhambisana nesigaba 2 noma 7 umsebenzi womkhumbi noma induna yomkhumbi yalowo mkhumbi inganikwa umyalo ngaphansi kwesahluko -2. Izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -1 yizinyathelo okufanele zisetshenziswe ngaphansi koMgomo weISPS uma kusebenza ezokuvikela izinga- 1. Izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -2 yizinyathelo okufanele zisetshenziswe ngaphansi koMgomo we ISPS uma kusebenza ezokuvikela izinga -2. Izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -3 yizinyathelo okufanele zisetshenziswe ngaphansi koMgomo we ISPS uma kusebenza ezokuvikela izinga- 3. Uma uMqondisi-Jikelele enika umkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe umyalo wezokuvikela ngaphansi komthethonkambiso- 30, lowo mkhumbi kufanele ugcine lowo myalo. Uma umkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe wehluleka ukulandela lowo myalo , umsebenzi womkhumbi noma induna yomkhumbi yalowo mkhumbi inganikwa umyalo ngaphansi kwesahluko- 2. Ukusebenza komkhumbi olawula kwelinye izwe akufanele kuthikameze noma kuphazamise ukulandelwa kohlelo lwezokuvikela lwasolwandle lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle ngendlela engaxengisa ezokuvikela zalowo obambe iqhaza. Ukusebenza komkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe akufanele kuthikameze noma kuvimbele ukugcinwa kohlelo lwezokuvikela lomkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngendlela engaxengisa ezokuvikela zomkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika.

Lo mbhalo ubeka uhlaka olukwazi ukusetshenziswa lwenhlangano ebumbene yobuliminingi ngaphakathi kwemigomo yomThethosisekelo. Ukusukela ekuhlaleni kokuqala kwamaDashi eNingizimu Afrika ngonyaka we-1652, ngokulandelana kwezikhathi zomthetho wokubusa wamaNgisi(Bhrithishi),iNyunyana yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nombuso wobandlululo nokulandelana neRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, kuze kufinyelele ekuveleni kombuso wentando yeningi ngonyaka we-1994 kanye nokufakwa emThethweni kobuliminingi obusemthethweni, umthethomgomo wolimi kahulumeni kanye namandla eziphathamandla kwehluleka ukubona ukwehluka ngokolimi kweNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela walesi simo kwaba ukungalinganiswa, lapho ukubusa kwesiNgisi nesiBhunu kwakha ukusebenzisana okungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zaboMdabu kanye nalezi zilimi. Ngakho-ke , izinqubomgomo zolimi zamakholoni nezobandlululo, sezihlangene nenqubomgomo yezenhlalakahle, ezomnotho nezombusazwe, zaveza ubukhosi bezilimi, ukungalingani okuveza izakhiwo zokungalingani ngokwebala nangakwezikhundla /amakilasi okwasingatha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke lezi zimo zehlisa izinga eliphezulu lezilimi zomdabu kanye nezinhlobo zezilimi zabantu bomdabu kanye nabezinye izinhlobo zabantu base-Afrika namanye amaqembu ayebandlululwa kufakelelwa nabangeZwa neziMpumputhe - kuphoqelelwa inkolelo embi okungeyona ngezilimi zabamnyama, loku akubangelwa yizikhulumi zolimi lwesiBhunu nolwesiNgisi kuphela, kodwa nayizikhulumi eziningi zolimi lomdabu ngokwazo.

Namuhla, inkinga yokubhaliswa emanyuvesi isaqhubeka, kodwa izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubhaliswa zikhombisa umphumela omuhle. Abafundi baphinde baqhamuka nezindlela zokuxhumana, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi nabaphathi benyuvesi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo, futhi uhulumeni waqala ukubona ubukhulu benkinga yokubhaliswa. Inkinga yokubhaliswa emanyuvesi ibonisa ukuthi imfundo iyinselele enkulu, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubhaliswa zikhombisa umphumela omuhle. Kodwa, kusemqoka ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi banethuba lokufunda, futhi baphumelele ezinhlelweni zabo zemfundo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inkinga yokubhaliswa iyaxazululwa.

Isiphathimandla semvume akumele singenele isivumelwano esixhasiwe ngaphandle kokwamukela ithenda ngokwemigomo ebekwe ngu MEC, ngokuya ngoko Mthetho ka Zwelonke. isigatshana 1 sizosebenza kanjalo kwizivumelwano zokuthutha ezingaxhasiwe, ngaphandle uma uMEC exolela ezokuthutha ezithile noma izinhlobo zevivumelwano kulezizidingongqangi ngokumemezela ku Somqulu. Izivumelwano kumele zinikezwe ngu Mnyango noma yisiphathimandla sezokuthutha esifanelekile ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zezokuthutha, ngokuya ngokwesigaba 39 5 ngoshintsho olufanele. Uma noma yisiphi isivumelwano siphela, zonke izimvume namalaysense okusebenza ngokwendlela izithuthi ebezisetshenziswa ngayo ngaphansi kwesivumelwano ziyophelelwa ngamandla ngosuku lokupheliswa kwesivumelwano futhi zihaniswe kwi Bhodi zingakaphele izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. b iBhodi, ngokucelwa yisiphathimandla sesivumelwano, kumele lihoxise noma yiyiphi imvume noma ilayisense yokusebenza enikeza amandla okusebenza kwimigudu ebandakanyeka kulesisivumelwano, uma ngabe umphathi wesivumelwano enxeshezelwa ngokokuboniswa okukhonjwe kusigaba 514 so Mthetho ka Zwelonke. Asikho isinxephezelo esikhokhwayo uma kukhanselwa ilayisense yokusebenza noma imvume ngaphansi kwendima a yesigatshana 2. Lapho izinhlelo zezokuthutha zibonisa isidingo sokwenezelela izithuthi kumgudu othile, isiphathimandla sezokuthutha singamemela kwi Bhodi izicelo zamalayisense okusebenza okuletha ezokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi angatholwa ngokwesivumelwano kulowomgudu.

Umlando weSoweto Uprising: Ukuhlola Umoya Wokulwa Umcimbi weSoweto Uprising, owenzeka ngomhla ziyi-16 kuNhlangulana ka-1976, ungomunye wemigubho ebalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto baphakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi lwesiBhunu ezikoleni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esiqinile sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo yayihlanganisa abantu bonke, ikakhulukazi intsha. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ubonisa ukuthi abantwana, nakuba bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima, bangaba namandla okwenza umehluko. Abantwana abaningi babebonakala benesibindi sokuphikisa ukungabi nabulungiswa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, noma ubudala bethu buncane, singaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ngiyakhumbula izithombe ezinhle zabantwana abavela ezikoleni, bejabulile, kodwa bazi kahle ukuthi impilo yabo ibhekene nezithiyo ezinzima. Umlando weSoweto Uprising akuwona umcimbi owawenzeka ngosuku olulodwa; ubonisa umoya wokulwa okwakukhona phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Abantwana baphakamisa izwi labo, baphikisa ukungabi nabulungiswa, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlanganisa amandla ukuze ufinyelele izinguquko. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangene, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi uma sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi weSoweto Uprising waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi impi yokulwa nobandlululo ayizange iphele. Ngemuva kokubulawa kwabantu abaningi, umphakathi wawudinga ukuvuka, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba izimo zazingezinhle, abantu bahlala bephila ngempilo yabo.

Umphakathi wezindawo ungumholi wezinkomiti zezakhamuzi, ngakho-ke ungumuntu obalulekile kule komidi. Umphakathi umela izintshisekelo zendawo futhi unegunya elivela kumkhandlu lokudlala indima ekusekeleni umphakathi wezindawo kule ndawo. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwabahlali bendawo ezinqumweni ezithathwa kumkhandlu, njengoba bengabo abakwazi ukuxhumana nekhansela ngqo noma ngokuqondile njengabamele indawo bendawo abaxhasa iqembu lezepolitiki kumele babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezifana nenqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu, isabelomali sonyaka, imisebenzi yephalamende, nezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile nezinhlelo njengoba zonke lezi zinto zithinta umphakathi ukuze ubone futhi uqale imisebenzi eqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu endaweni ngenkathi usekela umphakathi ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokusebenza komkhandlu, nokubhekana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nezinsalela, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka, ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo njengoba amalungu azi imiphakathi yabo nezidingo zayo. Khumbula ukuthi umphakathi wezindawo kumele abheke lokho okulindelwe yindawo yabo kanye nokuthi kulindelwe yinhla yabo yezepolitiki. Lokhu kwenza indima yabo ibaluleke kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda lokhu futhi ucacise indima yomphakathi ukuze ukwazi ukuza nemibono emihle yokukh

Yini ekhuthaza abanikeli ukuba banikele? Ukukhuthaza izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali ukuba zamukele izibopho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakwa okufanele nokugcinwa kwezinga eliphezulu ezinqubweni: ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwethembeka; ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele; ukuhweba ngempumelelo; ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nohulumeni, imiphakathi ethintekile, abanikeli, abaxhasi, kanye nomphakathi; ukuphatha ihhovisi lenhlangano ngokucophelela; nokuziphatha ngokuhlonipha. IPhiko Lezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi lisungule umgomo ohambisana nezidingo zeMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti ka-1997, ngokuxoxisana nezinhlangano eziningi kanye namalungu azo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinqubomgomo ziwumphumela wombono ophumelelayo wokuthi yini ebhekwa njengokusebenza kahle ekuholeni nasekuphathekeni kwezinhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali, kungakhathaliseki usayizi wenhlangano. Ukugxila kugxile kakhulu ezicini ezifana nokusebenza ngokulingana, ukugcina izindaba zokuphatha, ukuhweba, nokucabangela umphakathi othintekile. Kulindeleke ukuthi ngalezi ziqondiso, zonke izinhlangano ezibhaliswe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti zamukele lezi ziqondiso, zisebenzisa ukuze zithuthukise futhi zikhuthaze lesi sikhala lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona izindawo ezintathu ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kulo mthetho wokuziphatha, ezihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwedokhumenti eyodwa. Kucacile ukuthi inhlangano engaphansi kwemali ephumelelayo izuza ezisebenzisaneni phakathi kwabanikeli, abahwebi, kanye nalabo abaphatha izinsiza nezenzo zenhlangano. Umthetho wokuziphatha ubalulekile, kodwa awukhombisi kahle izinga elibekiwe lokuziphatha.

Ebangeni esikulo manje ezinye zalezizinkomba zibheka okwenzekayo okuholela kwimiphumela kunokuba zibheke imiphumela ngokwayo. Isibonelo, enye inkomba ibhekisisa ukuthi izinkampani ezinkulu ziyithatha kangakanani imali ebhekele ukuthi zithuthukise ngayo amakhono. Ngaleyondlela singathi siyabona ukuthi abaqashi bazinikele kangakanani ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono nasekuqeqeshweni kwabasebenzi. Kulula ke ukwenza lokhu ngoba kumbandakanya amanani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi nokho kufanele izinkomba zibhekisise ukuthi leyo mali kwenziweni ngayo, bazuzeni abasebenzi ngokuthathwa kwayo, sebenamaphi amakhono, sebethuthuke kangakanani ngolwazi lomsebenzi emva kokuqeqeshwa. Kuyisiqalo esihle ke nokho ukuhlola lokho okwenzekayo. Okusemqoka ke kulomkhankaso wokuphokophelela ekufinyeleleni ezinjongweni iphuzu lendinganiso yabasebenzi. Ukusimama komphakathi nokuncipha kobubha okubabelwe umphakathi wakithi ngeke sifinyelele kukho ngaphandle kokuba kuxazululwe izinkinga eziphathelene nobandlululo lwayo yonke inhlobo. Kufanele ukuba luphele ubandlululo kuzona zonke izinhlangothi. amaphesenti angu 84 kube abampisholo amaphesenti angu 54kube abesimame amaphesenti angu 4 kube abakhubazekile. Akuthi kufika u March 2005, okungenani amabhizinisi angu 20 kumbandakanya amabhizinisi amancane, aphakathi nendawo, namakhulu ngaphansi kwalolo nalolo hlangothi, neminyango emihlanu kahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke ababe sebezinikele ngokubonakalayo ekuthuthukiseni abantu. umqondo wokufunda okuqhubekayo yiwona mgomo okusetshenzwa ngawo kwaSAQA.

Uhlelo Lobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika: Ingxoxo-mpikiswano Uzinzo lwezombusazwe nokuthula kwabantu bamaZulu, maSotho, amaXhosa, kanye nezinye izizwe eNingizimu Afrika, kudinga ukuxoxwa ngendaba ethile eyayihawukele intshonalanga kwezombusazwe: uhlelo lobandlululo. Le nhlangano ibonakala iyindaba yokuphikisana, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinzuzweni kanye nemiphumela eyayibangelwa yalesi simo esihlukumezayo. Uhlanga lobandlululo lwakha umgwaqo owawuhleleke kahle ezintweni eziningana, kuqala ngenkohlakalo yomqondo wokuhlukaniswa kwabantu. Kukho abakholelwa ukuthi lo mbono wahlomula imiphakathi ethile, ikakhulukazi abantu abamnyama, ngokuhlinzeka ngemfundo, amathuba omsebenzi, kanye nokuhlala emakhaya afanele. Nokho, abanye bakhombisa ukuthi uthathwa njengomgibeli onzima kakhulu njengoba uqinisekiswa empilweni yabo. Uhlelo lobandlululo lwakha izinhlaka zomthetho ezikhethekile ezihambisana nomthetho oyisisekelo. Lezi zinhlelo zenza umphakathi wamaNgisi ukuwina izinzuzo ezithile ezikhokhelwa ngabantu abamnyama. Lokhu kubonakala ngokuthuthuka izigaba ezithile zabantu, nakuba ukuphikisana nemiphumela yeMedimu okuyisifunda esinezinkolelo ezahlukeneyo zibonisa ukungavumelani nokuphila kophuhliso oluphephile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphikisi baphakamisa ukuthi uhlelo lobandlululo lwadala amakha umhlaba, sikhumbuze izifundo ezinzima kakhulu ezitholakala emlandweni. Ukwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili nabanye nasekuzameni ukuthola umqondo womphefumulo wobuntu.

Ukwakha imithombo enomthelela emiphakathini kungasiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Isiphetho Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eqhubekayo eNingizimu Afrika, ethinta bonke futhi ichaphazela impilo yansuku zonke. Ukuze silwe nale nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezinqala, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuqiniswa kwemithetho ukuze sithole uhulumeni onokholo. Ngalendlela, singakha izifunda ezinzima ezisiza bonke abantu, futhi sithuthukise ukuzethemba phakathi kwabantu. Ukuhlola impumelelo yokulwa nenkohlakalo kuzobe kuhlale kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi uzithokozise empilweni yabo.

Ngesikhathi edlula emitholampilo, uNokuthula wathola ukuthi abantu bayeza, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, bephuma bezithokozisa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umsebenzi wabo wawubalulekile. "Siyabamba izimpilo, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," wayephinda njalo. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana, uNokuthula noSipho baqala ukubona izinguquko. Abantu bephila kahle, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawukhula. UMama Zodwa waba yisibonelo sokuthi, nakuba abantu behlupheka, ukuxhumana nokuxhasana kungabavusa. Abahlengikazi bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umphakathi wabo wawunamandla. Ekugcineni, uNokuthula noSipho baqonda ukuthi ukukhathala kwabo akukona okungapheli. "Siyabamba izimpilo, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," baphinda, kodwa manje bazi ukuthi, ngokubambisana, bangakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umoya wokubambisana wawunamandla, futhi umhlaba wawunethemba. Ngakho-ke, abahlengikazi baqhubeka nokusebenza, bephila impilo enothando, bejabulisa abanye, futhi bephila impilo enomoya opholile. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi bazi ukuthi, nakuba bekhathala, umphakathi wabo wawunamandla.

Kulesi simo esinjena, umuthi wogonyo ongarejistiwe ungathengiswa isikhathi esithize kuphela, kuze kufinyelele isikhathi lapho usurejistiwe. ubungakanani igama loMkhiqizo umxubo noma isithako , ezibandakanya ukujula nomkhawulo walezo zithako izwe umuthi obuya kulo abenzi bomuthi inombolo ye-batch yalowo muthi ongeniswayo i-technical data sheet noma ilebuli , enenombolo yobhaliso yenhlangano egunyazisiwe ebhekene naleyo mithi kulelo lizwe obuya kulo, lapho leyo-product erejistwe khona ichweba noma indawo engena kulo ukuthi ngabe leyo-product idingeka nini incazelo yokuthi lo muthi uzosetshenziselwa ukulinga ukuze urejistwe njengesitokwe semithi isimo sobhaliso lwawo kwezinye izindawo imininingwane ye-Trial Protocol , okubandakanya ukuthi ngabe kulindeleke ukuthi uzoqala ngaluphi usuku, isibonelelo esiyisipesheli sokuthi ngabe kuzokwenzekani ngokudla okuvela kuzilwane ezenza ukudla kanye nokuthi abanikazi bomuthi bachaza ngokufanele ngomuthi. Sicela wenze isicelo se-veterinary import permit okungenani amaviki ayisithupha ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokungenisa lokho ohlongoza ukukungenisa. Uma abe-state veterinarian sebevumele isicelo, kuthatha izinsuku ezimbili ukuya kwezintathu zokusebenza ukuthi ihhovisi lezimvume libhekane nesicelo nokunikeza imvume.

Ngaphandle uma kubonakala kunokushayisana noma kungahambisani nokuqukethwe, ubunye buzohlanganisa nobuningi kanti ubulili besilisa buhlanganisa nobesifazane, kanjalo noma kuphendukezelwe. Le SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelelele phakathi KWAMAQEMBU futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esike saba khona phakathi KWAMAQEMBU maqondana nokuqukethwe lapha. AMAQEMBU ayavumelana ngokuthi angeke kushintshwe, kwengezwe, noma kuvunyelwane ngokukhansela noma lutho kwakhiwe kabusha le SIVUMELWANO kukho konke noma iphuzu noma umbandela waso futhi noma kwenzeka angeke kube namphumela ekusebenzeni kwesivumelwan ngaphandle uma kubhalwa phansi futhi omabili amaqembu asayinde noma asayindelwe abawamele. Ukuthethelelwa okwenziwe yiqembu akusho ukuthi seliyawahoxisa amalungelo alo ngaphansi kwale SIVUMELWANO, ngakho-ke, lelo qembu angeke libe nesivimbezelo sokusebenzisa amalungelo alo ngenxa yokuthi esikhathini esidlule kade lixolelile noma ngoba kukhona okuqhamukayo. AMAQEMBU akule SIVUMELWANO ayavumelana ukuthi azokwenganyelwa amandla eNkantolo Enkulu yesiFundazwe saseTransvaal, yeNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika (noma iNkantolo Ephakeme leyo okungathi ukuhamba kwesikhathi kube yiyo esinamandla engamele iNkantolo yesifunda ePitoli), maqondana nanoma yisiphi isinyathelo noma ukubophana okungaqhamuka kule SIVUMELWANO.

Impilo Yengqondo Entsheni: Ukubaluleka Kokuqonda Nokunakekela Impilo yengqondo yentsha iyisihloko esibalulekile esidinga ukugxilwa kukho, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wanamuhla lapho izinselelo zikhula ngokushesha. Njengoba sikhula, sithola izimo eziningi ezithinta imizwa yethu, izinqumo zethu, kanye nezindlela esibona ngazo umhlaba. Ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyisici esibalulekile sokuphila kwethu. Ngokokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibandakanya izici eziningi, kuhlanganise nemizwa, ukucabanga, nokuziphatha. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu yizinkinga ezihlobene nokucindezeleka, ukwesaba, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kungenxa yokucindezeleka okuvela ezimweni eziningi, njengezidingo zokufunda, ukucindezeleka emndenini, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana nabanye. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, sikhuthaze ukuxhumana, futhi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana nabanye kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo yentsha. Abantu abasha badinga indawo yokukhuluma, yokwabelana ngemizwa yabo, kanye nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kungaba yindawo yokuhlala nabangani, umndeni, noma ngisho nezinsiza ezisemthethweni ezifana nezikhungo zokwelashwa. Ukuxhumana kahle kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo wengqondo, futhi kukhuthaze umuzwa wokuxhaswa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuxhumana ezivulekile, ukuze abantu abasha bakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto ezinzima abahlangabezana nazo. Okwesithathu, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo.

Ukudliwa kwamanzi - kwenzekani lapho kuniselwa? Izindawo ezidla amanzi nenani lalawo manzi kunikezwe nguMnyango Wezemanzi Nezihlalthi. Amasthathisithiki ngo-2000 zalokhu kuyalandela. Inani lamanzi libalwa ngamamiliyoni amamitha aphindwe kathathu (cubic metres) adliwe ngonyaka. Ngokubheka lokhu, kuyakhanya ukuthi ukunisela ekulimeni kudla ihhafu lamanzi angatholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokhu singasho ukuthi inani labantu ezweni lethu lizokwanda libe ngaphezu kwa-47 miliyoni. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sigaba sokulima sizoqindezelwa ukusebenzisa amanzi maqondana nomthetho, futhi ukukhiqiza ukudla kuphela. Abaziwo bathi ukusebenzisa amanzi lapha eNingizimu Afrika sekufike ekugcwaliseni - uma kusafuneka ukuthuthuka ngale ndlela kuzobiza imali eningi. Kungaba khona amahektheli angu-1,3 miliyoni amasimu eNingizimu Afrika aniselwayo nokwamanje, kodwa kusekhona mhlawumbe amahektheli angu-233 600 akwazi ukusentshenziswa ngale ndlela. Bayacabanga ukuthi amahektheli angu-178 000 azokwazi ukusetshenziswa ngakusasa ngenxa inkinga yamanzi angasathokali, angasekho.

ngikhathele ngozele namehlo ami ezivalekela, Nginohlobo lika-Type 1 lesifo sikashukela Uthathe ithuba lokweluleka abanye kusho le ntokazi. Ngesikhathi eya esibhedlela ukuyohlola izinga uLelethu. sikashukela ukuba bathole usizo lwezempilo likashukela egazini, uLelethu wathola ukuthi Le ntombazane ijova njalo uma sekusele ngokushesha. izinga likashukela liphezulu kakhulu. Ngaba nakho ukwethuka kodwa umndeni phakathi kwamabili. bayiphuze imithi kumbe amaphilisi wami kanye nabangane bami bebengeseka "Manje ngidla ukudla okuthoswe kuhhavini abawanikeziwe futhi balandele uhlelo lokudla futhi bekuqonda okwakwenzeka," kusho (grilled), okubilisiwe, okungenawo amafutha ukudla okunempilo njengoba besuke beyaleliwe uLelethu. futhi akufanele ngidle usawoti noshukela," ngudokotela," kusho uLelethu. izikole ezavakashelwa ngesikhathi salo mkhankaso lapho kwakugqugquzelwa ukuthi abafundi ukuthi baphile ngendlela enempilo, lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nabasebenzi ababephuma kweminye imikhakha yezempilo njengababhekele ukondleka, ukuvuselelwa kwezimilo, abakhubazekile, abezengqondo, ezemvelo kanye nabamazinyo. Abasebenzi ababehlome ngezixhubho, ngezinto zokuhlola amahehlo bahlala phezu komsebenzi ababewezele wokufundisa izingane ngokubaluleka kokuzigcina uphile kakhe. Baphinde babafundisa ngezindlela zokuvikela nokulwa nezifo njengokuvikela amazinyo ukuthi angaboli, lokhu kungavikeleka uma izingane zingafundiswa zihlolwe zisencane. Isizulu sithi umuthi ugotshwa usemanzi.

Izinga elilingene elitholakala ezweni lonke eluqukethe isithako esingama- 500 ppm (ingxenye yokuyinkulungwane) kanye nezinga eliphansi eliqukethe isithako esingama- 50 ppm. Ngabe udizili omusha uzothikameza izindleko zokulungisa noma isikhathi ukushintshwa kukawoyela? Abakhiqizi bezimoto bathe ukwehlisa izinga lezithako kuzovumela imoto ukuba kweluleke isikhathi sokudonsa noma ukukhipha uwoyela okuzokwenza kunciphe izindleko zokunakekela. Ngabe ubushelelezi buyophazamiseka? Zingakanani izindleko okukhulunywa ngazo, yingani zengezelelwa? Izinga lesithako se-sulphur kudizili lizobiza ngaphezulu kwesithako we-sulapher esisezingeni eliphezulu esingena esikhundleni salo lokhu kuhambisana namanani othengiswa ngawo kwamanye amazwe.

Okuqukethwe yile SIVUMELWANO kuyoba futhi iyona ngqokithi yesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokwesiGaba 13.2 ngenhla. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizoziphelela ngokwaso ekupheleni kwesikhathi esilingene (Bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi). Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela engakapheli amaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi yosuku olulodwa. Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela engakapheli amaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kepha ingakapheli inyanga eyodwa siqalile le SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi yamaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku. Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela eva kwenyanga eyodwa uma kubalwa usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi kwenyanga eyodwa . Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS engakwazi, kwizimo ezithile ezixolelekayo, ukuthi emukele inothisi yesikhathi esifishane. Noma yiliphi iqembu kule SIVUMELWANO lingasinqamula le SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula ingxenye yale SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo uma lelo qembu lokuqala elishiwo lilinikezile leli elinye iqembu inothisi ebhalwe phansi maqondana nalokhu kwephula futhi lokho kwephula kuhlale kungalungisiwe kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela osukwini elithole ngalo inothisi leyo.

Lapho umaziphathe onamandla okwengamela ukuphatha, ukuqhuba nokuphazamisa isinqumo ungaqagulwanga njengeqembu elithintekayo esimangalweni, iqembu eliphonsa inselelo esenzweni esingahambisani nomthethosisekelo noma inqubo noma umthetho siyothatha isinyathelo sokuhlanganyela nomkhandlu othintekayo njengeqembu elifuna ukubamba iqhaza ezingxoxweni, lokhu kuyokwenziwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu sifake kuNobhala incwadi lapho sethula khona okokuqala isikhalo sempikiswano mayelana nodaba oluqhubekayo eNkantolo. Asikho isinqumo esichaza leso senzo, inqubo noma umthetho njengesiphambene nomthethosisekelo esiyothathwa yinkantolo kulolo daba ngaphandle kokuba yonke imibandela yalo mthetho isilandelwe ngokugcwele. Ngaphandle kwesimo lapho Inkantolo noma UmphathimaJaji enquma khona ngenye indlela, akekho umuntu onegunya lokuvela egamele lelinye iqembu kunoma yiluphi udaba oluqhubeka eNkantolo ngaphandle kokuba lowo muntu enelungelo lokuvela eNkantolo ephakeme.. Uma othintekayo eshona noma ephenduka umuntu ongakwazi ukuzimmela noma ukuzenzela lapho kuqhutshwa udaba, isimangalo siyommiswa kuze kufike isikhathi lapho oqokiwe noma omunye umuntu onamandla okuma esikhundleni eseqokiwe ukuze ammele lowo muntu noma iqembu noma kufike isikhathi lapho umuntu othintekayo esekwazi khona ukuzimela. Lapho umuntu onegunya noma onamandla okummela eseqokiwe ngendlela echazwe ngenhla, ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, iNkantolo inganquma ukuba lowo muntu ogunyaziwe noma onamandla ammele lowo oshonile noma ongasenawo amandla okuzimmela.

Ngokocwaningo nangezibalo ezisanda kukhishwa aboMkhandlu kaZwelonke wezokuQhakambisa ezoLimo (National Agricultural Marketing Council) kube nokukhuphuka kokudla okukhulu kulonyaka odlulile. Ucwaningo lwaloMkhandlu lukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi ukudla okukhombise ukunyuka kakhulu amanani akho yilokho okungumgogodla wansuku zonke kubantu abangenamali etheni (Consumers of the basic staple diet foods have been the hardest hit). Mphathi wohlelo yikho kubalulekile ukuthi siyimiphakathi sibambisane noHulumeni noMnyango uma kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esizozithula lapha namhlanjena. Ngiyathokoza kakhulu ukusho singuMnyango wezoLimo nezeMvelo sikwazile onyakeni wezimali ka 2007/2008 ophele ngoMarch nonyaka ukuthi sibe nezinhlelo lezi ezifana nalezi engizozethula namhlanje lapha kwaDinane. Lezizinhlelo zokutshalwa kukabhontshisi nommbila kulaboMasipala ababili okungowaseBaqulusini kanye nowaseDumbe zihlomulise abantu abevile ezinkulungwaneni ezine namakhulu amabili (more than 4 200 beneficiaries benefited from these projects). Lapha endaweni yasoThaka sitshale ubhontshisi endaweni engamahektha angu 200 kanti singuMnyango silekelele ngemali ethi ayibe yisigidi nengxenye (R1,4million). Njengoba besengeshilo ngenhla ngaloluhlelo lokutshalwa kukabhontshisi lapha abantu abazohlomula bayizinkulungwane ezimbili (2 000 beneficiaries). Siphinde futhi satshala isibalo esifanayo samahektha kabhontshisi endaweni yaKwaDlamini nakhona futhi singuMnyango silekelele ngemali ethi ayibe yisigidi nengxenye (R1,4million). Abantu abazohlomula bangamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili (800 beneficiaries).

Zilokhu zikhula, ziqhuba njalo, futhi zikhombisa amandla enhloso neqhaza. Okwamanje, umhlaba ubheke phambili kanye nezenzo zethu ukuze isikhumbuzo sibuye singafani. Ukuphila, uthando, nokuhlakanipha - konke kuboniswe emidlalweni yeqembu labadlalayo abaninzi njengoba behamba phambili. Kwazulu, i-tennis iyinsika eyodwa engenamkhawulo, exhumanisa abantu thr. Izikhumbuzo, izifundo nemigudu ezokwenza ubuhlobo buhamba phambili. Akudluli kulezi ndaba, inyusa ngezinkanyezi ezizonjikile, ithenisi iyindlela yethu yempilo, imidlalo ehloniphekile, nelungelo lokwabelana nempumelelo.

Umthetho WamaBlack Authorities ka-1951 wawuhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuholi bendabuko buba ithuluzi elilula labacindezeli. Umsebenzi wezinkosi wokubika kwiRoyal House ungumkhuba wendabuko oneminyaka eminingi futhi uyisisekelo sokubusa. Uhulumeni esinawo njengamanje esifundazweni uqale uhlelo lwezomthetho oluhloselwe ukubuyisela isithunzi nesikhundla sobuholi bendabuko ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zokubusa eziphathwe nguMthethosisekelo. Njengohulumeni, siyazi ngomonakalo owenziwe yimithetho edlule emqondweni wobuholi bendabuko. Siyaqonda, Mhlaba Womhlabathi, ukuthi uthole ukuthi ungabhekiwe emicimbini yokufakwa kwezinkosi nakwezinye ezaziphethwe abaholi bendabuko kodwa zaphathwa osomabhizinisi. Nokho, namuhla siqinisekisa wena, Mhlaba Womphakathi, ukuthi ukufakwa kwezinkosi ngeke kusetshenziswe njengemivuzo noma ukuheha ukwesekwa kweziphathimandla zezombusazwe. Ubukhosi buwumsebenzi ophakanyisiwe emthethweni wethu. Yingakho uhulumeni ephakamisa izinhlelo zomthetho ezifanele zokubambisana (IGR) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkosi nezinye izigaba zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Ngikhuluma lapha namuhla ngoba uhulumeni wethu wesifunda saseKwaZulu-Natal uqale isifundo sokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kukahulumeni, ubuholi bendabuko kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Ngifuna ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ukuthi izinkosi nonke sikhishwe emthethweni wamaHulumeni adlule ekubambeni iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Kodwa kusukela manje, le nhlobo ingumlando.
