Uhlelo Lokuphakamisa Ababhekene Nezingozi lukhuthaza ukusungulwa nokuhleleka kwezimiso kanye nokubambisana phakathi kweminyango ehlukene kahulumeni noma izinhlelo zezigaba ezahlukene kanye nezinqubomgomo zokweseka, ukuvikela nokuphakamisa ababhekene nezingozi zokudlwengulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. I-VEP igxile kakhulu kwabantu besifazane nasezinganeni. Ababhekene nokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya ezimeni eziphuthumayo bangahlala endaweni yokuhlala isikhathi esiphakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili nezinyanga eziyisithupha, kuye ngemicimbi yabo. Lolu hlelo lutholakala kubabhekene nezingozi zokudlwengulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. Xhumana nanoma yisiphi isikhungo sokweseka ababhekene nezingozi mayelana nendawo yokuhlala yabesifazane nezingane ezihlukunyezwayo, ukuze uthole abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zikahulumeni noma izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni (NGOs) ezibhekene nokunakekela ababhekene nokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya. Umeluleki ohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo, ilungu leMnyango Wezokuphepha Kwamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika (SAPS), noma uphoyisa, umphakathi, uthisha, noma omunye umuntu ophathelene nezidingo zababikeli angasiza ekufakeni isicelo sokuvikela. Qinisekisa ukuthi uma umuntu ongumbhikishi efaka isicelo sokuvikela, kukhona incwadi yokuvuma ebhalwe ngumshushisi ehambisana nesicelo. Ayikho ifomu ethile edingekayo ukuze uthole le mvume - incwadi ebhalwe ngumshushisi evuma imvume iyanele. Umntwana noma umuntu onengqondo engasebenzi kahle uyakhululeka noma uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi lowo muntu akakwazi ukuvuma ngokwabo noma ukuhlinzeka ngovume.

Lokhu kwakhulisa umsebenzi wezinkanyezi, kobuchwepheshe nemikhakha eminingi. Kodwa-ke, awekho wonke amakhamandela akhula angathanda ukusebenza ezocwaningo. Kwakukhona izinzwa ezithile nezinhlobonhlobo, lapho imiphumela ethile yocwaningo yayicwengobile. Lokhu kubangele ukuthi abacwaningi bahlale bejula ngezinye izinkulumo zokwakha ibhodi lemigomo ye-protocol yokuhlola, stave izimiso ezithile zokulwa nobuqolo bokungabi nemiphumela emisha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wezocwaningo wathola ulwazi olunembile noluhloniphekile. Nbaza, eminyakeni yezi-1900 ukuza phambili, kwaqala ukusebenza ezinkampanini eziningi zezeMfundo, okukhombisa ukuthi ezinye izikhungo zenhlalphephendaweni zaziqala ukuthola izinsiza ezihamba phambili zokuhlola. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nemiphumela eminingi engakholeki. Ubufakazi bokuthi ezocwaningo bukhula ngendlela emangalisayo kungenziwa ngezigigaba ezifananezicelo ezithile njengokuthi “Ezocwaningo lwe-Genetic” noma izincwadi ezahlukene ezihamba phambili ekuthulaseni ubuchwepheshe bokugcina bahlola izinkanyezi. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni imikhakha eyahlukeneyo, evumela abacwaningi ukuba benze izifundo ezihlukene ezithinta abantu, imiphakathi nempilo. Ngokubambisana, izikhungo zemfundo zihlinzeka ngezimali ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni ezocwaningo. Lolu hlelo lwaqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso ezazitholwa ngezinsuku ezedlule zitholakala zisebenzayo. Abacwaningi bajejezelwa ukuphathwa okunembile kwezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, koko kulindeleke ukuthi ezobuchwepheshe zikhule zihlale kulungile. Ezocwaningo kanti umgudu eziyindlela yokuzithokozisa.

Abalimi bebecindezelike ukubheka ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo njengommbila nobhekilanga ukushintshana nokolo. Ukushintshana izitshalo zasebusika nalezo zazehlobo bekusebenza kahle. Kakhulukazi bekusiza ukubulala ukhula. Ukolo wasendle omila ebusika wayengabulawa emasimini ngaphambi kokutshalwa kwezitshalo zasehlobo. Futhi ukhula omila ehlobo wayebulawa kalula emasimini kakolo ngoba lezo zinhlobo zokhula zinamakhasi abanzi, ngakho-ke bekulula ukusebenzisa amakhemikheli. Abalimi baqale ukwakha uhlelo lokushintsha izitshalo bazitshalayo - olunye lungafana nalokhu okulandelayo: ukolo nokolo, bese ummbila nommbila, ubhekilanga bese kulandela ukolo futhi. Umlimi nomlimi ulandela uhlelo aluthandayo. Ngesinye isikhathi ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo - kaningi izinhlobo zefoliji. Manje abalimi babhekene nenkinga - badinga ukutshala isitshalo esimila ebusika kodwa abasakwazi ukutshala ukolo ngoba ukolo awusabaletheli inzuzo. Bazokwenzani manje? INingizimu Afrika iyabadinga na abalimi abakhiqiza ukolo? Kungumbuzo omuhle lo esifanele siwubuze - nogavumente ufanele ubuze lo mbuzo. Kungani sifanele siphatheke ngenkinga yabalimi Obani abazoba nendaba uma bakhawula ukukhiqiza ukolo? Kuyiqiniso ukuthi umhlaba jikelele uyanciphiswa - izinto ziyathengwa ziyathengiswa emakethe lomhlaba. Yebo, kungenzeka ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ithenge wonke ukolo odingekayo phesheya, nokolo odingekayo emazweni amanye njengaseLesotho, eSwazini naseBotswana. INingizimu Afrika inayo imali ekwanele yokuthenga phesheya Khumbula ukuthi uma ufuna ukuthola imali yokukhokha phesheya, kufanele ubenazo izinto zokuthengisa phesheya ukuyithola leyo mali?

ungqongqoshe kufanele, emva kokubonisana nongqongqoshe bezifundazwe bohulumeni basekhaya, ahlonze imigomo ykuqashwa kwamalungu alemikhandlu. imigomo yokuqashwa ingehluka kuleyo kasihlalo kanye nakwamanye amalungu omkhandlu wokwedlulisela udaba. umasipalati noma omasipalati abasungulelwe imikhandlu yokwedlulisa izindaba ngokulandisa kwesigaba -49 kufanele baholele amalungu omkhandlu wokwedlilisela izindaba ngokulandela izimo abaqashwe ngaphansi kwazo kanye nokulawulwa ngungqongqoshe wesifundazwe wohulumeni basekhaya. c Ngeke lisebenzise isikhundla salo noma amalungelo alo ukuze lizicebise noma licebise omunye umuntu; noma d Lingeze laziphatha nganoma yiyiphi enye indlela engalimaza ukwethembeka noma isithunzi somkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba. Ilungu lomkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba elehluleka noma elephula isigatshana 1 linecala lokungaziphathi kahle. b engasafanele ukuba yilungu lalomkhandlu; noma c ekhishwa ehhovisi ngokulandela isigatshana- 2. Ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe woHulumeni basemakhaya engalikhipha ehhovisi ilungu lomkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba kodwa ngaphansi kwemibandela yokungaziphathi kahle noma yokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele. Isinqumo sokususa sokususa ilungu emkhandlwini wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba ngaphansi kombandela wokungaziphathi kahle noma wokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi kufanele kweyame ekutholakaleni kokbufakazi obumayelana nalokhu, yilowo oqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wesifundazwe ukuba aphenye lolo daba.. Ungqongqoshe wohulumeni basemakhaya engamisa ilungu lomkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba uma lingaphansi kophenyo ngokulandisa kwesigatshana-3.

Uma ungazi ukuthi inani lezindleko zakho zokutshala lingakanani, kuzobanzima ukuthola ukuthi kufanele uthole umkhiqizo (ngamathani) ongakanani ukuze uthole inzuzo. Linganisa (bala) zonke izindleko zakho zokukhiqiza ukudla okuthile ngehektheli elilodwa. Bala izindleko ezidingeka masinya - izimbewu, umanyolo, idizili, umuthi wokhula nezifo, abasebenzi abaholayo neshuwalense. Bala izindleko ezibophekile ezizongena ekukhiqizweni kommbila bese uyakulinganisa nentengiso yomvuno ukubona ukuthi uzokwazi ukukhokhela izindleko futhi uthole nenzuzo. Funa imakethe elizokulethela leyo nzuzo. Izindleko ezibophekile zifana nalokhu: ukuqasha, intelo (uma ubolekile), iholo labantu abakusebenzela, nogesi (lezi zindleko ziyaqhubeka noma utshala noma ungatshali). I"Breakeven" kungachazwa kanje: inani lentengiso elizokwenza ukuthi izindleko ezibophekile zizolingana nalelo nani, ngaphandle kokuthola inzuzo. Ukukhiqiza ummbila ngokwejwayelekile kuyingxenye yemisebenzi evama ukwenziwa epulazini elithile. Ukufuya izimphahla esibayeni noma esigangeni nokuhlanganisa ummbila ngezinye izinto zokufuya lezo zimphahla kungaba isizathu sokukhiqiza ummbila. Futhi ummbila ungaba isitshalo esibalulekile epulazini lapho kushintshwa khona izinhlobo zezitshalo njalonjalo. Ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukulinganisa nokubala zonke lezi zinto uma ufuna ukuthola inani lentengiso eliyi'minimami' - khumbula ukubala nalezo zenzelelo (izinzuzo) ezihambelana nokukhiqiza umvuno othile.

Ukumele ukwenze uma unesikhalazo Umbono noma isincomo... Sitshela uma uzizwa ukuthi kunomsebenzi okuphathe kahle kakhulu ! Kumele ukhumbule ukuthi ungathola usizo lwezeMpilo e Addington kuphela uma uhlala kuluzindawo ezilandelayo... Kubalulekile ukuthi uqale eMtholaMpilo oseduzane nawe! Uma wena noma ingane yakho igula , uze ungamoshi imali yakho ngokugibela , kodwa iya EmtholaMpilo njengoba uzothola usizo olufanayo nasesibhedlela njengoba kukhona abahlengikazi abaqeqeshwe ngokugcwele bezikubona, uma kune-sidingo sokuthi ubone udokotela noma sokuthatha isithombe , umhlengikazi uzokudlulisela esibhedlela nencwadi yokukudlulisa (referral Letter). Iyini I referral letter Lena incwadi oy-ithola uma umhlengikazi ekudlulisela esibhedlela. Lokhu kuzosiza udokotela ukwazi konke ngokugula kwakho noma kwengane yakho . Uma ufika esibhedlela ungayiphethe lencwadi , uzothola ukwe-lulekwa , uphinde welashwe bese uyagqugquzelwa noma ukhunjuzwe ukuse-benzisa umtholaMpilo wangakini? Imalini okumele ngiyikhokhe? Kuzodingeka ukuthi ukhokhe njengoku-fanelekile komabhalane bethu. Kuphela uma uzobona odokotela emtholaMpilo wethu. Khumbula ukuthi noma iliphi ilun-gule onalo kodwa kumele ziham-bisane . Sizokusiza ngokukunakek-ela, nangenhlonopho . Neziguli zethu kumele zenze okufanayo kubasebenzi bethu bezeMpilo. Uma udinga noma iluphi ulwazi noma enemibuzo udinga izimpendulo. Buza ngoba kungumgomo wakho. Njengoa sithi lapha e Addington -- MASIBAMBANE!

Amalungu e-250 Ton Club aqhubeka ekhula. Njengamanje sinezikhulu eziyisixhenxe ku-1,000 Ton Club, amalungu ayi-13 ku-500 Ton Club, kanye namalungu ayi-21 ku-250 Ton Club. Kulonyaka, amalungu ayisishiyagalombili angena kuleli Club. Emcimbini walonyaka, sethule okuthile okusha - i-Smallholder Farmer Competition yonyaka. E-Mpumalanga nase-Eastern Cape, kukhona abalimi abaningi abakha umhlaba owodwa noma owabili emphakathini. Lezi zabalimi zenze umsebenzi omuhle wokuletha ukudla emphakathini njalo. Ingxenye yale nhlangano ihlose ukuqeqesha nokuxhasa lezi zabalimi ezincane ukuze bakwazi ukuthuthukisa izindlela zabo zokulima. Ngakho-ke, saqala lo mqhudelwano ukuze siqaphele umsebenzi wabo omuhle. Kulonyaka, u-F.J. Mhlanga ophuma e-Mpumalanga no-S.E. Shabhu ophuma e-Eastern Cape bathuthuke. Nokho, lezi zabalimi zisebenzisa izindawo ezincane kahle, ziletha izinto ezinhle emphakathini wazo.

Uma umsebenzi ethathelwa izinyathelo zokuqondiswa izigwegwe, ukusetshenziswa kwalenqubo ngumsebenzi ukuze abhekane nondaba oluphathelene nokuqondisa izigwegwe ngeke kuyimise inqubo yokuqondisa izigwegwe. Isikhalo kufanele sibhalwe phansi uma sifakwa futhi zonke izinqumo ezithathiwe kuleyo nqubo kufanele zibhalwe. Uma kubhekwa ukugcina isikhathi esinqunyiwe, lokhu kufanele kubalwe ngokuthi kushiywe ngaphandle usuku lokuqala bese kubalwa usuku lokugcina. Labo abathintekayo kufanele balandele isikhathi esimiswe kulenqubo, ngaphandle uma bevumelene ukuselula isikhathi. Isikhalo kufanele sifakwe kumqashi zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-90 kusukela ngosuku umsebenzi aze ngalo ngaleso senzo esimhluphayo noma ukwehluleka ukwenza. Umsebenzi angafuna ukuthi isikhalo sakhe sedluliselwe kwiKhomishani ezinsukwini eziyi-10 ngemuva kokuthola isinqumo sesiphathimandla esiphethe. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umsebenzi ulwazi olufanele oludingekayo ukuze akwazi ukufaka nokuqhuba isikhalo, uma elucela. Ukunikezwa kwalolo lwazi kuncike kunoma iziphi izithiyo ezingamiswa umthetho. Umsebenzi kufanele anikwe ulwazi mayelana nesimo sesikhalo sakhe nokuthi sesiqhubeke kangakanani ukuze siphothulwe ngosuku oluhleliwe. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umsebenzi umfanekiso wefomu lesikhalo ngemuva kwezinga ngalinye lapho isikhalo sibhekwe isiphathimandla. Umsebenzi angafaka isikhalo sakhe kumsebenzi okhethelwe ukuba enza-lula noma abe ngumxhumanisi kulenqubo yokuxazululwa kwezikhalo kulowo mnyango. Kufanele kusetshenziswe ifomu elinqunyiwe Isijobelelo A uma kufakwa isikhalo.

I- National Electronic Media Institute of South Africa (NEMISA) yasungulwa ngaphansi kwegama le-South African Broadcasting School; inhlangano eyasungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 21, futhi yashintsha igama yayo ngomhla ka-8 kuJuni 1999. Ngokwehlelo 3 ingxenye A yePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA) ka-1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999), njengoba kuguqulwe, futhi ngenxa yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, i-NEMISA inesibopho sokubhala le mmanual ezosetshenziswa njengedokhumenti yomphakathi ngendlela yokuthi umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kumarekhodi ethu. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlela inani labathuthukisi be-ICT abanolwazi kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezivela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo, nokwandisa amakhono emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. I-NEMISA ihlose ukugcina abafundi abahlukene enanini elikhulu labesifazane. Umbono we-NEMISA uwukuba ibe yisikhungo semfundo esilandela izindlela ezintsha ezigxile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana. Sihlose ukuba amandla aphambili ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakamiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihlinzeka ngezidingo zezimboni emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngempahla egxile kubantu, eshibhile, futhi efanele imboni ngokudlulisa ulwazi nobudlelwano. Isu le-NEMISA ukuhlela nokukhiqiza abafundi abanolwazi oluphakeme abazoba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana nezokukhuluma ngohlelo oluhlukahlukene, izifundo, nezinto ezintsha. IBhodi Yabaphathi ibophelelekile kubanikazi bezabelo ngokulandela izimiso ezibekwe yi-PFMA. Umphathi Omkhulu, ongumuntu ophakeme kwiBhodi, uqokwa ngokuhambisana ne-memorandum kanye nemibhalo yenhlangano ye-NEMISA.

Kungani kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakanyisiwe? Ukujabula umuntu akuthola uma eqhathanisa ukusebenza noma ukusetshenziswa kwalokho akutholayo ngokulindelwe kwakhe. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakanyisiwe ezingeni lomhlaba kuthuthukisa izinga lenkonzo esihlinzeka ngayo kumakhasimende ethu ngokushintsha umqondo wabasebenzi bethu ukusuka emcabangweni wesikhashana uye emcabangweni wokuzinza kumakhasimende - ngokwenza kanjalo, sizohlangabezana futhi sidlule kulokho abakulindele kulolu bhange kanye nezinsizakalo zalo. Ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe yikho esikufunayo ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngoba siyazi ukuthi ulindele ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe kulolu Bhange lwezeMali. Uma usizo olutholile namuhla lukujabulisile, sicela ubike kumngane. Uma ungenelisekile, sicela wazise umphathi wesikhungo. Ukubaluleka kokugxila ekugcineni amakhasimende kuye kwanda. Ubhange lwezeMali luzokwazi kuphela ukugcina amakhasimende alo uma luthuthukisa ekuhlangabezaneni nasekuthokoziseni izidingo zamakhasimende. Esikhathini esedlule, uBhange lwezeMali beluphakeme, futhi bekungadingeki ukuba lwenze imizamo ekhethekile yokugcina amakhasimende. Manje, uBhange lwezeMali luncintisana namakhasimende nabanye amabhange ezohwebo. Abantu manje bangakhetha ukuthi yimaphi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo abafuna. Amakhasimende anjengamanje afundile futhi ayahlola. Izinga lokulindela lamakhasimende lenyukile ngenxa yezinga lemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo.

Uma ungenayo imishini yokuhlola umswakama, thina izibonelo zezinkwa kumphathi wesilo eduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna. Ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kwezinkwa ngenxa yokuminyana ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nobungozi bezinyoni, u-sorghum ungavunwa uma umswakama usuka ku-20% kuya ku-25% bese umiswa emshinini wokumisa kuze kube sekufinyelele ku-9.5%. Lokhu kuminyana kuhle ukuze kubekwe (kugcinwe) u-sorghum ezibayeni. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, kungcono ukushiya u-sorghum emhlabeni ukuze umiswe kahle ngaphambi kokuvuna. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uma umswakama uphansi kuka-10%, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha umgubo. Isivinini se-combine kufanele sibe phakathi kuka-5 kuya ku-8 kilometers ngehora. Isivinini esiphezulu phambili sizohambisana nomswakama wezinkwa ze-sorghum nosayizi womkhiqizo. Isivinini kufanele sincishiswe uma umswakama uphansi ukuvimbela izinkwa ukuthi zibhujiswe uma zingena emshinini. Ungakwazi ukuhamba uma umswakama usuka ku-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Izinkwa ezinomswakama ophakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% zizobhubhisa kalula uma zingena kwi-cylinder. Izinkwa ezingabujwa ngokuphelele zihlala phansi. I-'concave' ivulekile kakhulu. Kunemathambo amaningi asala. Ukuphuma komoya okuphansi, ukonakala kwi-cylinder kwenzeka ngokushesha. Ukuvuleka kwe-'chaffer' kuncane kakhulu. Imfucumfucu eminingi iyashiywa kwi-'waste' bin.

ezemfundo zingasebenzisa izimoto ezincane, amakhumbi, amabhasi amancane, amabhasi ajwayelekile, amabhasi alekene, izitimela-mabhasi noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshelwe okuthile. Ngaphambi kokubonelela isicelo sokuphiwa, ukuvuselela, ukushintsha noma ukudlulisela ilayisense yokusebenza ngezemfundo, iBhodi kumele lihambise isicelo kulesosikole esithintekayo noma ezinye izikhungo zemfundo ukuzwa uvo noma izincomo zazo ngendlela ebekiwe, futhi kumele libhekisise lololuvo noma izincomo ezitholile. Ezokuvakasha kumele zibekiswe ukuze kwenzelwe ukuhamba kahle ngokungcebeleka lapho abavakashi bephelezelwa ngumbonisi-ndlela orejistiwe ngokwesigaba 21 so Mthetho wezoku Vakasha. Ayikho ilayisense egunyaza ukusebenza ngezokuvakasha engakhishwa ngaphandle uma iBhodi selithole futhi labonelela izincomo eziphuma kwisiphathimandla sezokuthutha ezivumelana no MEC, kodwa ibhodi lingaqhubeka ngaphandle kwalezizincomo lapho isiphathimandla singazange sikhiphe izincomo ngesikhathi esibekiwe ekucelweni yiBhodi. Ekukhipheni ilayisense lokusebenza ngezokuvakasha iBhodi lingabeka imigomo yokuthi imoto ibe nesipholisi, izipikha zokudlulisela umculo noma umlayezo, izitsha zasekhishini nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinto ezingabekwa yiBhodi, noma izindlu zangasese lapho uhambo lweqa amakhilomitha angu 200, noma yimiphi ke nje eminye imigomo. Ibhodi lingabeka ubuningi babagibeli abangathwalwa imoto esetshenziselwa ezokuvakasha, ngaphandle kokunaka ukuthi ubukhulu bemoto bungaphezulu kwalesosibalo esibekiwe. Lapho kufanelekile, iBhodi lingabeka izindawo ezithile noma imigudu yokusebenza ezokuvakasha.

Ukutholwa, ukuphathwa nokusakaza ulwazi ngezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ukuze kakhiwe isizinda solwazi. Ukwakha ukuhlanganyela ukuze kwenziwa lula ukutholakala kwezimali nezinye izimfanelo kubaxhasi, kuhulumeni nemincintiswana kazwelonke. Ukunikeza usizo lwezimali ngokumisa izinhlelo zokusiza ama-athilethikhi. Ukwaluleka uNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka. kanye nokusebenza njengesithunywa esiyinhloko yeSikhungo sikwaZwelonke kanye nokulawula iZikhungo zokuqeqesha ama-Olimpikhi. c Ukuqiniseka ukuthi kukhona izindlela zangaphakathi zokuxazulula izinkinga phakathi kwalo nalabo abahlanganyela nabo. Ukumisa inqubomgomo engagudlukile kunqubomgomo kazwelonke yezeMidlalo nokungcebeleka, izithunywa okufanele zihole lomsebenzi yizinhlangano zeziFundazwe nemigwamanda emikhulu. Ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwalezi zithunywa ezingenhla. Ukulungiswa kwezingqalasizinda ezakhiwe iziphathimandla zasekhaya, ukuze zisentshenziswe uma kunemicimbi kazwelonke neyezifundazwe. Ukumisa inqubomgomo ezingeni lohulumeni basekhaya. Ukuxhaswa ngezimali kwezithunywa ezisemqoka, njengamaqembu noma abantu ngabanye. Ukwakha izingqalasizinda ezizosentshenziswa ezingeni lasekhaya noma izifundazwe. f Ukwenza izinqubomgomo zeminye iminyango kahulumeni zihambisane nenqubomgomo yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ngomoya wokuhlela nokusiza umphakathi ngokubambisana. g Ukunikeza izaluleko zezomthetho ngasohlangothini lukahulumeni kubo bonke abathintekayo kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka.

Hey, Umshayeli weTaxi! B. Bheka amawheels akho! b. Bangane, amaTaxi ahlinzeka ngosizo olubalulekile kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Sithembele kini ukusihambisa ngokuphepha ezindaweni zethu. Nokho, amaTaxi enu aphapheme kangakanani? Bheka amawheels akho! Amawheels akho abalulekile kakhulu. Khumbula ukuthi yibo kuphela oxhumana phakathi komgwaqo, itaxi, kanye nabagibeli. Amawheels akho angakwenza umehluko phakathi kokuphila nokufa. Uyalungile. Ngiyabonga ngokusikhumbuza. Esikhathini esedlule, sithukile ukuphepha. Kodwa sizimisele ukuphakamisa amazinga embonini yethu! Ukuphepha kwabagibeli bethu kuphakathi kokubalulekile. Ngemuva kokukhuluma nawe, siyazi kahle ukuthi sizoqala kuphi - ngokunakekela amawheels! Yebo! Njengabagibeli, ukuphila kwethu kusezandleni zenu! Khumbula lokho - imindeni yethu ikudinga! Imindeni yenu ikudinga, sidinga nina, nezwe lenu lidinga nina. Asikwazi ukuhamba sishiywe umuntu oyedwa ngenxa yokunganaki nokungakhathaleli. Abagibeli kufanele bathuthwe ngokuphepha! Amawheels afanele + abashayeli abafanele = ukuphepha emigwaqweni. Ngiyabonga ngokuthatha le ndaba ngokungathi sína! a. Ingabe lokho ungukuthi? b. Woza, woza! Sinokuhamba okude phambili. Cha, Mama, ungakhathazeki! Ngiyethemba ukuthi ubheke amawheels akho. Onke amawheels akho - okuqala, kwesibili, kwesithathu, nokwesine. Yebo! Ingabe amawheels alungile? Unayo i-spare? Yini ehamba! Udlala nokufa! Lo mshayela ubukeka engazi lutho ngama-wheels aphephile! Uyalungile! Noma ubani ophuthelwa amawheels akhe udlala nokufa.

b engasafanele ukuba yilungu lalomkhandlu; noma c ekhishwa ehhovisi ngokulandela isigatshana- 2. Ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe woHulumeni basemakhaya engalikhipha ehhovisi ilungu lomkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba kodwa ngaphansi kwemibandela yokungaziphathi kahle noma yokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele. Isinqumo sokususa sokususa ilungu emkhandlwini wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba ngaphansi kombandela wokungaziphathi kahle noma wokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi kufanele kweyame ekutholakaleni kokbufakazi obumayelana nalokhu, yilowo oqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wesifundazwe ukuba aphenye lolo daba.. Ungqongqoshe wohulumeni basemakhaya engamisa ilungu lomkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba uma lingaphansi kophenyo ngokulandisa kwesigatshana-3. Usihlalo womkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba nguyena othatha isinqumo ekuthini umkhandlu uhlanganela kuphi nokuthi uhlangana nini, kodwa kufanele abize umhlangano uma iningi lamalungu omkhandlu limnxusa ngokubhala phansi ukuba abize umhlangano ngesikhathi esithile nokuba uhlanganele ndawana thize njengalokhu kucela isicelo. Ngenkathi kulalelwa udaba olwedlulisiwe, umkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba kufanele uhlanganele endaweni kaMasipalati ophepha lawo lokuhlola lingundaba mlonyeni wokwedluliselwa kodaba noma lokubuyekezwa kodaba. Uma usihlalo engekho, noma engatholakali, noma uma kunesikhala ehhovisi likasihlalo, amanye amalungu omkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba engaqoka omunye wawo ukuba asingathe umhlangano nma asebenze njengosihlalo.

Umbiko: Ukubhikisha Komphakathi Isingeniso Ukubhikisha komphakathi kube yinto ejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonitshwa. Lezi zibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, njengokungabi khona kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuhlala, noma ukungabikhona kwezinsiza zempilo. Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izimbangela, izindlela, kanye nemiphumela yokubhikisha komphakathi, sihlole izimo ezithile ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene. Izimbangela Zokubhikisha Izimbangela zokubhikisha komphakathi zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala zixhumene nezinkinga ezinzima. Enye yezimbangela ezivame kakhulu yikhono elingaphansi lokuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubandakanya amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bavame ukuhamba phambili ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo uma izinsiza ezisemqoka zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala nezikahulumeni zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubhekaneni nezidingo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngaphandle kokubandakanywa kwabo, lokhu kungaholela ekubhibhisheni. Izindlela Zokubhikisha Ukubhikisha komphakathi kudinga izindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuzuze umphakathi. Ezinye izindlela ezivame ukusetshenziswa zifaka phakathi kokuhlangana emihlanganweni, ukuhlela izinkulumo, nokwakha amaqembu okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo. Ezinye izibhikisho ziba nezimpikiswano ezinzima, lapho abantu behamba emigwaqweni, behlabelela, noma bephakamisa izimpawu ezikhombisa izikhalazo zabo.

Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesijabulisayo kubasebenzi nakumakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza lungumhlahlandlela wakho wokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakufronti." Omunye wemigomo ehleliwe yeBhange Lomhlaba ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo impilo yabantu bonke. Wena, njengommeleli webhange, unethuba elikhulu lokuba yingxenye yokushintsha ikusasa labantu! Ungowokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela amandla abo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-funds abangawasebenzisa ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo. Asigxili kuphela ekuthuthukiseni abantu ngaphandle kwebhange kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Lolu hlelo luzosiza futhi ukuba ukhule ube umuntu okhathalelayo kwabanye futhi uphathe kahle usizo oluhlinzekayo. Siphakamisa bonke abasebenzi beBhange Lomhlaba ukuba babambe iqhaza noma basebenze ngokulandela amaphuzu alandelayo: Masikhuthaze futhi sikhuthazane nsuku zonke, hhayi kuphela ukwenza kahle ngezakhono zethu kodwa futhi ukusabalalisa injabulo ekuphatheni umsebenzi wethu nasekuphileni kwethu! Bhalisela amakhasimende ngokushesha ngokubabheka emehlweni. Uma ungakwazi ukusiza ikhasimende ngokushesha, wazise ukuthi uzobasiza maduze. Bhalisela wonke amakhasimende endaweni yokulinda, noma uzobasiza noma cha, bese ubuza uma sebekwazile ukuthola usizo nokuthi ungabasiza kanjani. Uma usukulungele ukusiza ikhasimende, mushe, bhalisela, uthi "sawubona," uxolise ngokulinda, bese uzethula ngegama, isibonelo, "Sawubona, ngiyaxolisa ngokukugcina ulindile. NgiyiJane (noma uNkk. Smith), ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?"

Ngakho-ke, abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukuxhaswa, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele, futhi baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kubekhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni nohulumeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa, ezizovumela abathengisi ukuba baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abathengisi, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo kahle, futhi bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Nokho, bahlala bephikisana nezinkinga eziningi, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuxoxa ngalezi zinkinga kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukwesekwa, hhayi ukugxekwa. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi nohulumeni, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphila kahle, futhi baqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ehlukahlukene emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobumbano. Abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benza umsebenzi oncomekayo, futhi badinga ukuba siwasekele, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo.

Lokhu kudala ukungafani kokutholakala kukagesi, lapho abanye abantu besebenzisa izindlela ezindala zokukhanyisa, ezifana nezibani zezimoto, noma izibani ezisebenza ngogesi ophumayo. Izinzuzo Zokutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Uma ugesi utholakala kalula emakhaya, izinzuzo zikhula. Okokuqala, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nemisebenzi emisha. Lokhu kudala amathuba amaningi okukhula komnotho, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhaya abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ugesi uvumela abantu ukuba basebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengamakhompyutha nemishini yokusebenza, okwenza kube lula ukuphila kwansuku zonke. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukutholakala Kukagesi Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo ezivela kuhulumeni, ezinkampanini, kanye nasemiphakathini. Hulumeni angasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze akhe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwakha iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi ezincane, ezilula, nezisebenza kahle. Izinkampani ezingezona ezikahulumeni zingase zibe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala benokutholakala kukagesi. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Ukubambisana komphakathi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukutholakala kukagesi. Imiphakathi ingase ibambisane ukuze ithole izixazululo ezisemqoka, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina ugesi ezisebenza kahle. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi bangawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi ukuze bathuthukise izinga labo lokuphila.

Imisho kumele ibhalwe iphelele. Imisho kumele ixube. Kungabakhona imisho eqondile, embaxa kanye nemagatshagatsha. Indlela ozoyisebenza ngayo imisho eyahlukene kumele uqikelele isikhathi (tense) isetshenziswe ngendlela enembayo futhi ihambisane ukusuka ekuqaleni kuze kuyofika ekugcineni, sisho izivumelwano. "Ngisho lokhu okuthiwa ivalue. Ngeke nje uwuthengise ngoba owenkosi. Izinkomo zakho, baba ngeke zidliwe abafokazana. Usazozitika nje kuzo. Naba futhi nabafowethu abancane, basazodinga ukufunda. Ziyobasiza. Mhlawumbe nje ubaba ucabanga ukuthi njengoba ngithi ngizontuntiswa umsebenzi, ngizomkhohlwa, ngimlahle. Cha, baba akunjalo. Ngiyohlala nginikhumbula. Futhi ngizimisele ngokuba ngikwakhele indlu yesimanje ukubonga kuwe konke ongenzele khona.UJanie ngeke anginqabela kulokho." Ubaba Xulu wakhipha ama-R300 esikhwameni sakhe. Wanikeza ugogo. Ugogo wabonga wancocncoza. "Bekungengcono yini ukuba uthathe inkokhelo yakho uyoyibala wedwa bese kuthi nami ngithathe le mpahla yami ngiyoyibala ngasese" kubuza uXaba? "Nguyena impela Nzuza." "Kodwa bakithi nithi ngabe ngempela uqinisile noma ubeziphuphela nje"kubuza unina kaBrendon? Ngasivula kancane isikhwama engabe ngisinikwe nguXaba. Habe! Kwathi mangishayeke phansi ngenkathi ngibona imali eyabe iningi kanjeya! Ngaphuma ngokushesha maqede ngakhwekhwetha njalo sengiyothukusa leyo mali. Umane athenge nje noma kubani? Ubudoda abukhulelwa Akudingeki uze ube mdala ukuze ukhulume into ecacile nephusile. Wathi uyamenqabela uMnguni wehluleka.

ENtshonalanga Kapa, ezoLimo ziyizinsika empini yethu nobuphofu nempilo yabantu bethu. Kukweletwa amabhange aseNingizimu Afrikha kanye nezikhungo nezinye izingxenye zikahulumeni. Kuyacaca ukuthi besizoba mpofu kakhulu ukuba awenzanga isiphakamiso kanti siyabonga ukuthi uvimbele ubumpofu bungakenzeki. I-Security Council iphinde yaveza ukukhathazeka kwayo ngezenzo ezingekho emthethweni zamaqembu ahlomile entshonalanga Darfur kanye nasempumalanga Chad, okungaholela ekungezwanini. Lokhu kuvakasha kuhloswe ngakho ukuhlanganisa ubudlelwano nohulumeni waseNingizimu Afrikha nokugcizelela ubungani bethu neqembu elibusayo. Ukulunga nokuba semthethweni kwalo mzabalazo kwabhalwa ezivumelwaneni ezehlukene emphakathini womhlaba. Amathuba okuthuthuka komnotho ogwini kumele enziwe ahlangabezane nezidingongqangi zabantu ukuthuthukisa abantu. Umthethosisekelo ugunyaza ukuba kuqedwe emasontweni ayisihlanu. Iphrojekthi eyimpumelelo esiqalisiwe e-Durban Westville iyisisekelo sokukhishwa kwemithi yokwelapha. Amabhizinisi anempumelelo adinga ulwazi olunzulu kanye nokuqonda imigomo yezamabhizinisi. Iphrofayili ngokobuhlanga yabacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrikha iyashintsha. Izinhlaka zokuma, ukulawula zomsebenzi wokubuyisela izinto esimweni zizohlinzekwa yiNhlangano yeZizwe. Othisha kumele baqaphele kakhulu uma bekhetha ulwazi abazolufundisa nalapho sebedlulisela ulwazi kubafundi. Wathi isiteshi sasisiza ukufaka uthando kanye nokuzinikela e-North West ezinhliziyweni zalabo abasebenzi esifundazweni.

OWENKONTILEKA umsebenzi wakhe uzowenza ngokwesheduli exhunyelwe lapha yaba uSheduli A. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma izinsuku abekade engekho ngazo ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. u-SAPS uzoba nomsebenzi wokunikeza OWENKONTILEKA ezokuthutha imoto ukuya nokubuya EMSEBENZINI ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe bheka iziGaba 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. U-SAPS uzomholela OWENKONTILEKA ngokuba khona nangomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yenkontilela ezoba R - ...amarandi ngehora kuhlanganiswa ntelelaye-VAT: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS kungathi ekuhambeni kwesikhathi ngokuzikhethela kwakhe abuye ayikhuphule le mali yakhe yesivumelwano ekhokhelwa ngehora. Lo mholo ukhokhwa kamuva zinyanga zonke nghlobo lwemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yenkontileka (bona isiGaba 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo usuphelele nao zonke izinto eziyizinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi woWENKONTILEKA Inqobo, lokho kubanjwa kwemali kuhambisana nomThetho othize, iyobanjwa emholweni woWENKONTILEKA.

Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkosi noMeya abukhombisi ukufana ezikhundleni. Kungaba yiphutha ukususa inkosi ezindabeni zendawo ngenxa yokuthi, emicabangweni yethu, kufanele ikhulume nomlingani wayo eKapa noma ePitoli. Singase sibe nalolo cabango olukhuluma ngempela. Nokho, sikhumbuza namuhla ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu, obuhlanganisa izakhiwo ezahlukene zikahulumeni, bugxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kuhanjiswa ngokushesha ezizweni zobukhosi. Zonke izinkosi ziyazi ukuthi sikhona kude ekuthumeleni izinsiza ezindaweni zabo, futhi sidinga ukuba baxhumane nathi njengohulumeni ekuhlinzekeni ngokushesha kwalezi zidingo. Inkosi Hlongwane nomphakathi, njengendawo yaseKwaZulu-Natal, sibhiyozela intuthuko esiyenzayo ekubuyiseni isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko, ukuguqulwa kwaso, kanye nokuhambisana nezinye izakhiwo zokuphathwa, ikakhulukazi ezingeni likamasipala. Ngithatha leli thuba ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ngezinto ezibalulekile ezihlobene nesiko lokufakwa kwezinkosi ngokusemthethweni. Kukho umthetho ongakakwenziwa esifundazweni onikeza ulwazi olunembile ngalesi sihloko. Namuhla kuhle ukugcizelela ukuthi umndeni wobukhosi udlala indima ebalulekile ezinqum

amafomu esicelo ngokwezicelo ezikhonjwe kuzigatshana 1, 2 no 3 ngokwezamatekisi angamakhumbi kumele zicabange ngezincomo eziphuma kwinhlangano yamatekisi asebenzela kulowomgudu, imigudu noma ibalazwe umfaki sicelo ayilunga layo, okumele agcwaliswe yinhlangano ngaphambi kokuhambisa isicelo, noma isitatimende esikhomba ukuthi ayikho enye inhlangano ekhona noma umfaki sicelo ungongelilunga orejistile. Abafaki zicelo kumele basho ngokufunga kumafomu ezicelo ukuthi bake batholwa yini benamacala obugebengu emvelo emisiwe uma kunjalo, babale amacala futhi basho ukuthi bona noma abashade nabo, abalingani babo noma abalingani ngokwamabhizinisi noma abaqashi bayiziphathimandla zomthetho noma abameli bezomphakathi noma zabaphathiswa besi Fundazwe noma zabaphathiswa bakamasipala. a IBhodi kumele lihambise izicelo zabezokuthutha abangenazo izivumelwano baziyise kwizikhungo zokuthutha zedolobhakazi elifanele elikhonjwe kusigaba 87 ukuthola izincomo, ngendlela ebekiwe, ngaphambi kokuveza isicelo. b Lapho ikhansela noma isikhungo, esibonwa ngu MEC, sikhonela uhlobo lwezithuthi ezikhona, isikhungo sezithuthi sedolobhakazi kumele sixhumane nalo ngendlela ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuhanbisa izincomo zaso kwi Bhodi. Ibhodi lingakhipha, ekutholeni isicelo ngendlela ebekiwe nasekukhokhweni kwemali ebekiwe, ilayisense yokusebenza yesikhashana engevile ezinsukwini ezingu 60 lapho isivumelwano sesinikiwe umfaki sicelo yilungu lombuso nelayisense yokusebenza efanele ekhonjwe kusigaba 391 ingakakhishwa ngosuku lokuqala kwesivumelwa.

Le mali yenkontileka (bona isiGaba 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo usuphelele nao zonke izinto eziyizinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi woWENKONTILEKA Inqobo, lokho kubanjwa kwemali kuhambisana nomThetho othize, iyobanjwa emholweni woWENKONTILEKA. OWENKONTILEKA uyamxolela u-SAPS maqondana nanoma yimuphi umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okudalwe ukulimala emzimbemi, ukulahleka kwempilo, ukulahleka noma ukulimala kwempahla noma ngabe kudalwe ngu SAPS noma omunye umuntu oseceleni noma ngabe udalwe noma kungenxa yobudedengu obube khona ngezikhathi oyilungu lika-SAPS egcina umyalelo, futhi uyamxolela u-SAPS kunoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa, ukulimala, indleko noma inani lokukhokhwa maqondana nokuqhubekayo enkantolo okuqondene NOWENKONTILEKA nokungase kuhambisane nokufunwa imali noma ukuboshwa ngandlela thize. Le SIVUMELWANO sizoqala ukusebenza futhi sibe yisibopho kusukela osukwini esisayinwe ngaso le SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo nje uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO engasisayini kanye kanye AMAQEMBU, usuku lokugcina lokusayina kwelinye lamaqembu luyothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kokusebenza. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, zizoqhubeka isikhathi esithize esilingene (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi), okuyoqala ngosuku okuqala ngalo ukuthi le SIVUMELWANO siqale ukusebenza (bheka isiGaba 12.1 ngezansi).

b Uma leso saziso sikhishiwe, isicelo siyoqhutshwa ngendlela ehambisana nemibandela yomthetho- 11. b ukuba wonke amaqembu ezombusazwe esiShayamthetho sikaZwelonke noma esiFundazweni esithintekayo nabafisa ukwenza njalo bethule iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe ababona zifanele ekunqumeni udaba, singakedluli isikhathi esimiswe kuleyo miyalelo. Unobhala wenkantolo ekhiphe isinqumo sokungahambisani kwesenzo nomthethosisekelo njengoba kuhlonzwe esigabeni -172 soMthethosisekelo uyothula kuNobhala weNkantolo ikhophi yaleso sinqumo zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu -15 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwaleso sinqumo. Umuntu noma umnyango kahulumeni onelungelo nofisa ukwedlulisa isikhalo sokuphikisa leso sinqumo ungafaka isicelo sokwedlulisa udaba kuNobhala kanye nekhophi idluliselwe kuNobhala wenkantolo eyenze isinqumo ngokuhambisana nemibandela yesigaba- 1722d soMthethosisekelo, emuva kwalokho udaba luyophethwa ngokulandela imiyalelo enqunywe nguMphathimaJaji kodwa isicelo kufanele senziwe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu -15 inkantolo ithathe leso sinqumo. Esazisweni sokwedlulisa isikhalo, ummangali uyobeka ngokucacile izizathu zesikhalo, akhombise amaqiniso noma umthetho okuphikiswa ngawo isinqumo noma okufanele ngabe ulandelwe noma ubhekelwe ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo.

Imicimbi yokuphepha nemisebenzi ye-ofisi... Ukucubungula kwezezimali ngaphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamasiko. I-ofisi ephethe ukudalwa kwezimpawu. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhlanganiswa kwamasiko, isayensi, nobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni, inhlalakahle yomphakathi ekuphakamiseni ubunikazi nasekuphakamiseni amanani ahlukahlukene ezwe lethu. Emculweni, ifa lesiko, kanye namagugu, ngokuhlonipha ukuhlukahluka, nokuxhasa izinhlelo zezimali. Ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ezweni lethu njengendlela yokuphakamisa wonke umZulu ukuba abe nengxenye empilweni yokuxhumana, yezepolitiki, nezomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa okulinganiselwe ukuze kugcinwe, kugcinwe, kuvikelwe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando wethu, izimpawu zethu zenkululeko, ifa, namagugu kuyavunywa. Ukubheka emuva konyaka odlule, kube nempumelelo ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe ngomhla we-DACST. Kusukela ekubonakaleni/nokufinyeleleka kwezinsiza zamasiko okuholela ekudaleni imisebenzi, kuya ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zocwaningo ezisezingeni lomhlaba. Indlela imiphakathi noma umkhakha wezobuciko ongashintshwa ngayo nokuthi singanikeza kanjani umnikelo ezinhlelweni eziholwa uhulumeni ngendlela yokubambisana futhi ehambisanayo, esibiza ngayo njengezinhlelo ze-cluster. Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kunezinkomba ezibalulekile okufanele sihlole kuzo ezingeni eliphakathi njengelizwe. Ibhajethi enkulu yonyaka yokwakha ubuchwepheshe edinga ukuxhaswa ibhajethi ye-R1.5 billion. Emkhakheni wezobuciko namasiko, kunezidingo eziphuthumayo zokuthi uhulumeni asihole.

Lokhu kuveza umxholo omubi, okungekho emthethweni. Ngakho-ke, umbono wethu kumele ube umphakathi ophilayo, osebenzayo, futhi ohlakaniphile. Umphakathi kumele uzame ukufunda ngezinto ezithinta isimo sezulu futhi senze izinqumo eziqinile. Ukuze sithole isixazululo esihle, kufanele sihloniphe abakhiqizi bemvelo, sikhuthaze ukuzinakekela emhlabeni ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kuzokwenza kube nokukhula okuhle, kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nesizotha nezimiso eziqinile. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kumele uqhubeke nezenzo ezihloniphekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubomgomo zethu kumele ziqhubele phambili ukusimama nokukhulisa izinyathelo ezihlanzekile. Umhlaba udinga izixazululo ezithinta ngemfanelo, ezenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Njengoba sithatha izinyathelo ezithe xaxa, kufanele sihlale sihamba phambili nemibono emisha, sihloniphe imiphakathi kanye nezinselelo ezivelelayo. Ekugcineni, ukuze sikhulume ngezokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, kudingeka sihlale sihamba phambili. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda izimo ezithinta izimpilo zethu, ukuze siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela ezinhle zezimali, ezokuhamba, kanye nemvelo. Umhlaba wethu uyahluka, kodwa uma umphakathi uhlanganisa, akukho okungakwazi ukusivimbela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo nelungelo lokuphila kahle. Singenza umehluko, kudingeka sizakhele umhlaba ongcono.

Ngokuqinisekile, uhlelo lokukhiqiza, olwakha izinsiza zokudla, lubalulekile ekuphuculeni izinga lempilo, futhi uthintwa ngqo yizinguquko zesimo sezulu. Lokhu kuyisifundo esidala sokuthi uma kungenzeka kulungiswe kabusha, kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezimbili. Ukusebenzisana nabalawuli, izinkampani, kanye nezimboni ezahlukahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuguquka okuhle. Ngokwendaba, akukaze kube ngcono lapho sizama ukuqonda impilo yethu. Izinselelo ezivela ezinkampanini ezisebenza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokusiza abantu ezindaweni eziphansi zikhombisa umqondo ophumelelayo. Abesifazane abagqugquzela izinhlelo zokuvuselela, ukukhiqiza izinkanyezi, baneqhaza elikhulu ekuguqulweni kwemikhuba yokuphila. Ngokukodwa ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kwazulu, ukufundisa, umugqa wezinqubomgomo, ukuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze siqede ukudla okwenziwe ngenxa yokuguquka kwezimo. Ngokucacile kukhona izinkinga eziningi ezibangelwa ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi ngibe nemibono yokuthuthukisa — akukhona nje ukuthumela izinsiza ezithile, kodwa ukuxhumana. Ulimi lwezinto ezizokwenziwa lwaluphumelelisa, nokuthi akufanele kuthathwe ngezinyathelo ezithathekayo ukuze kugwenywe izingozi zempilo, izinkinga zemali, nezibalo. Ngakhoke, ukuhlola izinyathelo ezintsha nemishayo enezinhloso ezithile kulungile — ukuzama ukwakha uhlelo oluhlukile ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela weziningi ezithinta izikhalazo zansuku zonke. Ngemuva kwalolu hlangothi, kusemukelekile ukucabanga ngamathuba angeziwe. Hamba, fundisa! Ukukhuthaza amathuba okusebenza, kuphumelelisa zonke izinkampani ezizimele.

Zonke izindawo zinenani lemvula elibhaliwe. Inani lemvula elivamekile ngonyaka lizosikhombisa ukuthi kungatshalwa ziphi izitshalo ezindaweni ezithile lapho kutshalwa ngemvula kuphela. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona ithuba lokunisela kufanele sibheke ezinye izimo zezulu ngoba amanzi atholakala ngokunisela. Sibokhumbula ukuthi uma izulu lina inani elithile, akusho ukuthi onke lawo manzi azodliwa isitshalo. Uma lina kakhulu amaningi amanzi ayageleza ayalahleka. Lapho insimu isemehlelweni, ukugeleza kwamanzi kuyanda. Maqondana nendlela insimu ilinywe ngayo, umhlabathi ophezulu oqinile uzovimba ukuthi amanzi angene. Uma kungekho izinhlanga ensimini ukukhothwa ngumoya nakho kuyanda. Uhlobo lomhlabathi nalo lukhombisa ukuthi umhlabathi enekhono lokubamba amanzi futhi kungaba khona ukhula oluzovimba amanzi ukuya esitshalweni. Imvula nokukhothwa ngumoya okuvamekile njalo ngonyaka kukhonjiswa ezifanelekiso 1.1 na-1.2 (DWAF, 1986). Ngaphansi kwa-20% lomhlaba lapha eNingizimu Afrika olingana na-1,05 miliyoni amasquare kilometre unesimo sezulu esimanzana othola 750 mm/ngonyaka futhi kushabalala amanzi angaphansi kwa-1 400 mm/ngonyaka - kulezi zindawo isimo sezulu silungela ukutshala ukudla. Izindawo lapho inani lemvula lingaphezu kwa-500 mm/ngonyaka nokushabalala okungaphansi kwa-1 800 mm / ngonyaka yilezi: inkangala ephakathi, ngasolwandle empumalanga nezindawo eKapa lapho kuna khona ebusika.

b umuntu ophukile ezinkingeni zezimali futhi ongakabuyiselwa ngokomthetho. g ophume emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha okungafanele ngemva kokulalela mayelana nesenzo esingase sibe nomthelela omubi kwiCentre, kodwa leli lungu lingase likhanselwe kuze kube emhlanganweni wonyaka olandelayo lapho leli khanselo kumele libe kubhalwe emaminithini ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nemigomo yale ngxenye, umuntu ophakamisile isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokukhansela kufanele ayithumele kuMongameli futhi iBhodi izomukela le khanselo uma zonke izikweletu zikhokhiwe. Noma ilungu leBhodi elifuna ukukhansela ubulungu balo kufanele lithumele isaziso esibhaliwe sokukhansela esibhalwe kuMongameli, futhi iBhodi kufanele yamukele lesi saziso uma zonke izikweletu ezidingekayo zikhokhiwe. Uma isikhala selungu leBhodi siba singenalutho ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi salo lungu, uNgqongqoshe, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-subsection 1, kufanele aqashe umuntu ophakanyiswe yiBhodi ukuze agcwalise leso sikhala phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 zokungabi nalutho. IBhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwezinhlelo, ingasebenzisa amandla noma iqhube noma iyiphi imisebenzi yeCentre ebekwe kuyo yiBhodi. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalo ku-subsection 1 lizoba nezinye amalungu eCentre kanye nabasebenzi beCentre abathathwa njengabafanele yiBhodi, uma kukhona, iBhodi ingase isuse noma ibuyisele ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanele. Uma ikomidi linamalungu angaphezu kwelilodwa, iBhodi kufanele iqashe ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe ngumholi walelo komidi.

Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu, futhi kwakhula ukungalingani phakathi kwezigaba zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-Apartheid ngonyaka ka-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yathola ithuba lokwakha uhlelo lwezintela olusha, olwakhelwe phezu kokulingana nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinga lentela laqala ukwenyuka, kodwa kwaba nezinhlelo eziningi zokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Umthetho wezezimali wathuthukiswa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinga lentela lihlala lilingana, futhi uhulumeni waqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala ukuze athuthukise izimo zokuphila zabantu. Eminyakeni edlule, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala lishintsha, kuxhomeke ezimweni zomnotho. Ngonyaka ka-2018, uhulumeni waphakamisa izinga lentela eliphezulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga eziningi, njengoba abanye abantu bephikisana nezinguquko ezazenziwa. Kodwa-ke, izinga lentela lihlala linomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi nabakhiqizi bayakwazi ukuphila kahle, uhulumeni uhlele izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukwandisa izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nokwenza ngcono izinhlelo zokunakekela impilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala liphakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu. Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi.

Okwamanje, izindaba ze-wheat zibhaliwe kuphela ngesiNgisi nangesiSesotho futhi zizohlukaniswa nePula-Imvula eFree State. Esicelweni sethu kuWinter Cereals Trust, sicele usizo ngomsebenzi esifuna ukuwenzela ukusiza abalimi abasha be-wheat e-Eastern Free State naseCentral Free State. Sizobeka izindawo ezimbili zokubonisa - eyodwa eModderpoort, eduze kweLadybrand, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentshonalanga, kanti enye eGlen, eduze kweBloemfontein, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentral. Inhloso yokubeka lezi zindawo zokubonisa ukuveza nokufundisa abalimi ukuthi yiziphi izindlela zokulima ezinhle - ukulima ngendlela yokugcina umswakama emhlabathini phakathi nezinyanga zokuqala, ukukhetha izinhlobonhlobo ezifanele, inani leziphuzo ngehektare, inani lefertilizer, nokuphatha izitshalo nezifo - kuhle ukuva ngalezi zinto, kodwa kuhle kakhulu ukuzibona ukuze uqonde ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani kahle. Kukhona izincwadi eziningi ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho kunetha khona ngesikhathi sehlobo, kodwa sithathe umqondo wokuhlanganisa incwadi yokuhola (ikhasi lokuhola) ezobhekana ngqo nezinkinga zabafundi abasha kulezi zindawo. Le ncwadi izochaza kabanzi izindlela zokugcina umswakama emhlabathini - okubaluleke kakhulu kunanoma yini enye ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat ezindaweni ezithola imvula yehlobo kuphela. Le ncwadi izoba nezahluko ezizoxoxa ngembewu, isimo sesitshalo se-wheat, izidingo zokudla kwe-wheat, izindlela zokubeka ezizohambelana nokukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, inani leziphuzo nezikhathi zokubeka, izindlela zokulawula izitshalo ngesikhathi izitshalo zisakhula, ukuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuvuna, ukuhlukanisa, nokumaketha.

Thola: Kufanele ube nekhono, ithuba elihle lingavela nganoma isiphi isikhathi, kufanele ulibone! Thola: Zama ungazithwesi kakhulu ngezinto ezahlukene ngoba uzolahlekelwa ithuba elibalulekile elidingekayo ukuze ukhiqize kahle. Njengoba abakhiqizi bezinhlamvu bephupha njalo ukuthi unyaka ozayo uzoba ngcono, bakha umsebenzi wabo unyaka nonyaka. Ngesikhathi esifushane, kungenzeka kube nethuba lokuqhubeka mhlawumbe kanye ngonyaka. Abakhiqizi bavame ukuphuthelwa amathuba okunciphisa izindleko nokuvimbela ukulahleka kokukhiqiza ngoba baphuthelwa ithuba lapho kusen isikhathi. Amathuba amahle angavela ngesikhathi sokulungiselela ukutshala kanye nakuzo zonke izikhathi lapho izitshalo zikhula. Vula amehlo akho ukuze ubone izinto ezinhle ezithengiswa ngamanani aphansi. Qaphela kakhulu ngesikhathi sokukhula ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinto ozisebenzisayo epulazini zisebenza kahle noma cha. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukukhetha izinto ezizokwenza kahle. Ikhadi lokuthengisa elinamanani aphansi lingaba usizo olukhulu kusasa. Lokhu kuyithuba elivame ukuphuthelwa yizinkulungwane zabafuyi. Ngokuvamile, imishini engalungiswanga kahle idala ukulahleka kwesikhathi, ivimbela ukutshala ngesikhathi. Ekupheleni kokutshala, isikhathi esihle sokuhlola nokulungisa imishini yakho. Ngemva kokulungisa nokuvimbela ukuwa, kufanele ibekwe endaweni ezoyivikela kwezinye izingozi. Ngokufanayo, akufanele kuthathe isikhathi ukulungisa imishini lapho isikhathi sokutshala sifika, futhi izindleko zizoba phansi. Lapho isikhathi sokutshala sifika, kufanele wazi ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, uzokwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho kahle. Uma kuvela imvula enamandla, kungaba yingozi enkulu ezitshalweni. Uma umhlabathi uphume, awukwazi ukuwubuyisela.

c izizathu noma izinsolo zemicabango kaMongameli noma uNdunankulu wesiFundazwe. Amaqembu ezombusazwe ammelwe eSishayamthetho sikaZwelonke noma esiFundazweni esithintekayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye anelungelo lokwenza iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe neziqondene nodaba, inqobo uma zethulwe ngesikhathi esinqunywe emiyalelweni ebekwe emtheshwaneni -4. b ukubiza zonke izinhlangothi zamaqembu ezombusazwe anentshisekelo kwiSishayamthetho sikaZwelonke noma esiFundazweni esithintekayo abafisa ukwenza njalo ukwethula iziphakamiso zabo ezibhaliwe ngoba zibalulekile ekunqumeni udaba ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esinqunywe kule miyalelo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isicelo esenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba -801 no -1221 soMthethosisekelo emalungeni Omkhandlu kaZwelonke noma isiShayamthetho sesiFundazwe siyokhishwa ngesaziso senhloso yokuthatha isinyathelo siphelezelwa wumbiko ofungelwe ngezizathu eziyisisekelo zalokho ummangali afuna ukuncika kukho ngesikhathi sokulalelwa kodaba, lesi sicelo siyothulwa kuNobhala futhi sinikwe uSomlomo Womkhandlu kaZwelonke, uma kudingekile noSihlalo woMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe noma uSomlomo wesiShayamthetho esithintekayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isaziso siyocela uSomlomo, uma kufanele uSihlalo Womkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe azise ngokubhaliwe wonke amaqembu ezombusazwe ammelwe ngesicelo endlini efanele noma esishayamthetho zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu ethole leso sicelo.

I-LiEP ibhekene nalezi zindaba ezifana nolimi/nezilimi zokufunda nokufundisa ezikolweni zikahulumeni, ohlelweni lwezifundo lwesikole, kanye nasemisebenzini ephathelene nolimi kuminyango yemfundo yezifunda kanye nezinhlangano eziphethe esikoleni. UmThethosisekelo kanye nemithetho ehambisana nawo kubonakala kahle ukuthi kusekela ukuthuthukiswa kobuliminingi eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlaka lwenqubomgomo kumele luvumele ukulinganisa ngokwanele ukuhlanganisa inqubomgomo yolimi kuzo zontathu izigaba zikahulumeni futhi luveze ngokucacile ukuthi inqubomgomo imephi ngezinga nangokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zaseNingizimu Afrika. Inqubomgomo yolimi iyakunaka ukwenza komthethosisekelo wobuliminingi futhi iyavumelana nezinjongo zikahulumeni phezu komnotho, ezenhlalakahle kanye nokukhula ngemfundo. kuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kahle kolimi nokuphathwa kahle kwezemisebenzi yomphakathi ukuhlangabezana nokulindelwe ngamakhasimende kanye nezidingo. Kukhulisa ukucatshangelwa kwabantu uma kwenziwa izinto ezithandwa ngabantu, izidingo kanye nezifiso zemiphakathi yezilimi eziningi ngokukhulumisana kanye nenkulumo-mpikiswano eqhubekayo. Ukuthuthukisa ubuliminingi eNingizimu Afrika kudinga imizamo enganciphisa ulwazi oseluvele lukhona emiphakathini lapho izilimi ezisemthethweni zendabuko zibaluleke kakhulu . Loku kuzakwenziwa ngokusebenzisa nangokubandakanywa kwemiphakathi njengababamba iqhaza ezinqutsheni zokuthuthukiswa kolimi. Ilindeleke ukuthi izibandakanya nezingcweti zolimi ukunceda ukuthuthukisa indlela yokwenza izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zobuliminingi ngokwenza uhlolo kanye nokusakazwa kokutholiwe.

Iyona ebeka uhlaka lwesabelo sikaMasipala bese, ihlanganyela nesiphathi mandla esikhulu sezezimali, nophethe umnyango ukuvuma izabelo zezimali zeminyango. Emva kokuthi yonke imibono, iziphakamiso nezincomosezicutshungiwe, isabelo sezimali sibe sesethulwaemkhandlwini ukuze usivume. Lokhu kumele kwenzeke okungenani izinsuku ezingu 30 ngaphambi kokuqalakonyaka wezimali. Umkhandlu kemele futhi usamukelengaphambi kokuqala konyaka wezimali. Uma umkhandlu ususamukele isabelo sokugcinaisiphathimandla esikhulu kumele sisethule kuNgqogqoshewezizimali zingakapheli izinsuku eziyishumi nane. Isiphathimandla Esikhulu Sezimali isona esilungisa lombikookumele siqhathanise imali esetshenzisiwe naleyo esesabelweni. Umahluko phakathi kwalokhu okubili kubizwa ngokuthiokwahlukile. Kungakuhle ukuthi umahluko ungabibikho kodwalokhu akuvamile ukwenzeka. Ukuhlanganyela komphakathi ekwakheni uhlelo oludidinyelwelwentuthuko nesabelo sezimali zoHulumeni basekhayakubalulekile, nanjengoba izimali zingekho. Kunikeza abantuithuba lokubeka izidingo nezibono futhi libenze bangeneleleohlelweni lokubeka lokho abafuna kuqalwe ngakho. Lokhu okulandelayo ezinye zezindlela imiphakathi engabambangazo iqhaza esabelweni sezimali zikaMasipala. Ngokukhokhela izinsiza ezilethwa uMasipala njenga manzi, nogesi, ngesikhathi esifanele nyanga zonke. Ngokunikeza imibono uma kusakhiwa isabelo sezimalizikaMasipala. Ukuze bawenze kahle umsebenzi wabo, ngendlela enolwazi, amakhansela anelungelo lokuthola ulwazi lwezezimali nezibucikokubaphathi bakaMasipala.

Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho intsha ingakwazi ukufinyelela emisebenzini, futhi ibone ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi intsha ibone ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi umphakathi wethu ube ngcono. Ngakho-ke, asithathe isinyathelo sokuxhasa intsha, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukungasebenzi kwentsha akuyona inkinga engathathwa kalula, kodwa uma sihlanganyela, singakwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza umehluko.

ubuchwepheshe bolimi lwabantu Ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lolimi ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zekhompyutha ezingabona, zihumushe, futhi zikhiphe ulimi lwesintu ngazo zonke izindlela; njengokuthuthukisa okusetshenziswayo okwenza ukuthi kukwazeke ukuthi abantu basebenzisane namakhompyutha. izilimi zoMdabu Ulimi olungelabahlali balelo zwe. ukuhumusha Isenzo sokudlulisa inkulumo ukusuka kolunye ulimi uye kolunye. ukuqapha ulimi Ukuqaphela ukuthi ulimi lusetshenziswa kanjani esizweni, ukuthi abasebenzisi bolimi bayawazi yini amalungelo olwimi, nokuthi ulwimi lusetshenziswa kanjani ukukhuphula amandla nokuphinde ubehlise. ukulinganisa ulimi Ngokomthethosisekelo, zonke izilimi kumele zithole ukuhlonishwa okulinganayo. ezisemthethweni ezinjenge zishayamthetho, ezobulungisa, ukuphatha kanye nokuqondiswa komphakathi. ukulinganisa ulimi Ukunikezwa ngokulinganayo kanye /noma ukuphathwa kwezilimi ezimbili noma ezingaphezulu . Izinto ezifana nenani labakhulumi kanye nesimo solwimi esingenza inqubomgomo inqume lapho kungasetshenziswa khona ulimi oluthize . Loku kusetshenziswa angeke kulingane . "(A) umbuso angeke usebenzise ngempumelelo izilimi zazo zonke izakhamuzi futhi ungahle uzibophelele ngokusebenzisana ngolimi noma izilimi zawo ezisemthethweni, noma izilimi ezithize ngandlela thize" (Turi, 1993:14 - 15). ukuhlela ulimi Ukuhlelwa kolimi kubhekene nezimpendulo zezinkinga zolimi ngokuthola ezinye izindlela kanye nemiphumela . Ukufakelela izinqubo zokuqondisisa kanye nokwenza kangcono izilimi ngokuthuthukisa ulimi.

Uma isicelo sokurekhoda senziwe futhi irekhodi silungisiwe ukuze sikhishwe, kuhlanganise nanoma yiziphi amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo, kudinga amahora ngaphezu kwalawo abekiwe emthethweni ngenhloso, uMenenja Yolwazi uzokwazisa umfaki-sicelo ukuthi akhokhe, njengediphozi, ingxenye ebekiwe yemali yokufinyelela okudingeka ikhokhwe uma isicelo sivunywa. UMenenja Yolwazi uzogcina irekhodi kuze kube isikhathi lapho umfaki-sicelo ekhokha izimali ezibekiwe. Uma idiphozi ikhokhiwe mayelana nesicelo sokufinyelela esinquelekile, khona-ke uMenenja Yolwazi ophathwayo uzobuyisela idiphozi kumfaki-sicelo. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo, ukuthi ivume noma inqabe isicelo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Isikhathi esingu-30 sezinsuku lapho i-SAMSA kumele yenze isinqumo sokuvuma noma sokwenqaba isicelo singandiswe sibe esinye isikhathi ngokuhambisana noMthetho 26.

Amalungu e-NHC awazotholi umholo wanyanga zonke kodwa azokhokhelwa izindleko ezithathwe emsebenzini wabo ne-NHC. Amalungu azothola futhi uphawu lokubonga ngempumelelo yabo. Ikhompuyutha yokukhetha izosungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze idale uhlu lweziphakanyisiwe zayo yonke indawo, kulandelwe izingxoxo zomphakathi nezasezifundazweni. Incazelo yeKomidi esunguliwe izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kuhlanganisa wakhiwo ezivela kuzo zonke izigaba ze-heritage kazwelonke, zonke izindawo, nobulili bobabili, nokuthi ukukhethwa okuphelele kusezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu. Ikhompuyutha yokukhetha izozisa uhlu lwezithakazelo ezingu-15 kuNgqongqoshe, ozokwenza ukukhethwa kokugcina kwe-NHC kulolu hlu. Okungenani amalungu amahlanu e-NHC angakhethwa ngale ndlela, futhi i-MEC enesibopho sefa lemvelo nokuvikelwa kwazo zonke izifundazwe kumele ikhethe ummeleli oyedwa kulowo mhlaba. a Incwadi equkethe amagama aphelele, ikheli, izinombolo zocingo, nezifakazelo zabaphakanyisiwe, kanye nezizathu zokuphakanyiswa kwabo. b I-curriculum vitae noma umlando ophathelene nezimpilo zomphakanyisi ochaza iziqu zabo zokubekwa. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe, esibonisa ukuvuma kokuphakanyiswa. d Amagama nezixhumanisi zababoni ababili. Akukho ukuphakanyiswa okuzokwamukelwa uma konke okukhulunywe ngenhla kungafakiwe. Ukuphakanyiswa kumele kufike kuMphakathi Osebenzayo, uMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, ngaphambi kosuku lwe-14 kuFebhuwari 2003.

Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika 1. Isingeniso Umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika ubonakale ukhula ngokushesha eminyakeni edlule. Lokhu kukhula kubangelwa yizizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukwanda kwezidingo zamakhasimende, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. Le dokhumenti izobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nokukhula komkhakha wama-call centre, izinzuzo, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta lo mkhakha. Izizathu Zokukhula 2.1 Ubuchwepheshe Obuthuthukisiwe Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wama-call centre. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-CRM (Customer Relationship Management), zenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izingcingo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwenza ama-call centre akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende ngokushesha. 2.2 Ukukhula Kwezidingo Zamakhasimende Njengoba izinkampani zikhula, zidinga izinsizakalo ezinhle zokuxhumana namakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwama-call centre, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende athola usizo olusheshayo nolusezingeni eliphezulu. 2.3 Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umsebenzi Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umsebenzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, zikhuthaza ukukhula komkhakha.
