a ahlole futhi acaphune kulokho okubhaliwe emaphepheni okuhlola ngezikhathi zomsebenzi; bese b afake isaziso sokuphikisana nomphathi kamasipalati mayelana nanoma yiluphi udaba oluvela noma olungafakiwe kulawa maphepha. ukuphikisa ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- 1 b kufanele kuhambisane naleyo naleyo mpahla hhayi iphepha ngqo lokuhlola. umphathi kamasipalati kufanele elekelele lowo ophikisayo ukubhala isaziso salolu hlobo uma lowo ophikisayo engakwazi ukufunda kanye nokubhala. umkhandlu kamasipalati ungase ufake isaziso sokuphikisa umphathi kamasipalati mayelana nanoma yiluphi udaba oluvela noma olweqiwe ephepheni lokuhlola. umphathi kamasipalati kufanele athumele zonke izaziso zokuphikisa kumhloli kamasipalati ngaphandle kokuthandabuza, yena oyobe esethatha isinqumo sokudalula lezo zaziso ngokulandisa kwesigaba. ukufakwa kwesicelo sokuphikisa akusho ukwelulelwa isikhathi sokhokha intela yendawo sedlule leso ebesinqunyiwe. b athathe izinqumo mayelana nezimpikiswano ngokulandela amaphuzu, kubandakanya amaphuzu ethulwe yilowo ophikisayo, nokuthi uma umuntu ophikisayo engeyena umnikazi; aphinde c ahlele amaphepha okuhlola ngokulandela izinqumo ezithathiwe.

Lokhu kuyakhathaza ngoba sidinga imvume yoHulumeni ukuze siqhubeke phambili ngesikhathi esifanele ngokuvota nokunye. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngoba abaholi abakhombisi kahle indlela yokuhamba phambili mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Kodwa kubalulekile ukucabangela lezi zinto ezingaba yingozi mayelana nekusasa elide - ingabe singacabanga kuphela ngezingozi ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo esiseduze? I-Grain SA ibona ukuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel njengethuba likahulumeni lokwakha umoya wokubambisana ekudonseni izimali ezweni, futhi kufanele bavunyelwe ukuba bashiye izimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezinkinga ezifana nezitifiketi, imithetho, nezinye izithiyo ezivimbela izindlela zokusebenzisa umkhiqizo njengoba sifuna. Uma sibheka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokutshala, siqaphela ukuthi ushukela akuwona kuphela umkhiqizo wokudla ongasebenzisa ukukhiqiza i-bio-fuel, futhi akufanele sizame ukuqhathanisa izimo zomhlabathi nezimo zezulu nezinye izindawo eziseningizimu. Kunezimakethe eziningi ze-bio-fuel eduze kwezindawo ezikhiqiza ummbila nezinsimbi ezweni lethu, nasezindaweni lapho kukhona ukudla njenge-barley, i-triticale, noma i-wheat ezingasekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel. Ukuze sivalwe umgomo phakathi kokuhlinzekwa kokudla nokuthi yini ebiza kakhulu, kufanele sithole ukuqhubeka okuzoletha inzuzo enhle kubakhiqizi. Uma kuvunyelwe ukuba sithuthuke ngokukhululekile, sikholelwa ukuthi iminikelo ekukhiqizeni i-bio-fuel izovuselela ikhono lokukhulisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo.

Lesisimo sokukhuphuka kwamanani okudla sibabuhlungu kakhulu uma sithola ukuthi emazweni athuthukile abalimi bakhona basekwa kakhulu ngoHulumeni babo ngezimali ngemikhiqizo yezolimo abayikhiqizayo okwenza isimo sokuwhebelana singalingani. Lokhu ngizibonele ngamehlo ami njengoba emasontweni amabili edlule bengiseBelgium entshonalanga ye Europe. Ngokusho kwezazi nongoti kulomkhakha wezolimo, lesiSifundazwe sakithi KwaZulu-Natali uma siqhathaniswa nalezi ezinye eziyisishiyagalombili yiso esihamba phambili ngokuba nomhlabathi ovunde kakhulu siphinde futhi sibenenhlanhla ukuthi siyakwazi ukubamba amanzi emvula ezindaweni ezahlukene zaso isifundazwe. Lokhu-nje kokubili (umhlabathi ovundile kanye nenala yamanzi emvula) kucacisa kuthi bha ukuthi empeleni yithi okumele ngabe sondla lelizwe lakithi eNingizimu Africa. Kodwa-ke ngenxa yobuvila kanye nalomkhuba ongemuhle oya ngokudlanga wokuthi abantu bathi bazohlala ngokukhangeza kuHulumeni sizithola sibhekene nomqansa uma sizama ukukhuthaza abantu bakithi ukuthi mabasebenzise inhlabathi ukuze baziphilise. Bakwethu impilo iya ngokuqina iba nzima. Namhlanje umphongolo kawoyela ubiza imali ethi ayibe yikhulu namashumi amathathu amadola aseMelika kanti bekungekudala lapho wona umphongolo lona ububiza-nje amashumi amathathu amadola aseMelika. Lokhu kunyuka kwentengo kawoyela sekube nomthelela omubi kumanani okudla kanye nokutholakala kwakho. Ukudla esingathi simele sikudle njalo ukuze sihlale siphilile sondlekile (basic staple food such as rice, flour and maize) njenge rice, imikhiqizo eyenziwa ngokolweni kanye nommbila kubiza ngendlela exakile. Kungagcini lapho, ngisho namafutha okupheka noma lokhu esithi ukalakateni namhlanje abiza into enganambithisiseki.

Isibonelo, eminyakeni emihlanu eyedlule ezweni laseMelika imisebenzi eminingi iqhamuke kumabhizinisi amancane asanda kuqala. Sekwande umkhuba wokuthi izinkampani ezinkulu zisebenzise amakhono ezinkampani ezincane ukufeza izinhloso ezithile zabo, ngaleyo ndlela ke kudaleka amthuba omsebenzi kubantu abangaphandle kuleyonkampani.ENingizimu Afrika osomabhizinisi abancane baye balinganiswa nezikhungo ezinkulu zokusebenza, kanti lokho kuyiphutha. Buka ngoba izinkampani eziningi zamacomputer nobuchwepheshe esezizakhele udumo ngempumelelo emazweni angaphandle yizinkampanii ezincane impela. Izinkampani ezintsha ezincane futhi zisemweni esikahle impela ukuba zithuthukise ulwazi oluisha lobuchwepheshe nokuhlola imbuyiselo nomthelela emnothweni imiphumela yokwenza okuphathelene nentuthuko. Lenhloso yakhelwe ukuba amehlo abheke iqhaza elimqoka elingabanjwa ngamafemu amancane emnothweni wezwe. Lenhloso ikhombisa ngokusobala izinjongo zoMnyango wezaBasebenzi zokuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane awashiywa ngaphandle ezinhlelweni zentuthuko. Akwaziwe kusemanjena ke ukuthi kuzokuba umsebenzi omningi nokho ukuqondisisa ukusebenza kwamabhizinisi amancane kwizinhlangothi ezehlukahlukene zomnotho, kanye nohlobo losizo oluzokudingwa yilamabhizinisi ukuze akhule futhi afake nokubonakalayo emnothweni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuyingxenyana nje yesu lokugqugquzela ukuqalwa kwamabhizinisi nokusizwa kwezinkampani ezincane ukuba zidlondlobale. Amabhizinisi amancane kufanele akwazi ukuboleka imali, athole ukusekelwa nokwelulekwa nosizo oluphathelene nokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo, ukukhangisa lowomkhiqizo nokuwudayisa emazweni angaphandle.

Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal Isifo sofuba, esaziwa nangokuthi i-tuberculosis (TB), singenye yezifo ezibulalayo ezivame kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kubangelwa yizinto eziningi ezifana nezindawo zokuhlala ezivulekile nezingcolile, ukungena kwezinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokushoda kwemisebenzi. Ukuze kuqedwe lokhu, uhulumeni waseKwaZulu-Natal, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele, bahlele izinhlelo ezahlukene zokulwa nesifo sofuba. Okokuqala, imfundo iyinsika ebalulekile ekulweni nesifo sofuba. Izinhlelo zokuqwashisa umphakathi ziqhutshelwa phambili ngendlela yokwazisa abantu ngezimbangela, izimpawu, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela lesi sifo. Iminyaka edlule ibonise ukuthi uma umphakathi unolwazi olwaneleyo, kubalulekile ekwenzeni kube nokuncipha kokushaqeka kwemiphumela yesifo. Uhlelo olukhona luhlanganisa ukudlulisela ulwazi ezinkampanini, ezikoleni, nasezikhungweni zokwelashwa, okwenza abantu bakwazi ukuhlonipha izizathu zokuvakasha kumaphoyisa wezempilo. Okwesibili, kwesinye sezinyathelo ezibalulekile, uhulumeni uhlela uhlelo lwezokwelapha oluhlanganisa ukwelashwa kumahhala kwabo bonke abathola isifo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba isifo sofuba sithinta ikakhulukazi abantu abahlala ezindleleni eziphansi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kumaphayiphi emithi yamahhala eluthathwa khona, okusiza ukubuyisela amandla kwabaphila nesifo lokhu, okwenza kube lula ukubagqokisa abathola usizo. Uhlaka lokuxhaswa kwezemiti lubuyekezwa njalo emihlanganweni yakhe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izinga lokulashwa lisebenze kahle.

Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Umsebenzi Wokuphepha Kwendawo Nokuphila Komuntu Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo yazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo. Kuwo wonke umhlaba, itholakala emithonjeni ehlukene, kufaka phakathi izifudlana, imifula, nezindawo eziphilayo. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukene ezifana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, imikhuba yokuphila, kanye nokungcoliswa, ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile sekuba yinkinga ezweni lonke, futhi ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo kakhulu. Ukwazi ukubaluleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokuqhubekayo kokuhlelwa kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. NgokweZinhlelo Zenkampani Yezempilo Yomphakathi, amanzi ahlanzekile ayasiza ekugwemeni izifo ezithathelwana emanzini, okwenza kube nezidingo eziqinile zokwenziwa kohlaka lokuphathwa kwamanzi. Izinhlaka ezisemthethweni kumele ziqinise imizamo yokuphatha amanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, kanye nokwehlisa ubugebengu bokungcolisa. Ukuze kuzuze imiphakathi, abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile akupheleli kuphela ekuphileni kahle, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, okusikhombisa ukuthi inhlanzeko yamanzi ibalulekile ekulondolozweni kwemiphakathi futhi ibaluleke kakhulu emithonjeni yemvelo. Ikhwalithi yamanzi ayancikile kuphela kumaphuzu okutholakala, kodwa futhi ivumela inkululeko yokuphila. Ukuze ubheke lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithi: "Amanzi ahlanzekile anika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo." Lokhu kusho ukunciphisa izingozi zokugula, ukukhulisa ukwandisa umkhiqizo kanye nezinga lempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ezindaweni ezinezinsiza eziphansi, lapho kwenziwa khona izinhlelo ezihlose ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile.

Isicelo okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 1 siyophelezelwa yimali efanele enqunywe yiNgxenye 187. Lokho okushiwo uMthethonkambiso 108.06.1 no 2 kuyosebenza kulowo onesitifiketi okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 1. a ngemuva kokuhlolwa nocwaningo olwenziwe ngaphansi kwale Ngxenye, kubonakala ukuthi lowo onemvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa akahambisani nezidingo ezinqunywe kule ngxenye futhi lowo onesitifiketi uyehluleka ukulungisa iphutha noma ukulandela okushiwo yile Ngxenye zingakapheli izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu ngemuva kokuthola isaziso esibhaliwe esivela kumhloli noma kulowo ogunyazelwe lomsebenzi; noma b isikhulu esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma isisebenzi esifanele sivinjelwe ngumuntu onemvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa ukuba siqhube uphenyo noma ucwaningo ngaphansi kwale ngxenye; noma c ukumiswa kudingekile ukuze kuphephiswe noma kufezwe ezokuphepha. Isisebenzi esinegunya, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyaziwe omise imvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 1 uyothula umbiko obhaliwe kuKhomishani lapho echaza khona izizathu zokuthi kungani ngokubona kwakhe kufanele kwesulwe ukumiswa kwemvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa kufanele kwesulwe. Isisebenzi esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyaziwe othintekayo uyothula noma anike umfanekiso wombiko okukhulunywa ngawo kumthethonkambiso 2 kulowo onemvume noma onesitifiketi sokugunyazwa esimisiwe kanye nobufakazi bokwedlulisa umbiko kuKhomishani.

B. Abantu Abadala nomthelela ekwehliseni ukuphatheka kabi, ukukhathala kanye nokungaphatheki kahle okwehlisa umkhiqizo. Kuhlongozwa ukuba kusungulwe amaqembu abasebenzi ukuze kwenziwe lula ukuzimbandakanya. Izinhlelo zabasebenzi zemidlalo zingasiza futhi ukuba yizizinda zokuvumbulula amathalente, nokuthuthukisa imincintiswano yezemidlalo. Lokhu kuyodinga ukubambisana kwezinhlangano zabasebenzi. Ukusungula uhlelo lokwenza umsebenzi ovelele okuhloswe ngakho ukuba kulungiselelwe imiqhudelwano yezemidlalo emikhulu yabakhethiweyo. Izingqalazisinda ezinhle kwezesayensi nolwazi zibonakala njengokuyizona ezisemqoka ekwenzeni umsebenzi ovelele. Ukuqiniseka ukuthi yonke imigwamanda yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka iyahlangabezana nezimpokophelo zayo zokubhekela labo abenganakiwe ngaphambilini. Njengamanje amaqembu eziFundazwe nakaZwelonke awakhombisi ukwehlukana kwezinhlanga noma ubulili (lapho kunokwenzeka khona), kwalapha eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokucacile umongo othi "ezemidlalo zabo bonke" uthathelwe egugwini lokulingana nokufinyeleleka, okungafezeka kuphela ngemizamo yezinhlelo zokuhlanganisa ezizombandakanya abantu abavela emphakathini eyayinganakiwe. Ukwenza ukusebenza (ukufeza obekuphokophelwe) kube yiyonanto ezosentshenziswa uma kuthathwa izinqumo ngokwabiwa kwezidingo ezifana nezimali. Uma ngabe impumelelo itholakala ngokuhlinzekela ingxenye engama- 20 ekhulwini yabantu, ngabe ukuhlinzekela wonke umuntu (100%) kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu? Imigomo yokuziphatha mayelana nokwenzelana ngobuqotho kusemqoka kakhulu kuyo yonke imigwamanda yezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ukusentshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ezingavunyelwe nokuziphatha.

Umsebenzisi ofinyelela kulezi zinhlelo kumele alandele imiyalo ethile yokuphepha. Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa Ukufinyelela Kwezempilo Ukuze abafuna ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo bakwazi ukwenza kanjalo, kufanele kube nemigomo eqinile yokubopha ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamakhodi avikelekile, lapho kuphela abanolwazi lokufinyelela abavunyelwe ukufinyelela kulezi zinhlelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi alufinyeleli kubantu abangafanele. Isigaba 4: Ukuqwashisa Nokuqeqesha Abasebenzi Kubantu abasebenzi, kubalulekile ukwazi izinqubo ezimqoka zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha, ezifana ne-workshops, ama-seminars, kanye nemihlangano ebukhoma. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kumele kube njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bahlala beqaphele. Isigaba 5: Ukuphendula Izimo Zokuphula Ubumfihlo Uma kwenzeka izimo eziphula ubumfihlo, kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela iphendulwa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Uhlelo lokuphendula kumele lubeke izinqubo ezicacile, ukuze ulwazi lwezempilo lungatholakali kalula. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinsizwa eziyiqeqeshelwe ukwenza ukuhlola nokuphendula ezimeni ezingalindelekile. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlanganisa Izibuyekezo Nokuhlolwa Kwenqubo Ukuze sithuthukise ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola futhi ziqhube izibuyekezo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, nokubuyekezwa njalo kwemigomo yokuvikeleka.

Asebekhulile abebexegiselwe isibopho sokukhokha ngokwelungelo qobo bazoqhubeka basizakale kuze kufike ukuklanywa jikelele kwamanani okulandelayo ngo-2012. abe ngumnikazi obhalisiwe wendlu ahlala kuyo njengomnikazi. uma behlanganyele ubunikazi, bonke abanikazi kufanele bafeze imibandela yokufaneleka eku-7.2 noma 7.3. e umnikazi kufanele kube ngohlala ngokugcwele kulowo mhlaba; f ama-akhawunti amanzi, ugesi namarates kumele abe ndawonye egameni lomnikazi; g inani lomhlaba wokuhlala kumele lingeqi kwelikhonjwe nguMkhandlu emhlanganweni wawo wonyaka wolwabiwo mali h ohlelweni lokusingathelwa ifa, umsingathi wefa kumele afeze yonke imibandela engenhla. Kumele kuvezwe nekhophi yetayitela. i abaphathi bamafa afelwe ngabaniniwo, abawabayo kanye nabasingathi bawo kababaliwe ekuxegiselweni isibopho sokukhokha. ukuncishiselwa izimali kwasebekhulile kuyonqamuka: a uma ofake isicelo eshona; b kufakwa isicelo seRevenue Clearance Certificate esiholela ekwedluleleni kobunikazi bomuzi komunye umuntu; c lapho ofake isicelo engasahlali ngokugcwele kulowo muzi. ofake isicelo engasahlali kulowo muzi ngokugcwele. d Abanikazi amarates abo aseke ahlehliswa phambilini futhi abazanelisayo izidingo bangazifaka izicelo zokuxegiselwa kwasebekhulile ezibalulwe ku-7.2 ngenhla maqondana nama-rates abo okufanele akhokhwe. ukuhlangabezana nemibandela efanele bangafaka izicelo zokuncishiselwa imali zabahola impesheni ngokuka-7.2 ngenhla, kuma-rates abo abawakhokhayo. e Ukufaka isicelo sokuncishiselwa imali kumisa ukumiswa kwamarates kwangomuso.

Uhulumeni uqale uhlelo lokwabelana ngama-parcel okudla emindenini ehluphekayo kakhulu. Kubalwe ukuthi uhulumeni uzosebenzisa u-R230 million kulo nyaka ukusiza emindenini engu-200,000 ebhekene nezinkinga zokuphila ukuze ifinyelele ekudleni okunempilo ngenkathi iphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka ezinzima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imindeni enezingane. Okwamanje, kunezimuli eziyi-12,000 ezithola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Iminye imindeni izothola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo oluzoqala ngoMashi 2003. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ekudleni okunempilo okugcwele ama-vitamini nezinto ezidingekayo (ukuthuthukiswa kokudla). Izigaba zezeMidlalo, Ezolimo, Ezempilo, Ezemfundo, Uhlelo Lokuxhumana Nohulumeni (GCIS), iNational Development Agency, kanye ne-Independent Development Trust zisebenze ndawonye nezinhlelo zokholo, izinyunyana, umkhakha wezokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo ezingekho kuhulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imindeni ehluphekayo inekudla. Ukuhumusha okuncedwa ngumshini, iqoqa lamagama okuhumusha, izinhloli zesipelingi)kulezi zilimi zendabuko kuzawudlala indima enkulu emisebenzini yokwenza lula ulimi. 3.5 Ubukhulu obukhethiwe beyunithi yolimi buzawunqunywa nokuqeqeshelwa amakhono kule ndawo kuzawubekwa phambili emva kokunakwa kwenani lezilimi nezisemthethweni okumele zisetshenziswe. Amayunithi aqukethe abasebenzi abayizingcweti abane noma abangaphezulu, azodinga onobhala. 3.6 Ukwakhiwa kwamakhono ezindaweni eziboniwe zokwenziwa lula kolimi kuzokwenzeka ngokubambisana okunamathelene nabanikazi balo msebenzi njengezakhiwo zemfundo ephakeme enikeza izinhlelo ezamukelwa yi-SAQA kanye nezifundo zokusebenza ngolimi, ukuhumusha, ukuhlela, ukutolika, ukuhlela ulimi, ukuqanjwa nokuqoqwa kwamagama amasha (itheminografi) kanye isayensi yokwakhiwa kwezichazamagama (neleksikhografi). 4.1 Isigaba esiqhubekayo ekusebenziseni lenqubomgomo esikhathini esifushane, esilingene kanye nasesikhathini eside yindlela encomekayo kuzo zonke izigaba. 4.2 Mayelana nemibhalo kahulumeni, ukwenziwa kwayo kuzawubekwa ngendlela eguqulwa kalula kanye nephathekayo kuzakhiwo zikahulumeni esikhathini esingaba okungenani iminyaka emithathu. Ubuhle ngokwenziwa kancane kancane komzimba wemisebenzi ukuthi iminyango izokwazi ukuthuthukiswa ulwazi olwengeziwe futhi aphathe lendlela yokwenza ngempumelelo enkulu. 4.3 Izakhiwo zikahulumeni zizokuba nesikhathi sokuhlela izinhlelo mali ngokongeza kancane kancane ukunikezwa kwezimali esikhathini se-MTEF nemisebenzi yokuhlela ngokuhambisana nezinsiza ezidingekayo ekusebenziseni ngempumelelo lenqubomgomo.

Izincwadi zendiza okufanele zigcinwe ngendlela elandela umgomo 43.1.3 ziyolondolozwa isikhathi esingekho ngaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusuka osukwini okuhlakazwe ngalo uhlaka lwendiza, injini noma uphephela: Kungenzeka uKhomishani anqume isikhathi esingaphezulu sokugcina incwadi yendiza, injini noma uphephela wendiza elimale engozini. Kunezincomo zokungashiyi izincwadi zendiza kuyona uqobo. Uma kwenzeka imibandela yomgonyana 3 isebenza noma izincwadi zifunelwa inhloso yokulungisa indiza futhi ingekho enye indlela yokwedlulisa lezo zincwadi zendiza, izincwadi ziyobe sezifakwa kuyo uqobo leyo ndiza. Uma indiza ithengiswa kwelinye izwe futhi ithunyelwa nezincwadi zayo, umbhalo ofanayo wezincwadi ezikhombisa indlela enzulu elungiswe ngayo nokunye ukukhanda kanye namaphutha alungiswe esinyangeni eziyisithupha ezidlule, kufanele igcinwe yilowo oyidayisayo noma obhekele inhlangano elungise leyondiza, kuye ngokuthi ngubani oqondene. Imibhalo efakwa encwadini yendiza okufanele igcinwe ngokulandisa komgomo 43.01.3 iyophothulwa futhi isayinwe ngumnikazi wemvume, ngumuntu onegunya eliphelele ngokweNgxenye 145 noma yilowo ovunyiwe ngokwenhloso kaKhomishani. Izindaba okungenzeka zingafinyeleli noma zaziswe lowo ongumnikazi wemvune noma ogunyaziwe ziyofakwa futhi zisayinelwe wumshayeli ophethe indiza.

Lo mgomo wabhala ngamaNingizimu Afrika, wenzelwe amaNingizimu Afrika, ugcizelela izimiso nezindinganiso zedemokhrasi. Lo mgomo uhlanganisa iphupho esinalo kubafundisi nabafundi. Sifuna ukuba nabafundisi nabafundi abaziqondayo izimo ezahlukene zokuphila. Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi anele. Ukushisa okwandayo, izikhukhula, nezomiso zenza kube nzima ukuhlela kahle ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Umphakathi ungaba nesandla ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuhlanzeka, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokugcina amanzi, nokwakha imikhankaso yokuvuselela imithombo yamanzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinhlaka, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi? Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzayo. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuxhaswa kahle ukuze zisebenze ngempumelelo. Umbuzo 9: Yini umthelela wezobuchwepheshe ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi? Ubuchwepheshe bungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi. Izixazululo ezinjengokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kuhambisana okukhaliphile ngazo zonke izindlela zezezimali, eventual ukwehliswa kwi-railway manufacturing queries ngenxa yemoto encane kakhulu. Inhloso yokugcina iyiphuzu elisemqoka kulolu hlelo lokuphila kubantu, okuyisizathu esikhulu sokubamba umuntu ongaqhubeka nohlanga olukhanyayo kube phezulu. Leli qhinga lokukhomba umphakathi, uhambise izinyathelo eziyinqaba ezilungisayo ukucacisa uhlelo lobandlululo. Ngoba wonke umuntu ongamthandi umfowabo, kodwa amubonayo ngamehlo, akakwazi ukuthanda uNkulunkulu angakaze ambone ngamehlo.

Malungana nocwaningo lwezindawo-ke, njengalokhu kuchaziwe ngenhla, bekunesichibiyelo esithi asifane kuMthetho-sivinywa owandulela uMthetho ngqangi ngesikhathi ushicilelwa ukuthi kuphawulwe ngawo, kodwa awuzange waphunyeleliswa ukuba ube uMthetho ngenxa yamaphutha enzeka ngesikhathi ubhalwa. Kanti akuzange kube khona ukuphikiswa kwalowo mthetho. Umshwana 1 woMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela izincazelo zika "rizevu kaloliwe" kanye "nomzila wesitimela" bese ufaka incazelo entsha "yesiteshi" ukuze kubhekelwe izinhloso ezibhalwe ngenhla. UMshwana 2 woMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela isigaba 6 soMthetho. Isigaba esisha sihlinzeka ngokuthi uma umbiko wendlela yokuqala sewulungisiwe futhi nocwaningo lwendawo selwenziwe, loyo mbiko kanye nombiko wocwaningo lwendawo kuyoba ngaphansi kwenqubo yesaziso kanye nokubekwa kwemibono. Omasipala abafanele bayothintwa ngqo maqondana nemibiko. U-MEC kufanele acabange ngemibiko emibili kanye nemibono etholakele, bese eyanquma ukuthi uyayishicilela indlela noma udlulisela izindaba ezithile kukhomishini ukuze imeluleke. Lezo zindaba ziyoshicilelwa ukuze labo abathandayo nabathintekayo bakwazi ukuphawula, futhi ikhomishini kufanele yenze uhlolo lomphakathi futhi ivumele abantu abaphawulile ukuthi beze bazosekela imibono yabo. Ikhomishini iyobe seyihlanganisa umbiko wokweluleka u-MEC, oyobe-ke esengathatha isinqumo ngomgudu.

Wonke amalayisense okusebenza akhishwe yi Bhodi kumele asayinwe ngusihlalo walo noma umuntu obekwe ngusihlalo ngokubhala phansi. Ilayisense akumele iqashise ngaphandle uma imoto isebenza ngaphansi kwesivumelwano ngokokusebenza okungenalo uxhasomali noma ukusebenza ngesivumelwano. IBhodi kumele ligcine endaweni yalo yebhizinisi wonke amalayisense okusebenza ewakhilphile noshintsho olwenziwe kuwo, futhi kumele ifake imininingwane ebekiwe yalapho neyomnikazi welayisense yokusebenza nezimoto ezifanele kwimininingwane ebekiwe efakwe kwi khomputha. Lapho imoto esetshenziswa ngaphansi kwelayisense yokusebenza noma imvume isifile noma ingasetshenziswa ngenxa yokuthi ishayisile, iBhodi noma ilunga lalo elibekwe ngusihlalo, lingakhipha imvume yokuthi enye imoto isebenze esikhundleni sayo, uma kuhambisana nezigatshana 2 no 3. Ubuningi babagibeli abangathwalwa yimoto emele enye kumele bube kumkhakha ongasetshenziselwa ezokuthutha ebezisetshenzwa yimoto emelwe ngokuka sheduli A. Imoto emele enye ingasetshenziselwa isikhathi esincane esingevile ezinsukwini ezingu 42 kanjengoba kubeka iBhodi, lesosikhathi singanezelelwa ngokubona kwe Bhodi uma kunesicelo. Imoto emele enye kumele, ngesikhathi isayimele, ithathwe njenganemoto okuyiyona eyakhishelwa ilayisense yokusebenza noma imvume. g afake isicelo ngaphambi kwezinsuku ezingu 30 zokuphela kwemvume noma ilayisense yokusebenza, sokuvuselela ilayisense yokusebenza, noma sokushintsha imvume ibe yilayisense yokusebenza, uma efisa ukuvuselela noma ukushintsha. j Ngokwezithuthi ezihamba izindlela ezikude, agcine emotweni efanele uhla lwabagibeli abagitshelisiwe, ngesimo nangendlela ebekiwe.

Noma ilungu leCentre linomsebenzi, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-subsection 9, yokubamba iqhaza ekhetho lamalungu amasha eCentre kanye namalungu eBhodi. ICentre izophathwa futhi ibusiswe yiBhodi ngokweMthetho. IBhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinhloso zeCentre zifezwa ngokuzikhandla futhi kufanele ibheke ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi yeCentre. e kanye namalungu ayisixhenxe; kanye f ilungu elilodwa leBhodi yeZeluleko Kazwelonke ku-Innovation ezokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe. Amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwalawo malungu akhuluma ngawo ku-subsection 3 f, azokhethwa ngamalungu eCentre phakathi kwabo bese ekhethwa nguNgqongqoshe. IBhodi izosebenzisa amandla anikezwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho futhi iqhube imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngumlomo. a IBhodi izobamba imihlangano yayo ngezikhathi nezindawo ezizokwenziwa nguMongameli. b Amalungu akhona emhlanganweni azokwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano futhi enze izinqumo uma iningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni. b umuntu ophukile ezinkingeni zezimali futhi ongakabuyiselwa ngokomthetho. g ophume emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha okungafanele ngemva kokulalela mayelana nesenzo esingase sibe nomthelela omubi kwiCentre, kodwa leli lungu lingase likhanselwe kuze kube emhlanganweni wonyaka olandelayo lapho leli khanselo kumele libe kubhalwe emaminithini ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nemigomo yale ngxenye, umuntu ophakamisile isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokukhansela kufanele ayithumele kuMongameli futhi iBhodi izomukela le khanselo uma zonke izikweletu zikhokhiwe.

Kufanele bahlangane futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye kahle. Hlinzeka abalimi ngemininingwane futhi ungathathi izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuhlangana nabo. Kuthiwa - asifuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu - futhi kufanele kube njalo lapha. Ukuxhasa abalimi ngokuhlola nokunquma zonke izimpahla zabo epulazini, amapulazi, izinsiza, imishini, izinkomo, izitshalo, nezinye izinsiza, njll. Kufanele baqonde kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani ekulimaleni. Isibonelo: bangaki ama-kW (amandla) umalimi adingayo ukuze alime amapulazi athile? Qinisekisa ukuthi umalimi ungene ohlelweni oluzomfundisa futhi luthuthukise. Ukuba umalimi onguye osemthethweni kuthatha isikhathi, futhi kukhona izinhlangano eziningi ezingasiza ukuthuthukisa abalimi. Hlola isimo soqeqesho esinikezwayo. Kukho abaqeqeshi abaqoshiwe abangawenzi kahle umsebenzi ngoba nabo baphuthile amakhono okusebenza (awukwazi ukufunda ukulima ngokufunda kuphela izincwadi!). Qinisekisa ukuthi awuqali ngephrojekthi enkulu kakhulu. Abalimi abasha badinga isikhathi nokuxhaswa; uma iphrojekthi ikhuliswa kakhulu, izinto ziba nzima, futhi konke kuqhekeka. Kungase kube kuhle ukuxhasa abalimi abangama-50 noma ngaphezulu (kuqala), kodwa kaningi lokhu kuqhekeka ngoba kungekho izandla ezanele zokwenza umsebenzi. Kungcono ukuqala ngabalimi abangu-15 - 20 bese wandisa inani ngonyaka.

Ukugcina. - Akukho okukhulunywa ngalo Mthetho okuzosebenza ekugcineni noma ekufundiseni kwezilwane ezisetshenziselwa izinjongo zempi, amaphoyisa, noma ezemidlalo noma ezokuboniswa kwezolimo, imibukiso yezinyathi, imibukiso yezinja, imibukiso yezinyoni ezitholakala emakhaya, noma noma iyiphi imibukiso yomphakathi mayelana nokuphila kwezilwane, emjaho noma emncintiswaneni wezempilo noma amaphoyisa noma noma iyiphi imibukiso efanayo noma yokuboniswa kwezilwane noma ukusetshenziswa kwezilwane ezibhekwa ngesevisi yokuphepha yaseNingizimu Afrika, noma isevisi yamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika noma uMnyango Wezokulungisa. Umthetho okufanele ufundwe noMthetho Inombolo 71 ka-1962. - Lo Mthetho uzofundwa njengomunye noMthetho Wokuvikela Izilwane ka-1962 (Umthetho Inombolo 71 ka-1962), futhi amandla anikezwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho azosiza amandla anikezwe yilowo Mthetho ngaphandle uma inhloso iphikisana nalokhu. Ukuhumusha kwamagama asetshenzisiwe. ukuvikelwa kusho ukufundisa, ukusebenzisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngenhloso yokuthola noma ukusebenzisa inja ngenhloso yokuvikela abantu noma impahla. Isihloko esifushane. - Lo Mthetho uzobizwa ngokuthi uMthetho Wokuvikela Izilwane Zokusebenza zika-1935.

Iphrojekthi ngayinye idinga imigomo ethile, kodwa le migomo kufanele ihambisane nenhloso evamile. Isibonelo: umlimi ofuna ukukhiqiza ummbila kufanele abe nemigomo ethile yokukhiqiza ummbila, masithi uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamahektare angu-500 ommbila obomvu ngonyaka. Kodwa akupheli lapho. Kumele bazi futhi ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo mayelana nemisebenzi edingekayo nezindleko ezizovela ngoba lokhu kuzobakhombisa ukuthi amasheya abo ahlobene kanjani nezidingo zamakhowe nezifuywa. Umlimi ngamunye kumele aqonde ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo. Siphinda sithi kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izinhloso; umlimi kumele aqonde kahle ukuthi ufuna ukuya kuphi ngebhizinisi lakhe lokulima. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kulezi zinjongo, umlimi kumele ahlale phansi acabange ukukhetha imigomo efanele kubo, ukuphila kwabo, nezidingo zabo. Uma beqala ukwakha amasheya amasha ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambisana nezinjongo ezivamile nezidingo zabo. Konke esikushilo mayelana nokuhlanganisa izinhloso kungafingqwa kulezi zisho ezimbalwa: inhloso yebhizinisi lokulima ukufuna ukufinyelela inzuzo enkulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza zemvelo (izimpahla) ezifana nomhlabathi, amanzi, izindawo zokufuywa, njll., ukuze zisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezinhle esikhathini eside. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bahlela izinhlelo zokubheka ukuze baqhubeke beqoqa ulwazi oluzobavumela ukuba baphendule indlela yabo yokusebenza ngokushesha uma kwenzeka umonakalo.

Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Amatekisi Ukuze amatekisi abe usizo olukhulu emphakathini, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kubashayeli bamatekisi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde izindinganiso zokuphepha, izindlela zokuhweba, kanye nezidingo zabagibeli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngama-licence aqinile kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bahlala bephila kahle. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni amatekisi. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhamba, kungasiza abashayeli nabagibeli ukuba baxhumane kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhamba, futhi kunciphise isikhathi sokulinda. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani zamatekisi ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izindawo zokupaka ezikahle, ukuhlinzeka ngama-licence afanele, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisa amatekisi nezinye izindlela zokuhamba. Isiphetho Amatekisi, njengendlela yokuhamba, anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhamba emiphakathini. Nakuba ebhekene nezinselelo eziningi, izinzuzo zawo zikhombisa ukuthi ziwusizo olukhulu. Ngokuthuthukisa amatekisi, singaqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsiza zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaza umnotho, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabagibeli. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayeli, abagibeli, kanye nohulumeni kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lamatekisi.

Futhi umthetho 7 (ii) phakathi nesikhathi esingadluli ezinsukwini ezine kusukela ngosuku lapho isicelo samukelwe. Futhi isaziso senzo esisayiniwe; futhi ii isitatimende esibhaliwe ngumphakathi osayine isaziso senzo esinikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani indaba ehleliwe yokukhuluma kulomhlangano ophuthumayo ibalulekile futhi ayikwazi ukulinda umhlangano ojwayelekile. c Ukuhlonishwa okuphelele komthetho 7 3a no-7 3b kuthi umphakathi akavunyelwe ukusebenzisa amandla akhe kodwa kumele abize umhlangano. Kuncike ekutheni leyo mininingwane yokuxhumana kumele ithunyelwe ngumphakathi ngamunye kumphakathi wedolobha phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili ngemuva kokhetho lwabameleli futhi, emva kwalokho, noma nini umphakathi efuna ukushintsha noma iyiphi ikheli futhi lelo kheli kumele kube lapho umphakathi uthola khona imiyalezo futhi ungathola noma yisiphi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni kanye nanoma iyiphi imihlangano esemthethweni yebhodi. Zonke imibhalo ephathelene nanoma yimuphi umhlangano wekhansela noma ikomidi kumele ihlinzekwe kubo bonke abameleli okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu zikalenda ngaphambi komhlangano ojwayelekile wekhansela noma ikomidi futhi ezinsukwini ezimbili zikalenda ngaphambi komhlangano ophuthumayo wekhansela noma ikomidi ophuthumayo. Bonke abameleli kumele bazi umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezikhelini zabo phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu zokushintsha. Ngokusho komthetho 5 3, isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni kumele sithunyelwe ebhodini lesaziso somphakathi sedolobha. Umphakathi angacela uphenyo mayelana nokungatholi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni.

Lokhu akukhona kuphela ukulandela izinjongo zokwelapha, kodwa futhi kufaka phakathi ukungena komoya omuhle nephakethe lokusebenzisana okuyingqayizivele. Isinyathelo Sesine: Ukunakekelwa Ngemuva Kokubeletha Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama nomntwana badinga ukuqhubeka bephathwa kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlola ukuba baphila kahle, ukuphathwa kahle kwengane, nokuthola izeluleko ezibalulekile zomama eziphathelene nokunakekelwa kwezingane. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umama uyapholisa, ngokuhlanganyela nosizo ezivela kubahlengikazi, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekugcineni. Izinqubo zokubhekelelwa ziqinisekisa ukuba umama uyaphila, ezithobile. Ngaphandle kokuhlola, ukuqonda izinguquko ezimqoka empilweni yomama kubalulekile ekugcineni umphumela ophumelelayo. Isiphetho: Ukuqhubeka Nempilo Izinyathelo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile empilweni yomama nomntwana. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukulungiselela okusemqoka, nokuqonda okwandisayo, zonke lezi zici zithuthukisa impilo. Abantu abafaka isandla kulezi zinyathelo kudinga ukubonga, njengoba inhloso iwukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomama nezingane, kuhlelwe ngendlela ethokozisayo nebanzi. Ubufakazi bokuphila bukhombisa ukuthi izinqubo eziphathelene nokubeletha ziyasebenza, futhi kubalulekile ukugcina ukuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwemindeni nezinhlangano zezempilo.

Ukusiza, ukuhlela, nokweseka ubudlelwano bamazwe ngamazwe kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika kugxile ekuthengiseni, ukwabelana ngetekhnoloji/izeluleko, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezombusazwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela yokuqeqesha nokufundisa kwezolimo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zabantu emkhakheni. Ukusiza ekusunguleni nasekusebenziseni uhlelo lokuhlela, lokubheka, nokuhlola ukusebenza kwenhlangano nokubona ukuthi iyafeza yini imigomo yayo. Ukukhuthaza umkhakha wezolimo onamandla okudala ingcebo ngokukhiqiza izinkunzi nezinkomo e-RSA. Ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; intuthuko yenhlangano nokuqeqeshwa okusebenzayo kwangaphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo yezomthetho. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluxhasa amaqembu kanye nohlelo oluphatha imibhalo. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphatha nokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Ukuhlinzeka nge-NGO yezezimali. Ukubuyisa izikweletu zezolimo, ukuphatha imali efakwe, nokukhokha izikweletu. Umhlahlandlela uzotholakala eKomishini Yezamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika ngenyanga ka-Agasti 2003. Zonke izicelo kufanele ziqondiswe ku-PAII yeKomishini Yezamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Vula ifayela elihlukile leli zindaba zomgomo ngokuqalisa 1.P.2 kulandela / kanye negama lomgomo. Vula ifayela elihlukile leli zindaba kanye/noma umgomo ngokuqalisa 1.3.2 kulandela / kanye negama leMthetho kanye/noma umgomo. 1.3.2/Umgomo Wesevisi Yomphakathi.

Indlu yokuhlala iyindlu eyingxenye yempahla yokuhlala esetshenziselwa ukuhlala abantu, noma izindlu eziningi ezifana nalokhu endaweni lapha akukhulumi ngendawo lapho okungaphezu kokuthathu kwabelwana ngayo okuthile ngaphandle kokuhlala, noma ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, B&B, indlu yokwamukela izivakashi, noma efana naleyo eqashiswa nsuku zonke. Impahla ekhokha izintela ezikhethekile iyindawo eyenzelwe lapho abanikazi bezimpahla ngaphakathi kwayo bevuma ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo ezengeziwe ezingaphezu kwalokho okunikezwa yiMuniisipali. Lokhu kukhokha kwenziwa ngokwengeza enye imali ezinteleni ezikhokhiswa kumakhadi abanikazi bezimpahla kule ndawo. Imisebenzi yezohwebo ifaka: Izikhumulo zezindiza; indawo esetshenziswa uMnyango weGas weMuniisipali; indawo yokulahla udoti; Izakhiwo/Izindawo zokupaka, izakhiwo zemakethe, indawo esetshenziswa uMnyango weMvula weMuniisipali. Inani lomhlaba lisho intengo lapho umhlaba ungathengiswa khona njengoba kutholwe umthetho. UKUBUYEKEZWA KWEMIHLA YOMPOLI IBhodi yeMuniisipali kufanele ibuyekeze umthetho wezintela minyaka yonke, kanye nohlelo lwezimali lweMuniisipali. Ukukhokha izintela emhlabeni/ezakhiweni lapho ubunikazi babelwana khona kuyisithwathwa kulabo bonikazi ngokubambisana nalokhu isithwathwa somuntu kulabo bonikazi. Ukulethwa kwamakhadi noma izitatimende kunoma ngubani kubhekwa njengokwenziwe kubo bonke. IMALI YEZINTELA OKUFANELE IKHOKHEKE I-Muniisipali izonquma ubukhulu bezintela kuzo zonke izigaba zomhlaba ngokuvumelana nesivumelwano njengengxenye yesabelomali sonyaka.

UKULALELA iziphicaphicwano namahlaya. Umfundi uzokwazi ukulalela ukuze athole ulwazi nokuzijabulisa aphendule ngendlela Ukulalela imiyalezo akwazi ukuyidlulisela kwabanye efanele nangokuhlolisisa ezimweni ngendlela efanele. Ukwahlukanisa izinhlamvu zemisindo eyehlukene ikakhulukazi ekuqaleni kwamagama. Ukulalela, ukujabulela nokuphendula ngemfanelo Ukulalela , ukujabulela nokuphendula ngemfanelo iziphicaphicwano namahlaya. Ukulalela okhulumayo angakwazi ukumbona Ukulalela okhulumayo angakwazi ukumbona isib. ocingweni bese ephendula imibuzo alandele isib. emsakazweni, ku- inhakhomu bese nemiyalo. ephendula imibuzo nemiyalo. UKUKHULUMA Umfundi ukwazi ukuxoxisana ngokuzethemba nangendlela efanele ekusebenziseni ulimi ezimweni ezahlukehlukene. L oku kubonakala uma umfundi ekwazi: Ukuxoxa ngempilo yakhe, izimvo zakhe nezindaba. Ukusebenzisa ulimi ezicabangela nje enzela ubumnandi kanye nokuzijabulisa. Ukuxoxa indatshana ayaziyo enesingeniso, umzimba nesiphetho esebenzisa izithombe uma kunesidingo. Ukuhlabelela, ahaye, alingise aphinde alingise ngokudansa izinkondlo kanye nemigqumo. Akhombise uzwelo namalungelo nemizwa yabanye abantu. Ukwethula umbiko weqembu emva kokusebenza njengeqembu. Ngokuphendula imibuzo ebuzwe ngabalaleli. Ukuphinde axoxe ngempilo yakhe nangezehlakalo Ukuphinde axoxe ngempilo yakhe, nangezehlakalo zezindaba ezijwayelekile. ezejwayelekile aveze imizwa nemibono yakhe ngazo. Ukusebenzisa ulimi ezicabangela nje enzela Ukusebenzisa ulimi ezicabangela nje enzela ubumnandi nokuzijabulisa isib. enze amahlaya ukuzijabulisa nobumnandi isib.

Imiklomelo inethonya elikhulu ekusebenzeni kwabasebenzi. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuhlonishwa, bakhuthazwa ukuba benze kahle kakhulu. Lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile futhi bejabulile emsebenzini, okwandisa ukukhiqiza. Izinselelo ezibhekene nabasebenzi zingancipha uma beqinisekisa ukuthi imizamo yabo iyakwaziwa. Umbuzo 5: Kukhona izingozi ezihambisana nokuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo? Yebo, kunezingozi ezithile. Uma imiklomelo inganikezwa ngendlela engafanele, kungaholela ekucasuleni abasebenzi, ikakhulukazi uma abanye bethola imiklomelo engcono. Lokhu kungadala umoya wokuncintisana okungafanele. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo ngendlela efanele, eqondile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayaziswa. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuhlonipha abasebenzi? Ukuhlonipha abasebenzi kubalulekile emsebenzini. Izinzuzo zalesi simo zifaka: 1. Ukukhula Komoya Wokusebenza: Abasebenzi abaziswa bakha umoya omuhle. Abesifazane benza ingxenye enkulu yokuhlala kwabantu eNingizimu Afrika, yingakho izwi labesifazane kufanele lifakwe ezinqumweni nasekudalweni kwemithetho. Le nkwakha yabesifazane ezinqumweni iyilungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Abesifazane kumele babambe iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngoba ukuhlinzekwa kwemithetho nezinhlelo zik gouvernement kuthinta izimpilo zabo nsuku zonke. Kubalulekile, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi uma abesifazane bebamba iqhaza ezinqumweni, kuholela ekwandeni kokunakwa nokwabiwa kwezinsiza ezithuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu. Ukwanda kokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho kungaholela ekutholeni kalula izinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. UMsunguli weNingizimu Afrika uthi umphakathi kumele wazi futhi ubambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende nasemisebenzini yalo. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Abesifazane bangabamba iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngokuvota iqembu lezepolitiki abakholwa ukuthi lizobonisa kangcono imibono nezinkathazo zabo kwiPhalamende. Bangase futhi babambe iqhaza ekuhleleni nasekusebenzeni kweqembu abakhethile futhi ngokukhethwa ezakhiweni zalo. Abesifazane baphakame ezikhundleni eziphakeme ngalendlela. Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuyindaba umphakathi ofuna ukuyizwa, iKomidi leSishayamthetho noma iBhunga leSifunda lingase linqume ukuhlela izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze ukufakwa kwemibono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi kemikhono kufanele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kulawulwe izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha lezi zinkinga akubizi kakhulu kodwa kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ukuvimbela ukuthi zidalule ubungozi ezikhathini zokuqala zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukulima ebusika kuzophinde kusize ukubulala izilwane eziningi ngoba ebusika zihlala ezinsalela zezinto ezishiwo ezisemathafeni. Uma zihlala ngaphandle kwezitshalo eziphilayo izinsuku ezingama-35, izinkinga eziningi ezidalwa lezi zilwane zizokwenyuka. Imbewu ezizofakwa ingaphathwa ngama-pesticides noma i-pesticide ingafakwa emhlabathini lapho kufakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokubeka i-bait emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Umhlabathi ungaphinde uphuziswe nge-pesticide efanele. I-corn earworm (astylus atromaculatus), i-cutworm (agrotis segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ifile (protostrophus sulcatifrons), kanye nama-harpalus beetles angabangela ubungozi obukhulu ezitsholeni, futhi inani lezitshalo ezinhle lingancipha ngaphandle kokuba nenzuzo. I-African bollworm (helicoverpa armigera) iyalimaza ikhanda lesitshalo futhi ingadala ukuvuleka kwe-fungus rhizopus microsporus. Izilwane ezinjenge-nysius nataensis zingaphinde zilimaze izitshalo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-pesticides abhalisiwe ukuze abulale izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezilimazayo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezibangela ubungozi. Ngaleso sikhathi uzokwazi ukukhetha i-pesticide efanele - qaphela ukufaka i-pesticide ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nasemazingeni afanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo kanye nosayizi wesitshalo.

Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe: Imibuzo Nezincazelo Umbuzo 1: Yini izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zifundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise impilo yabo nemisebenzi yabo. Lezi zifundo zihlola indlela ubuchwepheshe obuthinta ngayo izimpilo zethu, izinqubo zethu zokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana. Zifaka phakathi izifundo ezihlukahlukene, njengekhompyutha, ubunjiniyela, ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bemvelo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zinikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, njengoba imikhakha eminingi idinga abantu abanolwazi kwezobuchwepheshe. Zikhuthaza futhi ukucabanga okwakhiwe, lapho abafundi befundiswa khona ukuhlaziya izinkinga nokufuna izixazululo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zikhuthaza ukusungula ubuchwepheshe obusha, okwenza kube nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo emhlabeni. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izifundo ezivamile ngaphakathi kwezifundo zobuchwepheshe? Izifundo zobuchwepheshe ziqukethe izifundo eziningi ezifana ne-Information Technology (IT), ubunjiniyela, ukuthuthukiswa kwesofthiwe, kanye nezifundo ze-robotics. Futhi, izifundo eziphathelene nezokuxhumana, njengezokumaketha kwi-inthanethi, kanye nezokuphepha kwedatha, zibalulekile kakhulu. Umbuzo 4: Kungani kubalulekile ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini yanamuhla? Emiphakathini yanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Ukufunda izifundo zobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko ezisheshayo, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini lapho ubuchwepheshe buguqula izinqubo zokusebenza.
