Imidlalo Yamazwe Ngamazwe (International Sports) Umbuzo 1: Yini imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ibhekisela emncintiswaneni yokudlala okubandakanya amaqembu, abanolwazi, noma abadlali abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Le midlalwano ibonisa ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kweqembu, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwemibuso eminingi. Imidlalo efana ne-Olympics, iFIFA World Cup, neNHL All-Star Game iyingxenye enkulu yalezi zinhlelo. Umbuzo 2: Kuthini ukukhethwa kwale midlalo? Ukukhethwa kwemidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe kuncike kakhulu ekuhlonipheni izindinganiso zendawo. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, ezifanele ukweluleka izwe, zikhulisa izinhlelo ezidinga ukuqeqeshwa okuhle, ukuhlela kahle, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala efanele. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baqeqeshe abadlali. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zezimidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Izinsiza ezinkulu zezimidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ziqhakambisa ubuchwepheshe, amandla, kanye nokuvuselela umoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, kuthuthukisa ubuhlobo, futhi kukhuthaza inhlonipho phakathi kwabantu bamasiko ahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwenza kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezimali, njengoba imidlalo ithinta ezomnotho. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ikhulisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizwe? Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe iyinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Abadlali bavela ezizweni ezahlukene, bahlala behlangene bemema abanye ezimweni zempilo. Lokhu kudala amandla okuthola ulwazi nokuhlonipha izinkolelo ezahlukene.

Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kuyisici esibalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokuba negesi, njengokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Nokho, kunokungafani okukhulu phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nezasezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Ukwakhiwa Kwesakhiwo Sokutholakala Kukagesi Ukuze kutholakale ugesi emakhaya, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokwakha nokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi, izintambo zokuhambisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina ugesi. Iziteshi zokukhiqiza zingaba yiziteshi zamandla ezivela emithonjeni ehlukene, njengamandla elanga, amanzi, noma amalahle. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka zisebenza kahle, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ugesi ngendlela elula. Izithiyo Ezinqubweni Zokutholakala Kukagesi Kukhona izithiyo eziningi ezithinta ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi izindleko eziphezulu zokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Izindawo ezisemakhaya zihlala zinezinkinga zokuhamba, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo zokwakha ugesi. Lokhu kudala ukungafani kokutholakala kukagesi, lapho abanye abantu besebenzisa izindlela ezindala zokukhanyisa, ezifana nezibani zezimoto, noma izibani ezisebenza ngogesi ophumayo. Izinzuzo Zokutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Uma ugesi utholakala kalula emakhaya, izinzuzo zikhula. Okokuqala, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nemisebenzi emisha.

Lezi zibalo eziphansi zisihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokungabi nemisebenzi ngokwenhlangano yobudala. Kucacile ukuthi kumele sigxile kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi entsha. Uhulumeni unendlela ephindwe kabili yokubhekana nale nkinga - isixazululo sesikhashana esizobhekana nalabo abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi ngenxa ye ngqungquthela yezomnotho njengoba kuboniswe emgqeni wesivumelwano, bese kuba nezinhlelo ezizobhekana nalabo abangasebenzi nabantu abashiywe emuva ekufuneni umsebenzi. Ngalesi sizathu, ngifuna ukuphinda ngiphinde ngikhumbuze ngokubiza kwePhini okwenziwe ngesikhathi sikhuluma esifundeni sokuthi izinkampani kumele zithole ithuba lokuhola uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluhlinzekiwe. Ukwehla komnotho nakho kuyazwakala ezimali zikahulumeni. Ukuqoqwa kwemali ezingeni lesizwe akuzange kusebenze kahle ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2009/10, kwehla ngaphezu kwe-R69 billion. Kulindeleke ukuthi le ndlela izoqhubeka ngisho nasekukhuleni kwezezimali ka-2010/11 ngenxa yokwehla kokuhola kwemali. Ngenkathi iNingizimu Afrika ikwazile ukugcina igama elihle "lokuba namabhange asebenza kahle" ekubolekeni ngemali enenzuzo ephansi, sonke siyazi ukuthi imali iyimpahla ebizayo, futhi kumele siqaphele ukuthi singazifaka kanjani ezikweletini. Ngokuvamile, amazwe abolekayo kakhulu (iJapane, iGreece, ne-Italy) kulindeleke ukuthi akhule umnotho wawo kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kunamazwe anokweleta okuncane (iChina neChile). Ukwanda kwezinga lokubolekwa kwemali kuholele ekwandeni okukhulu kwezikweletu zesizwe, okwenza kube nom

Umphakathi uvikela ngokwenza uphenyo oluzimele nolungakhethi emva kokuthola ukukhala noma ngokuqhubeka kwabo. Ukukhala okuhlobene nokusebenza kwemisebenzi (kungafaki lokho okuhlobene nezinkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa) kufanele kuthunyelwe kumphathi wesigaba esifanele, njengoba isigaba kufanele sinikezwe ithuba lokuphendula ekukhuleni. Uma ungekwazanga ukuthumela ukukhala esigabeni esifanele, ucela ukuthi wenze kanjalo. Zonke iziteshi zangaphakathi ezikhona kufanele zibe khona. Ingabe ufuna ukugcina igama lakho lihlelekile? 2.2 Ingabe usazise isigaba ngokungamukeli isinqumo, ngokuphakamisa udaba noma ngokuthatha izinyathelo ukuze isinqumo sibuye sahlaziywe? 2.3 Uma impendulo ingu-ye kunoma yimuphi wemibuzo engenhla, ucela ukuthi unikeze imininingwane. 3.1 Usuku lwezingozi 3. Ingabe wazisa uMnyango noma umphakathi ofanele ngalesi sikhathi?

Le nkonzo ikakhulukazi ngeyezingane zabazali abathola ilungelo lokuba yizakhamizi ngemuva kokuhlala iminyaka ethize inikeza ilungelo lokuba yisakhamuzi . Izingane zezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ngokuzalwa kanye nobuzukulwane zikufanele ukubayizakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika kanti futhi asikho isidingo sokuthi zenze isicelo selungelo lokuhlala unomphela. Izicelo zingenziwa ehhovisi laboMnyango wezaseKhaya noma kwinxusa laseNingizimu Afrika noma i-mission uma kwenziwa isicelo ngaphandle. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 no-BI-29. Khipha isitifikedi sokuzalwa. Kuye ngesimo sakho kwezezimali, abazali bako kungadingeka ukuthi bafakela isibopho zokuzimisela ukusiza kwezezimali. Asikho isikhathi esibekiwe sale nkonzo.

Asizukwehlisa izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu, kodwa sizogxila ekusebenzeni ngokuzikhandla, ngokucophelela, nangokuhlakanipha ukuze siphumelele kulolu simo somnotho esingesihle. Nokho, namuhla sihlangana emoyeni wokubheka impumelelo. Umnotho wethu awuhambi kahle njengamanje. Empeleni, sikhula ngesilinganiso esiphezulu kunalokho okulindelekile ngenxa yesinqubomgomo sethu somnotho. Njengoba unyaka odlule sahlulelwa ukuba ngu-15 emncintiswaneni wezomnotho emhlabeni, iNingizimu Afrika manje ibalwa ku-6 phakathi kwezizwe eziyi-133 "ngokubonga ukusebenza kahle kwamabhange." Umnotho womhlaba ukhula ngesivinini esikhulu kunalokho okwakucatshangwa ngaphambili. Njengoba umnotho womhlaba uzinzile kusukela ekwehlisweni komnotho kuka-2009, iMali Yomhlaba (IMF) iphoqelekile ukuba ibuyekeze ukubikezela kwayo kokukhula komnotho phezulu kuya ku-3.9% kulonyaka no-4.3% ku-2011. ENingizimu Afrika, iNhlangano Yezimali Yezwe ibikezela ukukhula kwe-GDP yangempela okungu-2.3% ku-2010 no-3.2% ku-2011. Ukubuyela ezingeni lokukhula elingu-5% nangaphezulu minyaka yonke kuzodinga ukuthi sisebenze kanzima. Sidinga ukuqinisa imizamo yethu, ikakhulukazi ekubandakanyeni intsha emnothweni, ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, nakubantu abaphucukile. Nokho, ngenkathi sinesithakazelo, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi asikaphumi emathafeni. Ngaphandle kokukhula komnotho okwenzeka esigabeni sokugcina sika-2009, kokubili umnotho wesizwe kanye nowesifunda kube nokuqina unyaka nonyaka. Ukwanda kwe-25% kwemali yokukhanyisa ngama-Eskom kuncane kunalokho okwakuphakanyisiwe.

Ngenxa yokuthi ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu kubonakala njengomgogodla wemibandela yeNqubomgomo yeziLimi, Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi lifuna kusungulwe inqalasizinda yolimi namalinge afanele okugxilisa ngempela ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi eMisebenzini yoMphakathi. Ngakho, umbimbi esisebenzisana nalo ezingeni likazwelonke, ezifundazweni nakohulumeni basekhaya luyodlala indima eqavile ekuqiniseni ukuthi Inqubomgomo yeziLimi isebenza ngempumelelo. Uma sicabanga ukuthi inselelo esibhekene nayo njengoHulumeni ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izakhamizi zithola izinsiza ngokushesha nokuthi ulimi yisikhali sokuxhumana nomphakathi, kuyacaca ukuthi Inqubomgomo yeziLimi kufanele iqale ukusebenza ngokuphuthuma. Ngaleyo ndlela, ngifisa ukucela bonke esisebenzisana nabo kuhlangene nezakhiwo zikahulumeni neminyango kanjalo neSigungu seziLimi zoMdabu zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuba siqinisekise ukuthi leli Qhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi liguqula ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezehlukene isimo esiyiqiniso ezakhamizini zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika. Leli Qhinga Lokuqhuba umsebenzi liyingxenye yoHlaka Lwenqubomgomo kaZwelonke yoLimi (NLPF) olunika igunya imibandela yolimi njengoba ibekwe esigabeni 6 soMthethosisekelo ka 1996 (Umthetho uNo. 108 ka 1996). Uma seliphelele, umgodla wonke uyoqukatha Umbiko weNqubomgomo yeziLimi, Iqhinga Lokuqhuba umsebenzi, Umthetho ohlongozwayo weziLimi nemigomo yakhona kanjalo noMthetho ohlongozwayo woMkhandlu woNgcweti beziLimi zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Ekugcineni, umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State uphakamisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezidingayo ukubhekwa ngokuphumelelayo. Umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezinhlelo zoLimo, abezindaba, noMkhandlu waseFree State usetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezisizayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukholo kwempilo yokudla, bonke bezokwazi ukunqanda umthelela wezimo zezulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela ezithuthukile zokulima, ukuze siqhubeke siqinisekise ukuhlala komphakathi okuhle ngumthombo wokusebenza kokukhula komnotho. Umphakathi wezolimo eFree State kufanele uphinde ubhekele phambili ukuze ubone indlela yokuphefumula kwezimo ezinzima zempilo ngesikhathi esifanele, ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle ekukhiqizeni. Siyavuma ukuthi umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State ungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu, ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo engeyona imfashini, kanye nokwakha umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuzodala isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwemboni yezolimo, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo kanye nezinga lokuphila kwabantu.

"Angazi nina madoda, kodwa kimi insika isiqala ukuwa. Bekunganjani siqale laphaya kwashisanyama sithole okuya ngasethunjini? 3.1 Ake ufunde le misho elandelayo bese uyibhala, uguqule imiqondo yemisho ngokufaka amagama amqondophika kulawa abhalwe agqama. "Umkhulu ulambele uxolo!" 2.7 Shono ukuthi kuyiqiniso noma amanga ukuthi "Amaphoyisa ayesemlinde endleleni uXulu". Beka ngokuthole endabeni. Sengiyifihlile imali ngaqonda esigxotsheni socingo. Ngafike ngafaka imali maqede ngashaya izinombolo. "Mina ngixakwa ukuthi kanti ubaba uMdindithwa akakuboni konke lokhu okwehlela abantu abadala,"kusho uSixova. "Kanti yini umsebenzi wamaKhansela ngempela? Izingcezu zenkulumo kumele uzisebenzise ngendlela efanele nehlabahlosile. Udlisele ngokwazi ulimi lwakho ngokuziqhenya. Imisho yakho mayibe nezingcezu zenkulumo ezahlukene. Kepha qikelela ukuthi inhloso yempendulo yakho ingalahleki. "Ishumi nje kuphela" ngibuza ngokungabaza? "We Siphelelo!" eyothi voshololo phansi esihlalweni. "Usho ukuthi lo muzi wami ongaka uzakuwushiya phansi. Le mfuyo yami engangiyiphembela wena, uzakuyishiya, ibe impango yabafokazana La mangcwaba obaba nelikanyoko uzakuwashiya ehlane Ungitshela lokho? "Kuyazisho ukuthi nguye kanye lowaya," kusho mina ngikhomba umfokazi wezimanga ngekhanda. Wathi engahlala phansi wabe eseqhweba intombi eyabe ithengisa lapho. Ngasuka ngamlandela ngafike ngahlala phambi kwakhe sengilindele ukuthi wabe ezothini. Wakhipha insimbi ethile ekhikhini maqede wayibeka esweni ebhekisisa leyo mali engabe ngimnike yona.

Kuyavunyelwana phakathi kwamaQEMBU, ukuthi OWENKONTILEKA isivumelwano asenziwe naye njengomqashwa ngokwale SIVUMELWANO futhi le SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kunobuhlobo bokuqashana obukhona phakathi koweNKONTILEKA no SAPS. OWENKONTILEKA kufanele, ngaphandle kwemigomo yesigaba 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo yeziGaba 5 no 9 ngezansi, anikezele u-ASPS izinsizakalo ngesikhathi ezidinga nangokwemibandela ebekwe ngu-SAPS, esikhathini esikaliwe esi , kusukela osukwini lokuqala kwale SIVUMELWANO bheka isigaba 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene noWENKONTILEKA izohlanganisa nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa ngezandla eyingxenye, futhi eqondene nemisebenzi yoWENKONTILEKA. OWENKONTILEKA uzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe (bheka iziGaba 3.1 - 3.2 ngenhla) ewenzela u-SAPS izinsuku ezinhlanu evikini: Inqobo nje, uma OWENKONTILEKA engeke asebenzela u-SAPS ngemiGqibelo nangamaSonto, noma ngamaholide omphakathi. OWENKONTILEKA umsebenzi wakhe uzowenza ngokwesheduli exhunyelwe lapha yaba uSheduli A. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma izinsuku abekade engekho ngazo ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. u-SAPS uzoba nomsebenzi wokunikeza OWENKONTILEKA ezokuthutha imoto ukuya nokubuya EMSEBENZINI ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe bheka iziGaba 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngokwale SIVUMELWANO.

Uhlaka: Ulwazi luthathwe kuHlelo lweMfundo Ephakeme lokukhiqiza iSorghum. Umkhiqizi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphathwa kokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi kubalulekile lapho kuthuthukiswa izinhlelo futhi ngaphambi kokutshala, njengoba lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthi kube nokukhiqiza okuphelele njengoba kuhilela zonke izenzo ezenziwa umphathi. Lezi ezilandelayo yizici ezingathinta ikhwalithi yezinsalela ezivunyiwe (okwakhiwa): ukulungiswa komhlabathi, ukujula komhlabathi, i-pH, ibhalansi yezimayini, ukugcina umswakama emhlabathini, uhlobo lwez plants, umanyolo ofanele, ukuphathwa kwezihlahla nezifo, ukuvuna ngesikhathi esifanele nokuphatha, ukuhlanza okwakhiwa, ukuwasha okwakhiwa, kanye nezindlela zokugcina (ukubeka) okwakhiwa. Ukuvuna kuyinselelo ebalulekile uma kutshalwa i-sorghum. Siqala ukuvuna ngaphambi kokwenza ezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kokwakhiwa njengokucubungula, ukugcina, nokugcina umkhiqizo. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindawo lapho ukuvuna, ukugcina, nokugcina imisebenzi kuhlukaniswe. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nokuvuna ngezandla bese yonke imikhiqizo ibekwe ukuvuna kamuva uma isomile emapulazini amancane. Bese kuqhubeka emapulazini ezohwebo lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna okwakhiwa. Ngokuvamile, i-sorghum ivunwa ndawonye ne-maize futhi ivunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma itshalwe kusenesikhathi, kuyilapho enye ivunwa ngoMeyi uma itshalwe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuna kwe-maize kuqale.

Abafundi bayakwazi ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwabo lokufunda nokubhala abasuke beluthole olimini lwabo lwebele/lwethunga bese belwedlulisela ekufundeni lolu olusha olwengeziwe lokuqala. Uhlelo lwemfundo lunikeza usizo olukhulu kulabo bafundi abayosebenzisa ulimi lwabo lokuqala olwengeziwe njengolimi lokufunda nokufundisa. Ekupheleni kwebanga lesi-9, laba bafundi kusuke sekufanele ukuthi bakwazi ukusebenzisa ulimi lwabo lwethunga/lwebele nolimi olwengeziwe lokuqala ngendlela eyiyo nangokuzethemba ngokwezinhloso eziningana ezahlukene nokufunda. Ulimi olwengeziwe lwesibili lona lwenzelwe labo bafundi abasuke befisa ukufunda izilimi ezintathu. Lolu limi lungaba olusemthethweni noma olwezizwe. Izindlela zokuhlola ziyaqikelela ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ukusebenzisa ulimi lwebele ngenhloso yokuxhumana. Lezi zindlela zikholelwa ekutheni sincane isikhathi okufanele sabelwe ukufunda ulimi lwesibili olwengeziwe kunesokufunda ulimi lwebele noma olwengeziwe lokuqala. Nolimi olwengeziwe lwesibili. Kubekwa umbono wokuthi ulimi lwebele lomfundi kumele lusetshenziselwe ukufunda nokufundisa lapho kungaphumelelekanga khona. Loku kusemqoka kakhulu eZingeni leMfundo eYisisekelo lapho abafundi befunda ukufunda nokubhala. Ulimi olwengeziwe kumele lufakwe njengesifundo ngokushesha kusaqalwa. Ulimi lwebele kumele baqhubeke balusebenzisele ukufunda nokufundisa baluhambise nolwengeziwe isikhathi eside nje impela.

Sisaqhubeka nalesi sibophezelo, ngikholwa wukuthi sikwenzile okusemandleni ethu ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobubha. Lokhu kufakazelwe nayisiqubulo sethu esithi kuloMnyango weZempilo, Silwa Nezifo, Silwa Nobubha, Sinika Ithemba kubantu abangaphezulu kuka 10 million kulesi sifundazwe sethu esihle kangaka kuleminyaka eyisihlanu edlule. Siphinde sahamba ibanga elide sisungula amathuba emisebenzi sihambisana nemigomo yokufukula abansundu kwezomnotho i-Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment. Ezikhathini eziningi izimo esihlangabezana nazo esizweni nasezweni lethu, nemisebenzi esizibekele yona, zifuna ukuba sigqugquzele abantu, sibadidiyele bonke ukuthi babemunye ekwenzeni izinto okumele zenziwe, siqonde nokuthi nebala ikusasa lethu ngamunye ngamunye lisezandleni zethu! Sihlalo oHloniphekile, uMongameli uthi kumele sizibheka thina ukuthi sesizuzeni kumbe sehluleke kuphi. Ngokunjalo-ke ngithanda ukuba kesibheke izinselelo esihlangabezane nazo kule minyaka eyisihlanu yesibophezelo kubantu njengoba uMongameli ememezela ukuzibophezela kubantu bakulelizwe nabakulesi sifundazwe. Okokuqala, phakathi kwezinselelo ezinkulu esabhekane nazo maqondana nezingxoxo zamaholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kwathi lapho lezi zingxoxo zifinyelela kwangqingetshe, lokho kwaholela ekutheni abasebenzi babeke phansi amathuluzi okusebenza ngomhlaka 1 Juni 2007. Lokhu akubashiyanga ngaphandle abasebenzi boMnyango weZempilo. Ukungenelela ngobuchule koMnyango kwakwazi ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka kokuphakelwa kwezidingo zezempilo ngalesi sikhathi esasinzima.

AbezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika (SRSC) neKhomishani yezeMidlalo (SASC) bayakwamukela ukubaluleka kwezemidlalo empilweni enhle yabantu abakhubazekile futhi bayakukhuthaza izinhlangano nokwethula imisebenzi yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kulamalunga - kusukela ezingeni lomphakathi kuya ekwenzeni kahle hle. Njengamanje kuneminye imigomo yokuziphatha kwezemidlalo enakekela izidingo ezikhethekile zabantu abakhubazekile, emkhakheni ethile yobudala babantu. Ezinye izidingo zingalungiswa ngezinhlelo ezimbandakanya eminye iminyango kahulumeni ethintekayo, njengowezeNhlalakahle, ezeMpilo, nezeMfundo, nezinye. Kufanele kulolongwe ezemidlalo ukuze kwengezwe ubugugu ezindaweni zemisebenzi, ngoba phela ingxenye eningi yesikhathi sethu sisichitha emsebenzini. Ezemidlalo zingaba ekuqhubeni izifundo kwezoqeqesho, ukuphatha, ukuqeqesha, nokulawula ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Kuyokwabiwa izidingo eziqondene ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono ezemidlalo nezimfanelo zabesifazane namantombazane. Kuyokhonjwa abantu abafanele abayongeniswa kwezokuqeqeshelwa ubuholi, ukuba ngumqeqeshi kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka . Abavelele kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kuyokhuthaza ukumbandakanywa kwabesifazane namantombazaane kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. B. Abantu Abadala nomthelela ekwehliseni ukuphatheka kabi, ukukhathala kanye nokungaphatheki kahle okwehlisa umkhiqizo. Kuhlongozwa ukuba kusungulwe amaqembu abasebenzi ukuze kwenziwe lula ukuzimbandakanya. Izinhlelo zabasebenzi zemidlalo zingasiza futhi ukuba yizizinda zokuvumbulula amathalente, nokuthuthukisa imincintiswano yezemidlalo.

Imibhalo efakwe encwadini yendiza uyoqukatha lonke ulwazi neminingwane ehlinzekelwe encwadini yendiza. Noma yinini, uma kunemibhalo ethile efakwa encwadini yendiza, lokho okulungiswayo kuyokwenziwa ngendlela eshiya umbhalo omdala ubonakala. Akuvunyiwe ukusebenzisa into efana nesisusi-mbhalo noma indlela efanayo ehliphizayo negqiba umbhalo omdala. Uma ukukhandwa kwendiza, injini noma insimbi ethile noma umshini kwenziwe ngemuva kokulimala okudalwe wukuhlala ngamawala kwendiza emhlabathini noma ngempoqo noma umonakalo oyiphutha lasemkhiqizweni, umbhalo ofakwa encwadini yendiza mayelana nalokho kukhanda kufanele kuchaze ukuthi sasikhona isidingo sokuba indiza ihlale ngamawala noma ngempoqo. Izincwadi zendiza ezichazwe wumgomo 43.01.3 kufanele zigcinwe zibuyekeziwe futhi ziphathwe kahle, zifundeke bese zihlala isikhathi eside ngendlela okusetshenziswa ngayo imiqulu yezindiza. Uma umnikazi wendiza ebika ukulahlekelwa yizincwadi zendiza yakhe evele isebenza, isicelo sentsha siyokwenziwa ngokubhaliwe siqonde kuKhomishani siphelezelwa wumbiko ofungelwe nemininingwane efanele ngenhloso yokuvuselela kabusha izincwadi zendiza. Uma uKhomishani emukela isicelo sezincwadi zokubambela endala, leyo mvume yezintsha iyokwenziwa ingxenye yaphakade yaleyo ncwadi yendiza. Uma ilahlekile incwadi yendiza, Isitifiketi seGunya lokuNdiza noma Igunya lokuNdiza liyothathwa njengento engasasebenzi kuze kufike isikhathi lapho zonke izidingo zokuvula incwadi yesibili engumfakela sezifeziwe.

Ukubakhona kwakhe kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi siqhubeka nokwakha izikhungo ezintsha ezifana nezikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, kusho uNgqongqoshe. Umnyango wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo esifundazweni njengamanje uphakathi kokuhola ukufuna abasebenzi ukuze abhekane nezimo eziphuthumayo ezisemgwaqweni. Lokhu kuyingxenye yephrojekthi eqale ngonyaka odlule lapho abantu abangu-50 baqeqeshwa futhi manje sebebhizinisi emnyangweni. UNtsobi uthe iningi labantu abazobanjwa kuzofakwa ezindaweni zasemaphandleni uma beqedile izifundo zabo, ezilindeleke ukuthi zithathe izinyanga ezintathu. Siphinde saqala isigaba sesibili sokwandisa izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kulandela impumelelo yesigaba sokuqala ngonyaka odlule lapho sathola khona abantu abangu-50, kuchaza uNtsobi. Umphakathi uthe ngaphezu kuka-90% walabo abaqeqeshwayo bazoba ngabesifazane. Sibone ukuthi kungcono ukuthatha abesifazane abaningi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi nabo bahlala bebaningi kulomkhakha wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Eminyakeni edlule, umsebenzi wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo wawaziwa ngokuba ubhekelelwe kakhulu amadoda. Sibone ukuthi abesifazane bangakwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi kahle njengabantu besilisa, kusho uNtsobi. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo kuyingxenye yephrojekthi kahulumeni wesifundazwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo kulesi sifundazwe zithola usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo uma zidinga. Sizokuqinisekisa futhi ukuthi imiphakathi enezinkinga ezilinganiselwe ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ibhekwa phambili kulolu hlelo.

Ukuhlinzeka Ngokuqeqeshwa: Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze bathole amakhono amasha. Ukwenza Izinqumo Ngemigomo: Ukuvumela abasebenzi ukuba babe nengxenye ezinqumweni zenkampani. Ukwakhiwa Kweqembu: Ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yokwakha iqembu ukuze umoya wokusebenza uthuthukiswe. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemihlangano: Ukuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yokuxoxisana ngempumelelo. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ikhumbule uma uhlinzeka ngimiklomelo? Kubantu abahlinzeka ngimiklomelo, kubalulekile ukuba bagcine izinto ezimbalwa engqondweni: 1. Ukuqonda Abasebenzi: Qonda izidingo zabo ukuze uhlinzeke ngimiklomelo efanele. Ubulungiswa: Qinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo inikezwa ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokubandlulula. Ukukhuthaza Ukubambisana: Qinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo ibamba iqhaza ekukhuthazeni ubudlelwano. Ukusebenza Ngempumelelo: Hlola njalo ukuthi imiklomelo iyasebenza yini emsebenzini. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani izinkampani zingakwazi ukugcina imiklomelo yabo ihlanzekile? Izinkampani zingaqinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo yabo iphumelelisa izinjongo zenkampani. Lokhu kungabandakanya: 1. Ukuhlola Imiphumela: Qapha imiphumela yemiklomelo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iyathuthukisa ukusebenza. Ukwenza Izinguquko: Khuluma nabasebenzi ukuze uthole impendulo nokuqonda ukuthi yini engasebenza kangcono. Ukugcina Izinga: Qinisekisa ukuthi imiklomelo ihlale ibalulekile futhi iyakhanga. Umbuzo 10: Yini esizayo ngenqubomgowo yemiklomelo? Ngokuvamile, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlala zithuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo. Ukubheka izidingo zabasebenzi kuzo zonke izikhathi kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bekwazi ukwenza kahle emsebenzini.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala liphakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu. Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi. Ngokuphetha, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlala lishintsha, lihlala linomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokuhlupheka, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinhlelo zentela ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zithola ithuba lokuphila kahle. I-Ningizimu Afrika ibheke phambili, ibheke ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo, futhi izinga lentela lizoba yinsika ebalulekile kulokhu kuqhubeka.

I-RXH idinga uhlelo lokwelashwa luhlotshaniswe nesiguli. Umgidi wacishe wonakala ngesikhathi iqembu lentsha engaziwa, eyayibhema ngemuva kwamathoyilethi angomahambanendlwana, iwisa ugwayi ovuthayo phansi, nokuyikhona okwaqala umlilo wequbula. Sibukeza futhi sichibiyela imigomo yezifundazwe yokugunyaza ukwenza izinto ezithile. Ishayelwa yizinqubomgomo zokukhululeka ekuhwebelaneni nakwezezimali. Izingane kade zisebenzisa amakesi njengezihlalo ukuze zihlale. Ulwazi olumayelana nezidingo zezenhlalakahle, ukungalingani kanye nokusilela emuva kwentuthuko luyoqoqwa. Ubufakazi bokucima umlilo bubheka izindlela ezinobuhlakani ezisetshenziswe yizinkampani ukutshala umqondo wokuzibambela ngaphakathi ezinhlanganweni. Yizinto zokusebenza eziphambili kakhulu kwabezindaba, kusho uMnu Gosper. Ukuhlonza noma ukubeka phambili kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi okwenzelwa ukuqinisekisa imiphumela. Inhloko yomnyango wezobunhloli nokuvikeleka kwakunguMnu Mzwai Poliso. Abasolwa bazovela enkantolo yemantshi eBenoni ukuze babhekane namacala okutholakala benesibhamu esingekho emthethweni kanye nezinhlamvu. Ukwengeza kulezi zindlela ezicindezelayo, nemisebenzi eminingi eyenziwa wuhulumeni noma labo abanamandla okuthatha izinqumo esikhundleni sawo. Abasolwa babe sebebaleka nesamba semali esingaziwa. Lokhu kwakhombisa ukuthi iDolobha lalingena khaxa lizofuna imali ekweletwayo. Usenike izeluleko ezindabeni eziningi ezithinta izinhlangano zabesifazane. I-MONUC, yabika ukuthi ukusabalala kokungaboshelwa ububi umuntu abenzile kwenza ukuba ukuhlukunyezwa okuningi kungajeziswa, ngisho emva kwezinyanga enziwa.

Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka nokuphumelela kokubeletha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zempilo, abazali, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze lezi zinqubo zenziwe kahle. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokubeletha ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo yomama nabantwana, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bazizwa bephephile, futhi bathola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukubeletha akuyona nje inqubo yokuzalwa, kodwa kuyisigaba esibalulekile sokwakha umndeni, futhi lezi zinqubo kufanele zihlale zibe sezingeni eliphezulu.

Umthelela Wokugqugquzela Nokuqwashisa Ngempilo Ezinhle Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, ukudlala kwemidlalo yesikole kufanele kudlale indima enkulu ekuqwashiseni ngempilo. Izinhlelo zokudla eziphilile, ukwelulekwa kahle, kanye nezindlela zokugcina umzimba unempilo zibalulekile. Uqhakambisa umqondo wokuhlala unempilo, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokuqonda indlela yokuphila kahle ngoba imidlalo ibalulekile ukuze izingane zifeze lokho. Izikhumbuzo Ezingangeza Ekuphileni Kwemfundo Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ibhodi yezenzo kumele ibuha izindlela zokukhuthaza ukugqugquzela nokuqwashisa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ezinkezi zokuqwashisa ngemiphumela emihle yokudansa phakathi kwemidlalo yesikole. Lokhu kuyindlela yokukhumbuza abantwana ukuthi ukuphila kungenziwa kube okuthokozisayo nempela. Iminhla yokwazi, imicimbi yokugqugquzela amandla okuncintisana, nemikhosi yamasiko kufanele kube yingxenye yenzuzo yephakheji yepolitiki. Umbono Wokugcina Imidlalo yesikole ihloba kakhulu neziqu ezinkulu zemfundo. Izikole, abafundisi, nabazali banelungelo lokusebenzisa lesi sikhali ukuze baqinise umqondo wokubambisana, ukusebenza, nokukhuliswa kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobuciko, nokuzikhandla. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yesikole ayisiyona nje eyomzimba, kepha iyinsiza ebaluleke kakhulu yokwakha umphakathi nosonkanyezi abavulelekile. Emavi emidlalo yesikole, kufanele siqhubeke nokuqhubekisela phambili umoya wokuthola amandla obukhali, ubumbano, nokuqonda impilo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekugcinweni kwempilo nomphakathi ophumelelayo.

Izinqubomgomo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinhlelo zokuthathwa komhlaba kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezihambisana nezimfuneko zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinqubomgomo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo zokuthathwa komhlaba zenzelwa abantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinxephezelo ezikhona zikhona. Izixazululo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kuhamba kahle, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izixazululo zingabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo, ukuze baqonde izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba, kanye nezindlela zokuphikisa uma kudingeka. Isiphetho Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo ihamba kahle, futhi ibhekelela amalungelo abantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo bayavumelana, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana, izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuthathwa komhlaba kufanele kube inqubo esebenza kahle, ehlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi eqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izithakazelo zikhuluma ndawonye ukuze kuzuze umphakathi wonke. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi noma ukusiza, sicela uxhumane nezikhungo ezifanele zomthetho noma ezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingase zibe usizo ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezihlobene nokuthathwa komhlaba.

Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ikakhulukazi kubantu abahamba phambili empilweni, abadinga ukuxhaswa ngezinsiza ezithile. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi izinqubo zokuqinisekisa kufanele zibe lula futhi zisheshiswe ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela izidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani eziphatha lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise lesi sikhathi sokulinda. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngesikhathi, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle, ezisheshayo, nezithembekile zidingeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo, futhi kuzokhulula umthwalo ezinkampanini eziphethe lezi zinhlelo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakala kubantu zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubheka ukuthi abantu basebenzisa kanjani lezi zinsiza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azisetshenziswanga ngokungafanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu bezimali, okungaholela ekutheni izinsiza zempesheni zihlale zikhona ukuze zisetshenziswe ngempumelelo. Ngokuhlanganyela, lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kudinga ukuba kube nenqubo eqondile, ehloniphekile, futhi esheshayo. Abantu kumele bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo ngaphandle kokubambezela, kodwa futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo.

Usihlalo ufana nombhidi webhendi hhayi umhlabeleli uhlabelela ngayedwana. Zama ukuthi kungabi uwena okhuluma kakhulu kodwaulalele ukuthi abanye bathini futhi ubheke ukuthi abaphumikwi-ajenda. Bhala phansi amaphuzu abalulekile ngesikhathi sezingxoxo. Yenza ukuthi umhlangano uhambe ngendlela ehlelekilelokhu kusho ukuqiniseka ukuthi izikhulumi ziyahlonishwa, abantu abalibali ukuhleka noma ukukhuluma emhlanganweni. Zama ukuqeda umhlangano ngesikhathi. Ikomidi lesigceme kemele lithathe izinqumo ngokuvumelana. Imidanti emile ingase inqume ukuthi amakomidi ezigceme kufaneleathamele yonke imihlangano yawo, futhi ilungu eliphuthaemihlanganweni edlula kwemithathu ilandelana lingazangelivunyelwe lingakhishwa ekomidini yesigceme. Imidanti ezimele inganquma indlela yokoziphatha emhlanganweni isibonelo ukulala, noma ukufika udakiwe emhlanganweni nomaukuba namazwi ayiziswana ngelinye noma amanye amalungukusho ukuziphatha kabi ngokwendlela yokuziphatha. Imvume yokudlulisela ulwazi emphakathini (nomakumaphephandaba noma kwabezindaba bebonke) kufanelekuqondiswe kusihlalo. Ilungu lekomidi yesigceme okhipha izimfihlolingalandelanga imigudu efanele linecala. USihlalo, emzamweni wokugcina ukuhleleka emihlanganwenilekomidi lesigceme, angakhipha ilungu lekomiti lesigceme (nomailungu lomphakathi) emhlanganweni. Usihlalo angacela ukuthilomuntu akhishwe noma alengiswe uma engayihloniphi imithetho. Kuvumelekile ukuthi ukuvota kwenziwe ngokuphakamisa izandla, ngaphandle uma kunesicelo esicacile sokusebenzisa ivotieliyimfihlo. Uma sekuvotiwe abantu belingana ngapha nangapha, sekufikwe kwangqingetshe, usihlalo usebenzisa iviyo lakhelokunquma.

Namuhla, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zikhona ezimbonini eziningi, futhi zihlala zishintsha ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo ezithuthukayo. Izinkampani ziqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzi, futhi ziqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokutshala imali ezinhlelweni zokuqeqeshwa, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala bephumelela, bephumelele, futhi bekwazi ukubhekana nezinguquko ezizayo emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube namandla, futhi kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wethu.

Ulwazi luthathwe kuhlelo lwezemfundo ephakeme lokukhiqiza u-sorghum. Umkhiqizi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi kubalulekile lapho ethuthukisa isu futhi ngaphambi kokutshala, njengoba lokhu kuzokwandisa ithuba lokuthola umkhiqizo ophelele njengoba kuhlobene nazo zonke izenzo ezenziwa umphathi. Lezi ezilandelayo yizinto ezingathinta ikhwalithi yezitshalo ezivunyiwe (izinkwa): ukulungiswa komhlaba, ubukhulu bomhlaba, pH, ibhalansi yezimayini, ukugcina umswakama emhlabeni, uhlobo lwezithombo, umanyolo ofanele, ukuphathwa kwezihlahla nezifo, ukuvunwa ngesikhathi esifanele nokuphathwa, ukuhlanza izinkwa, ukuwasha izinkwa, nezindlela zokugcina (ukubeka) izinkwa. Ukuvunwa kuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu lapho kutshalwa u-sorghum. Siqala ukuvuna ngaphambi kokwenza ezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinkwa ezifana nokucubungula, ukugcina, nokuvikela umkhiqizo. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindawo lapho ukuvunwa, ukugcina, nokuvikela izenzo zihlukaniswe. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nokuvuna ngezandla bese konke okukhishwayo kubekwe ukuze kuvunwe kamuva uma sekomile ezindaweni ezincane. Bese kuqhubeka ezindaweni zokulima ezinkulu lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna izinkwa. Ngokuvamile, u-sorghum uvunwa kanye no-maize futhi uvunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma usetshenziswe kusenesikhathi, kanti omunye uvunwa ngoMeyi uma usetshenziswe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvunwa kwe-maize kuqale. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezincane lapho ama-combine angavuna u-sorghum no-maize.

Iqembu elifisa ukuqala noma ukuphikisa udaba olusezithebeni zenkantolo nelinombono wokuthi lihlwempu noma umuntu othile osebenza egameni lalelo qembu kufanele enelise uNobhala ukuthi ngaphandle kwempahla yasendlini, izingubo zokugqoka nezikhali zokusebenza, lelo qembu alinamafa afinyelela ku -R20 000 futhi ngeke likwazi ukuthola maduzane leyo mali ngomholo eliwutholayo. Uma kwenziwa amakhophi, inkokhelo enqunywe emtheshwaneni- 6a iyokhokhwa. Amakhophi ombhalo ogciniwe angenziwa yinoma ngubani, inqobo uma enziwa kukhona Unobhala. a Ngokucelwa yiqembu, Unobhala angenza ikhophi yombhalo wenkantolo uma sekukhokhwe imali yenkantolo ekhokhwa ngokuthenga isitembu sika- R0,50 ikhophi ngayinye egayiwe engu A4 ogcwele noma ingxenyana, uma kukhokhwa omunye u-R1.00 leyo khophi ingagxivizwa ngesiqiniseko sokuthi iwumfanekiso waleyo yangempela umbhalo ofungelwe. b Imali yasenkantolo ingahoxiswa nguNobhala uma umuntu ehlwempu njengoba kuphawuliwe emtheshwaneni- 4 no 5. Uma inkantolo ithatha isinqumo esigunyaza noma esinika isiqiniseko sanoma yimuphi umthetho noma umbandela oshayisanayo noMthethosisekelo ngaphansi kwesigaba- 172 soMthethosisekelo, zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu -15 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwesinqumo, Unobhala angathatha izinyathelo zokwenza leso sinqumo sishicilelwe kwiGazethe kazwelonke neyesifundazwe uma leso sinqumo sincikene nomthetho wesifundazwe.

Awekho amandla ommeli noma igunya lokuthatha isinyathelo eliyodingeka kunoma ngubani osebenza egameni likaHulumeni. Ngemvume yawo wonke amaqembu athintekayo odabeni oluphambi kweNkantolo ekhishwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi esinqunywe kumtheshwana 5, nangokuhambisana nale mithetho, noma ngubani onentshisekelo odabeni oluthile olusezithebeni zenkantolo angavunyelwe ukubamba iqhaza njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlanganyela odabeni inqobo uma ezohambisana nemigomo kanye nemibandela, amalungelo namagunya okuvunyelwana ngawo ngokubhalwe phansi nawo onke amaqembu athintekayo noma ngendlela enqunywe nguMphathimaJaji ngokulandisa komtheshwana 3. Imvume ebhaliwe ephawulwe emtheshwaneni 1 iyothulwa kuNobhala zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu itholiwe ngokunjalo ofuna ukuba yingxenye yodaba kufanele engezele ngokuhambisana nezikhathi ezibekiwe ukuze kwethulwe impikiswano ebhalwe phansi. UmphathimaJaji angachibiyela imigomo, imibandela, amagunya namalungelo okuvunyelwene ngayo naphawulwe emtheshwaneni 1. Uma imvume ebhaliwe neqondwe emtheshwaneni 1 ingatholakalanga, noma ngubani onentshisekelo odabeni oluphambi kwezithebe zenkantolo angafaka isicelo kuMphathimaJaji ngenhloso yokwemukelwa njengomuntu ofuna ukubamba iqhaza, UmphathimaJaji angakhipha imvume evuna isicelo ngaphansi kwemibandela namagunya kanjalo namalungelo nemigomo eliyibona ifanele.

Isitezi sokunakekela izingane siyindawo ebhalisiwe yokunakekela izingane. Izindawo zokunakekela izingane zingafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali njalo ngenyanga kuhulumeni ukuze zisize ngezindleko zokusebenza kwesitezi sokunakekela izingane. Inani lokwesekwa kwemali liyahluka futhi lincike ezindlekweni zokusebenza kwesitezi kanye nenani lezingane ezihlala lapho. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali? Izindawo zokunakekela izingane ezibhalisiwe. Qedela ifomu ehhovisi lezinsizakalo zomphakathi eliseduze. Ifomu eliqediwe kumele lisayinwe nguSihlalo weKomidi Lokuphatha kanye noMphathi weSikhungo Sokunakekela Izingane ofaka isicelo. Thumela isicelo kanye nesitifiketi sokubhaliswa njenge-NPO kanye nezitatimende zebhange kumnyango wezimali. Ukusekelwa kwemali kuyatholakala esikhungweni sezingane ezihlala lapho. Imali yokwesekwa ikhokhelwa esitezi, hhayi ezinganeni. Inqubo yesicelo izothatha ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma usuthumele isicelo sakho, ubuqotho bayo buzohlolwa. Uma uMnyango ujabule ngesicelo, uzonikezwa imali. Isinqumo sisisekela ekutholakaleni kwemali nasekudingekeni kwalesi sevisi. Umnyango wehulumeni unikeza imali yokwesekwa kwezinyanga ezintathu, kuye ngokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yesikhungo sokunakekela izingane. Le sevisi iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhiswa.

Kuningi osekwenziwe ukuhlangabezana nalezo zinselelo nezandulelo, kodwa ngenxa yokusweleka kwesikhathi esanele nezinto zokusebenza iseyinde kakhulu indlela eya phambili. Ngokulandela isesekelo sezinqubomgomo namasu kahulumeni kuzwelonke, kuyadingeka ukuba izandulelo kwezemidlalo nokungcebelekwa kubuye kubhekisiswe futhi kushintshwe. Ukuze kufezwe inqubomgomo kahulumeni yempilo engcono kuwonke wonke, nokwenza isizwe sidlale, ukusungulwa kweKhomishani yezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka yaseNingizimu Afrika kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizoqinisekisa ukuthi ezemidlalo zifinyelela kuzo zonke izingxenye zeNingizimu Afrika. Iminikelo ephuma kubaxhasi abanjenge, ukuSizwa kwabaMpofu (Poverty Relief), Ukwakhiwa kweziNgqalasizinda (Infrastructure Creation), iminikelo eyaqoqwa eNgqungqutheleni yezemisebenzi (Job summit) kanye nemali etholakala kulothali kaZwelonke (National lottery) yokuthuthukisa izimfanelo zezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ezindaweni ebezinganakiwe nguhulumeni odlule izoba yindlela efanele yokwenza ezemidlalo zitholakale kuzakhamuzi zakuleli eziningi. AbezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) bazinqumele lezi mpokophelo ezilandelayo, eziyisisekelo somgomo othi "senza isizwe sidlale". a ukwandisa izinga lokubamba iqhaza emicimbini yezemidlalo nezokungcebeleka b Ukuphakamisa umlando wezemidlalo nakuba kunezinto eziphikisanayo. c Ukwandisa amathuba empumelelo emicimbini emikhulu. d Ukubeka phambili ezemidlalo emizamweni yokuhlangabezana nezinto ezibakulekile kuzwelonke.

Ukuthethelelwa okwenziwe yiqembu akusho ukuthi seliyawahoxisa amalungelo alo ngaphansi kwale SIVUMELWANO, ngakho-ke, lelo qembu angeke libe nesivimbezelo sokusebenzisa amalungelo alo ngenxa yokuthi esikhathini esidlule kade lixolelile noma ngoba kukhona okuqhamukayo. AMAQEMBU akule SIVUMELWANO ayavumelana ukuthi azokwenganyelwa amandla eNkantolo Enkulu yesiFundazwe saseTransvaal, yeNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika (noma iNkantolo Ephakeme leyo okungathi ukuhamba kwesikhathi kube yiyo esinamandla engamele iNkantolo yesifunda ePitoli), maqondana nanoma yisiphi isinyathelo noma ukubophana okungaqhamuka kule SIVUMELWANO. Inqobo nje uma le likheli elingenhla lingashintshwa ngokubhalwe phansi linikezwe leli elinye iqembu, bese liqala ukusebenza emva kwezinsuku eziyishumi sinikeziwe isaziso: Inqobo nje uma ikheli elisha elikhethiwe yiqembu lizobe nalo lingaphansi kwendawo lapho kunokuhanjiswa khona amaphepha. Noma yisiphi isaziso esinikeziwe maqondana nale SIVUMELWANO singahanjiswa ngesandla, noma sithunyelwe ngeposi elikhokhelwe: Inqobo nje uma noma yisiphi isaziso nomaamaphepha ahanjiswe kwiqembu maqondana nanoma yiluphi udaba noma isihloko kule SIVUMELWANO nanoma yisiphi isaziso siyothathwa njengesidlulisiwe uma sinikezwe umuntu omdala ekhelini lomthetho elikhethwe yinoma yiliphi lamaqembu futhi angeke kube nesidingo sokunikeza iqembu ngqo. ngosuku lwesikhombisa kusukela osukwini lokuyiposa, okubala usuku lokuyiposa, uma iposwe ngokurejistiwe; futhi ngosuku ethunyelwe ngalo uma ithunyelwe ngefeksi.

b ukuqhathanisa, ukuhlaziya nokusetshenziswa kwezinye izindlela zobuchwepheshe kubandakanya ukushaywa kwezithombe ngabasemabhanoyini kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemishini yamakhompiyutha. uma lungenele ulwazi olusezingeni lokudayiswa kwanoma yimuphi umkhakha wempahla efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo, ukuze kusetshenziswe izigatshana- 1 ne -2, impahla yalolo hlobo ingahlolwa ngokulandela indlela yokuhlola edidiyele noma ngokusebenzisa isu elemukelwe wumasipalati waleyondawo nanjengokuba kufanelekile, kubandakanya uhlobo lokuhlola olugxile enanini lwemikhakha eyase ivele ihlelwe phambilini kanye nokuqokwa kwezimpahla zaleyo mikhakha ngaphansi kwesisekelo solwazi olumayelana namanani aphansi kwezokudayisa. ngokulandela kwezigaba zalomthetho, inani lokudayisa impahla elenziwe ngcono kufanele kube yinani lempahla ebizodayiswa ngalo ngosuku lokuhlola kunanoma ngubani ofuna ukuyithenga. b inani lanoma yikuphi ukwenziwa ngcono kwenani lempahla eyakhiwa noma esisetshenziselwa izinhloso okungezona eyayakhelwe zona, kufanele ibandakanywe njengenani layo selenziwe ngcono futhi kubesengazuthi isetshenziswa ngokusemthethweni. b Lanoma yisiphi isakhiwo esixhunywe kulendlu esisetshenziswa ngokwehlukile; kanye c nokunye okungase kuhambisane nalezi zakhiwo d Kulesi sigaba, igama noma isisho esinikezwe incazelo Emthethweni Wamatayitele anobunikazi obusegcekeni elilodwa, linencazelo efanayo. iphepha lokuhlola kufanele liveze uhlu olu qukethe yonke impahla okufanele ikhokhelwe intela yendawo kumasipalati, ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 27. g Ikheli lemposi lomnikazi; kanye h Nayo yonke imininingwane esemthethweni.

4.1 Ubani umlingiswa oqavile kule ndaba Kungabe umbhali/umlandi ukwazile yini ukusheshe amethule Beka kucace? 2.2 Ubani lo ebifuna ukwazi ukuthi uyacacisa noma akacacisi? "Uqinisile," efakazelwa ngunina, "Umoya wami bese wephuke kabi Dokotela Kenny ngokuba ngithi ngihlupheka kangaka ingane yami iyophazanyiswa yimfanayo kanguboziyeweni." "Pho, uthuswa yini wena Sixova, uma wazi ukuthi umsulwa" kubuza ubaba uXulu belu? Hlalani ngamaqembu nenze lo msebenzi olandelayo ngokuxoxisana. 1.2 Ngabe bayathandeka yini noma abathandeki emphakathini Phendula uphikise noma uvumelane nalo mbuzo obekwe ngenhla unike izizathu ngokubona kwakho? Abafundi bavumelana. Bahamba bayobikela uThishanhloko wesikole sabo ngalo mbono wabo. Wafika wawuthokozela. Kwamenyezelwa ngombhobho, kwabizwa umhlangano. Abafundi baphuma ngobuningi babo. Kwakubonakala ngemibalabala yamanyufomu. Basuka emhlanganweni sebekhethwe baba ikomidi. Baqala emasupermarket, baya esikhumulweni samatekisi nesamabhasi. UMlobane wabonakala eseyisigwili baze baba nokudideka abanye. Wathi uma ebuzwa, wathi uwine ijackpot emahashini. Kwagcina kuvelile ukuthi ayikho imali uMlobane ayiwine emahashini, kodwa webe imali kagogo wakhe. 1.2 Ngabe isiphi isithombe esinifikela emiqondweni yenu, uma nifunda lesi sihloko Bekani kuzwakale. Lona enimkhethile ukuba abhale imicabango enifikelayo ngalesi sihloko njengeqembu akayibhale yonke imicabango yenu, kanye nezizathu zokucabanga ngale ndlela enicabange ngayo. Konke enixoxisane ngakho akakugcine ngoba nizobuye nikusebenzise kungekudala?

Ngokwenhloso yalo mbhalo-ke uChief Financial Officer noma lowo amqokile angalalela izicelo ezidluliselwe kuyena ngenxa yokuthi azamukelwanga. Ofake isicelo kungadingeka ukuba avume ukuba ahlolwe ngudokotela oqokwe nguMasipala futhi, kube ngofake isicelo okhokhayo. UChief Financial Officer noma lowo amqokile angathatha isinqumo nakanjani okumele sihlonishwe. Uma abantu abahola impesheni yokukhubazeka / abangasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula befaka isicelo unyaka nonyaka, bangancishiselwa imali, njengokusho kwesinqumo soMkhandlu kulwabiwomali lwawo lonyaka, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga elandela usuku lokufakwa kwesicelo ngaphansi kwale mibandala elandelayo: a abahola imali yokukhubazeka: ofaka isicelo kumele abe nencwadi ekhishwa nguMnyango Wezenhlalakahle Yomphakathi eqinisekisa ukuthi uthola impesheni yokukhubazeka, NOMA incwadi kadokotela eqinisekisa ukuthi ukhubazekile futhi akasakwazi ukusebenza; b abangasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula: ofaka isicelo kufanele akhiphe incwadi evela kumqashi wakhe noma kumshuwalense womqashi wakhe eqinisekisa ukuthi akasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula; c ofaka isicelo kumele alethe umazisi wakhe onamagabelo; d ofaka isicelo kumele kube uhlala khona ngokugcwele kulowo muzi; e ofaka isicelo kumele abe ngumnikazi walowo muzi obhaliswe ngokusemthethweni. f abanikazi ngokuhlanganyela kumele bafeze le mibandela engenhla noma eku-7.2 ngenhla g ama-akhawunti amanzi, ugesi namarates kumele abe ndawonye egameni lomnikazi h ohlelweni lokusingathelwa ifa, umsingathi wefa kumele afeze yonke imibandela engenhla. Kumele kuvezwe nekhophi yetayitela.

Lapho ufisa ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho lokulima ngendlela efanelekile, kubalulekile ukthi ubeke phansi imogomo nezinhloso zakho. Awungeke ulandele indlela kodwa awazi ukuthi uzofika endaweni lapho uqonde khona. Kaningi abakhiqizi babizwa ngokuthi abakwazi noma bayazisola ukubeka phansi izinhloso zebhizinisi noma ezabo. Kunzima kunzima ukuhlanganisa izinhloso zebhizinisi lokulima ngoba izimo zalo msebenzi aziqondile, awazi ukuthi ikusasa lizobanjani. Kuthathaisikhathi esiningi kakhulu ukuhlanganisa izinhloso eziqondile zebhizinisi lokulima. Zombili lezi zathu zineqiniso, kodwa ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa izinhloso kuyinto engafaneli ishiywe ngemuva, nokho kunzima futhi kuthatha isikhathi. Imigomo nezinhloso (amasu) kukhombisa indlela eya ngaphambili, ngaphandle kwakho awungeke wazi ukuthi uzophumelela noma uzolahlekelwa. Ngaphandle kwenhloso awukwazi ukulinganisa ukuthi usebenze kahle ngoba ayikho into oqonde kuyo. Ukuhlanganisa inhloso nokubeka umgomo emsebenzini wokulima kunzima futhi kuthatha isikhathi kodwa kubaluleke kakhulu ukwenza lowo msebenzi, kufanele siwenze. Ukubeka phansi nokuhlanganisa izinhloso zebhizinisi lokulima kaningi kuletha izinkinga. Isizathu salokho kuholakala lapha: ukulima kuyindlela yomlimi yokusebenza futhi kuyindlela umlimi ephila ngayo (kuyimpilo yakhe). Umndeni wakhe uyinxenye yezinto ezihambelana nomsebenzi wakhe wokulima nempilo yakhe. Ngokujwayelekile siyazi inhloso enkulu yebhizinisi iqonde ukuthola inzuzo nakusasa, kodwa ekulimeni lokhu akuhambelani sonke isikhathi ngoba ibhizinisi nendlela yokuphila kuhlangene.

Ukwakha izingqalasizinda ezizosentshenziswa ezingeni lasekhaya noma izifundazwe. f Ukwenza izinqubomgomo zeminye iminyango kahulumeni zihambisane nenqubomgomo yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ngomoya wokuhlela nokusiza umphakathi ngokubambisana. g Ukunikeza izaluleko zezomthetho ngasohlangothini lukahulumeni kubo bonke abathintekayo kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. h Ukuxhasa ngezimali labo abasizwa ngabezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika ngokuhambisana noMthetho wokuPhathwa kwezimali zoMbuso PFMA, nemithethonkambiso yawo, kanye nenqubomgomo yokuxhasa ngezimali yabezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika, ukubeka iso ekusentshenzisweni kwalezo zimali, ukwaluleka labo abaxhaswayo ngokuphathwa kwezimali. i Ukwengamela ubudlelwano kuhulumeni okusho ubudlelwano phakathi kweminyango kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika naphakathi kwabantu ngokwabo kanye nohulumeni bamanye amazwe ababambisene neNingizimu Afrika kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. j Ukuqhakambisa labo badlali ababambe iqhaza ngokuvelele emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika ngokubanikeza izidondo ezibizwa ngokulandela inqubomgomo kahulumeni kaZwelonke. b Ukuqhubela phambili ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ePhalamende. d Ukwaluleka ngokwenziwa kwamanye amazwe kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Ohulumeni bezifundazwe yibona abaseduze nomphakathi mayelana nokuletha usizo lwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kunohulumeni kazwelonke. aBenze ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka zitholakale/zifinyeleleke kalula kubo bonke abantu baleso sifundazwe. a Bakhe izingqalasizinda ezidingekayo zezemidlalo nokungcebeleka, nokunakekelwa kwazo.

Abagibeli ngeke baphathe ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabantu abafileyo, kodwa lesi sabelo sishintshele kuMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme. UMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme akadingi ukuzibandakanya mathupha ekuphathweni kwezindaba zezimali zabafileyo. UMphakathi uzokhetha umuntu ofanele emsebenzini wokuphatha impahla yomuntu ofile. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela impahla, umuntu angasazisa ukuthi impahla izokwabiwa kanjani ngaphansi komthetho wezifiso. Lokhu kufanele kubhalwe kwiWill. UMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza ngcono umthetho ophathelene nezifiso. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngokuvumela umndeni ophumulelayo ukuvumelana ngendlela impahla yomufi kufanele ihlukaniswe. Nokho, uMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme akufanele avumele amaqembu abuthakathaka afana nezingane nabesifazane ukuba aphathwe kabi ngenxa yezivumelwano zomndeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika baqonde lezi zinguquko ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izimpahla zabo ngendlela efanele. UMsunguli Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme usungule umshini wocingo lapho usizo lungatholakala khona.

Lokhu kuhlola kuqeda amaphutha nabanye. Lokhu kuhamba kancane ukusebenza ngaphakathi nemigomo yeMiphakathi yokuhlukunyezwa kobandlululo, okuyindida ezehla emiphakathini. Ukubuyiswa kokukhumbula ukuthi kunciphisa ukungalingani komphakathi. Uhlanga lobandlululo lungahlaziya izinkinga ezithile ziholele emikhakheni emisha yokuphila, nokuqhubekela phambili emvothweni ejulile, ijubane elihamba phambili kulolu hlelo kuyakhanya. Kumele sicabangele ukuthi, njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, nezinkolelo nokwenza kusebenza kumele kuhlale ngaphansi kokuhlaziya. Umphakathi asetshenziswa uthando lobuntu kumaphuzu ahlukahlukene ukuze uthuthukise inhloso eyiyo. Ngako konke lokhu, uhlelo lobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika kulokhu luyisifundo esiqinile, esikhuluma ngephupho lokukwazi okukhulu kokuhlala sobala emhlabeni wonke, ngenkathi sikhumbula ukugcina ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu bazo zonke izizathu. Le ngxoxo ibalulekile, iqhuba ukukhumbula kwesokudla, ikhuluma ngezindleko, imiphumela neqhaza lokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono.

a liqala ukusebenza ekuqaleni konyaka wezimali kulandela ukuphela kwesikhathi sokuhlolwa gumphakathi esidingwa yIsigaba-- 42; bese b lisebenza kulowonyaka wezimali noma owodwa noma eminye eminingi elandelayo ngokwesinqumo salowo masipalati kodwa isamba sayo singabi ngaphezu kweminyaka yezimali emine. ngokwesicelo sikamasipalati, ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe wohulumeni basemakhaya engaselula isikhathi sokusebenza kwamaphepha okuhlola sibe yiminyaka yezimali emihlanu. umasipalati kufanele aqoke umhloli kamasipalati ngaphambi kosuku lokuhlola. a kufanele aqaphele ukuqokwa kwabahloli bakamasipalati; bese b ethatha izinyathelo ezifanele, kubandakanya nokugxambukela ngokulandisa kwesigaba -139 somthethosisekelo wezwe, uma umasipalati ehluleka ukuhambisana nesigatshana- 1. f alungise isichibiyelo sephepha lokuhlola njalo uma kudingekile; bese g elekelele umasipalati ngokuweseka okudidiyelwe kwezokuphatha uma loko kudingekile emaphepheni okuhlola umphakathi kamasipalati angajuba omunye wezikhulu zikamasipalati ukuba elekelele abahloli bakamasipalati ngokwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi obalulwe esigatshaneni 1. ngesikhathi kuqokwa abelekeleli babahloli bakamasipalati, umhloli kamasipalati akudingekile ukuba abuyise izindleko kumasipalati mayelana nokuqokwa kwaloluhlobo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa isivumelwano esenziwa phakathi komhloli nomasipalati kulandela uhlela oluvulekile kanye nokuncintisana okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni -30 2. umasipalati angangena esivumelwaneni nomasipalati noma omasipalati ekuqokeni umhloli kamasipalati oyedwa bese bebambisana ezindlekweni zokulungisa amaphepha okuhlola.

Inhloso yale ngxenye iwukuhlinzeka abaphathi ngencazelo emfushane ye-insurance yokuphila eyinhloko enikezwa ngaphansi kwe-Overview yezinto eziyisisekelo ze-insurance ezihlinzekwa ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo ye-Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA) ngaphansi kwenombolo yeGPA Policy FASA/1998-00426 ephethwe yiFASA (Abaphathi abavuma ukukhokha uma kwenzeka ingozi baphuma kwiHollard Insurance Company Ltd). Izinzuzo ezihlobene nokufa nokukhubazeka okungapheli kokuphila kwakho zikhokhelwa ngaphezu kwezinye izinzuzo ezikhokhelwa kwezinye izinsiza (isb., Group Life, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases (COID), RAF). Izinzuzo zokukhubazeka okwesikhashana okuphelele zikhokhelwa kuphela kuze kube yilapho kuboniswa khona ngokwezimali yiPhalamende mayelana nokukhubazeka kwesikhashana komuntu ongena emshwalweni. Izinzuzo zezeMpilo zihlobene kuphela nokulimala komzimba okubangelwa yingozi. Izinzuzo zezeMpilo ezivela ezimweni ezihlobene nomsebenzi ez covered by COID kumele zifakwe kwi-COID claim. Ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo ye-Group Personal Accident Insurance kuzohlinzeka kuphela "ngokungezelela" uma inani elincane kakhulu likhokhelwa uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okudingekayo. (QAPHELA: Lokhu akuzokwenzeka njengoba i-COID ihlinzeka ngezindleko zezeMpilo ezingapheli zokulimala okuhlobene nomsebenzi). Izinzuzo zezeMpilo ezingakwazi ukufakwa ukuze zikhokhelwe ngaphansi kwe-COID kumele zifakwe ukuze zikhokhelwe ngaphansi kwale GPA policy. Ukufa ngengozi - 60% yeSalaries yonyaka ephindwe ngo-5 njengoba kuchaziwe.

OWENKONTILEKA umsebenzi wakhe uzowenza ngokwesheduli exhunyelwe lapha yaba uSheduli A. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma izinsuku abekade engekho ngazo ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. u-SAPS uzoba nomsebenzi wokunikeza OWENKONTILEKA ezokuthutha imoto ukuya nokubuya EMSEBENZINI ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe bheka iziGaba 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. U-SAPS uzomholela OWENKONTILEKA ngokuba khona nangomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yenkontilela ezoba R - ...amarandi ngehora kuhlanganiswa ntelelaye-VAT: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS kungathi ekuhambeni kwesikhathi ngokuzikhethela kwakhe abuye ayikhuphule le mali yakhe yesivumelwano ekhokhelwa ngehora. Lo mholo ukhokhwa kamuva zinyanga zonke nghlobo lwemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yenkontileka (bona isiGaba 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo usuphelele nao zonke izinto eziyizinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi woWENKONTILEKA Inqobo, lokho kubanjwa kwemali kuhambisana nomThetho othize, iyobanjwa emholweni woWENKONTILEKA.

Ngokwesibonelo, ukuvuselela izindlela zokulima, ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nokwakha izimakethe ezikahle ukuze kubonakale imikhiqizo yendawo, kungasiza ekukhuphuleni umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekwakheni imisebenzi emisha, okwenza kube nokwanda kwemali engenayo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesithathu, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele, kungasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya. Uhlelo lwezokuthuthukiswa lwezindawo zasemakhaya luyoba khona uma kunokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalezi zingxenye. Lokhu kubambisana kudinga izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bakhuliswa, baziqhenya ngezindawo zabo, futhi babe nesibopho sokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yabo. Imibono efana nokwakha amaqembu omphakathi, ukwakha izikhungo zokufundisana, kanye nokuxhumana ngezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, kuyasiza ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kubalulekile ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo eqhubekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zibhekelele futhi zivikele imvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo ngendlela sustainable, ukwenza izinhlelo zokuqinisa umhlaba, kanye nokuthi abantu basemakhaya bazi kahle ngendaba yokuvikelwa kwemvelo. Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingafunda ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nokwandisa isimo sokuphila kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zidinga ukuhunyushwa ngenhlonipho kumasiko, izinkolelo, kanye nezifiso zabantu bendawo. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqhuba ucwaningo olujulile ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zomphakathi.

NgokweMthetho Wokukhokha Izinkokhelo Zokulimala Ngezisebenzi Nezifo Zonyaka ka-1993, abaqashi badinga ukuveza zonke izifo noma izifo ezibangela umsebenzi emfundweni yokukhokha. Abakwaqashi kufanele baqedele umbiko wabo wezifo ezihlobene nomsebenzi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokuba bazi ngalesi sifo. Umbiko wokugcina wezokwelapha wesifo somsebenzi, umbiko wezinyembezi, umoya, umphumela, nezinye. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-60. Umbiko Womqashi Wesifo Somsebenzi, ID: W.CL. Umbiko wokuqala wezokwelapha mayelana nesifo somsebenzi, ID: W.CL. Isaziso ngesifo somsebenzi nokufaka isicelo sokukhokha, ID: W.CL. Umbiko wokugcina noma wokuthuthuka wezokwelapha mayelana nesifo somsebenzi, ID: W.CL.

Ekupheleni, umthetho ophatha izinga lomsebenzi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono abantu asetshenziswa ngokuphelele futhi ezinye izinsiza zithinte kahle imiphumela yomsebenzi, okuyimizamo yokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuguqula kuMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bahambisana nohlelo lokuguqula umsebenzi futhi iphinde ibheke ukuthi izinguquko ezivela ezimfundisweni zomthetho ziphathwa kanjani. Iphinde inikeze uhlaka lokuhlola uma kukhona izinguquko futhi ibeke umthetho. Ikhuthaza futhi ikhuthaza ukuvuleka nokucacile, futhi ukuze abasebenzi babambe iqhaza ukuze baqinise ubudlelwano bokwethembana, ukubambisana, nokwethembeka kubaphathi, kanye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinhlelo zabasebenzi ezizoba yisisekelo salolu hlelo. Ukususwa kwezinyathelo zokucwaswa ezihlobene nobuhlanga, ubulili, nezinye izici... Abasebenzi abanokucela ukuhlolwa komsebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa komsebenzi wabo, kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwesimo sabo, futhi kungenzeka futhi ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwabo kungancishiswa. Uma kudingeka ukunciphisa isikhundla somsebenzi, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo yokuvimbela lokho ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile kulowo msebenzi. Izinqubo zokuhola kufanele ziqinisekise ubulungiswa, ukungacwaswa, nokufinyelela kumathuba, kanye nokuba nesigaba esisebenzela umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Zonke izikhala kufanele zivuleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, inkolo, ubuzwe, izinkolelo zezombusazwe, isiko, ubudala, ulimi, ukungasebenzi, isimo somshado, nezinye izimo ezihlukahlukene.

Lokhu kubalulekile kumakhasimende afuna izinsizakalo ngesikhathi esifanele, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemidlalweni, emsebenzini, noma emakhaya. Ukusebenza okungapheli kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpilo zabo, kunciphise ukucindezeleka, futhi kwandise ukwaneliseka. Izinselelo Ezihambisana Nokusebenza Kwezikhungo Nokho, njengoba kunamathuba amaningi, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezihambisana nokusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu iwukuphepha. Njengoba ama-ATM ebhekana nezinkinga zokuphanga, izikhungo ezisebenza ngale ndlela nazo zidinga ukuvikela ulwazi lwamakhasimende. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela ulwazi, ukuqapha okungapheli, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bazi kahle ukusebenza kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, abantu bangathola usizo olufanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zisebenza kahle, kudinga ukufundiswa okuqhubekayo kwabantu abasebenza khona, ukuze bahlale bebheke izinguquko zobuchwepheshe. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi zisebenzise izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi, okuvumela amakhasimende ukuthi athole izinsizakalo ngaphandle kokuvakashela ezikhungweni. Lokhu kungenza kube lula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zingasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende angathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ngempumelelo.

Akukho ukuncishiswa kokuhlala okufanele kudlule ama-10% emiholweni yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Ukuncishiswa kokudla akufanele kudlule ama-10% emiholweni yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Uma kukhona abasebenzi bezihlahla ababili noma ngaphezulu abahlala endaweni yokusebenza, inani eliphelele lemali elingancishiswa kubo bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla abahlala kufanele lingadluli ku-25% ethathwe ezingeni lemiholo eliphansi kumuntu osebenza ehlathini. Ngamanye amazwi, uma kukhona abasebenzi bezihlahla abahlanu abahlala ngaphakathi kwenkampani, inani eliphezulu elingancishiswa kumuntu ngamunye lingama-5%. Indlu kumele ibe nekhono elikhulu elingama-30 square meters okungenani. Abasebenzi bezihlahla banesibopho sokubheka impahla yomphathi wabo. Impahla yomphathi ifaka imishini noma ezinye amathuluzi asetshenziswa ngabo ngesikhathi besebenza. Uma umsebenzi wezihlahla engaziphathi kahle ekubhekeni impahla yabo, umphathi angancisha imali ngenxa yokulahleka noma ukonakala. Kumele banikeze umsebenzi wezihlahla ithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi kungani imali ingancishiswa emiholweni yabo. Qinisekisa ukuthi inani elincishisiwe alidluli ingxenye eyodwa ye-quarters yemiholo yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Amalungelo nezibopho zabaphathi kanye nabasebenzi bezihlahla emkhakheni wezihlahla akhishwa ngendlela efuna ukuxazulula izidingo zombili izinhlangothi. Kungaki amahora ongawasebenza umsebenzi wezihlahla ngesonto? Amahora ayisishiyagalolunye ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu noma ngaphansi kwesonto; noma amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezingaphezu kwezihlanu ngesonto. Umsebenzi akufanele asebenze amahora angaphezu kwama-12 ngosuku.

Izingxoxo ezijulile zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abathola umshwalense bahlala benokuthula kwengqondo, ngoba bazi ukuthi bakhululekile uma kwenzeka ukuphazamiseka. Izindleko Zomshwalense Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda nezindleko ezithintekayo. Imishwalense ivamise ukutholakala ngemali ethile, futhi lezi zindleko zingahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomshwalense, izinga lokuvikeleka, kanye nezimo zomuntu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba abantu bahlolisise kahle izinketho zabo, ukuze bakhethe umshwalense ofanele izidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi izindleko zomshwalense zikhula uma umkhawulo wempilo yabo noma uma izinga lempilo lishintsha. Ukukhetha Umshwalense Lapho ukhetha umshwalense, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akukhona konke okubukeka kahle okukhangayo. Kubalulekile ukufunda imibiko, ukuqhathanisa izinkampani ezihlukene, nokuhlola izibuyekezo zabanye abantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba ukhethe inkampani yezezimali enokwethenjelwa, ehloniphekile, futhi enezinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ukuhlola lezi zinto kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela umakhalekhukhwini, umndeni, noma ibhizinisi. Isiphetho Ezomshwalense ziwumqondo obalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Zisiza ukuvikela abantu, imindeni, kanye nezinkampani ezimeni ezinzima, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu basenkingeni bangathola usizo olufanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukufunda nokwazisa izinsizakalo zomshwalense, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nezihlakaniphile ekukhetheni umshwalense ofanele izidingo zabo. Ngale ndlela, sizoba nekhono lokubhekana nezimo ezinzima, sibe nekhono lokuphila impilo enokuthula kwengqondo.

Ungaba kanjani ilungu leGrain SA? Bonke abantu abakhiqiza izitshalo zokudla bangaba amalungu eGrain South Africa. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zokuba amalungu, kodwa ngokujwayelekile, kunezithombe eziningi ezilungile ezikhona ezibandakanya abalimi bezomnotho kanye nalabo abangamalungu ezinhlelweni zokufunda. Ukuze ube ilungu eliphelele lezomnotho, kubiza u-R2 ngentoni yokudla ekhiqizwayo, kodwa akufanele kube ngaphansi kuka-R570 (i-VAT ifakiwe lapha). Kukhona nezinhlaka zokufunda ezibiza u-R10 kuphela ngonyaka. Uma kukhona abantu abafuna ukuhlela iqembu lokufunda futhi babe amalungu eGrain SA, xhumana noMphathi Wokuthuthukiswa endaweni yakho - ikheli nemininingwane yokuxhumana izotholakala ekupheleni kwedokhumenti le. Inhloso yalezi zinhlelo zokufunda ukuhlangana njalo ukuze kuxoxwe ngazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezithombo zokudla. Uma ungumuntu oyi ilungu leqembu, kusho ukuthi uzokwazi futhi ukuh attenda zonke (eziningi) izifundo zokuqeqesha ezitholakala yiGrain SA minyaka yonke. Sithemba ukuthi abalimi abaningi abasafufusa bazoba amalungu aphelele ezomnotho eGrain SA ngenkokhelo yabo ka-R2 ngentoni abavuna. IGrain SA idinga ubulungu bakho ukuze sikwazi ukumela nokulwa nawo wonke amalimi akhiqiza izitshalo zokudla lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

Kungcono ube nemakethe ngaphambi kokutshala ukudla ofuna ukukhiqiza, ngoba kukhona abaningi abalimi abatshala masinya, bese bayathemba nje ukuthi bazothola intengiso enhle ngesikhathi bevuna. Ngalesi sikhathi kubalulekile ukuthi ube nesu ukumaketha umvuno wakho ngendlela ezokulethela inzuzo enhle. Amasu ukumaketha afanele ahambelane namasu okuqala ukutshala isitshalo ofuna ukusikhiqiza. Ikhono lomlimi ukumaketha ukudla kwakhe kulingana nekhono lakhe lokutshala nokukhiqiza ukudla okuthile. Kufanele ukhulise ikhono lakho lokumaketha, kufanele wandise ulwazi lakho mayelana nezindlela zokumaketha. Isu lokumaketha elilandelwa ngumlimi oyedwa noma inkampani elilimayo kuyingxenye yezinto ezidingekayo uma ufuna ukuphatha izindleko nezingozi ngendlela efanelekile ezokulethela inzuzo nakusasa. Umsebenzi wokulima unezingozi eziningi futhi ngesinye isikhathi zingavela ngendlela ongazange ucabange ngayo. Ukwehla nokukhuphuka kwentengiso kwenza ukuthi kubenzima ukubheka phambili, kodwa kudingekile. Isu elihle lokumaketha kungasiza umlimi ukwehlisa izindleko nokuvela kwezingozi ezihambelana nokwehla nokukhuphuka kwentengiso yomkhiqizo. Isimo sakho maqondana nezingozi ezikhona kuzokukhombisa ukuthi ukhetha indlela enjani yokumaketha umkhiqizo wakho. Ngeminyaka eminingi edlule bekukhona ihlelo lokubamba imakethe ngentengiso ebophekile, kodwa abalimi abaningi bebakhala ngoba bethi abayitholi inzuzo efanelekile ngaleyo ntengiso. Ngokwamanje, intengiso ebophekile ayisekho, sekukhona ihlelo elibizwa ngokuthi i-'free-market, imakethe elikhululekile, kodwa manje abalimi bayakhala ngoba abakwazi ukuphatha lawo mamakethe ahlukile.
