Loku ukuqedelelwa komsebenzi owaqalwa ngonyaka we-1995, lapho ngaqoka iQembu lokuSebenza lokuHlela uLimi (LANGTAG) ukuze lingeluleke ngohlaka oluhlangene lohlelo lwenqubomgomo yolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sasisemqoka ngombono wokungabikhona kokumelana kokwehluka kwezilimi nomphumela wokuthi indlela "yokusebenza kobuliminingi iyinkinga yezinkokhelo" okubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu , kanye nokwanda kwezinsolo ezivela kwabaphethe bolimi ngokujwayelwa kokusetshenziswa kolimi lunye eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka LweNqubomgomo yoLimi kaZwelonke lusekelwe phezu komphumela wezindlela zokusebenzisana ngokubonisana, ngokusebenzisa kokubili i-LANGTAG kanye futhi namandla omNyango ngokuhlanganyela neQembu lokweLuleka leNqubomgomo yoLimi. Uhlaka lenqubomgomo lusemqoka ekuphathweni kwemithombo yezilimi zethu ezahlukile kanye nokufinyelela kukaHulumeni kwinhloso yokuthuthukisa intando yeningi, ubulungisa, ukulingana nobumbano lukazwelonke. Kungalomoya omuhle ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi -11 zezwe lakithi njengoba kunikeze umThethosisekelo zathatha ingaphakathi elingunqa phambili kule nqubomgomo. Lolu Hlaka lweNqubomgomo luphinde lubheke iphuzu lokuthi ubumqoka bezilimi zethu buvezwa kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezomnotho, kwezenhlalakahle nezombusazwe. Uma ulimi luphelelwa ubumqoka balo kulezi zimo, isikhundla salolo limi siyehla . Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo luphinda futhi lubonise ukuthi sibhekene nenselele yokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele nokuthi futhi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye yendawo yobuchwepheshe obanda ngokushesha.

Okuphoqelelayo okuyinqubo ukufaka amaqembu abuthakathaka afana nabakhubazekile, intsha, abesifazane kanye nezingane. Ziye futhi zanikeza ukunaka okukhethekile ezindabeni zokuguquka zesigaba ukungenisa ukulingana ekunikezeleni imithombo kanye nokulungiselela ukufinyelela kuzinhlelo. Amakhaya okudlalela, amabandla okunikeza imali kanye nezikhungo zobuciko bomphakathi zithola izamukeliso zonyaka ukuhambisa izinhlelo kanye nokuthuthukisa ubuciko namasiko. Ukwehluka ngokwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika kwesekwa ngokuzimisela ngokomthetho ukuvikela amalungelo olimi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu. Ngo-2003, ikhabhinethi yavuma Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Lolimi Likazwelonke, oluqukethe isitatimende senqubomgomo, uhlelo lokusebenzisa kanye nekhodi lokuziphatha lolimi lwaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka luthuthukiswa ukusetshenziswa ngokulingana kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11, futhi luqinisekisa ukulungisa ezilimini zomdabu ezazibandlululwa esikhathini esedlule. Inqubomgomo ibhekene nazo zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni, kanti lube lulokhu luqhubekisa inani lezilimi imibhalo esemthethweni yoqobo ezokhiqizwa ngazo, Iuzothuthukisa futhi ukuphatha izinsizakalo zomphakathi okunempumelelo ngokusebenzisa imibhalo efanele yolimi. Izifunda zizozakhela izinqubomgomo ngokulandela izimo zesifunda. Izinqubomgomo zizongeniswa ngamazinga ngokuqhubeka njalo. Ukumiswa kwesikhungo Semithombo Yamagugu Esizwe saseNingizimu Afrika njengenhlangano yomthetho ngo-2002 kanye Nebandla Lamagugu Esizwe Kazwelonke ngo-2003 kwenza ukuphathwa kwemithombo yamagugu esizwe kanye nokuguqula isigaba esingabakhona kube yimpumelelo.

UDkt Mijburgh, uyakhunjuzwa ukuthi usengaphansi kwesifungo. Sihlose ukuqeda le ndaba siphinde siqinisekise ukuthi ukungazi ukuthi kwenzekani okulokhu kulandela iClairwood kuphele okokugcina.. Bengilindele ukuba abe nokudabuka okuncane, abe nokweseka uma kuza kumlamu wami. IZeekoevlei kanye nejukskei eKhayelitsha nazo ziyothola usizo lwezezimali kwiDolobha. Sicela bonke abathintekayo ukuba baqede ukubulala okungagunyaziwe ngokomthetho okuqhubekayo. Siyajabula ukuthi inqubekelaphambili ikhona eSierra Leone kanye naseLiberia. UMthimkhulu uke wasebenza ezinhlakeni ezehlukene zokufukula umphakathi kanye nezombusazwe. Amaphoyisa aseKlerksdorp izolo akhombise ukuthi ukungamelani nezinto ezingalungile okusetshenziselwa ukwesabisa abatelekayo, kuzoqhutshekwa nakho. EKlerksdorp, abasolwa abayisikhombisa baboshelwa amacala asuka ekutholweni nezinto zokugqekeza, ukugqekeza, ukushayela bephuzile kanye nokweba. IKhanya igcine uhlaka oluyisicaba olunochwepheshe emikhakheni eyehlukene ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zephrojekthi emkhakha-mningi. Iphalamende ligunyaza izimpahla ezithile kanye nemisebenzi ngohlelo lwamathenda. Ukuchazwa kwemoto kudweba isithombe saleyo edunwe ekuqaleni. I-RXH idinga uhlelo lokwelashwa luhlotshaniswe nesiguli. Umgidi wacishe wonakala ngesikhathi iqembu lentsha engaziwa, eyayibhema ngemuva kwamathoyilethi angomahambanendlwana, iwisa ugwayi ovuthayo phansi, nokuyikhona okwaqala umlilo wequbula. Sibukeza futhi sichibiyela imigomo yezifundazwe yokugunyaza ukwenza izinto ezithile.

Ngalokhu, umnotho wezolimo uyanda, kodwa ubungozi bemvelo bushayisana nempilo yomphakathi. Ezakhamuzini, umthelela wesomiso ubonakala nakwiqembu labalimi; lokhu okuqukethwe kumkhakha wezolimo. Abalimi banelisekile ngezimo ezibalulekile zomhlaba, ngenkathi bephicha izinkinga ezivela ezimweni ezinzima zokuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abanye balimi bathola izindlela ezithuthukile zokusebenza, ukuze badlule kulezi zimo ezinzima. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yabanye, umthelela wesomiso uzokwandisa futhi uzowela kokubili okuphehlwa kwamanzi. Uma kuhlangene iziftsuko, ukuqhamuka kwezimo ezinhle kuhlale kulindelekile. Umphakathi uyamukeleka, idlanzana labalimi lekhono libhalwa ndawonye; okungase kube nomthelela omuhle emkhakheni wokulima nokukhiqiza. Ngokungakhathali kumele kube nesimangalo sokuvumelana nezimo. Kubalulekile ukuthi oteza ukuhamba phambili naye. Kulezi zimo, abesifazane nabesilisa baye bayaphumelela mudzanga ngemisebenzi yabo yezezimali, ngakho-ke umphakathi ufunda izifundo ezithile ezichaza ubuchopho nophoqelelo wezokuthengisa. Ekugcineni, umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State uphakamisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezidingayo ukubhekwa ngokuphumelelayo. Umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezinhlelo zoLimo, abezindaba, noMkhandlu waseFree State usetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezisizayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukholo kwempilo yokudla, bonke bezokwazi ukunqanda umthelela wezimo zezulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela ezithuthukile zokulima, ukuze siqhubeke siqinisekise ukuhlala komphakathi okuhle ngumthombo wokusebenza kokukhula komnotho.

Namuhla sikhona lapha njengeMnyango WezokuHulumeni Nezamasiko ukuze sisize futhi sisekele iRoyal House ekufezeni imisebenzi yayo, ehlanganisa ukufakwa kwezinkosi ngokwezinkolo nangokuhambisana nomthetho. Nanku, uMnumzane, umthetho osebenzayo uveza ngokusobala ukuthi ukufakwa kwezinkosi kwiRoyal House kungenziwa kuphela ngokuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko. Lo mthetho esiwakhe esifundazweni uveza ukuthi kuphela iRoyal House enegunya lokufaka izinkosi; ngaphandle kwalokho, uNgqongqoshe angasebenza kuphela ngalolu hlelo ngemvume yeRoyal House, uma singakwazi ukuba khona mathupha. Inkosi Hlongwane inguNkosi yesithupha okufakwe ngokusemthethweni esikhathini esifushane kusukela le nhlangano yamanje esifundazweni sethu iqale umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sokubusa ezindaweni ezifanele. Le ndawo, isivinini esihamba ngaso sikhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubukhosi busebenza njengephuzu elibalulekile lokuhola ngaphansi kukahulumeni onobulungiswa. Abaholi bendabuko ngesikhathi sokucindezelwa bavame ukungabhekiwe kulomsebenzi obalulekile wokufaka izinkosi. Ngesikhathi se-apartheid, lo msebenzi obalulekile wokufaka izinkosi wawunikezwa kumakhosana nabanye osomabhizinisi. Umthetho WamaBlack Authorities ka-1951 wawuhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuholi bendabuko buba ithuluzi elilula labacindezeli. Umsebenzi wezinkosi wokubika kwiRoyal House ungumkhuba wendabuko oneminyaka eminingi futhi uyisisekelo sokubusa. Uhulumeni esinawo njengamanje esifundazweni uqale uhlelo lwezomthetho oluhloselwe ukubuyisela isithunzi nesikhundla sobuholi bendabuko ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zokubusa eziphathwe nguMthethosisekelo.

Izinhlangano nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bomphakathi zibe nezingxoxo eziningi nemihlangano futhi zenze iziphakamiso ezibalulekile. Ekugcineni, siyabonga ukwesekwa kukahulumeni waseBrithani ekuthuthukiseni amazwe angaphandle ngokuhlinzeka ngemali yokushicilela le ncwadi echazayo mayelana nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ephelele yokuqukethwe kokuziphatha okufanele. Ukumisa ngokomthetho ukuziphatha okufanele kudinga isibindi, ukuqonda, kanye nohlelo lwezichazamazwi ezisemthethweni. Le ncwadi ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi baqonda kahle lokhu kuziphatha. Le ncwadi ayethuli imithetho emisha noma ilandele isakhiwo nemithetho njengemibhalo ephathelene nokuziphatha, ukuze kube lula ukuhlukanisa. Lapho usebenzisa le ncwadi, iminyango kumele izame ukufaka izibonelo zabo ezihambisana nomongo wabo wendawo. Kumele kugcizelelwe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi kuyinqubo ebalulekile futhi kuzodingeka ukuhlolwa njalo, njengokuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha. Ekukhuliseni izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha okufanele endaweni yokusebenza, abasebenzi kumele bakhuthazwe ukuba bacabange futhi baziphathe kahle. Ngakho-ke, le ncwadi kufanele ibonwe njengethuluzi ekuthuthukiseni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okufundisa kubo bonke abasebenzi. Le ncwadi iphinde iqukate izibonelo ezikhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele endaweni yokusebenza okufanele kuthathwe njengesisekelo sokufundisa nezifundo ezenzakalayo. Njengomngane wale kuziphatha, le ncwadi izosiza ukuqinisa ukuzethemba okwangempela nokungakhethi phakathi kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuncane kokuziphatha okufanele nokubonakalayo. Kuyinto evunyelwe ukuthi umuntu ufunda ngokuqwashisa nangesenzo.

Umuntu noma iqembu elifisa ukwedluliselwa ilayisense yokusebenza lingafaka isicelo esihambisana nemvume ebhalwe ngumphathi kwi Bhodi. e zicacise imoto ezosetshenziselwa ukuba yisithuthi. g zifake incazelo ehlalusisiwe yomgudu noma imigudu lapho umfaki sicelo esebenzela noma azosebenzela khona nazo zonke izindawo lapho abagibeli begitsheliswa khona noma bezogitsheliswa khona nalapho behliswa noma bezokwehliswa khona; bese h zifakwe kwiqembu labaphathiswa bezamalayisense okusebenza elibekelwe idolobhakazi elethile. amafomu esicelo ngokwezicelo ezikhonjwe kuzigatshana 1, 2 no 3 ngokwezamatekisi angamakhumbi kumele zicabange ngezincomo eziphuma kwinhlangano yamatekisi asebenzela kulowomgudu, imigudu noma ibalazwe umfaki sicelo ayilunga layo, okumele agcwaliswe yinhlangano ngaphambi kokuhambisa isicelo, noma isitatimende esikhomba ukuthi ayikho enye inhlangano ekhona noma umfaki sicelo ungongelilunga orejistile. Abafaki zicelo kumele basho ngokufunga kumafomu ezicelo ukuthi bake batholwa yini benamacala obugebengu emvelo emisiwe uma kunjalo, babale amacala futhi basho ukuthi bona noma abashade nabo, abalingani babo noma abalingani ngokwamabhizinisi noma abaqashi bayiziphathimandla zomthetho noma abameli bezomphakathi noma zabaphathiswa besi Fundazwe noma zabaphathiswa bakamasipala. a IBhodi kumele lihambise izicelo zabezokuthutha abangenazo izivumelwano baziyise kwizikhungo zokuthutha zedolobhakazi elifanele elikhonjwe kusigaba 87 ukuthola izincomo, ngendlela ebekiwe, ngaphambi kokuveza isicelo.

Ngalokho kubalilekileukuthi imali umasipala ayitholayo ilingane naleyo ayisebenzisayo. Ukuqikelela lokhu umasipala usebenzisa isabelo sezimali. Isabelosezimali sohulumeni basekhaya iyona ndlela okuyiyonayokukhalima esetshenziswayo. Isabelo sezimali sikamasipala uhlelo oludalula ukuthi kahle kahle imiphi imisebenzi nezinto umasuipala ofuna ukuzenza onyakeni olandelayo wezimali, ukuthi ilelo nalelo uhlelo luzodla malini, nanokuthi imalini ezodingeka ekwenzeni lemisebenzi. Umasipala uphoqelekile ukwakha isabelo sezimali ngobaumthetho usho njalo. Kodwa akufanele wenze lokho kuphela. Ukwakha isabelo sezimali kuyithuluzi elibalulekile lokuhleleka. ezizolandela kuyithuluzi elibalulekile lokukhalima. Ukwakha isabelo sezimali kusiza omasipala baphathe kahleizimali futhi bakwazi ukuthi bangasebenzisi imali ngaphezukwaleyo abayitholayo. Ikhombisa imali esetshenzisiwe kamasipala(ukuthi abaphathi bayisebenzisa kanjani imali yomphakathietholiwe) nangemali engenile (lapho nangendlela ohulumenibasekhaya bethola khona imali. Isabelo sezimali sikamasipala siyinhliziyo kamasipala. Zonkeizinto ofisa ukuzenza kanye nayo yonke imali acabanga ukuyithola, ukusho lutho, ngaphambi kokuthi zibe esabelweni sezimali. Iziphi izingxenye ezakha isabelo sezimali? Nemali ezuzwa uMasipala ngentela. Iyona ebeka uhlaka lwesabelo sikaMasipala bese, ihlanganyela nesiphathi mandla esikhulu sezezimali, nophethe umnyango ukuvuma izabelo zezimali zeminyango. Emva kokuthi yonke imibono, iziphakamiso nezincomosezicutshungiwe, isabelo sezimali sibe sesethulwaemkhandlwini ukuze usivume. Lokhu kumele kwenzeke okungenani izinsuku ezingu 30 ngaphambi kokuqalakonyaka wezimali.

Nokho, ngentengo yakho, ungacela iseluleko kumemeli ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke. Abasebenzi benkantolo kanye nosizo lwezomthetho enkantolo yezicelo ezincane bangakusiza ngaphandle kokukhokha. Noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika lungasetshenziswa kule nkantolo. Kumele uhambisane kusenesikhathi nomlomo wenkantolo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona umhumushi uma ubufakazi buzokhulumelwa ngolimi olungaqondakali kahle komunye wabantu abathintekayo. Xwayisa umphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa naye isicelo) ngqo, ngocingo, noma ngencwadi, ubacela ukuthi banelise izidingo zakho. Uma umphikisi engaphenduli esicelweni sakho, bhala incwadi yokufunwa (echaza zonke izimo zokufunwa, kuhlanganise nenani lezidingo zakho) ubanikeze ezinsukwini eziyi-14 kusukela ngosuku abathola ngalo incwadi yokufunwa ukuze banelise izidingo zakho. Thumela incwadi yokufunwa kumphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa naye isicelo) ngesandla noma ngeposi ebhalisiwe. Ngemva kwezinsuku eziyi-14, kumele uye ngqo kumlomo wenkantolo ulethe ubufakazi bokuthi uthumele incwadi yokufunwa kumphikisi. Noma iyiphi incwadi yokuvumelana noma ukuqinisekiswa kwezimo zokufunwa kwakho. Igama eliphelele kanye nekheli (ikhaya, kanye nekheli lomsebenzi, uma likhona) kanye nenombolo yocingo yomphikisi. Bona kanye nosizo lwabo lwezomthetho bazobuyekeza imibhalo onayo futhi bakusize ekubhaleni isikhumbuzo esilula. Uzobhala isikhumbuzo abasinikezayo. Yini okufanele uyenze ngesikhumbuzo? Ungasithumela ngesandla kumphikisi. Ungaphinde unikeze isikhumbuzo kumshushisi (umuntu) lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, ukuze umshushisi akwazi ukusithumela kumphikisi.

Idokhumenti losizo elivela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini linikeza amakhasimende awo ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi okulindelwe umphakathi mayelana nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo kuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Umphakathi uyazi ukuthi angaxhumana kanjani neMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini. Indlela yokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende isekelwe ekukhetheni ukuhambisana nezindinganiso zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ezishicilelwe ngenkathi kuhambisana namalungelo amakhasimende. IMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini izokweseka futhi ikusize njengamakhasimende ethu, izinga lenkonzo ongakulindela njengamakhasimende ethu, indlela ongasisiza ngayo ukuthi sikuhlinzekele kangcono, nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani iziphakamiso zokuthuthukiswa, kanye neziteshi ongazilandela njengamakhasimende uma ufisa ukuveza ukwaneliseka kwakho ngezinga lethu lenkonzo. Zonke ofisi zikhomba lapho izindaba ezihlobene namanzi ziphathwa khona. Ukulethwa kwamanzi aphakanyisiwe kuza ngqo emakhaya ukusuka kumapayipi omasipala. Amalitri angama-200 wamanzi ngosuku atholakala emtankini ophansi ogcwalisa nsuku zonke - kulingana namalitri angama-6,000 wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga. Amathaphu emigwaqo afakwe ezindaweni zomphakathi ezithintekile okwethula isikhathi esithile. Amathangi amanzi afinyelela lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okukhulu. Uhlanga lwezinkalanga luthuthwa ngepayipi ejwayelekile usebenzisa amanzi - xhumana nezinsiza zokuhlanza. Ukulethwa kwezingcindezi ngepayipi usebenzisa amanzi kudluliselwa emgqonyeni - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nalo.

Akekho umphakathi ongalokothi ubonge kanjani uSerena; umphakathi wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ezemidlalo zabesifazane, uthole izikhumbuzo eziningi ngenxa yokuthi uSerena udlale indima ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwalesi sikhala. Ngokwengeziwe, uSerena ubhale uhambo lwakhe, efuna izindlela zokuvula amathuba kubantu abasha, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, ukuze bazitholele izikhala eziphakeme. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi noma ubani angakwenza, ngaphandle kokubheka ukuthi uvelaphi. Uhlale esebenza kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi lokho kuveza ukuthi impumelelo yeyakho, ingekho ematheni. Ngaphandle kwemidlalo, uSerena ungena kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokuphupha, yena nomndeni wakhe benza izinhlelo eziningi zokugcina izimpilo zabanye zikhanya. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo esiqinile kumasiko ahlukeneyo, lapho eveza khona ukuthi umhlaba ungcono uma ubumbene, unokuhloniphana. Uhlale ethanda ukuzama izinto ezintsha, kanti lokho kumenza abe nesithakazelo esijulile esikhathini samanje. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lungakwenza ube yisithombe esihle, kodwa uSerena uyazi ukuthi ubukhulu bempumelelo buncike kumzamo, ubunzima, nomqondo oqinile. Uthumele imiyalezo emihle ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukubonisa ukuthi akukhona nje ukuncintisana nokuhlakanipha, kodwa futhi ukufuna izindlela zokuxhasa abanye. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo sokukhuthaza abanye, hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabo. Kodwa akukhona konke okuhle, hayi? USerena ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi empilweni yakhe. Uthole izigwegwe ezinzima, izinkinga zomndeni, nezikhathi lapho engazange azizwe kahle. Kodwa, ngokuhlakanipha, uSerena waqhubeka nokunqoba, ebamba izifundo eziphuma kulokhu.

OWENKONTILEKA umsebenzi wakhe uzowenza ngokwesheduli exhunyelwe lapha yaba uSheduli A. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma izinsuku abekade engekho ngazo ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. u-SAPS uzoba nomsebenzi wokunikeza OWENKONTILEKA ezokuthutha imoto ukuya nokubuya EMSEBENZINI ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe bheka iziGaba 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. U-SAPS uzomholela OWENKONTILEKA ngokuba khona nangomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yenkontilela ezoba R - ...amarandi ngehora kuhlanganiswa ntelelaye-VAT: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS kungathi ekuhambeni kwesikhathi ngokuzikhethela kwakhe abuye ayikhuphule le mali yakhe yesivumelwano ekhokhelwa ngehora. Lo mholo ukhokhwa kamuva zinyanga zonke nghlobo lwemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yenkontileka (bona isiGaba 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo usuphelele nao zonke izinto eziyizinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi woWENKONTILEKA Inqobo, lokho kubanjwa kwemali kuhambisana nomThetho othize, iyobanjwa emholweni woWENKONTILEKA.

Ukwelekelela ukuqeqeshelwa ukusebenzela umbutho, obekufanele bafakwe embuthweni we-MSDS bazonikwa ithuba lokukhetha ukuqeqeshwa ezintweni eziqondile. Vakashela ibhlogi kaNdunankulu ukuze uphawule ngenkulumo yebhajethi. Namuhla ukulinyazwa kakhulu kwezakhiwo kanye nengqalasizinda ezindaweni eziphethwe amaPhalestina kuyaqhubeka kanti imijondolo emisha kwa-Israel iyaqhubeka nokwakhiwa. I-Aliwal Shoal iyindawo ethandwa kakhulu ngabatshuzi eThekwini kanti iheha abatshuzi abevela emhlabeni jikelele. Amakhasi amazinga emiholo abasebenzi bakahulumeni abasebenza amahora amahlanu. Indawo yokuhlala inamatende anezindlu zokugezela eziphezulu, yakhiwe osebenzi lomfula endaweni ebuka iMachampane River. Ukwenza lokhu, iMenenja yeMiphumela idinga ukuhlela imithombo yokusiza umphakathi, lokhu kufaka amazinga ehlukene kahulumeni, amafemu azimele nezinhlangano, ama-NGO kanye nama-CBO. Kungabe lokhu kuvela enkundleni yabaviliyeli, into enjalo, wukucula amaculo? Ukushintsha izethembiso zibe yinto ephathekayo enye indaba, kodwa, njengoba uHolmes wavuma ukuthi izinhlangano zamavukelambuso ziyehlukana kulaba abangabalandeli. Umphakathi ugubuzelwe yizinkinga zenhlalakahle ezidinga ukubhekwa masinyane. Ihalalisele ababambe iqhaza abaningi ngokuphatha kwabo isimo ngendlela eyiyo. IDWAF isibeke eceleni izimali ngaphansi kwesikhwama sokweseka izikhungo ukusiza iWSA ekuqedeleni iWSDP. Mnu Nadel angikukhumbuze ukuthi usengaphansi kwesifungo. Ihhovisi likaMengameli we-EU lithukile ukuzwa ngokuhlaselwa kwanamuhla kwehhovisi likaNdunankulu maphakathi ne-Algiers nesiteshi samaphoyisa.

Umnyango, (kumbandakanya nesiphathimandla esiphethe) unezinsuku ezingama-30 zokubhekana nesikhalo. Lesi sikhathi singelulwa ngesivumelwano esibhaliwe. b isiphathimandla kufanele ngokwesigaba 35 1 soMthetho waBasebenzi bakaHulumeni ka 1994, sithumele isikhalo kanye nemibhalo esifanele kwiKhomishani yezaBasebenzi bakaHulumeni ukuze yenze izincomo zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela yazisiwe ngulowo msebenzi onesikhalo. Uma isikhalo sisho ukusolwa ngenqubo yokusebenza engalungile njengoba kuncaziwe eMthethweni wezaBasebenzi ka 1995, umsebenzi angazisa isiphathimandla esiphethe ukuthi ufisa ukusebenzisa inqubo yokuxazululwa kwezinkinga emiswe kuMthethosisekelo woMkhandlu oxhumanisa ukukhulumisana ngezaBasebenzi bakaHulumeni, noma omunye umkhandlu oqondene (noma imuphi oqondene) nokuthi iKhomishani yezabasebenzi bakaHulumeni ingasibheki isikhalo leso. a kuKhomishani ngqo; noma b uma kuyinqubo yezokusebenza engalungile nomkhandlu oxhumanisa ukukhulumisana ngezaBasebenzi bakaHulumeni noma umkhanldu oqondene noma imuphi oqondene ngokwenqubo yokuxazululwa kwezinkinga. Uma iKhomishani isithole lonke ulwazi kusiphathimandla esiphethe , kufanele kuthi zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-30 ibheke leso sikhalo bese ibhale yazise isiphathimandla esiphethe ngezincomo zayo nezizathu ngesinqumo sayo. Ngemuva kokuthola izincomo zekhomishani , isiphathimandla esiphethe kufanele kuthi zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu sibhale sazise umsebenzi neKhomishani ngesinqumo saso.

Zonke izicelo ezifakiwe zokufa kumele zibikwe ngaleso sikhathi ngaphandle kokulibazisa okungadingekile. Zonke izimali ezitholakele ngaphansi kwale nqubomgomo zizokhokhwa kuqala kwiPhalamende. b ukusetshenziswa okugunyaziwe kwempahla noma kwendawo; noma c indawo lapho kukhona khona impahla. Inani lentela yendawo ohlelweni lwendawo lapho kwakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela egcekeni elolodwa kufanele liklanywe ngokwehluka kuye ngobungako baleyo naleyo ndawo okufanele ikhokhelwe kulolu hlelo hhayi ukuthi kuklanywe inani elilodwa elihlanganisa indawo yonkana. a kubeyinani elisuselwe ekwenziweni ngcono kwenani lentela laleyompahla noma umhlaba ekhonjiswe ephepheni lokuhlola likamasipalati langaleso sikhathi; noma b Intela elinganayo empahleni noma endaweni emkhakheni othile obaluliwe, kuye ngokuthi lowomkhakha ungaphansi kwesilinganiso sokuhlola esisemthethweni. inani lentela efanayo yendawo ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- 1 b akufanele leve enanini obekufanele likhokhwe empahleni noma emhlabeni osezingeni lomkhakha ophansi ngokuhlolwa ukuba inani beliklanywe ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- 1 a. Intela yendawo ingaklanywa ngumasipalati esikhathini esingaphezu konyaka wezimali owodwa ngaphandle uma kugunyazwe ngungqongqoshe kahulumeni wasemakhaya. a liqala ukusebenza ekuqaleni konyaka wezimali noma osukwini olumakhathaleni njengaloku kungase kubalule isinqumo okukhulunywa ngaso esigabeni -13 mayelana nokuklanywa kwenani lentela yendawo; nokuthi b lingeke liklanywe ngokuthi kuhlehlelwe emuva. inani lentela yendawo liklanywa ngumasipalati ngokulandela isinqumo esithathwe ngumkhandlu kamasipalati ngokwesekelwa yisibalo esikhulu samavoti amalungu alowo mkhandlu.

Ukukhetha ukudla okufanele kubalulekile kakhulu kithi sonke, ikakhulukazi uma unegciwane elingapheli njenge-obesity, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV. Ukudla kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphucula uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela ukuze ulwe nezifo, kukhuphule amandla akho omzimba, futhi kukwenze uzizwe ungcono isikhathi eside. Ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo kubantu abaneziguli eziphakeme njengezifo zomdlavuza, obesity, kanye ne-HIV akufanele kuthathwe kalula. Ezinye izifo nemithi esetshenziselwa ukuwaphikisa ivame ukuholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo zizokusiza umuntu onegciwane elingapheli ukuthi abhekane kangcono nezimpawu zalesi simo futhi agweme ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Ubisi olungakawushintshi, ikhrimu, kanye nemikhiqizo yayo (ubisi oluphonswayo, ushizi, i-yogurt) kungangezwa ezidleni ukuze kuhanjiswe amandla engeziwe kanye nephrotheni. Faka amafutha afana ne-margarine, ibhotela, kanye ne-mayonnaise ezidleni ukuze uthole amandla engeziwe futhi uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla. Uma uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ungajabuli ngemva kokwengeza amafutha engeziwe ezidleni zakho, zama ukunciphisa. Ake sithole ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezimpawu zesifo ezingenza ungafuni ukudla. Yini engingayenza uma ngizwa sengathi angifuni ukudla? Izifo, ukudangala, nokuhlukumezeka kungakwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Zama lokhu okulandelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele ukuze ugcine umzimba wakho uqine.

Lolu hlelo lwaqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso ezazitholwa ngezinsuku ezedlule zitholakala zisebenzayo. Abacwaningi bajejezelwa ukuphathwa okunembile kwezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, koko kulindeleke ukuthi ezobuchwepheshe zikhule zihlale kulungile. Ezocwaningo kanti umgudu eziyindlela yokuzithokozisa. Isibonelo, uqhubeka uqedwa thina kufanele sibe nezinye izibonakaliso ezibonakalayo zokuhlola abanye. Kungaxisize ukwandisa umqondo wezocwaningo kudaleke ubudlelwano obusha, nokwandisa uzalo lwezinsiza olwakha izinsuku zangempela. Umgudu wokunciphisa izinkinga ezibhekene nezeNgqungquthela zamakhulu okusebenza kuyasivula umnyango omkhulu wezimfanelo. Ukucwaninga akuphumi nje ekusebenzelaneni kwezempilo, impilo yempilo, nokuxhobisa ubuchwepheshe obubuchopho. Yiphuphuni elunele nokukhula kokuhlola imicabango ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Ubumbeko benzo bukhonkolo ebudlelwaneni bethu nezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Kanjalo, imiphumela iyasilungiselela imicabango, ifanisa ukuxhumana kwezokuxhumana. Ngokuzayo, kufanele sigqoke izifiso zethu, sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wokucwaninga awupheleli. Njengoba siqhubeka siphenya futhi sihlole, sizothola izindlela ezintsha zokuthula izinkinga ezibucayi ezithinta umhlaba, ukuze sithole izinsiza ezinzima nezibalulekile ekusizeni abantu. Umgudu wezocwaningo, njengobukhulu beli qiniso, uphakathi nendawo ezama ubuchopho. Usiqondisa ukuthi ibhalwe ngezindlela ezizozama phambili ukuze sithole ukuqonda okukhulu, izixazululo ezisebenzayo kwaye sithole iqiniso elijulile lokwakha isizwe esiqinile nempilo engcono.

Noma kunjalo, ukwehluka kwamaphepha ezokuxhumana gewela eceleni komhlaba wezokungcebeleka. Ubhubhane lweCovid-19 luveze izinselelo ezingakaze zicaciswe. Ngaphezu kwesithangami sokuncintisana, abathandi bebholana benza izifundo ezinzima, bezama ukugcina uthando lwabo lwezemidlalo, ngenkathi bejabulisa izigidi abantu abanebhadi ngokwenziwa. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ibhola langempela lidlula imikhawulo yokungaphezulu; umoya wokuhlanganyela kufanele ube phezulu. Ukufingqa, amaqembu ebhola eNingizimu Afrika angaphezu kokuphila komdlalo, adinga ukuba abambe iqhaza empilweni yomphakathi. Ngaphakathi kwemigqa ethokozisayo, amaqembu afundisa ngempilo, angeza umoya wokubambisana emiphakathini, akhuthaza izifundo ezinkulu, futhi avumela abantu ukuba banikezele ngothando. Lokhu akusho ukusho ugqozi kuphela kodwa nokukhuthazwa kokuzimisela. Ubani owaziyo, kuze kube phakade, ibhola lizokhumbula lesi sikhathi njengokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle, kanti abantu bazokwazi ukuba neqhaza ekwakheni ithemba elisha. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ibhola lenza ukuba sithokozise imiphakathi yethu, lihlolisise izakhiwo zempilo zamasiko ethu, nezinkunka zezinhlangothi eziningi. Amaqembu akhombisa ubuhlakani bethu, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha, okufanele kwazise izizukulwane ezizayo. Ngakho-ke, ibhola akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kwenza kube nemigudu eqinile yokuba abantu bahlale bephakeme.

Kuyintokozo enkulu kimi ukwethula Iqhinga Lokuqhuba umsebenzi oqondene neNqubomgomo yeziLimi zikaZwelonke eyethulwe nguNgqongqoshe. Inqubomgomo yeziLimi zikaZwelonke iwumphumela wokubonisana okubanzi okwaqala ngonyaka ka 1995 lapho kwaqokwa khona Ithimba Lokubhekela Ezolimi (LANGTAG). Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi leneka amaqhinga ayosetshenziswa ekufezeni ngempela Inqubomgomo yeziLimi, ukuphakamisa izinhlaka eziyoba nqala ekusebenzeni kwayo nemizamo eyosetshenziswa ukuqhubela phambili intuthuko nokukhuthaza izilimi zethu zoMdabu zaseAfrika. Uhulumeni uyayiqonda inselelo ebandakanya ukuphatha ngendlela efanele ukwehlukana ngezilimi. Yiso lesi sizathu esenza Iqhinga Lokuqhuba umsebenzi liphakamise inqubo emukela uguquko nesimo esihlose inqubekela phambili. Ngenxa yokuthi ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu kubonakala njengomgogodla wemibandela yeNqubomgomo yeziLimi, Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi lifuna kusungulwe inqalasizinda yolimi namalinge afanele okugxilisa ngempela ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi eMisebenzini yoMphakathi. Ngakho, umbimbi esisebenzisana nalo ezingeni likazwelonke, ezifundazweni nakohulumeni basekhaya luyodlala indima eqavile ekuqiniseni ukuthi Inqubomgomo yeziLimi isebenza ngempumelelo. Uma sicabanga ukuthi inselelo esibhekene nayo njengoHulumeni ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izakhamizi zithola izinsiza ngokushesha nokuthi ulimi yisikhali sokuxhumana nomphakathi, kuyacaca ukuthi Inqubomgomo yeziLimi kufanele iqale ukusebenza ngokuphuthuma.

Ukuqina mayelana ne-GNSS kubhekisela ekwazini kwemishini ukuhlinzeka ngezixwayiso kulabo abasebenzisa yona uma ukusebenza kwayo kudlula imikhawulo yokuphepha esunguliwe futhi akufanele isetshenziswe ekulandeleni. Ukuhamba kwe-Side/edge kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuhola ukuhamba ngaphandle kwezinkomba ezithile ezivertical ezihlobene nezindlela zokulandela ukuhamba ngendlela engashayi ngqo umhloli noma yokuyifuna lapho idlula. Uhlelo lokuhamba lwezindiza oluyinhloko lubhekisela ohlelweni lokuhamba emoyeni olwamukelwa nguMphathiswa wezokuhamba noma ngesikhathi esithile sokuhamba, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zezinkomba ezivertical ezithile kanye nokuqina, kodwa akusho ukuthi kuhlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala noma ukuqhubeka. Ukuqina kolwazi olutholakalayo lwezobuchwepheshe (RAIM) kubhekisela kwisicwangciso lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS luthola ukuqina kwezimpawu zokulawula ukuhamba nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakale ngezinga lokuphuma. "RVSM" ibhekisela ekuhlukaniseni okukhona phakathi kwezinga lokuhamba elingu-290 kuya ku-1000 feet uma kubhekwa ohlangothini olulodwa futhi ama-2000 feet uma kubhekwa ngokuqondile kokuhamba. "Isikhala se-RVSM" sisho isikhala somoya phakathi kwezinga lokuhamba elingu-290 no-410 feet. "Isitifiketi sokuvunywa kwe-RVSM" sisho isitifiketi esibonisa ukuthi ukuhamba kanye nethimba kuhlangabezana nezidingo zokusebenza ze-RVSM. Ukuhola kokuhamba okuqondile noma phezulu kubhekisela kwisicwangciso sokulawula ukuhamba okuvumela ukuhlela okuqondile kusetshenziswa izinsiza zokulinganisa ezisemhlabeni, kubhekwa izindlela ezingaphandle kokuhamba noma ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi.

Okwesibili, umphenduli kufanele akwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abe nekhono lokucabanga ngokushesha, ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo, kodwa futhi enembile. Ukuze uthole leli khono, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza. Ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle, umphenduli angazama ukuphendula imibuzo eminingi ngezikhathi ezimfushane, ukuze azijwayeze nokuphendula ngokushesha. Izindlela Zokuphendula Ngempumelelo Ukuze ufike ekuphenduleni kahle, kunezindlela ezithile ongazisebenzisa. Okokuqala, ungasebenzisa indlela yokubhala emishweni emifushane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicabango yakho, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda. Okwesibili, ungasebenzisa izithombe noma amamephu ukuze ubonise imicabango yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicabango yakho, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo ecacile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izibonelo ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imicabango yakho iyacaca. Izibonelo zenza kube lula ukuveza umqondo wakho, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi uqonda kahle isihloko. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi noma abahloli ukuqonda impendulo yakho. Ukuzijwayeza Nokuhlola Ukuzijwayeza kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza ukuphendula imibuzo ngezikhathi ezimfushane. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imicabango yakho ihlelekile. Ungasebenzisa izivivinyo ezithile, noma ungazama ukuphendula imibuzo ethile esikhathini esinqunyiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlola impendulo yakho kuyasiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ubuyekeze impendulo yakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iyacaca, futhi ibhalwe kahle.

Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izigameko Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuphathwa ngokushesha nangokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphepha kweziguli. Ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zinyathelo, kubalulekile ukuba neziqu ezithile, ulwazi, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Nansi imiyalelo ecacile yokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela. Isigaba 1: Ukubona Isimo Esiphuthumayo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukubona isimo esiphuthumayo. Lokhu kungaba yisiguli esingaphenduli, esinezinhlungu ezinzima, noma esinokuphazamiseka kokuphefumula. Uma ubona isimo esinjalo, qinisekisa ukuthi ungena endaweni ephephile. Bheka izimpawu ezithile, njengokushaywa kwenhliziyo, ukungaphefumuli, noma ukungaphenduli. Isigaba 2: Ukuxhumana Nethimba Lezempilo Ngemuva kokubona isimo, xhumana nethimba lezempilo ngokushesha. Lokhu kungafaka ukushaya ucingo kumphakathi wezokwelapha noma ukucela usizo kumphakathi wezokwelapha. Qinisekisa ukuthi unikeza imininingwane ecacile, efana nesimo sesiguli, izimpawu ezibonakalayo, kanye nezinyathelo ozithathile. Isigaba 3: Ukuphatha Isimo Esiphuthumayo Uma usuthole usizo, qala ukuphatha isimo. Lokhu kungafaka: 1. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlungu: Uma isiguli sikhala ngezinkinga, sebenzisa izindlela zokuphatha izinhlungu ezifanele, njengokunikeza imithi yokuthambisa. Ukuphefumula: Uma isiguli singaphenduli kahle, hlola ukuphefumula kwaso. Uma kudingeka, sebenzisa izindlela zokuphefumula ezifanele, njengokusebenzisa umshini wokuphefumula. Ukubeka Isiguli Endaweni Ephumelelayo: Qinisekisa ukuthi isiguli sikhululekile futhi sikhululekile.

Ungagxeki amaphutha uthi enziwe yibhange lakwenye indawo noma yibhange eliyinhloko. Inkinga yenze ibe ngeyakho futhi ungaliboleka imali okwesikhashana ikhasimede uma isimo sivuma. Ngwema ukwenza umsebenzi ongaphathelene nokusiza abantu uma bephambi kwakho bekubona. Phetha inkulumo yakho nekhasimede ngokulibonga ulibize ngegama bese uvalelisa ngokuthi "ube nosuku olumnandi". Tshela umamukeli wezicingo uma ungenasi isikhathi sokuthatha izicingo ngalolosuku. Ungakhiphi ucingo lapho luxhunywe khona noma uluyeke lukhale lungaphendulwa. Xolisa kulowo muntu uma ucingo luke lwakhala isikhathi eside ungakaluphenduli. Umamukeli wezicingo iBhange LezoMhlaba "Igatsha", Sawubona, Ngingakusiza kanjani." ungakhetha ulimi ofuna ukukhuluma ngalo. Sawubona, Ngusibanibani okhulumayo, Ngingakusiza kanjani ungazikhethela ukuthi ukhuluma ngaluphi ulimi. Thola ukuthi lomuntu omsizayo yena ungubani bese uyalisebenzisa njalo engxoxweni yenu igama lakhe. Qiniseka ukuthi ulibiza kahle igama lakhe. Qiniseka ukuthi ubhale ngokuyikho imininingane yomyalezo. Dlulisa imiyalezo ingakapheli imizuzu engamashimi amathathu uwutholile lokhu kumbandakanya nonothisi ebhaliwe yabekwa lapho kusebenzela khona omunye. Yenza izithembiso ezizofezeka uma kunenkinga engeke yaxazululeka ngokushesha. Sebenzisa ulwazi lwakho lokwazi ukuthi inqubo ihamba kanjani uma umisa/ uhlela usuku lokuvala (closure dates). Uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo, phuthumisa undaba ngokuludlulisa kuMqondisi walelogatsha. Yonke imibuzo nezikhalo kwenze kube noma kuthathe njengokwakho kuze kube kuyaxazululeka.

Inzuzo etholakalayo emasimini aniselwayo ivama ukuba ngaphezu kwenzuzo etholakalayo emasimini lapho kuna khona kuphela. Kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi asikwazi ukunisela onke amasimu ngoba izwe lethu alinawo amanzi akwanele. Futhi singacabangi ukuthi abaniselayo balima kamnandi, singakhohlwa ukuthi basebenzisa ugesi ukumpompa amanzi emasimini. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uEskom ufuna ukukhuphukisa intengo kagesi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kuzokhuphukisa izindleko zokukhiqiza, mhlawumbe kuzovimba abanye abalimi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani abalimi basatshala ukolo? Abalimi baqale ukutshala ukolo ebusika eMpumalanga Freyistata ngesikhathi sase-1950. Ngaleso sikhathi izindleko bezilingana ne-0.5 lethani ehektheleni, ngokulima ngokuhlakanipha bavame ukuvuna ithani eligcwele. Lokhu kungabhekeka njengemvuno encane, kodwa khumbula ngaleso sikhathi bekungeku izimbewu eziyisphesheli futhi bekungathelwa umanyolo. Kodwa abalimi bayitholile inzuzo. Ezindaweni eziningi eFreyistata umhlabathi uyakwazi ukulondoloza amanzi. Imvula yasehlobo nasekwindla iyahlala emhlabathini bese ukolo usebenzisa lawo manzi ukumila kuze kufike imvula yasentwasanhlobo. Abalimi batshale ukolo iminyaka eminingi, kwase kwangena ukolo wasendle (wild oats) emasimini. Lokhu kwaba inkinga ngoba lesi sitshalo sicishe sifane nokolo, bekunzima ukubulala lesi sitshalo ngaphandle kokulimaza ukolo oqobo. Abalimi bebecindezelike ukubheka ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo njengommbila nobhekilanga ukushintshana nokolo. Ukushintshana izitshalo zasebusika nalezo zazehlobo bekusebenza kahle. Kakhulukazi bekusiza ukubulala ukhula.

Lokhu, kanye nokutholakala kokuthi umthofu okhishwa yi-ekzozo kungathikameza impilo yabantu, kuholele ekutheni ukhishwe kancane kancane, kuqale iMelika eseNyakatho kwalandela I-Europe kwase kuya ngokwanda kwalandela amanye amazwe emhlabeni. Kusukela ngaluphi usuku lapho uphetholo onomthofu ungeke usatholakala eNingizimu Afrika? UHulumeni usemise ukuthi kuzakuba nezinhlobo ezintathu zesithako se-actane kuphetholo ongaxutshiwe nomthofu (ULP) ezizovumeleka eNingizimu Afrika (kuzo zombili izindawo ezingudle ugu naphakathi nezwe) ngemuva komhlaka 1 kuMasingana (January) 2006, okuyilezi 91, 93 kanye ne- 95 iNombolo yoCwaningo nge-Octane (RON). Ukudingeka kwalezi zinhlobo yikhona okuzokhombisa ukuthi yiyona yiphi inhlobo edingeka ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zezwe. Abanezimoto kufanele balindele ukuthi ngeke bathole zonke izinhlobo kuzo zonke izindawo, kodwa bangakulindela ukuthi bazothola inhlobo ahambisana noma elungele izimoto zabo noma ikuphi lapho beya khona eNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izimboni zokuhluza amafutha ezimoto zaseNingizimu Afrika sezitshale imali noma zitshala imali ukwengezelela izinto zokusebenza noma ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikwazi ukukhiqiza izithako ze-actane ngobuningi. Isithako se-actane sidingeka kakhulu kunomkhiqizo okhishwa izimboni ezihluzayo zendawo kuyothengwa izithako zokuvutshelwa kwe-octane ephezulu noma i-octane kaphetholo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kwaneliswa ukudingeka kwayo. Azomiswa kanjani amanani ezinhlobo ezahlukene zophetholo? Amanani alawulwayo azomisiwe ngokusebenzisa indlela efanayo nalena esetshenziswayo njengamanje.

Yonke iminyango kaHulumeni ibambisene ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bakithi bathola imfundo nokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni kanye namakhono aseqophelweni. Uma singenza isibonelo ngoMnyango wezeMfundo, lomnyango uzinikele ekuthenini kube nezinguquko emfundweni jikelele, nasemfundweni ephakeme. Kanjalo noMnyango wezokuHweba neziMboni ugqugquzela ukusungulwa kwezinto ezintsha kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abazisebenzayo. ISu lokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono liqhakambisa iqhaza elibanjwe nguMnyango wami ohlelweni lwentuthuko yabasebenzi - futhi ikakhulukazi nezindlela okuzohlolwa ngazo impulelelo yaleloqhaza. Libuye linikeze eminye imiNyango kaHulumeni uhlaka engasebenzela phezu kwalo lapho ithuthukisa amakhono emikhakheni yayo. Okwesithathu, ngiye nganikezwa umdllandla ukusekelwa esiye sakuthola ngenkathi sisalibhala silihlela isu. Yize kwaba khona ukuqophisana malungana nezindlela zokuvivinya kimpumelelo yesu nokugagulwa kwezinhloso, ingqikithi yodaba yasekelwa ngokungangabazeki. Mayelana nodaba lokubeka izimpawu ezizokukhombisa impumelelo nokuhlolwa kwendima esihanjiwe ukuya ekugcwalisekeni kwesu, kwavunyelwana ngo elethu, kanti lomgomo ungolunye uphawu olukhombisa indlela uMnyango wami ozinikele ngawo ekubeni usebenzele umphakathi futhi wazise umphakathi ngakho konke osekwenziwe. Inselelo enkulu ke eyokulenza lisebenze lelisu kanye nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi lizoqhubeka ngokuwusiza umphakathi ngendlela edingakalayo. Loku ke kumbandakanya ukugqugquzela abaqashi, izinyonyana, abasebenzi, iminyango kaHulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuthi babambe iqhaza kuloluhlelo.

Ekugcineni, uThandi wajabula ngezithukuthuku ezinhle nezinkanyezi, futhi uMandla wanxusa abafowabo ukuthi bahlale bephila kahle. Njengabantu abasaqalayo, umsebenzi ukude wakwenza kumzamo omkhulu khona kulolu chungechunge olunobuhlakani. Bayazisola, kanti kwayenqaba izithombe ezinzima. Ubuqotho, uMandla noThandi babungangezwi, kanti lesi sikhathi sikhulu silindele ukuhamba phambili — lokhu kube ubufakazi buluntu lwezakhiwo. Baphelelisa imijikelezo, begxila kulokhu, ukukhokhela ukuqonda okwandile, okubonisa ukuba khona okumqoka kokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi nombono wakhe wezokuxhumana,behlanganisa kubasebenzi kodwa bebenza okwabelana ngayo. Uthando lwezokuphathelene nomsebenzi ukude lwaba umcabango omuhle, lwenza lokhu kube okufunayo. Isifundo esephuma emsebenzini ukushintsha umphakathi. Ukusebenza ukude kubalulekile, ukugcina umoya omuhle, nokuhamba phambili kuhlangene ngokuthandekayo yemibono ehamba phambili nezizathu ezinzima zomsakazo. UThandi wayekwazi ukuhamba phambili, kwakuyisikhathi esihle sabo. Lokhu kube yindaba emangalisayo, enokuthuthuka okukhulu endaweni yokusebenza!

a umkhumbi usetshenziselwa ukuthutha lwandle ; futhi b kukhona uhlelo lwezokuvikela lomkhumbi olusebenzayo; futhi c umkhumbi ungasetshenziswa ngokuhambisana nohlelo. Umthethonkambiso 1 awusebenzi uma umsebenzi womkhumbi enesizathu esizwakalayo. Icala okukhulunywa ngalo ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 1 kuyothi uma likulahlile ujeziswe ngokukhokhiswa imali noma ukuvalelwa ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12. Ukusebenza komkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika akufanele kuthikameze noma kuvimbele ukulandelwa kohlelo lwezokuvikela lomkhumbi lweminye imikhumbi. b Induna yomkhumbi olawulwa ngokokuqala. Lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle akufanele enze isenzo esingathikameza noma sivimbele ukulandelwa kohlelo lwezokuvikela lomkhumbi lwalowo mkhumbi. Uma lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle ephula umthethonkambiso 1 akenzi icala kodwa angakhishelwa umyalo wokuphoqwa. b lubeke izinyathelo zezokuvikela okufanele zisetshenziswe noma mayelana nomkhumbi wezokuvikela izinga- 1, 2 no 3. a Kubhekane nezidingo ezidingeka eNgxenyeni- A yoMgomo we-ISPS okufanele ubhekelwe ukuhlolwa kwezokuvikela zomkhumbi; futhi b Uma kungenjalo lungaqhutshwa ngokulandela noma iziphi izidingo njengoba zimiswe ngokubhaliwe isiPhathimandla. Ekumiseni izidingo ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 2 b isiPhathimandla kufanele sibheke izibopho ezimiswe eSahlukweni IX-2 seSivumelwano sezokuPhepha nomgomo we-ISPS. usetshenziselwe umsebenzi ongawulungele, ezinye zenziwa wukuthi okokuvalaakukho noma kususiwe. Kumele kube nohlelo lokuhlola ukuthi izintozokusebenza esingabala kuzo nemishini, ziphephile ukuthi zingasetshenziswa. Uma izinto zokusebenza zisetshenziswa ezimweni ezingezinhle, kumele uhlolwenjalo ukubheka ukuthi yini engakuholela ezingozini, uma kunesimoesingejwayelekile, esingenza ukuthi izinto zokusebenza zingabi ngeziphephile. Amathuluzi okutshala izihlahla kumele akhelwe leso sidingo. Isihloko sethuluzi lokusika nokugunda kumele sifakwe ngokunakekelaesibanjeni ngento eyiyo, isibonelo, isando, irivithi noma ibhawodi. Ukuthenga noma ukuboleka imishiniUma uthenga noma uboleka imishini umthetho uthi kumele umthengisi-mpahlaalethe izivalo eziyizo zokuvikela. Yenza isiqinisekiso sokuthi wena nabasebenzibakho. Abasebenzi baqeqeshiwe ukusebenza ngokuphepha nokuthi bahlinzekwengezingubo zokubavikela. Amandla abekiwe, ukwenza isibonelo, aqhamuka ezimpahleni ezicindezeleiziphethu noma amandla aqhamuka emanzini, ibekwa esimweni esilungeleukusebenza ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi. Bagqoka izingubo zokuvikela azifanele. Uphazamise abantu abasebenzisa imishini. Ukuphathwa kwezithuthi nezimpahlaEnye into edala izingozi kwezolimo ngogandaganda abagingqikayo. Izingoziezinkulu nezibulalayo zijwayelekile, izehlakalo zibandakanya abashayeli, abanyeabasebenzi nabahamba ngezinyawo. Ezinye izingozi zenzeka uma abantubeshiya izimoto bengenzanga isiqiniseko sokuthi ngeke zihambe noma zidaleingozi. Izihluthulelo zibekwa endaweni ephephileuma izimoto zingasebenzi. Imisebenzi yokuphakamisa izintoHlela futhi ulungise kahle izinto zokuqukula, usebenzise izinto eziyizo nabantuabaqeqeshekile ukunciphisa izingozi.

Ukuphuculwa Kwamakhono Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, abafundi bakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ahlukene. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile, ama-apps, kanye nevidiyo zokufundisa akwazi ukusiza abafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhono okucabanga, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, kanye namakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bukhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokusebenza ngokuqhubekayo, okubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni akukhululekile. Kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalokhu, njengokuntuleka kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuxhumeka ku-inthanethi, kanye nokungabi namakhono afanele kubafundisi. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokufundisa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Ukwenza imihlangano yokufundisa kubafundisi mayelana nezobuchwepheshe kungasiza ekwandiseni amakhono abo. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthuthukisa imfundo. Ngokusebenzisa amakhompyutha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi, abafundi bangathola ulwazi olusha, bathuthukise amakhono, futhi bakhulise ukuxhumana. Nokho, izinkinga ezithile zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi bayathola lezi zinsiza. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zazo zokufundisa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ubuchwepheshe busebenza kahle emfundweni. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele kuzoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emfundweni, kuzo zonke izigaba zempilo yabafundi.

Ngokusebenzisa izimali ezitholakalayo, uhulumeni uthuthukisa izinhlelo ezibalulekile, ezifana nezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zentuthuko. Uhlelo lwezentela oluhle lungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zemfundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, okukhuthaza ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga labo bophezo. Umphakathi ophilayo, owakhelwe phezu komnotho owaphumelela, ubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuphila. Ubuhle Bezintela Ubuhle bezentela bukhulu, njengoba zikhona ezinye izinzuzo ezifaka ukwakhiwa kokulinganiselwa kwemali, ukwelulwa kokubhuka kwezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokweseka, ezithinta izakhamuzi ezidinga usizo. Ukubhaliswa kwezintela kuhlinzeka ngendlela yokunciphisa ubumpofu, njengoba uhulumeni engathola insiza yokusebenza ukuze enze izinhlelo zokusiza. Ukuxhaswa kwezidingo eziphuthumayo, njengokwelashwa, ukudla, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi, zithuthukiswa ngezimali ezitholwe ngezintela. Ngakho-ke, ububi bokungakhokhi izintela buveza umthelela omubi emphakathini. Izinselelo Zohlelo Lwezintela Noma kube nezinzuzo eziningi, ezentela nazo zibhekene nezinselelo ezehlukene. Ukwehluleka kokuphatha kahle izimali kungaholela ezinkingeni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezifana nokukhwabanisa okwenziwa ngezintela, okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali okukhulu kuhulumeni. Umthelela wezintela eziphezulu emnothweni ungaholela ekutheni amabhizinisi anciphe, okusho ukwehla kwezimali ezitholakalayo kuhulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabazimele kanye nohulumeni kungaholela ekungqubuzaneni okukhulu kancane.

Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale benolwazi olungaphelele, okungaholela ezinqumweni ezingalungile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezinkinga zokwethembeka kolwazi olutholakala ezikhungweni. Kunezikhungo eziningi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi, kodwa akuhlali kucacile ukuthi lezi zikhungo ziwela kuphi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphatheke kabi, uma bephendukela kulwazi olungalungile. Ukuze izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibe usizo, kubalulekile ukuthi zibe nezinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwayo luyavuma nezifundo zakamuva. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kudinga izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kubandakanya abaphathi abaqeqeshiwe, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Uma izikhungo zinganikezi izinsiza ezanele, kuzoba nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale benolwazi olungaphelele, okungaholela ezinqumweni ezingalungile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Kodwa-ke, uma izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifakwa ngendlela efanele, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nomphakathi. Uma abantu bexhumana nezikhungo, bangakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi baphendule izidingo zabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi kunciphise izinga lokugula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zingaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo, imihlangano, kanye nemicimbi yokwazisa.

Izifundazwe ngokwazo kufanele zisungule izinqumo ngenhlanganisela yezifundo ezingenziwa isifundazwe sonke ezingeni eliphakathi. Ezingeni eliphezulu kunezinhlelo eziyisishiyagalombili zezinhlelo zezifundo ezisuselwa emikhakheni yezifundo. Ukwabiwa kwesikhathi kulowo nalowo mkhakha kumiselwe onke amabanga namazinga. Yileso naleso sitatimende somkhakha wesifundo sifaka ingxenye ebanzi yokuhlola. Uhlaka olusekelwe phezu kwemi-phumela lusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezikwaziyo ukubhekela izingqikithi ezahlukene. Ukuhlola lokhu kufanele kubeke obala indlela umfundi ngayo ulwazi ngempumelelo nangemfanelo, bese futhi kuqikelela ukuthi abafundi bayahlanganyela futhi bayawasebenzisa namakhono abanawo. Ukuhlola lokhu kumele futhi kusize abafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukuthatha izinqumo ngabakwenzayo, nangezinhloso abazibekele zona ngenqubekelaphambili yabo nokuthi bafunde baqhubeke. Bonke othisha kanye nabanye abafundisi baneqhaza elinqala ekuguquleni imfundo eNingizimu Afrika. Lesi sitatemende esibukeziwe sohlelo lwezifundo sikazwelonke samabanga R-9 (ezikoleni) sihlose ukuba nothisha abaqeqeshiwe, abanolwazi olufanele, abazinikele nabanesineke. Bazokwazi ukufeza izidingo njengoba zibekiwe ngokwezinkambiso namazinga avumelekile othisha.

Ekugcineni, uDonald Trump ungumuntu ophikisanayo, ohluke kakhulu kwabanye abaholi. Ubuye waba nesandla esikhulu emlandweni wezombusazwe, kodwa imiphumela yokuphatha kwakhe iyahluka. Njengabantu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuholi bukhona ezimfanelweni zethu, futhi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinqumo zethu, sihlole ukuthi zishintsha kanjani impilo yabantu. UTrump uyisibonelo sokuthi ubuholi bungenza izinguquko ezinkulu, kodwa kufanele sihlole ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziwusizo noma ziwubungozi. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngoDonald Trump, asikhulumi nje ngempumelelo noma ukwehluleka, kodwa sikhuluma ngempilo, izinqumo, nezindlela zokuphatha ezithinta wonke umuntu. UTrump uyisifundo esikhulu sokuthi ubuholi bukhona ezimfanelweni zethu, futhi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinqumo zethu, sihlole ukuthi zishintsha kanjani impilo yabantu.

Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya: Indaba Yomlando Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi edlule, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Enye yezinguquko ezibaluleke kakhulu kube ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya, okwenze izimpilo zabantu zashintsha kakhulu. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezahlukene zomlando, kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zikagesi, kuze kube sekutholakaleni kagesi emakhaya. Ekuqaleni, emakhaya amaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, abantu babebhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuntuleka kukagesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babebhekene nezindlela zendabuko zokukhanyisa, njengezibani ezisebenzisa amafutha, okwakwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokukhanya. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale besebenzisa izindlela ezithile zokuphila, ezazivame ukuba nzima futhi zidinga isikhathi esiningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, eminyakeni yama-1900, izinkampani zokuqala zikagesi zaqala ukuvela, ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, kodwa kwaba nezithiyo eziningi. Izindleko zokufaka ugesi emakhaya zaziphezulu, futhi abantu abaningi babengenakukwazi ukukhokhela lezi zindleko. Ngaleso sikhathi, ugesi wawungatholakali kalula, futhi abantu abaningi babengakaze bakwazi ukuwusebenzisa. Ngemva kweminyaka ethile, uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezihlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zikagesi zathuthukiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezindaweni ezikude.

Abasebenzikudingeka bahlale bephilile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi basebenza ngendlela nokuthibahlala besemsebenzini. Zonke izinhlangano zidinga inqubomgomo ukuze zikwazi ukuqalisa izinhlelozazo kwezempilo nokuphepha, ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga endaweniyokusebenzela. Lokhu kumele kubhalwe phansi, kulungiselelwe kahlekususelwe ekuzinikeleni kwabaphathi abaphezulu. Beka zonke izinhloso zakho ngempilo yabasebenzi nezokuphepha. Kumele zibuyekezwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kulungisiwe okuthile kuzouma imihlangano yakho ishintsha noma kunobungozi obuthile obuhlalukayo. nokuthi lokho ungakwenza kanjani. Ukuhlola ubungozi kusho ukubheka ngokuqaphelisisa ukuthi yini ebhizinisinilakho engalimaza abantu, ukuze ukwazi ukubheka ukuthi uthathe izinyatheloezifanele yini noma kumele wenze okunye. Uma sewunqumile ngezingalobungozi, kumele wenze izinto ezizovikela ukwenzeka kwezingozi. Ziningi izindawo lapho ungathola khona izeluleko kulabo asebenesikhathibekwenza lokhu uma uhlola ubungozi, ungasebenzisa lezi zindlela eziyisihlanuezilandelayo ukukusiza. Isinyathelo sokuqala: Bheka ubungoziBuka indawo yokusebenzela ubheke nokuthi abantu basebenza kanjani. Futhihlola imininingwane egciniwe mayelana nezehlakalo ezike zenzekangaphambilini, izingozi noma izinkinga zezempilo. Inhloso yalokhu ukutholaizingozi ezingaba nkulu ezingaholela ekulimaleni kwabantu abaningi. Hlonza abantu abangase babe sengozini, ubabale ukuthi bangaki. Umaucabanga ngokuthi uzokwenza "kanjani" lokhu, ungakhohlwa ungakhohlwayimisebenzi engaba nobungozi. Bheka ukuthi izinto ezinobungozi zinagadwa kanjani. Izindlela zokugada lobubungozi zingaba ngezale noma kube khona okunye okudinga ukwenziwa.

Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile okufanele umuntu azithathe ukuze aqinisekise ukufaneleka kwakhe? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, zikhona izinyathelo. Okokuqala, umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ubhaliswe kahle emnyangweni wakhe, ukuze ulwazi lwakhe luhambisane nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ngemva kwalokho, kufanele ahlole izinhlelo ezitholakalayo ze-GEMS ukuze akhethe eyamukelekayo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kulula. Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile zokuba ne-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, ihlinzeka ngempilo engcono, inezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwelashwa. Okwesibili, inikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha ezahlukene, kusukela ezikhungweni ezinkulu kuya ezincane, futhi inikeza izaphulelo ezinkulu ezindlekweni zokwelashwa. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinto ezithile okufanele abantu bazi ngazo uma bejoyina i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi izinqubo zokubhalisela i-GEMS. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqonda izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, izindleko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukufaneleka ne-GEMS kudinga ukuqonda okuhle. Unganikeza izeluleko kubantu abacabanga ngokujoyina? Mnu. Zulu: Ngempela. Okokuqala, ngincoma ukuthi bahlale bephapheme futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Bafanele baphendule imibuzo ethile, njengokuthi, "Yiziphi izinsizakalo engizidingayo?" noma "Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo?" Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezifanele. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu.

Umfundi uyakwazi ukuxhumana nabanye ngokuzethemba nangendlela ezwakalayo nefanele ezimweni eziningi ezahlukahlukene. Umfundi uyakwazi ukufunda abuke imibhalo ukuze athole ulwazi nokuzijabulisa, ananele ngokuhlolisisa amasiko nalokho okwaziswayo okuthinta imizwa. Umfundi uyakwazi ukubhala izinhlobo ezahlukehlukene zemibhalo eyiqiniso nezicatshangwayo ngezinhloso ezahlukahlukene. Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa ulimi ukucabanga nokucabangisisa, ukuze afinyelele elwazini, aluhlaziye, bese elusebenzisa ekufundeni. Umfundi unolwazi futhi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa imisindo, amagama kanye nohlelo lolimi, ukuziqambela nokuhumusha imibhalo. Nakuba ukulalela nokukhuluma, ukufunda nokubuka, ukubhala, ukucabanga nokucabangisisa, nolwazi lwemisindo, amagama kanye nohlelo kwethulwe njengemiphumela ehlukene, kumele kuhlanganiswe uma ufundisa noma uhlola. Balalela uhlobo oluthile lwesiqephu (isib. lapho kuchazwa indlela yokwenza okuthile njengokwembiwa kwegolide nokwakhiwa kwephepha). Baqambe bese bakha isiqephu esisha esifana nesinye , befakela izinto zokwakhiwa ezifana neshadi lengqondo eligelezayo. Ukuze bakwazi ukuqamba nokuhumusha iziqephu, abafundi badinga ulwazi ngolimi, ulwazi ngeziqephu, namakhono namasu asetshenziswa olimini. Nohlobo lombhalo - inhloso, isihloko, nezithameli. Nesakhiwo sombhalo, isibonelo senkondlo noma isaziso. Nendlela eyamukelekile yokusebenzisa ulimi ekuhlalisaneni kwabantu namasiko abantu, isib. indlela yokubingelela abantu ngezilimi ezahlukahlukene. Nohlelo imisindo kanye nolwazimagama lolimi. Nokubhala nobhalomagama, embhalweni obhaliwe.

Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke ukudlula ububanzi bemisele. Ububanzi bemisele emasimini athola imvula kuphela bungasuka ku-0,91 m, buye ku-2,1 m noma ku-2,3 m. Lokhu kuzohambelana nenhlobo yomshini osebenza ngawo nendlela yokulima. Inani lezitshalo elingaphansi kakhulu lizokwehlisa umvuno ongatholakala, kodwa inani elikhulu kakhulu lizokwenza ukuthi isitshalo zilwane bese umvuno wehle futhi. Izitshalo ezisondelene kakhulu zivama ukuthola izifo (njengokubola kwezinhlanga) futhi zivama ukuwa. Inkombiso yenani lezitshalo (akufanele libe ngaphansi kwe-20,000 yezitshalo ehektheleni kuzo zonke izindawo). (Ihektheli lingamamitha angu-100 ngangu-100). Kuyakhonjiswa ukuthi ipulantela lilinganiswe ngendlela ezotshala izimbewu ezingu-10% ngaphezu kwalokho okuqondisiwe ngoba ezinye zizolimala ngenxa yokungahlumi, ukudliwa yizilokazane nokuqina komhlabathi emva kwemvula eningi ngeskhathi sokuqala ukumila. Nakanjani, uma uthola ukuthi kukhona izitshalo ezingaphansi kwa-20,000 ehektheleni, kufanele ucabange ukuphinda ukutshala futhi lapho kusenesikhathi esikwanele sokumila kahle.

Umthethosisekelo weRiphabliki yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi oluphathwa Hulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi oluphathwa omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zakhe, futhi umthetho wesizwe kumele uthathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu kulungelo. Umgibeli Wolwazi wasungulwa ukuze unikeze iseluleko kwiOfisi Yolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphakathi Wolwazi mayelana nezicelo zolwazi futhi usize iOfisi Yolwazi kanye nezikhungo ezifanele mayelana nokucubungula izikhalazo. AmaKhomidi Okubonisana Ngolwazi amancane (IAASC's) nawo asungulwa ukuze anikeze iseluleko kuMphakathi Wolwazi mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. IOfisi Yolwazi yeMnyango Wezokuvikela yasungulwa njengesisekelo sokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. IOfisi Yolwazi izosiza labo abathumela izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalungu omphakathi ukuba babone isithombe noma uhlobo lwezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi ifaka izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulwazi nezincwadi nokuthi zikhona noma azikho. Ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwasendaweni, ukuphepha kwezifunda nezindawo ngokulandela amandla nezobuchwepheshe zokuphepha ezithuthukile, zanamuhla nezitholakala kalula. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inesibopho sokuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule nephumelelayo kubo bonke.

Bonke othisha kanye nabanye abafundisi baneqhaza elinqala ekuguquleni imfundo eNingizimu Afrika. Lesi sitatemende esibukeziwe sohlelo lwezifundo sikazwelonke samabanga R-9 (ezikoleni) sihlose ukuba nothisha abaqeqeshiwe, abanolwazi olufanele, abazinikele nabanesineke. Bazokwazi ukufeza izidingo njengoba zibekiwe ngokwezinkambiso namazinga avumelekile othisha. Lapha kubandakanywa ukuthi babe abaxazululi ezinkingeni ezingahle zibe khona ekufundeni, babe abahumushi bemfundo kanye nabaqophi bezinhlelo zokufunda nezinsizakufunda, babe abaholi abaphathi nabongameli bemfundo, babe abafunde kakhulu, babe abacwaningi, babe abafundi abafuna ulwazi oluthile kwasabona uqobo lwabo, babe amalunga omphakathi, babe yizakhamuzi nabelusi bemfundo, babe abehluleli nongoti kulowo nalowo mkhakha okanye kulelo nalelo zinga lemfundo. Ukugqugquzelwa kwalezo zinto ezisemqoka empilweni akukhona ukuthi kubaluleke kuphela uma kukhulunywa ngentuthuko yomuntu kodwa-ke nasekuqikeleleni ukuthi izinkomba zobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika ziyagqanyiswa kungafaniswa nangalesiya sikhathi semfundo yesikhathi sobandlululo. Uhlobo lomfundi olulindelekile yilolo olunelukuluku lenkuthazo esukela kulezo zinto ezisemqoka futhi oluzokwazi ukubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi owakhelwe phezu kwentando yeningi, okuwukulingana, ukuhlonishwa kwesithunzi somuntu, impilo kanye nenhlaliswano eyiyo yomphakathi.

Izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni (GEMS salary deduction procedures) Ngokwanda kwezidingo zokunakekela impilo, izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezikhethwe ngempela zibe yinsiza ebalulekile kubasebenzi abaningi. Kulokhu, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibonakala njengesisombululo esiqinile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Nokho, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezilula nezicacile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inqubo yokudonswa kwemali emholweni ingaba yinkimbinkimbi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni kubasebenzi. Ngokwesibonelo, abanye abasebenzi bangase bakhathazeke mayelana nezindleko ezihambisana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokwelashwa, futhi lokhu kungabavimbela ekuthatheni izinqumo eziphusile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ihlinzeke ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezindleko ezihambisana nezinhlelo zayo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungasiza abasebenzi ukuba benze izinqumo ezinhle mayelana nokuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo kangcono. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana phakathi kweGEMS nabasebenzi kumele kube kuhle kakhulu. Izikhathi eziningi, abanye abasebenzi bangenza izinqumo ezingalungile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olunembile. Izinqubo zokubhalisela izinhlelo zempilo kufanele zibe lula, futhi abaphathi bamasheya beGEMS kumele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bayazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze babhalisele izinhlelo zempilo. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezifana nezinsuku zokwazisa, kungaba usizo olukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi baqonda kahle izinqubo.
