Lapho iBhodi lakwesinye isifundazwe lihambise isicelo saliyisa kwi Bhodi ukuthola uvo ngesicelo esiphuma kwesinye isifundazwe, iBhodi kumele lithumele lesosicelo kwiqembu labaphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi elifanele ukuze iBhodi lithole izincomo noluvo okukhonjwe kusigatshana 3.

Ngokwezibalo ezitholakele, kubonakala ukuthi abantu abadala abanempahla enenani elingaphansi kwezigidi eziyisithupha rand banesidingo esikhulu sokusizwa. Ngakho-ke, iMuniisipali izoqala uhlelo lokubeka umkhawulo othile ezimalini zokukhulula isibopho sokukhokha. 2011 - R3,000,000 2011 / 2012 - R2,000,000 Amanye amakhawulo angase abekwe ngemuva kokubuyekezwa okujwayelekile kwezintela ezilandelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMuniisipali ngeke ivumele ukwehliswa kokukhokha emihlanganweni yangempela. Abantu abadala abake baphumule isibopho sokukhokha ngaphansi kwesikhwama esiqinile bazoqhubeka benza izinzuzo kuze kube sekubuyekezweni okujwayelekile kwezintela ezilandelayo ngo-2012. kumele kube umnikazi obhalisiwe wendlu abahlala kuyo njengomnikazi. uma bebambisana, bonke abanikazi kumele bahlangabezane nezimfuneko zokufaneleka ku-7.2 noma 7.3. e umnikazi kumele abe ngumnikazi wesikhathi esigcwele salo mhlaba; f amanzi, ugesi, nezinkokhelo kumele zibe ndawonye egameni lomnikazi; g inani lomhlaba wokuhlala kumele lingadluli leyo ebekwe yiBhodi esabelweni sayo sonyaka h ohlelweni lokuphatha impahla, umphathi wezakhiwo kumele ahlangabezane nazo zonke lezi z

Umphakathi uzonika ithuba lokubuza imibuzo, ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi, nokubiza abaqinisekisi. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo izwile yonke imininingwane evela kumphakathi nakuye ophikayo, umsolwa nomphikisi bazothola ithuba lokukhuluma enkantolo ngaphambi kokuthi umphumela udlule. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma umphumela, ummeleli wecala, umphakathi, noma ophikayo bangacela ukuthi ummeleli wezisulu noma omunye umuntu onekhono avunyelwe ukuveza umthelela wobugebengu kuwe noma kumsolwa. Le mininingwane ingathathwa ezitatimendeni zakho ezenziwe kumaphoyisa, noma umphakathi angase akubuze ngqo noma akubize ukuba unikeze ubufakazi ngesikhathi sokwahlulela. Umnyango wezobulungiswa uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlulelwa kwenzeka ngendlela

Njengoba ukuhlonishwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kudinga ukusekela, kubalulekile ukugxila ekwenzeni iminikelo ngokwakho. Izinsiza Ezinikezwayo Ngokungeziwe kumaholo okhulu, i-GEMS inika ububanzi bezinsiza eziqinile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izikhungo zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukwelashwa emtholampilo, nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile. Ubufakazi bokuba sevesheni yaseGEMS kwaziswe ngabahlali, bethola izinsizakalo ezibhekelela kahle izidingo zabo zempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ilunga le-GEMS kumele azise ngokuqhubekayo ngemali abayikhokhayo ukuze aqiniseke ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Ngokwezinsizakalo eziphezulu, i-GEMS iyasebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zokwelashwa zihlonishwa, futhi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bayaneliseka ngabantu abakhokhelwa. Uhlelo lwama-urgent care lunikezwa ukuze lwenze kube lula ukuhamba kwemali, noyedwa oyisithupha uyakwazi ukukhokha ngamaholo athile. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Nakuba i-GEMS ibonisa ukuphumelela ezindlelweni zayo, akukhona kokuphela okuhle. Abanye amalungu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene babe nezinselele zokukhokha izindleko eziziphakeme, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezidingweni ezimazombezombene. Lokhu kuphakanyiswa kwezimali eziphezulu ezimbalwa kuhlangene nezimo ezingathandeki, njengezindleko eziphezulu zokuhlola kanye nezikhungo zokwelashwa. Ngokuqaphela lokhu, i-GEMS isebenzisa izinqubo ezikhethekile ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga. Amabhodi afaka ukunikeza izixazululo zamasosha ezinkulu ukuze abavote ezindleleni zokuphila. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba phambili kwemali, kulindeleke ukuthi i-GEMS izoshintsha ukuphathwa kwezimali zobulungu bayo.

Ngakho-ke enye izunzo kubanini bezimoto yokusebenzisa uphetholo ungaxutshiwe yileyo yokuthi izindleko zokunakekela imoto ziyancipha. Yiziphi izimoto okufanele zisebenzise I-LRP futhi kungani? Njengokunika amandla amafutha esithako se-octane, umthofu usebenza njengamafutha okuthambisa phakathi kwezinto ezithintanayo kanye namavalufu e-ekzozo kanye namavalufu ehloko yesilida. Izinjini zezimoto ezithile ezidala zeminyaka yamashumi ayisishiyangalombili phakathi nawo zenziwa ngensimbi ethambile yamavalufu ngoba zazivikelwa nguphetholo oxutshwe nomthofu. Uma kususwa umthofu kuphetholo, lamavalufu awenziwe ngensimbi ethambile angaguga kanti ukuphela kwamavalufu kungadala ukulahleka kokucindezeleka namandla. Isimo sokusebenza esibaluleke kakhulu samavalufu isivinini esiphezulu noma umthwalo omkhulu okuholela ekukhuleni kwezinga lokushisa lamavalufu okwenza aguge kakhulu. Isiphi Isithako esisebhodleleni okumele ngisisebenzise? Kusukela ngenyanga kaNhlolanja (February) 2005, zonke izimoto ezihamba ngophetholo zokuthwala abantu nezohweba noma ezisetshenziselwa ibhizimisi eziqalayo eNingizimu Afrika kudingeka zibe amazinga afanele okukhipha ngakho kufanele zifakwe I- catalytic converter. Kusukela ngo-Masingana 2008, zonke izimoto zikaphetholo zonke izinhlobo noma ngabe ezikhona noma ezitsha kufanele zifakwe i-catalytic converters. Akudingekile kodwa ukuthi izimoto ezakhiwe ngaphambi kwalolusuku ziyofakwa I-catalytic converters. Izimoto ezingaphezulu kwama 70% ezimotweni ezintsha vele sezifakiwe i- catalytic converters. Okwengeziwe okuvimbela amavalufu kulula ukukusebenzisa.

Lena yindlela eyenza ohumushayo akwazi ukuletha usizo ngocingo. Ngakho, ukuhumusha ngocingo kulungele kakhulu umphakathi ofana nowase Ningizimu Afrika lapho umsebenzi wokukhuthaza izilimi ufuneka khona ngesikhathi esifushane ngaphansi kwezimo eziphuthumayo nasekusizeni amakhasimende, njengasemitholampilo naseziteshini zamaphoyisa. Lezi yizindawo lapho izilimi ezidingekayo nobude bokusiza ikhasimende bungachazeki kahle ngaphambi kwalowo msebenzi ngamunye. IDAC imatasatasa nohlelo lwesikhashana loMsebenzi Wokuhumusha Ngocingo eNingizimu Afrika (TISSA) ngenhloso yokuphenya ukuthi ukuhumusha ngocingo eNingizimu Afrika kungaba yimpumelelo yini. Lo msebenzi usahlolwa eziteshini ezingu 70 zamaphoyisa oMbutho wamaPhoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika, emitholampilo engu 11 nasezikhungweni zokusiza umphakathi ezingu 8 ezingeni likahulumeni wasekhaya eMkhandlwini kaMasipala iTshwane. IPanSALB isiqalile ukumisa amaNLBs azothuthukisa, akhuthaza futhi aqoke izidingonqangi zokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi iKhoe, iSan nolweziMpawu ukuze kwenyuswe isithunzi sazo. Kuyosekwa nezinye izakhiwo ezikhona ezikhuthaza intuthuko yeziLimi zeziMpawu zaseNingizimu Afrika nemisebenzi egamanxe emingceleni yamanye amazwe. Ukubambisana nababambe iqhaza yinto emqoka kakhulu kule ndima. Imithombo yezindaba iyobamba iqhaza eliwumgogodla wokuqwashisa ngoHlaka lweNqubomgomo yoLimi. Inhloso yokusebenzisa imithombo yezindaba kuyoba wukugxila emphakathini ngenjongo yokuwufundisa ngalokho okuqukethwe yiNqubomgomo.

Uma bephika ukusigna, kufanele banikezwe omunye umphakathi ozosigna ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isaziso. Incazelo ephelele yokuziphatha okungafanele, ubufakazi umqashi ozowethemba. Ulwazi ngamalungelo omphakathi, abamele abaphathi noma abamele inhlangano yezabasebenzi evunyelwe, kanye nalabo abazohlinzeka ngobufakazi. a. umqashi angase abambe umphakathi noma amukele imali ngokuphelele, noma amtransfer kuMnyango omunye wenhlangano. Ngaphansi kwalezi zimo; uma umphakathi uthola icala noma uphatha icala elibucayi, futhi umqashi ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela komphakathi emsebenzini kungaphazamisa uphenyo lwecala elibhekene naye, noma kube yingozi empilweni yomuntu noma impahla kahulumeni. c. Uma umphakathi ebhujiswa noma edluliselwa, umqashi kufanele abambe ukulalela phakathi kwenyanga. Umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela uzokwenza isinqumo sokuthi icala lizophumelela. a. Ukulalela kufanele kubanjwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokunikezwa isaziso kumphakathi. b. Umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela kufanele abe sezingeni eliphezulu kunommeleli womphakathi. Uma umphakathi obhekene necala engumholi wesigaba, umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela kufanele kube yisiphathimandla esisebenzayo noma umuntu onolwazi olwaneleyo futhi oqokwe nguMbuso noma umkhandlu wesifunda omkhulu. c. Uma umphakathi efisa,

Eziningi izindawo ezinikeza imali zidinga isibopho sepulazi ngaphambi kokunikeza intsheleko. Abalimi abaqasha amapulazi noma abalima umhlaba womuzi wonke abakwazi ukunikeza leso sibopho ngakho-ke bayahluleka ukutsheleka imali. Eziningi izindawo ezitshelekisa imali yokukhiqiza zidinga inshuwalense yokubopha leyo mali. Kodwa inshuwalense yokukhiqiza isebenza kuphela lapho izitshalo ziqala ukumila, ngaleso sikhathi zonke izindleko sezikhokhiwe. Ezinye izindawo ziyala ukuvumela intsheleko ngaphambi kokuthola imvumo yenshuwalense, bese umlimi uyahluleka ukuthola imali yokuqala ukukhiqiza. Enye inkinga yilokhu: inshuwalense ibopha i-65% lezindleko kuphela - i-35% lesele lisengozini. Ukulima kunzima, lapho ungenalo ulwazi uzongena enkingeni. Lapho inani lenzuzo lincane, awukwazi ukwenza amaphutha. Abakhiqizi abasakhulayo basafunda futhi, ngakho-ke ingozi yokubanikeza intsheleko inkulu kakhulu kulabo abatshelekisa imali. Kukhona abaningi abalimi abanethuba lokuthola ipulazi noma amasimu, kodwa abanyo imishini yokulima leyo ndawo. Imishini emisha idula kakhulu, abalimi abakwazi ukufikela futhi kunzima ukuthola ibhizinisi elizonikeza intsheleko yokuthenga imishini emidala. Lapho kukhona imishini yokulima, ivama ukungaphili kahle. Inzuzo encane lapho kukhiqizwa ukudla okuzinhlamvu kwenza ukuthi abalimi abanayo imali yokulungisa imishini yabo. Kaningi abalimi abanalo ulwazi lokulungisa nokubheka imishini yabo. Kaningi ukuthengiselana komhlaba kuhlanganisa zonke izinto ezikhona epulazini bese sithola ukuthi imishini igugile futhi iphukile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi omusha uqala phansi ngendlela embi.

Kumele kuvezwe nekhophi yetayitela. i abaphathi bamafa afelwe ngabaniniwo, abawabayo kanye nabasingathi bawo kababaliwe ekuxegiselweni isibopho sokukhokha. ukuxegiselwa kuyonqamuka: a uma ofake isicelo eshona; b kufakwa isicelo seRevenue Clearance Certificate esiholela ekwedluleleni kobunikazi bomuzi komunye umuntu; c lapho ofake isicelo engasahlali ngokugcwele kulowo muzi; d uma ongasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula ethola umsebenzi. Umuzi uyothathwa njengo 'muzi ophethwe yizingane' uma izingane zakulowo muzi ziphenywe ngusonhlalakahle woMnyango wezeNhlalakahle yoMphakathi wakuqinisekisa ukuthi kunjalo. isitifketi sokushona komzali;iii uma umzali ephethwe yisifo esingelapheki, ikhophi yombiko kadokotela wesifunda efakazela isimo sakhe; kanye iv nezitifiketi zokuzalwa zabantwana abahlala kulowo muzi. d Inani lomhlaba wofaka isicelo kumele lingeqi enanini elinqunywe ngokwesinqmo soMkhandlu olwabiweni mali lwawo lwaminyaka yonke. e izicelo kumele zivuselelwe minyaka yonke nguMnyango wezeNhlalakahle yoMphakathi. e uma izicelo zingafakwanga minyaka yonke. Labo izicelo zabo ezifike emva kwesikhathi bangakwazi ukuphinde bancishiselwe kusukela esikhathini esilandelayo se-akhawunti esivumayo. Njengokusho koMthetho, umhlaba ongowomuntu owunikwe ngaphansi kohlelo lokubuyisela abantu amalungelo omhlaba noma ongowezindlalifa zakhe awukhokhiswa marates iminyaka elishumi kusukela ngosuku itayitela lalowo muntu lobunikazi balowo mhlaba elabhaliswa ngalo egameni lakhe ehhovisi okubhaliswa kulo amatayitela obunikazi bemihlaba.

Abahlali be-Unit R no-S eLebowakgomo township eLimpopo, abanye babo bebelinde izindlu ze-Reconstruction and Development Programme (RDP) kusukela ngo-1996, bangase bathole ukuthi ukulinda kwabo okude sekuphela. Lokhu kuza kulandela uphenyo lweHhovisi leMphakathi (OPP) mayelana nokwehluleka kweMnyango wezeMisebenzi yezeMvelo, Izindawo Zokuhlala kanye Nezindaba Zendabuko eLimpopo ukufeza umthwalo wawo wokwakha izindlu ze-RDP kulolu hlelo. Le ndaba yethulwe ku-OPP nguMphakathi wendawo, uMnu. Frans Letwaba, owethule le ndaba kubahlali. Abafakizicelo bathumele izicelo zabo zokwesekwa kwezezimali kusukela ngo-1996 kuya ku-2006. Izicelo zabo z processingwe nguMnyango ngaphansi kohlelo lokwesekwa kwezezimali olubizwa nge-Project Linked Subsidy. Lolu hlelo lwanikezwa inkampani ebizwa ngokuthi i-COMDEV, eyahluleka ukwakha izindlu noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinto zokwakha. Kwatholakala ukuthi ingxenye yezindlu ezakhiwe yayiyingxenye kuphela yezinto zokwakha ezazimele ukuhlinzekwa kwabanye ababehloswe ukuwuthola lo msebenzi. Umnyango utholakala unecala lokwehluleka ukwakha izindlu noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinto zokwakha kubabikeli ukuze bakhe izindlu zabo. Uphenyo lwe-OPP luthole ukuthi izicelo zezimali zababikeli z processingwe kusukela ngo-1997 kuya ku-2006. Abanye bababikeli bakhetha ukwakha izindlu zabo ngezinsiza zabo, kanti abanye bashiya ingxenye yezakhiwo zokuhlala besebenzisa izinto zabo. U-Mphakathi ulethe isiphakamiso sokuthi uMnyango kufanele wakhe izindlu kubo bonke abazuzi ababehloswe ukwakhiwa kwezicelo zabo z processingwe ngo-2006 noma ngaphambi kwalokho.

Kuyisu elihle ukuhlela umhlangano ophuthumayo emuvakokubekwa kwekomidi lesigceme ukwakha uhlelo lokusebenzalonyaka. Lokhu kumele kwenziwe minyaka yonke. Umhlahlandlela ubeka ngokucacile izidingo ezinqala zekomidilesigceme nokuthi lifuna ukuzuzani. Lokhu kuzonikusiza ukuthiubone ukuthi niyazizuza yini izinjongo zenu. Kuzonisiza futhi umanibhala imibiko yenu eya kumasipala, njengoba kulindelekeukuthi nenze njalonjalo (esikhathini esiningi kanye ngenyanga). Iziphi izindaba ezibalulekile emphakathini Angasiza nganiamakomidi ezigceme Nokuthi ningakwenza nini lokhu? Iziphi izinkundla zomphakathi, njenge zempilo, ezamaphoyisa omphakathi, lapho ikomidi lesigceme lifunaukumelwa khona? Iziphi izinhlangano zomphakathi noma iminyangokamasipala enifuna ukuzimema ukuthi zimeleke ekomidinilesigceme noma emihlanganweni yomkhandlu? Obani abanganikwa miphi imisebenzi? Iziphi izinto ezibalulekile noma ezijahekile enifuna ukuzenza kuqala nokuthi ikuphi okungalinda isikhashana? Bheka isijobelelo 20 enesibonelo soHlelo Lomsebenzi wekomidilesigceme. Abasebenzi benhlangano bejwayeleukuthatha imilayezo yabantu abangekho. Amakhono okusebenzisa ucingo. Kubalulekile ukuzwakala njengomuntu oqeqeshiwe uma ukhulumanomunye ngocingo endaweni yomsebenzi. Ukwenza lokhu kumeleube namakhono amahle okusebenzisa ucingo. Phinda njalo inombolo otholakala kuyo. Yenza lokhu umaushiya inombolo komunye umuntu noma uthatha inombolo yomunye umuntu. Uma ushayela omunye umuntu, yazi kabanzi ngomuntuofisa ukukhuluma naye. Kuyisu elihle ukubhala phansi lokho ofuna ukukushongaphambi kokuthi ushaye ucingo khona ungezukukhohlwaobufuna ukukusho.

Umkhandlu udwebele lamakomidi uhlu lwemihlahlandlela. Lemihlahlandlela iveza izinhlaka ezincomekayo nokuthi nesibonelo sokuthi ingxube yobulungu ingabumbeka kanjani, izincomo ngemisebenzi yamalunga nokulindelwe neziphakamiso zokuba kwakhiwe ezifundazweni iziMpiko zokuqamba amagama ezindawo neziyosekelwa ngabasebenzi balamakomidi. Lemihlahlandlela iyobusa umsebenzi woMkhandlu ngokubuyekeza amagama asaphasa nalawo amadala kodwa angakaphasiswa wuMkhandlu. Kuyo yonke imihlangano, uMkhandlu uhlaziya uhlu lwamagama ethulelwe ukuphasiswa avela emaposini, komaziphathe nomasipala, kubathuthukisi bemihlaba nakwamanye amaqembu anentshisekelo. Kubhekwa kakhulu indlela okubhalwa ngayo igama ngokulandela imvelaphi yalolo limi okususelwe kulo igama kanjalo nokucabangela izinto ezifana nomlando wokuqamba leyonto, indawo noma isakhiwo, ukuphindeka kwamagama, ukungacaci kwegama, ukunganambitheki kwalo nobude ngokweqile. Umkhandlu uqikelela ukuthi uthola ulwazi namalekhodi ngaleyonto eqanjwayo, kuhlangene nokuxhumana kwayo nezindawo eziseduze, umsuka nencazelo yegama nokwazi ngalowo owethula imininingwane. Amanye amagama aphindiselwa emuva ngenhloso yokuthi kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo noma kuguqulwe izincomo. Uma uMkhandlu usuliphasisile igama, lethulwa kuNgqongqoshe ukuze ashaye isigxivizo sokugcina, ngemuva kwalokho lishicilelwe kwiGazethe kaHulumeni. UMnyango wezamaKhono, amaSiko, iSayense nobuChwepheshe udingeke ukuba usungule umtapo wolwazi nemininingwane ngamagama ezindawo eziphasisiwe.

indlela yokubingelela abantu ngezilimi ezahlukahlukene. Nohlelo imisindo kanye nolwazimagama lolimi. Nokubhala nobhalomagama, embhalweni obhaliwe. Nemifanekiso nezakhiwo ezakhiwe ngemfanelo emibhalweni ezibukwayo. Yonke imibhalo inokuyigugu kwabantu, okungaba kuhle (isib. intando yeningi) noma kube kubi (isib. Ukubandlulula ngobuhlanga, nangobulili). Okuyigugu akubonakali njalo. Abafundi kudingeka baqaphelisise futhi babhekisise okuyigugu uma befunda noma bebuka iziqephu abazitholayo nalezo abaziqambela zona. Funda ukuthi iziqephu ziveza umbono wabantu nezehlakalo ezithile. Thuthukisa amakhono okuhlaziya nokuhlolisisa, uma kunesidingo, bayophikisana ngalemibono nokuyigugu okuhambisana nako. Bonisa ukuthi bethula okuyigugu kuziqephu abazakhele zona - isibonelo: ukubekezelelana, ukuzwelana nabanye, ukuhlonipha, ukuzithokozisa, ukuba namahlaya, ukuthanda ukudlala, ukungathokozi, nentukuthelo. Ukufunda ulimi kungahlanganiswa futhi ngezindikimba. Ukusebenzisa indikimba ethile kuvumela umfundi ukuba akhe ulwazimagama oluhambisana nesihloko. Ukukhetha izindikimba nezihloko ngokucophelela kunikeza umfundi ugqozi lokufunda. Ukuthola izihloko nezindikimba ezithokozelwa ngabafana namantombazane, nabafundi abahlala ezindaweni ezisemakhaya nezisemadolobheni-nezindikimba ezihlanganisa zonke izinhlobo zabafundi. Ukukhetha izihloko eziphathelene nezimpilo zabafundi, ziphinde futhi zibafundise nokunye abangakwazi,. Isib.bazofunda ngokwenzeka kwamanye amazwe nakwamanye amasiko. Ukukhetha izindikimba nezihloko ezihambisana nemiphumela jikelele nemiphumela ethuthukisayo/ ekhulisayo.

Ekwenzeni uhlelo lwezesivumelwano, iziphathimandla kumele zibheke imigudu yonke, lokhu kusho ukuthi Zinake izithuthi ezithola uxhasomali nezingalutholi futhi, banikezele ngezivumelwano ezihlanganise ezokuthutha ezinoxhasomali nezingenalo lapho kufaneleke khona. Ithelevishini: Umcimbi Wokuxhumana Nezindaba Ithelevishini, njengomkhiqizo wezobuchwepheshe, ibalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Iqala ukuvela emhlabeni ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1920, kodwa yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu kuphela ngasekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1950. Ngalesi sikhathi, ithelevishini yaguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo ulwazi, behlola izindaba, nezokungcebeleka. Namuhla, ithelevishini isiyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Umcimbi wokwethulwa kwe-thelevishini ungumcimbi obalulekile, owawuhlelwe ngonyaka odlule eGoli. Kwakukhona izinkampani eziningi ezazihlanganyela, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinhlelo ezintsha, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile, lapho abaphathi bephakamisa izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ithelevishini, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile. Baphinde bagcizelele ukuthi ithelevishini ayisiyona nje indlela yokubuka, kodwa iyinsiza yokufundisa, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezethulo ezahlukene ezazihlanganisa izinhlelo ezahlukene, kusukela ezinhlelweni zezingane, ezokungcebeleka, nezokuhlola izindaba. Abadlalayo, ababhali, nabakhiqizi baveze izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezikhuthazayo, nezifundisayo. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo phakathi kwabantu, lapho bekhuluma ngendaba yokuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe.

Isigaba 183. Umphakathi wolwazi uzobhekana nesicelo solwazi ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kokusithola noma njengoba kungenzeka. [Isigaba 25]. Kwezinye izimo, le nqubo yezinsuku eziyi-30 ingandisiwe ngenye yezinsuku eziyi-30. [Isigaba 26]. Umfakisicelo uzokwaziswa nganoma yiziphi izimali ezikhokhwayo ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo solwazi processed. [Isigaba 22]. Umfakisicelo angafaka isikhalazo mayelana nokukhokhwa kwezimali ngaphakathi kwaleyo nkathi. [Izigaba 74 no-75] noma afake isicelo enkantolo sokuthola usizo olufanele ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwenqubo okukhulunywe ngayo ngenhla. [Isigaba 78]. Umfakisicelo uzokwaziswa ukuthi uzothola ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. [Isigaba 25]. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kwamakhono, ukuxhumana kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokukhuluma ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngababhalisile ngamakhono okusebenza okuphumelelayo ezingeni le-strategic lemisebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zitholakala emikhakheni ehlukahlukene yokukhuluma, umsakazo kanye ne-television, futhi zifaka izifundo ezimfishane, izifundo zomphakathi, izifundo eziphelele, kanye nemikhankaso edumile. Uhlelo lunemakethe ethile eqondiwe. Abantu abavela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo. Thumela isikhalazo sakho kwiKomidi Lezikhalazo mayelana nesinqumo somphakathi wolwazi. Uma umfakisicelo enganelisekile ngesinqumo seBhodi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olufanele enkantolo. Lolu lwazi luzotholakala kuphela uma luceliwe.

IBhodi lingakwazi, ekuvumeni isicelo, ukubeka imigomo engeke ingahambisani nalo Mthethi noma uMthetho ka Zwelonke. Ukwenzela lesisigaba izithuthi zizothathwa njengezisuka lapho umuntu egibela khona imoto ngenhloso yokuhanjiswa kwenye indawo, futhi agcine lapho. lapho kunokungabaza ukuthi izithuthi zizoqala kuphi, umfaki sicelo kumele afake isicelo kwisi fundazwe lapho imoto ekukhulunywa ngayo irejistwe khona. Ibhodi alikwazi ukuvuma isicelo selayisense yokusebenza egunyaza ukusebenza ngezithuthi ezisuka kwesinye isifundazwe, noma ukuvuselela noma ukudlulisela ilayisense yokusebenza, noma sokushintsha ilayisense yokusebenza yokuqhuba ukusebenza kwesinye isifundazwe, ngaphandle uma kuvuma isiphathimandla sezokukhishwa kwama layisense okusebenza esisungulelwe lesosi fundazwe. Lapho iBhodi lehluleka ukuthola impendulo edingekayo ephuma kwisiphathimandla sezokukhipha amalayisense okusebenza sakwesinye isifundazwe kwinkomba ekhonjwe kusigatshana 4, noma lehluleka ukuthola imvume yeBhodi esikhathini esibekiwe, iBhodi kumele lidlulisele loludaba njengesikhalo kwi Nkundla yokudlulisela izikhalo ngezokuthutha esungulwe ngu Mthetho we Nkundla yokudlulisela izikhalo ngezoku Thutha, ngendlela ebekwe ngokwalo Mthetho. Izikhalo ezimaqondana nezithuthi phakathi kwezifundazwe kumele zenziwe kwinkundla yezikhalo ngezokuthutha njeboba kusho uMthetho we Nkundla yokudlulisela iziKhalo ngezoku Thutha, njengoba kufuneka ngokwalo Mthetho.

Ukuzibophezela ezivumelwaneni zokuqashiselana - uma usikhwama kuyilona oqashiselwe. Abasolwa ababili baboshwa begqekeza endlini eBuccleuch, eSandton. Sebenzisa indwangu emunca amanzi uma kukhona okuchithekile ukwesula okusaluketshezi - uqale ukwesula usuka ngaphandle uye maphakathi. Imoto yohlobo lweVW Golf eyayebiwe endaweni yamaphoyisa yaseParkweg yatholakala eKagisanong. Siyazi ukuthi ukuza kwakho enkantolo kuvamise ukuba nengcindezi kuphinde kukuhlukumeze ngokomoya. Amaphoyisa aseChina avimba isimo esasizohlaza esasiqalwe saphinde senziwa yi "Eastern Turkistan" abehlukanisi ababesebhanoyini i-Southern Airlines flight ngoNdasa. Silinde ngamanzonzo uhlelo olumbaxaningi noluhambela izinto phambili i-Programme of Action. Izitifiketi ze-LPI azeseki muntu, zivumela inhlangano ukuthi ashintshele ekusabalaliseni kunoma iyiphi enye iLinux ngaphandle kokuqeqesha kabusha abasebenzi. Kusolakala ukuthi lo omncane wayengaboni ukuthi isibhamu sasihlohliwe ngesikhathi ekhwebula ingcipho. Inhlangano yeZizwe kanye ne-AU njengamanje imatasa ivakashela amazwe anamasosha abambe iqhaza ngaphambi kokuba ashintshelwe kwenye indawo ukuhlola abasebenzi abagqoke umfaniswano nezinto zokusebenza, ngokwezithunywa. Abaningi ababelwa empini bakhethe ukubuyiselwa emphakathini, ukunokuba babuyiselwe empini. Amaphoyisa aphuca umnikazi imoto kanti abasolwa bayiswa esitokisini esisemaphoyiseni ase-Alberton. Lokhu kufaka izinto ezinjengamajezi, opholonekha, amajezi anezinkinobho, izikibha namanye amavesti, iphentihosi, amathayithi, amastokhingi amasokisi nokunye okunjalo.

Ukulima kanye nekusasa: kungani kuthatha isikhathi eside? Sizamile ukuvuselela abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono ukuze babe abalimi abakwazi ukuziphilisa ngokwabo esikhathini esizayo. Njengoba isimo sezimali samanje emhlabeni sikhathazekile, lokhu kuzoba nzima - nokho, ungumuntu ophawulekayo. Uma ukulima eNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuqhubeke, kudingeka sifeze uguquko olugcwele emhlabeni wezolimo ukuze sikwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezivamile. Ukulima akulula; abalimi babhekana nezinto eziningi futhi kwesinye isikhathi bazibeka engcupheni. Amanani aphansi wezimpahla zokudla enza kube nzima kubalimi ukuba bathole inzuzo ezimpahleni zabo. Izinga lenzalo liphansi kakhulu futhi izindleko zemishini ziphezulu kakhulu. Abalimi abanamakhono kwezomnotho nabo babhekana nezinselelo (bakhathazekile!) - singasho ukuthini ngabo abasha? Uhulumeni angabasiza kanjani? Okwamanje, ukukhiqiza izimpahla zokudla ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo kunzima; abalimi abasha bangase bangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokulima esikhathini esizayo. Sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha; amanani okudla azophakama futhi. Kodwa okwamanje, kudingeka sisekele abalimi ngezimali, njengokuxhaswa - ukusiza ngezindleko zokuqala zokutshala noma ukuhlinzeka ngama-bonuses ezimpahleni zokudla ezikhiqizwayo. Le mikhankaso izoqinisekisa ukuthi labo abasebenza kanzima bazothola ama-bonuses - lokhu kuzosisiza abalimi abanamakhono ukuba babe nenzuzo. Enye inkinga enkulu yisimo semishini nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa abalimi abasha - kudingeka sibe nesisekelo sezimali ukusiza abalimi ukuthi balungise imishini yabo. Kukho ingxenye yezigaba zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngempahla nemishini kubalimi.

2.4.6.5 Umgomo wokujikeleza kufanele usetshenziswe uma kukhethwa ulimi lokukhipha imiqulu kahulumeni olwimini lwabe Nguni nabeSuthu. 2.4.6.6 Ukuxhumana nomhlaba jikelele: Ukuxhumana kukahulumeni nomhlaba jikelele kuzawuba ulimi lwesiNgisi noma kokungavamile kwenziwe ngolimi olukhethwe yizwe okuxhunyanwa nalo. 3.1 Ukusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yolimi kuzokongeza ukufuneka kokuhumusha nokuhlela umsebenzi kanye nemisebenzi yokutolika, ikakhulukazi ezilimini zendabuko. Umnyombo wokukwazi ukuhumusha kulezi zilimi kuzomele uthuthukiswe wandiselwe emiNyangweni kahulumeni nasemisebenzini yangasese yabasebenzi bolimi abazimele njengabahumushi, abahlali , kanye notoliki . Lesi sidingo esingeziwe semisebenzi yezisebenzi zolimi eziyizingoti kuzawidingeka ukuqeqeshwa kwamakhono okwengeziwe. 3.2 Ukusungulwa kwamayunithi kulowo nalowo mnyango kahulumeni kaZwelonke kanye nakuleso naleso sifunda kuzawuba nomthelela emisebenzini eyenziwa yiGatsha loLimi lukaZwelonke. I-NLS izawudingeka ukuthi lixhumanise ukuphatha nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo ngokwenza lula ukuqeqeshwa kweqembu leyunithi yabasebenzi boLimi emisebenzini yokuhlelwa kolimi nokusekela izinhlelo zemisebenzi zalamaqembu.I-NLS izawuphinde ibe nomthwalo wokuxhumanisa ukusungula izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa kwabahumushi, abahleli kanye nabatolikayo, kanye nokusungula izinkomba ezisebenzayo ezindabeni zezinga. 3.3 Izindawo zetheminografi netheminoloji nazo ngokunjalo zizoshintsheka .

Inkantolo ingase futhi icela imvume ebhaliwe enganeni uma seziphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi, futhi inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi ingane iyayiqonda indaba kanye nokubaluleka kwemvume. Uma kunoma yisiphi isikhawu sokulalela, uma inkantolo ithola ukuthi kunezizathu eziphakeme zokuthi imvume ebhaliwe engabazali bezinhliziyo zengane ingafunwa, inkantolo ingacela umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane ukuba ikhiphe isaziso noma iFomu 22 Isaziso kubazali ukuze bathumele izizathu ngokuhambisana nemigomo 21, 21 kulowo bazali. Isaziso sizocela abazali ukuba babe khona enkantolo yezingane uma befuna ukuveza izizathu zokuthi imvume yabo ingabekwa eceleni. Uma isaziso sithunyelwe kahle kubazali futhi akukho sizathu esiphakeme sokuthi abazali baphume enkantolo, inkantolo ingase iphendule ngokushesha udaba bese ikhipha isinqumo ngodaba. Uma isaziso singathunyelwa kahle kubazali, inkantolo ingase, ngokuthanda kwayo, ikhiphe isaziso kubazali futhi, uma ibona kudingeka, iphendule ngokushesha udaba bese ikhipha isinqumo ngodaba. Lapho inkantolo yezingane icabangela isicelo sokufakwa, ukuhlinzekwa kombiko obhaliwe owenziwe ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana ogunyaziwe, noma omunye umuntu ogunyaziwe, kuzoba ubufakazi obanele mayelana nokuqukethwe kombiko. Noma iyiphi i-parti ethintwa ngqo umbiko ingacela ukuthi okuqukethwe kombiko kukhishwe. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba. Umphakathi ophathelene nodaba uzokhuluma ngokucacile kumuntu othintekayo ngemiphumela yokwehluleka ukuphikisa umbiko nokuphikisa izitatimende ezivela kumbiko.

Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa imishanguzo, izikhali zokusebenza, noma amakhono okwelapha ukuze kube neqhaza eliphumelelayo. Izinselele ezahlukene zingavela ngesikhathi sokubeletha, njengezinkinga zokuphefumula noma ukungatholakali kahle komntwana, futhi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Enye indlela yokubeletha ibizwa ngokuthi "ukubeletha ngekesekwazi," lapho umama esebenzisa imishanguzo ethile ukuze anciphise ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Le ndlela iyanda, ikakhulukazi ezibhedlela, ngoba inikeza umama ithuba lokuba nakho okuhle ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Noma kunjalo, kubalulekile ukuqapha ukuthi le mishanguzo isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ukuze kugwenywe imiphumela eyongeziwe. Ngaphezu kwezindlela zokubeletha, izinqubo zokwakha indawo yokubeletha nayo ibalulekile. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezindawo ezikhethekile zokubeletha ezihlanganisa izinsiza ezifanele, njengokukhanya okungapheli, izigubungelo zezwi, nezinsiza zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinsiza ezikahle ezihambisana nezidingo zabesifazane abakhulelwe, ukuze bakwazi ukujabulela le nqubo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba nezinhlelo ezithile zokwelashwa kwabantu abakhulelwe. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundisi, odokotela, nezisebenzi zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane bathola ukwesekwa okuhle. Ukuhlola izinga lokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha zisebenza kahle. Izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukugxila ezicini eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuphathwa kwezempilo, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo.

Ungasisebenzisa uma okuqukethwe komswakama sishintsha sibe phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okwakhiwa okukhona phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% kuzonakala kulula ukonakala uma kungena kwi-cylinder. Okukhishiwe okungekho ngokuphelele okonakaliswe kuhlala emhlabeni. I-'concave' ivulekile kakhulu. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezisele. Ukuphuma komoya okuphansi, ukonakala kwi-cylinder kwenzeka ngokushesha. Ukuvuleka kwe-'chaffer' kuncane kakhulu. Izinto eziningi eziphukile zikhishwa ebhakedeni 'lokulahleka'. Ukonakala okuphezulu kakhulu, i-cylinder esheshayo, i-'concave' eqinile, umoya ophumayo uhamba kancane, ama-augers avulekile kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okuphukile kufihlwe. I-cylinder esheshayo, ukuvuleka okuncane kwe-'concave'. Okukhishiwe kufihlwe kodwa ngaphandle kusempilweni. Ukuvuleka kwe-'concave' kuncane kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okuphukile kanye nezinsalela ezikhululekile. Isivinini se-cylinder/rotary siphakeme kakhulu noma kukhona okuncane okusele. Okukhishiwe okungekho ngokuphelele okonakaliswe kuhlala emhlabeni. Amabhodi nekhanda akahambisani kahle. Okukhishiwe kuphuma ngemuva kwe-combine. Isivinini/ukuphuma komoya, hamba kancane emshinini futhi isivinini sokuphuma komoya. Ukulahleka komkhiqizo kungaba ngu-3% - 5% kodwa kungakhula kube ngu-10% - 15% ngezikhathi ezithile. Imishini yokuvuna kufanele ihlolwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isebenza kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuyihlola ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi mangaki alahlekile.

Amakhemikhali afanele nezibulala-zinambuzane angathengwa - xhumana nomphathi walezi zimpahla ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ezindaweni eziningi, imvula yafika nango-Agasti, okuzophinde kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo ngemishini emapulazini noma basebenzise amakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, uma ubungasebenzisa imishini kuphela ukuze ube neziqholo (ukulima) izihlahla eziphilayo, kungcono ukucabanga ngokuthenga imishini yokuphonsa (spray rig). Imishini ehlukene ingatholakala emakethe - kunezimoto ezixhunywe kulawa ma-hitch amathathu anama-tank aphakathi kuka-600 liters kuya ku-1,000 liters anama-booms (izandla) aphakathi kuka-12 m kuya ku-16 m. Imishini enama-tank angabamba u-1,000 liters kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela kumatraktha angakwazi ukuthwala u-1.5 tons noma ngaphezulu. Imishini eyakhiwe lapha ezweni lethu ayibizi kakhulu, futhi izingxenye ezithuthukile zitholakala kalula ngesikhathi sokutshala. Uma uthenga imishini ngaphandle, qiniseka ukuthi umthengisi angakuqinisekisa ukuthi uzokwazi ukuthola amapompo amasha, amafremu, nezibulala-zinambuzane noma nini lapho udinga khona. Indlela eyodwa yokuphonsa amakhemikhali idinga izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanele le ndlela - umkhuba wokuphonsa kanye nokuvula kwezibulala-zinambuzane. Ukulungiswa kwengcindezi kwelinye ibhande kubalulekile ngoba kufanele kukhiqize i-cone ethile ehambelana nohlobo lwezihlahla eziphilayo kanye nohlobo lwamakhemikhali. Uma ungathenga imishini ethwalayo, izokunikeza izinzuzo ezihlukene uma uziqhathanisa nemishini exhunywe kumahitch amathathu.

IBhodi ngokunjalo kumele livumele umfaki sicelo ukuthi ahlolisise, ngaphandle kokhokha, emahhovisi alo, nokwenza izishicilelo ekukhokheni imali ebekiwe, izimiso ezihlaba noma eziphakamisa isicelo sakhe. Isikhathi nokuvuselela ilayisense yokusebenza a Amalayisense okusebenza ezimoto ukuthi zisebenze ngezithuthi ngokwezimo zezivumelwano kumele akhishelwe isikhathi esingadlulile kwesesivumelwano futhi ahambisane nezimo nemigomo yesivumelwano. Ekunqanyulweni kwesivumelwano, ilayisense yokusebenza ehambisana naso kumele ibuyiselwe kwi Bhodi zingakedluli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Lapho isivumelwano sesiphelile naleso esizosimela singakaphethwa noma ukulungiselela ukusivuselela kungakapheli ukuze umphathi akwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ngesikhathi, iBhodi lingakwazi, ekucelweni yisiphathimandla sesivumelwano, ukuqhubezela isikhathi sokusebenza saleyo layisense isikhathi esingangokuba sicelwe yisiphathimandla. d okungenzeka ukuthi ilayisense yokusebenza efakelwe isicelo, singaphela isidingo sayo ngokwesimo sezinhlelo zezokuthutha ezifanele;futhi e okungenzeka ukuthi ezokuthutha ezifakelwe isicelo, zinganikwa ithenda. Ukuvuselelwa kwelayisense yokusebenza yezithuthi ezingenaso isivumelwano angeke sikhishwe ngaphandle kokuthi isiphathimandla sezokuthutha esifanele siveza ukuthi singakhishwa, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 39 5.

Mayelana ne-Mining Qualifications Authority (MQA), iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu (CEO). Umphathi wezokuxhumana anganikeza amandla noma imisebenzi enikezwe kuMphathi Wemininingwane ngaphansi kwalesi sikhungo kumphathi wezokuxhumana ophakeme. I-CEO kumele iqashe umuntu ukuze abe nguMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-MQA iyatholakala kulabo abafuna ukufaka isicelo sokuthola ulwazi olukhona kulabo abafuna amarekhodi. Umphathi Wemininingwane ungumuntu ongakwazi ukuhlela nokubhekelela uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme we-MQA. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi aqukethe ulwazi ngabo, imibono, nemibono yomunye umuntu mayelana nesipho, ithokheni, noma umklomelo onikezwe kulowo muntu lapho imibono noma imibono yomunye umuntu ivela; kanye negama lalowo muntu lapho livela kanye nolwazi lwabo noma luhambisana nalowo muntu noma lapho ukuveza kwegama kuzokhombisa ulwazi ngomuntu osefile isikhathi eside kuneminyaka engama-20. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi ku-MQA. Noma ubani (kubandakanya noma ongagciniwe), uhulumeni wangaphandle, inhlangano yomhlaba wonke engaphezu komfaki-sicelo, futhi futhi ngenhloso yesigaba 34 salolu shintsho, uma kukhulunywa ngencazelo ethi "umuntu" ezigabeni (a) no (b) kufanele ihunyushwe njengokukhuluma ng "umuntu ophilayo." IKomidi Lokukhuthaza Amalungelo Abantu elikhulunywa esigabeni 181 (b) seMthethosisekelo.

Umphakathi ungumuntu owawulwa empini yeMpi Yezwe Yokuqala noma yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili noma owawulwa empini yaseKorea. Labo abathola usizo lwezenhlalakahle, abangakwazi ukuzinakekela futhi badinga ukunakekelwa ngaso sonke isikhathi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olungaphezu kwalolo lwezenhlalakahle. Imali yokusiza abadala abavela ku-2008 kuyi-R960 ngenyanga. Kufanele uhlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola isimo sezimali. Ukuhlola isimo sezimali kwabantu abahlala ekhaya kuwukuthi uhulumeni uhla izimo zezimali zalowo mndeni. Ukuze uthole usizo, imali yakho kufanele ibe phansi kwenani elithile. Ngo-2008, ukuhlola kwezimali kokusiza abadala abavela kumuntu ongashadile kwakhomba ukuthi uma impahla yakho ibalwe ngaphezulu kwe-R451,200, awuzotholi usizo. Umndeni ophila kuwo awubalwa uma kuhlolwa, futhi imali yakho kufanele ibe phansi kwe-R26,928 ngonyaka uma ungashadile. Uma ushade, awuzotholi usizo uma impahla yenu ihlanganiswe ibalwe ngaphezulu kwe-R902,400. Umndeni ophila kuwo awubalwa uma kuhlolwa. Imali yenu ehambisanayo kufanele ibe phansi kwe-R53,856 ngonyaka. Awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abahlala ezindlini zikahulumeni futhi awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abathola usizo lwezimali ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Icheki yenani elithile ngosuku oluthile efakwe ku-akhawunti yomuntu siqu ingatholakala ngeposi ezindaweni ezithile, njengasezindaweni lapho abantu abadala behlala khona. Uma ungasebenzi kahle noma ugula kakhulu futhi ungakwazi ukuhamba ehhovisi, cela omunye umuntu ukuba acela ukuthi ihhovisi likuvakashele.

UVictor ungejiwe futhi noNorah, banezingane ezintathu: umfana oyedwa namantombazane amabili. UAyanda (24) uqede grade 12 kuMtshezi High School wathola futhi iN3 sithefikethi ngeCivil Engineering kuBerea Technical College eThekwini. UAyanda naye usebenza noyise epulazini. Amantombazane, uThakasile (20) ngokwamanje uku-grade 11 kuAbantungwa High School noBongeka (12) uku-grade 6 kuMathamo Primary School. UVictor unabogandaganda ababili: iMassey Ferguson 440 4 x 4 neMassey Ferguson 5465, futhi unemoto, iColt 2.8. Uzoqhubekela phambili ngokulima ngoba wakhulela emapulazini. Unesibonakalo sokuzayo futhi unesibindi sokubhekana nezinkinga ezingavelela umuntu ofuna ukuba umkhiqizi wokudla. Uyithola kanjani imali yokutshala izitshalo zakhe? UVictor akaboleki imali kumunye umuntu noma kwenye indawo, usebenzisa imali yakhe. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngokwamanje ngoba kakhulukazi usebenzisa amasimu omuzi wonke futhi uqasha amahektheli angu-15 kumunye umlimi wezomnotho. Uzitholaphi izinto zokuqala ukutshala? Uthenga zonke izinto ezidingekayo ukutshala kuTWK eWinterton futhi uthenga amakhemikheli kuFarmers Agri-Care eWinterton. Izimbewu uVictor uzithenga kuPannar noma kuMonsanto futhi bayamjabulisa ngendlela bamphatha ngayo. UGavumente banomsebenzi onjani ekulimeni futhi bawenza kanjani lowo msebenzi? UVictor ubona ukuthi uMnyango Wezokulima endaweni lapho elima khona bayawenza umsebenzi wabo futhi bayamsekela ngezindlela eziningi. UMnyango Wezokulima waleyo ndawo usize abalimi ukutshalela iSAB ummbila obomvu. Ukuphumelela kwakhe ekulimeni kusuka ekwakheni kwasu alungileyo nangokusebenza ngokukhuthala. Kuyini okungaba usongelo oluzovimba ukuthuthuka nokuphumelela kwakhe?

Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfashini ibonisa izinkinga ezithinta imvelo. Ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla eziningi kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekonakaleni kwemvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo. Ukukhuthaza imfashini esebenzisa izinto eziphinde zisetshenziswe, kanye nezindlela zokukhiqiza ezihlakaniphile, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela imvelo. Isiphetho: Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, imfashini izoqhubeka nokuguquka, ihambisana nezimo zomhlaba. Abantu bazoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izitayela ezizayo, njengoba bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobungane nemvelo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabathandi bemfashini, abakhiqizi, kanye nezinkampani kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ngakho-ke, imfashini akuyona nje indlela yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokuphila, yokuziveza, nokwakha umphakathi. Njengoba sithokozisa izitayela ezihlukahlukene, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imfashini ingaba yinsika yokuhlanganyela, yokuhlonipha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, sikhulise imfashini yethu, futhi sithuthukise umhlaba esiphila kuwo.

iDAC izibophezele ekwakheni amandla okuzenzela nokuhlinzeka ngenqalasizinda yobuchwepheshe bolwazi. Izilimi zendabuko ziyosekwa ngamaqhinga amasha entuthuko ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana nezinsiza. Inqubo Yokuziphatha ngoLimi kubaSebenzi boMphakathi iyochaza indlela yokukhuluma nokuxhumana nomphakathi ngenhloso yokwenza umsebenzi kahulumeni impumelelo. Inqubo yokuziphatha iyohlonipha inkambiso yomgomo weBatho Pele kuzo zonke izimo lapho iMisebenzi yoMphakathi inesibophezelo sokunika amakhasimende ulwazi oluphelele, oluqondile ngolimi abaluqonda kahle. Inqubo igcizelela ukuthi alikho ikhasimende noma isisebenzi somphakathi esiyocindezelwa noma sephucwe igunya ngenxa yokusebenzisa izilimi ezithile. IDAC ihlangene neDPSA seyibonisene neminye iminyango kahulumeni iyothuthukisa, isabalalise inqubo ngendlela ehlinzekelwe ngayo nguMthetho weziLimi waseNingizimu Afrika. Ungqongqoshe uyoshicilela imigomo eqondene nenqubo kwiGazethe ungakapheli unyaka ka 2005. Ngaphezulu kombiko oshicilelwe kwiGazethe, kuyosatshalaliswa omunye umbiko obhalwe ngolimi oluqondakala kalula ukuze kuqinisekwe ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi bayazi ngale nqubo. Kuyosungulwa usomqulu oqukethe imisebenzi yolimi (isibonelo, ingodla enamagama ezikhungo/izinkampani/amathimba olimi, imisebenzi yokuguqulela kolunye ulimi imibhalo, ukulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni nehlelo lamagama olimi, ukuhlela ulimi). Imibhalo efanayo yomqulu oqukethe imisebenzi yolimi iyosatshalaliswa nezinhlaka zikazwelonke nohulumeni bezifundazwe nasezinhlanganweni zolimi kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme.

Bonke amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwe-CEO, bakhethwa ngasikhathi sinye. a Ilungu leBhodi njengomholi. b Elinye ilungu njengomphakathi ophakeme ukuze abambe indawo yomholi weBhodi uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza leyo msebenzi. b Ilungu leziphathimandla, iziphathimandla zesifunda, ikhansela likamasipala, noma umholi wesiko osunguliwe ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke. c Umuntu okhishwe. d Umuntu onokukhubazeka kwengqondo noma onedokhumenti esemthethweni ekhombisa ukuthi umuntu unengqondo engalungile noma unokukhubazeka. f Umuntu okhishwe emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi. g Umuntu okhishwe eBhodi ngenxa yokwephula imithetho yayo. Ilungu leBhodi kumele likhishwe esikhundleni uma lelo lungu lenze noma iyiphi yalezi ezishiwo esigabeni sokuqala. a Ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi, ukungabi nolwazi, nokungafaneleki. b Ngenxa yokungawulandeli isigaba 8 2 noma 151. c Uma ilungu ingakwazi ukuya emihlanganweni yeBhodi ngokulandelanayo ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele, d Noma ngenye imbangela efanele. Ibhodi ingakhipha ilungu ngemva kokumnika ithuba lokuchaza iziphazamiso zayo. Isikhathi lapho amalungu eBhodi kufanele asebenze. a Kungaba iminyaka emithathu, b Kungase kube ngaphansi kwemithetho ebekwe yi-MEC kanye naleyo ebhalwe emqulwini wokukhetha ilungu. Uma ilungu ikhipha noma iyashiya esikhundleni, i-MEC ingakhetha omunye umuntu endaweni yalelo lungu kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi noma

Futhi bafinyelele emakhaya ngokuphepha. Lencwajana ingumhlahlandlela wokukusiza ukuba uzigcine usesimweni esihle sempilo ngenkathi usemgwaqeni. Bazimisele ukuphendula noma imuphi umbuzo ongase ube nawo malungana nempilo yakho. Uma uqashe abashayeli bamaloli, unesibopho kubona. Ugcina umgomo wezempilo wabo bonke abaqashwa? Ubanika ulwazi lwezempilo kanye namakhondomu? Uvumela abashayeli ukuthi bahambe nabazokubachithisa isizungu uma bezohamba amabanga amade na? Uyabahlinzeka nje abashayei bakho ngamagilavu enjoloba ukuze bawagqoke lapho besiza olimele na? Ake uthabathe umzuzwana uphendule lemibuzo elandelayo. Kungabe nginezinsumpa kumbe izilonda esithweni sami sangasese? Umlingani wami ke yena? Kungabe kukhona uketshezi oluphumayo, oluconsayo kumbe umchamo oshisayo? Umlingani wami yena kungabe unalo uketshezi oluphuma kuyena? Uma uthi yebo, wenzenjani? Uma uthi yebo, wena nomlingani wakho (noma abalingani) kufanele nithole izeluleko zezempilo esibhedlela, emtholampilo kumbe kumahamba nendlawana wezempilo. Ngoba kulula ukwelapha izifo zocansi/ amaSTD. Ngoba uma unesifo socansi amathuba okuba uthole futhi udlulise igciwane le HIV makhulu kakhulu. Uyazi yini ngezikhungo zezeMpilo nokwazisa eziseca komgwaqo? Abashayeli bamaloli bemukelekile! Ngingaya kuphi no uma ngigula ngisendleleni? Kumgudu ohamba ngawo ungaya kunoma isiphi isibhedlela sikahulumeni, umtholampilo, kumbe udokotela. Kodwa kulukhuni ukuchezuka endleleni yakho eqondile. Kulukhuni futhi ukumisa iloli lakho emini uma uzokulishiya isikhathi eside.

IBhodi Yabaphathi ye-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngentuthuko eyenziwe yiMihlangano nokuthi izinkinga ezavela ngo-2009 zaphathwa kanjani nokuthi izindaba ezisemqoka zamalungu ngaphansi kwe-GEMS zivikela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngamathuba alinganayo ukuze babe nezinzuzo zempilo ezibizayo. Uhlelo lokuphathwa kweMihlangano oluqinile ludinge ukusungulwa kohlelo lwecebo lesikhashana nelide oluhola futhi lukhombise ibhizinisi leMihlangano. Impumelelo ye-GEMS ikalwa ngamandla ezakhiwo zayo zokuphatha nokuphatha, kanye nezinqubo zayo zokuhlela amacebo - lezi zinto ziqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS inerekhodi yokuphumelelisa kahle amacebo ayo e-strategic wonyaka futhi ifinyelela izinhloso eziqukethwe kuyo. IBhodi yenza ukuhlela amacebo ka-2009 ngokuqonda ukuthi iMihlangano isibe inhlangano esezingeni eliphezulu esakhe indawo yokusebenza ephelele nezinhlelo zokuphatha zezimali eziqondile. Ukuhlela kwenziwa ngenhloso yokubeka i-GEMS njengemihlangano yokunakekelwa kwezempilo ehamba phambili, esebenzayo, futhi ephumelelayo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. IBhodi ibuyekeze ukwakheka kweKomidi okwakusungulwa yiBhodi ngo-2009 ngenhloso yokusebenzisa kahle amakhono nolwazi lwabaphathi kanye namalungu eKomidi ezimele. Ukuhlola kweBhodi kubuye kubheke ukufaneleka kwezimo zokubhekisela kumaKomidi futhi izinguquko ezincane zadingeka. Abaphathi basebenza kumaKomidi ngo-2009 njengoba kubikwe ezicini 7 no-8 zeMibiko yeBhodi. IBhodi yamukela ekuhlolweni kokusebenza kweBhodi yonyaka ukuthi amaKomidi asebenza kahle nokuthi ukubika kwiBhodi kuhle kakhulu.

UMshwana 4 woMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela isigaba 8 (b) soMthetho ukuze kubhekeleke ukuthi kungabi khona sidingo sokwenziwa kocwaningo lwendawo esigabeni sokuhlela esisezingeni lokuqala uma isiphathimandla sezendawo esikwazi ukwenza kahle umsebenzi sikuthatha njengokungenasidingo. Nezinye-ke izichibiyelo ezincane ezenziwe yileso sichibiyelo zenziwe kuleso sigaba. UMshwana 5 woMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela isigaba 10 soMthetho ukuze kulungiswe ukuqhathaniseka nesigaba 6 esisha. UMshwana 7 woMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela isigaba 51 soMthetho ukuze kulungiswe iphutha elenzeke kubhalwa. UMshwana 8 woMthethosivivinywa ufaka isigaba esisha u-51A eMthethweni ukuze kubhekeleke izivumelwano ezingahle ziphothulwe zokwakha, zoxhaso lwezimali, zokusebenza, zokuphatha, zokulawula nokubhekwa sakulalwula komgwaqo kanye nezinhlelo zikaloliwe, njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngenhla, ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe obhekele izindaba zezimali. UMshwana 9 woMthethosivivinywa unikeza isihloko esifushane.

Ukwethulwa koMbiko woNyaka ePhalamende, uma usuvunywe yi-NCACC. Odlala esiswini eqenjini le-AC Milan, uRonaldinho akekho esimweni esihle sokuthi angadlala eqenjini lakhe naseqenjini lesizwe muva nje. Kanjalo no-Brigadier Schoon osazofika. Oyisela elibanjiwe angagwetshwa intambo ngoba ukweba izinto zabantu kanjalo nokuvimbezela abantu endlini kunesigwebo sentambo emthethweni wase-US. Amaphoyisa aseWarrenton ahambisa ingane nomsolwa babasa eGaleshewe lapho aboshwa khona nengane yahlanganiswa nomama wayo. Kunesidingo sempendulo enhle ekubeni abalungele kwemboni ezimele ukuze isize ekunqobeni ukunganeli kwezisebenzi, okuphazamisa ukulethwa kwezidingo kubantu. Kodwa ngikholwa wukuthi indawo ebalulekile okumele kuqalwe kuyo yisu elithathwe amaLungu ahloniphekile njengoRenier Schoeman kanye no-Annelize van Wyk ukubala abambalwa. Uhlelo olusolwayo wezikhali zenunzi luyaqhubeka nokwenyuka kokungqubuzana kanye namathuba okuqubuka kwenye impi. Eminye imidlalo ayehlelwe phakathi kwabadlali ababili. Ama-Broms akhula emahlathini anamaqabunga athambile anameva noma amaskeyli. Isehlakalo sabikwa ukuthi senzeka emijondolo yaseHolomisa. UDkt Mijburgh, uyakhunjuzwa ukuthi usengaphansi kwesifungo. Sihlose ukuqeda le ndaba siphinde siqinisekise ukuthi ukungazi ukuthi kwenzekani okulokhu kulandela iClairwood kuphele okokugcina.. Bengilindele ukuba abe nokudabuka okuncane, abe nokweseka uma kuza kumlamu wami. IZeekoevlei kanye nejukskei eKhayelitsha nazo ziyothola usizo lwezezimali kwiDolobha.

Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokuzindla, sokubhala, noma sokulalela umculo. Abanye abantu bathola ukuthi uhambo lwabo luwumsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, lapho bejabulela umculo opholile noma izincwadi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi uhambo lwansuku zonke akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyithuba lokukhula nokuzithokozisa. Uhambo lwansuku zonke luhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Abantu abahamba ngebhasi bahlala behlangana, bexoxa ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi bejabulela ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu bebonana, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhambo lwansuku zonke lungaba yithuba lokufunda. Abantu bangafunda izifundo ezahlukene, baphinde bahlale beqaphela izimo ezithile. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokufunda izincwadi, ukufunda izindaba, noma ukufunda ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezitholakala emgwaqweni. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi kudala umqondo wokuthi impilo ayipheli, kodwa iqhubeka njalo. Noma kunjalo, uhambo lwansuku zonke akukhona kuphela ukuhamba. Kukhona nezikhathi zokuphumula, lapho abantu behlala bezilungiselela izinsuku zabo. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi sokuphuza ikhofi, sokudla isidlo sasekuseni, noma sokuxoxa nabangani. Lezi zikhathi zibalulekile, ngoba zenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yethu. Luhlanganisa izimo eziningi, izinselelo, nezikhathi zokujabula.

Umqashi uzokwazisa ngemiphumela bese enza okuthile okufanele kuye ngemiphumela. Kungaba ngumqashi wakho noma wena oqalisa umhlalaphansi wokungabi nempilo enhle uma kunokusola ukuthi usuhluleka ukusebenza safuthi. Loku ngokwesibonelo kungenzeka mhlawumbe emuva kwengozi yemoto embi. Uma ufake isicelo selivu yokungabi nezinsuku ezanele ende bese ukuphenya komqashi kubonisa awusoze wakwazi ukusebenza safuthi, bangaphakamisa isicelo sakho selivu yokungabi nezinsuku ezanele ukuthi sibe isicelo somhlalaphansi wokungabi nempilo enhle. Umphathi wephrojekthi - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, kwi-NPO njengomphathi noma uhlelo olwakhiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso. Izindleko ezikhokhwe yile muntu ozithandela ngokuvamile zikhokhelwa yi-NPO, futhi kungenzeka ukuthola izipho ezincane zokubonga. Kanti-ke ezweni elinezilimi eziningi njengeNingizimu Afrika nje, izindawo esikhathini esiningi ziye zibe namagama angaphezu kwelilodwa. Lezi zimo ziholela ekungaqondini kahle kanye nasekudidekeni. Ukuze kuvikwe lokho, emhlabeni wonke amagama emimo ayavanyiswa ngabaphathi. Kubalulekile ukuvanyisa amagama ngenjongo yokuqinisekisa umlando wezwe kanye nokuzazi ngobuzwe kanye nangezohwebo nokuhwebelana, ezokuthutha, ezokuxhumana, ukuhlelela izifunda nezemvelo, imisebenzi yomphakathi, isayensi nobuchwepheshe, ukhetho kanye nokubalwa kwabantu, ezokuvakasha, ukulawulwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nemisebenzi yokuhlonza nokutakula. I-SAGNC ithatha isinqumo sokugcina mayelana nendlela noma nezindlela zamagama bese uwancoma kuNgqongqoshe. Uma igama selivunyiwe nguNgqongqoshe, lelo gama liye libe selivanyisiwe. Ngaphezu kwamazwi, zikhumbuza ukuthi ukugcina imikhuba emihle kuyadingeka. Imizamo yokwakha ibhodi lokuphila ingaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngokubuyiselwa kwempahla nempilo ngemva kweziteleka? Ngemva kweziteleka, kungabakhona ukubuyiselwa kwezimali nempilo, kodwa lokhu kuxhomekeka ezivumelwaneni ezithathiwe ngesikhathi soberhelekileyo. Kwezinye izimo, izinkampani zingase zigxile ekubuyiseleni izimali ezichithwa ngaphambi kweziteleka, zigcine synto efanayo. Ukubuyiselwa kwempilo kuzodinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni ungaphatha ngezindlela ezinhle. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyavuma okuhlangenwe nakho emhlabeni? Yebo, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziye zathandwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho bahlala bephikisana nezinqubo zezimali, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlinzeko ngezintela zokusebenza. Izibonelo zikhona emakethe enkulu, nasemazweni ahlukeneyo, lapho izimpendulo ezihlukahlukene ziphuma khona. Umbuzo 10: Ingabe umphakathi unendima ekuxhaseni iziteleka? Umphakathi ungaba nendima ebalulekile ekuxhaseni iziteleka. Ukuze kusebenze kahle, ukuphakanyiswa kwezabelo zokuxhaswa kungakhale ukuphumeza izifiso zabathintekayo. Izinkampani kumele zibe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo nezindawo zokusebenzisana, ezokuxhasa iziteleka. Ngakho-ke, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wethu.

Lokhu kubonakala ekwandeni kwemali edlalwa emicimbini ye-gospel, lapho abaculi behluleka ukugcina ubumsulwa bomculo wabo. Lokhu kungase kube yinkinga, njengoba umculo we-gospel ungase ube yinsiza yokukhuthaza, kodwa uma uphenduka umkhiqizo, ungase uphumelele kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kube sekuphazamiseka umqondo wawo wokuqala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wokuhlanganyela emphakathini. Abaculi abaningi be-gospel baphumelela ekwakheni imiphakathi ethokozisayo, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngothando, bahlabelela, futhi baphile impilo enothando. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, futhi ungakhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Nokho, uma umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuphenduka umkhiqizo, kungase kube nzima ukugcina le miphakathi ibumbene. Kodwa-ke, kumele siqaphele ukuthi umculo we-gospel awuwona umculo owodwa, kodwa uhlanganisa izitayela eziningi ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo we-gospel ungavuma ukufaka izitayela ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-hip-hop, i-R&B, kanye ne-blues. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umculo we-gospel ungaba yindawo yokuhlanganyela kwezinkolo ezahlukene, futhi ungakhuthaza abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Nokho, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukwamukela izitayela ezihlukahlukene kungaphazamisa umqondo wokuqala we-gospel, okungase kube yinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungaba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinkolelo zenkolo. Abaculi be-gospel bahlala bephakamisa izinkolelo zabo, bencenga abalandeli babo ukuthi baphile impilo enokholo.

Ukuvuselelwa kwelayisense yokusebenza yezithuthi ezingenaso isivumelwano angeke sikhishwe ngaphandle kokuthi isiphathimandla sezokuthutha esifanele siveza ukuthi singakhishwa, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 39 5. Wonke amalayisense okusebenza akhishwe yi Bhodi kumele asayinwe ngusihlalo walo noma umuntu obekwe ngusihlalo ngokubhala phansi. IBhodi kumele ligcine endaweni yalo yebhizinisi wonke amalayisense okusebenza ewakhilphile noshintsho olwenziwe kuwo, futhi kumele ifake imininingwane ebekiwe yalapho neyomnikazi welayisense yokusebenza nezimoto ezifanele kwimininingwane ebekiwe efakwe kwi khomputha.

Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwamavoti nentando yeningi Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubaluleke kakhulu emphakathini wanamuhla. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nemigomo yokuphatha izwe, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho ubudlelwano phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nabantu bubalulekile ekwakheni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. I-ntando yeningi ifakazela ukuthi abantu banelungelo lokukhetha, lokho okwenza ukuthi kube khona izinqumo ezithinta izwe ezingezona ezomuntu oyedwa, kodwa ezibandakanya wonke umuntu. Ukwazi Ngentando Yeningi Intando yeningi ingachazwa njengendlela yokuphatha lapho izinqumo zenzelwa abantu, ngenhloso yokuhlonipha izidingo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bonke abantu, abavoti, banelungelo lokubamba iqhaza ekukhetheni abaholi babo, bephendula izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kuhilela ukhetho, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazibandakanye, baqonde ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abantu ukuthi baqonde ukuthi ubuholi buyingxenye yezenzo zabo eziphilayo, futhi ukudlulisa imiyalezo ebavotayo kulukhuni. Indima Yokuvota Ukuvota kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokubamba iqhaza. Lapho umuntu evota, ubeka phambili imbono yakhe, ukhetha uhulumeni noma abaholi abacabanga ukuthi bazomemezela izinqumo ezinobuhlakani. Ukuvota akuyona nje indlela yokuphendula, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokukhombisa izifiso zomphakathi. Ngokubamba iqhaza kokuvota, abantu bakha umbono omkhulu, begcina ubumbano phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Izingozi Zokunganaki Uma abantu bengavoti, bazibeka engozini. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi abangafanele baphumelele, okungaholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zingagcini kahle.

Noma yisiphi isinyathelo esibopha u-SAPS, kufanele sithathwe ngokwesigaba esifanele nesisemthethweni somThetho wamaPhoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, ka 1995 (umThetho onguNombolo 68 ka 1995), noma owelama wona emthethweni. Ukuthi, okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO uchazelwe kona OWENKONTILEKA. Ukuthi, SIVUMELWANO uyavuma ukuthi uyakuqonda konke okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO. U-SAPS wenza isivumelwano NOWENKONTILEKA ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuke sivumelwano, kanti noWENKONTILEKA uyavuma ukunikeza usizo lwakhe ngqo kuSAPS ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuleSIVUMELWANO, e (emveni kwalokhu ebizwa ngokuthi EMSEBENZINI): Inqobo nje uma OWENKONTILEKA engatshelwa ngu SAPS ukuthi makaye kosebenzela u-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma isiphi isigceme esiyisakhiwo sikaSAPS esingekho EMSEBENZINI, kube okwesikhashana. OWENKONTILEKA, ngenxa yale SIVUMELWANO , akufanele noma abe eseba nethemba lokulindela ukuthi sizovuselelwa le SIVUMELWANO, noma nje aqashwa kunoma yisiphi isikhundla njengomqashwa kwa-SAPS. Kuyavunyelwana phakathi kwamaQEMBU, ukuthi OWENKONTILEKA isivumelwano asenziwe naye njengomqashwa ngokwale SIVUMELWANO futhi le SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kunobuhlobo bokuqashana obukhona phakathi koweNKONTILEKA no SAPS.

Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesithokozisayo kubo bobabili abasebenzi namakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza luyisikhombandlela sokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakubona phambi kwakho." Omunye wemigomo ehleliwe yeBhange leMali ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ekuphatheni izinga lempilo kubo bonke. Wena, njengommeleli webhange, unethuba elikhulu lokuba yingxenye yokushintsha ikusasa labantu! Ungowokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela amandla abo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-akhawunti abangawasebenzisa ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo. Asigxili kuphela ekuthuthukiseni abantu ngaphandle kwebhange kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Lolu hlelo luzosiza futhi ukuba ube ngumuntu onakekela abanye futhi unakekele usizo oluhlinzekwayo. Siyacela bonke abasebenzi beBhange leMali ukuthi babambe iqhaza noma basebenze ngokulandela amaphuzu alandelayo: Masikhuthazane futhi sikhuthazane nsuku zonke, hhayi kuphela ukwenza kahle ngezakhono zethu kodwa futhi ukusabalalisa injabulo ekuphatheni imisebenzi yethu nasekuphileni kwethu! Bhalisela amakhasimende ngokushesha ngokubabheka emehlweni. Uma ungakwazi ukusiza ikhasimende ngokushesha, wazise ukuthi uzobasiza masinyane. Bhalisela wonke amakhasimende endaweni yokulinda, noma uzobasiza noma cha, bese ubuza ukuthi baphumelele yini ukusizwa nokuthi ungabasiza kanjani. Uma usukulungele ukusiza ikhasimende, khumbula, bhalisela, uthi "sawubona," uxolise ngokulinda, futhi uzethule ngegama, isibonelo, "Sawubona, ngiyaxolisa ngokukugcina ulindile. Ngiyena Jane (noma uNkk. Smith), ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?"

Byline: UF.B. Peairs, waseColorado State University Extension, ungumcwaningi ogxile ekuphathweni kwezinsongo futhi unguprofesa wezifundo zokulima nezokuphathwa kwezinsongo. Dala ibhokisi leziqiniso: Iziqiniseko ezisheshayo... I-Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) iyibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ekhiqiza i-toxin ebulala izinsongo. Izinhlobo zemvelo ezitholakala ku-Bt zingafakwa ezitshalweni zokudla, zinika amandla okukhulisa i-toxin ebulala ezinye izinsongo, ngakho azilimali yilezo zinsongo. Ama-hybrids e-corn aqukethe lezi zinhlobo ze-Bt awalimali izinsongo ezivame ukuba yingozi enkulu. I-Bt corn isebenza kahle ekunciphiseni izinsongo futhi iyindlela eshibhile yokuphikisa ama-pesticides emichiza. Le teknoloji entsha ivula indlela yokuthuthukisa izinhlobo ezintsha zezitshalo ngokufaka izinhlobo zemvelo kwezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo. Lokhu kuhle ngoba singashintsha ezinye izici zezithombo ukuze zikwazi ukuphikisa ezinye izinsongo - lokhu kulula ngoba akufani nokukhetha izitshalo ezinamandla ngendlela ejwayelekile. Enye indlela ephumelelayo yale teknoloji entsha ukuthi ama-hybrids e-corn angaphikisa izinsongo ezithile - efaka izinhlobo zemvelo ezivela kubhaktheriya zomhlabathi. Lezi hybrids zibizwa ngokuthi "transgenic," kodwa hhayi zonke zingaphikisa izinsongo. I-Bt imele ibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ebizwa nge-Bacillus thuringiensis. I-Bt iphinde ibhekisele kumkhiqizo we-pesticide owenziwe kulezi bhaktheriya. Yini indima ye-Bt mayelana nezifo zezinsongo?

Isinyathelo sokugcina siza ngemva kokubeletha, lapho umama ehlola ukuthi umntwana wakhe unjani futhi nabantu abamzungezile babe impilo enhle. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umama azigcine ethokozisa ngombono wokusebenza kwalezi zinyathelo. Uma kunezinkinga, kudinga ukuxoxa nezokwelapha abawifune kumgibeli. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zithuthukile kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ofanele oqondiswe ekwenzeni izinqubo zibe ngcono, ukugwema inselelo, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomama nomntwana. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokubeletha, umama kumele ahlale ethola usizo nezinsiza ezigcwele ukuze bandakanyeke. Lokhu kudinga ukuzijwayeza nemikhuba elungile. Ngakho, emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zizodwa, ziletha umuzwa omuhle, futhi zenze kube nokubekezela kwalezi zinyathelo eziyisisekelo ezidalwa njengomfazi ophakeme konogada. Ngalesi sikhathi, umama ushayela imoto ethokozisa ubudlelwane phakathi kokuphila nezinsana zakhe, nokwenza kube lula ngemfanelo engcono. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene ezikhetha kanjani, kepha iziguli zidinga ukunika umthetho kweminye imikhuba. Ngaleyo ndlela, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela yokubeletha ukuze uthole izinzuzo ezithile ezivela kuyo, ukuhamba phambili ngemifezelo yephakademiki kulezi zinyathelo. Uma umama noMbala behamba phambili kwezehlakalo, bahlala besaba impumelelo, ukuthuthukisa izinkinga zomphakathi nezingane zizo zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukufezwa kwimithetho ethile, futhi ukwenza ukuthi sithole ulwazi oluqhubekayo ukuze sibe nempilo enhle. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinqubo zakha indima ebalulekile ekuphuculeni impilo yamasiko nezinsizakalo zomama kanye nezinsana.

Iqembu yilona eliyisisekelo sezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. a Ukulandelwa kwenqubomgomo yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ezingeni lamaviyo nakubantu ngabodwana. b Ingqikithi yomsebenzi walo ngukwandisa kwabantu ngezinhlelo kube nesikhathi esiningi sokuphumula, okuholela ekhukhuleni komkhakha wezokuphumula emhlabeni wezomnotho. abezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA)neKhomishani (SASC) zisaqhubeka nokufuna izindlela ezingaheha abaxhasi kwezezimboni abangaxhasa ngezimali abalandeli bezemidlalo. I-sorghum etshaliwe kamuva izoba ready kuphela emva kokufriza kokuqala ebusika. Ngaphambi kokuqala ukuvuna, sebenzisa umshini wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uhlole okuqukethwe komswakama kokwakhiwa uma kuqala ukuvuthwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uzovuna ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma ungenawo umshini wokuhlola umswakama, thola amasampula okwakhiwa kumphathi wesilo oseduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna. Ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kokwakhiwa ngenxa yomswakama ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nezingozi zezinyoni, i-sorghum ingavunwa ngesikhathi sokugcina umswakama esiphakathi kuka-20% kuya ku-25% bese yoma emshinini wokoma kuze kube kufinyelela ku-9.5%. Lokhu kuqukethwe komswakama kufanelekile ukuze kubekwe (kugcinwe) i-sorghum ezindongeni. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, kungcono ukushiya i-sorghum emhlabeni ukuze yomile kahle ngaphambi kokuvuna. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uma okuqukethwe komswakama kuphakeme kuka-10%, kuzodonsa kalula umswakama. Isivinini se-combine kufanele sibe phakathi kuka-5 kuya ku-8 kilometers ngehora. Isivinini esiphakeme phambili sizohambisana nokwakhiwa komswakama kwe-sorghum kanye nosayizi womkhiqizo. Isivinini kufanele sinciphise uma okuqukethwe komswakama kuphansi ukuvimbela okwakhiwa ekonakaleni uma kungena emshinini. Ungasisebenzisa uma okuqukethwe komswakama sishintsha sibe phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okwakhiwa okukhona phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% kuzonakala kulula ukonakala uma kungena kwi-cylinder.

Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nomphakathi, ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinkinga. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umhlangano waphothulwa, kwavela abantu abaningi, bonke befuna ukwazi ukuthi yini engakwenziwa. Umphakathi wawuzizwa ungajabule. UThandi wakhuluma, “Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze silwe namalungelo ethu. Ngabe sikhona isizathu sokuthi umhlaba wethu uthathwe, uma singathola olunye usizo lokwakha?” Umphakathi wahlangana emihlanganweni, kwavela iziphakamiso eziningi ezazihlanganisa ukuhamba emaphoyiseni, ukufaka izikhalazo ezisemthethweni, nokuhlola amalungelo anikezwa umthetho. “Kumele sizame ukuqonda umthetho,” kusho uZungu, “ngoba uma singenzi njalo, sizokwehlulwa.” Ekhulumeni nezinye izifunda, uThandi wabona ukuthi abanye abantu babebhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo. “Ngabe kungenzeka sithole amandla uma sixhumanisa izwi lethu?” wacela. Lokhu kwaba umqondo omuhle, futhi baqala ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu, lapho abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bengena ndawonye, bechaza izinkinga zabo. Kwathi ngesikhathi somcimbi, izwi labantu lathinta izinyawo eziningi. Kukhona abezindaba ababeza, bethumele izindaba zomphakathi, bejabulisa abanye. “UThandi, ubukeka uveza ithemba,” kusho omunye umphakathi. “Kodwa umthetho ungaba yinkinga. Ngabe sikhona umthetho ozoqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba wethu awuthathwa ngaphandle kokuthi sithole induduzo?” Ngemuva kokuhlola kahle izinkinga, uThandi wathola ukuthi, yebo, kunezinhlinzeko zomthetho ezikhona, kodwa zidinga ukusimama. Uthandazile ukuthi umphakathi ungafaka izikhalazo ezisemthethweni, kodwa lokhu kwakungabizi.

Ngemuva kokuhamba noNandi, uThandiwe waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yakhe. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi ezikhuluma ngempilo, wathola izifundo zokupheka eziphilayo, futhi waqala ukuhamba. Waqala ukuxhumana nabanye abahlala nezinkinga ezifanayo, futhi wathola umphakathi ophilayo. Ngesikhathi esithile, uThandiwe waqala ukuzizwa engcono. Waqala ukubona izinguquko emzimbeni wakhe, futhi wathola amandla okwenza izinto ezazimjabulisa. Waqala ukugijima, wathola umoya omusha, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukwelashwa komdlavuza kwakungaphezu kokuphuma esibhedlela. Kwakuwukuhlola impilo, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuthola injabulo ezindaweni ezincane. Waqala ukubhala, wabhala izincwadi ezazichaza indlela abebhekene ngayo nezinkinga, futhi wathola ukuthi abanye abantu babefuna ukwazi. Ngemuva kokuhamba le ndlela, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukwelashwa komdlavuza akupheli, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, futhi waba umholi emphakathini wakhe. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuthaza abanye abahlala nezinkinga ezifanayo, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuphila. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuphila akukhona kuphela ukuphuma esibhedlela, kodwa kuyindlela yokubhekana nezinkinga, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuthola injabulo. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, futhi wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe ibuyile, futhi ibukeka ngcono kunakuqala. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandiwe waba nesifiso sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye. Waqala ukufundisa abantu abasha, wabelana ngempilo yakhe, futhi waba umholi emiphakathini. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono.

Kumele ngiye emsebenzini; uma umuntu engakwazi ukukuphika kokubili, abakwazi ukubona intaba ekhaya," kusho uLabase njengoba evuka. "Vumela idle lokho, mntwana wami; ngiyacela phansi umoya wengane yethu."

Sizibophezeleukuhlinzeka wonke amalunga nemindeni yawo ukuze akwazi ukungena kwizinzuzo ezikhokhelekayo nezigcwelengezinhlobo zezinkethi zezinzuzo ezi 5. Kusukela kwajoyina ilunga lokuqala u-GEMS ngo 2006, sesibhekane nokukhula okungakaze kwaba khona ngaphambili futhi sajika zonke izinto ekubeni isikimu sezokwelapha esihamba phambili, esisebenza ngokuyimpumelelo nesikhokhelekayo sabo bonke abasebenzi Bamasevisi Omphakathi. Noma iliphi iqembu labaqashi elivunywe yiSkimu. U-GEMS uhlinzeka ngezinzuzo ezikhokhekayo kubo bonke abantu! Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuba namandla okujoyina u-GEMS, ngoba inani lemali olikhokhela ukuba ilunga leSkimu lincike emalini oyiholayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uzokhokha imali engaphansi ngenkethi yezinzuzo efanayo kunomuntu ohola ngaphezu kwakho. Ukuthi ukhokha malini kuncike futhi kusayizi womndeni wakho nokuthi iyiphi inkethi kweziyisihlanu oyikhethayo. ISkimu esikhathalele ngokuyiqiniso futhi esigxile kwizidingo zakho siyalalela uma amalunga ethu ekhuluma! Izinzuzo zonakekelo lwezempilo ezihamba phambili kumareythi akhokhekayo. Ubumfihlo obuphelele - ulwazi lwakho lwezokwelashwa lugcinwa luyimfihlo ngokugcwele ngaso sonke isikhathi -ngisho nakumqashi wakho. Ukuxhumana namalunga ngezikhathi ezifanele. Isevisi yamakhasimende enobungani neqeqeshekile Ezikhungweni Zezingcingo na nakumahhovisi ethu ezifunda. Amahhovisi ezifunda ezweni lonke ukuze ube nokuxhumana okulula uma udinga usizo namasevisi. Isinyathelo 2: Gcwalisa ifomu - qinisekisa ukuthi ugcwalisa zonke izigaba ngokuphelele futhi uhlinzeke ngemibhalo esekelayo eceliwe bheka: Imiphi imibhalo odinga ukuyifaka nesicelo sakho?

Kuzochazeka futhi ukuthi awudingi ukujoyina lolu cwaningo. Kufanele ubuze imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi ufuna ukujoyina, noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi nenqubo yokubuza. I-Human Sciences Research Council ifuna ukuxoxa nawe njengengxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngababonisi abaqeqeshiwe [njengami] ababuya kwi-Human Sciences Research Council. Lolu cwaningo lukhona okwamanje ezweni lonke nasemazweni ambalwa. Unemukelekile ukukhuluma nomfakeli [mna], umcwaningi ophambili, noma noma ubani ofuna ukukhuluma naye ngalolu cwaningo uma unquma ukuthi uzobamba iqhaza noma cha. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama omphenduli... Umfakeli [mna] uzokunikeza ulwazi oluthile oluhambisana nalolu cwaningo - olungase luhlanganise nezinye izincazelo, amagama, noma imibono ongase ungayiqondi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, uzizwe ukhululekile ukuveza imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi sizokunikeza ithuba lokuphendula. Uma uvuma ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo, ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqondwe kangcono izinkinga ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo emphakathini wakho nasemhlabeni - ikakhulukazi impilo nokuphila kahle kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka uhulumeni ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphila nezokuxhasa. Lolu cwaningo ngeke lunikeze izinzuzo eziqondile kuwe. Ukujoyina kwakho kulolu cwaningo kuzohlanganisa ukuphendula imibuzo ngawe, kuhlanganise nempilo yakho nokuphila kahle, isimo sakho sokuxhumana, isimo sakho somnotho nomphakathi, kanye nokusebenzisa kwakho izinsiza zempilo.

Onompilo babalulekile kak-hulu, kuzozonke izikhungo zezempilo, ikakhulukazi ku-lezi ezisemaphandleni, ngoba phela izikhungo lezi zisuke zibe kude kakhulu kumphakathi, kanti nezinto zokuhamba azikho kahle. Siyisikhungo esincane kakhulu, esinamathemba aphezulu, namaphupho amahle nomsebenzi omningi futhi omkhulu kabi. Okwamanje abantu bayeza ukuzozihlola igazi kodwa bese sithumela amagazi ayohlolelwa eStanger esib-hedlela bese bewathumela kithi futhi, nemiphumela yawo. Thina ke, seluleka iziguli zethu ngakho konke ekufanele belulekwe ngakho ngalesisifo bese sibadlulisela esibhedlela eStanger ukuze babesohlweni lalabo abazot-hola lemishanguzo. Sesiqale umtholampilo lapho, siqeqesha khona iziguli zethu amasonto ay-isithupha ukuze sibone ukuthi bayokwazi yini ukuh-lala bewadla ngezikhathi zonke ezifanele amaphilisi abonikezwa wona. Nano-kuthi bayokwazi yini ukuphumela obala ngezimo zabo ukuze bathole ukusekelwa imindeni nem-phakathi yabo, baphinde basizakale. Siyajabula ukuthi yize noma izinto zokudlala zisencane kodwa sezikhonyana abant wana abadlala ngazo. Si-nodoli nama bhuku abak-wazi ukudweba kuwo. Ku-yasithokozisa impela lokhu esikubonayo futhi kusigqugquzele ukuthi siqhubeke nezinhlelo ezi-fana nalezi. Sekusele kan-cane ukuba siphumelele. Sinxusa bonke abasebenzi ukuthi basixhase. Siyethemba nabanye abasebenzi bazoheheka basisize ngokusixhasa, sisize labantwana abagulayo. tapo lwazi lwethu. Uma uhlanza umuzi wakho nje, uhlangana nezincwadi ezindala kodwa ezifundekayo uze ungasikhohlwa siyazidinga namabhayibheli alungile. Isandla esiphayo siyobusiswa.

Sihlose ukuba ngumholi ovelele ekuthuthukisweni nasekutshalweni kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphokophelele izimboni kumkhakha wezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe bekhompiyutha. Esikuhlosile ukuhlinzeka umkhiqizo oncike kubantu, ongabizi kakhulu, oncike embonini ngokwedlulisela ulwazi nobudlelwano. Iqhinga le-NEMISA ukuqeqesha nokukhiqiza abathwali beziqu abanobungoti obuningi abazoba ngababambiqhaza abavelele kumkhakha wezokusakaza nakowezokuxhumana ngezindlela eziningi ngezinhlelo ezahlukene, izifundo nokusungula. IBhodi labaQondisi liphendula kubantu abangabanikazi bamasheya ngokuthobela imigomo emiswe ngokwe-PFMA. noMqondisi Omkhulu, oyilungu eliphakeme leBhodi okhethwa ngokuhambelana nememorandamu neMibhalo yeNhlangano ye- NEMISA. IBhodi labaQondisi yilona elilawula izindaba ze-NEMISA neliqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwezinqubomgomo ze-NEMISA. nokuhola, ukuqondisa nokulawula izenzo ze-NEMISA. I-NEMISA igcizelela indlela yokuphatha ngokubambisana nokuziphatha, njengoba kubalulwe kumbiko ka-King ongokuphatha ngokubambisana kanye noMthetho weZokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi. Amakomiti eBhodi akhethwa yiBhodi ngokuthobela umthetho osuke wabalulwa ngaphambilini. IKomiti eliHlola amabhuku lamiselwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i- NEMISA ihlala inendlela enomfutho, ephelele nesobala yezezimali, ingozi kanye nolawulo lwangaphakathi. Okwamanje isanamalungu eBhodi kuphela, kodwa ikomidi inako ukukhetha ukuthi iqoke amanye amalungu.

Abantu abanokukhubazeka banelungelo lokuthola ukwesekwa okungama-R25,580 nangaphezulu ngenxa yezidingo ezengeziwe ezifana nezitini zokwakha ezisemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokungena endlini, izithiyo, nezindawo zokugeza; imihlahlandlela eholela emnyango ngebhodi lokushaya elingaboni. Lokhu kusekela kutholakala kubantu abafuna ukuthenga indlu noma indawo ehlanganisa nokwesekwa kwemakethe okukhona. Lolu hlobo lokwesekwa lutholakala ngokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abahlanganisiwe abavumelekile, abangaba ngabantu noma amaqembu akhiwe ngokomthetho angakha futhi aphathe isakhiwo sokuhlala esihlanganisiwe. Lolu hlobo lokwesekwa luvumela u-R23,100.00 kumuntu ngamunye noma emndenini ophuma ngaphansi kuka-R3,500.00 ngenyanga. Le nhlelo yokubolekwa isebenza ngendlela yokuphula. Le ndlela yokuphula iphethwe ngqo ngumphakathi, futhi uhlelo lokubolekwa lusekela lezo zindlu ezinezinga eliphansi ukuze lusize ekwakheni, ekugcineni, nasekukhuthazeni ukwakhiwa kwabo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala ngaleso sikhathi esithile. Kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezineziphumo ezithengiswa nguhulumeni, unelungelo lokuthola le nsizakalo echazwe. Lezi zindlu zakhiwe ngababambiqhaza abaqashwe nguhulumeni wesifunda noma ohulumeni bendawo kulezi ziqembu ezivumelekile. Esifundazweni saseLimpopo, ukwesekwa okungama-5 okuqhubekayo kuvela kuhlelo lokweseka izindlu zendawo, kuhlukanisa abanikazi bezimali be-Angishana, okuhambisana nemali yokonga yomndeni obolekayo. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abafuna ukwakha izindlu zabo.

Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, (Umthetho -108 ka-1996) unikeza isisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokufunda eNingizimu Afrika. Nokwakha iNingizimu Afrika ebuswa ngentando yeningi nebumbene futhi ezokwazi ukubamba iqhaza layo elifanele njengombuso ozimele phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene zomhlaba. Imfundo nohlelo lwezifundo kubamba iqhaza elinqala ekufinyeleleni kulezi zinhloso. Uhlelo lwezifundo luhlose ukuthuthukisa amandla okukwazi ukwenza yilowo nalowo mfundi abe yisakhamuzi esigcwele seNingizimu Afrika ebuswa ngentando yeningi. Imfundo eyakhelwe phezu kwemiphumela. Imfundo eyakkhelwe phezu kwemiphumela yakha isisekelo sohlelo lwezifundo eNingizimu Afrika . Izama ukuqikelela ukuthi bonke abafundi bakwazi ukuzuza ulwazi ngokusemandleni abo. Loku ikwenza ngokuthi ihlele leyo miphumela okufanele izuzwe umfundi nomfundi ekugcineni kwako konke okwenziwayo. Nokukwazi ukukhombisa ukuqondisisa ukuthi umhlaba wakhiwe yinhlanganisela yezingxenye ezahlukene ngokuthi akwazi ukubona ukuthi ingqikithi yokuxazulula izinkinga ayikwazi ukuzimela yodwana ithi qekelele. Abakwazi ukuthi bazame amaqhinga amaningana okukwazi ukufunda ngempumelelo.

Ake nichaze ngamafuphi izifiso zomlingiswa omkhulu azama ukuzifeza kule ndaba. Sizoyithathaphi imali Umba eqolo phela uJamuludi.? 1.1 Likhule kangakanani izinga lemalimbumbulu ezweni lethu namuhla? Amagama enkehli Kwenzeka njengoba bekushiwo. "Hhawu, leyo-ke yinqabakayitshelwana," usho uyavungula. "Engingakusho nje wukuthi icishe yafika enkulungwaneni yamarandi. Futhi niyazi ukuthini Ilanga selishaya okhakhayini phela manje. Cishe sekuyinsimbi yeshumi nambili uma ngibhekile nje. Yini singathi uma sisuka lapha, sivele sigibele siyobhukuda edamini likaMasipala le edolobheni? Usukhohliwe yini Mapholoba ukuthi intaka izobe ibekelwe amazolo kusasakusho uHadebe ebheke umkakhe uMaNgcobo ngobuso obuhle ethi ukumamatheka? 2.8 Laba bazali bayibhadama yenzani indodakazi yabo okungalindelekile Chaza? 2.2 Ixhegu lafikela kusiphi isikole? Ngamane ngamhleka usulu uSiyephu ngathi: "Kungadingeka ukuba ngibe yisithulu esiyimpumputhe ukuze ngingaboni ukuthi nguye lowaya". Kodwa kwakubuye kungangethusi kangako ngoba isisho sesiZulu siyangifakazela ngokuthi amathanga ahlanzela abangenamabhodwe. Ngake ngazama ukuyikhohlwa kancane indaba yalo mfokazi nanxa yabe ingidla ngaphakathi. Lo mthetho bawazi ingxenye ngoba uNkonka wabafundisa kanjalo. "Thula lesi sigebengu! Hamba! Usichithela isikhathi!" kusho iphoyisa limhlohloloza liphuma naye uXaba. Nakhu-ke manje uZama esethola incwadi evela kuyise imtshela ngoMaKhoza.
