Ngabe uNomagugu usefunde ukuqamba amanga? Langena icala, uNkonka ungummangalelwa wokuqala. Owesibili nguS'paza. Kodwa baba singamshiya kanjani umuntu kanjena, nokwenza eshayiswe yithina? 1.1 Ikuphi okwenziwa uHulumeni kaZwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abadala besizwe bayayihola imali yempesheni? UMsimang ungowaseThalaneni, esifundeni saseNkandla, KwaZulu. Amabanga aphansi emfundo wawafunda khona eThalaneni Primary School nase Mbizwe Secondary School. Ngenxa yesimo sezimali waphoqeka ukuba imfundo yakhe ayiqhube ngokufunda ngeposi e-Trans-Africa Correspondence College lapho enza khona i-Junior Certificate ne-Senior Certificate. Kanjalo nemfundo yeziqu wayifunda ngeposi e-UNISA. Izigilamkhuba Abantu abenza izinto ezingalungile. Bekuzoba nomdlalo omkhulu wendebe edumile ebholeni lezinyawo. Abafana bazilungiselela ukunqoba, bagcina bewunqobile. Baphuma lapho baqonda emzini kaNkonka kwakufinywa ngendololwane. UNkonka wathi lapho evulela izivakashi sezigoduka wazithela kwezakadalawane. Langena icala. UMshushisi wangena nofakazi bakhe abahlanu. Owokuqala owazi indaba yonke nozibonele uKapteni Qeda ongene esedlubhe yonke iyunifomu nezindondo ezikhombisa ukuhlabana. OPitsa noSiphaza bezwakala bethi: Hhawu kanti uPhenduka uyiphoyisa? Lo msebenzi wenze wedwa uwuphendule ngokuwubhala phansi. Kwangimangaza ukuthi yini aphuthume kangaka edolobheni uMlobane. Emehlweni wayesibuka sengathi wumzali ebuka ingane yakhe. Ingane abekade eyithembile. Ingane isimdumazile ngokwenza izenzo ezingalungile. Wasifulathela eseya kwaJamuludi.

Noma yisiphi isimemo sokukhuluma nebhodi noma ikomidi lebhodi; kanye nanoma yimuphi umphakathi wedolobha. Noma yisiphi ukuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo kumele kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesiNtu, umthetho kazwelonke, wesifunda, kanye nomthetho wedolobha, kanye nomthetho nokuqonda. Isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nokuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo emhlanganweni wekhansela noma ikomidi, ngokusekelwe ezicini 35 no-36, sizoba yisinqumo sokugcina. Ukuhumusha nokunquma komphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yile mithetho nemigomo kumele kubhalwe emaminitheni emhlanganweni wekhansela noma ikomidi. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele ugcine uhlu lwezinqumo nemibono yezomthetho. Noma yimuphi umphakathi ungacela umphakathi wedolobha, ngokubhala phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zesenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo mayelana nokuhumusha nesinqumo kanye ne-rapothi ye khansela noma ikomidi. Ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngemva kokubheka i-rapothi ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, kumele iqinisekise, ilungise, noma ishintshe isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yiziphi izimfanelo ezingase zithinte noma yiliphi ithathu ngenxa yesinqumo, futhi zonke izinqumo ezithinta amalungelo abanye kumele zibhalwe, futhi izizathu zalezi zinqumo kumele zibhale. Ibhodi kumele libe nemihlangano yebhodi ejwayelekile okungenani kanye njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu.

Ngemuva kokutshala kusukela ngo-Okthoba kuya kuDisemba 2010, izindawo eziningi lapho kukhuliswe khona ufulawa zathola imvula enkulu. Ezindaweni eziningi zokulima, lokhu kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo phakathi kwemigqa ye-maize. Abalimi abangakaze basebenzise amakhemikhali ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele ukuze bafeze izihlahla eziphilayo, nabangakaze baphonse amakhambi ngemuva kokuthi izitshalo zivele bazobhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu ngonyaka ozayo nezihlahla eziphilayo. Izitshalo eziphilayo ezisunguliwe ezivele zikhulule izithelo zizokhuphuka lezi zithelo emapulazini ngesikhathi esizayo. Abakhiqizi abangasebenzisi imishini kakhulu ngesikhathi sokutshala (ukunciphisa ukulima) nabo babhekane nezinselelo eziningi emapulazini lapho imishini ingasebenzi khona ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokutshala. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ngokucophelela amapulazi lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukutshala ukuze kutholakale ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla eziphilayo ezizokhula ezindaweni ezithile. Amakhemikhali afanele nezibulala-zinambuzane angathengwa - xhumana nomphathi walezi zimpahla ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ezindaweni eziningi, imvula yafika nango-Agasti, okuzophinde kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo ngemishini emapulazini noma basebenzise amakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, uma ubungasebenzisa imishini kuphela ukuze ube neziqholo (ukulima) izihlahla eziphilayo, kungcono ukucabanga ngokuthenga imishini yokuphonsa (spray rig).

Ezamabhange: Ukuhlaziywa Kokubaluleka Kwazo Emasikweni Asethu Ezamabhange zisebenza emhlabeni wonke futhi zinemisebenzi ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali. Zithuthukise izindlela zokuphila kwabantu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangagcina imali yabo, okwakha ithuba lokuhlela izindleko zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba ukulahlekelwa yimali. Amabhange awasizi kuphela ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo zokulondoloza, kodwa futhi adlala indima enkulu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezifana nezikweletu, ukutshala izimali, nokwenza ukuhweba kwezimpahla kube lula. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezamabhange ziza nezimo ezahlukene, futhi izinzuzo nezithiyo ezihambisana nazo kumele zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Akubona bonke abantu abathola kalula lezi zinsizakalo, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile, lapho ukuntuleka kokufinyelela nezindleko zokusebenzisa amabhange kungaholela ekuhlukaniseni. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezinzuzweni ezitholakala ezamabhange. Imithetho ethile yokubhalisela amabhange ibalulekile ekuvikeleni abathengi, inika abantu ithuba lokubanga amalungelo abo. Nokho, le mithetho ingase ibangele izithiyo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abanenkinga zokulawula izindleko. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubo ukufaka izicelo zemali, okukhulisa ubunzima. Amabhange adinga ukuthi umphakathi uphathwe kahle ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Ukukhula kwezimali kumabhange kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayi bezezimali, futhi lokhu kudinga umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obufanele. Ukuze amabhange akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende, kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngamasu amasha afanele.

Uma uneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwengu-49, sikukhetha ngaphandle kwemigomo phakathi kwamalungu omndeni abuye abe nethuba elifanayo lokukhethwa, futhi sikumema ukuba ubambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Uma uneminyaka engu-50 noma ngaphezulu, sithanda ukukumema wena nabanye abantu emndenini wakho abahlangene nawe ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Ukhethiwe ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga, yingakho sithanda ukuxoxa nawe. Le mininingwane elandelayo izochaza inhloso yocwaningo, lokho ozobuzwa khona, kanye nobuhlungu nezinsiza ongazilindela. Kuzochazeka futhi ukuthi awudingi ukujoyina lolu cwaningo. Kufanele ubuze imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi ufuna ukujoyina, noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi nenqubo yokubuza. I-Human Sciences Research Council ifuna ukuxoxa nawe njengengxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga.

Ukwenza ukusebenza (ukufeza obekuphokophelwe) kube yiyonanto ezosentshenziswa uma kuthathwa izinqumo ngokwabiwa kwezidingo ezifana nezimali. Uma ngabe impumelelo itholakala ngokuhlinzekela ingxenye engama- 20 ekhulwini yabantu, ngabe ukuhlinzekela wonke umuntu (100%) kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu? Imigomo yokuziphatha mayelana nokwenzelana ngobuqotho kusemqoka kakhulu kuyo yonke imigwamanda yezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ukusentshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ezingavunyelwe nokuziphatha. Ukubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umhlaba onokuthula ngezemidlalo ezingenabandlululo, ezidinga ukuzwana kwezinhlangothi zonke nomoya wobungani. Ubunye nokwenzelana ngobuqotho. Ukumisa inqubomgomo yobudlelwane namazwe ngamazwe, ngokuvumelana nenqubomgomo kahulumeni kazwelonke. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, iSASC iyosayida izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe eziphathelene nezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ngale kokwehliswa isithunzi sokuzimela seNingizimu Afrika. b Ukunikeza indlela yokugogodiswa kwabathuka bezimbandakanya bazimbandakanye kwezemidlalo ezikhethekileyo kulabo abanekhono. c Ukwenza ngcono ukudlala emicimbini yamazwe ngamazwe. Kwethenjwa ukuthi lelibhukwana liyokhuthaza imicabango kulowo ozolifunda aqambe izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezizokwenza kuzwakale isisho esithi "senza isizwe sidlale", kanye " nokwenza ngcono impilo yabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika". Ngaphezu kwalokhu, lelibhukwana kuhloswe ukuba libe ngumhlahlandlela womthetho ozokwenza kube nesiqiniseko sokuthi okuzuziwe akugcini nje kuphela bashiyelane ngolwazi lwabo nalabo abasadinga ukwalulekwa emkhakheni yokuqeqesha, ukuba unompempe noma ukuphatha.

a Intuthuko yezilimi zendabuko kuhlangene nokusungula inqalasizinda nokuthuthukisa imikhiqizo efana nezichazimazwi namagama olimi. b Ukuqinisa isibophezelo sikahulumeni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlomulo yokwethulwa kwemisebenzi yomphakathi isatshalaliswa ngendlela elinganayo ngokunika zonke izakhamizi ithuba lokufinyelela kuyo, akukhathalekile ukuthi usebenzisa luphi ulimi, inqobo nje ukukhuphula iqhaza labo nokuzwakalisa izwi ezindabeni zikahulumeni. c Ukuphathwa kwezilimi ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni zithola ithuba lokusebenza nokugqamisa isithunzi sikaHulumeni. d Ukugqugquzela ukufundwa kolimi, ikakhulu oluqondene nezidingo zeMisebenzi yoMphakathi, ukuthuthukisa ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi negalelo emsebenzini nokuveza obala imihlomulo yokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene. e Ukugqugquzela intshumayelo enamandla ngokwehlukana ngezilimi neqhaza labantu abanentshisekelo ngezilimi nabalo abathintekayo. a Ukuqalisa ngeNqubomgomo kuyongeniswa ngezikhawu, lokhu kuyokwenzeka ngesikhathi eside ngokwemukelekile. b Inqubo yokuqalisa iNqubomgomo iyokwenzeka ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe nezinkomba ezilawulekayo. c Amandla angaphakathi okuzenzela ayobumbeka ngezikhawu ukuze umsebenzi wokuqhubeka kwenqubomgomo ufezeke ngempumelelo nangendlela enegalelo. d Impumelelo yokusebenza kwenqubomgomo iyodinga ushintsho esikweni lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ezakhiweni zikahulumeni ukuze kube nesiqiniseko sokuthi izilimi zendabuko zisetshenziswa ngendlela enomfutho ezindabeni eziningi.

Lokho okushiwo ngumthethonkambiso 108.05.01 kuyosebenza nalapha. Uma kutholakala ukuthi ukungalandelwa kwemithethonkambiso, okuholela ekutheni kuhlolwe futhi, lokho kuhlolwa kuyokhokhelwa ngehora njengoba kubekiwe kumthethonkambiso 187.00.29. a ukuthi isitifiketi sitholwe enhlanganweni yokuqeqesha eyamukelekile kwelinye izwe;nokuthi b Lowo onesitifiketi uphothule ngempumelelo uqeqesho lokuvuselelwa ulwazi lwezokuphepha kokuthutha impahla ngendiza oluhlonzwe wumthethonkambiso 108.06.15. Isicelo okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 1 siyophelezelwa yimali efanele enqunywe yiNgxenye 187. Lokho okushiwo uMthethonkambiso 108.06.1 no 2 kuyosebenza kulowo onesitifiketi okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 1. a ngemuva kokuhlolwa nocwaningo olwenziwe ngaphansi kwale Ngxenye, kubonakala ukuthi lowo onemvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa akahambisani nezidingo ezinqunywe kule ngxenye futhi lowo onesitifiketi uyehluleka ukulungisa iphutha noma ukulandela okushiwo yile Ngxenye zingakapheli izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu ngemuva kokuthola isaziso esibhaliwe esivela kumhloli noma kulowo ogunyazelwe lomsebenzi; noma b isikhulu esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma isisebenzi esifanele sivinjelwe ngumuntu onemvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa ukuba siqhube uphenyo noma ucwaningo ngaphansi kwale ngxenye; noma c ukumiswa kudingekile ukuze kuphephiswe noma kufezwe ezokuphepha.

Imihlahlandlela, inqubo nezidingo ezibalulekile seziqoshiwe kanti futhi ziyahlangabezana nezidingo zoMkhandlu, amaqophelo ezinga lomhlaba, kanye neminye imicikilisho esemqoka ngohlobo lolwazi njengoba lwanqunywa yiNhlangano eBumbene Yezizwe engqungqutheleni okwakudingidwa kuyo udaba loMfaniswano ngamaGama eziNdawo. Sekufinyelelwe esivumelwaneni ngezihloko okumele zibe kumakholomu nohlobo lolwazi olufunekayo lapho kudwetshwa khona umtapo wolwazi lwamagama olugcinwe kukhompuyutha. Loluhlobo lusebenzisa ukuloba kwe "MS access" nokuwulimi lwekhompuyutha. Ukuze kusungulwe umtapo wolwazi nemininingwane yamagama ezindawo eMkhandlwini ezweni lonke, imitapo ehlukene kuyomele iqashelwe ukuze kuhambe kahle ucwaningo nokushiyelana kahle ulwazi. Lenqubo iyobandakanya uhlaziyo oluqhubekayo lokuhlola iqophelo lomkhiqizo ngoba ulwazi olutholakala elekhodini ngalinye lwalungaphelele, lushintshashintsha noma lungazange luvuselelwe. Ukulungisa amaphutha, ucwaningo, umsebenzi wokulandela nenqubo yokuthola isiqiniseko kuyomele kwenziwe wumcwaningi kanye nethimba labasebenzi bakhe. Kungenzeka akwenze ngokuhlanganyela nabanye abacwaningi nongoti emagameni ezindawo. Ngomhlaka-6 Disemba 2000, amalunga amathathu ethimba lonobhala bathola uqeqesho ngendlela yokusungula nokugcina umtapo wolwazi nemininingwane kuMkhandlu. UMkhandlu usuqalile ukubuyekeza lawo magama ayengazange ethulwe ukuze agunyazwe. Lawo ngamagama anokucwasa noma abandlululayo nadluliselwe komaziphathe nemiphakathi efanele ukuze kutholakale imibono nokwenza izinguquko ezifanele.

Uma usukulungele ukusiza ikhasimende, khumbula, bhalisela, uthi "sawubona," uxolise ngokulinda, futhi uzethule ngegama, isibonelo, "Sawubona, ngiyaxolisa ngokukugcina ulindile. Ngiyena Jane (noma uNkk. Smith), ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?" Ulimi lwakho lomzimba kufanele lukhombise ukuzithoba, futhi izwi lakho kufanele libe nomusa. Thola ukuthi ubani ikhasimende futhi usebenzise igama labo phakathi kwengxoxo. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakhipha kahle igama labo. Xoxa nomuntu ngokuba nengxoxo emfushane nabo uma kungenzeka. "Kuyinsuku enhle namuhla, akunjalo?" Yiba nomusa, ungakhethi, ulindele izinto ezinhle, futhi ube nomuntu. Khombisa ubuchwepheshe emsebenzini wakho futhi uhlale ulindele izinto ezinhle. Ungavumeli amakhasimende ukuba azwe izingxoxo zakho ezizimele, noma uma ukhuluma ophikweni noma unengxoxo phakathi kwabasebenzi ababili. Phatha ngokwezimvo zakho. Ungaphenduli ifoni yakho ye-cell ngaphandle kokuxolisa ku ikhasimende kuqala bese uzithiba ngemva kokuphothula ucingo. Wazise ikhasimende ukuthi uhamba kuphi uma ushiya indawo yakho yokusebenza. Lalela ngokucophelela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubuza yonke imibuzo ezokwenza uthole yonke imininingwane efanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda konke abakukhulumayo, noma uma lokho kusho ukuthola umuntu ozokuhumusha. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda inkinga ethulwe kuwe ngaphambi kokuzama ukuyixazulula. Phatha bonke abantu ngenhlonipho enkulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babukeka kanjani. Phatha wonke umuntu sengathi uphatha igolide. Thatha isikhathi sokuchaza ikhasimende ukuthi kungani isicelo sabo sokwakha sitholakale.

Kungakho nathi singuMnyango wezoLimo nezeMvelo KwaZulu-Natali sihamba emazwini kaNgqongqoshe uManuel sithi bakwethu isimo ngeke sishintshe kulesi okuyisona njengamanje kepha siya siba simbi kakhulu njengoba sonke sizwile ukuthi intengo kapetrol iyenyuka ngoLwesithathu lolu esiya kulo. Ukunezezela kulokhu kunezinkulumo ezithi iBhange-Ngodla lakuleli lingahle lenyuse izinga lemali eyinzalo ngamaphesenti amabili (2% interest rate increase) uma kuhlangene ikomidi leli elibhekene nenqubo-mgomo wemali ngenyanga ezayo. Lokho kusho into eyodwa okungukuthi abantu abanezindlu abazithengelwe ngamabhangi noma izimoto ezisakhokhelwa bazothwala kanzima kugcine ngokuthi zidliwe zibuyele kuwo amabhange ngenxa yokuthi abantu abasakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo zanyangazonke njengesivumelwano. Ngithi angikusho lokhu ngoba yinoma ngubani lapha emhlabeni into yokuqala ayicabangela imali uma ebhekene nezimo ezingezinhle ngasohlangothini lwempilo yakhe uma kuthinta izimali ukuthi athenge into eya ngaphansi kwekhala lokho okungukudla ngaphambi kokuthi abhekane nezinye izikweletu. Ngokocwaningo lwe IMF, amanani okudla emhlabeni jikelele asekhuphuke cishe ngesibalo esithi asiphindwe kuleso ayeyiso ngonyaka ka 2006 World Food Prices have increased by 48% since 2006. Ukwenza-nje isibonelo ngalokhu engikushoyo, uma ngo 2006 isaka lempuphu elingu 12,5kg wawulithenga ngo R15, njengamanje isaka elifanayo usungalithenga ngo R28.. Mphathi wohlelo, abaningi bazozibuza ukuthi uNgqongqoshe uMthimkhulu kutheni esifundekela ngento engekho eduzane nathi.

Kwakwakukhathala okukhulu kwabahlengikazi ngosuku olungelanga elishisayo eGoli, lapho umoya uhlehla izihlahla ezincane ezisemathafeni. UThandi, umhlengikazi, wayehamba esuka emsebenzini, enezinyembezi eziphuma emehlweni akhe. Usuku lonke ubhekene nezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezimkhathazayo, ezimshiya edinga ukuphumula. UThandi waqonda ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile, kodwa namuhla, ubuhlungu bokukhathala kwakhe babungaphezu kokujwayelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wakhumbula izinsuku ezinhle lapho wayezwa umoya wokuzimisela. Eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule, waqala umsebenzi wakhe emnyangweni wezempilo, futhi wathokozisa ukusiza abantu, ukuletha ithemba, nokubuyisela impilo. Nokho, njengoba izinsuku zidlula, umthwalo wempilo wabahlali bendawo waba nzima kakhulu. Abantu abaninzi befinyelela ezibhedlela bezinokukhathala nezifo ezinzima, futhi uThandi wababona bebheda, ezwa sengathi umhlaba ubambelele emuva. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi waba noMnumzane Dlamini, indoda ethwele kanzima. Wayengumuntu omdala, futhi izimpawu zokukhathala zazicacile ebusweni bakhe. UThandi wamthanda, ngoba wayebona ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini uzama ukulwa nezinkinga zempilo, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babungaphezu kokubekezelela. Waqala ukuxoxa naye, uMnumzane Dlamini wabelana ngendaba yakhe, ethi: “Ngiyazama, kodwa ngiyakhathala. Ngithanda umndeni wami, kodwa ngizizwa ngisolwa, ngingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono.” UThandi wathola ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ungumuntu onothando, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babumshiya edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu, futhi lokhu kumkhathaza.

I-Abe-EMIA izokwazi ukukwazisa uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe noma saphikiswa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-48 ngemva kokuthathwa kwesinqumo sokugcina. Izicelo ngeke zamukelwe ngokuqondile. Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukuvunywa okubhalwe phansi kwesicelo sakho ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili. Ikhophi yesaziso sokuvuma kumele ihambisane nazo zonke izincwadi zokuxhumana noma/ukufakwa kwezinye izincwadi kwi-EMIA. Uma i-Abe-EMIA ithola noma yiziphi izincwadi noma imibhalo evela kuwe engafaki incwadi yokuvuma yesicelo, i-Abe-EMIA ngeke ibhekelele uma lezi zincwadi zilahlekile noma zifakwe kwenye indawo ngendlela engafanele. Uma lezi zincwadi zilahlekile noma zibekwe endaweni engafanele, lokhu kungaphazamisa noma kuvimbe inqubo ye-ofisi. Uma isicelo sosizo sivunywa, ifomu lesicelo se-EMIA kumele ligcwaliswe, kanye nezincwadi ezisekelayo kanye nohlu lwezinkinga okufanele zigcwaliswe, bese kufakwa kwi-EMIA phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu kusukela ngosuku okufanele ibuyiselwe endaweni yebhizinisi evunywe. Uma ifomu lesicelo noma izincwadi ezihlobene nesicelo zingafakiwe phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu, isicelo ngeke sisavunywa. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngesevisi liyahluka kuye ngesevisi kanye nesevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Izinkampani noma abanikazi bamabhizinisi ngabanye kumele bafake izitifiketi zokukhokha zentela ezisemthethweni ukuze bazuze kulolu hlelo. Sicela ubheke ku-website ye-dti. Le sevisi inefomu layo lokufaka izicelo nemihlahlandlela. Amafomu wesicelo atholakala futhi kwezinye izinsizakalo.

Le le sevisi isebenza kumuntu wangaphandle onenhloso yokuzosungula ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika; noma osevele enemvume yebhizinisi ukuqhuba ibhizinisi ezweni; noma onenhloso yokuzotshala izimali kwibhizinisi elikhona ezweni. Izicelo zingenziwa kunoma yiliph ihhovisi laboMnyango wezaseKhaya kwiprovinsi onenhloso yokuqhuba ibhizinisi kuso. Yenza isicelo kwinxusa noma i-mission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. U-chartered accountant osebenza egameni lakho kumele afakele isiqiniseko sokuthi ngempela ifakelwe imali elingana umkhawulo obekiwe ezincwadini webhizinisi. Umkhawulo wemali okunqunywe ukuthi ifakelwe yinani lika-R2,5miliyoni kanti futhi leli nani lingabekelwa eceleni kuphela noma liphungulwe uma lokhu kuzobonelela izidingo zesizwe , noma uma kucela aboMnyango wezoHwebo neZimboni ukwenze njalo. Uma sekutholakele imvume yokuhlala unomphela, kumele uvuselele isiqiniseko se-chartered accountant eminyakeni emibili ngemuva kosuku lokukhishwa kwemvume yokuhlala unomphela, kanti futhi kweminye iminyaka emithathu ngemuva kwalokho. Ukuhluleka ukulandela lo mbandela kuyoba nomphumela wokuthi imvume yakho yokuhlala unomphela iphele. Asikho isikhathi esibekiwe sale nkonzosale sevisi.

Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandiwe waba nesifiso sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye. Waqala ukufundisa abantu abasha, wabelana ngempilo yakhe, futhi waba umholi emiphakathini. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwakhe akusabukeki njengokwakunjalo, kodwa kube yindlela yokuhlola, yokufunda, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, futhi wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe ibuyile, futhi ibukeka ngcono kunakuqala. Waba nesifiso sokuphila, futhi wathola injabulo ezindaweni ezincane. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, futhi wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe ibuyile, futhi ibukeka ngcono kunakuqala. Waba nesifiso sokuphila, futhi wathola injabulo ezindaweni ezincane. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuphila, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphila akupheli, kodwa kungenzeka kube ngcono.

Abameleli kumele balandele imithetho nemigomo kanye nemithetho yeziqu zedolobha futhi bahloniphe umthetho njalo. Ukusungulwa nokubambezeleka kuncike ekungahlangabezweni nezidingo ezidingekayo. Umphakathi ophumayo ubonisa noma yimuphi umuntu oqokwe njengomphakathi ophumayo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokusebenza Kwecala, 1977 Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977, okuhlanganisa imidiya futhi kubhekisela kunoma yimuphi umuntu ophila eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthetho Wezakhiwo Zedolobha uhlanganisa noma umphakathi omunye oqokwe ukwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. Umthetho Wezakhiwo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezakhiwo Zedolobha ka-1998 Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998. Umthetho Wezinhlelo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezinhlelo Zedolobha ka-2000 Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000. Ubulili nenombolo - Kunoma yimuphi umthetho, ngaphandle kokuba kube nenhloso ephikisanayo, amagama akhombisa ubulili besilisa ahlanganisa nobulili besifazane, futhi amagama akhombisa inani elilodwa ahlanganisa inani eliningi, futhi amagama akhombisa inani eliningi ahlanganisa inani elilodwa. Noma yisiphi isimemo sokukhuluma nebhodi noma ikomidi lebhodi; kanye nanoma yimuphi umphakathi wedolobha. Noma yisiphi ukuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo kumele kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesiNtu, umthetho kazwelonke, wesifunda, kanye nomthetho wedolobha, kanye nomthetho nokuqonda. Isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nokuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo emhlanganweni wekhansela noma ikomidi, ngokusekelwe ezicini 35 no-36, sizoba yisinqumo sokugcina.

Khulula amandla ngaphambi kokuhambisa umshini. Ukugoba kwe-header. Iziphuzo eziqinisekisiwe ezingagoba kancane zizovumela umshini ukuba uhambise ezindaweni eziphakeme ezingu-14% - 30% kokubili phansi noma phezulu. Umshini onama-header ajikayo ngaphandle kwe-header eyakhiwe ngepipi ngaphakathi kwendawo yokufakelwa amanzi angafinyelela ku-360°, kodwa angavinjwa ezindaweni ezincane hhayi emjikelezweni wonke. Ungafaka amanzi ku-80-90% wendawo yebhakabhaka. Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi u-75% wezitshalo ukhula engxenyeni yangaphandle yomjikelezo, kanti ingxenye yangaphakathi yomjikelezo (50%) inezitshalo ezingu-25% zendawo yonke. Iconsume amanzi, amandla (ugesi), kanye nemali. Abakhiqizi abafaka amanzi abahlola njalo izinga lokumunca komhlabathi bavame ukugcina amanzi namandla, bakhulise umkhiqizo, bavimbele ukuwa komhlabathi, futhi banciphise ukungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukuphathwa kahle kokufakwa kwamanzi kusho ukudala indawo lapho izitshalo zingakhula kahle, okusho ukuthi kubhekwa umhlabathi, akufanele kube umswakama kakhulu noma owomile kakhulu. Akekho omunye onolwazi olufana nolwakho ngamasimu akho, izitshalo zakho, kanye nokufakwa kwamanzi. I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokufaka amanzi ezitshalweni, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengazo zonke izinsiza. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izinto okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza nalesi sikhali. Le mishini inikeza ithuba lokufaka amanzi ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, kanye nezinye izifo, nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezithombo.

Amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika athonywa ukunikezwa kwendawo nokucela, kanye nezimo zemakethe zamazwe omhlaba. Kukhona ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene ezibangela ukushintsha kwamamanani ezolimo. Imakethe yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ithonywa izitayela zemakethe yomhlaba, njengoba leli lizwe linengxenye encane emakethe yezolimo yomhlaba. Amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika athonywa ukunikezwa kwendawo nokucela, kanye nezimo zemakethe zamazwe omhlaba. IOfisi Yolwazi yeMnyango Wezokuvikela izophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umgibeli wezincwadi nomlando weMnyango Wezokuvikela unesibopho sokugcina izincwadi nomlando. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali kuMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi (PFMA), kanye nemigomo ethile, nezikhombisi ezithunyelwe kuzo zonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwezokuphepha kwezwe nezindaba zokuhola umgomo weMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, ukuqapha, nokwamukela umgomo wezokuphepha, isu, ne-framework ngokuhambisana nomgomo wesizwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, okusebenzayo, nokuziphatha kahle kwezokuphepha. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. UMsunguli ungumholi wezindawo ezifanayo nezisekelo zabantu abahluphekayo. Ukuphatha nokubheka iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ukuze kusekelwe ukuvikelwa komhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabliki yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngemiyalo ngombono wokuvikelwa komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwezempi nezisekelo ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ukuze kusekelwe nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula umgomo wezempilo yezempi kanye nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina usizo lwezokwelapha oluyisisekelo kubalungu beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincikizi zabo noma labo abaxhaswa ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokweseka nezinto ezihlobene.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Uma abantu benempilo yengqondo enhle, bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, baphile kahle, futhi babe neqhaza elihle emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima lapho abantu bebhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukukhuthaza impilo yengqondo kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Kodwa-ke, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo, kudingeka sikhulume ngamasiko ethu. Ezinye izinkolo nezamasiko zethu zikhuthaza ukuba sibe namandla, sithande, futhi sibe neqhaza elihle. Kodwa, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nokukhathazeka akuyona into yokuhluleka. Kunalokho, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, baphinde bazi ukuthi akekho oyedwa ophila ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokwesekwa zingasiza abantu abahlangabezana nezinkinga zengqondo. Ngiyakhumbula ngesikhathi esithile lapho ngithola usizo, futhi ngathola ukuthi akukhona okubi ukufuna usizo. Lokhu kwangikhuthaza ukuba ngikhulume nabanye, futhi ngibakhuthaze ukuba baphinde bazi ukuthi akekho oyedwa ophila ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiyabona ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinselele, kodwa futhi iyithuba. Itholakala ezinkingeni zethu, kodwa futhi iyindlela yokukhula. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu yonke. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka.

Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo/nabathatha impesheni (GEMS self-employed/pensioner income verification) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kuqhubeka nokuba yinkinga ebalulekile kubantu abaningi. Ikakhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, abantu basemakhaya nakwezomnotho bacela izinsiza, futhi ukwethembeka kwemali engenayo kubalulekile ukuze bathole izinzuzo ezithile ezibhekelele impilo yabo. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo okugcinwe ngaphansi kweMithetho ye-GEMS, okuyinsika yokuphila kahle kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Emavikini ambalwa edlule, kuvele izinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuhlola izincwadi zokuphila kwabathola izinzuzo. Abanye basebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokukhombisa imali engenayo, ezihlanganisa izinqwaba zamadokhumenti ezisemthethweni, kodwa lokhu akuhlali kuhambisana nemigomo ebekiwe. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kubalulekile, ikakhulu uma kubhekwa ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo. I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano ehlanganisa izinsiza zezempilo, ibonisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kunomthelela omkhulu ekwanelisekeni kwabantu. Njengoba abantu besebenzisa izinsiza zabo, bakhombisa ukuthi imikhuba yokuphila, njengokudla, izokwelapha, nezinye izidingo, kufanele ihambisane nemali abayitholayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlolwa okuqinile kwezincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhombisa imali engenayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola lezi zinsiza bangakhokha izindleko zabo. Ngokwesimo samanje, izithiyo ezivela kwezokuxhumana nezokusebenza zenza kube nzima kwabanye abantu ukuthola lezi zinsiza.

2.7 Shono okushaqisayo okutholwe uHadebe nomkakhe okuqondene nendodakazi yabo lapho befika esikhungwini efunda kuso? "Dumakude, mangithi njena ngicela ungixolele kakhul, ngezwi elinosizi." "Cha mhlonishwa, imoto ilimale kumina manje nje ekuseni. Kade ngiphuma esangweni kwami sengixhanyazeliswa wucingo lokugula kukamama. Mina bengithi yinto encane kanti imoto yami ilimale ngampela," usho nje uyagwajaza. Usecabanga nokuvuleka kwezikweledu ezimmele ngenhla. Chaza ukuthi umlingiswa omkhulu, abalingiswa ababalulekile kanye nabalingiswa abancane ubabumbe kanjani umbhali endabeni ethi, "Okunjani Nje Lokhu"? "Uyabona MaMthembu abaphansi abazona izinto zokudlala. Uzothini uma sebethatha uNcamisile ngenxa yokukhohlakala kwakho" Akhale ngokunye manje uMaMthembu. Useze usenesibibithwane-ke manje. Ulokhu equme njalo uNcamisile. Aphenduke alale ngolunye uhlangothi. Kube ngcono ukuquma? 2.2 Kungani umka Mfundisi Bukhosini aqala kwaNzuza ukuyobheka umyeni wakhe? Ungihlaba umxhwele lo mqondo wenu zingane zami, ukuthi kanti lapha eMhlanganiso siqeqesha abaholi bangomuso. lmpela ubudoda abukhulelwa. Futhi uma niqokelele kahle ngala maholide, leyo mali iyofeza izidingo zomkhulu nogogo zonyaka wonke. Lo msebenzi wenzeni ngamaqembu, nixoxisane. Wenzeni lo msebenzi ngaphambi kokufunda indaba ethi: Okunjani Nje Lokhu. Amasela ayesezithathela nje impahla esitolo. Isivimbela-zigebengu sasehlulekile. Nomshini ocushwayo okhala nxashana kunothile ovula umnyango wase wehlulekile. Kusobala ukuthi wabe ehlangene nongqondongqondo impela.

Ukunikeza imibono ohlelweni lwezemfundo yokomzimba. c Ukwenza iziphakamiso eziKhungweni ezinikele ngezimali nasemiNyangweni kahulumeni ethintekayo mayelana nezemidlalo zezikole. d Ukuxhumana nezinhlangano zikazwelonke nezeziFundazwe mayelana nezemidlalo yezingane nentsha. a Ukulandelwa kwenqubomgomo kahulumeni kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. b Ingqikithi yomsebenzi wayo imbandakanya ukwabelana zokudoba/ukuheha abantu. d Ukwenza iziphakamiso ezihlanganweni zesiFundazwe nakuziphathimandla zasekhaya ukuze aqoqe izimfanelo azozisebenzisa ukwenza umsebenzi wawo. eYiwoma ayinqola ephambili yokuvumbulula, ukuthuthukisa nokondla/ukunonophalisa amathalente. Angeke kwenzeka ukuthi uhulumeni yedwa ahlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Ngalesi sizathu, ukuhlanganyela phakathi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (NGO) ezibhekele ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka, kanye nosomabhizimisi, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuze kutholakale izimali nezidingo ezizothuthukisa lesi sikhungo. UNgqongqoshe, abezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) kanye neKhomishani (SASC) bayazi ngomthethela wezemidlalo kwezomnotho nokukhula ngesivinini kokuthengiselana ngezemidlalo. Empeleni, ezemidlalo seziyimboni ngokwazo, futhi zibambe iqhaza emkhiqizweni wezwe (GDP). Ukunikela ngemali ukuze kwakhiwe noma kulungiswe izidingo noma izimfanelo zezemidlalo ezindaweni ezazinganakiwe ngaphambilini.

Ukurola, emva kokufakwa kwabagijimi, kubaluleke kakhulu. I-AHSC kumele kunwetshwe izinzuzo emithonjeni etholakalayo bese yemukela izindlela ezingambi eqolo. Umsolwa uzovela enkantolo yeMantshi yaseTembisa namuhla. Uhlelo lokwakha kabusha oluzoqalwa yiWCED oluzofaka izinto eziningi ngaphandle nje kokuhlela kabusha kwezikhala zokwelekelela eminyangweni kahulumeni. INxusa laseNingizimu Afrikha elihlala eDakar, eSenegal, liphinde libeke seGuinea, eMali, e Mauritania, eCape Verde kanye naseGambia nakuba lingahlali khona. Lezi zibhamu zatholwa zilahliwe kanti akekho owaboshwa. Hamba eduze kwendawo yokuhlola ubheke izimoto eziza ngakuwe. ITheku, yidolobha elaziwayo kanti liphakamise amasokisi kulolu hlobo. Izikhumulo zezindiza nazo zonke ezinye izithuthi ezingahambisani nemigomo ebekiwe. Kanti lonke ikhalenda likhishiwe layiswa kumakilabhu ehlukene. Ngesikhathi esathi uyabuza, indoda engaziwa yamyalela ukuba akhumule. Uphule imingcele yalokho okungcwele, nalokho okungathinteki. Kwenzeka ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi ukuthi umcubunguli we-Delta-G ashayele i-Forensic Department. Uma imali isidonsiwe ebhange ngeke isabuyiselwa emuva. Kodwa, uNomvete usanda kubuyela eNingizimu Afrikha ukuze azodlalela i-Orlando Pirates. Umnyango ungaqinisekisa ukuthi ukususa izitshalo ezingadingekile eduze nedamu laseFranschoek libe yisimo lapho wonke umuntu ewina khona. Ukubalwa kwamashifu angenakho ukufa emva kokuba kuqale izingozi ezibulalayo kwishifu emva nje kwaleyo shifu edale ukufa.

Bese kuqhubeka emapulazini ezohwebo lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna okwakhiwa. Ngokuvamile, i-sorghum ivunwa ndawonye ne-maize futhi ivunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma itshalwe kusenesikhathi, kuyilapho enye ivunwa ngoMeyi uma itshalwe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuna kwe-maize kuqale. Lokhu kubalulekile emapulazini amancane lapho ama-combine angavuna i-sorghum ne-maize. Umkhiqizi noma umuntu othile uzothola umqashi onemishini ekwazi ukuvuna i-sorghum ne-maize. Isikhathi esivela ekuphumeleleni kokwakhiwa kuya ekuvuneni kufanele sibe mfushane - lokhu kuzovimbela izingozi ezidalwa yizinyoni nokonakala kokwakhiwa nakwezinye izifo. Izitshalo ze-sorghum ziba zikhulile lapho umbala ngemuva kokwakhiwa ushintsha, ekuqaleni umbala ubuhlalu bese ube mpunga. Lokhu kushintsha ngokuvamile kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba okwakhiwa kumiswe ukuze kuvunwe. I-sorghum etshaliwe kamuva izoba ready kuphela emva kokufriza kokuqala ebusika. Ngaphambi kokuqala ukuvuna, sebenzisa umshini wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uhlole okuqukethwe komswakama kokwakhiwa uma kuqala ukuvuthwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uzovuna ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma ungenawo umshini wokuhlola umswakama, thola amasampula okwakhiwa kumphathi wesilo oseduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna.

Iyini le mbono? Le mbono ibeka abantu, izimpilo zabo, amandla abo, namathuba abo okuthuthuka njengesisekelo sokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ezosiza ekwehliseni ubumpofu. Ibonisa i-DWAF njengenhlangano ehamba phambili emkhakheni wezokusebenza ekwakheni indawo enezimo ezinhle zokukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ngokusebenzisa izihlahla eziphathwayo kahle. Lokhu kubhekisisa labo abaqashwe ngqo emisebenzini yokulima izihlahla (ehhovisi elikhulu nasemazingeni enhlangano) kanye nabanye abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano ye-DWAF yonke abanezindima nemisebenzi ethinta izinto ezikhuthazayo zendawo. Kubheka ukuthi kuphi umthetho nemigomo okufanele kukhuthaze imiphumela emihle kubampofu, ukuthi izinhlelo zingatholakala kanjani futhi zibe nezincazelo ezithile ezihlobene nalokhu, nokuthi isakhiwo semakethe nendlela yokusebenza ivulekile kangakanani ezidingweni zabangenayo abasha nabakhiqizi abancane. Ihlanganisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuphatha izihlahla (ndawonye nezinhlelo ezihlanganisiwe ezihlobene) ezingathinta imizamo ehlukene yokuthuthukiswa komnotho nomphakathi njengengxenye yesu lokwehlisa ubumpofu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqonda izindaba ezihlobene nokwenziwa kwemali nezinye izici zobumpofu bomphakathi kanye namathuba ezihlahla okuthuthukisa izimpilo. Kugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa indlela ye "forestry yabantu" ekwakheni, ukwesekwa kwezimali, nasekusebenzeni kokuqala kwezinhlangano ezisebenza emkhakheni wendawo.

b iBhodi, ngokucelwa yisiphathimandla sesivumelwano, kumele lihoxise noma yiyiphi imvume noma ilayisense yokusebenza enikeza amandla okusebenza kwimigudu ebandakanyeka kulesisivumelwano, uma ngabe umphathi wesivumelwano enxeshezelwa ngokokuboniswa okukhonjwe kusigaba 514 so Mthetho ka Zwelonke. Asikho isinxephezelo esikhokhwayo uma kukhanselwa ilayisense yokusebenza noma imvume ngaphansi kwendima a yesigatshana 2. Lapho izinhlelo zezokuthutha zibonisa isidingo sokwenezelela izithuthi kumgudu othile, isiphathimandla sezokuthutha singamemela kwi Bhodi izicelo zamalayisense okusebenza okuletha ezokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi angatholwa ngokwesivumelwano kulowomgudu. Umuntu noma iqembu elifisa ukusebenza ngezokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi ngaphandle kwezithuthi ezikhonjwe kusiga 521, kumele lifake isicelo kwi Bhodi ukuze lithole ilayisense yokusebenza efanela. Umuntu noma iqembu elifisa ukwedluliselwa ilayisense yokusebenza lingafaka isicelo esihambisana nemvume ebhalwe ngumphathi kwi Bhodi. e zicacise imoto ezosetshenziselwa ukuba yisithuthi. g zifake incazelo ehlalusisiwe yomgudu noma imigudu lapho umfaki sicelo esebenzela noma azosebenzela khona nazo zonke izindawo lapho abagibeli begitsheliswa khona noma bezogitsheliswa khona nalapho behliswa noma bezokwehliswa khona; bese h zifakwe kwiqembu labaphathiswa bezamalayisense okusebenza elibekelwe idolobhakazi elethile.

Ukudlula kwezinye izwe noma emngceleni wezinye izwe kuzodinga imvume ye-aviation authority kulelo zwe. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.08. d ukusebenza kwendiza noma ezindizeni eziningi ukusebenzisa indiza ngenkathi ungahambisani nezidingo zomsebenzi ezichazwe kumgomo 21.02.3; noma e ukusebenza kwendiza enesisindo esedlula umkhawulo ovunyelwe wendiza eqala ngaphezu komkhawulo ojwayelekile noma indawo yokuhlala ngaphandle kwezidingo ezifanele noma indawo yokuphinda ugcwalise indiza. Isisindo esedlula esingavunyelwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlaka sithathwa kuphela ngesisindo esengeziwe sefuels, indawo yokugcwalisa kabusha kanye nezinsiza eziphuthumayo nezokuhlola ezifanele isimo sokundiza. Imvume yokundiza eyingqayizivele yohlobo olungabhalwanga ingakhishwa njengogunyaziwe lokundiza ngendlela echazwe kwiSahluko 24 yemithetho. c ulwazi lokungahambisani nezimo zokulungela indiza nezidingo ezichaziwe zokundiza ezichazwe kumgomo 21.02. d noma noma iyiphi isimo sokusebenza esibhekwa njengendlela efanele yokuphepha yokusebenzisa indiza; futhi e olunye ulwazi olungacelwa yiKomishini ngenhloso yokuhlonza izimo zokusebenza kwendiza. IKomishini inegunya lokwenza noma icela kumfaki-sicelo ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlolwa noma kokuhlola ukuze kuhlolwe isimo sokuphepha. Isicelo esichazwe esigabeni 3 kufanele sibe nezindleko ezifanele ezithathwe ngaphansi kweSahluko 187. Isicelo sokukhishwa kwegunya lokundiza kwendiza noma ushintsho kufanele kuhambisane nezimo zeSahluko 24. Imvume yokundiza eyingqayizivele ekhishwe ngaphansi kwalolu Sahluko izohlala isebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeNingizimu Afrika nasemanzini ezwe.

inani lentela yendawo eliklanywe endaweni entsha efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo noma indawo umnini wayo enobunikazi ngokohlelo lwezinguquko zemihlaba, kufanele ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- , lifakwe ngezikhawu esikhathini esiyiminyaka yezimali emithathu, kuqalwe ekupheleni kwesikhathi sokungabandakanywa kwamanani entela yendawo okubalulwe endimeni- 15 (g). inani lentela yendawo eliklanywe empahleni/endaweni entsha efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo noma indawo lapho umnikazi enobunikazi ngokohlelo lwezinguquko zobunikazi ngokondlalifa lingebe ngaphezulu kwenani eliklanywe endaweni efanayo noma umkhakha wempahla/wendawo kumasipalati. ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe ilungu lesigungu esikhulu angelula isikhathi sokufakwa kwamanani entela yendawo okukhulunywa ngako esigatshaneni 1 esikhathini esithi uma sihlanganiswe nesasekuqaleni singevi eminyakeni yezimali eyisithupha. uma kwelulwa isikhathi sokufakwa kwentela yendawo, ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe wohulumeni basekhaya kufanele asho izinga lobuningi bokugcina ngokwamamaphesenti benani lentela yendawo obukhokhwa unyaka nonyaka wezimali esikhathini esengeziwe. a ungahlonza indawo ethile phansi kwawo njengendawo enentela eyehlukile; bese b eklama intela yendawo eyengeziwe empahleni ekuleyo ndawo mayelana nezinhloso zokukhokhelwa ukwenziwa ngcono kwaleyo ndawo.

Kungalesi sizathu sathatha isihloko esihlanganisa lesi siqondiso se "kuhlanganiswa." Njengomnyango, siqonda kahle izinkinga ezikhona kwezindlu esifundazweni sethu. Siqhubeka nokuzibophezela esinqumweni sethu sokukhipha ukuhlinzekwa kwezakhamuzi, ukungaphephi kokuhlala, ukungazinzi kwezakhiwo, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni, izingozi zempilo nokuphepha, nezinye izimo ezikhona ezindaweni zokuhlala ezisemthethweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zethu zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezithuthukile. Ekufezeni izinhloso zethu, sithola umyalo wethu kwiFreedom Charter, umqondo wayo uqhubeka usinika ukuhlakanipha, nakuba sekwedlule iminyaka engamashumi amahlanu selokhu yamukelwa yizikhungo zethu zokulwa, futhi sizohlale sikwazisa ngakho. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, kwakubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume "ngemithwalo nezinsiza" lapho sethula ibhajethi yeVoti 8 eminyakeni yokuqala yalo msebenzi weminyaka emihlanu. Izinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngezidingo ngaleso sikhathi zazinzima, futhi umsebenzi omkhulu owayekhuluma phambili wawubuhlungu. Nokho, asizange sishintshe ukuzibophezela kwethu emthwalweni weqembu, njengoba kugcizelelwe nguMongameli uMandela mayelana nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kubantu nokukhuthaza umphakathi ohlanganisiwe njengesisekelo sokukhululeka kwethu. Yenezela amaqanda amathathu achotshoziwe futhiuwagoqozisise. Kwenze kube amaqebelengwane amancanyana bese ukuthosa ngamafutha amancane. Umthetho wokuhlola okukhona odatshana ethi Disemba 23, 1998 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 19640) kanye nomthetho wezilimi emfundweni odatshana ethi Julayi 14, 1997 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 17997) kumele kufundwe ndawonye nesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni). Umthetho wokuhlola kumele ufundwe ndawonye nesigaba esihlobene sesitatimende sesigaba ngasinye sokufunda. Umthetho ophathelene nokukhishwa kwezitifiketi uzohlala ungashintshi kuze kube unyaka ka-2008. Ngemuva kwalokho, isitifiketi semfundo nokuqeqeshwa esihlobene nesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe kanye nesigaba esihlobene sizoba yiso esizosebenza. Isitifiketi semfundo nokuqeqeshwa emfundweni ephoqelelwe sizoba yisithembiso esiphelele ezikoleni futhi sizoba yiso esizoholela ekufezeni imiphumela ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezifanele ezingeni le-9. Uhulumeni wedemokhrasi waseNingizimu Afrika wamukela ohulumeni bangaphambili uhlelo lwezemfundo olwalungalingani. Ngaphansi kukahulumeni wobandlululo, iNingizimu Afrika yayinezigaba eziyi-19 ezihlukene zemfundo. Lezi zigaba zazihlukaniswe ngohlanga, ngezindawo lapho abantu bahlala khona, nangombono wezombusazwe waleso sikhathi. Lolu hlobo lwemfundo lwalulungiselela izingane ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene, kwezomnotho nangokwezombusazwe ngaphansi kobandlululo. Kuwo wonke lawa magunya, uhlelo lwezemfundo ludlale indima ebalulekile ekugcizeleleni ukungalingani phakathi kwabantu.

Ezocwaningo: Umgudu Wokuhlola Nokuthola Iqiniso Ekuqaleni kwalesi sahluko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezocwaningo akuhambisani kuphela nezinsiza noma imiphumela ethile; kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha ulwazi nokwabelana ngakho emphakathini. Kwezamazwe amaningi, ezocwaningo sekuvele kwaba nendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ezempilo, imfundo, nezobuchwepheshe. Ukucwaninga, ngesinye isikhathi, kuyindlela yokwakha izinsiza ezisemqoka nokuthola izixazululo ezintsha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wezocwaningo ufike walungiswa futhi wathuthuka. Ezinye izinsiza zokuqala zicafula eminyakeni edlule, lapho izazi ezifana no-Aristotle no-Plato bezama ukuqonda umhlaba wabo ngokuhlola nokuhlola. U-Aristotle, owakhayo umhlaba wefilosofi, wahlola izikhumbuzo ezidala, ehlola izinyathelo zokuhlola izimfanelo zempilo yezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kwakuhlosiwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile akuyena owodwa kuphela, kepha nabanye. Kwakuyisinyathelo sokuqala ekwakheni umqondo wezocwaningo njengoba sazi namhlanje. Njengoba izikhathi zedlula, isiko lokucwaninga ladlulela Phambili. I-Scientific Revolution yakhulela abantu ukuba bacwaninge izincazelo zezinqubo zemvelo. Abaphenyi bahlola izimo ezinjengokukhanya, amandla, nezinqubo zemvelo, bese bejolisa emiphumeleni engapheli ebudlelwaneni bethu nemvelo. Lokhu kwakhulisa umsebenzi wezinkanyezi, kobuchwepheshe nemikhakha eminingi. Kodwa-ke, awekho wonke amakhamandela akhula angathanda ukusebenza ezocwaningo. Kwakukhona izinzwa ezithile nezinhlobonhlobo, lapho imiphumela ethile yocwaningo yayicwengobile.

Njengoba abantu besebenzisa izinsiza zabo, bakhombisa ukuthi imikhuba yokuphila, njengokudla, izokwelapha, nezinye izidingo, kufanele ihambisane nemali abayitholayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlolwa okuqinile kwezincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhombisa imali engenayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola lezi zinsiza bangakhokha izindleko zabo. Ngokwesimo samanje, izithiyo ezivela kwezokuxhumana nezokusebenza zenza kube nzima kwabanye abantu ukuthola lezi zinsiza. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zidinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS nabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze baqinisekise imali yabo, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu abafanele bathola ukuhlinzekwa, i-GEMS ihlose ukwenza izinguquko ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngedokhumenti. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okuxhumana nabazisebenzayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabathola izinsiza. I-GEMS iphinde ibonise ukuthi izinsiza zayo zidinga ukwandiswa ukuze zifinyelele nakubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza. Ngokubheka uhla lwemibuzo evamile, kubonakala ukuthi abathola izinzuzo bangakhathazeki uma bezama ukuqinisekisa imali yabo, uma bezwa ukuthi kukhona izinqubo ezilula ezitholakalayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo, i-GEMS izokwenza izinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa nokwazisa abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uthola ukukhululeka ngalezi zinguquko, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu basebenzisane ne-GEMS ukuze bathole imininingwane efanele.

Njengomphumela, uMnyango Wezindlu ubeke othisha abaqondile ukuze basize izifunda ekwenzeni ngcono izinhlelo zabo zokwakha izindlu. Lezi zinhlelo zokwakha izindlu ziwamukelekile kuphela uma zicatshangelwa ukuthi zihlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokuhlanganiswa. Siyajabula ukusho ukuthi ukuhlala kwabantu, okuqhubeka nakho, kusemsebenzini ongcono kunakuqala ukuze kufezwe ukuhlanganiswa komnotho, kwezokuhlalisana, nezomhlaba. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngezindlu eKwaZulu-Natal lukhona esimweni esihle sokuba sustainable. Le mpumelelo isisondeza eduze kokunqoba ngokuphelele izinhlelo ezaziyingxenye yepholisi ye-apartheid. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, njengoba sibhiyozela le mpumelelo, sithokozisa kakhulu imibono nezinkokhelo zababambiqhaza. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ibhajethi ethulwe namuhla ibonisa imibono ehlukene yababambiqhaza. Ezinye zezikhungo esixhumene nazo zihlanganisa izifunda, abaholi gelenkolo, ochwepheshe bezindlu, abakhi bezindlu, ososayensi, nezinye izikhungo esisebenze nazo mayelana nezidingo zezindlu. ngaphandle kwalabo abatholwe njengabangenamthelela omkhulu. Izinkinga zokwakha izindlu zibalulekile kakhulu. allocated to areas that are being redeveloped. related to housing. employment and other sustainability requirements.

Isikhungo sikaZwelonke sezokuXhumana ngoBuchwepheshe bamaKhompiyutha eNingizimu Afrika safakwa ngaphansi kwegama leSikole seZokusakaza saseNingizimu Afrika; inhlangano eyafakwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 21, yase ishintsha igama layo zingu 8 kuJuni ngo-1999. Ngokwesheduli 3 ingxenye A yoMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), ka-1999 (uMthetho1 ka-1999), njengoba uchitshiyelwe, nangokwalo mthetho ongenhla, i-NEMISA inomsebenzi wokubhala le manuwali ezoba yibhuku lomphakathi ngendlela yokuthi umphakathi ukwazi ukuthola amarekhodi ethu. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukwandisa abathuthukisi nabasebenzisi be-ICT abanobungcweti abaphuma emiphakathini enomlando wokucindezelwa, nemiphumela yokwanda kwamakhono emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. I-NEMISA ihlose ukugcina ubuningi babafundi obunabesimame kakhulu. Umbono we-NEMISA ukuba yisikhungo sezemfundo esilandela izindlela ezenzekayo ezincike ekuthuthukiseni ubungoti bezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe bekhompiyutha. Sihlose ukuba ngumholi ovelele ekuthuthukisweni nasekutshalweni kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphokophelele izimboni kumkhakha wezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe bekhompiyutha. Esikuhlosile ukuhlinzeka umkhiqizo oncike kubantu, ongabizi kakhulu, oncike embonini ngokwedlulisela ulwazi nobudlelwano. Iqhinga le-NEMISA ukuqeqesha nokukhiqiza abathwali beziqu abanobungoti obuningi abazoba ngababambiqhaza abavelele kumkhakha wezokusakaza nakowezokuxhumana ngezindlela eziningi ngezinhlelo ezahlukene, izifundo nokusungula.

Uma umphakathi odabukile edinga isixwayiso, isixwayiso singanikezwa ngomlomo. Umphakathi kufanele wazise umphakathi ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokuziphatha kabi, angase abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala, futhi isixwayiso sizobhalwa phansi. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Uma umphakathi ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso esibhaliwe, umphakathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo ezidingekayo uma unikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi. d. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe sithobela umthetho iminyaka eyisithupha. Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele sikhishwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi futhi sibhujiswe. e. Uma umphakathi utholakala enecala phakathi kweminyaka eyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala okufanele azithole. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. Uma umphakathi ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe, umphakathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo ezidingekayo uma unikeza isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi.

Le ndima ingaba isikhathi esigcwele noma esithile, noma kwenziwe ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano. Umphathi - umuntu onikezwe ukuba abe yisikhulu senhlangano ngokuphelele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. Lo muntu uqashwe yibhodi elawulayo ye-NPO futhi ubika kulowo msebenzi ngakho konke okwenzekayo enhlangano nsuku zonke. Umeluleki - izinhlangano eziningi ezingekho phansi kwemali azinazo izinsiza nezimali zokuhola bonke abantu abadingekayo kanye nobuchwepheshe ukuze ziqhube izinhlelo, zenze umsebenzi, futhi ziqoqe imali. Ezinye zalezi zabelo zinganikezwa kubeluleki bangaphandle abaziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngalolo buchwepheshe. Lezi zinqumo zingase zibe ngqo ezicini zalezi zabelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zifushane noma zaphakathi. Abanikeli - umuntu noma isikhungo noma inhlangano enikela ngezinsiza ngokuzithandela izikhathi eziningi, ezingaba yimali, emva kokucela okuningana okwenziwe yinhlangano, ukuze kusekelwe izinhlelo nezindleko zansuku zonke. Umhwebi - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, enhlangano engaphansi kwemali ukuze athole izinsiza noma imali ukuze ahlangabezane nezinhlelo, izenzo ezihlosiwe, nezindleko zokusebenza. Le ndima inganikezwa kumuntu noma kumuntu wangaphandle noma ibhizinisi elizobhekana nokuhweba. Ibhodi elawulayo - iqoqo lamalungu enhlangano engaphansi kwemali akhethwe noma anikezwe ukuba abe abaholi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Ibhodi elawulayo lingabizwa ngokuthi iBhodi, Ibhodi Labaphathi, Ikhansela, noma Ikhansela Lokuphatha.

Ezindaweni ezisingethwe ngokwezifunda, noma yikuphi ukucaphuna okwenziwe emthethweni wesifundazwe olawula intela yendawo noma ukuhlola eziphathimandleni zendawo noma eminye imibutho kahulumeni wasemakhaya, kuthathwa njengekhuluma ngmasipalati ophethe ngalesosikhathi lapho impahla itholakala khona. b Futhi aklame intela yendawo ngokusebenzisa izamba zempahla ezikhonjiswe ephepheni lokuhlola. uma umasipalati esebenzisa amaphepha okuhlola ngokwesigatshana- 1, awayehlelwe ngomasipalati baphambilini abehlukene, umasipalati angabeka amanani ehlukile asuselwe emaphepheni okuhlola ehlukene ukuze intela yezimpahla ezisendaweni efanayo ibe yinye. Lesi sigaba siphela eminyakeni emine kusukela osukwini lomthetho wamenyezelwa ngokusemthethweni, futhi kusukela ngalolosuku nanoma yiliphi iphepha lokuhlola elalisetshenziswa ngaphambi kokuba lomthetho uale ukusebenza ngeke lisasetshenziswa. Isigaba-- 9 asisebenzi mayelana nentela yendawo eklanywe ngokwephepha lokuhlola elenziwe ngaphambi kokuba lomthetho uqale ukusebenza. Isigaba-- 22 asisithinti isibopho senhlangano eyengamele indawo lapho kwakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela egcekei elilodwa endaweni kamasipalati, ngokunjalo nomnikazi wempahla ngayinye enhlanganweni ephethe, mayelana nentela yendawo eklanywe ngokwephepha lokuhlola elenziwe ngaphambi kokuba lomthetho uqle ukusebenza. a Uchitshiyelwe ngendlela ekhonjiswe ohleni lwesithathu lohlelo;futhi b Uyahoxiswa ngendlela okukhonjiswe ngayo ohleni lwesithathu. Lomthetho. Ubizwa NGOKAHULUMENI WASEMAKHAYA: Umthetho wentela yendawo, we- 2003 futhi uqala ukusebenza ngosuku oluyonqunywa ngumongameli wezwe ngokumemezela kusomqulu kaHulumeni. Lomthetho.

Dlamini: Impela. Uma inkohlakalo ikhulile, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zomphakathi zincipha. Lokhu kudala ukungabi nakho kwabantu ukuthola imfundo, ezempilo, noma ezinye izinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemiphakathi emisha engase ibonakale njengoba izinsiza zingatholakali. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nenkohlakalo Umphenyi: Ngabe yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kulwiswe le nkinga? Mnu. Dlamini: Ukugcina izinga lokuphila eliphezulu kubalulekile. Kukho imizamo eminingi yokwakha amakhomishini ezokuhlola kanye nemithetho yokubopha abaphathiswa. Kodwa, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezingokwenhlalo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukubona ubungozi benkohlakalo. Indlela Yokwakha Ukuziphatha Okuhle Umphenyi: Ngabe abantu bangakwenza njani ukuze bakhe ukuziphatha okuhle? Mnu. Dlamini: Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baxhumane, bahlanganyele, futhi bakhulume ngezinkinga zabo. Umphakathi udinga ukwakha ubumbano ukuze uvikele izinqubo zokwenza izinto ezingekho emthethweni. Ukuhlonipha, ukusiza abanye, nokuphila ngokuhlonipha imithetho kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi owaziwayo. Isiphetho Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ingabe unokuthumeleka okuqondile komphakathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukuveza ukuthi abantu kumele bakhumbule ukuthi imiphakathi ithembele kubo. Kufanele basebenzisane ukuze baphumelele. Inkohlakalo ayiyona indlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Lokhu kuhlangene nabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kumele kuqhubeke ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi wethu uthola konke okudingayo. Ngiyabonga.

(QAPHELA: Lokhu akuzokwenzeka njengoba i-COID ihlinzeka ngezindleko zezeMpilo ezingapheli zokulimala okuhlobene nomsebenzi). Izinzuzo zezeMpilo ezingakwazi ukufakwa ukuze zikhokhelwe ngaphansi kwe-COID kumele zifakwe ukuze zikhokhelwe ngaphansi kwale GPA policy. Ukufa ngengozi - 60% yeSalaries yonyaka ephindwe ngo-5 njengoba kuchaziwe. Ukukhubazeka Okuphelele - Iphesenti yeNzuzo Yokufa, kuye ngokuthi kukhona ukukhubazeka okungakanani, isb., ukuzibulala, ukuzilimaza ngenhloso, ukuzibeka engcupheni yengozi, noma ukulimala okucacile (ngaphandle kokuzama ukusindisa impilo yomuntu). Ukufa noma ukukhubazeka okubangelwa isimo somzimba esivele sikhona noma ubuthakathaka (QAPHELA: sicela wazise iGlenrand M·I·B uma unabasebenzi abakhubazekile ukuze sizame ukwandisa ukuvikelwa). Abantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 nabaphezulu kweminyaka engu-75 (kodwa abanye abantu abachazwe kahle bavikelwe kuze kube seminyakeni engu-85). Ukundiza ngaphandle kokuba ungumgibeli. Ukufa noma ukulimala lapho kutholakala ukuthi umuntu ongena emshwalweni ubengaphansi kwethonya likasawoti noma izidakamizwa noma lapho izinga likasawoti egazini lidlula umkhawulo wemithetho. Imidlalo ekhokhelwayo, ukugibela izindiza ezincane, noma ukugibela izindiza ezincane. Ukufa noma ukulimala okubangelwa ukuphula umthetho. Zonke izigameko ezingaholela ekufakweni kwesicelo ngaphansi kwale nqubomgomo kumele zibikwe kuGlenrand M·I·B (ngokusebenzisa uPam Hintsho kubasebenzi bePhalamende noma uLinda Harper kubalawuli bePhalamende) ngokushesha okukhulu kodwa ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezi-3.

Izincwadi zokufakazela lemadlana encane esetshenziselwaukukhokhela izinto ezincane njengobisi, izitembu zokuposa. Yonke lemiqulu kufanele ishicilelwe ebhukwini lezimali (cashbook) elitholakala kunoma isiphi isitolo esidayisa izincwadi. Ukuphatha I akhawunti yasebhangi. Inhlangano yakho kunokuba isinayo inqubomgomo yezezimaliukuhambisa ngomthetho inqubo nenkambiso elandalwayokuzozonke ezeimali. Imvume esemthethweni yokusayina okuthile eziphathelene nezezimali enhlanganweni yakho. Enyeyalezizinqubo, ukuvula ibhuku lasebhange. Amalungiselelo kufanele enziwe nebhangi enifuna ukuvula kulo, bese kuba nababili noma abathathu okuyibona abazosayinaebhange. (Lokhu kuzoya ngokuthi inqubomgomo yenhlanganoithini.) Uma inhlangano ikhetha I akhawunti yesheke, kunaleyoyokulondoloza, ibhange lizoyinika ibhuku lamasheke. Ibhange lithumela inhlangano umbiko (isitatimende) kanyengenyanga esichaza wonke amasheke nezimali ezingenileebhukwini nalawomasheke nezimali eziphumile. Lombiko kumeleusetshenziswe ukuhlolisisa ukuthi imiqulu yezimali ekhona imi ngomumo na. Imibiko yezezimali yonyaka. Inhlangano kumele ilungise imibiko (izitatimende) yezezimaliekupheleni kwalowo nalowo nyaka wezimali. Lombiko uzonikaisithombe esiphelele ngemali engenile nezindleko ezibekhona, kanye nemali esele kulowonyaka. Kujwayelekile ukuthi lokhu kungeniswe ingakapheli inyangaemva kokuphela konyaka wezimali. Umcwaningi ozimele kumele ahlole amabhuku enhlanganominyaka yonke ukuze abone ukuthi konke kwenziwa ngendlelaeyiyo.

Ofake isicelo onikezwe imvume yokufinyelela irekhodi kumele akhokhe inkokhelo yokufinyelela yokufuna, nokuphinde kukhishwe, ukulungiselelwa kanye nezikhathi esidingekayo ukufinyelela samahora abekiwe okufuna nokulungiselela amarekhodi ukuze avezwe, kufakwa nokwenza ukulungiselelwa ukuze yenziwe ukuba itholakale efomini lokucela. Uma ngabe ukufunwa kwerekhodi sekwenziwe nokulungiselelwa kwerekhodi ezovezwa, kufakwa noma yikuphi ukuhlelwa kokuthi itholakale ngohlobo ecelwe ngalo, kudinga amahora edlula abekwe emthethweni ngale nhloso, i-Ofisa Yolwazi izokwazisa ofake isicelo ukuba akhokhe, njengediphozithi, ingxenye ebekiwe yenkokhelo yokufinyelela okuzodingeka ukuba ikhokhwe uma isicelo sivunyiwe. I-Ofisa Yolwazi izawugodla irekhodi kuze kube yisikhathi lapho ofake isicelo ekhokha izinkokhelo njengoba zibekiwe. Uma ngabe idiphozithi ikhokhiwe ngokuphathelene nesicelo sokufinyelela esenqatshelwe, ngalokho i-Ofisa Yolwazi ephathekayo izawubuyisela idiphozithi kofake isicelo. I-SAMSA izawuthi ezinsukwini ezingama-30 emva kokuthola isicelo, ithathe isinqumo sokuthi iyasivuma noma iyasenqaba isicelo, ngokweseka ngokubekwe Ngumthetho. Isikhathi esiyizinsuku ezingama-30 ngaphakathi kokuthi i-SAMSA kumele ithathe isinqumo sokunikeza noma sokwenqabela isicelo singongezwa ukuya esikhathini esinye ngokulandela Isigaba sama-26 Somthetho.

Abantu bayesaba ukushintsha ngoba bayazama nje ukuphumelela. Ukwesweleka kwe-infrastructure - kakhulukazi imigwaqo, amasayilo nezindawo zokomisa ukudla okuzinhlamvu. Ukusweleka kwemishini ezokulimeni - ogandaganda, amaskofela, amapulantela, imishini yokufafaza, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Ukusweleka kokusekela izinto zokuqala ukulima. Ukusweleka kokuthola imali yokukhiqithiza. Ukusweleka kokungena ekumakethini. Ukusweleka kokunikeza isisekelo esivela eminyangweni kahulumeni. Isimo sokunikeza (kuqale kugavumente owakuqala kwasekwandiswe isikhimu esikhulu saseEastern Cape sokunikeza ukudla). Ukusweleka kolwazi namakhono. Ukusweleka kwabantu abahamba phambili, abavulindlela - bonke balima ezindaweni ezincane futhi balimela ukudla kwabo kuphela. Ukuqasha abankontilaki bese kukhuphuka ithuba lokuvelelwa ingozi ngoba abasebenzi kahle futhi nezindleko zokukhiqiza ziyanda. IPhrogramu leGrain SA Lokuthuthukisa Abalimi libhekene kakhulu ngokukhiqiza ummbila. Sesingabuza ukuthi kungani sibhekisise kakhulu ummbila? Ummbila ngukudla okuvamileyo, ngakho-ke ukwandisa ukukhiqiza ummbila kuyasiza ukuqinisa ukuthi kuzobakhona ukudla nakusasa futhi kukhona imakethe likhona lapha (kusuka kummbila oseluhlaza (isikhwebu) kuya kuzinhlamvu ezivuthiwe). Ummbila ukhiqizwa ngabalimi lapha, lokhu kusho ukuthi lukhona ulwazi olungasetshenziswa ukuqhubekela phambili. Omningi ummbila usetshenziswa lapha, futhi ubekwa ngabalimi emakhaya - ngakho-ke akudingeki intilansipoti, indawo yokomisa nendawo enkulu yokubeka. Ummbila uyisitshalo esimila kalula futhi omningi umsebenzi ungenziwa ngezandla (lapho kungekho imishini).

noma "Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo?" Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezifanele. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngalezi zeluleko ezibalulekile. Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukukwabelana ngakho mayelana ne-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baqonda ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsiza ewusizo, kodwa kufanele bazi kahle izinqubo nezidingo ukuze bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa kahle. Futhi, bahlale bexhumana nomnyango wezabasebenzi ukuze bazi izinguquko ezithinta i-GEMS. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinto eziningi ezithakazelisayo. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngiyethemba ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abacabanga ngokujoyina i-GEMS.

Ukuze sikhulise ubuchwepheshe bethu, kufanele kube nezinsiza ezinengqondo ezisekelwe ezikhaleni zokudlala, izikole, nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, kugcinwa umphakathi kuphela engapheli, umphakathi omnyama kakhulu. Ukuxhaswa ngobuchwepheshe, ukukwazi ukwakha ithuba lokudala izindawo ezisemqoka kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze sikhulise ibhizinisi lethu elinempilo. Okwamanje, ukusebenzisa ithenisi njengendlela yokuthuthukisa impilo kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ukufaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukuzivocavoca, ikakhulukazi kumakhaya ezingane, kuyoba nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imiphumela yokuphila. Uma sikhuluma ngethenisi, sisebenzisa ukuba yimpumelelo, sikhombisa ubungcweti, futhi sihlinzeka ngamathuba angcono obuhlakani. Ithimba, kepha umphakathi ubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi omkhulu. Ekugcineni, ithenisi ingaphezu kwenkundla, iyindawo yokukhuthaza umphakathi. Abadlalayo, abaxhasi, nababukeli bahlala bejabulisa kalula, futhi umphakathi uyavuleka ngezinto ezizwayo ezikhuluma ngempilo. Umdlalo unikeza izifundo ezibaluleke kakhulu - ukuthi ukuphikelela, ukuzinikela, nokuhlonipha kuyoba yizinto ezibalulekile ezizobakhumbuza onke umuntu. Lokhu kuyisisekelo sikhumbula ukuthi ithenisi, njengenqubo, yizinto ezinkulu ezenzakalayo emhlabeni. Ngokuqhubeka kokudlalwa kwezenzo, sizokwazi ukubona ukuthi ithenisi iyindlela ebanzi yokuvuselela umphakathi. Zilokhu zikhula, ziqhuba njalo, futhi zikhombisa amandla enhloso neqhaza. Okwamanje, umhlaba ubheke phambili kanye nezenzo zethu ukuze isikhumbuzo sibuye singafani. Ukuphila, uthando, nokuhlakanipha - konke kuboniswe emidlalweni yeqembu labadlalayo abaninzi njengoba behamba phambili.

Sibeke isamba sezigidi ezingu-632.5 zamaRandi ukuze sikwazi ukunikeza lolu hlelo kanye nezinye ezihambisana nalo. Lemali inyuke ngezigidiezi-77.6 zamaRandi, uma uqhathanisa nemali eyayabelwe lolu hlelo eyizigidi ezingu-554.9 zamaRandi ngonyaka wezimali odlule. Sisahlalelwe umsebenzi onzima wokuqinisekisa ukuthi siphinde sengeze isibalo sama-Ambulensi, kusuka kulesi sibalo esinaso sama-Ambulensi angama-442 kuya kuma-960 ukuze sihambisane nemigomo kahulumeni kuzwelonke. Sibheke ukuthi sithole ama-Ambulensi amasha angama-147 ukuze isibalo sethu sama-Ambulensi sifinyelele kuma-598. Okusiphethe kabi, Sihlalo oHloniphekile, ukwentuleka kwabasebenzi bosizo lokuqala emkhakheni we-Advanced Life Support ne-Intermediate Life Support. Ngamanye amazwi abasebenzi bale mikhakha ekwaziyo ukuthi basize ezimweni eziphuthumayo mihla namalanga. Nakuba kunjalo sizothatha izinyathelo ezibonakalayo ukuthi sizigcwalise lezikhala. UMnyango weZempilo uzimisele ukuba nezivumelwano nabaphathi bezinkampani zama-Medical Aid ukuthi banxenxe amalunga abo asebenzise izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni, njengoba lokhu kuzokhuphula inzuzo yethu. Sikhuluma nje sesiphothuliwe isivumelwano noMnyango wezokuVikela, isivumelwano sithi uMnyango weZempilo uzobahlinzeka ngosizo lwezokwelashwa kubasebenzi babo namalunga emindeni yabo. Esikhathini esingaphambili, abasebenzi bezombutho wezokuvikela babethola usizo lwezokwelashwa ezibhedlela zangasese. Ukuze siqinisekise ukusebenza kwaloluhlelo, sizodinga uhlelo olunqala lokukhokhisa nokuqashwa kwabaphathi abafanele ezikhungweni eziqokiwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isifundazwe sizuza ngokufanele kulolu hlelo.

Emhlanganweni wokuqala, amalungu ekomidi kufanele ahlanganyele lokho abafuna ukukufeza njengamalungu ekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Cela uMphakathi ukuthi akhe uhlu lokuthi amalungu angatholakala kanjani bese wonke amalungu ekomidi athola ikhophi. Bheka i-Appendix 12 ukuze uthole isibonelo sohlaka lwamalungu ekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Kungavunywa ukuthi imihlangano ibanjwe. Hlela umhlangano wokuhlela unyaka. Lokhu kungaba umhlangano ophuthumayo noma kumkhankaso olandelayo. Izikhundla ezifana nezokwakha, ezempilo, ezokwelashwa, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nezinye. Ukuthatha imizuzu yazo zonke izihlanganiso kuyisibopho sikaMongameli kanye nekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Abantu babuyela emizuzwini ukuze bahlaziye izinqumo ezenziwe emhlanganweni. Nikeza isaziso somhlangano. Nika isaziso ngaleso sikhathi nendawo ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi. Njengoba kushiwo, uMphakathi uyena ophatha lokhu. UMongameli uzovula umhlangano futhi afunde uhlelo ngendlela. Kufanele abhale phansi bonke abakhona. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokuba ne-rekhodi noma uhlu lwabavakashi. Bheka i-Appendix 13 ukuze uthole isibonelo se-rekhodi yokuhamba. Izincwadi: lezi yizincwadi ezithunyelwa ekomidini noma lezo ezithunyelwa ngekomidi. Le dokhumenti kufanele yaziwe ekomidini ngoba ithunyelwa ngaphansi kwamandla awo. Omunye ummember kufanele ethule futhi aqale ingxoxo ngendaba ethile. Lokhu kungaba ukusiza ukucacisa iphuzu elivele lukhulunywe mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwe nokuthi yini esele. Khumbula ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi bonke amalungu ekomidi babambe iqhaza emhlanganweni. UMongameli akakwazi ukuhola umhlangano.

Ngemuva kokutholwa nguNobhala kwesaziso senhloso yesinyathelo sokuphikisa, noma lapho isicelo sitholwe sekwedlule isikhathi esibekiwe, udaba luyophothulwa ngokulandela imiyalelo ekhishwe nguMphathimaJaji , imiyalelo ingabandakanya a umyalelo wokwethula eNkantolo iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe kulabo abaziphendulelayo ngesikhathi esithile ngenhloso yokuthola uvo lwabo ngokunikwa kwemvume yokufinyelela ngqo okuceliwe; noma b umyalelo okhomba ukuthi azidingeki iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe noma imibiko efungelwe. Izicelo zokufinyelela ngqo zingadingidwa ngokufingqiwe ngaphandle kwenkulumo-mpikiswano yomlomo noma ebhaliwe ngaphandle kwaleyo equkethwe esicelweni uqobo. Inqobo uma lowo oziphendulelayo eyichazile inhloso yesinyathelo sokuphikisa ngokulandisa komtheshwana- 3, isicelo sokufinyelela ngqo siyokhishwa kuphela ngemuva kokuhambisana nemibandela yomtheshwana -4a. Inqubo ethulwe kulo mthetho iyolandelwa ngesikhathi kwenziwa isicelo sethuba lokwedlulisa isikhalo eNkantolo lapho isinqumo ngodaba lomthethosisekelo ngaphandle kwesinqumo esithinta ukungahambisani nomthethosisekelo esichazwe esigabeni -1722a soMthethosisekelo sikhishwe ngenye yezinkantolo, kuhlanganisa Inkantolo Ephakeme Yokwedlulisa Izikhalo, akukhathalekile ukuthi Umongameli usenqabile isicelo sethuba elejwayelekile noma elehlukile lokwedlulisa udaba.

Uma ufuna ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho lokulima ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukusetha imigomo nezinhlelo zakho. Awukwazi ukuhamba endleleni ungazi ukuthi uhamba kuphi. Ngokuvamile, abakhiqizi baziwa njengabangenakho noma abaphoxekile ngokungasethi imigomo yebhizinisi noma yokuphila. Kunzima ukuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima ngoba izimo zomsebenzi lo azilula; awazi ukuthi ikusasa lizoba kanjani. Kudinga isikhathi esiningi ukuhlanganisa imigomo ecacile yebhizinisi lokulima. Kokubili lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa izinjongo akufanele kushiywe ngemuva, nakuba kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi. Imigomo nezinhlelo (amasu) zikhombisa indlela phambili; ngaphandle kwazo, awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi uzophumelela noma uphumelele. Ngaphandle kwemigomo, awukwazi ukukala ukuthi usebenza kahle ngoba awunanto oyihlosile. Ukuhlanganisa inhloso nokusetha imigomo emsebenzini wokulima kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi, kodwa kubalulekile ukwenza lo msebenzi; kumele siwenze. Ukusetha nokuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima kuvame ukuza nezinkinga. Isizathu salokhu sitholakala lapha: ukulima kuyindlela yokusebenza komlimi futhi kuyindlela umlimi aphila ngayo (kuwukuphila kwabo). Umndeni wabo ungowengxenye yezinto ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabo wokulima kanye nokuphila kwabo. Ngokuvamile, siyazi ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yebhizinisi ukwenza inzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kodwa ekulimaleni, lokhu akuhambisani njalo ngoba ibhizinisi nempilo yokuphila kuhlangene. Singasho ukuthi imigomo yalomsebenzi ingaba ukwenza inzuzo enhle, kodwa akufanele ilethe umlimi nomndeni wakhe ubunzima. Izinjongo ezihlanganisiwe ngenhla azichaziwe kahle futhi zingabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene.

Omele iBhodi obekelwe lesisizathu unelungelo lokukhipha amlayisense okusebenza ngaphansi kwesigtshana 1, ngaphezu kwezimiso ezikhona kwenye indawo kulo Mthetho. Lapho uhlelo olufanele lubonisa isidingo sezithuthi ezifakelwe isicelo, Ibhodi kumele lamukele lesosicelo, ngokuhambisana nanoma yimiphi imigomo ebekiwe ngokwohlelo, ngaphandle kokuthi kungumbono, ngokwezimo ezibalwe kwizindinyana a kuya ku d zesigatshana 7, ezithi umfaki sicelo noma imoto ayikho esimweni sokusebenza. Lapho izinhlelo zingalungiswanga noma zingakaphethwa, iBhodi kumele libhekele izimo ezibalwe kwizindima a kuya ku j zesigatshana 7 ekuthatheni isinqumo sokuthi lichithe noma lamukele isicelo. Lapho izicelo zamalayisense okusebenza zingaphezu kokuba iBhodi lingawakhipha ngokwezinhlelo ezifanele, kumele kuqalwe ngezicelo zokuvuselela amalayisense bese kuthi uma uhlelo lungakwazi ukufaka ezinye izithuthi, kubhekelwa lezo zimo ezibalwe kwizindimaa a kuya ku j zesigatshana 7 ekuhloleni izicelo. ix uma iBhodi lithatha lesosinqumo, ilayisense yesitende noma amandla afanayo akhishwe ngaphansi komthetho kamasipala wendawo onika amandla okusethsenziswa kwesitende noma irenki, noma isincomo esiphuma kumasipala ofanele sokuthi indawo yerenki ikhona; noma x ezinye izimo okuthi, ngokombono we Bhodi, zingathinta ukulangaza ukuvuma noma ukuchitha isicelo. IBhodi alikwazi ukubhekela isicelo selayisense yokusebenza esifakwe ngumqashwa wesiphathimandla sezokuthutha, ummeli wesikhungo sezogcinomthetho noma ifemu yokubhekela ezokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi endaweni. nokuthi lesisicelo asidingi ukusakazwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 42.

Le mali yenkontileka (bona isiGaba 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo usuphelele nao zonke izinto eziyizinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi woWENKONTILEKA Inqobo, lokho kubanjwa kwemali kuhambisana nomThetho othize, iyobanjwa emholweni woWENKONTILEKA. OWENKONTILEKA uyamxolela u-SAPS maqondana nanoma yimuphi umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okudalwe ukulimala emzimbemi, ukulahleka kwempilo, ukulahleka noma ukulimala kwempahla noma ngabe kudalwe ngu SAPS noma omunye umuntu oseceleni noma ngabe udalwe noma kungenxa yobudedengu obube khona ngezikhathi oyilungu lika-SAPS egcina umyalelo, futhi uyamxolela u-SAPS kunoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa, ukulimala, indleko noma inani lokukhokhwa maqondana nokuqhubekayo enkantolo okuqondene NOWENKONTILEKA nokungase kuhambisane nokufunwa imali noma ukuboshwa ngandlela thize. Le SIVUMELWANO sizoqala ukusebenza futhi sibe yisibopho kusukela osukwini esisayinwe ngaso le SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo nje uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO engasisayini kanye kanye AMAQEMBU, usuku lokugcina lokusayina kwelinye lamaqembu luyothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kokusebenza. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, zizoqhubeka isikhathi esithize esilingene (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi), okuyoqala ngosuku okuqala ngalo ukuthi le SIVUMELWANO siqale ukusebenza (bheka isiGaba 12.1 ngezansi).
