Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko ngenxa yokulibaziseka. Ukulahleka ngenxa yokunganeliseki kwezinga. Izithiyo ekuqaliseni kwephrojekthi. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, sithula le bhajethi yeVoti 8 siqonda ngokuphelele amaphuzu aphakanyisiwe. Siyaqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi ukuntuleka kwekhono kuthinta bonke ababambiqhaza. Uhulumeni nomkhakha ozimele bayavuma ukuthi kukhona ukuntuleka kwekhono. Njengoba sizama ukuxazulula ukuntuleka kwekhono ezingeni lesifunda nelokhu, siqonda ukuthi ozakwethu emkhakheni ozimele nabo babhekana nokuntuleka kwekhono. Isibonelo salokhu wukuthi kudingeka sande inani labafundi abhalisile nabakhiqizwayo emkhakheni wezobunjiniyela. Asikwazi ukususa ngokuphelele inkinga yokuntuleka kwamakhono obuchwepheshe uma izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme zingakwazi ukuheha nokuqeqesha inani elanele labafundi emikhakheni efanele. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, umbono omusha wezindlu, onikeza umqondo walebhajethi, ugcine umgomo wayo oyinhloko wokukhuthaza umphakathi ongabandakanyi futhi ongenamahluko ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezizinzile nezanele. Le bhajethi iyisibonakaliso sokuzibophezela kwethu ekusizeni ukunciphisa ukungalingani kwezomnotho nezobuhlanga ekuhlinzekeni ngezindlu. Ngamanye amazwi, sihlanganisile ibhajethi esamukela ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa komnotho kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlala. Nokho, lokhu akusho ukuthi siyayishiya izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu ezigxile kakhulu kulezi zindawo ezihamba phambili kwezomnotho.

Uma imvume ebhaliwe neqondwe emtheshwaneni 1 ingatholakalanga, noma ngubani onentshisekelo odabeni oluphambi kwezithebe zenkantolo angafaka isicelo kuMphathimaJaji ngenhloso yokwemukelwa njengomuntu ofuna ukubamba iqhaza, UmphathimaJaji angakhipha imvume evuna isicelo ngaphansi kwemibandela namagunya kanjalo namalungelo nemigomo eliyibona ifanele. Uma zingabekiwe izikhathi emiyalelweni odabeni olusezithebeni zenkantolo, kuyokwenziwa isicelo esihambisana nemibandela yomtheshwana 4, lesi sicelo siyofakwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu ngemuva kokwethulwa kombiko obhaliwe wommangalelwa noma sekwedlule leso sikhathi sokwethula imibiko. c siyokweneka kusenesikhathi imibiko eyothulwa ngumuntu ofuna ukuba yingxenye yodaba, ukubaluleka kwayo mayelana nodaba olusezithebeni zenkantolo nezizathu zakhe zenkolelo yokuthi umbiko othulwayo uyoba wusizo eNkantolo nokuthi kungani wehlukile kuleyo ethulwe ngamanye amaqembu. Umuntu ofuna ukuba yingxenye yodaba enkantolo unelungelo lokwethula impikiswano yakhe ebhaliwe, inqobo uma leyo mpikiswano ebhaliwe ingaphindaphindi udaba noma impikiswano evele seyethuliwe enkantolo ngamanye amaqembu kanjalo inosizo oluqubula impikiswano noma umbono omusha nongaba wusizo Enkantolo.

Izindleko zokupakisha zifaka phakathi ukwehlukanisa, izinto zokupakisha, umsebenzi, ukugcina, umshwalense, njll. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi izinto, ukuthuthwa, ukupakisha, ukuhlanganisa, umsebenzi, ugesi, njll. Ukuze unciphise izindleko emugqeni wokuthengisa, ungasebenzisa umgudu omfushane ngokuthengisa ngqo kumthengi. Ukwengeza inani ngokupakisha nokugcina izintengo ukuze zenze zibe nentshisekelo kukhiqiza imali eningi. Ukwengeza inani ngokucubungula kukhuphula inani lomkhiqizo ngamunye futhi kukhuphula imali engenayo... Abalimi bathengisa imikhiqizo ngqo kubathengi. Abalimi bathengisa kubathengi noma abantu abathenga ukuze bathengise. Ukuthengiswa kwenziwa ngababambiqhaza bemakethe abathengisa kumlimi futhi bathola ikhomishini. Ikhwalithi, ukupakisha, nokubukeka kubalulekile kakhulu, futhi umkhiqizo kufanele uhambisane nezindinganiso zokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi ezamukelekayo nezindinganiso zokupakisha. Izikhungo ezivalwe zokukhiqiza izilwane zinikeza umsebenzi wokuthengisa kubalimi. Umlandeli uthengisa ngqo kumhwebi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokwakha. Ikhwalithi, intengo, nokulethwa kubalulekile kakhulu. Inhlangano yababalimi ithengisa isivuno ngokuhlanganyela emakethe esemthethweni. Urelationship phakathi kwezindleko nentengo = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa.

Le SIVUMELWANO sizoqala ukusebenza futhi sibe yisibopho kusukela osukwini esisayinwe ngaso le SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo nje uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO engasisayini kanye kanye AMAQEMBU, usuku lokugcina lokusayina kwelinye lamaqembu luyothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kokusebenza. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, zizoqhubeka isikhathi esithize esilingene (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi), okuyoqala ngosuku okuqala ngalo ukuthi le SIVUMELWANO siqale ukusebenza (bheka isiGaba 12.1 ngezansi). Le SIVUMELWANO singavuselelwa ngokukhetha kwe SAPS ngokuthi kubhalwe phansi ngemvume YOWENKONTILEKA kube okwesikhathi esithize esibekiwe: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS eyokwazi ukuthi esimweni esifana naleso naye anikeze isaziso esibhaliwe kwisiGaba 13.2 ngenhla, singakapheli isikhathi sale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla), anikeze OWENKONTILEKA ukuthi ufuna ukusivuselela ISIVUMELWANO. Okuqukethwe yile SIVUMELWANO kuyoba futhi iyona ngqokithi yesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokwesiGaba 13.2 ngenhla. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizoziphelela ngokwaso ekupheleni kwesikhathi esilingene (Bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi). Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela engakapheli amaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi yosuku olulodwa.

a acaphune kunoma yimuphi usomqulu noma kunoma yiluphi ulwazi akholelwa wukuthi ludingekile kulokho kuhlola; bese b ebhalela umnikazi noma lowo ohleli endlini noma lowo okhuluma egameni lomnikazi noma lalowo ohleli ukuba amnikeze imininingwane ebhalwe phansi emayelana nendlu umhloli akholelwa wukuthi idingekile kulokho kuhlola. b ngasebenzisi isikhundla sokuba wumhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati ngenhloso yokuba yena azinothise noma anothise omunye umuntu ngokungekho emthethweni; bese c ahambisane nendlela yokuziphatha ebalulwe ohlelweni- 2 Lomthetho Wezinhla Zomasipalati. umhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati owephula noma owehluleka ukuhambisana nesigatshana -1 unecala lokungaziphathi kahle futhi angase abhekane nokuxoshwa njengomhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati. isinqumo sokuxosha umhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- 3 kufanele kususelwe kulokho okutholwe wuphenyo olwenziwe ngokulandisa komthetho wabasebenzi ongunombolo-- 66 we- 1995. umhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati ongesona isikhulu sakwamasipalati owephula noma owehluleka ukuhambisana nesigatshana- 1 unecala futhi isivumelwano sokusebenza kwakhe singase sihoxiswe. b kusezinhlosweni zokuqhuba Izigaba- zalomthethio c kusezinhlosweni zokuthethwa kwecala; noma d kulandelwa umyalelo wenkantolo. impahla kufanele ihlolwe ngokulandela izindlela ezemukeleke ngokudidiyele, kanye nezigaba zalomthetho.

Ukufuya izimphahla esibayeni noma esigangeni nokuhlanganisa ummbila ngezinye izinto zokufuya lezo zimphahla kungaba isizathu sokukhiqiza ummbila. Futhi ummbila ungaba isitshalo esibalulekile epulazini lapho kushintshwa khona izinhlobo zezitshalo njalonjalo. Ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukulinganisa nokubala zonke lezi zinto uma ufuna ukuthola inani lentengiso eliyi'minimami' - khumbula ukubala nalezo zenzelelo (izinzuzo) ezihambelana nokukhiqiza umvuno othile. Usebhizinisini, ngakho-ke uma ufuna ukuqhubekela phambili ngale bhizinisi yakho kufanele uthole inzuzo njalo ngayo imisebenzi oyenzayo epulazini yakho. Kunzima ukuba umlimi okhiqiza ukudla - kukhona eziningi izinto ezifuna zihlolwe ngaphambi kokuthatha izinyathelo ezithile. Uma ushiye ukwenza ukumaketha umvuno ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi awuqondi kahle ukuthi kufanele uqhubeke kanjani, kungcono ukuvakashela i-Agri-business eliseduze nawe ukuthola umlayezo. Qaphela kodwa ukuthi usithola kuphi iseluleko, kukhona abantu abaqotho abalungile lapho ngaphandle abakwazi ukukusiza - bafune uze ubathole!

Inqobo nje uma le likheli elingenhla lingashintshwa ngokubhalwe phansi linikezwe leli elinye iqembu, bese liqala ukusebenza emva kwezinsuku eziyishumi sinikeziwe isaziso: Inqobo nje uma ikheli elisha elikhethiwe yiqembu lizobe nalo lingaphansi kwendawo lapho kunokuhanjiswa khona amaphepha. Noma yisiphi isaziso esinikeziwe maqondana nale SIVUMELWANO singahanjiswa ngesandla, noma sithunyelwe ngeposi elikhokhelwe: Inqobo nje uma noma yisiphi isaziso nomaamaphepha ahanjiswe kwiqembu maqondana nanoma yiluphi udaba noma isihloko kule SIVUMELWANO nanoma yisiphi isaziso siyothathwa njengesidlulisiwe uma sinikezwe umuntu omdala ekhelini lomthetho elikhethwe yinoma yiliphi lamaqembu futhi angeke kube nesidingo sokunikeza iqembu ngqo. ngosuku lwesikhombisa kusukela osukwini lokuyiposa, okubala usuku lokuyiposa, uma iposwe ngokurejistiwe; futhi ngosuku ethunyelwe ngalo uma ithunyelwe ngefeksi. Noma yisiphi isinyathelo esibopha u-SAPS, kufanele sithathwe ngokwesigaba esifanele nesisemthethweni somThetho wamaPhoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, ka 1995 (umThetho onguNombolo 68 ka 1995), noma owelama wona emthethweni. Ukuthi, okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO uchazelwe kona OWENKONTILEKA. Ukuthi, SIVUMELWANO uyavuma ukuthi uyakuqonda konke okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO.

Ipasipoti yesikhathi esiphuthumayo yidokhumende edingeka ngokuphuthumayo lapho unenhloso yokuhamba ukuya kumazwe angomakhelwane angadingi ivisa. Ipasipoti yesikhathi esiphuthumayo ingasetshenziswa nokubuya ngokuphuthumayo eNingizimu Afrika. Isebenza izinyanga eziyisishagalolonye ukusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa kwayo, kodwa ngeyokuhamba uhambo olulodwa kuphela ukuya kulelo lizwe oya kulo kanye nokubuyela eNingizimu Afrika. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma yiliphi ihhovisi lezaseKhaya eNingizimu Afrika. nezithombe ezine zosayizi wepasipoti. Isicelo singathatha ukufinyelela kwizinsuku ezinhlanu zokusebenza.

Abadlali Bebhola Abadumile: Umhlaba Wokudlalela Ubhola Ngaphansi kwelanga elikhanyayo, umhlaba ubonakala uthokozisa ngempela uma kukhulunywa ngabadlali bebhola abadumile. Lezi zinkanyezi zibhakabhaka ezinkundleni, zishaya izigigaba ezimnandi, futhi zishiya izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele ezizokhumbuleka unomphela. Kulokhu, sizobheka abanye babezikhumbuzo ezinkulu emhlabeni wobhola, ababe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umdlalo, nokuthi baphinde bahlonishwe ngempela. U-Diego Maradona: Umphakathi Wokudlala U-Diego Maradona, owaziwa njengenkanyezi ye-Argentina, ungomunye wabantu abavelele emlandweni wobhola. UMaradona, ophumelele kakhulu ngesikhathi sakhe, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani bokudlala bungaguqula umphakathi. Ngonyaka we-1986, waphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba, lapho akhombisa khona ubuchwepheshe obungakaze bubonwe. UMaradona, owaziwa ngempela ngama-dribbles akhe amangalisayo, waba yisithonjana sokuphumelela, futhi usenayo imithombo eminingi yokukhumbula, ehlanganisa nezithombe ezikhumbulekayo. U-Pele: Umhlaba Wokuhlonipha U-Pele, ongumfana waseBrazil, ungomunye wabantu abahlonishwa kakhulu emlandweni wobhola. Njengomdlali ophumelele, uPele waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eBrazil. Uthole ama-trophy amaningi, kuhlanganisa neNdebe yoMhlaba ezintathu, okwenza waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni jikelele. U-Pele uphinde waba umphakathi wokuhlonipha, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene.

Isibonelo: ngemuva kokugaya ummbila, kufanele uphume (uphake) ngaphambi kokuthengiswa, uma ukudla kuyinkwa esetshenziselwa ukuvusa utshwala, kufanele kube nomsebenzi wokuqala ngaphambi kokuthengiswa. Kulomsebenzi wonke, kukhona abantu abaningi nemisebenzi eminingi eyakha uhlelo lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ngamunye wabo ufanele ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nezinkampani zabo. Manje singabuza futhi - ingabe le ndaba yokwenyuka kwem prices yokudla ingabekwa kuphela kumlimi (umkhiqizi)? Iyini intengo yotshwala (ubhiya) engaphansi kuka-3% wentengo yemakethe yommbila? Ukusebenzisa ibhizinisi kuhlobene nokungena engozini - zonke izinkampani zibhekana nezingozi ezithile. Abakhiqizi bahlaselwa nje ukuba bamukele intengo yemakethe - abakwazi ukucacisa ukuthi bafuna malini nge-ton yommbila ngoba yonke imikhiqizo yokudla ithengiswa emakethe - banikezwa intengo yosuku. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi uphushwa ukuba wamukele intengo yokuvuna engaphansi kwezindleko zokukhiqiza leyo mvuno. Isibonelo: unyaka odlule eFree State bekubi kakhulu futhi imvula ibingalungile. Ezindaweni eziningi, abalimi bahluleka ukuvuna ngisho ne-ton eyodwa yommbila nge-hectare. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ummbila zishintsha zibe ngu-R4,200 nge-hectare, kanti intengo yemakethe ngaleso sikhathi bekuyi-R3,000 nge-ton. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umlimi evuna i-ton eyodwa nge-hectare, ulahlekelwa (udliwa) ngu-R1,200 nge-hectare. Uma ungumthosi, uzothenga ufulawa bese unquma ukuthi uzothengisela malini imikhiqizo yakho ephekiwe.

Le ndima inganikezwa kumuntu noma kumuntu wangaphandle noma ibhizinisi elizobhekana nokuhweba. Ibhodi elawulayo - iqoqo lamalungu enhlangano engaphansi kwemali akhethwe noma anikezwe ukuba abe abaholi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Ibhodi elawulayo lingabizwa ngokuthi iBhodi, Ibhodi Labaphathi, Ikhansela, noma Ikhansela Lokuphatha. Isitatimende somsebenzi - isitatimende esifushane esichaza inhloso nezinto ezihlosiwe zenhlangano engaphansi kwemali, sichaza isizathu sokuba khona kwenhlangano. Isitatimende somsebenzi kufanele sihlolwe njalo. Umphakathi - umuntu onikezwe igunya lokubamba isikhundla futhi abe namandla okuphatha nokubhekelela ngaphakathi kwenhlangano noma i-NPO. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke ngokukhonza ngenhloso yokuhola inhlangano nokuhola ngokuziphatha kahle noma ngokuphatha; njengomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. I-NPO yamukela izimiso zokuzilawula ezimweni ezibalulekile ezidinga ukucaciswa. Iziqu zikhomba izindinganiso ezisemqoka zenhlangano futhi zisebenza njengemiyalezo eyisisekelo yesitatimende somsebenzi wenhlangano. Lezi zinciphisa imibuzo mayelana nokuthi inhlangano isebenza kanjani ezingeni elihlukene futhi zikhombisa ukuthi izosetshenziswa kanjani esikhathini esizayo. Umphathi wephrojekthi - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, kwi-NPO njengomphathi noma uhlelo olwakhiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso. Akuvamile ukuthi le mthwalo unikezwe kumuntu wangaphandle noma ibhizinisi. Umhwebi - umuntu noma isikhungo esisekela i-NPO ngokuqondile, noma izenzo zayo noma imicimbi, kuvame ukukhuthaza abaxhasi noma imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zabaxhasi.

Mphathi wohlelo, ngaphambi kokuthi ngiqhubeke nenkulumo engizoyethula bengizocela ukuthi sigebise amakhanda umzuzu owodwa ukukhombisa ukuhlonipha abafowethu nodadewethu abebengabokufika kuleli bephuma kwamanye amazwe esakhelene nawo lapha kwizwekazi lakithi lase Africa abasishiyile emhlabeni ngenxa yezenzo zobunswelaboya ebezibhekiswe kubo ngabantu abebengenwe ngumoya wobulwane nokungahloniphi amalungelo abanye abantu. Ngiyabonga. Mphathi wohlelo, kuyangithokozisa ukuthi namhlanje kunguMgqibelo osukwini lokugcina enyangeni kaMeyi sihlangene lapha KwaDinane ukuzokwethula uhlelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi kunokudla okwanele kwimiphakathi yakithi. Ngikusho lokhu mphathi wohlelo ngoba udaba olusematheni kulezizinsuku umhlaba wonke-jikelele yilo phela lolu lwamanani aphezulu okudla okukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi awezukehla kepha asazoqhubeka eya ngokwenyuka. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule iNhlangano yeZizwe imbala kanye nezinhlangano ezinkulu ezibolekisa ngezimali emazweni asethuthuke kakhulu ezifana no International Monetary Fund kanye ne World Bank zaphawula zakhombisa ukukhathazeka kakhulu ngalesisimo samanani okudla asemba eqolo ikakhulukazi umthelela omubi lokhu okuwubangayo kubantu abampofu emazweni asathuthuka njengaleli lakithi. Ungqongqoshe weziMali wakuleli uMhlonishwa uTrevor Manuel ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule utshele umhlangano we International Monetary Fund owawuhlangene eMelika ukuthi lokhu kunyuka kwamanani okudla okukhombisa ukungami kusho into eyodwa vo: abantu nemiphakathi ikakhulukazi lena ehlala emazweni asathuthuka kumele babuyele emkhakheni wezolimo ukuze baziphilise.

Isikhungo sokuqala sokunakekelwa kwezempilo sasungulwa endaweni yasePholela lapha eKwaZulu-Natal ngo-1948, iminyaka engamashumi amathathu ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwe-Alma Ata Declaration ngonyaka ka-1978, njengendlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu. Umndeni wezempilo emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezweni elithuthukayo, uyavuma ukuthi kufanele siqinise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo uma sifuna ukubhekana kahle nomthwalo wokulwa nezifo. Sibe nemicimbi ehlukahlukene ngonyaka odlule lapho sakhuluma ngezaziso ezihlukahlukene zezempilo kumiphakathi. Kulonyaka sizokwakha kulokho njengesisekelo sigxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunomthelela ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi sisebenze ndawonye ekuxoxeni ngezihloko noma izindaba ezihlobene nezempilo, futhi ngaleyo ndlela sizokhula ndawonye. Ngithemba ukuthi ngalokhu sizobona intuthuko nezinkomba zokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo. Sibhekene nezinga lobubha elingu-54.3% kuleli, kanti kwezinye izindawo zasemaphandleni izinga lobubha lilinganiselwa ku-80%. Sake sakhuluma ukuthi izinga lokungabi nokudla linamandla kakhulu ku-70%. Kuleli, kuphela u-32% wabantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile (kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-79% futhi u-24% wezindlu unazo izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kuleli kanti kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-62%). Lezi yizinselelo ezifanayo ezithinta izindawo zasemaphandleni ezizungeze amadolobha lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo ezanele, kanye nezifo ezihlukahlukene.

Impahla lapho umnikazi ehlala khona iyimpahla umnikazi ayihlala kuyo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Isikole esingekho phansi kwemali sikhona esikoleni esizimele noma esingekho kuhulumeni esibhalisela abafundi kusukela kumazinga 0 kuya ku-12 esingatholi uxhaso olukhulu kuhulumeni. Isilinganiso siyintela ethathwa yiMasipala emhlabeni, njengoba kulindelekile esigabeni 229 (a) soMthethosisekelo. Ngaphezu kwabantu abachazwe kwiMthetho, "umnikazi" ubhekisela kumuntu onomhlaba, ohlelweni lokubambisana, ngaphandle kwendlu enegalari, indawo yokupaka, indlu yokuhlala eyindlala enezidingo zokuhlala, noma isikhala sokugcina, enomnikazi wayo, ibhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla KUPHELA ngokuya ngezicwangciso 7.3 lapha; b umnikazi wezimpahla ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ubhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla KUPHELA ngokuya ngezicwangciso 7.2 no-7. Indlu yokuhlala iyindlu eyingxenye yempahla yokuhlala esetshenziselwa abantu, noma izindlu eziningi ezinjalo endaweni lapha ayikhulumi indawo lapho okungaphezu kwesithathu sebenzisa okuthile ngaphandle kokuhlala, noma ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, B&B, i-guest house, noma efanayo eqashwa nsuku zonke. Impahla ekhokha izilinganiso ezikhethekile iyindawo ehleliwe lapho abanikazi bezimpahla ngaphakathi kwayo bevuma ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo ezengeziwe ngaphandle kwalokho okunikezwa yiMasipala. Lokhu kukhokha kwenziwa ngokwengeza enye inani kuzilinganiso ezikhokhiswa kumakhasimende abanikazi bezimpahla kule ndawo.

Ngo 2001, uNgqongqoshe uzokwethula uhlelo lwemifundaze ezokusiza abaqashi ukuba baqeqeshe abasebenzi ngalawo makhono anesidingo kakhulu. ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zenkomba-mpumelelo yenhloso 2 kuzobe kukhomba ukuthi imibandela yemithetho yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ilandelwe ngokugculisayo. Ukukala ukuthi lenhloso sekusele kangakanani ukuba ifezeke kuzombandakanya ukucubungula okuzuzwe abaqashi kanye nalawo maphuzu afana nokukhula komkhiqizo, ukugcina abasebenzi bangabalekeli kwezinye izimboni kanti nezinga lomsebenzi lizokubuyekezwa. Kusemqoka ke futhi nokuthi kukalwe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kubasize ngani abasebenzi, isibonelo, ukuba ngcono kwesimo sempilo yabo nokusebenza ngokuphepha izinkambiso zasemsebenzini, nobudlelwano phakathi kokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono nokukhushulelwa izikhundla ngoba umuntu esethuthukile phela. Kulesisikhathi samanje, u 72 phesenti wamabhizinisi angasese aseNingizimu Afrika aqashe abantu abane nangaphansi. Osekubonakale emazweni amanye omhlaba ukuthi iningi lemisebenzi emisha livezwa yizimboni zangasese futhi ezincane. Isibonelo, eminyakeni emihlanu eyedlule ezweni laseMelika imisebenzi eminingi iqhamuke kumabhizinisi amancane asanda kuqala. Sekwande umkhuba wokuthi izinkampani ezinkulu zisebenzise amakhono ezinkampani ezincane ukufeza izinhloso ezithile zabo, ngaleyo ndlela ke kudaleka amthuba omsebenzi kubantu abangaphandle kuleyonkampani.ENingizimu Afrika osomabhizinisi abancane baye balinganiswa nezikhungo ezinkulu zokusebenza, kanti lokho kuyiphutha. Buka ngoba izinkampani eziningi zamacomputer nobuchwepheshe esezizakhele udumo ngempumelelo emazweni angaphandle yizinkampanii ezincane impela.

Ubuxhwanguxhwangu Ezikoleni – Ukubuyekezwa Ubuxhwanguxhwangu ezikoleni, obaziwa ngokuthi "school bullying," yinkinga enkulu ethinta imiphakathi eminingi. Le nkinga ivame ukubonakala ezikoleni, lapho abafundi behlangana khona, futhi ingaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuxhwanguxhwangu, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimbangela, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nemiphumela ethinta abafundi, othisha, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Okokuqala, ubuxhwanguxhwangu bukhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi buphuma ezizindeni ezahlukene. Abafundi bangaba yizisulu ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene, njengokwehluka kwemvelo, izici zomuntu siqu, noma izimo zomndeni. Izinsuku zokuqala zesikole ziba nzima kubafundi abasha, ikakhulukazi uma behlangabezana nabanye abafundi abakhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuzizwa bekhululekile, futhi kungaholela ekutheni bahlale bephoxekile. Izindlela ezisetshenziswa ngabaxhwanguxhwangu zihluke kakhulu. Abanye bangasebenzisa amagama amabi, bahlambalaza, noma baqhamuka nezinsolo, kuyilapho abanye bengasebenzisa izindlela ezibucayi, ezifana nokuhlukumeza ngokomzimba. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga ezinkulu ezisizulweni, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nokwehla kokuzethemba. Abafundi abavame ukuba izisulu balahlekelwa ithemba lokuthi bazokwazi ukuhlala ezikoleni, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphume esikoleni noma baphumelele kahle ezifundweni zabo. Othisha, njengabantu abaphethe izikole, bahlala bebalulekile ekuxazululeni le nkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi othisha bazi izimpawu zokuxhwanguxhwangu ukuze bakwazi ukusiza abafundi abathintekayo.

Ushintsho kumgomo 1.00, kusukela ekuqaleni, uma kuqondwa emkhakheni woktraining wokundiza, kuchaza ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo ukuze kwenziwe isicelo sokuqala sokuthola ilayisense yomshayeli wezimoto zomoya kumuntu ofisa ukuhamba nendiza noma ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa ekhishwe ngaphansi kweSahluko 61 noma 62 salawa mthetho noma ngenhloso yokwengeza isigaba esithile kulowo mshini, kuyilapho ngenhloso yomgomo 91.02, 'uhlu lokugcinwa olwamukelekayo' luchaza incwadi yokugcina egcinwe ngumnikazi noma umsebenzisi ngokuhambisana nezimo zalawa Mthetho futhi yamukelwe yiKomishini ngaphansi kwemigomo yomgomo 43.02. 'Umuntu ogunyaziwe' uchaza umuntu ophilayo ogunyaziwe ngaphansi kweSahluko 66 yiKomishini noma inhlangano egunyaziwe ngaphansi kweSahluko 149, kuye ngendawo yokukwazi ukusebenza endizeni ngaphandle kwecebo lokundiza ngendlela ehambisana nalowo mshini futhi ichaza umnikazi wendiza yokusebenzisa komuntu siqu noma eyenziwe yilowo muntu ngokuhambisana nemigomo yeSahluko 24; 'umgibeli wewheels wendiza' uchaza indiza engasebenzi, eqhutshwa ngumoya futhi enezinhlaka ezihambayo ezihambisana nezinyawo zayo; incwadi yokulawula yokugcinwa ichaza incwadi egcinwe ngumnikazi noma umsebenzisi wendiza ngokuhambisana nezimo zalawa Mthetho yamukelwe yiKomishini ngaphansi komgomo 43.02. 'Ukuhlolwa okuphindaphindiwe' kuchaza ukuhlolwa okwenziwe ngaphansi komgomo 43.02. 'Indiza elula' ichaza indiza enomkhawulo ngesivinini nesisindo lapho iqala.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nezinkampani eziningi ezithumele abasebenzi babo emikhakheni ehlukene ukuze baqhubeke nezifundo zabo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha amakhono amasha, futhi kuwusizo ekwakheni izinkampani ezinamandla. Ukuze izinkampani ziqhubeke zihlala phambili, zidinga ukuqhubeka ziqeqesha abasebenzi bazo, futhi zibheke ukufinyelela emiphumeleni emihle. Ngokuphetha, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinkampani ezibheka phambili ziqonda ukuthi abasebenzi abaqeqeshwayo nabathuthukisiwe bangumgogodla wezimpumelelo zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinkampani zithathe lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha ngokungathi sína, ukuze zifeze imigomo yazo, zikhule, futhi ziqhubeke zihlala phambili emncintiswaneni. Uhlelo oluqinile lokuqeqesha luzogcina luholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi okhangayo, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphumelela.

Uma umphakathi ujolisa ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo, izinga lempilo liphumelela, futhi lokho kuyinzuzo kubo bonke. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nemicimbi yezempilo? Izinkinga ezithinta imicimbi yezempilo zihlanganisa ukungafinyeleli kwabantu, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezithiyo eziphathelene nokuxhumana. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, imiphakathi idinga ukwakha izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuxhasa imicimbi, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlukene ukuze kuxhunywe izinsiza ezidingekayo. Umbuzo: Imicimbi yezempilo ingaba yindlela yokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu? Imicimbi yezempilo ingaba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokuxhumana, nokwadlula ukweseka impilo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, obusiza abantu ukuba bazitholele izixazululo eziphumelelayo, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxisana ngezinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo. Umbuzo: Yini esiyifisayo ngezempilo yomphakathi esikhathini esizayo? Sifisa ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo iqhubeke nokukhula, ithuthukise amakhono abantu, futhi iqinisekise ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zempilo kubo bonke. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onolwazi, futhi okwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhlanganyela, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi kumele ziqhubeke nokuba nomthelela omuhle, zikhuthaze abantu ukuba babe nempilo engcono, futhi zifake imizamo yokwakha umphakathi onempilo nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubo bonke.

Sanibonani nonke, ngithemba ninempilo enhle. Namuhla, ngifuna ukwabelana nani ngenguquko ezithinta ubulungu bethu be-GEMS. Njengoba sazi, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi izinguquko ezithinta ubulungu zibalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi ziwusizo kanjani kithi. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-GEMS ibhekelele izidingo zethu zempilo, okusho ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zenzelwe ukusiza wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani. Kukhona izinguquko ezithile ezizokwenziwa ezindaweni ezithile, ezizothinta indlela esithola ngayo izinsiza zempilo. Kubalulekile ukuba nolwazi oluqondile ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Okwamanje, i-GEMS izobe ibuyekeza izinhlelo zayo zokubhalisela ubulungu, okubandakanya izinhlelo ezintsha ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukukhetha okokwelapha abakuthandayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuhlela izindleko zabo zempilo futhi bathole usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzoba nezinhlelo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithile, okungaba usizo olukhulu kubantu abanesidingo esikhethekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona nezinguquko ezithinta izindleko zokubhalisela ubulungu, okuzoba nomthelela ekutheni sikwazi ukuhlela izimali zethu. I-GEMS izobe ibheka izindleko zempilo ezikhulayo, futhi izozama ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi. I-GEMS izobe ibuyekeza futhi izinqubo zokubhalisela ubulungu, okuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuthi babhalise, futhi baqonde kahle izinqubo ezithinta ubulungu babo.

Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imihlahlandlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi abanelungelo lokuthola izinzuzo zokudlulisela ngesikhathi belindele umsebenzi bakwazi ukuzifinyelela. Iqondiswe ngokwezisebenzi ezithile ezikhiqizwayo, hhayi ngokusekelwe endimeni noma osayizi. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusiza ngezindleko abasebenzi abahlangabezana nazo uma bengaseduze nezindawo zabo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Ukubuyiselwa okufanele kunikezwa yiphakheji uma abasebenzi bekhuphuka emsebenzini, okuzothokozisa futhi umnyango. Kuyacaca ukuthi lezi zinzuzo zifana kubasebenzi bazo zonke izinga ngaphakathi komnyango. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikhefu linikezwa kuphela kubasebenzi abaphakathi kwezimo ezivumela ukuthi bakwenze, futhi ukuthi kubasiza ngokungabi khona emsebenzini. Izinhlinzeko zenziwe ngezikhathi zokuhlola, ukuya ezifundweni, ukuhamba ukusuka lapho umuntu ehlala khona, ucwaningo, nezemidlalo, uma umuntu engumrepresentative wabasebenzi ezinkulumweni, uma umuntu eya ukuzobamba iqhaza emkhandlwini yedolobha, nokunye. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusetha izibopho zomnyango uma kudluliswa umsebenzi ukusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye. Umnyango uzokhokhela izindleko zokuhamba, kungakhathaliseki izinga noma isikhundla. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula umhlahlandlela wokubuyisela abasebenzi abahamba ukuze kuzuzwe umnyango, kanye nalabo abasebenzi abakhishwe emsebenzini, noma labo abashonile. Kubalulekile lapha ukuthi kuphela abasebenzi abaphakathi kwezindima ezithile bazosebenzisa lezi zinhlinzeko. Kucacisiwe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izothola izinzuzo ezifanele kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma ubulili. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imihlahlandlela nezinhlinzeko mayelana nokuphela komsebenzi womuntu emnyangweni.

Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukuze ngibingelele uMongameli uNelson Mandela, omunye wabakhi abavelele kuhulumeni wethu wezwe ozogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-90 ngomhla kaJulayi 18 kulo nyaka. Namuhla samukela uMnu. Arthur Margeman omele abakhankaseli bokukhululeka ababe khona ngesikhathi ama-bhasi eqalwa e-Alexandra eminyakeni engu-50 edlule, futhi uNelson Mandela wayekhona kulolo suku. Sibusisiwe ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMiss Jann Turner, indodakazi kaRick Turner owabulawa ngababambiqhaza kuhulumeni wobandlululo eminyakeni engama-30 edlule. Sijabule kakhulu ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMnu. Dinilesizwe Sobukwe, indodana yeqhawe elalilwela izwe lethu, uRobert Sobukwe, owasishiya eminyakeni engu-30 edlule ngemuva kokubekelwa icala lokuhlala ejele iminyaka eminingi, ebanjwa, nakwezinye izindlela zokucindezelwa. Sikhumbula abasunguli be-United Democratic Front, abanye babo siwabonga phakathi kwethu. Bonke laba bahlonishwa bamele inkumbulo nethemba, futhi ubu presence babo busikhumbuza ukuthi umsebenzi wethu ufana nomjaho wokudlulisela phambili amaphupho okuphila kahle kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngempela, laba baqhawe bamele ukukhumbuza ngesithakazelo esiqinile sabantu bethu futhi banika nethuba lokuziphatha ngendlela engaphuli noma engaboni izifiso zabantu bethu. Silungiselela ukuqala unyaka wezimali wokugcina weseshini yesithathu yohulumeni wezokhetho, ngemuva kwalokho sizoya kokhetho lwesine lwezwe. Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima ayidlalile mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi sithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni izithembiso esazenzile kubantu ngo-2004.

Phatha abantu bonke ngenhlonipho enkulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babukeka kanjani. Phatha wonke umuntu sengathi uthwele igolide. Thatha isikhathi sokuchaza ikhasimende ukuthi kungani isicelo sabo sesikweletu saphikiswa. Uma ikhasimende lingatholi isikweletu ngokusekelwe ezimfuneko zeBronze, Silver, noma Gold, ubabheke kwenye uhlobo lwesikweletu oluphansi (isikweletu seBronze singaba isinyathelo sokuqala). Thatha isikhathi sokuzama ukuhlinzeka ikhasimende ngosizo olufanele kanye nezinsiza zezezimali (ukuhlukaniswa kwezingozi) ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Ungagxeki amaphutha enziwe yibhange elinye noma ibhange eliyinhloko. Yenza inkinga ibe yakho futhi ungaboleka ikhasimende imali ngokwesikhashana uma isimo sivumela. Gwema ukwenza umsebenzi ongekho emthethweni wokuhlinzeka ngosizo lapho abantu bekufronti. Qedela ingxoxo yakho nekhasimende ngokubabonga, ubabize ngegama, futhi ubafisele "ubusuku obuhle." Wazise umamukeli wocingo uma ungakabi nesikhathi sokuthola izingcingo ngalolo suku. Ungakwenzi izingcingo lapho usebenza noma uyeke ifoni ibhange. Xolisa kumuntu uma ucingo lwakho luhamba isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuphendulwa. Umamukeli wocingo kuBhange Lomhlaba "Isigaba," Sawubona, ngingakusiza kanjani?" ungakhetha ulimi ofuna ukhulume ngalo. Sawubona, ngiyi [Igama], ngingakusiza kanjani? Ungakhetha ukuthi yimaphi ulimi ofuna ukhulume ngalo. Thola ukuthi ikhasimende ngubani bese usebenzisa

Futhi ibhekelele uhlelo lokonga imali yokwakha izindlu. Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa amakhono ezakhiwo zezindlu. Ukukhuthaza nokusabalalisa kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwelizwe, ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa noma ukuhlanganisa bonke ababambiqhaza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zenhlangano, ukuze babelane ngolwazi namakhono futhi basebenze ngokubambisana. I-NHBRF inegunya lokumela amalungu ohlelo lokwakha izindlu ngokuhlinzeka ngesiqinisekiso sokuvikela izakhiwo eziphukile ezindlini ezintsha, nokuvikela abanikazi bezindlu, abaqashi, labo abavumelekile ngezidingo, kanye nezibopho lapho kungase kube nezinkinga, ukuze kulungiswe ngaphansi kwalesi simiso. Izwe elakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile sezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle.

Umshumayeli 4: Bonke abantu baseZimbabwe baphume. Nami ngiyahleka, ngiyena. Ngithi lo muntu ubefuna ukuveza laba bantu. Ulibele, kodwa wakhumbula ngokushesha ukuthi bekunjalo... Umshumayeli 4: Bathi ukhuluma ngama-apartheid. Kwathi kwathula kwathi cha, angizwakali kahle lokhu. Umamukeli: Ukhuluma nomuntu obubonile. Umshumayeli 4: Konke esikutholayo lapha sikuthola. Laba bantu babesikhalela. Umshumayeli 4: Mtshele lokho kodwa into iyinjani. Umshumayeli 4: Uthi ububona? Umshumayeli 4: Ungakwenza lokhu. Lokhu eMelika ngeke ukwazi ukukwenza. Umshumayeli 4: Awukwazi noma uma uthi ushade, uzokwenza kanjani? Umamukeli: Uthi ngeke abone lokho. Umshumayeli 4: Wow, mfo, ngishade nabo. Umshumayeli: Ngisho uGeorge ulibele ukuthi yena wayengubani ophazamisa. Umshumayeli: Cha, ungithokozisa, mntwana, ubambe ngokushesha, uyazi. Cha, abafuni muntu odla yedwa, yingakho bazompusha. Umshumayeli: Uphi lokho? Umamukeli: Manje uma sizothenga ubani ozosebenza kuye? Umshumayeli: Lo uphunyukile. Umshumayeli: Uphi ahlangane naye? Umshumayeli: Uthi kusho ukuthini? Umshumayeli: Kuzoba ngani kithi? Umshumayeli: Uthi kuzoba kithi? Umshumayeli: Oh, njengoba beqeda ukudla? Umshumayeli 5: Yebo. Ngithola ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi ukhuluma noMphakathi ngendlela akhuluma ngayo. Umshumayeli: Eh, outie, nansi ibhuthi, le mntwana emhlophe ithi ifuna thina ngalesi sikhathi. Ngimtshela uyazi angibeki igama elinjalo ukuthi lo mfana ukutshela ukuthi nini.

Uthe, "Uma singatholi uxhaso olufanele, sizobe sithola ubunzima ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezifundisayo." Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano phakathi kwabantu ababephakathi, abanye bephikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube okwenziwe ngababhalisile kuphela, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhasa. Uhlelo lwemibono lwaluhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nababukeli, abezindaba, nabaphathi bezokuxhumana. UJohn Nkosi, umphakathi ophakathi, waphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuxhasa, njengokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezizokwazi ukuheha ababukeli abaningi. "Uma i-SABC ingakwazi ukuheha ababukeli, izokwazi ukuthola uxhaso olungcono," kusho uNkosi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNkk. Sipho Dlamini, ongumsebenzi wezokuxhumana, waphikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube yinto ejwayelekile, futhi akufanele kube nomkhawulo. "Sidinga i-SABC ukuze ibonise izindaba zethu, izinkolo zethu, nezamasiko ethu. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, hhayi yokuhlukanisa," kusho uDlamini. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokuxoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ukuze ikwazi ukufinyelela kubabukeli abaningi. Lokhu kuhlangene nezidingo zomphakathi, njengoba abantu abaningi behamba phambili besebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokubuka izinhlelo.

Abantu abaphumelelayo ngezinye izikhathi bayazi ukuthi kufanele bathule futhi bagcine ukuzola kwabo. Ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ukuze banikeze isinqumo ngokushesha nangokuphuthumayo ukuze banikeze izeluleko. Siphila nezinkinga eziningi ezinzima ezihlanganisa abantu nezimo. Isidingo sokulalela ukuze siqonde sibaluleke kakhulu. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda abantu uma singabalaleli. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda isimo uma sibona ingxenye kuphela yesimo, sisiza kancane. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda izinkinga zabantu uma sinolwazi oluphansi kuphela nezici zayo, kuyilapho empeleni, sibhekene nezimpawu, hhayi imbangela. Kumele sibone ukuthi ukulalela kuyisici esiyisisekelo kulwazi nokuqonda. LENA YINDODA ENYE ETHATHA ISINYATHELO. Uvumela ukuthi bakuholele engxoxweni; awuphuthumi kubo ngokushesha ukuze bathathe indlela abafuna ukuyiya. Lokhu kuhlobene nenhlonipho yabo nokwethembeka. LENA YINDODA ENYE EHLANGANISWA NEZIMFUNDO. Lokhu kuyithuba elingajwayelekile kubantu abaningi, futhi bazothatha leli thuba ngokuzithoba futhi baziphatha ngendlela ejwayelekile futhi ngale okwakungokwabo. Uma ukhombisa ukuthi ungathembeka, abanye bazizwa bekhululekile ukwabelana ngezinkathazo zabo, izimfihlo, nezibopho. Umphumela uwukuthi - baziwa kangcono. ABANTU ABANINGI BAHLAZAYO INKINGA. Ukulalela okusebenzayo kusiza abantu ukuba babhekane nalabo abababhekelayo nezinkinga. Bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesimo esingasibheka ngqo, siqonde kangcono, bese sichaza inkinga ngokucacile nangokufanele. ENYE INDODA IHLAZ

I-CDCAA izokhuthaza ukuhlinzekwa kokukhwabanisa kwezwi ebusuku ezindaweni zokuhlala. Sigxile ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasemafamu ezweni lethu ukuze sikhulume nabesifazane, amadoda, nabasebenzi bezolimo mayelana nomkhankaso. Ukuhlinzekwa, ukuhanjiswa, nokuboniswa kwezinsizakalo eziphathelene nezinto zokweseka, izinsiza ezibalulekile, ukwesekwa kwamanzi, nezikhwama zokulawula umoya kwiMisebenzi Yezokwelapha Eziphuthumayo. Banokuxhumana okuclose nabasebenzisi bezempi, okungase kube ngokufakwa kwabasebenzi bezempi, noma ngokuxhumana nezinsizakalo nezinsizakalo zeDoD ezithintekayo. Imicimbi emikhulu yamazwe omhlaba ihlelwe ngosuku lokuzalwa lukaMnu. Mandela unyaka nonyaka, njengezinkonzathi, imibukiso, nezinkulumo. Itemple yeShembe edolobheni iqukethe ingxenye yendawo engakathuthukiswa eduze kwezindandatho ezimhlophe. Izinzuzo zikazwelonke zizodingeka zisetshenziswe ngababhalisi abafanele, ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamandla elanga ukufudumeza nokukhanyisa eCape Columbine. Lokhu akusho ukuthi i-HDI kufanele iphikwe noma yamukelwe. Sithemba ukuthi iwebhusayithi izoba ithuluzi lolwazi lwezinhlelo ze-NGO, ama-CBO, abameli, izingane zesikole, nabafundi, kanye nabo bonke abathanda ukuphatha ubulungiswa. Umkhankaso Wokuphepha uzokwenziwa uqinisekiswe ngezinsuku zokuphumula, ngezinsiza ezengeziwe ezabelwe imisebenzi yokuvikela engaguquki throughout unyaka. Izinkomishi ezintathu kumele ziwine: igolide, isiliva, nebronze. UKing Albert Luthuli wayengumholi ongenazifiso ozihola ngempela.

Ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa, abantu bahlala emigqeni emide, bekhombisa isifiso sabo sokuba neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubambisana, lapho abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bephakamisa izwi labo. Ukwamukelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho kwaba yisikhathi esijabulisayo. UNelson Mandela waba nguMongameli wokuqala omnyama weNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu behlanganyela. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwashintsha, futhi kwavulwa amathuba amasha emikhakheni ehlukene, kuhlanganise nezemfundo, ezempilo, nezomnotho. Ukwamukelwa kukaMandela njengomongameli kwaholela ekwakheni uhulumeni obumbene, owawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, futhi kwavula ithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwashintsha, futhi kwavulwa amathuba amasha emikhakheni ehlukene, kuhlanganise nezemfundo, ezempilo, nezomnotho. Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 awugcini nje ngokuba yisigameko esibalulekile, kodwa ubonisa amandla abantu uma behlanganyela. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu bephakamisa izwi labo. UNelson Mandela waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi wakhombisa ukuthi ubumbano lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo zaba khona, kodwa umqondo wokubumbana wahlala uqinile. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwaluhlala lukhula, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze bakhe ikusasa el better.

Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela okwakhiwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphathwa kwamamunicipality kanye nengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukufinyelela izinqumo ezimayelana nezindaba ezifana nezabelomali zamamunicipality, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngokuqonda, okuhlelekile, nendlela ebonakalayo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamamunicipality kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamunicipality. Esikhathini esedlule, amamunicipality avame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu ngenqubo yokuhlela i-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho uhlaka lomthetho. Amamunicipality amaningi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okudlulela Phambili) abengenazo izinsiza nezakhono zokuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe kulezi zimo, noma izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinselelo, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bazuze kakhulu kulwazi abaluqoqile. Kukhona amamunicipality ambalwa athole inqubekela phambili enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Izincwadi zokuhola i-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elinobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene kusuka ku-DPLG esekelwa yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa.

Uma umuntu efaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi ngaphezu kwesikhathi esibekiwe uma kubhekwa izimo zomthwali wezintela. Uma amarekhodi omthwali wezintela ehlonyiswe kwenye isigaba. Uma imibhalo yezintela noma inani le-VAT lingakakhokhwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo sesidlule noma engakaceli ukwandisa isikhathi sokuhambisa inani le-VAT. Uma isitatimende se-PAYE, noma imibhalo yezintela noma inani lezintela lingakathunyelwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo nezitatimende sesidlule noma engakaceli ukwandisa isikhathi sokuhambisa inani lezintela. Faka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi sokukhokha izintela ngokuvakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-SARS noma nge-imeyili. Bhala incwadi ecela ukwandiswa kwesikhathi esikhethekile sokukhokha izintela, uyithumele ehhovisi le-SARS eliseduzane. Uma isicelo sivunyiwe, uzothola isaziso nge-imeyili, usebenzisa ikheli le-imeyili olinikezile. Uma ungahlinzeki ngekheli le-imeyili, ungaxhumana nehhovisi le-SARS eliseduzane ngemva kosuku olunye lokusebenza. Le nsizakalo iyamahala. Bhalisela ku-inthanethi.

Itholakala ezinkingeni zethu, kodwa futhi iyindlela yokukhula. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu yonke. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile empilweni yethu. Akukhona okungaphezu kokuba nekhanda eliphilayo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nekhanda elinempilo. Ngakho, asithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavule izinkulumo, futhi sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Impilo yengqondo iyinselele, kodwa futhi iyithuba lokukhula, futhi kufanele sithathe leli thuba ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, kanye neyezizukulwane ezizayo.

Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokubhekana nokuvuza? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezisemthethweni zokubhekana nokuvuza, lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa abaqondisi abahlola ukuphepha kwedatha, izinhlelo zokubikela ukuvuza, nakho konke okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvikela. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele ukuphatha izinkinga ezithile, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zigcina izimfihlo zazo kubalulekile. Umbuzo 10: Yini okwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqolobane zokuvikela? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqolobane zokuvikela, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha okusezingeni eliphezulu kubasebenzi, kanye nokwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphepha. Ukuze ukuqina kokukhethwa kwezokuphepha, izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise uhlaka lwezobuchwepheshe olwakhiwe, kanjalo nezinhlelo zemvelo zokugcina ukuzwelana nesikhungo sabo. Isiphetho: Uphenyo lokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni luyisihloko esibalulekile emkhakheni wezokuphepha, okudinga ukuqonda okujule nokusebenza okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikeleke imininingwane eyimfihlo. Izinkampani nezinhlaka kufanele ziqhubeke nokwakha izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ukuvuza akwenzeki, futhi uma kwenzeka, kube nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokubhekana nakho. Kulokhu, abantu bangenza izinqumo eziphusile futhi bazidalela ikusasa eliqinile.

Lokhu akukhona nje ngezimali, kodwa nakwezinye izinto. Umsebenzi wothisha uhlanganisa ukugxila, ukuzimisela, nokubekezela. Abanye bethu basuke bephila nemindeni emincane, bahlala bejuggling phakathi komsebenzi namakhaya. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi baphile ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, bathole isikhathi sokuphumula, futhi baphinde banakekele izidingo zabo. Yize kunjalo, kunzima ukusho ukuthi othisha baningi abaphila kahle. Kukhona abanye abahlala bephila ngaphansi komthwalo omkhulu, bephoqeleka ukuba benze izinqumo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Abanye bahlale bephila ngezinkinga zempilo, kanti abanye bahlala bejolise ezintweni ezingezinhle. Kodwa, bahlala besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi bazama ukwenza kahle. Ngabe singakuphakamisela kanjani lokho? Noma yiziphi iziphakamiso ezitholakalayo? Kukhona izinsiza eziningi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezindlela ezihlukene zokubambisana. Othisha bethu badinga ukwakha imikhankaso yokuxhumana ukuze basize omunye nomunye. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, kumqoka ukuba sibe nezingxoxo, sabelane ngolwazi, futhi sifeze izinjongo ezihlangene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufundisa, futhi kuzoholela ekuphumeleleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, othisha bethu bahlala bejolise eminyakeni edlule, behlola izindlela eziphumelelayo zokufundisa. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola izifundo, ukuhlela izinhlelo, nokuhlola izifundo ezihluke kakhulu. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kakhulu, futhi kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni komfundi. Uthisha, ngokwenhloso, uyakwazi ukusizakala kuzo zonke izifundo, abamba izifundo ezichelekileyo, futhi aqhubele phambili izifundo. Noma kunjalo, akukona konke okwenziwa othisha. Bahlala belwela ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabafundi.

Noma iyiphi i-parti ethintwa ngqo umbiko ingacela ukuthi okuqukethwe kombiko kukhishwe. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba. Umphakathi ophathelene nodaba uzokhuluma ngokucacile kumuntu othintekayo ngemiphumela yokwehluleka ukuphikisa umbiko nokuphikisa izitatimende ezivela kumbiko. Ngesikhathi sokulalela isicelo, umfaki-sicelo kanye nomzali owathola isaziso bazoba namalungelo namandla afana ne-parti enenkantolo yezenzo, kulandela ukuhlolwa nokuphikiswa kwabafakizolo, ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi, nokukhuluma enkantolo. Isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngesicelo sincike ekwakhiweni kwesicelo. Isaziso kubazali bezinhliziyo zengane okufanele ifakwe abanye sizohlinzeka ngemininingwane eyanele noma izizathu zokungaceli imvume yabo ukuze ingane ifakwe abanye. Isaziso sizonikezwa okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-21 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela udaba. Uma unina wengane enqaba ukuhlinzeka ngemvume, isicelo sizokwenziwa enkantolo yezingane phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14. Ubaba bezinhliziyo zengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa zokukhishwa kwe-oda lenkantolo, afake isicelo sokushintsha imininingwane yakhe kumadokhumenti okubhaliswa kokuzalwa kwengane. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo sokushintsha, ubaba bezinhliziyo zengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele azise umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane lapho isicelo sokufakwa senziwe khona. Kufanele akwenze lokhu ebhalwe phansi, echaza usuku nendawo lapho enze isicelo sokushintsha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.

Kukhishwe nguMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo weZizwe Ezihlangene. Pheka ukudla okungokwemvelo noma okukhuliswe kahle emasimini. Ukudla okungokwemvelo okufana nezinhlanzi, izithelo, nezitshalo kungathwala nomkhuhlane wecholera, kodwa lo mkhuhlane ungafa uma ukudla kuphisiwe, ngakho qiniseka ukuthi awudli ukudla okungaphekwanga, futhi kufanele uhlanze izandla zakho ngemva kokudla. Uma ukudla kuphakathi, umkhuhlane uyakhula. Ngakho, dlani ukudla okushisayo noma kuphise kabusha ngemva kokudla. Gwema ukuxhumana phakathi kokudla okungokwemvelo nokudla okuphisiwe. Ukudla okuphekiwe okuphephile nakho kungathwala umkhuhlane wecholera ngenxa yokuxhumana okuncane nokudla okungokwemvelo. Lokhu kuxhumana kungenzeka uma usika izinhlanzi eziphilile ngenkathi usika ukudla okuphisiwe ngaphandle kokuhlanza izandla. Ezindaweni ezithintekile yi-cholera, ukudla okufana nezithelo nezitshalo akuphephile ngaphandle kokuphekwa, njalonjalo. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokuqala ukulungisa ukudla nangaphambi kwanoma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka, njengokushintsha noma ukuhlanza ingane, ukusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Hlanza izandla zakho futhi ngemva kokuphothula ukulungisa ukudla okufana nezinhlanzi nezitshalo ngemva kokuthinta ezinye ukudla. Indawo lapho ulungisa khona ukudla kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile; cabanga ukudla okungadliwa noma indawo engahlanzekile njengoba ikhipha umkhuhlane. I-cloth yokuhlanza izitsha kufanele ishintshwe nsuku zonke noma iphisiwe ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Hlukanisa i-cloth yokusula okufanele ihlanzwe njalo.

Ukuthuthukiswa komhlaba okungalawulwa kungaba nezmiphumela emibi endaweni yemvelo, ezindaweni zamasiko kanjalo nakwikhwalithi yomoya namanzi. UCharles Zwane wangenelela wathi bayangethemba njengomqeqeshi nokuthi abakholwa ukuthi ngiyimpimpi. Ukwenyuka kwezinhlelo okudla imali nokuqalisa kabusha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kumele kugwenywe. Okusoshiwe kumele kukwazi ukukaleka, kube nesigqi, kwaziswe emphakathini, kugadwe kuphinde kuhlangatshezwane nakho. Kunesidingo sokunakekela okunzulu nokweseka okuqhubekayo kule mindeni. Abasolwa kuthiwa babandakanyeka odlameni lwamatekisi oluphakathi kweHighflats kanye neSt Faith Taxi Association. La malungu angazigqaja ngobuwona njengoba kwakuyisikhathi sokuqala ukuthi i-SAPS Carnarvon iphuce izigelekeqe i-Mandrax. Abasolwa ababili baboshelwa ukudayisa utshwala ngaphandle kwelayisense kanti amalitha ambalwa otshwala obehlukene abanjwa eNortham. UKhomishani wamaPhoyisa eSifundazwe eNtshonalanga Kapa, uKhomishani uMiriam Mbombo, wahalalisela uSayitsheni Gerber ngokuziphatha kwakhe okuncomekayo nokwemukelekile nokuphenya kwakhe icala ngendlela enobuchule. Yilokhu okwenza silethe isiphakamiso ezilandelayo. Lezi zingxenye zidinga ukushintsha ekubeni yizinhlaka zokweseka nje kuphela kodwa zibe abadidiyeli bemisebenzi kahulumeni. Uma kungukuthi wakhuluma nomuntu obizwa ngoPiet, ngabe siyazi ukuthi uPiet wayehlala eSoweto. Indima yemifakela kanye nama-ionospheres ekuphuculeni ukukhiqizwa kwenyama yenkomo. Uhulumeni uyabona ukuthi, ngenxa yezizathu eziningi zezomlando, uxhaso lwezimali ngokomlando luyatholakala ezimakethe zezezindlu.

i ukuthi umkhandlu ususamukele isinqumo sokuklama inani lentela yendawo; nokuthi ii liyatholakala ikhophi lesinqumo ukuze licutshungulwe wumphakathi ngezikhathi zomsebenzi ehhovisi elikhulu lezokuphatha lalowo masipalati nakwezinye izindawo ezibalulwe kulesi saziso. a uhla lwabo bonke abanikezwe ushwele, ngababuyiselwe inkokhelo kanye nalabo abancishiselwe inkokhelo ngonyaka ofileyo ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- 1; kanye b nesitatimende esikhombisa imali engenile kumasipalati waphambilini emveni koshwele, imbuyiselo kanye nokwehliselwa. b ezomnotho ezingekho emingceleni yakhe umasipalati lowo; noma c ukuthuthwa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukuthunyelwa kwezidingo, imali noma abasebenzi. h Okungenani isamba sokuqala semali engu- R15000 senani lazo zonke izindawo lapho kwakhiwe futhi kuhlalwa khona, ngaphandle nje uma kwazeka ukuthi uNgqongqoshe, ngokuxoxisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali, ngezikhathi ezithile, inganyuswa lemali kwedlulwe emkhawulweni ukuze ihambisane nezinga lomnotho ngaleso sikhathi; futhi i Impahla/umhlaba noma umkhakha wezimpahla/wemihlaba ebaluliwe ngokwesigatshana- 3, noma inani lentela yendawo elevile enanini elibekwe njengomkhawulo empahleni/endaweni noma emkhakheni wempahla noma wendawo. i izindawo zezomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zezolimo isilinganiso okukhulunywa ngaso esigatshaneni- 1 b ingashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela ngokubambisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali. ungqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali kanye nesaziso, ahlele umkhawulo ngokwamaphesenti okufanele ukuba kwenyuswe ngalo inani lentela yendawo.

Uhlelo lwebhizinisi nesu lokusebenza kwemisebenzi esikhathini esizayo kwethulwa kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha futhi kuvunywa nguye ngonyaka ngonyaka, ngendlela yokubonisa ngohlelo lokusebenza(i-business plan) oluphinde lwafakwa imininingwane. I-SAMSA yenza imisebenzi yomthetho kanye neyobumeleli, esikhundleni sikaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha kanye Nomnyango Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke (i-NDOT). I-SAMSA ngakho-ke yenza imisebenzi ekhethiwe elevelini lokwenza, bese kuthi i-NDOT isebenze elevelini yamasu, okuyilapho ithuthukisa khona izinqubomgomo zokuthutha kanye nenkombandlela yamasu kumaziko. I-SAMSA ihlala njalo ixhumana nababambi qhaza ezimbonini zezolwandle, ngokusebenzisa amakomiti ahlukene ezasolwandle kanye futhi nangokubamba imihlangano yokuxhumana kanye nezinye izindlela ezingezona ezisemthethweni. Inhloso ye-SAMSA ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwempahla nempilo olwandle, ukuvikela nokulwisa ukungcola okuhlasela indawo yasolwandle yemikhumbi, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnako wezolwandle weRiphabhuliki. Ngaphakathi kweminye yemisebenzi, kodwa kube kungenamkhawulo kulena, kukhona ukuhlolwa kwemikhumbi, izisetshenziswa kanye nempahla, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkhumbi kanye nezikebhe zihlonyiswe ngokulandela amazinga abekiwe. I-SAMSA iphinda futhi ihambise iphinde inikeze iziqu okudingeka ukuthi umuntu abe nazo uma esebenza emikhunjini. Ikhomishana Yamalungelo esintu yaseNingizimu Afrika kumele yakhe umhlahlandlela oqukethe ulwazi olunje njengokuvumelekile okungadingwa yinoma yimuphi umuntu ofisa ukusebenzisa noma yiyiphi ilungelo elicatshangwe Ngumthetho.

Faka ama-teaspoons amane noshukela kanye ne-teaspoon eyodwa ye-salt. Hlanganisa le ngxube ngangokunokwenzeka. Ikhofi nezinye izidlo neziphuzo ezifana ne-cola ne-chocolate ziqukethe i-caffeine futhi zingathuthukisa i-dehydration. Esikhundleni salokho, dlani kakhulu... Ukudla okufana nama-apula noma ama-banana aphumile, ama-oats, noma ama-potato; lezi zinto ziqukethe i-fiber esheshayo esiza ukugcina amanzi esiswini. Ukudla okufana nama-potato nama-banana kuqukethe i-potassium, elahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. Dla kaningi ukuze ubuyise isisindo esilahlekile nezithako. Ukuntuleka kokuhlanzeka kungaholela ekuhambeni. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi ngethusi ngaphambi kokuphatha, ukuhlela, ukupheka, noma ukugcina ukudla. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi ngethusi ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ngemuva kokushintsha umgibeli. Uma inyama iphunga noma inambitha i-metallic, dlani kuphela izinkukhu, izinhlanzi, imikhiqizo yobisi, ama-beans omisiwe angakawushintshi, kanye ne-peas ukuze uthole i-protein. Ukudla okubandayo noma okubandayo kuvame ukunambitha kahle kakhulu kunokudla okushisayo. Sebenzisa ama-spices, izobho, noma uju lwelemons ukuze uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla kwakho. Dla ukudla kwakho kancane ngenkathi uphuza isiphuzo sakho. Kungasiza ukusebenzisa amanzi anesawoti ukuwasha umlomo wakho njalo. Ukuphuza amanzi anama-lemon ngaphambi

b umkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe. c indawo yokuwela emile noma etata emanzini aseNingizimu Afrika. ukuze kungabi bikho ukudideka, indawo yokuwela emile okukhulunywa ngayo kumthethosisekelo- 1 c ithathwa njengomkhumbi ngokwenhloso yalemithethonkambiso. Umkhumbi ungumkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe uma lowo mkhumbi... omunye umkhumbi; noma v ichweba, okusetshenziswa echwebeni noma ngokunye okuxhunyelwe echwebeni; kanye d isenzo besamulekile kuleso simo. a umuntu kudingeka ukuba alandele imiyalo yokuvikela; futhi b ukulandelwa komyalo kusho ukuthi lowo muntu wenze icala ngokwephula leso sidingo noma ukwephula uMthetho noma lemithethonkambiso, lowo muntu , uma elandela imiyalo yokuvikela , uthathwa ngokuthi akenzanga cala noma kaphulanga okudingekayo. Umuntu, ekulandeleni umyalo wokulawula, uthathwa ngokuthi akenzanga icala noma akephulanga okudingekayo. Ngokwenhloso yalemithethonkambiso umuntu anganikeza isaziso noma umyalo noma akhulumisane nomsebenzi womkhumbi ngokumnikeza isaziso noma umyalo noma ukuxoxisana nesithunywa salowo mkhumbi. c indawo echwebeni elilawulwa ngezokuvikela; kanye d lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle. e Imisebenzi eyenziwa yilabo ababambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle mayelana noma ngokuhambisana namachweba alawulwa ngezokuvikela. UMqondisi-Jikelele ngokubhaliwe angamemezela futhi ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 2 noma ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 3 elisebenzayo emikhunjini elawulwa kwamanye amazwe.

Amapulazi amakhulu angaphonswa phakathi nosuku nangezikhathi zokulala usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-GPS. Nokho, ngaphambi kokungena esivumelwaneni, qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli angafika ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi uzofika ngesikhathi esifanele uma kudingeka futhi yimaphi imishini ezodingeka ukuthi iphathwe ngumlimi noma umphakeli. Khumbula, abanye abaphakeli abanethangi lamanzi noma amabhasi. Uma ungakwazi ukukala amanzi adingekayo ngamakhambi afanele okufanele aphonswe, uzobhekana nezinkinga nomphakeli, futhi umsebenzi uzoma. Kufanele uhlaziye izindleko zokuthenga imishini yakho, ukuba namandla okuphonsa i-hectare ethile ngesikhathi esifanele, nezindleko zokukhokhela umphakeli ukuze enze lelo thasku lokuphonsa. Okwesibili, okungakusiza ukuthi abaphakeli abaningi banolwazi mayelana nezinhlobo nezifomula zamakhemikhali okwamanje asetshenziswa. Kuzokusiza ukuhlola ukuthi ukuphonsa kwenziwa kanjani ngezikhathi zonke. Kungasiza futhi ukukhuluma nochwepheshe abasebenza kumafemu ahlukene athengisa amakhemikhali, bese uzokwazi ukuhlola izindleko zamakhemikhali nge-hectare kanye nosizo oluvela kulawo mafemu athengisa amakhemikhali. Khumbula ukuthi abahlinzeki bamakhambi bahlala bephithizela ngesikhathi sokutshala futhi bangase bangakwazi ukusiza bonke abalimi ngokuhlanganisa amakhemikhali ethangini. Uma ungakabi nolwazi, ungase uphonse amakhemikhali kancane noma kakhulu.

viiiUma isicelo sesivunyiwe, njalo ngonyaka ofaka isicelo kudingeka alethe incwadi efungelwe eqinisekisa ukuthi uyayisebenzisa indawo. Izikhungo zenkolo -Njengoba kudingeka ngokuka-17 (i) woMthetho, umhlaba obhaliswe egameni lamakholwa futhi osetshenziswa ngamakholwa ikakhulukazi njengendawo yokukhonza, kubalwa nesakhiwo esisemthethweni esibhaliswe egameni lalawo makholwa okuhlala kuso osesikhundleni walawo makholwa ephatha izinkonzo kuleyo ndawo yokukhonzela. UMHLABA ONGAKHIWE UMasipala angalehlisa inani umhlaba ongakhiwe ongathengiswa ngalo ngokunquma koMkhandlu emhlanganweni wawo wonyaka wesabelo-zimali. Iziqiwu/izindawozokongiwa kwemvelo ezisanda kumenyezelwa angeke zikhokhiswe ama-rates uma sezenze isicelo kwavezwa nesimemezelo esisemthethweni esifanele. Umnikazimhlaba, elekelelwa nguMasipala, enza futhi alandele uhlelo lokuphatha ngalo okuqondwe ukuvikela nokwenza ngcono imvelo endaweni. I-EnvironmentalCertificate iyophelelwa yisikhathi uma umhlaba ungasasetshenziselwa izinhloso zokongiwa kwemvelo kanti uma kunjalo umhlaba uyobalelwa njengokusebenza kwawo okusha kusukela ngosuku okwaqala ngalo. uma kuthi phakathi nanoma yimuphi unyaka wezimali, umhlaba noma isakhiwo leso kusetshenziselwe enye inhloso okungaseyona le esixegiselwe ngenxa yayo, uMasipala kumele abize amarates ngalokho awabale ahambisane nesikhathi salokho kusetshenziswa. Isikole esingenzi nzuzo esakhiwe emhlabeni obhaliswe egameni lendawo yokukhonzela umphakathi, kumele iklanyelwe inani futhi ibalelwe ngokwamibandela engenhla.

Abasebenzi bangase badlale indima, behluleka, bese bethi, "Ngabe lokho kuzoba ngcono?". Kukhona ezinye izikhathi lapho iziteleka zempilo zibalulekile ukuze kusize abavela kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuziqukethwe emiphakathini, kwakha umoya ophilayo phakathi kwamalungelo nezimfanelo zabasebenzi. Lokhu akukhona nje umqondo, kepha kube sisekelo esiqinile sokusebenza kwamaNingizimu, umoya wokuhlonipha nokubambisana kumasiko ambalwa. Ngakho, uma sicabangela iziteleka zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izingxenye ezihlukahlukene, ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umoya wabantu obambekayo ugcwele izinkinga eziningi. Ukugcina izinduna zibambisene, kabhe zinduna ibhizinisi akukona okokudala. Lokhu kucacile, abavoti bangasiza, futhi noma yikuphi ukuxhumana kuzodingeka ukuze kube nezinhloso ezithile. Ngakho, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyahlonishwa. Zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi kufanele benze imizamo yokwakha impilo engcono, bahlanganyele ezintweni ezikhaliphile, futhi bakhuthaze ukunqoba, okuveza okuningi. Lokhu kusenhla kwakho ukwakha udumo lwabantu abavuma ukuzama impi yokuhamba phambili. Ngakho, sithumeza izinsiza, sithumele ukuphikisana, ukuze uthole izinhlelo ezithinta wonke umuntu. Hamba phambili, hamba phambili!

Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye babazali behlangene, kwavula izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ekugcineni, umphakathi wathola ukunconywa, kwavela izinkantolo ezazivuma ukuthi umhlaba wabo awuthathwa ngaphandle kokuvuma. UThandi waphakamisa izinkanyezi, “Siyaziqhenya ngamandla ethu. Umhlaba wethu awusikho konke, kodwa uthando lwethu, uthando lwethu, luyingxenye yethu.” Futhi ngamunye wakhumbula ukuthi, noma izimpi zomthetho zingahlala zikhona, umoya womphakathi ungavusa isibindi sokulwela amalungelo. UThandi wathola ukuthi empilweni, umhlaba ungavula izindlela ezintsha, uma abantu behlangana besebenzela okuhle. Lokhu kwaba yinkumbulo eqhubekayo, evuselela ithemba lokuthi umhlaba ungavikelekile, uma abantu bephila ngokubambisana.

Ubuye ukwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zezimali zomkhakha wezolimo uma kuqhathaniswa nezimo ezijwayelekile. Ukwanda kwesomiso kungaholela ekutheni, izitshalo ezithile zingakwazi ukufakwa emkhakheni wezolimo. Imiphumela emnandi, ngempela, ubonakalisa ukuthi izimfuno zokuhlanga zikhuphuka; kodwa ngemva kokuhla kwechungechunge, abanye abalimi bebheka izitshalo ezidliwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye bakhuluma ngokudinga izixazululo esimeme - ezihlanganisa izitshalo ezidinga amanzi amancane. Lokhu kubalulekile kumhlaba wezolimo eFree State. Ukufana kakhulu, uma sikhuluma ngalesi simo, kuphinde kube nezinselelo zokukhiqiza. Izitshalo ezingaphumeleli kahle kungenzeka zishiye abafundi bejabulile kuphela uma zikhona izinkomo ezincane. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokulima nemikhankaso yokuthola amanzi, okukhuthaza ukuzikhandla komphakathi. Phambilini phakathi nyaka, abanye abalimi basixhume izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalimi anikwa usizo oludingekayo. Nokho, kwezokuthutha, umthelela wesomiso ezingadini ezithile uphinde ube nomthelela. Ukwehla kokuhamba kwezimpahla kubalulekile, njengoba izimpahla ezingalungiswanga kungabathinti abathengi. Izinsuku zokusizakala kuncipha kodwa ungakwazi ukukhokha, ushintsho luveza izinzuzo zamabhizinesi nezimboni ukudala izimo ezithile ezisezingeni. Ngalokhu, umnotho wezolimo uyanda, kodwa ubungozi bemvelo bushayisana nempilo yomphakathi. Ezakhamuzini, umthelela wesomiso ubonakala nakwiqembu labalimi; lokhu okuqukethwe kumkhakha wezolimo. Abalimi banelisekile ngezimo ezibalulekile zomhlaba, ngenkathi bephicha izinkinga ezivela ezimweni ezinzima zokuhamba phambili.

Zonke izincwadi zendiza ezigcinwe futhi zalondolozwa ngokulandisa komgonyana odlule kufanele ngaso sonke isikhathi zinikwe isiphathimandla esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyazelwe ukuzihlola. Indiza ekhandwe ngendlela evumela izihlalo ezingaphezulu kwesishagalombili, ibhanoyi eligunyazelwe isisindo esingaphezulu ko 5 700kg noma ujikamanzi onesisindo esingaphezulu ko 3 175kg lingaqondana nohlelo oluseceleni mayelana nesheduli evunyiwe yokulungisa izindiza, izinsimbi zayo nokulandelela iziwombe zokukhandwa kwendiza. Noma yimuphi umbhalo ofakwe ebhukwini lendiza kufanele uhambisane nezidingo ezimiselwe incwadi yendiza. Indlela yokudweba izincwadi zendiza kufanele luyonqunywa wuMqulu we SA- CATS-GMR. Izincwadi zendiza okufanele zigcinwe ngendlela elandela umgomo 43.1.3 ziyolondolozwa isikhathi esingekho ngaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusuka osukwini okuhlakazwe ngalo uhlaka lwendiza, injini noma uphephela: Kungenzeka uKhomishani anqume isikhathi esingaphezulu sokugcina incwadi yendiza, injini noma uphephela wendiza elimale engozini. Kunezincomo zokungashiyi izincwadi zendiza kuyona uqobo. Uma kwenzeka imibandela yomgonyana 3 isebenza noma izincwadi zifunelwa inhloso yokulungisa indiza futhi ingekho enye indlela yokwedlulisa lezo zincwadi zendiza, izincwadi ziyobe sezifakwa kuyo uqobo leyo ndiza.

Wonke ama-oda wemarekhodi kumele athunyelwe kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme usebenzisa ifomu elibekiwe. Ifomu elibekiwe, uma seliqediwe ngokuphelele, lingathunyelwa, lithunyelwe ngekhoriyela, noma lithunyelwe nge-imeyili kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme usebenzisa imininingwane yokuxhumana enikeziwe ngenhla. UMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme, uma esethole isicelo solwazi, kufanele enze isinqumo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 sokuthi anikeze ukufinyelela kumarekhodi afunwayo noma cha. UMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme okuthunyelwe isicelo samarekhodi kuye angakhulisa noma alibambezelele lezi zinsuku eziyi-30 ezikhulunywa esigabeni 25 ngenye iminyaka engama-30 uma isicelo sikhuluma ngenani elikhulu lamarekhodi noma uma kudingeka ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezakhiwo ukuze kutholakale amarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele aziswe ngezizathu zokwandiswa kwesikhathi. Uma isicelo samukelwa, uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ngemali ekhokhwayo ngokwesigaba 10.4 salolu shintsho ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nesicelo. Uma uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ethola ukuthi isicelo sidinga ukubhekwa yisikhungo somphakathi, uMphathi Wemininingwane kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14, asithumele esikhungweni esifanele futhi azise umfaki-sicelo ngaleso sithunywa. Inqubo yokuxoxisana ixhaswa yizakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo ezifana neBhodi, Ikhansela Eliphezulu (EXCO), nezinye izinkomidi ezahlukene. Amarekhodi atholakala lapha yilezi okufanele afakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. La marekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo.

Kwenzekani ngabalimi abansundu abasakhulayo? Sonke sisebenza ngamandla ukuguqukisa ukulima lapha eNingizimu Afrika - kukhona abaningi abalimi abansundu abadinga ukutshala ukolo ohlelweni lwabo lokushintsha izinhlobo zezitshalo. Ngokwamanje sisaphumelela ukusekela abalimi abangena ekulimeni ngoba banenhlanhla ukuthola amagranti avela kuWinter Cereals Trust nakuMnyango Wezokulima waseFreyistata. Uma sifisa ukusekela abalimi abansundu ekulimeni okuzoqhubeka, kudingeka sibheke kahle ukutholakala kwenzuzo ngokutshala ukolo. Sinjani isimo sokuthenga phesheya? Emazweni amanye emhlabeni isimo sezulu singcono ukutshala ukolo - umhlabathi unonile nemvula iningi (imvula ifika njalo ngasikhathi esifanayo), nokukhithika kunikeza amanzi emhlabathini ebusika (ukolo osemncane awulimali kakhulu lapho kumakhaza). Izindleko zokukhiqiza zamanye amazwe futhi ziphansi - inani lentengo ledizili nomanyolo lingaphansi kwenani lalapha kithi. Lawo mazwe akwazi ukukhiqiza ukolo oningi kakhulu bese bayakwazi ukuthengisa phesheya ukolo ongadingeki. Yebo, iNingizimu Afrika iyakwazi ukuthenga ukolo phesheya - kodwa khumbula imibuzo esiyibuzile phezulu. Sikholwa ingxenye yezinto zokuxazulula le nkinga kungaba ukungenisa intelo kukolo obuya phesheya (import tariff). Lapho ukolo ubuya phesheya, umuntu othenga lo kolo bese uzokhokha naleyo ntelo esphesheli. Leyo ntelo izolethela izwe inzuzo, futhi izocindezela inani lentengiso labalimi likhuphuke. Khumbula, lapho umgayi efuna ukuthenga ukolo, ubheka ikhwalithi nenani lentengo.

Uhlu lwezincwadi zolwazi ezifundiwe lunikeza uhlelo lwezifundo jikelele kanye nohlu lokuhlola kanye nohlu olubhekene ngqo nalowo nalowo mkhakha wesifundo. Ingaphakathi lale ncwadi lihlukaniswe laba yizahluko eziningana. Isahluko ngasinye sibhekene nalelo nalelo zinga lenhlanganisela yemfundo nokuqeqesha jikelele-Izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, izinga eliphakeme Yileso naleso sahluko salamazinga sinengxenye emfushane eyisingeniso, izindlela zokuhlola zezinga ngalinye. Izindlela zokuhlola zezinga ngalinye zethulwe ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi inqubekelaphambili yokufundwayo ibonakale. Loku kusho ukuthi izindlela ezifanayo zokuhlola zebanga ngalinye zikleliswe zalandelana ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuqhathanisa inqubekelaphambili yokufundwayo ngokuhamba kweminyaka. Loku kwenza ukuthi kwezinye izindawo kube nezikhala , ngoba akuzona zonke izindlela zokuhlola ezinezifana nazo kuwo onke amabanga. Imfundo esekelwe phezu kwemiphumela 1 Isitatimende esibukeziwe sohlelo lwezifundo sikazwelonke: Izitatimende zemikhakha yezifundo 2 Isitatimende esibukeziwe sohlelo lwezifundo sikazwelonke: izinhlelo zezifundo. Incazelo 4 Isu elingeziwe ukubhekana nezilimi eziningi 5 Ulimi lokufunda nokufundisa 6 Inhloso 6 Izimpawu ezingajwayelekile kanye nomklamo 7 Umkhakha wesifundo sezilimi uluthelela kanjani uhlelo lwezifundo? Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, (Umthetho -108 ka-1996) unikeza isisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokufunda eNingizimu Afrika.

Uhlelo lunikeza isikhathi esiphelele semizuzu engama-30 nezinsuku eziyisithupha zokuzilolonga. Izikhathi ezitholakalayo zisetshenziselwa ukusukela ngo-08:30 kuya ku-15:00, okuhlanganisa nemizuzu engama-30 yokuphuza itiye, imizuzu engama-30 yokudla, nemizuzu eyi-10 yokwethula nokuphetha. Lokhu kushiya amahora ama-5 nemizuzu engama-30 yokuzilolonga. Kubalulekile kumfundisi ukuba aqonde izikhathi zokuphuza itiye nokudla. Izikhathi ezitholakalayo zabelwa ngaphezulu, futhi abafundisi kumele bahlale beqaphela isikhathi sohlelo ngalunye ukuze bangaphuthelwa. Le mikhombandlela izokhombisa umfundi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda isigaba ngasinye sokuzilolonga. Ungazami ukusebenzisa amagama abhalwe njengoba kukhulunywa encwadini yokuzilolonga. Sebenzisa amagama akho. Le yindlela kuphela ongazwakala ngayo kahle futhi uqiniseke. Futhi, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka ngqo kubabambiqhaza ngesikhathi sokuzilolonga ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bayabambisana nalabo obasiza. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle uhlelo lokuzilolonga nokuthi ufundile zonke izigaba zencwadi yokuzilolonga ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuzilolonga. Amalungu eqembu angakubuza imibuzo mayelana nezinkinga ezizobhekwa ezigabeni ezilandelayo zencwadi yokuzilolonga, futhi kuzongasiza isikhathi uma ungabatshela ukuthi imibuzo yabo izophendulwa njengoba ukuzilolonga kuqhubeka. Qaphela ukuthi ezinye imibuzo zingase zingaphendulwa kulezi zifundo kodwa zingase zibe nezincazelo ezizayo. Incwadi yokuzilolonga ibhalwe futhi ihlelwe ikakhulukazi njengethuluzi lokubuyisela emuva noma nini uma kudingeka ulwazi oluthile.

Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni - Ingxoxo Nengcweti Isingeniso Ngiyakwemukela, Mnu. Dlamini, uhlobo lwakho lwezinto ezithinta inkohlakalo kuhulumeni. Njengomphakathi, sizama ukuqonda kahle lesi sifo esingcolisa umphakathi wethu. Ngabe ungachaza ukuthi yisiphi isimo esikhona manje? Umlando Wenkohlakalo Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni ayikubona obala kuphela, kodwa ibonakala ezindaweni eziningi. Kukhona izigameko ezithinta izinkontileka, ukusetyenziswa kabi kwemali, kanye nokushintsha kwemithetho ukuze kube nezinzuzo ezingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kudala umonakalo omkhulu, hhayi kuphela kuhulumeni kodwa nakumphakathi wonke. Izimbangela Zenkohlakalo Umphenyi: Kukhona izimbangela eziningi eziyimbangela yalesi sifo. Kuthinta izimo zomnotho, umoya wokuncintisana, kanye nokungabi bikho kokubhekelela. Ungakuchaza lokhu ngokuningiliziwe? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, izimo zomnotho eziyingozi zithinta abantu ukuthi babheke izindlela ezithile zokuthola inzuzo ngokushesha. Ngaphandle kokubhekisisa, abanye bahamba phambili, behluleka ukuqonda ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima emaphakathini. Umoya wokuncintisana uvame ukuholela ekutheni abantu basebenzise izindlela ezingekho emthethweni ukuze bafeze izinjongo zabo. Imiphumela Yenkohlakalo Umphenyi: Lokhu kubuhlungu. Ngabe singakhuluma ngemiphumela ethile yokukhula kwenkohlakalo emiphakathini yethu? Mnu. Dlamini: Impela. Uma inkohlakalo ikhulile, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zomphakathi zincipha. Lokhu kudala ukungabi nakho kwabantu ukuthola imfundo, ezempilo, noma ezinye izinsiza ezibalulekile.

Uma unok complaint, isiphakamiso, noma isiphakamiso... Sazise uma uzwa ukuthi kukhona insiza ekuphathile kahle! Kufanele ukhumbule ukuthi ungathola izinsiza zezempilo e-Addington kuphela uma uhlala ezindaweni ezilandelayo... Kubalulekile ukuqala endaweni yezeMpilo eseduze! Uma wena noma ingane yakho iguliswa, ungachithi imali yakho yokuhamba, kodwa hamba endaweni yezeMpilo njengoba uzothola usizo olufana nalolo esibhedlela ngoba kukhona ab nurses abaqeqeshiwe abazokuhlola, futhi uma kudingeka ukubona udokotela noma ukuthola i-X-ray, um nurse uzokuthumela esibhedlela ngencwadi yokuthumela. Iyini incwadi yokuthumela? Le yincwadi oyitholayo uma um nurse ekuthumela esibhedlela. Lokhu kuzomsiza udokotela ukuba azwe konke mayelana nesifo sakho noma sesifo sengane yakho. Uma ufika esibhedlela, ungathatha le ncwadi, uzothola ukuqondiswa, uphathwe, bese ukhuthazwa noma ukhumbuzwa ukuthi usebenzise indawo yakho yezeMpilo? Ngabe kufanele ngikhokhe malini? Kuzodingeka ukhokhe ngokwejwayelekile yama clerks ethu. Kuphela uma uzobona odokotela endaweni yethu yezeMpilo. Khumbula ukuthi noma yisiphi isifo onaso kufanele siphathwe ngenhlonipho. Sizokweseka ngothando nangenhlonipho. Abaguli bethu kufanele benze okufanayo kubasebenzi bethu bezempilo. Uma udinga noma iyiphi imininingwane noma unemibuzo edinga ukuphendulwa, buza ngoba kungelakho. Njengoba sisho lapha e-Addington -- AKE SIBAMBE NDWESI!

Siphakamisa ukubonga kuNgqongqoshe wezezimali nokuthuthukiswa komnotho, uDkt Zweli Mkhize, ngokusichathazela ezinhlelweni zethu zokulwa negciwane lesandulela ngculaza nengculaza uqobo kanye nasezinhlelweni zokulwa nesifo sofuba. Sibonile ngamehlo ethu, mhlawumbe sazizwela thina qobo, ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukuhamba ungadlile nokuvuka ebuthongweni kade ukhungethwe ngamaphupho amabi nawo egcwele indlala ngokwawo, nokwazi ukuthi nosuku olulandelayo aluthembisi lutho. Siwabonile amehlo okuthe ecwebile kodwa enokwesaba abe enakho ukuncenga, abancane nabadala, obaba nomama bethungatha befuna okuya ethunjini ezinkunkumeni zokudla okulahliwe ukuze imindeni yabo ilale idlile, sibabona bekwenza lokhu ngoba bengasafunwa muntu. Sihlalo oHloniphekile, kumele ngizwakalise intakaso yami nokubonga kubantu abaningi abasebenze nathi ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi siyazigcina izethembiso zethu esazenza kubantu baKwaZulu-Natal. Ngithanda ukubonga kozakwethu esiGungwini eSiphezulu ngaphansi kobuholi buka Dkt Sibusiso Ndebele, u-Ndunankulu wesifundazwe sethu. Ngithanda ukubonga i-Komidi lesi-Shayamthetho leZempilo, ngaphansi kobuholi buka Nkk Zanele Ludidi, ngokuseseka, ukusiqapha nokuzinikela kwalo eMnyangweni wezeMpilo. Ngibuye ngibonge kuSihlalo we-Komidi lezeziMali, uNkk Belinda Scott, ngezeluleko zakhe ezinzulu asiphe zona. Ngibonga ngenhliziyo yami yonke eMkhandlwini wesifundazwe wezeMpilo nakwamanye amaKomidi ehlukene aselulekayo ngokuseseka kwawo.

Ubani ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa imishini? Ubani ozobuyisela izindleko? Ubani ozophatha futhi agcine imishini? Ingabe kukhona ukuqeqeshwa kulabo abazosebenzisa imishini? Izindlela zokukala imishini yokufafaza nezitshalo? Ukuphatha amarekhodi njalo ngemuva kokuphothula umsebenzi othile - isibonelo: ngemuva kokufafaza insimu ngezikhemikhali, ingabe kuzoba namarekhodi akhombisa ukuthi yiziphi izikhemikhali ezisetshenziswe kuphi? Ukuthola nokukhokha idizili? Ubani ongashayela i-tractor? Ubani ozobizwa ukuba ashaye ama-tractor? Ingabe kukhona ukuqeqeshwa kwabashayeli ngaphambi kokubagcina imishini?
