Yiziphi izinyathelo ezizothathwa uma izinto zidinga ukulungiswa?

Ukuxhumana namalungu omphakathi: Ngezinjongo zokubhalelana ngokusemthethweni, ulimi oluthandwa yisakhamuzi kumele lusetshenziswe. Konke ukuxhumana ngomlomo kumele kuqhubeke ngolimi, kwenzeke ngolimi elithandwa ngabantu okuqondiswe kubo . Uma kudingekile, yonke imizamo kumele yenziwe kusetshenziswa izinsiza zokwenza ulimi lube lula njengokutolika (ngokulandelana, ngesikhathi esisodwa nangocingo noma ukutolika okuhleliwe)lapho kungaphumeleleka khona. 2.4.6.2 Imiqulu kaHulumeni: Uhlelo lwemibhalo yobuliminingi obusebenzayo kumele lulandelwe iminyanngo kahulumeni kaZwelonke kulemBhalo engadingi ukuthi ikhishwe kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. 2.4.6.3 Lapho ukusebenza okunemiphumela nokusimeme kukahulumeni kunoma ngabe kukusiphi isigaba kudinga ukuxhumana okuqondakalayo kwemininingwane kumele kukhishwe ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 kanye nasezifundeni, kuzo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ezinikeziwe. 2.4.6.4 Lapho imiqulu kahulumeni ingeke yenziwa ukuthi itholakale kuzo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11, imiNyango kahulumeni kaZwelonke kufanele ikhiphe imiqulu ngesikhathi esisodwa okungenani ngezilimi eziyisithupha. 2.4.6.5 Umgomo wokujikeleza kufanele usetshenziswe uma kukhethwa ulimi lokukhipha imiqulu kahulumeni olwimini lwabe Nguni nabeSuthu. 2.4.6.6 Ukuxhumana nomhlaba jikelele: Ukuxhumana kukahulumeni nomhlaba jikelele kuzawuba ulimi lwesiNgisi noma kokungavamile kwenziwe ngolimi olukhethwe yizwe okuxhunyanwa nalo. 3.1 Ukusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yolimi kuzokongeza ukufuneka kokuhumusha nokuhlela umsebenzi kanye nemisebenzi yokutolika, ikakhulukazi ezilimini zendabuko.

Ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba usebenzise umzimba ukuze uhlale unempilo nokuthi usebenzise leyo mzimba ephilayo namathalente awo ukungenela imiqhudelwano yezemidlalo. ukudoba nokukhuthaza intsha nabadala ukuba babambe iqhaza ekuvocavoceni imizimba ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba usebenzise imizimba ukuze uhlale unempilo. Ukushoshozela labo abangabambe qhaza ukuba nabo babambe iqhaza ekuvocavoceni umzimba. Kunamaphuzu amabili okufanele abekwe phambili kulesi sandulelo, okungezokungcebeleka nokuthuthukisa ezemidlalo. Umsebenzi wezokungcebeleka uselwazini olutholakala kulowo mdlalo kunomdlalo qobo lwawo. AbezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) neKhomishani (SASC) bazinikele emgomeni "wokunikeza amathuba amahle ezokungcebeleka kubo bonke". Ezokungcebeleka zingacengwa ukuba kukhuthazwe ukungabandlululi ngokwebala, amathuba obuholi nokukhuthaza isizwe esinempilo. ezombusazwe, ukuzimbandakanya, ukukhubazeka noma isikhundla. Ukwabiwa kwezimali zezemidlalo ngokulinganayo. Kubalulekile ukudala ukusebenzisana ngokuxhumana nezinhlangano emkhakheni wangasese ukuze kuqinisekwe ngokuqhutshwa kwemigomo ngokuyikho nangenkuthalo. Ingxenye yabantu bakulelizwe ababambe iqhaza kwezemidlalo zokuncintisana balinganiselwa engxenyeni yokuyishumi ekhulwini. Lokhu akunambithisiseki uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amazwe, ikakhulukazi lawo mazwe asethuthukile lapho belinganiselwa ngaphezulu kwengxenye enga-50 ekhulwini. kwamukela usizo lwamavolontiya.

Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu (GEMS quality care assurance) Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elincane, lapho abantu behlale bejabulile futhi bephila impilo ejabulisayo, kwakukhona isikhungo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo esaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS. Lesi sikhungo sathandwa kakhulu ngababhalisile, ngoba sasinikeza ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Abantu abavakashela i-GEMS babebona ukuthi izidingo zabo zihlala zikhuliswa, futhi lokhu kwakubavusa ithemba. Uthando lokunakekela abantu belwakhiwa ngothando lukaDkt. Mthembu, ongumholi wesikhungo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayenobuchwepheshe obukhulu kwezempilo, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, wayenothando olukhulu lokunakekela abantu. Wazi kahle ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezempilo akukhona nje ukwelapha izifo, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwababhalisile nabahlengikazi. Ngelinye ilanga, uDkt. Mthembu wathola umyalezo ovela kumphakathi, owawukhombisa ukuthi abanye abantu babengajabuli ngempela ngezinqubo ezithile ezikhona e-GEMS. Lokhu kwenza uDkt. Mthembu wacabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezinguquko. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nabasebenzi besikhungo, ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinkinga. “Ngiyazi ukuthi sikhona isikhungo esihle, kodwa kufanele sibe nesibopho sokwenza kube ngcono,” kusho uDkt. Mthembu. “Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhalisile bahlala bejabule futhi bezizwa bekhuthazekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza sibe yisikhungo esihloniphekile, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi.” Abasebenzi bavuma ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqubo ezithile zokuphendula izikhalazo zabantu.

Bonke abameleli kumele bazi umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezikhelini zabo phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu zokushintsha. Ngokusho komthetho 5 3, isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni kumele sithunyelwe ebhodini lesaziso somphakathi sedolobha. Umphakathi angacela uphenyo mayelana nokungatholi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni. Ukungatholi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni ngeke kuphazamise ubungako boma mhlangano noma izinqubo zebhodi noma noma yiziphi zeziqu zayo. b Ngaphansi kwezidingo ezidingekayo zokubamba umhlangano, ukungaphumeleli komphakathi ukuvota ngeke kuvimbe ukuqhubeka komhlangano wekhansela. b Ngaphansi kwezidingo ezidingekayo, ukungaphumeleli komphakathi ukuvota ngeke kuvimbe ukuqhubeka komhlangano wekomidi. Akukho mhlangano ozoba khona uma izidingo ezidingekayo zingekho phakathi kwemizuzu eyishumi nambili yesikhathi esibekwe sokuthi umhlangano uqale, ngaphandle kokuthi abameleli abakhona bavumelane ngokubambisana ukuthi isikhathi kufanele sandiswe kodwa hhayi sibe sikhulu kunezikhathi ezingu-15; uma izidingo ezidingekayo zingahlangabezani, umhlangano kumele uphume. d Uma izidingo ezidingekayo zingahlangabezani ngemuva kokuphuma, umphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme kufanele ngakho-ke uphume umhlangano. Uma umhlangano uphume ngenxa yokungahlangabezani nezidingo ezidingekayo, umhlangano kumele uphinde uqale phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisixhenxe. a uvunyelwe ukuba ungabi khona ngaphansi komthetho 13; noma b lowo mphakathi ucelwa ukuba withdraw ngaphansi komthetho 462; noma c ngokuvuma komphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme. Umphakathi ngamunye obambe umhlangano wekhansela noma ikomidi kumele signing the attendance register eyenzelwe le njongo.

Kukho inketho yezinzuzo ehambelana nezidingo zempilo zomndeni wakho kanye nephakheji yakho! Lokhu kuyisibopho esiphelele sokuhlanganyela kubo bonke amalungu futhi akukhombisi isibopho somqashi. Uma umqashi elungele ukuthola isibopho somqashi, umqashi uzokhokha ingxenye yesibopho, kanti isiqeshana sizokhokhwa ngumsebenzi. Isibopho esiphezulu somqashi sincike osayizi bemindeni futhi siqediwe ku-75% yokuhlanganyela kwakho okuphelele, ngokuphakanyiswa kwe-R2,570. Ingabe udinga olunye ulwazi?

b ezinye Izigaba- zalomthetho; kanye c inqubomgomo yokukhokhela indawo okufanele umasipalati ayamukele ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 3. umkhandlu kamasipalati kufanele wamukele inqubomgomo ehambisana nalomthetho mayelana nokukhokhiswa kwentela yendawo empahleni noma endaweni efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo kumasipalati. f ivumele umasipalati ukuba akhuthaze intuthuko yendawo; kanye g Ihlonze, kulandela ukuhlaziya okunzulu mayelana nohlelo lwezindleko kanye nenzuzo, zonke izindawo noma izimpahla ezingase zingafakwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokuhlola ngenhloso yokuba kuklanywe intela yendawo. Noma yimuphi ushwele, ukubuyiselwa imali noma ukuncishiselwa okukhulunywe ngakho esigatshaneni- 2 nokubhekelwe enqubeni mgomo eyemukelwe ngumasipalati kufanele ke kuhambisane nohlaka lukazwelonke olungase lulawulwe ukuba lusetshenziswe. Umkhandlu kamasipalati kufanele ucubungule konke okwemukele nokuphawuliwe kwathunyelwa kuwo ngenkathi ucubungula uhlaka lwenqubomgomo yokukhokhela intela yendawo. Umkhandlu kamasipalati kufanele ubuyekeze njalo ngonyaka, kuthi uma kudingekile, ulungise inqubomgomo yokukhokhelwa kwentela yendawo. Isigaba-- 3 nesigaba- 4, sifundwa kanye nezinguquko ezidingekile kuye ngaloko okukhulunywa ngako, sisetshenziswa kunoma yikuphi ukulungiswa kwenqubomgomo yokukhokhelwa kwentela yendawo. umasipalati wendawo kufanele wemukele ukuba imithetho kamasipalati ibenegalelo ekusetshenzisweni kanye nasekuphoqelelweni komgomo wawo wokukhokhelwa kwentela yendawo. a kwemikhakha ehlukene yempahla nezindawo; kanye b kwemikhakha eyehlukene yabanikazi abanomthwalo wokuba bakhokhe intela yendawo.

Lombiko uzonikaisithombe esiphelele ngemali engenile nezindleko ezibekhona, kanye nemali esele kulowonyaka. Kujwayelekile ukuthi lokhu kungeniswe ingakapheli inyangaemva kokuphela konyaka wezimali. Umcwaningi ozimele kumele ahlole amabhuku enhlanganominyaka yonke ukuze abone ukuthi konke kwenziwa ngendlelaeyiyo. Kuyaphakanyiswa futhi ukuthi uma kungenzeka, kwenziweucwaningo lwangaphakathi, lungakenziwa olwabacwaningiabazimele ukuqiniseka ukuthi inhlangano iyakwazi ukubonaukuthi izinto zihamba kahle. Imibiko yezimali esayiniwe ibeisidluliselwa emkhandlwini bese kuthi amakhophi ayiwo ngqoagcinwe endaweni ephephile. Ukuntshontsha noma ukukhwabanisa, noma ukungazibhali phansiizimali zenhlangano kungenzeka kalula kakhulu. Abantu bangakhipha imali ngamasheke aphumekungabhekisiswanga ukuthi zonke izimfanelo zikhona na. Ikomidi lesigceme linemisebenzi eminingi ehlukahlukene okumeleliyenze esigcemeni. Lokhu kukhomba ukuthi uyoba cishe nolwazioluningi, amaphepha kanye nemiquluyaleyomisebenzi. Ukuze ukwazi ukwenzaleyomisebenzi kahle kuhle ukuba nendawoyokugcina lonke lolulwazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthiwonke amaphepha abalulekile ngesigcemenokusebenza kwaso kumele agcinwe lapho. Ungayigcina kanjani yonke imiqulu ukuze kube lula futhi kusheshe ukuthola ulwazi kuwona Uhlelo oluhle lokugcina imiqulu lunguhamba ibanga elide ukukusiza ekubhekeleni ulwazi oluningi? Ukuba nohlelo lokugcina kusho ukuthi noma ubani odinga umqulu uzokwazi ukuthi abheke kuphi. Ziningi-ke izindlel zokuhlela ukubeka imiqulu, kuya ngezidingo ezahlukahlukene.

Okwesibili, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kochwepheshe bempilo, ukuze othisha bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi baphile kahle, futhi baphinde baphendule kahle ezimfanelweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abazali ukuba babe nesithakazelo emfundweni yezingane zabo. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuqwashisa, imiphakathi kufanele ibambe imicimbi yokukhuthaza imfundo, ukuze abazali bazi ukuthi imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi izingane zifune ukufunda, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zemfundo zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emfundweni. Imfundo iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sibe nesibopho sokwenza kube lula ukuze bonke abafundi baphumelele. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi, okuzokwenza sibe nempumelelo esikhathini esizayo.

Ezinye izindlela ezivame ukusetshenziswa zifaka phakathi kokuhlangana emihlanganweni, ukuhlela izinkulumo, nokwakha amaqembu okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo. Ezinye izibhikisho ziba nezimpikiswano ezinzima, lapho abantu behamba emigwaqweni, behlabelela, noma bephakamisa izimpawu ezikhombisa izikhalazo zabo. Lezi zindlela zikhombisa ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokuzwana. Imiphumela Yokubhikisha Imiphumela yokubhikisha komphakathi ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izibhikisho zingaholela ekutholeni izixazululo ezithile, njengokwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezintsha noma ukulungiswa kwezinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kubonisa ukuthi izwi labantu liyalalelwa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izibhikisho zingaholela ekuphazamisekeni komphakathi, lapho abantu bephikisana, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezimweni ezinzima. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhikisho zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwababhikishi nohulumeni. Izimo Eziyinhloko Zokubhikisha Kunezimo ezithile ezithinta ukubhikisha komphakathi ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene. Isibonelo, eMzanzi, izibhikisho ezivame ukwenzeka zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni eziningi ezingenazo izinsiza ezisemqoka, futhi lokhu kubangela ukunganeliseki okukhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, emazweni athile, izibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinkinga zomnotho, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amathuba okusebenza awatholakali kalula.

Isibonelo, ukusungulwa kwezinkampani zomphakathi ezithola izinkontileka ezinkulu, noma ukungena ezikhungweni ezizimele ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ezithinta izinjongo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye baphathe amaholo aphezulu ngokubambisana nezinyunyana, kanti abanye abantu bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Izimpawu zingabonakaliswa nasekuthathweni kwezinyathelo ezingafanele, lapho abanye bephatha izinqumo ngendlela engalungile. Imiphumela Yenkohlakalo Imiphumela yenkohlakalo kuhulumeni ibonakala ekuthuthukisweni kwezobuchwepheshe, emnotweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Ukwanda kwenkohlakalo kuholela ekuncipheni kokufaka imali ezweni, okubangela umphakathi uthole imiphumela engalindelekile. Lokhu kubangela ukudumazeka phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaholi bembula ukuthi izinqumo zabo zenzelwe izinzuzo zabo kuphela. Ukuqashwa okuphakeme nokunganelisekile kuholela ekubeni abantu bacabange kabusha ngezinto abazifunayo empilweni. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nenkohlakalo Ukuze sihlule inkohlakalo, kudingeka izinyathelo ezicacile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezisekela ukuphepha komphakathi zikhona, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokubika, kanye nokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokulwa nenkohlakalo kubalulekile. Uhlelo lokuhlola izinqumo zomphakathi kanye nokubandakanya imiphakathi ezinqumweni kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ukwakha imithombo enomthelela emiphakathini kungasiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Isiphetho Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eqhubekayo eNingizimu Afrika, ethinta bonke futhi ichaphazela impilo yansuku zonke. Ukuze silwe nale nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezinqala, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuqiniswa kwemithetho ukuze sithole uhulumeni onokholo.

Uphawu olugqamile lobuliminingi eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izilimi zomdabu eziningana zikhulunywa ukweqa nemingcele yezifunda, ezahlukaniselwana phakathi kwemiphakathi yalolo limi oluvela ezifundeni ezahlukene. Kukhona manje ukwazi okunamandla kwesidingo sokukhuphula amandla okwenza ukuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu ezazibandlululwa esikhathini esedlule kany nokuthuthukisa ubuliminingi, uma ngabe izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele zikhululeke ekusekeleni ngokunganqamuki phezu kwezilimi okungezona zomdabu njengezisemqoka, okuyizona izilimi ezisemthethweni zombuso. Ukufikela kulesi sikhathi ukuphathwa kokwehluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika edlule kahulumeni wobandlululo kwenziwe kwaba yinkinga ngokungabi khona kwenqubomgomo yolimi echaziwe, okwaholela ekutheni kusetshenziswe isiNgisi nesiBhunu njengeziLimi ezinamandla okuthelela ezenhlalakahle nezomnotho kanye nezingxenye zombusazwe zomphakathi wethu. Emva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yombuso wentando yeningi, iNingizimu Afrika ifinyelele ephuzwini elisemqoka emlandwini walo. Izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele ziphendule ukwehluka kwazo ngokolimi nangamasiko kanye nenselele yobuliminingi obusemthethweni, yingakho-ke kungeniswa uHlaka lweNqubomgomo yoLimi kaZwelonke. Lolu Hlaka lweNqubomgomo aluqalisi kuphela indlela entsha yokubhekana nobuliminingi eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa lugqugquzela ngamandla ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu njengezilimi ezisemthethweni ukuze londle luphinde luthuthukise ubumbano lukazwelonke .

Inhloko yomnyango kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi ukuxazululwa kwezikhalo kuyahlolisiswa ngokugcina amarekhodi amanani ezikhalo ezixazululiwe kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka ngamunye bese ibikela iKhomishani ngalokhu njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Ikhomishani kufanele ibikele Indlu kaZwelonke okungenani kanye ngonyaka ngokuphathwa kwezikhalo nokusebenza ngempumelelo kwenqubo yezikhalo kanye nemisebenzi yayo, esiFundazweni kuSishayamthetho salelo siFundazwe. Uma kufakwa isikhalo ngokwalenqubo, umsebenzi ofake isikhalo kufanele adalule uma esebenzisa ezinye izinqubo. Isikhalo esifakwe ngaphambi kwesimemezelo seMithethonqubo yesikhashana, okungaphambi komhlaka 1 ku-Ntulikazi 1999, iyoqhutshwa futhi iphothulwe ngokweMithethonqubo yeZikhalo yesiKhashana ekhishwe ngaphansi kweSimemezelo ePhephabhukwini loMbuso elinguNombolo 20231 ngo 1999. Usuku lokuqala ukusebenza kwalemithethonqubo ngumhlaka 19 kuMandulo 2003, kuhanjiswana nalokho okushiwo kuMthethonkambiso K. Lelifomu kufanele lisetshenziselwe ukufa isikhalo (ngaphandle kwezinsolo zokuxhoshwa okungafanele) uma unganelisiwe yisenzo noma ukwehluleka ukwenza futhi ungakwazanga ukuxazulula leyo nkinga ngokusebenzisa ukuxoxisana okungamisiwe ngokomthetho. Ungasizwa noma ummelwe ngomunye umsebenzi noma ommele noma isikhulu esivela kwinyunyana eyaziwayo. Kubalulekile ukugcwalisa kahle ngokuyikho lonke ulwazi. Uma ifomu seligcwalisiwe, kufanele linikwe umsebenzi okhethelwe ukuba enze-lula noma abe ngumxhumanisi kulenqubo yezikhalo kuleso sikhungo. Umnyango uzojobelela lelifomu kweminye imibhalo yesikhalo futhi liyosetshenziswa kuzo zonke izigaba zenqubo yesikhalo.

Kukhona izindawo ezintathu ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kulo mthetho wokuziphatha, ezihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwedokhumenti eyodwa. Kucacile ukuthi inhlangano engaphansi kwemali ephumelelayo izuza ezisebenzisaneni phakathi kwabanikeli, abahwebi, kanye nalabo abaphatha izinsiza nezenzo zenhlangano. Umthetho wokuziphatha ubalulekile, kodwa awukhombisi kahle izinga elibekiwe lokuziphatha. Ababhekele izikhundla zenhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali banemithwalo yokubheka nokuphatha inhlangano ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo ngenkathi behlonipha imithetho elawulwa umthethosisekelo wenhlangano. Ngokucabangela ukuthi lo mthetho uzosetshenziswa yizinhlangano ezahlukene ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, le dokhumenti ivulekile futhi ibhalwe ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda nokuyisebenzisa. Umphakathi - umuntu owenziwe ukuba aqaphe isimo sezimali zenhlangano nsuku zonke. Lokhu kungaba umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele noma wesikhathi esithile, unikezwa umuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle, noma kwenziwa ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano, inani lemali eliqoqiwe, noma leyo ekhishwayo. Umphathi wehhovisi - umuntu onikezwe umsebenzi wokubheka ihhovisi nsuku zonke ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Le ndima ingaba isikhathi esigcwele noma esithile, noma kwenziwe ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano. Umphathi - umuntu onikezwe ukuba abe yisikhulu senhlangano ngokuphelele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. Lo muntu uqashwe yibhodi elawulayo ye-NPO futhi ubika kulowo msebenzi ngakho konke okwenzekayo enhlangano nsuku zonke.

Lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle akufanele enze isenzo ezingathikameza noma sivimbele uhlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle lomunye umuntu naye obambe iqhaza kulemboni yezasolwandle. i akudingekile ukuba abe nohlelo lwezokuvikela lwasolwandle; futhi ii esenikezwe izingxenye ezifanele zohlelo oluchithekela komunye. Lona omunye obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze alandele uhlelo. a uhlelo lwezokuvikela lwasolwandle uhlelo lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle elekela kumsebenzini womunye obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle ; futhi i kufanele abe nohlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle; futhi ii usenikezwe ingxenye efanele yalolo hlelo; futhi iii esevumile ngokubhaliwe lowo msebenzi owelekela kulolo hlelo olwelekayo. Lona omunye obambe iqhaza embonini wephula umthethonkambiso , no , omunye obambe iqhaza akenzi icala kodwa anganikwa umyalo wokuphoqwa. Umsebenzi wemikhumbi elawulwa eNingizimu Afrika akufanele uthikameze noma uvimbele ukulandelwa kohlelo lwezokuvikela lwasolwandle. e ukubhekana nezinye izidingo ezidingeka engxenyeni- A yomgomo we-ISPS okufanele kubhekwane nazo ohlelweni lokuzosetshenziswa uma kuhlolwa ezokuvikela; kanye f ukukhombisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kohlelo kuyoba nomthelela ekuncishisweni kwengozi yokugxambukela ngokungekho emthethweni kwezokuthutha olwandle.

Iminyango nezifundazwe ziyoba nesibophezelo sesabelo sezimali sokuqhuba umsebenzi osuqalile weNLPF ezinhleni zokuphatha. Abasebenzi bamaThimba eziLimi bayoqashwa yiminyango ebhekene nokuqhuba umsebenzi bese beqeqeshwa ngesikhathi besebenza yiDAC ngokubambisana nabasebenzi bePanSALB. Kuyosungulwa izinhlelo ezihleliwe zokuqeqesha (Bona 2.2.2). Kuyoba nokwehlukana ngobukhulu bamathimba eminyango ehlukene nezifundazwe. Isibalo songcweti bolimi abafuneka ethimbeni lolimi bayosingathwa ngokulingana nezinhlelo zokushicilela kanye nesabelo sezimali somnyangwo nesifundazwe. Ubukhulu bethimba lolimi buyonqunywa wuhlelo lomsebenzi kanjalo namakhono adingekayo ukushayela nokuqhuba umsebenzi weNqubomgomo. Isibonelo, ingosi yabasebenzi kufanele ixube abahumushi, abalungisa amaphutha embhalweni oguqulelwe kolunye ulimi, abahleli bolimi, izichazimazwi, nezazi zehlelo lamagama olimi, njalo njalo. IDAC iyaqonda ukuthi ukuqhuba umsebenzi weNqubomgomo osuqalile kuyophonsa inselelo enkulu. Ngaleyo ndlela, iyothembela kakhulu ekubambisaneni nawo onke amaqembu abandanyekayo ukuze iphendule zonke izinhloso zibe yizenzo eziphumelelayo. Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi lithathelwe emcabangweni wokuthi Umthetho weziLimi zaseNingizimu Afrika uyoqala ukusebenza ngoMfumfu 2003. Hlinzeka isabelo sezimali ngendlela ekhula njalo ngonyaka ngesikhathi inqumomgomo seyiqalile (unyaka wokuqala, amaphesenti angu30, unyaka wesibili, amaphesenti angu 60, owesithathu amaphesenti angu 100).

Bathe beqinisekisa ukuthi bazogxila kulokhu banhlonishwa, kulokhu kwaziswa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uJohn wabuyela emhlanganweni. “Ngabe sicabanga ngabantu bonke? Ngabe lezi zikhungo zikhumbula izidingo zethu? Hhayi ukuthi ngizoyiqinisa into ethile, kodwa izikhungo zikhona ukuze zixazulule izimo,” wawubona. UThandi waphakamisa okukhulu, yaze yadalwa imicabango emisha. "Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukwakheka kwezikhungo kuthinta indlela esiphila ngayo, indlela esixhumana ngayo; siyaqhubeka nesigaba esisha, sigodluke siqonde phambili." Kwakukhona umoya wokucacisa izinto ezinzima, okubalwa umphakathi odinga ukwakheka okuhamba phambili nangokuphumelela. Ngakho, leli dolobha elisha liqhubeka liphila phakathi kwezikhungo ezakhiwe ngenhloso, kumelwe kube yindawo yokholo, ngokuhambisana. UJohn, uThandi, uJabu noLinda bahlala behlangana, behlola izindlela zokuphucula ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni zomphakathi. Umoya omusha uphakamisa, uZiyanda wabe usuphumelele njengombono ongaphezu komphezulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, izikhungo zasilokhu ziqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizukulwane. Ezinsukwini ezilandelayo, uJohn wathola izindaba ezimnandi, izikhungo sezenzele kahle. Abantu bemabhuqa baphila kahle, izifundo zenzeka, imicimbi ihlalisana, izinkanyezi zikhanya esibhakabhakeni. E-Ziyanda, imifula yezenzo, ubuhlobo, noshintsho, izikhungo zikhona ukwazisa lokho okuhle ngendlela yesikhathi esizayo. Kona, lokhu kwaba yincwadi yokwakha, eyachazela ngesimo esisha sokuphila, umuzwa omuhle, okwakukhanya phakathi.

Izincwadi ezibekwe eceleni zingavuselelwa ngaphandle uma kukhona obevele esezivuselele. Samkhahlele, savele samkhahlela njengebhola. Olunye uhlobo lokulingisa olufaka ukusebenza kwe-GIS ukuze ihlinzeke ukubukeka kwendawo yamaphrojekthi e-MIG kanye namaleya okushisa emali esetshenziswa yi-MIG nokusalela emuva kokulethwa kwezidingo zabantu. Ngangingeke ngize ngiphikisane noDkt Asvat. Ngakho-ke ngigqugquzela ukuba uhlele izinhlelo zakho ezenezela isisindo kumakhomodithi anika inzalo kubo bonke ababambe iqhaza. Onke amaphrojekthi akhokhelwa yihhovisi elikhulu elise-Elsenburg, emva kohlelo lokubeka okubalulekile phambili. U-Ehud Olmert, uNdunankulu wakwa-Israel, kubikwa ukuthi u-ode uchungechunge olubizwa nge- "sharp and short" eGaza naseWest Bank. Izigebengu nababulali AKUMELE bathintane namalungu omphakathi. Uma kunenhloson nokuhlola okukholekayo komlando waseNingizimu Afrikha ngeminyaka yawo-70 kodwa ikakhulukazi, ngeyo-80 emva kweqiniso elingenakuphikwa okumele libhekwe. Yebo, kanti zabekwa kuyo yonke insimu njengokusho kohlelo lokwelapha. Ngesikhathi sokuboshwa, amalungu aqasheliswa ukuthi umsolwa wadlwengula umfana oneminyaka eyishumi endlini yakhe. Iphrojekthi ye-OASIS incike kakhulu ekufakweni kwesandla yimiphakathi eyakhelene nayo ukuze iphrojekthi isimame. Ukurola, emva kokufakwa kwabagijimi, kubaluleke kakhulu. I-AHSC kumele kunwetshwe izinzuzo emithonjeni etholakalayo bese yemukela izindlela ezingambi eqolo. Umsolwa uzovela enkantolo yeMantshi yaseTembisa namuhla.

Ubuhle Obungokwemvelo: Izithako Zokwakha Isithombe Ngaphandle kwemfashini, ubuhle bukhombisa indlela esizithanda ngayo, futhi kudinga izithako ezikhethekile. Ukuze sibe nobuhle, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo efanele isikhumba sethu. Izinkampani zikhuthaza imikhiqizo yokunakekela isikhumba enezithako ezisemvelweni, njengezihlahla namafutha, okukhuthaza ubuhle bethu futhi kuhlonipha imvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi behlola umthelela omubi wemikhiqizo enezithako ezimbi emvelweni. Ukuze sibe nobuhle obuqinile, kufanele siqaphele imikhiqizo esiyisebenzisayo, ukuze sikhulise isithombe esihle ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Imfashini Nezokuxhumana: Ukuhlangana Kwezimboni Izinkampani ezinkulu ziqhubeka nokuhlangana nezinkanyezi, okuholela ekwakheni izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwemfashini nobuhle. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuthola izitayela ezintsha nokwabelana ngemicabango nezithombe, ukudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Beauty Blender ne-Fenty Beauty ziqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, zikhuthaza abantu abanemibala ehlukene ukuba baveze ubuhle babo, okwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ukuze sakhe isithombe esihle, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhle buhluke kumuntu nomuntu, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze lezi zinto. Izifundo Zempilo: Ukubaluleka Kokunakekela Ngaphandle kwemfashini nobuhle, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yethu iyisisekelo. Ukudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokuphumula kahle kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isithombe esihle. Imfashini iyindlela yokukhombisa ubuhle bethu, kodwa impilo yethu ibalulekile kakhulu.

Lokhu kuphambana nokujiyiswa kwemisebenzi ezindaweni zikamasipala nezasemadolobheni. Ngingumshayeli wendiza, nginesipiliyoni esiningi, ngiyazi ukuthi abashayeli bezindiza bacabanga kanjani. Ukwakha kabusha umngcele endaweni yemvelo akusebenzi ezingeni eli-geo-political. Kuvamise ukuhlotshaniswa nenani 'elikhonekayo, elivamise ukufaka ukulinganiswa kwentengo. Kuwumthombo onesisindo osiza abantu uma beziveza ubunjalo babo. Ingelapheka uma imithi yokwelapha iqalwe kusenesikhathi nemithi ithathwa njalo kuze kuphele isikhathi. Siyanamukela, ngicela nisukume nizazise kanti uWendy uzosiza ukunifungisa. Uma izwekazi lethu likhipha abesifazane inyumbazana liyohlala liyisiceke kanti ngeke nangelilodwa ilanga likwazi ukusebenza ngokugcwele. Imisakazo esakaza mahhala incike cishe kakhulu emalini ekhishwa ngabakhangisayo ukuze isimame. Izinselelo zomhlaba wonke ezishukumisa umhlaba zidinga izixazululo zamazwe amaningi. NjengabaseNingizimu Afrikha nase-Afrikha, sethulela isigqoko abase-Bahamia ngokubambisaba ngomzabalazo wenkululeko ngesikhathi senkululeko kanye nengcindezelo. Siyazi ukuthi izakhamuzi sezilinde isikhathi eside kakhulu, belinde izethembiso, ezenziwa abaholi abanganaki. Zombili izinhlangothi seziluphothulile uhlelo lokukhetha ababambiqhaza okususelwa kuleyo naleyo nkampani. Ukudla imikhiqizo kungehluka ngenxa yokwenyuka kwezinga lamaphutha ezintweni ezisebenza ngogesi. Igubha inqubekela phambili empini yokulwa nesifo - bese iletha ukugxila ezinselelweni ezisele. Kubalulekile ukuthi ukubambisana emazweni omhlaba phakathi kwezinhlangothi kuqiniswe kunwetshwe kuwo wonke amazinga.

Ukuze kube khona ukuhweba okuhle, kudingeka izindawo ezithile ezitholakalayo, kodwa abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bejolisa emigwaqweni, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni komgwaqo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamiseni umphakathi, futhi kungase kube nomthelela ongemuhle ezindaweni ezikufuphi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi bathole izixazululo ezisemthethweni, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuphazamisa abanye. Ukuphikisana kulokhu, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangenza kube nzima ukuthola izikhala ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba abathengisi bejolisa emigwaqweni ethile, okungaholela ezimeni ezimbi. Nokho, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala benza umsebenzi oncomekayo, futhi bahlala bekhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, kunesidingo sokubheka izindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Bahlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, futhi bahlala bejabulisa abathengi ngezinto ezithengiswayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kuqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, abathengisi basemgwaqeni badinga ukuxhaswa, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba ngendlela efanele, futhi baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kubekhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi basemgwaqeni nohulumeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokuthengisa, ezizovumela abathengisi ukuba baphile kahle.

I-Bt imele ibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ebizwa nge-Bacillus thuringiensis. I-Bt iphinde ibhekisele kumkhiqizo we-pesticide owenziwe kulezi bhaktheriya. Yini indima ye-Bt mayelana nezifo zezinsongo? Ezinye izinhlobo ze-Bt zibulala izinsongo zisebenzisa ama-toxins az known as insecticidal crystal proteins noma delta endotoxins. Lezi toxins ngokuvamile azibeki engozini abantu noma ezinye izinhlanga ezingezona izinsongo. Yini i-Bt corn? Ukukhiqizwa kwe-delta endotoxins kulawulwa yizinhlobo zemvelo eyodwa phakathi kwalezi bhaktheriya. Izinhlobo ezishintshiwe zingafakwa ezitshalweni ze-corn. Isitshalo se-corn esinolezi zinhlobo zemvelo singakhiqiza ama-delta endotoxins azobulala izinsongo ezithambekele kulolo hlobo lwe-protein. Kungani sisebenzisa izinhlobo zemvelo ezifana ne-Bt ku-corn? Ama-delta endotoxins ashiswa ezitshalweni ngokuvamile alahlekelwa ukusebenza ngenxa yokukhanya okwaziwa njenge-UV light. Nokho, ama-delta endotoxins akhiqizwa ngaphakathi kwesitshalo awalimali ukukhanya kwe-UV. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifo eziningi ezidalwa izinsongo zihluke ukuphathwa, zidinga ukusetshenziswa okukhulu kwamapesticides ajwayelekile, kodwa zingabulawa ama-delta endotoxins akhiqizwa ngaphakathi kwesitshalo. Kukhona futhi teknoloji yokufaka le toxin edala lezi zinhlobo zemvelo. Ingabe wonke amasimu e-Bt corn anama-toxins? Kuya ngezimo. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezinqumayo ukuthi kuphumephi ama-delta endotoxins esitshalo: indlela akhiqizwa ngayo kanye nesimo esiqala inqubo yokukhiqiza.

Ukunalokho, kumele icabange ngendlela efanayo ne-ejensi yokuhlela imigwaqo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcabango wokuthi abanamandla bangaphezu komthetho kanye nokubekiwe kwenze ntekenteke ukusebenza komthetho womhlaba othuthukiswe ngaphansi kweNhlangano yeZizwe. Lokhu kubiza ukungenelela okunenhloso ngohlelo lokuhlnganisa amazwe omhlaba, njengama-Afrikha, ukukhipha le miphumela yendlela yokuziphatha, ukulingana ngokwesibalo kobulili obehlukene, ukufaka abantu bonke, ukuphepha kwabantu, ukugcina nokuthuthuka. Leyo naleyo nselelo ithola amaphuzu, kanti iqembu elinamaphuzu amaningi ekupheleni kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa lithola izindlu ezimbili ezinefenisha. Ukufakwa kwe-white paper kwiwebhusayithi sekuzophela njengengxenye yokwakhiwa kabusha kwebhusayithi yonke. Uma isiqediwe, le ndawo iyohlinzeka indawo esemngceleni ukulawula umngcele. Nginesiqiniseko sokuthi ngingafaka isandla kubantu besifazane nabesilisa abasebancane abafundile nabanamandla abenelisekile nabayizakhamuzi eziphilile zaseNingizimu Afrikha. Ukubekeka engcupheni yokucwila ezikweletini ngesikhathi sokubika wumthamo oyiwo waleyo naleyo ngxenye yokutholwayo okubalulwe ngenhla. Le phrojekthi yaqalwa yi-Vereeniging SAPS kanye noMnyango wezeMfundo, nokwasiza ekusimamiseni uhlelo lokumaka ama-eseyi. Sakhetha ukulwa ukunokuzehlisa, ngokuzehlisa, kuqhubekela phambili amacala angesikhathi sobandlululo okubukela phansi abantu. Lokhu kufaka nezenzo zenkohlakalo, ukukhwabanisa, ukweba kanye nokungasebenzisi ngendlela izakhiwo zikahulumeni. Ukusuka kwimuva elibuhlungu lezwe lethu kwenza libe nenqubekela phezulu kanti kumele liqhubekele phambili.

Omunye umuntu angakwazi naye ukufaka isikhalo sangaphakathi ngokuphikisana nesinqumo se-Ofisa Yolwazi, ukunikeza isicelo ukufinyelela ulwazi. Isikhalo kumele sifakwe efomini Elijotshelelwe ku-2, bese uyifaka ku-Ofisa Yolwazi kuleli kheli lokuposa, inombolo yefeksi noma ikheli le-i-meyili elishiwo ku-2 ngenhla, ezinsukwini ezingama-60 emva kokuthola isaziso sokwenqaba. Nekheli lokuposa noma inombolo yefeksi yokhalazayo. Uma okhalazayo engayikhokhile inkokhelo yesikhalo (uma kufanele), isinqumo ngesikhalo sangaphakathi singahlehliswa, kuze kube yileso sikhathi inkokhelo ekhokhwa ngaso. I-SAMSA izokuthi ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ekutholeni isikhalo, ithathe isinqumo sokuthi ingakuqinisekisa yini okukhalazwa ngako noma ifake isinqumo esisha endaweni yaso, ngokweseka ngokubekwe Ngumthetho. Uma i-SAMSA yehluleka ukunikeza okhalazayo isaziso sesinqumo sesikhalo ezinsukwini ezingama-30 zokufaka isicelo, i-SAMSA kuzakuthathwa ukuthi isichithile isikhalazo sangaphakathi. Ofake isicelo noma omunye umuntu angakwazi kuphela ukufaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze abonelelwe ngokufanele, emva kokuthi ofake isicelo noma omunye umuntu eqede wonke amasu okukhalaza angaphakathi maqondana nesinqumo se-Ofisa Yolwazi. Uma ofake isicelo noma omunye umuntu ezwiswe ubuhlungu yisinqumo se-Ofisa Yolwazi noma izicelo zabo zokukhalaza kwangaphakathi kungaphumelelanga, angakwazi ukufaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze abonelelwe ngokufanele, ezinsukwini ezingama-30 emva kokwethulwa kwesinqumo sesikhalo. Inkantolo Enamandla omthetho ngaphezu kwalesi sicelo Yinkantolo Enkulu noma enye inkantolo enezinga lesikhundla elifana naleli.

Indiza eqondwe wumgonyana 2aii engaqedile uhlelo lokuhlolwa singakapheli isikhathi esinqunywe ngumkhiqizi wayo noma yiKhomishani iyophoqelwa ukulandela uhlelo lokuhlolwa ngaphambi kokuba idedelwe iphindele emsebenzini. b uma ehlola ibanga lokusuka kwendiza emhlabathini abhale oqwembeni lwesikali sesivinini usuku nezinga lokugcina umshini okwazi ukufinyelela kulo ngesikhathi uhlolwa. Noma ngubani ovivinya noma ohlola ibhokisi lesimo esibucayi uyolivivinya noma alihlole ngendlela enqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-GMR. b uma eqhuba uhlelo oluyimpoqo olwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile, ukuhlola okuqhubekayo noma ukuhlola okuhleliwe kufanele asebenzise uhlu lokuqaphela oluxube umthamo nemininingwane yezivivinyo nokuhlola okuqondwe wumgomo 43.02.8. b aqhube isivivinyo ngokusebenzisa amaqhinga, amasu nemikhuba ejwayelekile ngendlela echazwe wuMqulu SA-CATS- GMR; kanye c asebenzise imishini efanele yokuhlola ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi isivivinyo esingalimazi siqhutshwa ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo ezifanele zomkhiqizi. Noma ngubani olungisa indiza ngendlela echazwe esigabeni semigomo yezimfanelo zebhukwana lomkhiqizi lokulungisa indiza noma eminye imiyalelo yokulisebenzisa ngokuphephile uyoqhuba umsebenzi wokulungisa ngendlela ehambisana naleso sigaba. Ngaphandle kwemvume ebhalwe wuKhomishani, akekho umuntu oyokwenza noma yiziphi izinguquko ezihlanganisa imishini noma impahla exhunywe endizeni ephazamisa noma engaba nomthelela wokuphazamisa indlela indiza elungiswa ngayo noma ukuphephe kwabagibeli noma abanye abantu nempahla.

Umculo we-Gospel: Uhlanga Olwakha Uthando Nokuqonda Umculo we-gospel ungomunye wemikhakha emikhulu yomculo, futhi uhlanganisa izici eziningi ezithokozisayo nezibalulekile empilweni yamaKristu. Kodwa, njengoba umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokwanda, kube nezinkulumo eziningi eziphikisanayo mayelana nendlela umculo lo okumele ubonakale ngayo, izinjongo zawo, kanye nomthelela wawo emphakathini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nomculo we-gospel, futhi sizokhuthaza ingxoxo ebanzi ngale ndaba. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo we-gospel ungumculo ophuma enhliziyweni, futhi uhambisana nezinkolelo zenkolo. Uhlanga lwawo luthinta imizwa, lukhuthaza, futhi luhlinzeka ngethemba kulabo abawulalelayo. Ngakho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo omkhulu wokukhuthaza ukholo, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Lokhu kubonakala emishinini eminingi ye-gospel, lapho abaculi bechaza izinselele zabo, bezama ukwabelana ngothando lukaNkulunkulu. Nokho, abanye abantu bakhathazekile ngokuqhubeka komculo we-gospel. Bakholelwa ukuthi umculo we-gospel usuphenduke umkhiqizo, udinga ukujolisa kumakhasimende kunokuhlonipha izinjongo zawo zokuqala. Lokhu kubonakala ekwandeni kwemali edlalwa emicimbini ye-gospel, lapho abaculi behluleka ukugcina ubumsulwa bomculo wabo. Lokhu kungase kube yinkinga, njengoba umculo we-gospel ungase ube yinsiza yokukhuthaza, kodwa uma uphenduka umkhiqizo, ungase uphumelele kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kube sekuphazamiseka umqondo wawo wokuqala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wokuhlanganyela emphakathini.

Le ngxenye ibeka ukuthi "Kuzoba khona indlela ezimele, esunguliwe futhi ephethwe nguMthetho Wezomthetho ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okukhulunywa ukuthi kwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe." a ngokuthanda kwakhe noma ngemva kokuthola isikhalazo, uhlola noma yisiphi isenzo esingafanele noma ukuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe yilunga le-SAPS noma le-MPS. c ingahlola noma yisiphi isimo esiqondiswe kuyo nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho noma ngaphakathi komkhandlu wesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywe ngenhla, imisebenzi nezibopho ze-ICD zanda ngokwengeziwe nguMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya (DVA), ka-1998 (iMthetho No. 112 ka-1998). Lo mthetho uthi uma ilunga le-SAPS lingahambisani nezibopho ezichazwe kuMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya (DVA) noma imiyalo yeZwe eyakhishwa ngokomthetho (DVA), le nto ibhekwa njengokungafaneleki ngokuhumusha kweMthetho we-SAPS. Ngakho-ke, i-ICD kumele ibhunyulwe ngalesi sikhala esibikwe kwi-SAPS. Umqondo ocacile wale mfuneko ukuthi i-ICD kumele isebenzise amandla nemisebenzi yayo ukuze ibheke umphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zikhalazo zokungafaneleki zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe yi-SAPS. I-DVA iphinde ibeke ukuthi i-SAPS kumele ithathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene nalunye ilunga le-SAPS olukhulunywa ukuthi aluhambisani nezibopho ezilawulwa yi-DVA, ngaphandle uma i-ICD ikhetha okuphambene ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile.

Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile ezidinga ukwenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke kusho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezwe, izifunda, nezindawo, eziphethwe nokuphathwa, zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele, zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Zonke izinhlelo zikahulumeni zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi esikhathini esizayo zizozama ukufezekisa kuzo zonke izindawo ukuze zifeze imiphumela elindelekile - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma nge-Inqubo Engajwayelekile, asikhulumi ngokuthi izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sikhuluma ngesivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, amandla nokusebenza okuzophumelelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphila kwabantu kuthuthuka ngokushesha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka, sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza kube nokuhleleka kokuthi izimali zisetshenziswe minyaka yonke, ezizokhishwa nguNgqongqoshe WezeMali ngaphambi kokuphela kwale nyanga, kuvumeleke ukuthi sifeze lezi zenzakalo ezidinga ukwenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke. Sizokwandisa ukuvumelanisa nezindawo ezibalulekile ekubambisaneni namanye amazwe, sigxile ezindabeni zase-Afrika nasezikhathini eziphathelene neNingizimu. Isimo esibhekene naso nomsebenzi esizibophezela kuwo sidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlangane njengomuntu oyedwa ukuze sifeze zonke izabelo ezidingekayo, singakukhohlwa ukuthi sonke siphethe ikusasa lethu ezandleni zethu! Njengoba sonke sisebenza ndawonye lapha ezweni lethu, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene ne-Inqubo Engajwayelekile!

Sizimisele ukuhlinzeka bonke ozakwethu nemindeni yabo ukufinyelela ezinzuzweni ezishibhile nezibanzi ezihlanganisa izinhlobo ezinhlanu zamaphakheji ezinzuzo. Kusukela lapho ilungu lokuqala, i-GEMS, langena ngo-2006, sihlangabezane nokukhula okungakaze kubonwe futhi saguqula konke kube uhlelo lwezempilo oluhamba phambili olusebenza kahle futhi olushibhile kubo bonke abasebenzi bethu bezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi. Noma iyiphi iqembu lomqashi elivunywa uHlelo lungangena. I-GEMS ihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezishibhile kubo bonke abantu! Wonke umuntu unethuba lokungena kwi-GEMS, njengoba inani olikhokhayo ukuze ube ilungu leHlelo incike emalini oyitholayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uzokhokha inani eliphansi ngaphakathi kwephakheji efanayo kunomuntu othola okuningi kunakho. Inani olikhokhayo liphinde lincike osayizi bemindeni yakho kanye nokuthi iyiphi yephakheji ezinhlanu oyikhethayo. Uhlelo lungathanda futhi lugxile ezidingweni zakho futhi lulalele uma amalungu ethu ekhuluma! Izinzuzo zempilo ezihamba phambili ngamanani asheshayo. Ukufihla ngokuphelele - ulwazi lwakho lwezokwelapha lugcinwa luqinisekisiwe ngaso sonke isikhathi - ngisho kumqashi wakho. Ukuxhumana namalungu ngezikhathi ezifanele. Insiza yamakhasimende enobungane futhi eqeqeshiwe ezikhungweni zokubiza nasezikhungweni zethu zendawo. Izikhungo zendawo ezweni lonke ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana uma udinga usizo nezinsizakalo. Isinyathelo 2: Gcwalisa ifomu - qiniseka ukuthi ugcwalisa zonke izingxenye ngokuphelele futhi uhlinzeka ngemibhalo esekelayo efunwayo. Bheka: Yimiphi imibhalo okudingeka uyithumele nencwadi yakho yesicelo?

Izinkinga Zamanzi: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izinkinga zamanzi? Izinkinga zamanzi zibhekisela ezinselelweni ezihambisana nokutholakala, ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, noma izinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ezindaweni ezithile. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala izinkinga zamanzi? Izinkinga zamanzi zingavela ngenxa yezinto ezahlukahlukene. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, izinguquko zesimo sezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezingasebenzi kahle, konke lokhu kudala izinselelo ezinkulu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izimpawu zokuntuleka kwamanzi? Izimpawu zokuntuleka kwamanzi zifaka phakathi ukuncipha kokutholakala kwamanzi emithonjeni, ukwanda kwezindleko zamanzi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kokutholakala kwamanzi emiphakathini. Abantu bangase baphinde babone ukwanda kwezifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Umbuzo 4: Kungani ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kubalulekile? Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kubalulekile ngoba kuthinta impilo yomphakathi. Amanzi angcolile angaholela ezimeni ezinzima, ezifana nezifo ezithathelwanayo, futhi kungaba nomthelela omubi ezilwaneni nasemvelweni. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izindlela zokulwa nezinkinga zamanzi? Kunezindlela eziningi zokulwa nezinkinga zamanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzayo, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi. Ukuhlanzwa kwemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 6: Yini umthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu ezinkingeni zamanzi? Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi anele.

Uhlaka nezidingo zeMCM zinqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS- GMR. Uma kutholakala ngesikhathi sokukhanda ukuthi kukhona izingxenye ezithile, umkhiqizo, umshini noma into engalungiseki noma okunamathuba amancane okuba igcineke esimeni esijwayelekile kuze kufike isikhathi esilandelayo sokuhlola, kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa iphutha layo ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi leyo ngxenye, insimbi noma into ilungiswa ngaphambi kokuba indiza idedelwe ukuyoqala emsebenzini. Izinto ezonakele kufanele zibhalwe zikhishwa ohlwini lwempahla yendiza zifakwe eshadini lokusebenza. Noma yisiphi isenzo sokulungisa ingxenye, insimbi, umshini noma into elungiswayo siyobhalwa ngokucacile encwadini yendiza noma kolunye uhlelo lokubhala oluvunyelwe bese iqinisekiswa ngemvume emukelwe noma ngumnikazi wegunya ngaphambi kokuba ifakwe noma kudedelwe indiza ekaze ikhandwa. Umuntu ogunyaza umbhalo ochazwe wumgonyana 2 uyophinde aqinisekise ebhukwaneni lokundiza ukuthi insimbi noma into etholwe ingalungile ilungisiwe ngempela futhi uyosayina abhale nosuku okwenziwe ngakho lokho. Ngaphandle uma Ukhomishani emukele ngokubhaliwe, indiza noma izitho zayo nemishini exhunywe kulo iyolungiswa noma ishintshwe ngezikhathi ezithile ezimiswe wumkhiqizi wendiza noma ngezikhathi ezinconywe nguye. Ukulungisa kakhulu umkhiqizo weSigaba 1 noma Isigaba II kanye nokukhanda isakhiwo uqobo, injini noma uphephela kufanele kwenziwe kuphela yinhlangano egunyazwe yimvume yokukhanda izindiza.

Uma kukhona ukuphambana kwalezo zinhloso, umlimi yena kufanele ahlale phansi acabange akhethe izinhloso ezifanele yena, impilo yakhe nezidingo zakhe. Lapho eqala ukwakha amasu amasha okuqhubeka ngomsebenzi wakhe, aboqinisa ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambelana nezinhloso ezivamekile nangezidingo zakhe. Konke esikushilo maqondana nokhlanganisa izinhloso kungashiwo ngamazwi ambalwa alandelayo: inhloso yebhizinisi lokulima yikufisa ukuthola inzuzo enkulu engatholakala, kodwa ukungalimazi izinto zezomvelo (izingcebo) njengomhlabathi, amanzi, amadlelo, njll. ukuze zikwazi ukusetshenziswa kusasa nakusasa ziqhubeke ukusilethela umkhiqizo omuhle esikhathini eside. Angenise izinhlelo zokuhlola ukuze athole njalo ulwazi oluzomnikeza ithuba lokushintsha indlela yokusebenza lapho kusenesikhathi uma kuvela umonakalo. Ukuhlanganisa izinhloso kufana nokubuza "kuqondeni lokhu" emsebenzini wokulima, kusho ukuthi sifuna impendulo yalo mbuzo "Sifisa ukwenzani, ukutholani, ukufikela kuphi? Eminye imigomo nezinhloso kuyinselele. Kubalulekile ukuthola inani elithile lomkhiqizo ehektheleni - lokhu kusho ukuthi inani lomkhiqizo elibekwe ebhajethini lonyaka lifanele litholwe. Lelo nani liyehluka emapulazini athile. Qinisa ukuthi umkhiqizo wakho ulingana nezidingo zemakethe - umphathi womkhiqizo kufanele abeke phansi ngaphambi kwesikhathi izinhloso ezizofikela kulezo zidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungaba izinto ezinjengobukhulu, umbala, ikhwalithi engaphakathi, njll. Qinisa ukuthi wonke umsebenzi usazokwazi ukuqhubeka nakusasa - lokhukusho ukuthi izinto zezemvelo zingavelelwa ingozi lapho kusetshenzwa khona, izinto ezinjengamakhemkheli abulala izifo, umanyolo, njll.

Uma ufunda le ncwadi ebizwa ngokuthi Pula-Imvula, uzothola ukuthi kukhona uHlelo Lokuthuthukisa Abalimi nguGrain SA. Esikhathini esedlule, lolu hlelo lwathola uxhaso ikakhulu oluvela kuMaize Trust, ngakho-ke sasingakwazi ukubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezinhlanga. Ubonile futhi ukuthi muva nje saqala ukubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezithelo ze-oyela - lokhu kwenzeka ngoba manje sithola uxhaso oluvela ku-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust. Okwamanje, sijabule ukukwazisa ukuthi sithole ngempumelelo uxhaso oluvela kuWinter Cereals Trust. Ngakho, kusukela kule nyanga kaDisemba, sizophinde siqhubeke nokubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho ibhakiwa khona ngesikhathi sehlobo. Lezi zindaba zizofakwa kuPula-Imvula ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Okwamanje, izindaba ze-wheat zibhaliwe kuphela ngesiNgisi nangesiSesotho futhi zizohlukaniswa nePula-Imvula eFree State. Esicelweni sethu kuWinter Cereals Trust, sicele usizo ngomsebenzi esifuna ukuwenzela ukusiza abalimi abasha be-wheat e-Eastern Free State naseCentral Free State. Sizobeka izindawo ezimbili zokubonisa - eyodwa eModderpoort, eduze kweLadybrand, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentshonalanga, kanti enye eGlen, eduze kweBloemfontein, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentral.

Le nsizakalo ikakhulukazi ibhekene nezingane zabazali abathola ilungelo lokuba ngababambiqhaza ngemva kokuhlala iminyaka ethile, ibanika ilungelo lokuba ngababambiqhaza. Izingane zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuzalwa nangokuhlala zinegunya lokuba ngababambiqhaza baseNingizimu Afrika, futhi akudingeki ukuthi zifake isicelo sokuhlala njalo. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi lemboni yaseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Ngokwesimo sakho sezimali, abazali bakho bangase badinge ukufaka i-affidavit yokuxhaswa kwezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi.

Isiqondiso sokukusiza ukuba udle ukudla okunempilo, usebenzisa ukudla ongase ukwazi ukukuthola. Uma unesifo esingamahlalakhona (njengofuba, umdlavuza noma ingculaza) kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba udle ukudla okunempilo. Ukukhetha indlela yokudla enempilo kungakusiza ukuba ulwisane nezifo futhi kukusize ukuba ubhekane ngokuphumelelayo nokugula. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo akusho ukuthenga ukudla okukhethekile, okumba eqolo! Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kusho ukukukhetha ngokuhlakanipha ukudla okuzokunikeza w onke umsoco umzimba w akho ow udingayo. Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uSipho, umfana ophuma edolobheni elincane, wathola ithuba lokuba ne-iPhone. Le foni yayiyinsiza ethokozisayo, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezobuchwepheshe. U-Sipho wayephupha ngale foni isikhathi eside, ngenxa yokuhamba kwayo phambili, izici zayo ezithokozisayo, kanye nokuxhumana okungakaze kube khona. U-Sipho wayehlala ekhaya, edlala imidlalo yevidiyo, efunda izincwadi, kodwa wayephupha ngalesi sikhumbuzo esisha. Ngemva kokusebenza kanzima emasimini, uSipho wathola imali eyanele yokuthenga i-iPhone. Wazizwa ejabule kakhulu, njengoba le foni yayizokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabangani bakhe, futhi wayengakwazi ukulinda ukufaka izithombe ezinhle. Ngemuva kokuthenga i-iPhone, uSipho wathola ukuthi le foni yayihamba phambili kakhulu kunalokho ayekucabanga. Izithombe ezithathwe ngale foni zazicace, zikhanya, futhi zikhumbuza izikhathi ezinhle. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ungathumela imiyalezo, abhale izincwadi, futhi abuke amavidiyo kalula. Waqala ukuhamba phambili, efunda izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uSipho waqala ukubona izinselelo ezihambisana ne-iPhone. Abangani bakhe babebonisa izithombe ezinhle, kodwa uSipho wathola ukuthi akakwazi ukuhamba phambili njengabo. U-Sipho waqala ukuzizwa engaphansi, njengoba abanye bejabulile, kanti yena ezwa ubuhlungu bokungabi nalokho abanye abanakho. Waqonda ukuthi i-iPhone, nakuba iyinsiza enkulu, ayikwazi ukuxazulula zonke izinkinga. Wafunda ukuthi ukuxhumana okungokoqobo, okwenziwa ngamehlo, kungcono kunokuxhumana ngefoni. Waqala ukuphila impilo enempilo, edlala ngaphandle, ehamba nabangani, futhi ethokozisa izikhathi ezinhle.

Ezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya, noma ngesiNgisi "rural development," yisihloko esibalulekile esihlobene nokukhuphula izinga lempilo kanye nezinga lemfundo, emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Lesi sikhala sithinta izinhlelo ezahlukene ezihlosiwe, ezibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezingqalasizinda. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile, kubalulekile ukubheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izindawo zasemakhaya zihlukaniswe nokutholakala kwezinsiza, izikhungo zezempilo, nezikhungo zemfundo ezikahle. Izindawo eziningi zasemakhaya zihlupheka ngokuntuleka kwezinsiza eziyisisekelo, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile, ukwakha izikole ezinamazinga aphakeme, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo eziphephile, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu basemakhaya. Okwesibili, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho kubaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni komphakathi. Imikhakha efana nezolimo, ubuchwepheshe befu, nezinsizakusebenza kufanele ithuthukiswe ukuze inikeze amathuba emisebenzi. Ngokwesibonelo, ukuvuselela izindlela zokulima, ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nokwakha izimakethe ezikahle ukuze kubonakale imikhiqizo yendawo, kungasiza ekukhuphuleni umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekwakheni imisebenzi emisha, okwenza kube nokwanda kwemali engenayo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesithathu, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele, kungasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya.

Uma kwenzeka kuba nesidingo sokuhumusha noma sokuguqulela kolunye ulimi umbhalo othile, lokhu kuyokwenziwa. Maqondana nokuxhumana ngendlela ebhaliwe, kufanele kulandelwe uhlelo lokushicilela oluphawula ngokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene (kummele kubhekelwe umsebenzi, abalaleli nomlayezo) kulezo zimo ezingadingi ukushicilela ngazo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye. Uma izinga elithile likahulumeni lifuna ukwedlulisa ngendlela enzulu ulwazi, kufanele lishicilele ulwazi ngazo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni. Ngaphansi kwezimo lapho imibhalo kahulumeni ingeke itholakale ngezilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni, iminyango kahulumeni kazwelonke kuyommele ishicilele umbhalo ngasikhathi sinye, okungenani ngezilimi eziyisithupha. Inkambiso yokunikana ithuba kufanele isebenze lapho kuqokwa izilimi emaqoqweni abeNguni nabeSuthu. Umbandela ommile okufanele ulandelwe wukuthi okungenani iminyango kahulumeni kazwelonke inqunyelwe ukushicilela imibhalo esemthethweni ngezilimi eziyisithupha noma ngaphezulu. Inkambiso yokunikana ithuba ayisebenzi ezifundazweni ngenxa yokuthi zinegunya lokusebenzisa izilimi eziqokwe yizo. Iminyango yohulumeni baseKhaya iyonquma ukusetshenziswa kolimi olufunwa wumphakathi ngokulandela umgudu omiswe wuhlaka lwenqubomgomo yolimi esifundazweni. Ngemuva kokunquma ulimi oluyosetshenziswa nolufunwa ngumphakathi, ohulumeni basekhaya kufanele bathuthukise, bashicilele futhi babone ukuthi inqubomgomo yezilimi ezahlukene iyenzeke, lokhu kummele kwenziwe ngokubonisana kakhulu nomphakathi. Ezincwadini zomsebenzi ezisemthethweni, ulimi oluqokwe yisakhamuzi yilona okufanele lusetshenziswe.

Izimo zezulu zango-2007/2008 - yini abakuhlanganyelayo? Inani lemvula elirekhodiwe ngonyaka odlule, ikakhulukazi phakathi nesikhathi esibalulekile sikaJanuwari 2007 kuya kuMashi 2007, belingaphansi kwezinga elibi lika-1992. Kwakunezindawo ezifana neGauteng nezingxenye zeMpumalanga esentshonalanga ezathola umswakama ofana nowango-1912. NgokukaMnu. Johan van den Berg ovela ku-ARS, kukhona izimpawu ezikhombisa umphumela onamandla weLa Nina. Kungenzeka ukuthi lo mphumela weLa Nina uzoqhubeka kuze kube kwentwasahlobo ka-2008. Umphumela walokhu ungaba ukuwa kwemvula okukhulu okuvela ngoDisemba 2007 kuya kuMashi 2008. Izibalo 1 - 3 zikhombisa amathuba okuthola izinga lemvula elijwayelekile. Izindawo eziphuma phambili zikhombisa izinga lemvula elijwayelekile, izindawo eziluhlaza zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphakeme kunjengokujwayelekile, kanti izindawo ezinsundu zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphansi kunjengokujwayelekile. Ukuhlela kukhombisa inani elijwayelekile (okuphuzi) eliphakeme kunjengokujwayelekile (okuluhlaza) ezinyangeni ezizayo. Amathuba okuthola imvula enkulu alungile kakhulu ngoDisemba 2007 noJanuwari 2008. Izibalo 1 - 3: Amathuba okuthola izinga elijwayelekile (%). Ezibalo 4 - 7, amathuba okuthola ngaphansi kuka-20 mm yemvula ezinsukwini ezithile akhombiswa. Izilinganiso zesikhathi eside zikhombiswa ngombala obomvu, kanti amathuba akhona (2007/2008) akhombiswa ngombala oluhlaza. Kumele kube yindlela endlalekile futhi ebandakanya wuwonke wonke ekuhlelweni kolimi nasekusetshenzisweni kwenqubomgomo eqinisa ubuchwepheshe bobuciko ekudluliseni ulwazi kanye namakhono. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni (uhulumeni kaZwelonke, wesifunda kanye nowendawo), kanye nezinhlangano ezisebenzisa amandla kahulumeni noma zenza umsebenzi kahulumeni ngokusho komthetho, oboshwe yilolu Hlaka lweNqubomgomo yoLimi. Ekuthuthikiseni ubuliminingi izifunda zizakwakha inqubomgomo yazo ngokuhambisana nezinkomba eziqukethwe kulolu hlaka lwenqubomgomo, zinake izehlakalo zezigodi zazo, kanye nezidingo kanye nezincomo zemiphakathi njengoba kushiwo kumThethosisekelo. Ohulumeni basemakhaya bazawunquma ukusetshenziswa koLimi kanye nokufunwa ngumphakathi wabo ngokuhambisana nohlaka lwenqubomgomo yolimi lwezifunda . Ngaphezu kokunquma ukusetshenziswa kolimi kanye nokufunwa yimiphakathi yabo, ohulumeni basemakhaya kumele ngokuxhumana okubanzi nomphakathi wabo, basungule, bakhiphe futhi basebenzise inqubomgomo yobuliminingi. Ulimi olusemthethweni lizawusetshenziswa njengoba kudingekile kumisebenzi yezishayamthetho, kufakelela nemikhiqizo ye-Hansard, njengendaba yelungelo, uma kungenzeka kube nezindaba zezishayamthetho zesifunda, izehlakalo zesifunda zizawunquma izilimi okumele zisetshenziswe. Ukuthuthukisa ubuliminingi le nqubomgomo iveza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezakhiweni zikahulumeni ngokulandelayo.

Umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State UMhlaba wezolimo eFree State uthinteka kakhulu izimo zezulu, ikakhulukazi kumkhiqizo wezolimo. Isomiso, indlala esheshayo emanzini, sishiye umthelela omkhulu ezitsheni, kukhulu kakhulukazi njengemiphumela yeClimate Change. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wesomiso kwezolimo kudinga ukubheka zonke izici ezihambisana nezimo zokutshala, ikakhulukazi ezikhiqizayo ezifana nezitshalo, izinkomo, nezinyoni. Ukwanda kwesomiso empeleni kubalulekile, ngoba kugcizelela imiphumela emibi kubalimi, okubenza bahlupheke kakhulu. Ngonyaka ka-2022, izinga lokushisa eliphezulu, kanye nesomiso, kwaholela ekunciphiseni komkhiqizo wezolimo, okuholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo yabantu abaningi. Ukuncishiswa kwamanzi kuyiwona msebenzi omkhulu wezolimo eFree State, njengoba izitshalo zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule. Ukungabi namanzi okwanele kuholela ekutheni izitshalo zingathuthukisi kahle. Ngokwendlela umhlaba ozolimo ushintsha ngayo, sithola imiphumela emibi kwizindlela zokwakha, ukuzinakekela, kanye nemisebenzi yokulima. Kukhona nezinkundla eziveza izindaba zabalimi okukhuluma ngazo. Izinkulumo zahlanganiswa nomnotho wezolimo – umkhiqizo ophuma ezoliminini kanye nezimali ezitholakala ngemikhiqizo ethengiswa ezitolo. Ubuye ukwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zezimali zomkhakha wezolimo uma kuqhathaniswa nezimo ezijwayelekile. Ukwanda kwesomiso kungaholela ekutheni, izitshalo ezithile zingakwazi ukufakwa emkhakheni wezolimo. Imiphumela emnandi, ngempela, ubonakalisa ukuthi izimfuno zokuhlanga zikhuphuka; kodwa ngemva kokuhla kwechungechunge, abanye abalimi bebheka izitshalo ezidliwayo.

Bafunda ukuthi ukubhala kunomqondo okuwudlulisayo, nokuthi bona -ke bangababhali balowo mqondo. Bathuthukisa amakhono okubhala, ukuze bakwazi ukubhala phansi imiqondo nemicabango yabo ukuze ifundwe yibo nabanye abantu. Bafunda ukusebenzisa inqubo yokubhala evumelekile njengopelomagama nokufaka izimpawu zenkulumo ukwenza abakubhalayo kuzwakale kwabanye. Bafunda ukuthi ukubhala kuyinto eqhubekayo efaka: Ukulungiselela ukubhala, ukwenza uhlaka, ukubukeza, ukuhlola amaphutha ukwenza imidwebo kanye nohlela okubhaliwe. Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa ulimi ekucabangeni nasekucabangisiseni, ukuze afinyelele elwazini, aluhlaziye, bese elusebenzisa ekufundeni. Amakhono abalulwa kulo mphumela ayingxenye yawo wonke amakhono okufunda ulimi. Isizathu sokuwafaka ngaphansi komphumela wokufunda owehlukile ukugqamisa ubumqoka bawo ekuthuthukiseni ulimi nakwezinye izinkundla zokufunda. Izilimi zingachazwa njengenkundla yokufunda "evula wonke amasango": ngoba yizona ezenza abafundi baqondisise kahle lokho abakufunda kwezinye izinkundla zokufunda. Yingakho-ke kumele othisha bangayeki ukuzithuthukisa, bazigxilise, bazizikise lezi zikhali zolimi zokucabanga nokucabangisisa. Kodwa-ke lokhu akumele kuzimele kodwa- abafundi kumele bawasebenzise lamakhono kuzo zonke izinkundla zokufunda. Umfundi unolwazi futhi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa imisindo, amagama kanye nohlelo lolimi ukuziqambela nokuhumusha imibhalo. Abafundi bazoqala ukuhlola ukuthi ulimi lusebenza kanjani. Bayoqala ukuthuthukisa ulimi olukhuluma ngolimi. Isibonelo, bazofunda ukusebenzisa amagama anjengalawa: 'umsindo', 'ilunga', 'igama', 'umusho', 'ungqi' .

AMAQEMBU ayavumelana ngokuthi angeke kushintshwe, kwengezwe, noma kuvunyelwane ngokukhansela noma lutho kwakhiwe kabusha le SIVUMELWANO kukho konke noma iphuzu noma umbandela waso futhi noma kwenzeka angeke kube namphumela ekusebenzeni kwesivumelwan ngaphandle uma kubhalwa phansi futhi omabili amaqembu asayinde noma asayindelwe abawamele. Izinhlamvu kanye ne-fertilizer - khumbula ukukala! Amathayi aphakanyisiwe asetshenziswa ukudlulisa amandla. Kunezindlela eziningi zokukala ukuhamba kwezindawo zokubeka izinhlamvu. Indlela evamile kakhulu iyona esebenzisa ipuleti elinamahole (eboniswe lapha ngezansi). Idiski yokukala inezikhala eziningi, usayizi walezi zikhala kufanele uvumele ukuthi inhlamvu eyodwa iwela ngesikhathi. Lapho idiski ijikeleza (iguquka), ihamba (ihamba) phezu kwepuleti elin hole elilodwa. Ingxenye ye-disk inenhlamvu esusa (esula) izinhlamvu eziphezulu kwalokho okukhona emhole lapho idiski iguquka. Phakathi kwalesi sula, kukhona nendawo enesiphethu esihamba phezu kwe-disk sicindezela inhlamvu ukuze iwela emholeni ephezu kwe-disk. Ukuklama nosayizi lwezikhala kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inhlamvu eyodwa kuphela ingena ngesikhathi futhi ayigcini emholeni, ingaphumeleli ukuwa noma ukungena kulowo mhole ephezu kwepuleti ukuze ifike emhlabathini. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-air planters - uhlobo olulodwa lusebenza ngengcindezi ethile (lokhu kusho ukuthi luphusha inhlamvu ukuba ingene emholeni), bese kuba nohlobo olusebenza ngengcindezi phambili (lokhu kusho ukuthi luphonsa inhlamvu ukuba ingene emholeni). Usayizi wezihlahla awubalulekile kakhulu kuma-air planters njengoba izihlahla ziphonswa emholeni, akubalulekile ukuthi zibe zinkulu kangakanani. Inani lezihlahla ezitshaliwe lihambisana nesivinini (isivinini) sepuleti elijikelezayo. Isakhiwo esivamile esiletha i-fertilizer sithiwa i-auger efana nesikhwama. Le screw ihlezi ngaphansi ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede elibamba i-fertilizer).

Ukuba nezinqubo ezilungile zokudonswa kwemali akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isithunzi esihle seGEMS. Uma abasebenzi benelisekile ngemisebenzi yeGEMS, bazoba nesifiso sokuyisebenzisa futhi bazokhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlale bephakathi kwalezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela nokwethembana phakathi kweGEMS nabasebenzi. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni kufanele zibe lula, zicacile, futhi zenziwe ngendlela evumela abasebenzi ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinhlelo zempilo. I-GEMS kufanele iqhubeke nokuthuthukisa lezi zinqubo, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana nabasebenzi, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane iyatholakala kalula. Ngaleyo ndlela, izisebenzi zizokwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko ezikhuphukayo, futhi zizokwazi ukugxila empilweni yazo kanye nokukhula kwabo. Ngokuhlanganisa konke lokhu, iGEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni zisebenza kahle, zithuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bathola umphumela omuhle emisebenzini yabo. Lokhu kuzokwandisa inhlalakahle yomphakathi, futhi kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bamaHulumeni bazogcina bephumelela emisebenzini yabo.

Ngomhla ziyi-29 kuSepthemba 2009, uhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development Program lwabamba umcimbi omkhulu - ukujabulisa amalungu e-250 Ton Club. Uhlelo lwe-Farmer Development Program lwezokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu eNingizimu Afrika luhlose ukuphakamisa abalimi abamnyama ngecala elikhulu e-Fanie Ferreira hall e-NAMPO ukuze wamukele futhi wabonga abalimi abafanelekayo ukuba bahlale emhlanganweni wabalimi abamnyama - labo abakhiqiza ngaphezu kwama-250 tons nge-hectare yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu. Indlela yokuba umlimi omnyama wokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu ayilula, futhi awekho amakhono okuthola khona kalula. Ukulima kuyinselele enzima, futhi inzuzo ivame ukuba ncane. Lezi zinkampani zixhaswa abantu abasebenza kuhlelo lwe-Grain Producers Development Program eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa kukhona nabanye abaningi abahlinzeka ngosizo, njengamabhange, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezinikeza izinto zokulima, iziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi oluvela eMnyangweni Wezolimo, nabanye abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Ngonyaka owedlule saphinde savuselela i-250 Ton Club ukuze wamukele labo abalimi abakhiqiza ngaphezu kwama-250 tons njengamanje futhi abaseduze kokubizwa ngokuthi "abalimi bezomnotho." Abaningi balesi sigaba bazoba yingxenye yohlelo lwethu eminyakeni ezayo, ngakho sifuna ukuqaphela umsebenzi wabo omuhle. Amalungu e-250 Ton Club aqhubeka ekhula. Njengamanje sinezikhulu eziyisixhenxe ku-1,000 Ton Club, amalungu ayi-13 ku-500 Ton Club, kanye namalungu ayi-21 ku-250 Ton Club. Kulonyaka, amalungu ayisishiyagalombili angena kuleli Club.

Amalungu omphakathi nawo amelelwa enkulumweni yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ukuze abambe iqhaza kulomcimbi obalulekile odlala indima ekwakheni isizwe. Kungani inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ibalulekile? Kule nkulumo, uMongameli ugcizelela impumelelo nezinkinga ezibhekene ne-nyanga edlule futhi uchaza indlela ezolandela ngonyaka lowo. Le nkulumo ibandakanya izindaba zezombusazwe, ezomnotho, nezokuxhumana, futhi ibonisa isimo jikelele sezwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Ikhuluma ngezindaba zangaphakathi zezwe kanye nezokuxhumana nezizwe zase-Afrika nakwamanye amazwe. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyithuluzi elibalulekile lokuphendula ePhalamende nasemphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nalokho okwenzekile ngonyaka odlule nokubandakanya abantu ezinqubweni zezombusazwe zonyaka lowo. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iphinde isetshenziswe ukuze kugujwe isizwe sethu futhi sakhiwe kabusha. Nini le nkulumo ithulwa? Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ivamise ukwenzeka ngoFebhuwari. Nokho, uma kukhona ukhetho lwesizwe, kuvame ukuba nezinkulumo ezimbili ngonyaka, eyodwa ibonisa iseshini yokugcina yePhalamende elandela, kanti enye iyenzeka ngemuva kokhetho lapho uMongameli omusha kanye nePhalamende elisha kumukelwa. NgoFebhuwari 2010, ukuphuma emkhubeni ojwayelekile, inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe yathulwa ntambama okokuqala, ivumela inani elikhulu labantu baseNingizimu Afrika ithuba lokubona izenzakalo nokulalela inkulumo kaMongameli.

amakhono: kufanele ukuba kwesekelwe kuxhaswe ngezimali nangezinye izindlela ukutholakala kwamakhono adingwa abasebenzi nomphakathi, okuzoyo ngokuya lawo makhono aveze izinga okufanele kufinyelelwe kulo oHlakeni lukaZwelonke lwamaKhono. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kumayelana nokukhuphula amandla nolwazi lomuntu ngamunye ngokumnikeza aamkhono athize nobungcweti obuthize obuyisidingo. Akusikhona ukunikeza abhluphekele imisebenzi into abazoyenza okwesikhashana kumbe ukunika laba abangabaqeqeshi imisebenzi ngoba benalezo zinhlelo. Amakhono kufanele ukuba ayamaniswe nokwenza okuseqophelweni eliphezulu nokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni (ngokuyingxenye kumbe ngokuphelele) okunomthelela kumnotho wezwe ubuzwe obunembuyiselo: udaba lobuphakathi nobuzwe eNingizimu Afrika buqondakala njengento yombusazwe esho - "ilungelo lokuvota" nokumbandakanywa lapho kuthathwa izinqumo. Kodw ainingi labantu, ikakhulu labo abadla imbuya ngothi, sebebonile ukuthi ilungelo lokuvota ligenqeza lodwa nje, kalanele. Ubuzwe lobu kufanele bumbandakanye ilungelo lokubeka induku ebandla lapho kuthathwa izinqumo ezithinta ukongela nokubekela ikusasa kanye nemisebenzi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kumalungana nokunikeza abantu ulwazi oluhambisana nokuthathwa kwezinqumo lezi kanye nokwenza leyo misebenzi edinga amakhono azothuthukiswa emveni kokuba kuthathwe lezo zinqumo. Emisebenzini izinqumo zimalungana nomkhiqizo, ukuhleleka komsebenzi, nobuchwepheshe; ezimbonini ezintsha nezisafufusayo zimalungana nolwazi lomsebenzi, ukusimama nokukhula, kanti emphakathini kumalungana nokudlondlobala komnotho. Kubo bonke: iphupho lingelimbandakanya konke.

Yenza lokhu umaushiya inombolo komunye umuntu noma uthatha inombolo yomunye umuntu. Uma ushayela omunye umuntu, yazi kabanzi ngomuntuofisa ukukhuluma naye. Kuyisu elihle ukubhala phansi lokho ofuna ukukushongaphambi kokuthi ushaye ucingo khona ungezukukhohlwaobufuna ukukusho. Bhala phansi yonke imininingwane oyinikwa abantuocingweni khona ungeke ukhohlwe ukuthi kufuneka wenzeni, njengokuthi uma uthola ucingo lokuthi kufanele ulungiseleumhlangano, bhala phansi imininingwane yokuthi nini, kuphi lapho kumele nihlangane khona. Ingxoxo kumele uyiqede njalo ngokubonga lomuntu omunyengesikhathi sakhe. Ungayisebenzisa iCV uma ufaka isicelo somfundaze, umxhasonoma umsebenzi womphakathi othize. Sithe abantu abaningi basebenzisa iCV uma befuna umsebenzi. Yiziphi ezinye izindawo lapho ungacelwa khona iCV yakho? Siyini isabelo sezimali? Kungani omasipala kumele babe izimali? Iyini inqubo nemigomo yokwabiwa kwezimali? Umasipala inhlangano eqoqa izimali zezakhamuzi nezinhlanganoezikuleyo ndawo eyabelwe. Uyabe ususebenzisa leyomalikulezozinsiza ezisiza bonke abantu abahlala kuleyondawo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izimali zikamasipala zenziwa izingxenyeezimbili ezibalulekile zokuvumelana - icala lemali engenayonecala lemali ekhokhwayo. Umasipala awukwazi ukusebenzisaimali engaphezu kwaleyo ayizuzayo. Ngalokho kubalilekileukuthi imali umasipala ayitholayo ilingane naleyo ayisebenzisayo. Ukuqikelela lokhu umasipala usebenzisa isabelo sezimali. Isabelosezimali sohulumeni basekhaya iyona ndlela okuyiyonayokukhalima esetshenziswayo.

Wathi engahlala phansi wabe eseqhweba intombi eyabe ithengisa lapho. Ngasuka ngamlandela ngafike ngahlala phambi kwakhe sengilindele ukuthi wabe ezothini. Wakhipha insimbi ethile ekhikhini maqede wayibeka esweni ebhekisisa leyo mali engabe ngimnike yona. UNkonka wayeyisethameli salowo mdlalo. Wahlabeka umxhwele ngendlela uPhenduka adlala ngayo. Lapho ezwa ngoS'paza ukuthi uPhenduka ubhema insangu futhi uyikhasimende wamkhonza kakhulu. Lokho kwathela izithelo ngoba uNkonka noPhenduka bagcina bengamathe nolimi. Ukuba yisilomo kwenza kube lula ukujwayelana nabantu. Bonke abaphatha izibhamu esikoleni wayebazi, abaphatha izidakamizwa nabo futhi babesondelene naye. Nabaziphethe kahle wayebazi. Adumalele khona ekamelweni likaThembisa uMaNgcobo. Ingani phela umfica ehlezi engazi nanyaka. Kusho khona ukuthi akukahanjwa. Lalahleka ithuba likaNomagugu lokushaywa wumoya. Ngabe babanjwe yini? Ngabe lesi singeniso siletha miphi imizwa noma imicabango Ngabe leyo micabango noma imizwa isilungiselelani, okuzosijabulisa noma okuzosijabhisa? Usejuluke umanzi nte. Kwazise likhipha umkhovu etsheni. "Lapha kuyacaca ukuthi sisenqineni kamabuyaze phela." "Awu Gxabhashe kwaze kwakubi baba. Mhlawumbe ngenye njeimoto emshayisile ziningi phela izimoto ezibovu," egqolozele owakwakhe owasezichitshana elokhu ebalisa. Akube khona iqembu elivumelana nesihloko, nalelo eliphikisana nesihloko. Yenzani onke amalungiselelo ahambisana nokwenziwa kwenkulumo-mpikiswano.

Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Phuma udoti lwezingane endlini yangasese noma uwubulale. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi ahlanzekile ngemva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Ngokuthatha amasampula kule ndawo okukholelwa ukuthi kunezifo, kungaba ukudla, amanzi, noma umoya, kungahlolwa elabhorethri. Khuthaza umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izindlu zangasese. Dala uhlelo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lwesikhashana kuze kube yisikhathi lapho abantu bezoba namanzi okusebenzisa njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi udoti uphume endaweni efanele. Khumbula ukuthi amanzi angcolile yindawo evamile lapho kutholakala khona iTyphoid. Ekugcineni, iTyphoid iyisifo esingavinjwa. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhambisana nezixwayiso ezishiwo ngenhla, lesi sifo singavinjwa. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi lezi zifo azikwazi ukubonwa ngamehlo alula. Ngakho-ke, uma ubona izandla zakho zingcolile, akusho ukuthi uphephile; noma zibonakala zihlanzekile, kufanele uzigeze ngaphambi kokuthinta ukudla. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kufanele baqaphele kakhulu. Lezi zindawo zivame ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile nezindlu zangasese. Le miphumela ikhulisa ukusabalala kwesifo. Uma umuntu eba nekhanda, ubuhlungu besisu, efuna ukuhamba, noma enezinkinga zokugaya, kufanele asheshiswe aye kudokotela noma esibhedlela. Khumbula, impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Lesi sifo sikhonjwa yisifo esibizwa ngokuthi iSalmonella typhi futhi sitholakala ngokuphuza amanzi, ubisi, noma ukudla okungcolile ngalesi sifo seSalmonella. Kukhona izinhlobo eziyi-107 zalezi zifo.

Umkhandlu ulungisa amaqhinga okusabalalisa lombono noyobandakanya amaKomidi okuQamba amaGama ahlongozwa eziFundazweni. UMkhandlu usuxhumene neNgosi yokuXhumana engaphansi kweDACTS ngenjongo yokusungula icebo lokushicilela yonke imikhiqizo yoMkhandlu. Okunye kuyoba wukusabalalisa ulwazi ngemisebenzi exhumanisa abantu ngabanye, amaphephandaba kanye nokusebenzisa amakhompuyutha. Umkhandlu uthola imibuzo nezicelo ngezihloko ezehlukene, kungaba ezivela kuhulumeni, amathimba anentshisekelo kanye nabathile. Lolugqozi luyemukeleka kanti noMkhandlu uyiphendula ngokusemandleni awo lemibuzo. Okuphawulekile kodwa, lemibuzo akusiyo ngempela eqondene nemisebenzi ejutshelwe loMkhandlu noma isuke ibekwe ngendlela elukhuni ukuthi umkhandlu ube nekhono lokuyihlaziya. Likhona ithemba lokuthi uma umkhankaso wokufundisa umphakathi usuqalile, kuyodaleka izingxoxo ezingcono phakathi koMkhandlu namathimba anogqozi. Usihlalo nePhini lakhe bayoba ngabameli boMkhandlu abasemthethweni ezingeni likazwelonke nelomhlaba, bayokwethula imibiko eMkhandlwini. NgoJanuwari 2000, uSihlalo woMkhandlu kanye nommeli woMnyango wezamaKhono, amaSiko, iSayense nobuChwepheshe bahambela ingqungquthela yoNgoti bamaGama eziNdawo yeNhlangano eBumbene yeZizwe (UNGEGN). Lengqungquthela yadonsa amasonto amabili. Loluhambo lwaba yimpumelelo futhi lwavula amehlo ikakhulu emalungeni amasha oMkhandlu. Okwadala lokhu kakhulu wukuthi kwakuyisiwombe sokuqala lapho babembulelwa amazinga aphekeme omhlaba mayelana nohlelo lokwethiwa kwezindawo.

Zicishe zifinyelele ema-25 izilimi ezahlukene ezikhulunywa eNingizimu Afrika, eziyi -11 yizona ezinikezwe isikhundla sokuba semthethweni kulandelwa isiGaba -6 somThethosisekelo we- 1996 (UmThetho weNombolo we - 108 wonyaka we-1996), kusekwa ngokuthi kumele ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufakele amaphesenti angama-98 ezakhazamuzi sezizonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni yisiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu kanye nesiSwati (ezibizwa ngokuthi iqembu lezilimi zesiNguni); IsiSuthu, isiPedi kanye nesiTswana (ezibizwa ngokuthi iqembu lezilimi zesiSuthu); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi nesiBhunu. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe eliziliminingi . Uphawu olugqamile lobuliminingi eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izilimi zomdabu eziningana zikhulunywa ukweqa nemingcele yezifunda, ezahlukaniselwana phakathi kwemiphakathi yalolo limi oluvela ezifundeni ezahlukene. Kukhona manje ukwazi okunamandla kwesidingo sokukhuphula amandla okwenza ukuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu ezazibandlululwa esikhathini esedlule kany nokuthuthukisa ubuliminingi, uma ngabe izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele zikhululeke ekusekeleni ngokunganqamuki phezu kwezilimi okungezona zomdabu njengezisemqoka, okuyizona izilimi ezisemthethweni zombuso. Ukufikela kulesi sikhathi ukuphathwa kokwehluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika edlule kahulumeni wobandlululo kwenziwe kwaba yinkinga ngokungabi khona kwenqubomgomo yolimi echaziwe, okwaholela ekutheni kusetshenziswe isiNgisi nesiBhunu njengeziLimi ezinamandla okuthelela ezenhlalakahle nezomnotho kanye nezingxenye zombusazwe zomphakathi wethu.

Ukusebenzela iqhinga-nqangi lomkhandlu; ukuhambela umcimbi wokuvulwa koSuku lwaMagama eziNdawo kaZwelonke; ukuthola imikhakha namaxhama okuxhumana nezinhlangano ezingasebenzeli nzuzo namathimba akhethiwe. Ukuqopha inqubo yokuziphatha; ukuphakamisa indlela yokusebenzisana koMkhandlu nezinye izinhlaka, ezingeni lezifundazwe nezifunda; ukubuyekeza imithetho nenqubo-mgomo ngomfaniswano wokuqamba izindawo. Lena yincwadi ewumgogodla neyisiqalo ekhomba umgudu nezinto uMkhandlu oqonde ukuzenza. Ilawula izindaba ezifana nenhloso yokusungulwa koMkhandlu, yilokho ojutshelwe khona, imisebenzi elindelwe, indawo onegunya kuyo, inqubo-mgomo nenkambiso, iqhinga-nqangi elikhulu lomkhandlu kanye nesabelo sezimali. NgokoMthetho, omunye umsebenzi woMkhandlu wukugqugquzela kusungulwe amaKomidi amaGama eziNdawo eziFundazweni. Lamakomidi kufanele asungulwe wuMnyango wesiFundazwe obhekele ezamaKhono namaSiko, ngemuva kokubonisana noMkhandlu. Umkhandlu udwebele lamakomidi uhlu lwemihlahlandlela. Lemihlahlandlela iveza izinhlaka ezincomekayo nokuthi nesibonelo sokuthi ingxube yobulungu ingabumbeka kanjani, izincomo ngemisebenzi yamalunga nokulindelwe neziphakamiso zokuba kwakhiwe ezifundazweni iziMpiko zokuqamba amagama ezindawo neziyosekelwa ngabasebenzi balamakomidi. Lemihlahlandlela iyobusa umsebenzi woMkhandlu ngokubuyekeza amagama asaphasa nalawo amadala kodwa angakaphasiswa wuMkhandlu.

Njengoba ukubhaliswa kwenkampani enenhlangano yokwabelana kungaba nzima, kunconywa ukuthi abafake izicelo bacele usizo lwezithunywa zomthetho. I-Memorandum kanye neziqondiso zenkampani kumele zilungiswe futhi zibe nohlaka lokuhambisana nenkampani engenashares, futhi lokhu kumele kuqinisekiswe ngu-notary public ochwepheshe. Inkampani yomphakathi ingamukela i-Table A yefomu lesicelo ngokuphelele noma njengoba kushintshiwe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ze-memorandum, uma ihambisana neMthetho Wezinkampani, 1973. Inkampani yangasese ingamukela i-Table B yefomu lesicelo ngokuphelele noma njengoba kushintshiwe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ze-memorandum ngokuphelele, uma ihambisana neMthetho Wezinkampani, 1973. Nikeza igunya elisemthethweni kummeleli wezomthetho, uveze ukuthi uyawavuma ukuba benze izenzo egameni lakho. CM2: I-Memorandum yokuvumelana nezinye - CM2A - CM2B - CM2C uma kukhona abanikazi abaningi, noma 2D uma kukhona umnikazi oyedwa. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-5 ukubhalisa inkampani enenhlangano yokwabelana ukuze iqale ukusebenza.

Lo mshayela ubukeka engazi lutho ngama-wheels aphephile! Uyalungile! Noma ubani ophuthelwa amawheels akhe udlala nokufa. Ngisho, amawheels angaphephile angabangela izingozi! Izikhathi eziningi amawheels afakwa ngendlela engalungile, noma awanekhwalithi ephansi! Kufana nokuba nama-wheels ahlanzekile! Amawheels angaphephile angasithatha ukuphila kwethu! Uma kuphela bonke abashayeli bengafunda ngokuqinisa nokunakekela amawheels. Uyalungile. Emini edlule ngashaywa yitayari, ngiyabonga, akekho owathinteka, kodwa ama-tire amasha abiza imali eningi. Ngakho! Uthole inhlanhla. Abantu bafa njalo ngesonto ngoba abashayeli kanye nabanikazi bamaTaxi abafaki amawheels ngendlela efanele futhi abathathi isikhathi sokunakekela. Ingabe ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awuwona umthombo wezingozi - ngisho nokufa? Ingabe ufuna ukusindisa imali? Uma ufuna ukuhlole amawheels akho! Funda ukunakekela amawheels akho? Kufanele sazi amawheels ethu, sizijwayeze ukuwabheka, silungise lokho okungalungile ngokushesha, futhi sigcine zisesimweni esihle, esanelisayo - amawheels agugile, amadala, kanye nezinto ezingazinzile zibanga izingozi! Amawheels akho afana nezinyawo zezikibha zakho. Uma izinyawo zakho zihlanzekile, zibhujiswe, ungakhalipha futhi uzitholele ubuhlungu. Amawheels awakwazi ukukhuluma. Ngakho-ke, kusezandleni zethu, abanikazi bamaTaxi, kanye nabashayeli ukuqinisekisa ukungabikhona kokulimala nokukulungisa ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkinga! Amawheels ezimoto asetshenziswa ahluke kuma-wheels ajwayelekile.
