Izinhlobo zamarekhodi zihlukaniswe zibe yilezo ezitholakala ngokushesha kanye neze ezitholakala ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo njengoba kutholakala emthethweni. Isigaba 5 soMthetho sikhombisa ukuthi i-PAIA isebenza ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona eminye imithetho engase ivimbe noma icishe ukuveza ulwazi futhi engahambisani nezinhloso noma nezinhlinzeko ze-PAIA. Angaxhumana noMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ukuze athole la marekhodi, atholakala ukuze abhekwe, athengwe, noma athathwe izithombe uma imali ethile enikeziwe esigabeni 11.4 ngezansi ikhokhwe. Ngicela/Ngivumela ukuthi ukhokhe inzuzo yami uma siphumelele esicelweni sokuhambisa imali kule akhawunti yasebhange elandelayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukudluliswa kwemali okukhishwe lapha kwenziwa ngohlelo lwekhompyutha olwaziwa ngokuthi i-ACB, futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi akukho ulwazi lokukhokha olunikezwa ebhange lami kodwa ulwazi lokukhokha luzobhalwa embikweni wami wasebhange. (lokhu akusebenzi uma ibhange lingajwayele ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi noma imibiko yasebhange, ngokwesibonelo, i-akhawunti yokonga noma uhlobo olufanayo). Le mvume ingakhanselwa ngami ngokunika isaziso esibhaliwe sezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Qaphela: Ubufakazi obubhaliwe be-akhawunti yasebhange (ngokwesibonelo, umbiko wesikhwama, iphepha elivela kwi-ATM, i-check ekhishwe) kumele kuhlanganiswe. Igama lomnikazi we-akhawunti... Ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olukhululiwe ngenhla luyiqiniso kuleli sikhathi futhi lugcwele ngazo zonke izindlela futhi uMphathiswa we-Inshurensi Yokungasebenzi akabhekiwe nganoma yiziphi ukukhokha okungalungile okungavela ngenxa yolwazi olungaphelele noma olungaqondile olunikezwe ngami. Ukusebenzisana neSAQA, DoE nezikhungo zemfundo ngezinye zezinto ezimqoka ekunciphiseni inkinga yokwentuleka kwabasebenzi abafundele umsebenzi wolimi. Imibandela enqunywe wuHlaka lukaZwelonke Lwamaqophelo eMfundo (NQF) iyolandelwa lapho kudwetshwa noma kwethulwa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Ukuthola nokuthuthukisa ubuciko ebasebenzini bomphakathi olimini abangaluncelanga yisimo esithathwa njengesibucayi uma kubhekwa indlela imisebenzi yomphakathi eyethulwa ngayo. IDAC ngokusebenzisana kakhulu nePanSALB, DoE neDPSA iyosungula imihlomulo yokukhuthaza abasebenzi bomphakathi ukwazi izilimi ezahlukene ngokufunda nokusebenzisa izilimi ezengeziwe. Ubuchwepheshe kufanele busetshenziswe ekukhuthazeni ukubambisana phakathi kwalabo ababambe iqhaza ezilimini kanjalo nokuthuthukisa izilimi zendabuko. Izinhlelo ezimumethwe ngamakhompuyutha ezifana nezinhlelo zamagama, izinhlelo zokusingatha ihlelo lamagama olimi nezokuhumusha kufanele zihambisane ukuze zikhuthaze ukushiyelana ngamagama nolunye ulwazi phakathi kwamathimba ezilimi nabamdibi nolwazi njengeHansard namathimba kazwelonke esayense yezichazimazwi (NLUs). Impendulo ngesidingo sokudlondlobalisa intuthuko yezilimi zendabuko, wukuthola nokusingatha uhlobo lwamagama angalotshiwe ephepheni natholakala kwinkulumo. iDAC izibophezele ekwakheni amandla okuzenzela nokuhlinzeka ngenqalasizinda yobuchwepheshe bolwazi. Izilimi zendabuko ziyosekwa ngamaqhinga amasha entuthuko ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana nezinsiza. Inqubo Yokuziphatha ngoLimi kubaSebenzi boMphakathi iyochaza indlela yokukhuluma nokuxhumana nomphakathi ngenhloso yokwenza umsebenzi kahulumeni impumelelo.

Ngesikhathi sehlobo, sizama ukuhlela iziboniso zabalimi lapho bezama khona ukwenza umsebenzi wezolimo, futhi simema amalungu ezigaba zokufunda ukuba bahlangane, futhi sizama ukusiza umbalimi ngamunye ngokwehlukana. Siphinde sathola impendulo enhle evela eziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi ngokusebenza nezinsizakalo zezolimo futhi silindele ukusiza bona ngonyaka omusha wezomnotho lapho kuzoba nezikole ezengeziwe ezifundisa umsebenzi ophathekayo - ukusebenza emhlabeni ngezandla kube inselelo enkulu kulezi ziphathimandla, behluleka ukukhombisa abalimi ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kahle. Siqhubeka nokusabalalisa ulwazi kuRadio ezindaweni ezine: Lesedi, Motsweding, Ligwalagwala, noUmhlobo Wenene - lokhu kuyindlela enhle yokuxhumana nabalimi - hhayi nje ukudlulisa ulwazi mayelana nobuchwepheshe kodwa futhi ukwazisa abalimi ngemicimbi yalolu hlelo. Pula-Imvula iyaqhubeka - kube yingxenye ebalulekile yalolu hlelo - ngakho sithokozisa le miphumela lapho siyibona iphrintiwe. Kukho abantu abahlukene abasebenza ukuze baqedele lo msebenzi - abanye basebenza ku-GSA, abanye baphuma ku-ARC-GCI ePotchefstroom, abahleli bahlala bejolise ekupheleni komsebenzi wabo ngesikhathi, abanye basebenza ku-Infoworks (labo abahlola ukubhala kwethu nalabo abakhiqiza i-newsletter oyifundayo), abahleli baqhubeka nokusebenza kulokho esikubhalayo nalabo abakhulisa ama-newsletters - bonke basebenza ukuze bakhiqize i-newsletter yethu njalo ngenyanga! Pula-Imvula iyamukelwa kahle kakhulu futhi labo abafunda ngayo bayanda - sesifinyelele ezinkopweni eziyi-16,500 ngenyanga, futhi lokhu kuyakhula. Siphinde sibhale ukubonga kuMaize Trust ngokuxhasa uhlelo lwethu.

Kungaki amahora ongawasebenza umsebenzi wezihlahla ngesonto? Amahora ayisishiyagalolunye ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu noma ngaphansi kwesonto; noma amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezingaphezu kwezihlanu ngesonto. Umsebenzi akufanele asebenze amahora angaphezu kwama-12 ngosuku. Ngenxa yokuthi umsebenzi wezihlahla akufanele asebenze amahora angaphezu kwama-45 ngesonto, umsebenzi wezihlahla osebenza amahora ayishumi ezinsukwini ezine akufanele asebenze amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku lwesihlanu. Amahora angaphezu kwenqubo kumele akhokhelwe ngentengo ejwayelekile yansuku zonke ehambisana nengxenye yemiholo ejwayelekile yomsebenzi. Isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo kumele sinikezwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kusukela ngosuku lokuqala umsebenzisi athola ilungelo lokuphumula. Nokho, isivumelwano sokubhala singakhulisa lesi sikhathi sibe yizinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Isivumelwano sokubhala singacela noma sivumele umsebenzi wezihlahla ukuba asebenze amahora ayishumi ngosuku ngokuhlanganyela nezikhathi zokuphumula zokudla ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa amahora angaphezu kwenqubo. Ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyisihlanu ngesonto. Uma usuku lokuphumula luhlangana nosuku olujwayelekile lokusebenza kwabantu bezihlahla, umphathi kumele akhokhele labo abanganqikazi okungenani imiholo ejwayelekile efana nosuku. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla noma yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakele zokusebenza ngosuku lokuphumula ngosuku lokukhokhela ejwayelekile.

Umbuzo 4: Zithini izinzuzo zokuhlanganyela kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zibandakanya ukunciphisa izindleko, ukuhlinza izinsizakalo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, kanye nokwakha umphakathi osekelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kukhulisa ukwakhiwa komthwalo wezithuthi kanye nokuhambela phambili ngokuhlangana kwemininingwane nokwabelana ngolwazi. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuletha ushintsho emphakathini? Impendulo: Nakanjani! I-GEMS ifaka izinguquko ezinkulu ngokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zezempilo, kuphumelele nakwezokusebenza. Lokhu kunciphisa izinga lokugula emiphakathini, ukusiza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, futhi kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kokuphila komphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe izikhungo? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinhlobo zezinqubomgomo zokuqala zihlanganisa ukuqokwa kwezikhulu eziphethe, ukwakhiwa kwemigqa yokuxhumana, ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezinhlelo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngamasu okuphila. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsizakalo kufanele kube ngaphansi kokuhola kweZikhungo zezempilo futhi kuxhaswe nguhulumeni nabanye ababambiqhaza. Umbuzo 7: Yini okumele ibhekwane kakhulu ekuphathweni kwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Ukugxila kwezindinganiso zempilo, ugcino noma ukwenza ngcono izikhungo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kumele kube sezinhliziyweni zemisebenzi ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zithola uxhaso olwenziwayo lokugcina izinga eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani imiphumela ye-GEMS iyabhekwa?

Ngemuva kwalolu hlangothi, kusemukelekile ukucabanga ngamathuba angeziwe. Hamba, fundisa! Ukukhuthaza amathuba okusebenza, kuphumelelisa zonke izinkampani ezizimele. Isifundo sokwenza izimboni, izindlela eziphumelelayo zokukhuthaza ukuqonda, kuyacashelwa. Ngaleyondlela, sizoqhuba impilo yethu ukuze siphushe izimo ezibalulekile ezizokhula, sizame izindlela zethu ezikhandiweyo. Njengoba kuncike empilweni yabantu, ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha ezithandwayo neziqukethe amalungelo kubalulekile, kuyilapho kudala ubuhlobo phakathi kwabezobuchwepheshe nezinhlelo ezenzakalayo. Ekugcineni, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhona nje okuhlobene nezinkinga, kodwa kuyinzuzo yokubambisana. Sinokuhlangenwe nakho okukhulu emhlabeni wemvelo, futhi njengoba sibona izinguquko ezinkulu ezintweni ezincane, kufuneka senze isifungo sokuthanda imvelo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sihlanganyela, singenza umehluko. Ngakho-ke, asithumeli kuphela izimvo eziphakeme, kodwa masithathe izinyathelo ezivamile, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba omusha uyathuthuka — umhlaba ophilayo, omangalisayo, nocansi — ohlala phakade. Uthando lwephuzu lokuzenzela izinguquko ezinhle lukhona, kanti sizokwenza njengoba sikhuthaza izinhlelo ezithile. Ngithanda ukukholwa kulokhu encane, elwa nokuguquka kwezimo — uyinto engakhi izinga lethu lokuphila, impilo yethu, nomphakathi wethu. Ngakho-ke, sizibophezela ekusebenza ndawonye — umhlaba wethu uyaqhakaza! Sinakho konke ukuphila okukhululekile nesinokukhanya. Qhubekani (siyaphi) ekwenzeni izindaba zesizukulwane esisha. Kulungile, jama, ukufunda, imali, futhi izifundo zendawo! Kungani ungasethemba?

Isibonelo, eMzanzi, izibhikisho ezivame ukwenzeka zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinsiza zokuhlala. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni eziningi ezingenazo izinsiza ezisemqoka, futhi lokhu kubangela ukunganeliseki okukhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, emazweni athile, izibhikisho zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinkinga zomnotho, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi amathuba okusebenza awatholakali kalula. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zikamasipala Ukuze izibhikisho zibe nemiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwababhikishi nezikhungo zikamasipala. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana okuhle, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi izinkinga zabo ziyaqondwa. Izikhungo zikamasipala kufanele zibe nezinqubo ezivulekile zokwamukela izikhalazo, futhi zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuveza izinkinga zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. Isiphetho Ukubhikisha komphakathi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokukhombisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Izimbangela zokubhikisha zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala zixhumene nezinkinga ezinzima. Izindlela zokubhikisha zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi imiphumela ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. uhulumeni uveze ukuthi umkhakha wezolimo ubalulekile ku-conomy kanye nokuhlinzekwa kokuphepha kokudla, kuqala ekukhiqizeni kuya ekumaketheni. Isu likahulumeni lihlose ukudala uhlelo oluhlanganyelwe oluhlanganisa imithombo, abathengisi abaphakathi, nezinsizakalo zezolimo ezithuthukisa ukukhiqiza, ukusabalalisa, nokushintshisana kwezimpahla zokudla. Lesi isu sibalulekile kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ezolimo ezikhethekile, ukwakha idolobha, nezinye izitayela zomnotho. Uhulumeni uhlose ukukhulisa inqubo yokukhiqiza ethuthukisa inani lemikhiqizo yezolimo, izindawo, isikhathi, kanye nekhwalithi yezimpahla zokulima. Lokhu kukhuphuka kwenani emkhakheni wezolimo kuhlanganisa nezinqubo zokukhiqiza emasimini. Isu likahulumeni lidala uxhumano olubalulekile phakathi kwabakhangisi bokudla nabathengi, oluxhaswe yizinsiza zendawo, ubuchwepheshe, nemithetho yomphakathi. Isu lezolimo lishintshile ngenxa yezidingo ezishintshayo zabakhiqizi nabathengi. Isu lezolimo lifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eqala ezingeni lokuqala iye emkhiqizweni wokugcina, njengokuthandwa kwabathengi. Ulwazi lwemakethe, ukuthengisa, nokuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kwezolimo kuthinta ukwethemba emakethe, kuthinta amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kumfanelo raw noma enezinhlaka ezingeziwe. Ukuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kubalulekile, futhi ukusebenza kahle kwesu lezolimo kunomthelela omkhulu kumakethe evunyelwe abakhiqizi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthinta izinqumo zabo.

i izindawo zezomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zezolimo isilinganiso okukhulunywa ngaso esigatshaneni- 1 b ingashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela ngokubambisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali. ungqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali kanye nesaziso, ahlele umkhawulo ngokwamaphesenti okufanele ukuba kwenyuswe ngalo inani lentela yendawo. a nezinhlobo zomasipalatiezingase, ngokulandela lesi sigaba, zichazwe esazisweni njengezihlobene nemikhakha noma izinhlobo zomasipalati ezingaphansi kwencazelo yomthetho wezinhlaka zomasipalati nangezinye izindlela; noma b izinhlobo zemikhakha yendawo/yempahla uma kunesizathu esihle, ungqongqoshe anganikeza ushwele kumasipalati emkhawulweni ohlelwe ngokulandela isigatshana-1. inani lentela yendawo eliklanywe endaweni entsha efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo noma indawo umnini wayo enobunikazi ngokohlelo lwezinguquko zemihlaba, kufanele ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- , lifakwe ngezikhawu esikhathini esiyiminyaka yezimali emithathu, kuqalwe ekupheleni kwesikhathi sokungabandakanywa kwamanani entela yendawo okubalulwe endimeni- 15 (g). inani lentela yendawo eliklanywe empahleni/endaweni entsha efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo noma indawo lapho umnikazi enobunikazi ngokohlelo lwezinguquko zobunikazi ngokondlalifa lingebe ngaphezulu kwenani eliklanywe endaweni efanayo noma umkhakha wempahla/wendawo kumasipalati. ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe ilungu lesigungu esikhulu angelula isikhathi sokufakwa kwamanani entela yendawo okukhulunywa ngako esigatshaneni 1 esikhathini esithi uma sihlanganiswe nesasekuqaleni singevi eminyakeni yezimali eyisithupha.

Osaziwayo Nodumo: Amaphupho, Izinselele, Nezimpilo Ake sibheke izimpilo zethu zansuku zonke. Sihlala sibonile izithombe ezinhle, izikhangiso ezikhangayo, nezindaba ezimnandi eziphathelene nosaziwayo. U-‘celebrity’ uvela lapho ibhizinisi lemidlalo, umculo, noma izinto zokuzijabulisa selitholakala emhlabeni. Kepha, kuyini ukuthanda osaziwayo, futhi kuyini okukhuluma ngempilo yabo? Ngibheke lokhu phakathi kwami, ukuze ngidwelise kahle. Kukhona okuthandayo lapho kukhuluma ngosaziwayo. Inhliziyo yezenhlalo ifuna ukwazi okuningi ngabo – abashadile, abanakanga, abanesithunzi, abani imali eningi. Phakathi nemihlangano, sihlangana nezifiso zokuba yibo, ukuphila ukuphila okuthandwa umphakathi. Kodwa kufanele sikhumbule, akekho umuntu ophelele. Abaningi bamele i-photogenic, kodwa abanezinkinga ezinzima zangaphakathi. Kukhona futhi ububi obuhambisana nodumo. Amasiko athwele kanzima futhi ahluphekile. Osaziwayo bahlala ngaphansi kwekhamera, abakwazi ukuphila impilo ejwayelekile. Cabanga nje, lapho uthola lo mculi omncane socela ukuthi uthumele isithombe, uvuma ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, udinga ukukwazi ukwakha ikhono lokuphila, okwenza umcabango ukuthi ungumuntu ophila njengabo bonke. Kukhona abampofu abavela ezindabeni, abafuna uthando nesikhumbuzo. Ngabe abavela ezindawenikazi, banelungelo lokubhekwa? Esikhathini esiningi, izinkinga zashintsha, okusho ukuthi abaculi bahlupheka kakhulu. Uphethwe izingcindezi zokubukeka, ukwenziwa kwezakhamuzi, nokugcina umphakathi uyajabula. Kodwa akufanele sibhale ngeso lokugxila kuphela. Abanye, abavela ezindaweni ezizimele, bazama ukwakha ibhizinisi labo.

IDAC iyosungula Ingodla kaZwelonke Yamagama egcinwe kukhumpuyutha ukuze ikhuthaza ukufinyelela nokusabalalisa ihlelo lamagama olimi kuzo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni. Ingodla Yamagama ingatholakala ngokusebenzisa ubunyoninco be-internet futhi lensiza ibuyekezwa okungenani kanye ngenyanga. Iziko Lezilimi zikaZwelonke limatasatasa nesibalo esithile semisebenzi ngenhloso yokubumba ingodla yehlelo lamagama ezilimi ezahlukene ezihlanganisa imikhakha engafani yolwazi. Lengodla inika ithemba lokuthi kungavela uhlu olusha lwamagama ngokudidiyela izilimi. Ngokwezidingo zabantu abasebenzisa amagama noma izicelo, lolu hlu lwamagama lunganika ulwazi olufana nezincazelo, imisho yezibonelo, ingqikithi nombhalo uma kushicilelwa. e Umsakazo woMphakathi. Kuyokhuthazwa ukubambisana namazwe aseMazansi neZwekazi lase-Afrika entuthukweni yezilimi ezigamanxe emingceleni yamanye amazwe. Njengamanje, kubonakala sengathi isantuleka inqalasizinda yokuguqulela kolunye ulimi umbhalo, ukuhumusha nokulungisa amaphutha embhalweni. Noma amathimba olimi eyodlala indima enqala ekulungiseni lesi simo, kusafanele kuhlolwe igebe phakathi kwezidingo zomsebenzi wolimi namandla okwethula lowo msebenzi. c Inqubomgomo yokuguqula amagama nokulungisa amaphutha embhalweni. Imihlahlandlela yokuguqulela kolunye ulimi amagama Nokulungisa amaphutha embhalweni imiselwe ukwethula imihlahlandlela yangaphakathi yokuguqulela kolunye ulimi amagama nokulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni eguquliwe nokuhlola leyo mibhalo enikwe abantu bangaphandle ukuba bayihumushe. Inhlosonqangi wukwenza ngcono iqophelo lomsebenzi ngokwethula umkhiqizo wezinga eliphezulu.

Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zathuthukiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezindaweni ezikude. Namuhla, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya sekuyinto ejwayelekile, futhi abantu abaningi baphila impilo engcono ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile ngokuba negesi emakhaya. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa ugesi ukuze bathuthukise izimpilo zabo. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akukona nje kuphela ukwakha izindawo ezinhle, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ugesi ube yinsika yokuthuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izimpilo ezinhle ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kube yisinyathelo esikhulu sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ngakho-ke, le ndaba yokutholakala kukagesi emakhaya ibalulekile, njengoba ibonisa indlela abantu abashintshile ngayo impilo yabo ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Ugesi ube yinsika yokuthuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokwakha izimpilo ezinhle, bejabulile ngokuba negesi emakhaya. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kube yisinyathelo esikhulu sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.

Ukuze ubheke lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithi: "Amanzi ahlanzekile anika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo." Lokhu kusho ukunciphisa izingozi zokugula, ukukhulisa ukwandisa umkhiqizo kanye nezinga lempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ezindaweni ezinezinsiza eziphansi, lapho kwenziwa khona izinhlelo ezihlose ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Ukwakhiwa kwemithombo esebenzayo, izivande zokuhlanza amanzi, nemithala yokwelapha, kuzoletha umphumela omuhle ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngaphandle kokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi ahlanzekile, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezinamandla zokuqhakambisa indawo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu endimeni yokugcina amanzi futhi nesimo sezulu esinempilo. Ukuze uhlole ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphila, kudingeka umphakathi owodwa, lapho abantu baphila ngokuhlanganyela, bejabulela ubuhlobo bokuthola izinsiza ezihambisanayo, ngaphezu kokukwazi ukuhlanzeka kwemvelo. Ubulungiswa bokuhlala futsi lubalulekile ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba ubhekene nezinqoba ezinzima ezihlobene nezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Izinhlaka ezithintekayo kumele ziqonde ukuthi imiphumela yalezi zinguquko ithinta ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezibuthakathaka zomphakathi. Ukuze sithathe izinyathelo eziphathekayo, kufanele sithathele phezulu ukufundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngezindlela zokuvikelwa kwemithombo yamanzi, ukuvuselela imithombo engcolile, nokugwema uhlelo lwezokuthutha olubi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokunqoba ezimweni ezinzima ezibhekene nezinsiza zomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulula kakhulu ukuhlola ukuvikelwa kwempilo yamanzi.

Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Izwe lethu libhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezithinta imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihlobene ne-GEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme). Lezi zinhlinzeko zenzelwe ukuvikela izinsizakalo zempilo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zigcizelela izindinganiso ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS iwuhlelo olwakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zisebenza kahle, imikhawulo ethile ibekwe ukuze igweme ukusetshenziswa okungafanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvikela izinsiza zokwelapha ezibhekelele izidingo zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kanti kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzisi bayawuqonda umthetho ophathelene nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo. Okwesibili, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibandakanya izinqubomgomo ezithile ezikhomba indlela izinsizakalo zempilo ezisetshenziswa ngayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izivumelwano zokusebenza ezithinta izinsizakalo ezithile, njengezokwelapha, izivivinyo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zingase zingatholakali uma zisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemigomo ethile, okungaholela ezinkingeni zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imikhawulo ibalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lempilo kubasebenzisi. I-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.

Ngithi angikusho lokhu ngoba yinoma ngubani lapha emhlabeni into yokuqala ayicabangela imali uma ebhekene nezimo ezingezinhle ngasohlangothini lwempilo yakhe uma kuthinta izimali ukuthi athenge into eya ngaphansi kwekhala lokho okungukudla ngaphambi kokuthi abhekane nezinye izikweletu. Ngokocwaningo lwe IMF, amanani okudla emhlabeni jikelele asekhuphuke cishe ngesibalo esithi asiphindwe kuleso ayeyiso ngonyaka ka 2006 World Food Prices have increased by 48% since 2006. Ukwenza-nje isibonelo ngalokhu engikushoyo, uma ngo 2006 isaka lempuphu elingu 12,5kg wawulithenga ngo R15, njengamanje isaka elifanayo usungalithenga ngo R28.. Mphathi wohlelo, abaningi bazozibuza ukuthi uNgqongqoshe uMthimkhulu kutheni esifundekela ngento engekho eduzane nathi. Cha, bakwethu ngithi lokhu angikusho ngoba ngisho nakuleli lakithi lenkinga yamanani aphezulu okudla nangendlela ekhahlameza ngayo abantulayo noma imiphakathi ehlwempu isibonakele kanti nathi singuHulumeni ikakhulukazi iMinyango yezoLimo kuzozonke izifundazwe nakuzwelonke loludaba lusikhathaze kakhulu. Ngokocwaningo nangezibalo ezisanda kukhishwa aboMkhandlu kaZwelonke wezokuQhakambisa ezoLimo (National Agricultural Marketing Council) kube nokukhuphuka kokudla okukhulu kulonyaka odlulile. Ucwaningo lwaloMkhandlu lukuveza ngokusobala ukuthi ukudla okukhombise ukunyuka kakhulu amanani akho yilokho okungumgogodla wansuku zonke kubantu abangenamali etheni (Consumers of the basic staple diet foods have been the hardest hit). Mphathi wohlelo yikho kubalulekile ukuthi siyimiphakathi sibambisane noHulumeni noMnyango uma kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esizozithula lapha namhlanjena.

Izindlela zokulima ezingafanelekile ngeminyaka neminyaka zenze ukuthi izingcebo zefosfeyiti kwezinye izindawo zicishe zidleke zonke. Njengokuthela umcako, ukulungisa lokhu kubiza imali eningi futhi kungathi awekho amasabsidi. Kaningi amapulazi lapho abalimi abasakhulayo balima khona awazange asetshenziswe kahle ngoba asekho amakontula nezindlela zamanzi ezinotshani. Nokho Umnyango Wezokulima unesigaba esibheka umhlaba (Land Care), ibhajete labo lincane, liyahluleka ukulungisa le nkinga enkulu nokuhlangana nalesi sidingo esikhulu. Kaningi ukuhhebuka komhlaba ngenxa umoya namanzi sekuqhubeke kangaka awusakwazi ukulungiswa. Abakhiqizi badinga ithuba lokuba banini bomhlaba nemishini ukuze bakhule babe bakhiqizi bezomnotho. KIwamanye amaphrovinsi kukhona ukuswela okukhulu kwehlelo lwezokulima njengemigwaqo, amasayilo, izindawo zokomisa ukudla okuzinhlamvu, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Abimi badinga ukuqeqeshwa, ukusekelwa neziphathimandla eziqobelelana nolwazi. Abantu bafenele banikezwa amandla okuma ngezinyawo zabo. Kufanele bafunde bazisebenzele. Abasebenzi bakaHulumeni abangakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kwenza ukuthi abantu bahlale babempofu (isibonelo, Umnyango Wezomhlaba ohluleka ukuqhubekisa umsebenzi wabo noMnyango Wezokulima ongasekeli abantu ngendlela efanelekile). Kulula ukuxhaphaza abantu abampofu (kubadla). Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu abasebenza ngokuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abasakhulayo basebenze ngendlela eqotho enokuphelela. Imithetho efanelekile nezimiso zokuthengiselana eziqondile ukuvikela amabhizinisi ezokulima zezwe. Nikeza isilekelelo ngezindleko zokufaka umcako. Nikeza isilekelelo ngezindleko zokufaka fosfati.

a umkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika ; kanye b namarekhodi ezokuvikela omkhumbi; kanye c noma imuphi umbhalo ophathelene nezokuvikela zomkhumbi, ngokwenhloso yokubhekisisa ukuthi umkhumbi uyahlangabezana nezidingo ezifunekayo zokufakazelwa kwe-ISSC. uma kungumkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika , noma imuphi umbhalo f sivule izinto zokusebenza emkhunjini olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuthola imibhalo noma amarekhodi akulowo mkhumbi. Kodwa-ke, isikhulu esigunyaziwe akufanele sisebenzise amandla ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 2 mayelana nomkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe ofulege lawo liyilunga lesivimelwano, ngaphandle uma amandla awuhlobo lwamandla olungasetshenziswa ngaphansi kweSahluko XI-2 seSivumelwano sokuVikela kanye noMgomo we-ISPS, yichweba mayelana nomkhumbi onefulegi lakwelinye izwe. a uma amandla esetshenziswa ngaphakathi kwemincele yechweba elilawulwa ngezokuvikela noma ingasiphi isikhathi nangaphandle kwesaziso; noma b ngale kwalokho, ngemuva kokunika umsebenzi womkhumbi noma induna yomkhumbi yalowo mkhumbi othintekayo isaziso esamukelekile. a uma ngabe amandla esetshenziswa ngaphakathi kwemincele yechweba elilawulwa ngezokuvikela, noma ingasiphi isikhathi, ngaphandle kwesaziso; noma b kungenjalo, ngemuva kokunika lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle isaziso esamukelekile. Ulwazi oluphathelene nokulandelwa, ukwahluleka ukulandela lemithethonkambiso ngulwazi oluphathelene nokulandelwa kwezokuvikela.

Cabanga uma umphakathi uqala ukuthanda nokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, kungenzeka kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Sizokwazi ukusiza abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba bahlale beqhubeka, futhi sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele futhi sikhulume ngemininingwane ethile. Kungani izinkampani ezincane zidinga ukuxhaswa kwezobuchwepheshe? Izinsiza ezinjengezinhlelo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuphatha, nemithombo yokuxhumana ziwusizo kakhulu. Uma umnikazi webhizinisi ethola usizo kwezobuchwepheshe, kungenzeka ukuthi akhuphule ukusebenza kahle, akhulise ukukhiqiza, futhi ahloniphe isikhathi. Lokhu kuhlobene nemicabango yethu yokuthuthukisa umnotho, ngoba uma izinkampani ziqhubeka, umphakathi uthola izinzuzo. Ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akupheli lapha. Kukhona nezinye izindlela eziningi zokuxhasa, ezifanele ukuba sikhulume ngazo. Isibonelo, ukubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi amancane nakakhulu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Uma abanikazi bamabhizinisi bexhumana, bangakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, benze izivumelwano zokuhweba, futhi bakhuthaze umphakathi. Lokhu kudala umoya womsebenzi ongenakuphikwa, futhi kukhuthaza ukuxhaswa phakathi kwabanye. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akuyona into eyodwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nomqondo ofanayo, sisebenzisane, futhi sikhuthaze omunye nomunye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhulumeni, abanikazi bamabhizinisi, noma umphakathi, sonke sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Ngeke sikwazi ukukwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela, futhi lokho kudinga ukuthi sibe nethemba, sibe nokuqonda, futhi sikhuthaze.

Loluxolelo luchaza ukuxolelwa ngaphansi kwemibandela ethile yoMthetho, imigomo, isaziso noma imilayelo engaphansi koMthetho. Umqashi kumele azise abamele ingosi yempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini ngokushesha lapho kunengozi eyenzekile emsebenzini. Ingozi yisehlakalo esivela emsebenzini lapho kufa khona, kulimale noma kugule umuntu. Isibonelo, kungaba wukuchitheka koketshezi oluwubuthi, lapho ithangwe livuza nokungadalwa yisivalo esingavaleki kahle noma lapho umshini uphunyuka ngaphandle kokubulala umuntu noma alimale. Imisebenzi evamile yabakhiqizi, abasunguli bezinto, abathenga emazweni angaphandle, okuthengwa kubo noma abathengisi maqondana nokusetshenziswa kwezinto kanye noketshezi emsebenzini. Uma othengiselwe leyompahla, isithako noma uketshezi ekhetha ukubhala abalule izinyathelo ayozithatha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leyompahla, isithako noma uketshezi luyohlangabezana nezidingo ezibekiwe, nokuthi siphephile futhi asinabungozi, umsebenzi walowo othenga kwelinye izwe, osungulayo noma oqophayo, odayisayo, umthengisi noma umkhiqizi uyobe sewedlulela kumuntu owenze isibophezelo sezinyathelo ayozithatha. ukunakekela impilo nokuphepha kwaso kanjalo nokwabanye abantu abangathola amachaphazela ezenzo zakhe noma ngobudedengu baleso senzo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukudlala emsebenzini. Abantu abaningi bayalimala abanye bafe ngenxa yokudlala amahashi emsebenzini, lento ithathwa njengokwephula umthetho okukhulu. Ukubikela umqashi, ogunyaziwe noma ilunga elimele ezokuphepha emsebenzini ngokuphuthuma isimo sokulimala okungaba nomthelela empilweni noma isimo esingadala ukulimala lingakapheli lelo shifuthi lokusebenza.

Inqubo yokuhamba kwefu ibhekisela ezicwangcweni ezihlelwe zokusebenzisa amathuluzi athile okundiza ukuze kuvikelwe ukuhamba kwezindiza ezithintwa yizithiyo ezingaba khona kumkhondo wayo wokuqala kuze kube kufinyelelwa endaweni lapho izinhlelo zokuxhumana zomhlaba zingasungulwa futhi zibe usizo ekubambeni noma ekujikelezeni kwehamba, bese-ke, ngemuva kwalokho, ingabamba endaweni lapho uhlelo lokuphatha izithiyo zendawo noma izithiyo zendlela zisebenza. I-GNSS ibhekisela kuHlelo Lokuhamba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe lwezindiza ukuze kuhlonishwe isikhundla sezindiza esikhaleni. Uhlelo lokuhlonza indawo nesikhathi emhlabeni wonke oluhilela ubuchwepheshe bezithombe bokuhlola kude noma ukuqoqa kwazo, ama-receivers ezindiza, kanye nohlelo lokulandela olusekela ukuqapha nokuhlola izindiza emoyeni. Umcimbi we-GNSS ubhekisela ezenzekeni nasezimo ezifanayo nezinkinga zemishini, izinkomba, noma amaphutha abantu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Ukuqina mayelana ne-GNSS kubhekisela ekwazini kwemishini ukuhlinzeka ngezixwayiso kulabo abasebenzisa yona uma ukusebenza kwayo kudlula imikhawulo yokuphepha esunguliwe futhi akufanele isetshenziswe ekulandeleni. Ukuhamba kwe-Side/edge kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuhola ukuhamba ngaphandle kwezinkomba ezithile ezivertical ezihlobene nezindlela zokulandela ukuhamba ngendlela engashayi ngqo umhloli noma yokuyifuna lapho idlula. Uhlelo lokuhamba lwezindiza oluyinhloko lubhekisela ohlelweni lokuhamba emoyeni olwamukelwa nguMphathiswa wezokuhamba noma ngesikhathi esithile sokuhamba, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zezinkomba ezivertical ezithile kanye nokuqina, kodwa akusho ukuthi kuhlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala noma ukuqhubeka.

Inhloso yalenqubomgomo wukuqinisa ukulawulwa kwezibhedlela nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle kwamaBhodi ezibhedlela. Lenqubomgomo isivele seyethuliwe emaBhodini alawula izibhedlela yathola ukwesekwa ngo elethu. Indlela abasebenzi bezokwelapha abaletha ngayo usizo emphakathini kube nomthelela omuhle ngisho nakubantu abanokukhubazeka. Sizophinde sisungule izikhungo zokuhlola amehlo (Opthalmology) oThungulu, eLembeni, eThekwini, oGwini naseMgungundlovu ukuhlangabezana nezinhlelo zethu zokunciphisa izinga labantu abaphoqelekayo ukuba bahlinzwe amehlo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abakwa-MTN benze lokhu kwalula ngokunikela ngemitholampilo engomahamba nendlwana emithathu esizoyithola ngoJuni nonyaka. Isibophezelo i-Alma Ata Declaration iyona eqapha indlela esisebenza ngayo uhlelo lokunakekela abantu emakhaya nasemphakathini okuyingxenye ebaluleke kakhulu ekuletheleni izingqalazidingo zezempilo. Le ndlela ihlale ithuthukiswa, kanti idinga ukuzibandakanya, ukubamba iqhaza okugcwele kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu esibasizayo. Kulo nyaka odlule wezimali, ngamavolontiya angu-15 700 abambe iqhaza elibonakalayo ekuletheni usizo lwezempilo behamba indlu nendlu nasemphakathini. Kuleli nani, angu-4749 kuwona abethola umthobanhliziyo ka-R500 ngenyanga. Sizoqhubeka nokusiza lama volontiya ukuze azihlele ukuba abe yizinhlangano ezisemthethweni zomphakathi, nokuzokwenza uMnyango ungene ezivumelwaneni nazo, futhi ukwazi nokuxhasa nangezimali zokukhokhelwa kwamavolontiya.

Ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa ezibhedlela zikahulumeni iyahluka. Kwezinye izindawo, izibhedlela zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela, kanti kwezinye, izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwabasebenzi nabathengi bempilo zingaholela ekwehliseni ikhwalithi. Uhlelo lukahulumeni luhlongoza ukuthuthukisa le khwalithi ngokwandisa izinsiza, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokwenza ngcono izinqubo zokusebenza. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyenze uma unganelisekile ngensizakalo ethile? Uma unganelisekile ngensizakalo ethile ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, ungaba nezinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ungakhuluma nomphakathi wezempilo ukuze uvezwe izinkinga zakho. Futhi, ungathola izeluleko ezivela kumalungu omphakathi noma izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngempilo. Uma kudingeka, ungabhalela izikhalazo ezisemthethweni ukuze kube nokuhlonzwa kwezinselelo ezikhona. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani uhulumeni angathuthukisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni? Ukuze uhulumeni athuthukise izibhedlela zikahulumeni, kudingeka: - Ukwandisa izimali ezitholakalayo - Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezempilo - Ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, njengezibhedlela nezinsiza zokwelapha - Ukuxhumana nomphakathi ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zabo - Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezizimele ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo Lezi zinyathelo zingasiza ekwakheni izibhedlela ezisebenzayo, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Umbuzo 9: Yini umphumela omuhle wezibhedlela zikahulumeni emphakathini? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zineqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zihlinzeka ngempilo engcono, zinciphisa izifo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezithengekayo, ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ophathelene nokulwa nobandlululo ube nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselelwa kwemithetho yokuvikela amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu. Izinguquko zikhuthaza ukufakwa kwemithetho eqinile yokuvikela abesifazane, izingane, kanye nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi unelungelo lokuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba. Imiphumela Yokuguqulwa Kwezomthetho Izinguquko zomthetho zinezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi zibuye zibe nezinselelo. Ngokwenyuka kwemithetho ethile, abantu bangase bazizwe bephakanyiswa, kodwa uma imithetho ingahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi, kungaholela ekuphikisaneni. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bezomthetho baqonde kahle izidingo zabantu ukuze baphendule kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko zomthetho zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uyakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kubonakala ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomthetho, izakhamuzi, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze izinguquko zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalezi zikhungo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi imithetho ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Isiphetho Izinguquko zomthetho zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Njengoba izwe lethu lihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi umthetho ulandele izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uhambisane nezimo zamanje. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abaphathi bezomthetho, izakhamuzi, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho iyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi.

Ishadi lokungenisa lemidlalosemhlabeni elitholakala ezweni lidingeka lapho kuhanjiswa iziphuzo ezine-alcohol eNingizimu Afrika. Ishadi lokungenisa noma ikhophi yalo kuzodingeka ngaphambi kokuthi umthwalo ukhululwe epulazini lokungena. Umthengisi kufanele afake isicelo se-shadi lokungenisa lempahla. Ngemuva kwalokho, ishadi lokungenisa lingasetshenziswa, uma kungabikho shintsho ekwakhiweni, ngaphakathi, usayizi wephetshana, kanye nelebuli yaleyo mveliso. Lihloselwe ukusetshenziswa komuntu siqu kulowo muntu, umndeni wabo, kanye nezivakashi zabo ezingathengi leyo alcohol. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo. Isicelo esisodwa kufanele sibe ne-sampuli ye-750ml yomkhiqizo okukhuluma ngawo. Uma kukhulunywa ngokungeniswa kwamabhodlela, kufanele uthumele isampuli ebhodleleni elinlebhuli, njengoba ithengiswa. Thumela isampuli ye-alcohol engenisiwe ebhodleleni ejwayelekile ye-750ml. Thumela isampuli ehhovisi leMikhiqizo yeziqhamo eStellenbosch. Thumela isitifiketi sokuhlaziywa esikhishwe yelabhorethri esemthethweni yaleso sizwe esitholakala khona i-alcohol. Uma lokhu kungatholakali, iMikhiqizo yeziqhamo izokwenza ukuhlaziywa kwekhemikhali ngesampuli. Mayelana ne-alcohol engenisiwe emabhodlelweni, ilebuli yebhodlela izohlolwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ihambisana nezidingo zomthetho weziqhamo, iMthetho weMikhiqizo yeziqhamo, 1989. Ngokungeniswa okukhulu, umkhiqizo ofikayo uzohlolwa. Ilebuli ibhekwa uma ufaka isicelo sesitifiketi sokuthengisa. Umnyango kufanele ukhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi bakhiphe ishadi lokungenisa ezweni.

Konke kuyoya NGOBUWENA. Ukuhlala ulindele okuhle, ulangazelela ukusebenza, ushisekele/unoqgozi futhi unamandla. Ukwenza okuhle kakhulu ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kumayelana nokuthanda umsebenzi wakho, nokuziqayisa ngalokho okwenzayo. Kumayelana nokuziqhenya ngokusebenzela iBhange lezoMhlaba. Yini uHlelo loSizo lweBhange LezoMhlaba? Loluhlelo luqukethe ukuthi singaluletha kanjani noku silunikezeleni usizo oluvelele kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezinkomba uyokwakha ulwazi (experience) olujabulisayo noluyothokozelwa ngabanye abasebenzi kanye namakhasemede ngokufanayo. Lomfanekiso wohlelo loSizo yiwona mqulu wakho osokusiza ekunikeni usizo kubantu "abaphambi kwakho". Enye yezinjongo ezihleliwe zebhange lezoMhlaba ukuthinta ngokunempumelelo izinga lempilo lawo wonke umuntu. Wena, njengenxusa lebhange usethubeni elihle lokuba ingxenye yokushintsha ikusasa labantu! Uyingxenye yokufezekisa amakhono abantu ngokubanikeza izimali abangazisebenzisa ukufeza amaphupho abo. Asigxilile kuphela ekuthuthukiseni abantu abangaphandle kwebhange kuphela kodwa nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu futhi. LoMfanekiso wohlelo luzokusiza nawe ukuba uthuthuke ube ngumuntu onakekela abanye abantu nonakekela usizo alunikezayo. Sifisa ukukhuthaza bonke abasebenzi beBhange lezoMhlaba ukuba benze noma basebenze ngokulandela lamaphuzu abalwe lapha ngezansi: Asigqugquzelane sikhuthazane zonke isinsuku, ayi kuphela ukuba senze okuhle ngamakhono ethu, kepha sisabalalise injabulo ekubhekaneni nomsebenzi nezimpilo zethu! Amukela ngokushesha amakhasimede ngokuwabheke emehlweni umoyizele.

Kwakukhona umoya opholile, umoya wokukhuluma, umoya wokukhumbula. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Umculo we-gospel wawungowokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa wawuphinde ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel wathuthuka. Kwakukhona abaculi abaninzi ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, behamba behamba, bejolise ekukhulumeni izindaba zabo. UThandi, umculi owayenothando olukhulu lokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, waba yisibonelo esihle. UThandi wayengumuntu ophila empilweni enezinkinga, kodwa umculo wakhe wawuhamba phambili. Waqala ukucula izingoma ezazikhuluma ngothando lukaNkulunkulu, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uyasithanda, noma ngabe sikhona esikhathini esinzima. indawo yokuhlala yindlu eyingxenye yendawo yokuhlala esetshenziswa njengendawo yokuhlala abantu, noma izindlu eziningana ezinjalo ebaleni lapha akukhulunywa ngendawo lapho ingxenye engaphezu kweyodwa kwezintathu isetshenziselwa okunye okungekhona ukuhlala, kumbe ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, iB&B, indlu yokulalisa izihambi kumbe okunye okunjalo okuqashisa nsuku zonke. Indawo ekhokha ama-rates ayisipesheli yindawo eklanyiweyo lapho abanikazi bezakhiwo ezikuyo bevumelene ukukhokhela okunye kwabakwenzelwayo ngaphezu kwalokho abakwenzelwa nguMasipala. Lokhu kukhokhelwa ngokwengeza enye imali kweyamarates efakwa kuma-akhawunti ama-rates abanikazi bezakhiwo ezikuleyo ndawo. Imisebenzi yohwebo ifaka: Amadela; Isikhumulo sezindiza, indawo esetshenziswa nguMnyango kaGesi wakwaMasipala; isisi esokhelekayo; Amabhilidi/ Izindawo zokuPaka, izakhiwo zeMakethe, indawo esetshenziswa nguMnyango wamanzi wakwaMasipala. Inani lomhlaba kusho intengo umhlaba ongadayiswa ngayo ebalwa ngokoMthetho. UKUPHASISWA KWALE NQUBOMGOMO UNYAKA NONYAKA UMkhandlu kaMasipala kufanele uyibuyekeze minyaka yonke inqubomgomo yamarates, kanye nesabelo zimali sikaMasipala. Ukukhokhwa kwama-rates omhlaba/esakhiwo lapho ubunikazi buhlanganyelwe khona kungumthwalo wabanikazi labo ngokuhlanganyela kanye nomthwalo womuntu ngayedwana kulabo banikazi. Ukulethwa kwama-akhawunti noma izincwadi kunoma yimuphi omunye wabo kuthathwa ngokuthi kwenziwe kubo bonke.

a kungasekho uhlelo lokuvikela lomkhumbi olusebenzayo lwalowo mkhumbi. IsiPhathimandla singanika umsebenzi womkhumbi I-ISSC yesikhashana yalowo mkhumbi. a IsiPhathimandla sinike umsebenzi womkhumbi I-ISSC yomkhumbi olawula eNingizimu Afrika; futhi b Ngesikhathi kusasebenza I-ISSC omunye umsebenzi womkhumbi eba ngusebenzi womkhumbi walowo mkhumbi, isiPhathimandla singanika omunye umsebenzi womkhumbi I-ISSC yesikhashana yalowo mkhumbi. isitatimende senziwe kumuntu ogunyaziswe yiSivumelwano soMbuso ukuba acele ulwazi mayelana noma oluhambisana nokuthi I-ISSC noma I-ISSC yesikhashana iyasebenza kulowo mkhumbi. Icala okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso 1 uma likulahlile uyojeziswa ngokukhokhiswa inhlawulo noma uvalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12. b ukwamukela izinto zokuletha ukuvikeleka ukuze zisetshenziswe ngaphakathi emkhunjini olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika. Uma sinika usizo, IsiPhathimandla kufanele sibhekisise izibopho njengoba zibekiwe kuSahluko Xi-2 sesiVumelwano sezokuvikela kanye noMgomo we-ISPS. c kungasulwa noma kuguqulwe ngemuva kokunikeza isaziso esifanele. a ube ne-ISSC esemthethweni noma I-ISSC eyamukelekile yalowo mkhumbi; futhi b aqiniseke ukuthi umkhumbi unamarekhodi omkhumbi ezokuvikela adingekayo. Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi olawula kwelinye izwe ephula umthethonkambiso 1 umsebenzi womkhumbi noma induna yomkhumbi inganikwa umyalo ngaphansi kweSahluko 2.

Ukubekwa okusemthethweni kwezishicilelo yigama elamukelwe emhlabeni wonke jikelele. Kuyini "ukubekwa okusemthethweni"? Ukubekwa okusemthethweni kuyisibopho somthetho sabashicileli bazo zonke izinhlobo zemiqulu ukuba babeke inani elithile lekhophi ngalinye yaleyo miqulu abayishicilele ezindaweni ezithile okubekwa kuzo lezo zishicilelo ngokusemthethweni. Imiqulu kumele ithunyelwe ezindaweni ebekwa kuzo ngokusemthethweni ngezindleko ezithwalwa ngumshicileli, futhi lokhu kumele kwenziwe zingakapheli izinsuku eziyi-14 zesishicelelo. Inhloso yokubekwa okusemthethweni kwezishicilelo kuwukuqoqa, ukugcina kanye nokwenza kutholakale kuzizukulwane zamanje nezizayo ubuhlakani kanye nendabuko yamasiko elizwe, ngaphezulu kwalokho ukuqinisekisa ukufinyeleleka ngokukhululeka kuyo yonke imiqulu etholakele. Umthetho mayelana nalokhu waqhutshekiselwa phambili ngoMthetho wamaLungelo okuShicilela ka 1965 kanye noMthetho wokuBekwa okuseMthethweni kweziShicilelo ngo 1982, kuze kube ngumthetho okhona manje, uMthetho wokuBekwa okuseMthethweni waphasiswa ngo 1997, ukuba ufake phakathi ukubekwa kwemiqulu ye-elekthroniki kanye naleyo miqulu eyizimviwa-kubukelwa. Umqulu uyinoma yini ehloswe ukugcinwa noma ukudlulisa umlayezo oyitheksthi, umdwebo, okubonwayo, okuzwakalayo noma yinoma iyiphi indlela yokuxhumana okunobuhlakani. Yini okumele ibekwe? Izimali zasemabhange noma amasheke. Kuqinisekisa ukufinyeleleka kuyo yonke imiqulu eshicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika. Kungenye yezinsika zolwazi olukhululekile. Kuyirekhodi lazo zonke izishicilelo ezikhiqizwa yizwe.

Ngithola ukuthi ucabanga ukuthi ukhuluma noMphakathi ngendlela akhuluma ngayo. Umshumayeli: Eh, outie, nansi ibhuthi, le mntwana emhlophe ithi ifuna thina ngalesi sikhathi. Ngimtshela uyazi angibeki igama elinjalo ukuthi lo mfana ukutshela ukuthi nini. (Uthi) Ngitshele, ngitshele ebusuku, ngimtshela uyazi ngitshele lowo mfana ukuthi uma engafuni izindaba, kufanele ayeke izindaba. Uma efuna sithumele okuthile, makakhulume kusenesikhathi, ungitshele ukuthi ufuna ukusibona ngo-6. Umshumayeli: Bathi manje? Umshumayeli: Ngimtshela ngosuku lokuqala ukuthi yena uqobo ngeke akutshele ukuthi ufuna wena uma umphatha, uya kuphi. Ngimtshela ukuthi hey mfo, awukwazi ukuba nolaka, kufanele usebenze. Ngithi mtshele lo mfana manje uthi mtshele namuhla ukuthi sithola manje nginokuhlangana futhi angikwazi ukukuphula? Umshumayeli: Ngithi mtshele lo mfana ukuthi akasebenzi kanjalo futhi uma engakutholi, mnike inombolo zami ukuze ungibize. Ngithi manje enye into uthi kufanele aye epitini ezindlini emapulazini. Umamukeli: Wow, mfo, ingabe kulokhu kubanda? Umamukeli: Noma lokhu kumphazamisela, akakhathali. Umshumayeli: Manje ngithi kuye angihambi kanjalo. Umshumayeli: Uyazi kukhona enye into eDiepkloof, ngakho, le nto ikutshela ukuthi hey manje mfo babambe abancane eStanera ngoba le Jozi uyazi, uyabona. Manje kukhona omunye umuntu ofuna ukuhlanganisa, manje uza nenye into ehamba le ndlela ye-BM ukuze afake i-MIG. Uthi manje sizoshiywa nini, ebuzwa le nto. Manje le nto ithi manje inkinga yimali, manje anginayo imali ngemva kokuthi. Manje uma ngifika sekwenziwe.

Uhlola kanjani ukuthi i-planter ilungiswe kahle ukuze ifeze ukutshala? Thola zonke izingxenye ze-planter ezingalungisa ukulungiswa (ama-sprockets, ama-gears, nezitsha). Qonda ukuthi i-planter ithengisa kanjani uma kuqhathaniswa nezimpande nez fertiliser ngamanani akhona. Linganisa ububanzi ngaphakathi kwezingxenye ze-planter ukuze unqume ububanzi bezigaba zokutshala - lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukala inani lezigaba ezizotshalwa ngaphezulu kwe-hectare (Isibonelo: ububanzi be-hectare bungama-100 meters, uma ububanzi ngaphakathi kwezigaba bungama-0.9 m, khona-ke 100 m / 0.9 m = 111 izigaba nge-hectare). Beka indawo endaweni engama-10 m. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezimpande nez fertiliser emabhokisini (ama-hoppers) - futhi uqinisekise ukuthi usayizi wezimpande uhambisana nezimbobo ezikuma-plates - kufanele kube ne-1 seed kuphela ehla ngesikhathi. Qinisa ipulasitiki emaphethelweni aphehla fertiliser ukuze ukwazi ukukala isisindo se-fertiliser ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Phusha i-planter kule ndawo engama-10 m (qinisekisa ukuthi amavili anokuxhumana okuhle nomhlabathi). Bala inani lezimpande eziphume kule ndawo engama-10 m. ku-100 m (khumbula ukuthi i-hectare iyalingana no-100 m x 100 m). uma ububanzi bethu bungama-0.9 m, kusho ukuthi kune-111 izigaba ku-100 m. Isibonelo: sithola ukuthi ama-30 seeds aphumelele kule ndawo engama-10 m. futhi ama-300 seeds ku-100 m. phinda: x 300 = 33,300 izitshalo nge-hectare. ama-sprockets ukuze i-planter ihambe ngokushesha.

Le SIVUMELWANO sizoqala ukusebenza futhi sibe yisibopho kusukela osukwini esisayinwe ngaso le SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo nje uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO engasisayini kanye kanye AMAQEMBU, usuku lokugcina lokusayina kwelinye lamaqembu luyothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kokusebenza. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, zizoqhubeka isikhathi esithize esilingene (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi), okuyoqala ngosuku okuqala ngalo ukuthi le SIVUMELWANO siqale ukusebenza (bheka isiGaba 12.1 ngezansi). Le SIVUMELWANO singavuselelwa ngokukhetha kwe SAPS ngokuthi kubhalwe phansi ngemvume YOWENKONTILEKA kube okwesikhathi esithize esibekiwe: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS eyokwazi ukuthi esimweni esifana naleso naye anikeze isaziso esibhaliwe kwisiGaba 13.2 ngenhla, singakapheli isikhathi sale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla), anikeze OWENKONTILEKA ukuthi ufuna ukusivuselela ISIVUMELWANO. Okuqukethwe yile SIVUMELWANO kuyoba futhi iyona ngqokithi yesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokwesiGaba 13.2 ngenhla. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizoziphelela ngokwaso ekupheleni kwesikhathi esilingene (Bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi). Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela engakapheli amaviki amabili uma kubalwa usuku nosuku (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi yosuku olulodwa.

Isahluko sokuqala: Lokhu okwakukhona Kukhona into ethokozisayo ebizwa ngeMinecraft, uKaphelani, ungayithanda. Kuthandwa kakhulu emhlabeni wonke, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Njengoba uyiqala, uzozwa ukuthi kumayelana nokuveza ubuhlakani bakho. Unemikhiqizo ethile, uhamba ngezinyathelo, ungena emhlabeni ogcwele amathuba. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi uzokwazi ukwakha izinto ezahlukene? Kubukeka kujabulisa, akunjalo? Isahluko sesibili: Umhlaba Obalulekile Uhlelo lube namaworlds amaningi, futhi lawa maworlds akhiwa ngezinto ezahlukene. Kuqhamuka nezindawo ezihlukene, imvelo ehlukile, namathafa ahluke kakhulu — ungakha izindlu, ungashintsha izimo, noma uhambe kubantu, yoshaya izinto eziningi. Kukhona nezinyoni ezibhakabhakayo, izilwane ezihamba phansi, kanye neziqhamo eziningi. Ugeza ngemuva, uyazi? Iziphumo zabantu, izinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu – ngempela, ungakwazi ukuthola wonke lama-thing. Isahluko sesithathu: Amathuluzi Okusebenza Awudingi ukuba yinsizwa yokwakha ukuze ube neMinecraft. Njengoba uqala, uzothola amathuluzi amaningi ongawasebenzisa ukuze uthole izinto. Kulula ukuhlanganisa izinto ezahlukahlukene ukuze udale ukukhanya, amatshe, noma imithi. Uthola izinkanyezi, ugcina ukukhanya. Ngakho, ungafaka phakathi kokudoba, udinga futhi ukwakha izinto ezikhuluma. Lokhu kuhle, akunjalo? Isahluko sesine: Ukuhlola nokusebenza Ngaphezu kokwakha, uMinecraft uyindlela yokuhlola. Njengoba uhamba, uzothola izinto ezidingekayo zokwakha, izinsiza zezinto. Kukhona amaphuzu amahle kakhulu abakhetha futhi, ukuze uqinisekise. Kulungile ukukwenza, ngenkathi uqhubeka.

Ingxenye yabantu bakulelizwe ababambe iqhaza kwezemidlalo zokuncintisana balinganiselwa engxenyeni yokuyishumi ekhulwini. Inqubeko/insebenziswano yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka inika umhlahlandlela wokunikela ngezidingo ezanele kusukela ezingeni labaholi bezemidlalo emphakathini, kuya kubaphathi bezifundazwe, kuzwelonke nezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe. Ukubhekisisa izidingo zoqeqesho, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zoqeqesho, ukumisa uhlelo oluzolandelwa ekwenzeni lokhu okungenhla. Ezemidlalo nezokungcebeleka zixhumene ngophawu lobuhlobo. abezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika neKhomishani (SASC) iyakwamukela ukuthi ezokungcebeleka zinika okungaphezulu kokubamba iqhaza kwezokuvocavoca nokuqinisa umzimba. Zibambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekuzimbandakanyeni kwezemidlalo. Lokhu kuthathelwa ekuthuthukeni ngokupheleleyo nohlelomgomo lwezemidlalo. Ukunikezwa amathuba ezokungcebeleka kuyisidingo esibalulekile emigomweni yentuthuko yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Ezokuthuthukisa ezokungcebeleka kufanele kuhambisane nezimfuno futhi kusekelwe yizimfuno zomphakathi. Imiphakathi kufanele ifundiswe ukubamba iqhaza kwezokuhlela, ukulandela nokulinganisa imigomo yezokungcebeleka, ukuze kumiswe imigomo ngokubona kwalabo ababambe iqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphakathi kufanele izibophezele futhi ikwazi ukubika ngentuthuko yawo. Ukuzimbandakanya kwezokungcebeleka kuyilungelo.

Waqonda ukuthi ukusebenza ndawonye kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuphumelela emsebenzini. U-Sipho wagcina ethola iziqu zeBachelor of Engineering, okuyinto eyamnika amandla okuba uMholi weQembu. Waqala ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwakhe ukuze athuthukise izinqubo zokusebenza, aqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi zihlala ziphephile, futhi ziyaqonda imithetho nemigomo yokusebenza. Ngaleso sikhathi, waba umholi ophumelelayo, owaziwa ngokukhuthaza abanye, futhi ethuthukisa izinga lempilo yezisebenzi. Ukwazi kwakhe ngemigomo yokusebenza kwaholela ekutheni abamba iqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yokuphucula izimo zokusebenza. Waqala imikhankaso yokuphucula impilo yezisebenzi, efaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izifundo zokuphepha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. U-Sipho wayehlonishwa kakhulu ezindaweni zokusebenza, futhi abantu babemfuna ukuze babonise izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuba uMphakathi Wokusebenza, lapho ahola khona imihlangano yokuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nezikhungo zempilo. Waba yisikhumbuzo sokubambisana, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule izinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo. U-Sipho waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, owawuhlonipha izisebenzi, futhi wathuthukisa izinga lempilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola izikhumbuzo eziningi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe oncomekayo. Waba ngumholi ohlonishwayo, futhi abantu bamsiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yezisebenzi. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kulesi sikhungo, ethuthukisa izindlela zokusebenza, futhi eqinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi zihlala ziphephile.

Kungenzeka ukuba unakile ukuthi kukhona oguliswa wukuhogela isisi esikhalisa unyembezi? Ukuphekwa ngemibuzo kanye nokufa kukaThemba Johannes Mabotha. Sazi kahle sonke ukuthi awunaso isikhathi kanti sihlele ukusiza. Izimoto ezimbili okucatshangwa ukuthi zebiwe zabanjwa kanti abantu ababili abangaziwa baboshwa. Isikole sokuqeqesha izinja se-SAPS siziqhenya ngendawo yokuzandisa esibizwa nge-Roodeplaat Breeding Centre enesibopho sokuzizalanisa nokuzifundisa. Ingabe le ndaba izobekwa kubakhiqizi? Kuzo zonke izindaba, kukhona abahle nabangafaneleki - kodwa kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi wokudla ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ukudla kubantu ungumuntu ongafaneleki ekugcineni. Bayahlukunyezwa uma kungekho ukudla, bayahlukunyezwa uma ukudla kungekho okukhona noma izinga lokudla lingahlangabezani nezindinganiso zabo. Uma sibheka indlela, umsebenzi noma uhlelo lokubeka ukudla etafuleni kubantu benhlangano, sizobona ukuthi kunabantu abaningi abenza lo msebenzi futhi sizobona ukuthi kuwumsebenzi odinga isikhathi esiningi. Ingxenye yezinto kufanele ilandele. Kumele bakwazi ukufakwa kahle futhi bathuthwe kahle. Kufanele kudalwe umanyolo ukusiza izitshalo zikhule kahle. Umuthi wezitshalo, izibulali-zinambuzane, kanye nokulawulwa kwezifo kufanele kutholakale ngendlela evikela izitshalo ukuze zime kahle. Futhi konke lokhu kunikezelwa ezinkampanini zokulima. Futhi bathenga izinkwa zokudla. Futhi bathutha umkhiqizo baye ezitolo. Futhi bathengisa umkhiqizo kubakhiqizi (noma ezimakethe zangaphandle). Futhi bapakisha ukudla ngaphambi kokukuletha kubathengisi abakhulu. Bathengisa ukudla okwakhiwe kubathengisi abancane. Bathengisa ukudla kubathengi. Le ncazelo ayichazi kahle zonke izinyathelo ezenzakalayo ngoba izinhlobo zokudla zihluka. Isibonelo: ngemuva kokugaya ummbila, kufanele uphume (uphake) ngaphambi kokuthengiswa, uma ukudla kuyinkwa esetshenziselwa ukuvusa utshwala, kufanele kube nomsebenzi wokuqala ngaphambi kokuthengiswa. Kulomsebenzi wonke, kukhona abantu abaningi nemisebenzi eminingi eyakha uhlelo lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ngamunye wabo ufanele ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nezinkampani zabo.

Impahla lapho umnikazi ehlala khona iyimpahla umnikazi ayihlala kuyo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Isikole esingekho phansi kwemali siyi-sikole esizimele noma esingekho kuhulumeni esibhalisa abafundi kusukela ezingeni le-0 kuya kwele-12 esingatholi uxhaso olukhulu kuhulumeni. Izinga liyintela ethathwa yiMuniisipali emhlabeni, njengoba kulindelekile esigabeni 229 (a) soMthethosisekelo. Ngaphezu kwabantu abachazwe kuMthetho, "umnikazi" ubhekisela kumuntu ongena ohlelweni lokubambisana, ngaphandle kokuhlala okune-garage, indawo yokupaka, indawo yokuhlala eyenzelwe abantu abadala enezidingo zokuhlala, noma indawo yokugcina, enenhloso yayo, ibhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla kuphela ngokwezinsika 7.3 lapha; b umnikazi wezimpahla ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ubhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla kuphela ngokwezinsika 7.2 no-7. Indlu yokuhlala iyindlu eyingxenye yempahla yokuhlala esetshenziselwa ukuhlala abantu, noma izindlu eziningi ezifana nalokhu endaweni lapha akukhulumi ngendawo lapho okungaphezu kokuthathu kwabelwana ngayo okuthile ngaphandle kokuhlala, noma ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, B&B, indlu yokwamukela izivakashi, noma efana naleyo eqashiswa nsuku zonke. Impahla ekhokha izintela ezikhethekile iyindawo eyenzelwe lapho abanikazi bezimpahla ngaphakathi kwayo bevuma ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo ezengeziwe ezingaphezu kwalokho okunikezwa yiMuniisipali. Lokhu kukhokha kwenziwa ngokwengeza enye imali ezinteleni ezikhokhiswa kumakhadi abanikazi bezimpahla kule ndawo.

Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingafunda ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nokwandisa isimo sokuphila kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zidinga ukuhunyushwa ngenhlonipho kumasiko, izinkolelo, kanye nezifiso zabantu bendawo. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqhuba ucwaningo olujulile ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezifiso nemigomo yomphakathi. Uhlelo oluhambisana nemigomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya lukhombisa ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba babambe iqhaza ezingxoxweni ezithinta izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kudinga ukuqhubeka nokugqugquzela izinguquko ezizwakalayo. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlobene, kanye nokuhlola imiphumela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi izinqubomgomo zithinta kanjani abantu, kanye nokuthi zidinga yini ukuhunyushwa kabusha ukuze zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngakho, ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya akusikho nje kuphela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza, kodwa kuyinqubo ebanzi edinga ubuhlakani, ubumbano, kanye nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwazo zonke izingxenye zomphakathi. Ngaleyondlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela izindawo zasemakhaya, sinikeze abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi sikhulise umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izindawo ezithokozisayo, ezihloniphekayo, nezikhula ngokwezimali, ezilungele ikusasa.

Kubahlali, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ayigcini nje ngokuvikela izinsizakalo, kodwa iphinde ibaluleke ekwakheni umqondo wokuziphatha phakathi kwabantu. Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo ngendlela engafanele kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okuhle nokuhlonipha imithetho. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, imikhawulo kufanele ifundiswe kubasebenzisi, ukuze baqonde kahle izinzuzo nezingozi zokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi i-GEMS idlala indima ebalulekile ekuphatheni lezi zinsizakalo. Ukuze lezi zinsizakalo zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola, izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisa ukuqonda kwabantu. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuvikela izinsizakalo zempilo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo, ngale ndlela sithuthukisa izinga lempilo kubantu bonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzisi be-GEMS baqonde imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zempilo, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile futhi ezivumelekile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, oqinile, nolwazi, futhi okwazi ukuvikela izinsizakalo zempilo kubo bonke abasebenzisi.

Izikhukhula eKwaZulu-Natal: Isikhumbuzo Sokuhlupheka Nokuphila Izikhukhula eKZN zibe yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini eminingi. Lokhu kuthinta imvelo kwenza kube nezindaba ezinzima nezivuselelayo. Kukhona ubuhlungu, uthando, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho, ngathatha isikhathi sokubhala lokhu ukuze ngiqonde ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje kuphela njengezingozi, kodwa zikhombisa nezinselele esibhekene nazo. Zenzeka ngezinsuku ezinzima, lapho imvula ingena emanzini, ikha amanzi amaningi ezindaweni eziphakeme. Okwesabekayo ngalesi sikhathi yindlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Abangane, odadewabo, nabangani bahlala bekhathazekile, befuna indawo ephephile. Izinga lokuhlupheka lishintsha kalula, kanti abanye bahlala benqena ukuvuka kulokho okubanjwe yimvula. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje izinyembezi, kodwa zikhumbuza ukuthi ukuphila kuncike kumoya wethu wokuqhubeka. Njengoba abantu besinda ezikhukhuleni, bahlangana, benza izinhlelo zokwakha kabusha. Izikhukhula ziveza umfanekiso onzima, kodwa zikhuthaza ubumbano. Lokhu kubumbene kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuvuma, besebenzisana ukuze bakhe imiphakathi eqinile. Ngibona ukuthi iminyaka yokuphila ebusuku ibonakala empilweni yabantu. Abahlali bahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile, kanti abanye bahlala benethemba lokubona usuku olukhazimulayo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi, kodwa umoya wethu uyasiza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo iyinsika yokusebenza, futhi abantu baphakathi kokuphila. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima, siphinde sihlole izindlela esizisebenzisayo. Siphakamisela ukunakekela imvelo.
