Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zingase zingatholakali uma zisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemigomo ethile, okungaholela ezinkingeni zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imikhawulo ibalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lempilo kubasebenzisi. I-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukungena ezinsizakalweni zempilo ngaphandle kokuhlonza izidingo zomsebenzisi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, okungaholela ekutheni izinsizakalo zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibalulekile ekugcineni ukwethembeka kwenhlangano. Uma izinsizakalo zisetshenziswa ngendlela engafanele, lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zokuphatha, okungase kubangele ukungathembeki phakathi kwe-GEMS nabasebenzisi bayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhawulo iyagcinwa, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zihlala zisebenza. Kubahlali, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ayigcini nje ngokuvikela izinsizakalo, kodwa iphinde ibaluleke ekwakheni umqondo wokuziphatha phakathi kwabantu. Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo ngendlela engafanele kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okuhle nokuhlonipha imithetho. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, imikhawulo kufanele ifundiswe kubasebenzisi, ukuze baqonde kahle izinzuzo nezingozi zokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zempilo.

Thengaimifino nezithelo okutholakala ngaleyo nkathi yonyaka, njengoba kusuke kushibhile. Ukudla okutholakala ezilw aneni njengenkukhu, inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi noma amaqanda kungase kudliw e nsuku zonke. Nokho, okunye kwalokhu kudla, ikakhulukazi inkukhu, inhlanzi nenyama ngokuvamile kubiza kakhulu. Ukufuya izinkukhu, onogwaja, izimvu, izimbuzi nanoma yiziphi ezinye izilwane ekhaya kungakunika inyama, amaqanda ngisho nobisi. Ungajabulela nokunye ukudla okunamaprotheni njengesibindi, izinso, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, amanqina, usu, inhlanzi esethinini, amasonja (amacimbi), amadumbe namaqanda.. Thenga ubisi loqobo kunokuthenga imifuziselo yobisi, okhilimu bekhofi nekhondensi. Lokhu kuyabiza ngoba mncane kakhulu umsoco otholakala kuzo. Lapho ugula futhi inhliziyo imnyama, yenezela amafushana noma ushukela ekudleni kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba ukudla kunambitheke kangconyw ana futhi kukusize uthole amandla engeziw e ngaphandle kokudla kakhulu. Kujabulele ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile nalondekile - Awabizi futhi anempilo ukw edlula itiye nekhofi. Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile noma alondekile yini, mane uwabilise bese uwapholisa ngaphambi kokuba uwaphuze. Utshwala busaphaza imali futhi bulahlekisela umzimba wakho umsoco. Kunalokho imali yakho yisebenzisele ukuthenga ukudla okunomsoco. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba ukugweme ukuphuza utshwala lapho usebenzisa imithi. Yiba matasa kakhulu ngangokunokwenzeka lapho uzizwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokusiza ekugcineniizicubu zakho ziqinile.

Uma ama-larvae (ama-caterpillar) ethola isikhathi sokukhula, le herbicide ayisasebenzi kahle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola njalo izitshalo zakho ukuze ukhethe isikhathi esifanele sokufaka le herbicide ezosebenza kahle. Kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla okufanele zikhishwe ngesikhathi esithile esifanele. Isibonelo, ngeziqhamo, uma uthola ngaphambi kwesikhathi noma uthatha isikhathi eside ukuhluza, izinga lokudla lizoba phansi. Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi isikhathi esifanele sokuhluza sithi kufanele kuholele umfuyi ukuba acabangele izinto eziningi: umbala wezithombo, izimo zezulu, kanye nezifo ezingase zenzeke. Ngezinye izikhathi, ungathola ukuthi isivuno siba sibi emasimini njengoba sikhula. Uma umfuyi ethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuhluza, lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni ukudla okuningi. Ungaphuthelwa ithuba lokuqoqa zonke izikhukhukazi uma uhluza.

Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwephupho Kwakukhona isikhathi lapho abantu babecabanga ukuthi ukuhamba emkhathini kuyinto engafinyeleleki. Nokho, u-Elon Musk, owayaziwa kakhulu, waphakamisa umbono omusha. Wazalelwa eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa wakhula e-United States, lapho athola khona izifundo ezimfakazela ukuthi umphakathi ungathuthukisa izinkanyezi. Ngemva kokuphumelela kwezinye izinkampani, uMusk wanquma ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokwenza umkhankaso omkhulu: ukuhamba emkhathini. Ngonyaka ka-2002, wasungula iSpaceX, inkampani eyayihlose ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhamba emkhathini. Waqala njengoba inkampani encane, kodwa umgomo wakhe wawukhulu. Wayefuna ukwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuba abantu baphume emhlabeni, baye kwezinye izinkanyezi. Lokhu kwakunzima, kodwa uMusk wayenokholo olukhulu. Isahluko 2: Izithiyo Nezimpumelelo Ngemuva kokwasungulwa, iSpaceX yahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhiqiza izindiza eziphakeme neziphephile kwakuyinselelo enkulu. U-Musk wayazi ukuthi ukuze aphumelele, kwakudingeka abekezelele. Ngemva kokuhluleka okokuqala, lapho iFalcon 1 ingaphumeleli, abanye babebona lokhu njengokuphela. Kodwa uMusk, onobuhlakani obukhulu, wabona lezi zinkinga njengezindlela zokuthuthukisa. Ngemva kokuhluleka okwesithathu, iFalcon 1 ekugcineni yaphumelela. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, futhi kwavula iminyango eminingi. U-Musk waphinde waqinisekisa ukuthi iSpaceX izoba yinkampani yokuqala ezokwazi ukuhamba emkhathini ngaphandle kokuncika ezinkampanini ezinkulu, okwakuyimpumelelo enkulu futhi kwavusa ithemba emhlabeni wonke.

Kuqinisekisa ukufinyeleleka kuyo yonke imiqulu eshicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika. Kungenye yezinsika zolwazi olukhululekile. Kuyirekhodi lazo zonke izishicilelo ezikhiqizwa yizwe. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi elilodwa layo yonke imiqulu eshicilelwe liyalondolozwa bese litholakala ngokubolekwa. Kulondoloza umsebenzi wababhali kanye nabashicileli ukuze usetshenziswe ngabacwaningi besikhathi esizayo. Kwakha isisekelo sokuhlanganisa ndawonye Umlando kaZwelonke weNingizimu Afrika, owazisa abasebenzisi bawo ezweni lonke ngezishicilelo ezikhona ngalokho-ke kuthuthukise ukusatshalaliswa kanye nokuthengiswa kwawo. Inombolo yocingo ongathola kuyo usizo iyatholakala esikhungweni somtapo wezincwadi sikaZwelonke saseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuchazeke kahle izindaba ezithintana nokubekwa okusemthethweni.

Isithunywa esilawulwayo esiletha impahla ukuze ithwalwe ngendiza sixolelwe ekulawulweni noma ekubophezelekeni isimo sezokuphepha ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 108.03. c kuhlolwe amaphepha ayo ukuze kutholakale ukuthi ulwazi kunoma imaphi amaphepha luyiqiniso futhi lwanele d ivikelwe ekuphazamisekeni okungagunyaziwe. a lokuhlola, noma ayalele isithunywa ukuba sihlole impahla eboshelwe noma equkethwe wumthwalo othwelwe ngendiza nokwenza uphenyo ngokuqonda nolwazi nemibhalo efanele ithulwe maqondana nomthwalo; futhi b ngaphandle kokuzibophezela angenqaba, alibazise noma aphindisele emuva impahla uma enezinsolo ezinesisekelo sokuthi impahla ineziqhumane noma izinto eziyingozi. Noma iyiphi into estshenziswa ngumnikazi noma ngosebenzisa indiza noma ogunyaziwe, ukuhlola izimpahla kufanele ikwazi ukunuka izikhali, iziqhumane noma impahla engavunyiwe noma enobungozi njengoba kuchaziwe wuHlelo lwezokuPhepha lweZithuthi Zomoya lukaZwelonke ka 2004, ezingasetshenziswa ezenzweni ezingekho emthethweni. Lezi zinto kufanele zihambisane nezidingo ezimiswe wuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Into okukhulunywa ngayo ngumthethonkambiso 1 iyogcinwa ngendlela emiswe umkhiqizo wawo futhi uhambisane nezinye izidingo ezingakhishwa ngaphansi koMthetho. b siphelezelwe imifanekiso yamabhukwana eNqubo yezokuPhepja kwempahla ezindizeni okukhulunywa ngayo kumthethonkambiso 108.01.025; futhi c siphelezelwe yimali efanele noma inkokhelo enqunywe yiNgxenye 187 yalo mthethonkambiso.

Lo mbhalo uhlose abantu abafaka izicelo zokuhlala okuphakade abangakwazi ukuthola ipasipoti ezweni labo, noma abangenamhlaba noma ababaleki abafuna ukufuduka. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma emsebenzini uma uphOutside kwezwe. Nikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ungum resident ophakade lapho ufaka izicelo. Izingcwephe zakho azizothathwa ukuze zirekhodwe kwi-register yokuhlala kwabantu kazwelonke. Futhi thumela nezithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-pasipoti. Le sevisi ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-6 ukuze iphumelele.

Siyakwemukela ukuthi abanye abantu besithathu bazixhumanise nolwazi olufakelwe kulama khasi. Lokhu kungasiza ngokuxhumanisa kwamanye ama-website njengento nje ewusizo , kanti noma yikuphi ukuxhunyaniswa akusho ukuthi abe-GCIS bavumelana nalawo ma-website. Ama-website axhumanisiwe noma amakhasi awekho ngaphansi kolawulo lwe-GCIS. Abe-GCIS abanawo umsebenzi emahlombe abo noma ukuba necala ngokuqonde ngqo noma ngokungaqondile ngqo nanganoma yiyiphi indlela maqondana nokuqukethwe, ukusetshenziswa noma ukungakwazi ukusetshenziswa noma ukufinyelela noma yiwaphi ama-website axhunyanisiwe , nonoma yiyiphi imixhumaniso atholakala kuma-website axhunyanisiwe (linked websites). Isitatimende semfihlo sisebenza kwabe-GCIS kanye nakunoma yiyiphi inhlangano ebhalise ngokomthetho elawula, eqinisekisa noma esebenzisa ulwazi olungaqokelelwa ngokusebenzisa le-website. Ngisho noma abe-GCIS benganikeza ulwazi lwabasebenzisi kwabanikeza ngezinkonzo abasebenza ngowlazi egameni labo, ngeke banikeza abantu besithathu ulwazi, noma eminye imikhakha kahulumeni ukuze ilusebenzisele ezinye izinhloso noma izinhloso ezingaqondene, ngaphandle kokuba lokho kuye kwadalulwa ngesikhathi sokuxhumana. Ulwazi lomuntu siqu lungadluliselwa kumikhakha yamazwe omhlaba ngabe-GCIS noma kubantu besithathu ngezinhloso ezingenhla. Lokhu ngeke kwabandakanya ukudluliseka kumazwe angenayo imitheshwana yolawulo lokuvikelwa kolwazi efana naleyo ekhona kuzwe okuhlala kulo umsebenzisi. Ngokunikeza ulwazi kwabe-GCIS ngale website, umsebenzisi uvumela ukudluliselwa kwalolo lwazi.

Kaningi amaphrogramu abheka phansi kulabo abafuna usizo enza ukuthi labo balimi bajwayele ukuthola usizo, abasakwazi ukuzisiza bona. Lapho siqonda ukuthi umuntu oyedwa uphethe ikusasa lakhe ezandleni zakhe, sizoqonda futhi akusizi ukunikeza umuntu inhlanzi njalonjalo ngoba akungumthuthukisi, akumfundisi ukuzibambela izinhlanzi. Ukuthuthukisa ngokuqhubekisa kunikeza abantu amandla ukuzisebenzela. Ukudla okunikezwa nje kwenza ukuthi abantu bahlale phansi bamukele kuphela, abakhuli ngokwabo, abafundi ukuzisebenzela. Emzini wonke kukhona abantu abaphatha umhlaba ngendlela engafanelekile bese abantu abampofu baydliwa. Kukhona izinto ezahlukene zezomnotho ezidala ubumpofu, abantu abanemali elondoloziwe, abakwazi ukuboleka, abekho abazisebenzelayo, ukusweleka kwezindawo zokubeka ukudla, ukusweleka kwamathulusi nemishini, i-inflation, ukumaketha, intengiso ephansi, ukusweleka kwentilansipoti, ukuxhumana nokukhuphuka nokwehla kwentengiso. Kukhona amaphrovinsi amanye ayisithombe sobumpofu lapha ezweni lethu. Abantu bayaphumelela, kodwa bayaqhubeka ukubampofu, nokho kukhona izingcebo zezemvelo ezingasetshenziswa. Izindawo ezinkulu zinomhlabathi ojulile, ononile, kukhona ukushisa okwanele, imvula ekwanele ukutshala ukudla okuzinhlamvu nezikawoyela. Ubumpofu kuletha ukwesaba ukulimazeka ngokudla ekhaya. Abantu bayesaba ukushintsha ngoba bayazama nje ukuphumelela. Ukwesweleka kwe-infrastructure - kakhulukazi imigwaqo, amasayilo nezindawo zokomisa ukudla okuzinhlamvu. Ukusweleka kwemishini ezokulimeni - ogandaganda, amaskofela, amapulantela, imishini yokufafaza, imishini yokuvuna, njll.

Ngalesi sikhathi, ibhizinisi le-entrepreneurship laqala ukuthandwa, lapho abantu abasha bezama ukudala imisebenzi yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zinguquko zaziholela ekubeni intsha iqale ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi eyahlukene. Ubumqoka babuhamba phambili, futhi abantu abasha baqala ukuzithokozisa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, bakha amabhizinisi amancane ahamba phambili. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi intsha ingakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo, uma ibhentsha izinsiza ezikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi yaqala ukubona impumelelo. Abantu abasha baqala ukuthola imisebenzi, besebenzisa amakhono abawafundile. Lokhu kwaba yiphupho eliphumelela empilweni yabo, kwadalela umqondo wokuthi intsha ingaba yinsika yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Noma kunjalo, izinselelo zasuwa, kodwa intsha yahlala iqhubeka nokulwela amalungelo ayo, iqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokumangalisayo, ukungasebenzi kwentsha akukaze kube yinkinga eyodwa kuphela. Kuveza ubuhle bokubambisana, ubuhlakani, nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu abasha. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, intsha ibonisa ukuthi inamandla okushintsha umphakathi, nokuqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezikhuluma ngempumelelo nempilo engcono. Namuhla, inkinga yokungasebenzi kwentsha isaxazululeka, kodwa kumele siqhubeke sisekela izinhlelo ezihlinzekayo. Imizamo yokukhuthaza abantu abasha ibalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukudala ikusasa eliqhakazile, elikhanyayo, neliphelele. Uhlelo lokusebenza kwabantu abasha alupheli, kodwa luhlala lukhula, lukhula, futhi luthuthuka. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi intsha ifuna ukwaziwa, ifuna ukusebenza, futhi ifuna ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono.

2.3 Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umsebenzi Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umsebenzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, zikhuthaza ukukhula komkhakha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olufanele lokuphatha izingcingo, okwandisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Izinyathelo Zokukhula Komkhakha 3.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Izinkampani kufanele zihlale zihlola ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ukusebenzisa ama-bots ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo kubasebenzi, nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlaziya ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. 3.2 Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala befundiswa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, izinqubo ezintsha, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abasebenzi bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni ezihlukahlukene. 3.3 Ukuphathwa Kwekhwalithi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakhasimende athola insizakalo engcono, izinkampani kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuphatha ikhwalithi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuphendula, isikhathi sokulinda, kanye nezinga lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Izinzuzo Zokukhula Komkhakha 4.1 Ukudala Imisebenzi Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre kuholela ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, lapho bezama ukunciphisa izinga lokungasebenzi. 4.2 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimali Umkhakha wama-call centre ungumthombo omkhulu wezindleko. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba izinkampani zikhula futhi zikhulisa imisebenzi yazo.

Lapho izimbewu nomanyolo akuphumi ngokufanele, hlola izakhi ezifanele zihambe ufune ukuthi ikuphi inkinga. Bheka ukuthi akhona na amanye amapuleti (lapho lisebenzisa amapuleti). Ngaphambi kokubophela umshini kugandaganda, hlola ileveli likawoyela ephampini. Bophela isifafazo kuPTO. Sihambise bese uhlola ukuthi onke amanozili ayasebenza. Uma kukhona inkinga, bheka ukuthi ikuphi - kungaba iphampu, ifiltiri noma amanozili. Lapho umshini awusebenzi kahle, uzokwazi ukuwulungisa noma qha? Hlola umzimba - ugobekile noma ufoklozile (Bheka izindawo lapho ushiselwe khona)? Hlola onke amabhawoti nezinye izindawo zokubopha. Hlola izakhi ezingena emhlabathini - kudingeka ezinsha? Hlola amaphayipi namaphampu - kusebenza kahle futhi ziyavuza na? Hlola amasondo - bheka isicindezelo somoya. Hlola amabheringi - anegrisi futhi ahamba kahle na? Qinisa ukuthi ukuhlola kwakho kogandaganda nemishini ukwenze kahle, qinisa futhi imishini izokwazi ukusebenza kalula endaweni yakho - akusizi ukuthola umshini omncane bese wena ufuna ukulima amasimu amaningi. Kungcono ukuthola inzuzo endaweni encane nokulahlekelwa imali endaweni enkulu. Sebenzisa amasimu asemandleni akho kuphela.

Imfashini Nobuhle: Ukuhlola Izitayela Nezindlela Zokwakha Isithombe Emhlabeni wethu, imfashini nobuhle zihlala zibalulekile, zidalela abantu ithuba lokwakha isithombe esihle, ukukhombisa ubuhle baphakathi kwethu, nokuvula indlela yokubonisa ubunikazi bethu. Namuhla, sizobheka izitayela ezisematheni, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuhle bethu, sikhangela lesi sikhathi esiguqukayo. Izitayela Zamanje: Umthelela Wezokuxhumana Izitayela zemfashini zihlala zishintsha, lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi ezifana nezinkanyezi, izinkulumo zomphakathi, nezinkampani ezinkulu ezithuthukisa imikhiqizo yazo. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhula, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba balandele izitayela ezithile. Uhlobo lwemfashini olukhona luhlanganisa izitayela ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-urban, i-bohemian, kanye ne-classic chic. Izinkampani ezifana neZara, H&M, kanye ne-Nike zisebenzisa izinkanyezi ezidumile ukuze zikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphile kahle nezinye izitayela. Izinkundla zokuxhumana, njenge-Instagram, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngezithombe, okwandisa ukufinyelela ezitayeleni ezahlukene. Ubuhle Obungokwemvelo: Izithako Zokwakha Isithombe Ngaphandle kwemfashini, ubuhle bukhombisa indlela esizithanda ngayo, futhi kudinga izithako ezikhethekile. Ukuze sibe nobuhle, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo efanele isikhumba sethu. Izinkampani zikhuthaza imikhiqizo yokunakekela isikhumba enezithako ezisemvelweni, njengezihlahla namafutha, okukhuthaza ubuhle bethu futhi kuhlonipha imvelo.

Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngobuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ukuze le nqubo isebenze kahle, abaqashi kufanele baqonde izidingo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuvulekile, lapho abasebenzi bezwakalisa khona izinkinga zabo, kanti abaphathi benza konke okusemandleni ukusiza. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okuzoholela ekwanelisekeni okuphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi kudinga ukucabangela izimo zomphakathi. Abasebenzi abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bangase babe nezidingo ezihlukile, futhi abaphathi kufanele bahlale beqaphele lezi zimo. Ukuze kube nokuhlanganiswa okuhle, abaqashi kufanele bazi ukuhluka kwezidingo zomphakathi, futhi baphendule ngale ndlela. Ngokuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi, sithola ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa kudala umnotho onempilo. Uma abasebenzi bezizwa beqinisekisiwe futhi bekwazi ukuthola izinsiza abazidingayo, bazoba nekhono elikhulu lokusebenza kahle, okuzoholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza. Kodwa, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi akusikho okwenziwa kalula. Kuningi okudingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nqubo iyaphumelela, okudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nokuqonda izimo zomphakathi. Uma lezi zinto ziqinile, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bethu. Ekugcineni, ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi ku-GEMS akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo.

Ishadi lokufunda liyidokhumenti elinika abantu abangaphandle amalungelo okwenza izifundo ezikhululiwe ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo sakho emahhovisi e-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma eMishini. Qedela isicelo ku-form BI-159. Isitifiketi sokuhlola kwezepolitiki esiqinisekisa ukuthi ummangali akanacala lobugebengu ezweni abahlala kulo isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Incwadi kadokotela njengobufakazi bokuthi ummangali uphilile kahle. Abammangali ngeke bakwazi ukungena eNingizimu Afrika kuze kube izicelo zabo zamukelwe. Abammangali abamukelwe bazonikezwa i-visa evumela ukuba bangene futhi baphume ezweni nge-visa yokungena kabusha kaningi. Abancane kufanele banikeze imininingwane yomuntu ongumZulu waseNingizimu Afrika ozoba ngumgibeli. Le mininingwane kumele ihambisane nencwadi yokuvuma, ubufakazi bokuhlala obukhona bobabili abazali, noma kubazali abanye kuphela ongumgibeli, kanye nobufakazi bokuthi ungumgibeli kuphela.

Ukuze kulandwe empumelelweni, izikhungo zezempilo zidinga ukuxhumanisa imisebenzi yazo nemiphakathi, ngokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhuba imiphumela emihle, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukufinyelela olwazini oluthile nokwelashwa okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesoftware nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezinamathuba okubhekana nezinsiza zokwelapha kudinga ukuhlanganyela okunomsoco emazingeni ahlukeneyo, kuhlanganise noHulumeni, ozimele, nabantu basekhaya. Ukuze uHulumeni ube nempumelelo yalesi sifo, kudinga ukuba kube kudalwe isikhala sokusebenzisana phakathi kwazo zonke izinhlangano ezibhekelele ezempilo. Okwesibili, kudinga imithombo eyengeziwe yokuxhasa abantu abane-TB, okubandakanya imithombo yezezimali yokwenza ucwaningo olujulile. Lokhu kulungisa imithombo ethize yokwenziwa kocwaningo lokwelapha kombuso, okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlela ezintsha neziphumelelayo zokwelapha ziyaqhubeka nokutholakala. Ucwaningo oluqinile luphethe amathuba amasha okuthola imithi emisha yokwelapha, okuyinto ethokozisayo ehlinzeka udaba lwempumelelo kumqondisi. Ekugcineni, ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, nezinhlaka eziphezulu zibalulekile ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zibe nomphumela omuhle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abanye abafundi, abafana nabangamaTBB, baxhaswa, kuhlinzeka umqondo wokuthi umphakathi ungalwa kanjani ne-TB ngokuhlanganyela. Yingakho ukubambisana phakathi kwezinsiza, izinsiza zemibono, kanye nezinhlelo ezisemthethweni zibalulekile ekulweni nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal.

Ukuthuthukisa amakhono ahlukene okukhumbula nokuqondisisa njengokukwazi ukuqaphelisisa imisindo yolimi. Ulwazi lokuhlanganisa (ukuhlanganisa izinhlamvu ezimbili noma ezintathu ukwenza umsindo). Ukuhlanganisa Imiphumela yesifundo. Imiphumela yesifundo kumele ibonakale isebenzisana ekuthuthukiseni ulimi lwabafundi. Ekuqaleni kwemithetho yokulinganisa ukuhlola, kunezibonelo zeziqephu ezinikiwe (ezethulwa ngomlomo, ezibhaliwe/ezibukwayo, nezinsiza-kuxhumana ezinhlobonhlobo) ezisiza abafundi nothisha ukwenza lolu hlobo lokuhlanganisa. Khumbula: abafundi ngeke balindeleke ukukhuluma ulimi abangakaze baluzwe, noma ukubhala nokukhipha iziqephu abangakaze bazifunde noma bazibone. Umfundi uyakwazi ukulalela ukuze athole ulwazi nokuzijabulisa, aphendule ngendlela efanele nangokuhlolisisa ezimweni eziningi ezahlukehlukene. Amakhono okulalela abafundi abafika esikoleni benawo kumele athuthukiswe asetshenziswe ukwandisa amakhono abo okukhuluma, ukufunda, ukubuka nokubhala. Ukulalela ngokunanela ikona okubalulekile ekufundeni nasekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye abantu. Abafundi bangalalela ukwandisa ulwazi lolimi namasiko abo kanye nolwezinye izilimi. Umfundi uyakwazi ukuxhumana nabanye ngokuzethemba nangendlela ezwakalayo nefanele ezimweni eziningi ezahlukahlukene. Abafundi kumele bakwazi ukusebenzisa amakhono abo okuxoxisana ngokuzwakalayo benanele amasiko nezilimi zezinye izizwe Ulwazi abanalo kumele lubafundise ukuthi ulwazi lwezilimi eziningi luyakhulisa futhi lwenza abantu bahlalisane kahle. Kumele bafunde izindlela zokuxhumana nabantu abakhubazekile ekukhulu-meni nasekuzweni, bazikhathalele nezidingo zabo.

Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okuhlelelekile KwezeMidlalo Ekhaya elibizwa ngokuthi uZiyanda, kwabusa inhloso yokwakha izikhungo ezizokwenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono. Leli dolobha laliphila ngophondo lwezokwakha, kodwa abanye babebheka kwezokugembula, kwezokudlala, nokwabelana ngempilo. UJohn, umongameli wendawo, wayezwa ukukhathazeka mayelana nezikhungo ezikhona. “Sidinga izikhungo zomphakathi ezilungiselelwe kahle, ezifanele bonke abantu,” wayekhuluma nabanye abaholi bendawo ngenkathi behlangana emhlanganweni. Ngolunye usuku, uJohn wahlangana noThandi, umqashi onokubona okukhulu. “Ngihuguza injabulo yokwakha izikhungo, kodwa kufanele sikwazi ukusiphatha kahle. Kumele sizame ukufaka izici zokwakha ezizokwenza abantu babe nentshisekelo, hhayi izikhungo ezivamile ezixhaphakile,” kusho uThandi, ephakamisa amehlo akhe ehlakaniphele. Bangena ejimini encane lapho besebenza khona. Bafuna ukuphakamisa imicabango, bachitha isikhathi bephosa iziphakamiso. UThandi wancome uZiyanda ngokwakha isikhungo esisha senkonzo, nesigubungela izidingo zezingane, abantu abadala, nabampofu. “Sizogxila ezikhungweni zokudlulisa imicabango nokuqonda, ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi,” wajabula uJohn. Baye balungiselela uhlelo lokwakha olwanemibono eminingi. Njengoba lithemba elenzeka, umphakathi wawudibene nabantu abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abacabangi, abadayisi, nochwepheshe kwezempilo, ukuze kunikezwe izindawo ezihlukahlukene ezizokwenziwa izikhungo ezithuthukile. Kwakufanele wonke umuntu avume, ngakho baqhuba izinkulumo ezijule mayelana nezidingo zabantu.

Ezinye izindaba ezehlukene mayelana namaphoyisa bekhipha imithombo nezindawo ezinezinkinga kwakhulunywa ngazo kwiwekshophu. Uma umbambiqhaza ehoxa ohlelweni lwemiklomelo, angabuyela khona uma lokho kuhambisana nemithetho ebekiwe. Thina, njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrikha, ikakhulukazi sinesibopho sokukhombisa samandla aphikisayo kwenye indawo atkhomba ukuphilisana kwethu emphakathini, emnothweni, nesizwe esisodwa. Maduzane ukuzihlola nethuluzi lokuhlola amabhuku ezimali lathunyelwa ezikoleni zonke - ukuze bahlole izakhiwo kanye nezinhlelo. Okufakiwe wukuphathwa kwezindlu, ukukhandwa kanye nokushintshwa ezindizeni noma ezinjinini zezindiza. Ngiyakuthokozela ukuba phakathi kwabantu abangabacubunguli, abangabathuthukisi, kanye nezithunywa ezikhethekile kanye nabaqhamuka kulo lonke izwekazi kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele. I-Hake ivamise ukuyiswa e-Europe lapho i-Spain siyimakethe enkulu, kodwa i-France, i-Germany, i-Italy kanye ne-Portugal nabo bathola izamba ezinkulu. Amabhajethi akhethekile ayokhishwa, uma kunesidingo, ukuze ahlangabezane nemali engaphezulu kwebibekiwe esetshenzisiwe omphakathi. Ukungabi namithetho elawulayo kwemisebenzi eyenziwa abasebenzi bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrikha kubhekwa kuphelwa wuhulumeni uma kunokuvumelana. Umbiko wokugcina ngezinkomba zokusbenza kwendawo okuhlongoziwe. Enye yezindawo esizicwaningayo kanti sethemba ukuthi kuzoba nokulalelwa kwecala mayelana namajele nokugxotshwa kwamalungelo abantu okwenzeke ngaphakathi emajele. Isisekelo sokusebenza kwakho wuhlelo lukahulumeni nge-Austrian Development Policy, eqhubeka nokulungiswa wuNgqongqoshe weZindaba zangaphandle.

Ngokusebenza nezinhloso ezithile, izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zikhumbula izidingo zabathengi, futhi zithuthukise umkhiqizo wazo ukuze ufinyelele ezimfanelweni ezithile. Isiphetho Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu, ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwakha, ukuthuthukisa, nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezintsha. Ukuqonda indlela lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngayo, kusiza abantu ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi imikhiqizo yazo ingaba kanjani usizo empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, ukuqonda izinkampani zobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinhle kubuchwepheshe obusha nokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa impilo yethu.

Lokhu kuvame ukuhamba ngesikhatsi sokuphuma kokuphila, lapho umama ethola izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze akhululeke ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Indlu yesikhumbuzo isetshenziswa ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula kothile ukugibela izinyathelo ezibalulekile. Ikakhulukazi, umama uzokhumbuza ezokuphila njengoba lezi zinyathelo ziphuma khona. Ngokuphathelene nezinyathelo ezibandakanyekayo, uma umama esefikile esibhedlela ngemva kokuba isikhumbuzo sikhishwe, Umdalayo uthola izinsiza ezithile ezifana nezinxushunxushu, izinsiza zokuhlinzwa, nemishini ethile yokubona impilo. Umdalayo uzophinde ahlolisise ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, ezakhiweni, nokuxhumana. Kunezindlela ezimbili ezinkulu zokubeletha ezibhedlela: ukubeletha ngemuva kokuphila kwezamathumba, kanye nokubeletha kweziguli ngokuhlinzwa. Ukubeletha ngemuva kokuphila kwezamathumba kuhlanganisa izindlela zokuhlinza ezinjengokukhupha izinsana eziboshwa emakwevini. Lokhu kuyindlela evamile emakhosini hebe kayiphumeleli, kanti ihlinzeka ngemiphumela emihle uma umama enganeliseki. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukukhethwa kokubeletha kweziguli ngokuhlinzwa kuvame ukuba yisinqumo esithathwe ngabeziqu ezininzi, ikakhulukazi uma umama ebambe izinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kuvumela abafundi ukuba baveze ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba wenziwe ngempahla ehlukahlukene, futhi ukuthi isizathu sokuxazulula izinkinga asikwazi ukuhlukaniswa. Bakwazi ukuzama izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda ngempumelelo. Bangaqhuba njengamalungu aphumelelayo emiphakathini abahlala kuyo, kokubili endaweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Isomiso: Umthelela Waso Emiphakathini Nasemvelweni Isomiso, okuyisimo sokungabi namanzi, sithinta izindawo eziningi emhlabeni jikelele, futhi siba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ezilwaneni, kanye nasemvelweni. Le nkinga ibangelwa izizathu ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukungaphumeleli kwezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, kanye nokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wesomiso, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nalesi simo. Izizathu Zesomiso Isizathu esiyinhloko sokwanda kwesomiso sitholakala ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu, okukhuluma ngakho izazi zezulu. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokushisa, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi izindawo ezithile zibe namanzi anele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi namvula okuphindaphindiwe kubangela ukuthi izindawo ezithile zibe nezimo ezinzima zokukhulisa izitshalo, okukhuthaza isomiso. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ukuphathwa okungafanele kwezinsiza zamanzi, njengokungasebenzisi kahle amanzi emasimini, nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi eziphumelelayo zidinga ukucabangela izidingo zomphakathi, izimo zemvelo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Uma lezi zinto zingahlangani kahle, umphakathi uthola ubunzima bokuphila, okukhuthaza isimo sokungabi namanzi. Umthelela Wesomiso Emiphakathini Isomiso sithinta kakhulu imiphakathi yasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi lezo ezincike kakhulu ekulimaleni nasekukhuleni kwezolimo. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imindeni ikwazi ukuziphilisa.

Thola i-receipt futhi uyigcine njengobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo. Uzokwaziswa ngeposi ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanseliwe, ihhovisi lezokuphepha kwezenhlalakahle izokubhalela incwadi echaza izizathu zokukhansela isicelo sakho. Uma ungavumelani nesinqumo sabo, ungafaka isikhalazo kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezokuhlala noma ilungu lekhansela echaza ukuthi kungani ungavumelani nesinqumo sabo. Isikhalazo kufanele sithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 ngemuva kokuthola impendulo yesicelo sakho. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-21 ukuze processing yesicelo sakho. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uzokhokhelwa kusukela ngosuku olufake isicelo. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhelwa.

Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Impilo, Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Kumhlaba wamanje Abathengisi basemgwaqeni badlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhulayo. Nakuba bejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, bavame ukufaka phakathi izinkinga ezihlobene nezezimali, imicimbi, kanye nokwaneliseka kwabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bathinta kanjani umphakathi nempilo yabantu, futhi kufanele sihlaziye izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nabo. Okokuqala, abathengisi basemgwaqeni banikela ngezinsizakalo eziphilayo emphakathini. Bahlala bejolise ekudleni, ezimakethe, nasezindaweni zokuhweba, bahlala eduze kwezakhamuzi. Lokhu kubavumela ukuthi benze imali ngenkathi behlinzeka ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, izitsha ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kanye nezinsiza ezincane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni imisebenzi, kuhlanganise nabathengisi abakhethiwe, futhi kukhulisa umnotho wendawo. Abathengisi basemgwaqeni banikeza ukudla okusheshayo okutholakala kalula, okubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, banomthelela omuhle ekukhuthazeni umoya wokuhweba phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlupheka ngezinkinga eziningi. Bahlala bephikisana nemithetho nezinhlinzeko zikahulumeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi benze imisebenzi yabo. Imithetho ethile ingavimbela ukuthola izindawo ezinhle zokuhweba, okwenza bahlale bezama ukuthola izindawo ezizimele, lapho bengahambisani nezidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, futhi abanye baphinde babe sengozini yokuthunjwa noma ukuxhaphazwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bavame ukuba sengozini yokulahlekelwa impilo ngenxa yokusebenza ezindaweni ezingaphephile.

Zama ukudla okungenani izinhlobo ezinhlanu zemifino noma zezithelo ngosuku. Ukuze ukwenze kuvumelane namandla akho, qala manje utshale imbewu yemifino nesihlahla esisodwa noma ezimbii zezithelo. Awudingi indawo enkulu ukuze wenze lokhu, futhi ungasebenzisa ngisho nezitsha zokutshala ukuze utshale imifino enempilo neluhlaza. Uma kungenandawo ekhaya, kunganiungangeneliumkhankaso womphakathi wokutshala izingadi, noma usize ekuqaliseni umkhankaso wokutshala izingadi emtholampilo wangakini. Ungaqala futhi ukutshala ingadi yakho encane kanye nabangane bakho. Uma izithelo zibiza kakhulu, thenga imifino eminingi esikhundleni sazo. Ithanga, amazambane, ubhatata, izaqathe, isipinashi notamatisi ziyibhamama ngoba zinikeza amavithamini namamineraliamaningi ngaphandle kokumba eqolo. Pheka imifino ngamanzi amancane. Khona-ke la manzi angabe esesetshenziselw a ukwenza isobho noma isitshulu - noma uwaphuze ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi umsoco osemanzini awuchithwa. Imithi yasendle ezimilelayo njengembuya noma ucadolo oyikha endle nayo iyindlela enhleyokuqinisekisa ukuthi udla imifino eyanele. Abantu abaningi bathenga imifino nezithelo kubantu abathengisa emgwaqw eni. Ngezinye izikhathibashibhile kunasezitolo kantibafinyeleleka kalula. Thenga imifino nezithelo okugcinwe emthunzini ngoba ilanga liqeda umsoco omningi obalulekile. Thengaimifino nezithelo okutholakala ngaleyo nkathi yonyaka, njengoba kusuke kushibhile. Ukudla okutholakala ezilw aneni njengenkukhu, inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi noma amaqanda kungase kudliw e nsuku zonke. Nokho, okunye kwalokhu kudla, ikakhulukazi inkukhu, inhlanzi nenyama ngokuvamile kubiza kakhulu.

Inhloso yethu enkulu singuhulumeni ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bakithi bathola impilo engcono elethwe inkululeko ababe nesandla ekufikeni kwayo. Njengoba sethula loluhlelo lapha namhlanje sikwazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi kusenabantu bakithi abaningi kwezinye izindawo abangenazo izindlu ezanele, futhi abangenazo izinqala-sizinda. Siyazi futhi ukuthi ububha, izifo, nokungafundi kusathanda ukuzakhela kakhulu ikhaya ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Ngakho ngezinhlelo ezifana nalolu lwanamhlanje siyazibophezela ekulweni nobubha silethele abantu bakithi impilo engcono ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Kuyinjongo yethu njengohulumeni ukuthi ekugcineni sibone yonke imiphakathi yakhelwe izindlu. Sifuna ukuletha izinhlelo zezindlu kuzo zonke izindawo ebezinganakiwe ohulumeni ebebephethe ngaphambili. Njengohulumeni sifuna ukubona abantu bakithi benezindlu ezithi bona. Kuyasidabukisa njalo ukubona ukuthi abantu bakithi ezindaweni zasemakhaya bahlala ezindlini ezakhiwe ngodaka, ezinye ezingakwazi ukumelana ngisho nemikhemezelo yemvula nomoya olula, nokugcina ngokudala izingozi nezingane zethu zithole izifo, njengoba kwenzekile e-Ndwedwe. SinguHulumeni sithi abantu bakithi ababe naso isakhiwo esizomelana neziphepho. Lokhu angeke kwenzeke uma iningi labantu bakithi lisazithola emikhukhwini, nasezindlini ezingekho esimeni. Unembeza wethu njengoHulumeni uyaphikisana nokuhlupheka kwabantu kanjalo nomthetho sisekelo wethu uthi abantu kufanele baphile impilo engcono. Ngesonto elizayo lomhlaka 23 kuya kumhlaka 24 kuyolenyanga kaMashi, sizobamba ingqunguthela cishe engenkulukazi esifundazweni emayelana nezindaba zokwakhela abantu bakithi izindlu.

Amalungu omphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele ayamenywa ukuba aphakamise amalungu eNational Heritage Council (NHC). Inhloso ye-NHC ukuhlinzeka, ukuthuthukisa, nokuvikela ifa lemvelo laseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuletha ukulingana ekuphathweni kwefa lemvelo. Izothola ukuvunywa kwephalamende kwiMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko futhi izohlinzeka, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngoxhaso lwezimali ngezimali ezithunyelwa ngababhalisi ezikhungweni nakumaphrojekthi/imisebenzi ngaphansi kwazo ezithunyelwe. I-NHC yasungulwa njengomzimba wezomthetho ngaphansi kweNational Heritage Council Act ka-1999 (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999). Amalungu e-NHC azoba nesibopho sokuphumeza izinhlinzeko zalesi simiso futhi kulindeleke ukuthi azijwayeze ukuphathwa kwe-NHC ngokuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999). Abaphakanyisiwe kumele babe nolwazi emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, amasiko okukhuluma, umlando, nokuvikelwa, kumele bahlonishwe ngalesi sikhungo emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, kumele baziwe njengabantu abanesithunzi abazinikele ekuvikeleni nasekuvikelweni kwefa lethu eliyingqayizivele lemvelo, futhi akumele babe nesikhundla kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yezepolitiki. Amalungu e-NHC awazotholi umholo wanyanga zonke kodwa azokhokhelwa izindleko ezithathwe emsebenzini wabo ne-NHC. Amalungu azothola futhi uphawu lokubonga ngempumelelo yabo. Cela uMphakathi ukuthi akhe uhlu lokuthi amalungu angatholakala kanjani bese wonke amalungu ekomidi athola ikhophi. Bheka i-Appendix 12 ukuze uthole isibonelo sohlaka lwamalungu ekhabhinethi yomphakathi.

Isiphetho Izinguquko zomthetho zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Njengoba izwe lethu lihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi umthetho ulandele izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uhambisane nezimo zamanje. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abaphathi bezomthetho, izakhamuzi, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho iyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, nolungile, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi unelungelo lokuphila kahle.

Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwe kwi-Security Council ziyovimbela ukuqubuka kokungqubuzana esifundeni. Ibhodi elibhekele amaholo alidlalanga indima ebonakalayo ekuthuthukiseni nasekuqinisekiseni ukulandelwa kwezinga lokuqasha emikhakheni engahleliwe. Ngaphandle kokufinyelela kalula ezindlini zangasese umphakathi womhlaba ungatheleleka ngezifo ezejwayelekile nezingundendende. Ukuhlonza izikhala ekulethweni kwemisebenzi nokuzovula amathuba okuxoxisana kohulumeni basekhaya. Uma imali engatholakala ngempahla yehlile yaba ngaphansi kwaleyo elindelekile, imali eqhubekayo iyehliswa ukuze kwehle umthamo. Ngala magama ambalwa ngifisela womabili amazwe ethu okuhle kodwa emizamweni yokuthuthukisa ezesayensi abavumelene ngayo ngokusayina lesi Sivumelwano. Emva kokuba amadoda amane egwetshiwe, u-Inspector Jansen namanye amalungu ombutho wamaphoyisa abamba umsolwa esazama ukuputshuluka phakathi kwabantu. Uchungechunge lwezethulo ezingenabuchwepheshe, ezisezingeni eliphezulu okuhloswe ngazo ukufinyelela kwinqubomgomo nokuthatha izinqumo ngendima kanye nenzuzo yobuchwepheshe basemkhathini e-Afrikha, luyokwenziwa. Asenze okulindeleke kithi njengezakhamuzi siphinde sehlise izinga lamacala ngokubophisa izigilamkhuba. Nakuba la ma-ejensi ekhona, osomabhizinisi abancane abangabesifazane, abangabeluleki ngezezimali noma osonkontileka, bangekwazi ukuya kulezi zikhungo zokweseka ukufinyelela kwezezimali kanye nokweseka ezobuchwepheshe. Okwesibili, amaphrojekthi akhiqiza umphumela ocacile nokhethekile otholakalayo kuyona iphrojekthi.

Uhlobo lomfundi olulindelekile yilolo olunelukuluku lenkuthazo esukela kulezo zinto ezisemqoka futhi oluzokwazi ukubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi owakhelwe phezu kwentando yeningi, okuwukulingana, ukuhlonishwa kwesithunzi somuntu, impilo kanye nenhlaliswano eyiyo yomphakathi. Uhlelo lwemfundo luzama ukwakha umfundi oyofunda impilo yakhe yonke, ozethembayo, ozimele, okwaziyo ukufunda nokubhala, okwaziyo ukubala, onamakhono amaningi ehlukahlukene, onobubele, oyihloniphayo imvelo emzungezile nonekhono lokuhlanganyela emphakathini njengesakhamuzi esihlelekile nesikhuthele. Izilimi ezigunyazwe umkhandlu wezilimi waseNingizimu Afrika, (PANSALB) nomkhandlu waseNingizimu Afrika ogunyaza izitifiketi (SAFCERT) ezinjengolimi olusetshenziswa yilabo abangaboni emehlweni (iBreyili) kanye nalolo limi lwezimpawu lwaseNingizimu Afrika olusetshenziswa yizithulu nezimungulu. Umkhakha wezilimi wethulwa ngezingxenye ezintathu kulolo nalolo limi olusemthethweni, kube ukuthi yilolo nalolo lunomthamo walo. Lezi zingxenye ezintathu yilezi: ulimi umntwana aluncele ebeleni, ulimi lokuqala olwengeziwe kanye nolimi lwesibili olwengeziwe. Ezweni elisebenzisa izilimi eziningi njengaleli laseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bafunde baze bafike ezingeni eliphezulu lolwazi okungenani kwezimbili izilimi zalezi zilimi ezisemthethweni nokuthi bakwazi ukuxhumana nabanye ngalezi ezinye izilimi. Umkhakha wesifundo sezilimi uyizithupha ziya ogwayini nomgomo womnyango wemfundo mayelana nolimi okufanele lusetshenziswe kwezemfundo.

Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kunzima kubalimi abasha abafuna ukungena ekulimeni ukuthola indawo yokulima masinya nokuyibhadala ngenzuzo engatholakala. Lokhu kodwa kuyehluka uma umhlaba ungatholakala ngegranti (LRAD), noma otholiweyo njengefa, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngentelo (interest) engaphansi (njengokwenzekayo kwamanje ngohlelo olusha olubekwe etafuleni nguMnyango weZemiHlaba olubizwa ngokuthi Proactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS). Ukuqasha umhlaba sekushintshile ngokwamanje, bekuyindlela yabalimi abaqalayo yokungena ezokulimeni kodwa manje sekuyindlela yabalimi bezomnotho ukuthola omunye umhlaba ukuze bathuthukise ukulima kwabo. Kufanele sicabange kahle ngalokhu ngoba kukhona umhlaba omkhulu osezandleni zomuzi wonke ongasetshenziswa, kanjalo kukhona abalimi abaningi abanekhono lokulima abadinga omunye umhlaba ukulima ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo. Ukuqasha kunikeza abalimi ithuba lokukhulisa umsebenzi wabo kodwa akudingeki imali eningi ehambelana nokuthenga nokuba umnikazi womhlaba. Khumbulani: Zikhona izindlela zokungena ekulimeni ngaphandle kokuba umnikazi womhlaba, ungaqasha ipulazi. ungasebenzisa umhlaba womuzi wonke noma ungasherisha lowo mhlaba nabanye abalimi.

Uma unalolu ngwengwezi ugcina ubona ngokufifiyela futhi kungaphazamisa impilo yakho nokuzenzela izinto ngaphandle kokusizwa. Isimo sokungaboni esingelapheka sihlasela kakhulu kubantu abantula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi abesifazne ezindaweni ezisemakhaya ngoba abanye abanalo ulwazi lokuthi bangaluthola usizo. Ukwehliswa kwezinga lokubhebhetheka kwesimo sokungaboni esingelapheka ngonyaka ka-2020 kwesekwa kakhulu ngumNyango. Ukuphazamiseka kwesimo sokubona kumuntu kunemithelela eminingi imibi kanti futhi kuthinta yonke imikhakha yezentuthuko, ezomnotho kanye nempilo efanele. Le nhlekelele yengozi iphuce umNyango amalungu awo njengoba bonke abasebenzi balo mnyango bewumndeni owodwa. SingumNyango wezeMpilo sithanda ukwedlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini wakwaChanda nowakwaMbatha kanye nakozakwabo. UNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo, uNkk Peggy Nkonyeni, iNhloko yomNyango uSolwazi Green-Thompson kanye nabo bonke abasebenzi bomNyango wezeMpilo bafisa ukwedlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini yaboshonile. "Abasebenzi bethu kwezosizo oluphuthumayo basebenza ubusuku nemini ngakho ukudlula kwabo emhlabeni akusilo nje usizi kuthina emNyangweni nasemndenini yabo kodwa silahlekelwe sonke," kusho uNgqongqoshe uNkonyeni. SHOKOLEDI, uswidi, amakhekhe, ama-chips ungakubala kube kuningi-sonke sike sifikelwe yisikhathi sokudla izinto ezimndani ezinoshukela omningi namafutha. Kubantu abasha abaningi lezi Kunezinto ezintsha zinhlobo zokudla ziyingxenye yempilo yabo ezisetshenzisayo uma yansuku zonke. Kodwa konke lokhu kwaphela kuhlolwa izinga kuLelethu Gxagxisa oneminyaka yobudala likashukela egazini, engu-20 ngesikhathi ethola ukuthi unesifo futhi kulula sikashukela.

Angidingi ukukukhumbuza ukuba izithunywa ezihloniphekile ukuthi ngonyaka owedlule sathumela ukwakhiwa kwezimali okwakuyisisekelo sokulwa nobuphofu nokwandisa amathuba abantu emnothweni. Ngiyajabula ukufingqa lokho esikutholile kulolu hlelo. Umkhulumeli, sanelisekile ngenqubekelaphambili eyenziwe ekwakhiweni nasekuxhasweni kwezinkampani. UMongameli ugcizelele ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ukuthi ukwesekwa kwezinkampani ezincane nezinkampani zabelwana kubalulekile kakhulu ezwenikazi. Kulesi sifundazwe, uhulumeni ubona leli hlelo njengokhiye wokuvula amathuba ezinkulungwane zabantu bethu ukuba bangene emnothweni. Ngonyaka ozayo, sizongena ohlelweni lokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zabelwana zihlala ziqhubeka futhi zingasebenza kahle. UThala noHulumeni Wesifunda bavuma ukuthi le mfuneko yezezimali ayikwazi ukuhlangatshezwane nguThala kuphela. Ngonyaka wezimali ozayo, sizobe siqala uhlelo olusha lokweseka abaqalayo - ngizokhuluma ngemininingwane ngalokho masinyane. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi uhlelo lokukhokhela abaqalayo ngizikhungo zikaHulumeni aluhlelwanga kahle. Kuvame ukuvele ukuthi luhlinzekwa uma kukhokhwa, kodwa umsebenzi usuwenziwe. Uhlelo lokukhokha ludinga ukulungiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aluhlinzekwa ngoba lokho kudala ingcindezi emalini nasezindleleni. Sengicelile iMnyango Wezezimali ukuba wakhe ithimba elincane el

Izindlela Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Ukubeletha kuwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yomama nabantwana, futhi izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuvikeleka nokuphumelela kwalolu hlelo. Lezi zinqubo ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukubeletha kwenzeka ngendlela ephephile, efanele, futhi ethokozisayo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinqubo ezahlukene zokubeletha ezibhedlela, imithetho ethinta lezi zinqubo, kanye nezidingo zokunakekelwa kwemindeni nabesifazane abakhulelwe. Ukuze uqale, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lezi zindlela zifaka phakathi ukubeletha ngokwemvelo, ukubeletha okwenziwa ngesiphuthuma, kanye nokubeletha ngekesekwazi. Ukubeletha ngokwemvelo, okuyindlela evamile, kubandakanya ukugcinwa kwemvelo nokuhamba kwezinyathelo zokubeletha ngaphandle kokusebenzisa imithombo yokwelapha eyengeziwe. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umama uzizwa ephephile futhi ekhuthazekile, futhi umntwana uthola umoya ophilayo lapho ezalwa. Ngokuphambene, ukubeletha okwenziwa ngesiphuthuma kudinga ukusebenzisa izindlela eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka komama kanye nomntwana uma kunezinkinga eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa imishanguzo, izikhali zokusebenza, noma amakhono okwelapha ukuze kube neqhaza eliphumelelayo. Izinselele ezahlukene zingavela ngesikhathi sokubeletha, njengezinkinga zokuphefumula noma ukungatholakali kahle komntwana, futhi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Enye indlela yokubeletha ibizwa ngokuthi "ukubeletha ngekesekwazi," lapho umama esebenzisa imishanguzo ethile ukuze anciphise ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha.

Lokhu kusho ukuthi izisebenzi kufanele zikhulume ngezinkinga zazo, zifune izixazululo, futhi zihlale ziqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zazo ziyaqondwa. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zidinga ukuhamba phambili, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi ziyaqonda ukuthi zibalulekile. Ubulungiswa emsebenzini akukhona kuphela isifiso, kodwa isidingo sokuphila ngendlela efanele. Ngokubuka phambili, iziteleka zabasebenzi zizohlala zibalulekile empilweni yabasebenzi. Zizokhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza bujolise kanjani emigomweni yokuphila. Uma izisebenzi ziqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, zikhuthaza umphakathi ukuze ube nesimo esihle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuphila kahle, okukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Ekugcineni, iziteleka zabasebenzi zingabhekwa njengendlela yokukhombisa lokho abantu abakufunayo empilweni yabo. Zikhombisa ukuthi izisebenzi zidinga ukuba nomthelela ezinqubweni ezithinta ukuphila kwazo. Ngaleyo ndlela, iziteleka ziba yisikhumbuzo sokubaluleka kwezisebenzi emnothweni. Akukhona kuphela ukulwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi obumbene, onobudlelwano obuhle, kanye nempilo engcono kubo bonke. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zihlala zikhumbuza umhlaba ukuthi abantu bayahlonishwa, futhi amalungelo abo adinga ukuvikelwa.

Le komidi ibika kwiBhodi ye-NEMISA ngemiphumela ye-audit nangokwethembeka nokuba khona kokuphila okukhulunywe ngakho. I-NEMISA, ngokubambisana neNational Services Commission (USA), ikwi ndlela yokusungula ikomidi le-audit langaphakathi elinamalungu amathathu, elilodwa elivela kwelinye isikhungo kanye nelinye elizimele. Le komidi izosebenza ngokuzimela kokuphatha, iBhodi ye-NEMISA, kanye nekomidi le-audit. Inhloso eyinhloko yale komidi ukusungula izinqubomgomo nezindlela mayelana nokuphathwa kwangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Le komidi izobika kokubili ukuphatha kanye neKomidi le-Audit le-NEMISA. I-NEMISA ikhuthaza ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi bayo ngezinhlelo zokubambisana ezihlobene nezindaba zabasebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwabelana ngolwazi. I-NEMISA ibheka isenzo sokuphakanyiswa njengokubalulekile ezinqubweni zayo zokuhweba, igxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni kwabesifazane. Le nkampani izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni indawo yokusebenza ephephile. IKomidi Lezempilo Nokuphepha linikezwe amandla ukuze kufezwe lokhu. Ikheli lewebhusayithi: www.nemisa.co. Ngokwezigaba 10 ze-Promotion of Access to Information Act, "Umphakathi Wamalungelo Abantu kufanele, ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-18 zokwenzeka kwalesi sigaba, aqoqe imanuwali equkethe ulwazi ngolimi olusemthethweni ngalunye, ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda, ngendlela engacelwa ngumuntu ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yisiphi isithakazelo njengoba kuchazwe kulo Mthetho." Umbiko wonyaka we-NEMISA. Umfakisicelo kufanele achaze ukuthi ufuna ikhophi ye-rekhodi noma ufuna ukuyibona emahhovisi e-NEMISA.

Ukufezwa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Semizuzu Eyi-15 Ekuhloleni nasekuphenduleni imibuzo, isikhathi sokuphendula siba yinto ebalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezidinga impendulo esheshayo, njengokuhlolwa, izivivinyo, noma izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15 kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphenduli banesikhathi esanele sokucabanga, ukuhlela, nokubhala impendulo yabo ngendlela efanele. Isizathu Sokubaluleka Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula Isikhathi sokuphendula sithinta kakhulu ikhwalithi yempendulo. Uma umphenduli enesikhathi esincane, kungenzeka ukuthi angakwazi ukuhlela kahle imicabango yakhe, okungaholela ekutheni impendulo yakhe ingabi nekhwalithi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma unikezwa isikhathi esanele, umphenduli angakwazi ukuhlela kahle, abhale kahle, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi yonke imicabango yakhe ibhalwe phansi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezidinga ukucaciswa, njengokuhlola izifundo noma izivivinyo. Ukuphendula Ngokushesha Ngesikhathi Esifanele Ukuphendula emibuzweni ngesikhathi esifanele kudinga amakhono athile. Okokuqala, umphenduli kufanele abe nekhono lokuhlela imicabango yakhe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele akwazi ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izimpendulo ezibalulekile, futhi azihlele ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlela izimpendulo ngokwezigaba, ukuqala ngombono omkhulu bese kuthi kancane kancane ahlukanise izici ezithile. Okwesibili, umphenduli kufanele akwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abe nekhono lokucabanga ngokushesha, ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo esheshayo, kodwa futhi enembile. Ukuze uthole leli khono, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza.

Yonke imibhalo ethulwe kamuva ngaleso simangalo noma kwenye ingxenye eqhubekayo iyobekwa uphawu lwaleyo nombolo yiqembu eliyethulayo futhi ngeke uNobhala ayemukele uma ingakashaywa lolo phawu noma inombolo. Yonke imibhalo ethulwe kuNobhala ukuze ilondolozwe emqulwini wesimangalo iyogcinwa nguNobhala efayeleni lezimangalo, ngaphansi kwenombolo efanele yaleso simangalo. Yonke imibhalo ethathelwe emtheshwaneni -1 iyohambisana nenkokhelo yezindleko zenkantolo engu R75,00, lenkokhelo ikhokhwa ngesitembu esithengwa eposini: Uma iqembu limenelisa Unobhala ngomtheshwana -5 ukuthi lihlwempu, inkokhelo yenkantolo ingahoxiswa nguNobhala oyobe eseqobela phansi lesi simo ekhasini lokuqala lombhalo okukhulunywa ngawo. Iqembu elifisa ukuqala noma ukuphikisa udaba olusezithebeni zenkantolo nelinombono wokuthi lihlwempu noma umuntu othile osebenza egameni lalelo qembu kufanele enelise uNobhala ukuthi ngaphandle kwempahla yasendlini, izingubo zokugqoka nezikhali zokusebenza, lelo qembu alinamafa afinyelela ku -R20 000 futhi ngeke likwazi ukuthola maduzane leyo mali ngomholo eliwutholayo. Uma kwenziwa amakhophi, inkokhelo enqunywe emtheshwaneni- 6a iyokhokhwa. Amakhophi ombhalo ogciniwe angenziwa yinoma ngubani, inqobo uma enziwa kukhona Unobhala.

Umb: Kwenzekani uma ukufa kubangwe yingozi? Imp: Esikhathini esiningi isikhathi sokulinda asisebenzi uma umuntu eshone ngengozi. Umb: Ingabe zikhona izinto ezikhishelwe ngaphandle? Umb: Kwenzekani uma ngeqa isikhathi sokukhokha noma ngiyeka ukukhokha? Imp: Angeke usaba ngaphansi komshuwalense futhi uma uqala ukukhokha futhi, kungenzeka isikhathi sokulinda siphinde sisebenze futhi. Umb: Ngabe ukuba ngaphansi komshuwalense kuphela nini emuntwini ngamunye? Umb: Ngabe ngiyabuthola ubufakazi bobulungu? Imp: Kumele uthole Isitifiketi Sobulungu, isifingqo sokuthi obani abakuloyo mshwalense, imali ekhokhwayo, zonke izikhathi zokulinda kanye nalokho okukhishiwe kupholisi. Imp: Yebo, ungayikhuphula inzuzo kupholisi yakho uma i-Master Policy ivuma, noma nini, lokhu kuyokhuphula nemali oyikhokha njalo ngenyanga. Okukhishiwe nezikhathi zokulinda kungasebenza enzuzweni ekhushuliwe. Umb: Ngabe ngisifaka kanjani isicelo semali uma kushoniwe? Imp: Inqubo yokucela imali kufanele uyinikezwe ngokugcwele emithethweni nasezimeni zepholisi. Imp: Ungayicisha ipholisi yakho kungakedluli izinsuku ezingama-30 zokukhokha imali yakho yokuqala futhi uthole yonke imali yakho uma kungukuthi ubungakafaki isicelo semali yomngcwabo. Emva kwalokho ipholisi ingacishwa noma kunini, kodwa imali obuyikhokha ngenyanga angeke ibuyiswe. Imp: Lokhu kungenziwa, kodwa kufanele waziswe futhi waziswe ukuthi kubathinta kanjani abantu ebebekuleyo pholisi esikhathini esedlule, ngakho konke lokhu okungenhla. Kufanele inkampani entsha ikunike isitifiketi sobulungu. Uma ucabanga ukuthi awukho esimeni esilinganayo noma esingcono, kufanele uthinte inkampani ekhona njengamanje ngokushesha.

Impendulo: Okokuqala, ukuvikeleka kwedatha kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yabantu ivikelwe. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuhle kwabasebenzi nabantu, ukuze kube neziqondiso ezicacile nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene kuhulumeni. Umbuzo 8: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa kanjani? Impendulo: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa ngokuhlola imiphumela engaba khona, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-AI ayikhubazi izigaba ezithile zomphakathi futhi ithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza kubo bonke. Ukuhlola njalo ukusebenza kwe-AI kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okuhle kwezinguquko ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 9: Ubulungiswa besimo se-AI kungakhuthazwa kanjani? Impendulo: Ukuze bulungiswe, kubalulekile ukufaka imithetho eqinile yokulawula i-AI, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kwabantu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa izimiso zokulingana, ubulungiswa, nokulungiselela izidingo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 10: Yintoni esikhathini esizayo esilindelekile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Esikhathini esizayo, silindele ukuthi uHulumeni uzokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ezindaweni eziningi, okubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, ukuxilongwa kwezinkinga, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza ngendlela ethuthukile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi ngokwenanela kwezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngale ndlela, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buphakathi kwezinsiza ezibaluleke kakhulu ezizokwenza uhulumeni ube nokusebenza okuhle nokuphumelelayo, ngaphakathi komphakathi.

Ngakho, uma bengu 19 kuphela abasebenzi, asikho isidingo sokuqoka ummeli. Ezindaweni ezifana nasezitolo nasemahovisi, ilunga elilodwa lokumela lingaqokwa ebasebenzini abangu 100 noma engxenyeni yalokhu. Isibonelo, linye ilunga okumele liqokwe kubasebenzi abasukela ku 21 kuya ku 100 kodwa kumele ebe mabili amalunga eqoqweni labasebenzi abaphakathi kuka 101 kuya ku 200, njalonjalo. Kwezinye izindawo zokusebenza, ilunga elilodwa lingaqokwa njalo eqoqweni labasebenzi abasukela ku 21 kuya ku50. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezehlukehlukene, umhloli angacela izikhundla eziningi zamalunga angabammeli, ngisho kulezo ziwombe okunabasebenzi abangaphansi kuka20. Isibonelo, ukuvuleka nesakhiwo semboni kungenzeka sakheke ngendlela yokuthi umuntu oyedwa akenele ukumele abasebenzi abangu 50. Umhloli usengacela ukuthi kube nesinye isikhundla esidalwayo somunye ummeli. Kodwa uma umqashi nabasebenzi abathintekayo bevumelana, abammeli bangedlula esibalweni esiphawulwe ngenhla. Bangaqokwa nini abammeli bezempilo nokuphepha? Kufanele baqokwe zingakapheli izinyanga ezine liqalile ibhizinisi. Abaqashi abanabasebenzi abevile emashumini amabili, asebesebhizinisini isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga ezine abaphoqelekile ukusungula abammeli. Esikhathini lapho kuqashwa khona abasebenzi abedlula ku20 ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka, njengabasebenzi basemapulazini futhi lokho kuqashwa okungedluli ezinyangeni ezine, asikho isidingo sokusungula abammeli. Bangayenza nini imisebenzi yabo abaqokelwe ezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yomsebenzi? Zonke izenzo nemisebenzi ephathelene nalezikhundla, uqeqesho lwabammeli kumele yenziwe ngesikhathi esijwayelekile somsebenzi.

Ubusakazi bamarediyo bemiphakathi kanye nobentengiso bomthamo ophansi buyosebenza iminyaka emithathu, kanti ilayisense yobusakazi bomthamo ophansi buyosebenza izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Ukubheka ukuthi ngabe yimaphi amafrikhwensi afanele angasetshenziswa ngumthamo ophansi. Ukubheka indawo isiteshi sokusakaza esizosakazela kuyo. Sungula iqembu lokusebenzisana elizobhekana nenqubo yesicelo kanye nokuba ngumenzi wesicelo egameni labagqugquzeli bomcimbi ozokwenziwa. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo ngokuprinta, ngokusebenzisa amagama amakhulu. Fakelani ifomu lesicelo lokuqala kanye namakhophi amafomu esicelo aqinisikisiwe angu-16 kwabe- nemali yesicelo. Izicelo ezingagcwalisiwe ngokuphelele, zizobuyiselwa kumenzi wesicelo kanti ngeke samukela emahlombe ethu ukuphazamiseka okungabakhona. Ukwamukelwa kwelayisense kungathatha izinyanga ezingu-2 ukuya kwezingu-3. Ifomu lesicelo lizoba yingxenye yamasheduli eGazethi kaHulumeni.

Ukuqala ukuhlela umbhalo wakhe. Ukukhetha uhlobo lombhalo azowubhala oluhambisana nenhloso nomuntu ozowufunda (incwadi yokubonga umndeni ngesipho asitholile). Ukubhala iziqeshana akhethe ukuzibhala Ngezinhloso ezahlukehlukene (isib. Indatshana emfushane enesigaba esisodwa noma amabili, ukubukeza incwadi elula, uhlu lwezinto zokupheka, izincwadi, ingxoxo, imiyalo). Ukubhala isihloko esifanele esikhombisa lokho akhuluma ngakho embhalweni wakhe. Umfundi uzokwazi ukubhala izinhlobo zemibhalo ezahlukehlukene eziyiqiniso nezicatshangwayo ngezinhloso ezahlukahlukene. Ukuxoxisana nabanye ngombhalo wakhe nowabanye ngenhloso yokuthola noma ukunikeza uvo ngawo. Ukubukeza umbhalo wakhe emva kokuba sekuxoxiwe nabanye. Ukukhombisa abanye umsebenzi awubhalile ngokuwufunda bezwe bonke noma ngokubabonisa bonke ekilasini. Uphenyo Lokuvuza Kwamaphepha Kamatikuletsheni Umbuzo 1: Yini ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni kubhekisela ekuveleni kolwazi oluyimfihlo lwemali, ibhizinisi, noma imininingwane yomuntu siqu ethunyelwa noma ikhululwa ngaphandle kwemvume. Lokhu kwenzeka kakhulu ezinkampanini, lapho izimfihlo zomkhiqizo, izinkontileka, noma izinqubomgomo zenzeka ukuba zivele emphakathini, okubangela ukubaluleka kwalesi sifo. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kungadalwa izizathu eziningi, ezifana nokungagcini kahle izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, ukwephula umthetho wabasebenzi, ubuchwepheshe obuphukile, noma ubudlelwane bobungozi phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase baveze imininingwane ngenxa yokubusa kwamafilosofi ahlukene noma ukufuna ukusiza abanye. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izingozi zokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni? Impendulo: Izingozi zokuvuza zingaba ziningi kakhulu. Okokuqala, kungase kubangele ukulahleka kokwethembeka kwezimali noma izinkampani, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwamakhasimende. Okwesibili, izinkampani zingaba nezingqinamba zomthetho, njengokubhalelwa amacala okubhayiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuza kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle ezimpilweni zabantu abathintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma imininingwane ehambisana nezokuphepha kube khona. Umbuzo 4: Yini okungaqhathaniswa nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphepha.

Izilinganiso zingabalwa futhi zikhokhiswe ngendlela ehlukile kuzo zonke izigaba zezimali. a kungase kube nesigaba esithile sabanikazi bomhlaba noma abanikazi besigaba esithile somhlaba bangakhokha izilinganiso ezikhokhiswa emhlabeni wabo; noma b kungase kwandiswe noma kuncishiswe isigaba sabanikazi bomhlaba noma abanikazi besigaba esithile somhlaba izilinganiso abazikhokhayo emhlabeni wabo ngokuya ngezimo ezikwi-7 ngezansi. IMasipala ingase iphazamise umthwalo wokukhokha, inciphise noma yehlise inani elikhokhiswa ngezizathu ezithile zabanikazi, ngokuya ngesimo sendawo. IMasipala ingase futhi yehlise ngelinye izilinganiso ezengeziwe inani lendawo ngokuya ngesinqumo seBhodi kwi-bhajethi yalo yonyaka. Le nqubo yokwehliswa ibhekwa ikakhulu kulabo abantu abanempahla enenani eliphansi futhi iyingxenye yesu leMasipala lokunciphisa umthwalo kubantu abampofu. Inhloso yale nqubo yokukhululeka ekukhokheni ukunciphisa umthwalo kubantu abadala abakhungathekile ngokwezimali futhi kungenzeka bangabi namandla. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, bonke abantu abadala bakhululwe emthwalweni wokukhokha ukuze babasize ekubhekaneni nomthwalo wentela odalwe yi-MPRA. Ngokwezibalo ezitholakele, kubonakala ukuthi abantu abadala abanempahla enenani elingaphansi kwezigidi eziyisithupha rand banesidingo esikhulu sokusizwa. Ngakho-ke, iMasipala izoqala uhlelo lokubeka umkhawulo othile ezimalini zokukhululeka ekukhokheni. 2011 - R3,000,000 2011 / 2012 - R2,000,000 Amanye amakhawulo angase abekwe ngemuva kokubuyekezwa okujwayelekile kwezilinganiso ezilandelayo.

Ukuze kusebenze ngendlela ezokhiqiza imiphumela esezingeni eliphezulu nephumelelayo, ihhovisi lezilimi kumele libheke izidingo zayo ukuze abahumushi nabahleli bakwazi ukugxila emsebenzini wabo ngenkathi abasebenzi behhovisi besiza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Idokhumenti kanye nesampula kulandela indlela futhi kudlula ezinyathelweni ezithile, ezinye zazo zingase zibe zokuphatha kanti ezinye zixhumene nokuhumusha nokuhlela. a. Idokhumenti yamukelwa kwiRegistry bese ibekwa uphawu ekhasini langaphandle elikhombisa usuku lokwamukelwa kwayo bese ithunyelwa kumqondisi walowo Mnyango ukuze iphathwe kanye nesinqumo sokuthi kufanele isebenze. b. Uma idokhumenti kufanele ihumushwe ngaphezu kolimi olulodwa, labo abaphethe umsebenzi wehhovisi benza amakhophi olimi lapho kudingeka ukuhumusha. c. Amakhophi athunyelwa kumakhanda alezo zindawo zolimi ezidingekayo ukuze kuhunyushwe leyo dokhumenti. d. Umphathi waleyo ndawo yolimi ubuyekeza idokhumenti, uxoxisana nabanye, bese ethatha isinqumo sokuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle. e. Idokhumenti ithunyelwa kumakhalekhukhwini noma kumuntu osebenza ngolimi ophatha incwadi yokurekhoda lapho ezobhala khona zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo ezifana nosuku idokhumenti yamukelwa, inani lamakhasi, igama leminyango ethumele idokhumenti noma umthengi, kanye nalowo ozokwenza umsebenzi wokuhumusha noma wokuhlela. f. Idokhumenti ithathwa umgibeli wombhalo wokurekhoda bese ithunyelwa kumuntu ozosebenza kuyo, futhi uma kufanele ithunyelwe ngaphandle, ithunyelwa kumqondisi ukuze uthole imvume yokuthi idokhumenti ithunyelwe ngaphandle.

Abalimi abakhiqiza ukolo eFreyistata konke okuhambelana nokulondoloza umswakamo emhlabathini kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu uma ufuna ukukhiqiza ukolo ehlobo. Ukubaluleka kokulondoloza umswakamo emhlabathini kuyinto esizokhuluma ngayo njalonjalo. Lo msebenzi ufanele uqale masinya emva kokuvuna. Eyesibili ngukukhuphuka kwamanzi phakathi emhlabathini bese uphephuka nomoya - nalokhu kwenzeka lapho umhlabathi uqina ulukhuni. Kufanele uphathe ubheke amasimu akho ngokusuka kwesikhathi lapho uqede ukuvuna kuya esikhathini sokuphinda ukutshala izitshalo ezinsha. Umphumla omuhle womvuno ozotholokala usezandleni kuphela!

Kukhona izincwadi eziningi ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho kunetha khona ngesikhathi sehlobo, kodwa sithathe umqondo wokuhlanganisa incwadi yokuhola (ikhasi lokuhola) ezobhekana ngqo nezinkinga zabafundi abasha kulezi zindawo. Le ncwadi izochaza kabanzi izindlela zokugcina umswakama emhlabathini - okubaluleke kakhulu kunanoma yini enye ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat ezindaweni ezithola imvula yehlobo kuphela. Le ncwadi izoba nezahluko ezizoxoxa ngembewu, isimo sesitshalo se-wheat, izidingo zokudla kwe-wheat, izindlela zokubeka ezizohambelana nokukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, inani leziphuzo nezikhathi zokubeka, izindlela zokulawula izitshalo ngesikhathi izitshalo zisakhula, ukuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuvuna, ukuhlukanisa, nokumaketha. Ngemuva kokuphothula le study, sizohlinzeka ngezifundo zoktraining kwabanye - iseshini eyodwa izogxila ekuqeqesheni abaholi ukuze babelane ngolwazi, kanti ezinye ezimbili zizogxila ekuqeqesheni abalimi - ekuseni sizobheka ulwazi ezincwadini futhi ntambama sizofundisa umsebenzi wezandla. Ukuze sisize abalimi ngendlela efanele, sizozama ukwenza amaqembu amane agxile ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat. Lezi zifundo zizohlangana njalo ngenyanga, futhi konke okukhona okuhlobene nokulima kule nyanga kuzoxoxwa. Siyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokusiza abalimi be-wheat eFree State.

Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula kubantu mayelana nalokho akwenzile nokuthi yini eyenziwe emphakathini, kanye nokuthi izimali ezichithwe zisetshenziswe kanjani. Kwenzekani ngemuva kokuthi inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ithuliwe? Ngemuva kokuthi inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ithuliwe, kokubili izindlu zePhalamende kuvamise ukuba nengxoxo. Amaphathi ezombusazwe athola ithuba lokukhuluma imibono yabo nokubuza imibuzo ngezindaba eziphakanyisiwe kule nkulumo. Izinkinga zikhuluma, futhi izindaba ezibalulekile zizwe zikhonjiswa. Umphakathi uyamenywa ukuba ube khona futhi ulalele le ngxoxo njengoba kwenzeka kuyo yonke imihlangano yePhalamende. UMongameli uphinde aphendule ezindabeni eziphakanyisiwe nemibuzo ebuzwayo phakathi kwale ngxoxo. Yini isiqubulo sePhalamende salonyaka? Isiqubulo sePhalamende sika-2011 sithi "Siyagubha umnikelo wenkululeko ngokwakha ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwePhalamende nabantu." Ngonyaka wonke, iPhalamende iyamukela isiqubulo esiba yisikhumbuzo semigomo yayo ngaleso sikhathi. Uhulumeni weqiniso weDemokhrasi uthola amandla awo kubantu ngokubamba ukhetho ngezikhathi ezithile futhi ngempela umphakathi uqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza ezinqubweni zokuphatha. Isiqubulo sikhuthaza ubukhona benkululeko yokubamba iqhaza, obonakalayo, kanye nokubophela, lapho abantu bezwa izindaba zomthetho nezokubheka. Kuphikisana indima yePhalamende ekumelelayo abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni wabantu ophatha ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo.

UMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kulandela inqubo ethile eyakhelwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokubambisana neKomidi Lezomthetho. Ingxenye ethile yabasebenzi be-ICD yakhiwe ngamalunga aqokwe nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho. Lokhu kwenzeka kulandela imithetho ephethe insizakalo yomphakathi kanye nabantu abathile abathunyelwa kwezinye izigaba ngenhloso yokusiza noma ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwi-ICD. Umsebenzi oqala ngalokho okukhulunywe ngumthetho (ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wesevisi Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika, iMthetho No. 68 ka-1965) we-ICD ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) kanye neMuni Police Service (MPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe. Lapha umthetho ubonisa kahle ukuthi u-ICD unikezwa umthwalo nomsebenzi wokubheka umphakathi mayelana ne-SAPS njengoba kuboniswe kuNgxenye -222 yeMthethosisekelo Wokushintsha ka-1993. Le ngxenye ibeka ukuthi "Kuzoba khona indlela ezimele, esunguliwe futhi ephethwe nguMthetho Wezomthetho ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okukhulunywa ukuthi kwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe." a ngokuthanda kwakhe noma ngemva kokuthola isikhalazo, uhlola noma yisiphi isenzo esingafanele noma ukuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe yilunga le-SAPS noma le-MPS. c ingahlola noma yisiphi isimo esiqondiswe kuyo nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho noma ngaphakathi komkhandlu wesifunda.

Umbiko NgamaMamelodi Sundowns Isingeniso AmaMamelodi Sundowns, eqembu elidumile lemidlalwano yebhola eliseGauteng, eNingizimu Afrika, ligama elaziwayo hhayi kuphela ezweni, kodwa nakwamanye amazwe. Leli qembu, elasungulwa ngo-1965, selidale igama elihle emlandweni wombhoxo, libe nomthelela omkhulu kumphakathi nasemidlalweni jikelele. Ngomlando walo ogcwele impumelelo, amaSundowns abhekwa njengelinye lamakilabhu aphambili e-Afrika. Umgomo Nokuqhuba AmaMamelodi Sundowns ahlale enezinga eliphakeme emqhudelwaneni wePremier Soccer League (PSL), njengoba liphumelele isicoco sePSL ezinyangeni eziningi. Umdlalo wabo omkhulu, owaziwa ngothando ngegama elithi "Masandawana", uphumelele izicoco eziningi, okuhlanganisa neTelkom Knockout, iNedbank Cup, neCAF Champions League. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwabo nokuqina kwabo emdlalweni. Ukuthuthukiswa Kweqembu Ukuze amaSundowns agcine izinga eliphezulu, abaphathi beqembu benze kahle ekukhetheni abadlali, begxila ekwakheni ithimba elinamandla. Abadlali abanjengoBongani Zungu, Percy Tau, noMosa Lebusa baye bathuthukisa umphakathi weqembu, baphinde banike umthelela omuhle emnothweni. Umdlali oncomekayo, uPeter Shalulile, ubukeka njengomfanekiso omuhle, njengoba ehamba phambili ezinhlelweni zokuhlangabezana nezinhloso zeqembu. Imiphumela Nezibalo Ngokubhekisisa ezibalweni, amaMamelodi Sundowns abamba izikhala eziphezulu kwiPSL.

UNelson Mandela waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi wakhombisa ukuthi ubumbano lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo zaba khona, kodwa umqondo wokubumbana wahlala uqinile. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwaluhlala lukhula, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze bakhe ikusasa el better. Uhlelo lwezokhetho lwaba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphumelele, futhi bakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphumelele, futhi bakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu behlanganyela, futhi lokhu kuhlale kuyisifundo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. UNelson Mandela, njengomholi, waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubumbano lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu, futhi lokhu kuhlale kuyisifundo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Ngakho-ke, umlando wokhetho luka-1994 ungomunye wezikhathi ezibalulekile emlandweni wezwe, futhi ubonisa amandla abantu uma behlanganyela. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko zingenzeka uma abantu bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi lokhu kuhlale kuyisifundo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Sekuphakanyisiwe futhi kwethulwe kwiCabinet. Le ndlela iphakanyiswe njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi eziyi-11 zaseNingizimu Afrika njengoba kuqinisekiswe ngumthethosisekelo. Le ndlela inikeza indlela yokuhamba phakathi kwezilimi. Kulolu hlelo, isigaba ngesigaba, kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ukwengeza ukuphothulwa kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi. Ulwazi lwasekhaya/nolwakho olunye lungaba umthombo wokukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona ingozi yokuthi lolu lwazi lungasetshenziswa ngamasu angaphandle angabheki ulwazi lomphakathi njengolwakhe. I-ethnomedicine ne-ethnopharmacology iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo, ezilwane, kanye nefa lesiko nokuhlonipha izinkampani, imvelo yokudla kwezitshalo, indlela amasiko aphathwa ngayo, kanye nokwakhiwa/ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezithile. Kukhona imithombo yokuxhasa ucwaningo lwezokwazi imvelo nezinsiza ezibekwe ngaphansi kwe-Human Research Council ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuvikelwe ulwazi lwasekhaya/nolwakho. Ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba bokuthula nokuvikela imithombo. Lezi zicabango zashintsha zaba izenzo ngonyaka odlule? Lesi sikhungo sithuthukise indlela eqinile yokuphatha eholelwa ngumenzi, esekelwa ngumsizi nomqondisi-jikelele. Indlela yokuhlangana kwabaphathi kanye nendlela yokwethula iziphakamiso nokuphatha izinsiza zabantu ithole ukunakwa okukhulu ngenxa yomsebenzi weqembu elisha lokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Njengoba umbiko wezinsiza zabantu uthi, zonke izinhloso zokwakhiwa kwabaphathi zifeziwe.

Le mikhankaso izoqinisekisa ukuthi labo abasebenza kanzima bazothola ama-bonuses - lokhu kuzosisiza abalimi abanamakhono ukuba babe nenzuzo. Enye inkinga enkulu yisimo semishini nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa abalimi abasha - kudingeka sibe nesisekelo sezimali ukusiza abalimi ukuthi balungise imishini yabo. Kukho ingxenye yezigaba zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngempahla nemishini kubalimi. Lokhu kungasiza esikhathini esifushane, kodwa labo abalimi kudingeka baqeqeshelwe ukuphatha le mishini kahle. Uma imishini isetshenziswa ngamaqembu abantu, akekho ozothatha umthwalo wokuphatha - kaningi imishini iyashiywa inganakekelwa futhi ngokushesha iba ingasebenzi. Lo msebenzi awukwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Izikhungo ezabelana ngolwazi nazo kumele ziqeqeshelwe ukuze ziqhubeke nomsebenzi wazo kahle - kukhona izikhungo eziningi ezinjalo, futhi kufanele zikwazi ukusiza abalimi ezindaweni zokulima. Ingxenye yezinselelo abalimi abasha ababhekana nazo ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali zokuqala zokulima. Kukho abaningi abanomhlaba nezinsiza (mhlawumbe ezinye azisebenzi kahle), baqeqeshelwe futhi baxhaswe, kodwa badinga imali. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphezulu kakhulu - kudingeka R4,000 kuya ku-R5,000 ukuze utshale ihektare eyodwa. Ekuqaleni, sathokoziswa ukubona amabhizinisi ezolimo esiza abalimi abasha ngoxhaso lokuqala, futhi kusekhona amabhizinisi ezolimo axhasa abalimi ukuba babe nenzuzo. Asebenzisa abalimi ekulungiseni nasekuphatheleni izinsiza zabo nemishini. Kanjani kufanele kusetshenziswe abaqashi emkhakheni wezolimo? Ingxenye yezindlela zokuqala zokulima umhlaba iwukusebenzisa abaqashi abakhulu.

Izinguquko kule mibandela nezimo zokusebenzisa ziyoqala ukusebenza ngaleso sikhathi sezinguquko lapho zifakelwa kule website. Kuyisibopho esisemahlombe omsebenzisi ukuthi ngezikhathi nezikhathi ahlole imibandela nezimo zokusebenzisa le websiste noma izinguquko noma ulwazi olusha olusanda kufakelwa. Ukuqhubeka komsebenzisi ukusebenzisa le website, ngemuva kokufakelwa kwezinguquko noma ulwazi olusha, kuyothathwa ngokuthi lowo msebenzisi uyitholile inothisi kanti futhi wemukela ukuzibophezela ngayo le mibandela nezimo zokusebenzisa, okubandakanya izinguquko nolwazi olusha.

Izinhlelo zethu zezempilo emphakathini sezibambe elikhulu iqhaza saphonsa itshe esivivaneni ekulweni nendlala ezindaweni ezintulayo. Kuze kube yinamuhla sekuvuleke amathuba emisebenzi angu- 9302. Ngifisa ukuyiqinisekisa le Ndlu ukuthi, phezu kwalezi zinselelo, uMnyango awuzanyazanyiswa yilutho futhi saqala kudala ukwenza izinto "ngendlela engajwayelekile" engakasho noMengameli wezwe. Sesiziqinisile izinhlaka zethu zezifunda ukuze zikwazi ukuba namandla okuhambisa izidingo ngqangi zezempilo. Isibonelo, e-Thekwini sekuqashwe uMphathi umkantsh' ubomvu esigabeni 14 ngokwezinga, futhi angikuveze ukuthi zonke izifunda zethu sezihlomisiwe ngolwazi lokuhlangabeza izimo ezibucayi ezingazama ukuhlasela isifundazwe noma ingasiphi isikhathi. Ukubaluleka kwalesi sibonelo wukuthi mhlawumbe sibuye, sikhombise, ngezinye izikhathi ukuphelelwa ngamandla siyishaye phambili sibuye siyishaye emuva ngenxa yokuthi asiyisebenzisi indlela ka-Lenin ukuchaza izinselelo esibhekene nazo kwezempilo zangaleso sikhathi kubantu. Njengoba kwake kwasho yena uLenin eminyakeni engu-90 eyedlule sidinga ukuba "sibe nesineke, siphindaphinde, ngobuchule kubantu indlela engasetshenziswa okuguquguqulwa ngayo umphakathi". Izigidi zalisebenzisa lelo thuba okwangempela, zazibophezela ekuzuzeni ukuthula, inkululeko engakhethi bala nabulili, ukwabelana ngempumelelo nempilo engcono kithi sonke.

Umkhandlu wendawo weMatjhabeng kanye nezinkomiti zawo zezakhamuzi ziye zanikela ngemininingwane ebalulekile nezifundo eziyisisekelo le bhukwana elakhiwe ngazo. Umxhumanisi wase-Australia uNkk. Pauline Peel usebenze ngokubambisana nomphakathi nomphakathi uMnu. George Moahloli ophuma kumkhandlu, kanye nomkhulumeli wombuso uMnu. TV Matsepe, iminyaka eyishumi ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezimiso ezingathuthukisa ukuzibandakanya komphakathi ngezikomiti zezakhamuzi. Amalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi uqobo nawo abambe iqhaza ekuqulweni naku ukuthuthukiswa kwaleli bhukwana. Ngesikhathi sokuqala uhlelo olusha lukamasipala ngo-2000, sakhombisa ukuthi lokhu kwakuyisici esibalulekile sokuphatha futhi sikhona ukuze sinikeze incazelo ecacile nephumelelayo yokuzibophezela esisekelweni sezepolitiki, okungukuthi, abantu bazokhulumela. Sabatshela abantu bethu ukuthi ndawonye nohulumeni bendawo, sizoletha ubuhlakani lapho uhlala khona. Embonini yethu yokuhulumeni bendawo, saphakanyiswa ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga ezisemqoka ezifana nokuthuthukiswa okunganele, ukungasebenzi, ukuhamba kancane, kanye nobuphofu. Izinkomiti ezisunguliwe zomkhandlu zidlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Njengemikhakha yomphakathi kanye nezakhamuzi, kumele zixwayise umkhandlu ngezifiso, amakhono, nezinkinga zabantu. Kumele futhi zakhe umgwaqo ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwecouncil nomphakathi abawumelwa. Umthetho wombuso wendawo unikeza ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ezizoba yinxenye ehlanganisa abantu nohlelo lwethu lokuphatha.

Qinisekisa ukuthi uma umuntu ongumbhikishi efaka isicelo sokuvikela, kukhona incwadi yokuvuma ebhalwe ngumshushisi ehambisana nesicelo. Ayikho ifomu ethile edingekayo ukuze uthole le mvume - incwadi ebhalwe ngumshushisi evuma imvume iyanele. Umntwana noma umuntu onengqondo engasebenzi kahle uyakhululeka noma uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi lowo muntu akakwazi ukuvuma ngokwabo noma ukuhlinzeka ngovume. Isikhathi esidingekayo sokulungiselela isicelo sokuvikela siyahluka kuye ngenkantolo kanye nenkantolo ethile kodwa sithinteka esikhathini sokuthi udaba lokuvikela luzokwenziwa nini enkantolo. Le nsizakalo iyamahala futhi ayikhokhiswa.
