Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ngendlela Efana Nama-ATM: Ukubuyekezwa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye balungisa izindlela eziningi zokuphila kwethu, futhi izikhungo zokusebenza zikhombisa lokhu ngokucacile. Njengoba abantu besebenzisa ama-ATM (Automated Teller Machines) ukuze bathole imali, izikhungo ezithile ziya zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufanayo ukuze ziqhube izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ekusebenzeni kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM, okubandakanya izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokusebenza. Izinzuzo Zokusebenza Kwezikhungo Njengama-ATM Okokuqala, ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi kumakhasimende. Njengoba ama-ATM ethola ukufinyelela okusheshayo nemali, izikhungo ezisebenzisa le ndlela zikhuthaza ukufinyelela okuphumelelayo ezinsizakalweni zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokusebenza kungaba nzima. Ngokusebenzisa izikhungo ezizimele, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ngaphandle kokulinda isikhathi eside. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhungo ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ngaso sonke isikhathi. Njengoba ama-ATM ethola imali 24/7, izikhungo ezisebenza ngale ndlela nazo zikhuthaza ukufinyelela okungapheli. Lokhu kubalulekile kumakhasimende afuna izinsizakalo ngesikhathi esifanele, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemidlalweni, emsebenzini, noma emakhaya. Ukusebenza okungapheli kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpilo zabo, kunciphise ukucindezeleka, futhi kwandise ukwaneliseka. Izinselelo Ezihambisana Nokusebenza Kwezikhungo Nokho, njengoba kunamathuba amaningi, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezihambisana nokusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM.

Ngaphandle uma kuhlinzekwe ngenye indlela, le nqubo iyosebenza kuzo zonke izicelo noma ziqonde yiphi inhloso, kuhlanganisa a udaba oluhlonzwe esigabeni- 1674a soMthethosisekelo, b ukuthola imiyalelo yenkantolo, leso sicelo siyofakwa ohlwini lwesaziso sokufisa ukuthatha isinyathelo, siyophelezelwa wumbiko ofungelwe maqondana namaqiniso ayisisekelo sesicelo somuntu ofuna uzwelo kanjalo siyochaza ikheli [elisendaweni ebuqamama obungaphansi kwamakhilomitha angu -25 ukusuka ehhovisi likaNobhala] elichaza indawo nekheli lokuposa elihambisana nesikhahlamezi, inombolo yocingo nekheli le e-mail uma likhona lapho ofaka isicelo eyothola noma emukele khona isaziso nezincwadi zasenkantolo, zingakapheli izinsuku ezihlanu ngemuva kwesicelo sofuna ukuba yingxenye, uyotshela oziphendulelayo ngesinyathelo somuntu noma seqembu elizimisele ukungenela udaba ngokunjalo kufanele oziphendulela asho ukuthi unayo yini inhloso yokuphikisa leso sinyathelo, uma ingekho inhloso ebhaliwe, Unobhala uyocelwa ethule udaba phambi kweJaji Elikhulu ukuze idingidwe ngokomtheshwana- 4. Uma kufakwa isicelo sozwelo siqondiswe kunoma ngubani, emkhandlwini, kuhulumeni, ezikweni likahulumeni noma emnyangweni noma lapho kunesidingo noma kufanele ukwethula esinye sesaziso sesicelo esichazwe ngenhla okuqondiswe kuso emtheshwaneni- 1, isaziso sesinyathelo siyobhekiswa kuNobhala nalabo abathintekayo abachazwe ngenhla, sichaze leyo mininingwane, ehlanganisa ikheli lendawo, isikhahlamezi, inombolo yocingo nekheli le e-mail uma likhona eqenjini ngalinye okufunwa kulo uzwelo, amakheli okuxhumana nalawo maqembu, kungenjalo isaziso nezincwadi ziyobhalelwa uNobhala, isicelo siyobhalwa sihambisane neFomu- 1 noma- 2, kuye ngesimo ngasinye.

Noma yikuphi ukuhlola okunqunywe emgomeni 43.02. a Ukuhlola okuphoqiwe noma okunye ukulungiswa kwendiza enikwe imvume evamile yokundiza noma efanele ukundiza: kuyokwenziwa ngumnikazi wemvume yenhlangano elungisa izindiza AMO okleliswe ezingeni elifanele. b Ukuhlola okuphoqiwe noma okunye ukulungiswa kwendiza eGunyazwe ukundiza ngaphansi kweNgxenye 24: kuyokwenziwa ngunjiniyela onemvume yokulungisa indiza AME noma ngumuntu onemvume nesitifiketi esikhishwe ngaphansi kweNgxenye 66 okleliswe ezingeni elifanele. Noma iyiphi indiza egcine ukuhlolwa ngokuphoqiwe yase inikwa imvume wunjiniyela onemvume yokulungisa indiza nokufanele ithole isitifiketi sokuba sesimweni sokundiza ngokombandela weNgxenye 21 kudingeka ihlolwe futhi iqinisekiswe yinhlangano elungisa izindiza ekleliswe ezingeni elifanele. Noma yikuphi ukulungiswa kakhulu kwendiza okuthathwa njengokuphoqiwe mayelana nendiza enikwe isitifiketi sesigaba esivamile sokuthi ingandiza kufanele kwenziwe ngezikhathi ezibekiwe futhi ngendlela enqunywe kuphela yinhlangano yokulungisa izindiza. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi wokwengeza, owenziwa ngesikhathi sokuhlola uyobhalwa ohlwini lokuhlolisisa futhi uqinisekiswe ebhukwini lendiza ngunjiniyela olungisa indiza noma ngumuntu ogunyazwe yinhlangano ethintekayo elungisa indiza. Imibhalo eqondene nezingxenye noma izinsimbi ezinempilo elingene noma ezike zasetshenziswa phambilini kufanele ilandeleke. Izingxenye ezingenawo umlando ziyothathwa njengezingxenye ezingalungiseki futhi lezo zingxenye ngeke zifakwe endizeni.

Kumele kuphakamiswe amacebo okuphumelelisa ukuhlangana kwezinndlela, ezokuthutha ezifinyeleleka kalula yilabo abanokukhubazeka, ukushintsha nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane nabantu ababenamathuba amancane ngenxa yobandlululo olungeluhle. a Abe nemvume efanele, ilayisense yokusebenza noma amandla esikhashana; futhi b Arejistwe ngokwalo Mthetho maqondana namakhumbi angamatekisi, amatekisi anamamitha, amabhasi kanye nezithuthi zokungcebeleka ngokwesigaba 69, isigaba 77 nesigaba 81. Inhlangano kungenzeka ingabi nayo ilayisense yokusebenza noma imvume. Imoto noma iyiphi ifumana ilayisense yokusebenza eyodwa kuphela. b ukuthuthwa kwabantu abakwi kilabhu yokugibelisana, lapho amalunga eshintshana ngokugibelisana noma ukuhlela ukugibelisa amanye amalunga noma labo abaqokwe yilawo malunga ukuya nokubuya kwizindawo eziqokiwe ngenhloso eqokiwe nalapho kungekho khona uhlelo noma olunjani lokukhokhelana ngokugibelisana. b bangabhemi; futhi c bayazi kahle indawo abasebenzela kuyo. Isigatshana 1 angeke sisebenze kubasenzi abasebenzela lapho kucace khona kahle ukuthi asingangeni. UMEC angashaya umthetho wokuthi bonke abashayeli bezithuthi zabahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi baye kofundiswa ngokuthile. b noma ummeli wehhovisi angacela lowo ofaka isicelo selayisense ukuthi ahambise imoto iye kohlolwa kabusha uma esola ukuthi ayikho esimweni sokuba semgaqweni, noma ngabe leyomoto ibisinayo ilayisense esemthethweni yokuba semgaqweni; futhi c angenqaba ukuphanisa ngelayisense yokusebenza uma ngokwakhe ebona imoto ingekho esimweni sokuba semgaqweni.

Akwaziwe kusemanjena ke ukuthi kuzokuba umsebenzi omningi nokho ukuqondisisa ukusebenza kwamabhizinisi amancane kwizinhlangothi ezehlukahlukene zomnotho, kanye nohlobo losizo oluzokudingwa yilamabhizinisi ukuze akhule futhi afake nokubonakalayo emnothweni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuyingxenyana nje yesu lokugqugquzela ukuqalwa kwamabhizinisi nokusizwa kwezinkampani ezincane ukuba zidlondlobale. Amabhizinisi amancane kufanele akwazi ukuboleka imali, athole ukusekelwa nokwelulekwa nosizo oluphathelene nokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo, ukukhangisa lowomkhiqizo nokuwudayisa emazweni angaphandle. UMnyango wezaBasebenzi uzosebenza ngokubambisana nohlangothi lwezemfundo nokuqeqesha, uMnyango weoHwebo neziMboni neminye imiNyango namaziko ayo ukugquqguzela ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono emabhizinizini amancane ukuze akhule. Akuthi kufika uMarch 2005, kube sekukaliwe kwabonakala ukuthi iSikhwama samaKhono sibe namuphi umphumela nomthelela, ngokubheka uhlobo lweprojekthi, nanokuthi ithathe isikhathi esingakanani, lokho okufanele kuveze nezinga lokutholelwa kwabantu benkosi imisebenzi emveni kokuba beqeqeshiwe phela, okulindeleke ukuba u 70% wabaqeqeshwa ube usuwasebenzisa mandawana thize amakhono lawo. Enkulumeni yakhe ekuvulweni kwephalamende ngo 2000, uMongameliIn uMbeki wakhuluma ngesidingo sokuba imisebenzi yentuthuko ihlanganiswe ukuze imiphumela ibonakalet. Leyomisebenzi yentuthuko yileyo eyenza ngcono izinga lempilo yabantu abaswele, yileyo enikeza izinsiza ezinqala kanye nengqala-sizinda, futhi eba yisisekelo sokukhushulwa kwezinga-mpilo ngokuqala izindlela ezintsha zokungenisa imali.

Umuntu oyisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika ngokuba yisizukulwane ngumuntu owazalelwa ngaphandlek weNingizimu Afrika kubazali omunye wabo owayeyisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuzalwa kwengane kumele kubhaliswe ngokulandela umthetho wokubhalisa ukuzalwa nokushona we-Births and Deaths Registration Act, 1992. Gcwalisa ifomu BI-24. Abazali abangabaseNingizimu Afrika kumele bagcwalise ifomu BI-529. Maqondana nesimo se-adoption , kumele ufanele umyalelo we-adoption. Fakela ikhophi yesifitikedi sokuzalwa sangaphandle. Fakela amakhophi ezitifikedi zomshado womenzi wesicelo kanye nabazali. Uma umenzi wesicelo ezalwe ngaphandle komshado, bobabili abazali kumele basayine ifomu lobhaliso lokuzalwa ifomu BI-24. Fakela ubufakazi, uma umzali waseNingizimu Afrika athola ilungelo lokuba yisakhamuzi sangaphandle. Fakela ubufakazi bokuzalwa bomzali waseNingizimu Afrika. Izicelo zingathatha amaviki ayisithupha ukuya kwangu-8. Le nkonzo ngeyamahhala ayikhokhelwa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali kulayini we-internethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze lonyango.

Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni: Isimo Esididayo Ezweni Lethu Isingeniso Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi eNingizimu Afrika, enezinhlobonhlobo zemiphumela emphakathini nasemnotho. Kulolu cwaningo, sizobheka umlando, izimbangela, izimpawu, nemiphumela yenkohlakalo kuhulumeni, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo zokulwa nalolu hlobo lwesimo. Umlando Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni eNingizimu Afrika ayisiyona into entsha. Ibangelwa yizimo zomlando ezahlukene, okubandakanya ubuhlanga, ukuhwebelana kwemali, kanye nokungabi nezinqubomgomo ezinamandla. Ngemuva kokuthola ukuzimela ngo-1994, ubuholi bokuqala babhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu zokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isithombe sibe sibi ngenxa yokungathembeki kwabaphathi. Izimbangela Zenkohlakalo Izimbangela zenkohlakalo ziningi futhi zihluke. Okokuqala, izikhala ezivumela ukuziphatha kabi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Imihola ephakeme, ukuntuleka kokubekwa kwentela, kanye nezinsongo zokungabi nezimo ezihle, kudala amathuba okwenza okungafanele. Okwesibili, ukungabikho kokubeka obala nokuqapha kwemisebenzi yomphakathi kuholela ekubeni kube lula ukwenza inkohlakalo. Izimpawu Zenkohlakalo Izimpawu zenkohlakalo kuhulumeni zibonakala ezindleleni eziningi. Isibonelo, ukusungulwa kwezinkampani zomphakathi ezithola izinkontileka ezinkulu, noma ukungena ezikhungweni ezizimele ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ezithinta izinjongo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye baphathe amaholo aphezulu ngokubambisana nezinyunyana, kanti abanye abantu bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Izimpawu zingabonakaliswa nasekuthathweni kwezinyathelo ezingafanele, lapho abanye bephatha izinqumo ngendlela engalungile.

Kumele ngithi le njongo ihlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha isikhungo sobukhosi ukuze sisebenze ngaphandle kokungabaza. Kungalesi sizathu nakwezinye engikhuluma ngazo ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa okuhle, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha kwezintela ezikhokhwayo ezindaweni zobukhosi. Ngakho-ke, Mhlaba Womphakathi, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngiqinisekise neRoyal House ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kwezinkosi ohulumeni ophathayo esifundazweni kuyisiko elihle elilandelwa emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kugcinwa ngezindinganiso ezahlukene kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukene okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe lesi sithunzi; akufanele kusetshenziswe ukukala izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko uma kuqhathaniswa nezikhundla ezahlukene zikahulumeni. Izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko ngaphansi kwesakhiwo sobukhosi ziyingxenye yalowo mphakathi ngaphansi kwenkosi. Ngaphezu kokusiza imiphakathi ezindaweni zobukhosi kanye nabaholi bendabuko ukuze bathole ukuhlonishwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona, imnyango yami isebenza ngokwakha kabusha izikhungo zokuphatha zendabuko. Lokhu kuhilela ukuguqula lezi "zinkantolo zobukhosi" ezazaziwa ngaphambili zibe izakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukusungula ubudlelwano nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza abaholi bethu bendabuko nezakhiwo zabo ukuba bathathe ithuba lezi zinhlelo ezichazwe emthethweni kazwelonke mayelana nokuphathwa kwezendabuko (njengokuphakanyiswa nguMthethosisekelo waseKwaZulu-Natal).

Uma uKhomishani enganelisekile, uyokwazisa lowo onquba umsebenzi ngalokho, asho izizathu kuleso saziso bese emnika ithuba lokulungisa amaphutha noma izici ezingalungile singakapheli isikhathi esinqunywe nguKhomishani, ekupheleni kwaleso sikhathi uKhomishani uyomnika noma achithe isicelo esithintekayo. Isicelo sokuvuselela isitifiketi semvume siyokwenziwa ngokugcwalisa ifomu enqunywe uMqulu SA-CATS-ACS futhi siphelezelwe yimali efanele njengoba inqunyiwe yiNgxenye 187. Okushiwo umthethonkambiso 108.05.01 kuyosebenza nalapha. Ngaso sonke isikhathi Isithunywa esilawulwayo siyoqhuba umsebenzi ngokulandela ibhukwana lezokuphepha elamukelwe. b phelezelwa yimali eqaguliwe noma inkokhelo enqunywe yiNgxenye 187 yale mithethonkambiso. b nika ofake isicelo sokuqinisekiswa isitifiketi sokugunyazwa njengomthumeli mpahla owaziwayo ngendlela enqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Isitifiketi sokuqinisekiswa sisebenza izinyanga eziyishumi nambili kusuka ngosuku esikhishwe ngalo. Ngokuhambisana nokushiwo yisigaba 4 no soMthetho, uKhomishani angaqoka abaqiniseki babathumeli-mpahla abaziwayo abazohlola impahla ngenhloso yokukhipha izitifiketi zokugunyazwa ukuzivuselela nokukhipha ezinye futhi ngokwesibili. Amalungelo okukhulunywa ngawo kumthethonkambiso 1 ayosetshenziswa futhi asebenze nemibandela, izidingo, imiyalo, nezinqubo noma ngamaqophelo anqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS.

Amaqembu Ebhola AseNingizimu Afrika: Umfanekiso Wokukhula Nokwazisa EBhola, impilo yamaAfrikaans, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, iyinsika ebalulekile yamasiko nezenhlalakahle. Amaqembu ebhola anjengomlingani, akhulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela nokwazisa okuvelayo phakathi kwabantu, okuhambisana nemisebenzi eminingi yombono wezenhlalo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngamaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela abathinteka ngayo empilweni nasemiphakathini. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukujula kuhlelo lwamasiko olwakhiwe yile midlalwano. Amaqembu afana neKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns awaze wathela ithoni ehluke kakhulu emhlabeni wethu. Lokhu akuhlangene nje nokuthokozisa, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa, izifundo zempilo, kanye nezikhuthazo zokuziphatha kahle emiphakathini. AmaChiefs nePirates awangama ‘derbies’ akhangayo, akhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, bejabulisa izinkulungwane ezibukele emidlalweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sihlangabezana nokukhula nokuguquka kwezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika. I-South African Premier Soccer League (PSL) iyinsika yalo mkhakha, igcwalisa izinkanyezi eziningi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Akusikho ukuhamba phambili kuphela kwezikhwama zemali, kodwa futhi nakuqala kokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe obusetshenziswa emidlalweni. Izikhumbuzo zamakilabhu, imikhankaso yokukhuthaza, nokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu kudala ithuba lokukhula kwezemidlalo futhi kwandisa ubuchwepheshe bokulinganisa.

Ngethemba ngenhlonipho ukuthi zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika zizolujabulela lolu Hlaka lweNqubomgomo yolimi kaZwelonke njengolwabo. Ngiyakholwa ukuthi ngokudibene kumele siqinisekise ukuthi inqubomgomo iba yinto yangempela ezimpilweni zethu, futhi isenza siziqhenye ubuthina beNingizimu Afrika engajwayelekile. DAC UmNyango wezobuCiko namaSikoDoE UmNyango wezeMfundo LANGTAG Iqembu lokuSebenza ngoHlelo loLimi HLT UbuChwepheshe boLimi lwaBantu LiEP Ulimi kuNqubomgomo weMfundoMTEF UHlaka lokuSetshenziswa kweMali esiKhathini esiLingene NLS IziNsiza zoLimi zikaZwelonkePanSALB Ibhodi yeziLimi yaseNingizimu AfrikaSADC Umphakathi wokuThuthukisa waseNingizimu AfrikaSAQA UmKhandlu wokuQinisekisa iZiqu waseNingizimu Afrika. Zicishe zifinyelele ema-25 izilimi ezahlukene ezikhulunywa eNingizimu Afrika, eziyi -11 yizona ezinikezwe isikhundla sokuba semthethweni kulandelwa isiGaba -6 somThethosisekelo we- 1996 (UmThetho weNombolo we - 108 wonyaka we-1996), kusekwa ngokuthi kumele ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufakele amaphesenti angama-98 ezakhazamuzi sezizonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni yisiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu kanye nesiSwati (ezibizwa ngokuthi iqembu lezilimi zesiNguni); IsiSuthu, isiPedi kanye nesiTswana (ezibizwa ngokuthi iqembu lezilimi zesiSuthu); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi nesiBhunu. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe eliziliminingi .

Ngonyaka owedlule, ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezwe, uMongameli uMbeki wathi, "Kucacile ukuthi izifiso zabantu bethu zikhombisa ukuthi izwe lethu selingene esigabeni esisha sethemba." Leli themba kube umbiko esiwamukele kubo bonke abantu bethu njengoba sahlala phakathi kwabo sixoxa ngezindaba zokwabiwa kwezimali. Ngesikhathi sihlanganisa le bhajethi, sahamba kuwo wonke amapulazi ale ndawo silalela izifiso zomphakathi ofuna ukubona lezi z allocation zezimali zethulwa namuhla zifeziwe. Abantu abaningi bakhathazekile kakhulu ngendlu, nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezifana namanzi nempilo. Amazwe athuthukayo, kanye nalawo abamba iqhaza emphakathini womhlaba, awanazo izindlela zokwenza izinto zifinyeleleke kubantu ohlelweni lwezimali lapho kutholwa khona izikweletu. Umsebenzi wabantu abampofu ufana nezinkampani ezingakwazi ukukhipha amasheya ukuze zithole ezinye izimali zokusebenza. Ngaphandle kokukwazi ukwenza lokhu, umsebenzi wabo ufana nokuba dead. Abantu abaningi abahlala kulezi zizwe abanakho ukufinyelela izimpahla zabo ukuze zibe yisibambiso sezikweletu. Lokhu kwenza ukukhula komnotho kulezi zizwe kube nzima, nakuba abantu benza zonke izinto ezwenziwa amazwe aseNtshonalanga. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yezomnotho wezokuthengisa. Saqala le ndlela yokuthuthukiswa ngonyaka owedlule sazi kahle ukuthi le ndlela ibanzi futhi izothatha iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokufinyelela endaweni yethu. Saziswa ukuthi singaqala kahle. Asizukushintsha indlela esiqale ngayo. Sizokwenza njalo kulonyaka njengoba siqala. Umthetho Wokwabiwa Kwezimali Wabantu bethu udinga ukuthi silalele imizwa nemibono yabantu abahlukene. Senze kanjalo kulonyaka futhi.

Kodwa ekugcineni, kuke kwaba nenkulumo yokuthi indiza ibambezelekile ukusuka e-Taipei. Ngicabanga ukuthi kuyinjwayelo ebholeni lezinyawo ukuba sithole amathikithi enkundleni. IKhabhinethi iyobe isibamba umhlangano ukuchaza uhlaka lomsebenzi kahulumeni oyomenyezelwa eNkulumweni ewuMhlahlandlela kaZwelonke. Umseshi ophezulu wamacala aphathelene nokuphanjanelwa wumqondo uklonyeliswe indondo ekhethekile yokumhlonipha. Iziteshi eziningi zemisakazo eNtshonalanga Kapa ziyasiza ngokugqugquzela ukunikela ngemali kanti kumele lokho kwesekwe. Asinaluvalo nokuziphikisa uma sisho ukuthi intando yethu yeningi izuze kakhulu, kokunye, ukunganaki kwePhalamende labo abasezikhundleni. Ngesikhathi use-North Park Lane wawukwazi ukubona noma yini eyayingaholela kulokho kushayisana? Ngokwejwayelekile, imibuzo ngokungaziphathi ngendlela kwezimantshi kubhekwana nayo iphinde iphothulwe kusenesikhathi. Ngesikhathi semisebenzi elawulwayo ngamalungu oPhiko lwe-Phokeng Organized Crime Unit kula masonto, abasolwa abane baboshwa kwatholakala iplathinamu, igolide kanye nekhokheyni. Ukuvakashela iSikhungo soLwazi lwezokuVakasha emahhovisi e-Cape Town Tourism aku-Burg Street kuyisiqalo esihle. Ukunweba okubonakalayo ekusebenziseni imali komphakathi emfundweni yokuqeqesha nokufundiswa umsebenzi, kulabo abaqashiwe nabangaqashiwe kumela kube seqhulwini emnothweni omkhulu. Uyibona uma ubuka uhlaka lwemali esetshenzisiwe njengoba idlavuza umnotho nengqalasizinda ukuba isebenze emazingeni aphakeme. Lapha, abasebenzi abaningi bezempilo babengakaze bezwe ngeKhodi noma ngezinyathelo zezempilo ezilungele izingane.

Lo hlelo luhlanganisa ukuhlela izikhungo eziqinisekisa ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi, ukuveza konke, nezinga lokwethembeka. Ukukhuliswa nokufakwa kwezinguquko ezakhiweni ezifana nalawo asebenzisa izinsiza ezikhethekile kubandakanywa. Sifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezwi lokuthula emndenini nasemakhosini akhe asebenzile naye eToyota kulandela ukulahleka kwendodana yakhe esuka kwi-Afrika. Lapho sibheka umhlangano waseAlgiers, umhlangano wokugcina weMillennium, sifuna ukuveza izinto ezibaluleke kakhulu kulezi zinsongo ezintsha. Imvume yomfuna ukuhlala phansi iphrintiwe, isayinwe, ibhampathwe, bese ikhishwa kumfuna ukuhlala phansi. Imvume ingavuselelwa kwezinye izinsuku eziyi-30 bese isivuselelwa izinyanga ezintathu. I-RSDO iqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo futhi yenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala phansi. Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Ngaphambi kokuba sihlole kabanzi ngokuqonda kokugunyazwa kokwelashwa ngaphansi kwe-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yomuntu. Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathola izinsiza zempilo ezidingekayo, bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano yokwelapha ehlonishwayo, inikeza izinsizakalo eziningi ezihlosiwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amalungu ayo athola ukwelashwa okufanele. UJohn, umphakathi ophila eGauteng, ungumuntu ophila impilo ejwayelekile, kodwa njengabanye, ubhekene nezinkinga zempilo ezithile. UJohn ungumuntu onothando, onobungane, futhi onomsebenzi oncomekayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba edlula ezinsukwini zakhe, uJohn uthola ukuthi udinga ukwelashwa okuthile, okungase kudinge ukugunyazwa ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokuba aqonde kahle inqubo yokugunyazwa kokwelashwa. UJohn uqala ngokuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze athole ulwazi oludingekayo. Uthola ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kudinga izinyathelo ezithile, kuhlanganise nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinkinga zempilo zakhe. UJohn uqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zempilo ezitholakalayo zisebenza kahle, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo bayazi ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze baphumelele. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, uJohn uthola ukuthi i-GEMS izobuyekeza isicelo sakhe. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zisebenza kahle.

Ukuze kuthuthukiswe inqubo yokubonisana, iKomishini izokwakha iphothali yokubhalisela ulwazi ngemithetho esunguliwe kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA lapho abantu bengabhalisela futhi bakhansela ngaphandle kwezindleko futhi lapho bezokwaziswa nge-imeyili ngale mthetho, ushintsho noma ukusula komthetho ophakanyisiwe noma udaba oluhlobene, kanye neziphakamiso ezihanjiswe kumgomo 11.03.2 (b) ngenhla. Noma yisiphi isitatimende somsebenzi esikhishwe sizoshicilelwa kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA ukuze sitholakale futhi singacelwa kwiCAA lapho sizotholakala khona ngephepha eliqinile noma ngendlela egcinwe ubuchwepheshe bekhompyutha, etholakala ngentengo ethile. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.01. a lusebenza ezindizeni, eziphathwayo ngenjini nezindiza zokuzijabulisa;". futhi b ushintsho lufaka esikhundleni somusho j wesigaba 1 ngomusho olandelayo j ukungaphatheki kahle okungakwazi ukulawulwa ngumuntu;".

Uhlelo i-Investing in Culture luqonde abantu besifazane, intsha kanye nabakhubazekile ngandlela thize. Ubuphofu Bempahla: ngokunikeza imali yokuthenga okokwenza okuluhlaza (ubuhlalu, izindwangu/okokwenza njll) kanye nokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda kuzimo ezidlulele kakhulu. Ubuphofu beholo/bemali engenayo: ngokunikeza ukweseka amabhizinisi angenisa imali/iholo kanye nokweseka ukumiswa kwama-SMME. Izimakethe: Indlela ehlanganisayo yokufinyelela ezimakethe ukuthola imikhiqizo kanye nezinsizakalo zaseNingizimu Afrika iye yavunywa. Amamaki okulinganisa emikhiqizo kanye nezinsizakalo zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi iyithuluzi lokuphawula ukwethula izinsizakalo nokuba sezingeni eliphezulu.

ISevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) isebenza njengengqalasizinda yokwesekwa kwezilimi kwezobuchwepheshe kuhulumeni. Kukhona uhlelo lokuthola ulwazi ngocingo. Izinhlobo zedokhumenti ezihumushwayo ikakhulukazi zifaka lezo eziqondiswe emphakathini, njengezincwadi ezimhlophe, izincwadi eziluhlaza, umthetho ophakanyisiwe ophumeleleke ukuze uthole imibono yomphakathi, izaziso zohulumeni, imithetho, imibiko yonyaka yeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni, imibiko ye-commission kanye nezinkomiti, izivumelwano zomhlaba, izinkulumo zomongameli, izinkulumo zabaminisitiri, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikaHulumeni, amadokhumenti ezinkontileka, amaphephandaba nemikhankaso, ulwazi lwezindaba, njll. Uma idokhumenti kufanele ihumushwe ngaphezu kolimi olulodwa, kuyakhethwa ukuthi ihlelwe ngaphambi kokuhumusha ukuze igcine umqondo wayo nomyalezo. Umbhalo ohumushiwe uqhathaniswa nomthombo ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa nokubekwa kolimi nokuqinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokucophelela nokugcwalisa umbhalo, kanye nokuhlelwa kahle kwamadokhumenti ezomthetho nezaziso zohulumeni, njll. Iminyango esebenza nohulumeni, izinhlangano, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ithola izinsizakalo zeSevisi Yezilimi Zangaphandle, futhi basebenza namadokhumenti afana nezivumelwano zomhlaba, imibiko yeMnyango Wezokuphepha, izincwadi ezibhaliwe ngababhalisile, njll. Uhlelo lwefoni lunikezwa ukuze kuxazululwe ngokushesha izinselelo zokusebenzisa, ukubhala, nokufaka lezi zilimi ezisemthethweni ngochwepheshe bezilimi bomnyango abaphatha lezi zinkinga. Uma kudingeka, ucwaningo lwenziwa.

Sikhuluma nje sesiphothuliwe isivumelwano noMnyango wezokuVikela, isivumelwano sithi uMnyango weZempilo uzobahlinzeka ngosizo lwezokwelashwa kubasebenzi babo namalunga emindeni yabo. Esikhathini esingaphambili, abasebenzi bezombutho wezokuvikela babethola usizo lwezokwelashwa ezibhedlela zangasese. Ukuze siqinisekise ukusebenza kwaloluhlelo, sizodinga uhlelo olunqala lokukhokhisa nokuqashwa kwabaphathi abafanele ezikhungweni eziqokiwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isifundazwe sizuza ngokufanele kulolu hlelo. Ukuze sikwazi ukufeza izinhloso esizimisele zona, sikhuphule isabelo-mali kusuka ezigidigidini ezingu-3.614 zamaRandi saya ezigidigidini ezingu-3.899 zamaRandi kulo nyaka wesabelo-mali. Kusho ukuthi sengeze izigidi ezingu-285 zamaRandi uma siqhathanisa nonyaka wezimali owedlule. Lokhu kuthasisela kuzosiza kakhulu ukuthi sikwazi ukuqhubeka nokufaka izinhlelo zokulwa nokukhuphuka kwamanani ezimpahla ezithengwayo, sinciphise isibalo sabantu abahlaselwe yiMDR neXDR TB, kanjalo nemithelela ye-Occupation Specific Dispensation. Kulo nyaka wezimali, sihlela ukuqeqesha isibalo esingu- 3,342 sabahlengikazi abasafunda, abangu-1,041 asebevele babhalisile nabangu-103 ababhalisele ukufundela ukusiza abahlengikazi. Kulo nyaka olandelayo wezimali sifisa ukusikhulisa isibalo sokuqeqesha abahlengikazi abazobhekana nokusebenza emitholampilo ethize naleyo engomahamba nendlwana. Kuzoqeqeshwa abasiza kuma-Ambulense ababalelwa ku-400 kulo nyaka wezimali uma uqhathanisa nabangu-88 bangonyaka owedlule wezimali. Lesi sibalo sihambisana nesidingo okumele sibe naso ungakashayi unyaka ka-2010 nangale.

Bheka izindleko zokuphila, amathuba emisebenzi, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko ezizokwakha impilo yakho. Ukwenza Ibhajethi: Dala ibhajethi yokuhamba, ehlanganisa izindleko zokuhamba, izindleko zokuhlala, nezindleko zokuphila zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi ungakwazi ukuphila kahle lapho ufinyelela emadolobheni. Ukuxhumana Nezihlobo: Xhumana nezihlobo noma abangane abahlala emadolobheni ukuze uthole izeluleko. Bangakunika imininingwane ewusizo mayelana nezindawo ezinhle zokuhlala, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Isigaba 3: Ukufuduka Uma usulungile, sekuyisikhathi sokufuduka. Nazi izinyathelo okufanele uzithathe: 1. Ukulungisa Izinto: Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlele kahle izinto zakho. Hlanganisa izinto ezibalulekile kuphela, ukuze ungabi nomthwalo omkhulu. Ungasebenzisa izikhwama ezinkulu noma amabhokisi ukuze uhlele kahle. Ukuthola Izinsiza Zokuhamba: Thola izinsiza ezikufanele zokuhamba, njengemoto, ibhasi, noma izindiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthola izinsiza eziphephile nezisheshayo. Ukuhamba: Lapho usuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela izinhlelo zakho. Hamba ngokuqapha, futhi ungakhohlwa ukugcina izincwadi ezisemqoka, ezifana nezitifiketi zokuzalwa, amakhadi ebhange, kanye nezincwadi zokuhamba. Isigaba 4: Ukuqala Impilo Entsha Ngemva kokufika emadolobheni, kubalulekile ukuqala impilo yakho entsha ngendlela efanele: 1. Ukufuna Ikhaya: Qala ngokufuna indawo yokuhlala. Bheka izindawo ezihlukahlukene, njengezindlu ezizimele, amaflats, noma izindawo zokuhlala ezabelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo oyikhethayo ihambisana nebhajethi yakho. Ukufuna Umsebenzi: Sebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole umsebenzi.

Lo mthetho uhlanganisa umthethosisekelo. I-Centre isunguliwe njengomuntu ophakathi kwezomthetho okuzobizwa ngokuthi i-South African Science Centre. Iphakamisa ngokuphelele ubuhlakani babantu bonke; futhi inikeza izeluleko ezinhle futhi ikhulisa izenzo mayelana nezidingo zokubambisana, amathuba, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nabo bonke abakha iNingizimu Afrika. Le Centre iyona kuphela i-science centre eyamukelwa nguHulumeni. UNgqongqoshe angayala le Centre ukuba iqhube imisebenzi ethile ehambisana nezinhloso zayo. Kunohlobo olulodwa lokubhaliswa kule Centre, kodwa amalungu angaba amalungu anenhlonipho (labo abahoxile kodwa basahlonishwa) kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka wabo wokusebenza obubanjwe iminyaka engama-70. Ilungu leCentre kulindeleke ukuthi lisize le Centre ukufezekisa izinhloso zayo. Inqubo ezolandela uma kukhethwa amalungu eCentre izoba yimpumelelo enkulu ekuthuthukiseni noma ekusebenziseni isayensi. Abantu abaphakanyiswa ukuba babe amalungu amasha eCentre bazophakanyiswa futhi banikezwe isitifiketi esinqunywe ngamalungu okungenani amane, okungenani amabili kufanele abe nolwazi lomuntu siqu ngomsebenzi wesayensi kanye nendima ebonakalayo edlalwe yilowo muntu esayensi. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sihlanganise incazelo echaza ukuthi ukhetho kwalowo muntu njengelungu leCentre kuzothuthukisa kanjani izinhloso zeCentre. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sibe nekhasi elichaza ukuzibophezela kwalowo muntu ukuba aqashwe njengelungu leCentre, futhi kufanele sibe ne dokhumenti echaza umlando wabo wezokufunda nezokusebenza (curriculum vitae). IBhodi leCentre kufanele ibuyekeze minyaka yonke zonke izicelo ezintsha ezithunyelwe ngonyaka odlule, kulandela inqubo esunguliwe yokufaneleka.

a Ukubeka iso ekulawulweni kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kuleso sifundazwe okufanele kuhambisane nenqubomgomo kazwelonke yezemidlalo e Ukuqondisa ukubandakanywa kweminye iminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana kwenqubomgomo yesifundazwe kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. f Ukusebenzisa izivumelwane namanye amazwe ezenziwe iNhlangano yezeMidlalo nokungcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokwabelana ngobuchwepheshe, namakhono okuthuthukisa ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Iziphathimandla zasekhaya yizona ezibhekene ngqo nokusondezwa kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. a ukumisa umhlahlandlela wenqubomgomo yokuphathwa kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ezingeni lasekhaya ohambisanayo nenqubomgomo kazwelonke neyesiFundazwe yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. b Ukwenza ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kutholakale kubo bonke abantu bakuleyondawo. c Ukwakha izingqalasizinda ezidingekayo zokusentshenziswa kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Uma ubheka ukuthi amaqembu yiwona ayisisekelo kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka, iziphathimandla a ukumisa nokusentshenziswa kohlelo lwezemidlalo lukazwelonke nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zezemidlalo ziyathokala kubo bonke , nokuthi zikhona izingqalasizinda zokuqhudelana namaqembu, nokuthi ziphathwa ngobungcweti. Ukuqagula nokuqoqela ndawonye izinto nezindawo zokudlala, amaqembu nezidingo zezingqalasizinda zemiqhudelwano, bese idweba uhlelo lwesikhashana. Ukuthuthukisa nokunikezela ngamathuluzi noqeqesho ukuze kuqinisekwe ukuthi izinto zokudlala, nezigungu zamaqembu nemiqhudelwano kuphathwa ngobungcweti.

Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphepha. Izinsiza Zokuqeqesha: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezokuphepha, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkinga Kubhalwe ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphepha komphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Izinhlelo Zokuphendula: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlola Izimo: Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo. Ukwazisa Umphakathi: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze izakhamuzi zazi kahle ngezinsiza zokuphepha. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kudinga ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwezizinda, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Le nqubomgomo ibeka izisekelo ezibalulekile zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onokuthula, futhi ophephile. Ngokusebenza ndawonye, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zethu zihlala ziphephile, futhi izakhamuzi zethu zinethemba lokuthi zikhona izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphepha.

Amalungu abezindaba ayelulekwa ukuba alungise izinto zabo zokuhamba ngesikhathi sokugcotshwa. Uke waqaphela ukuthi ugange olungaphandle lwalulaliswe phansi ngalesi sikhathi noma ingxenye yalo? Ingxenye enkulu yalo mzamo igxile eKapa. Sihlalo, yonke le mizamo iyingxenye yesu elikhulu lokwenza iSifundazwe sethu siphephe emaqenjini ezigelekeqe, ezidayisa izidakamizwa kanye nezigebengu. Sibe nezingxoxo ezibe nemiphumela emihle kanti sithokozile ngomsebenzi owenziwe kulo mhlangano. Izikhala ezimbi zamasekela aBaqondisi-Jikelele ezisohlakeni oluvunyiwe eHhovisi elikhulu ziyadingeka. Ongumhloli uzokwazi kangcono ukuthatha isinqumo kulokhu. Umsizi kachwepheshe wavakashela indawo waphinde waqoqa ulwazi olumayelana namanzi kanjalo nengqalasizinda yokuthuthwa kwendle. Wathi imboni yokuvakasha idinga ukuthi iqaphele okwenzeka emphakathini ezindleleni zayo zokwenza ibhizinisi njengoba abavakashi basemazweni aphesheya bakuqaphela okwakwenzeka. Ukuze kutholakale imiphumela eyiyo yesikhathi esiphakathi kanjalo neside kubalulekile ukuhlela izinhlelo zesikhungo ngendlela eyenza umzamo odidiyelwe phakathi kukahulumeni nabambisene nabo emphakathini. Idolobha laseKapa ngoMnyango wezokuHlola liqalise amalungiselelo esigaba sesithathu sokuhlola ngenhloso yokulinganisa. Umnyango awuniki igunya kokuqukethwe yinoma iyiphi iwebhusaythi engaba nokuxhumana nalena. Uhlu lwezimali okumele zikhokhwe kwiwebhusaythi yase-Elsenburg noma zingatholakala elabhorethri. Ake ngiqale ngokukhuluma ngezindaba ezimqoka esibhekana nazo cisho zonke izinsuku.

Thela amanzi ebhodweni noma sebenzisa ikomishi ukuyiphakela. Gcina ihlanzekile - gcina amanzi akho ephephile. VI. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe uhlanza izandla zakho? Ukungcola okuningi ezandleni zakho kungakwenza uthole i-cholera ngaphandle kokwazi? Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ukuhlanza ingane. Ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. Ngemva kokudla. Ngemva kokunikeza ingane yakho ukudla. Yini indlela engcono yokuhlanza izandla zakho? Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa usawoti njalo. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile njalo. Hlanza izandla zakho njalo ngemva nangaphambi, phakathi kwezitho zakho, nasemathanjeni. Gcina zihlanzekile - hlanza izandla zakho? VII. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe usebenzisa indlu yangasese? Umuntu ohlanzekile angathola i-cholera endlini yangasese. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa indlu yangasese njalo? Phumula udoti lwengane endlini yangasese noma ulufake phansi. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nosawoti ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina ihlanzekile - sebenzisa indlu yangasese. Phuza amanzi avela emthonjeni ophephile noma ovikelwe. Pheka ukudla noma kuphise kabusha, bese udla ngesikhathi kuse-hot. Hlanza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokuthinta udoti noma ukuchama, ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. I-cholera ayizokubulali uma iphathwa kahle. Shesha umguli ophukile uye esibhedlela ukuze uphathwe. Nika umguli amanzi.

Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, izakhamuzi zithola ithuba lokuvota, lapho zikhuluma khona ngezintandokazi zabo, zikhombisa ukuthi zifuna ubani ukuba ummeleli wazo. Isigaba sesithathu: Ukusebenza kwePhalamende Uma ukhetho sekuqedile, iPhalamende iqala ukusebenza. Izigameko zokuqala zifaka phakathi umhlangano wokuqala, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ahlangana khona ukuze aqinisekise izikhundla ezibalulekile, njengeMenenja yePhalamende (Speaker) kanye noMholi weMpumalanga. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iPhalamende iyakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Isigaba sesine: Ukubhala umthetho Umthetho ubhalwa ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamalungu ePhalamende. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela iziphakamiso, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokwenza izinguquko uma kudingeka. Ukuze umthetho uphumelele, kufanele udlule ezinyathelweni ezithile, kuhlanganise nokuvunywa kwamaKomidi, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ebheka khona iziphakamiso ngokucophelela. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ukuhlola umthetho Ngemuva kokuba umthetho ubhalwe, iPhalamende kufanele ihlole ukuthi umthetho uyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlola kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho awubangeli umonakalo, futhi ufinyelela ezinjongo ezithile zomphakathi. Uma umthetho uthola ukugunyazwa, uqala ukusebenza, futhi izakhamuzi ziqala ukuwusebenzisa. Isigaba sesithupha: Ukubambisana nezakhamuzi IPhalamende linomsebenzi wokubambisana nezakhamuzi. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuhlela imihlangano, lapho izakhamuzi zingabamba iqhaza khona, zikhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi wazo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze iPhalamende iqonde izidingo nezifiso zabantu, futhi ikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nalezi zidingo lapho ibhala khona imithetho.

Umkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba ungahlonza inqubo yawo yangaphakathi ngokulandela noma yiyiphi inqubo engase ibekwe ngokusemthethweni mayelana nokuqhuba kwawo ukuchitha izindaba ezedluliswayo. Umbuzo ngaphambi komkhandlu wokwedlulisela izindaba, uhlelwa yivoti elesekayo okungenani leningi lamalungu omkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba. Umhloli kaMasipalati kufanele alungise amaphepha okuhlola ngokulandela izinqumo ezithathwe emkhandlwini wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba. Noma yikuphi ukulungisa okwenziwe emaphepheni okuhlola ngokulandisa kwesigatshana 1 kuqala ukusebenza ngesikhathi leso esinqunyiwe. a Ungakhipha umyalelo omayelana nezindleko ezingevi esambeni esilingana nezindleko phakathi kukamasipalati nomnikazi mphla, esibalwe ngokulandela isilinganiso esiphezulu kakhulu esinikusetshenziswa emacaleni ombango, enkantolo esungulelwe isifunda ngokulandisa komthetho wezinkantolo zezimantshi, ongunombolo-- 32 we- 1944; futhi b Ungayalela noma yimuphi umuntu owedlulise udaba noma ophikisa udaba alwedlulisiwe, nobona ukuthi akahambisi kahle ekuxoxweni kwaloludaba, noma luchitha isikhathi ngokungadingekile ekunxephezeleni ngezimalingokugcwele noma ngengxenye amalungu omkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba kanye nezinye izindleko zikamasipalati othintekile mayelana nokudluliselwa kodaba. Ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe woHulumeni basemakhaya, angagunyaza umkhandlu wokwedlulisela izindaba ukuba usungule ikomidi noma amakomidi ukuba elekelele ekwenzeni umsebenzi walo. dUngasusa ilungu lekomidi ehhovisi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi; futhi eUngahlonza inqubo yekomidi.

Uma beqala ukwakha amasheya amasha ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambisana nezinjongo ezivamile nezidingo zabo. Konke esikushilo mayelana nokuhlanganisa izinhloso kungafingqwa kulezi zisho ezimbalwa: inhloso yebhizinisi lokulima ukufuna ukufinyelela inzuzo enkulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza zemvelo (izimpahla) ezifana nomhlabathi, amanzi, izindawo zokufuywa, njll., ukuze zisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezinhle esikhathini eside. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bahlela izinhlelo zokubheka ukuze baqhubeke beqoqa ulwazi oluzobavumela ukuba baphendule indlela yabo yokusebenza ngokushesha uma kwenzeka umonakalo. Ukuhlanganisa izinhloso kufana nokubuza "lokhu kusho ukuthini" emsebenzini wokulima, okusho ukuthi sifuna impendulo emibuzweni ethi "Sifuna ukwenza ini, sifuna ukufinyelela ini, sifuna ukufika kuphi?" Ezinye izinhloso nezinhlelo zihlupha. Kubalulekile ukusetha inani elithile lemikhiqizo ngehektare - lokhu kusho ukuthi inani lemikhiqizo elibekwe ebhajethi yonyaka kufanele likwazi ukufezeka. Lokhu kuhluka phakathi kwezindawo zokulima ezithile. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yakho ihlangabezana nezidingo zemakethe - umphathi wemikhiqizo kufanele abeke phambili izinhloso ezizohlangabezana nalezi zidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungafaka izinto ezifana nosayizi, umbala, ikhwalithi yangaphakathi, njll. Uma ofaka isicelo edinga izizathu zesinqumo ngenye indlela, kumele asho indlela kanye nemininingwane okungenzeka idingeka. Uma ngabe umuntu engakwazi ukugcwalisa ifomu ngenxa yokuthi engafundile noma ekhubazekile, umuntu onjena angafaka isicelo ngomlomo. Ocelayo kumela akhokhe inkokhelo yokucela ngaphambi kokwenzeka kwanoma yiyiphi inqubo. Nenkokhelo yokufinyelela, ebalwa ngokubheka izindleko zokuphinde kushicilelwe, ukufuna kanye nesikhathi sokulungisa, izindleko zesibizo kanye nezokuposa. Uma isicelo sifunyanwa Yi-Ofisa Yolwazi, i-Ofisa enjena izokufuna ngesaziso ukuthi ofaka isicelo, ngaphandle kofaka isicelo, ukuthi akhokhe inkokhelo ebekiwe yokucela, ngaphambi kokuqhubeka kulungiswe isicelo. Ofake isicelo onikezwe imvume yokufinyelela irekhodi kumele akhokhe inkokhelo yokufinyelela yokufuna, nokuphinde kukhishwe, ukulungiselelwa kanye nezikhathi esidingekayo ukufinyelela samahora abekiwe okufuna nokulungiselela amarekhodi ukuze avezwe, kufakwa nokwenza ukulungiselelwa ukuze yenziwe ukuba itholakale efomini lokucela. Uma ngabe ukufunwa kwerekhodi sekwenziwe nokulungiselelwa kwerekhodi ezovezwa, kufakwa noma yikuphi ukuhlelwa kokuthi itholakale ngohlobo ecelwe ngalo, kudinga amahora edlula abekwe emthethweni ngale nhloso, i-Ofisa Yolwazi izokwazisa ofake isicelo ukuba akhokhe, njengediphozithi, ingxenye ebekiwe yenkokhelo yokufinyelela okuzodingeka ukuba ikhokhwe uma isicelo sivunyiwe. I-Ofisa Yolwazi izawugodla irekhodi kuze kube yisikhathi lapho ofake isicelo ekhokha izinkokhelo njengoba zibekiwe.

Lo Mthetho ume esikhundleni sesahluko 3 soMthetho ka Zwelonke ngokwezinto eziqukethwe kulo Mthetho. b umsebenzisi ubhekelene nezimali zokugibela ezikhokhwa abagibeli abagibeliswayo futhi, lapho abagibeli bekhokha khona imali eyehlisiwe, nalapho futhi umphathi wesivumelwano evuselela isivumelwano nomsebenzisi; nalapho c osebenza ngezokuthutha engatholi uxhasomali noma ukusizwa ngokwemali kunoma yiliphi ilungu nanoma iyiphi ingxenye kahulumeni ngakho ke ngokwalesisigaba, ukuvuselelwa okwenziwe kosebenza ngezokuthutha ngokwemali yokugibela eyephuliwe angeke ibhekwe njengoxhasomali nanganoma iyiphi enye indlela yokusizwa ngezezimali. Kumele kuphakamiswe amacebo okuphumelelisa ukuhlangana kwezinndlela, ezokuthutha ezifinyeleleka kalula yilabo abanokukhubazeka, ukushintsha nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane nabantu ababenamathuba amancane ngenxa yobandlululo olungeluhle. a Abe nemvume efanele, ilayisense yokusebenza noma amandla esikhashana; futhi b Arejistwe ngokwalo Mthetho maqondana namakhumbi angamatekisi, amatekisi anamamitha, amabhasi kanye nezithuthi zokungcebeleka ngokwesigaba 69, isigaba 77 nesigaba 81. Impendulo: Ukugxila kwezindinganiso zempilo, ugcino noma ukwenza ngcono izikhungo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kumele kube sezinhliziyweni zemisebenzi ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zithola uxhaso olwenziwayo lokugcina izinga eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani imiphumela ye-GEMS iyabhekwa? Impendulo: Ukuhlola imiphumela ye-GEMS kwenziwa ngokuhlaziywa kwemibiko, ukubuyekezwa kwezinsizakalo, nokubandakanya imiphakathi. Lokhu kunika umbono ocacile wokuthi kuyasebenza yini imizamo ethile futhi kuyakwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kubalulekile ukuba nodlame lwempilo kumphakathi? Impendulo: Yebo, udlame lwempilo lukhulu emiphakathini. I-GEMS idinga ukwazisa abantu ngendaba yezenhlalo, ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha kahle, kanye nokubhekelela izidingo zamakhosikazi nezinsizwa ezisebenzayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini esikufundile mayelana ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Siyazi ukuthi i-GEMS ikhulisa indlela esisebenzisana ngayo nezikhungo zezempilo. Imizamo yokubambisana ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuqonda kwethu lokho konke okuhlangene, kufanele sikhuthaze imithombo yakho yokuhlala nezinsizakalo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusizakala kwabantu. Isiqedelo, i-GEMS inikeza amathuba amasha.obuchwepheshe futhi iyindlela ebalulekile yokuqhubeka nokukhulisa izinsizakalo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa kuphela kepha kuthokozisa uxhumano phakathi kwabantu nabakhiqizi bempilo. Ngokuhlanganiswa nokuxhumana, sinethemba lokushintsha impilo yabantu, lapho sihamba phambili funa izinzuzo.

Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okufanele Abasebenzisi Isingeniso Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okufanele abasebenzisi kubalulekile emiphakathini yanamuhla, njengoba kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abahlukahlukene. Lokhu kubaluleka kuvela emibonweni yamakhasimende, abavakashi, kanye nezinhlaka ezisebenzisa izikhungo ezahlukene. Ukuze izikhungo ziphumelele, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izici zikhangisa futhi zihlala zisebenziseka, ukuze abantu bahlale bejabule futhi bephumelelayo. Ukubaluleka Kokwakheka Okusebenziseka Kahle Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo engcono akukhona nje ukwakha imishini, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlonipha izidingo zabantu. Izikhungo ezikhiqiza umuzwa ophumelelayo zikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi nabavakashi, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuhlonipha izidingo ezihlukene zabantu, ikakhulukazi labo abaphila nezinkinga ezithile ezifana nezokuhamba, ukuze kuthuthukiswe umuzwa wabo. Izici Zokwakheka Okusebenziseka Kahle Kunezici eziningi ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe uma kukhulunywa ngokuqhuba ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi. Lezi zici zihlanganisa ukufinyelela kalula, ukwakheka kwezindawo, ukuvumelana, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile. Ukufinyelela kalula kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zokufunda, nezitolo, ukuze abantu abanezinselelo zokuhamba bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni. Ukuklama izikhala ezivulekile, ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kuyasiza ekwakheni umuzwa ophumelelayo nokuthuthukisa ukuhamba kwezakhamuzi.

Ukwengeza, uMnu. Dlamini waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano nabanye abaqashi emzaneni. Waqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umphakathi uqonda kahle izinzuzo zokuhlanganiswa kwemali, futhi waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha, lapho wonke umuntu ebona ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo akukhona nje kuphela umqondo omuhle, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukubona izinzuzo ezithile. Abasebenzi babeyazi kahle indlela yokusebenzisa izinsiza zempilo, futhi imishwalense yempilo yakhula, yenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo. Umsebenzi wakhula, futhi uMnu. Dlamini waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungaba namandla uma uhamba phambili ndawonye. Njengoba lezi zinhlelo ziqhubeka, umphakathi waba nekhono lokwenza izinqumo eziphusile mayelana neminikelo yabo, futhi lezi zimpumelelo zakhula nangaphezu kokulindelekile. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, umphakathi, nabaphathi baziwa njengephazili elihamba phambili. Ekugcineni, uMnu. Dlamini waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukuhlanganiswa kweminikelo yomqashi kwakungaphezulu kokukhokha – kwakungukwakha umphakathi onokuthula, ukuhleleka, nokubumbana. Iminikelo yabo yahlala ibalulekile, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula, uqhubeka ufinyelela phezulu. Lokhu kwakuwukwenzeka kwempumelelo okwakubhalwe emlandweni, futhi kwaba isikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha izizinda eziqinile zokuphila ezintsha.

Umbiko: Ukusetshenziswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ezikoleni Isingeniso Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni sekuyinto ebalulekile emfundweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa amathuluzi afana namakhompyutha, ama-tablet, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile, okwenza kube lula ukufunda nokufundisa. Ubulungiswa bokufunda bukhula ngokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsiza zingasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinga lemfundo. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezemfundo Izikhungo zemfundo ziye zathola izinzuzo eziningi ngokwethula ubuchwepheshe. Ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile kunceda abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olusha kalula. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi zenza kube khona ukufinyelela kwezinsiza eziningi, okwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Lokhu kuthuthukisa umqondo wokuzimela nokuzifundela. Ukuxhumana Nokuqonda Ubuchwepheshe buphinde busebenze njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi. Izinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi zenza kube lula ukuxhumana, futhi abafundi bangabeka imibuzo yabo kalula. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuxhumana esivulekile, lapho abafundi bezwa bekhululekile ukufaka imibono yabo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bejabule futhi bephokophele ekufundeni. Ukuphuculwa Kwamakhono Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, abafundi bakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ahlukene. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile, ama-apps, kanye nevidiyo zokufundisa akwazi ukusiza abafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhono okucabanga, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, kanye namakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo.

Iphakathi lendawo elisha endizeni liyokalwa kahle ngobuchwepheshe ngemuva kwalokhu. a siyoqinisekiswa wuchwepheshe wesiphathimandla sikaHulumeni; noma b uma kusetshenziswa isikali sikagesi, siyohlolwa yiNhlangano yaMaqophelo yaseNingizimu Afrika noma umkhandlu ofanayo omukelwe wuKhomishani. Imininingwane yesisindo nendawo ephakathi nendiza njengoba yethulwe wumkhiqizi wendiza entsha iyomukeleka ekufezeni inhloso yalo mgomo esikhathini seminyaka emihlanu yokuqala, inqobo uma isisindo ngaphandle kokulayisha sitholwe ngesikali sesisindo. Ngenhloso yalo mgomo, isisindo sendiza engalayishile ngendlela eqokwe ngosuku lokugcina lokukala isisindo siyoba yisisindo sendiza kanye nezinjini zayo kuhlangene neziqandisi zenjini, amafutha enjini nezinye izitho zayo, izitho ezixhunywe endizeni neminye imishini enamathele kuyo. Ngaphandle kwemibandela yemigonyana edlule, noma ngasiphi isikhathi, Uma uKhomishani ebona isidingo sokuphepha komphakathi uyofuna indiza ihlolwe isisindo noma imaphakathi layo. Inqubo yokuthola isisindo nalapho uyobhalwa khona umphumela wezibalo zokuthi ibhalanse kangakanani indiza kufanele inqunywe wuMqulu SA- CATS-GMR. Izivivinyo zempoqo nokuhlola kuyokwenziwa ngokulandisa kohlelo olwemukelwe lokulungisa leyo ndiza ngezikhathi ezithile noma ngezikhawu ezinqunyiwe. b noma iyiphi indiza ngaphandle kwaleyo eqondwe endimeni a kufanele kube nohlelo lokulungisa olwemukelwe isigaba esithile sezindiza okufanele zihlolwe ngezikhawu ezithile ezinqunyelwe kanjalo wuhlelo.

c ukwenqabela ukuthi lemoto Igibelise noma yehlise abagibeli kumagatsha athile ngezikhathi ezithile, bese ebeka izikhathi zokugibelisa nokwehlisa abagibeli. d ukuziphatha kwabashayeli bezimoto ezisetshenziselwa ukuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi, okungaba khona kuko ukuncenga nokuhutha ukuze kuheheke abagibeli. Umasipala angangena kwisivumelwano nabantu noma izikhungo mayelana nokubeka noma ukusebenzisa izinto zokusebenza ngokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi ezisezindaweni zabantu, ngokuhambisana nenqubo nemigomo eyenziwe nguMEC, uma ukubekwa noma ukusetshenziswa kuhambelana nezinhlelo zezokuthutha. c angasungula ukuqoqa imininingwane mayelana nezokuthutha abahamba ngezimoto zomphakathi bese eyinika labo abayifunayo bese ekhipha lemininingwane ngezokuthutha kumaphephandaba, imisakazo, omabonakude nanoma yiluphi uhlelo lokusakaza. U MEC angedlulisela noma anikeze amandla noma umsebenzi onikwe yena awudlulisele kumsebenzi wehhovisi loMnyango, ngaphandle kwamandla okwenza imigomo, futhi angawahoxisa lamandla noma umsebenzi noma nini. e kumele kube nohlelo olufanele lwezokuthutha olutshengisa izindlela ezizosetshenziswa noma ezisetshenzisiwe ukusiza abagibeli abanezidingo ezehlukile, njengabantu abakhubazekile. b imigudu esetshenziswa abezokuthutha abathola uxhasomali nabangalutholi. futhi kumele ifake izinhlobo zezithuthi njengoba zibalwe kusigaba 6 njengoba zingabekwa. Lezizinhlelo kumele zibe nemininingwane njengoba ibekwe inqubomgomo noma eminye imithetho kazwelonke noma yesifundazwe.

b uma eqhuba uhlelo oluyimpoqo olwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile, ukuhlola okuqhubekayo noma ukuhlola okuhleliwe kufanele asebenzise uhlu lokuqaphela oluxube umthamo nemininingwane yezivivinyo nokuhlola okuqondwe wumgomo 43.02.8. b aqhube isivivinyo ngokusebenzisa amaqhinga, amasu nemikhuba ejwayelekile ngendlela echazwe wuMqulu SA-CATS- GMR; kanye c asebenzise imishini efanele yokuhlola ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi isivivinyo esingalimazi siqhutshwa ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo ezifanele zomkhiqizi. Noma ngubani olungisa indiza ngendlela echazwe esigabeni semigomo yezimfanelo zebhukwana lomkhiqizi lokulungisa indiza noma eminye imiyalelo yokulisebenzisa ngokuphephile uyoqhuba umsebenzi wokulungisa ngendlela ehambisana naleso sigaba. Ngaphandle kwemvume ebhalwe wuKhomishani, akekho umuntu oyokwenza noma yiziphi izinguquko ezihlanganisa imishini noma impahla exhunywe endizeni ephazamisa noma engaba nomthelela wokuphazamisa indlela indiza elungiswa ngayo noma ukuphephe kwabagibeli noma abanye abantu nempahla. a anike uKhomishani lolo lwazi, imininingwane, izibalo, imibiko yokuhlola, imidwebo noma imidwebo yezintambo zikagesi eziphathelene nesakhiwo sendiza nobufakazi bamandla noma sokulungela kwebhanoyi ukundiza ngemuva koshintsho, kuye ngokuthi uKhomishani yini enye ayifunayo, kanjalo b afake nenkokhelo efanele enqunywe yiNgxenye 187.

Ofake isicelo noma omunye umuntu angakwazi kuphela ukufaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze abonelelwe ngokufanele, emva kokuthi ofake isicelo noma omunye umuntu eqede wonke amasu okukhalaza angaphakathi maqondana nesinqumo se-Ofisa Yolwazi. Uma ofake isicelo noma omunye umuntu ezwiswe ubuhlungu yisinqumo se-Ofisa Yolwazi noma izicelo zabo zokukhalaza kwangaphakathi kungaphumelelanga, angakwazi ukufaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze abonelelwe ngokufanele, ezinsukwini ezingama-30 emva kokwethulwa kwesinqumo sesikhalo. Inkantolo Enamandla omthetho ngaphezu kwalesi sicelo Yinkantolo Enkulu noma enye inkantolo enezinga lesikhundla elifana naleli. Ofaka isicelo kumele alandele izidingo zenqubo eziqukethwe Umthetho, ophathelene nesicelo sokufinyelela irekhodi. Ofake isicelo kumele agcwalise ifomu Elijotshelelwe ku-1, bese elingenisa, ngokuhlanganisa ngenkokhelo yesicelo kanye nediphozi (uma kufanelekile), ku-Ofisa Yolwazi Ekhelini lokuposa, Inombolo Yefeksi noma ikheli le-e meyili elishiwo ku-2 ngenhla. Nekheli lokuposa noma inombolo yefeksi yofaka isicelo. Uma isicelo senzelwa omunye umuntu, ngakho-ke ofaka isicelo kumele anikeze ubufakazi besikhundla enze lesi sicelo ekuso. Ofaka isicelo uzokwaziswa ngokubhalelwa ukuthi unikeziwe noma wenqatshelwe ukufinyelela. Uma ofaka isicelo edinga izizathu zesinqumo ngenye indlela, kumele asho indlela kanye nemininingwane okungenzeka idingeka. Uma ngabe umuntu engakwazi ukugcwalisa ifomu ngenxa yokuthi engafundile noma ekhubazekile, umuntu onjena angafaka isicelo ngomlomo. Ocelayo kumela akhokhe inkokhelo yokucela ngaphambi kokwenzeka kwanoma yiyiphi inqubo.

Imiphi imibhalo odinga ukuyifaka nesicelo sakho? Uma ungathanda ukujoyina u-GEMS, uzodinga ukuhlinzeka ngamakhophi aqinisekisiwe emibhalo ethile, njengomazisi, wakho nowamalunga omndeni wakho, kanye nefomu yesicelo sakho. Xhumana newebusaythi www.gems.gov.za ngohlu oluphelele lwayo yonke imibhalo ongayidinga ukuhambisa isicelo, noma fonela i-Call Centre yethu ku 0860 00 4367. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi uma ungayifaki yonke imibhalo esiyidingayo, u-GEMS ngeke akwazi ukuqhuba isicelo sakho futhi kuyoba nokubambezeleka kuzo kwamukelwe yonke imibhalo edingekayo. Njengenjwayelo, u-GEMS uphokophele ukukulethela izinzuzo zezempilo ezinhle kakhulu ezihambisana nephakethe lakho. Kuze kube manje, sikwazile ukugcina ukunyuka kwemininkelo yakho yanyangazonke ihambisana nokunyuka kwezokwelapha. Ukukunika ukukhetha okuningi yilokho isibophezelo sethu kuwena esingakho. Kunenketho yenzuzo elungele izidingo zezempilo zomndeni wakho kanye nephakethe lakho! Lena iminikelo ephelele yanyangazonke kanti ayiyikhombisi Imali yokwelekela yomqashi.

Inkululeko YaseNingizimu Afrika yakhula emakhaya amaningi, lapho umoya wokukhathazeka ubhujiswa yizinyembezi zothando, umoya wokulwa, nezimo ezinzima. Kwakukhona izinsizwa nezintombi ezazithumele izinkanyezi zokukhanya ezinyangeni ezinzima, zihlabelela izinkanyezi ezingavumi ukuncipha. Lezi zinkanyezi zaziwubukhona bezwi labantu abahluphekayo, abebebhujiswe yizinhlelo zokubandlulula. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yombuso wobandlululo, abantu bahlangana, behlanganyela izimpilo zabo ukuze bakhe ithemba. Kwalapho kwavela khona amaqhawe, abantu abanjengoNelson Mandela, uOliver Tambo, noWalter Sisulu, ababehlonishwa njengezikhumbuzo zekhuluma. Laba bantu baphila ngesibindi, behamba emigwaqweni, behlukanisa imikhuba emibi, bejolisa ekutheni abantu bonke baphile ngokulingana. Ngonyaka ka-1960, kwenzeka umcimbi omkhulu eSharpeville, lapho abahlali bejolisa ekuphikeni ukuhamba kwezokuphepha ezazihambisana nomthetho wobandlululo. Lapho, abantu abavota ngokukhululekile, futhi okwakungamaphoyisa abavikela abanye, bathi bahamba phambili, baphikisa, kodwa ukuhlangabezana nempumelelo bekukude kakhulu. Izinsizwa zathi ziqhamukile, zikhala ngezikhathi ezinzima, kwagcina sekutholakala ukuphila okungaphezu kwemingcele. Ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka kokuphikisana, umoya wezemidlalo, ubuciko, nezincwadi zaba yizikhumbuzo eziqhubekayo zomzabalazo. Ababhali, abaculi, nabanye abathandi bezemidlalo babhalela ukulwela ukukhululeka.

Waqala ukuxoxa naye, uMnumzane Dlamini wabelana ngendaba yakhe, ethi: “Ngiyazama, kodwa ngiyakhathala. Ngithanda umndeni wami, kodwa ngizizwa ngisolwa, ngingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono.” UThandi wathola ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ungumuntu onothando, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe babumshiya edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu, futhi lokhu kumkhathaza. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe akukhona kuphela emzimbeni, kodwa nakweminye imizwa. Wayebona ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa bahlala bephila ngethemba. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, uThandi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano noMnumzane Dlamini. Wamfundisa ukuthi akufanele azizwe edinga ukulwa yedwa. Wamkhuthaza ukuba axoxe nomndeni wakhe, abavumele ukuba bamsize. UThandi wathola ukuthi umndeni kaMnumzane Dlamini wawulungele ukusiza, kodwa babengazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani. Waba yisixhumanisi phakathi kwabo, wakhuthaza ukuxhumana, futhi waba umgibeli wothando. Nokho, njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokusebenza, waqala ukuzizwa edinga usizo. Waqonda ukuthi ukukhathala kwakhe akukwazi ukuncipha. Wazama ukuxhumana nabanye abahlengikazi, kodwa abanye babebonakala bephila kahle, bejabulile. Wacabanga ukuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi abanye abahlengikazi bahlala bephila phakathi kokukhathala, kodwa bahlala bejabulile. Waziswa ukuthi lokhu kwakuyinto ejwayelekile, kodwa wayezwa sengathi akakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noNokuthula, omunye umhlengikazi. UNokuthula wayenobungane, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ungumngane omuhle.

Uma ubona kungcono uyeke - ungaxheguli. Kube nesicelo esivela kumlingani wami emsebenzini othi uDkt Wouter Basson wahoxisa ukuphawula kwakhe okwakubukela phansi abantu besifazane kuleli tshitshi elisemva kwakhe. Yebo, wayebudedengu kulokho, kodwa uBotha Swala uyena owayedale lokho. Emva kophenyo olunzulu oluthathe inyanga olwenziwe yi-Kimberley Organized Crime Unit, ababili bokufika abakuleli zwe ngokungekho emthethweni abaqhamuka e-Uganda baboshwa ngoba besolwa ngokuthi bakhipha abantu izisu ngokungekho emthethweni. Kunabantu abalele phansi endleleni kanti umpheme uwele phezu kwabo kqnye nabantu ababephezu kwawo? Isathelaythi ithumela igagasi eliqoqa ulwazi eziteshini zesimo sezulu, imihosha kanye namanye amaplatifomu asemhlabathini. Lezi zinhlelo zamahlaya ezincike ezindabeni zinabalandeli abaningi kanti zidlalwa emathiyetha omphakathi nakwezinye izindawo ezenziwe kanjalo eThekwini namaphethelo. Ukuhlanza okungasuseka kalula kanye nokuhlola amaphaneli kumele kukhonjiswe ezikhathini ezifanayo njalo uma kushintshwa indlela. Bakutshela ukuthi uRichardson wathatha uStompie ngobusuku obandulele. Iningizimu Afrikha inxenxa bobabili uhulumeni waseSudan kanye neqembu lamavukelambuso ukuba bahloniphe izivumelwano zokubeka phansi izikhali. Ukuchazwa kuyobhalelwa ihhovisi lika Mnu van de Hoven. Lokhu kungakusiza uma ubheka umumo wombukiso wakho. Ukuxhumana kwami noLolo Sono kwakususelwe ebudlelwaneni bakhe noTebogo, omunye wezingqalabutho engangizibeke endlini kaJerry Richardson.

Uma kungeke kwenzeke, umqashi makaqwashise abasebenzi ngalezingozi, indlela yokuyigwema, ukusebenza ngokuvikeleka kanye nokwenza amalinge ezindlela zokuphepha emsebenzini. Kumele kuphawulwe ukuthi akusiwona kuphela umsebenzi kamqashi ukwenza lesibophezelo sempilo nokuphepha. Umthetho uncike emgomweni wokuthi izingozi zasemsebenzini kumele zixazululwe ngokwenza amaxhama okuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi kanye nomqashi. Abasebenzi nomqashi mabehlukaniselane ngesibophezelo sempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenzela. Izinhlangothi zombili kumele zihlaziye izinto ezingaba nobungozi bese ziveza amaqhinga okuvikela nokwenza indawo yokusebenzela iphephe. Ngalendlela, umqashi nabasebenzi bamdibi munye ezinhlelweni lapho abahloli bezempilo nokuphepha bengakwazi khona ukuhlola indawo njalonjalo bese bethula umbiko ekomidini lezempilo nokuphepha. Lelikomidi selingenza izincomo kumqashi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi loluhlelo lusebenza kahle, bonke abasebenzi kumele bawazi amalungelo nemisebenzi yabo njengoba ibhaliwe eMthethweni. Miningi imitheshwana, edingida izihloko ezithile ede ifakwa nguNgqongqoshe wabaSebenzi njalo ngaphansi kwaloMthetho. Umthetho noma imitheshwana iyatholakala eSigayweni semibhalo kaHulumeni (Government Printer), kungaba ngamaGazethe noma itholakale ikhiqizwe ngabanye abashicileli. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha kwabasebenzi usingethwe yiNgosi Enkulu yeZempilo Nokuphepha ngaphakathi eMnyangweni Wabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqhutshwe isiqiniseko sokuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi, sekusungulwe amahovisi alengosi kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

Ngaphandle kwemibandela engaphikiswa yokuba khona kwabo eNingizimu Afrika, kwenziwa uphenyo olukhulu. Kubalulekile, izikhungo zesayensi kufanele zibe nendima ebonakalayo ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe obusha nasekuvezeni imibono emisha phakathi kwentsha yethu. Inani labafundi lenyukile phakathi kwabafundi abamnyama, kodwa leli nani elikhulayo labafundi abamnyama alihambisani nezikhangiso ezazidingeka kulabo bafundi. IKomidi Lezomnotho lenqume ukuthi noma ngabe kube nokwehla okuncane emibonweni yezezimali, ukugcina umgomo wezezimali kusemqoka okwamanje. Izinguquko kumele zicabangele izindaba ezibalulekile ezifana nezimele zabaqondisi, kugcizelelwa izinhlelo zangaphakathi ukuze abaqondisi bakwazi ukuphendula kulokho okwenzekile nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ubulungiswa kubo bonke. Kumele kube nezindlela ezibekiwe zokuhlola ukuhlala kwabesifazane ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha kwezempilo. Amathuba akhona lapha - thina singabantu abakhathalelayo, ngakho asinakumisa futhi siqale ukusebenza. Amabhizinisi aphuma ngaphandle kwekontinent akhipha izinkuni awasebenzisa ukungabi nezimiso eziphathelene nemikhawulo yokuhlasela izinkuni. Lapha, izimali zikahulumeni ezabelwe unyaka nonyaka zokwakha izakhiwo nezimali zokusebenza zirekhodwa. Lo msebenzi usitshela ukuthi, ukuze abantu bethu baphumelele, abesifazane bethu nezingane kumele zingasetshenziswanga ukuthwala izidakamizwa ngalezi zigebengu. Sivumelana nesu lokuthuthukisa elinophahla olukhulu futhi investa izinsiza kubantu bethu bonke. Ukulungiselela umhlaba kube kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukusungulwa kwesistimu nokufeza inzuzo enkulu. Futhi kulabo abaseduze kakhulu nezingozi, bahlupheka kakhulu.

Njengoba ngimi lapha, ngimi nginomuzwa wokujabulo nomuzwa wokudabuka, ngijabule ngoba namhlanje sizofeza iphupho lokufika kwempilo engcono kubantu bakithi KwaNibela, kanti ngidabukile isibili ngoba ezinsukwini eziyisihlanu ezedlule, silahlekelwe yimiphefumulo yezakhamizi zezwe lakithi ezinhlanu ezingenacala ngenxa yeziphepho ezisanda kuhlasela izindawo zakithi eMshwathi, eMandeni naseNdwedwe. Lezizehlakalo zibuye zasikhumbuza iqiniso elibuhlungu lokungabi sesimeni esifanele kwezindlu abantu bakithi abahlala kuzona ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Esikhathini esincane nje kusukela mhla zingu 17 December 2004, kuze kube manje, sesibe neziphepho ezinamandla ezingu 19, uma ngibala nalezi zangoLwesibili esiphuma kulo, nezidale umonakalo ezingxenyeni eziningi zesiFundazwe sakithi. Uma siphosa iso nje emonakalweni odalwe yileziphepho, kuyavela ukuthi abantu abaningi abakhahlamezekile, abantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Siyazi ukuthi akulona iphutha labantu bakithi abahlala emakhaya, kodwa kungenxa yengcindezelo abazithola bengaphansi kwayo, ivela kuHulumeni wobandlululo owawunendluzula, nowawuzishaya indiva izidingo zezindlu zemiphakathi yethu emakhaya nasemalokishini. Ngenxa yomonakalo odalwe yisiphepho ezindlini zabantu, kuye kwadingeka ukuthi sisebenzise isamba semali engu 19,3 wezigidi zamarandi, ukusiza abantu bakithi abakhahlamezekile kanti futhi sisazodinga enye imali ukuze sibhekane nezimo eziphuthumayo zakamuva.

Ukuqasha abasebenzi abadingekayo noma abanele ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo; nokwenza noma yiziphi imisebenzi enikezwe yona ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono kanye noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono noma ehambisana nezinhloso zale mithetho. I-MQA inawo wonke amandla adingekayo ukuze iqhube imisebenzi yayo njengokuchazwe ngenhla kanye nanoma yiziphi amandla anikezwe yona ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. Umbono we-MQA uwukuba nolwazi olwaneleyo nolufanele ukuze kusizakale umkhiqizo, impilo, nokuphepha kwabasebenzi kanye nezinguquko emkhakheni Wokumbiwa Kwezinsimbi Nezinto. Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-MQA uwukwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono emkhakheni wokumbiwa kwezinsimbi ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu omphakathi angathola usizo ehhovisi likaMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme. Wonke ama-oda wemarekhodi kumele athunyelwe kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme usebenzisa ifomu elibekiwe. Ifomu elibekiwe, uma seliqediwe ngokuphelele, lingathunyelwa, lithunyelwe ngekhoriyela, noma lithunyelwe nge-imeyili kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme usebenzisa imininingwane yokuxhumana enikeziwe ngenhla. UMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme, uma esethole isicelo solwazi, kufanele enze isinqumo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 sokuthi anikeze ukufinyelela kumarekhodi afunwayo noma cha.

Mphakathi ohloniphekile weKwaZulu-Natal, udokotela ophakeme, uS.J. Sihlalo, ngivuka lapha ukuze ngethule ibhajethi yonyaka wezezimali ka-2008/2009 yeVoti 8 (uMnyango Wezindlu) ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: "Indlu ayikhethwa kuphela kodwa iyisisekelo sokushintsha." Lesi sihloko sihambisana nokugxila ekuhlanganiseni izindawo zokuhlala njengoba sisondela ekupheleni kohlelo lweminyaka emihlanu. Sisesimweni lapho kufanele sihlolisise ngokucophelela umnikelo wohlelo lwezindlu njengengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza futhi sikhumbule nesimo sokuhlanganiswa kwezomnotho, kwezokuhlalisana, nezinhlelo zomhlaba. Njengoba siqala ukuhlola umthelela wohlelo lokwakha izindlu, siqonda ukuthi ukusebenza kwethu akukwazi ukukalwa kuphela ngenani lezindlu ezakhiwe. Siyaqonda ukuthi izindlu ziyisisekelo esibalulekile lapho ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, ukufinyelela ezidingweni eziyisisekelo, nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kubantu kwakhiwa khona. Kungalesi sizathu sathatha isihloko esihlanganisa lesi siqondiso se "kuhlanganiswa." Njengomnyango, siqonda kahle izinkinga ezikhona kwezindlu esifundazweni sethu. Siqhubeka nokuzibophezela esinqumweni sethu sokukhipha ukuhlinzekwa kwezakhamuzi, ukungaphephi kokuhlala, ukungazinzi kwezakhiwo, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni, izingozi zempilo nokuphepha, nezinye izimo ezikhona ezindaweni zokuhlala ezisemthethweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zethu zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezithuthukile.

Lokhu kudala umoya wokubuyisela emuva, lapho abantu bejolise ekwakheni izithombe ezihlukile, ezihambisana nezinkumbulo zabo. Ubuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokuxhumana Ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhona emkhakheni wemfashini. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitayela zifinyelela kubantu abaningi, izinkampani zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze zikhuthaze imikhiqizo yazo. Izithombe ezinhle, ama-video, kanye nezibuyekezo ezivela kubathandi bemfashini zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezitayeleni ezintsha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bexoxa ngezinto abazithandayo, behlanganyela imibono, futhi bejabulisa abanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile zenza kube lula ukuthola izitayela ezithile. Abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezilula ukuze bathole izimpahla ezihambisana nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi imfashini iyatholakala, futhi abantu bangenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo. Imfashini Nezinkinga Zokuhlukumezeka Nokho, imfashini ayinakho konke okuhle. Njengoba izitayela zishintsha, kunezinkinga ezithile ezivela, ikakhulukazi ezokuhlukumezeka. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuziphatha kahle, lapho bezama ukufanisa izithombe ezibukwayo ezitholakala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu kufanele baphile ngendlela ethile ukuze bahlonishwe, okungaholela ekudumazekeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfashini ibonisa izinkinga ezithinta imvelo. Ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla eziningi kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekonakaleni kwemvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezimpahla abazithengayo.

Nginentokozo enkulu ukuthi ngethule phambi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika Isu likaZwelonke lokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono. Lokhu kungumphumela wocwaningo olunzulu kanye nezingxoxo phakathi koMnyango wezokuSebenza kanye noHlaka lukaZwelonke lwamaKhono. Ngenyanga ka November 2000 kwakudingidwa kabanzi isu elisavivinywa. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke wamaKhono ke usubuyekeze iziphawulo nemibono eminingi ngesikhathi saloludingido. Ngo January 2001 loMkhandlu wethula kimina iziphakamiso malungana namalungiselelo okuqala ezwe lakithi okukhanda isu elibanzi lokuthuthukisa amakhono. Leziziphakamiso nezincomo zangithokozisa kakhulu emoyeni wami ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, kulelicebo sesiye satomula okuyizona zinto zihamba phambili ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono futhi sase sizibekela izinkomba esiyokubona ngazo impumelelo nentuthuko esesiyenzile. Ngalokho ke icebo lihlahlela uMnyango wami, umnyango wezemfundo, kanye neminye imikhakha yokuqeqesha indlela. Okwesibili, iCebo liveza ngokusobala ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuzoba nomthelela ongakanani emkhankasweni kazwelonke wokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. UHulumeni uzinikele entuthukweni yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Yonke iminyango kaHulumeni ibambisene ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bakithi bathola imfundo nokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni kanye namakhono aseqophelweni. Uma singenza isibonelo ngoMnyango wezeMfundo, lomnyango uzinikele ekuthenini kube nezinguquko emfundweni jikelele, nasemfundweni ephakeme. Kanjalo noMnyango wezokuHweba neziMboni ugqugquzela ukusungulwa kwezinto ezintsha kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abazisebenzayo.

Amalungelo phezu komhlaba womunye kanye namalungelo omuntu nje awakwazi ngokomthetho ojwayelekile ukuthi amane asetshenziswe kumbe edluliselwe kumuntu wesithathu futhi kwakunesidingo samalungiselelo abhekene nalokhu.ngqo. Enye injongo yoMthethosivivinywa, ukulungisa isimo mayelana nocwaningo olwenziwayo lwendawo. Ucwaningo olubili lokuqala beluhlinzekelwe ngenxa yokuthi kwenye inkathi kuyenzeka ukuthi kudlule isikhathi eside phakathi kwesigaba sokunquma ngemizila kanye naleso sokudizayina okokuqala. Noma kunjalo-ke, ucwaningo lwesibili alunasidingo uma lokhu kucwaninga okubili kuzokwenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa noma kulakanyane, njengalokhu kuzokwenzeka ngocwaningo loMzila i-Rapid Rail Link. Ngakho-ke, uMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela isigaba 8 (b) soMthetho ukuze kwenziwe ucwaningo lwesibili lungabi nasidingo lapho isiphathimandla esikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi esishiwo emthethweni wezendawo sisithatha njengesingenasidingo ngenxa yocwaningo lwezendawo olwenziwe ezingeni lokunqunywa kwendlela luzibhekele zonke izinto ezifanele. Umthelela woMthethosivivinywa endaweni okuhlalwa kuyo unobudlelwano nokuncishiswa kocwaningo lwendawo njengalokhu sekuchaziwe ngenhla. Kanti uMthethosivivinywa awunawo omunye umthelela endaweni. Akukho ukuxabhelela ezimalini, ngaphandle kokuthi izichibiyelo zingahle zilethe izinqubo ezihlongozwayo ezingahle zingabi nazindleko eziphezulu. Azikho izindleko ezingaphezulu ezingabhekana nohulumeni basekhaya. Ukonga kungahle kubonakale ngokuthi kugwenywe ukuthutha okungenasidingo ezindaweni zaseziteshini nasezindaweni lapho kuhamba khona imizila yezitimela.

a umsebenzi womkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika esenike iSiphathimanda uhlelo lokuvikela loMkhumbi; futhi b umsebenzi womkhumbi womkhumbi enika IsiPhathimandla olunye uhlelo lwalowo mkhumbi uhlelo olubukeziwe , umthethonkambiso- 63 no- 64 kuyosebenza kulolo hlelo oselubukeziwe. Uma uhlelo olubuyekeziwe loMkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika luqala ukusebenza lungena esikhundleni sanoma iluphi olunye uhlelo obelusebenza ngaleso sikhathi. IsiPhathimandla singabhala isaziso sisibhekise kumsebenzi womkhumbi, simyala ukuba asinike sona isiPhathimandla uhlelo oselubukeziwe ngokusho komthethonkambiso- 66. Isaziso kufanele sisho isikhathi okufanele kulethwe ngaso uhlelo olubukeziwe. Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi engasiniki isiPhathimandla uhlelo olubukeziwe singakapheli isikhathi esiqhunyiwe noma esinye isikhathi esingengezwa, isiPhathimandla kufanele sibhale isaziso sinike umsebenzi womkhumbi simazisa ngokwesulwa kokwamukela kohlelo. a uhlelo lwezokuvikela lomkhumbi, loMkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika uhlelo olukhona njengamanje selusebenze iminyaka emihlanu; futhi b IsiPhathimandla singakaze samukele uhlelo olubukeziwe lwalowo mkhumbi ngaphansi komthethonkambiso-66 ngalesi sikhathi. ukwamukelwa kohlelo olukhona kuyokwesulwa ngokwalomthethonkambiso. isiPhathimandla singabhala isaziso sisibhekise kumsebenzi womkhumbi sisule ukwamukelwa kohlelo.

Bavama nje ukuqhubeka ngezindlela ezindala ngoba bayazi bekusebenza kahle. Khumbula ukuthi abazi ukuthi kukhona izindlela ezingcono ezinsha zokulima. Bazovama ukukhetha izindlela ezingenazo izingozi. Bangeke bazame ukutshala uhlobo olunye lwesitshalo ngoba bayesaba ukuthi umndeni awungeke ubenokudla kusasa. Ngala maphrogramu ethu ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa sivulela laba balimi umnyango ukuthintana nezindlela ezinsha zokulima, kodwa kufanele futhi sibavikele bangashoni phansi, ngoba uma bafeyila kungaletha ingozi ekudleni kwasekhaya. Kukhona futhi ezinye izinto ezenza ukuthi abantu bahlale babempofu, njengalokhu: ukomisa kwezulu, izifo, ukungenwa ngamanzi, ukubulalwa kwemithi, ukuguguleka komhlabathi, ubumpofu bomhlabathi nobumuncu bomhlabathi. Uma umpofu, awukwazi ukuvikela izingozi - mhlawumbe awazi ukuthi kukhona inshuwalense nokuyithola kanjani. Lapho iwalakahla lesicotho lishaya izitshalo zakho uzogcina ungenakudla. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umuntu ngumuntu ngokwakhe futhi uphethe ikusasa lakhe ezandleni zakhe. Kodwa kaningi abantu abaphatha umhlaba wethu banamandla ukuzama ukuphatha nokubamba impilo yalabo abangaphansi kwabo. Ukuthuthukisa kufanele kuqale phansi kuye phezulu. Abantu abadinga ukusizwa kufanele baqonde kahle ukuthi usizo luzonikezwa kanjani bese bazokwazi ukuqhubekela phambili. Kaningi amaphrogramu abheka phansi kulabo abafuna usizo enza ukuthi labo balimi bajwayele ukuthola usizo, abasakwazi ukuzisiza bona. Lapho siqonda ukuthi umuntu oyedwa uphethe ikusasa lakhe ezandleni zakhe, sizoqonda futhi akusizi ukunikeza umuntu inhlanzi njalonjalo ngoba akungumthuthukisi, akumfundisi ukuzibambela izinhlanzi. Ukuthuthukisa ngokuqhubekisa kunikeza abantu amandla ukuzisebenzela.

Ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyisihlanu ngesonto. Uma usuku lokuphumula luhlangana nosuku olujwayelekile lokusebenza kwabantu bezihlahla, umphathi kumele akhokhele labo abanganqikazi okungenani imiholo ejwayelekile efana nosuku. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla noma yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakele zokusebenza ngosuku lokuphumula ngosuku lokukhokhela ejwayelekile. Abaphathi kumele baziqhenye ngabasebenzi bezihlahla abajwayele ukuba basebenze ebusuku mayelana nezimo ezibucayi ezihambisana nomsebenzi kanye nelungelo labasebenzi ukuba bahlolwe uma bebuza njalo lapho izindleko zikhokhelwa umphathi. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla olindele umcalla inzuzo yokulinda. Le nzuzo kumele ibe okungenani u-10% wemiholo ejwayelekile yomsebenzi. Isivumelwano singasusa isikhathi sokuphumula sokudla kumsebenzi wezihlahla osebenza ngaphansi kwamahora ayisithupha ngosuku. Isivumelwano sokubhala singanikeza okungenani amahora angama-60 wesikhathi sokuphumula njalo ngesonto lesibili noma sinciphise isikhathi sokuphumula ngesonto ukuze sifinyelele amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngesonto, uma isikhathi sokuphumula sikhuliswa ngokulinganayo ngesonto elilandelayo. Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuphuma ezingathathwa ngumsebenzi wezihlahla? Kungaki izinsuku ezingathathwa ngumsebenzi wezihlahla ngonyaka? Umsebenzi wezihlahla unelungelo lokuthatha izinsuku ezintathu zokuphumula unyaka nonyaka. Kwenzekani uma usuku lokuphumula luhlangana nezinsuku zokuphumula? Yini ebalulekile mayelana nezinsuku zokuphumula? Ukusekelwa noma isikhathi esibaliwe ngokusekelwe kumalungelo okuphuma siyi-36 izinyanga ezithathwe ekubhaleni kwezinsuku ezisebenze phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha. Umsebenzi wezihlahla use

Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel wathuthuka. Kwakukhona abaculi abaninzi ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, behamba behamba, bejolise ekukhulumeni izindaba zabo. UThandi, umculi owayenothando olukhulu lokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, waba yisibonelo esihle. UThandi wayengumuntu ophila empilweni enezinkinga, kodwa umculo wakhe wawuhamba phambili. Waqala ukucula izingoma ezazikhuluma ngothando lukaNkulunkulu, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uyasithanda, noma ngabe sikhona esikhathini esinzima. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, umoya wokukhuluma, umoya wokukhumbula. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Umculo we-gospel wawungowokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa wawuphinde ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo.
