Ukubhujiswa Kwenziwa Ngenxa Yezimayini Ngiyanibingelela, ngithanda ukucacisa ngendaba ebalulekile ethinta impilo yethu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo zihlala khona. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izimayini zineziphumo ezinzima emvelweni? Lokhu akukhona okungaqondakali, kodwa kuyinto esiyibona nsuku zonke. Masikhulume ngalezi zimayini. Ziyindawo lapho kudingeka khona izinsiza eziningi ukuze kuqhubeke imisebenzi yokumba, okwakha izinkinga ezinkulu zemvelo. Lokhu kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemvelo, okuvulela indlela yokubhubhisa izitshalo nezilwane. Uma umhlaba uthinteka, izitshalo ziningi ziya phezulu, kanti izilwane zihlala zikhathazekile. Ucabanga kanjani uma izimayini ziqala? Umhlaba ushintsha ngendlela engalindelekile. Izingadi zethu, izindawo ezijabulisayo, zonke ziye phansi. Lokhu akukhona nje ukubhujiswa, kodwa kudala izinkinga zempilo ezinzima. Abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo ezinezimayini bahlupheka kakhulu. Uhlanga lwezempilo lungaphazamiseka, futhi imiphumela ingaba yingozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngamanzi. Izimayini zikhona ezindaweni eziningi ezinamachibi, imifula, nezindawo zokugcina amanzi. Lapho kudingeka ukumba, amanzi angase aphazamiseke, okwenza kube nzima kubantu nabanye abahlala kulezi zindawo. Ucabanga ukuthi kuzoba kanjani uma amanzi engatholakali? Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomoya omncane. Njengoba izimo zokusebenza zikhula, izimayini zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenzise izindlela eziphusile, kodwa akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi lezi zindlela zinezinselelo. Abanye abanikazi bezimayini bazama ukwenza kahle, kodwa abanye bahlala bejolise kuphela emalini.

Nkosikazi ophakeme; uMphakathi noMphakathi oPhakeme bePhalamende; Ozakwethu abahloniphekile bePhalamende; uMongameli nozakwethu abahloniphekile beKomidi Lezempilo. Abaphathiswa kanye nabavoti; Oholayo bendabuko phakathi kwethu; uMphathi weSikhungo, uDkt. Busi Nyembezi; Abaphathi bezigaba ezahlukene kuhlanganise nabaphathi bezempilo bezifunda, abaphathi bezibhedlela, amalungu ebhodi lezibhedlela, amalungu eBhodi Yokubuyekezwa Kwezingqondo, Amakhomidi Ezempilo, Abadokotela bendabuko, kanye nazo zonke izigaba ezibandakanyekayo eMnyangweni Wezempilo. Abanye abahloniphekile abakhona lapha engingabakhumbuli; Bafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Izinselelo ezimangalisayo esibhekene nazo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, sizama ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo obekwe ezikhwameni zethu ngenxa yokwehla okukhulu kwezinga lobubha okwenza umsebenzi wethu ube nzima kakhulu. Masihlangane njengabantu baleli gumbi elihle kulolu hlelo lokulwa nobubha, ukwephulwa kwamalungelo abesifazane nezingane, izifo, nokukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwethu ekunakekeleni amalungelo abantu kanye nobuntu bomuntu ngamunye. Izindaba zezempilo kanye namalungu abahloniphekile yizihloko eziyinhloko ezixoxwa ezinkundleni ezibhekana nokuthuthukiswa kokuphila komphakathi kanye nomnotho. I-International Rural Women's Conference ibanjwe eThekwini njengoba sikhuluma. Siyazi ukuthi kuleli gumbi, abesifazane benza u-53% wabantu bonke futhi iningi labo bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, izifo, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwezinsiza.

(Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ayihambisani naleyo yezenhlalakahle). Okwamanje, sigcina uxhaso lwe-GDP kazwelonke ku-0.7%, okuyingxenye yesithathu ye- OECD average futhi encane uma kuqhathaniswa nenani elihambisanayo lamazwe athuthukile afana neNingizimu Korea neFinland. Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuphambili kunezimpempe ezinkulu ekwehliseni izindleko emnothweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala izindlela ezizinzile zokudlulisela ulwazi nobuchwepheshe ezinkampanini (ikakhulukazi ku-SMMEs). Ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yamasiko. Izinhlelo zezimali zonyaka zalesi sikhungo zika-2000/2001 zifaka imicimbi ehlukahlukene ezindaweni zomphakathi. Singachaza ukuqwashisa komphakathi ngokwesayensi, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokubhekana ne-HIV/AIDS ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe, nokusungulwa kohlelo lweMlando Womlomo. Ukugcina nokuthuthukisa ifa. Ifa liyingxenye ebalulekile yobunikazi. Iningi leNingizimu Afrika linezakhiwo zefa ezithuthukiswe ngokwanele nakuba zingaxhaswanga kahle (njengeminyuziyamu, izinkalo zokulawula). Ukuguqulwa kwalezi zakhiwo kubalulekile emnothweni nasekultureni. Ukuhlanganiswa nokwandiswa kweminyuziyamu emihlanu yomlando wezimo nezithombe ezintathu eKapa: umlando wezimo, umlando wamasiko, nomlando wezempi, kubonise inzuzo enkulu. Sekuphakanyisiwe futhi kwethulwe kwiCabinet. Le ndlela iphakanyiswe njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi eziyi-11 zaseNingizimu Afrika njengoba kuqinisekiswe ngumthethosisekelo. Le ndlela inikeza indlela yokuhamba phakathi kwezilimi.

Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile ezivumela abathengi ukuba bafake izicelo zokugunyazwa kalula, kanye nokuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubathengi ukufinyelela odokotela babo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isiphetho Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS idinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinqubo zisebenza kahle ukuze abathengi bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezi zinqubo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubodokotela, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, i-GEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola usizo olufanele, ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zikhona kubo bonke abathengi.

Umthetho okufanele ufundwe noMthetho Inombolo 71 ka-1962.

Izidingo zamaphepha omholo zamalungu aqashiwe (GEMS employed member salary slip requirements) Ukuze amalungu aqashiwe e-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) akwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi abenamaphepha omholo afanele. Lezi zidingo zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, futhi akwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo zempilo zabo ngendlela efanele. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaphepha omholo ahlangabezana nezidingo ezisemthethweni. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda amaphepha omholo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amaphepha omholo ayisithombe esicacile sokwaziswa kwemali eyamukelwe emsebenzini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imininingwane efana nemali eyamukelwe, izaphulelo, nezindleko ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amaphepha omholo akhe ahlanzekile, acacile, futhi anembile ukuze akwazi ukuwasebenzisa kalula. Isigaba 2: Izidingo eziyisisekelo zamaphepha omholo Lapho uthola amaphepha omholo, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ahlangabezana nezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, amaphepha omholo kufanele abe nezinombolo ezisemthethweni, ezifana nenombolo yempesheni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi luhambisana nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube nenombolo ye-employee ID, ukuze kube lula ukuhlela nokuhlola izinsiza. Isigaba 3: Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amaphepha omholo ahambisana nezidingo ze-GEMS. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo ezitholakele zifanele izindleko ezibekwe yi-GEMS. Uma amaphepha omholo engahambisani nalokhu, amalungu kufanele axhumane ne-HR (Human Resources) ukuze athole usizo.

Ulimi lomuntu ngandlela thile "luyisikhumba sesibili" , ukuba nokuthile ngokwemvelo komuntu wangempela, esikusebenzisa esethula ngakho amathemba nezifiso, ukuphimisa imicabango yethu nokuyigugu, ukuhlola ulwazi kanye namasiko ethu , kanye nokwakha umphakathi wethu nemithetho ewuphethe . Ngolimi sikwazi ukusebenza njengabantu emhlabeni oguquka njalo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethile luyaziswa ngumThethosivivinywa wamaLungelo nomThethosisekelo wethu ovumayo ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziwumthombo okumele usetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi , emva komsebenzi wokubonisana ngempela, siyakwazi ekugcineni ukwethula uhlaka lwenqubomgomo yolimi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Loku ukuqedelelwa komsebenzi owaqalwa ngonyaka we-1995, lapho ngaqoka iQembu lokuSebenza lokuHlela uLimi (LANGTAG) ukuze lingeluleke ngohlaka oluhlangene lohlelo lwenqubomgomo yolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sasisemqoka ngombono wokungabikhona kokumelana kokwehluka kwezilimi nomphumela wokuthi indlela "yokusebenza kobuliminingi iyinkinga yezinkokhelo" okubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu , kanye nokwanda kwezinsolo ezivela kwabaphethe bolimi ngokujwayelwa kokusetshenziswa kolimi lunye eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka LweNqubomgomo yoLimi kaZwelonke lusekelwe phezu komphumela wezindlela zokusebenzisana ngokubonisana, ngokusebenzisa kokubili i-LANGTAG kanye futhi namandla omNyango ngokuhlanganyela neQembu lokweLuleka leNqubomgomo yoLimi.

Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu empilweni yazo yesikole, ngoba kubasiza ukuthi bafunde ukulawula ukucindezeleka, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi semiphakathi ethina. Ukuze uthole okuningi, imidlalo ibavumela ukuthi bazitholele izindlela ezintsha zokuqhamuka nezixazululo, okwakha ukucabanga okuthuthukile. Ubuciko Bokubambisana Nempumelelo Imidlalo yesikole ifundisa abantwana ukuthi basebenze ndawonye. Ubuciko bokubambisana buvelela lapho izingane zisebenza njengeqembu. Lokhu kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ukusebenza eqenjini kudingeka emikhakheni eyahlukene, kusukela emsebenzini kuya ekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Isimo sokuncintisana nobumbano kungenza abantwana bazwe befana ngoba benza okuhle ngokuhlanganyela. Ukuze sikhulise lezi zinto, izikole kufanele ziqinise izinhlelo zokuhlela imijaho nemidlalo yokubambisana. Izifundo Zokubekezela Zokuhlola Imidlalo yesikole nayo ifundisa abantwana ukubekezela. Izingane zithola ukuthi ukufinyelela empumelelweni kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukwenza umsebenzi obalulekile ekufundeni. Ngokuhlanganyela esigabeni sokubhekana nezithiyo, umntwana ufunda ukuthuthuka, ahlule ubunzima, futhi aqhubeke yini akwenziwa. Lokhu kubalulekile phakathi kwezizukulwane, ngoba kwenza kube lula ukuza nezixazululo ezintsha. Umthelela Wokugqugquzela Nokuqwashisa Ngempilo Ezinhle Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, ukudlala kwemidlalo yesikole kufanele kudlale indima enkulu ekuqwashiseni ngempilo. Izinhlelo zokudla eziphilile, ukwelulekwa kahle, kanye nezindlela zokugcina umzimba unempilo zibalulekile. Uqhakambisa umqondo wokuhlala unempilo, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokuqonda indlela yokuphila kahle ngoba imidlalo ibalulekile ukuze izingane zifeze lokho.

Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwabavoti Nentando Yeningi Isingeniso Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumula, futhi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi ubani okufanele ahole, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ezikhombisa izifiso nezidingo zomphakathi. Sizobheka izinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokubamba iqhaza kwabavoti ukuze siqonde indlela yokwakha intando yeningi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Indima Yabavoti Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abavoti banendima ebalulekile ekwakheni intando yeningi. Abavoti bamele izwi labantu, futhi kufanele baqonde ukuthi izinqumo zabo zinefuthe elikhulu ezinqumweni ezithathwayo. Ukuze abavoti baqonde kahle, kufanele bahlale befundiswa ngamalungelo abo, izinqubo zokhetho, kanye nezinketho ezikhona. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubhalisela Ukhetho Isinyathelo esilandelayo ukubhalisela ukuvota. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuphela abavoti ababhaliwe abavuma ukuvota. Ukuze ubhalise, kufanele uvakashele ihhovisi lezakhamizi lendawo yakho noma usebenzise izinsiza eziku-inthanethi. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwakho luyiqiniso. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvota ngosuku lokhetho. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izinketho Zokhetho Ngemuva kokubhalisela ukuvota, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinketho zokhetho. Lokhu kusho ukufunda ngababambiqhaza, izinhlelo zabo, kanye nezinto abazimisele ukuzifeza uma bephumelela. Ungafunda ngezinhlelo zabo ezisemthethweni, ubuke izinkulumo zabo, futhi uxoxe nabanye abantu ukuze uthole imibono ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha umuntu ofanele.

Basebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze benze ucwaningo futhi babhale izidingo zomphakathi wethu behamba emakhaya. Idatha ephelele yeziqalo izosivumela ukuthi sibone amazinga obubha, isimo sempilo, kanye nezinga lemfundo emphakathini. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka isifunda ngemininingwane eyanele ukuze kuqhamuke nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo ezizoba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bethu. Izindleko ezihambisana nokuhola abantu abazithandayo abaningi ukuze benze ucwaningo lwezindlu emiphakathini ziyaqoqwa, ngakho-ke imali yalolu hlelo izotholakala uma isabelomali sithathwa sika-2010/11. Okwamanje, iminyango kahulumeni ephethe lolu hlelo kufanele isebenzise imali etholakalayo ukuze iqhube lezi zinhlelo. Izinto ezibalulekile esifundeni ukuze sifinyelele lezi zimpumelelo eziyi-12 zisazothola ukwesekwa, futhi ozakwethu, oNgqongqoshe, bazochaza lokhu uma beveza izabelomali zabo. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlalisana kahle nokuziphatha okuhle emphakathini. Isimo somnotho esingesihle samanje sikhulise imibuzo mayelana nokuziphatha nokubaluleka, futhi kukhona umuzwa oqinile wokuthi umhlaba udinga umqondo omusha wezomnotho ozosibonisa intuthuko. Kumele sifunde eziphuthumayo esizenzile kanye nezokwenziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Sizokwenza le mkhankaso ngombhalo othi YENZA OKUNGEKHO KAHLE NGOKUNCANE. Asizukwehlisa izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu, kodwa sizogxila ekusebenzeni ngokuzikhandla, ngokucophelela, nangokuhlakanipha ukuze siphumelele kulolu simo somnotho esingesihle. Nokho, namuhla sihlangana emoyeni wokubheka impumelelo. Umnotho wethu awuhambi kahle njengamanje.

Itayari yakho ingagugula ngokushesha esontweni lokuqala uma ingafakiwe kahle noma uma i-valve ivuleka umoya. Bheka umoya kumatayi akho nsuku zonke esontweni lokuqala ngemuva kokufaka ama-tire amasha. Ngemuva kwalokho, hlola umoya kumatayi akho njalo. Njalo umshayeli kufanele abe ne-gauge ye-air pressure yakhe. Ama-gauges e-air atholakala kumagaraji angase angasebenzi. Umoya ongafanele we-tire ungumthombo wezingozi eziningi zemaTaxi. Thola umkhuba wokuhlola umoya kumatayi akho. Qinisa ama-bolts kumawheels akho. Izingxenye eziningi zenzeka ngoba umshayeli ucabanga ukuthi bazohamba noma ama-bolts aphukile. Ungazami ukuhamba ngebhasi eline-bolts eziphukile noma ezikhishiwe. Ingabe lokhu akukhona nje ukunakekela itayari okuyisisekelo? Ungafaka ama-tire ashibhile futhi ungawakhathaleli - kodwa lokhu kungakubiza ukuphila kwakho. Lokhu kubiza kakhulu kunezintela ezinhle ezinakekelwe kahle. Ungacabangi ukuthi ashibhile kungcono! Ama-tire ashibhile - njengezintela eziphindwe kabili, noma ezivuselelwe noma ezibuyisiwe - angakubiza ukuphila kwakho kanye nabagibeli bakho. Ungazami ukufaka ama-tire aphindwe kabili noma avuselelwe. Ama-tire ashibhile abiza kakhulu ekugcineni - ngoba adinga ukunakekelwa okuningi futhi awahlali isikhathi eside njengezintela ezintsha. Ama-tire anekhwalithi ephezulu angase abize kakhulu kodwa abiza kancane ekugcineni ngoba kulula ukuwakhathalela futhi ahlale isikhathi eside. Ukulayisha kakhulu imoto kubangela ukuguguleka kwetayari futhi kungabangela ukuphuma, okuholela ezingozi nasekufeni. Ungacabangi ngentengo ye-tire. Cabanga ngokulondoloza kumatayi nasekuphepheni kwabagibeli bakho.

i ngenxa yokuthi kunoshintsho esimweni esihambisana nezokuvikela ezokuthutha zasolwandle; noma ii ngenxa yokuthi kunoshintsho olungaba nomthelela kwezokuvikela ezokuthutha zasolwandle;noma iii nezinye izizathu, uMqondisi-Jikelele angabhala isaziso ayale lowo obambe iqhaza ukuba anike uMqondisi-Jikelele uhlelo olubukeziwe ngokomthethonkambiso- 47. Isaziso kufanele sisho isikhathi okufanele lulethwe ngaso uhlelo oselubukeziwe. Uma ngabe lowo obambe iqhaza enganiki uMqondisi-Jikelele uhlelo olubukeziwe esikhathini esiqhunyiwe, noma ngesinye isikhathi eselulwe nguMqondisi-Jikelele, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele abhalele obambe iqhaza isaziso emazisa ngokwesulwa kohlelo olukhona. a uhlelo lwezokuvikela lwasolwandle lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle uhlelo olukhona selusebenze iminyaka emihlanu ; futhi b uMqondisi-Jikelele engakaze amukele uhlelo olubukeziwe lwalowo obambe iqhaza ngokomthethonkambiso- 47 ngaleso sikhathi, ukwamukela kohlelo olukhona kuyesulwa ngokwalomthethonkambiso. i aguqule uhlelo ngaphansi komthethonkambiso- 46; noma ii abukeze uhlelo ngokomthethonkambiso -48, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele abhale isaziso asinike lowo obambe iqhaza asule ukwamukelwa kohlelo. a uhlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezokuvikela olwandle lusebenza; futhi b lowo obambe iqhaza ehluleka ukulandela uhlelo, uMqondisi-Jikelele angabhala isaziso asinike lowo obambe iqhaza emazisa ngokwesulwa kokwamukela kohlelo.

uma umuntu ehluleka ukwenza lokho okushiwo isaziso ngekomthethonkambiso 2, lowo muntu wenza icala elingajeziswa ngokukhokhiswa inhlawulo noma ukuvalelwa ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12. Umthethonkambiso 5 ngeke usebenze uma umuntu enesizathu esizwakalayo sokwahluleka. Umuntu angeke axolelwa ukuba anganiki ulwazi oluphathelene nokulandelwa kwezokuvikela ngaphansi kwesigaba- 98 ngesizathu sokuthi ulwazi lungamthwesa icala noma lungaholela ekutheni ahlawuliswe. a ulwazi; kanye b nokunikwa kolwazi; kanye c noma iluphi ulwazi, umbhalo noma into etholwe ngenxa yalolo lwazi, ngeke kwamukelwa njengobufakazi obuzosetshenziswa kumuntu othwese icala lobugebengu, noma ngenye inkundla ephathelene nokukhokhiswa inhlawulo, ngaphandle kwenkundla okukhulunywa ngayo kumthethonkambiso- 100. ulwazi lunikwe ngokulandela noma ngenhloso yokulandela umthetho waseRiphablikhi. a ulwazi lokuhambisana nezokuvikela olunikwe ngumuntu esikhundleni somgwamanda kuthathwa ngokuthi lunikwe ngumgwamanda; futhi b ulwazi noma isimo sengqondo noma imuphi umuntu osebenzela noma othintekayo ekuphathweni komgwamanda kuthathwa ngokuthi ulwazi noma isimo sengqondo somgwamanda. Icala okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso 1 linesijeziso uma likulahlile ungahlawuliswa imali noma uvalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12. a ukuvimbela noma ukuthiya izenzo ezithile ezingenziwa yilowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezolwandle oshiwo umyalo wokuphoqwa; noma b oyala lowo obambe iqhaza obizwe umyalo wokuphoqwa kuba ayeke ukwenza okuthile.

USilomo ugcina ngokuthi akeze umakoti azombona? Abaphansi Amadlozi, abangasekho, asebadlula emhlabeni. Adabuke kakhulu uBrendon wawakhipha amaphephandaba kamkhulu wawendlala. Phakathi kwawo kwaphuma iheheba lencwadi. Yaphuthunywa. Yacoshwa. Yafundwa. Yayingeyokwaba ifa. Ipulazikazi likamufi lalabelwe isikole sabancane eNelpmekaar esasifunda uBrendon. Indlu yakhe eyayisedolobheni eKipithawini namakhulu ezinkulungwane zamarandi wayekwabele uBrendon nonina. Bakhamisa oVera noWest. Aqhamuke angakabizwa uMaMthembu lowo. Okusho ukuthi ubelalele sonke lesi sikhathi. Usho omama! Acasuke okunye uShange. Aqalise ukushafuza futhi uGule. Alande ngendlela aqhasha ngayo uMaMthembu. Yini le abathi iya ngasethunjini? Kwathula kwathi cwaka endlini. Abanye abantu babhekana. Abanye babheka phansi. Abanye bamjamela. Babefisa ukuzwa kahle yonke into engakagqibuki ngoba kwase kubonakala ukuthi zase zihuba sakusha, UMfundisi Bukhosini ngamakhela uzungu ngoba ngangifuna ukuphatha. Ngambulalela esizibeni esisegumbini lomfula. Ngambophela etsheni elikhulu, ngamphonsa khona wazika Wathi ukuthula isikhashana uNzuza, ekhefuzela kabuhlungu, elokhu ekhoshobala, kusobala ukuthi yayimphethe indoda ngensimbi eshisayo. 2.11 Libulawa yini ikhehla? Uyacabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kukhona olume uthishomkhulu indlebe Acabange isu okumele alenze. Acabange ukushaya achithe, aphule amagatsha. Acabange ukuqunga isibindi angabaleki. Phela uNkonka wake wamuthi fahla ngamalungelo oMthethosisekelo.

Faka isicelo ngokwezidingo zakho! Ubani ongafaka isicelo sezidingo? Noma ubani ngaphandle kwezinkampani ezibhaliswe ngokuqondile emthethweni kanye nezinhlangano. Umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 kumele asizwe ngumzali wakhe noma umgibeli ofanele. Ubani ongafunwa ngezidingo? Ngaphandle kukahulumeni, noma ubani angafunwa kuhlanganise nezinkampani, izinhlangano, imiphakathi, kanye nanoma yini esebenza endaweni ephethwe yilelo qembu. Yimalini engaphezulu kokuthi ingafunwa? Imali engaphezu kuka-R7000. Uma izidingo zakho zidlula u-R7000, ungafaka izicelo zemali engaphansi kwalokho ukuze isicelo sakho samukelwe enkantolo yezicelo ezincane. Yiziphi izimangalo ezingathathwa kule nkantolo? Izicelo zemali ezidlula u-R7000. Izicelo eziphikisana nohulumeni. Izicelo ezihlobene nesimo sokucabanga somuntu. Izicelo ezicela isenzo esithile esingavumeli ukukhokhelwa, ngaphandle kwezimo ezihilela ukudluliswa kwezinsiza noma impahla ezinzile noma ezihambayo ezidlula u-R7000 ngenani. Ingabe udinga ukufaka enkantolo yezicelo ezincane? Cha, ungakhetha ukuthi ufuna ukufaka enkantolo yezicelo ezincane noma enye inkantolo engakwazi ukulalela icala lakho. Ukuze uthole ummeli kanye nosizo lwabo ekulungiseleleni isicelo. Awuvunyelwe ukuba umelwe ummeli ojwayelekile noma omdala. Nokho, ngentengo yakho, ungacela iseluleko kumemeli ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke. Abasebenzi benkantolo kanye nosizo lwezomthetho enkantolo yezicelo ezincane bangakusiza ngaphandle kokukhokha. Noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika lungasetshenziswa kule nkantolo.

Induna yomkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe kufanele uma icelwa isikhulu esigunyaziwe inikezele amarekhodi ezokuvikela alowo mkhumbi agcinwe emkhunjini. Uma Induna yomkhumbi yephula umthethonkambiso 1 , induna noma umsebenzi womkhumbi walowo mkhumbi anganikwa umyalo ngokwesahluko -2. Lomthethonkambiso ubeka izinyathelo zokuphepha okufanele zisetshenziswe yimikhumbi elawulwa kwamanye amazwe. Ngaphandle uma kushiwo okunye, umthethonkambiso 3 no 7 kufanele ngaso sonke isikhathi imikhumbi isebenzise izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga- 1. Uma kusebenza ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 2 ngoba umkhumbi usechwebeni elilawulwa ngezokuvikela lapho kusebenza khona ezokuvikela olwandle izinga -2, umkhumbi kufanele usebenzise izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga- 2. Uma kusebenza ezokuvikela izinga -3 kulowo mkhumbi ngoba umkhumbi usechwebeni elilawulwa ngezokuvikela lapho kusebenza khona ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 3, umkhumbi kufanele usebenzise izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -3. Uma uMqondisi-Jikelele ememezela ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 17 2 ukuthi kusebenza ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 2 kulowo mkhumbi, lowo mkhumbi kufanele usebenzise izinyathelo se-ISPS izinga- 2.

Ngaphakathi kweminye yemisebenzi, kodwa kube kungenamkhawulo kulena, kukhona ukuhlolwa kwemikhumbi, izisetshenziswa kanye nempahla, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkhumbi kanye nezikebhe zihlonyiswe ngokulandela amazinga abekiwe. I-SAMSA iphinda futhi ihambise iphinde inikeze iziqu okudingeka ukuthi umuntu abe nazo uma esebenza emikhunjini. Ikhomishana Yamalungelo esintu yaseNingizimu Afrika kumele yakhe umhlahlandlela oqukethe ulwazi olunje njengokuvumelekile okungadingwa yinoma yimuphi umuntu ofisa ukusebenzisa noma yiyiphi ilungelo elicatshangwe Ngumthetho. Izimemo ezifunyenwe zokuyovakasha/ukuxhumana namanye amazwe/izinhlangano/okungaba ngamaklayenti kanye nomphakathi. Akukho isaziso esishicilelwe ngokulandela Umthetho. I-SAMSA iphatha ukuvikela ukungcoliswa kanye namandla okuphendulela, ngokuhlanganyela Nomnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha. Ukwethulwa kwanoma yiyiphi indaba kumele kuqondiswe ku-CEO ye-SAMSA. Uma ngabe isicelo sokufinyelela ulwazi senqatshelwa noma sithathwa ngokulandela Isigaba sama-22, 26 noma sama-29 Somthetho, ocelayo angafaka isikhalo sangaphakathi ngokuphikisana nesinqumo se-Ofisa Yolwazi. Omunye umuntu angakwazi naye ukufaka isikhalo sangaphakathi ngokuphikisana nesinqumo se-Ofisa Yolwazi, ukunikeza isicelo ukufinyelela ulwazi. Isikhalo kumele sifakwe efomini Elijotshelelwe ku-2, bese uyifaka ku-Ofisa Yolwazi kuleli kheli lokuposa, inombolo yefeksi noma ikheli le-i-meyili elishiwo ku-2 ngenhla, ezinsukwini ezingama-60 emva kokuthola isaziso sokwenqaba. Nekheli lokuposa noma inombolo yefeksi yokhalazayo.

Nansi thina, sesingene esikhathini sesibili sonyaka. Sithemba ukuthi kuzoba unyaka ojabulisayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo kubo bonke amalungu. Ndawonye, kukhona okuningi esingakwenza ukuze sifinyelele emsebenzini wethu - asizweni uma unazo izimvo mayelana nezinsizakalo le Nhlangano okufanele iyinikeze. Khumbula ukuthi imali yokuba yilungu yale nyaka kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMashi. Amarekhodi athunyelwa ngoDisemba. Uma ungakawatholi, ucela ukuthi uxhumane nehhovisi le-SATI ukuze uthole ikhophi. Khumbula ukuthi ubulungu bezinkampani buyatholakala mayelana nezinsizakalo nezihhovisi. Siyabonga kulabo balungu abakhokhile. Ucelwa ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi uyazisa umregistrar ngokuqhubeka kokukhokha kwakho. Imiphumela yocwaningo lwamakhono olwakamuva iboniswe kuwebhusayithi ye-SATI. Amalungu ayakhumbulelwa ukuthi lezi azikho "ezisemthethweni" noma "ezibekiwe." Ngokomthetho, asivunyelwe ukusetha amanani. Lokho esikwenza ukuqoqa ulwazi lokuthi yini evame ukukhokhwa futhi senze lelo lwazi lutholakale. Ngakho-ke, sicela amalungu angasho ukuthi "i-SATI iphakamisa lezi zintengo." Amalungu nabanye bangazisebenzisa ukuze baqhathanise namazinga abo, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi kuzohlala kukhona abaqashi abakhokhayo ngaphezu noma ngaphansi kwalezi zintengo. Muva nje, sathola ukuthi uMnu. PF (Flippie) du Toit washona ngoFebhuwari 2007. UMnu. Du Toit wayengumuntu wokugcina ophilayo kulabo baqale i-SATI. Saxhumana naye ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka komcimbi wethu wokugubha iminyaka engu-50 ngo-2006, kodwa impilo yakhe ayivumelanga ukuba abambe iqhaza ngqo kulolo mcimbi.

Loku ikwenza ngokuthi ihlele leyo miphumela okufanele izuzwe umfundi nomfundi ekugcineni kwako konke okwenziwayo. Nokukwazi ukukhombisa ukuqondisisa ukuthi umhlaba wakhiwe yinhlanganisela yezingxenye ezahlukene ngokuthi akwazi ukubona ukuthi ingqikithi yokuxazulula izinkinga ayikwazi ukuzimela yodwana ithi qekelele. Abakwazi ukuthi bazame amaqhinga amaningana okukwazi ukufunda ngempumelelo. Abakwazi ukubamba iqhaza njengezakhamuzi ezithembekile ekubhekeleni izimpilo zemiphakathi abakhe nayo ezindaweni abakuzo, kuzwelonke nasemhlabeni wonke jikelele. Abakwazi ukuba nozwela nokuthinteka ngamasiko nobuhle obukhona ezimweni ezahlukene zokuhlalisana kwabantu emiphakathini eyehlukene. Nokusungula amathuba ezohwebo. Izindaba eziphathelene nobuphofu, ukungalingani, ukwehlukana ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, ukukhubazeka, kanye nezinselelo ezifana nesandulela ngculazi nengculazi uqobo lwayo konke loku kunomthelela ezingeni nasendleleni abafundi abafunda ngayo esikoleni. Isitatimende esibukeziwe sohlelo lwezifundo sikazwelonke samabanga R- 9 (ezikoleni)sona siqoka isu elididiyelayo ngokuthi sigqamise izidingo ezincanyana zabo bonke abafundi. Zonke izitatimende zemikhakha yezifundo zizama ukuqhakambisa ubudlelwane obukhona phakathi kwendlela eyiyo yokuhlalisana, amalungelo esintu, indawo ephephile enempilo ebazungezile kanye nokubandakanya wonke umuntu. Abafundi nabo bayakhuthazwa ukuthi bazi futhi baqonde kabanzi ngokungefani kwezinto ezweni lakithi ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngamasiko, inkolo nobuzwe okuyizona zinto ezigqamayo kulokhu kungefani okukhona.

uhlelo luyoqala ukusebenza ngosuku okunikwe ngalo isaziso. a kufike isikhathi lapho kungena olunye esikhundleni salo ngokomthethonkambiso- 47 2; noma b ukwamukelwa kohlelo kwesulwa ngokusho kwalomthethonkambiso. UMqondisi-Jikelele ngokukhipha isaziso esibhaliwe angayala lowo obambe iqhaza ukuba aguqule uhlelo. Kodwa-ke uMqondisi-Jikelele angeke anika isaziso ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 1 ngaphambi kokuba esenelisekile ukuthi uma seluguquliwe uhlelo luzokwazi ukubhekana ngokwanele nezidingo ezifanele ngokwesahluko- 3. a asho ukuthi yikuphi okuzoguqulwa; futhi b asho isikhathi okufanele lowo obambe iqhaza anike ngaso uMqondisi-Jikelele uhlelo oseluguquliwe. a oseluguquliwe njengokusho komyalo; futhi b ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe, noma ngesinye isikhathi esengezwe nguMqondisi-Jikelele, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele asule ukwamukelwa kohlelo lolo ngokubhalela lowo obambe iqhaza isaziso. a lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle enike uMqondisi-Jikelele uhlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle; futhi b lowo obambe iqhaza enika uMqondisi-Jikelele olunye uhlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle uhlelo olubukeziwe, umthethonkambiso- 44 no -45 kuyosebenza kulolo hlelo olubukeziwe. a Uma uhlelo olubukeziwe lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle luqala ukusebenza lungena esikhundleni sanoma iluphi olunye uhlelo lwalowo obambe iqhaza olusebenzayo ngaleso sikhathi.

Ubani ozongamela uhla lokugcina imiqulu? Lomuntu kumele aqiniseke ukuthi yonke imiqulu igcinwe ngendlelaeyiyo futhi endaweni efanelekile. Ukwengamela loluhla, akushoukuthi uwena osuzobopheka ukugcina imiqulu ohlwini. Noma nini uma usebenzisa izindlela zokulobelana izincwadi njengendlela yokuxhumana izincwadi, izimemezelo, imibiko, izikhahlamezi nokunye umele ukwenza okumbalwa phambikokuthi uqale. Ngifunelani ukubatshela lokhu? Bhala phansi ofuna ukukusho. Funda uhla osulubhalila bese uyanquma ukuthi ikuphiokubalulekile futhi ikuphi ongakushiya. Lifunde futhi uze ube nesiqiniseko ukuthi umbiko ofunaukuwudlulisa iwona ngempela yini. Yiba lula - sebenzisa amagama alula aqondwa yibobonke. Izincwadi ziwuhlobo olujwayelekile yo kuxhumana ngokubhala. Ikheli lakho nosuku incwadi ebhalwe ngalo. Igama nesikhundla salowo ombhalelayo. Isingeniso - esishoyo ukuthi uyibhalelani lencwadi. Ufaka isicelo somsebenzi, ufaka isikhalazo, kukhona okubikayo noma kukhona okucelayo. Isiqu - Ilapho ubhala khona ingqikithi yomlayezo yencwadi. Umusho wokuphetha: Lapho usuphetha incwadi. Isiphetho: Ukuvalelisa, igama lakho nokusayina. Bheka isijobelelo 14 esinesiboniso sencwadi yomsebenzi. Imicikilisho yalokhu kuxhumana kuyangobudlelwano onabo naloyo ombhalelayo. Ulimi olusetshenziswayo kujwayeleke ukuthilungunwebi futhi lube lula. Njengeminye yemisebenzi yakho njengelungu lekomidi lesigcemekungenzeka kudingeke ukuthi ubhale imibiko. Uzodinga ukuxhumana nehhovisi likaSomlomo kamasipala wakhoukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izidingo zemibiko kamasipala, okufakaumlamulajuqu wemibiko.

Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nokuphuculwa Kwezisebenzi Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene neziqu eziwumsuka ekuphuculeni kwemisebenzi. Enye yalezi zinselelo iwukungabikhona kwezinsiza ezanele, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izinhlelo zokuqashwa akuvamile ukutholakala, futhi lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka kokukhula kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abakwazi ukuqhubeka nokuthola iziqu zabo ngoba bengekho ezikhungweni zokuxhasa. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga zokuhambisana kwemisebenzi nezifundo. Abantu abaningi banemfundo ethile, kodwa bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi ehambisana naleyo mfundo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izidingo zemakethe zishintsha ngokushesha, kanti abantu abafuna umsebenzi bavele bahluleka ukuhambisana nalezi zidingo. Lokhu kubangela ukukhathazeka, kwandiselezikhathi zokungasebenzi, okuthinta umnotho. Izindlela Zokuqhubeka Nokuqeda Lezi Zinhlamvu Ukuze silungise lezi zinkinga, kunendaba yokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokufundisa. Izikhungo zobuchwepheshe kufanele zisebenze eduze nezinkampani ukuze kuqhamukele izifundo ezihambisana nezidingo zakho. Lokhu kungabandakanya izifundo ezifanele ezindaweni ezikhulayo zezimboni, futhi lokhu kuzokunikeza abantu amandla okwandisa amakhono abo. Ngokufanayo, izinhlelo zokwakha amakhono kufanele zihloswe ukuze zifinyelele izindawo ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphumelela kulabo abanglezinga eliphakeme lemfundo. Ukusimama kokuhweba nezinkampani ezincane nakho kubalulekile, ukuphucula ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kumele kube phakeme kakhulu kulabo abafuna ukukhula nokuqhubeka empilweni.

Izinhlelo zokuhlola zanyatheliswa ezinkampanini ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abangathanda ukufunda bamukelekile. Lesi simo sithuthukisa ukwaziswa nokwakhiwa kobungcweti, kunciphisa izingozi zokumiswa, nokwandisa impumelelo ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi. Uhlanga lwenhlangano olubambisene nolohulumeni, luzama ukwenza imisebenzi yethu ifinyeleleke kalula, ikakhulukazi kubantu abancinane. Lokhu kubukeka kuyisinyathelo esihle sokuvula amathuba, futhi kulandela izimpumelelo zethu zesikhathi eside. KuMnyango Wezemfundo, kubhekeziwe umthelela wezinhlelo zokufunda kulabo abafuna ukuthola izitifiketi zobungcweti. Imiphumela yocwaningo ibonisa ukuthi ukuqinisekisa ubungcweti kunciphisa isikhala sokusebenza phakathi kwabantu. Lezi zinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhuthaza ukuhlela kahle izinsiza zomphakathi, okwenza abantu baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zitifiketi zingaphinda zibe nemiphumela emihle engcwele ezingeni lokuphila, ikhulisa izinga lokuphila nokugcina izinga lokucindezelwa. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu kanye noHulumeni, kube nemiphumela emihle eqhubekela phambili, kuyinto ewusizo emiphakathini yethu. Izinsiza ezinqunyelwe kulabo abawaqhamukayo aziziswa kuphela ngokwakhiwa kolwazi, kodwa futhi kwiSikhumbuzo sezinqumo eziphusile. Ukwakha ozakwethu abagulayo, kuza sekuthuthukisa izinsiza zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezindaweni ezingenamathuba. Umphakathi ubonile ukuthi ungathola kanjani izinzuzo kulolu hlelo.

UMnu. Du Toit wayengumuntu wokugcina ophilayo kulabo baqale i-SATI. Saxhumana naye ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka komcimbi wethu wokugubha iminyaka engu-50 ngo-2006, kodwa impilo yakhe ayivumelanga ukuba abambe iqhaza ngqo kulolo mcimbi. Ekupheleni konyaka odlule, umregistrar wethu wenza ucwaningo lwamalungu e-SATI ngolimi lwabo lwekhaya. Imiphumela iyathakazelisa. Kwi-707 amalungu abhaliswe ngaleso sikhathi, cishe uhhafu (311 noma u-44%) babekhuluma isi-Afrikaans. Iqembu elilandelayo elikhulu - abakhuluma isiNgisi - liphansi kancane kwalolo nani: amalungu angu-139 noma u-19.7%. IsiJalimane: amalungu angu-39; isiTaliana: amalungu angu-8; isiPhuthukezi: amalungu angu-22; isiRomania: amalungu angu-4; isiRashiya: amalungu angu-4; isiSpanish: amalungu angu-9, bese kukhona amalungu amabili ngalinye kulezi zilimi - isiCantonese, isiGreki, isiHebheru, isiSwahili, isiPolish, nesiShona. I-Common Sense Advisory, Inc., inkampani yocwaningo nokuqondisa esekelwe e-USA, ikhishile ukubikezela kwayo kuka-2009 kwemisebenzi yolimi, izinsizakalo, kanye nobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi olungeziwe: www.commonsenseadvisory.com. Uhlu lwamagama lweNhlangano Yezilimi Zesizwe manje lutholakala kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, www.dac.gov.za. Landela isixhumanisi kule mnyango ekhasini eliyinhloko ukuya ekhasini le "National Language Service completed terminology."

a Ukwahlulela isikhalo ngokubheka imibhalo ethulwe kuye; noma b Ukujuba odlulisa isikhalo kanye nesikhulu esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma umuntu onegunya ukuba bavele phambi kwakhe ziqu zabo noma bamelwe, ngesikhathi nendawo eyonqunywa nguKhomishani lapho beyothula khona ubufakazi. Ukhomishani angaqinisekisa, aguqule noma achithe ukumiswa okukhulunywa ngakho kumthethonkambiso 1. a Uma eqinisekisa ukumiswa ngokusho komthethonkambiso 9 noma b Uma imvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa simiswe ngokusho komthethonkambiso 1 kanti lowo onaso angadlulisa isikhalo ngokulandisa komthethonkambiso 4, uyokwesula imvume noma isitifiketi sokwemukelwa esithintekayo. UKhomishani uyogcina ilejista yazo zonke izimvume nezitifiketi zokugunyazwa ngaphansi kwale Ngxenye. Ukhomishani anganikeza noma imuphi umuntu okucashunwe kulejista uma ekhokha imali efanele enqunywe kwiNgxenye 187, aongaveza isizathu esizwakalayo nesanele sokuthi yingani kufanele anikwe lokho okucashuniwe. Ingqikithi yoqeqesho lokuqala lwabasebenzi mayelana nokuphepha kwempahla ethuthwa ngendiza kanye nokuvuselela ezokuphepha kwempahla nokuvuselelwa koqeqesho kuyoqhutshwa ngendlela echazwe yibhukwana lezokuphepha njengoba inqunywe kuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Noma imuphi umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kumthethonkambiso uyophothula izifundo zokuvuselela uqeqesho lwezokuphepha kwempahla ethuthwa ngendiza njalo ezinyangeni ezingamashumi amabili nane, kusukela ephothule ngempumelelo olunye uqeqesho lokuzijwayeza ezokuphepha noma uqeqesho olwandulela lolo, kuyoya ngaleso naleso simo.

Umbiko: Ukuqinisekisa Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ngokufana Nama-ATM Isingeniso Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, izikhungo ziye zathola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Okwamanje, ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM sekuthandwa kakhulu, njengoba kwenza kube lula, kusheshise, futhi kwandise ukufinyelela ezinsizweni kubantu abaningi. Lo mbiko uzophenya ukuthi lezi zikhungo zisebenza kanjani, izinzuzo zazo, kanye nezinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Izikhungo ezisebenza njengama-ATM zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokuthengisa, ezokwelapha, nezokuthutha. Njengoba ama-ATM evumela abantu ukuthola imali, lezi zikhungo nazo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ezithile. Isibonelo, izikhungo zokuthengisa zingaba nezindawo ezizimele ezivumela abantu ukuthi bathenge imikhiqizo ngaphandle kokulinda, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izinto ezibalulekile. Izikhungo zokwelapha, ezifana nezikhungo zokuhlola, nazo zisebenzisa le ndlela. Abantu bangabhalisela ukuhlolwa noma izinsizakalo ngefoni noma ku-inthanethi, bese bephuma kuphela uma sekukhona isidingo sokuhlolwa. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda futhi kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizweni zezempilo. Izinzuzo Zokusebenza Kwezikhungo Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM yenzeka lapho abantu befika kalula ezinsizweni abazidingayo ngaphandle kokulinda emgqeni omude. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho ukufinyelela ezinsizweni kungaba nzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza ukuzimela, njengoba abantu bangakwazi ukwenza izinqumo zabo ngaphandle kokuncika kwabanye, okusebenza kahle kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi.

Sifundisa ukuzimisela, ukuhlonipha, umsebenzi onzima, ukuzinikela, nokuzinikela njengokhiye ophumelelayo. URonald Green-Thompson, uma sibuyela, sifunda kuye ukuze sibe ngcono. Usifundisile ukuthi kumele sikhule ngokwanele ukuze sikwazi ukusiza imiphakathi yethu. UGreen-Thompson uthe uyajabula ngentuthuko yezibhedlela ezintsha ezimbili, ezilindeleke ukuthi zivulwe maduze, futhi njengoba waziwa ngokusebenza nabo emkhakheni wezempilo kazwelonke nakuzo zonke izimpumelelo zezibhedlela zeMahatma Gandhi, sivuma lapho sikhuluma ngalesi siphakamiso, nalabo abahlanganyela naye kanye neBhodi, ngithumele amazwi eMnyango ngesikhathi seMnyango Wezempilo ngeziBhedlela zayo ezineziBhedlela ezingu-340, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, abasebenzi kulo mnyango abanjalo abawazisa kakhulu uProfesa osephakathi. Lezi zibhedlela ezingu-340 noKing Albert yizinto ezithinta konke esikwenzayo, wamenywa njengomphakathi kaGreen-Thompson ngenxa yokwakha. "Noma kukhona okuningi okufanele kwenziwe, iLuthuli Central Hospital kufanele ifune okungcono, kodwa umnyango ngonyaka ka-1995. kulo mnyango. Sibonga wonke umuntu ngalokho okwenzekile, kodwa ezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu nakubantu esisebenza nabo." UGreen-Thompson ungumholi wezobuchwepheshe osinikeze ithuba lokusiza labo abanemibhede engu-840," kusho yena. UMnyango Wezempilo uqaphele ukuthi uProfesa Green-Thompson ukwazi ukufaka izinzuzo ezivela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezingu-122. Umcimbi wokuhamba kwabo uProfesa wabanjwa ngothando olwakhiwe ngonyaka ka-2003.

Ngokuhlanganyela, lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kudinga ukuba kube nenqubo eqondile, ehloniphekile, futhi esheshayo. Abantu kumele bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza zabo ngaphandle kokubambezela, kodwa futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Nokho, le nqubo kumele ithuthukiswe ukuze ibhekelele izidingo zabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sibe nezinqubo eziphumelelayo, ezisheshayo, nezithembekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola lokho akufanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu, futhi kuzokhulisa ukwaneliseka kwabo ngezinsiza ezitholakala kubo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onothando.

Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile, futhi kudingeka ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga. Ukuxhumana, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa, kanye nokwamukela kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuxhasa abantu abasha, sibanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, lapho abantu abasha bengakwazi ukukhula, baphile, futhi baphumelele. Impilo yengqondo yentsha ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyisici esibalulekile sokuphila kwethu sonke. Ngakho, masithathe izinyathelo ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo yentsha, ukuze sibe nomphakathi onempilo, onothando, futhi onokuthula.

Ukubuka umkhiqizo khetha inombolo edingekayo, isibonelo, ukunquma ukubiza kwamazambane emakethe yaseBloemfontein, u-Bloemfontein (Bfn) ungunombolo 2. Cindezela impendulo okungu-2 bese uthumela. Ukwengeza ku-USSD, kukhona olunye usizo olubizwa i-SMS bulk olwethulwa ngo-Ephreli futhi njengamanje lusahlolwa kubalimi bokutshalwayo abayi-10 kuzo zonke izifundazwe. Ngokuhlukile ku-USSD, i-SMS bulk ithumela ulwazi lokubiza ezimakethe zomkhiqizo wezolimo nge-SMS kubalimi ababhalisile kanye nabakudathabhesi . UTlou Kabe ovela ophikweni lokuzithengisa weluleke abalimi ukuba babhalise kuzigodi zabo nakomasipala babo ukuze bazuze ekutholeni lolu ziso oluhlinzekwayo. Inhlosombono yoHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokunakekela Umhlaba (i-NLP) ukuba nemiphakathi kanye nabantu ngabanye abazokwemukela indlela ezimele yobudlelwano bezinto nendawo yazo ekuphatheni imvelo nemithombo yemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika, ngenkathi zenza ngcono ikhwalithi yempilo yabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu basebenzisa inhlabathi, amanzi kanye nemithombo yezimila ngendlela yokuthi ikhwalithi yempilo yabo ibe ngcono kanye nokuthi izizukulwane zakusasa zikwazi ukuyisebenzisa ukwanelisa izidingo zazo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukutshala, ukufuya kanye nokuvuna imithombo yemvelo kufanele iphathwe ngendlela enqanda umunakalo (ofana nokuguguleka kwenhlabathi, ukuphela kwezakhamzimba, ukuphela kwezingxenye zezimila, ukukhula kokugeleza kwamanzi, njll. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, uMnyango Wezolimo Kazwelonke uhlinzeka ngokusekelwa kokuphathwa kwemithombo yemvelo ngoHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokunakekela Umhlaba.

Izinsizwa zathi ziqhamukile, zikhala ngezikhathi ezinzima, kwagcina sekutholakala ukuphila okungaphezu kwemingcele. Ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka kokuphikisana, umoya wezemidlalo, ubuciko, nezincwadi zaba yizikhumbuzo eziqhubekayo zomzabalazo. Ababhali, abaculi, nabanye abathandi bezemidlalo babhalela ukulwela ukukhululeka. UThami Mnyele, uMiriam Makeba, noHugh Masekela, babamba umoya wabantu, behlanganisa izinkanyezi zomculo, bekhombisa umoya wokulwa, ukulwa nenkohlakalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imikhankaso eyahlukene, efana ne-ANC (African National Congress), yahlangana nemibono emisha yokusebenzisa izindlela ezithile zokuphikisana. Kwavela izinkulumo, izinkomfa, nemihlangano ebivame ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Lokhu kwakhuthaza abantu abaninzi ukuba bahlanganyele, bese bephikisa lesi simo esinzima. Izinhlaka zomphakathi zazinokubaluleka okukhulu, futhi abantu baphila ngokwakha umndeni omkhulu, bejabulile ngokukhululeka. Kuyaqhubeka ukulwa, izimpi zazikhula, futhi umoya wokuphikisa wawukhula. Izinsuku zashintsha, phakathi kwamathafa aseNingizimu Afrika, abantwana babona imikhankaso yokugcina yokulwa. Kwazalwa izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa izinsizwa zikhumbula imizamo yazo, zifuna ukwakha izimpilo ezinhle. Umphakathi wawugqugquzela, ugxile ezintweni ezinhle, ubonisa uthando, uhlanganisa ubumbano. Ngonyaka ka-1990, kwavulwa ithuba elisha. UNelson Mandela, ngemva kweminyaka engama-27 esebenzisa ubuhlungu, wakhululwa. Kwakungumcimbi omkhulu, umhlaba wonke wawujabule, uMandela waba yisithonjana sokukhululeka. Ukubuyisana nezizathu eziphambili kwavula indlela yokwakha ikusasa elinobungane.

a uhlelo lwezokuvikela lwasolwandle lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle uhlelo olukhona selusebenze iminyaka emihlanu ; futhi b uMqondisi-Jikelele engakaze amukele uhlelo olubukeziwe lwalowo obambe iqhaza ngokomthethonkambiso- 47 ngaleso sikhathi, ukwamukela kohlelo olukhona kuyesulwa ngokwalomthethonkambiso. i aguqule uhlelo ngaphansi komthethonkambiso- 46; noma ii abukeze uhlelo ngokomthethonkambiso -48, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele abhale isaziso asinike lowo obambe iqhaza asule ukwamukelwa kohlelo. a uhlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezokuvikela olwandle lusebenza; futhi b lowo obambe iqhaza ehluleka ukulandela uhlelo, uMqondisi-Jikelele angabhala isaziso asinike lowo obambe iqhaza emazisa ngokwesulwa kokwamukela kohlelo. a uhlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle lwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle lusebenza; futhi b lowo obambe iqhaza enikeza uMqondisi-Jikelele isicelo esibhaliwe ecela ukuba uhlelo olwamukelwe lwesulwe, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele abhale isaziso ezise lowo obambe iqhaza ngokwesulwa kohlelo olwamukelwe. b ukwamukela izinto ezisetshenziswayo eziphathelene nezokuvikela ukuze zisetshenziswe emachwebeni alawulwa ngezokuvikela. Ekwamukeleni lokho uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele akhumbule izibopho njengoba zibekiwe eSahlukweni IX-2 seSivumelwano sezokuPhepha noMgomo we-ISPS.

Isikhathi sokusebenza kumele sihlanganise ukusebenza; nokunye okukhulunywe. Umphakathi ungase, njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense ezibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, avimbe umnikazi welayisense ekwenzeni noma uphoqele umnikazi welayisense ukuba enze noma yisiphi isinyathelo esichazwe kulayisense. Umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukukhokha noma iyiphi imali kumakhasimende futhi abeke izimo ezivela ezivumelwaneni ezilawulwa noma ezibekwe umphakathi njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense. UNgqongqoshe kumele achaze inqubo ezizolandelwa ekukhanselweni, ekuphakamiseni okwethulwa, ekususweni, noma ekubekweni kwanoma iyiphi isimo selayisense. Noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ofuna ukukhombisa ukuthi angathatha amalungelo namandla omnikazi walelayisense ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalomthetho, futhi ilayisense entsha inikezwa kulowo muntu; noma isimo selayisense asihlonishwanga. Umnikazi welayisense kumele, ezimweni ezichazwe ezigabeni 1a no-b, anikeze umphakathi okungenani izinyanga eziyi-12 izaziso ebhalwe phansi ngenhloso yabo yokumisa ukusebenza, ngaphandle kokuthi umphakathi ubonge okunye. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga noma wehluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho, izimo, noma noma yiziphi izinhlinzeko zalomthetho, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga izaziso eziphathelene nesigaba 2, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Uma umkhandlu uthola ukuthi izinsolo ngaphansi kwesigaba 3 ziyiqiniso, bangase babeke imali engaphansi kuka-R2,000,000.00 ngosuku uma le miphumela engahambisani iqhubeka.

Abafundi bazoqala ukuhlola ukuthi ulimi lusebenza kanjani. Bayoqala ukuthuthukisa ulimi olukhuluma ngolimi. Isibonelo, bazofunda ukusebenzisa amagama anjengalawa: 'umsindo', 'ilunga', 'igama', 'umusho', 'ungqi' . Lokhu kuyobasiza lapho bebonisana becabanga ngokwenzeka olimini njengokupelwa kwamagama, ukwakhiwa kwemisho nokufaka izimpawu zenkulumo nokunye. Ezigabeni ezilandelayo, izindlela zokuhlola yomphumela ngamunye izonikezwa ibanga ngebanga. Ekuqaleni kwebanga ngalinye, kunikezwa izibonelo zeziqephu ezingasetshenziswa ukuhlanganisa ukufundwa kolimi. Lezi akuzona zodwa izibonelo ezinganikezwa, ungazandisa ngokukhetha noma yiziphi ezinye iziqephu ezifanele nezitholakalayo. Imiyalo elula eya ngokuya iba lukhuni. UKULALELA Loku kubonakala uma umfundi ekwazi: Umfundi uzokwazi ukulalela ukuze atholeulwazi nokuzijabulisa aphendule ngendlela Ukulalela ngokucophelela lapho ebuzwa imibuzo, efanele nangokuhlolisisa ezimweni imiyalo nezimemezelo aphendule ngendlela efanele. ezahlukehlukene. Ukukhombisa indlela yokulalela ngaphandle kokungena omunye emlonyeni, ekhombisa ukuhlonipha okhulumayo, elinda ithuba lakhe lokukhuluma. Ukudlala ingxenye ethile yendaba, ingoma noma umgqumo. Ukungena acule nabanye ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukudweba isithombe sendaba, ingoma noma umgqumo. Ukubeka izithombe ngokulandelana kwazo. Ukuthuthukisa ukuqaphela imisindo yamagama. Ukubona ukuthi amagama akhiwe ngemisindo. Ukwahlukanisa imisindo eyehlukene ikakhulu ekuqaleni nasekugcineni kwamagama. Ukucozulula umusho ube ngamagama azimele (aqale ngokusebenzisa amagama alunganye).

Ukhomishani unegunya lokwenza noma lokufuna kulowo ofake isicelo isiqiniseko sokuhlola noma izivivinyo zokuhlola isimo sokuphepha. Isicelo esichazwe wumgonyana 3 kufanele siphelezelwe yintengo efanele enqunywe yiNgxenye 187. Isicelo sokukhishwa kwegunya lokundiza ebhanoyini noma isichibiyelo kufanele sihambisane nemibandela yeNgxenye 24. Imvume yokundiza okwehlukile ekhishwe ngaphansi kwale Ngxenye iyohlala isebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika nasemanzini akhele lelizwe. Uma indiza yeqela kwelinye izwe noma umngcele welinye izwe iyofuna imvume emkhandlwini ongamele ukundiza kulelo lizwe. Isichibiyelo soMgomo 21.08. i yokuhlola indiza entsha ekhiqizwe yilowo mnikazi wemvume; noma ii yokuviliyela ngenjongo yokukhangisa ekhasimendeni uhlobo oluthile olusha lwendiza eqede ngempumelelo izivivinyo zokulungela isimo sokundiza. Imvume ekhishwe ngaphansi kwalomgomo iyigunya kanjalo nezimo nemigomo yokundiza ebhalwe kahle ebhukwaneni noma emqulwini wenqubo yokusebenza kwendiza yalowo onemvume yesitifiketi segunya, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Imvume ekhishwe ngaphansi kwalo Mgomo iyosebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika nasemanzini alelizwe. Uma indiza iwelela ngaphakathi komngcele welinye izwe iyodinga imvume yomkhandlu oqondene walelo lizwe. b kwalezo zingxenye okufanele zifakwe kuleyo ndiza.

ULawrence Luthango, umphakathi wezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi eGrain SA kule ndawo. UMonica Mathamba uhlala endaweni yeMthatha Mbozisa lapho engum member weMbozisa Farmers' Association. UMonica ulima indawo engama-6 hectares futhi uphumelele ekulimaleni izinkambu zakhe lapho efaka khona amanzi. UMonica uhambele izifundo zokuqeqeshwa zeGrain SA zabafuyi, kuhlanganise nokwethulwa ekukhiqizeni ujeqe kanye nezifundo ezithuthukile zokukhiqiza ujeqe. UMonica ukhuphule umkhiqizo wakhe usebenzisa ulwazi alutholile kwiGrain SA. Ujwayele ukukhiqiza ama-ton angu-3.5 nge-hectare kodwa manje ukukhiqiza ama-ton angu-4.5 nge-hectare. UMonica uthola kanjani uxhaso lokuhlwanyela? Ukuze athole uxhaso lokuqala, UMonica usebenzisa imali ephuma ephaketheni lakhe ngoba umphathi wezimali uvame ukuthola imali ebolekiwe ngemva kokuvuna. UMonica uthola kuphi izinto zokuhlwanyela? UMonica uthi uthenga izinto zokuhlwanyela zakhe zokuqala kwiMthiza Farmers Co-op nase-East Cape Co-op. Intengo ivame ukuba phezulu (zibiza kakhulu) futhi abafuyi banikezwa izeluleko mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezinto lezi. Yiziphi izinselelo ahlangabezana nazo ekulimaleni futhi uphumelelani kulolo work? Uhlangabezana nezinselelo ezidinga abakhiqizi ukuba banikeze imibiko (izeluleko) nezakhono ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe, futhi kufanele banikeze izindlela namathuba okuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo (izakhiwo). UMonica uthi akahlangabezani nalezi zinselelo ngoba sebezixazulule izinqubomgomo zabo lapho kudingeka. UMonica uthi uthini ngempumelelo yakhe eqhubekayo ekulimaleni?

Ukufundisisa umbhalo ngenhloso yokulungisa amaphutha nokugaya imibhalo ngezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ukukhuthaza umsebenzi wokusebenzisa ulimi ngezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ukweluleka umnyango noma isifundazwe ngokusetshenziswa kolimi (ngokubhaliwe noma ngomlomo). Ukusingatha nokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abantu abaqashelwe ukuhumusha, ukulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni nokuthuthukisa ihlelo lamagama olimi nezinhlelo zolimi ngezilimi ezisemthethweni kubasebenzi bomnyango noma besifundazwe. Ukusebenzisana nezigungu zeDAC nePanSALB (isibonelo, amakomidi olimi ezifundazweni, izigungu zolimi kuzwelonke namathimba ezesayense yezichazimazwi kuzwelonke) ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa ihlelo lamagama olimi. Ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kolimi oluqondile eMisebenzini yoMphakathi. Wonke amathimba olimi amiswe yiNqubomgomo kufanele asungulwe ungakapheli unyaka ka 2005. Kuyosungulwa Inkundla yeziLimi zikaZwelonke eyobunjwa yinxanxathela yabaqokiwe abammele uhulumeni nezakhiwo ezingaxhumene nohulumeni. Inkundla iyohlangana njalo emuva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Iyoxuba abaqokwe ezifundazweni nohulumeni bakazwelonke abayoba yingxenye yenqubo yokungeniswa kancane ngezikhawu kanjalo nePanSALB nezakhiwo zayo. Ngenxa yobuchwepheshe obungase budingeke, ommele Umkhandlu weziKhungo zokuFunda kuyofanele abambe iqhaza kule Nkundla. Inhloso yeNkundla yeziLimi wukukhuthaza intshumayelo yenqubomgomo yolimi nezinto eziphathelene nokusebenza kwayo phakathi kongcweti nabaholi bolimi ngaphansi koMnyango wezoBuciko namaSiko.

Lolu Hlaka lweNqubomgomo luphinde lubheke iphuzu lokuthi ubumqoka bezilimi zethu buvezwa kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezomnotho, kwezenhlalakahle nezombusazwe. Uma ulimi luphelelwa ubumqoka balo kulezi zimo, isikhundla salolo limi siyehla . Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo luphinda futhi lubonise ukuthi sibhekene nenselele yokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele nokuthi futhi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye yendawo yobuchwepheshe obanda ngokushesha. Yingakho-ke luzimisele ukubuyisela isikhundla nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngethemba ngenhlonipho ukuthi zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika zizolujabulela lolu Hlaka lweNqubomgomo yolimi kaZwelonke njengolwabo. Ngiyakholwa ukuthi ngokudibene kumele siqinisekise ukuthi inqubomgomo iba yinto yangempela ezimpilweni zethu, futhi isenza siziqhenye ubuthina beNingizimu Afrika engajwayelekile. Umphathisihlalo we Bhodi kumele aqashwe isikhathi esingevile eminyakeni emithathu, amanye amalunga eBhodi isikhathi esingevile kwiminyaka emibili, futhi, ngokulandela lo Mthetho, aphathe ihhovisi ngokomgomo wokuhola futhi uma u MEC engabeka lapho beqashwa. Uma kuzoba noma kukhona isikhala somsebenzi ehhovisi lomphathisihlalo we Bhodi noma ilunga le Bhodi, u MEC kumele athathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukugcwalisa lezozikhala ngokuqasha, ngokuya ngokwalesisigaba, umuntu ofanelekile ongeke ehliswe esikhundleni ngalendlela ebalwe kusigaba 5. Umuntu osephelelwe yisikhathi sokuba yilunga le Bhodi uvumelekile ukuthi aqashwe kabusha. Inhloko yo Mnyango kumele, ngokulandela umthetho ophethe ezomphakathi, anikezele ngabasebenzi abafanele ukusiza iBhodi ekwenzeni umsebenzi walo. d eselehluleke ukuhambela imihlangano ye Bhodi kwaze kwa yizihlandla ezintathu zilandelana ngaphandle kwesizathu esicacile. b lisusiwe ehhovisi ngokwesigatshana 2. v lenqabe ukuzwa ubufakazi bomuntu owenqaba ukufunga noma ukufungiswa. Umuntu ophethe umhlangano weBhodi lapho kunomuntu ozokwethula ubufakazi njengoba kukhonjwe kusigatshana 1, angamfungisa lowomuntu owethula ubufakazi. IBhodi kumele libanike labobantu abafuna izizathu ezibhalwehe phansi ngezinqumo ekufinyelelwe kuzo. Imihlangano ye Bhodi kumele ibanjwe ngezindlela nangezikhathi nasezindaweni ezibekiwe. Umphathisihlalo kanye namalunga okungenani amabili banegunya lokubamba umhlangano we Bhodi osemthethweni.

Intela-sabelo esanda kusungulwa yamakhono yenzelwe ukuba ihehe ikhuthaze abaqashi ukuba bathuthukise amakhono ezindaweni zabo. Kanti amasu Amakhono aseMsebenzini asungulelwe ukuthi abaqashi kanye nabasebenzi balubuke njengolumqoka udaba lokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Yize imithetho yentuthuko ibekelwe ukuba isize ukujika imiqondo yabantu, okumqoka nakakhulu kunokuphoqwa umthetho ukuzinikela okujulile emzabalazweni wokuthuthukisa amakhono abantu futhi lokho kube yinhloso kazwelonke. Amanye amazwe omhlaba, izinkampani, abantu nemiphakathi aseyazibona ayazivuna izithelo zokuthuthukisa abantu ngamakhono. Lelisiko nokuzinikela kufanele ukuba kukhuthazwe nasezweni lakithi iNingizimu Afrika. Kufanele futhi ukuba sizinikele ukuba sizokuzikhandla ukwenyusa izinga lethu lolwazi ngendlela eqhubekayo ukuze siqhathaniseke ngendlela ephezulu ezweni lethu nakwamanye amazwe nokunikeza bantu isiqiniseko sokuthi ukuzithuthukisa ngamakhono akusiyona into yokuchitha isikhathi kokdwa kunembuyiselo. Izinhlaka ezintsha nezeMfundo nokuQeqesha, kanye nezinye izinhlangano zongoti ezinhlakeni ezithize zinesibopho ngokusemthethweni ukuba zikhuthaze iqophelo eliphezulu nokuqapha amazinga. Inqubo yokugcina amazinga aphakeme kufanele ilandelwe nasekwakhiweni kwamathuba omsebenzi nawokuqashwa. Ukuthuthukisa amakhono kungukuhlomisa abantu ukuba baqasheke emisebenzini abanokuziqhenya ngayo. Imithetho eshayelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nezinhlelo zoMnyango wezaBasebenzi zakhelwe ukuba ziguqule imiqondo yabantu malungana nodaba lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono.

UThandi, umculi owayenothando olukhulu lokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, waba yisibonelo esihle. UThandi wayengumuntu ophila empilweni enezinkinga, kodwa umculo wakhe wawuhamba phambili. Waqala ukucula izingoma ezazikhuluma ngothando lukaNkulunkulu, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uyasithanda, noma ngabe sikhona esikhathini esinzima. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, umoya wokukhuluma, umoya wokukhumbula. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Umculo we-gospel wawungowokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa wawuphinde ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel wathuthuka. Kwakukhona abaculi abaninzi ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, behamba behamba, bejolise ekukhulumeni izindaba zabo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kumalungana nokunikeza abantu ulwazi oluhambisana nokuthathwa kwezinqumo lezi kanye nokwenza leyo misebenzi edinga amakhono azothuthukiswa emveni kokuba kuthathwe lezo zinqumo. Emisebenzini izinqumo zimalungana nomkhiqizo, ukuhleleka komsebenzi, nobuchwepheshe; ezimbonini ezintsha nezisafufusayo zimalungana nolwazi lomsebenzi, ukusimama nokukhula, kanti emphakathini kumalungana nokudlondlobala komnotho. Kubo bonke: iphupho lingelimbandakanya konke. Inhloso eyokuba kuvezelwe labo asebemsebenzini amathuba okuthuthuka kanye nalabo abangenamisebenzi; kulabo abaqalayo ukusebenza kanye nalabo asebezingqwathule emsebenzini; abesimame nabesilisa, kanye nabantu abakhubazekile ababekade bemakhono abo engashaywa ndiva esikhathini esiphambili. Ukufunda kwanjalo-njalo: imiphakathi nezindawo zasemsebenzini kuyaguqu-guquka. Ukuze yilowo nayilowo muntu abhekane nalezo zinguquko kufanele acije ngamakhono athize ukuze kukhuphuke izinga lempilo yakhe. Ukuthuthukiswa kokulinganiswa kwesibalo: ngale kokusiphulwa kwezimpande zomlandu omubi kufanele kube khona okwenziwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awuphindeki lowomlandu bese wonke umuntu eba namathuba entuthuko. Eminyakeni engemingaki eyedlule baye ngokuncipha kakhulu abampisholo emisebenzini. Kubantu abangu 40 million abakhona ezweni lakithi bangamaphesenti angu 20 kuphela abanemisebenzi. Kubantu abangu 4,6 million abaswele imisebenzi, abangu 4,2 million bansundu, kanti u 58 phesenti wabo abesifazane. Ngokuthuthukikswa kwamakhono sidinga ukuba sikhandele ababebandlululekile amathuba, bese kuthi phezu kwalokho sigqugquzele ubambiswano oluphilayo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zabantu.

Isingeniso IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liyisikhungo esiyinhloko sokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi, elibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umthetho, ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zomphakathi, nasekuphatheni izinqumo ezithinta izakhamuzi zethu. Ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi iPhalamende lisebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukwazi izigaba ezihlukene ezisemqoka, izinqubo, kanye nezimiso ezilawula ukusebenza kwalo. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukwakheka kwePhalamende IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liqukethe izingxenye ezimbili ezisemqoka: iNdlu ePhakeme (Senate) kanye neNdlu ePhansi (National Assembly). INdlu ePhakeme ibhekelela izindaba ezithinta izifunda, kanti iNdlu ePhansi ibhekelela izindaba ezijwayelekile zomphakathi. Ukuze ube yilungu lePhalamende, umuntu kufanele abe ngumuntu ophethe iziqu ezithile, athole ukhetho, futhi abe nekhono lokuhola. Isigaba sesibili: Ukhetho lwePhalamende Ukhetho lwePhalamende lwenziwa njalo eminyakeni emine. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukuvota, kubalulekile ukuthi izakhamuzi ziqonde izinqubo zokubhaliswa. Abantu kufanele babhalise ukuze bavote, futhi lokhu kungenziwa ezikhungweni ezikhethekile noma online. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, izakhamuzi zithola ithuba lokuvota, lapho zikhuluma khona ngezintandokazi zabo, zikhombisa ukuthi zifuna ubani ukuba ummeleli wazo. Isigaba sesithathu: Ukusebenza kwePhalamende Uma ukhetho sekuqedile, iPhalamende iqala ukusebenza. Izigameko zokuqala zifaka phakathi umhlangano wokuqala, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ahlangana khona ukuze aqinisekise izikhundla ezibalulekile, njengeMenenja yePhalamende (Speaker) kanye noMholi weMpumalanga.

Izinga lokungasebenzi liphezulu kakhulu lilinganiselwa kumaphesenti angu 25 kumbe angu 37 kuye ngezincazelo ezisethsenzisiwe. Kodwa ke noma ngabe iyiphi incazelo esetshenzisiwe iqiniso elisobala elokuthi inani labantu abaMpisholo baseNingizimu Afrika labaswele imisebenzi liphezulu kakhulu. Kunjalo nje abesimame abangasebenzi yibona abaningi kunabesilisa. Abaphezulu eqhulwini kwabaswele imisebenzi yilabo abangazange bake basebenze noma labo abangasho ukuthi sebeke basebenza phambilini. Baningi futhi abangasebenzi abangaphansi kweminyaka yobudala engu 34. Izwe lethu libulawa ububha kanti negebe likhulu phakathi kwabadla izambane likampondo nalabo abadla imbuya ngothi. Enye into eyinselelo kakhulu yilena yezifo ezithathelwanayo ikakhulukazi igciwane lesandulela ngculazi nesifo sengculazi uqobo okuyinto eyande kakhulu kithi ngenxa yesimo sobuphofu nokungabi nezindawo zokuhlala ezamukelelkile. Kukhona futhi ubudlelwano phakathi kokweswela nezinga lobugcwelegcwele. Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zomphakathi, nokubaqeqesha ngamakhono kuzokunciphisa ukusweleka kwemisebenzi nezilingo ezihambisana nakho, futhi lokho kuzobeka abantu esimweni sokuba bakwazi ukuziqalela eyabo imisebenzi. Lamaphuzu ehlukahlukene athinta umnotho ngezindlela ezehlukahlukene futhi uzwelo lwawo kumuntu ngomuntu alufani. Njengoba izinguquko zizoya ngokwanda nje, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuzokuba yinto ekufanele sizinikele kuyo safuthi. Lezizinto ezintathu ke ziyabonakala nasezinguqukweni ezenzekayo ngasohlangothini lwezemfundo kuzona zonke izigaba.

Umculo we-Gospel: Uhambo Lwenhliziyo Ekuqaleni, emaphandleni ase-Afrika, umculo wawungelula. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, izinsimbi eziphakeme, nezwi elivela enhliziyweni. Umculo wawungowokukhuluma, wokukhumbula, nokukhuthaza. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo ezinkulu, izinkanyezi ezazihamba phambili emhlabeni. Kodwa, phakathi kwalezi zinkanyezi, kwavela umculo we-gospel, umculo owayezokhombisa uthando, ithemba, nokholo. Umculo we-gospel waqala ukuvela phakathi kwabantu abahluphekayo, ababephila ezimeni ezinzima. Kwakukhona ubuhlungu, kodwa futhi kwakukhona ngethemba. Abantu babengakwazi ukuxoxa izindaba zabo ngezingoma. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo we-gospel wawungowokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa wawuphinde ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Abantu babengakholwa ukuthi, noma bahluphekile, uNkulunkulu ubakhumbula, ubabheka, futhi ubathanda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel wathuthuka. Kwakukhona abaculi abaninzi ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, behamba behamba, bejolise ekukhulumeni izindaba zabo. UThandi, umculi owayenothando olukhulu lokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, waba yisibonelo esihle. UThandi wayengumuntu ophila empilweni enezinkinga, kodwa umculo wakhe wawuhamba phambili. Waqala ukucula izingoma ezazikhuluma ngothando lukaNkulunkulu, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uyasithanda, noma ngabe sikhona esikhathini esinzima. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, umoya wokukhuluma, umoya wokukhumbula. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Leli Qhinga Lokuqhuba umsebenzi liyingxenye yoHlaka Lwenqubomgomo kaZwelonke yoLimi (NLPF) olunika igunya imibandela yolimi njengoba ibekwe esigabeni 6 soMthethosisekelo ka 1996 (Umthetho uNo. 108 ka 1996). Uma seliphelele, umgodla wonke uyoqukatha Umbiko weNqubomgomo yeziLimi, Iqhinga Lokuqhuba umsebenzi, Umthetho ohlongozwayo weziLimi nemigomo yakhona kanjalo noMthetho ohlongozwayo woMkhandlu woNgcweti beziLimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi lethulwa njengesiphakamiso esemukela ukuguqulwa nalapho kungachitshiyelwa khona ngezakhiwo namalinge athile okukhuthaza izilimi ezahlukene. Umbiko weNqubomgomo yeNLPF wamenyezelwa nguNgqongqoshe wezoBuciko namaSiko, iSayense nobuChwepheshe ngomhla-ka 3 kuZibandlela ngo-2002. Umkhandlu wesiShayamthetho wemukela lombiko ngomhla-ka 12 Nhlolanja 2003. Inqubomgomo iqonde ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisa ngendlela efanayo izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni ngenhloso yokugqugquzela ukufinyelela emisebenzini kahulumeni, ulwazi nemininingwane kanjalo nokuhlonipha amalungelo olimi. Lezi zinhloso zincike empumelelweni yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezazincishwe ithuba. Ngesizathu sokuthi ulimi yisikhali sokuxhumana ezimpilweni zabantu nomphakathi, kusemqoka ukudala amaqhinga okuqondisa amaphutha okungalingani adaleka ngesikhathi esedlule. Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi liveza imininingwane ephathelene nezakhiwo namacebo adingekayo okwenza iNqubomgomo yeziLimi nomthelela wesabelo sezimali eminyangweni kazwelonke nezifundazwe isebenze ngempumelelo.

Emva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yombuso wentando yeningi, iNingizimu Afrika ifinyelele ephuzwini elisemqoka emlandwini walo. Izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele ziphendule ukwehluka kwazo ngokolimi nangamasiko kanye nenselele yobuliminingi obusemthethweni, yingakho-ke kungeniswa uHlaka lweNqubomgomo yoLimi kaZwelonke. Lolu Hlaka lweNqubomgomo aluqalisi kuphela indlela entsha yokubhekana nobuliminingi eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa lugqugquzela ngamandla ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu njengezilimi ezisemthethweni ukuze londle luphinde luthuthukise ubumbano lukazwelonke . Ifakela ukuvunywa okubanzi kokwehluka kwezilimi, ezobulungisa, umthetho wokufinyelela ngokulinganayo kuzinhlelo nezinsiza zomphakathi, nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo olimi. Lo mbhalo ubeka uhlaka olukwazi ukusetshenziswa lwenhlangano ebumbene yobuliminingi ngaphakathi kwemigomo yomThethosisekelo. Ukusukela ekuhlaleni kokuqala kwamaDashi eNingizimu Afrika ngonyaka we-1652, ngokulandelana kwezikhathi zomthetho wokubusa wamaNgisi(Bhrithishi),iNyunyana yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nombuso wobandlululo nokulandelana neRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, kuze kufinyelele ekuveleni kombuso wentando yeningi ngonyaka we-1994 kanye nokufakwa emThethweni kobuliminingi obusemthethweni, umthethomgomo wolimi kahulumeni kanye namandla eziphathamandla kwehluleka ukubona ukwehluka ngokolimi kweNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela walesi simo kwaba ukungalinganiswa, lapho ukubusa kwesiNgisi nesiBhunu kwakha ukusebenzisana okungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zaboMdabu kanye nalezi zilimi.
