Ezinye izinhlobo ze-star wheels zinegate efana nesakhiwo se-disk sokukala. Lapho uvula isango, i-fertilizer eningi izophuma. Sifunde ukuthi izakhiwo zama-planters ziwuphi futhi zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukukala inani lezihlahla ne-fertilizer - kodwa manje kufanele sibuze ukuthi lezi zakhiwo ziqhutshwa kanjani? Uhlelo lokukala luvame ukuthola amandla kumathayi asekelayo i-planter. Futhi amathayi aphakanyisiwe kwesinye isikhathi asetshenziswa ukudlulisa amandla nokusekela i-planter. Ngesinye isikhathi, ithayi elilodwa lixhunywe kwi-planter elenza lowo msebenzi. Leli thayi lingabamba isisindo esanele kodwa lingacindezelwa ngesiphethu ukuze libambe kahle ngaphandle kokushelela. Kukhona futhi ama-treads nezinye izinto ezingangezwa ukuvimbela ithayi ukuthi lingasheleli kakhulu. Isivinini se-thayi esiqhuba sitholakala ngesivinini se-tractor - uma i-tractor ihamba ngokushesha, leli thayi lizohamba ngokushesha. Uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni lusetshenziswa ukukala isivinini sokuhamba kwezakhiwo ezikala inani lezihlahla, futhi kukhona olunye uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni ukukala ukuhamba kwezakhiwo ze-fertilizer.

Mazi umlingani wakho ngokocansi. Ingozi yokuthola igciwane lesandulela-ngculazi/ HIV inkulu uma ungamazi kahle lowo oya naye ocansini. Abantu abaningi abanaleli gciwane abazi ukuthi banalo. Khuluma ukhululeke nomlingani wakho mayelana nengcuphe yeNgculazi. Uma unganalo iqiniso lokuthi umlingani wakho akanalo leligciwane ziphephise uye ocansini uzivikele. Uma uphuza amponjwana kumbe ubhema umthunzi wezinkuku unokwehluleka ukulawula ukwenza kwakho. Kungalula ke nokuvuma ukuya ocansini ungazivikele futhi kulula nokuthi ukhohlwe ukusebenzisa ijazi likamkhwenyana/ikhondomu. Vele phela, uyakwazi ukuthi akufanele nje uze ushayele uma uke wathi ukuhabula utshwala kumbe wathi ukudonsa insangu. Hlala uzihlinzeke ngamakhondomu ngaso sonke isikhathi. Angeke wazi ukuthi uyokuhlangani nobani, noma ukuthi uzoba namiphi imizwa. Awazi futhi ukuthi uzogcina wenzeni. Sebenzisa ikhondomu ngaso sonke isikhathi uma ungamethembi kumbe ungamazi umlingani wakho ngokocansi, futhi ungalokothi uye kwabadayisa ngemizimba ungahlomile ngekhondomu. Ungawathenga amakhondomu emakhemisi, ezitolo, kumbe ezindaweni ezidayisa uphethiloli. Ungathola awamahhala kuzikhungo zempilo eziseca komgwaqo, emitholampilo nasezibhedlela. Asebenzise ngendlela yakhona amakhondomu. Bukisisa ulandele umbhalo okukhombisayo ukuthi asetshenziswa kanjani. Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kwaselaboratory kuphela okunokuveza iqiniso lokuthi unayo noma awunayo I- HIV. Kuhle ulihlole igazi ukuze uhlale usazi isimo sempilo yakho, wazi ukuthi unalo noma cha igciwane elandulela ingculazi kumbe yona ingculazi uqobo. Lokho kwenza ukuthi ungabe usaba nexhala nokungabaza.

Ngokufanayo, ithangi le-hitch elinokwakhiwa okungama-600 liters lizophonsa ama-hectare amathathu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uqhubeke nokuphonsa. Lapho ucabanga ukuphonsa i-herbicide, kufanele ucabangele okulandelayo: ukuthi mangaki amapulazi adingeka ukuphonswa, ukuthi ungasithola isikhathi esingakanani sokuphonsa, ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele ukuze uhlanganise amakhemikhali, amandla omatraktha nemishini - kanye ne-trailer enethangi elingabamba u-5,000 liters. Kuzosiza futhi ukufaka ipompo kulolo thangi ukuze ugcwalise ngokushesha amanye amathangi. Kufanele ulungiselele kahle ngaphambi kwesikhathi futhi uphathe kahle yonke imishini yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga emapulazini ngesikhathi sokutshala. Namuhla, kunzima ukwenza inzuzo ekulimaleni uma ungakaze ube nolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwezihlahla eziphilayo ngamakhambi, ukuphonsa lelo khemi kahle, nokusebenzisa imishini efanele. Ngaso sonke isikhathi funa usizo kulabo abanamava kanye nochwepheshe ukuze bakusize ngokuqhuba nokuphonsa ama-herbicides. Uma ungenayo imishini enamandla noma ungenayo imali yokuthenga le mishini, cabanga ngokukhokhela umphakeli onemishini yokuphonsa enkulu. Labo bantu bavame ukukhokha phakathi kuka-R65 no-R100 nge-hectare, kanye nezindleko ze-diesel. Amapulazi amakhulu angaphonswa phakathi nosuku nangezikhathi zokulala usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-GPS. Nokho, ngaphambi kokungena esivumelwaneni, qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli angafika ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi uzofika ngesikhathi esifanele uma kudingeka futhi yimaphi imishini ezodingeka ukuthi iphathwe ngumlimi noma umphakeli. Khumbula, abanye abaphakeli abanethangi lamanzi noma amabhasi.

Ngeke sikwazi ukuvumela izethembiso zethu ukuba zibe yizifungo eziyizifiso, nokufisa okungenalutho, bese ziba amazwi nje kuphela akhombisa izithembiso ezephuliwe. Esinye sezinyathelo ezathathwayo kwakuwukusatshalaliswa kwabasebenzi emigwaqweni lapho amacala enzeka khona kakhulu. Angicabangi ukuthi lokho kunegunya elisemthethweni kanti ngicabanga ukuthi kuchaza amasu okungenzeka ukuba asetshenziswa ngabaseBhrithani e-Malaysia. Usizo lwenqubomgomo yabahlwempu kuJames kumele luqale ngoNtulikazi kanti impesheni kahulumeni kumele iqale ukukhokha ngoMandulo noma ngoMfumfu. Ngiyaziqhenya ngempela ngabasebenzi beNhlangano yeZizwe ngokubhekana nezimo ezinzima nezinobungozi ukusiza labo abadinga usizo. Izolo ebusuku sibe nenkonzo esibusise ngokumangalisayo kanti siyakubonga lokho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sithola izinga eliphezulu elethulwe wuMnyango wohlelo lokugada nokuhlola. Abafundi bagqugquzelwa ukuba babhale izindatshana ezigxile ezindabeni zendawo abahlala kuzo nabafunda kuzo. Akwethusi ukuthi i-Argus yayaziwa njengephepha elikholelwa kokwasendulo. Kodwa, amathuba okuba ibheyili ikhishwe kuleli sonto awaqinisekisiwe. Umuntu wesithathu, owalimala empini, wakhonjwa ngufakazi, emva kwalokho naye waboshwa. Ngakho-ke wukwenza kwamakhasimende okuyikhona okuhlonza ukuqhutshwa kwendlela yokuqasha endaweni yokusebenza. Ngokolwazi olutholakele, ummangali nabangani bakhe ababili babehamba ngezinyawo beyokwethamela ingqungquthela yesonto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubufakazi beKomidi obethulwe wuMnu Varney, obuphinde banxusa leli Komidi ukuba lingenelele.

Ngemva kwempi, ama-ambulensi aqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Ngonyaka we-1865, i-Red Cross yaseSwitzerland yathuthukisa uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okwakuhlanganisa ama-ambulensi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo nemigudu yokusebenza kwama-ambulensi, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-ambulensi aqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi phakathi neMpi Yezwe II, izimoto eziphuthumayo zathuthuka zaba nezinsiza eziningi, ezifana nezinsiza zokwelapha eziphuthumayo, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhamba eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kwama-ambulensi, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha okuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwelapha. Namuhla, ama-ambulensi asebenza njengengxenye ebalulekile yesistimu yezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Asebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezithuthi ezisheshayo, izinsiza zokuxhumana eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Abasebenzi bama-ambulensi bahlala beqeqeshwa ukuze baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-ambulensi awasebenzi kuphela ezimeni eziphuthumayo, kodwa futhi ahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu bengenakho ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude bangathola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo.

b Uhulumeni noma Unobhala ngeke athwale isibopho sokuhlawula umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okusukela osizweni olwethulwe ngaphandle kwenhloso yobubi yilowo Nobhala ngesikhathi esiza lelo qembu kweNkantolo noma ekuqhubeni umsebenzi wokuhlangabezana nesinqumo ngokulandisa kwale mithetho ngesikhathi eluleka ngokomthetho noma ehlanganisa, eqoqa imibhalo yanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwenqubo noma umqulu. Kunoma yiluphi udaba kuhlangene nokwedlulisa udaba lapho kunengxabano ngesinqumo somthethosisekelo noma ngesenzo sokwengamela noma indlela yokuqhuba noma yophazanyiswa kwesinqumo noma isenzo sokuphatha, noma emibuzweni eqondene nokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo komthetho, kuhlangene nanoma yimuphi uMthetho wesiSishayamthetho noma lowo wesishayamthetho sesifundazwe. Lapho umaziphathe onamandla okwengamela ukuphatha, ukuqhuba nokuphazamisa isinqumo ungaqagulwanga njengeqembu elithintekayo esimangalweni, iqembu eliphonsa inselelo esenzweni esingahambisani nomthethosisekelo noma inqubo noma umthetho siyothatha isinyathelo sokuhlanganyela nomkhandlu othintekayo njengeqembu elifuna ukubamba iqhaza ezingxoxweni, lokhu kuyokwenziwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu sifake kuNobhala incwadi lapho sethula khona okokuqala isikhalo sempikiswano mayelana nodaba oluqhubekayo eNkantolo. Asikho isinqumo esichaza leso senzo, inqubo noma umthetho njengesiphambene nomthethosisekelo esiyothathwa yinkantolo kulolo daba ngaphandle kokuba yonke imibandela yalo mthetho isilandelwe ngokugcwele.

a uma isikhathi sokuqala ukusebenza esingemuva kosuku okunikwe ngalo lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yasolwandle othintekayo umyalo sibhaliwe kulowo myalo, ngaleso sikhathi; noma b ngale kwalokho, ekuqaleni kosuku lwesikhombisa ngemuva kokunikwa kwalowo obambe iqhaza embonini othintekayo. a isikhathi esibhalwe kuleso sinqumo uma sibhaliwe; noma b kuze kube sichithwa ngokubhaliwe ngoMqondisi-Jikelele. a ngezikhawu ezingadluli izinyanga ezi-3, abukeze umyalo wokuphoqwa; futhi b ngemuva kokubukeza, aqinisekise, aguqule noma achithe noma esule lowo myalo ngokubhaliwe. UMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele asule umyalo kuphela uma anelisekile ukuthi umyalo usadingeka ukuze kuvikelwe ukugxambukela okungekho emthethweni kwezokuthutha zasolwandle. a kuzoba nokubhekelwa nokuvikeleka kwezokugxambukela okungekho emthethweni kwezokuthutha olwandle. ukuhlangabezana nezidingo njengoba zibekiwe umthethonkambiso- 101 no. Uma ngabe umyalo uguqulwa, leso myalo uyaqhubeka nokusebenza njengoba uguquliwe. Ngokushesha ngemuva kokwenza noma kokubukeza umyalo, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele aqiniseke ukuba lowo obambe iqhaza oshiwo umyalo uyaziswa ngomyalo, noma ukubukezwa komyalo, noma ikuphi okwenzekayo. Ukwahluleka ukwenza lokho okushiwo yilomthethonkambiso akuphazamisi ukusebenza komyalo. a enikezwe umyalo wokuphoqwa; futhi b ehluleka ukugcina noma ukwenza lokho okushiwo umyalo. Icala okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso- 1 linesijeziso uma likulahla ungakhokhiswa inhlawulo noma uvalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12.

Uthisha, ngokwenhloso, uyakwazi ukusizakala kuzo zonke izifundo, abamba izifundo ezichelekileyo, futhi aqhubele phambili izifundo. Noma kunjalo, akukona konke okwenziwa othisha. Bahlala belwela ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabafundi. Othisha bethu badinga ukufundisa ngezinhliziyo zabo, benze abafundi babe nomdlandla, bejabulisa. Noma ngabe umphakathi unzima, othisha bethu baphila ngaphakathi kwalokho, bahlala bezama ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhlobene. Ngokuphetha, othisha bethu bahlala bekhuthaza, bejabulisa, futhi bezama ukusiza abafundi. Othisha babalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sibabonge ngakho. Lokhu akuyona nje imfundo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngakho, asiqhubekeni sabelane ngothisha bethu, sibabonge, futhi sihloniphe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula, futhi kuzoholela ekuphumeleleni. Ngiyabonga.

Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izindleko zokwelapha zingase zibe phezulu kakhulu, futhi zingabiza abantu impilo yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umshwalense wezempilo ungase unikeze umuntu ithuba lokwelashwa ngokushesha, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Okwesibili, kukhona umshwalense wezimpahla, okhathalela ukuvikela impahla yomuntu, njengemoto, ikhaya, noma impahla yebhizinisi. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi impahla yephukile, ibhuloshiwe, noma ibhujiswe, umshwalense ungakhokhela umnikazi wayo izindleko zokulungisa noma zokuthenga entsha. Okwesithathu, sikhuluma ngomswalense wokuphila. Le nhlangano ivikela umndeni uma umnikazi wemishwalense eshintsha, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi umndeni uthola imali ethile ukuze uqhubeke nokuphila ngendlela efanayo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu, njengoba kungasiza ukuvikela abantu abaseduze nomnikazi ngesikhathi sokulahlekelwa. Ukubaluleka Kwezomshwalense Ukubaluleka kwezomshwalense akungabazi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uma kwenzeka okuthile, abantu abathintekayo bazoba nekhono lokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Ngaphandle kwesimo sokwelashwa, umshwalense ungavikela umuntu emishwalense ethinta izimo zokuphila, ezinjengokuphazamiseka emsebenzini noma ukulahlekelwa yimpahla. Izingxoxo ezijulile zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abathola umshwalense bahlala benokuthula kwengqondo, ngoba bazi ukuthi bakhululekile uma kwenzeka ukuphazamiseka. Izindleko Zomshwalense Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda nezindleko ezithintekayo. Imishwalense ivamise ukutholakala ngemali ethile, futhi lezi zindleko zingahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomshwalense, izinga lokuvikeleka, kanye nezimo zomuntu.

Sizokwenza njalo kulonyaka njengoba siqala. Umthetho Wokwabiwa Kwezimali Wabantu bethu udinga ukuthi silalele imizwa nemibono yabantu abahlukene. Senze kanjalo kulonyaka futhi. Sihlangane nezinkonzo ukuze sithole imibono yabo, sihlangane nezinhlangano zomsebenzi ukuze sithole imibono yabo; futhi sivakashele izindawo eziningi ukuze sixoxe nomphakathi ezindaweni zabo. Siyabonga kakhulu ukuthi umphakathi wethu usekela kakhulu leli hlelo. Umkhulumeli kanye Nezithunywa Ezihloniphekile, ulwazi esilutholayo kubantu emphakathini lunenani elikhulu. Sibone ukuthi izinga lemibono alihambisani nalokho esikukhona lapha eNdlu yenu Ehloniphekile. Uma ngingacaphuna eminye imibono, ngesikhathi sikhona eMandini naseBergville bekukhona imibono efanayo evela kuJabulisiwe Sithole noThabani Kubheka ukuthi kubonakala sengathi imali ebekwe kwiMnyango Wezokwakha iyancipha ngenkathi isidingo sendlu siqhubeka sikhula. Ngiyethemba bazokujabulela ukuzwa namuhla ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwemali kwiMnyango Wezokwakha kukhuphukile ngo-29%. UMnu. Thamsanqa Thwala waseThekwini uthe uma kuqhathaniswa nokwakhiwa kwemali kwiMnyango Wezemfundo kanye neMnyango Wezempilo, kukhona umehluko omkhulu. Ngokuvamile, iMnyango Wezempilo ibonakala ihluleka. Ngaleso sikhathi, eShowe, uMnu. Lucky Mkhize wabona ukuthi iMnyango Wezemfundo kungenzeka udinge uxhaso olungeziwe. Ngiyethemba impendulo ekhombisa ukuthi izabelo zalezi zMnyango ezimbili zikhuphukile izobajabulisa. Siphinde sithole abantu ezindaweni ezahlukene bekhalaza ngokungatholi usizo ngesikhathi soktraining nangaleso sikhathi beqinisekisa izinhlelo zabo zebhizinisi.

Ukwebiwa kogesi kuchaza noma luphi uhlobo lokugxambukela okungagunyaziwe amathuluzi, izinto noma izinsiza zokuxhuma ngendlela etshengisa noma engaholela esimweni sokungafundeki noma sokuntshontsheka kwenani logesi noma ekuhlomuleni ugesi ngendlela engafanele. Ukwebiwa kogesi kuyinselelo edinga kubhekanwe nayo ngenhloso yokusimamisa lemboni yokuphakela ugesi. Kungani kubalulekile? Akukho emthethweni: ukweba kuthathwa njengesenzo esiyicala nesijeziswayo ngaphansi komthetho. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngaphandle kwemvume yokuwuxhuma noma ukubhalisa njengekhasimende esikhungweni sendawo yokuphakela ugesi kanjalo nokuphazamisa imitha kagesi yinto eyicala. Ukugwema lesisimo, kufanele uthintane nomphakeli-gesi wakho wendawo bese ufaka isicelo. Kuyodingeka ukhokhe inani lokuxhuma ugesi ngaphambi kokuphasiswa kwesicelo sakho. Abukho ubulungiswa kulawo makhasimende awukhokhelayo ugesi. Ukuphazamiseka kogesi: ukuxhuma ugesi ngokungemthetho kuvame ukuholela ekwesindweni kwengqalasizinda kagesi, ngaleyo ndlela bese ude uwa. Ukwesindwa kungaphazamisa nezindawo ezingomakhelwane. Ukuphazamiseka kogesi kwaloluhlobo akulona iphutha lomphakeli-gesi. Ukwesindwa kogesi kungaholela nasemandleni kagesi angalawuleki ngokwezinga elejwayelekile nokuyinto engalimaza izinto zasendlini ezisebenza ngogesi, ikakhulu kulawo makhasimende awukhokhelayo ugesi. Okunzima wukuthi lamakhasimende angenacala angeke aba nandlela yokukhononda kumphakeli-gesi, ngenxa yokuthi lenkinga isuke ingadalwanga wumphakeli-gesi noma kungenxa yobudedengu bakhe. Abaphakeli-gesi badinga ukuthola inzuzo efanele umsebenzi wabo ukuze babhekana nezindleko zogesi abawuthenga kubakhiqizi bogesi.

Ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luyimfihlo futhi luyimfihlo futhi ngeke lukhululwe kumuntu. Luzosetshenziswa kuphela ezinhlelweni zokucwaninga nasekucwangcweni. Igama lakho, ikheli, kanye nezinye imininingwane yakho yomuntu zizokhishwa ku-questionnaire, futhi kuzosebenza kuphela amakhodi ukuze kuhlanganiswe igama lakho nezimpendulo zakho ngaphandle kokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho. Iqembu Locwaningo lingase likuthinte futhi uma kudingeka ukuze kuqedwe ulwazi locwaningo noma ukuqoqa ulwazi olwengeziwe esikhathini esizayo. Uma kudingeka lokhu, kuzokwenzeka ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ezilandelayo. Lolu cwaningo luzoqhubeka isikhathi eside, futhi sizobuyela kule ndawo cishe ezinyangeni ezimbili. Sizozama ukuthinta lo mndeni futhi, futhi sithanda ukukhuluma nawe futhi. Le mininingwane iwukwazisa kuphela futhi ayidingi imvume yakho. Ukusayina le mvume kukhombisa ukuthi uqonda ukuthi kuzolindelwa kuwe futhi uyavuma ukujoyina lolu cwaningo. Awudingi ukujoyina lolu cwaningo uma ungafuni. Unesikhathi sokuhoxa kulolu cwaningo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uzizwe ukhululekile ukuveza imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uma ufuna ukuveza imibuzo kamuva, ungathintana nanoma ubani kulabo abalandelayo: uProfesa Nancy Phaswana-Mafuya (Ucingo: 021-4667914), uProfesa Karl Peltzer (Ucingo: 012-3022000), noma uMargie Schneider (Ucingo: 012-3022000) be-Human Sciences Research Council. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama omphenduli... Ngifunde ulwazi olukhona kule fomu yokuvuma, noma lufundwe kimi. Nginethuba lokubuza imibuzo, futhi noma yimiphi imibuzo engiyibuzile iphendulwe kahle.

Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kuphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo, lapho izindawo ezisemthethweni zihlupheka ngenxa yokuthi zidinga izinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ngenxa yokungakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokuhlala. Izimpempe Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezimpempe eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo, ezokuphepha, nezomthetho. Okokuqala, lezi zindawo zihlupheka ngezinkinga zempilo, njengoba abantu bengenayo imithombo efanele yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okwenza kube nzima ukuba abantu baphile impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zihlala zikhungathekile, futhi lokhu kuholela ezimeni zokweba, udlame, nokuhlukunyezwa. Okwesibili, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho. Abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo bavame ukuba sengozini yokwenziwa kwemithetho, okungaholela ekutheni kube khona ukuhoxiswa kwezindlu zabo. Lokhu kubangela ukungabi nokuqonda kwezokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima ukuba abantu bakhe izimpilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zihlupheka ngezinkinga zomphakathi, njengoba abahlali bengenayo imisebenzi ethile yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Izixazululo Zokunciphisa Ukwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Ukuze kuncishiswe ukwenzeka kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele ahlinzeke ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni ezishibhile, ukuze abantu abampofu bakwazi ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni.

Kufanele siqale ngezitshalo ezilula ukutshala, bese siqhubeka kwezinye izitshalo ezinzimana. Nikeza umlimi ithuba lokuqala ukulima ngezinto enazo - ukuqala ngezinto ezincane endaweni encane kungcono ngoba akungeke kulethe ingozi enkulu. (Khumbula ukuthi loyo muntu ofisa ukusebenzisa indawo yakhe uphumelele ngaso sonke isikhathi ngemali evela noma kuphi. Uma ekwazi ukuthola inzuzo encane nje ehektheleni elilodwa kuyimali ekhukhwini ngaphezu kwaleyo ayiholayo. Ngokuqala endaweni encane umlimi uzokwehlisa itshansi lokuvelelwa ingozi, uma elandela umlayezo oqondile, uzokhula ngolwazi nangamandla). Ungamcindiseli umlimi ukusebenzisa umnkontilaki, kungcono ukusiza umlimi aphathe alungise imishini yakhe alime ngokwakhe. Kuzoba ngcono futhi umlimi eqashisa amasimu angawasebenzisi ngesikhathi ezama ukukhula emsebenzini wokulima. Ukuthola umaluleki othembekileyo kuyinto enhle - kodwa kufanele kube umuntu oqotho, hhayi lowo nalowo! Umaluleki ungumuntu ononake, ofisa ukukhulisa umlimi, umuntu ozothatha isikhathi sokunikeza ulwazi nokumsekekeIa. Ukuhlangana nokusebenzisana ngaphakathi komlimi nomaluleki kufanele kube kuhle - bayathembana, bayahloniphana, bezwa okumnandi lapho basebenzisana bahlangene. E-Eastern Cape kunzima ukuthola abaluleki ngoba abekho abakhiqizi bezomnotho emaphandleni. Kufanele siqhubeke ukwazisa abalimi, akufanele sithathe izinyathelo ngaphandle kokukhuluma nabo - 'asivuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu'. Sekela abalimi ukubheka kahle isimo sebhizinisi sabo sokulima - amasimu abo, ogandaganda, imishini, izimpahla, izimfuyo, izinto bazinazo, izikwenethu, njll.

Amalungu, anyunyane zawo azilandelanga imigomo, kumele aqaphele ukuthi isiteleka esingavikelekile ngakho-ke bayothathelwa izinyathelo zokuqondisa izigwegwe. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi bangabuyisela izimpahla kubahlinzeki bezikweletu ngokwesivumelwano sokukhokha amancozuncozu. Umasipala angakwazi, ngokwesixazululo somkhandlu wawo, uhlinzeka ukuphepha nganoma yiziphi izibopho zezikweletu. Sinenkululeko yokuhlangana kanye nokubuthana nokudansa ngokugubha ukwehlukana kanye nokuhlangana kwethu. Ikomidi lezimo ezibucayi lethiwa kanjalo ngabezindaba, laliyiqembu lalabo baholi, abaholi bomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, sidinga ukunweba imizamo yethu kanye nayo yonke imithombo esingayithola ukuzingela le nhloso. Zonke izimoto ezihamba ku-Soldiers Way ezehla ngo-Gardiner Street ziyokhonjwa ku-Pine Street. UMthetho uphinde uhlinzeke izindlela ezehlukene zokukhipha isigwebo okungakhethwa kuzo ezilungele izidingo zabantwana. Umbiko ngezindaba zomnotho zemboni kaphayinaphu eNingizimu Afrikha. Cha, angikhumbuli kahle ngoba anginazo izincwadi zokukhombisa lokho. Ekugcineni, lezo zithombe kumele sikhathazeke ngazo. Ukwedluliselwa kwamalungelo kuHulumeni kuzokhulula imboni yezimayini kulabo abasanda kuqala, nokuzothuthukisa imboni ezimele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunenye "into yokulengisa ukhiye" ezosetshenziswa kokhiye bemoto nama-alamu asekhaya. Le ncwadi isilungiselwe ukuvezwa kwi-inthanethi. Waphendula ukuthi akazi ukuthi kukhona lokho nokuthi ubufakazi baqoshwa ngendlela engeyiyo. Cha, ngahlinzeka ushevu kuDkt Immelman kuphela, abe esekwenza ngoshevu-ke angikwazi, akangitshelanga.

Yingani sizinikela esikweni lokunikeza usizo olungungqaphambili? ukwaneliseka umuntu akuthola uma eqathanisa ukusebenza noma ukusebenziseka kwaleyonto ayitholile kanye nalokho abekulindele. Ukunikeza usizo olungungqaphambili ezingeni lomhlaba ukwandisa izinga losizo esilinikeza amakhasimede ethu ngokuguqula ukugxila komngqondo wabasebenzi bethu kusuka kuleyo ngqondo yesikhashana ngokwemvelo siyiguqulele kuleyo yokuzinza kumakhasimede - ngokwenza njalo siyohlangabezana futhi sengeze kulokho obekulindelwe ngamakhasimede kulelibhange nosizo lwalo. Usizo olungungqaphambili yilona esiluzabalazela sonke isikhathi, ngoba phela siyazi ukuthi wena ulindele usizo olungungqaphambili kuleli bhange lezoMhlaba. Uma ngabe usizo oluthole namhlanje lukuthokozisile, siyakucela ukuthi uxoxele umngani wakho. Uma ngabe ungathokozanga yazisa uMqondisi walelogatsha. Sekuye kwanda ukubaluleka kokugxila ekugcineni amakhasimede. Ibhange lezoMhlaba liyokwazi ukugcina amakhasimede alo kuphela uma lenza ngcono ekuhlangabezeni nasekwaneliseni izidingo zamakhasimede. Esikhathini esedlule iBhange lezoMhlaba belingungqoshishilizi, futhi bekungadingeki ukuba lenze imizamo eyisimpesheli ukuze ligcine amakhasimede. Manje, Ibhange lezoMhlaba selincintisana ngamakhasimede namanye amabhange ahwebayo. Labantu manje sebengazikhethela ukuthi bafuna yiphi impahla noma luphi usizo. Amakhasimede amanje asefundile futhi awacengi. Izinga lokulindelwe yilabantu selikhuphukile ngenxa yempahla nosizo oluphambili olutholakalayo.

uma imali okufanele ikhokhelwe intela yendawo ingakhokhiwe kuze kwedlule usuku oluqokwe ngokulandisa kwesigaba -23 , umasipalati angayibuyisa leyomali iyisamba esiphelele noma ngengxenye kulowo ohlezi endlini. isamba umasipalati angase asibuyise kulowo oqashile akufanele sibe ngaphezulu kwemali yokuqasha noma enye imali okufanele ikhokhwe yilowo oqashile noma ohleli endlini eyikhokhela umnikazi wendlu. noma yisiphi isamba umasipalati asibuyisayo kulowo oqashile noma ohleli endlini singasetshenziswa ekukhokheleni isikweletu somnikazi. uma umnikazi wendlu engekho umasipalati angasibuyisa ngokuphelele isamba semali yentela yendawo okufanele sikhokhelwe indlu noma asibuyise ngezikhawu kulowo muntu owamukela imali yenkokhelo yendlu egameni lomnikazi. umasipalati angasibuyisa isamba semali yokukhokhela intela yendawo kulowo muntu owamukela imali yokuqasha indlu egameni lomnikazi, emva kokuba esethumele isaziso esibhalwe phansi kulowo owemukela imali egameni lomnikazi. isamba esingabuyiswa ngumasipalati kulowo muntu omukela imali yokuqasha indlu egameni lomnikazi ngeke sedlule esambeni saleyomali yokuqasha indlu esemukelwa yilowo owemukela imali egameni lomnikazi noma lowomuntu esethunyelelwe isaziso ngumasipalati noma lowo muntu okukhulunywa ngaye esigatshaneni- 2, sekukhishwe imali yeholo lalowo muntu ngokulandisa komthetho olawula Izindaba Zabasingathi Bamafa ongunombolo- -112 we-1976. lowo osingethe noma lowo muntu, onxuswe ngumasipalati ukuba anikeze umasipalati yonke imininingwane ebhaliwe emayelana nenkokhelo yokuqasha indlu ayemukele ngesikhathi esiqokwe yilowo masipalati.

Yiba nobungane, ungabandlululi, yiba ngolindele okuhle ube nobuntu. Khombisa ukwenza umsebenzi ngobungoti futhi uhlale ulindele okuhle ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ungavumeli amakhasimede ezwe ingxoxo yenu yangasese, noma ngabe nixoxa ngocingo noma ingxoxo phakathi kwabasebenzi ababili. Yenza ngokubona kwakho. Ungaphenduli umakhalekhukhwini wakho ungacelanga uxolo kuqala ekhasimedeni futhi uxolise uma uqeda ukukhuluma ngomakhalekhukhwini. Lazise ikhasimede ulitshele ukuthi uyaphi uma usuka lapho usebenzela khona. Lalelisisa ngokuqaphela futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ubuza yonke imibuzo ezoholelela ekutholeni lonke ulwazi olufanele. Qiniseka ukuthi ukuzwa kahle konke akushoyo ngisho ngabe lokhu kusho ukuthola umuntu ozokutolikela. Qiniseka ukuthi uyaluzwa undaba olethulwe kuwe ngaphambi kokuba uzame ukuluxazulula. Baphathe ngenhlonipho enkulu bonke abantu ungabheki ukuthi banjani. Bonke abantu bathathe njengabalethe iGolide. Zinike isikhathi sokuchazela lowo muntu omsizayo ukuthi yingani isicelo sakhe sokubolekwa imali sachithwa. Uma ngabe lowo omsizayo engeke akwazi ukunikwa imalimboleko ngokweBhulonzi, iSiliva noma iGolide, yedlulisela lowo muntu kolunye uhlobo lwemalimboleko olungaphansi (ibhulonzi ezomnikwa isinyathelo sokuqala). Zinike isikhathi uzame ukuniza lowo muntu usizo olufanele kanye nocayi ngokwezimali (risk classification) okuzohambisana nezidingo zakhe. Ungagxeki amaphutha uthi enziwe yibhange lakwenye indawo noma yibhange eliyinhloko. Inkinga yenze ibe ngeyakho futhi ungaliboleka imali okwesikhashana ikhasimede uma isimo sivuma. Ngwema ukwenza umsebenzi ongaphathelene nokusiza abantu uma bephambi kwakho bekubona.

Izimvume zezithuthi ezibekelwe isikhathi ezinika amandla okusebenza endaweni echaziwe kumele zishintshelwe kumalayisense okusebenza echaza umgudu ngamunye namathebula alemigudu. Izimvume zezithuthi ezibekelwe izikhathi ezikhishwe ngokwezivumelwano zesikhashana nezivumelwano ezisebenza ngalesosikhathi kumele zishintshelwe kumalayisense okusebenza ngokubalulwe kulezozivumelwano. Izimvume zezithuthi ezingabekelwe zikhathi, kungabalwa ezamatekisi amamitha nezamatakitaki ezivumela ukusebenza endaweni echaziwe kumele zishintshelwe kumalayisense okusebenza achaza umgudu noma imigugu ngokusobala, kodwa indawo echaziwe inganikezwa ezimeni ezehlukile, njenganasemikhukhwini lapho kungekho khona imigwaqo ecacile. Izimvume zezamatekisi amamitha kumele zishintshelwe kumalayisense okusebenza acaciselwe noma abekelwe indawo athatha kuyo abagibeli, ngokukwesigaba 8. Indlela yokufaka izicelo ngaphasi kwesigatshana 2 izoba njengokuba imisiwe. Isiphathimandla semvume akumele singenele isivumelwano esixhasiwe ngaphandle kokwamukela ithenda ngokwemigomo ebekwe ngu MEC, ngokuya ngoko Mthetho ka Zwelonke. isigatshana 1 sizosebenza kanjalo kwizivumelwano zokuthutha ezingaxhasiwe, ngaphandle uma uMEC exolela ezokuthutha ezithile noma izinhlobo zevivumelwano kulezizidingongqangi ngokumemezela ku Somqulu. Izivumelwano kumele zinikezwe ngu Mnyango noma yisiphathimandla sezokuthutha esifanelekile ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zezokuthutha, ngokuya ngokwesigaba 39 5 ngoshintsho olufanele.

Izindlela Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Incazelo Engenhla Ukubeletha kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ukuhlangana komama nezinsana zabo. Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidlala indima enkulu ekunikezeni ukuhlinzeka okufanele nezindlela zokuphepha. Lezi zindlela zingatholakala emabhodleni ahlukene, ezibhedlela eziphakeme, kanye nasemakhaya. Kulesi sikhathi, sizoqhubeka nokuchaza izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokubeletha ezibhedlela, izinyathelo ezibandakanyekile, kanye nezinzuzo zazo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha ziqala kanjani. Umama ofikela esibhedlela ukuze abelethe, uqala ngesikhashana sokuhlola impilo neqhaza labodokotela. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi komama nabahlinzeki bezempilo, ukuze kubonakale ukuthi kudingeka ziphi izinyathelo ezithile. Ngokuvamile, umama udinga ukuhlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi uhlelwe yini kahle, futhi lokho kusemqoka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi impilo yomama nephaya bana iyi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi umama azizwe ephumile njengezinga przicional, ukuze abe nesithakazelo nempilo nomntwana wakhe. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, umama uzodinga ukufaka isikhumbuzo sokubeletha. Lokhu kuvame ukuhamba ngesikhatsi sokuphuma kokuphila, lapho umama ethola izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze akhululeke ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Indlu yesikhumbuzo isetshenziswa ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula kothile ukugibela izinyathelo ezibalulekile. Ikakhulukazi, umama uzokhumbuza ezokuphila njengoba lezi zinyathelo ziphuma khona.

Ungaba kanjani yingxenye yokugubha ukufungiswa kukaMongameli? Iziteshi eziningi zethelevishini nezomsakazo zizokwenza ukusakazwa kokufungiswa bukhoma ngomhla ka-9 kuNhlangulana 2009 - uzobe ulalela? Kukhona nezinye izenzakalo ezihlelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni - yiba yingxenye yayo! Uma udinga ulwazi ngemicimbi endaweni yakho, shayela u-1020 (inombolo yokushayela engenamali uma ushayela kusuka kumakhalekhukhwini). Ndawonye sihlangene ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo!

Ikhono Lokuphatha Abaphathi beqembu, ikakhulukazi uPitso Mosimane, benze imizamo emikhulu yokuthuthukisa amaSundowns. Uqinisekisile ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zisebenza kahle ukuze kugcinwe ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabadlali nokuqanjwa kwezindlela ezintsha zomdlalo. Lokhu kuphumelela kwesikhala sokuphatha kudlale indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni amaSundowns abe qembu elihloniphekile. Ukujabulisa Abalandeli Abalandeli beMamelodi Sundowns bangabantu abanjalo, behlale beseka iqembu labo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi imiphumela ibukeka kanjani. Ukubamba imicimbi ehlukene, njengezikhumbuzo zomphakathi, kuhlobene nokubaluleka kokuba nemiphakathi eqinile, nokuxhasa abadlali ngesikhathi somsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweqembu nabalandeli. Isiphetho AmaMamelodi Sundowns aqhubeka nokuba ngempumelelo enkulu, ebonisa isibindi, ubuchule, nokuzinikela emqhudelwaneni. Ngokusebenza kanzima, izinqumo ezicacile, nezinsizakalo eziyinkanyezi, leli qembu liqhubeka lishaya izinhlelo eziphakeme zokudlala. Ngaphandle kokubhaliswa kwezikhalazo, amaSundowns ayisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi, ubudlelwano, nokuba neqhaza emiphakathini kungaba namandla amakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile emhlabeni wombhoxo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, amaMamelodi Sundowns azohamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika, futhi sizobona impumelelo yabo eminyakeni ezayo. Hamba uMasandawana!

Usihlalo womkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba nguyena othatha isinqumo ekuthini umkhandlu uhlanganela kuphi nokuthi uhlangana nini, kodwa kufanele abize umhlangano uma iningi lamalungu omkhandlu limnxusa ngokubhala phansi ukuba abize umhlangano ngesikhathi esithile nokuba uhlanganele ndawana thize njengalokhu kucela isicelo. Ngenkathi kulalelwa udaba olwedlulisiwe, umkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba kufanele uhlanganele endaweni kaMasipalati ophepha lawo lokuhlola lingundaba mlonyeni wokwedluliselwa kodaba noma lokubuyekezwa kodaba. Uma usihlalo engekho, noma engatholakali, noma uma kunesikhala ehhovisi likasihlalo, amanye amalungu omkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba engaqoka omunye wawo ukuba asingathe umhlangano nma asebenze njengosihlalo. Umkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba ungadinga ukuba umkhandlu ophepha lawo lokuhlola liyacutshungulwa, uwubhekele indawo noma ihhovisi okungahlanganelwa kulo nolunye usizo lwezokuphatha kubandakanya abasebenzi balo mkhandlu. Umasipalati ophepha lawo lokuhlola liyacutshungulwa, yiwona obhekana nezindleko zomkhandlu wokwdluliselwa kwezindaba. Umkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba ungahlonza inqubo yawo yangaphakathi ngokulandela noma yiyiphi inqubo engase ibekwe ngokusemthethweni mayelana nokuqhuba kwawo ukuchitha izindaba ezedluliswayo. Umbuzo ngaphambi komkhandlu wokwedlulisela izindaba, uhlelwa yivoti elesekayo okungenani leningi lamalungu omkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba. Umhloli kaMasipalati kufanele alungise amaphepha okuhlola ngokulandela izinqumo ezithathwe emkhandlwini wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba.

Isu lezolimo lifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eqala ezingeni lokuqala iye emkhiqizweni wokugcina, njengokuthandwa kwabathengi. Ulwazi lwemakethe, ukuthengisa, nokuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kwezolimo kuthinta ukwethemba emakethe, kuthinta amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kumfanelo raw noma enezinhlaka ezingeziwe. Ukuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kubalulekile, futhi ukusebenza kahle kwesu lezolimo kunomthelela omkhulu kumakethe evunyelwe abakhiqizi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthinta izinqumo zabo. Imakethe ichazwa njengendawo lapho abathengi (abathengi) nabathengisi (abakhiqizi) behlangana futhi bashintshisana ngezimpahla noma ngezinsizakalo ngentengo abavumelana ngayo. Ukuxhasa inqubo yokwenza izinqumo mayelana nokuphathwa kwezolimo kubalulekile, kuhlanganisa nokuqonda ukuthi nini nokuthi kuphi ukuthengisa. Ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kulwazi lwemakethe oluchanile kubalulekile. Amanani nezindleko kudlala indima enkulu ezinqumweni ezithinta ezolimo. Amanani nezindleko kuthinta ukusabalalisa nokwabiwa kwezinsiza zezolimo. Intengo evunyelwe ibonisa ukuthi uma kukhona ukuphazamiseka emakethe, amanani, izinga lokusetshenziswa, nezinga lokukhiqiza konke kulawulwa yisikhathi nezinsiza. Abathengi babhekana nenkinga yokwenza ukukhetha. Banemfuno ehlukahlukene, kuhlanganisa lezo ezidinga izinketho - okusho ukuthi ukuthandwa kwabo akukhawulelwe emikhiqizweni ethile. Bazama ukukhetha imikhiqizo ehambelana nezidingo zabo kangcono, ngaphandle kokukhawulelwa yizindleko zemikhiqizo abayithandayo. Ukunikezwa kungachazwa njengobudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani elinikeziwe.

Isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika esifuna ukuba nesimo sokuba yisakhamuzi sakwelinye izwe kumele senze isicelo kwaboMnyango wezaseKhaya ukuze sikwazi ukuqhubeka nokuba yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika kodwa sibe sithola isimo sokuba yisakhamuzi sakwelinye izwe. Ukuba nesimo sokuba yisakhamuzi samazwe amabili kusho ukuthi umuntu othathwa njengasakhamuzi sawo womabili amazwe. Isimo sokuba yasakhamuzi samazwe amabili sinikezwa abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-21. Yenza isicelo kwinxusa noma imission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-1664 kanye ne-BI-529 kunoma yiliphi ihhovisi lezaseKhaya eNingizimu Afrika. Khipha umazisi esebenzayo. Kungathatha amaviki ayisithupha ukufinyelela kumaviki ayisishagalombili.

Uhulumeni weqiniso weDemokhrasi uthola amandla awo kubantu ngokubamba ukhetho ngezikhathi ezithile futhi ngempela umphakathi uqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza ezinqubweni zokuphatha. Isiqubulo sikhuthaza ubukhona benkululeko yokubamba iqhaza, obonakalayo, kanye nokubophela, lapho abantu bezwa izindaba zomthetho nezokubheka. Kuphikisana indima yePhalamende ekumelelayo abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni wabantu ophatha ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Umsebenzi wePhalamende kanye namalungu akhe kufanele ugxile ekwenzeni ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nabamele babo abakhethiweyo. Impumelelo yePhalamende itholakala ekubambeni okubonakalayo kwabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubatshela abamele babo abakhethiweyo, abangaba ngamalungu ePhalamende (ama-MPs), kanye naleli zikhungo indlela yokusebenza okudingeka yenziwe. Isigaba sesithupha: Ukubambisana nezakhamuzi IPhalamende linomsebenzi wokubambisana nezakhamuzi. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuhlela imihlangano, lapho izakhamuzi zingabamba iqhaza khona, zikhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi wazo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze iPhalamende iqonde izidingo nezifiso zabantu, futhi ikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nalezi zidingo lapho ibhala khona imithetho. Isigaba sesixhenxe: Ukuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yePhalamende Ukuze iPhalamende iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlola imisebenzi yayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi imithetho ibhalwe kahle, ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngendlela efanele, nokuthi izakhamuzi zifinyelela kanjani ezinsizeni ezitholakala ngaphansi kwemithetho. Ukuhlola lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuphendula izikhalazo ezivela kubantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi iPhalamende iyakwazi ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona. Isigaba sesishiyagalombili: Ukubuyekeza umthetho Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izidingo zomphakathi zishintsha. IPhalamende kufanele ibuyekeze imithetho yayo ukuze ihambisane nezimo ezikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umthetho uhlale uvumelana nezidingo zabantu, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlala zikhululekile futhi ziphila kahle. Isiphetho IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuqonda izinqubo zalo, ukusebenza kwalo, nokubambisana nezakhamuzi kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azibandakanye, aqonde, futhi abe neqhaza ekwakheni iPhalamende elisebenzayo, elihloniphekile, nelikhululekile.

Ngaphezulu kombiko oshicilelwe kwiGazethe, kuyosatshalaliswa omunye umbiko obhalwe ngolimi oluqondakala kalula ukuze kuqinisekwe ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi bayazi ngale nqubo. Kuyosungulwa usomqulu oqukethe imisebenzi yolimi (isibonelo, ingodla enamagama ezikhungo/izinkampani/amathimba olimi, imisebenzi yokuguqulela kolunye ulimi imibhalo, ukulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni nehlelo lamagama olimi, ukuhlela ulimi). Imibhalo efanayo yomqulu oqukethe imisebenzi yolimi iyosatshalaliswa nezinhlaka zikazwelonke nohulumeni bezifundazwe nasezinhlanganweni zolimi kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. Le misebenzi iyotholakala nasezikhungweni zeDAC ezitholakala kukhompuyutha, izikhungo zeDAC ziyohlala zinemininingwane emisha. Ukuphatha ngobunyoninco umsebenzi oqhubekayo wenqubomgomo kuyoqina ngokukhipha ulwazi ngezinsiza ezikhona nezinhlaka zolimi. Kunesidingo sesigcawu noma sohlelo olumiselwe kuphela umsebenzi wokuqoqa nokusabalalisa ulwazi lwenqubomgomo yolimi nezindaba eziphathelene nokuqhuba umsebenzi, imizamo yokuqala into entsha nezinkomba (ikakhulu ezingeni likazwelonke, ezingeni lesiFunda saseMazansi neZwekazi lase-Afrika kuze kufike ezingeni lomhlaba). Izinhloso wukukhuthaza ukushintshisana ngolwazi, ucwaningo nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezisingethe ulimi namathimba anentshisekelo. Ngaphezulu kwephephandaba eliphuma njalo ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu, kuyosungulwa isikhungo esitholakala kukhompuyutha esiyoba ngumthombo wezindaba zemisebenzi. INLS iyofuna ngamandla ulwazi olufanele neminikelo evela kulabo ababambe iqhaza.

Abantu kanye nezikhungo ezingalandeli izinqumo ezithathwe wuMkhandlu zingathathelwa izinyathelo zokushushiswa. UNgqongqoshe wezamaKhono, amaSiko, iSayense nobuChwepheshe wazemukela izincomo zokuqokwa kwalaba bantu abalandelayo, nabakhethwa yiKomidi lokuQoka. Abaqokwa bayosebenza eMkhandlwini waseNingizimu Afrika wokuQamba iziNdawo amaGama. Umkhandlu wathatha indawo yeKomidi likaZwelonke lamaGama elaleluleka uhulumeni ngokuphasisa amagama athile ezindawo kusukela ngonyaka ka1940. Kwezinye zezinto ezehluke kakhulu phakathi koMkhandlu nophiko olwalusebenza esikhathini esiphambili, wukuthi loMkhandlu unikwe amandla amaningi axuba lonke uhlobo lwendawo kubandakanya; ukuzifunela ngokwawo lezozindawo ezidinga ukuqanjwa kabusha noma zethiwe okokuqala nokuthi izinqumo zawo ziyophoqelela, uma nje zamukelwe wuNgqongqoshe. UMkhandlu ususungule inkambiso nenqubo-mgomo, ngokulandela izinqumo nenqubo yeZizwe eziBumbene zoMhlaba. UMkhandlu unegunya kuwo wonke amagama ezindawo nezinto kanye nezakhiwo ezingaphansi kwemingcele yezwe laseNingizimu Afrika nalapho lelizwe libusa khona, noma lezo zindawo ezitholakale ngokuxoxisana okuthile. Ezinye izizathu ezifanele nezingatholwa. o amagama abantu abasaphila. Ukunquma igama noma amagama ngendawo kudinga ukuqhathanisa okuphusile phakathi komlando nesidingo solimi, ubulula bokuxhumana, intando yomphakathi neyesizwe sonkana. ukugqugquzela ulwazi ngomhlomulo otholwa wumnotho kanjalo nenhlaliswano ngenxa yomfaniswano ngamagama ezindawo. ukuveza iqhinga lokukhipha, kufakwe amanye amagama ezindaweni ezaqanjwa ngaphansi kwencindezi.

Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga noma wehluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho, izimo, noma noma yiziphi izinhlinzeko zalomthetho, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga izaziso eziphathelene nesigaba 2, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Uma umkhandlu uthola ukuthi izinsolo ngaphansi kwesigaba 3 ziyiqiniso, bangase babeke imali engaphansi kuka-R2,000,000.00 ngosuku uma le miphumela engahambisani iqhubeka. Ukuze sithole isixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke uhlanganyele. Abazali, othisha, nabafundi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe isimo esiphephile nezindawo zokufunda. Ukukhuluma ngale nkinga, ukufundisa abafundi ngezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi kungasiza ekunciphiseni ubuxhwanguxhwangu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya ukufundisa abafundi ngezinto ezinjengokuhlonipha, ukuziphatha kahle, nokubambisana. Ekugcineni, ubuxhwanguxhwangu ezikoleni yinkinga edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze siqede le nkinga. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izimbangela, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa, futhi sakhe isiko lokuhlalisana kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusiza abafundi bethu ukuba bakhule, bathole impumelelo, futhi babe nekhono lokuphila kahle empilweni yabo. Ubuxhwanguxhwangu akufanele buphumelele; kumele sibe neqhaza eliqinile ekulweni nalesi simo.

Inkokhelo yezimoto zangasese R 9 269. Yomphakathi R 92 598. Mina, Baldwin Sipho Ngubane, uNgqongqoshe wezamaKhono, amaSiko, iSayense nobuChwepheshe, ngigunyaza ngokusemthethweni lamagama ezindawo alandelayo ngemuva kokwelulekwa yiKomidi likaZwelonke lamaGama eziNdawo, zingu 9 Juni 2000. Mina, Baldwin Sipho Ngubane, uNgqongqoshe wezamaKhono, amaSiko, iSayense nobuChwepheshe, ngigunyaza ngokusemthethweni lamagama ezindawo alandelayo ngemuva kokwelulekwa yiKomidi likaZwelonke lamaGama eziNdawo, zingu 14 Mashi 2000.

Inani lezihlahla ezitshaliwe lihambisana nesivinini (isivinini) sepuleti elijikelezayo. Isakhiwo esivamile esiletha i-fertilizer sithiwa i-auger efana nesikhwama. Le screw ihlezi ngaphansi ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede elibamba i-fertilizer). Ngokuvamile, le screw iqhutshwa yicheni evela kumathayi ahamba emhlabeni anikeza amandla. Lapho i-fertilizer ilethwa, ibanjwa ezindaweni ze-screw bese ithuthwa lapho iphuma khona. Indlela yokushintsha ukukala yile: shintsha ama-sprockets aqhuba icheni ngaphakathi kwe-bucket kanye nephayiphi yamandla. Isakhiwo se-disk esikala inani le-fertilizer sithandwa kakhulu kuma-planters angakakhiphi kakhulu. Idiski yokukala ayifani ne-screw ethumela i-fertilizer. Ikakhulukazi, i-fertilizer iyaphuma ebhakeni le-fertilizer futhi idiski yokukala isiza ukukhulula i-fertilizer. Isakhiwo esihamba i-fertilizer siyisithiyo (ridge) phezulu kwe-disk esiza ukuhambisa i-fertilizer ukuze ingene emhlabathini. Ukukala kungashintshwa ngokuvula noma ukuvala umhole noma isango lapho i-fertilizer iphuma. Isakhiwo sokukala esifana nesithwathwa sikhombisa uhlelo lokukala ngqo. I-star wheel ikhuluma ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede) kodwa inezinhlamvu ezikhula (eziphuma) ngaphandle kwe-bucket. Phakathi kwe-bucket, i-fertilizer ibanjwa yizinhlamvu zaleyo wheel, lapho i-wheel ijikeleza, i-fertilizer ikhishwa ukuze iphume ebhakeni futhi iwela emathubeni. Shintsha ama-sprockets ajikelezayo ukuze ajikeze ngokushesha noma kancane. Shintsha i-star wheel ukuze ufake enye enezinhlamvu ezinde noma ezimfishane.

Ngokwejwayelekile izikhathi zokutshala zingalandela umlayezo olandelayo: ezindaweni ezipholile empumalanga ungatshala ngokuqala kwaNovemba ukuya evikini lokuqala likaDisemba; ezindaweni ezingaphakathi kwelizwe lethu, ungaqala ukutshala ngeviki lokugcina likaNovemba uye ekugcineni kwaDisemba; ezindaweni ezomile ezingasentshonalanga ungatshala ekugcineni kwaDisemba uye ngaphakathi kwaJanuwari. Khumbula ukuthi uma utshala ngezinye izikhathi, kungehliza inani lomkhiqizo. Ubhekilanga ungatshalwa ngokujula okusuka ku-2,5 cm okuya ku-5 cm, maqondana nenhlobo yomhlabathi nesikhathi sokutshala. Ukujula kufanele kuphakame emhlabathini osindayo (njengesidaka) kodwa ungashona esihlabathini. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi imbewu itshalwe emhlabathini onomswakamo okwanele ozoyisiza ukumila. Kubalulekile ukuthi umhlabathi uthintane kahle nezimbewu. Sebenzisa ipulantela elithembekile. Izimbewu zifanele zibekwe ngobubanzi obulingene nangokujula okufanayo. Ububanzi ngaphakathi kwezitshalo kubalulekile ngoba kufanele izitshalo zincintisane ngokufana, akufuneki ukuthi ezinye ezisondelene kakhulu zincintisane zilwe ukuthola ukudla nokukhanya. Inani lezitshalo ezikwazi ukumila kahle endaweni ethile lihambelana nenani lamanzi elikhona emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke ukudlula ububanzi bemisele. Ububanzi bemisele emasimini athola imvula kuphela bungasuka ku-0,91 m, buye ku-2,1 m noma ku-2,3 m. Lokhu kuzohambelana nenhlobo yomshini osebenza ngawo nendlela yokulima. Inani lezitshalo elingaphansi kakhulu lizokwehlisa umvuno ongatholakala, kodwa inani elikhulu kakhulu lizokwenza ukuthi isitshalo zilwane bese umvuno wehle futhi.

Kufanele kubhekisiswe umgomo wokunakekelwa kwalowo okuthiwa yikhasimende. Bakhona abaqashi asebenikeze abasebenzi ithuba lokuqeqeshwa ngamakhono, abasebenzi ngokwabo abakangeni emgqeni ngokuthi bazibonele bona isidingo sokuba kuthuthuke amakhono abo. Ngokombiko we ILO ngezwe laseNingizimu Afrika amaphesenti angu 87 ezimboni ezaphenywayo, zathi ziqeqesha abasebenzi ngamakhono kanti okwangempela iningi lazo, okungu 70% zikha phezulu nje futhi lokho kuqeqesha ezikhuluma ngakho kumbandakanya ukufundisa abantu umsebenzi uma befika kuphela. Wona lowombiko futhi unobufakazi bokuthi emafemini lapha lincane kakhulu inani labantu abqeqeshwayo ngonyaka ababhekenne nomkhiqizo, abevi kumaphesenti angu 10 walabo ababeqeqeshwe ngonyaka odlule. Yileyo naleyo nhloso ephakamisiwe, kubekwe iznkomba ezithile zenqubekela phambili. Zinikeza into ejongiwe okufanele kufinyelelwe kuyo. Zenza ukuthi kubonakale indima esikhathuliwe nokuba kuhlolwe inqubekela phambili. Izinkomba zempumelelo zichazwe zahambisana nezinjongo zikazwelonke. Kuyaziwa ukuthi azifani zonke izinhlangothi zomnotho futhi namathuba ezinawo kawefani. Yize yilolo nalolo hlangothi luzobe luphokophelele ekufezeni izinjongo, akuzikwenzeka ngokulinganayo lokhu. Ebangeni esikulo manje ezinye zalezizinkomba zibheka okwenzekayo okuholela kwimiphumela kunokuba zibheke imiphumela ngokwayo. Isibonelo, enye inkomba ibhekisisa ukuthi izinkampani ezinkulu ziyithatha kangakanani imali ebhekele ukuthi zithuthukise ngayo amakhono. Ngaleyondlela singathi siyabona ukuthi abaqashi bazinikele kangakanani ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono nasekuqeqeshweni kwabasebenzi.

Ithenisi: Ukuphila Okuphilayo Nempumelelo Ekhulayo Ithenisi, umdlalo odlalwa phakathi kwezinsika ezimbili, ungowokuzijabulisa, umthombo wenjabulo, kanye nomkhakha ophumelelayo obambe izimpilo zabantu abaninzi emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kokuhlangana komphakathi, ithenisi iyindlela yokukhombisa amakhono, ukuzikhandla, nokugqugquzela impilo enempilo. Ukuze siqonde ukuhlonishwa kwalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukubheka izinto ezithize ezibangela ukuba ithenisi ikhanye njengenkanyezi ebhalayo ezinkundleni zomhlaba. Okokuqala, ithenisi iyinselelo enkulu. Umdlalo ubandakanya ubuchule, isiqondiso, nokusebenzisa amandla ngokufanele. Ukuphumelelisa umgomo wakho wokuwina kudinga izinyathelo eziyinqaba, njengoba umphakathi wesansuku wanamuhla ungabheki nje kuphela kumphumela, kodwa futhi ubheka nezenzo ezinamandla ezingasiza ukufinyelela empumelelweni. Umgibeli odlalela izinsika, kufanele akwazi ukuthola izinga eliphakeme lokuqonda nokusebenza kwegagasi lokuphendula kwezithombe ezicacile. Ngaphezu kokusebenza ngempumelelo, ithenisi iyindawo yokukhuluma ngezenhlalakahle. Abadlalayo bakha izixhumanisi ezibalulekile phakathi kwabo nababukeli. Umbono wobugovu, ubudlelwano bamazwi nezimo zeqembu zikhombisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu ngezikhathi zokuqhuba umjaho. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuhlangana, sokwakha ubuhlobo obuyingxenye yezenzakalo ezinjalo. Umphakathi uhamba phambili, ubuthakathaka, bheka ukuthi abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bazithokozisa kanjani ngomqondo owodwa. Into ebalulekile ukuze ithenisi ibe njalo phambili ukwakha ikusasa lemidlalwano.

Izingane zidinga ukunikezwa amathuba okujabulisa emidlalweni, naye umphakathi kufanele ube nenkathazo yokuthuthukiswa. Othisha, abazali, nabaphathiswa kufanele babe uchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise imiphumela emihlanu yempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi udinga ukuhlanganyela ukuze hushe izinqumo eziphathelene nempilo yamalunga. Ngokukufingqa, abadlali abasebasha babhekwa njengezimpawu zokukhula emphakathini wezemidlalo. Ubuhle bezemidlalo buphinde buhlobene nezinsiza eziphuma ezintweni eziningi. Abadlali abancane badinga ukunakekelwa, abathandi besikhumbuzo, nezinsiza ezinkulu ukuze bakhule. Kusemqoka ukufaka umqondo omuhle kwemidlalo, benesibopho sokugcina impumelelo yezenhlalo. Lokhu kuhambisana nezinhlelo ezinethezekile, ukuxhumana okuhle, nokuqhuba izifundo eziphumelelayo. Kukhona uzhokufa ozodinga ´ukwazi ukubamba kokubili, ukuzijabulisa nokuxhasa imisebenzi ezothuthukisa impilo yabo. Sifuna ukusekela abadlali basebasha ukuze bakhule babe nethuba lokuphumelela, bahloniphe isimo, bemukele uhla lwezinselelo, bese beqhubeka phambili. Ukugcina umhlaba wobuchwepheshe, bawuthumele lokho kuchaza ese, bekwazi ngempela ukwenza njengempilo, bathuthukise umqondo wezemidlalo, negalelo elichaphazelekayo elizogqugquzela ubuchule. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuhamba phambili kwezemidlalo phakathi komphakathi, kuzokwenza umkhakha wezemidlalo ube yinsika ethe xaxa.

Asikho isinqumo esichaza leso senzo, inqubo noma umthetho njengesiphambene nomthethosisekelo esiyothathwa yinkantolo kulolo daba ngaphandle kokuba yonke imibandela yalo mthetho isilandelwe ngokugcwele. Ngaphandle kwesimo lapho Inkantolo noma UmphathimaJaji enquma khona ngenye indlela, akekho umuntu onegunya lokuvela egamele lelinye iqembu kunoma yiluphi udaba oluqhubeka eNkantolo ngaphandle kokuba lowo muntu enelungelo lokuvela eNkantolo ephakeme.. Uma othintekayo eshona noma ephenduka umuntu ongakwazi ukuzimmela noma ukuzenzela lapho kuqhutshwa udaba, isimangalo siyommiswa kuze kufike isikhathi lapho oqokiwe noma omunye umuntu onamandla okuma esikhundleni eseqokiwe ukuze ammele lowo muntu noma iqembu noma kufike isikhathi lapho umuntu othintekayo esekwazi khona ukuzimela. Lapho umuntu onegunya noma onamandla okummela eseqokiwe ngendlela echazwe ngenhla, ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, iNkantolo inganquma ukuba lowo muntu ogunyaziwe noma onamandla ammele lowo oshonile noma ongasenawo amandla okuzimmela. Ngemuva kokufaka isaziso emaqenjini wonke athintekayo, noma ngubani onelungelo lokubamba iqhaza njengeqembu noma onesibophezelo sokwenziwa ingxenye yeqembu odabeni angafaka isicelo sokungenelela udaba njengeqembu, lokhu angakwenza noma ngasiphi isikhathi ekuqhubekeni kwesimangalo. Ekutholeni lesi sicelo, Inkantolo noma UmphathimaJaji angathatha isinqumo esihlanganisa isinqumo ngezindleko nokukhipha umyalelo ongaholela kwinqubo eyolandelwa maqondana nesimangalo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye.

Intengo yokulingana ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "intengo yokucacisa emakethe," njengoba ihlangabezana nabathengi nabathengisi emakethe - abathengi bangathenga konke abakufunayo, kanti abakhiqizi bangathengisa konke abakufunayo. Izici ezithinta ukunikezwa zifaka izindleko zokukhiqiza, izimo zezulu, izifo, nezinye izinto ezingathinta ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo. Izici zokucela zifaka ukuthandwa kwabathengi, amanani, kanye nokutholakala kwezinketho. Imakethe yezolimo ithonywa izindleko zokukhiqiza, amanani, kanye nokutholakala kwezinsiza. Imakethe yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ithonywa izitayela zemakethe yomhlaba, njengoba leli lizwe linengxenye encane emakethe yezolimo yomhlaba. Amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika athonywa ukunikezwa kwendawo nokucela, kanye nezimo zemakethe zamazwe omhlaba. Kukhona ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene ezibangela ukushintsha kwamamanani ezolimo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinguquko ezinqumweni zabakhiqizi mayelana nokukhiqiza, izimo zezulu, izifo, nezinye izinto zingathinta imakethe. Abakhiqizi bangaphatha ezinye izici zokunikezwa, kodwa hhayi zonke. Ngenkathi abakhiqizi bezama ukuhlela ukunikezwa nokucela, isimo semakethe singaba nezimo ezingalindelekile. Abakhiqizi bangalungisa amanani ngokuya ngezindleko ezilindelekile noma izimo ezithinta ukukhiqizwa kwabo. Esikhathini esedlule, kwakuvame ukucabanga ukuthi ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika zanele futhi zingahlangabezana nezidingo zendawo ngaphandle kokuthembela kumalungelo. Nokho, lokhu akusasebenzi. Emnothweni wanamuhla ophakathi kwezwe, akukho mkhakha wezimali, kuhlanganisa nezolimo, ongazinzile ngokuphelele.

Umbuzo 5: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni emhlabeni? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona izibonelo eziningi: - E-Estonia: UHulumeni wase-Estonia usebenzisa i-AI ukuphatha izicelo zokuhweba, ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula. - E-United States: Izinhlelo zokuhlaziya idatha ezisebenzisa i-AI ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze kuhlolwe izidingo zabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. - E-Singapore: Uhlelo lwe-AI lwenziwa ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga zomphakathi, ngaphandle kokubanga ukwephula umthetho. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uHulumeni aqhubeke nokusebenzisa i-AI? Impendulo: Ukuze uHulumeni aqhubeke nokusebenzisa i-AI, izinyathelo ezibalulekile zifaka: 1. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqeqeshwe kahle ukuze basebenzise i-AI ngempumelelo. Ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo: Uhlelo oluqinile lwezokuphepha nolwezemvelo luzodingeka ukuvimbela imiphumela emibi ehambisana ne-AI. Ukubambisana: Ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, uhulumeni kufanele ubambisane nezinkampani ezizimele kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ibhekwane kakhulu uma kuziwa ekusetshenzisweni kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Okokuqala, ukuvikeleka kwedatha kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yabantu ivikelwe. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuhle kwabasebenzi nabantu, ukuze kube neziqondiso ezicacile nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene kuhulumeni. Umbuzo 8: Ubulungiswa bokusebenza kwe-AI kuhulumeni bungabhekwa kanjani?

Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Ngokwanda kwezimo zomnotho, izinkampani zidinga abasebenzi abanamakhono ahlukahlukene ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokwakha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi, ukuze baqhubeke nokufuna izixazululo ezintsha nezingcono, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephambili emncintiswaneni. Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zisiza abasebenzi ukuthi bathole ulwazi olusha nolwabantu. Lokhu kulungele kakhulu izinkampani, njengoba abasebenzi abaqeqeshwayo banemigomo emisha yokusebenza, bazi kahle izinqubo ezintsha, futhi banamathuba okukhuthaza amakhono abo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinkampani zithola izinzuzo zokuphuculwa kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo, okwandisa imakethe yazo. Kwakhiwa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuqeqesha, kuhlanganisa nezifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, izifundo eziphakathi kokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana nezikhungo zemfundo. Lokhu kuhlelwa ngendlela yokuthi kube lula kubasebenzi ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babe nezinjongo ezicacile zokuphumelela, ukuze bakwazi ukukhipha okungcono emizimbeni yabo. Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha aluhlinzeki kuphela ngokuqeqeshwa kwemikhakha ethile, kodwa futhi luhlinzekela abasebenzi ithuba lokuthola amakhono empilo, okubandakanya ukuxhumana, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezinto ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemvelo yokusebenza ehloniphekayo, enokuthula, futhi enempumelelo. Izinkampani ezithatha lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha zikhombisa ukwethembeka ezinhlelweni zazo zokuthuthukisa abasebenzi.

Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zezinkantolo uma lezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi zisebenza kahle. Isinyathelo 17 Yini iHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe? Ukwethulwa kufanele kube nokuqhubeka ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezifana nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhasa kanye nokuqinisa uhulumeni bendawo, kuhlanganise nezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Lezi zinkomiti azikona nje amalungu abasebenzi; zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuxhumana okufanele phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zethu zohulumeni. Isici esibaluleke kakhulu kulokhu kuzodingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zihlangana njalo futhi zisebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe. Le bhukwana ihlinzeka ngamasu anembile, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zezinkantolo uma lezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi zisebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, le bhukwana izokwandisa ekugqugquzeleni ukubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithathwa ngababusi nezomkhandlu. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngababusi kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe lapho besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ngababusi kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuhlinzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe lapho besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Ukuze kugqugquzelwe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ezindabeni zikamasipala. Isixwayiso: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlola izinto ezisemqoka zomkhandlu nendawo yakho uma usebenzisa imibono neziphakamiso ezitholakala kule bhukwana.

Ezehlakalweni (Kuzehlakalo) ezijwayelekile zempilo yakho kungenzeka ukuthi uke wagula noma walimala ngakho-ke uzodinga ilivu yokuthi ube ngcono ekuguleni noma ekulimaleni. Uyacelwa ukuba uqaphele ukuthi ukulimala lapha kule ngqikithi akusho ukulimala usemsebenzini. Izinsuku ezijwayelekile zokusebenza zelivu yokugula ezingamashumi athathu anesithupha-36 ezihambisana neholo eliphelele kukuyingiliza kwelivu yokugula. Ukuyingiliza kwelivu yokugula kuyisikhathi seminyaka emithathu elandelanayo. Uma waze ngaphambi kwesikhathi ukuthi kuzomele uyokwenziwa inqubo ethize noma ulaliswe esibhedlela uma uzohlinzwa, faka isicelo bese ugcwalisa ifomu lakho lokucela ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kodwa, uma uhlaselwa ukugula ungazelele noma uthola ukulimala, yazisa umphathi (i-supervisor) wakho ngokushesha uma uhluleka ukusebenza ngenxa yokugula noma ukulimala. Umlayezo othunyelwa ngomlomo ngesihlobo, osebenza naye noma umngane uvumelekile kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sokugula/ukulimala sikuvimbela ukuba ukwazi ukubikela umphathi wakho ngokwakho. Thumela isitifiketi esibonisa ukuthi uyagula sesikhathi esiyizinsuku ezintathu nangaphezulu KANYE nalapho uye wasebenzisa ilivu yokugula ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezimbili esikhathini esingamaviki ayisishiyagalombili-8, kunganakwa isikhathi sokungabikho emsebenzini.? Bheka futhi nalapho kukhulunywa Ngokuvunywa kwezitifiketi Zokugula ngezansi. Sebenzisa bese uhambisa ilivu yabagulayo ejwayelekile ngendlela enesibopho kanye nangokubuhlakani? Gwema ukusebenzisa ilivu yabagulayo uyisebenzisele ezinye izinto ngaphandle kokugula nokulimala ngokuba kungenzeka ukuthi ugcine usotakwini esikhathini esizayo sokuyingiliza kwelivu yabagulayo. Ukubheka nokukunikeza ilivu yabagulayo ngokwesicelo sakho.

Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela eva kwenyanga eyodwa uma kubalwa usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi kwenyanga eyodwa . Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS engakwazi, kwizimo ezithile ezixolelekayo, ukuthi emukele inothisi yesikhathi esifishane. Noma yiliphi iqembu kule SIVUMELWANO lingasinqamula le SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula ingxenye yale SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo uma lelo qembu lokuqala elishiwo lilinikezile leli elinye iqembu inothisi ebhalwe phansi maqondana nalokhu kwephula futhi lokho kwephula kuhlale kungalungisiwe kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela osukwini elithole ngalo inothisi leyo. Izihloko zezigaba kule SIVUMELWANO ziyizinkomba kuphela, ngakho azisiyona ingxenye futhi azithintene nokuhunyushwa kwesigaba nganomaiyiphi indlela. Ngaphandle uma kubonakala kunokushayisana noma kungahambisani nokuqukethwe, ubunye buzohlanganisa nobuningi kanti ubulili besilisa buhlanganisa nobesifazane, kanjalo noma kuphendukezelwe. Le SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelelele phakathi KWAMAQEMBU futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esike saba khona phakathi KWAMAQEMBU maqondana nokuqukethwe lapha. AMAQEMBU ayavumelana ngokuthi angeke kushintshwe, kwengezwe, noma kuvunyelwane ngokukhansela noma lutho kwakhiwe kabusha le SIVUMELWANO kukho konke noma iphuzu noma umbandela waso futhi noma kwenzeka angeke kube namphumela ekusebenzeni kwesivumelwan ngaphandle uma kubhalwa phansi futhi omabili amaqembu asayinde noma asayindelwe abawamele.

Abantu ababalelwa ku-2 545 000 okulindeleke ukuthi bavakashele izibhedlela zethu ezisezingeni lesifunda kulo nyaka wezimali uma kuqhathaniswa nabawu-2 168 440 ngonyaka wezimali ka-2007/2008. Kanjalo nenani lesilinganiso seziguli ezithutheleka kulezi zibhedlela kulindeleke ukuthi likhuphuke lisuka-4 903 785 zangonyaka wezimali owedlule linyukele ku-5 600 000 kulo nyaka wezimali ka-2008/2009. Ngenxa yokushintsha kwendlela okuhlasela ngayo izifo, isikhathi esijwayelekile esizothathwa yiziguli kulezi zikhungo zezempilo kulindeleke ukuthi senyuke ezinsukwini ezi-5.6 ziya kweziphakathi kweziyi-7 ne 15 ngenxa yezifo esesibhekene nazo. Imali eyabelwe lolu hlelo olubalulekile izonyuka ngo izigidi ezingu-539 zamaRandi isuka ezigidigidi ezingu-6.376 zamaRandi ngonyaka wezimali odlule iya ezigidigidi ezingu-6.915 wezigidigidi zamaRandikulo nyaka. Umehluko wokukhushulwa kwale mali ubonakala kanje: Ukuphathwa kwezifunda, Imitholampilo yemiphakathi, usizo lweZempilo olutholakala emiphakathini, izinhlelo zokulwisana negciwane lesandulela ngculazi kanye nengculazi kanye nezinhlelo zezibhedlela ezisezingeni lesifunda. Sibeke isamba sezigidi ezingu-632.5 zamaRandi ukuze sikwazi ukunikeza lolu hlelo kanye nezinye ezihambisana nalo. Lemali inyuke ngezigidiezi-77.6 zamaRandi, uma uqhathanisa nemali eyayabelwe lolu hlelo eyizigidi ezingu-554.9 zamaRandi ngonyaka wezimali odlule. Sisahlalelwe umsebenzi onzima wokuqinisekisa ukuthi siphinde sengeze isibalo sama-Ambulensi, kusuka kulesi sibalo esinaso sama-Ambulensi angama-442 kuya kuma-960 ukuze sihambisane nemigomo kahulumeni kuzwelonke.

IPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika lineZindlu ezimbili iNdlu Yesishayamthetho Sikazwelonke (eyaziwa ngokuthi yi-NA), enamalungu angama-400, kanye noMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezifundazwe (owaziwa ngokuthi yi-NCOP), onamalungu okungenani angama-90. UMthethosisekelo ubalula ukuthi uMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezifundazwe i-NCOP imele izifundazwe ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izimfuno zezifundazwe ziyabhekelwa ohlakeni lukahulumeni kazwelonke. Ukwenza lokhu ikakhulukazi ngokubamba iqhaza emsebenzini wokushaya imithetho kazwelonke, nangokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngenkundla kazwelonke yokuthi ubambe iqhaza ngokuthi ukhulume ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta izifundazwe. Futhi i-NCOP iqinisekisa ukuthi izimfuno zohulumeni basekhaya ziyabhekelelwa ezingeni likahulumeni kazwelonke. Izithunywa ziholwa nguNdunankulu wesifundazwe ngasinye, ongomunye wezithunywa eziyisipesheli. Uma kunesidingo, uNdunankulu angaqoka omunye umuntu esikhundleni sakhe. uSihlalo, kanye . namaPhini oSihlalo amabili. Lezi zikhulu ziphatha umsebenzi we-NCOP kanye nokwengamela izinkulumompikiswano, ziqinisekise ukuthi izithunywa zikhuluma ngokukhululeka inqobo nje uma zilandela imithetho ebekwe yiNdlu. Kukhethwa iPhini likaSihlalo elisebenza ngokugcwele isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu kanti oNdunankulu bezifundazwe bona bayashintshana ngokubangamaPhini Sihlalo azungezayo isikhathi esiwunyaka.

Asenze okulindeleke kithi njengezakhamuzi siphinde sehlise izinga lamacala ngokubophisa izigilamkhuba. Nakuba la ma-ejensi ekhona, osomabhizinisi abancane abangabesifazane, abangabeluleki ngezezimali noma osonkontileka, bangekwazi ukuya kulezi zikhungo zokweseka ukufinyelela kwezezimali kanye nokweseka ezobuchwepheshe. Okwesibili, amaphrojekthi akhiqiza umphumela ocacile nokhethekile otholakalayo kuyona iphrojekthi. Ikhonsothiyamu izophinde ibe nesibopho sokugada izindawo ezizungeze i-Green Point Common emapaki asedolobheni nasesiyingini semidlalo. Kubalulekile kithina ukuthi sithole ithuba lokuhlangana nawe, ngesikhathi sivakashile kuleli zwe elihle neliphatha kahle izihambi. Izithasiselo ezikala ukwehla nokwenyuka kwamandla emali, noma ushintsho lwentengo, ukuhlinzeka isibonelo esihle salokhu kwehlukana. Iphasiphothi - Incwadi kahulumeni esemthethweni eqinisekisa ubuwena kanye nokuba yisakhamuzi ephinda ikuvumele uye phesheya. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkinga zemvundo kumele kwaziwe ngokuhlola inhlabathi. Ukulawula indawo yokundiza eNingizimu Afrikha, kuhloswe ngakho ukuba kube nokulawuleka kwemingcele, kanti kubaluleke kakhulu ukuvimba ukuqubuka kokwesaba ngobugebengu emingceleni. Ungakwazi ukusabalalisa amanye noma bonke onogada ngaphandle noma ngaphakathi enkundleni yezemidlalo? I-Singapore yayingenisa ikakhulukazi imikhiqizo yokusamafutha, amavejithebuli, izindwangu, amakinati omile kanye nenyama yengulube yaseNingizimu Afrikha. Isikhathi ngeke sisiumele ukuba sikhiphe imininingwane emisebenzini ehlukene eyenziwa kulezi zindawo.

Njengoba besengeshilo ngenhla ngaloluhlelo lokutshalwa kukabhontshisi lapha abantu abazohlomula bayizinkulungwane ezimbili (2 000 beneficiaries). Siphinde futhi satshala isibalo esifanayo samahektha kabhontshisi endaweni yaKwaDlamini nakhona futhi singuMnyango silekelele ngemali ethi ayibe yisigidi nengxenye (R1,4million). Abantu abazohlomula bangamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili (800 beneficiaries). Mphathi wohlelo kunemiphakathi eyathola umhlaba ngaphansi kohlelo lokubuyiswa komhlaba laphaya emapulazini aseGeluk kanye nase Berooft. Kulamapulazi womabili sitshale ummbila endaweni engamahektha angu 40 ipulazi ngalinye. SinguMnyango salekelela ngemali engango R300 000 ipulazi ngalinye kanti abantu abazohlomula laphaya eGeluk bangamakhulu ayisithupha (600 beneficiaries) bese kuthi lapha eBerooft babengamakhulu ayishiyagalombili (800 beneficiaries). Ngalezizinhlelo esizethula namhlanje siyethemba singuHulumeni ukuthi sikwazile ukuthi silekelele imiphakathi ehlukene ehlomulile ukuthi nayo izicathulele ngokuzayo ukuze iqale ukubamba iqhaza emnothweni wakuleli njengoba sonke siyazi ukuthi lemikhiqizo izothengiswa bese nikwazi ukuba nemali okuyiyo ezonisiza ukuthi nibe ngabalimi abasimeme ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngazo futhi izinhlelo lezi kudaleke amathuba emisebenzi ngenkathi ziqala zethulwa kunina. Ngalamazwi amafishane ngithi angithathe lelithuba ukuthi ngibonge kuzozonke izisebenzi zoMnyango lapha kuMasipala waseBaqulusini kanye naseDumbe ngomsebenzi omuhle engiwubonile laphaya ngenkathi ngivakashele amasimu kabhontshisi. Ngibonga kusukela kubalimisi noma abaluleki nabaphathi babo kanye nezimenenja ngomsebenzi omuhle owenziwe lapha.

Isicelo esenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba -801 no -1221 soMthethosisekelo emalungeni Omkhandlu kaZwelonke noma isiShayamthetho sesiFundazwe siyokhishwa ngesaziso senhloso yokuthatha isinyathelo siphelezelwa wumbiko ofungelwe ngezizathu eziyisisekelo zalokho ummangali afuna ukuncika kukho ngesikhathi sokulalelwa kodaba, lesi sicelo siyothulwa kuNobhala futhi sinikwe uSomlomo Womkhandlu kaZwelonke, uma kudingekile noSihlalo woMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe noma uSomlomo wesiShayamthetho esithintekayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isaziso siyocela uSomlomo, uma kufanele uSihlalo Womkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe azise ngokubhaliwe wonke amaqembu ezombusazwe ammelwe ngesicelo endlini efanele noma esishayamthetho zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu ethole leso sicelo. Isicelo esiphawulwe emtheshwaneni -1 siyophelezelwa yisitifiketi esikhishwe nguSomlomo weSishayamthetho esichaza ukuthi isigaba -802a noma isigaba- 1222a soMthethosisekelo senelisiwe, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. d ithuba elifunywayo lokukhululwa, kuhlanganisa ithuba lesikhashana. a Noma yiliphi iqembu lezombusazwe esishayamthetho esithintekayo noma uhulumeni ofisa ukuphikisa isinqumo senkantolo esifunywayo ngaphansi kwesicelo liyokwazisa uNobhala ngokubhaliwe ngenhloso yokuphikisa zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu- 15 sethuliwe leso sicelo, esazisweni liyoqoka ikheli lapho lelo qembu noma uhulumeni eyokwemukela khona isaziso namaphepha afanele odaba oluqhutshwa enkantolo.

Uma umkhiqizo wakho muhle, thenga umshini wakho wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uvimbele ukuhamba kwezinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kubalulekile lapho kukhiqizwa nokumakethwa kwezinkwa zokudla. Ukonakala kwezinkwa uma zimanzi kakhulu bese zibekwe ezibayeni uma kubanda kakhulu noma ezibayeni ezisebenzisa umoya okhona kuphela. Izindleko zingavela uma izinkwa zivunwa uma zimanzi kakhulu. Ukukhula kwezinkwa nezindleko zokumisa lezo zinkwa. Ukulahleka kwenani lomkhiqizo. Ukuze wenze ukuhlolwa okuqondile, kufanele uqale uthole isampuli enhle ezokhombisa inani lemikhiqizo yonke. Nansi sithatha isampuli ezitshalo ezingakavunwa (emhlabeni) ukuze sithole ukuthi izinkwa zimanzi kakhulu, lokhu kungasiphazamisa, futhi sithola ukuvuna kube sekwedlule, hhayi ngesikhathi esifanele. Vuna ingxenye bese uyi-test. Hlanganisa amakhanda ezitshalo ozikhethile emhlabeni wonke, uziphumeze kuze kube izinkwa ziphuma. Thatha ukuhlolwa okuthathu kulezi zinkwa futhi uthole okungaphakathi. Thumela le sampuli kumphathi wesilo ukuze enze ukuhlolwa okuqondile. Yenza lokhu njalo uma amakhanda eshintsha abe mnyama ukuze izinkwa zivuziwe ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze kulethe umkhiqizo omuhle. Lokhu kungaba kuhle kumlimi osanda kufika kulabo abizwa ngokuthi abalimi bezohwebo. Kukhona izibaya ezenziwe ngesinyithi esigcwele ezisuka ku-10 kuya ku-30 tons. Uma kungekho mali eningi, izibaya ezincane (10 tons) zingasetshenziswa ekuqaleni, bese lokhu kungakhuliswa njengohlelo lwezibaya ezizokwenziwa njengoba ukulima kuqhubeka. Izinto ezihlobene nokuvuna nokugcina izinkwa zimi kanje: umlimi akanayo indawo yokugcina umkhiqizo wakhe, noma unendawo yokugcina ingxenye yomkhiqizo noma yonke imikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe.

Ukusebenza komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi. B. Uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng ubonisile ukuthi kudingeka isu lokusiza amabhizinisi amancane elidlula izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezikhona kanye nezikhungo zezezimali ukuze kusekelwe amabhizinisi amancane ngokwezezimali nangokunye. "Ibhodi" ibhekisela ebhodini le-GEP elisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sesixhenxe somthetho. "Umnyango" ubhekisela kumnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba esifundeni. "Inhloko yoMnyango" ibhekisela enhlokweni yomnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Umthetho" uveza umthetho wesifunda. "MEC" uveza ilungu lekhansela elibhekene nezindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Kwenziwe" kusho okwenziwe ngumlomo. "Isifunda" sisho isifunda saseGauteng. "Umthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi" ubhekisela kumthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi, Umthetho 1 ka-1999. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa uhlu neminye imithetho ephathelene nayo. Ukusebenza komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi.
