Akukho okukhona kulomthetho okunezikhali zokukhipha imithetho esunguliwe yi-GEP ngaphansi komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi.

Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye ezihambelana kahle. Isibonelo, uma ugqoke ijezi elikhulu, ungakhetha amabhulukwe amancane ukuze udale ibhalansi. Futhi, ungakhetha izesekeli ezifana nezikhwama, amabhande, noma izicathulo ezihambisana nezimpahla zakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukunakekela Ubuqotho Bakho Ubuqotho bethu buwubuhle obukhulu. Ukuze ugcine ubuhle bakho, kubalulekile ukunakekela isikhumba sakho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukugeza, ukusebenzisa ama-moisturizers, kanye nokusebenzisa izithako ezithile ezithuthukisa isikhumba. Futhi, ungakhetha ukusebenzisa imikhiqizo yemvelo, ngoba imikhiqizo enezithako zemvelo ivame ukuba nezinzuzo eziningi. Isinyathelo 5: Ukusebenzisa Izinwele Izinwele zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi uzenza kahle, futhi ungakhetha isitayela esihambisana nezimo zakho. Uma ungenayo isikhathi sokwenza izinwele, ungakhetha izixazululo ezilula ezifana nezikhwama noma ama-braids. Futhi, ungakhetha imikhiqizo yokunakekela izinwele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangayo. Isinyathelo 6: Ukugqoka Ngokufanele Ukugqoka ngendlela efanele kubalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungagqoki kakhulu noma kancane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde izimo ezahlukene, njengezikhathi zomsebenzi, imicimbi, noma amaholide. Futhi, ungakhetha izingubo ezihambisana nezimo zomoya, ukuze uzizwe ukhululekile. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuzithokozisa Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuzithokozisa. Imfashini nobuhle akufanele kube umthwalo, kodwa kufanele kube yindlela yokuziveza. Zama izinto ezintsha, udlale ngemibala, futhi ungazithokozisi uma ungathandi okuthile.

Inselelo yethu manje wukusabalalisa impumelelo esifundazweni sonke. Nakuba intombazane ibe nezilonda eziningi emzimbeni wayo omncane, yasinda, yahlinzwa kabili kanti iselulama. Ama-SME angaba nokuncintisana ukunamafemu amakhulu ngamaphrojekthi amancane, angaqhathaniseki nagcwele yonke indawo ngoba avamise ukusebenzisa imali encane ukuqhuba ibhizinisi. Imoto yatholwa ipakwe eTshilungoma village ngosizo lwe-Tracker system. Kubikwa ukuthi i-Transitional Federal Government ike yangena ohlelweni lokuxoxisana nabakhuzi bempi eSomalia. USgt Busaphi Mathenjwa, ophenya icala, ujabule ngesigwebo. Le ndaba idinga ukubhekwa nokwenziwa ibe semthethweni ezingeni le-TRCl. Ngiyajabula ukuthi ngilapha namuhla ebusuku ukuvula lo mbukiso omangalisayo: iTimbuktu: Script and Scholarship. Ngokosiko, inkulumo yetshitshi ayididi ngokwesidalo kanti amanye amalungu kumele ayeke ukuphazamisa ngokubabaza. AbaMhlophe baxoshwa ngenxa yokuphatha kabi abaMnyama. Amanyuvesi afundisa abafundi ezifundweni ezehlukene ebe enombono wokuqeqesha okusezingeni eliphezulu, nokubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni lwezesayensi. Ngokwakhiwa komgwaqo uMalandela Road, kuhlelwe ukuba kulungiswe intuba yokudlula. Lokhu kwakhonjiswa ngokucacile esontweni elandulela ukwethula inkulumo yikomidi. Emva nje kancane komdlalo, umqeqeshi waseBotswana uDH Motsheare wagcizelela umlingani wakhe waseSwazini u-Ernest Mavuso ukuthi abafana bakhe bayiqembu eliyizingane elisanda kuhlanganiswa. Ukugxila kumele kube sezixazululweni kwezinkinga ezivimbela isimo ukunezilungisa okonakele.

Lokhu kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, lapho bezama ukunciphisa izinga lokungasebenzi. 4.2 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimali Umkhakha wama-call centre ungumthombo omkhulu wezindleko. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba izinkampani zikhula futhi zikhulisa imisebenzi yazo. 4.3 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zamakhasimende Njengoba umkhakha ukhula, izinkampani zikhuthazwa ukuba zithuthukise izinsizakalo zazo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende, okubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani namakhasimende. Izinselelo Ezithinta Umkhakha 5.1 Ukuncintisana Okukhulu Njengoba umkhakha ukhula, kukhona ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwezinkampani. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zihlale ziqhamuka nezixazululo ezintsha ukuze zihlale zikhangisa amakhasimende. 5.2 Izinga Lokuphila Kwabasebenzi Izinga lokuphila kwabasebenzi emkhakheni wama-call centre lingase libe phansi. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi bazo, ukuze kugwenywe ukushiya emsebenzini. 5.3 Izinguquko Ezemthethweni Izinguquko emthethweni zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni. Izinkampani kufanele zihlale ziqaphele izinguquko ezisemthethweni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Isiphetho Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa amathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunezinselelo ezithile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokuphatha ikhwalithi ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa amakhasimende. Ngale ndlela, umkhakha ungakhula futhi ube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.

Isitifiketi sokuqinisekiswa sisebenza izinyanga eziyishumi nambili kusuka ngosuku esikhishwe ngalo. Ngokuhambisana nokushiwo yisigaba 4 no soMthetho, uKhomishani angaqoka abaqiniseki babathumeli-mpahla abaziwayo abazohlola impahla ngenhloso yokukhipha izitifiketi zokugunyazwa ukuzivuselela nokukhipha ezinye futhi ngokwesibili. Amalungelo okukhulunywa ngawo kumthethonkambiso 1 ayosetshenziswa futhi asebenze nemibandela, izidingo, imiyalo, nezinqubo noma ngamaqophelo anqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. a lowo mqinisekisi uqokwe ngokmthethonkambiso 1; kanye bnencazelo yokunikwa kwalowo mqinisekisi amandla okusebenzisa amalungelo okukhulunywa ngawo kumthethonkambiso 1. Isicelo sokuqokwa njengoMqinisekisi okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 1 siyophelezelwa yimali efanele enqunywe yiNgxenye 187. Lowo onesitifiketi sokugunyazwa uyofaka isicelo kuKhomishani sokuvuselela leso sitifiketi zingakapheli izinyanga ezimbili ngaphambi kokuphelelwa yisikhathi kwesitifiketi esikhona. Ekubhekisiseni isicelo sokuvuselela isitifiketi sokugunyazwa, Ukhomishani engenza uphenyo abona ludingeka ukuze aqiniseke ukuthi lowo onegunya usaqhubeka yini nokuhambisana nezidingo zale Ngxenye. Isicelo siyovunywa kukhishwe nesitifiketi uma Ukhomishani eneliswa wukuthi ofake isicelo uyohambisana nezimiso zale Ngxenye. Uma uKhomishani engeneliswa, uyoveza izizathu zesinqumo bese enika lowo ofake isicelo ithuba lokulungisa amaphutha noma izici ezingalungile ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esinqunywe nguKhomishani, ngemuva kwalokho akhiphe noma achithe isicelo esithintekayo.

Ngale kwemibandela yomgonyana 1 kuya ku 5, umnikazi wesindizi esingadingi sitifiketi esiqhutshwa ngokulandisa kweNgxenye 94 yaleMigomo enganikwa ushwele esidingweni sokwethula uhlelo lokulungisa isindizi sakhe esiyophasiswa wuKhomishani, inqobo uma egcina isindizi sakhe ngendlela ehambisana nemibandela yeNgxenye 24 neNgxenye 94. b elungisa indiza ngaphansi kweso likanjiniyela onemvume yokuyikhanda okleliswe ezingeni elifanele ngaphansi kweNgxenye 66; noma c ogunyazwe yilowo onemvume yenhlangano elungisa izinsiza okleliswe ezingeni elifanele ngokulandisa kweNgxenye 145 ukuba angalungisa indiza nokuyilungelo alithole ngemvume anayo. a lowo engumnini noma esebenzisa indiza; futhi b indiza isetshenziselwa imisebenzi engaqondene nohwebo. a egunyazwe wuKhomishani noma yinhlangano eqokwe wuKhomishani ngenhloso yokufeza Ingxenye 149, kuye ngesimo ngasinye ukuba engalungisa indiza; noma b elungise indiza ngaphansi kweso lomqaphi ogunyazwe wuKhomishani noma yinhlangano eqondwe wumgonyana a. Ukulungiswa kwendiza okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile, ukuhlolwa kwendiza ngabahloli, ukushintsha isakhiwo sayo, ukulungisa umonakalo omkhulu, izinguquko nokuguqula kakhulu isimo sendiza engaphezulu ko 5 700kg noma ujikamanzi onesisindo esingaphezulu ko 3 175kg kuyokwenziwa kuphela futhi kuqinisekiswe yiNhlangano Yokulungiswa kweziNdiza egunyaziwe AMO. f uma kulungiswa indiza okusetshenziswa kuphela isitifiketi sayo, kufanele ilungiswe ngokulandela ibhukwana lokuyilungisa eligunyazwe ngumnikazi MCM.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibonakala iphazamiseka ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi. Izinselelo zomsebenzi, ezifana nokushoda kokuhlela isikhathi, ziye zashintsha. Abantu abahlala emakhaya bahlushwa ukuba basebenze imisebenzi eminingi ukuze baphile, okuholela ekucindezelekeni kwengqondo, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulela impilo. Izinhlangano ezinjengama-syndicate, ezivamise ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, zisebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinkinga ziyaqondwa. Nokho, kunzima ukuphikisa umgomo omubi ophakanyisiwe. Abantu abasebenzayo banamazinga angaphezulu okungafaneleka. Impilo yabo ibonisa amagugu amakhulu - ukufaka isandla, ukuzinikela emsebenzini, nokuqamba amasu. Lokhu kuyazwakala lapho abantu beqalaza imiphakathi yabo, bezama ukufinyelela izimfuno eziphakeme. Ubumbano lwabo luwumphumela wezinhlelo ezithinta izifunda, ezithokozisa impilo yabo yonke. Umphakathi ojabulayo ungavela lapho abantu beqonda ukuthi kufanele bahlale bexhumene, bezama ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Baningi abantu abasebenzayo abaneliseka. Nakuba abaningi babo behlangabezana nezinselelo ezinzima, balindele ukuphila okuhle. Imali engaphezulu ayithathwa njengomzamo ophelele, kodwa ukuhamba phambili kumayelana nokuthi umuntu uzitholele ubumba emhlabeni. Lokhu kwenziwa ekuthuthukiseni izakhono, noma ukwandisa ukuxhumana emsebenzini ukuze baziqhenye ngendlela eqondile. Empeleni, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ikhuluma ngempilo ebucayi, ngoba ibonisa indlela ubudlelwano bethu nomphakathi. Lokhu kubhaliwe kumele kube uphawu lokuqonda, lokudlela abanye, kanye nokuphikelela emakhazeni ukuqhubeka.

Iziguli engizibonayo yilezo ezisuke zedluliselwe kimi ngudokotela, umhlengikazi noma ngabanye abasebenzi bezempilo uma besibona isiguli ukuthi siyentula. Sengikwazile ukuzibonela ububha kanye nokuhlupheka okubhekene nabantu bakule ndawo futhi kuyadabukisa. Sengike ngahlangabezana nezingane ezingondlekile ngoba kungekho ezingakudla emakhaya. Ngibona ogogo nomkhulu bebhekene nomthwalo nosizi lokukhulisa bondle izingane zabantababo eseziyizintandane. Uma ngikwazi ukusiza ngisho noma ngabe ngumuntu oyedwa ngiyazi ukuthi ngizokwazi ukuqhubeka nalolu hlelo. Ngijabula kakhulu uma ngibona umuntu obekade ondile eseqala ukukhuluphala emamatheka ngoba ethole ukudla naye afake okuthize esiswini. Yebo, ngesinye isikhathi kuba nzima ukubona ngempela ukuthi ngubani oswele nongeswele. Kukhona nje abake bafike benakho ukudla emakhaya kodwa beze bazocela ukudla ngoba ebefuna ukuphiwa mahhala. Yize kunjalo sizama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukufinyelela kulabo abadinga usizo ngempela. Njengoba lolu hlelo luya ngokuthuthuka ngithemba ukuthi sizoletha usizo nempilo engcono kwabaningi. Ngiyathanda ukuvakashela olwandlela nokuxoxa nabangani bami. AKUBA umNyango usuzame ngazo zonke izindlela ukunciphisa umalaleveva kulesi sifundazwe, kusabalulekile ukuzivikela uma uzoba nohambo olukuyisa ikakhulukazi enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal. Ukuzivikela okugcono kunakho konke yilokho okufanele wena uzisize ngakho ngoba omasikito batinyela kakhulu ngokuhlwa. Akhona amaphilisi ongawasebenzisa ukuzivikela kumalalevela. Uma unokungabaza, buza emtholampilo oseduze nawe, isibhedlela noma udokotela. Iba nesiqiniseko sokuthi leyo mithi oyitholile uyisebenzisa ngendlela.

U-SAPS wenza isivumelwano NOWENKONTILEKA ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuke sivumelwano, kanti noWENKONTILEKA uyavuma ukunikeza usizo lwakhe ngqo kuSAPS ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuleSIVUMELWANO, e (emveni kwalokhu ebizwa ngokuthi EMSEBENZINI): Inqobo nje uma OWENKONTILEKA engatshelwa ngu SAPS ukuthi makaye kosebenzela u-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma isiphi isigceme esiyisakhiwo sikaSAPS esingekho EMSEBENZINI, kube okwesikhashana. OWENKONTILEKA, ngenxa yale SIVUMELWANO , akufanele noma abe eseba nethemba lokulindela ukuthi sizovuselelwa le SIVUMELWANO, noma nje aqashwa kunoma yisiphi isikhundla njengomqashwa kwa-SAPS. Kuyavunyelwana phakathi kwamaQEMBU, ukuthi OWENKONTILEKA isivumelwano asenziwe naye njengomqashwa ngokwale SIVUMELWANO futhi le SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kunobuhlobo bokuqashana obukhona phakathi koweNKONTILEKA no SAPS. OWENKONTILEKA kufanele, ngaphandle kwemigomo yesigaba 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo yeziGaba 5 no 9 ngezansi, anikezele u-ASPS izinsizakalo ngesikhathi ezidinga nangokwemibandela ebekwe ngu-SAPS, esikhathini esikaliwe esi , kusukela osukwini lokuqala kwale SIVUMELWANO bheka isigaba 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene noWENKONTILEKA izohlanganisa nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa ngezandla eyingxenye, futhi eqondene nemisebenzi yoWENKONTILEKA.

Empeleni nje akekho ongase akwelaphe uma selikungene leligciwane. Uma usunalo ke kufanele uthole makhambi thizeni futhi welulekwe abezempilo. Kuyiqiniso Owesimame okhulelwe one HIV/AIDS angalidlulisela enganeni yakhe leligciwane, lapho izalwa kumbe ngenkathi eyincelisa. Kusemqoka ke ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlole igazi ukuze bazi noma likhona leli gciwane emzimbeni wabo noma cha. Bangazithola izeluleko emtholampilo abayivakashelayo lapho bekhulelwe. Lolu sizo lubeka ingane ethubeni lokuba iphile. Akunjalo Ngeke umbone ebusweni umuntu onegciwane le HIV. Abantu baye babukeke beyimiqemane futhi bebahle njengamampentshiso, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi sebelithwele leligciwane khona bebahle benjalo. Kanti ngakolunye uhlangothi akuzuthi wonke umuntu ozizacele nje futhi ezigulela bese kuthiwa uphethwe yilesi sifo. Yimiphumela yokuhlolwa kwegazi kuphela enokuveza ubufakazi bokuthi nangempela umuntu ulithwele leligciwane, kumbe kanalo. Kuyiqiniso Uma utholakale unegciwane leHIV akusho lokho ukuthi usufike kwangqi ngetshe. Usenokuphila eside isikhathi futhi uqhubeke nokushayela. Kuzokufanela nje kuphela ude uvakashela kwadokotela ukuze akweluleke. Kuzokufanela futhi uzijwayeze ukudla ngokufanele futhi uzivoca-voce njalo njalo, futhi kufanele ukuyeke ukuphuza nokubhema. Uma usulitholile leligciwane unesibopho sokuthi ungalidluliseli kumkakho kumbe omunye umlingani wakho ngokocansi. Ukhumbule ke ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi uma uya ocansini usebenzise ijazi likamkhwenyana/ikhondomu. Kuyiqiniso Abantu abanezifo zocansi (amaSTD) kulula kakhulu ukuba batholwe yigciwane le HIV uma beya ocansini nomuntu onalo leligciwane.

Imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe iyinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Abadlali bavela ezizweni ezahlukene, bahlala behlangene bemema abanye ezimweni zempilo. Lokhu kudala amandla okuthola ulwazi nokuhlonipha izinkolelo ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaqembu ahlangene ancintisana afinyelela izinjongo ezijolile, okukhuthaza ukubambisana kuzo zonke izici zempilo. Umbuzo 5: Iyini indima yokuhlanganyela kwemiphakathi emidlalweni? Ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo kubalulekile emidlalweni yamazwe ngamazwe. Umphakathi udinga ukusekela abadlali, kuhlanganise nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, ukuzibophezela, kanye nokuthokozisa abanye. Lokhu kunceda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali banikezwa ithuba lokwenza kahle emncintiswaneni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthuthukisa ubuqotho, uhlanga, kanye nobumbano phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 6: Yini ezobangela utshani kumazwe anezimidlalo? Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezithinta izwe lapho imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ibanjwe. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, izinkinga zokulawula, kanye nezinkinga zokukhethwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanye amazwe angazithola ezithombeni ezimbi ngezomenzi, okwenza kube nzima ukudala umphakathi onokuthula. Kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle imicimbi yezemidlalo ukuze kuzuzwe okungcono kumazwe. Umbuzo 7: Eziphumelelayo, yiziphi izindlela ezitholakalayo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe? Ukuze imidlalo yamazwe ngamazwe ithuthuke, kunendlela ezahlukene ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle, izinsiza, imishini, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kudlala indima enkulu.

Ukuphefumula: Uma isiguli singaphenduli kahle, hlola ukuphefumula kwaso. Uma kudingeka, sebenzisa izindlela zokuphefumula ezifanele, njengokusebenzisa umshini wokuphefumula. Ukubeka Isiguli Endaweni Ephumelelayo: Qinisekisa ukuthi isiguli sikhululekile futhi sikhululekile. Lokhu kungafaka ukususa izinto eziphazamisayo noma ukuhlela indawo ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela. Isigaba 4: Ukuqapha Isimo Sesiguli Ngemuva kokuphatha isimo, qhubeka uqapha isiguli. Bheka izinguquko ezinkulu ezimweni zempilo, njengokushintsha kokuphefumula, ukushaywa kwenhliziyo, noma izimpawu zokuphuma. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinguquko ezidinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Isigaba 5: Ukubika Isimo Ngemuva kokuphatha isimo, kubalulekile ukubika isimo kumphakathi wezokwelapha. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezidingekayo zokwelashwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi ubika zonke izinyathelo ozithathile, izimpawu ezibonakalayo, kanye nezinguquko ezitholakele. Isigaba 6: Ukubuyekeza Nokufunda Ngemuva kokuphatha isimo, kubalulekile ukubuyekeza izinyathelo ezithathwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda ezimweni eziphuthumayo ezizayo. Bheka ukuthi yini eyasebenza kahle, nokuthi yini engasebenza kangcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Isigaba 7: Ukuqeqesha Abasebenzi Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazi kahle izinqubo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazithatha kanjani.

Ngomhlaka-6 Disemba 2000, amalunga amathathu ethimba lonobhala bathola uqeqesho ngendlela yokusungula nokugcina umtapo wolwazi nemininingwane kuMkhandlu. UMkhandlu usuqalile ukubuyekeza lawo magama ayengazange ethulwe ukuze agunyazwe. Lawo ngamagama anokucwasa noma abandlululayo nadluliselwe komaziphathe nemiphakathi efanele ukuze kutholakale imibono nokwenza izinguquko ezifanele. Njengesigungu sikaZwelonke, uMkhandlu waseNingizimu Afrika wamaGama eziNdawo ugidlabezwe ngomsebenzi wokugqugquzela ukuthi kusungulwe amakomidi okuqamba izindawo amagama nasezifundazweni (PGNC). Ngokulawula koMthetho No. 118 ka 1998, ngaphansi kwesigatshana 9 , uMkhandlu kumele unqume imihlahlandlela yokusebenza kwamaKomidi eziFundazwe namiselwe amaGama eziNdawo kanjalo nomaziphathe/omasipala ezindaweni abazilawulayo. Emhlanganweni woNgqongqoshe kanye nemiKhandlu yabaHlonishwa abengamele imiNyango eziFundazweni owabanjwa ngomhlaka-21 Novemba 2000, abaHlonishwa abengamele imiNyango bavumelana ngokuthi kumele kubunjwe izinhlaka zezifundazwe ngokushesha. Ngomhlaka- 16 Januwari 2001, kwakhishwa izincwadi mayelana nalokhu zaqondiswa kubo bonke abahlonishwa abazicelela ukuqhuba loluhlelo. Loluhlelo lulindelwe ukuphothulwa ngoJuni 2001. Umkhandlu ulungisa amaqhinga okusabalalisa lombono noyobandakanya amaKomidi okuQamba amaGama ahlongozwa eziFundazweni. UMkhandlu usuxhumene neNgosi yokuXhumana engaphansi kweDACTS ngenjongo yokusungula icebo lokushicilela yonke imikhiqizo yoMkhandlu. Okunye kuyoba wukusabalalisa ulwazi ngemisebenzi exhumanisa abantu ngabanye, amaphephandaba kanye nokusebenzisa amakhompuyutha.

Maka ibhokisi elifanele ngo-X. AMANOTHI: (a) Ukukhomba kwakho isimo esidingekayo sokufinyelela erekhodini kuncike esimeni irekhodi elitholakala ngaso. (b) Ukufinyelela esimeni esiceliwe kungaliwa ezimeni ezithize. Kulezo zimo uzokwaziswa uma ukufinyelela kuzonikezelwa ngesinye isimo. (c) Imali ekhokhelwa ukufinyelela erekhodini, uma ikhona, izoshiwo kancane yisimo ukufinyelela okucelwa ngakho. Uma irekhodi linemifanekiso ebonakalayo Lokhu kubandakanya izithombe, amasilayidi, ukurekhodwa kwamavidiyo, imifanekiso eyenziwe ngekhompiyutha, imidwebo, njll. Uma ucele ikhophi noma umbhalo werekhodi (ngenhla), ufuna ikhophi noma umbhalo ukuthi uposelwe kuwe Kukhokhwa imali yokuposa? Yazi ukuthi uma irekhodi lingekho ngolimi oluthandayo, ukufinyelela kunganikezelwa ngolimi irekhodi elitholakala ngalo. Ungafuna ukulithola ngaluphi ulimi irekhodi? Uzokwaziswa ngokubhalelwa ukuthi isicelo sakho sinikezelwe/saliwe yini noma cha. Uma ufuna ukwaziswa ngenye indlela, sicela ucacise indlela futhi uhlinzeke nangemininingwane edingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukuhambisana nesicelo sakho. Ungathanda ukwaziswa kanjani ngesinqumo maqondana nesicelo sakho sokufinyelela olwazini?

Sihlalo ohloniphekile Ndunankulu wesiFundazwe, Mhlonishwa Dkt Sibusiso Ndebele Amalungu aHloniphekile esiGungu esiPhezulu Amalungu aHloniphekile eSishayamthetho sesiFundazwe Sihlalo oHloniphekile namalungu eKomidi abhekele ezeMpilo AbaHlonishwa oMeya namaKhansela Amakhosi, izinduna Abelaphi beNdabuko IBamba leNhloko yoMnyango uDkt. Yolisa Mbele Abasebenzi boMnyango weZempilo Izihambeli zethu ezehlukahlukene Izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika BaFowethu noDadewethu, ngiyabingelela. Sihlalo oHloniphekile, ngizizwa ngihloniphekile ukuma phambi kwakho nale Ndlu namuhla njengelungu elizigqajayo nelizinikele le-African National Congress, lapho sigubha khona iminyaka eyisihlanu yokuzibophezela kwalenhlangano ekusebenzeleni abantu njengoba kwasho uMongameli weZwe uMhlonishwa, uMnuz Thabo Mbeki, mhla ekhuluma ngesibopho sokusebenzela abantu ngokuthi kwakhiwe amathuba emisebenzi futhi silwe nobubha. Sisaqhubeka nalesi sibophezelo, ngikholwa wukuthi sikwenzile okusemandleni ethu ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobubha. Lokhu kufakazelwe nayisiqubulo sethu esithi kuloMnyango weZempilo, Silwa Nezifo, Silwa Nobubha, Sinika Ithemba kubantu abangaphezulu kuka 10 million kulesi sifundazwe sethu esihle kangaka kuleminyaka eyisihlanu edlule. Siphinde sahamba ibanga elide sisungula amathuba emisebenzi sihambisana nemigomo yokufukula abansundu kwezomnotho i-Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment.

Isisebenzi esinegunya, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyaziwe omise imvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 1 uyothula umbiko obhaliwe kuKhomishani lapho echaza khona izizathu zokuthi kungani ngokubona kwakhe kufanele kwesulwe ukumiswa kwemvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa kufanele kwesulwe. Isisebenzi esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyaziwe othintekayo uyothula noma anike umfanekiso wombiko okukhulunywa ngawo kumthethonkambiso 2 kulowo onemvume noma onesitifiketi sokugunyazwa esimisiwe kanye nobufakazi bokwedlulisa umbiko kuKhomishani. Lowo onemvume noma onesitifiketi sokugunyazwa ozizwa ehlukumezekile ngokumiswa kwemvume noma kwesitifiketi sakhe sokugunyazwa angadlulisa udaba kuKhomishani zingakapheli izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu ngemuva kokuba ethole ulwazi lokumiswa kwemvume noma kwesitifiketi. Lowo odlulisa isikhalo/udaba uyothumela isikhalo esibhaliwe ebeka izizathu zokukhononda nokuthi kungani ecabanga ukuthi isinqumo kufanele siguqulwe noma sichithwe. Lowo odlulisa isikhalo uyothula umfanekiso wesikhalo kanye neminye imibhalo eyesekela udaba kusiphathimandla esigunyaziwe, kumhloli noma kumuntu onegunya eliqondene futhi athumele kuKhomishani ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela uthumele imifanekiso ochaziwe. Isikhulu esinegunya, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyaziwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu ethole umfanekiso wesikhalo okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 6, uyothumela umbiko noma impendulo yakhe ebhaliwe mayelana nesikhalo esidluliswayo kuKhomishani.

Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nomqondo ofanayo, sisebenzisane, futhi sikhuthaze omunye nomunye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhulumeni, abanikazi bamabhizinisi, noma umphakathi, sonke sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Ngeke sikwazi ukukwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela, futhi lokho kudinga ukuthi sibe nethemba, sibe nokuqonda, futhi sikhuthaze. Ngakho, ngicela ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane awusizo kuphela emnothweni, kodwa futhi awusizo ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba nokwesekwa okuhle kungaba nomthelela omkhulu, futhi kuyinsakavukela yempilo yethu. Sihamba phambili!

Uma umphikisi engakwazi ukuhambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ngokushesha, inkantolo izobuza ngesimo sabo sezimali nokuthi bangakukhokhela yini mayelana nesinqumo nezindleko futhi izokhipha isinqumo ngalokho. Uma umphikisi othole icala engahambisani nesinqumo noma isinqumo senkantolo yezicelo ezincane futhi ufuna ukuqhubekisela phambili leso sinqumo, icala lidluliselwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, futhi lizolalelwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wenkantolo YamaMagistrate, 1944 (Umthetho 32 ka-1944). Kubalulekile ukuthola ummeli ukuze ulalelwe kwalolu cala. Le pamphlet ikwazisa ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele zilandelwe mayelana nokufaka isicelo enkantolo yezicelo ezincane. Uma udinga usizo nganoma yini, ikheli nenombolo yocingo yomlomo wenkantolo yezicelo ezincane zitholakala enkantolo yakho yendawo ye-magistrate. Umnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo.

Ukukhokha izilinganiso emhlabeni/ezakhiweni lapho ubunikazi babelana khona kuyisithwathwa kulabo banikazi ngokuhlanganyela futhi isithwathwa somuntu kumalungu lawo banikazi. Ukulethwa kwamakhasi noma izitatimende kunoma ngubani wabo kubhekwa njengokwenziwe kubo bonke. INANI LEZILINGANISO OKUFANELE UKUKHOKHWA IMasipala izonquma ububanzi bezilinganiso kuzo zonke izigaba zomhlaba ngokwesivumelwano njengengxenye ye-bhajethi yonyaka. IMasipala kumele iqoqe izilinganiso ngezinkokhelo ezifanayo zenyanga zenyanga ezingu-12 kanye nanoma yiziphi ezingeziwe. IMasipala ingaqoqe izilinganiso minyaka yonke kubanikazi abanama-akhawunti ezilinganiso angama-50 noma ngaphezulu uma bephakamisile. IMasipala ingakhokhisa minyaka yonke izilinganiso emhlabeni wombuso kanye nomhlaba wesifunda. IMasipala ingashicilela izinguquko eziningi ohlwini lwezilinganiso ezengeziwe phakathi nonyaka ngokweSigaba 78 se-MPRA. Izilinganiso zizokhokhwa ngokusekelwe ohlwini olushintshiwe lwezilinganiso ezengeziwe. Izigaba zezimali zihlukaniswa ngokuya ngokuthi le mpahla isetshenziswa kanjani, futhi izilinganiso zinqunywa ngokuthi le mpahla isetshenziswa kanjani. Ukushintsha ekusebenziseni impahla kungaholela ekushintsheni kwesigaba se mpahla ethinta. amalungelo okwandisa ezindaweni ezibambisene. Izilinganiso zingabalwa futhi zikhokhiswe ngendlela ehlukile kuzo zonke izigaba zezimali. a kungase kube nesigaba esithile sabanikazi bomhlaba noma abanikazi besigaba esithile somhlaba bangakhokha izilinganiso ezikhokhiswa emhlabeni wabo; noma b kungase kwandiswe noma kuncishiswe isigaba sabanikazi bomhlaba noma abanikazi besigaba esithile somhlaba izilinganiso abazikhokhayo emhlabeni wabo ngokuya ngezimo ezikwi-7 ngezansi.

URobertson Colleens unikeza incazelo ebanzi nephakathi kwezobuciko ohlwini lwezenzo ezihlobene ezisemqoka ezihlanganiswa nesiko lesizwe. Isiko lesizwe iyiqoqo lolwazi lwansuku zonke namasiko amakhulu, izici zomphakathi, imibala, nezinkolo. Yakhiwa ngesikhathi nasemcabangweni, okungase kufake isikhathi esisodwa, uhlobo oluhlukile olungakaze luphindwe, futhi, olunzima ukukopisha, izakhiwo, izindawo zokukhulekela, izindawo zokwakha, izinto zomlando. Kodwa ngaphezu kwezakhiwo, ngaphezu kwezinto, sithola ulwazi oluhlelwe noma olungahlelwanga lwezimpilo, imizwa, ukuvuka kwenhliziyo, imibala, amakhambi, nezwi endleleni. Iyiqoqo lezimiso, ukudla, izixazululo, nezindlela zokuziphatha; indlela abantu ababingelelana ngayo, bathandana ngayo, bazonda ngayo, bashadile ngayo, futhi babhujiswa ngayo. Iziphuzo zabo nezimpahla zemakethe yabo. Imali nendlela abayitholayo, bayibala, futhi bayisebenzisa. Indlela abantu abagqoka ngayo, bahamba ngayo, baphuza ngayo, badansa ngayo, bafa ngayo, bahlupheka ngayo, babonga ngayo, futhi ngisho bangenela impi ngayo. Iphunga labo emigwaqweni, izithandazo zabo ezindlini zokukhulekela, nezinkanyezi zabo ezindaweni zokudlala. Imidlalo, abadlali, nezinkundla zezemidlalo. Indlela izingane ezifunda ukuyifunda nokubhala. Izikhali, amathuluzi, amafabrics, amadoli, izindawo zokungena, umculo, amathuluzi, imaski, amabhokisi, amabhidi, imithwalo, izimbiza, izikhali, ama-charm anenhlanhla, ukudla, amaposta, ama-veil, ukukhetha, amakhanda, nezindlela zokuhweba. Imithi, amatshe, izindlela, izintaba, ubuciko bezindlu, izindlu zomlando, kanye nocwaningo lwezinto zakudala.

Lengqungquthela yadonsa amasonto amabili. Loluhambo lwaba yimpumelelo futhi lwavula amehlo ikakhulu emalungeni amasha oMkhandlu. Okwadala lokhu kakhulu wukuthi kwakuyisiwombe sokuqala lapho babembulelwa amazinga aphekeme omhlaba mayelana nohlelo lokwethiwa kwezindawo. Kuwo lomhlangano, bafunda ngezibophezelo zamakomidi okuqamba izindawo amagama nokulindelwe ezingeni lomhlaba. I-UNGEGN yisigungu somhlaba esinquma umhlahlandlela nenqubo okumele ilandelwe, cishe yizo zonke izigungu zamagama ezindawo emhlabeni jikelele. Kwagcizelelwa kakhulu ukuthi akufanele amagama okufika kube yiwona aqonela lawo endabuko. Lokhu kwavezwa njengenkinga umhlaba wonke obhekene nayo ngenxa yezizathu zombusazwe nomlando. Yinto eyahlaba umxhwele ukubona ukuthi amazwe amaningi asezamile ukulwisana nokulungisa lesisimo. Akumangalisi-ke ukuthi lokhu kuyinselelo enkulu kuleli lakithi njengoba igcwele amagama ezindawo okufika nokwenza kubenzima ukuzigqaja ngemvelaphi yethu , singamaAfrika noma ngabaseYurophu. Leliphepha liqhakambisa amagama avele ekhona kwamanye amazwe nafakwe kithi ngencindezi ngokuhlukumeza awoselwa. Amagama oselwa ayenencazelo ngokomlando futhi eyigugu kubantu bokudabuka eNingizimu Afrika; ngakho ukuwasusa kuchaza ukuqeda isiko kanye negugu labantu. Inqubo yokuphatha eMkhandlwini isimi ngomumo. Imigomo nenqubo yoMkhandlu sekusunguliwe kanti indlela yokunquma ukuphasisa amagama amasha nokubuyekeza amadala sekuphothuliwe. Sewuqalile umsebenzi wokubuyekeza amagama amadala nangakaphasiswa. Umhlahlandlela wokusungula amaKomidi eziFundazwe usudwetshiwe kanti nenqubo yokusungula lamaKomidi isiqalile.

Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimoto zidinga izithako ze-octane ezahlukene. Ukusebenzisa uphetholo onesithako se-octane esingaphezulu kwaleso esidingwa yimoto yakho akudingekile futhi kungukusebenzisa budedengu imali ikakhulukazi ngoba awuzuzi lutho ekusebenzeni kwenjini. Ukusebenzisa uphetholo onesithako se-octane esingaphansi kwalokho okudingwa yimoto kwehlisa ukusebenza kwenjini lokhu kungadala ukuthi injini ishayeke noma yonakale ngokuhamba kwesikhathi . Kufanele kwaziwe ukuthi ukudingeka kwesithako se-octane emotweni ethile kuncike kwezinye izinto, okubalwa kuzo ukusetshenziswa kanye nendlela eshayelwa ngayo imoto, izidingo zesithako se-octane zemoto enomthwalo omkhulu, izindawo eziphakeme nesimo esiklinyayo. Kungani kungafanele ngisebenzise uhlobo lwesithako se-octane esingaphezulu kwaleso esidingwa yimoto yami? Uphetholo onesithako se-octane esiphezulu udinga ukuhluzwa kakhulu kanti kusetshenziswa amandla amaningi uma ukhiqizwa. Uma lamandla engadliwa noma asetshenziswe ngukusebenza kahle kwemoto yakho kusho ukuthi lawo mandla amaningi afakiwe ayachitheka noma ayamosheka. Lokhu kuchitheka kuholela ekukhishweni komoya ongasasebenzi noma i-(carbon dioxide), okulimaza imvelo yethu. Ukusetshenziswa kohlobo lwesithako se-octane esingaphezulu kwalokho okudingwa yimoto yakho kuzobiza noma kudla umninimoto kakhulu , kubiza noma kudla ize kakhulu futhi kunomthelela omubi kwimvelo. Kanti akuzukuba nazuzo ekusebenzeni nasekushayelweni kwemoto. Ngabe uphetholo ongaxutshiwe nomthofu uzilungele izithuthuthu, imishini yokuguda utshani nezinjini zezikebhe?

Isinqumo sokungena esivumelwaneni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Noma iyiphi enye indaba ehlinzekwe ngumthetho. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele unikeze isaziso somphakathi, ngendlela evunyelwe yibhodi, ekhombisa isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yazo zonke imihlangano ejwayelekile yebhodi noma ikomidi kanye nanoma yimuphi umhlangano wesikhashana noma ophuthumayo, ngaphandle kokuthi isikhathi asivumeli ukuba kwenzeke njalo. Umphakathi kumele abize imihlangano yebhodi, okungenani izikhathi ezine ngonyaka, "ngokubhalwa kwemihlangano yebhodi" esayiniwe, ekhombisa usuku, indawo, nesikhathi somhlangano kanye noma i-akhawunti yaleso sikhathi esiphakanyisiwe. Futhi ezinsukwini ezimbili zezikhalazo ngaphambi kosuku lomhlangano ophuthumayo, kumele abize umhlangano ophuthumayo. Futhi umthetho 7 (ii) phakathi nesikhathi esingadluli ezinsukwini ezine kusukela ngosuku lapho isicelo samukelwe. Futhi isaziso senzo esisayiniwe; futhi ii isitatimende esibhaliwe ngumphakathi osayine isaziso senzo esinikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani indaba ehleliwe yokukhuluma kulomhlangano ophuthumayo ibalulekile futhi ayikwazi ukulinda umhlangano ojwayelekile. c Ukuhlonishwa okuphelele komthetho 7 3a no-7 3b kuthi umphakathi akavunyelwe ukusebenzisa amandla akhe kodwa kumele abize umhlangano.

Isithombe 4: Ubungozi obukhulu buqhamuka ezilwaneni ezilimazayo emapulazini. Uma lezi zilwane ziningi kakhulu, ukukhiqiza izitshalo kungase kungabi nenzuzo. Kukhona izilwane ezilandelayo ezilimini ezingathi zikhathaza - eziningi azinabungozi ezitsholeni. Izilwane ezibangela ubungozi yilezo ezivame ukudla ngempela izitshalo ezikhulayo, izimpande, noma ukudla okukhulayo. Ukuphatha izilwane ezilimazayo kuhilela ukusebenzisa ama-pesticides (imikhiqizo emitholakala ngemithi ebulala izilwane ezilimazayo), ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi esifanele, kanye nenani elifanele le-pesticide - ikakhulukazi ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ethile eqondile ezilwaneni ezithile. Kukhona i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ebulala zonke izilwane ezilimazayo ezidla izitshalo. Uma usebenzisa le pesticide, uzothola imiphumela emihle. Kufanele uhlanganise izindlela ezahlukene ukuze ulawule izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Le nhlanganisela izosiza ukuvimbela ukwanda kwezilwane ezithile ezivame ukubangela ubungozi ezitsholeni zakho. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezilimazayo ezidla izitshalo, njengokuthi: ama-cutworms, ama-beetles anemibala, nezinye. Lezi zilwane zinciphisa inani lezitshalo ezikhulayo - uma zingaphathwa kahle, kuzodingeka ukuphinda zifakwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi kemikhono kufanele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kulawulwe izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha lezi zinkinga akubizi kakhulu kodwa kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ukuvimbela ukuthi zidalule ubungozi ezikhathini zokuqala zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukulima ebusika kuzophinde kusize ukubulala izilwane eziningi ngoba ebusika zihlala ezinsalela zezinto ezishiwo ezisemathafeni.

Ubuye waba nomoya ophakeme, okwenza akwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo: Yini uUsain Bolt ayisebenzisela umphakathi? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt usebenzisa impumelelo yakhe ukuze asize umphakathi. Uthembisa ukweseka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantwana, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, futhi uhlanganisa imithombo yokuxhasa ezempilo kanye nemfundo. Ubuye abambe imicimbi yokukhuthaza abantwana ukuba bakhule bezithanda imidlalo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi imidlalo ingaba yindlela yokuphila engcono. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola kuUsain Bolt? Impendulo: Izifundo eziningi zingafundwa kuUsain Bolt. Okokuqala, ukusebenza kanzima kuyisihluthulelo sempumelelo. Ubuye ufundise ukuthi ukuphikelela, nokungayeki, kubalulekile ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo zakho. Ubuye ubonise ukuthi ukuhlala uzithoba nokuhlonipha abanye kubalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uphumelele kangakanani. UUsain Bolt ungumfanekiso ophilayo wokuthi, uma unethemba, ungafeza noma yini. Umbuzo: Yini ezayo kuUsain Bolt? Impendulo: Njengoba uUsain Bolt eseshayile emqhudelwaneni, ubheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ubonisa intshiseko yokuba umphakathi, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa abanye. Uthanda ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, futhi uqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli ophawulekayo, futhi impumelelo yakhe izohlala ibhalwe emlandweni. Ubonisa ukuthi, ngekhono, umsebenzi onzima, kanye nokuzinikela, umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, uUsain Bolt uzohlala engumfanekiso wempumelelo, futhi izifundo zakhe zizohlala zikhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo.

Khumbula ukuthi singathola ukudla kuphela uma amanye amazwe anokudla okuningi kakhulu futhi uma sinayo imali yokuthenga lokho kudla phesheya. Uma isimo sezulu sibi phesheya, lawo mazwe angeke athengise ukudla kwabo, ngeke sikwazi ukuthenga lokho kudla. Uma inani lokushintshana kwezimali zaphesheya liqala ukulimaza inani leRand, thina ngeke sikwazi ukukhokhela imali yokudla kwaphesheya bese abantu bethu bazolamba njengakwamanje amazwe eAfrika. Abalimi bethu bangabantu abakhuthele lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngakho-ke kufanele sibasekele baqhubeke ukukhiqizela izwe ukudla. Uma uphinda futhi uthenga isinkwa - cabanga ngalowo mlimi olahlekelwe imali ukuze wena uthole ukudla!

c Ukudala indawo efanele yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi amancane. d Ukufinyelela okulula kumabhizinisi amancane ukuze bathole usizo lwezezimali nezinye izinsiza, nokuthi basebenzise kanjani nokuthi benza kanjani. e Ukufinyelela okulula kumabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda nakwamanye amazwe. Ukukhuthaza, ukuhlanganisa, nokukhuthaza uhulumeni bendawo, izinhlangano ezizimele, nezinye izithakazelo ukuba babambisane ukuze i-GEP ifinyelele izinhloso zayo. Ukuhola nokuhlela ucwaningo oluhambisana nezinhlelo ezisiza amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwandisa ukuqwashisa komphakathi mayelana nendima yamabhizinisi amancane ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, nokuphila kahle jikelele. Ukuqala izakhiwo zomphakathi nezasezindaweni ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinhloso zayo ngempumelelo. Ukwenza eminye imithetho ephathelene nalomthetho. Umthetho uyisisekelo seBhodi nokukhethwa kwamalungu. Ngaphambi kokukhetha amalungu eBhodi, i-MEC kumele ixhumane ngazwi ngezaziso ku-Gazette yesifunda, ukhetho lwamalungu afanele okukhethwa. a Representa ingxenye ebalulekile yabantu baseGauteng, egxile kumasiko, ubulili, ukungasebenzi, ukusabalala kwezindawo, nezinhlelo ezikwiindawo zokuhweba. Umthetho wezomthetho ophathelene namabhizinisi amancane. I-MEC ingasungula noma yiziphi izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekukhetheni amalungu. I-CEO iyilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla esibambayo. Bonke amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwe-CEO, bakhethwa ngasikhathi sinye. a Ilungu leBhodi njengomholi. b Elinye ilungu njengomphakathi ophakeme ukuze abambe indawo yomholi weBhodi uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza leyo msebenzi.

Umkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba oqoke ikomidi, ungalichitha lelokomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Isigaba- -54, uma sifundwa ngokuhlanganyela nezinguquko ezidingekile njengalokhu kungalawula incazelo, sisebenza emibandeleni yokuqashwa kwamalungu ekomidi angewona amalungu ekomidi lokudluliselwa kwezindaba. Ngokulandisa komthethosisekelo wezwe kanye nanoma yimuphi omunye umthetho onqumela noma ovimbela ukungena, ilungu noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ogunyazwe ngumkhandlu wokwedlulisela izindaba, engangena futhi ahlole impahla engundabamlonyeni ekwedlulisweni kodaba kanye nokubuyekezwa. aAngacaphuna kunoma yimuphi usomqulu noma ulwazi lelo lungu noma umuntu akholelwa wukuthi ludingekile ekuhloleni; nokuthi bAangabhala phansi, acele umuntu ohleli endlini noma umnikazi waleyondlu, noma lowo onikezwe ilungelo ngumnikazi ukuba anikeze lowo muntu noma ilungu imininingwane ebhalwe phansi emayelana nempahla lelo lungu noma umuntu akholwa wukuthi idingekile ekuhloleni. i azokwethula ubufakazi; noma ii abeke phambi komkhandlu okubhaliwe njengaloku kuchaziwe esazisweni athunyelelwe sona. d ungaphosa imibuzo kulowo muntu noma wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi umuntu uyaphoswa imibuzo; futhi e ungalondoloza iminyaka emithathu ulwazi olubhaliwe olwaluveziwe ngokwendima a ii noma b ii. umuntu ovele phambi komkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba, ephoqiwe noma engaphoqiwe ukuba avele, angathola usizo kummeli wakhe azomkhekhela yena. a umuntu ophoqelelwe ukuba avele phambi komkhandlu wokwedluliselwa kwezindaba, unelungelo lokuthola ulwazi olumayelana nemali ekhokhelwe ofakazi bombuso mayelana necala.

Njengoba lokhu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile esakhiwe ekwenzeni kahle nasekuziphatheni kahle, umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi ngokuqondile ukuziphatha okufanele. Kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi umgomo oyinhloko wokuziphatha ukuthi okwamukelekayo, okuwukukhuthaza isibonelo esihle sokuziphatha. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umphakathi angase azithole noma abhekane nezinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele mayelana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla, bese ebhekiswa ngaphansi kweZigaba 18 kuya ku-27 eziphakanyiswe ekuziphatheni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi zika-1997, uma umuntu engalandeli ukuziphatha okufanele okumiswe. Umsebenzi kumele ube nethembekile kuMbuso futhi ahloniphe noMthethosisekelo ngenkathi egcina noma emukela imisebenzi abekwe kuyo nsuku zonke. Okuhambisana noMbuso kumele kubonakale njengokuhambisana ne "zinsizakalo zomphakathi" eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisidingo esiyinhloko esikhombisa ubuqotho bonke abasebenzi. UMthethosisekelo uthinta lezi zindaba eziphathelene namalungelo nezinto ezanelisayo kubo bonke obala. Lezi zinkomba zokuziphatha zidinga nje ubuqotho babantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi enqubweni yokuphatha ngaphansi kohlelo lwezombusazwe. Okwesibili, ukubaluleka koMthethosisekelo kumele kwamukelwe futhi kuhlinzekwe ngabo bonke. Okwesithathu, bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele baqonde kahle okuqukethwe nenhloso yoMthethosisekelo njengendlela yokuvikela nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle. Isibonelo 1: Abasebenzi bomphakathi ezingeni elihlukahlukene bavunyelwe ukuhlela futhi benze iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo. Lezi ziphakamiso kumele zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphikisi umoya noma izigaba ezithile zoMthethosisekelo.

IDWAF isibeke eceleni izimali ngaphansi kwesikhwama sokweseka izikhungo ukusiza iWSA ekuqedeleni iWSDP. Mnu Nadel angikukhumbuze ukuthi usengaphansi kwesifungo. Ihhovisi likaMengameli we-EU lithukile ukuzwa ngokuhlaselwa kwanamuhla kwehhovisi likaNdunankulu maphakathi ne-Algiers nesiteshi samaphoyisa. Izinkinga ezinjengokushoda kwezindlu zabahlwempu, amabhilidi okungafinyeleleki kuwo, izindawo ezingaphephile, olayini abade nokubheka ukususwa kwesithunzi namandla kubantu. Eminye imishini yezolimo, yokukhuliswa kwezimbali, amahlathi, ukugcina izinkukhu, izinyosi, lokhu kufaka nokuqhuma kwezinhlamvu ezitshaliwe ezifakwe imishini eshisisayo; imishini efukamelayo. Izibonelo zemisebenzi efakwe lapha yileyo evamise ukwenziwa amahhotela, amamotela, ama-ini, amadomi ezikole, izindlu zezivakashi, amahostela entsha, izindlu zabahlwempu, njll. Ukusebenza ngendlela kwamadiphu amaningi kuphazanyiswa amanzi angcolile. Abasolwa ngokuntshontsha amakhebuli (izinyoka) bashiya imoto babaleka ngenye. Baphuma baqala baphinda lokho abebekufundile. Umbiko wagxeka ukuba kubi kwesimo ngenxa yezidingo ezisemaceleni, ukwehla kakhulu komnotho womhlaba wonke kanye nokusimama kwe-ye. Imiphakathi yemukela abahambayo ngezandla ezifudumele ngesikhathi bedlula. Amaphoyisa athola okhiye bemoto ababaleka ngayo kuye. Okunye okubalulekile wukuhlolwa kwezimali. Siphinde sibone ukwenyuka kwezinga le-Russia ecebile nenokuziqhenya emhlabeni. Nakuba imnandi, kodwa idala ukwenyuka kwezinga lama-esidi emzimbeni.

Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu basebenzisa inhlabathi, amanzi kanye nemithombo yezimila ngendlela yokuthi ikhwalithi yempilo yabo ibe ngcono kanye nokuthi izizukulwane zakusasa zikwazi ukuyisebenzisa ukwanelisa izidingo zazo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukutshala, ukufuya kanye nokuvuna imithombo yemvelo kufanele iphathwe ngendlela enqanda umunakalo (ofana nokuguguleka kwenhlabathi, ukuphela kwezakhamzimba, ukuphela kwezingxenye zezimila, ukukhula kokugeleza kwamanzi, njll. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, uMnyango Wezolimo Kazwelonke uhlinzeka ngokusekelwa kokuphathwa kwemithombo yemvelo ngoHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokunakekela Umhlaba. Ngalolu hlelo amaqembu omphakathi akhuthazwa ukuba aphathe ngemfanelo futhi alondoloze umhlabathi, izimila, amanzi kanye nokwehlukahluka kwemvelo ezindaweni zabo. Ukwedlula kulokhu, uMnyango Wezolimo Kazwelonke ufuna ukuqhubekisela phambili inqubomgomo yawo kaZwelonke Yokuphathwa Komhlaba Kanye Nemithombo Yezolimo kuyo yonke imikhakha kahulumeni nakwabanye abanotho ngokusebenzisa lolu hlelo. Inhloso yoHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokunakekela Umhlaba (i-NLP) ngukusungula kanye nokusebenzisa izindlela ezimbandakanyayo zokuphatha imithombo yemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika ngempumelelo, ngokuzimele, nokulingana, kanye nezihambisana nemigomo yokuthuthukiswa okuzimele kobudlelwano bemvelo. Ngukwenza amalungiselelo ezikhungo okusungula nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo kanye nezinqubo ezizokhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okuzimelel kwemithombo yemvelo. Ngukuvula amathuba okuthuthukiswa kwezinhlangano zamabhizinisi ngokugxila ekuphatheni okuzimele kwemithombo.

Indlela izingane ezifunda ukuyifunda nokubhala. Izikhali, amathuluzi, amafabrics, amadoli, izindawo zokungena, umculo, amathuluzi, imaski, amabhokisi, amabhidi, imithwalo, izimbiza, izikhali, ama-charm anenhlanhla, ukudla, amaposta, ama-veil, ukukhetha, amakhanda, nezindlela zokuhweba. Imithi, amatshe, izindlela, izintaba, ubuciko bezindlu, izindlu zomlando, kanye nocwaningo lwezinto zakudala. Iyiwo umhlaba nomqondo wabahlali besikhathi, umuzwa wabo wesikhala, kanye nendaba yabo yemvelo.

Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba ukugweme ukuphuza utshwala lapho usebenzisa imithi. Yiba matasa kakhulu ngangokunokwenzeka lapho uzizwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokusiza ekugcineniizicubu zakho ziqinile. Ukunyakazisa umzimba njengokuhamba, ukusebenza engadini noma ukuhlanza indlu ngeke nje kukugcine uqinile, kodwa futhi kuzothuthukisa umuzwawakho wokuba ngumqemane. Kucabangele ukunikela ngesikhathi sakho noma ukw enza izinkonzo ezithile ukuze uthole ukudla. Ungase usize esikoleni, esontweni, ekhishini noma ebhizinisini lokwenza isobho ukuze uthole ukudla okunempilo noma isikhwama sokudla. Khetha ukudla okujabulelayo nokutholakalayo endaweni. Izibonelo ezilandelayo zingakusiza ngamacebiso okudla okulungiseleleka kalula nokunomsoco omningi nokho okutholakala ngamanani aphansi. Pheka isitambu esinobhontshisi bese usixuba nesitshulu sikatamatisi no-anyanisi. Ungase futhi wenezele nodali kulokhu kudla ukuze kucebe. Uma uzwa ungakuthandisisi kahle ukudla, phekaiphalishi elisuthisayo. Lokhu ungakwenza kanje: Pheka inkomishi eyodwa yempuphu yommbila. Yenezela izipuni ezintathu ezincane ezigcwele zobisi lwempuphu, isipuni esincane esisodwa samafutha noma ubhotela nezipuni ezincane ezimbili zikashukela ephalishini bese ugoqoza. Ukuzewenzele wonke umkhaya amaqebelengwane enhlanzi ungase ubhuce ithini elilodwa elikhulu lesadini (pilchards)(khumbula ukuba usebenzise namathambo) futhi ulihlanganise nohhafu wenkomishi kafulawawamakhekhe noma wesinkwa. Yenezela amaqanda amathathu achotshoziwe futhiuwagoqozisise. Kwenze kube amaqebelengwane amancanyana bese ukuthosa ngamafutha amancane.

Izinga Eliphezulu Lobugebengu: Izimbangela Nezixazululo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinga lobugebengu emadolobheni amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika lidlulelwe emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, elikhathaza izakhamuzi, abaholi, kanye nohulumeni. Kulokhu kuhlola, sizobheka izimbangela ezahlukene zokwanda kobugebengu kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuncishiswe ubugebengu. Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu lihlobene kakhulu nezimo zomnotho, ububha, nezinkinga zempilo engokwengqondo, okuyizinto ezidinga ukujoliswa ngeso lokho. Izimbangela Zobugebengu Okwamanje, ukuqonda izimbangela zobugebengu kudinga ukuhamba ngemigudu ethile. Ubugebengu buhlala buphakathi kokungabi namsebenzi nokuntuleka kwemali. Emakhelwaneni anobuphofu, abantu bavame ukwenza ubugebengu ukuze bathole imali yokuphila, ikakhulukazi uma izinsiza zikhona kodwa zingasebenzi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubudlelwane obunzima phakathi kwabantu, ukuntuleka kokuthula, nokwehluleka kwesistimu yomthetho kudala izimo ezikhuthaza ubugebengu. Izinga lokuhlukunyezwa komphakathi, okungaholela ebudhedeni nasezinkingeni zomphakathi, lizingela kahle lapho bukhona ubugebengu. Imiphakathi engafinyeleli ezinsizweni ezifanele, njengezemfundo, imisebenzi, nezokwelapha, ibhekana nemiphumela emibi yokuphila, okwenza ubugebengu bube yindlela yokuphila. Ubukhulu Bobugebengu Ubukhulu bobugebengu, obubhalwe ngempela emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu, bufaka kakhulu izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa, ubudlandawonye, nokulwa kwemibango. Ukubulawa kwabantu, izigameko zokweba, kanye nezidakamizwa kuyizinto ezivamile ezidala ukwesaba phakathi kwabantu.

Ubuchwepheshe bungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi. Izixazululo ezinjengokuhlunga amanzi, izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 10: Kanjani abantu bangakwazi ukusiza ukugcina amanzi? Abantu bangakwazi ukusiza ukugcina amanzi ngokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, njengokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi emakhaya, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi, nokuhlanza amanzi ngendlela efanele. Ukufundisa abanye ngalezi zindlela kubalulekile ukuze kube nomthelela omuhle. Umbuzo 11: Yini okumele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile? Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile, kudingeka izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi, ukwakhiwa kwemithombo yamanzi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwemfundo kubantu mayelana nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kubalulekile. Umbuzo 12: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola ezinkingeni zamanzi? Izifundo esingazithola ezinkingeni zamanzi zifaka phakathi ukubaluleka kokuhlakanipha ekusetshenzisweni kwamanzi, ukuhlela kahle izinsiza, nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukufunda ngezinkinga zamanzi kusiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yamanzi. Umbuzo 13: Kanjani umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi? Umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi ngokuhlanganisa imikhankaso yokufundisa, ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlanza imithombo yamanzi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi.

Abalimi abasemhlabeni ohlanganyelwe ngesikhathi soguquko lokusuka ekulimeleni ukuziphiliza ukuya ekubeni ngabalimi abasafufusa. Yokufakwayo ukuze kukhiqizwe (umanyolo, imbewu, izibulalazinambuzane), njll. Ukuthengwa kwamathuluzi okulima kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa amahalavu, izimfologo, ogandaganda, imishini, njll. Izakhiwo ezimile impela (ukwenziwa ngcono) zokuba umlimi wezinyoni noma izingulube, njll. I-akhawunti yokonga imali ngePosi. Xhumana nezindawo zeMAFISA kuzikhungo okubanjiswene nazo ezikhona ezibamba iqhaza ezifana neBhange Lomhlaba, iPosi Hhovisi, kanye neziKhungo Zesifundazwe Zezimali Zentuthuko, ukuze uthole amafomu okufaka isicelo, kusukela ngezinsuku ezishiwo. Kusikhulu Sokwelulwa soMnyango Wezolimo. KuBhange Lomhlaba, iPosi Hhovisi noma izikhungo zezezimali ezibamba iqhaza. Uma imali ibolekwe ivela kwa-MAFISA kufanele ibuyiswe ngokwezimo nemibandela okuvunyelenwe ngazo njenganoma kukuyiphi imalimboleko. Nanoma ngabe yikuphi okwenziwayo kuzobe kusiza obolekayo.

Izikhalo ezimaqondana nezithuthi phakathi kwezifundazwe kumele zenziwe kwinkundla yezikhalo ngezokuthutha njeboba kusho uMthetho we Nkundla yokudlulisela iziKhalo ngezoku Thutha, njengoba kufuneka ngokwalo Mthetho. Ngokwezithuthi phakathi kwezifundazwe, abagibeli akumele bagitsheliswe noma behliswe noma yikuphi ngaphandle kwasezindaweni zokugibela noma lapho beya khona, ngaphandle kokuthi zingekho ezinye izithuthi phakathi kwezindawo zokugibela noma lapho beya khona nasezindaweni zokwehla noma zokugibela, noma, ngokwezamatekisi angamakhumbi, izinhlangano ezifanele amalunga azo asebenza kulowo noma kuleyomigudu zivumelene ngokwehlukile. Ngokuhambisana nesigatshana 2, iBhodi kumele ngaphambi kokubhekela isicelo sokukhishwa, ukuvuselelwa, ukushintshwa noma ukudluliselwa kwelayisense yokusebenza, yenze ukuthi lisakazwe ku Somqulu ka Hulumeni ngendlela ebekiwe, imininingwane yesicelo ngengoba kungabe kubekiwe bese lichoma isaziso ngalesisicelo ebhodini lezaziso emahhovisi alo isikhathi esingangoba sibekiwe. a sokushintsha imininingwane ethile yemoto chazwe kwilayisense yokusebenza; noma b singokwesivumelwano esikhonjwe kusigaba 391. a kumele livumele umuntu, okuthe ngesikhathi esibekiwe, waletha izimiso zokuhlolisisa amafomu omfaki sicelo nezincwajana ezihambisana nawo ehhovisi le Bhodi ekukhokheni imali ebekiwe; bese b lingakwazi, ngokucelwa yilowomuntu, ukuthi limunike izishicilelo zamafomu namabhukwana omfaki sicelo ekukhokheni imali ebekiwe.

h Okungenani isamba sokuqala semali engu- R15000 senani lazo zonke izindawo lapho kwakhiwe futhi kuhlalwa khona, ngaphandle nje uma kwazeka ukuthi uNgqongqoshe, ngokuxoxisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali, ngezikhathi ezithile, inganyuswa lemali kwedlulwe emkhawulweni ukuze ihambisane nezinga lomnotho ngaleso sikhathi; futhi i Impahla/umhlaba noma umkhakha wezimpahla/wemihlaba ebaluliwe ngokwesigatshana- 3, noma inani lentela yendawo elevile enanini elibekwe njengomkhawulo empahleni/endaweni noma emkhakheni wempahla noma wendawo. i izindawo zezomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zezolimo isilinganiso okukhulunywa ngaso esigatshaneni- 1 b ingashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela ngokubambisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali. ungqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana nongqongqoshe wezezimali kanye nesaziso, ahlele umkhawulo ngokwamaphesenti okufanele ukuba kwenyuswe ngalo inani lentela yendawo. a nezinhlobo zomasipalatiezingase, ngokulandela lesi sigaba, zichazwe esazisweni njengezihlobene nemikhakha noma izinhlobo zomasipalati ezingaphansi kwencazelo yomthetho wezinhlaka zomasipalati nangezinye izindlela; noma b izinhlobo zemikhakha yendawo/yempahla uma kunesizathu esihle, ungqongqoshe anganikeza ushwele kumasipalati emkhawulweni ohlelwe ngokulandela isigatshana-1.

Njengomdlali ophumelele, uPele waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isithombe sobhola eBrazil. Uthole ama-trophy amaningi, kuhlanganisa neNdebe yoMhlaba ezintathu, okwenza waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni jikelele. U-Pele uphinde waba umphakathi wokuhlonipha, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bobhola bungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. U-Lionel Messi: Ubuchwepheshe Obuphakeme U-Lionel Messi, owaziwa njengenye yezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni, ubhalwe emlandweni wobhola njengomdlali ophakeme. UMessi, ophumelele izicoco eziningi, unamakhono akhangayo, futhi ubuchwepheshe bakhe buhlale bujabulisa izigidi zabalandeli. U-Messi ubonakale emkhakheni wobhola kusukela esemncane, futhi usaqhubeka nokukhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu eminyakeni engama-15 edlule. Uhlonishwa ngempela, futhi uthole izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganisa neBallon d'Or, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ungomunye wabathandwa kakhulu emhlabeni. UMnyango Wokuhumusha Nokuhlela weSevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) uhlukaniswe ngezindawo ezilandelayo zolimi: Afrikaans, English, Izilimi Zangaphandle, isiZulu, isiXhosa, isiNdebele, isiSepedi, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiSwati, isiTshivenda, nesiXitsonga. Uhulumeni omusha uhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seMthethosisekelo, uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi "uhulumeni wesizwe nohulumeni bezifunda basebenzisa noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni ngenhloso zohulumeni, kubhekwa ukusetshenziswa, ukufinyeleleka, izindleko, kanye nesimo sezifunda kanye nezinye izintandokazi zabahlali." Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala indawo lapho iminyango kahulumeni ixhumana ngempumelelo, phakathi kwezinye izinto, nabo bonke abantu bomphakathi ngolimi lwabo olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. ISevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) isebenza njengengqalasizinda yokwesekwa kwezilimi kwezobuchwepheshe kuhulumeni. Kukhona uhlelo lokuthola ulwazi ngocingo. Izinhlobo zedokhumenti ezihumushwayo ikakhulukazi zifaka lezo eziqondiswe emphakathini, njengezincwadi ezimhlophe, izincwadi eziluhlaza, umthetho ophakanyisiwe ophumeleleke ukuze uthole imibono yomphakathi, izaziso zohulumeni, imithetho, imibiko yonyaka yeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni, imibiko ye-commission kanye nezinkomiti, izivumelwano zomhlaba, izinkulumo zomongameli, izinkulumo zabaminisitiri, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikaHulumeni, amadokhumenti ezinkontileka, amaphephandaba nemikhankaso, ulwazi lwezindaba, njll.

Amakomiti eBhodi akhethwa yiBhodi ngokuthobela umthetho osuke wabalulwa ngaphambilini. IKomiti eliHlola amabhuku lamiselwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i- NEMISA ihlala inendlela enomfutho, ephelele nesobala yezezimali, ingozi kanye nolawulo lwangaphakathi. Okwamanje isanamalungu eBhodi kuphela, kodwa ikomidi inako ukukhetha ukuthi iqoke amanye amalungu. Ikomidi libika kwiBhodi le-NEMISA ngemiphumela yokuhlolwa kwamabhuku kanye nangobuqotho nokukhona empilweni ebikwayo. I-NEMISA, ngokubambisana neSithunywa seNsizakalo Yezwelonke (USA), isendleleni yokumisa ikomiti langaphakathi lokuhlolwa kwamabhuku elinamalungu amathathu, ilungu eliphuma esikhungweni ngasinye kanye nelungu elizimele. Leli komiti lizozimela linganciki nakancane kubaphathi, iBhodi le- NEMISA kanye nekomidi lokuhlolwa kwamabhuku. Inhloso enkulu yaleli komiti ukumisa izinqubomgomo nezinqubo mayelana nolawulo lwangaphakathi enhlanganweni, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthobela uMthetho woKuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA.) Le komiti izobika kukhona kokubili abaphathi kanye neKomiti loKuhlolwa kwamabhuku le- NEMISA. I-NEMISA iphakamisa ukuhlomisa abasebenzi bayo ngezakhiwo zokubandakanyeka ezindabeni eziphathelene nabasebenzi, ukuqeqesha, ukuthuthukisa nokwabelana ulwazi. I-NEMISA ibona isenzo sokwakha (affirmative action) siyingqikithi yokuqasha kwayo ngokugxila kakhulu ekuqasheni abesimame. Inkampani izinikele ekuqinisekiseni indawo yokusebenza ephephile. IKomiti yezeMpilo nokuphepha yedluliselwe amandla okuthi iphumelelise lokhu. Ikheli leWebhsayithi: www.nemisa.co.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusiza abathintekayo, ukuvula uphenyo olunembile, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zihlanzwe. Ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukulawula lezi zinkinga, izinkampani kufanele zikhumbule ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluccelayo futhi ziqikelele ukusiza abathintekayo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izibonelo ezidumile zokuvuza kwamaphepha? Impendulo: Kunezibonelo eziningi ezidumile zokuvuza, njenge-Whistleblower Edward Snowden, owavula imininingwane eyimfihlo ye-NSA ngendlela eyahluka kakhulu ekukhulumeni ngedijithali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezinjenge-Wikileaks zaveza amaphepha amaningi akhombe izinqubo ezizimele, okwakuholela ekwenzeni izinguquko eziningi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuzwakalisa indima enkulu yokukhuluma kwempilo elula emphakathini. Umbuzo 8: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba abantu bazi ngalezi zindaba? Impendulo: Kulula ukuba abantu bakhumbule ukuthi ulwazi lwasemphakathini luyisibopho, futhi kunomthelela empilweni yabo. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zindaba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi izingozi ezihambisana nokungena kwemali nokuhlala kusesimweni sokuvikela izimfihlo zabo. Lokhu kungalawula izingozi zokuphazamiseka kwezimali noma ukulahlekelwa ukufaka izinhlelo ezithile kumasiko. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokubhekana nokuvuza? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezisemthethweni zokubhekana nokuvuza, lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa abaqondisi abahlola ukuphepha kwedatha, izinhlelo zokubikela ukuvuza, nakho konke okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvikela. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele ukuphatha izinkinga ezithile, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zigcina izimfihlo zazo kubalulekile.

Umhlaba ophucukile (ongenalutho) awunenani uma ulinganiswa nomhlaba ogunyisiwe onezimpahla. Ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukubheka izindlu, izintango nemigwaqo epulazini lakho kuhlale kuphilile sonke isikhathi. Okwakhiwe epulazini kufanele kuphathwe ngendlela efanelekile ukuze kukwazi ukusetshenziswa njalo nakusasa - ukubeka umvuno, ukusebenza ngomkhiqizo, ukugunda izimvu, njll. Kungcono vele ukubeka ogandaganda neminye imishini ngaphansi kophahla, uma zima ngaphandle zizolimala. "Izintango ezinhle eziphilile zidala omakhelwane abazozwana kahle nawe", kufanele izimfuyo zakho zihlale endaweni yakho. Lapho utshala, kubalulekile ukuthi izimfuyo zingakwazi ukungena kulawo masimu. Uhlelo (isu) lokudlisa izimfuyo ezindaweni ezithile ngesikhathi esithile lenza ukuthi utshani obuthile obuthandekayo buzovikelwa futhi buzothola isikhathi sokuphinda ukumila. Amakontula nezindawo lapho amanzi amaningi azokwazi ukugeleza khona kubalulekile ukuvimba ukuguguleka komhlabathi - ukuguguleka komhlabathi kudala ingozi engakwazi ukulungiswa, kusemahlombeni abantu bonke ukunonisa nokuvikela umhlabathi ukuze abantwana bethu bazokwazi ukusebenzisa lowo mhlabathi nakusasa bathole impilo enhle. Imigwaqo ibalulekile lapho kulinywa ngendlela yezomnotho - izinto ezifana nomanyolo zifanele zifike kahle epulazini, futhi umvuno wethu ufanele ukwazi ukuhamba kahle uye lapho uzothengeswa khona. Ukuphatha imigwaqo emapulazini kuyinto ebalulekile ekulimeni.

Ezinye izidingo zingalungiswa ngezinhlelo ezimbandakanya eminye iminyango kahulumeni ethintekayo, njengowezeNhlalakahle, ezeMpilo, nezeMfundo, nezinye.

Uma abantu abahola impesheni yokukhubazeka / abangasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula befaka isicelo unyaka nonyaka, bangancishiselwa imali, njengokusho kwesinqumo soMkhandlu kulwabiwomali lwawo lonyaka, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga elandela usuku lokufakwa kwesicelo ngaphansi kwale mibandala elandelayo: a abahola imali yokukhubazeka: ofaka isicelo kumele abe nencwadi ekhishwa nguMnyango Wezenhlalakahle Yomphakathi eqinisekisa ukuthi uthola impesheni yokukhubazeka, NOMA incwadi kadokotela eqinisekisa ukuthi ukhubazekile futhi akasakwazi ukusebenza; b abangasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula: ofaka isicelo kufanele akhiphe incwadi evela kumqashi wakhe noma kumshuwalense womqashi wakhe eqinisekisa ukuthi akasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula; c ofaka isicelo kumele alethe umazisi wakhe onamagabelo; d ofaka isicelo kumele kube uhlala khona ngokugcwele kulowo muzi; e ofaka isicelo kumele abe ngumnikazi walowo muzi obhaliswe ngokusemthethweni. f abanikazi ngokuhlanganyela kumele bafeze le mibandela engenhla noma eku-7.2 ngenhla g ama-akhawunti amanzi, ugesi namarates kumele abe ndawonye egameni lomnikazi h ohlelweni lokusingathelwa ifa, umsingathi wefa kumele afeze yonke imibandela engenhla. Kumele kuvezwe nekhophi yetayitela. i abaphathi bamafa afelwe ngabaniniwo, abawabayo kanye nabasingathi bawo kababaliwe ekuxegiselweni isibopho sokukhokha. ukuxegiselwa kuyonqamuka: a uma ofake isicelo eshona; b kufakwa isicelo seRevenue Clearance Certificate esiholela ekwedluleleni kobunikazi bomuzi komunye umuntu; c lapho ofake isicelo engasahlali ngokugcwele kulowo muzi; d uma ongasasebenzi ngenxa yokugula ethola umsebenzi.

Singathanda ukuveza ukuthi asikakayisayini i-Geneva protocol. Uhlelo lumele imisebenzi edinga ukuba yenziwe ngamakota amane onyaka wezimali. Ngaphandle kophethe, ayikho inhlolokhono engenzeka ngaphakathi kwemingcele yasesiteshini sokuvota. Funda kakhudlwana ngamazinga kanye nemithetho elawula ukufakwa kwamalebula emafrijini asemakhaya. Kunomcabango othi izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane ezihlala emithonjeni yasolwandle ziyehla ngenxa yomthelela enawo ngokuvula izimayini ogwini. Sihlangana namuhla ukuzosayina isivumelwano esaziwa nge-Declaration of Intent phakathi kohulumeni base-Nordic kanye neNingizimu Afrikha ukuba babmbisane ezindabeni zentuthuko eNingizimu Afrikha nabanye abantu. I-Biodiversity Explorer izimisele ukukhombisa nokuchaza ukwehlukana, ibhayoloji kanye nokusebenzisana kwezimpilo e-Afrikha eseNingizimu. Izindaba zasekhaya ezinomthelela omubi endleleni abaseYurophu ababuka ngayo izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrikha njengomlingani kwezomnotho kanti nekusasa lezwe kumele kuhlonzwe izindlu zamanxusa bese kuyiswa kuhulumeni. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukugqugquzela, ukwamukela, nendawo lapho kunokukhononda kanye nexhala nalapho izinkinga zingaxazululeka khona. Ngaleso sikhathi, abaseNingizimu Afrikha ababili babonakale eNingizimu naseMpumalanga ye-Chad ngokwehlukana kanti akukadingeki babuyiselwe emuva okwamanje. Sithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzovimba isimo lapho kwakhiwa khona izakhiwo ezintsha , kodwa zigcine ziyimigede ngoba kungekho muntu owacabanga ukuthi zizosebenza kanjani nokuthi kuzosebenza obani. Izikole zamenywa ukuba zizokwenza izethulo ngengqikithi: ethi Izixazululo zasekhaya eZinselelweni zoMhlaba.

Uma abantu bebuza imibuzo, bakhombisa ukulangazelela ukufunda izinto ezintsha, okungukuhle - kumele bakhumbule, "ulwazi luwumsebenzi!" Chaza ukuthi ungubani. Khuluma ukuthi kunezigaba ezintathu zokuzilolonga ezihlanganisa izihloko ezahlukene eziphathelene nomsebenzi wezinkomidi zomphakathi. Uma unolwazi, batshele abafundi ukuthi uzilolonga nini futhi kuphi izifundo ezimbili ezilandelayo. Baphathe ngemininingwane yonke ephathelene nalokho okukhuluma ngakho. Kuphi izindawo zokuhlala ngesikhathi sokuphuza itiye nokudla, futhi nini ukufunda kuphetha? Yini ezikhulumayo ezihambelana nezinhlelo zokuhamba, njengoba kushiwo yilabo abathunyelwe yihhovisi elizokhokhela, hhayi uMnyango noma i-DBSA? Izikhathi zokubhema azikhuthazwa ngoba isikhathi sinqunyelwe futhi sibalwa. Amafoni kufanele apagwe. Khuluma kafushane ngendlela incwadi yokuzilolonga ehlelwe ngayo. Chaza ukuthi ulwazi olungeziwe lutholakala ngasohlangothini futhi ukuthi uphawu ngalunye lumele ulwazi oluthile oluhlukile. Khuluma kafushane ukuthi uphawu ngalunye lumele ini. Umhlahlandlela womfundisi wokusebenzisa incwadi yokuzilolonga. Kungani ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kubalulekile? Thola esigabeni a-d ngaphansi kokwethulwa ukuthi iyiphi imithetho ephethe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yiziphi izindawo ezibalulekile zeMthetho Wezindleko Zempahla Zomkhandlu ezidinga ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yenza lo msebenzi ngamaqembu ama-4 noma ama-5. Buza amaqembu ukuthi abhale izindlela umphakathi angabamba ngazo iqhaza ezindabeni zikamasipala. Batshele iqembu ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kube isigaba esibaluleke kakhulu kule ncwadi yokuzilolonga. Yenza umsebenzi kuqala ukuze uthole ukuthi izindawo zabo zokukhathazeka zikhona kuphi.

Imiphakathi kufanele ifundiswe ukubamba iqhaza kwezokuhlela, ukulandela nokulinganisa imigomo yezokungcebeleka, ukuze kumiswe imigomo ngokubona kwalabo ababambe iqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphakathi kufanele izibophezele futhi ikwazi ukubika ngentuthuko yawo. Ukuzimbandakanya kwezokungcebeleka kuyilungelo. Ukukhoneka nokufinyeleleka kwemigomo nezimfanelo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuqinisekiswe, ngale kokunaka ubulili, ubudala, ibala, ulimi, amasiko, ukulandela kwezemidlalo. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezemidlalo luzungeza ezintweni ezine ezingumongo: Imfundiso nokuvocavoca umzimba, ezemidlalo zentsha nabantwana, ezemidlalo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nezinhlangano zikazwelonke. a Ukuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa nokwethulwa kwezokungcebeleka okumbandakanya, ukudlala, ukuvocavoca umzimba ngokuvamile nokuzifunela/nokufuna isikhathi sokuphumula ngokuzijabulisa okunenzuzo, ukukhomba nokwenza imigomo yocwaningo nokubamba/ukwethamela imiboniso nezingqungquthela nezinhlanganiso zolwazi kwezemidlalo. b Ukumela iNingizimu Afrika kuzwelonke, kumazwekazi kanye namazwe ngamazwe. c Ukwaluleka uNgqongqoshe ngenqubomgomo kwezokungcebeleka. Akukho nqubomgomo okuvunyelwene ngayo ngamahora azosentshenziswa kwezemidlalo noma ezokungcebeleka ngesikhathi sesikole. Akukho malungiselelo ezingane ezisafanele ukuya esikoleni kodwa ezingafundi. Lokhu kuqinisa isiko lokusebenza phakathi kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni, okuhlose ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi. Umqondisi wocwaningo olwenziwe kuMnyango Wezabasebenzi, uNdunankulu uMthethwa, usho ukuthi lezi zitifiketi zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokusebenza. "Sifuna ukuba nezisebenzi ezibambisene, ezisenza uthando lomsebenzi wazo. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa kuhulumeni," kuchaza uMthethwa. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamahhovisi kahulumeni nabafundi kudala izifundo ezithakazelisayo nezithuthukisa. Lokhu kubambisana kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaqeqeshi bahlala besekela izisebenzi, benza kube lula ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa. Lezizifundo ziqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela ezihambisanayo, zifaka entweni amakhono amasha, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze isisebenzi sikhule. Ngokuphendula izidingo zabantu, uhulumeni uthathe izinyathelo eziqinile zokwakha uhlelo lwezokuhlola lwalolu hlelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izisebenzi zithola izimpendulo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kwenza abasebenzi bazi ukuthi imisebenzi yabo iyabhekwa futhi ibalulekile ekwenzeni ngcono impilo yomphakathi. Uhlelo lokuthola izitifiketi luthathwa njengomkhankaso owaziwa, owakuveza obala imiphumela emihle. Izinhlelo zokuhlola zanyatheliswa ezinkampanini ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abangathanda ukufunda bamukelekile. Lesi simo sithuthukisa ukwaziswa nokwakhiwa kobungcweti, kunciphisa izingozi zokumiswa, nokwandisa impumelelo ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi. Uhlanga lwenhlangano olubambisene nolohulumeni, luzama ukwenza imisebenzi yethu ifinyeleleke kalula, ikakhulukazi kubantu abancinane.

Kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezibangela ubungozi. Ngaleso sikhathi uzokwazi ukukhetha i-pesticide efanele - qaphela ukufaka i-pesticide ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nasemazingeni afanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo kanye nosayizi wesitshalo. Ukufaka ama-pesticides kungavimbela ukuncipha kokukhiqiza, kodwa umbulali kufanele abe nekhono ngoba kuhilela izindleko. Kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle uma izilwane ezilimazayo zibangela ubungozi obukhulu, noma kungase kubize kakhulu ngaphandle kokusiza ngoba izindleko zizodlula inzuzo. Akukhuthazeki ukuphuzisa izitshalo uma izilwane ezilimazayo zingakabi nengozi enkulu. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi kukhona abaphangi bemvelo abawadla ezinye izilwane ezilimazayo. Uma uphuzisa kakhulu, lezi zilwane ezidla izilwane ezilimazayo zizobulawa, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi izilwane ezilimazayo zizokwazi ukujwayela i-pesticide uma ifakwa kaningi futhi ngeke zife. Imikhiqizo emitholakala ngemithi nayo iyingozi futhi iyalimaza umhlabathi, ngakho kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela uma kudingeka kakhulu. Ukulima ngaphambi kokufaka kusiza ukuvimbela ubungozi bezilwane ezilimazayo. Nokho, inani lezilwane ezilimazayo kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zikwazi ukuphathwa ngempumelelo. Ngokuvamile, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokuvikela ubungozi bezilwane ezilimazayo - sebenzisa indlela ehambisana nohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo ngesikhathi esifanele sesitshalo esithile. Ukuphatha izilwane ezilimazayo kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezitshalo ngoba kuzokhombisa ukuthi kuzoba nenzuzo ekulimaleni nasekukhiqizeni noma cha.

Uhlelo olusha lokuthuthukisa imfundo, yize kungeyilo olwabantu abasha nje kuphela, luzokunikeza ithuba lokuba bafunde amakhono adingakalayo futhi kufanele lukwazi ukwandisa izifundo kabanzi ngesikhashana esifushane. Ukuqalwa kwezinhlelo zokusekela abasha kuzombandakanya ukwenza ngcono isimo solwazi nokuthola izeluleko ngemisebenzi kanye nezinsiza zokufunelwa imisebenzi. Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe, kanye nezingane zabo, bathola usizo olufanele, oluphumelelayo nolwakusasa. Lezi zinsizakalo zihlala ziguquguquka, zihlala zizinzile, futhi zisebenza ukuze zifeze izidingo ezahlukahlukene zabantu. Umbiko lo uzobheka izici ezahlukene zezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, kuhlanganiswe nezinga lokuphumelela, izinselelo, nezindlela zokuthuthukisa. Uhlaka Lwezinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ziqala ngezinqubo zokuhlola nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile kumama abakhulelwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, ukuhlola isimo sokukhulelwa, kanye nokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bazi ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokusiza abesifazane abakhulelwe nabagula. Izinsiza Nezinto Eziphumelelayo Izibhedlela zinezinzuzo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuba nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezifana nezibhedlela ezinomoya opholile, abahlengikazi abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nodokotela abanolwazi. Lezi zinsiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bahlala benempilo, futhi lezi zinsizakalo zikwazisa ukuthi ukubeletha kungenzeka kuphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zihlala zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili obusiza ekwehliseni ubunzima bokubeletha. Ukuphumelela Kwezinsizakalo Izibhedlela eziningi zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuphumelela kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha.

Imfashini Nobuhle: Izinyathelo Zokwakha Isitayela Esihle Isingeniso Imfashini nobuhle kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Zihlanganisa indlela esiziphatha ngayo, indlela esibukeka ngayo, kanye nezinto esizikhethayo ukuze sikhombise ubuhle bethu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile ezizosisiza ukuba sakhe isitayela esihle, esihambisana nezidingo zethu, futhi esikhombisa ubuntu bethu. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Isitayela Sakho Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi isitayela sakho siwubani. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ucabangele izinto ezifana nezinto ozithandayo, imibala ethokozisayo, nezinto ezikwenza uzizwe kahle. Thola izithombe ezikukhombisa kahle, noma ubuke izincwadi zemfashini ukuze uthole ugqozi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha izingubo ezizokwenza uzizwe uthokozile. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Izingubo Ngemva kokuba uqonde isitayela sakho, isikhathi sokukhetha izingubo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukhetha izingubo ezihambisana nezimo zomzimba wakho. Uma unomzimba omncane, ungakhetha izingubo ezikhululekile, kanti uma unomzimba omkhulu, ungakhetha izingubo ezihlanganisa kahle umzimba. Ungakhohlwa ukufaka imibala ehlukahlukene, kodwa qiniseka ukuthi imibala oyikhethayo ihambisana. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlanganisa Izingubo Ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izingubo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye ezihambelana kahle. Isibonelo, uma ugqoke ijezi elikhulu, ungakhetha amabhulukwe amancane ukuze udale ibhalansi. Futhi, ungakhetha izesekeli ezifana nezikhwama, amabhande, noma izicathulo ezihambisana nezimpahla zakho.

Noma yisiphi isithunywa esilawulwayo esisebenza ukwemukela/ukulondoloza/ukwedlulisa nokuthinta impahla okufanele ithwalwe ngomoya/ngendiza uyoba nesitifiketi semvume ekhishwe nguKhomishani. Iqobo nje ukuthi noma imuphi umuntu oqashwe yisithunywa esilawulwayo futhi othintekayo ekuphatheni impahla eyaziwayo, kuyodingeka aphothula uqeqesho olunqunywe wumthethonkambiso 108.06.1 futhi abe nesitifiketi solwazi olufanele ukuba athole lolo luqeqesho. Isithunywa esilawulwayo siyosungula ibhukwana lezokuphepha eliqukethe lonke ulwazi nempahla ethwalwa ngendiza equkethe lonke ulwazi olunqunywe nguMqulu I-SA-CATS-aCS nalapho eneka khona indlela ayosebenza ngayo. Lelo bhukwana liyonikwa uKhomishani ngenhloso yokulamukela. Noma imuphi umuntu ofaka isicelo sokuba isithunywa esigunyaziwe noma esiqinisekisiwe njengomthumeli-mpahla owaziwayo, uyovumela umuntu ogunyaziwe, umhloli noma isikhulu esigunyazwe yiKhomishani ukuba aqhube uphenyo nocwaningo olufanele ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuthi imiyalelo yezokuphepha eqondene nokuphatha, ukuthutha nokulondoloza impahla eyaziwayo ihambisana ngemfanelo yezidingo zale Ngxenye. Lowo onesitifiketi semvume noma isitifiketi sokugunyazwa uyovumela isisebenzi esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma umuntu onemvume noqokwe nguKhomishani ukwenza uphenyo nocwaningo olufanele ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuthi izidingo zilandela izimiso ezihlonzwe ngaphansi kwale Ngxenye.

iOpenAI Ngomhla ka-30 kuMfumfu 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wenzeka eGoli, lapho iOpenAI, inkampani edume kakhulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, yethula khona izinhlelo zayo ezintsha ezihlosiwe ukuguqula indlela esisebenzisa ngayo ubuhlakani bokwenziwa. Lo mcimbi, owawubanjelwe endaweni ethokomele, waba nethuba lokuhlangana kwabantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa osomabhizinisi, abacwaningi, nabathandi bobuchwepheshe. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo ethokozisayo kaMnu. Sam Altman, umphathi omkhulu weOpenAI, owachaza khona izinjongo zenkampani. Uthe, "Sifuna ukwenza ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bube yinsiza esiza abantu, hhayi ukuba yingozi. Sifuna ukwakha ubuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo, obuphephile, futhi obusebenziseka kalula." Lezi zisho zakhuthaza abathandi bobuchwepheshe, futhi zaveza umbono omuhle wokuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bungaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni yethu. Ngemuva kwalokho, abacwaningi beOpenAI baphinde baveza izinhlelo ezintsha ezihlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ezinjenge-ChatGPT, ezithuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezinhlelo. Lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa amandla amakhulu okwenza imisebenzi ethile, njengezincwadi, izifundo, nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Ababukeli babonisa intshisekelo enkulu, futhi kwaba nezikhathi zokuxoxa lapho abantu bebuza imibuzo ethokozisayo. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezinye izinkampani ezinkulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, okuhlanganisa iGoogle neMicrosoft, ezazikhuluma ngezindlela zokubambisana neOpenAI.

Lokhu kusho ukufunda ngababambiqhaza, izinhlelo zabo, kanye nezinto abazimisele ukuzifeza uma bephumelela. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuvota Lapho usuku lokhetho lufika, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela zonke izinyathelo zokuvota. Vakashela endaweni yokuvota ebekiwe, uthathe ubufakazi bokubhaliswa kwakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulandela imiyalelo yokuvota. Isinyathelo 5: Ukubamba Iqhaza Ngemva Kokhetho Ngemuva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukulandela izinqumo ezithathwayo, ukuhlinzeka ngombono, noma ukufaka iziphakamiso kumalungu omphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza ngemuva kokhetho kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bahlala bephendula ezidingweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, futhi onokuthula. Qhubekani nibambe iqhaza, nikhumbule ukuthi izwi lenu linamandla!

Awukho umkhumbi wangaphandle ozonikezwa ilayisensi yokudoba yase South Africa ngamphandle uma usebenzisana ngokubambisana nomuntu onelungelo wase South Africa bedoba. Kumele bathintane negatsha eliphethe izindaba zenhlalo yendawo nezokuvakasha bengakaqalisi ukudoba ukuze kutholisiswe ukuthi ukuqasha umkhumbi wangaphandle kuvumelekile yini enhlobeni ethize yezinhlanzi nokuthi maphepha mani adingekayo ukuze imvume inikezwe. Uma ngokomgomo kwemukeleka ukuthi kusetshenziswe umkhumbi wangaphandle, ofaka isicelo kumele athole ifomu lokucela ukusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle ehhovisi eliseduze naye lakwa DEA&T. igama lomkhumbi wokudoba igama nimininingwane yomnikazi womkhumbi amandla omkhumbi ubude nokuthi uthwala kangakanani inombholo obhaliswe ngayo umkhumbi izwe obhaliswe kulona umkhumbi isitifiketi sokuphepha esivela kulelozwe. Yonke imikhumbi yangaphandle kumele ibe nomshini osebenzayo okuthiwa yi INMARSAT CVMS othintana nabaphethe ezamanzi olwandle. Kumele ufakazelwe yilabo abaphethe ezamanzi olwandle. Esicelweni sakho, yisho ukuthi nguyiphi isekisheni yokudoba ozosebenza kuyona nokuthi uzodoba Isikhathi esingakanani. Uma umkhumbi ungewona okhethiweyo ngokuya ngomthetho welungelo, ofaka isicelo kumele agcwalise ifomu lokugudluzela lomkhumbi kwenye indawo. Ukuze umkhumbi unikezwe ilungelo lokudoba, ofaka isicelo kumele agcwalise ifomu lephomedi ehambelana nesekisheni yokudoba lomkhumbi ozodoba kuyo. Okokugcina, uma ofaka isicelo acabanga ukuthi lomkhumbi uzodoba olwandle olunamagagasi aphezulu, kumele agcwalise ifomu lokudoba endaweni enjalo.

Wayibizela ekamelweni indodana, yayothothobala eceleni kombhejana owawunomfowabo nodadewabo naba ababelandwe-kwaJakobusi. Ufuze uyihlo lo owangishiya nani engishiyela ukuhlupheka. Njengoba ngingenayo ngisho imali yokukuthengela ucezu lwesinkwa lodwa lolu, ngizolondla ngani leli xhegu lakho" eqhubeka nokumbeka isandla mawala? Sase siqala-ke siyihlohlozisa emlilweni inyama. Zibambe Ziqine Wethu! Kuthi uma efika kule migqa avele acinane uZama. Ingani usuke akhumbule uMaMthethwa owathathwa uyise emva kokudlula emhlabeni kukanina, owayenguMaMthethwa naye. Lalungafakwa kuloyo mamncane wabo. Ubebaphethe ngesandla sensimbi yize bekungudadewabo kanina obezalwa ngumfowabo kaMthethwa omncane.
