Ukwakha ubudlelwano emikhakheni enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqale ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yokuphatha nokuphatha efanayo. E-Cabinet Lekgotla kaJanuwari 2001, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo, izinsiza zamasiko ezifana nezandla, umculo, nezinkonzo, kanye namafilimu, zizofakwa ezinhlelweni zezimali ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuthuthukiswa/ukukhula nokudala imisebenzi. Sekucacile ukuthi izinsiza zamasiko zingadlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni ophumayo, okufana nezinsiza zemvelo ezifana nokumbiwa nokulima. Amazwe ahlukene afana neSweden neMexico anikeza ukuqinisekiswa okungaphikiswa ngalokhu. Ukuphakamisa imikhakha yocwaningo nokuthuthukiswa. Le ndawo kumele iphathwe ngokuhlonipha ukuphathwa kwayo nokubhekelela, ngokuya ngezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba ekubhekelweni nasekuthuthukisweni, ngokuya ngezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba. Ukuze kusizakale le nhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe ukuhlola nokuhlola okufanele (isibonelo, ukubheka phambili) ngokubambisana neNational Advisory Council for Development. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhajethi ehleliwe yonyaka ye-R2.5 billion kufanele ikwenze okungenani kabili ezinyangeni eziyishumi ezizayo. (Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ayihambisani naleyo yezenhlalakahle). Okwamanje, sigcina uxhaso lwe-GDP kazwelonke ku-0.7%, okuyingxenye yesithathu ye- OECD average futhi encane uma kuqhathaniswa nenani elihambisanayo lamazwe athuthukile afana neNingizimu Korea neFinland. Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuphambili kunezimpempe ezinkulu ekwehliseni izindleko emnothweni.

Umlando Wokhetho Luka-1994 Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 eNingizimu Afrika ungomunye wezikhathi ezibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Lokhu kukhetha kwaba yisigaba esisha sokuphila kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, lapho kwavulwa amathuba amasha emiphakathini ehlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle leli phepha, kubalulekile ukubheka izigameko ezaholela kulolu khetho, izinqubo ezazisetshenziswa, kanye nemiphumela yalo. Ngonyaka ka-1990, umholi we-ANC, uNelson Mandela, wakhululwa ejele, lapho abesebenza khona iminyaka engama-27. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, kwavula umnyango wokuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukukhululwa kukaMandela kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlangano eziningi ezazifuna ukulwa nokucindezelwa, futhi kwavula ithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngonyaka ka-1994, izinkulungwane zabantu zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhetheni. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubuyisana, lapho abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene behlangana ukuze bakhe ikusasa elisha. Ukuze kube nokhetho oluqondile, izinhlelo zokuvota zaphakanyiswa, futhi izikhungo zokuvota zavulwa ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abaningi, kuhlanganise nabesifazane, ukuba bavote, okwakungakaze kube khona ngaphambili. Uhlelo lokhetho lwaluqukethe izinyathelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokuvota ezisemthethweni. Ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa, abantu bahlala emigqeni emide, bekhombisa isifiso sabo sokuba neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubambisana, lapho abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bephakamisa izwi labo. Ukwamukelwa kwemiphumela yokhetho kwaba yisikhathi esijabulisayo.

Uma sibheka imibono emayelana nezempilo kanye nokuphepha okuhlobene nemboni yezikhali zenunzi, uhulumeni ukholelwa wukuthi ukuhlola okungachemile kulokhu kuyadingeka. Iphrojekthi kumele ibe seqhulwini lokuthuthukiswa kokuhlosiwe wumnyango okungukuthi ugu. Izimboni zezinhlanzi eNingizimu Afrikha zisetshenziswa kakhulu yilabo abdobela ukuziphilisa nalabo abakwenza samdlalo kanjalo nokuqooqa okokucusha. Umbutho wezokuvikela wakhombisa ukuthi wawufuna isamba esithile njengento yokwenyusa amathuba. Amalungu amaphoyisa asebenzisa amahhashi ukugada imicimbi nokusebenzisa amahhashi uma izimoto zingakwazi ukusetshenziswa. Kunokulindela ukuthi emva kwesivumelwano sase-Mecca kanye nokwakhiwa kukaHulumeni woBumbano kuyocatshangwa ngendlela. Ukubamba kwakhe iqhaza enhlanganweni kufaka nokuhlala eMkhandlwini owaziwa nge-UWC University Council, i-Senate kanye ne-Orientation Committee. Kusolakala ukuthi umufi kanye nentombi yakhe babevakashele umuzi osepulazini ngesikhathi kuqala ukuphikisana noK. Isimo samakhono sichaza umuntu onamakhono aphezulu ovunyelwe ukungena ezweni okwesikhashana ukuzokwenza umsebenzi othile noma ukuzothatha isikhundla esithile. Abakhiqizi abancane - abagxile ezingutsheni zokugqoka, ukwakha ifenisha, ukusebenza ngensimbi, ezobuciko aknye nokubumba, njll. Ukugxibha umkhuba wabantu abaningi bedla kanyekanye esiqukathini sawo wonke umuntu. Lokhu kuphambana nokujiyiswa kwemisebenzi ezindaweni zikamasipala nezasemadolobheni. Ngingumshayeli wendiza, nginesipiliyoni esiningi, ngiyazi ukuthi abashayeli bezindiza bacabanga kanjani. Ukwakha kabusha umngcele endaweni yemvelo akusebenzi ezingeni eli-geo-political.

esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu sesaziso saloluhlobo, lowo ophikisayo noma umnikazi angase afake isicelo kumhloli kamasipalati acele izizathu zalesi sinqumo. umhloli kamasipalati kufanele esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokuthola isicelo saloluhlobo, anikeze izizathu ngokuzibhala phansi emva kokukhokhwa kwemali enqunyiwe. b kuthinteke umnikazi wempahla ngaleso sinqumo; noma c kuthinteke umkhandlu kamasipalati mayelana nesinqumo salolu hlobo. b umnikazi wempahla yaloluhlobo kufanele atshelwe esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu emva kosuku lapho isaziso esibhaliwe nokukhuljunywa ngaso esigabeni- 47 1 saposelwa kumnikazi noma uma umnikazi ecele izizathu ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 47 2 esikhathini esiyizinsuku eziyishumi nane emva kosuku okwaposelwa ngalo izizathu kumnikazi; noma c umkhandlu kamasipalati oqondene naloku kufanele waziswe esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu emva kosuku okwathathwa ngalo isinqumo. ukudluliselwa kodaba ngokulandisa kwalesi sigaba akumeluleli isikhathi lowo okufanele akhokhe intela yendawo size sedlule usuku olunqunyiwe. ungqongqoshe wesifunda wohulumeni basekhaya kufanele, ashicilele isaziso kusomqulu kahulumeni wesifunda, asungule imikhandlu eminingi yokwedluliselwa kodaba esifundazweni njengaloku kudingekile, kodwa hhayi engaphansi kowodwa kulowo nalowo masipalati wesifunda kanye nakulowo nalowo masipalati wedolobha elikhulu.

Lezi zikhathi zibalulekile, ngoba zenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yethu. Luhlanganisa izimo eziningi, izinselelo, nezikhathi zokujabula. Uhambo lwansuku zonke lwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho, nakuba uhambo lwansuku zonke lungase lube nzima, luyithuba lokukhula, lokufunda, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi impilo iyinhle, futhi uhambo lwansuku zonke luyingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu.

Inhloso yalolu hlelo ngukuhlinzeka ngokusekelwa ngemuva kokuhlaliswa kwabazuzayo kuzinguquko zomhlaba kanye nabanye abakhiqizi abazitholele umhlaba ngezindlela zangasese futhi, isibonelo, abaneqhaza kumabhizinisi enza ukubaluleka ngaphakathi ezweni nangaphandle. Izabelozimali zokungezelela kuzifundazwe zokwenza ngcono futhi zikhuphule izinsizo zokusekelwa kwabalimi ngaphakathi kohlaka lwe-CASP. Luyini uHlelo Oluncane Lezezimali Zezolimo LweNingizimu Afrika? Ngokulandela isaziso sikaMongameli uThabo Mbeki, sokusungula kabusha uHlelo Lokukweledisa Lwezolimo kuMnyango Wezolimo, i-MAFISA yasungulwa njengohlelo oluncane lwezimali zohwebo lwezolimo ukwenzela abantu abaswele abakhuthele kwezomnotho. I-MAFISA izovumela ukufinyeleleka kuzinsizo zezezimali ngezikhungo zezezimali ezisendaweni ngokwamaziko anzinze endaweni yasekhaya ngokwendlela engabizi neqhubekayo. Ukufinyeleleka okukhulu kuzikoledu ezincane zezolimo kanye nakuzinsizo zokonga. Izimalimboleko okuqondwe ngazo amaqembu ukuzisa kubalimi ngabanye abakumaqembu. Izikhungo zokonga nokufaka imali ebhange kuzikhungo ezamukelwe. Abalimi abancane abasafufusa abangabanini bomhlaba. Uguquko lomhlaba kanye nabazuzayo kwezolimo. Abalimi abasemhlabeni ohlanganyelwe ngesikhathi soguquko lokusuka ekulimeleni ukuziphiliza ukuya ekubeni ngabalimi abasafufusa. Yokufakwayo ukuze kukhiqizwe (umanyolo, imbewu, izibulalazinambuzane), njll. Ukuthengwa kwamathuluzi okulima kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa amahalavu, izimfologo, ogandaganda, imishini, njll.

Isithombe 1: I-header ejikayo emaphakathi ikhombisa inani elikhulu lokufakwa kwamanzi okwenzeka ekugcineni lapho amanzi ehla khona. Khumbula ukuthi ingaphandle kwe-header ihamba ibanga elide ngaphambi kokufika lapho iqala khona, ngakho amanzi amaningi aphonswa ekugcineni kwezimpondo. I-sprinkler yokuqala eyayikwazi ukuhamba yona ngokwayo yatholwa ngo-1948 futhi yafakwa iphethini ngo-1952 nguFrank Zybach e-Eastern Colorado e-United States of America. Lokhu kwaba isisekelo semishini yamanje enama-header ajikayo nalawo ahamba ngokuqonda. Zingafaka amanzi ngendlela elawulwayo. Zisebenza ngamandla azo ngaphandle kokudinga abantu abaningi ukuze zisebenze. Zifaka amanzi ezindaweni ezinkulu ngendlela efanele. Zingafaka amanzi ngendlela eshibhile futhi zingafaka umanyolo ohlangene namanzi ukuze izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi zikwazi ukulinywa. I-header ejikayo inama-frames namapayipi axhaswe njalo ngemitha engama-50 nge-frame ehamba ezinyaweni ezimbili. Lokhu kuqinisa i-header endaweni eqinile ngoba zonke ezinye izingxenye ezihambayo zixhunywe kule header. I-header ikakhulu yakhiwe ngophahla olukhulu oluhambisa amanzi, i-frame exhasa le pipe, kanye nemishini ehambisa konke. Ubude be-span abudingi ukuba bufane ngoba kuzodingeka bube bufushane noma bube bukhulu kuye ngesisekelo sebhakabhaka noma isimo somhlabathi. Le pipe encane enama-sprinklers iqinisiwe ngama-cables athuthukayo ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze wandise indawo efakwe amanzi. Ama-sprinklers asebenza kahle kakhulu angabekwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufakwa kahle kwamanzi ngisho nasezindaweni ezikhaleni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula imitha engama-1,000 ubude.

Umnini noma inhlangano ebhekele ukulungiswa kwendiza uyothula uhlelo lokulungisa indiza kuKhomishani ukuze alwemukele. Umnini wendiza engacela uKhomishani aguqule okwesikhashana noma ngokugcwele uhlelo oluvele selwemukelwe. Ukukhuluma kweMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe kwenzeka njalo ngoFebhuwari, lapho uMongameli ethula khona inkulumo kubantu njengomholi wezwe. Yini inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe? Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyinkulumo ethulwayo nguMongameli weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kubantu ngesikhathi sokuvulwa kwePhalamende minyaka yonke. Le nkulumo ithulwe kwiHholo Elihlangene lePhalamende - okuyiNdlu Yezwe (eyaziwa kakhulu njenge-NA) kanye neNdlu Yezifunda (efushane njenge-NCOP). Igxile ezithuthukisweni zezombusazwe nezomnotho. Le mhlangano ibizwa nguMongameli futhi iphostelwa nguMsizi weNdlu Yezwe kanye noSihlalo we-NCOP. Lezi yizikhathi ezithile lapho zonke izigaba ezintathu zohulumeni zihlangana endaweni eyodwa ngasikhathi sinye: lapha sithola i-Executive, emelelwa nguMongameli, uMongameli Osenyukwini, kanye noNgqongqoshe; iJaji, emelelwa nguMphakathi Oholayo kanye noJaji; kanye neLegislature, emelelwa ngamalungu ePhalamende (afushane njenge-MPs). Amalungu omphakathi nawo amelelwa enkulumweni yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ukuze abambe iqhaza kulomcimbi obalulekile odlala indima ekwakheni isizwe. Kungani inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ibalulekile? Kule nkulumo, uMongameli ugcizelela impumelelo nezinkinga ezibhekene ne-nyanga edlule futhi uchaza indlela ezolandela ngonyaka lowo.

Izinguquko Zomthetho: Ukubuyekezwa Izinguquko zomthetho ziwumgogodla wokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Njengoba izwe lethu lihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi umthetho ulandele izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uhambisane nezimo zamanje, izidingo zabantu, kanye nezimfuno zomnotho. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzobheka izinguquko ezithile zomthetho, izizathu ezikhona, kanye nemiphumela ethile ezithinta umphakathi. Isizathu Sokuguqulwa Kwezomthetho Izinguquko zomthetho zidingeka ngenxa yokushintsha kwezimo zomphakathi. Njengoba abantu bephila ezimweni ezihlukahlukene, izidingo zabo ziyaqhubeka zishintsha. Isibonelo, izinguquko emthethweni wezokuphepha, ezokuhlala, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komnotho zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izakhamuzi zithola amalungelo azo. Ukungahambisani phakathi kwemithetho esesikhathini eside nezinselelo ezikhona kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bengavikelekile, okungaholela ekuphuleni kwemithetho. Izinguquko Eziyinhloko Okwamanje, izinguquko eziningi zomthetho ziqhakambisa izici ezibalulekile ezifana nokuvikelwa kwamalungelo abantu, ukulwa nobandlululo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho. Umthetho wezokuhlala, ngokwesibonelo, ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezithengekayo, ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ophathelene nokulwa nobandlululo ube nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselelwa kwemithetho yokuvikela amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu.

Ikhophi yeSikhumbuzo seSikhungo itholakala kubakhiqizi boMnyango noma uMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Yini inhloso yeSikhumbuzo seSikhungo? ISikhumbuzo seSikhungo sichaza izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi bezihlahla kanye nabanye abasebenzi bezihlahla, kuhlanganise nezinto ezifana nezinsuku zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane yokusebenza, kanye nokupheliswa kokusebenza. Iphinde ichaze nemiholo encane okufanele ikhokhwe ngabaphathi. Bonke abahlwanyela izihlahla; abaqashi bezikhathi ezithile; abaqashi abachitha isikhathi esiningi emsebenzini wezihlahla; bonke abahamba embonini yezihlahla; umsebenzi wasekhaya oqashwe endaweni lapho kuhlwanyelwa khona izihlahla; umgibeli oqashwe ehlathini kodwa engaphansi kwenkampani yokuvikela eyimfihlo. Ubani ongengxenye yalezi? Abaphathi abangahlanganisi izigaba zokuhlwanyela; amahlathi omphakathi; amahlathi okugcina imvelo; noma noma ubani oqashwe noma obandakanyeka emsebenzini wezihlahla ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo seSikhungo noma ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esivumelanayo nebhodi labasebenzi njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wezobudlelwano Babasebenzi ka-1995, isibonelo, umthetho ophatha ngaphansi kweBhodi Labashayeli Bezokuthutha kanye nomsebenzi wokusika nokuguqula izihlahla zibe omunye umkhiqizo, ngokuhlanganyela nomkhakha wezinkuni nephepha, nokunye. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nemiholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bakhokhelwe okungenani imiholo efana naleyo echazwe etafuleni elingezansi. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla bathola imiholo efanayo? Bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bathole okungenani imiholo echazwe etafuleni 1.

Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayazi ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwamalungu, ukuze bonke bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo, futhi bazi ukuthi izinsiza zikhona. Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa akuhlosile ukuveza umehluko phakathi kwamalungu, kodwa kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma amalungu ezwa ukuthi ahlukaniswe, kungaholela ekudumazekeni nasekuphazamisekeni kokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kuhlonipha ubunikazi bawo. Ukwengeza, kufanele kube nezindlela zokuxazulula izingxabano, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe ephephile futhi ehloniphekile. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwamalungu, ukuze bonke bazi ukuthi bangaxhumana kanjani uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS major member classification) kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi uyaziswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Uma sikwazi ukwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukudala umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho wonke amalungu ezwa ukuthi ayingxenye ebalulekile yempumelelo, futhi lokho kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obuqinisa izimpilo zethu sonke.

Umhloli angakwazi ukuhlola isimo noma impahla, angathatha amasampula aleyonto noma abambe impahla engaba nobufakazi. Yini okumele umqashi aqiniseke ngayo ekuqikeleleni ngokuphepha nesimo esingenabungozi emsebenzini kanjalo nasezimpilweni zabasebenzi? Umqashi kumele agcine imishini nezinsiza ezifanele zokusebenza, nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo okufanele kuqhutshwe ngazo umsebenzi zisesimweni esingeke siphazamise impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imishini nezinto zokuphepha, umqashi makaqale ngokugudlula noma asuse ingozi engaba nomthelela omubi empilweni nasekuphepheni kwabasebenzi. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi usengasebenzisa impahla nezinsiza zokuvikela ezisetshenziswa ngabasebenzi. Umqashi unesibopho sokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokuvikela impilo nokuphepha ezingozini ezingadalwa wukukhiqiza, ukuqhuba umsebenzi, ukusebenzisa, ukuphatha, ukulondoloza noma ukuthwala impahla noma izinto. Ngamanye amazwi, noma yini isisebenzi esingahlangabezana nayo. Ukunikela ngolwazi olubalulekile, izifundo, uqeqesho nokusingatha abasebenzi kube kuqashelwe izinga labo lobungoti emsebenzini. Ngamanye amagama, lokho okufanele bakwenza nokungafanele. Akungavunyelwa muntu ukuqhubeke nomsebenzi ngaphambi kokuthatha zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha ezifanele akuthathwe izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ongaphansi komqashi ulandela uMthetho akuphoqelelwe indlela efanele yokugwema izingozi ngentshisekelo yokulandela umgomo wokuphepha nempilo enhle. Ukuqaphela ukuthi umsebenzi nomshini usetshenziswa ngumuntu ngaphansi kweso lalowo oqeqeshelwe lomsebenzi noma umshini ukuze aqonde kahle ngobungozi obuphathelene nomsebenzi noma lowomshini. Isisebenzi leso kumele siqikelele ukuthi imizamo yokunqanda iyalandelwa futhi iyagcinwa.

Khumbula, impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Lesi sifo sikhonjwa yisifo esibizwa ngokuthi iSalmonella typhi futhi sitholakala ngokuphuza amanzi, ubisi, noma ukudla okungcolile ngalesi sifo seSalmonella. Kukhona izinhlobo eziyi-107 zalezi zifo. Izimpawu zifaka phakathi inhliziyo encane noma ukulahlekelwa yisifiso sokudla, ukuhamba, noma ukungahambi kahle. Pheka ukudla kwakho. Phosa noma uhlunge amanzi owaphuzayo. Geza izandla zakho. Izindlela zokulungisa ukudla. Ukupheka kahle kubulala iTyphoid; pheka inyama, inhlanzi, nezithelo ngaphambi kokudla. Ukuhlanza kuvimba iTyphoid - geza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokulungisa ukudla. Hlanza izitsha zakho ngensipho namanzi. Geza izithelo nemifino edliwayo ingashisiwe. Ukudla izithelo ezihlanzekile, ezifana namagilebhisi namabanana, kuvikela iTyphoid. Gcina ihlanzekile futhi upheke noma uyigeze. Amathilidi angama-25 wamanzi. Gcina amanzi owaphuzayo ezitsheni ezihlanzekile ezinomlomo omncane noma ezivaliwe. Sebenzisa isitsha esinokubamba sokuphosa. Kungase kube ezandleni zakho ngaphandle kokubona ngaphambi kokudla noma ukudla izingane zakho. Yini indlela efanele yokugeza izandla zakho? Njalo sebenzisa insipho. I-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ibonakala iyisihloko esibalulekile. Siyayibona ikhuluma, icubungula izinkinga zethu, futhi isiza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, ubuchwepheshe bunciphisa isikhathi, futhi buhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphusile. Sekukhona izinhlelo ezithile ezithuthukisayo ezithatha izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, okukhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenze kahle. Ukuphila Kwansuku Zonke: Ubulili Bokuxhumana Ngokuphathelene nezokuxhumana, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona nje ubuchwepheshe obukhuluma, kodwa ubudlelwane, uthando, nezimpendulo zethu. Uthando lwethu lukhona nasemibonweni yethu, okwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile. Cisha ucingo, ubuke umndeni wakho, udlale, futhi uvuselele ubudlelwane obuphila. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi isidingo sokuxhumana sikhona, noma ngabe ubuchwepheshe bunjani. Ekuhlukaniseni Nokuqhubeka Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, okutholakalayo kuwusizo, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona konke okukhona ku-inthanethi okungase kube kuyiqiniso. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sihlale siphapheme, sihlolisise, futhi siqaphele. Ubulungiswa, ukwethembeka, nobuciko bokuxhumana bukhona. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi sihlala sikhula, sifunda, futhi sikha izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Isiphetho: Ukubhekana Nezinguquko Kwakukhona izindlela ezilula zokuxhumana, kodwa namuhla sikhuluma ngezinto eziyinkimbinkimbi, eziphusile, nezikhuthazayo. Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe akukhona nje kuphela ukuxoxa, kodwa kuhilela ukuxhumana okukhulu, ukwakha ubudlelwane, nokuthola izixazululo eziphusile.

Umthetho ubonisa ukuthi abantu banamalungelo athile uma kuziwa ekuthathweni komhlaba, okuhlanganisa amalungelo okuthola izinxephezelo ezifanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bangavuma noma baphikise ukuthathwa komhlaba, futhi baphinde bathole izinxephezelo ezikhona. Izinyathelo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinyathelo zokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngendlela efanele, ezimweni ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izindawo ezithintekayo, ukuxhumana nabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezizathu zokuthathwa komhlaba. Ukuhlola izimo zomhlaba, izinsiza, kanye nemiphakathi ethintekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zenzelwa ngesisekelo esiqinile. Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezivela lapho kuthathwa umhlaba ukuhamba kahle kokuxhumana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezihlukene. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo bahlala bezwa ukuthi abaphathi abavumelani nabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuphikisaneni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavumelana, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezibandakanya izithakazelo zomphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Izinqubomgomo Zokuthathwa Komhlaba Izinhlelo zokuthathwa komhlaba kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezihambisana nezimfuneko zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinqubomgomo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo zokuthathwa komhlaba zenzelwa abantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinxephezelo ezikhona zikhona.

Ifomu lakho lesicelo kumele lingeniswe ngumuntu onegunya weqembu lakho lezombusazwe futhi alingenise ngendlela efanelekile ukuze kube nesifungo noma nesiqiniseko sokuthi leli cala obugwetshelwe lona ngempela belihambelana nezizathu zezombusazwe ngaleso sikhathi, kanti futhi obukwenza ubukwenza ngaphansi komyalo weqembu lakho. Yiba nokucophelela uma ugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo ngoba lawo agcwaliswe ngendlela efanele yiwona kuphela azobhekwa. Kumele kube nomuntu oyedwa esicelweni ngasinye. Yonke imininingwane kumele igcwaliswe ngokufanele ngangokweqiniso, kanti futhi kuhambisane nawo wonke amaphepha alindelekile asekelayo. Iqembu lakho lezombusazwe lingakufakela isicelo; kodwa uma lenza lokho nalo kumele liqinisekise ukuthi ifomu lesicelo ligcwaliswe ngendlela. Kulindelekile ukuba iqembu lakho livume ngaphansi kwesifungo ukuthi leli cala owethweswe lona yicala eliphathelene nezombusazwe. Kuzoqalwa ngokuba zonke izicelo zihlolwe wuMnyango weZobulungisa. Kuzothi emvakwalokho izicelo zidluliselwe eqenjini elibhekisisa lidlulisele okuthiwa phecelezi yi-RG, elimbandakanya amalunga amaqembu ezombusazwe anezihlalo ePhalamende. Leli qembu lizohlolisisa isicelo ngasinye bese lidlulisela umbiko ophelele kuMongameli wezwe ozomnceda ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuthi uyasenqaba noma uyasivuma lesi sicelo sikashwele. Leli qembu lizoqhubeka ngomsebenzi kuze kube ngu-30 kaSepthemba ngo-2008. UMnyango wezobulungisa nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo yiwona ozonikeza izinsiza eziphathelene nomsebenzi wezamahhovisi.

Okwesibili, Isigaba- 229 2 b sivumela umthetho kazwelonke ukuba usingathe loluhlobo lwamandla omasipala. uhulumeni wasekhaya: umthethosivivinyo wokuklanywa kwentela yendawo awuwona umthombo wamandla olandisa ukuba omasipala baklame intela yendawo, kodwa uyithuluzi lokusebenzisa Isigaba- 229 (a) no (b) somthethosisekelo wezwe. Lesi sigaba sichaza indlela efanayo yokusetshenziswa siphinde sisho imikhawulo edingekile emayelana nokudicilela phansi kwemigomo kazwelonke yezomnotho, imizamo yezomnotho emingceleni yomasipala noma ukugudluzwa kwezimpahla nokwenziwa kwemisebenzi. yokweseka uhulumeni wasekhaya osimeme ngokubhekela umthombo wezomnotho osimeme eyindaweni ezisingethwe yimikhandlu yomasipalati ukwelekelela omasipala ekwenabiseni isizinda sabo sentela ngaphandle kwemingcele yomasipala baphambilini kanye nokubhekela imithetho yesikhashana yokufaka intela yendawo kulezi zindawo; kanye nokubhekela imithetho kazwelonke efanayo mayelana nokuhlola nokudluliswa kwezindaba, inqubomgomo yokuklanywa kwentela yendawo kanye nokuhlelwa kwentela yendawo. Isahluko 2 somthethosivivinywa sikhuluma ngokuklanywa kwamazinga entela yendawo. Sigcizelela amandla omasipalati ngokomthethosisekelo okuklama intela yendawo ezindaweni zabo, kodwa ukuvimbela ukuklanywa kabili kwentela yendawo ezindaweni zomasipala ezingeni lesifunda, sinikeza amandla komasipala bendawo. Nokhoke umthethosivivinywa uyabavumela omasipala ezingeni lesifunda ukuba baklame intela yendawo ezifundeni zabo. Akuvumelekile ukuklanywa kwentela yendawo okungenasisekelo.

Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuphila ziye zashintsha, futhi lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emkhakheni wezimali, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinhlelweni zempesheni. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni, ikakhulukazi ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bezempilo nabanye abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Le nqubo ibalulekile, kodwa ibuye ibangele izingxoxo eziningi phakathi kwabathintekayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kuhilela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu uthola izinzuzo ezifanele ezivela kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudinga ukuba kube nokwethembeka emalini ethunyelwa kumalungu e-GEMS. Uma kungekho ukuqinisekiswa, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuphatha, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali noma ekutholeni izinzuzo ezingalungile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi bezempilo bangatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye baphikisa ukuthi le nqubo iyabambezela abantu. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kudinga isikhathi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlale belindile ukuze bathole izinzuzo zabo. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ikakhulukazi kubantu abahamba phambili empilweni, abadinga ukuxhaswa ngezinsiza ezithile. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi izinqubo zokuqinisekisa kufanele zibe lula futhi zisheshiswe ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela izidingo zabantu.
