Sisekude kakhulu ukuyeka ukusebenzisa abasebenzi abayitoho eMnyangweni wethu. Ziseningi izikhungo ezisaqhubeka nokuqasha abasebenzi abayitoho ukuqinisa izibhedlela nezinye izingxenye zoMnyango. Sihlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke lokhu kuphele ngokushesha nokuthi bonke labo basebenzi baqashwe ngokugcwele wuMnyango. Siyaqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikhala ezisemqoka zizogcwaliswa ngenyanga kaJuni futhi sesiphakathi nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kuyenzeka. UMongameli wezwe enkulumeni yakhe wathi "ngizokwenza izinto ngendlela engajwayelekile" futhi sihlela ukwenza noma yini esemandleni ukufezekisa leli phupho - noma ngabe akujwayelekile kangakanani. Sihlalo oHloniphekile, sibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu ngokushona kwezingane. Imibiko esinayo ikhombisa ukuthi lesi simo siyanyuka kunoma sehle, sikhathazeke kakhulu ngezinhlelo ezihamba kancane ezibhekiswe komama nokuyibona abathinteka kakhulu ngokushiywa izingane. Ngenxa yalokhu sizoqasha uMphathi ozoseluleka aphinde asize ezinhlelweni zomama. Phakathi kwemisebenzi azobhekana nayo ukuqhamuka namasu azosiza ukungeneli kwezinsiza zokuhlela imindeni futhi ezizokwazi ukwemukelwa nayintsha, ikakhulukazi njengoba ubudlelwane bentsha nabasebenzi kungakabi seqopheleni elivuna izinhlelo zethu ukuthi zibe impumelelo. Ngizophinde futhi ngenze isibonelo ngezinga lokukhulelwa kwentsha okukhathaza kakhulu futhi ngenxa yalokho sidinga ukukhuphula izinga lezinhlelo zethu esinazo ukuze kunciphe ukukhulelwa kwentsha, ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezehlukene sethemba ukuthi kungaguqula indlela yokuziphatha, ngaleyondlela bese kushintsha lesisimo.

Ngokubamba iqhaza kokuvota, abantu bakha umbono omkhulu, begcina ubumbano phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Izingozi Zokunganaki Uma abantu bengavoti, bazibeka engozini. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi abangafanele baphumelele, okungaholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zingagcini kahle. Ukunganaki kokuvota kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba abaholi abangahambisani nezidingo zabantu bangathatha izinqumo ezingavumelani nezifiso zamasiko, ezomnotho, nezokuphila. Ukwenqatshwa Kwezinqumo Ukwenqatshwa kwezinto ezithinta imiphakathi kuncike ekubeni abantu baphatheka kahle empilweni yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni izinqumo ezizokwandisa ukuphila kwabantu. Ukuvota kuhilela ukwaziwa komphakathi, nokuhlola izinqumo ezithinta izidingo zabo. Uma abantu benza izinqumo ezithile, banqanda ukwenqatshwa kwezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kubavumela ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa labo. Izifundo Zokubamba Iqhaza Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nakho kunemfundo ebalulekile. Amaphoyisa, izikhungo zemfundo, nezokuxhumana zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi ukubamba iqhaza kwabo kubalulekile. Umphakathi kufanele uthole izifundo ezivumela abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izinqubo zokuvota, izinqumo ezithathwayo, kanye nendlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baziqhenye ngempela ngezinsiza zokuvota, okubasiza ukuba bakhulume ngezinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo. Isiphetho Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kudinga ukuqhubeka nokwenziwa. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke uqwashisa abantu ng importance yokuziqhenya, nendlela yokuvota ngendlela efanele. Ngokuziqhenya, abantu bangakha umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo.

Ukuze sithathe izinyathelo eziphathekayo, kufanele sithathele phezulu ukufundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngezindlela zokuvikelwa kwemithombo yamanzi, ukuvuselela imithombo engcolile, nokugwema uhlelo lwezokuthutha olubi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokunqoba ezimweni ezinzima ezibhekene nezinsiza zomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulula kakhulu ukuhlola ukuvikelwa kwempilo yamanzi. Izindlela ezithile ezifana nezithuthi eziphumelelayo zifanele zisetshenziswe ukuphatha izinzuzo zamakhaya. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho abantu beqondiswa kahle, imiphakathi ithola amathuba okuphila akhula, futhi amanzi ahlanzekile avikela abantu ezinhlekeleleni eziningi. Ukukhulisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinsiza, ukwabelana ngezinsiza, nokwakha ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukile, kudinga ukhethe; lesi simo kufakazela ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kokuphila kwethu nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ekugcineni, amanzi ahlanzekile anikeza ithuba lokwenza kahle. Imiphakathi edinga amanzi ahlanzekile, kufanele iqaphele ukuthi onke amalungu kufanele athathe isinyathelo sokuphila kahle. Iphuzu elisemqoka ukuthi lowo msebenzi awuphathwa yihhovisi lempilo kuphela, kodwa wonke umuntu unendima okumele iyigcine, futhi kumele kuxhaswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ahlinzekwa, avikelwe, futhi anqandwa ekungcolisweni. Njengoba besiphila ezimweni ezinzima, kudinga ukuba sibe nezindlela eziphumelela, siziphe izinsiza ukuze sibe nempilo enempilo, sigcine futhi sakhe umhlaba onempilo, onezinga eliphezulu lempilo kuzo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo.

Amaqembu ezombusazwe ammelwe eSishayamthetho sikaZwelonke noma esiFundazweni esithintekayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye anelungelo lokwenza iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe neziqondene nodaba, inqobo uma zethulwe ngesikhathi esinqunywe emiyalelweni ebekwe emtheshwaneni -4. b ukubiza zonke izinhlangothi zamaqembu ezombusazwe anentshisekelo kwiSishayamthetho sikaZwelonke noma esiFundazweni esithintekayo abafisa ukwenza njalo ukwethula iziphakamiso zabo ezibhaliwe ngoba zibalulekile ekunqumeni udaba ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esinqunywe kule miyalelo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isicelo esenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba -801 no -1221 soMthethosisekelo emalungeni Omkhandlu kaZwelonke noma isiShayamthetho sesiFundazwe siyokhishwa ngesaziso senhloso yokuthatha isinyathelo siphelezelwa wumbiko ofungelwe ngezizathu eziyisisekelo zalokho ummangali afuna ukuncika kukho ngesikhathi sokulalelwa kodaba, lesi sicelo siyothulwa kuNobhala futhi sinikwe uSomlomo Womkhandlu kaZwelonke, uma kudingekile noSihlalo woMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe noma uSomlomo wesiShayamthetho esithintekayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isaziso siyocela uSomlomo, uma kufanele uSihlalo Womkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe azise ngokubhaliwe wonke amaqembu ezombusazwe ammelwe ngesicelo endlini efanele noma esishayamthetho zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu ethole leso sicelo. Isicelo esiphawulwe emtheshwaneni -1 siyophelezelwa yisitifiketi esikhishwe nguSomlomo weSishayamthetho esichaza ukuthi isigaba -802a noma isigaba- 1222a soMthethosisekelo senelisiwe, kuye ngesimo ngasinye.

b zibuyiselwe noma zehliselwe inani lemali ekhokhwayo ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 14; bese c kufakwe inani lentela yendawo ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 18. uhla kufanele luvuleleke ekuhlolweni ngumphakathi ngezikhathi zomsebenzi. umasipalati kufanele abuyekeze uhla okungenani minyaka yonke. inani lentela yendawo eliklanywe ngumasipalati empahleni/endaweni kufanele likhokhwe ngumnikazi waleyondawo ngokulandela isahluko - 9 somthetho wezinhla zomasipalati. izindawo ezinobunikazi obuhlanganyelwe ngaphandle kwalezo ezisohlelweni lapho abanikazi bakhe khona ngokuhlanganyela egcekeni elilodwa lapho behlanganyela khona bonke ekukhokheni inani elilodwa lentela yendawo elidingekayo. intela yendawo eklanywe ngumasipalati endaweni ngayinye lapho abanikazi bakhe khona ngokuhlanganyela egcekeni elilodwa, ikhokhwa ngumnikazi ngamunye. umasipalati angeze abuyisa izindleko zentela yendawo, nanoma iyiphi ingxenye yayo, esigungwini esisingethe indawo lapho kwakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela. isigungu esisingethe indawo lapho abanikazi bakhe khona ngokuhlanganyela singeze sacaza futhi siqoqe intela yendawo kubanikazi bezindawo. a ngesamba esisodwa unyaka nonyaka noma ngezikhawu ezilinganayo noma ngamanani ahlukene; noma b ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile okungavunyelwana ngazo phakathi komnikazi wendawo nomasipalati. a uma inani lentela yendawo likhokhelwa ngesamba esisodwa unyaka nonyaka, kufanele likhokhwe ngaphambi kosuku oluqokwe yilowo masipalati b uma likhokheka ngezikhawu kufanele likhokhwe ngaphambi kosuku lwaleso naleso sikhathi esiqokwe yilowo masipalati.

Ngicela/ngijuba/ngigunyaza ukuba ukhokhe umhlomulo wami, uma siphumelela isicelo kule-akhawunti elandelayo yebhange. Ngiyaqonda ukuthi ukwedlulisa imali okugunyazwe lapha kwenziwa ngohlelo lwekhompuyutha olwaziwa nge-ACB, futhi ngiyaqonda ukuthi ayikho imininingwane yenkokhelo eyonikwa ibhange lami kodwa imininingwane yenkokhelo ngayinye iyobhalwa ephepheni lesitatimende sami sasebhange. (lokhu akusebenzi lapho ibhange ingavamile ukukhipha imibiko noma izitatimende zasebhange, isibonelo i-akhawunti yokonga noma uhlobo olufuzile). Leli gunya lingamiswa yimina ngokufaka isaziso esibhaliwe sezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Qaphela: Ubufakazi obubhaliwe be-akhawunti yebhange (isibonelo, isitatimende sasebhange, iphepha eliphuma emshinini wemali, isheke elidwetshiwe) kufanele bufakwe. Igama lomnikazi we-akhawunti... Ngiyaqinisa ukuthi ulwazi oludalulwe ngenhla luyilo njengamanje futhi luphelele ngayo yonke indlela nokuthi uKhomishani woMshuwalense wokungaSebenzi awuzibophezeli ekukhokheni okungesikho okungaqubuka ngenxa yemininingwane engaphelele noma engaqondile ethulwe yimina. Ulwazi lwethulwe : (Igama lesisebenzi saseBhange)...

Ukuhambisana nobuchwepheshe obuqhubekayo, uphiko lezoKuzithengisa loMnyango Wezolimo, Ezamahlathi Nezezinhlanzi (i-DAFF) lwethula iDatha Yezinsizo Ezingahlekekile Zokwesekela (i-USSD) ngonyaka odlule ngoSephtemba. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukwelekela abalimi kanye nanoma ngabe ngubani ongenako ukufinyeleleka ku-ithanethi ukuba athole ulwazi ngemakethe. Ngaphambilini uHlelo Lolwazi Lwemakethe Yezolimo (i-AMIS) olutholakala ku-inthanethi labe lungukuphela komthombo wolwazi ngemakethe olutholwa ngabalimi abanokufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Manje, ulwazi olusetshenziswayo olutholwa ngabalimi kuphela ku-inthanethi lutholakala ku-inthanethi ngeselula. Ngalolu sizo, ngisho abalimi abasezindaweni zasemakhaya abangenakufinyeleleka ku-inthanethi ukuze bathole ulwazi ngokuthi imikhiqizo yabo ibiza kanjani ngokuhambelana nokubiza okufana nalokhu ezimakethe. Ngemikhiqizo eyi-157 yokutshalwayo kanye nokubiza kwenyama ezimakethe eziyi-16, abalimi banendathane yamathuba okukhetha kuwo uma bebeka ukubiza kwezimpahla zabo. "Lolu sizo luhlomisa abalimi ukuba benze izinqumo ezifanele zokuthengisa ngaphambu kokuba baye emakethe futhi aliphoqi ukuba babe sendaweni ethile nomalidinge ukuba babe nokufinyeleleka ku-ithanethi" kusho uBilly Morokolo ongumqondisi wophiko lokuzithengisa, ekhuthaza abalimi ukuba basebenzise usizo lwabo. Uqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukuba bangaqedwa umoya izindleko ezibizwayo ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi lufanele nanoma iliphi isenti elikhokhwayo. Lo lusizo lubiza amasenti angama-60 ngomzuzu, futhi kuthatha ngaphansi komzuzu ukuhlinzekwa ngolwazi oluzwakalayo.

Nakuba isiNgisi sihlinzekela ukufinyelela emathubeni omsebenzi nemfundo, ngakolunye uhlangothi luyisikhubekiso ebantwini abangenalo ikhono laso. Nakuba isiNgisi sibonakala njengokhiye ekunyakaziseni ezomnotho nenhlalonhle futhi sithathelwa phezulu, sikhomba ubungozi ekusetshenzisweni nasekugcinweni kwezilimi zendabuko nokwenza umbhidlango wenqubomgomo yokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezehlukene ube yimpumelelo. Ubuchule besiNgisi abandile ngendlela elindelwe kanti ukuvumbuka kweqeqebana longcweti baso yinto enokwenzeka. Ucwaningo lukazwelonke lokuhlola ukusetshenziswa kolimi emphakathini olwaqokwa yiPanSALB ngonyaka ka 2000 lukhombisa ukuthi abantu abangaphezulu kwamaphesenti angu 40 eNingizimu Afrika abasiqondisisi kahle isiNgisi. Lolu cwaningo lwaphinde lwathola ukuthi abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika abenelisiwe yindlela izilimi zabo ezisetshenziswa ngayo emkhakheni kahulumeni. Ucwaningo lwathola nokuthi iningi lomphakathi libona kungafinyeleleki kuHulumeni, uma kukhulunywa ngolimi. Ngaphezulu kwentuthuko yezilimi zoMdabu, kuyobaluleka ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni. Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi lisombulula lolu daba ngokuhlongoza ukusungula izakhiwo ezithile nokuqagula amacebo okuxazulula lesi simo. Ukuzwelana nesimo sokuthi umsebenzi wokuqhuba Inqubomgomo uyodinga ukugudluka kancane emisebenzini evamile, kuyosetshenziswa iqhinga elivumela uguquko nokungenisa ngezikhawu inqubomgomo. a nakuba iyishumi iminyango eyokleliswa phambili ukuze kusungulwe amathimba olimi, yonke iminyango kahulumeni kufanele isungule amathimba olimi.

Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela izindawo ezisemthethweni. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kusemqoka kakhulu, futhi kudinga izixazululo ezithile ezithathwa yiziphathimandla. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abanikazi bezindawo, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni bazohlala bephila impilo enezinkinga eziningi, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Ukubambisana nokuhlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni kuzoba yisixazululo esikhulu ekunciphiseni le nkinga.

Imali yokufunda, izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nezindleko zokuphila zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abafundi badinge ukusebenza ngenkathi befunda, okungase kube nomthelela ekutheni bakwazi ukugxila ezifundweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka kuyizinkinga ezivamile phakathi kwabafundi. Ukuphila emanyuvesi kudinga ukuzivocavoca, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nokuphila phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bazizwe bedangele noma bephazamisekile, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ekufundeni kwabo. Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi badinga izinsiza ezihlinzekwa emanyuvesi, ezifana nezikhungo zokwelashwa kwengqondo, izifundo zokuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa. Izinto Eziwusizo Nezixazululo Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi basemanyuvesi badinga ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zemfundo zihlala zinikeza izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, ezihlanganisa izifundo ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banethuba lokuthola usizo lapho kudingeka khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Abafundi basemanyuvesi baphinde babe nethuba lokuthola ulwazi olungaphezulu ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzithandela, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kobuholi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono amasha, bathuthukise ubuholi, futhi bakhe izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwabo nabanye.

Amatekisi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinsiza Zokuhamba Emphakathini Amatekisi, njengendlela yokuhamba, adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhamba emiphakathini ehlukene. Le ndatshana izobheka izici ezahlukene zamatekisi, kuhlanganise nomlando wabo, izinzuzo, izinkinga, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinsiza ukuze zibe usizo olukhulu emphakathini. Umlando Wamatekisi Umlando wamatekisi uqala ezikhathini zasendulo, lapho abantu behamba ngezinyawo noma ngezilwane. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubekela phambili, kwavela izindlela zokuhamba ezithuthukisiwe, okuhlanganisa amatekisi. Emazweni amaningi, amatekisi aqala njengemoto ezithengiswa ngabantu ngabanye, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zinsiza zaba yizinkampani ezinkulu ezihlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo nolulula. E-South Africa, amatekisi aqala ukuvela ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho abantu abaningi behamba besuka emakhaya baye emadolobheni ukuze bafune amathuba emisebenzi. Izinzuzo Zamatekisi Amatekisi anikeza izinzuzo eziningi kubasebenzisi bawo. Okokuqala, ahlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo, olungabizi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezindlela zokuhamba ezinkulu, njengezitimela noma izindiza. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho ukuhamba ngezinyawo noma ngezimoto zomphakathi kungathatha isikhathi eside. Okwesibili, amatekisi avumela abantu ukuba bahambe ngezikhathi ezihlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zabo zansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebenza ezikhungweni ezahlukene abadinga ukufika emsebenzini ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amatekisi anika abantu ithuba lokuhweba emiphakathini.

Kodwa, uNomvete usanda kubuyela eNingizimu Afrikha ukuze azodlalela i-Orlando Pirates. Umnyango ungaqinisekisa ukuthi ukususa izitshalo ezingadingekile eduze nedamu laseFranschoek libe yisimo lapho wonke umuntu ewina khona. Ukubalwa kwamashifu angenakho ukufa emva kokuba kuqale izingozi ezibulalayo kwishifu emva nje kwaleyo shifu edale ukufa. Kunenzuzo enkulu ukwehlukanisa phakathi kokusakaza kwabazimele nabancike kuhulumeni. Njenganoma yimuphi umnotho kunokwehla nokwenyuka emnothweni wethu. Amaphoyisa aphenya amacala okugqekeza, ukuba nezimpahla okucatshangwa ukuba zintshontshiwe nesibhamu esingenalayisense kanye nokuntshontsha izimoto. Amathuba okusetshenziswa ngezindlela eziningi kwesikhumulo adinga ukuphenywa nokuphuculwa. Amaphoyisa asevule idokodo lokuphenya okuqhubekayo. Uhlelo lokuhlela kabusha isimo sezulu nokulimala ngenxa yemithi ebulala izimila ezingathandeki eTala Valley. Ukulungiswa kokuqedwa kwezikhali, ukuhlukaniswa kwemibuthano nokudidiyela kabusha kwalabo ababebuthwe ezweni elinempi ngamaqembu ahlomile kuyaqhubeka. Njengomuntu onguMkhalathi izikole zethu nazo zaziphazanyiswa yiziteleka. Uyacelwa ukuba uphendule obhalile ukuze alungise izindaba zokudla nokuhlala. Kumele siqinise ubumbaxaningi sisuke ezintweni ezihlomulisa umuntu ngamunye. Ilungu lePhalamende elingaphansi kwe-ANC eGeorge, uBruce Kannemeyer, wamema ongqongqoshe emva kwezikhalazo ngesidakamizwa i-"Tik" ezikoleni. Cha, wayengahlala kanjani u-Oupa Seheri endlini yami? Jabulela ibhulakufesi elimnandi kwibhalkhoni ngesikhathi ubuka amadolfini ebhukuda edlula.

Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde lezi zinkinga ukuze kusebenze ekwakheni izixazululo. Njengoba izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhula, ziba yinkinga enkulu kwezempilo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izifo ezinjengokukhuluphala, umoya, nesifo sikashukela zikhula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile, ngenxa yezinto eziningi ezifana nezindlela zokuphila, ukudla okungafanele, kanye nezinga lokungasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, siqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukudla okunempilo, futhi sithuthukise imikhuba yokuzivocavoca. Nokho, akusikho konke okubi; izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Abantu abaningi baye bathola ukuthi uma bephila kahle, bahlala bejabulile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona. Ekugcineni, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhombisa ukuthi impilo yethu ayilula, futhi zidinga ukusekelwa okuqinile. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda lezi zinkinga ukuze sikwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi. Asithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi. Izifo ezingamahlalakhona zingaba yinkinga enkulu, kodwa uma sikhuthaza impilo enempilo, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, okuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.

Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kanjani emlandweni wezokugijima? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt ubaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezokugijima ngoba waguqula indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngale midlalwano. Waba isibonelo sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuphumelela. Ubuye waba yisithonjana sokukhuthaza abanye abantwana, ikakhulukazi eJamaica, ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. Uthandwa kakhulu, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yezimpumelelo zakhe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuzithoba kwakhe nendlela ahlangana ngayo nabalandeli. Umbuzo: Yini eyamkhuthaza uUsain Bolt ukuba aqhubeke? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt uthi ukusebenzela umndeni wakhe kanye nezwe lakhe kube yinto eyamkhuthaza kakhulu. Uqonda ukuthi impumelelo yakhe ibaluleke kakhulu, hhayi kuphela kuye, kodwa nakubantu abaninzi abamlandelayo. Ubuye akhuthaze abanye ukuba basebenzise amathuba abawatholayo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ngekhono, ukusebenza kanzima, kanye nokuzinikela, umuntu angafinyelela noma yiziphi izinjongo. Umbuzo: UUsain Bolt ubhekana kanjani nezinselelo? Impendulo: Njengomgibeli ophumelelayo, uUsain Bolt ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukulwela ukuhlala uphumelelayo emqhudelwaneni, ukugwema ukulimala, nokuphatha ingcindezi yokuba ngumgibeli ophumelele, konke kwaba yizinto ezinzima. Nokho, uBolt uthembisa ukuthi umsebenzi onzima, ukuzikhandla, kanye nokubambisana nabanye kuhlale kumphumelela. Ubuye waba nomoya ophakeme, okwenza akwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo: Yini uUsain Bolt ayisebenzisela umphakathi? Impendulo: UUsain Bolt usebenzisa impumelelo yakhe ukuze asize umphakathi.

Ulwazi lomuntu siqu lungadluliselwa kumikhakha yamazwe omhlaba ngabe-GCIS noma kubantu besithathu ngezinhloso ezingenhla. Lokhu ngeke kwabandakanya ukudluliseka kumazwe angenayo imitheshwana yolawulo lokuvikelwa kolwazi efana naleyo ekhona kuzwe okuhlala kulo umsebenzisi. Ngokunikeza ulwazi kwabe-GCIS ngale website, umsebenzisi uvumela ukudluliselwa kwalolo lwazi. Lapho kufanele khona, ulwazi lomuntu siqu lungadalulwa kwabomthetho, kwabezinqubo zolawulo, noma kwimikhakha kahulumeni, noma abesithathu lapho kufanele khona, noma kuyinto efanele ukulandela imithetho, noma izibopho zenqubo yolawulo, noma ngezinhloso ezibekwe ngenhla. Uma kunikezwe ngolwazi lomuntu siqu kule website, abasebenzisi abafisa ukubuyekeza ulazi lwabo ziqu bangenza lokho ngesicelo sokucela ukubuyekeza ngokusebenzisa i-feedback link. Ngemuva kwalokho, abasebenzisi bazokwazi ukufinyelela ama-profile abasebenzisi, ukuqondisa lolo lwazi kanye nokufakela imininingwane yabo yakamuva noma ukukhipha amagama kuhla noma kunini. Abasebenzisi abanenkinga yokuthola ama-profile abo, noma abafuna ukucela ikhophi yolwazi lwabo ziqu, kumele baxhumane no-web administrator ngokusebenzisa i-feedback link. Kuzo zonke izimo, abe-GCIS bazobhekana nezicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi, noma ukushintsha ulwazi ngokulandela izidingo zomthetho ezisebenza kulesi sigaba. Akukho okutholakala lapha ngaphakathi, okubanga noma okunenhloso yokubanga ikontraki noma isivumelwano phakathi kwabe-GCIS kanye nomsebenzisi ovakashela i-website. Abe-GCIS bamukela ukubaluleka kokuvikela imfihlo yangasese yezingane ekuxhumaneni ngokwe-online kuwo wonke umhlaba.

Imikhakha yezimoto mayelana nezinhlobo zokusebenza eziboniswe kusheduli A. UKULALELA Loku kubonakala uma umfundi ekwazi: Umfundi uzokwazi ukulalela ukuze atholeulwazi nokuzijabulisa aphendule ngendlela Ukulalela ngokucophelela , imiyalo nezimemezeloefanele nangokuhlolisisa ezimweni aphendule ngendlela efanele.ezahlukehlukene. Ukukhombisa indlela efanele yokulalela ngaphandle kokungena omunye emlonyeni, akhombise inhlonipho kulowo okhulumayo, alinde ithuba lakhe lokukhuluma, abuze nemibuzo lapho edinga khona incazelo. Ukulalela ngenhloso yokuthola umongo nemininingwane esemqoka endabeni. Ukulingisa izingxenye ezithile zendaba, ingoma noma umgqumo. Ukubamba iqhaza uma kuhutshwa. Ukudweba isithombe ngendaba abhale amagama ayingcosana ngaso. Ukuhlela izithombe ngokulandelana kwezehlakalo eziqhathanisa nezihloko. Ukuphendula imibuzo evulekile ngendaba. Ukuveza imizwa ngendaba. Ukuxoxa ngokulandelana kwemiqondo endabeni. Ukulalela ngokucophelela isikhathi eside Ukulalela ngokuqaphelisisa andise isikhathi ngezinga elithuthukile lesikhathi sokulalela sokulalela bese elandela imiyalo eminingi alandele imiyalo eminingi elandelanayo elandelanayo efanele izinga lakhe.

U-SAPS wenza isivumelwano NOWENKONTILEKA ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuke sivumelwano, kanti noWENKONTILEKA uyavuma ukunikeza usizo lwakhe ngqo kuSAPS ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuleSIVUMELWANO, e (emveni kwalokhu ebizwa ngokuthi EMSEBENZINI): Inqobo nje uma OWENKONTILEKA engatshelwa ngu SAPS ukuthi makaye kosebenzela u-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma isiphi isigceme esiyisakhiwo sikaSAPS esingekho EMSEBENZINI, kube okwesikhashana. OWENKONTILEKA, ngenxa yale SIVUMELWANO , akufanele noma abe eseba nethemba lokulindela ukuthi sizovuselelwa le SIVUMELWANO, noma nje aqashwa kunoma yisiphi isikhundla njengomqashwa kwa-SAPS. Kuyavunyelwana phakathi kwamaQEMBU, ukuthi OWENKONTILEKA isivumelwano asenziwe naye njengomqashwa ngokwale SIVUMELWANO futhi le SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kunobuhlobo bokuqashana obukhona phakathi koweNKONTILEKA no SAPS. OWENKONTILEKA kufanele, ngaphandle kwemigomo yesigaba 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo yeziGaba 5 no 9 ngezansi, anikezele u-ASPS izinsizakalo ngesikhathi ezidinga nangokwemibandela ebekwe ngu-SAPS, esikhathini esikaliwe esi , kusukela osukwini lokuqala kwale SIVUMELWANO bheka isigaba 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene noWENKONTILEKA izohlanganisa nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa ngezandla eyingxenye, futhi eqondene nemisebenzi yoWENKONTILEKA.

Yena nomsizi wezomthetho bazocubungula izincwadi oziphethe bese bekusiza ukubhala isamanisi elilula. Uyobhala isamanisi akunikeze lona. Yini okufanele uyenze ngesamanisi? Ungalihambisa wena uqobo isamanisi kummangalelwa. Isamanisi ungalinikeza nenkokhelo yokulihambisa ephoyiseni lesi-funda (u-Sheriff) lapho ummangalelwa ehlala khona, ukuze iphoyisa lilihambise kummangalelwa. Yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo? Lapho uyewasetshenzelwa khona ngu sherrif, kufanele uthole isiq-inisekiso sokuthi ukwenzile lokho ngaphambi kosuku lokuqulwa kwecala. Gcina incwadi yesivumelwano noma iyiphi incwadi eyisiqinisekiso semibandela yesibizo osenzayo. Yazisa ofakazi bakho ngosuku nesikhathi sokuqulwa kwe-cala uhlele nokuthi babe khona enkantolo ngaleso sikhathi esibekiwe. Angase abambisane ngokwenelisa izimfuno sika mmangali. Angathumela isitatimende esibhaliwe kunobhala wenkantolo, esiqukethe imininingwane nemibandela yokuzivikela kwakhe, abese ethumela ikhophi kummangali. Angafaka esakhe izimfuno esimelene naleso ngokuletha isitatimende esiqukethe iminingwane edingekayo yesamanisi mabhalane wenkantolo. Uma kuvela isikhalo sika shwele noma izimfuno esimelene, icala kusafanele liqhubeke nokuqulwa. Yini okufanele uyenze uma ummangalelwa esenelisile izimfuno sakho? Wazise umabhalane wenkantolo masinyane ukuthi izimfuno sakho sesanelisiwe nokuthi ngeke usaqhubeka necala. Yini okufanele uyenze ngosuku nesikhathi sokuqulwa kwecala? Kufanele uze enkantolo qobo lwakho. Indlela yokuqulwa kwecala ingekhululekile futhi elula. Ukhomishani wenkantolo uzokucela ukuba wethule udaba lwakho.

Kukhona izibaya ezenziwe ngesinyithi esigcwele ezisuka ku-10 kuya ku-30 tons. Uma kungekho mali eningi, izibaya ezincane (10 tons) zingasetshenziswa ekuqaleni, bese lokhu kungakhuliswa njengohlelo lwezibaya ezizokwenziwa njengoba ukulima kuqhubeka. Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona: Ukuhlola Umthelela Wazo Empilweni Yethu Izifo ezingamahlalakhona, ezaziwa nangokuthi izifo ezihlala isikhathi eside, zibe yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni wonke. Lezi zifo, ezifana nesifo sikashukela, umoya, nezinto eziningi ezihlobene, zihlala zikhona empilweni yomuntu futhi zishiya umthelela omkhulu emzimbeni nasempilweni yengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zifo zidinga ukwelashwa okuqhubekayo, futhi zishintsha indlela esiphila ngayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi izifo ezingamahlalakhona azithinti kuphela umguli, kodwa ziba nomthelela emndenini nasemphakathini. Umuntu onezifo ezingamahlalakhona ubhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukwelashwa okungapheli, izindleko eziphezulu zokwelashwa, kanye nezinguquko ezinjengokuphila kwansuku zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukusekelwa okuqinile, hhayi kuphela kumndeni, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Umndeni udinga ukufunda ukuhamba nomguli, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle nokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhombisa ukuthi impilo yethu iyinselele. Umuntu ophila nesifo sikashukela, isibonelo, udinga ukulawula ukudla kwakhe, ahlale eqapha amazinga akhe kashukela, futhi aqaphele impilo yakhe yonke. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu, futhi kungaholela ekudambiseni umoya uma umguli engatholi ukwesekwa okwanele. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde lezi zinkinga ukuze kusebenze ekwakheni izixazululo. Njengoba izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhula, ziba yinkinga enkulu kwezempilo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izifo ezinjengokukhuluphala, umoya, nesifo sikashukela zikhula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile, ngenxa yezinto eziningi ezifana nezindlela zokuphila, ukudla okungafanele, kanye nezinga lokungasebenzi.

Isinyathelo sesithupha: ukubikwa nokubekwa kabushangemisebenziUma sithatha ngokuthi isilinganiso sokuphathwa kokwenziwakwemisebenzi sesikhona, uMasipala kuyomele aphendule ngokuthisisebenze kanjani uma siqhathaniswa nezikhalo ezibekiwe. Lokhukuyomele akwenze ngezakhiwo zokubika okuvunyelwene ngazonezinqubo zokubika imibiko ebuyayo kanye nokucebisangokusamele kwenziwe. Hayi ukuthi umkhandlu kuyomeleuziphendulele wona nezakhiwo zawo zangaphakathi kuphela, kuyomele futhi ulethe umbiko ngemisebenzi emphakathini. Kufanele inqandane nohlu lokubaluleka, izinjongo, izinkomba kanye nemigomo equkethwe I-IDP. Ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi uzumbandakanye ekwakhiweni nasekwethulweni nasekubhekweni kabusha ukuphathwa kokwenziwa kwemisebenzi kamasipala nasekubekweni kwezinkomba zemisebenzi nemigomo yemisebenzi kamasipala. Ukunquma ngenqubo yePMS. Ukukhetha abantu abayizohambisa lenqubo, beluse ukwakhiwa nokwethulwa kanye nenqubo yokuphatha. Imenenja kamasipala Isibopho nje sonke sokuphathwa nokuhlanganisa ukuthi bonke abaneqhaza bambandakanyele nokuthi inqubo ihamba njongoba kuhleliwe. Ukucwaningisisa izikalo zomsebenzi. Imiphakathi njenga bantu abaneqhaza elibalulekile, ibhekweukuthi idlale indima ebonakalayo ekwakheni iPMS kamasipala. Imiphakathi iyabandanyeka ekwakhiweni kwePMS kamasipala. Ngokushushumbisa ukukhonjwa okubalulekile kuqala, ukukhethwa kwezenkomba nokubekwa kwemigomo. Nokufuna ukuthi umkhandlu unikeze amathuba okusho ngomsebenzi wekomidi lokucwaninga ngokusebenza. Yini okumelwe kubikwe ngayo, kubani futhi nini. Kuzohlolwa futhi kubhekwe kanjani kabusha ngomsebenziokubikwe ngawo.

Unobhala wenkantolo ekhiphe isinqumo sokungahambisani kwesenzo nomthethosisekelo njengoba kuhlonzwe esigabeni -172 soMthethosisekelo uyothula kuNobhala weNkantolo ikhophi yaleso sinqumo zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu -15 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwaleso sinqumo. Umuntu noma umnyango kahulumeni onelungelo nofisa ukwedlulisa isikhalo sokuphikisa leso sinqumo ungafaka isicelo sokwedlulisa udaba kuNobhala kanye nekhophi idluliselwe kuNobhala wenkantolo eyenze isinqumo ngokuhambisana nemibandela yesigaba- 1722d soMthethosisekelo, emuva kwalokho udaba luyophethwa ngokulandela imiyalelo enqunywe nguMphathimaJaji kodwa isicelo kufanele senziwe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu -15 inkantolo ithathe leso sinqumo. Esazisweni sokwedlulisa isikhalo, ummangali uyobeka ngokucacile izizathu zesikhalo, akhombise amaqiniso noma umthetho okuphikiswa ngawo isinqumo noma okufanele ngabe ulandelwe noma ubhekelwe ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo. Umuntu noma umnyango kahulumeni onelungelo noma onesifiso sokufaka isicelo sesiqiniseko sesinqumo ngokulandisa kwesigaba -1722d soMthethosisekelo uyofaka isicelo sokuthola isiqiniseko kuNobhala edlulisele ikhophi kuNobhala wenkantolo eyenze leso sinqumo, emuva kwalokho udaba luyophethwa ngokulandela imiyalelo enqunywe nguMphathimaJaji kodwa isicelo kufanele senziwe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu- 15 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwaleso sinqumo.

Izindleko zokukhiqiza ummbila zishintsha zibe ngu-R4,200 nge-hectare, kanti intengo yemakethe ngaleso sikhathi bekuyi-R3,000 nge-ton. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umlimi evuna i-ton eyodwa nge-hectare, ulahlekelwa (udliwa) ngu-R1,200 nge-hectare. Uma ungumthosi, uzothenga ufulawa bese unquma ukuthi uzothengisela malini imikhiqizo yakho ephekiwe. Uma umthengi engavumi ukukhokha lelo nani, uzokwehlisa intengo yefulawa kanye nokupheka kuze kube intengo yefulawa yehlile. Kodwa uma umlimi ethatha izinyathelo zokuqala zokutshala ukudla, abakwazi ukwehlisa ngaphakathi emsebenzini wabo bese belinda intengo inyuke - sebebhekene nezindleko manje kufanele baqhubeke nokuvuna nokuthengisa leyo mvuno. Abakhiqizi bethu bayinsiza enkulu kithi - basebenza kanzima, bathatha amathuba ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokudla nemisebenzi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi singathenga kuphela ngaphandle uma lezo zizwe zinezakhamizi eziningi zokudla, futhi uma izwe lethu linemali yokuthenga lokho. Uma izimo zezinye izizwe zibi, zizogcina ukudla kwazo, ngakho sizophumelela ukukwazi ukuthenga ngaphandle. Futhi uma intengo yokushintshisana ibangela ukuthi inani le-rand lehle, izwe lethu ngeke likwazi ukuthenga ukudla futhi abantu bazohlupheka, lokhu sibona ezindaweni eziningi e-Afrika. Ngaphambi kokubeka icala kulezo zizwe ngokukhokha izintengo eziphezulu, masibheke le ndaba ukuze sithole ukuthi yini imbangela yokwenyuka kwentengo. Uma singasekeli abakhiqizi bethu ukuze baqhubeke nokutshala ukudla ngokwenzuzo, ngisho lapha abantu bazohlupheka ngendlala.

Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana (GEMS doctor authorization and communication) Isingeniso Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ibalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zokugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. Umbiko lo uzogxila ekuchazeni lezi zinqubo, izinselelo ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bathola usizo olufanele. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo zikhokhelwa yi-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo zokwelashwa, ezivame ukuhlinzekwa odokotela abaqeqeshiwe. Ukuze umtholampilo uthole ukugunyazwa, kudingeka ukuthi udokotela ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile, efana nezizathu zokwelashwa, izivivinyo ezidingekayo, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nalokho. Izinsizakalo ezidinga ukugunyazwa zifaka phakathi, kodwa azikhawulelwe kulokhu: ukuhlinzwa, izivivinyo ezithile, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi odokotela baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa, ukuze bazi ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwabo nabathengi. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nodokotela kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo.

Uma isicelo singafakiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekwe noma singaqhubeki nezimali zokubhaliswa ezibekwe; noma uma isicelo siphikisana nenhloso yalomthetho. Ubufakazi bokulandela uhlelo olufanele lokuhlanganiswa kwamandla ngaleso sikhathi; kanye neminye imininingwane evela kuNgqongqoshe njengoba kuchaziwe. UNgqongqoshe kumele achaze izidingo ezizolandelwa abafaki-sicelo ngaphambi kokuba umphakathi ucabangele isicelo selayisense. Uma ilayisense iceliwe kumphakathi, kufanele icela umfaki-sicelo ukuthi azise isicelo ephephandabeni elifanele noma ezinkundleni ezihlobene nendawo yokusebenza ngolimi oluphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezimbili. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke umfaki-sicelo ngazo zonke izixhaso ukuze avumele umfaki-sicelo ukuthi aphendule kulokhu; futhi angafaka eminye imininingwane njengoba kudingeka ukuze umphakathi ucabangele isicelo ngendlela efanele. Ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka; ukuhweba nokuthumela ugesi; noma ukuhweba. Umphakathi akufanele uphoqelelwe ukuthi usebenzise ilayisense futhi kufanele inikeze kuphela ilayisense eyodwa yesicelo esisodwa semisebenzi echazwe esigabeni 3. Isikhathi sokusebenza kumele sihlanganise ukusebenza; nokunye okukhulunywe. Umphakathi ungase, njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense ezibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, avimbe umnikazi welayisense ekwenzeni noma uphoqele umnikazi welayisense ukuba enze noma yisiphi isinyathelo esichazwe kulayisense. Umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukukhokha noma iyiphi imali kumakhasimende futhi abeke izimo ezivela ezivumelwaneni ezilawulwa noma ezibekwe umphakathi njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense.

Alikho ilungu lombutho we-South African Police elalinelungelo lokwephula umthetho. Kukholakala ukuthi izinhlangano ezihleliwe zihlasela izitolo ezithile enxanxatheleni yezitolo beyokweba izimpahla. Ukusebenza ngokuxhumana kwezinhlaka ezintathu zikahulumeni, nokuxoxisana nezinhlangano ezisebenzisana nohulumeni ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa ukukhula kwezokuvakasha. Noma ngubani oya endlini yokuyohlolwa, ngingambona lowo muntu. Ukuhlinzeka ukucubungula kulokho okuzoshicilelwa, izikhangiso njll kwenzelwe uNgqongqoshe kanye noMnyango. Ucwaningo seluveze ukuthi ukufunda ngolimi lwebele kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa ukuba nemibono kwabafundi basezikoleni zamabanga aphansi. Siyaphinda sigcizelela ababambiqhaza e-Zimbabwe baqhubeke ukufuna izixazululo ezinoxolo kanye nezifaka konke. Lapho ukukala okuqondile komthamo kwemali ekhishiwe kuyenziwa, umthamo ozokhokhwa uyohlonzwa kulokho kukala okuqondile. Lokho wukuphendulwa kwendlela yokuziphatha kwethu nokwenza amadluladlulane ohlelweni lwethu. Ngike ngakusho lokho kuwe Mbhishobhi, ukuthi kumele ubheke mina kuphela. Kancane kancane ilanga liyaphuma phezu kwezwe lethu liletha ithemba, ukuhleka nenjabulo. Namuhla, emva kweminyaka engamashumi amathathu sinezinhlanzi ezincane olwandle, umoya ongcolile ogcwaliswa emkhathini, ukunganakwa, ukuguguleka kwenhlabathi nokuncipha kwezinhlobo ezithile zezilwane. NgangiwuMqondisi ongenamandla okuthatha izinqumo, uMnu Beukes wayenekhono elanele lokuphatha inkampani ngayekwenza, kanti angicabanganga ukuthi kunesidingo sokuba uzikhathaze. Nakuba kunemiphumela emibi emva kokugoma, ivamise ukuba ibe lula futhi isheshe iphele.

Naphezu kwemiphumela emibi, abanye bakholelwa ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke nendlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bethu bokuthuthukisa amandla kumele buhlonishwe. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma kahle ngalezi zinguquko; kubalulekile ukuthi sifeze izixazululo ezintsha. Ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obuhlukeneyo nokwenza izinqubomgomo ezicacile ezikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zikusize ekugcineni imvelo kahle, kubalulekile. Ukuze siphumelele, lezi zinguquko zidinga ukusiza ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlanzekile, ezazisa umnotho nemvelo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izifundiswa, nohulumeni kuyadingeka ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizinzile. Uma sithola umthelela omubi wezimo, izindawo ezivulekile zidinga ukuhlela umkhakha wezolimo, umnyango wezokwakha, kanye nemithombo yokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza ukusebenzisa imithombo yezezimali futhi kudinga ubuchwepheshe bokubika kahle. Umhlaba udinga ukuzwa izidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kudinga isimilo esithile. Kulezi zimo, abantu badinga ukuqonda isimo sezulu esingaphezulu kwazulu. Izenzo ezifanele zingaveza umphumela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izindlela ezizinzile zokuphila. Ukuzama ukunciphisa ukuncika kwezinto ezilimazayo kumele kube yinjongo eyinhloko. Kukhona abahlola izifundo ezikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinzima lapho izimo zezimali zixhumene kakhulu nezinguquko ezidalwa yizimo zezulu. Lokhu kuveza umxholo omubi, okungekho emthethweni. Ngakho-ke, umbono wethu kumele ube umphakathi ophilayo, osebenzayo, futhi ohlakaniphile. Umphakathi kumele uzame ukufunda ngezinto ezithinta isimo sezulu futhi senze izinqumo eziqinile.

Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Kwakukhona edolobheni elincane elibizwa ngeNhlangano, elalikhula ngokushesha. UThandi, umphakathi ophakathi kwezinsuku zakhe zokusebenza, wayengumuntu onothando olukhulu lomhlaba. Wavuka ekuseni, elungiselela ukuphuma ngokushesha ukuze ajabulele umoya opholile. Ngeshumi nambili, uThandi wathola ukuthi umhlaba wabo uzuziwe ukuthi uzothathwa nguhulumeni ukuze kwakhiwe indawo yokuhlala. Lesi sikhathi sasilokhu sihamba phambili, kanti izimpikiswano zomthetho zazingaphansi kokuqonda. UThandi noMnumzane Zungu, umphakathi wakhe, babebhiyoza ngokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kodwa-ke, lapho beqala ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zinhlelo ezimfishane ezivela kuhulumeni, baqala ukungabaza. "Kanjani umhlaba wethu, owatholakala kumzali wethu, ungathathwa ngaphandle kokuvuma?" kusho uThandi, ebheke kuMnumzane Zungu. UZungu, ehlakaniphile, wamxwayisa, “Thandi, kufanele sazi ukuthi umthetho uvumela uhulumeni ukuthatha umhlaba uma kunesidingo sokwakha izinsiza zomphakathi.” Kodwa uThandi wayengakakwazi ukuvuma lokhu. Wabheka emuva, ekhumbula izinsuku lapho abazali bakhe bejabulela umhlaba wabo. Wayazi kahle ukuthi umhlaba awuwona nje umhlaba; uyisikhumbuzo, uyinqaba yesiko, futhi uyimfihlo yokuphila. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wanquma ukuthi akasoze avume ukuthathelwa umhlaba wakhe ngaphandle kokulwa. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nomphakathi, ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinkinga. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umhlangano waphothulwa, kwavela abantu abaningi, bonke befuna ukwazi ukuthi yini engakwenziwa. Umphakathi wawuzizwa ungajabule.

Irrigation - kuyini lokhu? Umhlaba wonke unenkinga ngamanzi ngoba inani labantu liqhubeka likhula, kodwa amanzi atholakalayo awakhuli. Imephu elandelayo ikhombisa izindawo lapho kukhona amanzi emhlabeni. Kunabantu abaningi emhlabeni abangakwazi ukufinyelela kokudla namanzi ahlanzekile, njalonjalo. Ukukhiqiza ukudla/izitshalo ngamanzi agcinwe ezindaweni lapho ukuna kwemvula kuncane noma akuzinzile. Ukusebenzisa amanzi agcinwe endaweni ethile kubalulekile. Ukunciphisa ingozi yokufa kwezitshalo ezitshalwe futhi kuvuselela ukuqhubeka kokukhiqizwa kokudla ezweni. Ukwandisa umkhiqizo ngaphezulu kwehektare. Ukukhiqiza ukudla phakathi nezikhathi ezomile nezimanzi. Ukukhiqiza ukudla kabili ngonyaka. Ukusebenzisa imali etholakale ebhizinisini ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlinzeka ngemakethe ekhula ngokwakha ukudla okwanele. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye nemikhiqizo. Ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemaphandleni. Ukukhiqiza izinhlobo ezikhethiwe zezithako ezindaweni ezomile (lapho imvula ingafiki ngezikhathi ezingafanele ezingenza umkhiqizo ube sengozini). Kunezindawo eziningi ezishisayo nezomile lapha eNingizimu Afrika, lapho kukhona ukwehla kwamanzi kakhulu futhi akuhlali kuthola imvula. Kulokhu, kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ejwayelekile ngaphandle kokungenisa amanzi endaweni ethile. Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngaphandle kokufaka amanzi kubizwa ngokuthi: ukuncika emvuleni kuphela, noma ukukhiqiza ezindaweni ezomile. Isimo sezulu esihlala sishisayo nesishisayo sikhuthaza ukukhula kwezithako ezithile, futhi eziningi zikhula kahle uma kukhona amanzi anele okokufaka.

Lamaphuzu ehlukahlukene athinta umnotho ngezindlela ezehlukahlukene futhi uzwelo lwawo kumuntu ngomuntu alufani. Njengoba izinguquko zizoya ngokwanda nje, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuzokuba yinto ekufanele sizinikele kuyo safuthi. Lezizinto ezintathu ke ziyabonakala nasezinguqukweni ezenzekayo ngasohlangothini lwezemfundo kuzona zonke izigaba. Imithetho elawula ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokusungulwa kwezinhlaka ezifana neSAQA okungumnyango ophethe izinga lokuqeqeshwa namakhono kuyakhombisa ukuthi kunesidingo esingakanani sokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kwethu namakhono kube sezingeni eliphezulu. Kufanele futhi sikwemukele ukuthi imfundo nokuqeqeshwa akupheleli esikoleni kimbe esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme kodwa yinto ekufanele iqhuneke ngenxa yezinguquko kubuchwepheshe nasesimweni somnotho. Izwe lakithi linabantu abayizigidi ezintathu kuphela abanamakhono aphezulu , kanti ziyisikhombisa ezabantu abasebenza imisebenzi engadingi makhono lokho okubabeka engozini yokuphelelwa umsebenzi. Kubantu abevile kwizigidi ezine abaswele imisebenzi, isigamu sabo abantu abasebancane futhi asebefunde iminyaka engaphezulu kuka 9 esikoleni. Ukuswela kwentsha imisebenzi kusukela ikakhulukazi uhlobo lwemfundo abayitholayo obelunganakho ukuqeqeshwa ngokwamakhono umuntu angawasebenzisa ukuziphilisa nokungamakhono adingakalayo ezindaweni eziningi zokusebenza, kanye nokwesela izeluleko besesikoleni ngemikhakha aabngase bayilandele ukuze baqasheke. Iphesenti elilodwa kuphela labafundi basezikoleni zemfundo ephakeme abanenhlanhla yokufunda ubuchwepheshe kumbe lezokole zabo ziyizikhungo zobuchwepheshe.

Ukhomishani anganikeza noma imuphi umuntu okucashunwe kulejista uma ekhokha imali efanele enqunywe kwiNgxenye 187, aongaveza isizathu esizwakalayo nesanele sokuthi yingani kufanele anikwe lokho okucashuniwe. Ingqikithi yoqeqesho lokuqala lwabasebenzi mayelana nokuphepha kwempahla ethuthwa ngendiza kanye nokuvuselela ezokuphepha kwempahla nokuvuselelwa koqeqesho kuyoqhutshwa ngendlela echazwe yibhukwana lezokuphepha njengoba inqunywe kuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Noma imuphi umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kumthethonkambiso uyophothula izifundo zokuvuselela uqeqesho lwezokuphepha kwempahla ethuthwa ngendiza njalo ezinyangeni ezingamashumi amabili nane, kusukela ephothule ngempumelelo olunye uqeqesho lokuzijwayeza ezokuphepha noma uqeqesho olwandulela lolo, kuyoya ngaleso naleso simo. Noma yiliphi izinga loqeqesho oluvamile lezokuphepha kwempahla ethuthwa ngendiza okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso 1 wale Ngxenye luyoqhutshwa yinhlangano emukelwe ngaphansi kweNgxenye 141. Udaba lwezinga lokuqukethwe wuqeqesho lokuphepha kwempahla ethuthwa ngendiza luyonqunywa nguMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Noma ngubani okukhulunywa ngaye kumthethonkambiso 1 uyophothula izifundo zokuvuselela zokuphepha kwempahla ethwelwe ngendiza ngezikhawu ezimiswe wuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Ngemuva kokuphothula ngempumelelo izifundo zokuqala zoqeqesho lwempahla ethwalwa yizindiza okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso 2, inhlangano eqeqeshayo ethintekayo iyonika umfundi isitifiketi sekhono nolwazi ngezidingo nolwazi lwempahla ethuthwa ngendiza.

c indawo echwebeni elilawulwa ngezokuvikela; kanye d lowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle. e Imisebenzi eyenziwa yilabo ababambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle mayelana noma ngokuhambisana namachweba alawulwa ngezokuvikela. UMqondisi-Jikelele ngokubhaliwe angamemezela futhi ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 2 noma ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 3 elisebenzayo emikhunjini elawulwa kwamanye amazwe. a eseke waxoxisana ne-NICOC; futhi b anelisiwe ukuthi kukulungele yini ukwakhiwa kwezokuvikela ezisezingeni eliphezulu kulelo chweba, mkhumbi, indawo noma umuntu obambe iqhaza ngoba ubungozi buphezulu bokugxambukela okungekho emthethweni kwezokuthutha zasolwandle okungakhonjwa. b uma isimemezelo sichitha ngokubhaliwe uMqondisi-Jikelele. b noma imuphi umsebenzi owenziwe yilowo obambe iqhaza embonini yezasolwandle. Uhlelo lokuvikela lwalowo mkhumbi kungalandelangwa ngaphandle uma izinyathelo okukhulunywa ngazo kulolo hlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle zisetshenziswa. Umyalo wezokuvikela unikezwa mayelana nechweba, umkhumbi, indawo, obambe iqhaza noma umsebenzi, amazinga ezokuvikela akhona kuyaqhubeka nokusetshenziswa. Uma ngabe uMqondisi-jikelele ememezela ukuthi ezokuvikela olwandle izinga elisetshenziswayo lechweba elithile, uMqondisi-Jikelele ngokushesha angazisa... i olawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemincele yechweba lwezokuvikela olwandle ii osebenza ngaphakathi kwemincele yechweba lezokuvikela olwandle.

Ngokuhambisana nesigatshana 2, iBhodi kumele ngaphambi kokubhekela isicelo sokukhishwa, ukuvuselelwa, ukushintshwa noma ukudluliselwa kwelayisense yokusebenza, yenze ukuthi lisakazwe ku Somqulu ka Hulumeni ngendlela ebekiwe, imininingwane yesicelo ngengoba kungabe kubekiwe bese lichoma isaziso ngalesisicelo ebhodini lezaziso emahhovisi alo isikhathi esingangoba sibekiwe. a sokushintsha imininingwane ethile yemoto chazwe kwilayisense yokusebenza; noma b singokwesivumelwano esikhonjwe kusigaba 391. a kumele livumele umuntu, okuthe ngesikhathi esibekiwe, waletha izimiso zokuhlolisisa amafomu omfaki sicelo nezincwajana ezihambisana nawo ehhovisi le Bhodi ekukhokheni imali ebekiwe; bese b lingakwazi, ngokucelwa yilowomuntu, ukuthi limunike izishicilelo zamafomu namabhukwana omfaki sicelo ekukhokheni imali ebekiwe. IBhodi ngokunjalo kumele livumele umfaki sicelo ukuthi ahlolisise, ngaphandle kokhokha, emahhovisi alo, nokwenza izishicilelo ekukhokheni imali ebekiwe, izimiso ezihlaba noma eziphakamisa isicelo sakhe. Isikhathi nokuvuselela ilayisense yokusebenza a Amalayisense okusebenza ezimoto ukuthi zisebenze ngezithuthi ngokwezimo zezivumelwano kumele akhishelwe isikhathi esingadlulile kwesesivumelwano futhi ahambisane nezimo nemigomo yesivumelwano. Ekunqanyulweni kwesivumelwano, ilayisense yokusebenza ehambisana naso kumele ibuyiselwe kwi Bhodi zingakedluli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa.

Izinja, izilwanyana zasekhaya kanye nezinye nje izilwane azivunyelwe ehlathini likaHulumeni, ngaphandle kwamahhashi uma egunyazelwe ukuhamba emigudwini wamahhashi. Ukubhukuda kanye nokudoba kuvunyelwe kuphela kulezondawo ezenzelwe lokho. Ukugoba amadlangala, uma ngabe kuvunyelwe, kungenziwa kuphela kulezondawo ezenzelwe lokho uma ngabe sekukhokhwe imali efanelekile. Ukusuka noma ukuhlala ngenzindiza, izindiza ezinophephela emhlane, ukuntweza emoyeni, izindizamshini, amabhaluni kanye namaphalashuthi akuvunyelwe ehlathini likaHulumeni. Ukusebenzisa noma ukuphatha iziqhumane akuvunyelwe ehlathini likaHulumeni. Alikho icala noma izindleko eziyothweswa uHulumeni ngenxa yokulimala kwempahla yabavakashele ihlathi likaHulumeni kulandela imisebenzi eyenziwa nguHulumeni noma eyenziwa egameni likaHulumeni noma ngenxa yanoma ngabe iyiphi inbangela, ngaphandle uma lokho kulimala kudalwe ubudedengu babasebeni bakaHulumeni lapho benza umsebenzi wabo wangemihlangemihla. Abavakashele ihlathi likaHulumeni bazobhekana nezindleko zomonakalo oyodaleka kwisivuno sehlathi nenye impahla kaHulumeni okungadalwa izenzo zabo. Eminye imibandela, izimali noma amalayisense kungalindeleka kweminye yemicimbi, kwezinye izindawo, nakwezinye izinkathi (bheka isixhumo kanye nezigaba zemicimbi).

Ukuthethelelwa okwenziwe yiqembu akusho ukuthi seliyawahoxisa amalungelo alo ngaphansi kwale SIVUMELWANO, ngakho-ke, lelo qembu angeke libe nesivimbezelo sokusebenzisa amalungelo alo ngenxa yokuthi esikhathini esidlule kade lixolelile noma ngoba kukhona okuqhamukayo. AMAQEMBU akule SIVUMELWANO ayavumelana ukuthi azokwenganyelwa amandla eNkantolo Enkulu yesiFundazwe saseTransvaal, yeNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika (noma iNkantolo Ephakeme leyo okungathi ukuhamba kwesikhathi kube yiyo esinamandla engamele iNkantolo yesifunda ePitoli), maqondana nanoma yisiphi isinyathelo noma ukubophana okungaqhamuka kule SIVUMELWANO. Inqobo nje uma le likheli elingenhla lingashintshwa ngokubhalwe phansi linikezwe leli elinye iqembu, bese liqala ukusebenza emva kwezinsuku eziyishumi sinikeziwe isaziso: Inqobo nje uma ikheli elisha elikhethiwe yiqembu lizobe nalo lingaphansi kwendawo lapho kunokuhanjiswa khona amaphepha. Noma yisiphi isaziso esinikeziwe maqondana nale SIVUMELWANO singahanjiswa ngesandla, noma sithunyelwe ngeposi elikhokhelwe: Inqobo nje uma noma yisiphi isaziso nomaamaphepha ahanjiswe kwiqembu maqondana nanoma yiluphi udaba noma isihloko kule SIVUMELWANO nanoma yisiphi isaziso siyothathwa njengesidlulisiwe uma sinikezwe umuntu omdala ekhelini lomthetho elikhethwe yinoma yiliphi lamaqembu futhi angeke kube nesidingo sokunikeza iqembu ngqo. ngosuku lwesikhombisa kusukela osukwini lokuyiposa, okubala usuku lokuyiposa, uma iposwe ngokurejistiwe; futhi ngosuku ethunyelwe ngalo uma ithunyelwe ngefeksi.

OWENKONTILEKA uyamxolela u-SAPS maqondana nanoma yimuphi umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okudalwe ukulimala emzimbemi, ukulahleka kwempilo, ukulahleka noma ukulimala kwempahla noma ngabe kudalwe ngu SAPS noma omunye umuntu oseceleni noma ngabe udalwe noma kungenxa yobudedengu obube khona ngezikhathi oyilungu lika-SAPS egcina umyalelo, futhi uyamxolela u-SAPS kunoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa, ukulimala, indleko noma inani lokukhokhwa maqondana nokuqhubekayo enkantolo okuqondene NOWENKONTILEKA nokungase kuhambisane nokufunwa imali noma ukuboshwa ngandlela thize. Le SIVUMELWANO sizoqala ukusebenza futhi sibe yisibopho kusukela osukwini esisayinwe ngaso le SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo nje uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO engasisayini kanye kanye AMAQEMBU, usuku lokugcina lokusayina kwelinye lamaqembu luyothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kokusebenza. Le SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisanayo neziGaba 13.2 no 14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, zizoqhubeka isikhathi esithize esilingene (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngezansi), okuyoqala ngosuku okuqala ngalo ukuthi le SIVUMELWANO siqale ukusebenza (bheka isiGaba 12.1 ngezansi). Le SIVUMELWANO singavuselelwa ngokukhetha kwe SAPS ngokuthi kubhalwe phansi ngemvume YOWENKONTILEKA kube okwesikhathi esithize esibekiwe: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS eyokwazi ukuthi esimweni esifana naleso naye anikeze isaziso esibhaliwe kwisiGaba 13.2 ngenhla, singakapheli isikhathi sale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isiGaba 3.1 ngenhla), anikeze OWENKONTILEKA ukuthi ufuna ukusivuselela ISIVUMELWANO.

Abantu bemabhuqa baphila kahle, izifundo zenzeka, imicimbi ihlalisana, izinkanyezi zikhanya esibhakabhakeni. E-Ziyanda, imifula yezenzo, ubuhlobo, noshintsho, izikhungo zikhona ukwazisa lokho okuhle ngendlela yesikhathi esizayo. Kona, lokhu kwaba yincwadi yokwakha, eyachazela ngesimo esisha sokuphila, umuzwa omuhle, okwakukhanya phakathi. Njengoba uZiyanda wandla, abakhi bezokuvakasha baphinda baqondise ukwakheka kwezikhungo ezizoshintsha impilo yazo zonke izizukulwane ezizayo. Ekugcineni, uZiyanda waba isibonelo sobumbano nokwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi, okwakha indlela entsha yokuphila enezinto eziningi ezilungile.

Lezi zinsiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bahlala benempilo, futhi lezi zinsizakalo zikwazisa ukuthi ukubeletha kungenzeka kuphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zihlala zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili obusiza ekwehliseni ubunzima bokubeletha. Ukuphumelela Kwezinsizakalo Izibhedlela eziningi zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuphumelela kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha. Lokhu kuboniswa inani elincane labantu abahlala bephila emva kokubeletha, kanye nenani eliphansi labesifazane abathola izinkinga ezigulayo. Izibhedlela ezinkulu zinamathuba amaningi okwenza izifundo ezithuthukisa izinsizakalo, okuvumela ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokwelapha. Izinselelo Ezinqunyelwe Naphezu kokuphumelela, izinsizakalo zokubeletha zibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuntuleka kwemithombo, ukungabi neziguli ezanele ezibhedlela, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthi abesifazane bathole usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsizakalo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo ukuze zihlale zisebenza kahle. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokubeletha, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubahlinzeki bezinsiza ukuze baqhubeke nokuthola ulwazi olusha. Okwesibili, abesifazane kufanele babe nolwazi olunembile ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Okwesithathu, izibhedlela zingasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokwelapha Ukuze izinsizakalo zokubeletha zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukubambisana nezikhungo ezahlukene zokwelapha.

U-Grade R unyaka wokuqala wesigaba sesisekelo kwimfundo egxila kwimiphumela ezikoleni zeprayimari zikahulumeni. Le mfundo ihlelelwe izingane zeminyaka emine-nohafu ukuya kwiminyaka emihlanu-nohafu ubudala. Abazali kanye nabanakekeli kumele babhalise izingane zabo ezikoleni ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina phakathi kuka-August no-Okthoba, walowo nyaka ngaphambi kokuba izingane ziqale. Yenza isicelo ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina phakathi kuka-August no-Okthoba.. Bhalisa esikoleni esiseduzane nawe. Hambisa isitifikedi sokuzalwa sengane kanye nekhadi lokugonywa. nobufakazi bokuthi wenze isicelo sokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Isicelo sakho singathatha iviki elilodwa ukuya kumaviki ayisithupha ukubonelelwa. Izimali zesikole ziyahlukahluka ngezikole nezikole. Amafomu okumele agcwaliswe atholakala ezikoleni.

Ucwaningo nokucwaninga amabhuku ezimali. Ukukhombisa umdwebo oyisibonelo sezidingo. Ukuthuthukisa nokukhuthaza umkhakha wangasese ukuba uzithathele ithuba lokusiza. Ukuthuthukisa amakhono adingekayo ukuze kuphathwe ngokuyikho ezemidlalo. Intuba yokungena kuleqhubeko ngumsebenzi kahulumeni omusha sha, umphathi, umqeqeshi noma imenenja yezidingo yilelizinga "eliyisisekelo". Ngesikhathi ethola amakhono laba bantu bazogogotha bekhuphuke baze bafinyelele ezingeni "lokwenza kahle hle". Uhulumeni wesikhathi esedlule wayengenalo uhlelo lokuthuthukisa abantu kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Imikhuba yamazwe ngamazwe nayo ikhombisa ukuthi kunesimo esiyisibhicongo ngabantu abazinikelayo emazweni asathuthuka. Okobuchwepheshe, isibonelo ezokwelapha. Usizo olujwayelekile, isibonelo, abashayeli, abaqaphi. Kuyokwethulwa izinhlelo ezithile zokudoba amavolontiya emkhakheni eyahlukene ehlosiwe. Bese kwakhiwa isizinda solwazi esinemininingwane yawo wonke amavolontiya. d Ukwamukelwa kwamavolontiya. Kuyomiswa uhlelo lokubonga amavolontiya, lapho amavolontiya ayobongwa ngezidondo ezikhethekile ngosizo lwawo kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba usebenzise umzimba ukuze uhlale unempilo nokuthi usebenzise leyo mzimba ephilayo namathalente awo ukungenela imiqhudelwano yezemidlalo. ukudoba nokukhuthaza intsha nabadala ukuba babambe iqhaza ekuvocavoceni imizimba ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba usebenzise imizimba ukuze uhlale unempilo. Ukushoshozela labo abangabambe qhaza ukuba nabo babambe iqhaza ekuvocavoceni umzimba.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Abafundi basemanyuvesi baphinde babe nethuba lokuthola ulwazi olungaphezulu ngokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzithandela, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kobuholi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono amasha, bathuthukise ubuholi, futhi bakhe izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwabo nabanye. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Noma bephakathi kwezinselelo eziningi, izifundo abahlangabezana nazo zikhuthaza ukukhula kwabo, kokubili njengabantu kanye nabafundi. Ukuze baphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, baphinde basebenzise amathuba okuthuthukisa amakhono abo. Ngokwenza lokhu, abafundi basemanyuvesi bangaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo, bephakamisa izinga lemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumphakathi wonke.

Ukuhlela, ukwakha noma ukukhomba indawo ekahle laphokuzohlanganyelwa khona futhi lapho umphakathi ungakwaziukufinyelela khona. Ukusiza ngokutolika imibiko kanye nosomqulu. Ukuletha amandla angeziwe nemikhankaso yokwazisaabantu engadingeka ukulungisela imihlangano emikhulu, uma kunesidingo. Ukwakha nokuletha izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokufundisanokwakhana ngokomqondo emakomidini ezigcemengesikhathi asibekelwe sokusebenza. Ligcine imibiko ephelele futhi efanele amaminithiemihlangano, uhla lwezimali zekomidi ezingenayoneziphumayo, impahla ikomidi elinayo, izikweletu kanyenazo zonke izivumelwano zezimali azenziwe ikomidi. Liqiniseke ukuthi zonke izinqalazizinda ezikhona zigcinekekahle futhi zisetshenziswa ngendlela eyiyo. Liqiniseke ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zomthetho eziqondenenamakomidi ziyalandelwa na. Liqiniseke ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwe yikomidi lesigcemezenziwe zibe semthethweni futhi zifakwe ehhovisi likaSomlomo ukuze zethulwe emkhandlwini ngezikhathiezikhishwe uSomlomo. Ukubhala imibiko eqhubekela phambili yempumelelo kanyenokwehluleka, kubekwe izizathu zingakapheli izinyangaezimbili emva kokuphela konyaka wezimali. Ukugcinwa kwamabhuku nekhono lokwenza imibiko. Njengekhansela noma ilungu lekomidi lesigcemekungenzeka ukuthi udinge ukuphatha izimalizenhlangano yakho. Ukugcina amabhuku yindlela yokulandela yonke imali engenayonaleyo ephumayo enhlanganweni. Indlela enhle yokugcinaamabhuku incike ebufakazini - futhi kubalulekile ukugcina wonkeamaphepha ahlangene nemali esetshenzisiwe noma eqoqiwe.

Isingeniso Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, okwaziwa nangokuthi "izindawo zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni," kube yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi. Lezi zindawo, ezakhiwe ngaphandle kwemvume yohulumeni, zihlala zinezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezomthetho, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Umbhalo lo uzogxila ezimbangweni ezikhokelela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni, izimpempe zazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuncishiswe le nkinga. Izimbangela Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Omunye wemibandela eyinhloko eholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni ukuwohloka kwezimo zokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba umnotho uthuthuka, abantu abaningi bahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abampofu ukuthola izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izindlu eziphuthumayo ezindaweni ezingavunyelwe ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kwemithetho eqinile yokwakha ezindaweni ezithile, kanye nokungabi nezimali ezanele zokwakha izindlu ezisemthethweni, kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Ukwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni kuphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo, lapho izindawo ezisemthethweni zihlupheka ngenxa yokuthi zidinga izinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ngenxa yokungakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokuhlala. Izimpempe Zokwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zinezimpempe eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo, ezokuphepha, nezomthetho.

Isahluko 6: Izinkinga Ezihlobene Nokubhaliswa Naphezu kokubaluleka kokubhaliswa, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene nale nqubo. Ezinye iziguli zingase zibe nesithukuthezi sokugcwalisa amafomu, noma zingase zingabi nalwazi olufanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelweni kokwelashwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziguli ezithile zingase zibe nokukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemfihlo yazo, okungaholela ekutheni zingafuni ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqonde lezi zinkinga futhi zisebenze ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Isahluko 7: Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Le nqubo ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zezempilo, futhi inikeza odokotela ithuba lokuhlola isiguli ngempumelelo. Ukuze lokhu kuqhube kahle, izibhedlela kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinqubo ezilungile zokuphatha imininingwane, futhi ziqonde izinkinga ezihlobene nokubhaliswa. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu.

Ukuhlaziywa kokusalela emuva kokwelashwa komdlavuza UThandiwe wayengumfazi ophumelelayo, oneminyaka engama-35, owayebhekene nezinselelo ezinzima zokwelashwa komdlavuza. Ngemuva kokuthola ukuthi unomdlavuza wesifuba, wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe izoshintsha phakade. Waqala ukwelashwa, wathola imishanguzo, futhi waba neziguli eziningi ezazimkhuthaza. Kodwa, ngemuva kokuphumelela ekwelashweni, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwakhe akusabukeki njengokwakunjalo. Ngemuva kokuphuma esibhedlela, wayezizwa engathokozile. Uhlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi, ezazihlanganisa ukungabi namandla, ukucindezeleka, nokungabi nokuqonda kahle ukuthi uzophila kanjani empilweni yakhe entsha. UThandiwe wayefuna ukubuyela empilweni yakhe, kodwa wayezwa sengathi umhlaba wakhe ubhujiswe. Ngesinye isikhathi, uThandiwe wahlangana noNandi, umngani wakhe omdala, owawazi kahle umgwaqo odabukisayo owawuhamba. Ukwandisa Ukubambisana: Ukuhlanganisa izakhamuzi ekuthatheni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphepha komphakathi, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuqinile. Izindlela Zokusebenza 1. Izinhlelo Zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphepha nezindlela zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuthembeka kubalulekile ukuze kube nokwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo kanye nabathengi bazo. Ubuchwepheshe, ngakolunye uhlangothi, buhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza kahle. Ukuhlonipha abathengi, okungukuthi, abathengi bazo kanye nezidingo zabo, kubalulekile ekwakheni izinsizakalo ezizokhuthaza ukwaneliseka. I-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo ezikhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinsizakalo kufanele zihlolwe njalo, ziqhathaniswe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi zihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuhlola kwezimali, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle futhi zisebenza ngokufanele.

Ukufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS (GEMS eligibility and requirements) Ingxoxo noMnu. Zulu, Umeluleki wezeMali Umphakathi: Sawubona, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngokuqonda okufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS. Ungangichazela ukuthi iyini i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyindlela yokwelapha eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi kanye nezihlobo zabo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ungachaza ukuthi ubani ofanele ukujoyina i-GEMS? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ukuze umuntu abe ne-GEMS, kumele abe ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abasebenzi bezikhungo zomphakathi, abaphathi, kanye nabanye abasebenzi abahlinzekwa nguhulumeni. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengeminyango ehlukene, bangakwazi ukujoyina. Umphakathi: Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi i-GEMS igxile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngabe kukhona izidingo ezithile okufanele zifeziwe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujoyina? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kunezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele kube nesivumelwano sokuqashwa esiqhubekayo, okusho ukuthi umsebenzisi kufanele abe ngumsebenzi osebenzayo, hhayi ophumile emsebenzini. Okwesibili, kufanele kube nesivumelwano esibhalwe phansi sokuba ne-GEMS, esivunyelwene phakathi komsebenzi nomqashi. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile okufanele umuntu azithathe ukuze aqinisekise ukufaneleka kwakhe? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, zikhona izinyathelo.

Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha aluhlinzeki kuphela ngokuqeqeshwa kwemikhakha ethile, kodwa futhi luhlinzekela abasebenzi ithuba lokuthola amakhono empilo, okubandakanya ukuxhumana, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezinto ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemvelo yokusebenza ehloniphekayo, enokuthula, futhi enempumelelo. Izinkampani ezithatha lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha zikhombisa ukwethembeka ezinhlelweni zazo zokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Lokhu kudala isimo esihle sokusebenza, okwaholela ekwenzeni kahle emsebenzini. Abasebenzi bazizwa bebalulekile, futhi lokhu kubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze ngaphezulu nangokuzikhandla. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha akukhona nje kuphela ukwandisa amakhono abasebenzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isiko lokuphumelela. Ukwakhiwa kosuku nosuku lokuphumelela nokwenza kahle kuncike ekusebenzisaneni kwababambiqhaza bonke, kusukela kubaphathi kuze kube sekusebenzeni kwabantu abasebenzayo. Iziphumo zezinqubo zokuqeqeshwa zicacile. Izinkampani ezikhipha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuqeqesha zihlala ziphumelela ngezinga eliphezulu, zehlisa izindleko zokuhola, futhi zithola imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophumelelayo lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nezinkampani eziningi ezithumele abasebenzi babo emikhakheni ehlukene ukuze baqhubeke nezifundo zabo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha amakhono amasha, futhi kuwusizo ekwakheni izinkampani ezinamandla. Ukuze izinkampani ziqhubeke zihlala phambili, zidinga ukuqhubeka ziqeqesha abasebenzi bazo, futhi zibheke ukufinyelela emiphumeleni emihle.

Ukusiza uhlelo lokuzinza nokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokubambisana zabafuyi nokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ukuthuthukisa nokugcina ukuphepha kokudla ezingeni likazwelonke nokusiza ukwesekwa kokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yasemakhaya. Ukusiza ekuhloleni izingozi nezimo zokuphahlazeka kwezolimo. Ukukhuthaza ukusungulwa, ukubhaliswa, nokwaziswa kwezinhlelo zokubambisana kwezolimo (Lo msebenzi uzodluliselwa kuMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni). Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zebhizinisi lezolimo ezikhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okufanele nokwabiwa okufanele kwezinsiza nokukhula kwebhizinisi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezinhlelo zomnotho nokunikeza izeluleko mayelana nemikhiqizo yezolimo, izinsiza, nezisebenzi zomkhakha othintekayo. Ukusungula nokuphatha uhlelo lwezibalo lwezomhlaba.

La manzi ayiqhwa azosiza ukugcina ukudla kubanda uma ugesi ungekho. Sengiphetha, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukunamukela kwami nokuhalalisela onobhala ngokuhlela ngempumelelo imihlangano yethu. Ukuzama ukuthola izimali ekade zingekho nokuzama ukweseka uhlelo obese luwa ngokushesha. Ukuzibophezela ekuqhubekiseleni phambili uhlelo lwase-Afrikha ngaphakathi kwi-EU kuyemukeleka kanti kuwukungenelela okwenzeka ngesikhathi, ikakhulukazi njengosizo lokuqinisa izikhungo zase-Afrikha. Ngingathanda ukumema uDkt Adissa ukuba aninike amanqampunqampu ezindaba esizozidingida kuleli sonto elizayo. Manje ngingathanda ukwazi ukuthi uyayifunda yini into ebhaliwe noma ulalele ithephu obuziqophe kuyo. Uma kuba nokulibaziseka, abashayeli bezitimela kanye nabasizi babo bazokwazi ukwenza izimemezelo besebenzisa uhlelo lwasesitimeleni lokukhuluma nomphakathi. Ukulawulwa kwemisebenzi yasogwini kumele kudidiyelwe nezinye izinhlelo zokuphatha kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola intuthuko ikakhulukazi uhlelo lokuhlola intuthuko oludidiyelwe, ukuhlola isimo sendawo kanye nentuthuko. Ngakho-ke sinxusa izinkampani ukuba zeseke izikhungo zethu zobuciko ngohlelo lokuxhasa, amathuluzi kanye nezimali. Zombili ziveze amathuba amaningi ukuba iNingizimu Afrikha ibe yingxenye yezizinda ezihlinzeka izimpahla ezilokhu zikhula, kwasho uNgqongqoshe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwemigomo kanye nemisebenzi yabadayisa emgwaqweni, ikakhulukazi labo abadayisa ukudla okuvuthiwe, kuyingxenye enkulu yokuletha izidingo kubantu kukamasipala waseThekwini.

a lowo obambe iqhaza; kanti b uma lowo obambe iqhaza eqhuba umsebenzi othintwa isimemezelo ngaphakathi kwechweba elilawulwa ngezokuvikela futhi engeyena umsebenzi womkhumbi, kanye nomsebenzi womkhumbi. a UMqondisi-Jikelele azise umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kumthethonkambiso- 22, 23,24 noma- 25 ukuthi kusetshenziswa izinga lezokuvikela olwandle; futhi b UMqondisi-Jikelele echitha leso simemezelo, uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele ngokushesha, azise lowo muntu ngokuchithwa lokho. a umsebenzi wechweba azise omunye umuntu ngokusho komthethonkambiso- 22 2 ukuthi kusebenza izinga lezokuvikela olwandle; futhi b uMqondisi-Jikelele echitha leso simemezelo, umsebenzi wechweba kufanele ngokushesha azise lowo muntu ngokuchithwa lokho. a umsebenzi womkhumbi azise induna yomkhumbi ngokusho komthethonkambiso- 23 2 ukuthi kusebenza izinga lezokuvikela olwandle; bese b uMqondisi-Jikelele echitha isimemezelo leso, umsebenzi womkhumbi kufanele azise induna yomkhumbi ngokuchithwa kwesimemezelo leso ngokushesha. a umsebenzi wechweba ehluleka ukulandela lokho okushiwo umthethonkambiso 2; noma b umsebenzi womkhumbi ehluleka ukulandela lokho okushiwo umthethonkambiso 2 ; noma umsebenzi wechweba noma umsebenzi womkhumbi , noma imuphi othintekayo uyobe esenze icala okuyothi uma elahlwa yicala ahlawuliswe imali noma evalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12.
