Imvume ekhishwe ngaphansi kwalo Mgomo iyosebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika nasemanzini alelizwe. Uma indiza iwelela ngaphakathi komngcele welinye izwe iyodinga imvume yomkhandlu oqondene walelo lizwe. b kwalezo zingxenye okufanele zifakwe kuleyo ndiza. a ushintsho olungamanga noma oluyinkohliso embhalweni okufanele wenziwe, ugcinwe noma usetshenziswe sengathi uhambisana nezidingo ezinqunywe ngaphansi kwale Ngxenye; noma b oyokhiqiza kabusha noma ashintshe ngenhloso yenkohliso noma yimuphi umbhalo noma umbiko ngaphansi kwemibandela yale Ngxenye. c uphephela ngamunye uyoba nencwadi yawo egunyaziwe. Izincwadi zokusebenza kufanele zigcinwe endaweni ephephile ngaphakathi endizeni. Imininingwane yokulungiswa kwayo ngesikhathi iphumile esikhungweni kufanele idluliselwe encwadini yendiza, engakapheli amahora angu 48 libuyile esikhumulweni salo noma ifakwe ebhukwini engakapheli amahora angu 48 liqediwe ukulungiswa noma eminye imishini ibuyiselwe esikhumulweni salo. Zonke izincwadi zendiza ezigcinwe futhi zalondolozwa ngokulandisa komgonyana odlule kufanele ngaso sonke isikhathi zinikwe isiphathimandla esigunyaziwe, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyazelwe ukuzihlola. Indiza ekhandwe ngendlela evumela izihlalo ezingaphezulu kwesishagalombili, ibhanoyi eligunyazelwe isisindo esingaphezulu ko 5 700kg noma ujikamanzi onesisindo esingaphezulu ko 3 175kg lingaqondana nohlelo oluseceleni mayelana nesheduli evunyiwe yokulungisa izindiza, izinsimbi zayo nokulandelela iziwombe zokukhandwa kwendiza. Noma yimuphi umbhalo ofakwe ebhukwini lendiza kufanele uhambisane nezidingo ezimiselwe incwadi yendiza.

UDonald Trump – Umfanekiso Wokuphikisana Nokuhamba Phambili UDonald Trump, igama elidumile emhlabeni, akusikho nje igama lomuntu, kodwa kube yimpikiswano enkulu. Ngonyaka ka-2016, uTrump waba ngumengameli wokuqala waseMelika ongene emsebenzini ngaphandle kokuba neziqu ezinkulu kwezombusazwe. Lokhu kwavusa izwi elikhulu phakathi kwabantu, kwaba nezinkolelo eziphikisanayo ezimayelana nezindlela zakhe zokuphatha. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uTrump ubaluleke kangakanani emlandweni wezombusazwe. UTrump ungumuntu ophikisanayo, onobuntu obuhlukile. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuholi bakhe, kufanele sihlole izici ezithile ezimqoka. Okokuqala, uTrump unokukhanga okukhulu. Ubuye abe nekhono lokukhuluma kahle, okwenza abantu bamthande noma baphikise izinqumo zakhe. UTrump waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umqondo wokuthi uzokwenza izinto zibe ngcono, okwakubukeka kuyiphupho elihle kubantu abaningi. Nokho, uTrump uphinde waba nemiphumela emibi. Izinkulumo zakhe ezivame ukuba nezinsolo zashiya abantu abaningi bephikisana. Ubuye waba nesikhumbuzo esibi sokuhlukumeza abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngama-immigrants. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemiphakathi ehlukene, lapho abanye bebona uTrump njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye bebona yena njengomphikisi wezokuhlalisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uTrump ube neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezomnotho. Wazama ukususa izinqubomgomo eziningi ezazikhona ukuze akhe umnotho ophumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo ezithile ezathokozisa abanye, kodwa zashiya abanye bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.

Ngaphambi kokuba indiza ibuyiselwe endleleni kade likhandwa, kuyolandelwa umgudu ofanele wokulikhanda ngaphambi kokuba liqale emsebenzini. Noma yimuphi umkhiqizo weSigaba 1, II noma III noma ingxenye ethile, akukhathalekile ukuthi intsha noma seyike yasebenza phambilini engenawo umlando noma elandelekayo noma enomlando ongavezi ukuthi igunyazwe ngumkhandlu obhekele izindiza iyothathwa ngokuthi ayilungiseki futhi akufanele ifakwe ohlotsheni lwendiza ekhishele imvume yokundiza esetshenziswa noma ehlose ukusetshenziswa ngaphansi kweNgxenye 96. i indawo, uma kwenzeka igama lesikhungo lapho ikhandwe khona indiza; kanjalo j indawo lapho indiza ilungiswe kuyo ngenxa yokwehluleka kwanoma yimuphi umshini noma umonakalo odalwe wukuhlaliswa phansi ngempoqo noma ngengozi, izizathu zokulungiswa kwendiza. b uma kunamaphepha okuqopha umsebenzi owenziwe noma eminye imibhalo yomlando wokulungisa asetshenziswe ekubhaleni imininingwane yokukhanda, kufanele achazwe ebhukwini lendiza, ephepheni lendiza noma emlandweni wokulundiza ovunywe wuKhomishani. Indlela yokugcwalisa ibhuku lendiza, amaphepha okundiza nomlando wokulungisa indiza okuqondwe wumgonyana 2 nesikhathi esiyohlalwa yile miqulu iyonqunywa wuMqulu SA-CATS-GMR.

Into ebaluleke kakhulu nganoma iyiphi IPHOLISI YOSIZO LOKUNGCWABA/IPHOLISI ENKULU (MASTER POLICY) ukuthi leyo pholisi kufanele ibe ngaphansi kwenkampani yomshuwalense erejistwe isikhathi eside. Lokhu okokuqinisekisa ukuthi ilungu liqinisekisiwe ukuthi liyothola imali yosizo lapho liyicela uma kwenzeka lesi sehlakalo esidinga umshwalense (ukufa). UMNIKAZI WEPHOLISI/ILUNGU kufanele lihlinzekwe NGESITIFIKETI SOBULUNGU. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele silisho silicacise igama lenkampani enikezela ngepholisi; imali ekhokhwayo; izinzuzo ezikhokhwayo; izinqubo zokucela imali nolunye ulwazi olubalulekile ngePHOLISI ENKULU. IPHOLISI ENKULU kufanele ikusho kucace ukuthi abangcwabi noma ababasebenzelayo abaqashiwe yinkampani yepholisi, ngakho-ke akusibo abakhokhela le pholisi. Kubalulekile kubanikazi bepholisi ukuthi bazi ukuthi bangakhetha ukuthatha izinzuzo zepholisi njengenzuzo yomsebenzi wokungcwaba noma ukuthi bathole imali ewukheshe. Isitifiketi kufanele sichaze yonke imininingwane edingekayo kuMnikazi wepholisi/Elungwini njengokuthi nje kuqala nini ukukhokha nokukhokhelwa; yini ekhokhelwayo yini ENGAKHOKHELWA; izikhathi zokulinda njll. Kushiwo umqulu osemthethweni okhishwa yinkampani onemininingwane yezinzuzo, amanani, imithetho nezimo futhi unenombolo yomshuwalense, okufanele ibonakale esitifiketini sobulungu. Umbuthano Wobungane isikhungo sezezimali esakhiwa yiqembu labantu abanezidingo ezithile, abakhipha imali bese beyilondoloza ndawonye ukuze basizane ngezimali ezidingweni ezithile, njengomngcwabo. Inzuzo enkulu i-R5000.

Waqonda ukuthi ezemisebenzi akukhona nje umgudu, kodwa kuwumsebenzi ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu edlala indima yakhe. Ngakho, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi impilo yakhe yayigcwele izifundo, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele, bazi ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza umsebenzi oncomekayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yakhe yokuphila, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle emiphakathini yabo bonke ababephila edolobheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi izifundo zempilo zazingapheli, futhi wayejabule ngokuthi waqhubeka nokukhula, efundisa abanye, futhi ebakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi umsebenzi awupheli, kodwa uhlala uqhubeka, futhi umphakathi uhlala unamathuba amaningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi impilo ayikhathalekile, kodwa ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sithokozise izinselelo zethu, ngoba ziwusizo empilweni yethu. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma sikhuthazekile, singafinyelela phezulu, futhi sithole impumelelo ezemisebenzi.

Uyophinde uvikele amalunga omphakathi asebenzisa umsebenzi wolimi. Umkhandlu Wongcweti beziLimi zaseNingizimu Afrika uyosingatha uqeqesho, ukwemukelwa kongcweti nokubhaliswa kongcweti bezilimi ngomzamo wokukhuphula isithunzi somkhakha wolimi neqophelo lomkhiqizo wolimi. Lokhu kuyokwenziwa ngokumisa amaqophelo athile. Umkhandlu uyobambisana nezinhlelo zoHlaka Lwamaqophelo eMfundo kuZwelonke (NQF) noMkhandlu Wamaqophelo eMfundo eNingizimu Afrika (SAQA). Imigudu yokuqhuba umsebenzi weNqubomgomo yeziLimi iyogqugquzelwa wukuthuthukisa ihlelo lamagama olimi, ukuguqulela kolunye ulimi imibhalo nokulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni eguquliwe, ubuchwepheshe bolimi, inqubo yokuziphatha ngolimi, umqulu oqukethe imisebenzi yolimi, ucwaningo-mabhuku nenhlolovo yolimi, imikhankaso yokuqwashisa ngolimi, Umsebenzi Wokuhumusha Ngocingo eNingizimu Afrika, ingodla yokulondoloza ulwazi, intuthuko yeziLimi zeziMpawu, ukufunda ulimi nesabelo sezimali. Ukusebenza kweNqubomgomo yeziLimi kuyoholela esidingweni esiphezulu sokuguqulela kolunye ulimi imibhalo nokulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni eguquliwe. Ngakho, intuthuko yehlelo lamagama olimi kuyo yonke imikhakha iyoba semqoka kakhulu idinge ukusebenzisana kwabo bonke ababambe iqhaza, amathimba olimi nezigungu zolimi (isibonelo, izakhiwo ezincane zePanSALB ezifana namathimba kazwelonke esayense yezichazimazwi, izigungu zikazwelonke zolimi namakomidi olimi kwizifundazwe).

Izinhloso wukukhuthaza ukushintshisana ngolwazi, ucwaningo nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezisingethe ulimi namathimba anentshisekelo. INLS iyofuna ngamandla ulwazi olufanele neminikelo evela kulabo ababambe iqhaza. Ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ngendlela enamandla kwenqubomgomo kanye nokubuyekeza kudinga imininingwane eqondile ngezimpawu zokusetshenziswa nemikhuba yolimi ngenhloso yokuqagula amandla nobuthakathaka beNqubomgomo nokulandelela inqubekela phambili. Ucwaningo nokuphenya ngolimi kuyokwenziwa ngokusebenzisana kakhulu nezigungu ezifanele zolimi ezifana nePanSALB nezikhungo zokucwaninga kanye nentuthuko. Imiphumela etholwe kulolu cwaningo iyosiza uhulumeni ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinomqondo ngokusebenza kweNqubomgomo yeziLimi. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile maqondana nokuqasha, ukuqhuba Inqubo Yokuziphatha ngoLimi nokunquma izidingo nemibandela yomnyango othile noma isifundazwe. Imikhankaso yokuqwashisa ngolimi ibalulekile ukuze umphakathi ube nentshisekelo ngezindaba ezithinta ulimi. i ukuqinisekisa ukuqondisisa nokwazi kabanzi ngenqubomgomo kuwo onke amazinga. Kuyoba nemikhankaso yokuqwashisa ngolimi ethile eyoqhutshwa ngamathimba ezilimi (kuZwelonke naseziFundazweni), iDAC nePanSALB.

Izinhlelo Zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphepha nezindlela zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziya: Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha ezikhona, ukuhlaziya izigameko ezedlule, nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphepha: Ukusebenzisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, amaphoyisa, kanye nezinye izikhungo zokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. Ukubandakanywa Kwezizinda Zomphakathi Ukubandakanywa kwezizinda zomphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni izinkundla zokuphepha eziphumelelayo. Izakhamuzi kufanele zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthatheni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphepha kwazo. Lokhu kungafaka: 1. Izinhlelo Zokubambisana: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokubambisana phakathi kwezizinda nezakhamuzi ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Ukubamba Imihlangano: Ukuhlela imihlangano evulekile ukuze izakhamuzi ziveze imicabango yazo, izinkinga, nezixazululo. Ukwakha Amathimba Okusebenza: Ukusungula amathimba ahlanganisa izakhamuzi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo zokuphepha ukuze kube nokubambisana okuhle. Izinsiza Zokuxhasa Ukuze le nqubomgomo isebenze kahle, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Izinsiza Zezimali: Ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo zezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphepha. Izinsiza Zokuqeqesha: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezokuphepha, iziphathimandla, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkinga Kubhalwe ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphepha komphakathi.

Uma umkhumbi ungewona okhethiweyo ngokuya ngomthetho welungelo, ofaka isicelo kumele agcwalise ifomu lokugudluzela lomkhumbi kwenye indawo. Ukuze umkhumbi unikezwe ilungelo lokudoba, ofaka isicelo kumele agcwalise ifomu lephomedi ehambelana nesekisheni yokudoba lomkhumbi ozodoba kuyo. Okokugcina, uma ofaka isicelo acabanga ukuthi lomkhumbi uzodoba olwandle olunamagagasi aphezulu, kumele agcwalise ifomu lokudoba endaweni enjalo. Isicelo sokusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle kungathatha izinsuku ezingu 14 uma onke amaphepha ephelele.

Ummbila ukhiqizwa ngabalimi lapha, lokhu kusho ukuthi lukhona ulwazi olungasetshenziswa ukuqhubekela phambili. Omningi ummbila usetshenziswa lapha, futhi ubekwa ngabalimi emakhaya - ngakho-ke akudingeki intilansipoti, indawo yokomisa nendawo enkulu yokubeka. Ummbila uyisitshalo esimila kalula futhi omningi umsebenzi ungenziwa ngezandla (lapho kungekho imishini). Lapho kukhona ummbila omningi kakhulu, ungasetshenziswa ngumuzi wonke, abantu, izinkomo, izimvu, izinkukhu nezingulube. Ummbila okwanele wenza ukuthi yonke impilo ibengcono. Kungani ukuthuthukisa kwabalimi kuthathe isikhathi eside? Ukulima akusiyo into elula, abalimi bafanele bakwazi ukuphatha imisebenzi eyahlukene, futhi kukhona njalo izinkinga nezingozi ezingavela. Izindleko zokuqala ukutshala ziphakeme nentengiso yokudla iphansi, ngakho-ke kunzima lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuthola inzuzo ezindaweni lapho kutshalwa ngemvula kuphela. Intengo yemishini iyamangaza. Abalimi abanolwazi nabezomnotho bayahlupheka - singathini ngabalimi abasathuthukayo abasakhulayo. Nabo bahlupheka kakhulu. Sikholwa ukuthi kuyini okusebenzayo lapho sizama ukuphakamisa abalimi? Bonke abasebenza kule phrogramu kufanele basebenze ngokukhuthala, ngobuqotho - ukulima kuhambelana kakhulu ukuphakamisa umlimi, emva kwalokhu sizobheka umhlaba. Kufanele siqale ngezitshalo ezilula ukutshala, bese siqhubeka kwezinye izitshalo ezinzimana. Nikeza umlimi ithuba lokuqala ukulima ngezinto enazo - ukuqala ngezinto ezincane endaweni encane kungcono ngoba akungeke kulethe ingozi enkulu. (Khumbula ukuthi loyo muntu ofisa ukusebenzisa indawo yakhe uphumelele ngaso sonke isikhathi ngemali evela noma kuphi.

Izakhiwo ezintsha endaweni yeSRA ziyobalwa ngokuhambisana nosuku olufanele lohlu lokwengeza lokuklanywa kwamanani. Lapho ngokusetshenziswa okukodwa kungakhokhwa, umhlaba kumele wahlukaniseke ngaphansi kwesigaba "sokusetshenziselwa okuningi" bese kuthi ingxenye engakhokhi ithathwe ngokwehlukile kulezi ezinye. Lapho ingxenye esele nayo isetshenziselwa okuningi, kuyolandelwa umgomo "wokusetshenziswa ngokuphezulu kunakho konke okunye". a ingxenye isetshenziselwa ukuhlalisa umnikazi noma oqashile hhayi imenenja yepulazi; noma b ingxenye ingasetshenziselwa ukuhlala noma ezolimo. Uma umhlaba ushiywe ngumnikazi, wakhiwe noma usetshenziswa ngokungemthetho futhi ngokuphambene nemithetho yedolobha kaMasipala, uMasipala angawuguqula umkhakha wawo ube ngowokusetshenziswa / ukuthuthukiswa okungagunyaziwe noma okungekho emthethweni. Uma umthuthukisi ethuthukisa ngezigaba, inani lomhlaba omningi kumele liklanywe ngokulandela u-12. Uma amalungelo ededelana, angafakwa ohlwini lokuklanywa kwamanani. Ukukhokhwa nokuqoqwa kwamarates kumele kulawulwe yinqubomgomo kaMasipala yokulawula izikweletu nokuqoqwa kwazo. IQHAZA LOMPHAKATHI Bheka u-4.3 wenqubomgomo yezimali ezikhokhwayo nezindleko ezengeziwe.

Izinsiza ezinqunyelwe kulabo abawaqhamukayo aziziswa kuphela ngokwakhiwa kolwazi, kodwa futhi kwiSikhumbuzo sezinqumo eziphusile. Ukwakha ozakwethu abagulayo, kuza sekuthuthukisa izinsiza zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezindaweni ezingenamathuba. Umphakathi ubonile ukuthi ungathola kanjani izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kuyasiza ukudala izinkampani ezisebenzayo ngokuthunikwa ngesandla izinselelo, ukuhamba phambili kwesizukulwane esisha sokusebenza, nokwakha umbono oqondile wokuphila okungokoqobo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokusebenza, ukwakhiwa kobungcweti, kanye nokwandiswa kokuhweba, kuzoqhubeka kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti zabaqeqeshi zihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izisebenzi zethu nakwezobuchwepheshe. Ekuhambeni kwalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni qhubeka nokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezithuthukisi ukuze abantu bathole amathuba afanayo. Njengoba sikhula, siphinde siphinde siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, kuhlanganisa nezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nathi. Ngaleyo ndlela, sihamba phambili emsebenzini wabo bonke abaqeqeshi, sithuthukisa ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Ubani ozokwazi ukuhola lo mzila? Abasebenzi badinga ukuba nomoya obambekayo, bezinikele, ukuze bathole umphumela ofanele. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye bazama ukugcina izimpilo zabo zisebenza, nakuba bephila ezimeni ezinzima. Iziteleka azilingani; zikhona ezivamile nezizimele. Izinhlangano zisebenza lapho abanye bezama ukudlula emikhakheni, baphuma balwa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuphila kokusebenza kukhona, futhi kuphila. Lokhu kuhlole izinzuzo zesikhathi esifushane, noma izimo ezithile. Ngokuqhubeka, sikhuluma ngamasu okuxhumana okukhuthaza abantu emsebenzini. Iqiniso ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zicacile, zifuna intshiseko, ziqhubekela phambili, futhi zikhuthaza abanye ukuba bawe, banakekele, nokuba bazimisele ekushintsheni. Uhlola Okwengeziwe: Ngabe imizamo yebhizinisi ibonakala? Abasebenzi baye baphawula noma kusezingeni elincane. Ngabe umphakathi ugcwele ubungqina bokusebenza kahle? Iziteleka zithinta abokuqala, nabanye, kubekwe phezulu izimo zempilo, umndeni, nempilo yomsebenzi. Uhlelo lwezeMali luhlobene nezinye izinkinga. Sidinga ukuzibuza: "Yini engase yenzeke?" Uhlelo lwezempilo lugcwele izinkinga ezikhulisa ithuba lokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sikhuluma ngokuqonda, sibhekelele imiphumela, nokuqonda izibalo. Abasebenzi bangase badlale indima, behluleka, bese bethi, "Ngabe lokho kuzoba ngcono?". Kukhona ezinye izikhathi lapho iziteleka zempilo zibalulekile ukuze kusize abavela kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuziqukethwe emiphakathini, kwakha umoya ophilayo phakathi kwamalungelo nezimfanelo zabasebenzi.

Ukukhala kokukhuluma: "Umhlabathi uyifa labantu futhi bonke abantu abathokozile benhlangano: umhlaba ungowethu. Umhlabathi uyindawo yokukhula zonke izinhlobo zokudla futhi udala umsebenzi wezolimo. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakufaka esikhundleni. Ngakho, thina njengabantu sinezibopho zokugcina leli th Treasure lethu ngokukhuthaza njalo, silisebenzise ngendlela efanele, ukuze sakhe umhlaba onempilo ngoba umhlaba onempilo ungakha kuphela ezimpahleni zomhlabathi eziphilayo." - JC Ross. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakufaka esikhundleni. Ngaphakathi kwayo, akukho okushintshayo. Konke okwenzeka, njengokuphuma komhlabathi, kubangele umhlabathi ukuba wakhiwe ezitokisini. Nokho, kufanele sihlukanise phakathi kokushintsha kwemvelo nokushintsha okwenziwa abantu. Ukwakhiwa komhlabathi kwemvelo kuthatha izinkulungwane zeminyaka, kodwa umuntu angawuchitha konke lokhu ngosuku olulodwa uma engasebenzisi umhlabathi ngendlela efanele futhi ezolimo ngendlela engahambisani nezimiso zokulima eziqhubekayo. Ukuphatha kahle ukuhamba komhlabathi kuzuza umlimi kanye nabantu bonke emhlabeni - kusiza umnikazi ukugcina umhlabathi nomswakama (amanzi) ngaphakathi komhlabathi, kusiza abanye ukuvimbela imifula ukuthi ingawashiyi impahla yabo, kuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi emifula acacile futhi kuqinisekisa umhlaba emhlabeni jikelele. Ukulahleka komhlabathi nokukhiqiza kwawo. Ukulahleka kwamanzi agijimayo angasetshenziswa. Ukuwohloka kwezindawo zokulima nomhlabathi ongakhiqizi ukudla. Izikhukhula (zamanzi amaningi) kanye nezomiso ezinzima. Ukwehla kwenani lemakethe yomhlaba. Ukwehla kwemikhawulo yokwenza inzuzo kwezolimo.

Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomoya omncane. Njengoba izimo zokusebenza zikhula, izimayini zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenzise izindlela eziphusile, kodwa akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi lezi zindlela zinezinselelo. Abanye abanikazi bezimayini bazama ukwenza kahle, kodwa abanye bahlala bejolise kuphela emalini. Lokhu kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwabantu, izimayini, nemvelo. Uma sikhuluma ngoMhlaba, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Ihlangene nezinhlobonhlobo zempilo, futhi uma ibhujiswa, sithola ukuthi sibhujiswa sonke. Uhlanga lwezinto eziphilayo luyahluka, futhi uma sikhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zonke zibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baye baqala ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Sifuna ukugcina izindawo zethu zihlanzekile, futhi imithombo yethu yamanzi icace. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imvelo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imizamo yokuvikela imvelo ibalulekile? Izinkampani ziyaqonda ukuthi uma ziqhubeka nokwenza izimayini ngaphandle kokucabangela imvelo, kuzoba nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokumba, ukuvuselela izindawo ezibhujiswe, nokwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola imiphumela yemisebenzi yezimayini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baye baqala ukwakha imiphakathi yokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi imvelo iyathinteka. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo iyingxenye yokuphila kwethu. Njengoba izimayini ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Ngabe sithanda ukuphila endaweni enempilo?

Uma indiza ithengiswa kwelinye izwe futhi ithunyelwa nezincwadi zayo, umbhalo ofanayo wezincwadi ezikhombisa indlela enzulu elungiswe ngayo nokunye ukukhanda kanye namaphutha alungiswe esinyangeni eziyisithupha ezidlule, kufanele igcinwe yilowo oyidayisayo noma obhekele inhlangano elungise leyondiza, kuye ngokuthi ngubani oqondene. Imibhalo efakwa encwadini yendiza okufanele igcinwe ngokulandisa komgomo 43.01.3 iyophothulwa futhi isayinwe ngumnikazi wemvume, ngumuntu onegunya eliphelele ngokweNgxenye 145 noma yilowo ovunyiwe ngokwenhloso kaKhomishani. Izindaba okungenzeka zingafinyeleli noma zaziswe lowo ongumnikazi wemvune noma ogunyaziwe ziyofakwa futhi zisayinelwe wumshayeli ophethe indiza. Noma yimuphi umbhalo ogcinwe ngenhloso yokuqoqa umbiko ofakwa ezincwadini zendiza noma umbiko othinta uhlelo lokubhala ngaphandle nje kwencwadi yendiza uqobo uyovezwa uma kwenzeka ufunelwa ukuhlolwa noma uphenyo yisiphathimandla esigunyaziwe, ngumhloli noma ngumuntu onegunya. Imibhalo efakwe encwadini yendiza uyoqukatha lonke ulwazi neminingwane ehlinzekelwe encwadini yendiza. Noma yinini, uma kunemibhalo ethile efakwa encwadini yendiza, lokho okulungiswayo kuyokwenziwa ngendlela eshiya umbhalo omdala ubonakala. Akuvunyiwe ukusebenzisa into efana nesisusi-mbhalo noma indlela efanayo ehliphizayo negqiba umbhalo omdala.

Izinhlaka zokuma, ukulawula zomsebenzi wokubuyisela izinto esimweni zizohlinzekwa yiNhlangano yeZizwe. Othisha kumele baqaphele kakhulu uma bekhetha ulwazi abazolufundisa nalapho sebedlulisela ulwazi kubafundi. Wathi isiteshi sasisiza ukufaka uthando kanye nokuzinikela e-North West ezinhliziyweni zalabo abasebenzi esifundazweni. Kuzomele samukele ukuthi umbono kaMnu Beukes njengoba awubhala ngoba wayenguMqondisi Jikelele, wabhekana nawo. Kodwa, ngenxa yokuthi akukho okunye okungenziwa, kubalulekile ukuqaphela kakhulu uma usebenzisa le nkomba. Ukulethwa kwezinto zokusebenza kwe-exequatur, inhloko yesikhundla esimayelana namanxusa okwesikhashana ukuze ikwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe. Ezinye izitatanyiswa eziqhamuka eMnyangweni kaZwelonke neyoHulumeni baseKhaya nabo bazokwethamela ukwembulwa kwetshe. Sihlangane lapha ekuseni ukuhlonipha laba abasebenze ngendlela nokugubha nabo kulesi sikhathi esimnandi. Ukuthuthukisa usiko kubantu baseNingizimu Afrikha ukuba balwisane nesizukulwane sokunukubezeka komoya namanzi. Lokhu kunconywe yisimo esihle sezombusazwe esikhona phakathi kwezinhlaka ezimbili zikahulumeni eNtshonalanga Kapa. I-South African High Commissioner ese-Canberra, e-Australia ingathintwa uma kunemibuzo. Idayiswa abantu abangasebenzi nabangenamakhaya ukuze bahole. Kodwa, kunama-ejenti amaningi abuya abuyiselwa ngokushesha ohlelweni lwezokuphepha. Izimo zokutshuza zingakukhombisa into okungeyona kanti abahlenga izimpilo zabantu basebenzise amakhono abo kanye nolwazi lolwandle ukuba bahenqe indawo ephephile yokubhukuda.

Umthetho noma imitheshwana iyatholakala eSigayweni semibhalo kaHulumeni (Government Printer), kungaba ngamaGazethe noma itholakale ikhiqizwe ngabanye abashicileli. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha kwabasebenzi usingethwe yiNgosi Enkulu yeZempilo Nokuphepha ngaphakathi eMnyangweni Wabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqhutshwe isiqiniseko sokuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi, sekusungulwe amahovisi alengosi kuzo zonke izifundazwe. Kuyimanje, abahloli bezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi endaweni yokusebenza nabakanise ezifundazweni baqhuba lomsebenzi wokuhlola nokwenza uphenyo lapho kufanele ezindaweni zokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuhlola ziqhutshwa ngokulandela izinkomba ezithile esingaphawula kuzo; ubukhona bezinto eziyingozi, ukusetshenziswa kuka-benzini lapho kuwashwa khona impahla noma izindawo okunemishini eyingozi khona. Kukhona futhi izinhlelo zokuhlola indawo ezingahlelwa kusenesikhathi, njengezicelo ezenziwayo, izikhalazo zabasebenzi, abaqashi noma amalunga omphakathi. Lezikhalazo noma izicelo zigcinwa ziyimfihlo. Uma umhloli ethola into eyingozi noma engaholela engozini emsebenzini, angabeka imibandela ethile kumqashi. Esimweni esibonisa ingozi engavela, umhloli anganqanda lesosenzo, inqubo noma ukusetshenziswa komshini ngokukhipha isaziso esifanele sokuvimbela. Akekho umuntu ovunyelwe ukushaya indiva ingqikithi yaleso sexwayiso, kumele umlayezo okhishiwe ulandelwe ngokushesha. Uma kukhona umthetho othile ophuliwe, umhloli angafaka isaziso sokwephulwa komthetho kubasebenzi noma kumqashi. Ukwephulwa koMthetho kungaholela ekushushisweni ngokuphuthuma.

Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi iXbox ayigcini nje ngokudlala imidlalo? Ibuye ibe yindawo yokubuka amafilimu, ukusakaza umculo, nokwenza izinto eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani. Ngabe ubungakholwa ukuthi ungabuka amafilimu akho owathandayo ngenkathi udlala imidlalo? Lokhu kwenza iXbox ibe yindawo yokuhlala, hhayi nje indawo yokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMicrosoft yathuthukisa iXbox One, futhi lokhu kwaba yinto eyodwa eyayithokozisa kakhulu. I-4K gaming, izithombe ezicacile, nezici eziningi ezithokozisayo zenza kube lula ukujabulisa. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi ungakwazi ukuxhuma iXbox yakho kumakhalekhukhwini? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukudlala noma kuphi, futhi ungakwazi ukujabulisa ngisho nasemsebenzini. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithokozisayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngabe ubungakholwa ukuthi iXbox iyakwazi ukuxhumana nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi ungakwazi ukudlala imidlalo yakho oyithandayo noma kuphi. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithokozisayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi ungakwazi ukuxhumana nabangane bakho nge-voice chat? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi ungakwazi ukujabulisa ngisho nasemsebenzini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iXbox Series X ne-Series S zethulwa, futhi lokhu kwaba yinto eyodwa eyayithokozisa kakhulu. Ezinye izifo zihlala zikhona kodwa azikhuli ngoba azithintani nesitshalo noma nezimo zezulu. Izifo ziphathwa ngokuqinisekisa nokuvikela. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izifo ngokuvikela. Kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhuliswe ukuze zibe nokumelana nezinye izifo. Lokhu kumelana kwesitshalo kubhekisela ekulweni nesifo esithile; akusho ukuthi ezinye izifo azikwazi ukulimaza lelo sitshalo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yisiphi isifo esivame ukubangela ubungozi endaweni yakho bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungakwazi ukumelana nalolo sifo. Ukuphatha ngama-chemicals kusho ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ukuze ubulale izifo ezithile ze-fungal kanye ne-bacterial ezimweni ezithile. Kufanele ucabange kahle izindleko zokuthenga i-pesticide - kungase kube kuhle ukufuna iseluleko kumeluleki wezokulima mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwemithi ethile. Ukulima umhlabathi kungaba yinto ebalulekile uma uzama ukuphatha izifo - ezinye izifo zihlala ezinsaleni ezishiwo ezisemathafeni, ngakho kufanele wazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona bese ukhetha indlela efanele yokulima umhlabathi. Ukushintsha izinhlobo zezihlahla kusho ukuhlinzeka isikhathi sokuthi izinsalela ezishiwo ezisemathafeni zife. Kubalulekile ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezithanda yiziphi izitshalo bese ubhekana nalolo daba ngokushintsha izinhlobo zezitshalo ozifakayo. Isikhathi sokufaka sithinta futhi ukukhula kwesifo esithile - ukufaka ngaphambi kwesikhathi noma emva kwesikhathi kungavimbela isifo esithile ekukhuleni nasekubangeleni ubungozi. Ingxenye yokudala ubunzima ekukhul

Lesi sitifiketi kumele sihlanganise incazelo echaza ukuthi ukhetho kwalowo muntu njengelungu leCentre kuzothuthukisa kanjani izinhloso zeCentre. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sibe nekhasi elichaza ukuzibophezela kwalowo muntu ukuba aqashwe njengelungu leCentre, futhi kufanele sibe ne dokhumenti echaza umlando wabo wezokufunda nezokusebenza (curriculum vitae). IBhodi leCentre kufanele ibuyekeze minyaka yonke zonke izicelo ezintsha ezithunyelwe ngonyaka odlule, kulandela inqubo esunguliwe yokufaneleka. Bonke abakhona njengamalungu eCentre kuzodingeka bavote, ngovoti olufihlekile, baveze ukuthi bayamukela noma abamukeli umuntu othile ophakanyiswe yiBhodi noma baveze uma besendaweni yokungavoti noma bephakathi. Amalungu eCentre angavoti azobhekwa njengokuthi abavoti. Umuntu othola okungenani amavoti amathathu uzobhekwa njengokhetho njengelungu leCentre, uma okungenani ingxenye yamavoti imamukele. a "Mina, egameni eliphelele, ngiyafunga ukuthi ngizothuthukisa isimo eNingizimu Afrika ngokucabanga kwesayensi futhi ngiphakamise izinhloso ze-South African Science Centre ngokusemandleni ami; futhi b Ngizohlonipha umthethosisekelo osunguliwe kanye nezikhombandlela ezisunguliwe zeCentre njengoba ngisahlala ngilungu leCentre." Noma ilungu leCentre linomsebenzi, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-subsection 9, yokubamba iqhaza ekhetho lamalungu amasha eCentre kanye namalungu eBhodi. ICentre izophathwa futhi ibusiswe yiBhodi ngokweMthetho. IBhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinhloso zeCentre zifezwa ngokuzikhandla futhi kufanele ibheke ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi yeCentre.

Onke amalungelo obuqotho nokulunga kanye noma yimaphi amanye amalungelo ezokuXhumana koMbuso noma ezinye izinhlangano zomthetho maqondana nengqikithi emaqondana nakho kule website angabekwanga obala, kusho ukuthi agodliwe. Lolu lwazi kule website lunenhloso yokunikeza ngolwazi olunabile maqondana nesihloko esithile noma izihloko, kanti futhi alunikeze yonke injula ngalesi sihloko. Kungumsebenzi osemahlombe omsebenzisi ukuzenelisa yena ngaphambi kokuba angene kule website, ngokuthi le website izohlangabezana nezidingo zakhe siqu umsebenzisi, kanye nokuhambisana ne-hardware kanye/noma i-software yakhe. Ulwazi, imibono kanye nemiqondo kule website, akumele kuthathwe ngokuthi yiseluleko esiprofeshinali, noma umqondo osemthethweni we-GCIS, noma enye inhlangano ebhaliswe emthethweni maqondana nolwazi, imibono noma imiqondo evezwa kule website. Abasebenzizi bakhuthazwa ukubonisana nabolwazi lweprofeshini ngaphambi kokuba bathathe noma yiliphi inyathelo maqondana nolwazi, imibono, noma imiqondo evezwe kule website. Abe-GCIS abenikezi kumela noma amawaranti, abekwe ngendlela engaqondile ngqo noma ngenye indlela , ukuthi kuyothi phakathi kokunye, ingqikithi equkethwe lapha kanye netheknoloji etholakala kule website akunawo amaphutha, okweqiwe ngephutha , noma ukuthi inkonzo izoba ngengaphazamiseki ukufinyelela ku-100%, nokuthi ayinawo amaphutha, noma izohlangabezana nombandela wesici esithize ngokwenziwa komsebenzi noma iqophelo.

U-SAPS wenza isivumelwano NOWENKONTILEKA ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuke sivumelwano, kanti noWENKONTILEKA uyavuma ukunikeza usizo lwakhe ngqo kuSAPS ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuleSIVUMELWANO, e (emveni kwalokhu ebizwa ngokuthi EMSEBENZINI): Inqobo nje uma OWENKONTILEKA engatshelwa ngu SAPS ukuthi makaye kosebenzela u-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma isiphi isigceme esiyisakhiwo sikaSAPS esingekho EMSEBENZINI, kube okwesikhashana. OWENKONTILEKA, ngenxa yale SIVUMELWANO , akufanele noma abe eseba nethemba lokulindela ukuthi sizovuselelwa le SIVUMELWANO, noma nje aqashwa kunoma yisiphi isikhundla njengomqashwa kwa-SAPS. Kuyavunyelwana phakathi kwamaQEMBU, ukuthi OWENKONTILEKA isivumelwano asenziwe naye njengomqashwa ngokwale SIVUMELWANO futhi le SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kunobuhlobo bokuqashana obukhona phakathi koweNKONTILEKA no SAPS. OWENKONTILEKA kufanele, ngaphandle kwemigomo yesigaba 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo yeziGaba 5 no 9 ngezansi, anikezele u-ASPS izinsizakalo ngesikhathi ezidinga nangokwemibandela ebekwe ngu-SAPS, esikhathini esikaliwe esi , kusukela osukwini lokuqala kwale SIVUMELWANO bheka isigaba 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene noWENKONTILEKA izohlanganisa nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa ngezandla eyingxenye, futhi eqondene nemisebenzi yoWENKONTILEKA.

Ngokuphambene, abanye abakholwa ekutheni imidlalo kufanele ibe yinsika yokufundisa, okukhombisa ukuthi edlini yezenhlalo nabadlalayo abadala kufanele kube neqhaza elikhulu ekunikezeni abantwana abasha ithuba lokukhula. Izingxoxo ezinjalo zishaywa indiva, zikhombisa indlela ezahlukeneyo zokubheka isimo. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi abadlali abasebasha badinga ukuhlonishwa ngebanga locwaningo lokuziphatha, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bajabula kangakanani. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuzijabulisa emidlalweni, okukhuthaza abantwana ukuba baqhubeke bezama. Abadlali abaningi basengozini yokucindezelwa, okukhumbuza ukuthi imidlalo akuyona nje into yokuzijabulisa, kepha ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Njengoba abantwana bejolisa emkhakheni wezenhlalo, kudingeka bahlale bexhumana nabazali, othisha, nabaphathiswa abakhuthazayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezikhona zikhula kakhulu, kodwa zidinga ukuhamba phambili emikhankasweni yokuletha izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Imali yokuxhasa abathandi bemidlalo iphakathi kwezinsiza ezibucayi. Abakhiqizi bemidlalo nabaxhasi kufanele bahloniphe imiphumela ethile yokuthuthukiswa kwemidlalo phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kucwaninga kubalulekile ukuze kubhekelwe ukukhula kwempilo nokuxhasa umphakathi. Kodwa ke, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokudlala esebenzayo. Izingane zidinga ukunikezwa amathuba okujabulisa emidlalweni, naye umphakathi kufanele ube nenkathazo yokuthuthukiswa. Othisha, abazali, nabaphathiswa kufanele babe uchwepheshe ukuze bathuthukise imiphumela emihlanu yempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha.

Ngokuvamile izindawo zokulima azihambisani, ezinye ziphakeme, ezinye zisezingeni eliphansi, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Amanzi avame ukuhamba ngaphansi kwezindawo eziphakeme, akha imifula emincane yokukhula. Lapho ukuhamba kwenzeka endaweni enokwehla, lezi zimpophoma zixubana ukuze zakhe imifula engavezwa ngamagatsha ezihlahla - bese kwakhiwa imifula emikhulu. Lapho amanzi eqala ukuhamba emifula ethile, amandla ale mfula ayanda futhi ukuhamba nakho kukhula kakhulu. Lapho ukuhamba okufana nezithupha kufika endaweni lapho imifula eyakhiwe ingasapholisa, kufika ezingeni lokuhamba okufana nezithupha. Lokhu kukhuphuka okusheshayo kwemifula kungalimaza izindawo ezinkulu zomhlaba futhi kuvimbe ukuqhubeka kokulima kulezo zindawo. Izizukulwane zethu ezizayo zinethemba lokuthi sizogcina umhlabathi ukuze bakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ngokuphatha umhlabathi kahle, singaqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uzosasebenza kusasa nakusasa.

Ukuze ube yilungu, kufanele uqedele ifomu lokubhalisela, ulethe nemininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu, kanye nemininingwane yezezimali ethile. Izinzuzo ezitholakalayo I-GEMS inikeza izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinsizakalo zempilo, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zezokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Imithetho nemigomo ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ichaza ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kumalungu, kanye nemikhawulo ethile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukuhlela kahle izindleko zempilo zabo, futhi akwazi ukujwayela izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Izimo zokwamukelwa kwezicelo Uma umsebenzisi efuna ukwamukela izinsizakalo, kufanele aqonde kahle izimo ezithinta ukwamukelwa kwezicelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngamadokhumenti adingekayo, kanye nemikhawulo ethile yokwelashwa. Imithetho ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ibeka izimiso ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izicelo zihlolwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu awatholi izinsizakalo ezithile ngaphandle kokuhambisana nemigomo ebekiwe. Ukuphathwa kwezimali I-GEMS ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali, futhi imithetho nemigomo ibalulekile lapha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yezezimali, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukuqonda kahle lezi zimo kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuhlela izindleko zabo zempilo, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi awatholi izinsiza ezingekho emthethweni. Izinkinga nezixazululo Njengoba sithokozisa izinzuzo ze-GEMS, kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda izinkinga ezingavela.

Abaningi ababelwa empini bakhethe ukubuyiselwa emphakathini, ukunokuba babuyiselwe empini. Amaphoyisa aphuca umnikazi imoto kanti abasolwa bayiswa esitokisini esisemaphoyiseni ase-Alberton. Lokhu kufaka izinto ezinjengamajezi, opholonekha, amajezi anezinkinobho, izikibha namanye amavesti, iphentihosi, amathayithi, amastokhingi amasokisi nokunye okunjalo. Kuphinde kuveze, kube wuphawu lomcebo ongaphakathi komhlaba abaseMnquma abaziqhenya ngalo okuyigranaythi, ithaythaniyamu nokunye. Bahlotshaniswa nokubulala kanye nokugqekeza izindlu. Umalusi wuhlaka olusemthethweni olubhekele ukuqinisekisa imiphumela yokuhlolwa. Phezu kwalokhu kudideka kokucwaswa kwezobuchwepheshe sekuvele inselelo entsha ezobeka umthwalo ezizweni ezisathuthuka. Ukukala ukuyiswa eceleni kwemingcele yendishi okunesisisndo esehlayo esiqwini esingaphezulu, umgwaqo omkhulu kanye nemincane. Ngesikhathi abadlali bengena enkundleni, ukugxobana kwaba kubi kakhulu. I-GCIS isehhovisi likaMengameli kanti ingaphansi kukaNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likaMengameli uDkt Mantombazana Tshabalala-Msimang. Okhulumela amaphoyisa aseNewlands uCapt PM Pillay wathi abasebenzi babajaha ngezinyawo kodwa abasolwa babaleka bangena emijondolo. Abanye abantu emphakathini benza esikubiza ngokuziphatha ngokungemukelekile emphakathini. Umsebenzi onguMxhumanisi waseMayville, u-Inspector Patrick Ngwane, wancoma abasebenzi ngokuphendula kwabo ngokushesha. Thola umlando ogcwele wokusebenza kukaNoria Mabasa lapha.

Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi, okuvumela amakhasimende ukuthi athole izinsizakalo ngaphandle kokuvakashela ezikhungweni. Lokhu kungenza kube lula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zingasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende angathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ngempumelelo. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, izikhungo zingakwazi ukwazisa amakhasimende ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izinguquko, kanye nezinsizakalo ezintsha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumakhasimende ukuhlela izikhathi zabo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuthi baphendule izidingo zamakhasimende. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM kubonisa indlela entsha yokuphila, enezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi nezinselelo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, izikhungo kufanele ziqhubeke zithuthukisa izindlela zazo zokusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumakhasimende, kunciphise izinkinga, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zikhona. Ngalesi sikhathi sokushintsha, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze ziqhubeke zikhonza abantu ngendlela efanele.

Uhlelo lwezohwebo kanye nesu lokusebenza kwemisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo lukhonjiswa kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha futhi luvunywa ngaye minyaka yonke, ngendlela yesicelo (uhlelo lwezohwebo) oluhlanganisa nolwazi olunembile. I-SAMSA yenza imisebenzi yezomthetho nezok regulation, egameni likaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha kanye neMnyango Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke (NDOT). Ngakho-ke, i-SAMSA yenza imisebenzi ekhethiwe ezingeni lokusebenza, kanti i-NDOT isebenza ezingeni lesu, lapho ithuthukisa khona izinqubomgomo zokuthutha nezikhombisi-ndlela ezibalulekile kumaphrojekthi. I-SAMSA iqhubeka nokuxhumana nabathintekayo emikhakheni yezokuthutha, ngamakomidi ahlukahlukene ezokuthutha nangokubamba imihlangano yokuxhumana nezinye izindlela ezingezona ezisemthethweni. Inhloso ye-SAMSA ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezimpahla nokuphila olwandle, ukuvikela nokulwa nokungcoliswa okuthinta imvelo yolwandle yezikebhe, nokukhulisa izintshisekelo zezimali zeRiphabhulikhi. Phakathi kwezinye izenzo, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulezi, kukhona ukuhlolwa kwezikebhe, imishini, kanye nezimpahla, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isikebhe nezikebhe zifakwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe. I-SAMSA iphinde ikhiphe futhi inikeze izitifiketi okufanele zibe nazo abantu uma besebenza ezikebheni. IKomidi leMithetho Yamalungelo Abantu laseNingizimu Afrika kumele lithuthukise isikhombimsebenzisi esiqukethe ulwazi olufanele ukuhlinzekwa kunoma ubani ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yiluphi ilungelo elicatshangelwayo nguMthetho. Izimemo ezitholiwe zokuhamba/nokuxhumana namanye amazwe/izinhlangano/okungabandakanya amaklayenti nomphakathi.

Isimo sandiswa yiphuzu lokuthi, ngenxa yezizathu zokungacacelwa kahle kanye nezokufuna amandla eziphikisana nokufakwa kobuliminingi, izikhungo zikahulumeni nezangasese zinendlela ethile yokuthatha izinqumo zesikhashana zolimi eziphikisana nengxenye yomthethosisekelo kanye nezidingo ezihambisana nezilimi. IsiGaba sesi-6 somThethosisekelo sinikeza uhlaka oluphakeme olusemthethweni lobuliminingi , ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni kanye nokukhuthazwa kwenhlonipho nokubekezelana kokuhluka ngolimi kwaseNingizimu Afrika. Ithola amalungelo olimi lwezakhamuzi, okumele ahlonishwe kuzinqubomgomo zolimi zikazwelonke. UmThethosisekelo ugcizelela ukuthi zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kumele "zibe nesithunzi esilinganayo" futhi ziphathwe ngokulinganayo, loku kuzawube sekukhulisa izinga nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendabuko, nohulumeni athathe izindlela zokushaya umthetho kanye nezinye zokulawula kanye nokubheka isimo sokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendabuko ezingenamathuba. UmThethosisekelo uvumela inguquko kulesi simo solimi kulo lonke lelizwe, unikeza ukunakwa kwezenhlalakahle kanye nezombusazwe kumaqembu ezilimi akade encishwa amathuba ngaphambilini ngezizathu "zezidingo eziveziwe zemiphakathi kanye namaqembu anentshisekelo". IsiGaba sesi-6(2) somThethosisekelo sidinga izindlela zokwenza zilungiswe ukuthuthukisa lezi zilimi zomdabu. IsiGaba sesi-6(3) nese (4) siqukethe ukunikezelwa okuhlobene nezilimi zikahulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda, lapho iminyango kahulumeni kumele isebenzise okungenani ezimbili izilimi ezisemthethweni.

Isu kufanele kube ngeliseqophelweni impela. Sengiyokuhlala ngilindele imibiko yenqubekela phambili ke kumnyango wami, nakuwo uMkhandlu obhekele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ngibuye ngimeme uMkhandlu ukuba uhlale ubuyekeza izinjongo ukuze siqiniseke ukuthi ziyaqhubeka nokubhekela izidingo ezimqoka kakhulu zezwe lethu. Ngithanda ukubonga ngokungenamkhawulo kulezo zinkulungwane zabesimame nabesilisa asebefake isandla ekuthuthukisweni kwalelisu elihlaba umxhwele. Izinhloso engizibekile zisezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu, kodwa akukho okungenzeke uma sizimisele. Kanjalo nogqozi esinalo ngokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono lungagcwaliseka. Osekuyinselelo kuthina manje ukuba iphupho lethu silenze libe yinto ekhona. Asibhukule ke siyosebenza!. Kuyinto eyaziwayo nxazonke ukuthi izwe laseningizimu Afrika alikabi nawo amakhono adingakalayo ukuthuthukisa ezomnotho, ezokusebenza, nezomphakathi. Ukuze nathi sifinyelele kulelo zinga, sesinoMthetho wokuThuthukiswa kwamakhono, kanye noMthetho weNtela yamaKhono, eyaphasa ngo 1998 no 1999 ngokulandelana. Lemithetho-ke inikeza uNgqongqoshe wezemiSebenzi isibopho sokuba enze amalungiselelo eSu likaZwelonke lokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono, ebambisene noMkhandlu wokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono. UMkhandlu wokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono wasungulwa ngokoMthetho wokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono ka 1998. Amalungu ayo abamele amabhizinisi, abasebenzi, uHulumeni, nezinhlangano zomphakathi.

Abavakashi emnyangweni wezokubeletha bazovunyelwa ukufika kusukela ngo-09H00 - 10H00, emva kwalokho bazongena ngezikhathi ezichaziwe zokuvakasha. Abavakashi emnyangweni wezifo ezinzima bazovunyelwa ukufika kusukela ngo-09H00 kuze kube ngu-08H00 ebusuku, kodwa isikhathi abangahlala kuso sizokwenziwa ngabasebenzi bomnyango. Abavakashi emnyangweni wezifo ze-tuberculosis kanye nalabo abanezingqondo eziphukile bazongena ngezikhathi ezichaziwe zokuvakasha. Abathengisi abavunyelwe emhlabeni wesibhedlela. Zonke izikhungo zik government zikhishwe njengendawo lapho izivakashi zingavakashela khona, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bendawo bahloniphe le mthetho. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha azivunyelwe ukuvakashela esibhedlela. IMISEBENZI. Isibhedlela sinezinhlelo nemigomo ethinta ukukhangiswa nokuholwa kwabasebenzi. Izikhala ezitholakalayo zikhangiswa ezincwadini zendawo nezizimele, kuye ngendawo yesikhala somsebenzi. Bonke abathanda lo msebenzi kufanele bathumele izicelo zabo kule ndawo ethile. NB. Zonke izicelo kufanele zithunyelwe ngeposi njengoba kuchaziwe kukhangiso. Izicelo ezithunyelwe ngesandla azizokwenziwa. Labo abavunyelwe kuzokhishwa uhlu bazomenywa ezivivinyweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abahlangabezana nezimfuneko ezidingekayo bayaqashwa. IBHODI YESIBHEDLA. Laba ngabantu bomphakathi abaqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Bakhonza njengoxhumana phakathi kwesibhedlela nomphakathi. Banikeza izeluleko kubaphathi besibhedlela ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi kanye nezidingo ezingasiza umphakathi njengoba behlela isibhedlela.

Umfundi uyakwazi ukuxhumana nabanye ngokuzethemba nangendlela ezwakalayo nefanele ezimweni eziningi ezahlukahlukene. Abafundi kumele bakwazi ukusebenzisa amakhono abo okuxoxisana ngokuzwakalayo benanele amasiko nezilimi zezinye izizwe Ulwazi abanalo kumele lubafundise ukuthi ulwazi lwezilimi eziningi luyakhulisa futhi lwenza abantu bahlalisane kahle. Kumele bafunde izindlela zokuxhumana nabantu abakhubazekile ekukhulu-meni nasekuzweni, bazikhathalele nezidingo zabo. Umfundi uyakwazi ukufunda abuke iziqephu ukuze athole ulwazi nokuzijabulisa, ananele ngokuhlolisisa amasiko nalokho okwaziswayo okuthinta imizwa. Ukufunda imibhalo ngenhloso yokuqondisisa yiyona njongo esemqoka. Ukusebenzisa amasu namaqhinga asiza abafundi ukuba bafunde ngendlela efanele kuyabalekelela ukuba baqondisise lokho abakufundayo. Ukufunda (kukhona okubonwayo kanye nezinsiza kuxhumana eziningi) kuyadingeka ekuthuthukiseni ulimi, ukufunda ukubhala, ukuzijabulisa, ukuthuthukisa ubuyena, nokufunda ngomhlaba. Umfundi uyakwazi ukubhala izinhlobo ezahlukehlukene zemibhalo eyiqiniso nezicatshangwayo ngezinhloso eziningi ezahlukahlukene. Ezingeni eliyiSisekelo, abafundi basebenzela ukufinyelela kulo mphumela. Bafunda ukuthi ukubhala kunomqondo okuwudlulisayo, nokuthi bona -ke bangababhali balowo mqondo. Bathuthukisa amakhono okubhala, ukuze bakwazi ukubhala phansi imiqondo nemicabango yabo ukuze ifundwe yibo nabanye abantu. Bafunda ukusebenzisa inqubo yokubhala evumelekile njengopelomagama nokufaka izimpawu zenkulumo ukwenza abakubhalayo kuzwakale kwabanye.

Kwathi lapho lezi zingxoxo zifinyelela kwangqingetshe, lokho kwaholela ekutheni abasebenzi babeke phansi amathuluzi okusebenza ngomhlaka 1 Juni 2007. Lokhu akubashiyanga ngaphandle abasebenzi boMnyango weZempilo. Ukungenelela ngobuchule koMnyango kwakwazi ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka kokuphakelwa kwezidingo zezempilo ngalesi sikhathi esasinzima. Noma yayikhona lemizamo esibaluliwe izikhungo zethu zempilo zashayeka kakhulu kwasetshenziswa nezimali ezinkulu kuqashwa abasebenzi bangaphandle ikakhulukazi abezimo eziphuthumayo ukwelekelela umphakathi owawudinga usizo. Saphoqeka ukuba seboleke imibhede ezibhedlela ezizimele nokwasidla imali eshisiwe. Enye inselelo esibhekene nayo ngeyesifo i-Klebsiella esifundazweni. Amalungu azosikhumbula isigameko esingesihle esehla esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial lapho izingane ezashona zisazelwe ngenxa yegciwane i-Klebsiella. Uphenyo lwethu lwakhomba ukuthi inkinga yehlukene kaningi okubalwa kuzo; (i) indlela okwakhiwe ngayo izibhedlela zethu ikakhulukazi amawadi; (ii) yisimo senhlalo nesomnotho kwabesifazane abasebancane okumele bathembele komaqondana babo besilisa nokwenza bangakwazi ukuzilawula nokulawula udaba lokuya ocansini, (iii) ukuthelelana ngamagciwane ngenxa yendlela okwakheke ngayo izindlu, ikakhulukazi imijondolo, kanye (iv) nendlela okuhlelwa ngayo imindeni engahambisani nempilo yentsha. Isibhedlela i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial iyisibonelo esihle esibhekene nezinkinga ezifana nalezi esezibalulile.

Uzakwabo uMandla, owayesebenza nezingane embonini yezezimali, wakhombisa uthando lwezobuchwepheshe. UThandi noMandla babengabantu abazalayo, bemelele ukuphakamisa, behlola ijubane lempilo. Kwakungumbono omuhle, uhlelo lokuphila luhamba phambili, ngabe uThandi uMandla sikhumbule, ngisho naloko okulungile. Lokhu waqonda ukukhokhela uMandla kuqala ukuhlola izinkampani ezaziwa okufanele kedahliwa. Lokhu kwaba yinzuzo enkulu kumuntu ofuna kakhulu ukukhokhela izikole. UThandi waqaphela ukuthuthukiswa okwandisa igunya lokusebenza kude. Lezi zinkampani, kusukela emkhakheni wezokuxhumana zezimali de kube yizinkampani eziyindida, zafeza isivuno esihle. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uThandi noMandla baqala ukuze basebenze Imininingwane Iglobal, ezobuchwepheshe obulinganayo. Lokhu kwakukhipha isithombe esikhangayo somphakathi lapho bezohamba beqhamuka nezimo ezijabulisayo. Imininingwane ifana nezithombe ezizwakala kumatasa abendzeli bezenhlalakahle, izifundo ezihleliwe. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside esisebenza kude, uThandi wakhumbula ukuthi kuyafana njengenhliziyo, okukhombisa umphakathi. Ubhekanisa nosuku olukhejwayo lokulawulwa, nesikhathi sokusebenza sinobudlelwane obuphambili. Esethulela umbono wakho, akekho ozokwazi ukuhamba phambili, uThandi noMandla basibangela umnotho. Ekugcineni, uThandi wajabula ngezithukuthuku ezinhle nezinkanyezi, futhi uMandla wanxusa abafowabo ukuthi bahlale bephila kahle. Njengabantu abasaqalayo, umsebenzi ukude wakwenza kumzamo omkhulu khona kulolu chungechunge olunobuhlakani. Bayazisola, kanti kwayenqaba izithombe ezinzima.

Umlilo awungashiywa unganakiwe, kanti futhi kumelwe ucishwe lapho ususetshenzisiwe. Akungalahlelwa zibi phansi, noma amathini okuphatha emahlathini kaHulumeni , ngaphandle uma elahlelwa emigqonyeni ebekelwe lokho. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa isigxobo, umngcele, ucingo, amabhodi ezaziso noma okunye emahlathini kaHulumeni ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuphazamisa imisebenzi yokuphatha ehlathini likaHululumeni, kanti akekho ovunyelwe ukungena kunoma ngabe iyiphi indawo lapho abasebenzi besebenza khona kanye nalapho impahla yehlathi isebenza khona ngaphandle kwemvume. Akuvunyelwe muntu ukulimaza, ukususa noma ukwenza uphawu oluthize edwaleni, esihlahleni noma kusiphi isimila ehlathini likaHulumeni. Noma ngabe ngubani, otholakala ezingela noma edoba izinhlanzi, ebulala, noma eqokelela izilwane, izinyoni, izinambuzane, izinhlanzi noma ezinye izilwanyana ngaphandle kwelayisense noma okunye okumgunyazayo, unecala. Ukupha izilwane ukudla ehlathini likaHulumeni akuvunyelwe. Izibhamu, izimbazo, imicibisholo kanye nezinye izikhali zokuzingela azivunyelwe ehlathini likaHulumeni ngaphandle kwelayisense yokuzingela. Izinja, izilwanyana zasekhaya kanye nezinye nje izilwane azivunyelwe ehlathini likaHulumeni, ngaphandle kwamahhashi uma egunyazelwe ukuhamba emigudwini wamahhashi. Ukubhukuda kanye nokudoba kuvunyelwe kuphela kulezondawo ezenzelwe lokho. Ukugoba amadlangala, uma ngabe kuvunyelwe, kungenziwa kuphela kulezondawo ezenzelwe lokho uma ngabe sekukhokhwe imali efanelekile.

Isisindo esedlula esingavunyelwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlaka sithathwa kuphela ngesisindo esengeziwe sefuels, indawo yokugcwalisa kabusha kanye nezinsiza eziphuthumayo nezokuhlola ezifanele isimo sokundiza.

Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo zokuvikela ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokusebenza. Sidinga ukusiza abathengisi basemgwaqeni ukuba baqhubeke phambili, ngenkathi sikhuthaza amandla abathengisi nezinhlelo ezizovumela ukuba bahlanganyele nemithetho yendawo. Umphakathi, ohulumeni, nabathengisi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe indawo ehlanzekile, ekhuthazayo, nephephile kubo bonke. Ngakho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Bazimisele, futhi bahlala bekhuthaza umqondo wobudlelwano obunempilo. Sidinga ukubabukela ngeso lokhozi ukuze sithuthukise izindlela zokusiza nokubasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokuhweba, bahlale befika emiphakathini yabo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, akufanele sikhumbule lezi zinkampani ezisemqoka ezihlanganyela emnothweni wethu. Ukubavikela, ukubasiza, nokubahlonipha kuyoba umculo ophumayo emiphelandaba yethu.

Umnini wendiza engacela uKhomishani aguqule okwesikhashana noma ngokugcwele uhlelo oluvele selwemukelwe. Ngale kwemibandela yomgonyana 1 kuya ku 5, umnikazi wesindizi esingadingi sitifiketi esiqhutshwa ngokulandisa kweNgxenye 94 yaleMigomo enganikwa ushwele esidingweni sokwethula uhlelo lokulungisa isindizi sakhe esiyophasiswa wuKhomishani, inqobo uma egcina isindizi sakhe ngendlela ehambisana nemibandela yeNgxenye 24 neNgxenye 94. b elungisa indiza ngaphansi kweso likanjiniyela onemvume yokuyikhanda okleliswe ezingeni elifanele ngaphansi kweNgxenye 66; noma c ogunyazwe yilowo onemvume yenhlangano elungisa izinsiza okleliswe ezingeni elifanele ngokulandisa kweNgxenye 145 ukuba angalungisa indiza nokuyilungelo alithole ngemvume anayo. a lowo engumnini noma esebenzisa indiza; futhi b indiza isetshenziselwa imisebenzi engaqondene nohwebo. a egunyazwe wuKhomishani noma yinhlangano eqokwe wuKhomishani ngenhloso yokufeza Ingxenye 149, kuye ngesimo ngasinye ukuba engalungisa indiza; noma b elungise indiza ngaphansi kweso lomqaphi ogunyazwe wuKhomishani noma yinhlangano eqondwe wumgonyana a. Ukulungiswa kwendiza okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile, ukuhlolwa kwendiza ngabahloli, ukushintsha isakhiwo sayo, ukulungisa umonakalo omkhulu, izinguquko nokuguqula kakhulu isimo sendiza engaphezulu ko 5 700kg noma ujikamanzi onesisindo esingaphezulu ko 3 175kg kuyokwenziwa kuphela futhi kuqinisekiswe yiNhlangano Yokulungiswa kweziNdiza egunyaziwe AMO.

Ngokuphetha, ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi kuyindaba ebalulekile emlandweni wezempilo. Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo, kuze kube namuhla, ama-ambulensi abe yinsiza ebalulekile ekuphatheni izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umphakathi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina ama-ambulensi esebenza kahle, ukuze aqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo oludingekayo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi akugcini nje ngokusiza abantu abagulayo, kodwa futhi kuveza umoya wokubambisana nokuzinikela emphakathini.

Izinga Lentela eNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-2023, izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika libe nendaba ebalulekile emphakathini, njengoba izinqumo ezithathwe uhulumeni ziqhubekile nokuthinta izigidi zabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle lesi simo, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi izinga lentela sisho izinga elisetshenziselwa ukukhokha intela kumholo, ezentela zokuthengiselana, kanye nezinto zokusebenza. Kuqala, sithola ukuthi izinga lentela yomuntu siqu ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Izinhlaka zikanxusa zihlala ziqwashisa abantu ukuthi intela ethile iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi, njengemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinselelo zokuntuleka kwemali nemithombo yezimali zihlala zikhona. Nokho, izinga lentela elikhulayo lingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Lokhu kwaziswa ngengqikithi yokuthi uma izinga lentela lenyuka, umphakathi ubhekana nezindleko ezengeziwe. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bacabangele kabusha indlela abaphila ngayo, bese kudingeka izindlela ezintsha zokuphila ukuze bakwazi ukukhokha izindleko. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhulumeni uthathe izinyathelo ezahlukene ukuze athuthukise izinga lentela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo ezithile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqhamuka ezindaweni eziphansi. Kukho imizamo yokunciphisa izinga lentela kumholo ophansi, ukuze abantu bahlale bezithokozisa futhi baphile kahle. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko, akusiyona nje impendulo yokuthi izinga lentela lenyuka noma lehlisa, kodwa kumele sihlolisise imithelela ehambisana nalezi zinguquko.

Kuyiqiniso ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi wenza iphutha, nokuthi ukukhumbula kwakho akuyikho? Yebo, kanti ngokunjalo ukuqinisekisa kwebhange kwakhishwa imali yabe isiphindiselwa eNingizimu Afrikha isuka ebhange. Imithetho yokufinyelela kwi-inthanethi nokusebenzisa i-imeyili kuyonanyathiselwa eduze kwemithombo yamakhompyutha noma kutholakale uma icelwa. Ukuthuthuka kwemboni esafufusa akwenzeki kahle ngenxa yokuthi akufinyeleleki kwezezimali nezikweletu, kanjalo kanjalo nokuqeqeshelwa umsebenzi noma ukuphatha. Isiteshi esiphehla ugesi esiku-Dock Road sesize savalwa ngci saphucwa namandla okusebenza. Kuyokusiza ukuba ube nolibofuzo olwenza abaseNingizimu Afrikha babe yisizwe esiwinayo nesihlomulayo. Ama-ajenda kanye namaminithi emihlangano akhona kuphinde kukhishwe ulwazi kulolu daba. Kulokhu, kunezindaba ezine okumele wethule kuze inkulumo eyenebe. Bangafa uma bengelashwa ngesikhathi baphinde baphuze amanzi enele, kusho uNgqongqoshe u-Uys. Kumele kuphumelele, kungenjalo intando yeningi ilahlekelwa yincazelo kubantu abaningi. Kule minyaka ababheka izindawo, imiphakathi, iningi labo labekwa eceleni, namanye amaqembu anentshisekelo akhombise ukwethuka ngokuthuthka kwenkundla yegalofu kwi-Garden Route edumile. Siyobe sesakha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Ejensi izoqhubeka nokufaka isandla okukhethekile nokuzimele kubantu. Umcimbi wakulo nyaka izoba ngomkhulu nongcono kweyake yaba khona njengoba indawo yengqungquthela isibhukhwe yonke. Ama-WebPals ayisango elihlinzeka indlela elula eMitapweni yolwazi kwi-North West Provincial Government Library Service.

Imininingwane yokumthinta ikhonjiswe esazisweni esisemthethweni nangemuva kwaleli khasi lale ncwajana. Ukukhula kwamanani okudla, ikakhulukazi kwezinto ezivame ukudliwa, kube nokukhathazeka kubathengi ezinyangeni ezedlule, futhi bakhathazekile ngokuqhubekayo kokwenyuka kwamanani kabhontshisi. Kuthiwa izizathu zokwenyuka kwamanani zidalwe ukukhula kwamamanani ezimpahla zokulima emhlabeni jikelele kanye nokushoda kwalezi zinto ezweni lethu. Uma siqhathanisa i-Safex price index kanye ne-bread price index ezinyangeni ezedlule, kubonakala ukuthi intengo ye-maize ikhule kakhulu kune-intengo kabhontshisi (I-Grafu 1). Kucacile ukuthi amanani okudla kungenzeka aqhubeke ekhula ezinyangeni ezizayo. Abathengi okwamanje bahlupheka, kodwa kubonakala sengathi bangase babhekane nezimo ezinzima kakhulu esikhathini esizayo. I-Grafu 1: I-bread price index kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye ne-Statistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi ye-Sagis). Ingxenye yamamanani okudla atholakala ezolimini iholele abantu abaningi abanolwazi ukuba bakholelwe ukuthi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kubiza kancane futhi kukhiqiza inzuzo enkulu. Labo balimi abaphumelele eminyakeni edlule ngokugcina ukulima ngesikhathi esinzima ngenxa yokwehla kwamanani kanye nezomiso, okwamanje baphumula kancane. Nokho, uma sicabangela ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima, ukwehla kwamamanani okudla kungaba iphupho kuphela. I-Grafu 2 ibonisa ukuthi phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi kuka-2004 no-2007, intengo ye-maize ayizange ilingane nokukhula kwamanani we-diesel kanye ne-fertilizer - lokhu akukaze kube yinto ehlala njalo. Amanani aphansi akhuthazwa abakhiqizi kanye nezindleko ezikhulayo zokulima kube yimbangela yokuthi abalimi abaningi bame ukutshala ukudla okuyisisekelo.

Amalungu azosikhumbula isigameko esingesihle esehla esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial lapho izingane ezashona zisazelwe ngenxa yegciwane i-Klebsiella. Uphenyo lwethu lwakhomba ukuthi inkinga yehlukene kaningi okubalwa kuzo; (i) indlela okwakhiwe ngayo izibhedlela zethu ikakhulukazi amawadi; (ii) yisimo senhlalo nesomnotho kwabesifazane abasebancane okumele bathembele komaqondana babo besilisa nokwenza bangakwazi ukuzilawula nokulawula udaba lokuya ocansini, (iii) ukuthelelana ngamagciwane ngenxa yendlela okwakheke ngayo izindlu, ikakhulukazi imijondolo, kanye (iv) nendlela okuhlelwa ngayo imindeni engahambisani nempilo yentsha. Isibhedlela i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial iyisibonelo esihle esibhekene nezinkinga ezifana nalezi esezibalulile. Okokuqala, ilokishi laseMlazi linabantu abaningi kakhulu uma uliqhathanisa namanye amalokishi esifundazweni, kanti lishoda kakhulu ngezinsiza zezempilo nokwenza i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial ithwale kanzima ibelethisa abesifazane abaningi. Lesi sibhedlela sibelethisa abesifazane ababalelwa ku-1000 ngenyanga, futhi kulezi zingane ingxenye yazo ezingu-525 kuzona ziqala zigcinwe egumbini lezingane ezisesimweni esibucayi, kwi-neo-natal unit. Indawo ekhona incane kakhulu yokwemukela izingane eziningi futhi maningi amathuba okuthi zithelelane ngamagciwane ahlukahlukene. Okwesibili, ukungeneli kwezinsiza kwelapha kuleli lokishi kwenza umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlela kahle imindeni, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane abasebancane okuyibona abaningi abazithola bekhulelwa.

Ngokwejwayelekile nangokwemvelo inani lentengo belihambelana namandla walowo mhlaba ukukhiqiza ukudla ekulimeni. Ukungenisa imali ukwakha izindlu nokunye epulazini nakho kwenza ukuthi inani lentengo lamapulazi lishintshe. Ungangena esivumelwaneni nabanye abalimi ukusherisha umkhiqizo. Inzuzo izotholakala emva kwesikhathi eside ngoba kuhambelana nokukhuphuka kwentengo yomhlaba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Inzuzo ezotholakala emva kwesikhathi eside nayo ihambelana nenani lomkhiqizo ongatholakala epulazini elithile, kodwa nalokhu kuyehla kuyakhuphuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokwejwayelekile intengo yamapulazi ikhuphukile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi sekuyakhanya ukuthi umhlaba ovundile okhiqiza kahle usezandleni zabantu abancinci. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kunzima kubalimi abasha abafuna ukungena ekulimeni ukuthola indawo yokulima masinya nokuyibhadala ngenzuzo engatholakala. Lokhu kodwa kuyehluka uma umhlaba ungatholakala ngegranti (LRAD), noma otholiweyo njengefa, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngentelo (interest) engaphansi (njengokwenzekayo kwamanje ngohlelo olusha olubekwe etafuleni nguMnyango weZemiHlaba olubizwa ngokuthi Proactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS). Ukuqasha umhlaba sekushintshile ngokwamanje, bekuyindlela yabalimi abaqalayo yokungena ezokulimeni kodwa manje sekuyindlela yabalimi bezomnotho ukuthola omunye umhlaba ukuze bathuthukise ukulima kwabo.

Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kunezinkomba ezibalulekile okufanele sihlole kuzo ezingeni eliphakathi njengelizwe. Ibhajethi enkulu yonyaka yokwakha ubuchwepheshe edinga ukuxhaswa ibhajethi ye-R1.5 billion. Emkhakheni wezobuciko namasiko, kunezidingo eziphuthumayo zokuthi uhulumeni asihole. Isidingo sesithombe esisha sezobuciko, esisekelwe ekuxhumaneni kwezinsiza ezingashintshi. Ukuguqula imicabango ibe izenzo ngokwenza ukuthi imboni yamasiko idale amathuba emisebenzi. Mayelana nezilimi, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenkomba efanele ngokomthetho yokukala izilimi nokuhlukahluka kwazo, ngesikhathi umhlaba ungumkhiqizo owodwa futhi isimo sezimali sikhulu. Unyaka odlule wabona izinguquko ezinkulu ngendlela i-DACST eyibona ngayo. IyiSikhungo esisebenzisa okungenani ama-90% ebhajethi yayo (R1 billion) ezinhlelweni zangaphandle uma kuqhathaniswa nezinhlelo zangaphakathi, nezinsiza zangaphandle ezixhaswe yi-DACST zithola uxhaso kulolu-90%, okuhlanganisa nezinhlangano ezihola ucwaningo lwesayensi, amabhodi ahlobene nezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika, iminyuziyamu, nezinkalo ezihlobene nokuboniswa kobuciko. Ukwakha ubudlelwano emikhakheni enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqale ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yokuphatha nokuphatha efanayo. E-Cabinet Lekgotla kaJanuwari 2001, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo, izinsiza zamasiko ezifana nezandla, umculo, nezinkonzo, kanye namafilimu, zizofakwa ezinhlelweni zezimali ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuthuthukiswa/ukukhula nokudala imisebenzi. Sekucacile ukuthi izinsiza zamasiko zingadlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni ophumayo, okufana nezinsiza zemvelo ezifana nokumbiwa nokulima.

Ngakho-ke wukwenza kwamakhasimende okuyikhona okuhlonza ukuqhutshwa kwendlela yokuqasha endaweni yokusebenza. Ngokolwazi olutholakele, ummangali nabangani bakhe ababili babehamba ngezinyawo beyokwethamela ingqungquthela yesonto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubufakazi beKomidi obethulwe wuMnu Varney, obuphinde banxusa leli Komidi ukuba lingenelele. Lokhu kuzogcina idamu lokubhukuda lihlanzekile, okunciphisa ukufakwa nokukhishwa kwamanzi nokwehlisa ukuthwala kanzima kwephampu. Amaphoyisa e-Trio Task team ayekhuluma nomlimi mayelana nophenyo ayematasa ngalo ngesikhathi ebona indoda eyayihlomile iza ngakuwo. Lokhu kuqhubeka kahle kakhulu; eqinisweni sibe nombukiso onempumelelo wezolimo eningizimu. Ngiyakholwa ukuthi labo abahlukumezekile nalabo akade benganakiwe bangakha izwe elihle kubantu bonke. Kuyacaca ukuthi kumele siqhubeke nokubhekana neminye imisebenzi ebhekene nathi njengamazwe asafufusa. Uhlelo lwe-African Renaissance luhlinzeka uhlaka lwenjulalwazi kuma-Afrikha kwizwekazi nalabo abasabalele kuyo yonke indawo olubachazayo. Ukunalokho, kumele icabange ngendlela efanayo ne-ejensi yokuhlela imigwaqo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcabango wokuthi abanamandla bangaphezu komthetho kanye nokubekiwe kwenze ntekenteke ukusebenza komthetho womhlaba othuthukiswe ngaphansi kweNhlangano yeZizwe. Lokhu kubiza ukungenelela okunenhloso ngohlelo lokuhlnganisa amazwe omhlaba, njengama-Afrikha, ukukhipha le miphumela yendlela yokuziphatha, ukulingana ngokwesibalo kobulili obehlukene, ukufaka abantu bonke, ukuphepha kwabantu, ukugcina nokuthuthuka.

Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni (AI in public administration) Umbuzo 1: Yini ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) futhi kungani kubalulekile kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) ubhekisela kumakhono wekhompuyutha okwenza izinqumo, ukufunda, nokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngendlela efana nokuhlangenwe nakho komuntu. Kubalulekile kuhulumeni ngoba kungenza izinqubo zibe nezindlela eziphumelelayo, kunciphise isikhathi sokusebenza, futhi kuthuthukise ukuxhumana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nezakhamuzi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izindlela ezilula zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ziningi izindlela zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza: I-AI ingasiza ekuphatheni izinsiza zomphakathi ngokuhlaziya idatha futhi inikeze izincomo zokuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswe kanjani kahle. Izinsizakalo zokuxhumana: Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa i-AI zingathuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kukahulumeni nezakhamizi, njengokusebenzisa ama-chatbots ukuze kube lula ukuphendula imibuzo. Ukuxilongwa kwezinkinga: I-AI ingasiza ekuhloleni nasekuxilongeni izinkinga ezithile emphakathini, ikakhulukazi lezo eziyingozi, ukuze uHulumeni uthole izixazululo ezisheshayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni zifaka: - Ukuphumelela: I-AI ingasiza ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisheshayo nezisebenza kahle, okwenza izinqubo zibe ngcono. - Ukunciphisa izindleko: Ngokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-AI ingase isize ukunciphisa izindleko zokusebenza.

Kubalulekile ukuthi labo abaphakathi kwezikhundla benze izinto ngokomthetho, bagweme ukwamukela amathuba nezipho, njengoba lokhu kungabhekwa njengenkohlakalo. Sifisa ukuhlabela izinkanyezi bonke abaphathi nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla abathintekayo ekukhuliseni ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ngiyakhuthaza ukuba niqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi omuhle ngaphandle kokuphenduka ezinselelweni zokuthuthukisa ikhodi yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithemba ukuthi le ncwadi echazayo izoba yisikhombandlela esifanele ekukhuliseni ubuqotho nokwethembeka endaweni yokusebenza futhi futhi idale amathuba amakhulu kithi sonke ukuze sifeze isiko lokungamukeli inkohlakalo eNingizimu Afrika. Ekugcineni, ngifisa bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi baqinisekise ukuthi ukuziphatha okufanele kuhambisana nendlela evumelekile yokuphatha nokuphatha umphakathi futhi baziqhelanise nokuziphatha okufanele kanye nale ncwadi echazayo. Umphathi: IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Iminyango kazwelonke neyomphakathi iyawusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi echazayo futhi iphinde ifake imibono ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni kwayo. Ihhovisi leMphakathi elivikela liphinde lafaka umnikelo ekuthuthukiseni le ndatshana ngemibono ebalulekile. Izinhlangano nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bomphakathi zibe nezingxoxo eziningi nemihlangano futhi zenze iziphakamiso ezibalulekile. Ekugcineni, siyabonga ukwesekwa kukahulumeni waseBrithani ekuthuthukiseni amazwe angaphandle ngokuhlinzeka ngemali yokushicilela le ncwadi echazayo mayelana nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ephelele yokuqukethwe kokuziphatha okufanele.

Ngesaziso sokuthatha isinyathelo, isicelo esenziwe ngaphansi komtheshwana- 1 kufanele siphelezelwe wumbiko ofungelwe ochaza ngokucacile isimo esivuna ukuchezuka kwinqubo evamile. Impikiswano ebhaliwe iyothulwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Iyoqukatha ithebula lokuqukethwe nethebula lemikhandlu ethintekayo lapho iyochazwa khona ukuthi itholakala kumaphi amakhasi embhalweni lapho icashunwe khona. a Impikiswano yomlomo kuyoba yileyo ngeqondene nodaba olwethulwe phambi kweNkantolo kanti isikhathi sayo siyoncika emgamwini wesikhathi esinqunyiwe, kuye ngegunya nokubona koMphathimaJaji. b Amaqembu ayothatha ngokuthi wonke amajaji ayifundile impikiswano ebhaliwe ngokunjalo nokuthi asikho isidingo sokuphinda lokhu okuvele kwethulwe kuleyo mibhalo. a Impikiswano ingaqondiswa eNkantolo nganoma yiluphi ulimi olusemthethweni kanti iqembu elithintekayo alinasibophezelo sokuhlinzeka ngomhumushi. b Uma umuntu efuna ukukhuluma neNkantolo ngolimi olusemthethweni ngaphandle kwalolo okubhalwe ngalo impikiswano yakhe, lowo muntu kufanele akhiphe isaziso asiqondise kuNobhala lapho echaza khona isifiso sakhe sokusebenzisa olunye ulimi olusemthethweni, kummele aluchaze lolo lulimi. Isicelo siyofakwa kusasele okungenani izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngaphambi kokulalelwa kodaba yinkantolo. Ngesinyathelo senkantolo ngokwayo noma ngesicelo seqembu elilodwa noma ngaphezulu, Inkantolo inganquma ukuba izimangalo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezibandakanya umbuzo owodwa noma ezibonakala zencikene ukuba zidingidwe njengesigameko noma ngesimangalo esisodwa noma zidingidwe ngaphansi kwezimo nemigomo engase inqunywe ngokwaleso simo.

ukunweba 'ukufinyeleleka' kwelungelo lokuthola ulwazi ukubandakanya ukufinyelela kweningi kumkhakha wokwenza nokukhiqiza imisebenzi yobusakazi. ilungelo lenkululeko yezezindaba zamaphepha nababhali bezindaba nezinye izinhlobo zezezindaba , inkululeko yokuthola nokuhambisa ulwazi nezindaba nemibono, inkululeko kwezobuciko nobuqambi; inkululeko kwezomkhakha wezemfundo ophezulu kanye nenkululeko yezocwaningo. ukusukela ekuthuthukisweni kombono, udaba lwenqubo yokulingana lubalulekile ekwenzeni ukuthi zonke izinto zihambe ngokulingana ngendlela efanele nelungile kwimboni yezokusakaza ngokukhuthaza ukungena nokusungulwa kwamabhizinisi amasha kule makethe yezokusakaza. Ubusakazi bamarediyo bezentengiso bomthamo ophansi - kungawubusakazi obusebenza ukusakaza kuma-mall ezitolo/ezikhungweni, emabaleni emidlalo, emabaleni emibukiso, kanye nasezindaweni zamabhayisikobho okushayela ubukele uhlezi emotweni noma amanye amasevisi anjalo, iziphathimandla ezingabona bufanele. Izinkonzo ezobusakazi bamaredioyo bomthamo ophansi - obusebenza ezindawo ezihlala abantu abadala, ukuxhumanisa izindawo zamasonto, ukuxhumanisa izindawo zezinkonzo zenkolo kanye namakhaya, noma ezinye izindawo ezinjengalezi, iziphathimandla ezingabubona bufanele. Ubusakazi bamarediyo bemiphakathi kanye nobentengiso bomthamo ophansi buyosebenza iminyaka emithathu, kanti ilayisense yobusakazi bomthamo ophansi buyosebenza izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Ukubheka ukuthi ngabe yimaphi amafrikhwensi afanele angasetshenziswa ngumthamo ophansi. Ukubheka indawo isiteshi sokusakaza esizosakazela kuyo.

Ukubona ukuthi onkamisa abandelani egameni isib. Ukubona akhumbule amagama amaningi angena ngaphansi kwesibaya esisodwa isib. Ukufunda ngokugeleza nangokuqondisisa imibhalo ebhaliwe. Ephimisa amagama ngokuqaphelisisa uma efunda ephimisa. Efunda ngokuphimisa amagama esebenzisa ukugcizelela okufanele, ephumula, ekhuphula ehlise iphimbo ngendlela efanele. Esebenzisa amakhono akhe okukhumbula nokuqonda ekufundeni iziqephu ezingajwayelekile isib. imisindo, izici zengqikithi, nokubonela phambili. Esebenzisa izindlela eziningi ezizenzelayo, nezokuzibheka nokuzilungisela amaphutha uma efunda njengokuphinde afunde, ukuqhubeka nokufunda ukuthatha ikhefu, ukuzilolongela ukuphimisa igama ngaphambi kokuba alikhiphele phandle.. Ukubona ukuthi amagama apelwa ngezindlela ezahlukile. Ukubona ukuthi igama elipelwe ngendlela okungeyona lingaveza umqondo okungewona isib. Ukubona akwazi nokusho bonke onkamisa abakhona. Ukubona nokuhlukanisa phakathi konkamisa bemvelo nabokuvela. UKUFUNDA NOKUBUKELA Umfundi uzokwazi ukufunda nokubukela ukuze athole ulwazi nokuzijabulisa, ananele ngokuhlaziya izinzwa, ezamasiko kanye nokuyigugu emibhalweni. Ukubona ukuthi onkamisa abanye bayeqiwa kwamanye amabizo njengasegameni "umfana, umfula ". Ukubona ongwaqa abajwayelekile abahlanganayo ekuqaleni noma ekugcineni kwegama. Ukubona akhumbule amagama awabona njalo emphakathini. Anjengo, mina, imoto, efakela negama lakhe nokubhaliwe kundawo akuyo. Ukukhumbula imisindo ephindaphindwayo isib. Ukubona izijobelelo ezithe ukuba nzima (isib -azane, - anyana). Ukubona inani lamagama awabona emphakathini. Ukufunda izincwadi zezithombe nezindaba ezilula azikhethele zona.

Abadlalayo, ababhali, nabakhiqizi baveze izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezikhuthazayo, nezifundisayo. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo phakathi kwabantu, lapho bekhuluma ngendaba yokuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Abathuthukisi baveze izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana, ezifana ne-4K ne-8K, ezithuthukisa ikhwalithi yokubuka. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphendule ngempela, bephakamisa imibuzo mayelana nezindleko, ukufinyelela, kanye nezidingo zokubuka ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, njengokufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkampani ezinkulu ezikhiqiza ithelevishini, ezazikhombisa izindlela ezintsha zokukhangisa. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi, ababhali, nabadlalayo, njengoba izinkampani zifuna izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezizokhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphinde babuke. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi ezithokozisayo, ezihlanganisa izindaba, ubuciko, nezokungcebeleka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde wagxila ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi. Abantu baphakamisa izinkinga ezithinta izinhlelo ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo enkulu, lapho abantu bephakamisa imibono yabo, bephinde bahlola ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
