Ngabhadi limbi kungeke kwakhulunywa okufanayo ngokopeletsheni bezolimo abavelayo. Inselelo enkulu ngukunganeli kwamakhono. Abasebenzi kanye namalungu ebhodi alabo kopeletsheni aswele amakhono jikelele okuphatha ngenxa yokunganeli kokusekelwa kokuqeqeshwa okukhona. Amathuba amabhizinisi amaningi amahle ayalahleka ngoba kunokunganeli kokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nebhodi. Ubunzima bohlobo Iokuphatha okopeletsheni kanye nokubambelela emthethweni okuphoqayo kudinga ukwesekelwa okuphelele kokopeletsheni. Uhlobo olukhulu lobunikazi obuphawula le modeli yebhizinisi bethula ubunzima obuqhubekayo obuvimbela inqubekela phambili kula mabhizinisi. Ukwenziwa kokopeletsheni kuphawulwe ngoHlaka Lwamasu Esikhathi Esimaphakathi (i-MTSF) njengenye yezinkundla ezibekwe phambili ezizoqiniswa ukuba zisize uhulumeni ukuba afeze okukodwa kwezinhloso ngqangi zamasu akhe okuqinisekisa ukuthi kunesu eliphelele lokuthuthukisa izindawo zasemaphandleni elihlobene nenguquko yomhlaba nezolimo kanye nokutholakala kokudla. Ngaphandle uma okopeletsheni bezolimo basekelwa futhi baqinisiwe ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi badlala indima ebalulekile kulo lonke iketanga lokubaluleka kwezolimo, bazokudlala indima engabonakali enqonde ekufezeni izintshisekelo zoHlaka Lamasu Esikhathi Esimaphakathi. Ngakho-ke kuyabaluleka ukuba uhulumeni abeke izilinganiso kanye nezinhlelo zokusekela okopeletsheni bezolimo. Kuwo wonke umhlaba okopeletsheni bezolimo badlale indima ebalulekile ekwakheni iminotho, ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi kanye nasekwenzeni ngcono amazinga empilo yemiphakathi yasemaphandleni.

Izinguquko Zesimo Sezulu: Ingxoxo Yamanje Namuhla, sikhuluma ngezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta izimo zokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu. Lezi zinguquko zithinta imvelo, ukuphila kwethu, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela zethu zokuphila. Sifuna ukuhlola izici ezahlukahlukene ezithinta le ndaba, okuhlanganisa izakhamuzi, umnotho, nezemvelo, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizoletha ukuthula nokuphila kahle. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde izinguquko ezithinta isimo sezulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwanda kokushisa emhlabeni, ukuphazamiseka kwemvula, nezimo zokuphila zamaphilisi. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukushisa komhlaba sekukhuphuke ngamaphesenti amabili eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu edlule, okungabangelwa ukuvela kwemikhuba yokugcina imfucuza, ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokungcola emoyeni. Izizathu eziningi zikhona ezibangela lezi zinguquko, kodwa ubuchwepheshe bethu buphambili bunemiphumela emibi. Izinjini zomkhiqizo, izinto zokwakha, nezinsiza ezisontekile zenza kube nzima ukuthola izixazululo ezilula. Umnotho udinga izinqubomgomo ezizinzile, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Kunemibono eminingi mayelana nezinguquko ezidingekayo, kanti abanye bakholelwa ukuthi kudingeka izinguquko ezinzima ekuphakamiseni imikhuba yokuphila, ukuze sihambisane nemvelo. Naphezu kwemiphumela emibi, abanye bakholelwa ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke nendlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bethu bokuthuthukisa amandla kumele buhlonishwe. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma kahle ngalezi zinguquko; kubalulekile ukuthi sifeze izixazululo ezintsha.

Uma umnikazi wendiza ebika ukulahlekelwa yizincwadi zendiza yakhe evele isebenza, isicelo sentsha siyokwenziwa ngokubhaliwe siqonde kuKhomishani siphelezelwa wumbiko ofungelwe nemininingwane efanele ngenhloso yokuvuselela kabusha izincwadi zendiza. Uma uKhomishani emukela isicelo sezincwadi zokubambela endala, leyo mvume yezintsha iyokwenziwa ingxenye yaphakade yaleyo ncwadi yendiza. Uma ilahlekile incwadi yendiza, Isitifiketi seGunya lokuNdiza noma Igunya lokuNdiza liyothathwa njengento engasasebenzi kuze kufike isikhathi lapho zonke izidingo zokuvula incwadi yesibili engumfakela sezifeziwe. Indiza ngayinye kwiLejista yeziNdiza zaseNingizimu Afrika iyolungiswa ngokulandela uhlelo lokulungisa izindiza olunqunywe ngaphansi komgomo 43.02.8. Umnini wendiza uyodweba noma aqinisekise ngokudweba uhlelo lokulungiswa kwendiza yakhe ngendlela ehambisana nemibandela yeQophelo Elifanele Lomsebenzi 43.02.8 eMqulwini SA-CATS-GMR. Umnini noma inhlangano ebhekele ukulungiswa kwendiza uyothula uhlelo lokulungisa indiza kuKhomishani ukuze alwemukele. Uma uhlelo oluhlongozwayo lokulungisa indiza luhlangabezana nezidingo zeQophelo Elifanele elingu 43.02.8, uKhomishani uyovuma lolo hlelo oluphakanyiswayo ngendlela olwethulwe ngayo noma ngemuva kwezinguquko ezithile ezenziwe nguye noma ngabathize abanentshisekelo ekuphepheni kwemboni yokundiza. Umnini wendiza engacela uKhomishani aguqule okwesikhashana noma ngokugcwele uhlelo oluvele selwemukelwe.

Amaqoqo ezindleko ezivamile ezifana Nokuphatha ihhovisi (isibonelo, izindleko zokushintshelwa kwenye indawo, ukuhamba, ukulala, ihhovisi nokukhokhela ucingo), impahla ethengwayo (imibhalo eshicilelwe, ukuloba, izincwadi, izinsiza zokubhala, izinsiza zasehhovisi) nemishini (amakhompuyutha, imishini elalelwayo, imishini yocingo) kuyoba nomthelela ezindlekweni. Isithebe esethulwe ngezansi sikhombisa futhi siqhathanisa isilinganiso sezindleko zethimba lolimi ngokuhleleka ngesikhathi seMTEF. Ngokubhekela ukuthi iMinyango kuyofanele isebenzise iNLPF ngokwenkambiso yeMTEF, mhlawumbe kungaba wusizo ukuchaza ukuthi yini ebandanyekayo kule nqubo. Inqubo yesabelo sezimali seMTEF iqala ngo-Mbasa ngokuklelisa phambili izinto ezifunekayo nokwenza amalungiselelo ohlaka lwesabelo sezimali. Ukulumbanisa nohlaka olubanzi lwesimo sezomnotho, inqubomgomo yesimo senzalo yezimali neDoR kwenziwa kusukela ngoNtulikazi lapho neKomidi Lokukhokha iziNdleko zoNyaka kuya Kwemithathu (MTEC) liyokwenza khona izincomo zalo. Amalungiselelo esabelo sezimali esigcwele nemibhalo ayokwenzeka ngemuva kokuba uHlaka Lokukhokha iziNdleko zoNyaka kuya Kwemithathu (MTEF) lemukeliwe ngoMfumfu 2003. Ukuthola imithombo yezimali. Iminyango nezifundazwe ziyoba nesibophezelo sesabelo sezimali sokuqhuba umsebenzi osuqalile weNLPF ezinhleni zokuphatha. Abasebenzi bamaThimba eziLimi bayoqashwa yiminyango ebhekene nokuqhuba umsebenzi bese beqeqeshwa ngesikhathi besebenza yiDAC ngokubambisana nabasebenzi bePanSALB. Kuyosungulwa izinhlelo ezihleliwe zokuqeqesha (Bona 2.2.2).

Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlale bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima. Abashayeli bahlala bephazamisekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka. Abantu badinga izimpawu ezicacile, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zemigwaqo ziya ziba zimbi. Umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kodwa imigwaqo ayithuthuki. Lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka, futhi abantu badinga izixazululo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo bakhe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imigwaqo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba kahle. Izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga ukunakwa, futhi abantu badinga izixazululo. Ukugcina imigwaqo iphephile, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezimoto zabo. Abashayeli badinga ukuqonda ukuthi imigwaqo ingase ibe yingozi, futhi kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi bahlala behamba nezinye izimoto. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphele, futhi baziqhenye ngezimoto zabo. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomoya wokuhlanganyela, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ephephile. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga ukunakwa. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomoya wokuhlanganyela, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ephephile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo bakhe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imigwaqo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba kahle. Izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga izixazululo, futhi abantu badinga ukuhamba kahle. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomoya wokuhlanganyela, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ephephile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Ngakho-ke, masithathe izinyathelo zokwakha imigwaqo ephephile, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba kahle. Imininingwane ibalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukuhamba kahle.

Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ngokuphetha, i-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaze impilo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. I-GEMS, ngakho-ke, iyinsika ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elikhanyayo.

Imikhakha yezakhiwo yehlukaniswa ngokwendlela leso sakhiwo esisetshenziswa ngayo ngempela ngokunjalo namarates anqunywa ngokwendlela esisetshenziswa ngayo okwangempela isakhiwo. Inguquko ekusetshenzisweni kwesakhiwo ingadala inguquko emkhakheni isakhiwo esingena kuwona. amalungelo okunweba ezindaweni ezinobunikazi ngokuhlanganyela. Amarates angabalwa akhokhiswe ngokwehlukahlukana ohlobeni lwendawoi ngalunye emikhakheni eyehlukene yezakhiwo. a angawubonelela umkhakha othile wabanikazi bomhlaba noma abanikazi bomkhakha othile womhlaba bangawakhokhi amarates akhokhelwa umhlaba wabo; noma b ephulele noma ehlisele umkhakha othile wabanikazi bomhlaba noma abanikazi bomkhakha othile womhlaba amarates abawakhokhela umhlaba wabo ngokwemibandela eku-7 ngenzansi. UMasipala angaxegisela isibopho sokukhokha, anciphise noma ehlise imali ekhokhwa yimikhakha ethile yabanikazi, kuye ngesimo sendawo. UMasipala angaphinde alehlise ngesinye isilinganiso esengeziwe inani lendawo ngokwesinqumo soMkhandlu kulwabiwomali lwawo lwaminyaka yonke. Lokhu kwehliswa okwengeziwe kwenzelwa ikakhulukazi labo bantu abanemizi enenani eliphansi futhi kuyingxenye yesu likamasipala lokuphungula umthwalo kwabampofu. Inhloso yalokhu kuxegiselwa isibopho sokukhokha ukuphungula umthwalo kubantu asebekhulile abangenelwa yimali emile futhi abanomkhawulo kwabangaba nakho. Eminyakeni emibili edlule bonke abantu asebekhulile baxegiselwa isibopho sokukhokha ukuze belekeleleke ekubhekaneni nenguquko yesisindo sentela esadalwa yiMPRA.

Wafundisa abantu ukuthi impumelelo ayizwakali ngaphandle kokusebenza kanzima, nokuthi izinselelo zingaba yizifundo ezibalulekile. UThandi waba yisithombe sokuthi amaphupho angaphila, futhi abantu baqala ukumbiza ngegama elisha, "UThandi, intombazane yeHollywood." Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yinkanyezi, kodwa wahlala ehlonipha izimpande zakhe. Waqhubeka nokudlala umculo, futhi waba ngumholi wezobuciko, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye. IHollywood, yize iyindawo enezinselelo, yabe iyikhaya lakhe, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya khona, futhi umculo wakhe waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi amaphupho angafezeka uma umuntu esebenza ngokuzikhandla. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi iHollywood iyindawo yokuphila amaphupho, futhi umculo ungaba yindlela yokudlula ezinsizweni. Waqhubeka nokukhanyisa izinkanyezi, eqhubeka nokukhumbuza abantu ukuthi, noma ngabe izinselelo zikhona, uthando nomsebenzi oncomekayo kuzoholela empumelelweni.

Bheka izindawo ezihlukahlukene, njengezindlu ezizimele, amaflats, noma izindawo zokuhlala ezabelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo oyikhethayo ihambisana nebhajethi yakho. Ukufuna Umsebenzi: Sebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole umsebenzi. Ungasebenzisa ama-inthanethi, izikhangiso, noma uxhumane nezinkampani ezikufanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uvuselela i-CV yakho futhi uzilungiselele izingxoxo zomsebenzi. Ukuxhumana Nomphakathi: Xhumana nabantu bendawo ukuze uthole ukuxhaswa. Ungakwazi ukujoyina izinhlelo zomphakathi, izikhungo zokuxhumana, noma izifundo ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uyazizwa uhlelekile endaweni entsha. Isiphetho Ukufuduka kwabantu emakhaya kuya emadolobheni kuyinqubo enezinselelo, kodwa futhi inezinzuzo eziningi. Ngokuqonda izizathu, ukulungiselela kahle, nokwenza izinyathelo ezifanele, abantu bangakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impilo yabo entsha izoba ngempumelelo. Ukuhlonipha izinkolelo zomdabu, ukugcina izixhumanisi zomndeni, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, konke lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni impilo engcono emadolobheni. Ukufuduka akuwona umqondo wokushiya emakhaya kuphela, kodwa kuwumqondo wokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Ukuphuma elolini nakho kwenza umqondo wakho uphaphame futhi kukunika ukuphumula. Inhlanzeko - ukusuka nokuhlala! Yize zingeningi izikhumulo zamaloli ezinezindawo zokugeza, zama ukugeza nsuku zonke. Ukuziphatha ngokuhlanzeka akuyilungele impilo yakho nje kuphela; kodwa kukwenza uzizwe uncwaba futhi unentokomalo. Emgwaqeni lapha ubhekana nezingozi eziningi. Abashayeli bayaqolwa futhi bephucwe nezimoti, njengoba wazi ke. Ngakho ke qaphela uhlale uvule amehlo ngaso sonke isikhathi uqikelele ugweme inhlekelele. Ukuthi iHIV ngenye yezinto eziyingozi enkulu kubashayeli. I-HIV phela yileligciwane elidala isifo sengculazi I-AIDS. Siyingozi kakhulu ke lesi sifo ngoba uma uke wasithola, awube uselapheka futhi nempilo yakho iyafingqeka. Akunjalo Ngeke uthole igciwane le HIV ngoba nakhu ushayela nomuntu onalo emzimbeni wakhe. INgculazi/AIDS ungayithola kuphela uma uya ocansini ungavikelekile kanti lo olele naye usenalo leligciwane noma uma igazi lakho lithintana negazi elinaleligciwane. Kungalesi sizathu ke kufanele ukuthi usebenzise ikhondomu ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho uya ocansini. Kungaleso sizathu ke futhi kufanele ukuthi ugqoke amagilavu uma usiza umuntu olimele. Akunjalo. Ayelapheki I-AIDS. UDokotela ngeke naye ayelaphe. Ngisho nenyanga mbala ngeke ikwelaphe. Empeleni nje akekho ongase akwelaphe uma selikungene leligciwane. Uma usunalo ke kufanele uthole makhambi thizeni futhi welulekwe abezempilo. Kuyiqiniso Owesimame okhulelwe one HIV/AIDS angalidlulisela enganeni yakhe leligciwane, lapho izalwa kumbe ngenkathi eyincelisa.

Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba isifo sofuba sithinta ikakhulukazi abantu abahlala ezindleleni eziphansi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kumaphayiphi emithi yamahhala eluthathwa khona, okusiza ukubuyisela amandla kwabaphila nesifo lokhu, okwenza kube lula ukubagqokisa abathola usizo. Uhlaka lokuxhaswa kwezemiti lubuyekezwa njalo emihlanganweni yakhe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izinga lokulashwa lisebenze kahle. Ukusetshenziswa kwemithi esemthethweni, ngokuhambisana nemigomo esebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abanesifo sofuba bathola usizo olwanele. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ukugqugquzela ukuhlolwa okuvamile kwempilo kubalulekile. Ukuhlolwa kwe-TB kudinga ukuba kube yinto evamile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezizinda eziphakeme zokushayelwa yilesi sifo. Uhlelo lokuhlola oluhlanganisa ukubamba izithombe zokuqagela nokuhlolwa kwe-viral liqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banikela ngeziqu zempilo zabo futhi, uma kungenjalo, bathole ukwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Uhlaka lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwehliseni izinga lokwanda kwesifo. Ukuze kulandwe empumelelweni, izikhungo zezempilo zidinga ukuxhumanisa imisebenzi yazo nemiphakathi, ngokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhuba imiphumela emihle, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukufinyelela olwazini oluthile nokwelashwa okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesoftware nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezinamathuba okubhekana nezinsiza zokwelapha kudinga ukuhlanganyela okunomsoco emazingeni ahlukeneyo, kuhlanganise noHulumeni, ozimele, nabantu basekhaya.

Okokuqala, imiphumela yemvelo iyinkinga enkulu. Ukuvuna izinsiza kudala umonakalo omkhulu emithonjeni yamanzi, emhlabathini, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kubangela ukonakala kwemvelo, okukhathaza kakhulu izakhamuzi ezihlala eduze kwezindawo zokumba. Ukungcola okukhishwa emayini, njengamagesi nemfucumfucu, kubangela izinkinga zempilo kubantu abaseduze. Okwesibili, izimayini zidalela abantu izimo ezinzima zokusebenza. Imisebenzi emayini ivamise ukuba yingozi, futhi izisebenzi zihlala zibhekene nezingozi ezinkulu. Ukushisa, ukungcoliswa, kanye nezingozi zokuhlaselwa yizinto ezinjengemishini yokumba, konke lokhu kudala izimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zikhokhe izindleko ezinkulu zokuvikela izisebenzi, kodwa kwezinye izikhathi, lokhu akwenziwanga ngendlela efanele. Ukubheka Phambili Ukuze sithuthukise izimayini, kudingeka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuphucula izinqubo zokusebenza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo emvelweni. Izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izindlela zokumba ezihlanzekile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela emibi iyancishiswa. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimayini zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuvikela izisebenzi. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanele nokuphathwa kwezimo zokusebenza kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi zikhululekile futhi ziphephile emsebenzini wazo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini, okukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa, izimayini zinezinto ezinhle nezimbi.

Isisebenzi silandele isaziso esisemthethweni , isibonelo, isenqabelo, isaziso sokwephula umthetho, njalonjalo. Isisebenzi sethule ubufakazi eNkantolo Yokwedlulisa izicelo noma enkantolo yomthetho ngodaba oluphathelene nempilo kanye nokuphepha. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuphazamisa noma ukusebenzisa budedengu impahla ebekelwe impokophelelo yezempilo nokuphepha. Isibonelo, akekho ovunyelwe ukususa insiza yokuphepha emshinini bese esebenzisa lowomshini noma avumele noma ngubani ukusebenzisa umshini ngaphandle kwensiza. Ngobani futhi yini abammeli bezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza? Laba ngabantu abasebenza ngokugcwele, bakhethiwe noma baqokiwe base begunyazwa ngokubhaliwe wumqashi ngemuva kokuba umqashi nabasebenzi behlale phansi babonisana baze bafike esivumelwaneni sokuqoka labo abayobamela ezinhlakeni zempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini. Okunye futhi, abakhethiwe kufanele baqonde izimo nezihibe ezikhona endaweni yokusebenza nomsebenzi abaqokelwa wona. Kumele kufinyelelwe ezivumelwaneni mayelana nezikhathi zokuqhuba lomsebenzi kanye nawo qobo lomsebenzi wabameli bezempilo nokuphepha. Konke lokhu kufanele kuvunyelwane ngakho phakathi komqashi nabasebenzi. Bangaki abammeli bezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini okumele baqokwe? Makuqokwe umuntu oyedwa noma ummeli oyedwa njalo ebantwini abangu 20 noma ngaphezulu. Ngakho, uma bengu 19 kuphela abasebenzi, asikho isidingo sokuqoka ummeli. Ezindaweni ezifana nasezitolo nasemahovisi, ilunga elilodwa lokumela lingaqokwa ebasebenzini abangu 100 noma engxenyeni yalokhu. Isibonelo, linye ilunga okumele liqokwe kubasebenzi abasukela ku 21 kuya ku 100 kodwa kumele ebe mabili amalunga eqoqweni labasebenzi abaphakathi kuka 101 kuya ku 200, njalonjalo.

UThandi wajabula kakhulu, kodwa wayezwa ukwesaba. Wayecabanga ukuthi angakwazi yini ukuhamba phambili, futhi ukuthi abantu bazomthanda yini. Kodwa uSipho wamkhuthaza, wathi, "Ungesabi, uThandi. Umculo wakho unamandla, futhi abantu bazowuzwa." Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, uThandi waba yingxenye yephrojekthi enkulu, umculi ophakathi kwezinye izinkanyezi. Umculo wakhe waba yimpumelelo, futhi abantu baqala ukumthanda. Wazi ukuthi wayefezile amaphupho akhe, kodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo, waqala ukuqaphela izinselelo ezazihambisana nalokhu. Njengoba edlula ezinsukwini, uThandi waqala ukubona ukuthi iHollywood ayiyona indawo elula. Abantu abaninzi babefuna ukuhamba phambili, futhi izimbangi zazikhona. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho wayezwa sengathi angakwazi ukuhamba phambili, kodwa wayenokholo. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, waphinde wathola abaxhasi abasha abamthandayo. Ngemuva kokuhamba phambili, uThandi wathola umklomelo omkhulu. Waba yinkanyezi eHollywood, futhi umculo wakhe wawuduma emhlabeni wonke. Kodwa akazange akhohlwe ukuthi uhambo lwakhe lwalungelula. Wazi ukuthi ubumba obukhulu buza nezinsizi, kodwa wathola ukuthi uthando lwakhe lomculo lwalungakwazi ukumthwalisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wakha umphakathi wakhe, waba yisibonelo kwabanye abaculi abasha. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi impumelelo ayizwakali ngaphandle kokusebenza kanzima, nokuthi izinselelo zingaba yizifundo ezibalulekile. UThandi waba yisithombe sokuthi amaphupho angaphila, futhi abantu baqala ukumbiza ngegama elisha, "UThandi, intombazane yeHollywood." Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yinkanyezi, kodwa wahlala ehlonipha izimpande zakhe.

Omunye wemisebenzi yenkundla kuyoba ukuxhumana nokusebenzisana ngezindaba ezithinta ukusebenza kweNqubomgomo yeziLimi. Ngaleyo ndlela, iyogxila kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ihlelo lamagama olimi nemisebenzi yolimi ukuvikela izenzo eziphindekayo nomhlomulo ovelele ezinsizeni ezitshalwe emsebenzini. Kunesiphakamiso sokuba Inkundla yeziLimi zikaZwelonke yemukelwe ngokusemthethweni. Umkhandlu uyoqokwa nguNgqongqoshe wezoBuciko namaSiko, Isayense nobuChwepheshe futhi uyoba nomuntu oqokwe yiDAC, DoJ, PanSALB, SAQA noMkhandlu weMfundo Ephakeme nabantu abayisithupha abaqokwe yizinhlangano ezingochwepheshe emkhakheni wokuguqulela kolunye ulimi umbhalo, ukuhumusha, isayenze yezichazimazwi, ihlelo lamagama, ukulungisa amaphutha embhalweni nomthetho. Amalunga oMkhandlu ayohlala esikhundleni iminyaka emihlanu kodwa angakwazi ukushintsha izikhundla noma ukuqashwa kabusha lapho kuphela isikhathi esibekiwe. Umkhandlu uyoba yisigungu somthetho esisungulwe ngoMthetho weNdlu yeZigele. Inhloso yoMkhandlu Wongcweti beziLimi zaseNingizimu Afrika kuyoba ukuphakamisa isithunzi salo mkhakha nokuvikela iqophelo lomkhiqizo wawo. Uyophinde uvikele amalunga omphakathi asebenzisa umsebenzi wolimi. Umkhandlu Wongcweti beziLimi zaseNingizimu Afrika uyosingatha uqeqesho, ukwemukelwa kongcweti nokubhaliswa kongcweti bezilimi ngomzamo wokukhuphula isithunzi somkhakha wolimi neqophelo lomkhiqizo wolimi. Lokhu kuyokwenziwa ngokumisa amaqophelo athile.

Uma lezi zinto zingahlangani kahle, umphakathi uthola ubunzima bokuphila, okukhuthaza isimo sokungabi namanzi. Umthelela Wesomiso Emiphakathini Isomiso sithinta kakhulu imiphakathi yasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi lezo ezincike kakhulu ekulimaleni nasekukhuleni kwezolimo. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imindeni ikwazi ukuziphilisa. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka, njengoba abantu bephoqwa ukuba baphume emakhaya abo ukuze bafune amathuba okusebenza kwezinye izindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isomiso sithinta impilo yomphakathi. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuhlobene nokwanda kwezifo, njengoba abantu bengenayo imithombo ewusizo yokuhlanza. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezithathelwana kalula, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imiphakathi ibhekane nezinkinga zempilo. Umthelela Wesomiso Emvelweni Ngaphandle komthelela emiphakathini, isomiso sinesithombe esikhulu emvelweni. Izitshalo nezilwane zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule futhi ziphile. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuholela ekwehleni kwezinga lokuphila kwezilwane, okungaholela ekufeni kwazo. Lokhu kubangela ukuguquka kwemvelo, njengoba izilwane zidinga ukuhamba zifuna amanzi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi zihlale ezindaweni ezithile. Isomiso sibuye sibe nomthelela ezinhlelweni zokuphila ezihlukahlukene, njengokuphila kwezilwane zasendle. Uma izilwane zingatholi amanzi anele, ziba sengozini yokuphela. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwezinhlelo zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imvelo ibuyisele emuva. Izixazululo Zokulwa Nesomiso Ukuze siqedele isomiso, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo.

Izimayini: Izinzuzo Nezingozi Izimayini, noma mining, yindlela ebalulekile yokukhipha izinsiza ezisemhlabeni, ezifana nezinsimbi, amalahle, nezinsiza zemvelo. Le mboni inezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi ibhekene nezingqinamba ezithile ezidinga ukucutshungulwa. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nezimayini, ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi le mboni ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yethu. Izinzuzo Zezimayini Okokuqala, izimayini zidlala indima enkulu emnothweni wezwe. Ukukhipha izinsiza ezisemhlabeni kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi, okwenza kube nezisebenzi eziningi ezithola imiholo. Lokhu kuholela ekukhuleni komnotho, njengoba abantu bethola imali yokuphila. Umsebenzi wezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezimboni zidinga lezi zinsiza, futhi lokho kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. Okwesibili, izimayini zenza kube nokwabelana ngempumelelo kwezimali. Izinkampani ezinkulu ezisebenza emayini zikhokha izintela ezinkulu, okukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izikole, izibhedlela, nezinsiza zomphakathi, okwenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimayini zenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, njengoba izinkampani zidinga izindlela ezintsha zokwenza umsebenzi wazo ube lula futhi uphumelele. Izingqinamba Nezingozi Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Izimayini zibuye zibe nezingozi eziningi. Okokuqala, imiphumela yemvelo iyinkinga enkulu. Ukuvuna izinsiza kudala umonakalo omkhulu emithonjeni yamanzi, emhlabathini, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kubangela ukonakala kwemvelo, okukhathaza kakhulu izakhamuzi ezihlala eduze kwezindawo zokumba.

Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel wathuthuka. Kwakukhona abaculi abaninzi ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene, behamba behamba, bejolise ekukhulumeni izindaba zabo. UThandi, umculi owayenothando olukhulu lokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, waba yisibonelo esihle. UThandi wayengumuntu ophila empilweni enezinkinga, kodwa umculo wakhe wawuhamba phambili. Waqala ukucula izingoma ezazikhuluma ngothando lukaNkulunkulu, nokuthi uNkulunkulu uyasithanda, noma ngabe sikhona esikhathini esinzima. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, umoya wokukhuluma, umoya wokukhumbula. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Umculo we-gospel wawungowokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa wawuphinde ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo ezindabeni zabo. Kushicililwe e ngalolusuku lomhlaka.............. Ngenyanga ka .....................ku 20....... Uyakwazi futhi uyakuqonda okuqukethwe kulesisimemezolo esibhaliwe? Uyaphikisana yini nokuthatha isifungo/ngokufunga njengoba kumisiwe? Ngabe isifungo esigciniwe usithatha njengesikubophayo kunembeza wakho na? Ngiyaqinisa ukuthi lona othatha isifungo uvumile ukuthi uyakwazi futhi uyakuqonda okuqukethwe yilesi simemezelo esibhaliwe. Lona othatha isifungo usho lamazwi alandelayo: "ngiyafunga ukuthi lokhu okuqukethwe yilesi simemezelo esibhaliwe kuyiqiniso, inkosi ingisize"/ Ngiqinisile ngiqinisile ngithi lokhu okuqukethwe yilesi simemezelo esibhaliwe kuyiqiniso". Lona othatha isifungo usayinde/wenze uphawu phambi kwami ngikhona. Amagama nesibongo ngokuphelele.

Uma ungazi izitha zakho, ngeke ukwazi ukuzilwela. Uma uthola izinkambu ezintsha ongazazi, kungaba nzima ukusho ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zemibila ezizokhula. Kodwa ngemuva konyaka, kuzoba sobala ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo, futhi uzokwazi ukuzilawula ngaphambi kokukhula. Kufanele uqonde ukuthi imibila inezinhlaka ezibanzi noma izinhlaka ezifanayo nezitshalo. Kungaba usizo uma uthola amagama ezinhlobo zemibila ezikhona enkundleni ethile, bese uzokwazi ukuthola umlayezo ofanele ukuze uzisuse. Uma usebenzisa imishini yokuhlanza, qinisekisa njalo (kokubili emthonjeni nasemva) ukuthi uyashaya yonke imibila. Qaphela ukuthi imikhono ibukhali ukuze kungabi nendawo phakathi kwazo engashiya eminye imibila. Uma inkambu ibhaki kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuhlanza, khumbula ukuthi imibila oyisusa izophinde ikhule. Kufanele wazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi amakhemikhali ozowasebenzisa ngaphambi kokutshala. Qinisekisa ukuthi umshini wokuphalaza usemkhathini omuhle, i-PTO iyasebenza kahle, kukhona igauge elilinganisa ingcindezi, futhi ama-nozzles afanele. Kukho abantu abanolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwemibila. Khumbula ukuthi indlela yokuphatha imibila enezindleko eziphezulu iyindlela engasebenzi. Ungase ungafuni ukukhokha imali, kodwa khumbula: uzolahlekelwa kakhulu. Amakhemikhali awahlukanisi uhlobo lwezithombo angasetshenziswa kuzo (njengeRoundup noma iGramoxone), noma ungahlanzisa ngemishe. Khumbula uma sikhuluma ngamakhemikhali angakhethi, azobulalela zonke izitshalo eziluhlaza kule nkambu. Qaphela uma usebenzisa lawa makhemikhali ngoba uma usuwasebenzisile, ngeke ukwazi ukuwasusa emhlabathini.

Kunezimakethe eziningi ze-bio-fuel eduze kwezindawo ezikhiqiza ummbila nezinsimbi ezweni lethu, nasezindaweni lapho kukhona ukudla njenge-barley, i-triticale, noma i-wheat ezingasekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel. Ukuze sivalwe umgomo phakathi kokuhlinzekwa kokudla nokuthi yini ebiza kakhulu, kufanele sithole ukuqhubeka okuzoletha inzuzo enhle kubakhiqizi. Uma kuvunyelwe ukuba sithuthuke ngokukhululekile, sikholelwa ukuthi iminikelo ekukhiqizeni i-bio-fuel izovuselela ikhono lokukhulisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo. Lokhu kuzovimbela ukwehla kwenani lemikhiqizo yokudla kanye nezinsimbi zamafutha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzovuselela amathuba okuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezolimo ozosiza abantu bethu basemaphandleni. Umphakathi womhlaba kufanele ubone ukuthi i-South Africa ikwazi ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Lokhu akuzokweseka kuphela izimiso ze-ASGISA kodwa kuzosekela nezika-NEPAD ezizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.

Uma inkantolo ikholwa umbiko, kanye nanoma iyiphi enye imininingwane mayelana nabazali abafuna ukufaka ingane ngokomthetho, ingase, ngokuthanda kwayo, ivume isicelo futhi ikhiphe i-oda yokufakwa ngaphandle kokulalela omunye umuntu. Nokho, ingakwenza kuphela uma kungekho muntu ophikisa isicelo. Uma isicelo singaqedwa, noma asikaphelwanga, kuzobekwa usuku lokulalela isicelo enkantolo yezingane. Umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane uzokhipha isaziso kuFomu 1A Isaziso kubazali abafuna ukufaka ukuze bazi abazali bezinhliziyo zengane mayelana nolalelo lwesicelo sokufakwa. Abazali bezinhliziyo zengane ngeke babe nelungelo lokuba khona enkantolo ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba lokufakwa kwengane yabo, ngaphandle kokuthi inkantolo, ngokuthanda kwayo, ivumele ukuba bakhona, uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi ukuba khona kwabo kuzohlangabezana nezidingo zengane. Inkantolo ingacela abazali noma umgadi wengane ukuba banikeze imvume ebhaliwe. Inkantolo ingase futhi icela imvume ebhaliwe enganeni uma seziphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi, futhi inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi ingane iyayiqonda indaba kanye nokubaluleka kwemvume. Uma kunoma yisiphi isikhawu sokulalela, uma inkantolo ithola ukuthi kunezizathu eziphakeme zokuthi imvume ebhaliwe engabazali bezinhliziyo zengane ingafunwa, inkantolo ingacela umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane ukuba ikhiphe isaziso noma iFomu 22 Isaziso kubazali ukuze bathumele izizathu ngokuhambisana nemigomo 21, 21 kulowo bazali. Isaziso sizocela abazali ukuba babe khona enkantolo yezingane uma befuna ukuveza izizathu zokuthi imvume yabo ingabekwa eceleni.

Lo mthetho uqala ukusebenza ngosuku lokuqala lwezinhlinzeko zokuhlola umthelela wezimo, zika-2006 ezasungulwa ngaphansi kwengxenye 24 yeMthetho, ezashicilelwa kuMbiko Wokuhulumeni No R. 385 ka-2006. Indawo yokumbiwa ithathwa njengendawo echazwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokuphehla, u-2002 Umthetho No. Ukuhweba kwemigodi kusho ukusebenza njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokuphehla, u-2002 Umthetho No. Ilungelo lokwenza ukuhweba kwemigodi lisho ilungelo njengoba lichazwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokuphehla, u-2002 Umthetho No. Lo Mthetho ubonisa iMithetho Yokuphathwa Kwezimo Zomhlaba, u-1998 Umthetho No. Izinqubomgomo zisho Izinqubomgomo Zokuhlola Umthelela Wezimo, u-2006. Noma iyiphi uhlelo noma umsebenzi odinga imvume noma igunya ngaphansi komthetho ophatha ukukhululwa kwemithombo, ukungcoliswa, udoti, noma ukulahla futhi engakadalulwa kuMbiko Wokuhulumeni No. R. Igunya elifanele lezi zenzakalo ezibalwe kule ngxenye yeshejuli nguMnyango wezokuhlala endaweni lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa khona ngaphandle uma kuyisicelo sephrojekthi njengoba kucatshangwa ngaphansi kwengxenye 24C yeMthetho, lapho igunya linguNgqongqoshe noma ilungu leziphathimandla elithunywe njengokunjalo ngokuhambisana nengxenye 42 yeMthetho njengoba kuhlelwe kabusha.

Uma kudingeka ukunciphisa isikhundla somsebenzi, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo yokuvimbela lokho ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile kulowo msebenzi. Izinqubo zokuhola kufanele ziqinisekise ubulungiswa, ukungacwaswa, nokufinyelela kumathuba, kanye nokuba nesigaba esisebenzela umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Zonke izikhala kufanele zivuleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, inkolo, ubuzwe, izinkolelo zezombusazwe, isiko, ubudala, ulimi, ukungasebenzi, isimo somshado, nezinye izimo ezihlukahlukene. Izikhangiso kufanele zicacise kahle ukuthi iSikhungo Sezikhungo Zomphakathi sizibophezele ekungacwasweni emsebenzini, ekuvumelaneni kwabasebenzi, futhi ukuthi izicelo ezivela ezindaweni ezithile zomphakathi ezake zaba nezinselelo zikhuthazwa. Izinga elisetshenzisiwe lapho kukhethwa abasebenzi kufanele libe nolungile futhi lihlobene nezidingo zomsebenzi futhi kufanele lisetshenziswe ngokuqhubekayo ngezikhathi zonke. Inqubo yokuhola izobandakanya wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nalabo abavela ezindaweni eziphansi nezomphakathi, futhi nakuba bamenywa ukuba bafake izicelo zemisebenzi, akufanele bacwaswe futhi kufanele baphathwe ngendlela efanele futhi enhlonipho. Uma umuntu engenayo imfundo edingekayo, iziqu, noma amakhono olimi, noma ufunde ngaphezu kwezidingo zomsebenzi, noma usebenze isikhathi eside, zonke lezi zinto ezingahlangene nomsebenzi akufanele zibe izizathu zokukhetha umuntu ophuma emphakathini owake waba nezinselelo, futhi ngenxa yalokho, amathuba abantu abavela ezindaweni eziphansi akufanele ancishiswe.

Ukwabelana ngokukhula kubheka ukuthi ukukhula kodwa kuyadingeka kodwa akusona isimo esanele. Inhlangano yavumelana ukuba ihlukane ngesikhathi esifanele esivumela lokho, yase iyala amalungu ukuba ake angene kwi-ANC okwesikhashana. Lona wumsebenzi omumethe okuningi, lapho izakhamuzi zikwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni eziningi ezihlinzekwe wuhulumeni eduze nalapho zihlala khona. Ithuba lokuqala liyonikwa amathuba entuthuko yomnotho wezindawo ezakhele ugu kanye nemisebenzi encike kulokhu. UMnyango wezoLimo kanye ne-Cape Women's Forum nabo baba nezidlo zasekuseni esifundazweni sonke ukuhlonipha abasifazane abasebenza emapulazini. Umkhakha wezimboni e-Angola uhlelwe kabusha ukuze uhlangabezane namazinga amazwe omhlaba. Intsha ihuhekela ezintweni zobugebengu isencane ibe ihlukumezeka ngaso leso sikhathi. Inani labantu abaqashiwe liyenyuka ngengxenye yesigidi eminyakeni emithathu eyedlule. Unombono oxakile ngezehlakalo kanti awuvumelani nalokho okwenzeka ecaleni elathatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili eNatali. Idiski eyi-off-set ingasetshenziselwa ukususa izinto zokutshala i-kikuyu kanjalo nokufaka izinto emhlabathini. Ukuhlola okusabalele nokucwaninga okunezinzuzo zemali ukusiza ukwakha izizinda zokusebenza kwenziwa kubhekwe yiNyuvesi yase-North West University. Ujenga lwezimoto ku-Victoria Embankment eThekwini lwama nse isikhathi esingamahora amane ngoLwesithathu. Waphinde wakhuluma nabasebenzi enkanijni yeNhlangano yeZizwe e-Gaza nge-video-conference.

Inqobo nje uma le likheli elingenhla lingashintshwa ngokubhalwe phansi linikezwe leli elinye iqembu, bese liqala ukusebenza emva kwezinsuku eziyishumi sinikeziwe isaziso: Inqobo nje uma ikheli elisha elikhethiwe yiqembu lizobe nalo lingaphansi kwendawo lapho kunokuhanjiswa khona amaphepha. Noma yisiphi isaziso esinikeziwe maqondana nale SIVUMELWANO singahanjiswa ngesandla, noma sithunyelwe ngeposi elikhokhelwe: Inqobo nje uma noma yisiphi isaziso nomaamaphepha ahanjiswe kwiqembu maqondana nanoma yiluphi udaba noma isihloko kule SIVUMELWANO nanoma yisiphi isaziso siyothathwa njengesidlulisiwe uma sinikezwe umuntu omdala ekhelini lomthetho elikhethwe yinoma yiliphi lamaqembu futhi angeke kube nesidingo sokunikeza iqembu ngqo. ngosuku lwesikhombisa kusukela osukwini lokuyiposa, okubala usuku lokuyiposa, uma iposwe ngokurejistiwe; futhi ngosuku ethunyelwe ngalo uma ithunyelwe ngefeksi. Noma yisiphi isinyathelo esibopha u-SAPS, kufanele sithathwe ngokwesigaba esifanele nesisemthethweni somThetho wamaPhoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, ka 1995 (umThetho onguNombolo 68 ka 1995), noma owelama wona emthethweni. Ukuthi, okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO uchazelwe kona OWENKONTILEKA. Ukuthi, SIVUMELWANO uyavuma ukuthi uyakuqonda konke okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO.

UDokotela Wouter Basson wayeyinhloko yesikhungo, uDokotela Philip Mijburgh kanti kwakunabanye odokotela nenqwaba yezincwadi ezikhishwa. Izinqwatshana zeziqhumane zatholakla kumsolwa kanjalo nemali okucatshangwa ukuthi yantshontshwa emshinini yemali. Ukuxolisa ngenhliziyo yonke kubalulekile kanti lokho kufaka nokukhokhela ukulungisa okukhulu kulabo abahlomula kuhulumeni wobandlululo ukunabakhokhi bentela. Ukubamba iqhaza ngamandla emisebenzini yezinhlaka zomhlaba ezimele ukubheka ukuhlolwa kweziqu, ikakhulukazi kwi-IAF kanye ne-ILAC. Okumele kulethwe kufaka nokusayina ukudwetshwa kwezindawo amarobhothi kanye nokuphuculwa kwemigwaqo. Sino-Superintendent Skosana osuka ebhokisini lokuphekwa ngemibuzo. Imali estshenziswayo ibizwa nge-Kina eshintsheka kalula. Sasihlala njengomndeni owodwa noWinnie kanye noTembe kanye nobhuti wami ekhaya. Izincwadi ezibekwe eceleni zingavuselelwa ngaphandle uma kukhona obevele esezivuselele. Ngicabanga ukuthi ama-Scorpions awuphiko olwakhiwe ngokukhethekile? Laba basolwa abathathu babehlobene namacala anjengawokugqekeza, ukuhlasela amaphoyisa kanye nokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni. Ngokucabanga kwami emva kwekhona likaCurrey kanye noSivewright kuzoba namaleyni amane njengoba indawo ebibekelwe izitatanyiswa isivuliwe? Abafundi sebefukamele irenki yamatekisi, bakhanda ibhilidi elicekelwe phansi, batshala endaweni, baqala izinhlelo zokuhlanza indawo, bathola izingane ezineminyaka engaphezu kweyisithupha ezingafundi. Lokhu kwehluka kumele kufakwe kwi-NQF ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyafinyeleleka, kuyahambisaneka futhi kutholakala imfundo nokuqeqeshwa kwesikhathi eside.

Ingxenye 3 yeMthetho ibeka ukuthi umthetho wezintela uzophumelela ngosuku lokuqala lwezintela olwakhiwe yiMuniisipali ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Lo mbhalo uchaza umthetho we eThekwini Municipality futhi kufanele ufundwe ndawonye ne-MPRA. Ngokulandela umthetho wezintela, iMuniisipali izohlangabezana nezidingo ze-MPRA kanye ne-MFMA, kuhlanganise nanoma yiziphi izinhlinzeko ngaphansi kwalezi zMthetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le mthetho isebenza kulokhu okulandelayo. Umhlaba wezolimo ungumhlaba noma izakhiwo ezibambe isiqinisekiso sezolimo. I-Bed & Breakfast iyindawo yokuhlala enamagumbi okwamukela izivakashi angama-4. Isikhathi sokukhokha izintela kusukela ekuqaleni sibhaliwe njengedebhithi kuze kube usuku lokukhokha. Indlu yokwamukela izivakashi iyindawo yokuhlala enamagumbi okwamukela izivakashi phakathi kwe-5 no-10. Umuntu omdala ungumuntu oneminyaka engaphezu kweyi-60. Impahla lapho umnikazi ehlala khona iyimpahla umnikazi ayihlala kuyo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Isikole esingekho phansi kwemali siyi-sikole esizimele noma esingekho kuhulumeni esibhalisa abafundi kusukela ezingeni le-0 kuya kwele-12 esingatholi uxhaso olukhulu kuhulumeni. Izinga liyintela ethathwa yiMuniisipali emhlabeni, njengoba kulindelekile esigabeni 229 (a) soMthethosisekelo.

Isinyathelo 7: Ukuzithokozisa Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuzithokozisa. Imfashini nobuhle akufanele kube umthwalo, kodwa kufanele kube yindlela yokuziveza. Zama izinto ezintsha, udlale ngemibala, futhi ungazithokozisi uma ungathandi okuthile. Ukuzithokozisa kuzokwenza ube nekhono lokwakha isitayela esihamba phambili. Isiphetho Imfashini nobuhle kuyindlela yokuziveza, futhi kufanele kube yinto ethokozisayo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha isitayela esihle, esihambisana nezidingo zakho, futhi esikhombisa ubuhle bakho. Khumbula, ubuhle bukhona ngaphakathi, futhi imfashini iyindlela yokukubonisa. Qhubeka uzithokozise, futhi ungavumeli imfashini ikuphazamise. Ubuqotho bakho bukhulu, futhi kufanele bukhanye.

Amazinga ephrotheni ezinhlotsheni eziningi avamise ukuba khona ebusika. UMokoena wajeziswa ngesikhathi egxuma okwesibili, egijimela emgodini emva kokukhubeka. Uma ukufunda ngokucophelela idatha kuqubula imibuzo ngokubaluleka kwenqubomgomo nokuqalisa ukusebenza kwayo, lokho kuyosho ukuthi idatha iphethe lukhulu. Lawo makhasimende lapho ushintsho oludingekayo lungakaqaliswa, ayokwaziswa ngaphambi kokuba ushintsho lufike. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi ingxenye yenkinga ibuye ibe nokukwazi kwabafundi ukulandela imiyalelo yolimi. Lo mumo obalulekile usunesikhathi uyinqubo ye-ANC, kusukela isesekudingisweni kuze kube yimanje kuhulumeni. Emphakathini ogxile olwazini, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezibalo kanye nokuphuculwa kwezintshisekelo ezithile kuyohlala kunamandla. Indawo entsha evikelekile iyosiza ukukwaziukuqhubezela intuthuko yendlela entsha yokukhokhwa kwezimali namasu okwandisa imali. Ucwaningo, ukubika kanye nokuhlola kuhlobene nokuQoqwa nokuHlolwa kweDatha, ngakho womabili amaqembu ayasebenzisana. Isimo amazwe amaningi abhekana naso wukubhekana nezidingo zokuthi esikuthunyiwe kususelwe ezintweni eziphathekayo ezisekelwe emphumeleni. Uma sibheka imibono emayelana nezempilo kanye nokuphepha okuhlobene nemboni yezikhali zenunzi, uhulumeni ukholelwa wukuthi ukuhlola okungachemile kulokhu kuyadingeka. Iphrojekthi kumele ibe seqhulwini lokuthuthukiswa kokuhlosiwe wumnyango okungukuthi ugu. Izimboni zezinhlanzi eNingizimu Afrikha zisetshenziswa kakhulu yilabo abdobela ukuziphilisa nalabo abakwenza samdlalo kanjalo nokuqooqa okokucusha.

Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV Licence ye-SABC Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wahlangana emcimbini obalulekile owayenzelwe ukuxoxa ngezimpikiswano eziphakanyiswe ngoxhaso lwe-TV licence ye-SABC. Lo mcimbi, owawubanjelwe eGoli, waba nethuba lokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nabamele izinkampani, abezindaba, nabantu abajwayelekile, ukuze baxoxe ngale ndaba ebalulekile. I-SABC, okuyinhlangano enkulu yokukhangisa eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nokho, izinkinga ezithinta ukungabikhona kwemali, ukunganeliseki kwabathengi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali zikhuluma kakhulu emiphakathini. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yeMenenja ye-SABC, uNkk. Thandiwe Mthembu, owakhuluma ngokuqinile ngendaba yokuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence akusizi kuphela i-SABC, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi onolwazi. Uthe, "Uma singatholi uxhaso olufanele, sizobe sithola ubunzima ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezifundisayo." Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano phakathi kwabantu ababephakathi, abanye bephikisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kufanele kube okwenziwe ngababhalisile kuphela, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhasa. Uhlelo lwemibono lwaluhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nababukeli, abezindaba, nabaphathi bezokuxhumana.

Uma usulitholile leligciwane unesibopho sokuthi ungalidluliseli kumkakho kumbe omunye umlingani wakho ngokocansi. Ukhumbule ke ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi uma uya ocansini usebenzise ijazi likamkhwenyana/ikhondomu. Kuyiqiniso Abantu abanezifo zocansi (amaSTD) kulula kakhulu ukuba batholwe yigciwane le HIV uma beya ocansini nomuntu onalo leligciwane. Abalingani babo ngokocansi basengcupheni embi yokutholwa yi- HIV/AIDS. Uma unesifo socansi, shesha uthole ukwalulekwa ngabezempilo. Izifo zocansi ziyelapheka ngaphandle kwezindleko nangaphandle kobuhlungu. Khuluma ukhululeke nalowo ongumlingani wakho kwezocansi (kumbe abalingani ke) ngenkinga yakho futhi ubakhuthaze ukuthi nabo bakhulume ngayo. Uthole kwakungaki ke ngenkathi uhlolwa? Ulwazi lwakho nge HIV/AIDS luhle kakhulu futhi uyazi ukuthi ungakugwema kanjani ukutholwa yileli gciwane. Kodwa ke, yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi awuyi ocansini ungavikelekile. Bukisisa izimpendulo ongazitholanga. Qinisekisa ukuthi awuyi ocansini ungavikelekile ngejazi likamkhwenyana/ikhondomu. Zinike isibopho nangaphezulu. Qinisekisa futhi ukuthi noma yini oyenzayo ayizukukubeka engcupheni nasengozini yokutholwa yileli gciwane. Kufanele uthole olunye ulwazi. Kanti imithombo yalolo lwazi yilena: abaqashi, imitholampilo, izibhedlela, izikhungo zezempilo eziseca komgwaqo, abeluleki ngocingo beAIDS. Ngingazivikela kanjani ke mina? Mazi umlingani wakho ngokocansi. Ingozi yokuthola igciwane lesandulela-ngculazi/ HIV inkulu uma ungamazi kahle lowo oya naye ocansini. Abantu abaningi abanaleli gciwane abazi ukuthi banalo.

Iziguli ezelashelwa isifo sofuba negciwane lesandulela ngculaza, izingane ezingondlekile nomama abancelisayo abangaphansi kohlelo lokuvikela ukuhaqeka kwengane encelayo uma umama enegciwaneolwaziwa nge-PMTCT zemukeliswe amaphasela okudla esigabeni sokuqala nesesibili salo nyaka wezimali esedlule. Ngenxa yokushodakwezimali lezi ziguli bese zilokhu zinikezwa iphalishi elicolekile ukwelekelela indlela abadla ngayo. Zibalelwa ku 130 000 ezinikezwa leliphalishi ngesigaba esisodwa sonyaka. Besilokhu sikhipha nokudla okunezakhamzimba ezisemqoka kulezo ziguli ezinesandulela ngculazi. Umgomo omuhle wokulwa nesifo kumele uncike ekwakheni umzimba owondlekile ngokwemvelo; kodwa hhayi umzimba osuphila ngokwakhiwa ubuchule bodokotela phezu kwamasosha omzimba abuthakathaka; okungenani, ukuwakha ngokuhlangisa zonke izidingo ezidingwa umzimba oziphilelayo ngokwendalo. Sihlalo oHloniphekile, ngicela ukunxusa kumaLungu esiShayamthetho ukuba aphile impilo engcono yokuzijwayeza ukuhamba, ukuzivocavoca nokudla ngendlela efanele bese bekhetha ukungasondelani nokubhema, ukuqhelelana nophuzo kanye nezidakamizwa. UMnyango wezeMpilo usuhlanganise amaqhinga anzulu nezikhungo ezithize zomphakathi abhekiswe ekukhuthazeni impilo engcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikole, imitholampilo, izibhedlela, emakhaya nasemisebenzini. Phezu kwalokho, iNyuvesi iphinde yenze nocwaningo lokuthi lolu hlelo lunomthelela kangakanani empilweni yabafundi.

Manganyi Abraham uphakamise ukuthi umhlangano wamukele imizuzu, futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. Nxumalo Themba. UMongameli wemihlangano wethula izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2008, zokwamukelwa futhi wazisa umhlangano ukuthi amalungu anikezwa izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe ngaphambi komhlangano. UMongameli watshela amalungu abukhoma ukuthi ngokuhambisana namafomu amelelayo amukelwe, amalungu angama-205 avote ekwamukeleni izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ka-2008 ngenkathi kungekho ilungu elivote ngokumelene nokwamukelwa kwezitatimende zezimali. Amalungu amabili afuna ukuhamba phambili ekuvoteni. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi inqubo yokuvula izikhangiso ilandelwe ukuze kuqashwe inkampani ye-auditors yangaphandle ukuze iqashwe njengama-auditors angaphandle eMihlangano unyaka wezezimali ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2009. IMihlangano yaqhubeka nokukhula ngo-2009 nangaphezulu kwalokhu kukhula okuqhubekayo, usayizi jikelele webhizinisi nezinkinga ezavela, kube nempumelelo enkulu eyenzeka ngo-2009. IBhodi Yabaphathi ye-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngentuthuko eyenziwe yiMihlangano nokuthi izinkinga ezavela ngo-2009 zaphathwa kanjani nokuthi izindaba ezisemqoka zamalungu ngaphansi kwe-GEMS zivikela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngamathuba alinganayo ukuze babe nezinzuzo zempilo ezibizayo. Uhlelo lokuphathwa kweMihlangano oluqinile ludinge ukusungulwa kohlelo lwecebo lesikhashana nelide oluhola futhi lukhombise ibhizinisi leMihlangano.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuza kungaba nomthelela ongemuhle ezimpilweni zabantu abathintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma imininingwane ehambisana nezokuphepha kube khona. Umbuzo 4: Yini okungaqhathaniswa nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukuvuza? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa abasebenzi ngokubaluleka kokugcina izimfihlo, ukuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuvikela, njengokufaka amakhodi okungena, ukuhlola ukuphathwa kwesistimu, nokuphatha ngokuphepha amafayela anemininingwane ebalulekile. Umbuzo 5: Yini umthelela wokuqhamuka kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni emhlabeni wonke? Impendulo: Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni akugcini nje kuphela endaweni ethile, kepha kuthinta abantu emhlabeni wonke. Imininingwane ethunyelwa ngaphandle ingase ibangele ukungathembeki phakathi kwezinkampani, kuthumele imibuzo mayelana nokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zemali, futhi kudale ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kumakhasimende. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ezinkampanini ezinkulu, lapho ukuphathwa kwemali kudinga ukuqashelwa okukhulu. Umbuzo 6: Ziyini izinyathelo okumele zithathwe uma ukuvuza kwenzeka? Impendulo: Uma ukuvuza kwenzeka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezisheshayo zokubhekana nakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusiza abathintekayo, ukuvula uphenyo olunembile, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zihlanzwe. Ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukulawula lezi zinkinga, izinkampani kufanele zikhumbule ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluccelayo futhi ziqikelele ukusiza abathintekayo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izibonelo ezidumile zokuvuza kwamaphepha?

Indlela abantu abesilisa kwekhulu abesilisa. Ngabe lokhu kubangwa yini? Ngokusho kukaNzuza lokhu kubangelwa yizinto eziningi okubalwa kuzo indlela azibheka ngayo amadoda emphakathini. UNzuza uthi kokhona izigameko lapho izithandani ikakhulukazi ezamadoda zingafuni khona ukubonakala zidla imishanguzo ngendlela yokuthi baze baqome ukuthi bantshontshe leyo enikezwe omkabo. Omunye weziguli zethu weza kithi ekhala ngokuthi imithi yakhe iyanyamala. Ngesikhathi senza uphenyo sathola ukuthi umyeni wakhe kade entshontsha amaphilisi akhe. Sase siyamchazela ke ukuthi kuyingozi kangakanani ukungayilandeli imigomo uma usebenzisa imishanguzo njengoba igcine ingasasebenzi kuchaza uNkk Nzuza. Umnyango weZempilo usunxusa abesilisa ukuthi nabo balusebenzise uhlelo lukahulumeni lokuthola imishanguzo mahhala. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezikhona ohlelweni lwemishanguzo zokungalandeli kahle indlela yokusebenzisa imithi, uhlelo luhamba kahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zitholakala kuzo zonke iziyingi ezingu-11 kulesi sifundazwe. Lezi zikhungo zinezinhlelo ezibhekelela abadala, izingane kanye nabesimame abakhululwe. UNzuza uthi abantu abanikezwa imishanguzo yilabo abane-CD 4 count engaphansi kuka-200. Inani legciwane lengculazi emzimbeni womuntu libizwa nge-viral load. Odokotela baye babheke inani le-viral load emzimbeni uma belapha isiguli ngoba ukwehla kwayo kusho ukuthi imithi iyasebenza. Ukwenyuka kwe-viral load emzimbeni womuntu osebenzisa imishanguzo, kungabangelwa ukuthi isiguli sesinekinga yokuthi imithi ayisasebenzi kuso noma ukuthi imithi ayithathwa ngendlela. Imishanguzo isebenza kahle uma ithathwa njengokomyalelo womhlengikazi noma udokotela.

Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kudingeka imizamo eqhubekayo yokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuvota. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, ukwakha izikhungo zokuvota ezikahle, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ekugcineni, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu babe neqhaza elikhulu, bazi kahle amalungelo abo, futhi bahlale bexhumene nezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka imizamo eqhubekayo yokufundisa, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuhlanganyela. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha intando yeningi eqinile, lapho izwi labantu lisizwa, futhi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izifiso nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube namandla, ube neqhaza, futhi ube nempilo engcono.

Uhlelo lokuvikela lwalowo mkhumbi kungalandelangwa ngaphandle uma izinyathelo okukhulunywa ngazo kulolo hlelo lwezokuvikela olwandle zisetshenziswa. Umyalo wezokuvikela unikezwa mayelana nechweba, umkhumbi, indawo, obambe iqhaza noma umsebenzi, amazinga ezokuvikela akhona kuyaqhubeka nokusetshenziswa. Uma ngabe uMqondisi-jikelele ememezela ukuthi ezokuvikela olwandle izinga elisetshenziswayo lechweba elithile, uMqondisi-Jikelele ngokushesha angazisa... i olawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemincele yechweba lwezokuvikela olwandle ii osebenza ngaphakathi kwemincele yechweba lezokuvikela olwandle. i lawula indawo engaphakathi komncele wechweba wezokuvikela; noma ii osebenza ngaphakathi kwemincele yechweba elilawulwa ngezokuvikela; futhi b induna yomkhumbi olawulwa ngezokuvikela kulelo chweba noma mayelana nokungena kulelo chweba. Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi ehluleka ukulandela umthethonkambiso- 3, uyobe esenze icala okuyothi uma elahlwe icala ahlawuliswe imali noma avalelwe ejele isikhathi esengevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12. Umthethonkambiso 3 awusebenzi uma umsebenzi womkhumbi enesizathu esizwakalayo. a umsebenzi walowo mkhumbi; noma b induna yomkhumbi. Uma uMqondisiJikelele azisa umsebenzi womkhumbi njengoba kushiwo kumthethonkambiso 1 ngenhla, umsebenzi womkhumbi kufanele ngokushesha adlulisele leso saziso kwinduna yomkhumbi othintekayo. Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi ehluleka ukulandela lokho okushiwo kumthethonkambiso 2 ngenhla, uyobe esenze icala, okuyothi uma elahlwa yicala ahlawuliswe inhlawulo noma avalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12.

umphathi kamasipalati kufanele athumele zonke izaziso zokuphikisa kumhloli kamasipalati ngaphandle kokuthandabuza, yena oyobe esethatha isinqumo sokudalula lezo zaziso ngokulandisa kwesigaba. ukufakwa kwesicelo sokuphikisa akusho ukwelulelwa isikhathi sokhokha intela yendawo sedlule leso ebesinqunyiwe. b athathe izinqumo mayelana nezimpikiswano ngokulandela amaphuzu, kubandakanya amaphuzu ethulwe yilowo ophikisayo, nokuthi uma umuntu ophikisayo engeyena umnikazi; aphinde c ahlele amaphepha okuhlola ngokulandela izinqumo ezithathiwe. b abuyise isikweletu noma akhokhele umuntu ofanele ukukhokhela intela yemali yendawo, imali engumehluko ngokulandisa kwesigaba- a. a umhloli kamasipalati kufanele anikeze umphathi kamasipalati izizathu ezibhalwe phansi; nokuthi b umphathi kamasipalati kufanele athumele isinqumo salowo mhloli kamasipalati emkhandlwini oqondile wokudlulisela izimpikiswano izizathu zesinqumo kanye nazozonke izincwadi eziphathelene nalokhu ukuba kubuyekuzwe. a wesinqumo somhloli; futhi b nanoma yikuphi ukulungisa okwenziwe emaphepheni okuhlola kulandela isinqumo. esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu sesaziso saloluhlobo, lowo ophikisayo noma umnikazi angase afake isicelo kumhloli kamasipalati acele izizathu zalesi sinqumo. umhloli kamasipalati kufanele esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokuthola isicelo saloluhlobo, anikeze izizathu ngokuzibhala phansi emva kokukhokhwa kwemali enqunyiwe. b kuthinteke umnikazi wempahla ngaleso sinqumo; noma c kuthinteke umkhandlu kamasipalati mayelana nesinqumo salolu hlobo.

ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe ilungu lesigungu esikhulu angelula isikhathi sokufakwa kwamanani entela yendawo okukhulunywa ngako esigatshaneni 1 esikhathini esithi uma sihlanganiswe nesasekuqaleni singevi eminyakeni yezimali eyisithupha. uma kwelulwa isikhathi sokufakwa kwentela yendawo, ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe wohulumeni basekhaya kufanele asho izinga lobuningi bokugcina ngokwamamaphesenti benani lentela yendawo obukhokhwa unyaka nonyaka wezimali esikhathini esengeziwe. a ungahlonza indawo ethile phansi kwawo njengendawo enentela eyehlukile; bese b eklama intela yendawo eyengeziwe empahleni ekuleyo ndawo mayelana nezinhloso zokukhokhelwa ukwenziwa ngcono kwaleyo ndawo. b kufanele athole imvume yeningi lamalungu omphakathi waleyo ndawo ephakanyiswe njengenentela yendawo eyehlukile engase idingeke emnikelweni wokwengezwa kwentela yendawo; bese c esungula ikomiti elakhiwe ngabantu abamele umphakathi waleyo ndawo ukuze babe yisigcawu sokweluleka salowo masipalati mayelana nokwenziwa ngcono okufanele kwenziwe emphakathini, futhi kubhekelwe ukumeleka ngokobulili ngesikhathi kusungulwa ikomiti laloluhlobo. b acacise loko okufanele kwenziwe ngcono kuleyo ndawo; bese c esungula izinhlelo ezehlukile ezimayelana nokubala kanye nokugcinwa kwamabhuku amayelana nemali engeniswe yimali eyengeziwe yentela yokukhokhela indawo kanye nokwenziwa ngcono kuleyo ndawo. isigatshana 1 kasiwenqabeli umasipalati ekusebenziseni izinsiza zawo ezithathwe kweminye imithombo yawo engabandakanyi ukwengezwa kwentela yendawo yokukhokhela ukwenziwa ngcono kwanoma iyiphi indawo engaphansi kwalowo masipalati, kubandakanya nendawo enentele yendawo eyahlukile.

Ubuqotho bokwakha umphakathi obumbene busekelwe ekutheni intsha ibonakale futhi ibonakale. Bika icala ngamagama akho ngokucacile nangokunembile. Awuvunyelwe ukubuza imibuzo phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, ngemvume yomphakathi, ungabuza imibuzo embalwa kumphikisi. Lalela kahle umphikisi uma echaza, futhi uma ucabanga ukuthi abakhulumi kahle, qaphela noma yiziphi izingxenye ukuze uzilethele emqondweni womphakathi. Uma umphakathi esekhulume ngalokho okukhuluma wena nomphikisi kanye nabafakizolo abangase babe khona, inkantolo izokhipha isinqumo. Umphakathi angase akwazise ukuthi uzokuthumelela isinqumo sabo ngokubhala kamuva. Akekho ophikisa isinqumo noma umyalo wenkantolo. Ukuphathwa kwalolo cala kubalulekile kakhulu. Isinqumo senkantolo siyi-final, ngaphandle uma kukhona isizathu esivumelekile sokuphikisa. Khokha noma yiziphi izindleko ezibekwe yinkantolo kuwe. Izindleko ezingaba khona yilezo umphaki-sicelo angazithola ngokukhokha umshushisi. Landela isinqumo senkantolo. Umphikisi uzokhokha inani lesinqumo kuwe ngokushesha uma enalo. Mnika i-receipt yalolo nani ngokushesha. Uma umphikisi engakwazi ukuhambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ngokushesha, inkantolo izobuza ngesimo sabo sezimali nokuthi bangakukhokhela yini mayelana nesinqumo nezindleko futhi izokhipha isinqumo ngalokho. Uma umphikisi othole icala engahambisani nesinqumo noma isinqumo senkantolo yezicelo ezincane futhi ufuna ukuqhubekisela phambili leso sinqumo, icala lidluliselwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, futhi lizolalelwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wenkantolo YamaMagistrate, 1944 (Umthetho 32 ka-1944). Kubalulekile ukuthola ummeli ukuze ulalelwe kwalolu cala.

Enkulumeni yakhe ekuvulweni kwephalamende ngo 2000, uMongameliIn uMbeki wakhuluma ngesidingo sokuba imisebenzi yentuthuko ihlanganiswe ukuze imiphumela ibonakalet. Leyomisebenzi yentuthuko yileyo eyenza ngcono izinga lempilo yabantu abaswele, yileyo enikeza izinsiza ezinqala kanye nengqala-sizinda, futhi eba yisisekelo sokukhushulwa kwezinga-mpilo ngokuqala izindlela ezintsha zokungenisa imali. Imisebenzi yokuThuthukisa uMphakathi imbandakanya ukuqalwa kwemisebenzi yokuzisebenza emikhakheni yamabhizinisi amancane. Ezinhlelweni eziningi esezisunguliwe nezisahlelwayo, njengesu lokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zentuthuko ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, nokuvuselelwa kwasemadolobheni, nezinhlelo zangaphakathi zokukhula ngokomnotho, kunokwenzeka ukuba kwakheke ingxenye esimeme yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Asingeke sakugwema ukuthi ezinye izinhlelo zentuthuko zithatha isikharthi esincane kakhulu kodwa kungenziwa aamlungiselelo okuthi kube khona abazuzayo amakhono azokubasiza esikhathini esizayo ekutholeni imisebenzi, nokuthi bakwazi ukuqala awabo amabhizinisi, nanokuthi baqhubeke nokusiza umphakathi wakubo noma lezonhlelo seziphelelwe yisikhathi. Ngakho ke ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokusiza umphakathi, ukwakhiwa kwezindlu, imigwaqo nokulungiswa kwezikole, amakhono asemqoka kakhulu.

Zama ukuphuza lezi ziphuzo ngezikhathi lapho ungadli noma ngaphambi kokudla, njengoba lokhu kungakwenza uzwe ukungakhululeki. Ukubhekana nokungakhululeki nokuhamba... Imithi yokwelapha ivame ukuholela ekungakhululekeni nasekuhambeni. Dla izigaba ezincane zokudla ngezikhathi eziningi - ukungakhululeki kuba kubi uma kungekho lutho esiswini. Linda kuze kube uzwa ungcono ngaphambi kokudla, kodwa ungashiyi izidlo. Gwema ukudla okushisayo kakhulu nokunamafutha. Faka kancane uju lwelemons noma ingxenye ye-lemon eziphuzweni ezibandayo. Gcina indawo yakho yokuhlala ivulekile kahle. Hlala uphakamile ngemuva kokudla - linda okungenani imizuzu engama-20 ngaphambi kokulala ukuze ugweme ukuhamba. Uma unomkhuhlane, udinga ukufaka amanzi alahlekile uma uphumeza. Phuza amanzi amaningi - ngaphezu kwalokho okudingayo uma ungatholi amanzi. Uma uzwa sengathi awufuni ukudla, ungakha isobho sezinhlanzi, ama-patato, amakharoti, noma noma yiziphi ezinye izitshalo onazo. Lokhu kunganikeza umzimba wakho amandla nezithako. Ungazizwa ungatholi kahle uma kunzima futhi kunzima ukudlula. Gwema ukusebenzisa ama-laxatives nanoma yiziphi ezinye "imikhiqizo yokuhlanzeka kwesisu" efana ne-enemas.

Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izibhedlela zikahulumeni? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni yizikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo eziphathwa nguhulumeni. Lezi zibhedlela zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo esezingeni eliphezulu kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenamali yokukhokhela izinsizakalo ezibucayi. Zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukene, kusukela ekwelapheni izifo ezilula kuya ekunakekeleni izimo ezinzima. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zihlinzeka ngempilo ebanzi, okuhlanganisa: - Ukwelashwa kwezifo ezahlukene - Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo - Ukuthola imithi - Izinsizakalo zokubeletha - Ukunakekela iziguli ezibhedlela - Izinhlelo zokuvikela izifo Lezi zinsizakalo zenzelwe ukusiza umphakathi, ikakhulukazi abantu abangenamali. Umbuzo 3: Kanjani umuntu angathola usizo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni? Ukuthola usizo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, umuntu kufanele aqale ahlole izidingo zakhe. Uma kudingeka, angaya ezibhedlela eziseduzane, lapho angabhalisela ukuvakashelwa. Ngokuvamile, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zidinga ukuthi abantu babhalise, futhi lokho kungafaka ukufaka imininingwane yabo, njengokuthi bahlala kuphi, izinkinga zempilo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nemininingwane yokwelashwa edlule. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni zonke? Yebo, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezisemaphandleni.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waba yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bungaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni yethu, futhi iOpenAI ibonakale iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, uma sisebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ngendlela efanele, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo, futhi elinobuntu. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi weOpenAI ungumcimbi obalulekile, owaveza izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphokophele phambili, bejabulisa izinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngokubheka iziteleka zabasebenzi, kumqoka ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinyathelo azilungile. Lokhu akushintshi umqondo wokuthi izisebenzi zidinga ukuzwa ukuthi zibalulekile. Iziteleka zingakha umoya wokuphikisana, kodwa futhi zikhuthaza umqondo wokubambisana. Izinhlangano zabasebenzi zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi ziyaqondwa, futhi zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ukwengeza, iziteleka zabasebenzi zikhumbuza umphakathi wobuchwepheshe bokusebenza. Ubulungiswa, ubumbano, nokubambisana yizinto ezibalulekile ezidingekayo ukuze kube khona impumelelo emsebenzini. Uma izisebenzi zisebenza zodwa, ungakubona lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, iziteleka zikhumbuza umphakathi ukuthi umoya wokubambisana udinga ukuhamba phambili, futhi izisebenzi zidinga ukusekela izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwazo. Ngokuphawula, iziteleka zabasebenzi zenziwe ngezizathu eziningi, kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi ziyindlela yokuzwakalisa ukuphikisana. Abasebenzi bahlala bebhekene nezinkinga ezithinta izimo zabo zokusebenza. Inhloso yezi ziteleka akukhona nje kuphela ukuvuselela izinkinga, kodwa futhi ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo ethile phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi izisebenzi zifune ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabaphathi, okungaholela ekutholeni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi nabaphathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izisebenzi kufanele zikhulume ngezinkinga zazo, zifune izixazululo, futhi zihlale ziqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zazo ziyaqondwa. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zidinga ukuhamba phambili, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi ziyaqonda ukuthi zibalulekile. Ubulungiswa emsebenzini akukhona kuphela isifiso, kodwa isidingo sokuphila ngendlela efanele.

Abadlali Abasebasha: Ukuhamba Komzila Wokukhula Nezinkinga Eziwubuhlungu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadlali abasebasha bakhula ngokushesha ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izigidi zethu ngezinsuku zemidlalo. Abantwana abavela ezindaweni zemidlalo, izikole, nezikole ezimaphakathi, bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukisweni kwemisebenzi yabo yokudlala. Nokho, ukubhekelela izinzuzo eziqhamukayo kulezi zindawo kudinga ukucaciswa. Abadlali abasebasha banamathuba amaningi emhlabeni wezokudlala, kepha baphinde babhekane nezinselelo ezinzima. Lapho sikhuluma ngabadlali abasebasha, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abanye baphikiswa yizimo eziningi. Okwokuqala, sinama-athletics, imidlalo yeqembu, kanye nezemidlalo ezinzima ezidinga ukuthi abadlali babe nekhono eliphezulu. Abadlali abancane bakhuthazwa ukuba bathathe imidlalo ukuze bathole ithuba lokuphumelela, kepha kanjani, uma umuzwa wokuncintisana ungaholela ekucindezelweni? Lokhu kwempi yoxhaso phakathi kokuzijabulisa nobunzima bokuthola impumelelo kukhombisa isimo esingabi nansi esivame ukwenzeka. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi abezindaba kumele bahloniphe abadlali abasebasha, begcizelela imithetho nezindlela zokuziphatha ezinhle. Ngokuphambene, abanye abakholwa ekutheni imidlalo kufanele ibe yinsika yokufundisa, okukhombisa ukuthi edlini yezenhlalo nabadlalayo abadala kufanele kube neqhaza elikhulu ekunikezeni abantwana abasha ithuba lokukhula. Izingxoxo ezinjalo zishaywa indiva, zikhombisa indlela ezahlukeneyo zokubheka isimo. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi abadlali abasebasha badinga ukuhlonishwa ngebanga locwaningo lokuziphatha, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bajabula kangakanani.

Ikomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithole igunya ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo ka-1996 ukuze ikhulise futhi iqinisekise izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha kwabantu abaphakathi kwezikhundla ezisebenzela isizwe. Ngo-1997, ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi kwamenyezelwa futhi kwathuthukiswa ngokubizelwa kwemihlangano kanye nochwepheshe bezomthetho ezingeni likazwelonke nelokuhlala. Kwakubalulekile ukuthuthukisa incwadi yokuhola mayelana nokuziphatha ukuze kusizwe abantu baqonde kahle futhi basebenzise lokho. Engxenyeni yeKomishini esebenza isizwe, ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukwethula incwadi echaza ukuziphatha okufanele kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyisisekelo esibalulekile sokuphatha nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Lokhu kuziphatha futhi kukhuphula izindaba ezifana nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abantu, umthetho, ukuzinikela, ukuveza uhulumeni, ukuziphatha komuntu siqu, nokujabulela okwakhe. IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi icela bonke abasebenzi, kusukela kulabo abasezingeni eliphansi kuya kwezinga eliphezulu, ukuba baveze ukuqonda okubonakalayo kwenqubo, iziqondiso, nezincwadi ezitholakala ekuziphatheni okufanele. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okubalulekile kodwa kungasivumela ukuba sihlangabezane nezidingo ezifanele zabantu bethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi labo abaphakathi kwezikhundla benze izinto ngokomthetho, bagweme ukwamukela amathuba nezipho, njengoba lokhu kungabhekwa njengenkohlakalo. Sifisa ukuhlabela izinkanyezi bonke abaphathi nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla abathintekayo ekukhuliseni ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ngiyakhuthaza ukuba niqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi omuhle ngaphandle kokuphenduka ezinselelweni zokuthuthukisa ikhodi yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi.

Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi intsha ifuna ukwaziwa, ifuna ukusebenza, futhi ifuna ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, intsha iyinhloso yethu, futhi izizathu zayo ziqhubeka zikhuthaza ubuhlakani, umoya wokwakha, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuveza amandla okwenza ushintsho, futhi sikholelwa ekutheni impumelelo iyavela lapho abantu benza isiqiniseko sokuthi bawela izithiyo, bazitholele izindlela zabo, futhi baphokophele phambili.

a samukele uhlelo lolo; futhi b sinikeze umsebenzi womkhumbi isaziso esibhaliwe esimazisa ngokwamukela. Uma ngabe IsiPhathimandla singanelisiwe ukuthi uhlelo lubhekana ngokwanele nezidingo ezifanele ngokwesahluko -3, kufanele a sichithe ukwamukelwa kohlelo; futhi b sibhale isaziso sazise umsebenzi womkhumbi ngokuchithwa kumbandakanya nezizathu ezenze ukuba luchithwe uhlelo lolo. Uma sifisa ukubona ukuthi uhlelo lubhekana ngokwanele nezidingo ezifanele ngokwesahluko- 3, isiPhathimandla kufanele sibhekisise isimo esikhona mayelana nezokuVikela kwezokuthutha olwandle. a umsebenzi womkhumbi womkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika enika isiPhathimandla uhlelo lokuvikela lomkhumbi lwalowo mkhumbi; futhi b isiPhathimandla singalwamukeli, noma sinqaba ukwamukela uhlelo esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezinga-90 kusukela ngosuku anikwe ngalo uhlelo, kuyothathwa ngokuthi siPhathimandla sikuchithile ukwamukelwa kwalolo hlelo. Uma isiPhathimandla samukela uhlelo lokuvikela lomkhumbi, lolo hlelo luqala ukusebenza ngesikhathi esibalulwe kuleso saziso sokwamukelwa kohlelo. a isikhathi esibalulwe kusaziso singaphambi kwesikhathi esinikwe ngaso isaziso; noma b isikhathi sokuqala ukusebenza kohlelo singabalulwangwa kusaziso, uhlelo luqala ukusebenza ngesikhathi kunikezwa isaziso. a kungena olunye uhlelo esikhundlenni salo ngokusho komthehonkambiso-662; noma b kuyesulwa ukwamukela kohlelo ngaphansi kwalesi sahluko. IsiPhathimandla singabhala isaziso sinike umsebenzi womkhumbi simyala ukuba aguqule uhlelo.

Kubantu abangu 40 million abakhona ezweni lakithi bangamaphesenti angu 20 kuphela abanemisebenzi. Kubantu abangu 4,6 million abaswele imisebenzi, abangu 4,2 million bansundu, kanti u 58 phesenti wabo abesifazane. Ngokuthuthukikswa kwamakhono sidinga ukuba sikhandele ababebandlululekile amathuba, bese kuthi phezu kwalokho sigqugquzele ubambiswano oluphilayo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zabantu. Ukuqhutshwa yizidingo: sesiside manje isikhathi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphandle kokuqashwa ukuthi kuhamba kanjani nanokuthi lawomakhono azokusetshenziswa ngayiphi indlela ezokuba nenzuzo. Kuzogcizelelwa ekuthuthukiswenio kwamakhono nobungoti obudingekayo ukuze kusebenzeke ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo, ukuze sibe sezingeni lomhlaba ngemikhiqizo, ukuze abasebenzi bakheke, abantu bakwazi ukuzisebenza bona, kubuye kuhlangabezwanwe nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi. Ukuthobela nokuhambisana nesimo nokubambisana: uHulumeni ebambisene noMkhandlu wokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono unesibopho sokwakha uhlaka, nenkombandlela yesu lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono nokulididiyela, nokuqapha ukuthi umsebenzi wokulifezekisa wenziwa kanjani. Ubungcweti nokuzwela: izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kufanele zibe nezimpawu zokonga imali kanti futhi zibe nenzuzo ekugcineni kubo bonke abaye baphosa itshe esivivaneni bazinikela ngandlela zonke ekuthuthukisweni kwesu. Ukuhlomisa iNingizimu Afrika ngamakhono ukuze ibhekane nemikhiqizo yomhlaba futhi lokho kunike abantu nemiphakathi amathuba ukuba bazithuthukise futhi babe neqhaza elibonakalayo nelinenzuzo ekukhuphuleni izinga lomnotho wezwe.

Umphakathi womhlaba otshala izimali ucele ukuba thina njengama-Afrikha ukuthi izimo zenza ukwazi ukuthatha izinqumo eziphusile zokutshala izimali isikhathi eside e-Afrikha. Sibheka ukuthi isixazululo, sasekhaya, sesifunda kanye nokubamba iqhaza esifundeni kuyindlela yokubhekana nesimo. Amadolobha ayisishiyagalolunye amakhulu eNingizimu Afrikha asakhe ubuxhakaxhaka bokuxhumana ukuze abelane ngolwazi nokuthola izixazululo ezinobuchule oshintshweni ngokwezindawo. Ezingxoxweni ezibe khona kucacile ukuthi ukuphatha ngendlela nokukwazi ukuphatha kuyizinto ezibalulekile ekwenzeni inzuzo emikhiqizweni yobisi. Sizibophezele ukuqhubeka nokubhekela ukuphepha, ukuphucula ezokuthutha nezinye izingqalasizinda, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuhamba ngomoya, isipiliyoni samasiko esiyiso nokwehlukana kwemikhiqizo. Izigebengu zabe sezisabisa ukudubula uthishanhloko uma engamkhiphi umfundi. Ngahambisa isicelo sokukhokhelwa ngesikhathi esithile kanti savunywa ngabe sengikhokhelwa. Ezimnyama nezimhlophe zakhethelwa lokho, kangangokuthi izilwane ezibomvu zakhishelwa ngaphandle ngesikhathi kurejistwa. Ngokunjalo, yiNkantolo ePhakeme kuphela engavimbela ukugada ingane kulowo oyigadayo. Waqhamuka ngemuva kwesango lendawo ephakeme enkundleni, wama lapho isikhashana wabe usungena ngaphakathi. Kodwa ekugcineni, kuke kwaba nenkulumo yokuthi indiza ibambezelekile ukusuka e-Taipei. Ngicabanga ukuthi kuyinjwayelo ebholeni lezinyawo ukuba sithole amathikithi enkundleni. IKhabhinethi iyobe isibamba umhlangano ukuchaza uhlaka lomsebenzi kahulumeni oyomenyezelwa eNkulumweni ewuMhlahlandlela kaZwelonke.

Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umholi akakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngaphandle kokuphikiswa. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa izinqumo zakhe zaphinde zaba nezinselelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abantu baphikise izinqumo zakhe, bethi akazange abheke kahle izidingo zabantu abavamile. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngoThabo Mbeki, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umholi akakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngaphandle kokuphikiswa. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa izinqumo zakhe zaphinde zaba nezinselelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abantu baphikise izinqumo zakhe, bethi akazange abheke kahle izidingo zabantu abavamile. UThabo Mbeki ungomunye wabantu abahlonishwa kakhulu emlandweni wezombusazwe zethu, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umholi akakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngaphandle kokuphikiswa.
