Ukhomishani angasho nokuthi uzonazisa isahlulelo sakhe ngokunibhalela kamuva. Akuna sikhalazo esiyokwamukelwa ngokumelene nesinqumo noma isiqondiso senkantolo. ukuphathwa budedengu okukhulu kwalelo cala. Isinqumo senkantolo singu juqu, ngaphandle-ke uma sikhona isizathu esamukelekayo sesikhalazo. Khokhela noma yiziphi izindleko ezibekwa yinkantolo kuwena. Izindleko ezingaba khona yilezo ummangali angabe uzithole ngokukhokhela u-sheriff. Hambisana nesinqumo senkantolo. Lowo enimangalenene naye uyokukhokhela masinyane imali yesahlulelo, uma enayo. Mnikeze ilasidi laleso samba masin-yane. Uma lowo enimangalenene naye engakwazi ukulandela isinqumo senkantolo khona lapho, inkantolo izofunisisa isimo sakhe ngokwezimali nokuthi angakwazi yini ukukukhokhela mayelana nesahlulelo kanye nezindleko bese ikhipha isinqumo salokho.

Ngokuvamile, siyazi ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yebhizinisi ukwenza inzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kodwa ekulimaleni, lokhu akuhambisani njalo ngoba ibhizinisi nempilo yokuphila kuhlangene. Singasho ukuthi imigomo yalomsebenzi ingaba ukwenza inzuzo enhle, kodwa akufanele ilethe umlimi nomndeni wakhe ubunzima. Izinjongo ezihlanganisiwe ngenhla azichaziwe kahle futhi zingabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kodwa uma zisetshenziswa, lezi zinjongo zicacile ngoba akukhona abantu ababili abacabanga ngendlela efanayo noma baphila ngendlela efanayo futhi abavumi umndeni omuhle ngendlela efanayo. Ngakho-ke, isifiso somlimi sokwenza inzuzo sizohluka ngoba omunye ngeke abuke lezi zinto ngendlela efanayo futhi ngeke alandele indlela efanayo yokwenza inzuzo. Nokho, kubalulekile kumlimi othile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi impilo enhle izobiza malini mayelana nomsebenzi wabo wokwenza inzuzo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele kubo kanye nezidingo zabo. Umphakathi udinga umkhakha wezolimo ukuze ukhiqize imikhiqizo ethile - lokhu kuzohambisana namakhono ezwe elithile - ikakhulukazi ukudla nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ngentengo ephansi, futhi siqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinto. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abalimi kumele basebenzise izinsiza zemvelo ikakhulukazi esikhathini eside. Kodwa izinhloso ezivamile zodwa azizukwanele. Iphrojekthi ngayinye idinga imigomo ethile, kodwa le migomo kufanele ihambisane nenhloso evamile. Isibonelo: umlimi ofuna ukukhiqiza ummbila kufanele abe nemigomo ethile yokukhiqiza ummbila, masithi uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamahektare angu-500 ommbila obomvu ngonyaka. Kodwa akupheli lapho.

Ngokuhambisana nezihloko 3, 6, kanye no-31 zeMthethosisekelo, izinsizakalo zokuhumusha nokuhlela zeNLS ziyasiza uhulumeni ekufezeni izibopho zawo kubantu ngokweMthethosisekelo. Abathengi abakhulu balolu mnyango wokuhumusha nokuhlela bangeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni ezinomsebenzi nezinyathelo nohulumeni bezwe. Kukhona iminyango kahulumeni enezinsizakalo zayo zolimi, futhi zihumusha zodwa, njengeMnyango Wezokulungiswa, iMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanye neSevisi Yezobulungiswa. Nokho, iNLS iyasiza le minyango lapho ibhujiswa umsebenzi noma uma kudingeka ubuchwepheshe obuthile, njengokuthi uma kukhona amadokhumenti adinga ukuhumushwa ezilimini zangaphandle noma akhishwe ezilimini zangaphandle. Ezinye izifunda zinezinsizakalo zazo zolimi, kodwa zifuna usizo ku-NLS uma kudingeka. I-NLS ingancoma izifunda ngababhalisile abathembekile bezilimi ezithile abangasebenzisa. Ukuze kusebenze ngendlela ezokhiqiza imiphumela esezingeni eliphezulu nephumelelayo, ihhovisi lezilimi kumele libheke izidingo zayo ukuze abahumushi nabahleli bakwazi ukugxila emsebenzini wabo ngenkathi abasebenzi behhovisi besiza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Idokhumenti kanye nesampula kulandela indlela futhi kudlula ezinyathelweni ezithile, ezinye zazo zingase zibe zokuphatha kanti ezinye zixhumene nokuhumusha nokuhlela. a. Idokhumenti yamukelwa kwiRegistry bese ibekwa uphawu ekhasini langaphandle elikhombisa usuku lokwamukelwa kwayo bese ithunyelwa kumqondisi walowo Mnyango ukuze iphathwe kanye nesinqumo sokuthi kufanele isebenze.

Uhulumeni wengcindezelo awuzange ubabhekelele abantu bakithi abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Iningi labantu baphoqelelwa ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezingakulungele ukuhlala umuntu, okungumhlaba owomile, ongasebenzeki nongenanzuzo. Ukususwa ngenkani ezindaweni zethu kwaphenduka insakavukela umchilo wesidwaba. Iningi lenu liyabazi lobobuhlungu obabuhambisana nokwehliswa kwesithunzi sabantu bakithi. Imindeni yahlukumezeka yehlukana phakathi, amasiko ethu ashabalala kodwa asilahlekelwanga ummongo nethemba. Abaningi balababantu babetholakala ezindaweni zasemakhaya ezifana nalena yalapha KwaNibela, kanti abanye babalekela emikhukhwini ezungeze amadolobha. njengenkinga enkulu ebhekene neNingizimu Afrika emva kokuwa kombuso wobandlululo. Kuleminyaka yombuso wentando yeningi elishumi nanye eyedlule sesikwazile ukusebenzisa izinqubo-mgomo kuzwelonke nasezifundazweni ukulungisa isimo. Namhlanje kuyasithokozisa ukusho ukuthi sesikwazile ukwakha izindlu ezevile esigidini namakhulu ayisithupha , sakhela abantu bakithi abebengenazindlu ngaphambilini kanti ziningi futhi ezinye ezisakhiwa ngikhuluma nje. Sizimisele ukukhuphula uhlelo lokwakhiwa kwezindlu minyaka yonke ukuze silwisane nenkinga yokwentuleka kwezindlu ngokushesha. Nakuba loluhlelo luzothatha iminyaka, kuyasijabulisa kodwa ukuthi izinhlelo zentuthuko sizethula ngokushesha, ubufakazi balokho ukuma kwami phambi kwenu namhlanje. Sinesiqiniseko sokuthi siphethe uhlelo oluphumelelayo. Izinqubo-mgomo zethu akuzona nje izifiso zikahulumeni.

Wayezizwa esaba njengokuthi kukhona okuzokwenzeka kuye. Lapho elele ebusuku, wayevakashelwa yiziphupha ezimbi yedwa. Ekugcineni watshela uSindi ngalolu daba, ongakatholi isixazululo kulokhu. Wacasuka futhi washada nembongolo ngoba wabona ukuthi iyona ayisebenzisa endlini yabo ezinsukwini ezedlule. Lokhu akukaze kumnike ithuba lokukhuluma, kukhiphe isikhwama semali esivela kwi-wallet futhi wacela. Ngisho namuhla bahlala ekhishini bekhuluma. USindi ulungiselela ukufaka izitsha emlilweni. "Hey Mveli, ngiyasho ukuthi ngempela," akazange aqede le nkulumo ngoba lapho ebheka uMveli, wabona ubuso obudabukisayo. Kwavela kucace ukuthi kukhona okuningi okwehlile. "Wow, kodwa oh my God, ngiyamthanda uMveli! Ngiyaqala empilweni yami ukuthola umuntu ongithanda kangaka. Awukwazi ukwazi, ngangingumkhosi namuhla, ngidla lokho engikuthandayo. Ungabona ngalesi sikhwama sokudla ukuthi ngihola," kusho yena, evula isikhwama ayethwele. "Angazi, kodwa uma bekungami, besizohlangana." "Ngiyamthanda uMveli Nelile, akashiyi umoya wami. Kusukela sakhangisana, ngiye ngiphupha ngaye usuku nosuku. Kwezinye izinsuku, ngiphupha ngaye elele esibhedlela, egula kakhulu. "Wow,

Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni kweminyaka ye-1990, uMzansi Afrika wabhekana nezinguquko ezinkulu. Lezi zinguquko, ezihlelwe ngamalungelo abantu, zashaya umoya omusha emakholweni ezehlakalo zomphakathi. Nokho, phakathi kwalokhu kuzama ukuguqula isimo sezinto, intsha yayibhekene nenkinga enkulu: ukungasebenzi. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enobuhlungu, ethinta izigidi zabantu abasha, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu afana noNxamalala, eGoli, naseKhayelitsha. Intsha yayinokufunda okukhulu, kodwa ukuphuma emsebenzini kwakungathiwe. Izifundo ezitholakalayo zazingahambisani nezidingo zemboni. Ngalesi sikhathi, izifundo eziphezulu zathola ukugxekwa, njengoba abantu abasha bephokophele emikhakheni ethile yokufunda, kodwa imakethe yebhizinisi yayingenakho ukuphuma kwezikhala zomsebenzi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi baphinde bahlale emakhaya, bezama izindlela zokuphila ezizimele. Kwakukhona umuzwa ophakathi kwentsha, umuzwa wokuphikisana nezinqubomgomo ezithile zehulumeni. Njengoba umnotho wawuhlupheka, abantu abasha bahlola izindlela zokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo. Izinkulumo ezazihambisana nomkhankaso wezomnotho zazisuswa emakhaya nasemaphandleni, zifaka phakathi imihlangano, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezibopho zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibono emisha, ebandakanya umqondo wokuthi intsha inemfanelo yokubamba iqhaza ekuqhamukeni kwezixazululo. Njengoba lesi sikhathi sikhula, izinkinga zokuqala zaba nzima kakhulu. Umnotho waqala ukuphuka, futhi izinkampani ezinkulu zathola izinkinga zokuthola abasebenzi abaneziqu ezithile.

Isigaba-- 3 nesigaba- 4, sifundwa kanye nezinguquko ezidingekile kuye ngaloko okukhulunywa ngako, sisetshenziswa kunoma yikuphi ukulungiswa kwenqubomgomo yokukhokhelwa kwentela yendawo. umasipalati wendawo kufanele wemukele ukuba imithetho kamasipalati ibenegalelo ekusetshenzisweni kanye nasekuphoqelelweni komgomo wawo wokukhokhelwa kwentela yendawo. a kwemikhakha ehlukene yempahla nezindawo; kanye b kwemikhakha eyehlukene yabanikazi abanomthwalo wokuba bakhokhe intela yendawo. uma umasipalati enquma ukuklama imali yentela yendawo kufanele, ngokulandisa kwesigatshana- , aklame intela yendawo kuyo yonke impahla noma izindawo okumele zikhokhelwe intela yendawo endaweni kamasipalati noma, endaweni engaphansi kukamasipalati wendawo efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo. i lapho umasipalati yena noma omunye umasipalati engumnikazi; noma ii okukhulunywa ngakho endimeni -b encazelweni yemihlaba noma yempahla esesigabeni -1; noma iii lapho ilungelo lobunikazi bendawo lingavikelekile ngokusemthethweni ngenxa yemithetho yobandlululo yaphambilini noma okuthile okwenza kube lukhuni noma kungenzeki sanhlobonhlobo ukuthola inani; noma b ukuvimba umasipalati ekutheni anike ilungelo ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 14 sikashwele, noma sokubuyiselwa kwemali ekhokhwe ngokweqile noma izaphulelo ekukhokhweni kwentela yendawo ngokulandisa kwesigatshana-1. b ukusetshenziswa okugunyaziwe kwempahla noma kwendawo; noma c indawo lapho kukhona khona impahla.

Ngaphezu kokunquma ukusetshenziswa kolimi kanye nokufunwa yimiphakathi yabo, ohulumeni basemakhaya kumele ngokuxhumana okubanzi nomphakathi wabo, basungule, bakhiphe futhi basebenzise inqubomgomo yobuliminingi. Ulimi olusemthethweni lizawusetshenziswa njengoba kudingekile kumisebenzi yezishayamthetho, kufakelela nemikhiqizo ye-Hansard, njengendaba yelungelo, uma kungenzeka kube nezindaba zezishayamthetho zesifunda, izehlakalo zesifunda zizawunquma izilimi okumele zisetshenziswe. Ukuthuthukisa ubuliminingi le nqubomgomo iveza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezakhiweni zikahulumeni ngokulandelayo. 2.4.6.1 U(Izi)limi olu(ezi)setshenziswayo / U(izi)limi lo(zo)kurekhoda: Ngokuvumelana isakhiwo sikahulumeni ngasinye kumele sivumelane ngo(ngezi)limi olu(ezi)sebenzayo (ngezinjongo zokuxhumana ngaphakathi kwemiNyango kanye nokuxhumana neminye imiNyango), lapho kungaphumeleleka khona, akekho umuntu ozawuvinjelwa ukusebenzisa ulwimi olufunwa nguye. 2.4.6.2. Ukuxhumana namalungu omphakathi: Ngezinjongo zokubhalelana ngokusemthethweni, ulimi oluthandwa yisakhamuzi kumele lusetshenziswe. Konke ukuxhumana ngomlomo kumele kuqhubeke ngolimi, kwenzeke ngolimi elithandwa ngabantu okuqondiswe kubo . Uma kudingekile, yonke imizamo kumele yenziwe kusetshenziswa izinsiza zokwenza ulimi lube lula njengokutolika (ngokulandelana, ngesikhathi esisodwa nangocingo noma ukutolika okuhleliwe)lapho kungaphumeleleka khona.

Ukukhathala Kwamahlengikazi Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzini omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, kwavela umoya opholile, ubonisa ukuthi kube nesikhathi eside sokusebenza. Abahlengikazi bendawo, uNokuthula noSipho, babephakathi kokulungiselela usuku olujwayelekile emtholampilo. Njengoba bephuma emakhaya abo, babebona izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza ukuthi, nakuba bephila impilo enzima, umhlaba unikeza ithemba. UNokuthula, owayenobungane obukhulu, wayehlala ebakhumbuza abanye abahlengikazi ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ubalulekile. "Siyabamba izimpilo zabantu, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukwenziwa nganoma ubani," wayephendula njalo. Kodwa, ngaphakathi, wayezwa ukukhathala okukhulu. Izinsuku zabe ziphila zifana, ziqhubeka zikhathaza, futhi imithwalo yokukhathazeka yayiqinile. USipho, owayenobuchule bokwelapha, wayehlale edinga izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo. "Sidinga ukuhamba phambili, Nokuthula. Abantu bethu badinga usizo, futhi akufanele sithule," wayekhuluma, kodwa wayezwa umoya wokukhathala emzimbeni wakhe. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, wayehluleka ukulala kahle, imicabango yakhe ibihamba ngezindlela eziningi. Ngelinye ilanga, kwafika umama oneminyaka engama-70, uMama Zodwa, owayenokukhathala okukhulu. Wayefika emtholampilo enezimpawu zokukhathala, kodwa wayehlale eqinile. "Ngiyazi ukuthi ningabahlengikazi, kodwa ngicela ningithumele emuva, ngidinga ukuxoxa," kusho yena. UNokuthula noSipho babemthanda, futhi bazi ukuthi uMama Zodwa wayengumuntu onothando, kodwa izinkinga zakhe zazinzima. Baqala ukuxoxa naye, bahlola izinkinga zakhe, futhi uMama Zodwa wabelana ngendaba yakhe.

Ukwesekwa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane Ngiyahlanganyela nomuzwa omuhle kulolu daba lwamabhizinisi amancane. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkampani ezikhulayo, ngoba yilezo ezikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza umnotho wethu, futhi ziphinde ziqinise umphakathi. Ngabe ubona kanjani ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane? Ngizokutshela ngakho kahle. Lokhu kuqala, ngizokwenza kucace ukuthi kungani amabhizinisi amancane ebalulekile. Uma ubheka emaphandleni, noma ezindaweni eziphakathi kwedolobha, uzobona ukuthi lezi zinkampani, noma zikhona ezindaweni zokudlela, izitolo, noma izisebenzi ezizimele, zenza umehluko omkhulu. Zivuleka ezindaweni eziningi, zikhulisa umkhiqizo, futhi zenza umphakathi ube nempilo. Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umnotho wethu uphila ngezinyathelo ezincane, ezikhuthazwe yilezi zinkampani. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokwesekwa. Ngabe sikhona yini isiqondiso esikhona ukusekela lezi zinkampani? Yebo, izinhlelo eziningi zikhona, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zikhona ezivela kuhulumeni, ezikhungweni ezizimele, noma ngababambiqhaza emphakathini. Ngokwesibonelo, uhulumeni unikeza izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, njengezimali zokuqala, imihlangano yokufundisa, namathuba okuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane banganqoba izithiyo eziningi uma behola imali, futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhulume ngebhizinisi elizimele. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane bahlushwa izinselele eziningi, kodwa umphakathi ungasiza.

Njengomnikazi wezinsiza nemishini, kufanele wazi ukuthi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokubheka abantu abasebenza nalezi zinto. Izimo ezinjengalezi zivame ukudala ubungozi. Ungasebenzisi imishini yokuvikela. Sebenzisa imishini ngenkathi isahamba. Sebenzisa amathuluzi afanele: ungasebenzisi amathuluzi amancane ukwenza umsebenzi wamathuluzi amakhulu. Gcina amathuluzi enempilo: qinisekisa ukuthi akhanya kahle, alinganisiwe futhi uwacwebezele njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-pins aqinile. Sebenzisa izing glasses zokuvikela uma usebenza. Sebenzisa umask uma kukhona uthuli oluningi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokuphepha iyasebenza kahle. Vimbela izingane ukuthi zingangeneli. Bonke abavakashi endaweni yokusebenza (isitolo) akufanele basondeze endaweni lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Gcina indawo yokusebenza ikhanya kahle. Izinto eziphukile yonke indawo zidalela ubungozi. Beka amathuluzi kude ngemva kokuwasebenzisa - awadingeki lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Vala wonke amathuluzi anogesi. Gqoka izingubo ezifanele. Izingubo ezikhululekile zingabamba emishini. Qinisa umsebenzi wakho: sebenzisa ama-clamps nezinsiza zamathuluzi owasebenzisayo. Kungcono ukubamba ngezandla ngoba manje uzokwazi ukusebenzisa zombili izandla uma usebenza. Ungazami ukwenza amathuluzi akho enze imisebenzi emikhulu kakhulu. Ungazami ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Qinisekisa ukuthi ume kahle njalo. Donsa i-lever - ungacindezeli. Uma kunzima ukudonsa, sebenzisa isikhumba sesandla sakho ukusunduza. Amathuluzi akhanyayo akufanele abhekiswe emzimbeni wakho. Lokhu kungavimbela izingozi uma ithuluzi lishayisa. Xhuma yonke imishini enogesi emhlabeni (umhlaba). Sebenzisa i-plug enezinhlangothi ezintathu kuphela.

Isiko Nezinkolelo Inyama yenkomo ibalulekile emikhubeni yamaZulu. Isetshenziswa ezinsukwini zokugubha, emishadweni, nasezikhumbuzweni. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuhlanganisa imindeni. Izinkolelo ezihambisana nenyama yenkomo zikhombisa ukuthi inhlonipho nokuqonda kwamasiko kubalulekile empilweni yamaZulu. Ukugcina Nokuthuthukisa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithuthukisa izindlela zokulima nezokugcina izinkomo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono yezinkomo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlala ziqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi inyama yenkomo iqhubeke ibalulekile empilweni yethu. Isiphetho Inyama yenkomo ayigcini nje ngokuba umthombo wokudla, kodwa ibalulekile emlandweni, ezwenikazi, nasempilweni yamaZulu. Ukuqonda kahle inyama yenkomo, izinzuzo zayo, nezindlela zokuyilungisa, kubalulekile ukuze sihloniphe futhi sigcine lesi siko. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokugcina lezi zinkolelo, sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokulima, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi inyama yenkomo iyinsika yempilo yethu.

Lo muntu kufanele ahambisane nomfakisicelo eMnyangweni Wezasekhaya lapho umfakisicelo nalowo muntu bazobuzwa ezindlini ezahlukene. Izicelo zingathatha ezinyangeni ezi-3 kuya kwezi-6. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze ukuze uthole usizo.

Ngokwesibonelo, izinsuku zempilo zingahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-screening nezinsiza zempilo mahhala, kanti imikhankaso yokugoma ingagqugquzela abantu ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zibhukha izigulane zazo. Umbuzo: Abantu bangayithola kanjani imicimbi yezempilo? Imicimbi yezempilo ivamise ukukhushulwa emiphakathini ngezindlela ezahlukene, njengezikhangiso ezisemaphandleni, izikhangiso eziphepheni, nakuma-social media. Abantu bangathola ulwazi ngemihlangano ethile ngokuvakashela ezindaweni zomphakathi, njengezikhungo zempilo, izikole, noma izikhungo zokuxhumana, lapho imicimbi ivame ukwenzeka. Umbuzo: Yimaphi amasu angasetshenziswa ukuze imicimbi ibe nempumelelo? Ukuze imicimbi yezempilo ibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu babezobandakanyeka, nokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emkhankasweni. Lokhu kungafaka ukufaka izinhlelo zokukhuthaza ukuxhumana, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imicimbi iyathinta futhi iyasiza abantu. Umbuzo: Yini edinga ukunakwa ekuxhumaneni ngezempilo? Ekuxhumaneni ngezempilo, kubalulekile ukugwema amagama angathandeki noma angacacile. Lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni noma ekuhlanekeleni kwabantu. Ukukhuluma ngempilo kufanele kube kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile, kanye nokuhlola amaqhinga athinta izithakazelo zomphakathi. Umbuzo: Imicimbi yezempilo iyasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo?

Akhona namathuba okusebenzisana nezinhlelo ezisungulelwe ukuthuthukisa umphakathi, njengezinhlelo ezizinze emphakathini zokwakha izidingo zomphakathi, uhlelo lwamanzi okuthiwa yiWorking for Water, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa intsha ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzisebenza nokuziqasha. Noma lemizamo ingeke ibonakale njengeyokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abancane, iyisisekelo sokunombola labo bantu abanamathalente athize abangahle benze ngawo amabhizinisi baziphilise bafake nesandla emnothweni wezwe. Maningi amaqembu eNingizimu Afrika afuna ukuthi kucatshangwe ukuthi yiwona adinga lolusizo kunamanye. Iningi labaswele imisebenzi intsha kanti cisho isigamu salabo abaswele imisebenzi sebefunde iminyaka engu 9 yonke nangaphezulu esikoleni. Ngo 2000 amaphesenti angu 57,8 alabo ababhala uMatikuletsheni baphasa kodwa bangamaphesenti angu 14 kuphela abaphasela ukuthi baqhubekele emfundweni ephakeme. Intsha engu 206,000 ayifundile okutheni, ayinasicucu. Kunesidingo ke esiphuthumayo ukuthi leyo ntsha esanda kuphuma esikoleni naleyo engaphasanga kahle ithole ithuba lokuqeqeshwa nelokuba ithuthuke ngemfundo. Uhlelo olusha lokuthuthukisa imfundo, yize kungeyilo olwabantu abasha nje kuphela, luzokunikeza ithuba lokuba bafunde amakhono adingakalayo futhi kufanele lukwazi ukwandisa izifundo kabanzi ngesikhashana esifushane. Ukuqalwa kwezinhlelo zokusekela abasha kuzombandakanya ukwenza ngcono isimo solwazi nokuthola izeluleko ngemisebenzi kanye nezinsiza zokufunelwa imisebenzi. UMnyango wezeMisebenzi ubambisene noMkhandlu wamaKhono futhi uphokophelele ukuzenza lezi zinhloso zibe impumelelo.

Nokho, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukwamukela izitayela ezihlukahlukene kungaphazamisa umqondo wokuqala we-gospel, okungase kube yinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-gospel ungaba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinkolelo zenkolo. Abaculi be-gospel bahlala bephakamisa izinkolelo zabo, bencenga abalandeli babo ukuthi baphile impilo enokholo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umculo ungaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enobuntu, futhi baphile ngokuhlonipha abanye. Nokho, uma umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuphenduka umkhiqizo, kungase kube nzima ukugcina lezi zinkolelo zihlala ziqinile. Ekugcineni, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo omkhulu wokukhuthaza, ukuxhumana, nokwakha imiphakathi ethokozisayo. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nomculo lo, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezingxoxo eziphusile mayelana nendlela umculo we-gospel okumele ubonakale ngayo. Kumele sihloniphe izinjongo zawo zokuqala, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umculo we-gospel uqhubeka nokuba yinsiza yokukhuthaza uthando, ukholo, kanye nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Umculo we-gospel ungaba yindlela yokwakha umhlaba ongcono, uma siqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela zokwenza umculo lo ube yinsiza ethokozisayo nehloniphekile.

Ikota Umbuzo 1: Yini ikota? Ikota iyisikhathi esithile sokuphila esivame ukwenziwa ngezinyanga ezine. Kubalulekile emikhakheni ehlukene, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, ezemali, nasezinhlelweni zokuphatha. Ikota ibonisa indlela yokusebenza, yokuhlola, nokubika imiphumela ethile ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ikota ibalulekile? Ikota ibalulekile ngoba isiza izinkampani ukuba zihlaziye ukusebenza kwazo, zenze izinqumo ezifanele, futhi zihlale ziqonda izimo zemboni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikota ivumela abaphathi ukuba bahlaziye izindleko, imikhiqizo, nezinsizakalo, ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. Umbuzo 3: Kanjani ikota isetshenziswa ezinkampanini? Ezinkampanini, ikota isetshenziswa ukuze kubonwe ukuthi izinjongo zonyaka zifezekile yini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubika ngezindleko, imali engenayo, kanye nezinga lokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphathi basebenzisa ikota ukuze baphumelele ekwenzeni izinhlelo ezintsha, ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo, noma ukwandisa imakethe. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izigaba ezisemqoka ze ikota? Izigaba ezisemqoka ze ikota zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukucacisa izinjongo: Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhloso ezizofezwa kule nkathi. Ukuhlela: Ukubeka phambili izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinsizakusebenza, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukusebenza: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi yini okufanele ayenze. Ukuhlola: Ukuhlola imiphumela yokusebenza ukuze kutholakale ukuthi izinjongo zifezekile. Ukubika: Ukubika imiphumela kumphakathi, kubaphathi, noma kubanikazi bezinkampani. Umbuzo 5: Ziyini izinselelo ezihambisana ne ikota? Izinkampani zibhekana nezinselelo eziningi uma zisebenzisa ikota.

Abafundi Basemanyuvesi: Izifundo, Izinselelo Nezinto Eziwusizo Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, njengoba bephakamisa izinga lemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Lezi zifundo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kubafundi uqobo, kodwa nakumphakathi wonke. Ukuze siqonde kahle indima yabafundi basemanyuvesi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izifundo abahlangabezana nazo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezinto eziwusizo ezitholakala kulolu hambo. Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe Nezokufunda Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bejolise ekutholeni ulwazi olujulile nolwakhiwe. Izifundo ezitholakala emanyuvesi zihluke kakhulu, kusukela ezifundweni zezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe, ezemfundo, ezomnotho, nezobuciko. Lezi zifundo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bacabange ngokuqhubekayo, bakhe amakhono amasha, futhi bathuthukise ubuchwepheshe babo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni izixhumanisi ezinamandla phakathi kwezifundo zabo nezidingo zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo ezinkingeni ezithile. Izinselelo Abafundi Abahlangabezana Nazo Noma kunjalo, abafundi basemanyuvesi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yizindleko zemfundo. Imali yokufunda, izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nezindleko zokuphila zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abafundi badinge ukusebenza ngenkathi befunda, okungase kube nomthelela ekutheni bakwazi ukugxila ezifundweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka kuyizinkinga ezivamile phakathi kwabafundi.

b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi. d. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe sithobela umthetho iminyaka eyisithupha. Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele sikhishwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi futhi sibhujiswe. e. Uma umphakathi utholakala enecala phakathi kweminyaka eyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala okufanele azithole. Imicimbi efanayo ephathelene nabasebenzi kufanele ithole izixwayiso ezifanayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe indlela ehambisanayo yokuphatha noma yokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele. Uma icala elibhekene nomphakathi libalulekile kakhulu, kudinga isijeziso esinzima kunezikhumbuzo ezikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, umqashi angase aqale uphenyo mayelana nesijeziso. Umqashi kufanele akhethe ummeleli ukuze aqale uphenyo, okumele kube umphakathi. Isaziso sokuphenya a. umphakathi kufanele anikezwe isaziso okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela. b. Umphakathi kufanele asigne isaziso esiqinisekisa usuku lokulalela. Uma bephika ukusigna, kufanele banikezwe omunye umphakathi ozosigna ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isaziso. Incazelo ephelele yokuziphatha okungafanele, ubufakazi umqashi ozowethemba. Ulwazi ngamalungelo omphakathi, abamele abaphathi noma abamele inhlangano yezabasebenzi evunyelwe, kanye nalabo abazohlinzeka ngobufakazi.

Yini engingayenza uma ngizwa sengathi angifuni ukudla? Izifo, ukudangala, nokuhlukumezeka kungakwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Zama lokhu okulandelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele ukuze ugcine umzimba wakho uqine. Ukudla okufana noshukela, ubisi oluphonswayo, kanye namafutha kuhlinzeka ngamandla amaningi nakuba kudliwa ngezinga elincane. Uma kungenzeka, kufanele kube kuhlanganiswe nezinye izidlo. Zama ukudla nomunye umuntu - ukudla nabanye kukwenza ujabulele ukudla kakhulu. Dla izidlo zakho endaweni ethokomele ukuze ujabulele kakhulu (dlala umculo, ngaphansi kwesihlahla, noma epakini). Ungabambeleli ezikhathini ezinqunyiwe zokudla - dlani noma nini uma uzizwa ufisa ukudla. Ukuhamba kancane kukhuphula umnqweno wokudla. Phuza iziphuzo ezinamandla phakathi nosuku, ezifana neziphuzo ezisekelwe kubisi, iziphuzo ezinamazambane, kanye nesobho esenziwe ekhaya. Dla ukudla okuthandayo - kungenzeka ukuthi uzodla kakhulu ngalendlela. Gwema ukudla okunokuthungwa okuqinile njengekhabhishi nekhofi uma kukwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Uma imithi oyithathayo ikwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno, buza umhlinzeki wezempilo uma ungathatha imithi ngemuva kokudla. Ingabe uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ukuhamba? Dla izigaba ezincane zokudla ngezikhathi eziningi ukuze ugweme ukuzizwa ungaphilile. Linda okungenani amahora amabili ngemuva kokudla ngaphambi kokulala. Gwema ukuphuza nothuli. Bangathuthukisa ukungakhululeki futhi bahlukumeze impilo yakho. Zama ukuphuza amanzi amaningi njengezimpahla ezihlanzekile kanye netiye.

Ukubamba izinhlelo zokuhlola nokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezikhethekile. Izikhungo ezikhipha izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu zizokwandisa umphakathi futhi ziqhubele phambili ukufinyelela kwezinsiza. Ukwamukela Izimvo Zabasebenzisi Ukubaluleka kokwamukela izimvo zabasebenzisi akuphikiswa. Izikhungo ezibheka izidingo zomphakathi zikhuthaza ukuhlanganyela, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni izikhungo ezizophumelela. Ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlanganyela, ukuthola imibono, nokuhlola izimo ezikhona, kuyasiza ekwenzeni izinguquko ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kukhuthaza umqondo wombuso ovulekile, okuholela ekwakheni izikhungo ezihlala zisebenziseka. Izingozi Nezinselelo Nokho, kunezingozi ezithile ezihambisana nokwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi. Ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinsiza ezanele, izinsizakusebenza, nomqondo wokwakha ohlakaniphile. Uma lezi zinto zingekho, izikhungo zingaba nezinkinga zokungasebenzi kahle, okukhathaza abathengi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukwakha izinqubo eziqinile zokugcina izikhungo ziphila njalo, nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezishiwo ngabasebenzisi. Isiphetho Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zisetshenziswa kahle, zihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabavakashi nezisebenzi, kubalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi ejabule.

Umbiko Ngomsebenzi KaBlack Coffee Isingeniso UBlack Coffee ungumculi ophumelelayo eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ufinyelele impumelelo enkulu, edlulisela umculo owamukelekile, ohlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene. Umculo wakhe udala izikhumbuzo ezikhethekile empilweni yabantu. Kulolu mbiko, sizobheka izimpumelelo zakhe, izinhlelo ezithinta impilo yakhe, kanye nomsebenzi wakhe. Ukukhula Nokubambisana UBlack Coffee, ogama lakhe langempela linguNkosinathi Maphumulo, wazalelwa eLimpopo ngomhla zingu-11 kuNhlangula ngo-1976. Wakhulela emndenini ophila impilo ejwayelekile, kodwa umculo wamkhanga kusenesikhathi. Ngesikhathi esekhaya, wagxila ekuthuthukiseni ikhono lakhe lokudlala ikhithi ye-DJ, okwakuwuqala wempilo yakhe njengomculi. Waqala ukufaka ama-samples omculo abaculi abanjengoBeyoncé, uDavid Guetta, noKylie Minogue ukuze akhe umculo ophumelelayo. UBlack Coffee usebenzise ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukuze athuthukise umculo wakhe, evula izicabha eziningi ezinhle, kuholele ekubeni abambe iqhaza emicimbini emikhulu, njenge-Coachella ngo-2019. Umculo Nethonya UBlack Coffee uthole udumo ngezinkanyezi zakhe eziningi, ezifana ne-"SBCNCSLY", "Drive", kanye ne-"Inkalakatha". Umculo wakhe uhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene, kusukela kumculo wezizukulwane zasemzini kuze kufike emculweni wezothando. Ungomunye wabaculi abahamba phambili beHouse Music eNingizimu Afrika, futhi uthanda ukusebenzisa izinsiza ze-melody nezithombe eziphilayo ukuze akhe imvamisa abazwanayo. Ukwazisa Umphakathi UBlack Coffee akagcini nje ngemculo, kodwa ube nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi.

I-South African Premier Soccer League (PSL) iyinsika yalo mkhakha, igcwalisa izinkanyezi eziningi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Akusikho ukuhamba phambili kuphela kwezikhwama zemali, kodwa futhi nakuqala kokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe obusetshenziswa emidlalweni. Izikhumbuzo zamakilabhu, imikhankaso yokukhuthaza, nokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu kudala ithuba lokukhula kwezemidlalo futhi kwandisa ubuchwepheshe bokulinganisa. Ukwazi ukuthi ingabe amaqembu anjengeGolden Arrows, Supersport United, neBidvest Wits axhumene kanjani nezifunda ezahlukahlukene kuyathakazelisa. Njengoba imiphakathi ihamba phambili, amaqembu abona izinselelo zabo ezithile, efaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, nokugcina abasebenzisi bawo benelisekile. Lokhu kwenza kube sobala ukuthi izinkolelo eziwumgogodla wokulwa nezinkinga zempilo yesikhumbuzo njalo zikhona. Kubavubukuli bebhola, njengamathimba weBafana Bafana, umsebenzi wabo obalulekile ubonakala engxenyeni yase-Africa. Ngemva kokuhluleka kwabanye, uBafana Bafana uyisibonelo sokuthi uma uhola kahle, ungafinyelela impumelelo enkulu. Ukukhula kolwazi nolwazi lokuhola okayela kokufunda okuxhasayo, kubalulekile empumelelweni yeqembu. Noma kunjalo, ukwehluka kwamaphepha ezokuxhumana gewela eceleni komhlaba wezokungcebeleka. Ubhubhane lweCovid-19 luveze izinselelo ezingakaze zicaciswe. Ngaphezu kwesithangami sokuncintisana, abathandi bebholana benza izifundo ezinzima, bezama ukugcina uthando lwabo lwezemidlalo, ngenkathi bejabulisa izigidi abantu abanebhadi ngokwenziwa.

E-Eastern Cape kunzima ukuthola abaluleki ngoba abekho abakhiqizi bezomnotho emaphandleni. Kufanele siqhubeke ukwazisa abalimi, akufanele sithathe izinyathelo ngaphandle kokukhuluma nabo - 'asivuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu'. Sekela abalimi ukubheka kahle isimo sebhizinisi sabo sokulima - amasimu abo, ogandaganda, imishini, izimpahla, izimfuyo, izinto bazinazo, izikwenethu, njll. Kufanele sisize abalimi ngazo zonke izinto ukuze bazoqonda kahle ukuthi umsebenzi wokulima unjani. Isibonelo: umlimi unamandla (Kw) angakanani ukulima amasimu angakanani? Qinisa ukuthi abalimi baya ukuqeqeshwa futhi bangene kule phrogramu lokuthuthukisa. Ukuba umlimi wezomnotho kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kukhona izinhlangano ezahlukene ezikwazi ukusiza ngalo msebenzi.

Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi noma induna yomkhumbi eyalwa ukuba athathe isinyathelo okukhulunywa ngaso kumthethonkambiso 4 d, umkhumbi othintekayo kuthathwa ngokuthi uboshiwe ngokwaloMthetho. a kusebenza umyalo ophathelene nomkhumbi olawula kwelinye izwe; futhi b umsebenzi womkhumbi ehluleka ukugcina umyalo. a kusebenza umyalo wokulawulwa ophathelene nomkhumbi; futhi b induna yomkhumbi yehluleka ukulandela umyalo. Icala okukhulunywa ngalo kumthethonkambiso 1 no 2 linesijeziso uma likulahlile uyojeziswa ngokukhokhiswa inhlawulo noma ukuvalelwa ejele isikhathi esiyizinyanga ezingevile kweziyi-12. d ilunga leziNhloli kuZwelonke. a umkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika ; kanye b namarekhodi ezokuvikela omkhumbi; kanye c noma imuphi umbhalo ophathelene nezokuvikela zomkhumbi, ngokwenhloso yokubhekisisa ukuthi umkhumbi uyahlangabezana nezidingo ezifunekayo zokufakazelwa kwe-ISSC. uma kungumkhumbi olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika , noma imuphi umbhalo f sivule izinto zokusebenza emkhunjini olawulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuthola imibhalo noma amarekhodi akulowo mkhumbi. Kodwa-ke, isikhulu esigunyaziwe akufanele sisebenzise amandla ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 2 mayelana nomkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe ofulege lawo liyilunga lesivimelwano, ngaphandle uma amandla awuhlobo lwamandla olungasetshenziswa ngaphansi kweSahluko XI-2 seSivumelwano sokuVikela kanye noMgomo we-ISPS, yichweba mayelana nomkhumbi onefulegi lakwelinye izwe.

Ukufunda ngezinkinga zamanzi kusiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yamanzi. Umbuzo 13: Kanjani umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi? Umphakathi ungakha umqondo wokugcina amanzi ngokuhlanganisa imikhankaso yokufundisa, ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlanza imithombo yamanzi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yamanzi. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zinto kuzokwenza abantu babe nesibopho sokugcina amanzi. Umbuzo 14: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi? Singathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphakelwa kwamanzi ngokwenza ucwaningo olujulile, ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, nokubambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ubuchwepheshe bokuphakelwa kwamanzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 15: Kanjani izinkinga zamanzi zingathinta umnotho? Izinkinga zamanzi zingathinta umnotho ngendlela enkulu. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukukhiqiza, ukwanda kwezindleko, kanye nokwehla kokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uyakhula. Isiphetho: Izinkinga zamanzi zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngokuqonda izizathu, izimpawu, kanye nezixazululo, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ukubambisana, ukufundisa, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga.

Ukuxhumana kahle kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo wengqondo, futhi kukhuthaze umuzwa wokuxhaswa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuxhumana ezivulekile, ukuze abantu abasha bakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto ezinzima abahlangabezana nazo. Okwesithathu, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Abantu abasha badinga ukufundiswa ukuthi bangaziphatha kanjani uma behlangabezana nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufunda izindlela zokuphumula, ukusebenzisa amasu okucabanga, kanye nokuthola izindlela zokuzithokozisa. Ukuphatha imizwa kahle kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zengqondo, futhi kukhuthaze impilo enempilo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokufunda zifake lezi zifundo, ukuze abantu abasha bakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo. Okwesine, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze umqondo wokwamukela. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu yizinkinga zokuzizwa bengafaneleki, noma bengafaneleki. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphatheke kabi, futhi kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo yengqondo. Ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo yentsha, kufanele sikhuthaze umqondo wokwamukela, sikhuthaze abantu abasha ukuba bazethembe, futhi sibavumele ukuba baphile impilo yabo ngaphandle kokwesaba ukugxekwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi baziqhenye ngabo. Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile, futhi kudingeka ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga. Ukuxhumana, ukufunda ukuphatha imizwa, kanye nokwamukela kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuxhasa abantu abasha, sibanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi sikhuthaze izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo.

ngokulandela Isigaba--14 somthethosisekelo wezwe esibeka imibandela noma esivimbela ukungena, komhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati noma umuntu ogunyazwe ngumhloli kamasipalati angase phakathi kwa- 7h30 ekuseni no 05:00 ntambama angene ahlole noma iyiphi impahla okufanele ihlolwe ngokwezinhloso zalomthetho. a acaphune kunoma yimuphi usomqulu noma kunoma yiluphi ulwazi akholelwa wukuthi ludingekile kulokho kuhlola; bese b ebhalela umnikazi noma lowo ohleli endlini noma lowo okhuluma egameni lomnikazi noma lalowo ohleli ukuba amnikeze imininingwane ebhalwe phansi emayelana nendlu umhloli akholelwa wukuthi idingekile kulokho kuhlola. b ngasebenzisi isikhundla sokuba wumhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati ngenhloso yokuba yena azinothise noma anothise omunye umuntu ngokungekho emthethweni; bese c ahambisane nendlela yokuziphatha ebalulwe ohlelweni- 2 Lomthetho Wezinhla Zomasipalati. umhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati owephula noma owehluleka ukuhambisana nesigatshana -1 unecala lokungaziphathi kahle futhi angase abhekane nokuxoshwa njengomhloli kamasipalati noma umelekeleli womhloli kamasipalati.

Kukhona amathuba entuthuko ezinhlakeni zabazisebenzayo, kwezokuvakasha, nakwezamasiko. Isu lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono liqonde ukukhuthaza abaqashi ukuthi babone ukuthi abasebenzi yibona abayisisekelo sokudlondlobala nokukhula kwemisebenzi yabo. Ukusungulwa kwaMasu amaKhono aseMisebenzini kuzodala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono namacebo ezinkampani okukhula kanye nawomgomo wendinganiso yabasebenzi. Labo baqashi asebethole isabelo sokuthuthukisa amakhono kuyofanela bakhombise ukuthi imithetho yokuthuthukiswa sebeyilandele kangakanani. Kanjalo nasemisebenzini yomphakathi amasu okusetshenziswa kwamakhono angahambisana kahle kakhulu nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi ukuze nomsebenzi womnyango lowo ube ngcono. Kuqala ke kwakuye kugxilwe efemini ethize ngokuthuthukisa amakhono. Sekujikile ke lokho kwenza manje, kuthi kubhekwe umkhiqizo walelofemu kodwa kube kubhekwe nanokuthi kungahlanganyelwa kanjani namanye amafemu ukuze kwenziwe ngcono isimo somnotho nanokuthi umkhiqizo ukhuphuke nakhu izandla seziningi. Sekusetshenzwa ngokuxhumana manje emafemini, kanti namaxhama aya ngokuqina uma kubanjisenwe. Izingqungquthela zezimboni ezahlukene ziye zidingide ukwenza ngcono amasu okusebenza. Lawo masu ke angasithola isisekelo futhi enziwe ngcono ngokusungula izindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezizokwandisa umkhiqizo bese kuthuthuka nabasebenzi nezizokwazi ukuba amakhono athutheke. Lezizinhlelo ezintsha zokufundiswa nokuqeqeshwa ezawo wonke umuntu, omdala nomncane. Izinhlelo zokufunda zizokunikezwa izigaba ezehlukene ohlakeni lokuqeqeshwa likazwelonke.

Abasebenzi abangase babe nezinkinga uma kuneziteleka, ezinjengokuvalelwa emsebenzini, ukuvinjwa kwemiholo, noma ukungaphenduli kahle emsebenzini. Ngezinye izikhathi, iziteleka zingaholela ekuphazamisekeni komkhiqizo, okuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu kwibhizinisi. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyavunyelwa ngokomthetho? Yebo, iziteleka zabasebenzi zivunywa ngokomthetho eziningi zezwe. Kokubili umthetho kazwelonke nezifunda zikhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi banezikhala zokuphikisana uma izinkampani zingakholwa izidingo zabo. Nokho, imithetho ingahluka kakhulu ezwenikazi nasemikhakheni ehlukene, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baqonde amalungelo abo. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele uyenze uma ubamba iqhaza ezitelekeni? Uma ubamba iqhaza ezitelekeni, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle amalungelo akho. Ukuze kukhulunywe ngesivumelwano esifanele, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nezenzo ezithile ezilawulwa imo yokuphepha. Kubalulekile futhi ukuzijwayeza nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezivumelwano zomsebenzi eziphathelene neziteleka. Umbuzo 7: Zithini izibonelo zeziteleka zabasebenzi ezidumile? Kuneziteleka eziningi ezidumile emhlabeni jikelele. Isibonelo, iziteleka zabasebenzi bezokusebenza ezinkampanini zokuqashwa kwezimoto eMelika zabe ziveza izinkinga ezinzima zokusebenza. Ezinye izimo ziqhakambisa izitesi ezilawulayo, iziteleka zabakhweli bezokuxhumana, kanye neziteleka zomsebenzi wezempilo, okukhombisa izinkinga eziwohlokayo ezikhona emikhakheni ehlukene. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngokubuyiselwa kwempahla nempilo ngemva kweziteleka?

Asebenzisa abalimi ekulungiseni nasekuphatheleni izinsiza zabo nemishini. Kanjani kufanele kusetshenziswe abaqashi emkhakheni wezolimo? Ingxenye yezindlela zokuqala zokulima umhlaba iwukusebenzisa abaqashi abakhulu. Lokhu sekwenziwe izikhathi eziningi, futhi kuthiwa umqashi uzosetshenziswa kuphela ekuqaleni, ekugcineni umalimi uzosebenza ngokwakhe. Umalimi akatholi inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza nemishini. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ziya zanda. Imali ekhokhwayo ukuze uthole umqashi ingasetshenziswa ukulungisa nokugcina izinsiza nemishini. Abalimi abangasebenzi nomqashi, ngakho, abaqondi kahle ukuzenzela. Isimo sezulu esomile ezindaweni eziningi lapha senza isikhathi sokutshala, ukutshala, nokuvuna sibe mfushane; kaningi umsebenzi awuqhutshekanga ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi umalimi ulahlekelwa umkhiqizo wabo (ukutshala nokufaka umanyolo sekwephuzile). Umqashi ukhokhelwa ngehektare elitshaliwe, hhayi ngokusekelwe kwekhwalithi yomsebenzi wabo - noma umalimi enza inzuzo noma cha, umqashi uthola ukukhokhelwa kwakhe. Kukho abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abalimayo futhi banemithombo. Laba abalimi kufanele bakwazi ukuqasha amapulazi kwabanye abanikazi bomhlaba abangafuni noma abangakwazi ukulima. Okwamanje, amapulazi amaningi akhishwa ngamabhizinisi ezolimo, ngakho-ke abanye abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakwazi ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Lapho kukhona abalimi abangenazo izinsiza, kuthiwa bazokwazi ukwenza inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza. Kodwa lokhu akuphumeleli - inzuzo etholakala ekulimaleni kwezimpahla zokudla incane kakhulu, futhi abaqashi baphinde baphinde banciphise inzuzo.

Ukunquma igama noma amagama ngendawo kudinga ukuqhathanisa okuphusile phakathi komlando nesidingo solimi, ubulula bokuxhumana, intando yomphakathi neyesizwe sonkana. ukugqugquzela ulwazi ngomhlomulo otholwa wumnotho kanjalo nenhlaliswano ngenxa yomfaniswano ngamagama ezindawo. ukuveza iqhinga lokukhipha, kufakwe amanye amagama ezindaweni ezaqanjwa ngaphansi kwencindezi. ukwenza lula, ukufafaza ulwazi nokwedlulisa ulwazi ngenqubo yohlelo lomfaniswano lapho kuqanjwa amagama ezindawo, kungasakazwa emaphephandabeni noma ngemibiko yekhompuyutha. ukusungula amakomidi amagama ezindawo ezifundazweni (PGNC's), ngokulawula kwemibandela yoMthetho waseNingizimu Afrika wamaGama eziNdawo neMithetho ephathelene noMfaniswano emaGameni eziNdawo. Umkhandlu waqoka lamakomidi amancane alandelayo. Ngaphezulu kwalabo abaqokwa ekuqaleni, kunamanye futhi amalunga anokusetshenziswa ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsebenzi walo wukuqondisa nokwenza umfaniswano ezinhlamvini zamagama: ukubuyekeza amagama amaningi; yilawo avele ekhona kodwa angemukelekile ngokomthetho, nezinye izindaba ezencikile nezinganqunywa wuMkhandlu. Libunjelwe ukuqopha uhlelo lokwakha nokugcina ulwazi nemininingwane; ukuqoqa ulwazi; ukunquma iqhinga lokuvuselela ulwazi, kuhlale kunolwazi olusha; ukuxhumana nezinye izinhlaka zokugcina ulwazi; nokunquma izidingo zabasebenzisi balomtapo. Umsebenzi walo: ukubumba isizinda sababambe iqhaza; ukubamba imibuthano yokufundisa nokuvuselelana (workshops) kubafundi; ukuqopha umbhalo wokuqeqesha nokubumba ithimba emazingeni kazwelonke nasezifundazweni.

Ngokwezibalo ezitholakele, kubonakala ukuthi abantu abadala abanempahla enenani elingaphansi kwezigidi eziyisithupha rand banesidingo esikhulu sokusizwa. Ngakho-ke, iMasipala izoqala uhlelo lokubeka umkhawulo othile ezimalini zokukhululeka ekukhokheni. 2011 - R3,000,000 2011 / 2012 - R2,000,000 Amanye amakhawulo angase abekwe ngemuva kokubuyekezwa okujwayelekile kwezilinganiso ezilandelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMasipala ngeke ivumele ukwehliswa okwengeziwe kwemithwalo yokukhokha ezabelweni zangempela. Abantu abadala abake bakhululwa emthwalweni wokukhokha ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo sangempela bazoqhubeka benenzuzo kuze kube kubuyekezwa okujwayelekile kwezilinganiso ezilandelayo ngo-2012. kumele kube umnikazi obhalisiwe wendlu abahlala kuyo njengomnikazi. uma bebambisene, bonke abanikazi kumele bahlangabezane nezimo zokufaneleka ezikwi-7.2 noma 7.3. e umnikazi kumele abe ngumnikazi wesikhathi esigcwele salo mhlaba; f amanzi, ugesi, nezilinganiso kumele zibe ndawonye egameni lomnikazi; g inani lomhlaba wokuhlala kumele lingadluli kulokho okukhulunywe yiBhodi kwi-bhajethi yalo yonyaka h ohlelweni lokuphathwa kwezimpahla, umphathi wezimpahla kumele ahlangabezane nazo zonke

c kungasulwa noma kuguqulwe ngemuva kokunikeza isaziso esifanele. a ube ne-ISSC esemthethweni noma I-ISSC eyamukelekile yalowo mkhumbi; futhi b aqiniseke ukuthi umkhumbi unamarekhodi omkhumbi ezokuvikela adingekayo. Uma umsebenzi womkhumbi olawula kwelinye izwe ephula umthethonkambiso 1 umsebenzi womkhumbi noma induna yomkhumbi inganikwa umyalo ngaphansi kweSahluko 2. Induna yoMkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe, noma umkhumbi ofisa ukungena emanzini aseNingizimu Afrika okuyothi uma sewungenile ube ngumkhumbi olawula kwelinye izwe kufanele unikezele ulwazi ngaphambi kokufika ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezimiswe ngokubhaliwe IsiPhathimandla. ichweba elingalawulwa ngezokuVikela; futhi b ungowohlobo olungacelwa ngaphansi komthethonkambiso XI-2/9 weSivumelwano sezokuVikela yichweba lomkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe lefulege. Uma induna yomkhumbi iphula umthethonkambiso 1, induna noma umsebenzi womkhumbi anganikezwa umyalo ngokwesahluko- 2. Induna yomkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe kufanele ivumele isikhulu esigunyaziwe ukuba singene sihlole umkhumbi ngokwengxenye- 6. Induna yomkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe kufanele uma icelwa isikhulu esigunyaziwe inikezele amarekhodi ezokuvikela alowo mkhumbi agcinwe emkhunjini. Uma Induna yomkhumbi yephula umthethonkambiso 1 , induna noma umsebenzi womkhumbi walowo mkhumbi anganikwa umyalo ngokwesahluko -2. Lomthethonkambiso ubeka izinyathelo zokuphepha okufanele zisetshenziswe yimikhumbi elawulwa kwamanye amazwe.

Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu wukuthi abathengi bavame ukungaqondi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokwelashwa, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Odokotela nabo bahlushwa izinselelo ezithile, njengokungabi nesikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo yokugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abathengi bangatholi ukwelashwa okudingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe zokugunyazwa. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa ukugunyazwa kodokotela Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugunyazwa kodokotela, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubodokotela ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele kubathengi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izicelo zokugunyazwa zifinyelela ngesikhathi. Okwesibili, i-GEMS ingase ibheke ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile ezivumela abathengi ukuba bafake izicelo zokugunyazwa kalula, kanye nokuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubathengi ukufinyelela odokotela babo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isiphetho Ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo.

Uma siqikelela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono sizokwenza ukuthi sisheshe kakhulu ukunciphisa igebe elikhona phakathi kwabampofu nabadla izambane likampondo, abeswele nabanothile. Sineqiniso ukuthi indlela esihamba ngayo ibheke ekuqedeni ubuphofu nokwantuleka kwemisebenzi. Bafowethu nodadewethu siyazi ukuthi kukhona abathile abalokhu bezame njalo ukucekela phansi imizamo yethu yokusheshisa intuthuko. Udlame nobugebengu buyasiphazamisa emgomweni wethu, Kanjalo nalabo abakhela abantu bakithi izindlu ezingekho esimeni, abaqashisa ngezindlu zomxhaso kaHulumeni ngisho nalabo abazidayisayo. Bonke lababantu basibuyisela emuva ngoba, izimali nesikhathi okumele ngabe kusetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bakithi zichithwa ekulwisaneni nenkohlakalo, udlame nobugebengu. Ngakho ngiphonsa inselelo kithina njengomphakathi ukuthi silwe nalokhu ukuze siziveze obala izigilamkhuba ezifuna ukusibuyisela emuva. Asingavumeli idlanzana labantu licekele phansi konke okuhle esesikuzuzile kuleminyaka elishumi nanye sathola inkululeko. Umphakathi yiwona okufanele uziqaphela ngokwawo izinsiza zawo. Impumelelo esesibe nayo besingeke siyithole ukuba nina njengomphakathi anibambanga iqhaza naguqula imiphakathi yenu ngokuthi nizithuthukise nina. Loluhlelo esilwethula namuhla luwubufakazi bokubekezela kwenu nilwisana nokungafiki kwentuthuko nobubha. Singuhulumeni asenzi izethembiso ezingekho. Okwethu ukuthi silethe intuthuko ngoba intuthuko phela ingumongo wentando yeningi kulelizwe lethu. Ngempela njengoHulumeni sesisenzile isisekelo sempilo engcono futhi siyaqhubeka ngamandla.

umuntu ovunyelwe' uchaza umuntu ophilayo ogunyazwe ngaphansi kweNgxenye 66 wuKhomishani noma inhlangano egunyazwe ngaphansi kweNgxenye 149, kuye ngesimo sokuba akhande indiza engenaso isitifiketi sokundiza ngendlela ehambisana naleyo ndiza futhi uchaza umnikazi wendiza yokuzakhela noma ekhiqizwe yilowo muntu ngokulandela izimiso zeNgxenye 24 ";. umgibeli wesindizi sesondo' sichaza into endizayo engenanjini engaphansi kwendizamshini, esizwa wumoya nezinsiza zesondo eliphendukayo elixhunywe emilenzeni yalo;. ibhukwana lokulawula iziwombe zokulungisa lichaza ibhuku elihlanganiswe ngumnikazi noma ngosebenzisa isindizi ngendlela ehambisana nemibandela yaleMigomo zemukelwe wuKhomishani ngaphansi komgomo 43.02. ukuhlola ngempoqo ngezikhathi ezithile' kuchaza ukuhlola okuphoqwe ngaphansi komgomo 43.02. indiza elula kalula' ichaza indiza encishiselwe isivinini sokundiza nesisindo ngesikhathi isuka emhlabathini. isindiza sokungcebeleka' sichaza ibhanoyi elinesisindo esingekho ngaphezulu kwamakhilogilemu angu 850, esihamba ngenjini futhi esinezinkomba zesindizi esihamba ngaphandle kwenjini uma icinyiwe;. b Shicilela umgomo ohlongozwayo noma iqophelo lomsebenzi, isichibiyelo noma isihoxiso ngendlela evunywe yikomidi kulandela imizamo yalo echazwe emgonyaneni 3 njengoba ihlongoze ukushaya umthetho ngesaziso seGazethe uma uphathelene nemigomo noma ngesaziso sewebusayithi-CAA, uma uphathelene namaqophelo omsebenzi. Ukugaxa umgomo 11.03. Ngakho umgomo olandelayo ugaxwa ngemuva komgomo 11.03.

Izindaba zezempilo kanye namalungu abahloniphekile yizihloko eziyinhloko ezixoxwa ezinkundleni ezibhekana nokuthuthukiswa kokuphila komphakathi kanye nomnotho. I-International Rural Women's Conference ibanjwe eThekwini njengoba sikhuluma. Siyazi ukuthi kuleli gumbi, abesifazane benza u-53% wabantu bonke futhi iningi labo bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, izifo, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Kukhona amazwe athuthukayo athole umehluko omkhulu kulezi zinselelo esibhekene nazo. Sithemba ukuthi le nkulumo izohlinzeka ngethuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yokuthi singabhekana kanjani nalezi zindaba ezibhekene nabesifazane kuleli sikhathi. Umsebenzi wethu njengomnyango wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngokulandela umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kusukela ezingeni eliphansi, sigxile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu bonke ngokulinganayo, sithinta umphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo futhi sibambisane nazo zonke izigaba ezikhona kuleli. Isikhungo sokuqala sokunakekelwa kwezempilo sasungulwa endaweni yasePholela lapha eKwaZulu-Natal ngo-1948, iminyaka engamashumi amathathu ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwe-Alma Ata Declaration ngonyaka ka-1978, njengendlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu. Umndeni wezempilo emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezweni elithuthukayo, uyavuma ukuthi kufanele siqinise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo uma sifuna ukubhekana kahle nomthwalo wokulwa nezifo. Sibe nemicimbi ehlukahlukene ngonyaka odlule lapho sakhuluma ngezaziso ezihlukahlukene zezempilo kumiphakathi.

Isivimbela-zigebengu sasehlulekile. Nomshini ocushwayo okhala nxashana kunothile ovula umnyango wase wehlulekile. Kusobala ukuthi wabe ehlangene nongqondongqondo impela. Okwakufike kumqede du ukuthi kwakungasali nomncane umkhondo owawungasiza abakwasidlodlo. Ukuhamba kwezimpahla ubuthaphuthaphu esitolo kwase kumfake kwezinkulu izindleko. Izikweledu zase zithanda ukumgabha. Abasebenzi nabo ngapha, babebhilidile befuna ukwenyuselwa amaholo. "Bantabami, ugogo Sweluboya usedukelwe yimali yakhe yonke yomholo. Impilo Yabantu Abasebenzayo: Ukuhlola Izimo Nezinselelo Impilo yabantu abasebenzayo, eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-working class, iyinkinga edidayo futhi eyahlukene. Laba bantu, abaneziqu eziphansi, bavame ukuba neziqu eziphansi, bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, besebenza imisebenzi eminingi ethwalisa kanzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi impilo yabo ibhekane nezinkinga. Le ndatshana izama ukufakazela ukuthi impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi akufanele ibonakale njengento engcolile. Ukuze siqonde kahle impilo yabo, kudingeka sihlolisise izici ezisemqoka. Okokuqala, lezi zisebenzi zithwalaniswa imithwalo eminingi, zikhungathekile ngezinto ezilula eziphathelene nosuku nosuku. Imisebenzi engaphandle kwezokuphila, efana nokusebenza ezindlini, ezinyangeni, noma emakhaya, ibabamba phansi, ikakhulukazi lapho ivame ukuzenzakalela ngaphandle kokunakekelwa. Abantu abasebenzayo bahlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezimali, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulisa imindeni yabo. Lokhu kubuhlungu, njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kanti izinkampani ziphakamisa umholo ngendlela engahambisani nezindleko ezikhulayo zokuphila. Ukuhlupheka kwalezi zisebenzi kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu, ngoba akukhona nje ukusweleka kwemali, kodwa nakukwazi ukuzitholela isikhathi sokuphumula, sokuxhumana, nempilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibonakala iphazamiseka ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi. Izinselelo zomsebenzi, ezifana nokushoda kokuhlela isikhathi, ziye zashintsha. Abantu abahlala emakhaya bahlushwa ukuba basebenze imisebenzi eminingi ukuze baphile, okuholela ekucindezelekeni kwengqondo, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulela impilo.

Lezi zifaka phakathi: - Ukungabi Nabo Ubuchwepheshe Obuphezulu: Ezinye izinkampani zikagesi zingase zingabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlola izinkinga, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. - Ukungavumi Kwezinhlaka: Abanye abantu bangase bangavumi izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe, okwenza kube nzima ukuvuma izinqumo ezithile. - Izinsiza Ezinganele: Ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngogesi emiphakathini ethile kungaholela ekutheni izinkinga zibe nzima kakhulu. ### Ukubaluleka Kokulalela Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba: - Kwakha Uxolo: Ukuxoxisana nokuhlola izinkinga ngokubambisana kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezixazululweni eziphumelelayo. - Kwandisa Ukubambisana: Lokhu kukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi, iziphathimandla, nabantu, okuholela ekwakheni isixazululo esiqinile. - Kwakha Ukuzethemba: Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izinkinga zabo zihlolwe futhi zixazululwa, bakha ukwethemba kwiPhalamende, okubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. ### Isiphetho Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuxazulula izinkinga ezithinta ugesi, okuyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Le nqubo idinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga zihlolwe ngokujulile, futhi izixazululo eziphumelelayo zikhishwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezithuthukisa ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola ugesi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila impilo engcono.

Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezichaza umnako ovukile mayelana nokuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika, isibonelo: umhlaba okwazi ukukhiqiza uyabelwa, intengo yokudla ikhuphukile kakhulu futhi kukhona omnako omkhulu mayelana nokutholakala kokudla ezweni lethu nasemhlabeni jikelele. Kukhulunywa kaningi ngenkinga yokudla okukhona emhlabeni jikelele, ngokulondoloza lokhu kudla emhlabeni jikelele, ngelungelo lokuba nokudla nendawo yokuhlala, ekugcineni lokhu kudla kukhiqizwa ngumuntu othile endaweni ethile - kukhona umuntu osebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi simbheke kahle lowo muntu. Kudingeka ukuthi kuthuthukiswe lowo muntu nokumnikeza ikhono lokuba umkhiqizi wezomnotho ozonikeza ukudla kwakhe ezweni lethu lapho kudingekayo. Kungani abantu bafune ukwazi ukuthi benzani abalimi abasakhulayo? Isigaba sezokulima sidinga ukuba nezwi elilodwa elihlangene elibakhulumelayo. Izinto zezokulima kuyingcebo enikeza ukudla emhlabeni jikelele futhi kuyisisekelo sezomnotho samazwe emhlabeni jikele. Izinto zezokulima zinikeza umsebenzini obalulekile kubantu abaningi emhlabeni. Ukukhula kwezomnotho wasemaphandleni kwenza ukuthi izingcebo ezisemadolobheni zingacindezeleki kakhulu. Lapho 1-30% lomhlaba lisezandleni zabantu abangazange banethuba lokuba abanini bomhlaba, sizocabanga ukuthi i-30% lomkhiqizo ovela ngokulima uzovela kulabo bantu. Ngakho-ke sicabanga ukuthi i-30% lezinto ezidingekayo emsebenzini wezokulima zizothengwa yilabo balimi. Ziyini izinkinga abakhiqizi abasakhulayo babhekene nazo? Inzuzo ephansi yokudla okuzinhlamvu lapho kulinywa ngemvula kuphela futhi isilinganiso senzalo (interest rates) esikhuphukayo.

Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweSishayamthetho neBhunga leSifunda. Ukhetho lwesizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abakuthandayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi ibeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa. Umgwaqo omusha weZinsiza Zabesifazane, Izingane, nabantu abaneZinkinga Zokusebenza usunguliwe ukuze uqinise imizamo yohulumeni yokukhuthaza nokuvikela abantu abahluphekayo emphakathini wethu. Nakuba abesifazane bebaningi kubantu eNingizimu Afrika, bahlala bengabantu abancane uma kuziwa ezinqumweni. Kunezinkinga eziningi ezivimbela abesifazane ekudlaleni indima ephelele futhi ebonakalayo, kanti eyodwa enkulu yilezi ubumpofu. Ubumpoor buwumsebenzi obhekene nabesifazane abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane basemaphandleni. Ukuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nemfundo, amanzi, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kuvinjwa ubulili, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Ukuze abesifazane babambe iqhaza ngokuphelele ekudalweni kwemithetho, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile kubabesifazane kumele kuthuthukiswe. Abesifazane abahluphekayo banokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ezikhungweni zokudala imithetho. Abaningi babesifazane babhekene nezinselelo zokwakha umnotho. Abesifazane ngokujwayelekile bangumphakathi ophakeme kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi bangase babe ngaphansi kokusebenza noma bengenamsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS luthinta kakhulu ingxenye enkulu yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasha eminyakeni yabo yokukhulelwa.

Ngaphandle uma kubonakala kunokushayisana noma kungahambisani nokuqukethwe, ubunye buzohlanganisa nobuningi kanti ubulili besilisa buhlanganisa nobesifazane, kanjalo noma kuphendukezelwe. Le SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelelele phakathi KWAMAQEMBU futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esike saba khona phakathi KWAMAQEMBU maqondana nokuqukethwe lapha. AMAQEMBU ayavumelana ngokuthi angeke kushintshwe, kwengezwe, noma kuvunyelwane ngokukhansela noma lutho kwakhiwe kabusha le SIVUMELWANO kukho konke noma iphuzu noma umbandela waso futhi noma kwenzeka angeke kube namphumela ekusebenzeni kwesivumelwan ngaphandle uma kubhalwa phansi futhi omabili amaqembu asayinde noma asayindelwe abawamele. Ukuthethelelwa okwenziwe yiqembu akusho ukuthi seliyawahoxisa amalungelo alo ngaphansi kwale SIVUMELWANO, ngakho-ke, lelo qembu angeke libe nesivimbezelo sokusebenzisa amalungelo alo ngenxa yokuthi esikhathini esidlule kade lixolelile noma ngoba kukhona okuqhamukayo. AMAQEMBU akule SIVUMELWANO ayavumelana ukuthi azokwenganyelwa amandla eNkantolo Enkulu yesiFundazwe saseTransvaal, yeNkantolo Ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika (noma iNkantolo Ephakeme leyo okungathi ukuhamba kwesikhathi kube yiyo esinamandla engamele iNkantolo yesifunda ePitoli), maqondana nanoma yisiphi isinyathelo noma ukubophana okungaqhamuka kule SIVUMELWANO.

Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo iyinsika yokusebenza, futhi abantu baphakathi kokuphila. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima, siphinde sihlole izindlela esizisebenzisayo. Siphakamisela ukunakekela imvelo. Izinhlelo zokuvikela imvelo zidingeka ukuze sinciphise imiphumela yalezi zinsuku ezinzima. Umthelela wezikhukhula awukhawulelwanga, kodwa udlula ezicini ezahlukene zokuphila kwabantu. Ngiyavuma, izikhukhula zikhumbuza izinkumbulo ezimbi, kodwa ziqinisa ukholo lwethu empilweni. Ukuhlupheka kuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihlakaniphile, lapho abantu bevela emazweni ahlukahlukene behamba ngezinyawo. Izibonelo zomphakathi ezinhle zikhona, lapho abavakashi bahlala bechubeka bethu. Ngifisa intuthuko e-KZN. Ukuze sibe nezikhumbuzo ezinhle ngezikhukhula, kufanele sithinte izinselelo zokuvikela imiphakathi. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhlungu bukhona, kodwa bangenza izinhlelo ezinhle. Ubuqotho bokubambisana, ukucabanga, nezinqubomgomo ezifanele zingasiza abantu bakhule. Ngemva kwesikhathi esinzima, umoya wezinkumbulo ulethe umuzwa wokuphila. Izikhukhula zikhumbuza ubuNkulunkulu bomphakathi, obhukuza abantu ukuba babekezelele, bese bezivumelanisa nezinhlelo zempilo. Kukhona ukuphila kwemiphakathi ethe xaxa, izikhukhula zikhuthaza ucwaningo nolwakhiwo. Ngaphezu kwamazwi, zikhumbuza ukuthi ukugcina imikhuba emihle kuyadingeka. Imizamo yokwakha ibhodi lokuphila ingaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo. Namuhla, ngikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba aphinde athathe izinyathelo eziningi, ukuphila okwaziyo.
