Loku kusemqoka kakhulu eZingeni leMfundo eYisisekelo lapho abafundi befunda ukufunda nokubhala. Ulimi olwengeziwe kumele lufakwe njengesifundo ngokushesha kusaqalwa. Ulimi lwebele kumele baqhubeke balusebenzisele ukufunda nokufundisa baluhambise nolwengeziwe isikhathi eside nje impela. Lapho abafundi bengena esikoleni lapho ulimi lokufunda nokufundisa kungolwengeziwe kumfundi, othisha nesikole kumele bahlele izindlela ezingajwayelekile zokusiza nokulekelela umfundi ukuba afunde ulimi olwengeziwe, kuze kufike isikhathi lapho umfundi ekwazi ukufunda ngempumelelo olimini lokufunda nokufundisa. Izilimi ziyizisekelo sempilo yethu. Sixoxisana siqonde kahle ngomhlaba wethu ngokusebenzisa ulimi. Ulimi-ke lwakha ubuthina kanye nolwazi esinalo. Izilimi ziveza izinjongo ezahlukehlukene, ezibonakala esiTatimendeni somkhakha wokuFunda weZilimi. Ubuwena - ukugcina ukuthuthukisa nokushintsha ubuwena;ukugcina ubudlelwano emndenini nasemphakathini; kanye nokuzikhulisa nokuzijabulisa. Ukufunda - ukuthuthukisa izikhali zokucabanga nokucabangisisa, kanye nokunikeza amathuba ukuthola ulwazi. Ukusebenzisa imizwa - Ukwakha , ukuhumusha nokudlala ngomcabango ngeziqephu zomlomo, ezibukwayo kanye nezibhalwayo. Kwezamasiko - ukuzwisisa nokwazisa ezinye izilimi namasiko, kanye nokuyigugu okuhambisana nazo. Kwezombusazwe - Ukuzethemba nokucela inselele kwabanye ngento ongayiboni kahle eyenziwa omunye umuntu; ukwenza abantu babone izinto ngendlela obona ngayo; ukuzibeka wena noma omunye umuntu ngendlela yokuthi abantu bathole esinye isithombe ngawe noma ngabo; ukugcina, ukuthuthukisa nokushintsha ubuwena.

Okunye ukuvunyelwa okuphathelene nezindaba zolimi kwenziwa kwenye indawo yomThethosisekelo. IsiGaba sesi-9(3) sivikela ukubandlululwa ngezizathu zolimi, ngaso leso sikhathi isigaba sama-30 nama-31(1) sikhuluma ngamalungelo esintu mayelana namasiko, inkolo kanye nokuzibandakanya ngokolimi nokuzijabulisa. IsiGaba sama-35(3) nama (4) sikhuluma ngamalungelo olimi abantu ababoshiwe, abagciniwe nabasolwa ngokuthize, ngokugcizelela ikakhulukazi ilungelo lokugwetshwa ngokungabandlulula nenqubo okuqhutshwa ngayo noma okuhunyushwa ngayo ngolimi oluthandwa yiloyo muntu. UmNyango wezeMfundo (DoE) wangenisa Inqubomgomo yoLimi lweMfundo (LiEP), egcizelela ubuliminingi njengokwandiswa ukwehluka kwamasiko kanye nengxenye esemqoka yokwakha iNingizimu Afrika engabandlululi ngebala . Umgomo okuncikwe kuwo ukugcina ulimi lebele lomfundi ekufundeni nasekufundiseni, kodwa abafundi bagqugquzelwa ukuthi bafunde nezilimi ezengeziwe. I-LiEP ibhekene nalezi zindaba ezifana nolimi/nezilimi zokufunda nokufundisa ezikolweni zikahulumeni, ohlelweni lwezifundo lwesikole, kanye nasemisebenzini ephathelene nolimi kuminyango yemfundo yezifunda kanye nezinhlangano eziphethe esikoleni. UmThethosisekelo kanye nemithetho ehambisana nawo kubonakala kahle ukuthi kusekela ukuthuthukiswa kobuliminingi eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlaka lwenqubomgomo kumele luvumele ukulinganisa ngokwanele ukuhlanganisa inqubomgomo yolimi kuzo zontathu izigaba zikahulumeni futhi luveze ngokucacile ukuthi inqubomgomo imephi ngezinga nangokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinjengezokufihla ulwazi, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula ukufinyelela kolwazi. Okwesibili, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayo baqeqeshwa ngokuqinile mayelana nokuvikelwa kolwazi. Ukuqeqeshwa kubalulekile ukuze bonke abasebenzi baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangaluvikela kanjani ulwazi lwabantu. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kuhlanganisa izifundo ezisemthethweni, izinkulumo, kanye nezifundo ezibukhoma. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma i-GEMS ithatha izinyathelo eziningi, izinkinga zokuphepha kolwazi zisekhona. Ukuhlaselwa kwezobuchwepheshe, okungaba yizigebengu ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze zithole ulwazi, kuyinkinga enkulu. I-GEMS ibhekana nalezi zinkinga ngokuqinisa izinhlelo zayo zokuphepha, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zayo zihlala zisesikhathini nezinguquko ezibhekene nezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibambisana nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zayo zokuvikelwa kolwazi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana nezinhlangano eziphethe izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, kanye nokubambisana nezinhlangano eziphethe izifundo zokuvikela ulwazi. Ukubaluleka Kokuvikelwa Kolwazi Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akukhona nje kuphela okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kolwazi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuze kwandiswe ukwethenjwa kwabantu. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luhlala lukhuselekile, bazoba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni izinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni i-GEMS ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle kakhulu, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emphakathini.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsiza zezimali, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezindawo zokuzijabulisa. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abahamba phambili ezinkingeni. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza lokukhulisa impilo engcono kubantu abahlala kule ndawo, futhi kufanele simise izindlela zokubambisana ezikhuthaza izixazululo ezihlala zikhona ekwehliseni ubugebengu. Ubufakazi obuphuma ezinyathelweni ezithathwayo bukhombisa ukuthi uma sinqoba ububi ngothando, sizonqoba nezinye izinkinga.

Akekho umuntu ongaletha impahla ukuba ithuthwe ngendiza ngaphandle kokuba iphelezelwa wumbhalo oqondene nayo. b Incwadi esuka kwisikhulu esengamele izindlu zenxusa lapho kusuka khona isikhwama, egunyaza ukuba umsebenzi aphelezele leso sikhwama senxusa esithintekayo. Akekho umuntu ongaletha impahla engaziwa ukuba ithuthwe ngendiza noma ithwalwe isithuthi somoya sokuhweba. Ngaphandle kokuba ipakishwe futhi yaqinisekiswa ngumthumeli- mpahla owaziwayo yase inikezwa isithunywa esilawulwayo esisendizeni ngokulandela umthethonkambiso 108.2.2 kanye no 108.2.3;. Ngemuva kokuba impahla eyaziwayo seyamukelwe yisithunywa esinegunya iyogcinwa endaweni ephephile ukuze ifakwe endizeni futhi ivikelwe ekugxambukeleni okungekho emthethweni ngesikhathi isagcinwe yisithunywa esilawulwayo. Uma impahla yedluliswa ngumuntu owaziwayo iqondiswe kumthumeli-mpahla owaziwayo noma isithunywa esilawulwayo noma isuka kwesinye isithunywa esilawulwayo iqondiswe kwesinye isithunywa esilawulwayo futhi igcinwe iphephile, leyo mpahla iyoqhubeka nokuthathwa njengempahla eyaziwayo. Umnqubi wendiza noma isithunywa sakhe esiphansi uyoqikelela ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi impahla iphephile ngaphambi kokuba ilayishwa endizeni. Ngaphambi kokulayishwa endizeni yohwebo, umnqubi wendiza noma isithunywa sakhe esiphansi uyoqikelela ukuthi yonke impahla ethunyelwayo ihlolwa ngamehlo ukuze kuqinisekwe ukuthi ayizange iphazanyiswe. Yonke Impahla evela kumuntu ongaziwa futhi ongahlolwanga ngokulandela imithethonkambiso yale Ngxenye kanye noMqulu SA-CATS-ACS, iyothathwa njengempahla engaziwa.

Noma yimuphi umphakathi ungacela umphakathi wedolobha, ngokubhala phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zesenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo mayelana nokuhumusha nesinqumo kanye ne-rapothi ye khansela noma ikomidi. Ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngemva kokubheka i-rapothi ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, kumele iqinisekise, ilungise, noma ishintshe isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yiziphi izimfanelo ezingase zithinte noma yiliphi ithathu ngenxa yesinqumo, futhi zonke izinqumo ezithinta amalungelo abanye kumele zibhalwe, futhi izizathu zalezi zinqumo kumele zibhale. Ibhodi kumele libe nemihlangano yebhodi ejwayelekile okungenani kanye njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu. Zonke imihlangano yebhodi kanye naleyo yeziqu kumele ivulelwe umphakathi, futhi ibhodi noma ikomidi lingakhipha umphakathi emhlanganweni, ngaphandle kokuthi ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngenxa yokuthi umqondo ophathelene nendaba ekhuluma ngayo noma uma ukuvezwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kungaphazamisa izinhloso zedolobha, ibone isizathu esifanele sokwenza njalo ngokuhambisana nezimiso zokuphatha okuvulekile kanye nedemokhrasi. Isinqumo sokungena esivumelwaneni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Noma iyiphi enye indaba ehlinzekwe ngumthetho. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele unikeze isaziso somphakathi, ngendlela evunyelwe yibhodi, ekhombisa isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yazo zonke imihlangano ejwayelekile yebhodi noma ikomidi kanye nanoma yimuphi umhlangano wesikhashana noma ophuthumayo, ngaphandle kokuthi isikhathi asivumeli ukuba kwenzeke njalo.

Sikuthola kwethusa ukuthi abanye othisha basebenza izinyanga ngaphandle kokuhola, kusho uMvimbi. Le wadi ngaphambilini yayimelwe yi-Adelaide Residents Association. Kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi uPhiko lwesimo seZulu luyaqhubeka nokuba umlawuli ogunyaziwe ozohlinzeka imisebenzi yasemkhathini ohlelweni lokuhamba emoyeni, ngokuhambisana namazinga e-ICAO kanye nezindlela ezinconywayo. Isixazululo esiwuhlaka siphinde sifune ukuba iNhlangano yeZizwe ibambe iqhaza olumayelana nezibalo. Uhlelo lokuqanjwa kabusha kwemigwaqo yaseThekwini luyaqhubeka kanti umphakathi ubambe iqhaza ekukhetheni amagama amasha. Umuntu angasho ngokuphephile ukuthi wayengenayo ibhibhi ngaphansi kwaleyo ye-Stallion? Uphenyo lwaselabhorethri luqinisekisile ukuthi kwakunesimo se-meningococcal meningitis. Izikhala ezinkulu phakathi kwemibhede zizovimba ukuthathelana izifo kanti kuzoba negumbi lesiguli ngasinye kulezo ziguli ezifakelwe umnkantsha. Izinkulungwane zosomabhizinisi abancane eKapa zizilungiselela umcimbi othandwa kakhulu wosomabhizinisi abancane ezweni. Leli zinga liqukethe izimpawu okupendwe phezu kwazo, ezixhumene noma ezikhiqizwe yibhaluni noma enye indiza enganikiwe igama. Ososayensi baseNingizimu Afrikha baseqhulwini lazo zonke izinhlelo zokucwaninga ngemikhoma kanti izwe lidlala indima enkulu oguqukweni. Amalungu abezindaba ayelulekwa ukuba alungise izinto zabo zokuhamba ngesikhathi sokugcotshwa. Uke waqaphela ukuthi ugange olungaphandle lwalulaliswe phansi ngalesi sikhathi noma ingxenye yalo? Ingxenye enkulu yalo mzamo igxile eKapa.

Isaziso esibhekiswe kule Mthethosisekelo 2 kumele sichaze ulwazi oluzobhekwa uma kufakwa isiphakamiso njengelungu kanye nesikhathi sokufaka amagama aphakanyisiwe. a ye-subsection 7c yomthetho kumele ifakwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma elungu leBhodi elibhekelele impilo lapho umphakathi ophakanyisiwe esebenza khona; futhi b imisebenzi e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yomthetho kumele ifakwe kuNgqongqoshe weSizwe. Elungu leBhodi noma uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kumele athumele amagama abaphathi abathathu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze abheke ukufaneleka kokukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7c yomthetho. Uma uNgqongqoshe engatholi amagama aphakanyisiwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlobo noma uma amagama aphakanyisiwe enganele njengoba kuchaziwe kulolu mema, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha inani elanele labantu abafanele ukukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7 yomthetho noma acela ukuthi amagama engeziwe aphakanyiswe ukuze kufezwe le njongo.

R.434 enesikhathi sika-28 March 2003, Gazethi Yombuso No. R.435 enesikhathi sika-28 March 2003, Gazethi Yombuso No. R.1375 enesikhathi sika-1 November 2003, kanye neGazethi Yombuso No. 1340 enesikhathi sika-31 March 2004. Ngokukhethekile mayelana ne-GNSS, ibhekisela ezingeni lokuhambisana kwepharamitha elilinganisiwe, noma indawo ethile noma ijubane lelo ndlela ngesikhathi esithile noma endaweni ethile, kanye nejubane langempela elivame ukuhlinzekwa njengokulinganiswa kwezibalo kokwephutha kwemishini, futhi kuboniswa njengokuhlola okuphindaphindiwe futhi okungafani. uType A1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. uType B1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. b Type B2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezikhumulweni sezindiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. "Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C" ubonisa umshini we-GNSS onama-sensors okulandela i-GNSS ahlinzeka ngemininingwane ngohlelo oluhlanganisiwe lokuhamba kwezindiza futhi uphinde usize ngokukhombisa indlela yokuhamba lapho iphathwa ngumshayeli noma umphathiswa wezindiza ukuze kuncishiswe amaphutha wezobuchwepheshe ezindizeni ze-FTE. uType C1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. b Type C2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezikhumulweni sezindiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM.

Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokusekela zingaba usizo? Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakala, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ngazo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa. Ucabanga ukuthi imiphakathi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuxhaseni abantu? Ngiyavuma, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye kungasiza kanjani? Uxhumano lwemindeni, abangani, nabanye abaphila nezinkinga ezifanayo lungasiza kakhulu. Lokhu kuza nomthelela omkhulu empilweni. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi abawedwa, futhi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle. Ngokuphathelene nokuphila kahle, ngicabanga ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi impilo ibalulekile. Ukudla kahle, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphila impilo enempilo kuyasiza. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle ngemuva kokwelashwa. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izindlela zokuphila zihluke kanjani kumuntu nomuntu? Lokhu kubalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi yini ehamba kahle kubo. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukujabula? Ukuphila kahle akukhona nje ngokungabi nomdlavuza, kodwa futhi nokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukujabulisa impilo yabo. Ngabe ungakholwa ukuthi ukujabulisa impilo yakho kungaba yindlela yokubhekana nezinkinga? Ngokuphetha, ukuhlaziywa kokusalela emuva kokwelashwa komdlavuza kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu bahlala bephila nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi bathole usizo. Ukuxhumana, ukuxhaswa, nokuphila impilo enempilo kubalulekile. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi baphile kanjani ngemuva kokwelashwa? Ngiyavuma, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile.

Uma izilwane zingatholi amanzi anele, ziba sengozini yokuphela. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwezinhlelo zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi imvelo ibuyisele emuva. Izixazululo Zokulwa Nesomiso Ukuze siqedele isomiso, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi ezisebenzayo, ezifaka phakathi ukulondolozwa kwamanzi, ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo kubalulekile ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa imiphakathi mayelana nezindlela zokulima ezihlala zikhona, ezifana nokusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi, kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi imiphakathi ibhekane nezimo ezinzima zokungabi namanzi. Isiphetho Isomiso yinkinga enkulu ethinta imiphakathi emhlabeni jikelele. Umthelela walesi simo ubalulekile, njengoba uthinta impilo, ezolimo, kanye nemvelo. Ukuze siqedele le nkinga, kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ezihlanganisa ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zamanzi, ukufundisa imiphakathi, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, elinamanzi anele, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imiphakathi yethu iyaphila futhi iyakhula.

U-SAPS uzomholela OWENKONTILEKA ngokuba khona nangomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yenkontilela ezoba R - ...amarandi ngehora kuhlanganiswa ntelelaye-VAT: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS kungathi ekuhambeni kwesikhathi ngokuzikhethela kwakhe abuye ayikhuphule le mali yakhe yesivumelwano ekhokhelwa ngehora. Lo mholo ukhokhwa kamuva zinyanga zonke nghlobo lwemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yenkontileka (bona isiGaba 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo usuphelele nao zonke izinto eziyizinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi woWENKONTILEKA Inqobo, lokho kubanjwa kwemali kuhambisana nomThetho othize, iyobanjwa emholweni woWENKONTILEKA. OWENKONTILEKA uyamxolela u-SAPS maqondana nanoma yimuphi umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okudalwe ukulimala emzimbemi, ukulahleka kwempilo, ukulahleka noma ukulimala kwempahla noma ngabe kudalwe ngu SAPS noma omunye umuntu oseceleni noma ngabe udalwe noma kungenxa yobudedengu obube khona ngezikhathi oyilungu lika-SAPS egcina umyalelo, futhi uyamxolela u-SAPS kunoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa, ukulimala, indleko noma inani lokukhokhwa maqondana nokuqhubekayo enkantolo okuqondene NOWENKONTILEKA nokungase kuhambisane nokufunwa imali noma ukuboshwa ngandlela thize. Le SIVUMELWANO sizoqala ukusebenza futhi sibe yisibopho kusukela osukwini esisayinwe ngaso le SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo nje uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO engasisayini kanye kanye AMAQEMBU, usuku lokugcina lokusayina kwelinye lamaqembu luyothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kokusebenza.

Iyoxuba abaqokwe ezifundazweni nohulumeni bakazwelonke abayoba yingxenye yenqubo yokungeniswa kancane ngezikhawu kanjalo nePanSALB nezakhiwo zayo. Ngenxa yobuchwepheshe obungase budingeke, ommele Umkhandlu weziKhungo zokuFunda kuyofanele abambe iqhaza kule Nkundla. Inhloso yeNkundla yeziLimi wukukhuthaza intshumayelo yenqubomgomo yolimi nezinto eziphathelene nokusebenza kwayo phakathi kongcweti nabaholi bolimi ngaphansi koMnyango wezoBuciko namaSiko. Okuyogxilwa kakhulu kukho wukuxhumanisa izakhiwo ezahlukene zolimi nemisebenzi wokuqhuba umsebenzi weNLPF ngenhloso yokuqinisa igalelo lokudidiyela nokusebenzisa ngendlela egculisayo izinsiza. Le nkundla iyoba yisigcawu sokushiyelana imiqondo nolwazi ngesifiso sokuhlela imisebenzi nezinto ezincikile. Umsebenzi omkhulu weNkundla kuyoba ukuqapha inqubo yokuqhubeka komsebenzi, ukuhlolisisa nokuklelisa ngezidingo imisebenzi nokuhola umkhankaso. Omunye wemisebenzi yenkundla kuyoba ukuxhumana nokusebenzisana ngezindaba ezithinta ukusebenza kweNqubomgomo yeziLimi. Ngaleyo ndlela, iyogxila kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ihlelo lamagama olimi nemisebenzi yolimi ukuvikela izenzo eziphindekayo nomhlomulo ovelele ezinsizeni ezitshalwe emsebenzini. Kunesiphakamiso sokuba Inkundla yeziLimi zikaZwelonke yemukelwe ngokusemthethweni.

UKUPHASISWA KWALE NQUBOMGOMO UNYAKA NONYAKA UMkhandlu kaMasipala kufanele uyibuyekeze minyaka yonke inqubomgomo yamarates, kanye nesabelo zimali sikaMasipala. Ukukhokhwa kwama-rates omhlaba/esakhiwo lapho ubunikazi buhlanganyelwe khona kungumthwalo wabanikazi labo ngokuhlanganyela kanye nomthwalo womuntu ngayedwana kulabo banikazi. Ukulethwa kwama-akhawunti noma izincwadi kunoma yimuphi omunye wabo kuthathwa ngokuthi kwenziwe kubo bonke. INANI LAMA-RATES OKUFANELE AKHOKHWE UMasipala uzonquma ubungako erandini ngalinye kulowo nalowo mkhakha womhlaba ngokwesivumelwano njengengxenye yohlahlomali lwaminyaka yonke. UMasipala kumele aqoqe amarates ngamanconzunconzu alinganayo nyanga zonke izinyanga ezilishumi nambili kanjalo nalawo engeziwe. UMasipala angawaqoqa amarates ngonyaka kubanikazi abanamashumi amahlanu ama-akhawunti amarates noma ngaphezulu uma befake izicelo. UMasipala angawakhokhisa unyaka nonyaka amarates emhlabeni kaHulumeni kaZwelonke kanye nakoweSifundazwe. UMasipala angashicilela izichibiyelo eziningana zohlu lwamanani ezakhiwo olwengeziwe phakathi nonyaka njengokusho kweSigaba 78 seMPRA. Kuyobe sekukhokhiswa ama-rates amiswe kabusha afanele ngokwalolu luhlu lwamanani ezakhiwo olwengeziwe. Imikhakha yezakhiwo yehlukaniswa ngokwendlela leso sakhiwo esisetshenziswa ngayo ngempela ngokunjalo namarates anqunywa ngokwendlela esisetshenziswa ngayo okwangempela isakhiwo. Inguquko ekusetshenzisweni kwesakhiwo ingadala inguquko emkhakheni isakhiwo esingena kuwona. amalungelo okunweba ezindaweni ezinobunikazi ngokuhlanganyela.

Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS: Isingeniso Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo sekuyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wamanje. I-GEMS, inhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo, ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lwabantu luhlala lukhuselekile. Lesi sithangami sizogxila ekubalulekeni kokuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, izinqubo ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwa yi-GEMS ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kolwazi lwezempilo. Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi lwezempilo Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo kubandakanya izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwabantu oluhambisana nezempilo luhlala lukhuselekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ulwazi lwezempilo luyimfihlo futhi lungase luthinteke kalula uma lungavikelwe kahle. I-GEMS ibona ukuvikelwa kolwazi njengomgomo ophambili, okubonakala ezinqubweni zayo ezikhethekile. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ulwazi I-GEMS ithatha izinyathelo eziningi ukuze iqinisekise ukuphepha kolwazi lwezempilo. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zayo zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi luhlala lukhona kuphela kubantu abafanele. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinjengezokufihla ulwazi, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula ukufinyelela kolwazi. Okwesibili, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayo baqeqeshwa ngokuqinile mayelana nokuvikelwa kolwazi. Ukuqeqeshwa kubalulekile ukuze bonke abasebenzi baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangaluvikela kanjani ulwazi lwabantu.

Ngenxa yalokhu sizoqasha uMphathi ozoseluleka aphinde asize ezinhlelweni zomama. Phakathi kwemisebenzi azobhekana nayo ukuqhamuka namasu azosiza ukungeneli kwezinsiza zokuhlela imindeni futhi ezizokwazi ukwemukelwa nayintsha, ikakhulukazi njengoba ubudlelwane bentsha nabasebenzi kungakabi seqopheleni elivuna izinhlelo zethu ukuthi zibe impumelelo. Ngizophinde futhi ngenze isibonelo ngezinga lokukhulelwa kwentsha okukhathaza kakhulu futhi ngenxa yalokho sidinga ukukhuphula izinga lezinhlelo zethu esinazo ukuze kunciphe ukukhulelwa kwentsha, ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezehlukene sethemba ukuthi kungaguqula indlela yokuziphatha, ngaleyondlela bese kushintsha lesisimo. Lokhu, bafowethu nodadewethu, kucacisa ngokusobala ukuthi kungani sidinga ukungenelela ngokushesha nokuthi senza kahle uma sicwaninga ngemishini yokuhlonza umdlavuza webele ozokwazi ukusebenziseka ezindaweni zethu ezisemakhaya ukuze sehlise umthwalo kulezi zibhedlela nokuthi sivimbele amanani aphezulu okwelapha umdlavuza webele uma ususesigabeni esiphezulu. Kubalulekile kithina ukubalula ukuthi sisesifundazweni esingefaniswe nezinye. Ngokwezibalo, isifundazwe sethu sichazwa njengesinezibalo eziphakeme sezifo ezithathelanayo; ezifana nesifo sofuba, isandulela ngculazi, ingulazi uqobo lwayo, nezinye ezithathelana ngokocansi nezinye ezingamahlalakhona njengesikaShukela, uMdlavuza, nezeNhliziyo. Konke lokhu kunomthelela omubi kwezempilo zethu ezivele zithwele kanzima.

Esikhathini lapho kuqashwa khona abasebenzi abedlula ku20 ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka, njengabasebenzi basemapulazini futhi lokho kuqashwa okungedluli ezinyangeni ezine, asikho isidingo sokusungula abammeli. Bangayenza nini imisebenzi yabo abaqokelwe ezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yomsebenzi? Zonke izenzo nemisebenzi ephathelene nalezikhundla, uqeqesho lwabammeli kumele yenziwe ngesikhathi esijwayelekile somsebenzi. Yini engenziwa ngabammeli bezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yomsebenzi? Abamele ezempilo nokuphepha bangacubungula ukusebenza ngemfanelo kwezinzame zokuphepha ngokuhlola uhlelo lokucwaninga isimo sempilo nokuphepha. Abamele ezempilo nokuphepha bangacubungula izinkomba zezingozi endaweni okusetshenzwa kuyo bese bethula imibiko ekomidini lezempilo nokuphepha noma kumqashi. Abammeli abakhethwe ngokuhlanganyela nabaqashi bangenza uphenyo ngezehlakalo, baphenye izikhalo zabasebenzi mayelana nempilo nezindaba zokuphepha bese bethula imibiko ngokubhalwe phansi. Abammeli bangenza iziphakamiso ngezindaba zokuphepha emsebenzini kubaqashi noma ekomidini lempilo nokuphepha kuthi uma behluleka bedlulisele udaba kumhloli. Abammeli bangethamela imihlangano yamakomidi ezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini. Yini inhloso yamakomidi ezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini? Amalunga ayahlangana ukuzosungula, akhuthaze, agcine futhi abuyekeze izinzame zokuqinisekisa ngokuphepha nangempilonhle ebasebenzini endaweni yokusebenza. Amakomidi ezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi anamalunga amangaki? Ngakho ke, bonke abammeli kufanele babe ngamaluna ekomidi. Umqashi angaqoka abanye abantu ukuba bamele yena ekomidini, kodwa labo abaqokiwe ngeke bedlule isibalo sabammeli abajutshelwe lelokomidi.

Okwesibili, izinkampani ziqala ukwakha umqondo wombono, okukhuluma ngezixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwethimba lezakhiwo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abathuthukisi, abaklami, nabaphathi. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-prototyping iyenzeka, lapho umkhiqizo wokuqala udalwa ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwawo. Lokhu kuvumela izinkampani ukuba ziqonde ukuthi umkhiqizo uzosebenza kanjani empilweni yangempela. Uma umkhiqizo ubukeka usiza, izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuwuthuthukisa, ziqinisekisa ukuthi uyahlangabezana nezidingo zomsebenzisi. Isigaba 3: Ukwethula Umkhiqizo Uma umkhiqizo sekuqediwe, usuku lokwethulwa lufika. Lokhu kuwumcimbi omkhulu, lapho izinkampani zikhuthaza umkhiqizo kumakethe. Ukwethulwa kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze abathengi bazi kahle ukuthi umkhiqizo usetshenziswayo kanjani. Izinkampani zisebenzisa iziteshi ezahlukene zokuxhumana, njengezikhangiso ze-inthanethi, imicimbi, nezikhangiso ezinkulu ezitolo. Okubalulekile, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zihlala zithola impendulo kubasebenzisi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuqhubekeni nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo. Ngemuva kokwethulwa, izinkampani ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuthola izimvo, nokwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka, ukuze umkhiqizo uhlale uphucukile futhi ufinyelele izidingo zabathengi. Isigaba 4: Ukuhlinzeka Ngesevisi Nezixazululo Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe azikhokhi nje umkhiqizo, kodwa zenza kube lula ukuwusebenzisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yokuxhaswa, izifundo, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Ukuxhaswa okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukusebenzisa umkhiqizo ngendlela efanele, futhi bathole usizo uma kudingeka.

Kushiwo umqulu osemthethweni okhishwa yinkampani onemininingwane yezinzuzo, amanani, imithetho nezimo futhi unenombolo yomshuwalense, okufanele ibonakale esitifiketini sobulungu. Umbuthano Wobungane isikhungo sezezimali esakhiwa yiqembu labantu abanezidingo ezithile, abakhipha imali bese beyilondoloza ndawonye ukuze basizane ngezimali ezidingweni ezithile, njengomngcwabo. Inzuzo enkulu i-R5000. Umbuthano Wobungane akusilo ibhizinisi lokwenza inzuzo, kodwa inzuzo eyenziwe kuleyo mali elondolozwa ngamalungu bahlukaniselana yona. Kufanele uphikelele ukuthola lesi sitifiketi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyilungu. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sikukhombise yonke imininingwane yepholisi yakho. Lokhu kusho inkampani egunyazwe yinkampani yomshuwalense ukuthi iyithengisele umshwalense egameni layo. Uma isitifiketi segunya lokundiza siphelelwa yisikhathi ngenxa yamaphutha akhona endizeni kodwa angaxhumene nesakhiwo uqobo, isitifiketi siyovuselelwa uma iphutha selilungisiwe kanjalo kwakhishwa isiqiniseko esifanele.

Isiphetho Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kudinga ukuqhubeka nokwenziwa. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke uqwashisa abantu ng importance yokuziqhenya, nendlela yokuvota ngendlela efanele. Ngokuziqhenya, abantu bangakha umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kuwumgogodla wokwakha isizwe esiqinile, esimeme, esikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi intando yeningi ibonakala empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baphatheke, bavote, futhi baqhubeke bephakamisa izwi labo, ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Izithombe ozibonayo lapha zikhombisa ukuthi kungakwenzekani uma umlimi ehlulekile ukuthola umshini wokuvuna ngesikhathi esifanelekile. Lezi zithombe zithathwe ngoFebruwari lo nyaka eEastern Cape - ukolo lowu awuzange uvunwe, ekugcineni amasimu ashisiwe! Kuyisidabukiso ukubona umsebenzi oqhubeke wonke umnyaka ongangenisi umvuno kumasayilo - kufanele sivimbe ukuthi lokhu kungaphindi kwenzeke. Kuyinkinga kodwa kuliqiniso ukuthi ukolo ungavunwa kuphela ngomshini ukuze kutholakale umkhiqizo omuhle, futhi umshini ovunayo uyazihambela ngakho-ke kuyadula ukuvuna. Igreyidi likakolo libalulekile lapho uthengisa ngoba ukolo ungukudla olahlekelwa igreyidi masinya nakalula lapho ungavunwa ngesikhathi esifanelekile. Lapho ukolo uvuthwa kufanele uvunwe masinya ngoba imvula encane nje enethayo izokwehlisa igreyidi bese akungeke kutholakale inzuzo. Abaningi abalimi abasakhulayo abatshala indawo encane bathembeke abakontilaki abanomshini wokuvuna. Uvama ukungena esivumelwanini nomlimi masisha onyakeni lokutshala. Uqonde ukungena ezivumelwaneni eziningi ukuze akwazi ukuvuna amahektheli amanini ukuthola imali eningi. Yena akakwazi ukusho ukuthi kuzokuna nini nakuzipho izindawo okuzokwenza ukuthi alahlekelwe isikhathi sokuvuna. Ukhetha ukuvuna emasimini amakhulu angenawo amakontula ngoba umshini wakhe ungavuna amahektheli amaningi ngosuku olodwa ngoba akudingeki ukuthi umshini ujike kaningi. Akafuni ukulinda izinqola ezihambisa ukolo ovuniwe. Ubhadalwa maqondana namahektheli awavunile hhayi maqondana negreyidi umlimi uzolithola.

c Inqubomgomo yokuguqula amagama nokulungisa amaphutha embhalweni. Imihlahlandlela yokuguqulela kolunye ulimi amagama Nokulungisa amaphutha embhalweni imiselwe ukwethula imihlahlandlela yangaphakathi yokuguqulela kolunye ulimi amagama nokulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni eguquliwe nokuhlola leyo mibhalo enikwe abantu bangaphandle ukuba bayihumushe. Inhlosonqangi wukwenza ngcono iqophelo lomsebenzi ngokwethula umkhiqizo wezinga eliphezulu. Ukwakha amandla okuzenzela, ikakhulu ekuguquleleni kolunye ulimi amagama, ukuhumusha, izichazimazwi nehlelo lamagama olimi kuyodingeka ekusebenziseni ngempumelelo iNqubomgomo. Uqeqesho maqondana nokusingatha indlela yokusebenzisa ulimi luyolawulwa yizinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezisungulwe yiDAC nePanSALB ngokuhlanganyela nababhaliselwe lo msebenzi. Ongcweti abavele bebambe iqhaza lokwenza lo msebenzi bangahlelelwa izinhlelo ezihanjelwa ngezikhathu ezithile kanti kungakhishwa nemifundazwe kulabo abasanda kuqashwa nabavele sebewenza lo msebenzi wolimi. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ziyoxuba izifundo ezimfushane, ukuqeqeshwa ngesikhathi usebenza nezinhlelo zokufunda ngokugcwele. Ukusebenzisana neSAQA, DoE nezikhungo zemfundo ngezinye zezinto ezimqoka ekunciphiseni inkinga yokwentuleka kwabasebenzi abafundele umsebenzi wolimi. Imibandela enqunywe wuHlaka lukaZwelonke Lwamaqophelo eMfundo (NQF) iyolandelwa lapho kudwetshwa noma kwethulwa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Ukuthola nokuthuthukisa ubuciko ebasebenzini bomphakathi olimini abangaluncelanga yisimo esithathwa njengesibucayi uma kubhekwa indlela imisebenzi yomphakathi eyethulwa ngayo.

Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Ezweni lanamuhla, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngemininingwane, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, ukufakwa kwezikhungo ezinjalo akukhona okungokwemvelo kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukucabangela izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nakho. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezithinta izifo, izindlela zokwelapha, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Uma abantu benolwazi olufanele, bangakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Lokhu kunciphisa izinga lokugula, futhi kunceda ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezinjalo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, ngokubafundisa ngezindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingase zingabi zanele. Ezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale benolwazi olungaphelele, okungaholela ezinqumweni ezingalungile mayelana nezempilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezinkinga zokwethembeka kolwazi olutholakala ezikhungweni. Kunezikhungo eziningi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi, kodwa akuhlali kucacile ukuthi lezi zikhungo ziwela kuphi.

Isivinini/ukuphuma komoya, hamba kancane emshinini futhi isivinini sokuphuma komoya. Ukulahleka komkhiqizo kungaba ngu-3% - 5% kodwa kungakhula kube ngu-10% - 15% ngezikhathi ezithile. Imishini yokuvuna kufanele ihlolwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isebenza kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuyihlola ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi mangaki alahlekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhiqizi angakwazi ukuqala ukuphatha ukuvuna nokwakhiwa komswakama ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela zokuhlola okwakhiwa kwakho. Uma umkhiqizo wakho uhamba kahle, thenga umshini wakho wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uvimbele ukuvuvukala esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kubalulekile lapho kukhiqizwa futhi kuthengiswa okwakhiwa kokudla. Ukonakala kokwakhiwa uma kuphumelelwe kakhulu bese kubekwe ezindongeni uma kubanda kakhulu noma ezindongeni ezisebenzisa umoya olemukelekayo kuphela. Izindleko zingavela uma okwakhiwa kuvunwa uma kuphumelelwe kakhulu. Ukukhula kokwakhiwa nezindleko zokomisa lezi zakhiwa. Ukulahleka kwenani lomkhiqizo. Ukuze wenze ukuhlola okuqondile, kufanele uqale uthole isampula enhle ezokhombisa inani lomkhiqizo wonke. Lapha sithatha isampula ezitshalo ezingakavunwanga (emaphandleni) ukuze sithole ukuthi okwakhiwa kuphumelelwe kakhulu, lokhu kungasiphazamisa, futhi sivame ukuvuna kamuva, hhayi ngesikhathi esifanele. Vuna ingxenye bese uhlola. Hlanganisa amakhanda ezitshalo ozithathile ngezandla emaphandleni, ucindezele kuze kube okwakhiwa kuphuma. Thatha ukuhlola okuthathu kulokhu okwakhiwa bese uthola ngaphakathi. Thumela le sampula kumphathi wesilo ukuze wenze ukuhlola okuqondile.

Umuntu ogunyaza umbhalo ochazwe wumgonyana 2 uyophinde aqinisekise ebhukwaneni lokundiza ukuthi insimbi noma into etholwe ingalungile ilungisiwe ngempela futhi uyosayina abhale nosuku okwenziwe ngakho lokho. Ngaphandle uma Ukhomishani emukele ngokubhaliwe, indiza noma izitho zayo nemishini exhunywe kulo iyolungiswa noma ishintshwe ngezikhathi ezithile ezimiswe wumkhiqizi wendiza noma ngezikhathi ezinconywe nguye. Ukulungisa kakhulu umkhiqizo weSigaba 1 noma Isigaba II kanye nokukhanda isakhiwo uqobo, injini noma uphephela kufanele kwenziwe kuphela yinhlangano egunyazwe yimvume yokukhanda izindiza. Inqubo yokuvuselelwa kwesitifiketi sokundiza ebhanoyini elimiswe ngenxa yokulimala engozini noma esigamekweni esibeka umkhiqizo wesigaba I ungakulungeli ukusebenza inqunywe wuMqulu SA-CATS-GMR. Izidingo zokulungisa kabusha izingxenye nezitho kanye nemishini exhunywe endizeni, izinjini nophephela zinqunywe kahle wuMqulu SA-CATS-GMR. Uma Ukhomishani evumela isikhathi sokukhanda indiza TBO esihlukile kuleso esinconyiwe noma esichazwe wumkhiqizi wendiza, leso sikhathi siyochazwa ohlelweni olwemukelwe lokulungiswa kwendiza. Ngaphezulu kwalokhu, uma umkhiqizi wendiza engenzanga sincomo noma echaze ukukhandwa kwesitho esichaziwe ngezikhathi ezithile kodwa Ukhomishani ebona kufanele lezo zitho zilungiswe ngezikhawu ezithile ngenhloso yokufeza isimo sokuphepha, Ukhomishani enganquma isikhathi esisondele phakathi kokulungiswa kwalezo zitho zendiza ngendlela efakwa ohlelweni olwemukelwe lokulungisa indiza.

IBhodi kumele libanike labobantu abafuna izizathu ezibhalwehe phansi ngezinqumo ekufinyelelwe kuzo. Imihlangano ye Bhodi kumele ibanjwe ngezindlela nangezikhathi nasezindaweni ezibekiwe.
