Ukwehla kwamazinga okuphutha emsebenzini kuhambisana nokuphila kahle ngokomzimba okuyingxenye enga-23 ekhulwini okuholela ekongeni usuku nengxenye lokusebenza ngonyaka. Okuphikisana nesisho esithi usathane uyawatholela umsebenzi amavila yileso sisho esithi umntwana okwezemidlalo umntwana ongekho enkantolo. Ukuziphatha njengeselelesi kuhambisana nokungazithembi, kanti ukuphumelela kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kwenza ngcono ukuzethemba. Labo abayizibonelo ezinhle kwezemidlalo baphakathi kwalabo abavela namasu akhayo emazweni amaningi iv Impumelelo kwezemidlalo njengebhola lombhoxo rugby, ibhola lezinyawo nokushaya isibhakela kuholele ekuncipheni kwezigameko zokuncwasana ngokwebala kulelizwe. i Impumelelo kwezemidlalo ilethe ukuhlonishwa, ngisho kumazwe amancane. Amazwe amaningi aya ngokwanda elandela ukubambisana kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka nasekwakheni izinqubomgomo namanye amazwe. Ngokwamukela ukwanda komthelela wezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kuyo yonke imikhakha yomphakathi, uNgqongqoshe wezeMidlalo nokuNgcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika neKhomishani yezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika bavumelene ngalezi zandulelo eziyisishiyangalombili ezilandelayo eziyisisekelo soMthetho oHlongoziwe. Ukuqinisekisa izindima nokuhlelemba imithwalo yabathintekayo kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufezeka kokuqondiswa nokonga. IPhalamende, ikakhulukazi uNgqongqoshe neKomiti LeNdlu yeziFundazwe, yibona abanomthwalo wokuchaza inqubomgomo kahulumeni; imithetho yephalamende, ukwabiwa kwezimali zezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Ukwandisa amazinga okuzimbandakanya kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka.

umasipalati angasibuyisa isamba semali yokukhokhela intela yendawo kulowo muntu owamukela imali yokuqasha indlu egameni lomnikazi, emva kokuba esethumele isaziso esibhalwe phansi kulowo owemukela imali egameni lomnikazi. isamba esingabuyiswa ngumasipalati kulowo muntu omukela imali yokuqasha indlu egameni lomnikazi ngeke sedlule esambeni saleyomali yokuqasha indlu esemukelwa yilowo owemukela imali egameni lomnikazi noma lowomuntu esethunyelelwe isaziso ngumasipalati noma lowo muntu okukhulunywa ngaye esigatshaneni- 2, sekukhishwe imali yeholo lalowo muntu ngokulandisa komthetho olawula Izindaba Zabasingathi Bamafa ongunombolo- -112 we-1976. lowo osingethe noma lowo muntu, onxuswe ngumasipalati ukuba anikeze umasipalati yonke imininingwane ebhaliwe emayelana nenkokhelo yokuqasha indlu ayemukele ngesikhathi esiqokwe yilowo masipalati. a enze ukuhlola okudididyele kwayoyonke impahla/indawo okufanele ikhokhelwe intela yendawo kumasipalati ngokulandela isigatshana isigatshana -2; bese b kulungiswa onke amaphepha okuhlola ayoyonke impahla/indawo impahla/indawo efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo echazwe esigabeni - 7 2 a kufanele kubandakanywe ekuhlolweni okudidideyelwe kuphela ngendlela umasipalati afuna ukuklama ngayo intela yendawo kulezo zimpahla/zindawo. mayelana nezinhloso zokuhlola okudidiyele umasipalati kufanele ahlele isikhathi esingeke sibe ngaphezulu kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye ngaphambi kokuqala konyaka wezimali lapho kuzoqala khona ukusetshenziswa kwamaphepha okuhlola. ukuhlola okudidiyele kufanele kukhombise inani lezimpahla/lezindawo ngokulawula kwalomthetho, kusukela ngosuku ukuhlolwa okwenziwe ngalo.

Imvume yebhizinisi, yimvume ekhishelwa umuntu wangaphandle ofisa ukusungula noma ukutshala izimali kwibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika. Yenza isicelo kumanxusa eNingizimu Afrika noma i-mission noma ihhovisi eliseduzane lezaseKhaya eliseduzane nalapho kuzosungulwa khona ibhizinisi. imali yenani okungenani elingu-R2,5 miliyoni elingukheshi noma okungenani uR2 miliyoni okungukheshi kanye nekhapitali engu-R500 000. Inani elingaphezulu kumele libe ngeliphuma ngaphandle, nakhona kumele libe yimali ekhona engatshalwa njengengxenye ye-book value yebhizinisi iplani yebhizinisi echaza ngemibandela eyenza neqinisekisa ukuthi ngemepla ibhizinisi ngelingaphumelela, esikhathini esifishane kanye nesikhathi eside ubufakazi bokuzibophela ukuthi okungenani kuzoba nezakhamizi okungenani ezinhlanu noma abanelungelo lokuhlala unomphela abazoqashwa ngokuphelele isimemezelo sokuzibophezela ukuthi uzobhalisa nabophiki lwezimali zentela ezingenayo abe-South African Revenue Service isitifikedi samaphoyisa sokuba msulwa somenzi wesicelo sawo onke amazwe umenzi wesicelo kanye nowakwakhe abahlale kuwo, ukusukela kwiminyaka engu-18, kanye nezingane ezincike kuye ezineminyake engu-18 ukuya kwephezulu, ezizobe zihamba nomenzi wesicelo ezweni isitifikedi sogonyo lwesifo se-yellow fever uma uzohamba noma unenhloso yokuhamba udlule endaweni evamise ukuba nesifo se-yellow fever idiphozithi yokubuyiselwa ezweni lakini, elingana ithikithi elilodwa lokubuyela ezweni lapho obuya khna noma lapho onelungelo lokuhlala khona unomphela: Leyo diphozithi izobuyiselwa ngemuva kokuba usuhambile noma ngemuva kokuba usuthole imvume.

a enze ukuhlola okudididyele kwayoyonke impahla/indawo okufanele ikhokhelwe intela yendawo kumasipalati ngokulandela isigatshana isigatshana -2; bese b kulungiswa onke amaphepha okuhlola ayoyonke impahla/indawo impahla/indawo efanele ukukhokhelwa intela yendawo echazwe esigabeni - 7 2 a kufanele kubandakanywe ekuhlolweni okudidideyelwe kuphela ngendlela umasipalati afuna ukuklama ngayo intela yendawo kulezo zimpahla/zindawo. mayelana nezinhloso zokuhlola okudidiyele umasipalati kufanele ahlele isikhathi esingeke sibe ngaphezulu kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye ngaphambi kokuqala konyaka wezimali lapho kuzoqala khona ukusetshenziswa kwamaphepha okuhlola. ukuhlola okudidiyele kufanele kukhombise inani lezimpahla/lezindawo ngokulawula kwalomthetho, kusukela ngosuku ukuhlolwa okwenziwe ngalo. a liqala ukusebenza ekuqaleni konyaka wezimali kulandela ukuphela kwesikhathi sokuhlolwa gumphakathi esidingwa yIsigaba-- 42; bese b lisebenza kulowonyaka wezimali noma owodwa noma eminye eminingi elandelayo ngokwesinqumo salowo masipalati kodwa isamba sayo singabi ngaphezu kweminyaka yezimali emine. ngokwesicelo sikamasipalati, ungqongqoshe wesifundazwe wohulumeni basemakhaya engaselula isikhathi sokusebenza kwamaphepha okuhlola sibe yiminyaka yezimali emihlanu. umasipalati kufanele aqoke umhloli kamasipalati ngaphambi kosuku lokuhlola.

AmaNLUs ayoqhubeka nokusungula izichazimazwi kuzo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni. Kuyofanele asebenze ngokuhambisana neSigaba sokuXhumanisa Ihlelo lamagama Olimi esenganyelwe yiNLS. Imigudu yokubika ngalokho ekwenza namaNLB kuyommele ichazwe ngendlela ecacile. AmaNLBs awabunjiwe kuphela ngamalunga ancele lolo limi oluthintekayo kodwa isikali esimiselwe wona yigalelo lobungcweti ngoba alindelwe ukweluleka iPanSALB ngezinto eziphathelene nokumisa Iqophelo elifanayo, Isayense Yezichazimazwi, Ihlelo lamagama olimi Nolwazi lwemibhalo. Izigungu zinikwe amagunya athile aqondene nokwemukela incazelo yamazwi namaqophelo olimi. Ngohlobo lwemisebenzi emiswe emthethweni nangelungelo elikhishiwe, Izishayamthetho zeziFundazwe neNdlu Yezigele zifanele zethule imisebenzi ngazo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni. Izimo ezifundeni zingaba nomthelela wokunquma izilimi okufanele zisetshenziswe. Ngamanye amazwi, akusho ukuthi izifundazwe kufanele ngaso sonke isikhathi zihlinzekele izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni. Amahhovisi kaHansard aseNdlini Yezigele nakwezinye izifundazwe adlala indima eqavile ekwesekeni lesi sibophezelo. Ngakho, kusemqoka ukuba lamahhovisi asebenze ngokusondelana namaThimba Olimi nezakhiwo ezincikile. Ukusebenza kweNqubomgomo yeziLimi kuyoba nomphumela wokwenyuka kakhulu kwesidingo somsebenzi wezilimi, ikakhulu ukuguqulela kolunye ulimi imibhalo, ukuhumusha, ukulungisa amaphutha emibhalweni nokuthuthukisa ihlelo lamagama olimi.

Izikhukhula (zamanzi amaningi) kanye nezomiso ezinzima. Ukwehla kwenani lemakethe yomhlaba. Ukwehla kwemikhawulo yokwenza inzuzo kwezolimo. Izindawo zokulima azisakhiqizi, zishiywe. Izitshalo ezikhula kahle. Kukhona izinto ezintathu eziyinhloko ezibangela ukuhamba komhlabathi: amanzi, umoya, kanye neqhwa. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sibhekene kakhulu nokuhamba kwamanzi, bese sihamba sihlole ukuhamba komoya. Ukuhamba kwamanzi kwenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuhamba kwamanzi phezulu nokwakhiwa kwemifula. Ngokuvamile, umhlabathi lapho kuzolima khona ulungiselelwe kahle, uyakhululwa, uyathambile, uyazinzile. Okwamanje, sisebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi ukulima okuncane - umhlabathi awusulungiswanga ngendlela evamile ukuvimbela ukulahleka komhlabathi ophakeme. Isikhathi sokulima siphinde sibe yisikhathi sezikhukhula ezinzima. Lapho kuwa imvula enkulu kulomhlabathi olulungiselelwe, umhlabathi uvame ukujula, kodwa kuvame ukuba khona amakhompiyutha amancane omhlabathi azohamba namanzi. Ngemuva kwemvula yokuqala, amanzi amaningi aqala ukuhamba futhi agijime lapho kukhona ukwehla, ethwele umhlabathi nezinye izinto. Lokhu kungaqhubeka isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuba kubonakale kalula. Ekugcineni, umlimi uzobona ukuthi izinkulungwane zamathani omhlabathi zilahlekile ngonyaka. Ngokuvamile izindawo zokulima azihambisani, ezinye ziphakeme, ezinye zisezingeni eliphansi, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Amanzi avame ukuhamba ngaphansi kwezindawo eziphakeme, akha imifula emincane yokukhula. Lapho ukuhamba kwenzeka endaweni enokwehla, lezi zimpophoma zixubana ukuze zakhe imifula engavezwa ngamagatsha ezihlahla - bese kwakhiwa imifula emikhulu.

Lokhu kwehliswa okwengeziwe kwenzelwa ikakhulukazi labo bantu abanemizi enenani eliphansi futhi kuyingxenye yesu likamasipala lokuphungula umthwalo kwabampofu. Inhloso yalokhu kuxegiselwa isibopho sokukhokha ukuphungula umthwalo kubantu asebekhulile abangenelwa yimali emile futhi abanomkhawulo kwabangaba nakho. Eminyakeni emibili edlule bonke abantu asebekhulile baxegiselwa isibopho sokukhokha ukuze belekeleleke ekubhekaneni nenguquko yesisindo sentela esadalwa yiMPRA. Ngokwezibalo ezitholakele, kuyacaca ukuthi asebekhulile abanemizi enenani elingaphansi kwesigidi samarandi nengxenye banesidingo esedlulele sokusizwa. Ngakho uMasipala uzoqala uhlelo lokubeka umkhawulo othile emananini okuxegiselwa isibopho sokukhokha. 2011 - R3 000 000 2011 / 2012 - R2 000 000 Eminye imikhawulo inganqunywa ngemuva kokuklanywa jikelele kwamanani okulandelayo. Okunye, uMasipala ngeke esakuvumela okunye ukuxegiselwa isibopho sokukhokha emalungelweni qobo. Asebekhulile abebexegiselwe isibopho sokukhokha ngokwelungelo qobo bazoqhubeka basizakale kuze kufike ukuklanywa jikelele kwamanani okulandelayo ngo-2012. abe ngumnikazi obhalisiwe wendlu ahlala kuyo njengomnikazi. uma behlanganyele ubunikazi, bonke abanikazi kufanele bafeze imibandela yokufaneleka eku-7.2 noma 7.3. e umnikazi kufanele kube ngohlala ngokugcwele kulowo mhlaba; f ama-akhawunti amanzi, ugesi namarates kumele abe ndawonye egameni lomnikazi; g inani lomhlaba wokuhlala kumele lingeqi kwelikhonjwe nguMkhandlu emhlanganweni wawo wonyaka wolwabiwo mali h ohlelweni lokusingathelwa ifa, umsingathi wefa kumele afeze yonke imibandela engenhla.

Noma yisiphi isinyathelo esibopha u-SAPS, kufanele sithathwe ngokwesigaba esifanele nesisemthethweni somThetho wamaPhoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, ka 1995 (umThetho onguNombolo 68 ka 1995), noma owelama wona emthethweni. Ukuthi, okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO uchazelwe kona OWENKONTILEKA. Ukuthi, SIVUMELWANO uyavuma ukuthi uyakuqonda konke okuqukethwe YISIVUMELWANO. U-SAPS wenza isivumelwano NOWENKONTILEKA ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuke sivumelwano, kanti noWENKONTILEKA uyavuma ukunikeza usizo lwakhe ngqo kuSAPS ngokwemigomo nemibandela ebekiwe kuleSIVUMELWANO, e (emveni kwalokhu ebizwa ngokuthi EMSEBENZINI): Inqobo nje uma OWENKONTILEKA engatshelwa ngu SAPS ukuthi makaye kosebenzela u-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma isiphi isigceme esiyisakhiwo sikaSAPS esingekho EMSEBENZINI, kube okwesikhashana. OWENKONTILEKA, ngenxa yale SIVUMELWANO , akufanele noma abe eseba nethemba lokulindela ukuthi sizovuselelwa le SIVUMELWANO, noma nje aqashwa kunoma yisiphi isikhundla njengomqashwa kwa-SAPS. Kuyavunyelwana phakathi kwamaQEMBU, ukuthi OWENKONTILEKA isivumelwano asenziwe naye njengomqashwa ngokwale SIVUMELWANO futhi le SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kunobuhlobo bokuqashana obukhona phakathi koweNKONTILEKA no SAPS.

Iqhinga lokuqhuba umsebenzi lisombulula lolu daba ngokuhlongoza ukusungula izakhiwo ezithile nokuqagula amacebo okuxazulula lesi simo. Ukuzwelana nesimo sokuthi umsebenzi wokuqhuba Inqubomgomo uyodinga ukugudluka kancane emisebenzini evamile, kuyosetshenziswa iqhinga elivumela uguquko nokungenisa ngezikhawu inqubomgomo. a nakuba iyishumi iminyango eyokleliswa phambili ukuze kusungulwe amathimba olimi, yonke iminyango kahulumeni kufanele isungule amathimba olimi. b Imibhalo elotshwe ngezilimi ezahlukene kufanele ingeniswe ngezikhawu esikhathini esiyiminyaka emithathu ngokulandisa kwezinhlelo zokushicilela zeminyango. Isibonelo, ngonyaka wokuqala, kube ngamaphesenti angu 30, kowesibili amaphesenti angu 60, kowesithathu kube ngamaphesenti angu 100 emibhalo eshicilelwayo. Izakhiwo namacebo athile axoxwe esigabeni esilandelayo ahlongozelwe ukukhuthaza umsebenzi osuqaliwe. Izakhiwo ziyobaluleka ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi, ukuxhumanisa intuthuko yemisebenzi yezilimi, ukufaka ubungoti nokuqhakambisa iqhaza lemisebenzi yolimi nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Iziko leziLimi zikaZwelonke (NLS) engaphansi koMnyango wezoBuciko namaSiko (DAC) iyokhuthaza ukusungulwa kwezakhiwo bese idlala indima yokuxhumanisa maqondana namacebo aqaguliwe. Impumelelo yalo msebenzi iyoncika kakhulu ekubambisaneni nazo zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni, ezingeni likazwelonke nezifundazwe.

Lokhu angeke kwenzeke uma iningi labantu bakithi lisazithola emikhukhwini, nasezindlini ezingekho esimeni. Unembeza wethu njengoHulumeni uyaphikisana nokuhlupheka kwabantu kanjalo nomthetho sisekelo wethu uthi abantu kufanele baphile impilo engcono. Ngesonto elizayo lomhlaka 23 kuya kumhlaka 24 kuyolenyanga kaMashi, sizobamba ingqunguthela cishe engenkulukazi esifundazweni emayelana nezindaba zokwakhela abantu bakithi izindlu. Kulengqungquthela sibheke ukuthi udaba lwezindlu emakhaya luhambe phambili. Mphathi wohlelo ngithanda ukuthatha lelithuba kengikhumbuze isizwe ukuthi asigcini ngokwakha izindlu nje kuphela kodwa, izinhlelo zokwakhiwa kwezindlu zihambisana nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, sizoqinisekisa kakhulu ukuthi kuloluhlelo lwezindlu lwalapha kwaNibela, abesifazane, yintsha kanye nabakhubazekile baba yingxenye yalezizinhlelo. Kuyo yonke iminyango esengibe uNgqongqoshe kuyo eminyakeni eyisithupha edlule, besilokhu sikuqinisekisile lokhu. Sizophinde sikuqinisekisa nokuthi abazosebenza kuleprojekthi bayaqeqeshelwa amakhono azobenza bakwazi ukuba yingxenye yabasebenzi abanamakhono esifundazweni sonke, nokuzobenza baqasheke ngisho kwezinye izindawo uma sekuqediwe ukwakhiwa lapha. Uma siqikelela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono sizokwenza ukuthi sisheshe kakhulu ukunciphisa igebe elikhona phakathi kwabampofu nabadla izambane likampondo, abeswele nabanothile. Sineqiniso ukuthi indlela esihamba ngayo ibheke ekuqedeni ubuphofu nokwantuleka kwemisebenzi. Bafowethu nodadewethu siyazi ukuthi kukhona abathile abalokhu bezame njalo ukucekela phansi imizamo yethu yokusheshisa intuthuko.

Kunokukhula kokugxila emandleni ezimboni zamafilimu. Isabelo sokusiza ebuphofini ezikhethekile sihlose ukuthi kufinyeleleke emakhonweni nasekuthengiseni njengethuluzi lokuvuselela amadolobha, ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemakhaya, kane nokwenza amathuba omsebenzi. Amaprojekthi enziwa ngokubambisana noHulumeni bezifundazwe nabasekhaya, kanye nezinhlangano zikahulumeni kanye nalezo ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni. Imizamo yokuthuthukiswa kwendawo i-Wild Coast, Lebombo ne-Maputo Corridor yizindawo okugxilwe kuzo zokuthuthukisa ezokuvakashela amasiko ezixhunywe nalokhu kwabiwa. Lo mzamo uzoqhubeka ngokwaba izimali kuprojekthi ebizwa ngokuthi i-Investing in Culture. I-Investing in Culture izolwela ukuthi inikeze amandla kuzona zonke izinto eziphathelene namasiko ekuphokopheleni ekuzuzeni lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi "okuhlalwa kuyo". Umnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko uyakweseka ukuthi imiphakathi eminingi ehlwempu ngokomnotho engaphakathi kwemingcele yethu bangabanikazi bezinsiza sidingo zemvelo nezabantu, impahla yamasiko amakhono kanye nolwazi lwendabuko, izinto zendabuko kanye namasiko okungaba ekuphumeleliseni uguquko lwenhlalo yomphakathi nanye nezomnotho. Imiphakathi yethu icebe kakhulu ngolwazi lwendabuko, amakhono kanye nemiphumela yobuciko obuvela kubantu abanamakhono aphezulu abayithatha emuveni labo lemfundo esemthethweni nengekho emthethweni. Umnyango Wamasiko Nezobuciko usebenzela ekutheni uhlelo lwe-Investing in Culture kufanele luqale ngayo le mpahla futhi lutshale izimali kubantu abanamakhono okwenza izinto, izinto eziphathelene nobuciko, ukukhiqizwa nomculo.

Ukwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukuthenga sekuphenduke umkhuba obalulekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba izimpilo zethu ziba zisheshayo, izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu ziyaqhubeka nokwanda, zifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni indlela esithenga ngayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izizathu ezibangela lokhu kukhula, izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezinyathelo zokuthi sikwazi ukuthola okuhle kakhulu kulezi zindawo. Izizathu Zokwanda Kwezindawo Zokuthenga Ezinkulu Isizathu sokuqala sokwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu sitholakala ekukhuleni komnotho. Njengoba imakethe yama-ejensi ibonisa ukukhula, abantu banemali eningi yokuthenga. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukugcina abasebenzisi bazo behleli behlelekile, behlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi ngaphakathi kwebhizinisi elilodwa. Okwesibili, izifiso zabathengi ziye zashintsha. Abantu baphakathi kwezimo ezisheshayo, futhi bayakufuna ukuhamba nge-‘one-stop shop’ — indawo lapho bengathola khona konke abakudingayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudla, izingubo, izinto zokubhala, nezinsiza zansuku zonke. Izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zinikeza lezi zinsizakalo, ngaleyo ndlela zikhulisa ukuthengiswa kwazo. Izinzuzo Zokuthenga Ezindaweni Ezinkulu Izindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zikhulisa umbono wabathengi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abathengi bangakhetha izinto eziningi, beqhathanisa amanani futhi benze izinqumo ezicacile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ethengiswa ngamanani aphansi, okuyinto ephumelela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila.

Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Kwakukhanya usuku olukhulu emhlabeni wonkana, usuku lokhetho lukazwelonke. Izixuku zabantu zazihlezi ezindaweni ezihlukene, zithe nikhona isibonda sokukhathalela ikusasa lezwe. Abantu babethokozile, behlanganyela imicabango yabo, bekhuluma ngomfanekiso okhula ezihlalweni zepolitiki. Imithombo yemvelo yayivulelekile, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, umoya uthanda ukuhamba, udlulisa izwi lothando phakathi kwabantu. UMnumzane Dlamini, oneminyaka engama-53, wayephethe izifundo zezombusazwe eNyuvesi. Ngolunye usuku, ngesikhathi enza ucwaningo, wathola ukuthi abantu abaningi abakacacisi kahle ngesinqumo sabo sokuvota. Lokhu kwammangaza, wahlala wacabanga ukuthi kumele enze okuthile. Ngakho, wathola ukuthi kufanele ahlasele umphakathi, achaze abavoti ngendima yabo. Umqondo wakhe washintsha, wathi, "Kumele sikhuthaze abantu bethu ukuba bazi ukuthi ukhetho lwethu luyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa." Uhlanga lwakhe lokuzama ukukhuthaza abantu lwalubhalwe ezincwajaneni, akhipha imiyalezo ehlukahlukene ngezikhalazo zikaHulumeni. Kodwa, njengoba kukhona abantu abaningi abashaya indiva, kwavela izithiyo. Ubuya kulezi zithiyo, wathola isixazululo—ukuphawula imibuzo nezinkinga ezibhekene nezinye izifunda, ukuze abantu baqonde ukuthi ukuvota akusiyona indaba encane. Ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho, uMnumzane Dlamini wadala umkhankaso wokukhuthaza ukuvota. Wahlangana nomphakathi, wafundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, wabela abavoti abakhethiwe. Wazi kahle ukuthi abantu kufanele babenhloso, bangabi nokuphoxa, silindele impumelelo.

Lezi zinto kufanele zihambisane nezidingo ezimiswe wuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Into okukhulunywa ngayo ngumthethonkambiso 1 iyogcinwa ngendlela emiswe umkhiqizo wawo futhi uhambisane nezinye izidingo ezingakhishwa ngaphansi koMthetho. b siphelezelwe imifanekiso yamabhukwana eNqubo yezokuPhepja kwempahla ezindizeni okukhulunywa ngayo kumthethonkambiso 108.01.025; futhi c siphelezelwe yimali efanele noma inkokhelo enqunywe yiNgxenye 187 yalo mthethonkambiso. Ukhomishani angaqhuba uphenyo oluyohamba ngendlela emiswe yiNgxenye 187 yalomthethonkambiso ngokusebenza komuntu ofake isicelo nofuna ukunikwa imvume yokuba isithunywa esilawulwayo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi yini ukuhlangabezana nokushiwo yile Ngxenye. b phindisela umfanekiso owodwa webhukwana lezokuphepha kulowo ofake isicelo; futhi c nika ofake isicelo isitifiketi semvume yokuba yisithunywa esilawulwayo ngendlela enqunywe kuMqulu SA-CATS-ACS. Uma uKhomishani eneliswa wukuthi izichibiyelo ngeke ziphazamise okushiwo kule ngxenye, uKhomishani uyoqinisekisa ngokubhaliwe imifanekiso yomibili yezichibiyelo zebhukwana lezokuphepha eziveza ukuthi izinguquko zimukelwe bese ephindisela umfanekiso owodwa kulowo onikwe igunya. Isithunywa esilawulwayo ngazo zonke izikhathi sisebenza ngendlela ehambisana nebhukwana lezokuphepha noma izichibiyelo zalo ezamukelekile. Isitifiketi semvume siyoqhubeka nokusebenza isikhathi esiyizinyanga eziyishumi nambili kusuka ngosuku esikhishwe ngalo.

Le pipe encane enama-sprinklers iqinisiwe ngama-cables athuthukayo ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze wandise indawo efakwe amanzi. Ama-sprinklers asebenza kahle kakhulu angabekwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufakwa kahle kwamanzi ngisho nasezindaweni ezikhaleni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula imitha engama-1,000 ubude. Izinhlobo ezithile zamapayipi kanye nezindawo zingatholakala ngenombolo ethile yemishini. Lokhu kuyahluka uma imishini yakhiwa ngabakhiqizi abahlukene. Umkhiqizi we-header ethile uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuphakama kwe-span kumshini othile. Ukuphakama kungahluka kusuka kumitha ezi-4 kuya kumitha ezi-0.3 kumshini othile. Umshini ongahanjiswa kuphela ungathengwa uma kukhona izindawo ezahlukene emasimini lapho i-header izobekwa - lokhu kungase kwenzeke uma kukhuliswe izitshalo ezahlukene emasimini awodwa. Isimo somhlabathi nesimo sebhakabhaka - kungaba umswakama noma umhlaba owomile - kungavimbela kalula ukuhamba kwe-header. Kunenani elilinganiselwe le-span ezingahanjiswa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umgwaqo ongamitha ezi-6 udingeka ezindaweni lapho ama-header ebekwe khona. Qaphela lapho uhamba lapho kukhona izithiyo nezimbobo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-span - kukhona izinhlobo ezingathuthwa. Khulula amandla ngaphambi kokuhambisa umshini. Ukugoba kwe-header. Iziphuzo eziqinisekisiwe ezingagoba kancane zizovumela umshini ukuba uhambise ezindaweni eziphakeme ezingu-14% - 30% kokubili phansi noma phezulu.

Lesi sibhedlela sibelethisa abesifazane ababalelwa ku-1000 ngenyanga, futhi kulezi zingane ingxenye yazo ezingu-525 kuzona ziqala zigcinwe egumbini lezingane ezisesimweni esibucayi, kwi-neo-natal unit. Indawo ekhona incane kakhulu yokwemukela izingane eziningi futhi maningi amathuba okuthi zithelelane ngamagciwane ahlukahlukene. Okwesibili, ukungeneli kwezinsiza kwelapha kuleli lokishi kwenza umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlela kahle imindeni, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane abasebancane okuyibona abaningi abazithola bekhulelwa. Lokhu kunobudlelwane obuqonde ngqo ekuthelelaneni ngezifo zokocansi, ezihlanganisa isandulela ngculazi nezinye izifo njengesofuba neNyumoniya. Lokhu kuphinde kunike isithombe esicace bha sokuthi intsha yethu ayifuni ukuzibandakanya nocansi oluphephile noluvikelekile! Kungalesi sizathu-ke ngihlale ngihlaba umkhosi wokuthi masifingqe imikhono sidlale indima enqala ekulweni nokubhebhetheka kwezifo ezithathelana ngokocansi (kuhlanganisa nesandulela ngculazi) nokuguqula imiqondo uma kuziwa ngakwezocansi. Yize uMnyango uzosebenzisa yonke imizamo yokuvikela ukushona kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa; sidinga futhi ukuba wonke umuntu asilekelele ukukhuthaza inhlanzeko emakhaya, futhi kufundiswe amantombazane nabafana ngokuvikela ukukhulelwa okungadingekile kanye nezexwayiso zobungozi bezifo ezithathelana ngokocansi. Sonke asibambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekufundiseni izingane zethu zamantombazane ukuba kube yizo ezizonaka amalungelo azo okuya ocansini. Sizophinde sidinge ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela neminye iminyango sinqande ukubhebhetheka kwezifo ngenxa yezimo zenhlalo.

Ezomshwalense: Ukuqonda Kwezinsizakalo Zokuqinisekisa Ezomshwalense, noma insurance ngesiNgisi, ziwumqondo obalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Kukhona izimo eziningi ezithinta abantu, imindeni, kanye nezinkampani, futhi ezomshwalense ziwusizo ukuze kuphumelelwe ukuvikela abantu kulokhu okungase kwenzeke. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba empilweni, asikwazi ukwazi ukuthi imiphumela ezithile izoba kanjani, futhi ezomshwalense ziwusizo ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi, uma kwenzeka okuthile, sizobe sinesiqinisekiso sokuthi sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ukwakhiwa Kwezomshwalense Umqondo wezomshwalense uqala ngezimali, lapho umuntu noma inkampani ekhombisa isifiso sokuvikela impahla yabo noma impilo yabo. Lokhu kuvame ukwenza ngokuhola imali ethile, eyaziwa ngokuthi imishwalense, enhlanganweni ethile eyaziwayo njengezinkampani zomshwalense. Lezi zinkampani ziwumgogodla wezomshwalense; zenziwa ukuze ziqoqe le mali, bese ziwasebenzisa ukuze zikhokhele abanikazi bazo uma beface izinkinga ezithile. Izinhlelo Zomshwalense Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zomshwalense, futhi ngasinye sinezinjongo ezithile. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngomswalense wezempilo, ovikela abantu ezindlekweni zempilo, ezifana nezindleko zokwelashwa. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izindleko zokwelapha zingase zibe phezulu kakhulu, futhi zingabiza abantu impilo yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umshwalense wezempilo ungase unikeze umuntu ithuba lokwelashwa ngokushesha, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Okwesibili, kukhona umshwalense wezimpahla, okhathalela ukuvikela impahla yomuntu, njengemoto, ikhaya, noma impahla yebhizinisi.

Ngaphezu kokusiza imiphakathi ezindaweni zobukhosi kanye nabaholi bendabuko ukuze bathole ukuhlonishwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona, imnyango yami isebenza ngokwakha kabusha izikhungo zokuphatha zendabuko. Lokhu kuhilela ukuguqula lezi "zinkantolo zobukhosi" ezazaziwa ngaphambili zibe izakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukusungula ubudlelwano nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza abaholi bethu bendabuko nezakhiwo zabo ukuba bathathe ithuba lezi zinhlelo ezichazwe emthethweni kazwelonke mayelana nokuphathwa kwezendabuko (njengokuphakanyiswa nguMthethosisekelo waseKwaZulu-Natal). Enye yalezi zithuba ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni zokubambisana nezinsiza zikahulumeni ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi ethile lapho isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sinokwakha ukwenza kanjalo. Ngokwesibonelo, mhlawumbe isakhiwo sokuphatha senkosi singasiza umphakathi ngezincwadi zokufaka izicelo zomsebenzi, ukuqeqesha abantu ngamakhono amasha e-computer. Izinkosi zingamalungu ohulumeni abekwe phambili. Ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuze sihambisane nezakhiwo zabo nezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezimisiwe. Kumele ngiqinisekise namuhla ukuthi le nhlangano ihloselwe kuphela izinjongo zokusebenza. Kuyinhloso yokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza nokuthuthukiswa. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkosi noMeya abukhombisi ukufana ezikhundleni. Kungaba yiphutha ukususa inkosi ezindabeni zendawo ngenxa yokuthi, emicabangweni yethu, kufanele ikhulume nomlingani wayo eKapa noma ePitoli. Singase sibe nalolo cabango olukhuluma ngempela.

Emhlanganweni owenziwe kahle ukuze kuqhubeke kuxoxwa ngendaba esesimeni, uMongameli wemihlangano uqinisekisile ukuthi isaziso sokubiza umhlangano wesithathu weMihlangano Yonyaka yeziqubulo, kanye nohlelo lwezinhlelo zomhlangano, umbiko weBhodi Yabaphathi, izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe zonyaka, kanye nombiko we-auditor, sathunyelwa kumalungu ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMeyi 2009 ngokuhambisana Nezikhumbuzo zeMihlangano. UMongameli wemihlangano uqinisekisile ukuthi amalungu awathumelanga iziphakamiso eziphakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho 28.1.5 we-GEMS, okwakuphakamisa ukwamukelwa kohlelo olunikezwa amalungu etafuleni lokubhalisela. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi ezinye amalungu asetshenzisile amafomu okhetho ukuze athumele iziphakamiso zawo kwiMihlangano futhi lezi zindaba zizophakanyiswa ngesikhathi sokubuza nokuphendula. U-Mnu. Adriaan Van Wyk uphakamise ukuthi uhlelo lwamukelwe futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. John Themba. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi izinhlinzeko zeMithetho yeMihlangano, iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kunoma yimuphi umhlangano wonyaka kufanele kube ngendlela yokuvota kwenani elikhulu lamalungu abukhoma futhi amelelwe ngu-proxy. UMongameli wazisa umhlangano ukuthi iMihlangano yamukela amafomu okhetho angama-207 asemthethweni avela kumalungu ngosuku lokugcina lukaJuni 19, 2009. Inani eliphelele lama-48 amafomu amelelayo adingeka ukuthi asuswe njengoba aqukethe izinombolo zokubhaliswa ezingalungile noma ezingafundeki noma abamenyiwe ngabantu abangamalungu eMihlangano njengabamele.

Ngezikhathi ezinqunyiwe, UMnyango wezabaSebenzi uzokulungisa ubhale imibiko ngaleyo naleyo nkomba. UMkhandlu wamaKhono uzokube usuyayicubungula lemibiko. Ngalokhu kwenza uNgqongqoshe uzobe eseyaziswa ngokuqhubekayo nangezinkinga eziye zaqhamuka. Uma kunesidingo, Ungqongqoshe unokwenza izinguquko ezidingakalayo ukuze kuhlangabezwanwe nezidingo zamakhono zangalesosikhathi ezweni. UMthetho wokuThuthukiswa kwamakhono ka 1998, noMthetho weNtela yokuThuthukiswa kwamaKhono ukhombisa ukuzinikela kukaHulumeni ekuthuthukiseni imigomo ebhekele abasebenzi nentuthuko yabo. Lemithetho emibili iveza imiqondo emisha malungana nezinhlelo nezinqubo zokuxhaswa ngezimali ezakhelwe ukusimamisa nokugqugquzela uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Zimbili izinto ezimqoka ezibhekelwe yilemithetho. Okokuqala ukuthuthuka kwezommnotho okusezingeni lomhlaba wonke nokuqhudelana kwezimboni zethu nezakwamanye amazwe. Okwesibili ukubhekana nezinselelo zentuthuko yomphakathi kanye nokuqeda ububha. Imithetho yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono isiqalile ukusebenza. Ngo April 1999 kwasungulwa uMkhandlu obhekele ukThuthukiswa kwamaKhono. Ngo 20 March 2000, kwasungulwa izinhlaka ezingu 25 eziqondene nokufundisa nokuqeqesha. Ukusukela ngo 1 April 2000 kwasungulwa inkokhelo esanhlawulo ephuma kubaqashi okuyinkokhelo okufanele bayikhiphele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezindaweni zabo nanokubhekana nezindleko zokuqeqesha abasebenzi kumakhono athize. Ziningi ke nokho izingqinamba ezisasilele okusafanele ukuthi kubhekanwe nazo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lemithetho isethenziswa ngendlela nangokugcwele.

Ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somsebenzi seGrain SA, uhlelo luhlanganiswa ngaphansi kwesigaba seZinsizakalo Zenkampani esiphethwe nguMnu. Nico Vermaak. Ihlobo elidlule lidlule kube nzima kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemvula ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi sehlobo - kukhona abalimi abahluleka ukutshala, abanye batshala kodwa bangatholi umkhiqizo, kanti ezinye izindawo zithole imvula ejwayelekile. Njalo abalimi batshala ngemali ebolekiwe - baphokophela ezibankini noma emabhizinisini aboleka imali yokulima (noma ama-Co-ops amadala) - futhi abambalwa bathatha umshwalense ukuvikela inani lemali abakhokhela ukuze baqale ngoba inzuzo iphansi futhi abafuni ukufaka izindleko ezengeziwe. Ngonyaka onjengalowo, kukhona abalimi abathile abahluleka ukukhokha izindleko zabo zokukhiqiza, ngalokho bahluleka ukuthola imali yokutshalwa kabusha. Uma sisebenza nabalimi abasha abangenayo imali ebekiwe, unyaka odlule ubeka ingozi enkulu engavimbela intuthuko yesikhathi esizayo ekwakheni abalimi bezomnotho. Uhlelo lwethu lwezinga eliphezulu lwebalimi luhamba kahle futhi sesethule abalimi abakhethiwe kuhlu lwethu lweMfundo Yezolimo. Sibona ukwethulwa kwalolu suku nomsebenzi olandelayo njengokuphetha kohlelo oluzosiza umbalimi ukuba abe umbalimi ongenza imali. Le nkambo ihlanganisa lonke ulwazi olukhona oluvela kwezinye izifundo futhi ihlose ukukhombisa umbalimi izindawo okufanele agxile ekuthuthukiseni, izici ezibalulekile uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla ngempumelelo ngesikhathi esifanele nangemikhuba efanele. Uhlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abalimi lugcwele eminyakeni eminingi - ngezikole ezingaphezu kuka-80 kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2006 kuya kuSepthemba 30, 2007.

Ithini leli qembu lokufunda? Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zehlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabathengisi bezolimo ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuphatha amaqembu okufunda. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukukhuthaza abakhiqizi abasafufusa abangenasemafamu ukuba bakhe amaqembu okufunda ukuze bahlangane njalo ukuze baphinde bahlolisise ukuqeqeshwa okukhona nolwazi oluhambelana nokukhiqizwa kweziphuzo. NgeLawrence Luthango (oqale ukusebenza ngoMeyi 2008) eMpumalanga Kapa - kunabangu-14. Ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukusebenzisa i-auger, ukujula komhlabathi, ubunzima bomhlabathi obudala ngokulima, ukufaka umanyolo, umphumela wokuhlaziywa komhlabathi, ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, umkhiqizo wombhede, umanyolo, izidingo zokudla kwezitshalo, inani lokudla okukhona emhlabathini, izindlela zokulima, nokugcina amanzi omhlabathi. Imali engabolekwa abakhiqizi - konke okukhuluma ngokubolekwa kwemali, amasu okuphatha imali, izindleko zokukhiqiza, ukubala inani lokukhiqiza, izikhathi zokutshala, ukujula kokutshala, izinhlobo zezithelo, inani lezitshalo ngehektare, umthelela wezimo zezulu ekukhiqizeni, ukukala imvula nokushisa, ukujikeleza kwezithelo, ukusebenzisa ithrekhtha, ukuvuna, inani lokunwetshwa kokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, ukutshala u-mazayi, izindleko zokuthutha, ukuthenga izinto ezidingekayo ukuze uqale ukulima kahle, usizo ngezinto ezisele emasimini ngemuva kokuvuna, ukuhweba ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, izikhwama, nezisekelo ezivela kuhulumeni.

Baye balungiselela uhlelo lokwakha olwanemibono eminingi. Njengoba lithemba elenzeka, umphakathi wawudibene nabantu abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abacabangi, abadayisi, nochwepheshe kwezempilo, ukuze kunikezwe izindawo ezihlukahlukene ezizokwenziwa izikhungo ezithuthukile. Kwakufanele wonke umuntu avume, ngakho baqhuba izinkulumo ezijule mayelana nezidingo zabantu. Ngemuva konyaka wesikhumbuzo sokwakha, izikhungo ezintsha zaqala ukunqamuka emoyeni. ISikhungo Sokwakha Ubufakazi, esizokwaziwa ngokuthi "Ubufakazi". Le ndawo yabe isebenzisa izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okubalwa nemithombo ekhangayo, izindawo zokwenza imidlalo, nendawo yokudlela enezimnandi. Izikhungo ziqalile ukumangaza futhi abantu babesezandleni ezinkulu. Ubulunga zombili izikhungo, uBani noNandi, babekhanya lapho behlola. "Akusizi nje kuphela ukuthi sikhona, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izidingo zabanye zifanele ukusisiza," kusho uBani. Nombono, umphakathi wawubona ukuthi lezi zikhungo zaziqinisa imiphakathi, zine nganso – zihlangene kwezobuchwepheshe, zikhululekile. Hhayi kancane, izikhungo zokuqala zithola impumelelo. UJabu, owayesephila eZiyanda, wasukuma wancome uJohn ngokuhola le nqaba. “Nkulunkulu akusisize, kuhle isikhungo sethu, sikhuluma ngempilo, sicumelela. Empilweni, sithole umkhondo.” NgoMsombuluko, uJabu abesekanye noLinda baphinde bebamba isikhumbuzo. Bathe beqinisekisa ukuthi bazogxila kulokhu banhlonishwa, kulokhu kwaziswa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uJohn wabuyela emhlanganweni. “Ngabe sicabanga ngabantu bonke?

Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kwaselaboratory kuphela okunokuveza iqiniso lokuthi unayo noma awunayo I- HIV. Kuhle ulihlole igazi ukuze uhlale usazi isimo sempilo yakho, wazi ukuthi unalo noma cha igciwane elandulela ingculazi kumbe yona ingculazi uqobo. Lokho kwenza ukuthi ungabe usaba nexhala nokungabaza. Futhi lolo lwazi lukusiza ukuba uyihlele kahle impilo yakho. Ungalihlola igazi lakho emtholampilo kumbe esibhedlela kumbe ungaya kudokotela wangasese ukuba akuhlole. Abeluleki abongongoti nochwepheshe bayokukhuluma nawe ngasese nangobumfihlo ngaphambi kokuba uhlolwe igazi nasemveni kokuba uthole imiphumela yalokho kuhlolwa. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwegazi lakho iyokunikezwa wena kuphela. Akekho ke omunye umuntu ozokwazi ngaleyomiphumela. Ngokuvamile uhlolwa mahhala. Njengendoda, unezibopho eziningi... Umelwe ukunakekela unkosikazi wakho, izingane, abangane, nezinye izihlobo zakho. Kusemqoka ke ukuthi unakekele impilo yomndeni wakho nanokuthi uqikelele ukuthi awumtheleli umkakho ngezifo zocansi nengculazi. Ivikele impilo yakhe bo! Khumbula futhi ukuthi uma ekhulelwa kanti usenegciwane elandulela ingculazi, nengane yakho nayo ingase yesuleleke yilesi sifo. Vikela impilo yengane yakho bo! Ukuba nesibopho kusho ukuthi unakekela nezimpilo zalabo abesifazane oya nabo ocansini. Qinisekisa ukuthi awudluliseli kugula kubona, futhi uqaphele ukuthi nabo kabakutheleli ngezifo. Hamba ke uyobonisana ngempilo nokuphepha nosebenza nabo. Mhlasimbe nabo sebelifundile lelipheshana futhi bathanda ukukhuluma ngabakufunde kulona. Qiniseka ukuthi iloli lakho linakekeleke kahle.

I-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo ezikhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinsizakalo kufanele zihlolwe njalo, ziqhathaniswe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi zihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuhlola kwezimali, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisebenza kahle futhi zisebenza ngokufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibaluleka ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezizokwazi ukusiza ekuqondeni izidingo zomphakathi kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nalezo zidingo. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukwaziswa nokwazisa, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. I-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze izinsizakalo zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, kufanele kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene kuzokwandisa amandla okuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi, kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu nezisebenzayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinga, kodwa iphinde ibheke ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle.

Uma kusebenza ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 2 ngoba umkhumbi usechwebeni elilawulwa ngezokuvikela lapho kusebenza khona ezokuvikela olwandle izinga -2, umkhumbi kufanele usebenzise izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga- 2. Uma kusebenza ezokuvikela izinga -3 kulowo mkhumbi ngoba umkhumbi usechwebeni elilawulwa ngezokuvikela lapho kusebenza khona ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 3, umkhumbi kufanele usebenzise izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -3. Uma uMqondisi-Jikelele ememezela ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 17 2 ukuthi kusebenza ezokuvikela olwandle izinga- 2 kulowo mkhumbi, lowo mkhumbi kufanele usebenzise izinyathelo se-ISPS izinga- 2. Uma uMqondisi-Jikelele ememezela ngaphansi komthethonkambiso 17 2 ukuthi kusebenza ezokuvikela zaselwandle izinga -3 kulowo mkhumbi, lowo mkhumbi kufanele usebenzise izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -3. a umkhumbi ubhaliswe kwelinye izwe ifulege lombuso; futhi b umkhumbi uyalwa yilowo mbuso ukuba usebenzise ezokuvikela ezisezingeni eliphezulu kunalelo ezisebenza ngaphansi kwalemithethonkambiso , lowo mkhumbi kufanele ulandele lowo myalo. Uma umkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe ungazisebenzisi izinyathelo zokuvikela ngokuhambisana nesigaba 2 noma 7 umsebenzi womkhumbi noma induna yomkhumbi yalowo mkhumbi inganikwa umyalo ngaphansi kwesahluko -2. Izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -1 yizinyathelo okufanele zisetshenziswe ngaphansi koMgomo weISPS uma kusebenza ezokuvikela izinga- 1. Izinyathelo ze-ISPS izinga -2 yizinyathelo okufanele zisetshenziswe ngaphansi koMgomo we ISPS uma kusebenza ezokuvikela izinga -2.

Umkhiqizo kufanele uncike emakethe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uthole ukuthi abathengi bafuna ini (izidingo), bese ukhiqiza (uhlinzeka) lowo mkhiqizo ukuze uthengise ukuze uthole inzuzo. Uma intengo ikhula, abathengi bazothenga kancane, kodwa uma intengo yehlile, bazothenga kakhulu noma izinhlobo ezahlukene zemikhiqizo. Thola izidingo nezintandokazi zabathengi ngokwenza ucwaningo lwemakethe. Ikhwalithi ibaluleke kakhulu. Kufanele ibe mnandi futhi ibukeke kahle! Intengo ibalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ube nenqwaba yokuthengisa. Ukuhlinzeka kubalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ngithole njalo futhi ngesikhathi. Thola ukuthi yiziphi zalezi zimpahla ezifanele ukukhiqiza. Hlela ukukhiqizwa komkhiqizo. Phanda isivuno bese uyivuna uma isilungele ukuvuna. Khetha umgudu wokumaketha osebenza kahle kakhulu futhi lapho ungathola khona inzuzo eningi. Uchungechunge lokuthengisa lunezinto ezihambayo ezithatha umkhiqizo usuka kumlimi uye kumthengi. Ungazuza ngokwengeza inani kumikhiqizo ukuze wandise intshisekelo yakho ngokubandakanya ukuwashwa, ukupakisha, ukugcina, ukucubungula, nokuhweba. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi imbewu, umanyolo, ama-pesticides, amathuluzi, imishini, uphethiloli, umsebenzi, njll. Izindleko zokuhweba zifaka phakathi ukuthuthwa, ukukhangisa, nokugcina. Izindleko zokupakisha zifaka phakathi ukwehlukanisa, izinto zokupakisha, umsebenzi, ukugcina, umshwalense, njll. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi izinto, ukuthuthwa, ukupakisha, ukuhlanganisa, umsebenzi, ugesi, njll. Ukuze unciphise izindleko emugqeni wokuthengisa, ungasebenzisa umgudu omfushane ngokuthengisa ngqo kumthengi.

d Ukuqondisa nokubamba iqhaza ekubhalweni kwayo yonke imithetho yezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. e Ukutolika kabanzi inqubomgomo kahulumeni, nokuhumusha inqubomgomo kahulumeni ukuze ihambisane nezinqubomgomo zezemidlalo nokungcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika, ukubuyekeza lezo zinqubomgomo uma kudingekile ngaleso sikhathi nokubeka iso ngama-Presidential Sport Awards ezikhishwa njalo ngonyaka. kUkuzama ukutholela izidingo zokusentshenziswa kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kumazwe aphesheya kwezilwandle ngokulandela imigudu efanele kaSikhwama kaZwelonke. lUkusakaza izindaba eziphathelene nezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ngasohlangothini lukaHulumeni. mUkuphendula nokuqondisa izimpendulo zemibuzo ebuzwa ephalamende mayelana nezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. nUkwenza lula nokuqondisa nokubeka iso ekwakhiweni nokulungiswa kwezingqalasizinda zezemidlalo nokungcebeleka ngokulandela uhlelo "Sakhela ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka". a Ukubeka iso ekulawulweni kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka kuleso sifundazwe okufanele kuhambisane nenqubomgomo kazwelonke yezemidlalo e Ukuqondisa ukubandakanywa kweminye iminyango kahulumeni wesifundazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvumelana kwenqubomgomo yesifundazwe kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. f Ukusebenzisa izivumelwane namanye amazwe ezenziwe iNhlangano yezeMidlalo nokungcebeleka eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokwabelana ngobuchwepheshe, namakhono okuthuthukisa ezemidlalo nokungcebeleka. Iziphathimandla zasekhaya yizona ezibhekene ngqo nokusondezwa kwezemidlalo nokungcebeleka.

Sibona ukwethulwa kwalolu suku nomsebenzi olandelayo njengokuphetha kohlelo oluzosiza umbalimi ukuba abe umbalimi ongenza imali. Le nkambo ihlanganisa lonke ulwazi olukhona oluvela kwezinye izifundo futhi ihlose ukukhombisa umbalimi izindawo okufanele agxile ekuthuthukiseni, izici ezibalulekile uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla ngempumelelo ngesikhathi esifanele nangemikhuba efanele. Uhlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abalimi lugcwele eminyakeni eminingi - ngezikole ezingaphezu kuka-80 kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2006 kuya kuSepthemba 30, 2007. Lezi zikole zamukelwa kahle, abalimi babuyela futhi bacela ezinye izikole. Lezi zikole ziqhutshelwa kusukela kuFebhuwari kuya kuNovemba ngonyaka - kwesinye isikhathi abalimi babephakathi emasimini abo futhi bengenayo isikhathi sokuhambela izifundo. Ngesikhathi sehlobo, sizama ukuhlela iziboniso zabalimi lapho bezama khona ukwenza umsebenzi wezolimo, futhi simema amalungu ezigaba zokufunda ukuba bahlangane, futhi sizama ukusiza umbalimi ngamunye ngokwehlukana. Siphinde sathola impendulo enhle evela eziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi ngokusebenza nezinsizakalo zezolimo futhi silindele ukusiza bona ngonyaka omusha wezomnotho lapho kuzoba nezikole ezengeziwe ezifundisa umsebenzi ophathekayo - ukusebenza emhlabeni ngezandla kube inselelo enkulu kulezi ziphathimandla, behluleka ukukhombisa abalimi ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kahle. Siqhubeka nokusabalalisa ulwazi kuRadio ezindaweni ezine: Lesedi, Motsweding, Ligwalagwala, noUmhlobo Wenene - lokhu kuyindlela enhle yokuxhumana nabalimi - hhayi nje ukudlulisa ulwazi mayelana nobuchwepheshe kodwa futhi ukwazisa abalimi ngemicimbi yalolu hlelo.

Umphakathi uzohlola ngokucophelela imininingwane yecala. Umphakathi angakwenza okukodwa kwezinto ezintathu: Bangakhetha ukuthi kukhona ubufakazi obanele ukuze baqhubeke nokudlulisa icala. Bangakhetha ukuthi kudingeka olunye ulwazi ukuze benze isinqumo esifanele bese beqondisa umphenyi ukuthi aqhubeke efuna ubufakazi. Ngenxa yezizathu ezithile, njengentshisekelo yomphakathi, bangakhetha ukuwuphonsa icala. Ungalindela ukuthi umphakathi uzofuna ulwazi olufanele ukuze uthole inqubekelaphambili ekuphenyweni futhi uluhlonze enkantolo, uqinisekise ukuthi isinqumo sokuvumela noma sokwenqaba ukugcina umsolwa sithathwa sikhumbula izifiso zakho nemizwa yakho. Ngaphambi kokwamukela imvume yakho yokuthi ubekwe phansi, umphakathi uzocabangela izidingo zakho nezomndeni wakho. Amaphoyisa azokwazi ukukwazisa uma kudingeka ubonakale enkantolo. Izigameko eziningi zizwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, kanti lezo ezinzima kakhulu ziya enkantolo ephezulu. Ukufaka icala enkantolo kungaba nzima, ikakhulukazi uma kuhlobene nabantu abaningi. Labo abathintekayo kuleli cala bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze kuze kucace enkantolo ngokushesha okukhulu. Ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo kungaba yinkinga. Uma uthinteka, amapolisa, abaphakanyisi, nabasebenzi bekhaya bazokwazi ukukwazisa, bakulungele, futhi bakuhlinzeke ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nalokho okungenzeka. Uma ufika enkantolo, ungathola izimpawu ezizokwenza ukwazi indlela yakho. Uma lezi zimpawu zingacacile futhi ungazi ukuthi iyiphi inkantolo okufanele uye kuyo, uma ikhona, buza etafuleni lolwazi ukuze uthole umhlahlandlela wokuthi iyiphi inkantolo ubufakazi bakho buzokwenziwa khona noma kuphi izindaba ezifanele.

Uhlaka lwenqubo yokuguqula ubuciko, amasiko kanye namagugu esizwe luchazwe Emthethweni Ohlongoziwe Wobuciko Amasiko kanye Namagugu Esizwe ka-1996. Isibopho sokusebenzisa lezi zinqubomgomo sigunyaza Umnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko, oqale ukuwusebenzisa ngomhlaka-1 ku-Agasti ka-2002. Inhloso enqala ukuqondisa uphinde ukhulise ibhajethi yobuciko namasiko ukusiza ngezidingo zobuciko namasiko kulo lonke ilizwe. Ukwakha kabusha kwenhlangano nako kube semqoka kanti futhi ekuqaleni kuye kwabhekana ngqo namabandla okwenza ubuciko aphambilini, aye asebenzisa okuningi kokunikezela izimali esikhathini esedlule. Ubuciko namasiko budlala igunya elisemqoka ekwakheni kabusha, ubumbano kanye nokubuyisana. Ezobuciko Namasiko eyunithini yomphakathi zilungiselela ukweseka amasu kuzikhungo zobuciko kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wezakhamuzi. Ziphathelene nokuthuthukisa ubuciko, kodwa ziphinde futhi zidlale igunya elisemqoka ngokuphathelene nenselele yezenhlalonhle. Zizama ukubhekana nezindaba eziphathelene nokufakela nokuhlanganisa kanye nokususa ukungalingani kwesigaba sezobuCiko namaSiko sokunikeza imithombo. Okuphoqelelayo okuyinqubo ukufaka amaqembu abuthakathaka afana nabakhubazekile, intsha, abesifazane kanye nezingane. Ziye futhi zanikeza ukunaka okukhethekile ezindabeni zokuguquka zesigaba ukungenisa ukulingana ekunikezeleni imithombo kanye nokulungiselela ukufinyelela kuzinhlelo. Amakhaya okudlalela, amabandla okunikeza imali kanye nezikhungo zobuciko bomphakathi zithola izamukeliso zonyaka ukuhambisa izinhlelo kanye nokuthuthukisa ubuciko namasiko.

a Uma kuhlaluka kuNobhala ukuthi iqembu alimmelwe, angedlulisela lelo qembu ehhovisi eliseduzane noma esisebenzini seKhomishani Yamalungelo Esintu, eBhodini Yosizo Lwezomthetho, emtholampilo wezomthetho noma enhlanganweni noma esikhungweni esifanele esinothando noma esizimisele nesinamandla okusiza lelo qembu. b Uhulumeni noma Unobhala ngeke athwale isibopho sokuhlawula umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okusukela osizweni olwethulwe ngaphandle kwenhloso yobubi yilowo Nobhala ngesikhathi esiza lelo qembu kweNkantolo noma ekuqhubeni umsebenzi wokuhlangabezana nesinqumo ngokulandisa kwale mithetho ngesikhathi eluleka ngokomthetho noma ehlanganisa, eqoqa imibhalo yanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwenqubo noma umqulu. Kunoma yiluphi udaba kuhlangene nokwedlulisa udaba lapho kunengxabano ngesinqumo somthethosisekelo noma ngesenzo sokwengamela noma indlela yokuqhuba noma yophazanyiswa kwesinqumo noma isenzo sokuphatha, noma emibuzweni eqondene nokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo komthetho, kuhlangene nanoma yimuphi uMthetho wesiSishayamthetho noma lowo wesishayamthetho sesifundazwe. Lapho umaziphathe onamandla okwengamela ukuphatha, ukuqhuba nokuphazamisa isinqumo ungaqagulwanga njengeqembu elithintekayo esimangalweni, iqembu eliphonsa inselelo esenzweni esingahambisani nomthethosisekelo noma inqubo noma umthetho siyothatha isinyathelo sokuhlanganyela nomkhandlu othintekayo njengeqembu elifuna ukubamba iqhaza ezingxoxweni, lokhu kuyokwenziwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu sifake kuNobhala incwadi lapho sethula khona okokuqala isikhalo sempikiswano mayelana nodaba oluqhubekayo eNkantolo.

Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kufanele kuhambisane nezinye izinto ezingaqondene nomsebenzi. Ngaphezu kokucijwa ngamakhono okusebenza baningi abasebenzi abadinga ukufundiswa ukubhala nokubala, kanti fufanele babuye bafundiswe ngezempilo nangokuphepha emsebenzini. Phakathi kuka 1970 no 1995 ukuqashwa kwabantu kwanda ngamaphesenti angu 17. Esikhathini esifanayo abasebenzi banda ngamaphesenti angu 35. Okuqaphelekayo ukuthi imisebenzi yabantu abansundu yancipha ngalesisikhathi. Kwathi abantu abangafundile nabanemfundo ephansi balahlekelwa imisebenzi, izikhala ezavuleka lapho zathathwa yilabo abafunde ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme abaneziqu namadiploma. Umnotho ongeniswa yizinhlangothi zemisebenzi ezihlelekile unakho ukukhula usimame uma kwandiswa imikhiqizo nokulinyua izinga lomkhiqizo, uma kwenzeke lokho namathuba omsebenzi ayanda kanti nezikhala zomsebenzi ziba nesiqiseko. Isizinda samakhono esibhekile sinokuheha ukutshalwa kwezimali okusha okuqhamuka ngaphakathi ezweni nangaphandle. Lokho kuzokuvula namathuba okuthola izindawo ezintsha zokusabalalisa umkhiqizo nokuthola ubuchwepheshe obusha, ucwaningo nentuthuko nokudala imisebenzi. Yize eminye imikhiqizo incike kakhulu ebukhoneni bezimali, zikhona izimboni ezizokuphumelela ngokwanda kwabasebenzi. Kukhona amathuba entuthuko ezinhlakeni zabazisebenzayo, kwezokuvakasha, nakwezamasiko. Isu lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono liqonde ukukhuthaza abaqashi ukuthi babone ukuthi abasebenzi yibona abayisisekelo sokudlondlobala nokukhula kwemisebenzi yabo. Ukusungulwa kwaMasu amaKhono aseMisebenzini kuzodala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono namacebo ezinkampani okukhula kanye nawomgomo wendinganiso yabasebenzi.

Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ukuze kusekelwe ukuvikelwa komhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabliki yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngemiyalo ngombono wokuvikelwa komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwezempi nezisekelo ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ukuze kusekelwe nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula umgomo wezempilo yezempi kanye nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina usizo lwezokwelapha oluyisisekelo kubalungu beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincikizi zabo noma labo abaxhaswa ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokweseka nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuhlakanipha sokuvikela nolwazi lwezokuhlakanipha ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukwesekwa kokuhlakanipha emkhakheni wezokuvikela, usizo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezokusebenza. Ukuhola umsebenzi wabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwezemfundo kubantu bezempi abakhathalela bonke abalungu beMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezincikizi zabo nokukhuthaza ukukhula kokomoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngemiyalo evela kwezempi. Ukusungula umgomo wokuxhumana wezokuvikela, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nomgomo weMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nomgomo wezokuxhumana wesizwe (GCIS) futhi isebenza njengesisekelo sokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okusebenzayo, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela nezithakazelo zayo.

Kunokuba ahlinzeke izinsizo nje kokufakwayo kanye nokwenziwe, ukopeletsheni ombandakanyayo usiza ngqo amalungu ukukhulisa umkhiqizo wawo, ngokuhlinzeka ngeqoqo elimbandakanyayo lezinsizo, kumbandakanya ukwelula, isikoledu, okufakwayo, umhlahlandlela nokuqashwa, ukubiza okungcono kokwenziwe kwabo kanye neminye imisebenzi yokuzithengisa. [a] Imisebenzi yokwenza ngcono umkhiqizo imbewu engcono, amakhemikhali, njll. Inhloso yale Modeli ukuhlinzeka ngohlaka lokusekela okopeletsheni bezolimo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi baba amabhizinisi asebenzayo ayakwazi ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi futhi aba nesandla emnothweni ojwayelekile. Ubunini bokuphatha ingozi ngokuhlanganyela. Ukusungula izinhlangano zezinsizo zezezimali zamalunga, isib. Ukuhlela izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezifana neMafisa, i-Casp, njll. Okopeletsheni bezolimo banamandla anele okuvala isikhala esinganalutho somphakathi ngokuhlinzeka izinsizo ezidingwa ngumphakathi ngempumelelo nangesikhathi futhi ezisekelwe kumigomo yezinga eliphezulu lokuphatha kanye nakunkambiso elungile yeNkambiso yoKopeletsheni. Ezinye zalezi zinsizo zimbandakanya ukuthenga ngobuningi, ukuzithengisa, ukwakha amandla, ukungeza ukubaluleka, njll. Kodwa-ke okopeletsheni bohwebo lwezolimo ababe ngababamhlophe babehlinzeka futhi basahlinzeka ngalezi zinsizo kumalungu abo. Ngabhadi limbi kungeke kwakhulunywa okufanayo ngokopeletsheni bezolimo abavelayo. Inselelo enkulu ngukunganeli kwamakhono. Abasebenzi kanye namalungu ebhodi alabo kopeletsheni aswele amakhono jikelele okuphatha ngenxa yokunganeli kokusekelwa kokuqeqeshwa okukhona.

"Lolu sizo luhlomisa abalimi ukuba benze izinqumo ezifanele zokuthengisa ngaphambu kokuba baye emakethe futhi aliphoqi ukuba babe sendaweni ethile nomalidinge ukuba babe nokufinyeleleka ku-ithanethi" kusho uBilly Morokolo ongumqondisi wophiko lokuzithengisa, ekhuthaza abalimi ukuba basebenzise usizo lwabo. Uqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukuba bangaqedwa umoya izindleko ezibizwayo ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi lufanele nanoma iliphi isenti elikhokhwayo. Lo lusizo lubiza amasenti angama-60 ngomzuzu, futhi kuthatha ngaphansi komzuzu ukuhlinzekwa ngolwazi oluzwakalayo. Lolu sizo lusekelwe nganoma ngabe yimuphi umakhala ekhukhwini futhi lutholakala kunoma ngabe kukumuphi umhlinzeki wosizo lomakhalekhukhwini ofana no-MTN, u-CellC, kanye no-Vodacom. Lukhuluma ngokuphelele futhi alufani ne-SMS. Lolu hlelo lukuphendula ngesikhathi okuyisona. Yonke imiyalo yohlelo izovela kumakhalekhukhwini wakho, futhi ilindele ukuba umsebenzisi aphendule, ngokufanayo nemishini yasebhange ama-ATM. Lezi zinyathelo ezilula zizoqinisekisa ukuthi noma ngabe ngubani ofuna ulwazi lwakamuva nje ngezimakethe aluthole ngokushesha. Umsebenzisi angakhetha okuku-1 okungukukhiqiza bese ethumela, izinhlobo zomkhizo ezahlukene zizobe sezivela. Ukubuka umkhiqizo khetha inombolo edingekayo, isibonelo, ukunquma ukubiza kwamazambane emakethe yaseBloemfontein, u-Bloemfontein (Bfn) ungunombolo 2. Cindezela impendulo okungu-2 bese uthumela. Ukwengeza ku-USSD, kukhona olunye usizo olubizwa i-SMS bulk olwethulwa ngo-Ephreli futhi njengamanje lusahlolwa kubalimi bokutshalwayo abayi-10 kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

Amakhemikhali awahlukanisi uhlobo lwezithombo angasetshenziswa kuzo (njengeRoundup noma iGramoxone), noma ungahlanzisa ngemishe. Khumbula uma sikhuluma ngamakhemikhali angakhethi, azobulalela zonke izitshalo eziluhlaza kule nkambu. Qaphela uma usebenzisa lawa makhemikhali ngoba uma usuwasebenzisile, ngeke ukwazi ukuwasusa emhlabathini. Ngemuva kokutshala, amakhemikhali abhalisiwe angasetshenziswa ukubulala izinhlobo ezithile zemibila ezitshalweni ezithile ngaphambi kokuthi imibila iqale ukukhula. I-Nut grass ingaba yinkinga ngoba ayifile kalula. I-Yellow Nut Sedge ingaphathwa kahle emmbileni nasezibandleni ngokufaka iServian (amakhemikhali aziwa ngokuthi "Syngenta"). Imigomo nezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala esimemezelweni esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole kanye nezimemezelo zezifundo ziyisisekelo sezinhlelo zokufunda. Njengoba izindawo zezifundo zigcizelela ukufezwa kolwazi, amakhono, nezinto ezibalulekile zemfundo ngesisekelo nesigaba, izinhlelo zomgomo ziqhakambisa ukwakheka kwalokho okuzofundwa nokuthi umsebenzi uzohlolwa kanjani ezingeni ngalinye lemfundo. Izinhlelo zomgomo zifaka uhlu lwezisebenzi okufanele ziqedwe, lapho isivinini sokuphela kwazo kufanele sibe khona kanye nesigaba sokulandela unyaka nonyaka, kanye nomgomo wesikole okufanele usebenze phakathi nesikhathi esishiwo. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, kukhona izinhlelo zomgomo ezintathu: ikhono lokufunda nokubhala, ikhono lokubala (ukusebenza nezibalo), nolwazi lwezempilo. Ezingeni eliphakathi, ulwazi lwezilimi kanye nezeMthetho zihlala njengezinhlelo zomgomo ezizimele. Ezinye izinhlelo zomgomo kufanele zithuthukiswe yizikole ngemva kokuthola imvume kuMnyango Wezemfundo wesifunda. Izifunda ngokwazo kufanele zenze izinqumo mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezifundo ezinganikezwa kuzo zonke izifunda eziphezulu ezingeni eliphakathi. Ezingeni eliphezulu, kukhona izinhlelo zomgomo eziyisishiyagalombili ezisekelwe ezindaweni zezifundo. Ukwabiwa kwesikhathi kwezifundo ngakunye kunqunywa kuzo zonke izigaba nezinga. Isimemezelo ngasinye se-subject sihlanganisa ingxenye yokuhlola ebanzi. Umgomo osekelwe kumiphumela usebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezingabhekana nezihloko ezahlukene.

Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uminyaka uthisha umculi ofuna ukungena, phela izinsiza zenza kube nzima ukuya phambili. Ezemfundo, ezemidlalo, kufana nezinhlelo eziningi exubile. Akamfuni umphakathi, kufanele acacise izifiso zezehlo, imikhankaso nezizathu. Impilo ithokozisa kakhulu uma ubona ulwazi lwenkanyezi, ungathola ukuphila ehla ngaphezu kwezindonga ezimnyama. Uyazi kusho ukuthini. Lokhu kumele kube ngogqozi, ukuze uziqhenye futhi ukwazi ukubaluleka kokuba uyiqaba yabalungiselela izifiso zabo. Ngakho, lapho sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, asikho sehluko phakathi kwezinkanyezi eziphakeme nezempilo ezinokungafani. Ubulili, ubuchwepheshe, unaphi zenzwayo lilokhu silungiswa phakathi kwezinto ezilindelekile. Ngabe siyazi kahle okukhuluma ngakho? Ngcuka uma lokho kudinga izinkanyezi ezithile, sikhumbule ukuthi konke kuhlangene, njengenhliziyo elungisa konke. Ngamafuphi, impilo yosaziwayo iyinkimbinkimbi. Phezu kwakho konke, nezinto ezithile zikhona. Akekho ophelele, futhi abanye bahlala befuna ukuzijabulisa. Isikhathi sishintsha, futhi izinkanyezi ziyashintsha. Ngakho-ke, hamba izinto ezinhle, uzoba nezinselele, ukuze usebenze ngezindlela eziningi. Lokhu kubalulekile, usaziwayo nalowo ogcizelela umoya obalulekile. Ubudlelwano, uthando, nezinkanyezi – konke kushintsha. Ngiyabonga.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yezezimali, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukuqonda kahle lezi zimo kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuhlela izindleko zabo zempilo, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi awatholi izinsiza ezingekho emthethweni. Izinkinga nezixazululo Njengoba sithokozisa izinzuzo ze-GEMS, kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda izinkinga ezingavela. Imithetho nemigomo ibalulekile lapha, njengoba ibeka izinqubo ezidingekayo zokubika izinkinga, kanye nezindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu anelungelo lokubika izinkinga zabo, futhi athole usizo oludingekayo. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezihlinzekwa yalesi sikhwama. Ukuqonda kahle lezi zimo kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi sithole izinsizakalo eziphusile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke amalungu aqonde imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS, ukuze bakwazi ukujabulisa izinzuzo ezihlinzekwa yilesi sikhwama. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS izoba yisisekelo sokuphila okukhululekile nokunempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokufunda nokuhlola lezi zimo ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa kahle izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo.

Ubizwa NGOH ULUMENI WASEMAKHAYA: Umthetho wentela yendawo, we- 2003 futhi uqala ukusebenza ngosuku oluyonqunywa ngumongameli wezwe ngokumemezela kusomqulu kaHulumeni. Intela yendawo ingumthombo omkhulu wokungenisa imali kuhulumeeni wasemakhaya, iphinde ibe wumthombo omkhulu wentela yomasipala . intela yendawo ibaluleke kakhulu ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni kanti-ke nangokomlando intela yendawo yayivele iklanywa emadolobheni. Ukwehlukanisa intela ngokwamazinga kwakuvele kwenziwa ngezindlela ezehlukene ezifundazweni ezehlukene. Yileso naleso sifundazwe phambilini sasinomthetho waso kanye nendlela yokuhlola kanye nokuklma intela yendawo. Njengaloku kucaciswe emthethweni kahulumeni wasemakhaya, kudingeka indlela elula nefanayo njengengxenye yezinguquko kuhulumeni wasemakhaya. Omasipala bathola amandla abo okuklama intela yendawo kumthethethosisekelo wezwe (bheka Isigaba- 229 somthethosisekelo mayelana naloku)igama elthi impahla alichaziwe kumthethosisekelo kanti lithatheka njengokuthi lisho umhlaba kubandakanya nanoma iyiphi impahla noma idawo phezu noma phakathi ezweni noma ngaphansi komhlaba. Kubandakanya lonke izwe ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika njengaloku lonke linomasipala. Amandla omthethosisekelo anikezwe omasipala ukuba baklame intela yendawo nakuba umthethosisekelo ungabavumeli omasipala ukuba basebenzise lawa mandla bebodwana.

IHollywood Ekuqaleni, eHollywood, kwakukhanya izinkanyezi eziningi. Le ndawo, eyaziwa njengegqugquzela yezinkanyezi, yayigcwele amaphupho, izifiso, nezibani ezikhanyayo. Abantu abaningi bayeza lapha, befuna amathuba okwenza izinkanyezi zikhanye emhlabeni. Kwakuyindawo lapho izithombe zikhuluma, futhi lapho izwi lomuntu lwalungavunyelwa ukuba lishayeke. UThandi, intombazane encane eyayinethemba elikhulu, wayehlala edolobheni elincane elikude neHollywood. Wayefisa ukuba ngumculi, kodwa ubunzima bokuphila bamenza wahamba phambili. Njengoba ethanda umculo, wayehlale ethokozisa umndeni wakhe ngezinkanyezi ezincane ezazikhanya emoyeni. Kodwa uThandi wayeziqhenya ngempela ngempilo yakhe, futhi wayezazi kahle ukuthi udinga ukwenza okukhulu ukuze afinyelele amaphupho akhe. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wanquma ukuhamba eHollywood. Wathola imali yokuhamba, waphuma edolobheni lakubo, wajabula kakhulu. Waqonda ukuthi leli dolobha laligcwele amathuba, kodwa futhi laligcwele izinselelo. Njengoba efika, wathola izithombe ezinkulu, izakhiwo ezinhle, nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Waqala ukuhamba ezitaladini, ethokozisa abantu ababejabulile, edlala umculo wakhe. Kwathi uma esebenza, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umculi odumile owayesebenza eHollywood. USipho wathokoziswa umculo kaThandi, wambiza ukuba abambe iqhaza emculweni wakhe. Wayecabanga ukuthi angakwazi yini ukuhamba phambili, futhi ukuthi abantu bazomthanda yini. Kodwa uSipho wamkhuthaza, wathi, "Ungesabi, uThandi.

Umqashi kufanele anikeze umsebenzi umfanekiso wefomu lesikhalo ngemuva kwezinga ngalinye lapho isikhalo sibhekwe isiphathimandla. Umsebenzi angafaka isikhalo sakhe kumsebenzi okhethelwe ukuba enza-lula noma abe ngumxhumanisi kulenqubo yokuxazululwa kwezikhalo kulowo mnyango. Kufanele kusetshenziswe ifomu elinqunyiwe Isijobelelo A uma kufakwa isikhalo. Lowo msebenzi okhethewe kufanele axhumane nomkhakha oqondene wesiphathimandla kulowo mnyango ukuze azame ukuxazulula isikhalo. Isikhalo singaxazululwa yinoma imuphi umuntu kulowo mkhakha oqondene onamandla okwenza lokho. Umsebenzi ofake isikhalo uyokwaziswa yilowo msebenzi okhethiwe ngesimo nenqubekela-phambili eseyenziwe ekuxazululeni isikhalo. Uma isikhalo sixazululiwe waneliseka umsebenzi ofake isikhalo isiqinisekiso salokhu siyobhala phansi ngumsebenzi okhethiwe. Uma isikhalo singaxazululeki, isiphathimandla esiphethe kufanele sazise umsebenzi ofake isikhalo. Umnyango, (kumbandakanya nesiphathimandla esiphethe) unezinsuku ezingama-30 zokubhekana nesikhalo. Grabber: Ukuthuthukisa kuhambelana nabantu - kuthintana nomuntu oyedwa. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika kukhona abalimi abaningi bezomnotho abanolwazi ukulima ngokwezomnotho, abakwazi ukukhiqiza noma siphi isitshalo noma ukufuya noma ziphi izimfuyo. Akukho ukusweleka kolwazi - manje sekudingeka ukuthi lolu lwazi luhanjiswe kulabo abalimi abansundu ukuze nabo bathole ikhono lokulima ngokwabo ngokuqhubeka. Izimiso zokuthuthukisa okuqinile nempilo eqinile emaphandleni zihambelana nokubheka izingcebo/izimpahla ezikhona ezingasetshenziswa ngumuntu oyedwa futhi nokwandisa ikhono laloyo muntu ukusebenzisa lezo mpahla. Lezi zimpahla ziyahluka, kungaba abantu, okwezomnotho, okwezomvelo, njll. Uma sifisa ukuthi ukuthuthuka kuqine, kufanele sisebenzise izinto ezikhona ezisetshenziswa ngabantu ukuthola ukudla nemali. Impilo engcono isho ukuthi uhola imali engcono, uphila kangcono, udla kangcono futhi usebenzisa izingcebo zemvelo ngendlela eqinisayo. Umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa wakhiwa ngaphezu kwamandla nezimpahla okusetshenziswa ngabantu. Izizathu zobumpofu ziyahluka, kodwa kukhona izinto ezifanayo njalo - iholo elincane, ukukhiqiza okuphansi nokusweleka kolwazi. Abantu abampofu bavama ukungathintani netheknoloji elisha nezindlela ezinsha zokukhiqiza ukudla, basaqhubeka ngezindlela ezindala ngoba abatholi ulwazi maqondana nezindlela ezinsha zokulima. Futhi kaningi abantu bayala ukushintsha ngoba besaba izinto ezinsha ezingaziwa. Bavama nje ukuqhubeka ngezindlela ezindala ngoba bayazi bekusebenza kahle. Khumbula ukuthi abazi ukuthi kukhona izindlela ezingcono ezinsha zokulima. Bazovama ukukhetha izindlela ezingenazo izingozi.

Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi babheke kahle izintengo. Ukuqhathanisa amanani ezitolo ezahlukene kungasiza ukuthola izaphulelo ezinhle. Okwesibili, abathengi kufanele bahlale behlola izikhangiso nemikhankaso yokuthengisa. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde ukuthi yiziphi izitolo ezibeka izaphulelo ezinhle, futhi bagweme ukuhamba ezitolo ezithengisa ngamanani aphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi kufanele basebenzise izinhlelo zokunxenxa. Izinhlelo zokunxenxa ziyindlela enhle yokuthola izinzuzo ezengeziwe, njengokuthola ezinye iziphakamiso noma amanani aphansi, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa omuhle wokuthenga. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwezindawo zokuthenga ezinkulu kudala izinketho eziningi kubathengi, kodwa kudinga ukuqashelwa izinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuthenga ngokucophelela. Imiphumela yokuthenga ezindaweni ezinkulu ingathinta kakhulu impilo yempilo yethu, ngakho-ke kufanele sibe nokuqonda okuhle nokuqaphela indlela esithenga ngayo. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo eziningi ezivela kulokhu kukhula, siphephe nemiphumela emibi.

Bheka ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lwezokugunyazwa oludingekayo bese ugcwalisa ifomu elifanele. Izicelo zokukhululwa okukhulu kufanele zidluliselwe ngemicimbi ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokutshala. Izicelo zokuph continueda ngaphansi komsebenzi othile zizovunyelwa kuphela uma lowo msebenzi ugunyazwe esikhathini esedlule. Khokha imali echaziwe okufanele ikhokhwe. Thumela umbiko wezinto ezenziwe esikhathini esedlule. Thumela ubufakazi benkomba ejwayelekile. Ikhomidi yokweluleka ibuyekeza ulwazi lwezesayensi oluthunyelwe nezesicelo futhi yenze isiphakamiso mayelana nokuphepha komsebenzi ophakanyisiwe, bese iwethula kwiKhansela eliphezulu. Umqondisi wamukela imibono ejwayelekile ngesikhathi esivunyelwe. Ikhansela eliphezulu lenza isinqumo ngesicelo, ibheka isicelo, isiphakamiso sekhansela yokweluleka, imibono ejwayelekile, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona emikhakheni efana nezolimo, impilo, imvelo, umsebenzi, ukuhweba, kanye nentuthuko yesayensi nobuchwepheshe. Uma isinqumo seKhansela eliphezulu sihambisana nesicelo, umqondisi ugunyazwe ukuba akhiphe imvume. Umqondisi ukhipha imvume efanele. Zonke izimvume zisebenza ngaphansi kwezimo zokunciphisa. Ukuphikiswa okuvela kuMnyango Wezolimo kugadla ukuhambisana nezimo zemvume.

Mayelana nodaba lokubeka izimpawu ezizokukhombisa impumelelo nokuhlolwa kwendima esihanjiwe ukuya ekugcwalisekeni kwesu, kwavunyelwana ngo elethu, kanti lomgomo ungolunye uphawu olukhombisa indlela uMnyango wami ozinikele ngawo ekubeni usebenzele umphakathi futhi wazise umphakathi ngakho konke osekwenziwe. Inselelo enkulu ke eyokulenza lisebenze lelisu kanye nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi lizoqhubeka ngokuwusiza umphakathi ngendlela edingakalayo. Loku ke kumbandakanya ukugqugquzela abaqashi, izinyonyana, abasebenzi, iminyango kaHulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuthi babambe iqhaza kuloluhlelo. Umnyango wami ke uzijube ngesibopho sokuqapha ukuthi isu liyasebenza futhi liqhubekela phambili. Yonke imizamo efanelekile yokuthi lokhu kwenzeke ngempumelelo nanokuthi kuhlale kunemibiko eyenziwayo malungana nenqubekela yecebo, isimi ngomumo. Ngethembele kakhulu ke kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke wamaKhono ukuba ubuyekeze imibiko ebhalwe ngumnyango wami, futhi uma kunesidingo uziqalele olwawo uphenyo, unginike futhi nezeluleko kunoma iluphi udaba olungase ludinge ukubuyekezwa kwemigomo nangezinguquko ekwenzeni izinto. Ukuphumelela nokungaphumeleli kufanele kubhalwe phansi ukuze sonke sifunde kukho silungise namaphutha ethu futhi. Isu kufanele kube ngeliseqophelweni impela. Sengiyokuhlala ngilindele imibiko yenqubekela phambili ke kumnyango wami, nakuwo uMkhandlu obhekele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ngibuye ngimeme uMkhandlu ukuba uhlale ubuyekeza izinjongo ukuze siqiniseke ukuthi ziyaqhubeka nokubhekela izidingo ezimqoka kakhulu zezwe lethu.

Ekwenzeni uhlelo lwezesivumelwano, iziphathimandla kumele zibheke imigudu yonke, lokhu kusho ukuthi Zinake izithuthi ezithola uxhasomali nezingalutholi futhi, banikezele ngezivumelwano ezihlanganise ezokuthutha ezinoxhasomali nezingenalo lapho kufaneleke khona.

Inhloko yo Mnyango kumele ibeke oyedwa noma ngaphezulu emahhovisi wonke esiphathimandla sedolobhakazi ukuthi benze imisebenzi yeqembu labaphathiswa bezimvume zezokuthutha, ngendlela ebekiwe. Iqembu labaphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezokuthutha kumele lithole amafomu asegcwalisiwe kunye nemali ehambisana nawo okufaka izicelo zamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi eziqala endaweni yedolobhakazi layo, bese lihlola ukuthi amafomu okufaka isicelo agcwaliswe kahle nokuthi zonke izincwajana okumele zihambisane nawo zikhona futhi zisemthethweni, bese lifaka imininingwane ekumafomu kumabhange emininingwane ngendlela ebekiwe. Iqembu lezobuphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza kumele bese lihambisa izicelo kusiphathimandla sedolobhakazi, omasipala abafanele kwidolobhakazi, izikhungo ezifanele namakomidi oxhumaniso afanele ukuze athole izincomo ngendlela ebekiwe. Ekwenzeni izincomo, iziphathimandla zedolobhakazi kumele zenze isiqiniseko sokuthi isicelo siyahambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona zezokuthutha nezinye izinhlelo ezikhona zezokuthua nezomhlaba beze zibhekela nezaba ezifana nezimfuno nezidingo ngokwemigudu, ubukhona bendawo yokupaka nesiminyaminya nokunye okungukubhekela idolobhakazi nendawo. Uma kungekho sikhungo noma ikomidi loxhumaniso ngokomgudu noma indawo ngalesosikhathi, iqembu lobaphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi kumele lihambise isicelo siye kwizinhlangano ezifanele ukuyothola izincomo novo, ngaphandle uma inhlangano seyiphawulile kwifomu yesicelo. Iqembu lobuphathiswa bamalayisense okusebenza ngezithuthi kumele liqoqe konke okungubumelwana kunye namafomu nezinye izincwajana ezixhasa isicelo likuyise kwi Bhodi ukuze lithathe isinqumo.

Ukubika: Ukubika imiphumela kumphakathi, kubaphathi, noma kubanikazi bezinkampani. Umbuzo 5: Ziyini izinselelo ezihambisana ne ikota? Izinkampani zibhekana nezinselelo eziningi uma zisebenzisa ikota. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukungahambisani kwezinsiza, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezimakethe, noma izinkinga zokuphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaphathi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhlola imiphumela, ikakhulukazi uma izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokusebenza. Umbuzo 6: Kanjani ikota ingathuthukiswa? Ukuze ikota ithuthuke, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke zihlola izinqubo zazo, zifunde ezivela kwezinye izinkampani, futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene zenkampani kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwe ikota. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kungaba nomthelela omuhle ekusebenzeni kahle. Umbuzo 7: Ikota ingafaka izinguquko ezinkampanini? Yebo, ikota ingafaka izinguquko ezinkampanini. Ngokuhlola nokubheka imiphumela, izinkampani zingathola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, njengokwandisa imikhiqizo, ukunciphisa izindleko, noma ukushintsha izinqubo zokusebenza. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ikota? Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ikota zifaka phakathi: - Ukuqonda kahle ukusebenza kwenkampani. - Ukuthuthukisa izinqumo eziphusile. - Ukukhulisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi. - Ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ikota ibalulekile emkhakheni wezomnotho? Emkhakheni wezomnotho, ikota ibalulekile ngoba isiza ekuhloleni imiphumela yezenzo ezithile.

U-SAPS uzomholela OWENKONTILEKA ngokuba khona nangomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yenkontilela ezoba R - ...amarandi ngehora kuhlanganiswa ntelelaye-VAT: Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS kungathi ekuhambeni kwesikhathi ngokuzikhethela kwakhe abuye ayikhuphule le mali yakhe yesivumelwano ekhokhelwa ngehora. Lo mholo ukhokhwa kamuva zinyanga zonke nghlobo lwemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yenkontileka (bona isiGaba 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo usuphelele nao zonke izinto eziyizinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi woWENKONTILEKA Inqobo, lokho kubanjwa kwemali kuhambisana nomThetho othize, iyobanjwa emholweni woWENKONTILEKA. OWENKONTILEKA uyamxolela u-SAPS maqondana nanoma yimuphi umonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okudalwe ukulimala emzimbemi, ukulahleka kwempilo, ukulahleka noma ukulimala kwempahla noma ngabe kudalwe ngu SAPS noma omunye umuntu oseceleni noma ngabe udalwe noma kungenxa yobudedengu obube khona ngezikhathi oyilungu lika-SAPS egcina umyalelo, futhi uyamxolela u-SAPS kunoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa, ukulimala, indleko noma inani lokukhokhwa maqondana nokuqhubekayo enkantolo okuqondene NOWENKONTILEKA nokungase kuhambisane nokufunwa imali noma ukuboshwa ngandlela thize. Le SIVUMELWANO sizoqala ukusebenza futhi sibe yisibopho kusukela osukwini esisayinwe ngaso le SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo nje uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO engasisayini kanye kanye AMAQEMBU, usuku lokugcina lokusayina kwelinye lamaqembu luyothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kokusebenza.

Ngezinye izikhathi umlaleli usebenzisa lesi sikhathi esengeziwe ukuhlela izinkinga zabo, izintshisekelo, nezinkinga esikhundleni sokulalela, ukuhambisana, nokufingqa lokho okukhuluma okufanele kukhulumiswe. Ukulalela Okubomvu: Kubantu abathile, amagama afana nesikhumbuzo sebhokisi elibomvu akhuthaza anger futhi abenze bame ukulalela. La magama ahluka ukusuka kwelinye inhlangano kuya kwelinye. Kubantu abathile, amagama afana "nobunzima," "ukuvuleka," "intsha yamanje," njll., yizici esijwayele ukuziphendulela. Ngesikhathi izimpawu zivele, sithola umkhulumeli. Silahlekelwa uxhumano nabo futhi siphumelele ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela ngezindlebe ezivulekile nokuvala ingqondo: Ngezinye izikhathi sithatha isinqumo esisheshayo sokuthi umlaleli noma umkhulumeli uhlinzeka ngokuphoxeka, nokuthi lokho okukhuluma akukwazi. Njalo sithatha isinqumo sokuthi singakhuluma ngakho okukhuluma noma lokho abazokukhuluma - futhi bakhetha ukuthi akukho sizathu sokulalela ngoba akukho okusha okuzokhuluma. Kungcono ukulalela bese uthola ngempela ukuthi lokhu kuyiqiniso noma cha. Ukulalela ngezinyembezi ezikhanyayo: Ngezinye izikhathi sibheka umuntu ngqo sengathi silalela kanti izingqondo zethu zikhona kwenye indawo noma ezindaweni ezikude. Sifaka endaweni ethanda kahle imicabango yethu. Ukukhanya kwezinyembezi (uma kungelona iphupho) kubonakala ebusweni bethu. Singakwazi ukusho uma abantu besibheka ngalendlela. Ngokufanayo, bangase babone okufanayo kithi - sithatha noma ubani njengomhlanya. Phendulela amaphupho kubo ngezinye izikhathi.

Ukusebenza Kwama-Ambulensi: Indaba Yomlando Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezimeni eziphuthumayo ube sewandeni, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwama-ambulensi. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi, kubalulekile ukubheka imvelaphi yawo, izinguquko ezenzekile, kanye nomthelela wawo emphakathini. Ekuqaleni, ngaphambi kokuba ama-ambulensi abe yinsiza ejwayelekile, abantu babebhekana nezimo ezinzima lapho kudingeka ukusiza abagulayo noma abalimala. Izithuthi ezinjengezinqola, izinyathi, noma izikebhe zazisetshenziswa ukuze zidlulisele abantu abadinga usizo. Lokhu kwakuyinselele enkulu, njengoba izithuthi zazingenakuhamba kalula ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi abahlinzeki ngosizo babephakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, kwavela umqondo wama-ambulensi njengemoto ethile eyenzelwe ukusiza abantu abagulayo. I-ambulensi yokuqala eyaziwayo yadalwa eNgilandi ngo-1832, futhi yayiyimoto eyayihamba kancane, kodwa yayinezinhlaka ezikhethekile zokuthutha abagulayo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula indlela yokwakha izinhlelo ezihamba phambili zokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo. Ngemva kwempi, ama-ambulensi aqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Ngonyaka we-1865, i-Red Cross yaseSwitzerland yathuthukisa uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okwakuhlanganisa ama-ambulensi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo nemigudu yokusebenza kwama-ambulensi, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo.

Umthetho ophathelene nezifiso uthintekile kakhulu ngesinqumo esithathwe emacaleni kaBhe, esashintsha indlela yokwabelana ngefa phakathi kwabafileyo. Lokhu kwashintsha nendlela uMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo ubheka ngayo ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabafileyo. Kwenzekeni esinqumweni sikaBhe? Ngesikhathi ephila, umufi wayehlala noNksz. Bhe kanye nengane yabo eyodwa ezinsaneni zabo ezimbili eKhayelitsha. Kwakukhona ukungabaza ukuthi umlingani kaBhe nomufi babashadile noma cha. Intombazane yabo yesibili yayihlala noyise womufi eBerlin, okuyindawo eseningizimu yeMpumalanga. Umufi washona ngaphandle kokwenza ifa, ngakho-ke impahla yakhe yabelwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nezifiso. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uyise womufi uzothola yonke impahla, ngaphandle kukaNksz. Bhe nezingane zabo. Impahla yayiqukethe ishayela nomhlaba ophakanyiswe kuyo. Uyayise wayefuna ukuthengisa umhlaba ukuze akhokhele umngcwabo wendodana yakhe. Uma eqhubeka kanjalo, uNksz. Bhe nezingane bazoshiywa bengenalutho. UNksz. Bhe ufake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi izingane zakhe ezimbili zikhonjwa njengezizathu ezisemthethweni zokuthola ifa likayise. INkantolo Yomthethosisekelo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi indlela yokwabelana ngefa ngaphansi komthetho wezifiso ibingaphansi kwesigaba 23 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zabantu Abamnyama, ngakho-ke ayikufaneleka ukuhlangabezana nezinkinga zezimo zokuphila ezishintshashintshayo ezazisunguliwe kusukela ekuqaleni.

Kuyavunyelwana phakathi kwamaQEMBU, ukuthi OWENKONTILEKA isivumelwano asenziwe naye njengomqashwa ngokwale SIVUMELWANO futhi le SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kunobuhlobo bokuqashana obukhona phakathi koweNKONTILEKA no SAPS.
