OWENKONTILEKA kufanele, ngaphandle kwemigomo yesigaba 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo yeziGaba 5 no 9 ngezansi, anikezele u-ASPS izinsizakalo ngesikhathi ezidinga nangokwemibandela ebekwe ngu-SAPS, esikhathini esikaliwe esi , kusukela osukwini lokuqala kwale SIVUMELWANO bheka isigaba 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene noWENKONTILEKA izohlanganisa nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa ngezandla eyingxenye, futhi eqondene nemisebenzi yoWENKONTILEKA. OWENKONTILEKA uzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe (bheka iziGaba 3.1 - 3.2 ngenhla) ewenzela u-SAPS izinsuku ezinhlanu evikini: Inqobo nje, uma OWENKONTILEKA engeke asebenzela u-SAPS ngemiGqibelo nangamaSonto, noma ngamaholide omphakathi. OWENKONTILEKA umsebenzi wakhe uzowenza ngokwesheduli exhunyelwe lapha yaba uSheduli A. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma izinsuku abekade engekho ngazo ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. OWENKONTILEKA angeke abe nalo ilungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngokwale SIVUMELWANO. u-SAPS uzoba nomsebenzi wokunikeza OWENKONTILEKA ezokuthutha imoto ukuya nokubuya EMSEBENZINI ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe bheka iziGaba 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngokwale SIVUMELWANO.

Isicelo sokufinyelela ngqo esihlonzwe esigabeni -1676a soMthethosisekelo siyothulwa ohlwini lwesaziso sokuthatha isinyathelo kanti siyosekwa wumbiko ofungelwe oyoneka wonke amaqiniso ayisisekelo nembangela yesicelo. c isinqumo sokuthi udaba lungadingidwa yiNkantolo ngaphandle kokulalela ubufakazi bomlomo, uma ingeke ikwazi, d indlela yokuthola ubufakazi nokusombulula ukushayisana kwamaqiniso. Wonke umuntu noma iqembu elifisa ukuphikisana nesicelo liyokwazisa ngokubhaliwe ofake isicelo noNobhala ngenhloso yokuphikisana nesicelo, zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu- 10 ngemuva kokuba sifakiwe leso sicelo. Ngemuva kokutholwa nguNobhala kwesaziso senhloso yesinyathelo sokuphikisa, noma lapho isicelo sitholwe sekwedlule isikhathi esibekiwe, udaba luyophothulwa ngokulandela imiyalelo ekhishwe nguMphathimaJaji , imiyalelo ingabandakanya a umyalelo wokwethula eNkantolo iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe kulabo abaziphendulelayo ngesikhathi esithile ngenhloso yokuthola uvo lwabo ngokunikwa kwemvume yokufinyelela ngqo okuceliwe; noma b umyalelo okhomba ukuthi azidingeki iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe noma imibiko efungelwe. Izicelo zokufinyelela ngqo zingadingidwa ngokufingqiwe ngaphandle kwenkulumo-mpikiswano yomlomo noma ebhaliwe ngaphandle kwaleyo equkethwe esicelweni uqobo. Inqobo uma lowo oziphendulelayo eyichazile inhloso yesinyathelo sokuphikisa ngokulandisa komtheshwana- 3, isicelo sokufinyelela ngqo siyokhishwa kuphela ngemuva kokuhambisana nemibandela yomtheshwana -4a.

Inhloso yokusungulwa kwalesi sikhungo ukunikeza umphakathi wonkana usizo lwezempilo ngaso sonke isikhathi ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zokuxhumana ezifana nemisakazo, isikhahlamezi, i-email, imiyalezo ethunyelwa ngomakhalekhukhwini (sms) kanye nocingo. Uqhube wathi, Lesi sikhungo siwusiz kithini kwezosizo oluphuthumayo ngoba uma umphakathi uhlaba umkhosi siyakwazi ukusheshe sifike lapho sidingeka khona ngoba lesi sikhungo sinobuxhakaxhaka obusiza abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo bakwazi ukuyalelwa lapho kudingeka usizo khona ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi befuna leyo ndawo. Futhi lesi sikhungo siyakwazi ukuthumela imiyalezo esiqaphisayo uma kungenzeka kuba khona izimo zezinhlekelele sikwazi ukuma ngokumumo, kuchaza uNtsobi. Ingxenye enkulu yezincingo esezamukelwe kulesi sikhungo ivela kubantu abafuna ulwazi nosizo maqondana ne-HIV nengculazi kanti abanye bafuna ulwazi mayelana nemishanguzo, "Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi lesi sikhungo siyakwazi ukusiza ngokunikeza ulwazi abantu abafuna usizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS okusho ukuthi nathi siphosa okuthize esivivaneni ekufundiseni umphakathi. Esikubonile wukuthi baningi nabantu abebefuna ukwazi ngesimo sezempilo sakulesi sifundazwe ngoba befisa ukuvakasha nokusho ukuthi siba nomthelela kwezokuvakasha," kuchaza uNtsobi. Uhlobo lwezincingo ebezifika kulesi sikhungo luhlanganisa lezo zabafuna ukubika izinto ezifana nenkohlakalo, izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa, ezokukhwa-banisa, ababika abadukile, ababika izingozi, abafaka izikhalo mayelana nezabasebenzi kuze kufike kulabo abafaka izikhalo. Zonke izikhalo ziyalandelwa futhi ziphenywe.

Ngokwezigaba 10 ze-Promotion of Access to Information Act, "Umphakathi Wamalungelo Abantu kufanele, ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-18 zokwenzeka kwalesi sigaba, aqoqe imanuwali equkethe ulwazi ngolimi olusemthethweni ngalunye, ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda, ngendlela engacelwa ngumuntu ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yisiphi isithakazelo njengoba kuchazwe kulo Mthetho." Umbiko wonyaka we-NEMISA. Umfakisicelo kufanele achaze ukuthi ufuna ikhophi ye-rekhodi noma ufuna ukuyibona emahhovisi e-NEMISA. Isigaba 292. Umfakisicelo uzoyithola ngendlela abacela ngayo. Nokho, ukutholakala kolwazi kuzoncika ekutheni isicelo asiphazamisanga izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza ze-NEMISA, noma kuthinte irekhodi, noma kuphazamise idokhumenti engelona idokhumenti yesifunda. Isigaba 293. Uma, ngezizathu ezithile, ulwazi lungakhululwa ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngendlela ehlukile, imali izobala ngokuya ngendlela umfakisicelo akhethe ngayo. Isigaba 294. Uma, ngaphezu kokuphendula okubhaliwe kwesicelo sabo se-rekhodi, umfakisicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela ehlukile, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kufanele kuchazwe kuSigaba 182e. Uma umfakisicelo efaka isicelo ngombono womunye umuntu, kufanele abonise ukuthi unegunya lokwenza leso sicelo. Isigaba 182f. Uma abafakisicelo bengakwazi ukubhala noma ukufunda, noma benokukhubazeka okuthile, bangacela irekhodi ngokuqhubekayo. Umphathi wehhovisi kufanele aqedele ifomu labo futhi abahlinzeke ngekopya. Isigaba 183. Umphakathi wolwazi uzobhekana nesicelo solwazi ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kokusithola noma njengoba kungenzeka. [Isigaba 25].

Ukutholakala kokudla kuholela endlaleni futhi kungaba nemiphumelela engadingekile yokungaziphathi kahle enhlalweni. Ngeminotho emikhulu yomhlaba ehlupheka ngokwehla komnotho kusukela ngesikhathi sokwehla komnotho sakamuva nje (kufakwa phakathi neNingizimu Afrika), inani elikhulu lemisebenzi lilahlekile emikhakheni emikhulu yomnotho. Lesi simo nezinye bubeka ubunzima emkhakheni wezolimo wokwakha amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokuba nendima ekuqedeni ubuphofu. Ekwaziseni ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemaphandleni njengensika ebalulekile ekulweni nokungabikhona kwemisebenzi, ubuphofu kanye nokungalingani, imizamo kufanele iqondiswe ekwenzeni ngcono izinga lokwethulwa kwezinsizo emiphakathini yasemaphandleni. Okopeletsheni bezolimo njengolunye lwezinhlobo zamabhizinisi bangasetshenziselwa ukuqhubekisela phambili izintshisekelo zikahulumeni zokwakha imisebenzi emkhakheni ukwenzela imiphakathi yasemaphandleni. Okopeletsheni emkhakheni wezoLimo babe ngabokuqala ukwenziwa babe semthethweni ngaphansi komthetho wokopeletsheni waseNingizimu Afrika futhi ukusuka lapho sebethuthuke baba yinhlangano ehlelekile neyimpumelelo yombuthano kuzwelonke, umKhandlu Wamabhizinisi Ezolimo (i-ABC). Inhlangano kakopeletsheni wezolimo yaphumelela futhi yathuthuka njengomphumela wesimo esihle esakhiwe nguhulumeni ngokwenza izinqubomgomo namasu afanele okusekela inhlangano. Ukwethulwa kweBhange Lomhlaba ngonyaka we-1912 njengelinye lamasu okusekela abalimi kwaba ngumnyakazo omkhulu emkhakheni.

Lezi zici zihlanganisa ukufinyelela kalula, ukwakheka kwezindawo, ukuvumelana, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile. Ukufinyelela kalula kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zokufunda, nezitolo, ukuze abantu abanezinselelo zokuhamba bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni. Ukuklama izikhala ezivulekile, ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kuyasiza ekwakheni umuzwa ophumelelayo nokuthuthukisa ukuhamba kwezakhamuzi. Ukwakhiwa Kwezikhungo Zokufunda Ezikhungweni zokufunda, ukwakheka okuhlinzekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo ethokomele, enezinhlamvu ezifanele, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukile, kubalulekile ekukhuthazeni abafundi. Ukwakheka okufanele, okufaka izindawo zokuphumula, izindawo zokubhalela, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana, kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi, kungakhathaliseki ngezinga labo, banomuzwa wokwamukelwa. Ukusebenzisana Nabantu Abakhombisa Izidingo Ezikhethekile Kubhalwe kahle futhi ukufaka abakhombisa izidingo ezikhethekile ekuhloleni nasekuthuthukiseni izikhungo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abantu abanezinselelo zokuhamba, abanesidingo sokuxhaswa, kanye nabantu abaphila nezingane. Ukubamba izinhlelo zokuhlola nokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezikhethekile. Izikhungo ezikhipha izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu zizokwandisa umphakathi futhi ziqhubele phambili ukufinyelela kwezinsiza. Ukwamukela Izimvo Zabasebenzisi Ukubaluleka kokwamukela izimvo zabasebenzisi akuphikiswa.

Masijabule ukufungiswa kukaMongameli wethu omusha! Amamiliyoni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abambe iqhaza ekhetho ngomhla ka-22 kuMbasa 2009. Ngokuvota, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathatheka enhlanganweni yezenkolo yokukhetha uMongameli omusha. Manje njengoba sesazi imiphumela yokhetho, sekuyisikhathi sokufungisa uMongameli omusha. Yini ukufungiswa kukaMongameli? Ukufungiswa kukaMongameli kuyisenzakalo esisemthethweni esiqala isikhathi sokuphatha kuk governo omusha. Kulolu suku, uMongameli omusha ufungiswa nguMphakathi Oyinhloko waseNingizimu Afrika. Oomongameli abavela kwamanye amazwe, izikhulu zikahulumeni, kanye nezithunywa ezivela kuhulumeni bamanye amazwe bayavakashela leli eventi elibalulekile. Kuzoba nomculo nemidlalo yendabuko ekugubheni leli suku. Ngabe ukufungiswa kukaMongameli kuzokwenzeka nini? Kulonyaka, uMongameli uzofungiswa ngomhla ka-9 kuNhlangulana 2009 kuqala ngo-11 a.m. eZakhiweni zeUnion ePitoli. Kungani leli suku libalulekile? Kulolu suku, sibhiyozela impumelelo yezwe lethu ngokusebenzisa ubudlelwano bezepolitiki kanye namalungelo namathuba esinawo eNingizimu Afrika aphathwa ngedemokhrasi, ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga noma ngocansi. Leli suku singahlangana njengomphakathi ukuze siqhubeke sakha iNingizimu Afrika esingayigqaja ngayo. Ungaba kanjani yingxenye yokugubha ukufungiswa kukaMongameli? Iziteshi eziningi zethelevishini nezomsakazo zizokwenza ukusakazwa kokufungiswa bukhoma ngomhla ka-9 kuNhlangulana 2009 - uzobe ulalela? Kukhona nezinye izenzakalo ezihlelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni - yiba yingxenye yayo!

b umyalo ususebenze isikhathi esiyizinyanga ezintathu. UMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele achithe umyalo wezokuvikela uma ngabe lokho kugxambukela okungekho emthethweni kwezokuthutha zasolwandle kungasekho noma kungasenakwenzeka maduze. UMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele azise noma abikele lowo muntu ngokuchithwa. Uma uMqondisi-Jikelele ekhombise noma ekhangisi ngomyalo wezokuvikela ngokusho komthethonkambiso- 29 2 futhi uMqondisi-Jikelele echitha lowo myalo , uMqondisi-Jikelele kufanele asuse lowo myalo obukhangisiwe. a umsebenzi wechweba azisa noma ebikele umuntu ngokomthethonkambiso- 292 ngengxenye noma ngawo wonke umyalo; futhi b UMqondisi-Jikelele echitha lowo myalo. a umsebenzi womkhumbi azise noma abikele induna yomkhumbi ngokomthethonkambiso- 30 2 ; futhi b uMqondisi-Jikelele echitha umyalo, umsebenzi womkhumbi kufanele ngokushesha azise noma abikele induna yomkhumbi ngokuchithwa komyalo. c umsebenzi wechweba noma umsebenzi womkhumbi, lowo othintekayo, uyakuba esenze icala okuyothi uma elahlwa yicala akhokhe inhlawulo noma avalelwe ejele isikhathi esingevile ezinyangeni eziyi-12. Umthethonkambiso 6 ngeke wasebenza uma umsebenzi wechweba noma umsebenzi womkhubi, lowo othintekayo, enesizathu esizwakalayo. b b kusetshenziswa umyalo ; futhi c umuntu ehluleka ukugcina umyalo; futhi d ukwahluleka kungekhona ukwahluleka ukugcina izidingo eziyimfihlo. Umthethonkambiso 1 awusebenzi uma lowo muntu enesizathu esizwakalayo.

Lokhu kunganikeza umzimba wakho amandla nezithako. Ungazizwa ungatholi kahle uma kunzima futhi kunzima ukudlula. Gwema ukusebenzisa ama-laxatives nanoma yiziphi ezinye "imikhiqizo yokuhlanzeka kwesisu" efana ne-enemas. Ama-laxatives ne-enemas enza ukuthi umzimba wakho ulahlekelwe izithako eziningi ezibalulekile futhi kuyisixazululo esikahle kuphela esingaxazululi inkinga yangempela. Dla ukudla okungakawushintshi futhi okuncane okwenziwe ngeziphuzo ezimhlophe (amakhukhi, ama-pastries, njll.). Hlala usebenza kakhulu! Ukuhamba njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa umnqweno wokuhamba. Ungazizwa ukungakhululeki uma unokuhamba kathathu ngosuku nezinkanyezi ezimanzi. Ukuhamba kungaholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle ngoba ukudla kudlula emzimbeni wakho ngokushesha kakhulu ukuze umzimba wakho ukwazi ukukwamukela. Umuntu uphinde udle kancane ngoba ungenamfuno. Uma unokuhamba, umzimba wakho uzoba ne-dehydration ngoba ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi - lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi yi-dehydration. I-dehydration ibalulekile kakhulu futhi ingaba yingozi. Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma nginokuhamba? Phuza amanzi amaningi nezimpahla ukuze ubuyise amanzi alahlekile emzimbeni wakho. Ukuze wenze isiphuzo esenziwe ekhaya sokubuyisela amanzi alahlekile, thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi aphekiwe bese uvumela ukuba kuphume. Faka ama-teaspoons amane noshukela kanye ne-teaspoon eyodwa ye-salt. Hlanganisa le ngxube ngangokunokwenzeka. Ikhofi nezinye izidlo neziphuzo ezifana ne-cola ne-chocolate ziqukethe i-caffeine futhi zingathuthukisa i-dehydration.

Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Izinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni zifaka: - Ukuphumelela: I-AI ingasiza ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisheshayo nezisebenza kahle, okwenza izinqubo zibe ngcono. - Ukunciphisa izindleko: Ngokwenza imisebenzi ethile ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-AI ingase isize ukunciphisa izindleko zokusebenza. - Ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo: I-AI ingahlinzeka ngensizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu, ukwenyusa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinselelo zihlanganisa: - Ukuphepha kwedatha: Ukusebenzisa i-AI kudinga ukuvikeleka kwedatha, njengoba izinkampani nohulumeni badinga ukuvikela imininingwane yabantu. - Ukungabi nankinga kwezobuchwepheshe: Uhlelo lwe-AI lungase lungasebenzi kahle uma kungekho ubuchwepheshe obufanele, okungaholela ekunganeliseki. - Ukwamukela: Abantu abaningi bangase babe nezinselelo zokwamukela ubuchwepheshe obusha, okungase kube nomthelela ekuphumeleleni kokusebenzisa i-AI. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokusebenzisa i-AI kuhulumeni emhlabeni? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona izibonelo eziningi: - E-Estonia: UHulumeni wase-Estonia usebenzisa i-AI ukuphatha izicelo zokuhweba, ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula. - E-United States: Izinhlelo zokuhlaziya idatha ezisebenzisa i-AI ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze kuhlolwe izidingo zabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo.

Ukusebenza kukaMasipala kube sekukalwa maqondana nezikalo ezibekiwe, ezakhiwe ngokuzwana futhi kuvunyelwane ngazo ngesikhathi senqubo yeIDP, ngokumele kwenziwe kuqala. Ukuphathwa kokwenziwa komsebenzi akuqondile ukuba indlela yokujezisa kodwa kuyithuluzi lokusekela. Kunika ulwazi olufanele ngokuphathwa ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo. Kusiza ekubhekeni ukuthi umsebenzi wenzeke ngendlela obekuhlelwe ngayo. Kuveza izinkomba zengozi masinyane mayelana nezinkinga ezingase zivele ekuqaliseni I-IDP. Kukhuthaza ukwenziwa komsebenzi ngendlela okubhekwe ukuthi wenziwe ngayo. Kumele ikhombise ukuthi izosebenza futhi iphathwe kanjani kusukela esikhawini sokuhlela kuze kufike esikhathini zokubhekwa komsebenzi nokubika. Kumele icacise izindima nezibopho zamuntu ngamunye ngisho nezomphakathi wendawo, ekusebenzeni kwenqubo. Kumele icacise inqubo yokuqalisa uhlelo ngaphakathi komkhombandlela wenqubo ye-IDP. Kumele iqophe izikhathi zokubika, nini futhi ubani okubekwe kuye nezindlela zokuphendula ngemisebenzi. Lawamathuluzi ajwayelekile abizwa ngokuthi izikali ezisetshenziswa ukuphatha ukwenziwa komsebenzi. Isinyathelo sesithupha: ukubikwa nokubekwa kabushangemisebenziUma sithatha ngokuthi isilinganiso sokuphathwa kokwenziwakwemisebenzi sesikhona, uMasipala kuyomele aphendule ngokuthisisebenze kanjani uma siqhathaniswa nezikhalo ezibekiwe. Lokhukuyomele akwenze ngezakhiwo zokubika okuvunyelwene ngazonezinqubo zokubika imibiko ebuyayo kanye nokucebisangokusamele kwenziwe. Hayi ukuthi umkhandlu kuyomeleuziphendulele wona nezakhiwo zawo zangaphakathi kuphela, kuyomele futhi ulethe umbiko ngemisebenzi emphakathini.

Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibono emisha, ebandakanya umqondo wokuthi intsha inemfanelo yokubamba iqhaza ekuqhamukeni kwezixazululo. Njengoba lesi sikhathi sikhula, izinkinga zokuqala zaba nzima kakhulu. Umnotho waqala ukuphuka, futhi izinkampani ezinkulu zathola izinkinga zokuthola abasebenzi abaneziqu ezithile. Abantu abasha, abahlala bezama ukufunda, babona ukuthi akubona bonke abaphumelelayo. Lokhu kwabavusa umuzwa wokuziqhenya, bephakamisa izwi labo, begcizelela ukuthi badinga ukwaziwa. Izinyathelo ezithile zathathwa ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo. Uhulumeni waqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokufundisa, ezakhelwe ukusiza abantwana ukuthi bathole amakhono adingekayo emsebenzini. Lezi zinhlelo zafaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe, izifundo ezihambisanayo nezimiso zokuphila, okwakuhloselwe ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abasha. Nokho, okwenzeka kwakungekho okwanele ukuxazulula inkinga enkulu yokungasebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukuqonda ukuthi akusikho kuphela ukuthi abantu badinga imisebenzi, kodwa badinga nemisebenzi ehambisana nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kwaholela emishinini emisha, izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, kanye nezinkampani ezincane ezandleni zabantu abasha. Ngalesi sikhathi, ibhizinisi le-entrepreneurship laqala ukuthandwa, lapho abantu abasha bezama ukudala imisebenzi yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zinguquko zaziholela ekubeni intsha iqale ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi eyahlukene. Ubumqoka babuhamba phambili, futhi abantu abasha baqala ukuzithokozisa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, bakha amabhizinisi amancane ahamba phambili.

Izikhungo zendawo ezweni lonke ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana uma udinga usizo nezinsizakalo. Isinyathelo 2: Gcwalisa ifomu - qiniseka ukuthi ugcwalisa zonke izingxenye ngokuphelele futhi uhlinzeka ngemibhalo esekelayo efunwayo. Bheka: Yimiphi imibhalo okudingeka uyithumele nencwadi yakho yesicelo? Uma ungathanda ukujoyina i-GEMS, kuzodingeka uhlinzeke ngezinkomba eziqinisekisiwe zemibhalo ethile, njengokukhomba wena nomndeni wakho, kanye nefomu lakho lesicelo. Xhumana newebhusayithi www.gems.gov.za ukuze uthole uhlu oluphelele lwemibhalo ongase uyidinge ukuthumela isicelo sakho, noma shayela iCall Centre yethu ku-0860 00 4367. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi uma ungathumelanga zonke izimfuno ezidingekayo, i-GEMS ngeke ikwazi ukukhipha isicelo sakho, futhi kuzoba nezikhathi zokulinda kuze kube zonke izimfuno zatholwa. Njengoba kuvamile, i-GEMS izama ukuk bringa izinzuzo zempilo ezinhle ezihambelana nephakheji yakho. Kuze kube manje, sikwazile ukugcina ukwanda kokuhlanganyela kwakho ngokuhambisana nokwanda kwezindleko zempilo. Ukuhlinzeka ngeminye imikhankaso kuyisibopho sethu kuwe. Kukho inketho yezinzuzo ehambelana nezidingo zempilo zomndeni wakho kanye nephakheji yakho! Lokhu kuyisibopho esiphelele sokuhlanganyela kubo bonke amalungu futhi akukhombisi isibopho somqashi. Uma umqashi elungele ukuthola isibopho somqashi, umqashi uzokhokha ingxenye yesibopho, kanti isiqeshana sizokhokhwa ngumsebenzi.

Isigaba 4: Ukuhlinzeka Ngesevisi Nezixazululo Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe azikhokhi nje umkhiqizo, kodwa zenza kube lula ukuwusebenzisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yokuxhaswa, izifundo, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Ukuxhaswa okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukusebenzisa umkhiqizo ngendlela efanele, futhi bathole usizo uma kudingeka. Izinkampani zihlala zikhuthaza ukuxhumana nabathengi, ukuze ziqonde izidingo zabo, kungaba ngokuqondile, nge-imeyili, noma ngezingxoxo eziku-inthanethi. Izinkampani eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe zihlala zifuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhlala ziqhubeka nezinselele nezidingo zabasebenzisi. Isigaba 5: Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zihlala zishintsha, zifuna izinto ezintsha ezithuthuka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokufunda okuphezulu, i-AI (Artificial Intelligence), ne-Blockchain. Lezi zinto ezintsha zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zisebenze ngomqondo omusha, zikhulise imikhiqizo yazo, futhi ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithuthukile. Ngokusebenza nezinhloso ezithile, izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zikhumbula izidingo zabathengi, futhi zithuthukise umkhiqizo wazo ukuze ufinyelele ezimfanelweni ezithile. Isiphetho Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu, ziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwakha, ukuthuthukisa, nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezintsha. Ukuqonda indlela lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngayo, kusiza abantu ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi imikhiqizo yazo ingaba kanjani usizo empilweni yabo.

Yize uMnyango uzosebenzisa yonke imizamo yokuvikela ukushona kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa; sidinga futhi ukuba wonke umuntu asilekelele ukukhuthaza inhlanzeko emakhaya, futhi kufundiswe amantombazane nabafana ngokuvikela ukukhulelwa okungadingekile kanye nezexwayiso zobungozi bezifo ezithathelana ngokocansi. Sonke asibambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekufundiseni izingane zethu zamantombazane ukuba kube yizo ezizonaka amalungelo azo okuya ocansini. Sizophinde sidinge ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela neminye iminyango sinqande ukubhebhetheka kwezifo ngenxa yezimo zenhlalo. Isibonelo esihle nje ngesoMnyango wezezindlu emizamweni yayo yokuqeda imijondolo ngonyaka ka-2014, isenzo lesi esidinga ukushayelwa ihlombe. NjengoMnyango, kwisabelomali esidlule, senze imikhankaso engu-45 yezempilo, okuyimizamo yokufundisa imiphakathi ngempilo engcono, sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokwehlisa umthwalo ezikhungweni zethu ezizithola zelapha iziguli ezihaqwe izifo ebezinganqandeka. Sihlalo oHloniphekile, sekukaningi lapho sishayeka khona kakhulu ngokulahlekelwa ngabasebenzi abanamakhono nokwehluleka kwethu ukubaheha ukuthi basebenze ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kungenxa yokungabikho kwezindawo zokuhlala kanye nokungabi khona kwezimali ezanele, zokwakha izindawo zokuhlala futhi lokhu kuseyiphupho njengoba sidonsa kanzima ukwakha izikhungo zempilo nje. Sisekude kakhulu ukuyeka ukusebenzisa abasebenzi abayitoho eMnyangweni wethu. Ziseningi izikhungo ezisaqhubeka nokuqasha abasebenzi abayitoho ukuqinisa izibhedlela nezinye izingxenye zoMnyango. Sihlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke lokhu kuphele ngokushesha nokuthi bonke labo basebenzi baqashwe ngokugcwele wuMnyango.

Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zokufundisa ezizokhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabavoti nabaholi bempilo yomphakathi kubalulekile. Abaholi kumele bahlale bexhumana nabavoti, bephendula imibuzo yabo, futhi bechaza izinqumo ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bazizwe behlanganyela, futhi bazizwe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izifiso zabo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakhuthazwe ukuba bavote, futhi bazizwe bebalulekile ekwakheni intando yeningi. Ukwengeza, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti akupheli kuphela ekukhetheni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ezindabeni zomphakathi ngemuva kokhetho. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlela imihlangano, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bahlale bexhumene nezindaba zomphakathi, futhi bazizwe bebalulekile ekwakheni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngokubheka izinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kunezithiyo eziningi ezivimbela abantu ekubambeni iqhaza. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukungabi nolwazi, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kudingeka imizamo eqhubekayo yokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuvota. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, ukwakha izikhungo zokuvota ezikahle, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ekugcineni, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.

Uma ngabe usejele ugwetshelwe icala eliphathelene nezombusazwe isenzo sakhona esenzeka ngaphambi kukaJuni 16, ngo-1999, noma uqeda kuphuma ejele khona futhi ubugwetshelwe icala eliphathelene nezombusazwe usesimeni esihle sokuba ungathola ushwele kuMongameli wezwe. Hlale wazi-ke ukuthi uma ngabe icala obugwetshelwe lona kungesilo eliphathelene nezombusazwe, awukho sesimeni sokuba ungathola ushwele ngaphansi komthetho omisiwe. Kodwa ungakwazi-ke ukuba ucele ushwele owejwayelekile ngaphansi kweSigaba 84 (j) soMthethosisekelo weRiphablikhi yaseNingizimu Afrka, esinikeza amandla kanye negunya kuMongameli wezwe ukuba anike ushwele, noma asule amacala ezelelesi ebezigwetshiwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele ugcwalise ifomu lesicelo ngokushesha. Emahhovisini amakhulu nawezifunda oMnyango wezoBulungisa nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo www.gcis.gov. Uma udinga usizo ukuba ugcwalise la mafomu, iqembu lakho lezombusazwe kumele likusize ukuze uwagcwalise la mafomu ngendlela okuyiyona. Ifomu lakho lesicelo kumele lingeniswe ngumuntu onegunya weqembu lakho lezombusazwe futhi alingenise ngendlela efanelekile ukuze kube nesifungo noma nesiqiniseko sokuthi leli cala obugwetshelwe lona ngempela belihambelana nezizathu zezombusazwe ngaleso sikhathi, kanti futhi obukwenza ubukwenza ngaphansi komyalo weqembu lakho. Yiba nokucophelela uma ugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo ngoba lawo agcwaliswe ngendlela efanele yiwona kuphela azobhekwa. Kumele kube nomuntu oyedwa esicelweni ngasinye.

Amabhange adinga ukuthi umphakathi uphathwe kahle ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Ukukhula kwezimali kumabhange kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabashayi bezezimali, futhi lokhu kudinga umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obufanele. Ukuze amabhange akwazi ukuphendula izidingo zamakhasimende, kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngamasu amasha afanele. Ukuba nolwazi olunembile mayelana nezinsizakalo zamabhange kubalulekile ukuze abathengi baqonde kahle izinqubomgomo ezithinta izimali zabo. Ukuhlakanipha kwabathengi kudinga ukuba kube ngaphezu kokuhlola ibhange elithile; kumqoka ukuthi kube nokuhlonipha nolwazi oluqinile. Ngokuphetha, ezamabhange zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali, futhi umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuxoxa ngalezi zinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bathola izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze umnotho ube muhle, umphakathi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle, ukuze amabhange ahlale enza umthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu.

UNelson Mandela, ngemva kweminyaka engama-27 esebenzisa ubuhlungu, wakhululwa. Kwakungumcimbi omkhulu, umhlaba wonke wawujabule, uMandela waba yisithonjana sokukhululeka. Ukubuyisana nezizathu eziphambili kwavula indlela yokwakha ikusasa elinobungane. Izinsizwa nezintombi zafuna ukuphila, zathi: "Siyavuma! Sizokwakha ikusasa elihle." Ngemuva kokukhululeka kwalezi zinsizwa, kwavela umoya wokubuyisana. Abantu abavuka emnqamlezweni, baphuma ebumnyameni, babonisa ukuthi basafuna ubumbano. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi inkululeko iyinsika yokwakha ubumbano. Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibona izizukulwane eziningi eziphila ngaphansi kwenhloso yokwakha isizwe esihlangene. Amathuba abhalwe phansi, izindlela zokukhuluma zafaka umoya wokuphila. Izinsizwa nezintombi zifunda izifundo zenkululeko, ziqhubeka nezinyathelo, zifuna ukukhumbuza abantu ukuthi umoya wokulwa awupheli. Umgomo wokuhlonipha, ubumbano, nokubambisana akukaze kuphele, kusho ukuthi inkululeko iyajabula, iyaphila. Nakuba izinkinga zisekhona, umoya wokulwa phambili usaqhubeka. Abantu bazi ukuthi inkululeko iyinsika yempilo, futhi bazokwakha umhlaba omuhle, izinsuku ezizayo zibe yizinsuku zokuthula, ubumbano, nokukhululeka. Ngale ndlela, ukulwa kwenkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika kwaba yindlela yokwakha isizwe esithokozisayo, esihloniphekile, nesithokozisayo. Ngaphandle kwemikhankaso, izinsizwa nezintombi zafuna ukuphila okungcono, zathi: "Siyavuma, sizokwakha ikusasa elihle!"

Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphumelela kulabo abanglezinga eliphakeme lemfundo. Ukusimama kokuhweba nezinkampani ezincane nakho kubalulekile, ukuphucula ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kumele kube phakeme kakhulu kulabo abafuna ukukhula nokuqhubeka empilweni. Lokhu akukhona nje ukunakekela abantu, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, izindlela ezihlukahlukene zingatholwa ukuze kubhekelelwe lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sisebenze ngokubambisana – izikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, futhi umphakathi ngokwawo. Uma sikhuthaza imisebenzi yokuphuculwa kwemisebenzi, sizoba nempilo engcono, umnotho ophumelelayo, kanye nemiphakathi eqinile. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho oluhle empilweni yabantu, futhi kube umthombo wezenzo ezinhle emhlabeni wonke.

Umphakathi ungathinta lesi sikhungo uthole usizo ngokushayela inombolo yamahhala ethi: 0800 005 133. Lesi sikhungo esisezingeni eliphezulu kwezokuxhumana nobuchwepheshe, sinabasebenzi abakwazi ukunikeza umphakathi izeluleko nolwazi mayelana nezempilo kanye nanoma yiluphi ulwazi nemininingwane edingwa yilowo oshaye ucingo. Uma nje kuphathelene nezempilo uyaluthola usizo. Lesi sikhungo esisebhilidini iNatalia, okuyiNhloko Hhovisi yomNyango wezeMpilo eMgungundlovu, sinabasebenzi abaqeqeshelwe ukunikeza usizo kunoma ngubani oxhumana naso. Inhloso yokusungulwa kwalesi sikhungo ukunikeza umphakathi wonkana usizo lwezempilo ngaso sonke isikhathi ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zokuxhumana ezifana nemisakazo, isikhahlamezi, i-email, imiyalezo ethunyelwa ngomakhalekhukhwini (sms) kanye nocingo. Uqhube wathi, Lesi sikhungo siwusiz kithini kwezosizo oluphuthumayo ngoba uma umphakathi uhlaba umkhosi siyakwazi ukusheshe sifike lapho sidingeka khona ngoba lesi sikhungo sinobuxhakaxhaka obusiza abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo bakwazi ukuyalelwa lapho kudingeka usizo khona ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi befuna leyo ndawo. Futhi lesi sikhungo siyakwazi ukuthumela imiyalezo esiqaphisayo uma kungenzeka kuba khona izimo zezinhlekelele sikwazi ukuma ngokumumo, kuchaza uNtsobi.

Ibhodi alikwazi ukuvuma isicelo selayisense yokusebenza egunyaza ukusebenza ngezithuthi ezisuka kwesinye isifundazwe, noma ukuvuselela noma ukudlulisela ilayisense yokusebenza, noma sokushintsha ilayisense yokusebenza yokuqhuba ukusebenza kwesinye isifundazwe, ngaphandle uma kuvuma isiphathimandla sezokukhishwa kwama layisense okusebenza esisungulelwe lesosi fundazwe. Lapho iBhodi lehluleka ukuthola impendulo edingekayo ephuma kwisiphathimandla sezokukhipha amalayisense okusebenza sakwesinye isifundazwe kwinkomba ekhonjwe kusigatshana 4, noma lehluleka ukuthola imvume yeBhodi esikhathini esibekiwe, iBhodi kumele lidlulisele loludaba njengesikhalo kwi Nkundla yokudlulisela izikhalo ngezokuthutha esungulwe ngu Mthetho we Nkundla yokudlulisela izikhalo ngezoku Thutha, ngendlela ebekwe ngokwalo Mthetho. Izikhalo ezimaqondana nezithuthi phakathi kwezifundazwe kumele zenziwe kwinkundla yezikhalo ngezokuthutha njeboba kusho uMthetho we Nkundla yokudlulisela iziKhalo ngezoku Thutha, njengoba kufuneka ngokwalo Mthetho. Ngokwezithuthi phakathi kwezifundazwe, abagibeli akumele bagitsheliswe noma behliswe noma yikuphi ngaphandle kwasezindaweni zokugibela noma lapho beya khona, ngaphandle kokuthi zingekho ezinye izithuthi phakathi kwezindawo zokugibela noma lapho beya khona nasezindaweni zokwehla noma zokugibela, noma, ngokwezamatekisi angamakhumbi, izinhlangano ezifanele amalunga azo asebenza kulowo noma kuleyomigudu zivumelene ngokwehlukile.

Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinsizwa eziyiqeqeshelwe ukwenza ukuhlola nokuphendula ezimeni ezingalindelekile. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlanganisa Izibuyekezo Nokuhlolwa Kwenqubo Ukuze sithuthukise ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola futhi ziqhube izibuyekezo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, nokubuyekezwa njalo kwemigomo yokuvikeleka. Isigaba 7: Ukuxhumana Nokubambisana Nabanye Ukuze uhlelo lokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu e-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi, abakhiqizi bezinsizakalo, nabanye ozakwethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukudlulisela ulwazi nokuhlala uhlanganyela. Isigaba 8: Ukubeka Izinyathelo Zokugcina Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesimo sokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kudinga izinyathelo eziphakeme. Lokhu kubandakanya ukucwaninga njalo ngezindlela eziphephile zokuphathwa kolwazi, ukwakha isithombe esiqinile sokuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luqinisekisiwe. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinyathelo, i-GEMS ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwa luphephile, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, izinqubo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo ku-GEMS kufanele zibe yimpumelelo eqinile, evikelekile, futhi zenze kube lula ukusimama kwemisebenzi ye-GEMS.

Isichibiyelo soMgomo 21.08. Isichibiyelo soMgomo 21.08. ukundiza okweseka izinguquko ezinqala ezinhlotsheni; kanye iv nokundiza ngenhloso yokukhombisa ukuhambisana nemisebenzi nezidingo zokwethembeka ezifunwa yiMigomo; noma b ucwaningo nentuthuko ephathelene nokuhlola izinhlobo ezintsha zamabhanoyi, imishini emisha yamabhanoyi, izinsiza nobuchwepheshe obusha, amaqhinga amasha okusebenzisa izindiza noma izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa izindiza. isitifiketi sokuhlola sohlobo lwendiza esikhishwa njengomkhandlu ofakazela igunya lokundiza ngendlela enqunywe kwiNgxenye 24 yeMigomo. h olunye ulwazi olungafunwa wuKhomishani ngenhloso yokuphephisa umphakathi. Isicelo sokukhipha igunya lokuzibonakalisa amandla okundiza ohlotsheni lwendiza ekleliswe esigabeni esithile noma soguquko kufanele senziwe ngendlela ehambisana nemibandela yeNgxenye 24. Isitifiketi sokuhlola esikhishwe ngaphansi kweNgxenye siyoba semthethweni kuphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika nasemanzini ezwe. Ukunqamula kwelinye izwe noma emngceleni welinye izwe kuyodinga imvume yomkhandlu wezindiza olawulayo kulelo lizwe. Isichibiyelo soMgomo 21.08. d ukundizisa ibhanoyi noma iziwombe ezimbalwa zokusebenzisa ibhanoyi ngesikhathi lingasahambisani namaqophelo afanele omsebenzi ahlonzwe kumgomo 21.02.3; noma e ukusebenzisa indiza enesisindo esingaphezulu kwesilinganiso esivunyelwe ibhanoyi elisukayo lidlule ibanga elivamile noma umhlaba ongenazo izidingo ezifanele noma indawo yokwetha amafutha endiza.

NgoNovemba, umphakathi wanikezwa enye ithuba lokuxoxa ngalolu mgomo. Ngemuva kokuthi umphakathi uthumele impendulo yabo neziphakamiso, lezi zahlaziywa ngamaqembu akhethiwe eqembu lokuhlola labaphathi futhi zaba yisichasiso ngoDisemba 2001 ukuze kufakwe izinguquko eziphakanyisiwe. Lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo siwumphumela womsebenzi okhuluma ngenhla. Le ndatshana kanye nezitatimende zezigaba eziyisishiyagalombili ezishicilelwe njengokungeziwe zisebenza njengesisekelo lapho lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni) sakhiwe khona. Lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni) sizothatha indawo yesitatimende somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 esamukelwa ngo-1997 uma sekuqinisekiswe ngokomthetho njengomgomo wesifundo. Uhlelo oluhle lokusebenza luzosungulwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhunyushwa kwalesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe kuphumelele. Umthetho wokuhlola okukhona odatshana ethi Disemba 23, 1998 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 19640) kanye nomthetho wezilimi emfundweni odatshana ethi Julayi 14, 1997 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 17997) kumele kufundwe ndawonye nesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni). Umthetho wokuhlola kumele ufundwe ndawonye nesigaba esihlobene sesitatimende sesigaba ngasinye sokufunda. Umthetho ophathelene nokukhishwa kwezitifiketi uzohlala ungashintshi kuze kube unyaka ka-2008.

Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izisebenzi zikhululekile futhi ziphephile emsebenzini wazo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini, okukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa, izimayini zinezinto ezinhle nezimbi. Zenza kube nokuthuthukiswa komnotho, kodwa futhi zibangela umonakalo emvelweni nezingozi ezinkulu zokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuphucula le mboni, ukuze sithole izinzuzo ngaphandle kokubeka engcupheni impilo yabantu nemvelo. Ngokubambisana, singathuthukisa izimayini zethu ukuze zibe yinzuzo kubo bonke, futhi sithuthukise izimpilo zethu ngendlela ehloniphekile.

Isahluko 1: Ukuqonda Izikhathi Zokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezinsukwini zethu, ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kubaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma kwenzeka ingozi, umcimbi ongamukeleki, noma isimo sokuhlukumeza, kufanele sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Isikhathi sokuphendula sisho ukuthi sithatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze sithole usizo noma sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze silungise isimo. Ukuze sithuthukise lesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu nezinto ezifanele. Isahluko 2: Izimbangela Zokuphendula Ngaphezu Kwesikhathi Kunezimo eziningi ezingadala ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula sibe sephuthumayo. Okokuqala, inkinobho yokuqala yenza kubaluleke kakhulu ukwazi izindawo zokugcina ulwazi, njengemithombo yolwazi ejwayelekile, abantu abazinikele, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olufanele ngokushesha. Kwesiqalo, abantu abangahambisani nomawuwela badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukubambisana. Amaphoyisa, abenhliziyokwezinye izinhlelo, nezinduna zempilo bahlala beqedela imicimbi yokuphendula eziphuthumayo, ukuze baziqonde izindlela ezinhle zokuphendula. Isahluko 3: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphendula Ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zamphakathi, izinhlelo zokuphendula kufanele zakhiwe kahle, zibe nesikhalazo sokuxhumana okuhle. Ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphuthumayo, cenayo amandla okuvuselela imiyalezo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele uthakasele imihlangano yokubaluleka. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi uqonde izinyathelo zokuphendula, kube nenhloso yokuzivikela ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo.

iXbox Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukhuluma nawe ngento ethokozisayo, iXbox. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi le midlalwano yevidiyo ibaluleke kangakanani emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla? Ngiyazi, kungenzeka ukuthi abanye bethu sikhuluma ngalezi zinto ezithokozisayo, kodwa iXbox iyinto ethokozisayo kakhulu. Ngizokhuluma ngayo, ngizokhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezihambisana nayo, futhi ngizokwenza kube lula ukuze uqonde kahle. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngokuqala kweXbox. Iqala ngonyaka ka-2001, lapho iMicrosoft yethula khona iXbox yokuqala. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu emhlabeni wezokudlala, njengoba kwavula umnyango omusha kubadlali abaningi. Ngabe ubungakholwa ukuthi iXbox yokuqala yayinekhono lokuxhuma ku-inthanethi? Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokudlala nabantu abavela emhlabeni wonke, okwakungakaze kube khona ngaphambili. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babengakaze bacabange ukuthi bazokwazi ukudlala imidlalo nabantu abavela emazweni ahlukene. Ngemuva kwalokho, iXbox 360 yatholakala, futhi lokhu kwaba yinto enkulu. I-360 yenza kube lula ukudlala imidlalo emisha, futhi yathuthukisa kakhulu izithombe nemiphumela. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi imidlalo efana ne-"Halo" ne-"Gears of War" yathandwa kakhulu? Le midlalwano yenza abantu babe nezinhloso ezithile, futhi ibangele imiphakathi emisha. Abantu babebhalisela iXbox Live, lapho bekhuthazwa khona ukuba badlale imidlalo, baxhumane, futhi benze abangane abasha. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi iXbox ayigcini nje ngokudlala imidlalo? Ibuye ibe yindawo yokubuka amafilimu, ukusakaza umculo, nokwenza izinto eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani.

Uma kudingeka unikeze ubufakazi, kwesinye isikhathi cela umngane noma othile ophakathi kwecala ukuthi akuhambise enkantolo. Ngemuva kokunikeza ubufakazi bakho, uzokwazi ukukwazisa uma ungahamba. Ngokwesimo esithile, ungase unikeze ubufakazi wakho egumbini elivaliwe ngevidiyo (lokhu kusho ukuthi ngeke ube khona egumbini elifanayo nomsolwa, kodwa uzobe ungaphakathi kwezinye izindlu). Ungase futhi, uma ungaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 noma uma umuntu omele icala (kungaba ummagistrate noma ijaji) ekholelwa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi kungase kubangele ukukhathazeka okungadingekile, kube nomuntu osekelayo (othile ozokhuluma ngokuqondile) uma unikeza ubufakazi ngevidiyo egumbini elivaliwe. Kumele kube nobufakazi obuqinile ngaphambi kokuthi umuntu atholakale enecala. Umphakathi kumele ukhombise ngaphandle kokungabaza ukuthi umsolwa unecala. Lokhu kungase kusho ukuthi umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi unecala utholakala engelona. Lokhu akusho ukuthi isinqumo sakho sikhulu, kodwa kukhombisa amandla wecala lokuphakanyiswa. Umphakathi ngezinye izikhathi uzobiza abaqinisekisi bakahulumeni ukuba bakuhambise kuleli cala elibhekiswe kumsolwa. Umhumushi uzobe ekhona uma kudingeka. Umphakathi uzonika ithuba lokubuza imibuzo, ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi, nokubiza abaqinisekisi. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo izwile yonke imininingwane evela kumphakathi nakuye ophikayo, umsolwa nomphikisi bazothola ithuba lokukhuluma enkantolo ngaphambi kokuthi umphumela udlule. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma umphumela, ummeleli wecala, umphakathi, noma ophikayo bangacela ukuthi ummeleli wezisulu noma omunye umuntu onekhono avunyelwe ukuveza umthelela wobugebengu kuwe noma kumsolwa.

Ukusebenzisa imizwa - Ukwakha , ukuhumusha nokudlala ngomcabango ngeziqephu zomlomo, ezibukwayo kanye nezibhalwayo. Kwezamasiko - ukuzwisisa nokwazisa ezinye izilimi namasiko, kanye nokuyigugu okuhambisana nazo. Kwezombusazwe - Ukuzethemba nokucela inselele kwabanye ngento ongayiboni kahle eyenziwa omunye umuntu; ukwenza abantu babone izinto ngendlela obona ngayo; ukuzibeka wena noma omunye umuntu ngendlela yokuthi abantu bathole esinye isithombe ngawe noma ngabo; ukugcina, ukuthuthukisa nokushintsha ubuwena. Ukuhlolisisa - ukuqonda kahle ukuhlobana phakathi kolimi, amandla nobuwena, nokucela inselele ekumelaneni nasekusetshenzisweni kolimi namandla ngendlela engafanele; ukuqonda ukuthi amasiko ayashintshashintsha; nokwenqaba ukulandela uvo lomunye umuntu nokuba kwakhiwe isithombe esithile ngawe lapho kudingeka khona. Izimpawu ezingajwayelekile kanye nomklamo. Umkhakha wesifundo sezilimi uluthelela kanjani uhlelo lwezifundo? Uthuthukisa ukufunda nokubhala, okuyisisekelo esisemqoka sokufunda ezinye izinto. Kufundwa ngazo ezinye izifundo njengeMetametikisi neSayensi yezokuhlalisana kwabantu. Ukugqugquzela ukuzwisisa ukuhlobana kwamasiko , ukufinyelela kweminye imibono nokuzwisisa ukuthi ayiniamasiko. Uvusa usinga lokucabanga nokuqamba imisebenzi edinga acabange, ngaleyo ndlela ugqugquzela izinjongozobuciko namasiko. Ukunikeza indlela yolwazi, nokuthuthukisa izinjongo eziningi zesayensi, ubuchwepheshe nezifundo ngemvelo. Ukuthuthukisa izikhali zokuhlolisisa izinto abazidingayo ukuze babe yizakhamuzi ezithembekile. Izilimi: zihlanganisa ulwazi, amakhono nokuyigugu.

Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezibhekelela izimoto eziningi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abashayeli baphila ngokuphepha. Ngokuphetha, izimoto eziningi zineqhaza elibalulekile ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi usizo lufika ngesikhathi, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Nokho, zikhona izinselelo ezihambisana nalokhu, ezifana nokuhamba komgwaqo, izinsiza ezidingekayo, kanye nezinsiza zokuphepha. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde lezi zinto ukuze sikwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izimoto eziningi zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sikhuthaze izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisebenzayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, futhi sithuthukise izimo zokuphila zabantu bethu.

I-SAMSA iphinde ikhiphe futhi inikeze izitifiketi okufanele zibe nazo abantu uma besebenza ezikebheni. IKomidi leMithetho Yamalungelo Abantu laseNingizimu Afrika kumele lithuthukise isikhombimsebenzisi esiqukethe ulwazi olufanele ukuhlinzekwa kunoma ubani ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yiluphi ilungelo elicatshangelwayo nguMthetho. Izimemo ezitholiwe zokuhamba/nokuxhumana namanye amazwe/izinhlangano/okungabandakanya amaklayenti nomphakathi. Akukho sikhumbuzo esishicilelwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho. I-SAMSA iphethe ukuvikelwa kokungcoliswa kanye nekhono lokuphendula, ngokubambisana neMnyango Wezokuphila Nendawo. Ukwethulwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kumele kuthunyelwe ku-CEO we-SAMSA. Uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sikhanselwa noma sithathwa ngokuhambisana Nezikhala 22, 26, noma 29 zoMthetho, umceli angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi. Omnye umuntu angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi, ukuze afune ukufinyelela kulwazi. Isikhalazo kumele sithunyelwe ngendlela ebekiwe ku-2, bese sithunyelwa kuMenenja Yolwazi kwikheli leposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhonjiswe ku-2 ngenhla, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola isikhumbuzo sokwenqaba. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yesikhalazo. Uma umceli engakakhokhi imali yesikhalazo (uma kudingeka), isinqumo ngesikhalazo sangaphakathi singabambezela, kuze kube yilapho imali ikhokhiwe.

Isicelo esiphawulwe emtheshwaneni -1 siyophelezelwa yisitifiketi esikhishwe nguSomlomo weSishayamthetho esichaza ukuthi isigaba -802a noma isigaba- 1222a soMthethosisekelo senelisiwe, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. d ithuba elifunywayo lokukhululwa, kuhlanganisa ithuba lesikhashana. a Noma yiliphi iqembu lezombusazwe esishayamthetho esithintekayo noma uhulumeni ofisa ukuphikisa isinqumo senkantolo esifunywayo ngaphansi kwesicelo liyokwazisa uNobhala ngokubhaliwe ngenhloso yokuphikisa zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu- 15 sethuliwe leso sicelo, esazisweni liyoqoka ikheli lapho lelo qembu noma uhulumeni eyokwemukela khona isaziso namaphepha afanele odaba oluqhutshwa enkantolo. b Uma leso saziso sikhishiwe, isicelo siyoqhutshwa ngendlela ehambisana nemibandela yomthetho- 11. b ukuba wonke amaqembu ezombusazwe esiShayamthetho sikaZwelonke noma esiFundazweni esithintekayo nabafisa ukwenza njalo bethule iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe ababona zifanele ekunqumeni udaba, singakedluli isikhathi esimiswe kuleyo miyalelo. Unobhala wenkantolo ekhiphe isinqumo sokungahambisani kwesenzo nomthethosisekelo njengoba kuhlonzwe esigabeni -172 soMthethosisekelo uyothula kuNobhala weNkantolo ikhophi yaleso sinqumo zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu -15 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwaleso sinqumo.

Igama elithi iBhodi leziMvume zeZithuthi e-Gauteng elamiswa ngaphansi kwesigaba 2 so Mthetho weSikhashana weZithuthi zaPhansi e-Gauteng, ka 1998 u Mthetho 2 ka 1998 ushintshelwe kwi Bhodi laMalayisense Okusebenza nge Zokuthutha e-Gauteng futhi lithathwa njengebhodi elikhonjwe kusigaba 301 so Mthetho ka Zwelonke. IBhodi kumele libe nomphathisihlalo namalunga ambalwa abekwa ngu MEC okumele kube ngabantu abanezipiliyoni ngezinto ezehlukene, futhi batshengise nekhono kwezokuthutha abahamba ngezimito zomphakathi, ezezimboni, ezomnotho, ezamabhizinisi, ezezimali nezomthetho noma ekuphatheni izindaba zomphakathi. Amalunga eBhodi leziMvume Zezithuthi e-Gauteng aqashwa ngaphambi kokuqala kwalo Mthetho azoqhubeka ehhovisi kuze kuphele isikhathi sokuqashwa kwawo ngaphandle uma u MEC enqamula ukusebenza kwabo ngaphambi kokufika kwesikhathi. a Ngaphambi kokuqasha amalunga eBhodi, u MEC kumele akhiphe isaziso ngenhloso yokuqasha, futhi ameme izicelo zomsebenzi wobulunga, okungenani kanye kwiphephandaba lesi Fundazwe, ngolwimi lwesingisi nangolwimi okungenani olulodwa olusemthethweni olusetshenziswa kakhulu kwisi Fundazwe. b Ngaphambi kokuqasha noma yiliphi ilunga, u MEC kumele akhiphe isaziso, ngendlela efanayo, amagama abantu acabanga ukubaqashela iBhodi, bese emema izimvo nokumelana ngalokhu. c engowawa futhi engakavuki kwezamabhizinisi; noma d ake atholwa enecala elinokungathembeki noma esake wasuswa ehhovisi ngenxa yokungaziphathi kahle.

Uhlelo lokungalahlekelwa ubuzwe bakho lungelakho, lwasiza abezwe laseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokuba ngabeziNtu zaseNingizimu Afrika noma ngabe baphendukela kubuzwe besinye isizwe. Uhlelo lungafakwa ehhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka uhlelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emsebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Gcwalisa amafomu okusebenza ku-inthanethi: BI-1664 no-BI-529. Thumela ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesitifiketi sakho sokuzalwa saseNingizimu Afrika, kanye ne-affidavit eqinisekisiwe evela kummeli, ethi awunayo enye ubuzwe kwenye indawo. Zonke izinkampani zamadokhumenti kanye nesitatimende esiqinisekisiwe kufanele ziqinisekiswe umuntu ogunyaziwe ukwenza izinkontileka zomthetho, kungaba uMphakathi Oqinisekisiwe noma uMphakathi Wokufungisa. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abalahlekelwe amalungelo abo okubuzwe ngemuva kokuthola ubuzwe besinye isizwe, ngenkathi bengengabantu abancane ngokomthetho, futhi ngaphandle kokufaka isicelo sokulahlekelwa ubuzwe ngaphambi kokuba babe ngabeziNtu besinye isizwe, bangafaka isicelo sokukhululwa emthwalweni. Kumele bagcwalise amafomu okusebenza ku-inthanethi: BI-1666 no-BI-529. Kumele bathumele ikhophi yesitifiketi sobuzwe besinye isizwe. Thumela ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-ID yaseNingizimu Afrika noma ipasipoti, noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa saseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izinkampani zamadokhumenti kufanele ziqinisekiswe umuntu ogunyaziwe ukwenza izinkontileka zomthetho, kungaba uMphakathi Oqinisekisiwe noma uMphakathi Wokufungisa. Le sevisi ithatha izinsuku ezi-5 zokusebenza.

UThandiwe, owayengumsebenzi ophakathi kwezokuxhumana, wathola ithuba lokuhola isifundo sokuxhumana. Wazizwa ejabule, ngoba wayefuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono akhe ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini wakhe. Izifundo zakhula zaba yindawo yokuhlangana, lapho abantu behlanganyela izimvo, benza imisebenzi ethokozisayo, futhi bezama izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Kwathi uma uThandiwe ehamba phambili, waqala ukuqaphela ukuthi izifundo azizange zikhulume kuphela ngamasu okuxhumana, kodwa futhi zazikhuluma nangokwakha ubudlelwano. Wafunda ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu buvumela ukusebenza kahle, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsika yempumelelo. UThandiwe waba isibonelo esihle, ngoba waqala ukufaka izifundo zakhe emsebenzini, futhi ngokushesha waqala ukuthola imiphumela emihle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uSipho, owayengumsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe, naye wathola ithuba lokuhola isifundo sokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Wazizwa engazi kahle, kodwa wagxila ekufundeni. Izifundo zakhuluma ngamasu amasha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, kodwa kudinga ukuzinikela, futhi lokhu kumenze waba nomdlandla. Waqala ukusebenzisa amakhono akhe amasha, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abone izinguquko ezinhle emsebenzini wakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabulile, futhi umphakathi waMzimkhulu waqala ukuvuma izinguquko ezinhle. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa amakhono lwenza abantu babe namandla, futhi lokho kwaba yinsika yokukhula kwempumelelo. Umphakathi waqala ukubona izinzuzo, njengoba abantu behola kahle, futhi izinga lokusebenza lenyuka.

Abasebenzi ababehlome ngezixhubho, ngezinto zokuhlola amahehlo bahlala phezu komsebenzi ababewezele wokufundisa izingane ngokubaluleka kokuzigcina uphile kakhe. Baphinde babafundisa ngezindlela zokuvikela nokulwa nezifo njengokuvikela amazinyo ukuthi angaboli, lokhu kungavikeleka uma izingane zingafundiswa zihlolwe zisencane. Isizulu sithi umuthi ugotshwa usemanzi. Snyman wathi umnyango lusisize kakhulu ekethini siqinise yezemfundo kanye eyamazinyo, ukwenza isibonelo nje, lokugqugquzela ezempilo kuthi usebenzise lesi sikhathi ukuthi olwethu nokuthi siluphucule, nowezenhlalakahle." sizokwazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi kubonakala sengathi lolu hlelo usekele uphinde uqinise lezo sakwazi ukuluhlanganisa nezinye Lokhu kuhlolwa kuzosiza sibheke lezo zinkinga ezidinga luzodluliselwa nasezikoleni zinhlelo zezempilo esezivele izinhlelo esesikhona,"kuphawula umnyango ukuthi uthumele izinto ukuqaphelisiswa ngokushesha." zamabanga aphezulu. ZINYANGENI eziyisithupha ezedlule, umNyango wezeMpilo KewaZulu-Natal usungule uhlelo lokuqeqesha abosizo oluphuthumayo ngaphansi kwezimo ezibucayi. kuphela. Oyedwa waphumelela wadluliselwa ohlelweni lokuqeqeshwa lwezinyanga ezintathu ngo-Agasti, usanda kuthola isitifiketi futhi usekulungele ukubhekana nomphakathi awunike usizo oluphuthumayo. Lokhu kukhishwa kwezitifiketi kwenzeke ngesikhathi esihle. Njengoba sesifikile isikhathi samaholidi, kubhekwe ukuthi sande isidingo sosizo oluphuthumayo.

INtshonalanga Kapa okwamanje isesigabeni sokudlulisela lezi zindawo esifundazweni. Usizo lokulondoloza imilando ye-Nepad nalo lubekwe ezintweni eziphambili ohlwini lokubalulekile. Ukwengeza kulokhu, kwenziwe imithetho kazwelonke emisha emithathu. ONgqongqoshe basayine Isiqinisekiso Ngezindawo Zokulonda Amarekhodi Omlando, Ukubusa Okuhle kanye Namalungelo Abantu avela emazweni ase-Afrika ayi-10 ayeselethwa ukuthi amukelwe njengephrojekthi ye-Nepad. NgoNovemba 2003 kwenziwa Umkhandlu Kazwelonke Wemitapo Yezincwadi Nezinsiza Zezincwadi The National Council for Library and Information Services NCLIS, umhlangano wokuwumisa wawubanjwe ngoMashi 2004. Kwaqokwa ochwepheshe kwezokwakha nokufanekisa izakhiwo abazobhekela ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo esisha seNgxenye yasePitoli yoMtapo Wezincwadi Kazwelonke eNingizimu Afrika ngo-Januwari ka-2004. Isu Lokukhula Kwezimboni Zamasiko ukusebenzisa amandla omnotho obuciko bezandla, omculo, efilimu, okushicilela kanye nezimboni zokwenza amadizayini. Usizo lomnyango lungena ekuthuthukiseni ukubambisana nokuqala izinto ezintsha nomphakathi/nabazimele, kusetshenziswa isiko ngethuluzi lokuvuselela amadolobha kanye nemizamo yokuhlanganisa lezi zimboni. Kunokukhula kokugxila emandleni ezimboni zamafilimu. Isabelo sokusiza ebuphofini ezikhethekile sihlose ukuthi kufinyeleleke emakhonweni nasekuthengiseni njengethuluzi lokuvuselela amadolobha, ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemakhaya, kane nokwenza amathuba omsebenzi. Amaprojekthi enziwa ngokubambisana noHulumeni bezifundazwe nabasekhaya, kanye nezinhlangano zikahulumeni kanye nalezo ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni.

Ngakho-ke uhulumeni uyasibona isidingo sokuqondisa inkundla yemidlalo phakathi kwendawo enogesi nengenawo. Umsolwa wagcinwa emaphoyiseni ase-Welkom kanti usuku lwakhe lokuvela enkantolo alukakaziwa njengamanje. Itemu kwesinye isikhathi lisetshenziswa ngokungeyikho ukuchaza ukuphatha kwezikhulu eziphezulu kanye nohulumeni. Bazohambisa izimali enhlanganweni enakekela nesekela abahlukunyezwe wudlame nokuhlumezeka nje. Umsolwa wabaleka, kodwa ngosizo lwamalungu ezimoto eziGijima kakhulu walandelwa futhi waphoqwa ukuphuma emgwaqweni. Siyanibonga kakhulu ngokuphelezela uThandi ukuze eze azoxoxa udaba lwakhe. Ngenhlanhla, emhlanganweni wethu nama-French, ayizwe elithuthuke kakhulu ekusebenziseni amandla enunzi ukuze kube nokuthula, sikhulume ngokubambisana kulolu daba. Uwuphawu loxolo nokubuyisana emhlabeni kanti waphilisa 'umoya wenkululeko emhlabeni wonke. Ugange lwe-almond manje seluzungeze iziqiwi zabantu bakule ndawo, nokwenza sikwazi ukuchaza le ndawo njuengeyethu. Angingabazi ukuthi nike nazibuza lo mbuzo naphinde nahlinzeka izimpendulo ezidingekayo. Uhambo lweminyaka eyishumi, nakuba belulukhuni, lwalunezehlekalo futhi lungolungakhohleki. Babegqoke okhakhi abansundu, inyumfoma yombutho wezokuvikela. Ukufaka izinhlangano zentsha engamavolontiya kwi-National Youth Service kuqubula izindaba eziningi okumele zibhekwe kakhulu. Uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luzoqhubeka kanti sethemba ukuthi ababulali bazoboshwa. Umnikelo uyokwenza abakhipha imikhiqizo yaseNingizimu Afrikha ukuba banwebe izimakethe zabo zakwamanye amazwe.

Ucwaningo lokuqagula izindleko olwenziwe wuMnyango weZimali kuHulumeni neDAC ngonyaka ka 2001 ukhombisa ukuthi isilinganiso sezindleko zokuqhuba umsebenzi wezilimi ezahlukene yinto engasimama futhi ungahlinzekelwa ngaphandle kwezinguquko ezinkulu kwisabelo sezimali esihleliwe. Ucwaningo lokuqagula izindleko lwenziwa ngokulandela uhlelo lokunikana ithuba emikhakheni emine yezilimi. Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi lomsebenzi udinga isabelo sezimali esenyuke ngaphansana kwephesenti elilodwa. Ukusebenzisa izilimi eziyisithupha ngokulandisa kweNLPF kuyoholela ezindlekweni ezingaphezulu kancane kodwa ezingevile emaphesentini amabili. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni kuyofanele zihlinzeke ngesamba esenele sokweseka ukusebenza kweNqubomgomo yeziLimi ehambisana noHlaka Lokukhokha Izindleko zoNyaka kuya kwemiThathu (MTEF) oluyoqala ukungena ngezikhawu kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka wezimali ka 2003/4. Amaqoqo ezindleko ezivamile ezifana Nokuphatha ihhovisi (isibonelo, izindleko zokushintshelwa kwenye indawo, ukuhamba, ukulala, ihhovisi nokukhokhela ucingo), impahla ethengwayo (imibhalo eshicilelwe, ukuloba, izincwadi, izinsiza zokubhala, izinsiza zasehhovisi) nemishini (amakhompuyutha, imishini elalelwayo, imishini yocingo) kuyoba nomthelela ezindlekweni. Isithebe esethulwe ngezansi sikhombisa futhi siqhathanisa isilinganiso sezindleko zethimba lolimi ngokuhleleka ngesikhathi seMTEF. Ngokubhekela ukuthi iMinyango kuyofanele isebenzise iNLPF ngokwenkambiso yeMTEF, mhlawumbe kungaba wusizo ukuchaza ukuthi yini ebandanyekayo kule nqubo.

Lokhu kungavimbela izingozi uma ithuluzi lishayisa. Xhuma yonke imishini enogesi emhlabeni (umhlaba). Sebenzisa i-plug enezinhlangothi ezintathu kuphela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukukhanya okwanele nokuhamba komoya endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-bench akhanya kahle futhi umoya ongcolile uyakhishwa njalo eshopheni. Ngokufanayo, gcina ithuluzi lokwelashwa elibalulekile liseduze. Phendula noma yiziphi izingozi ezincane ngokushesha ukuze uvimbele ingozi enkulu ekwenzekeni.

Ngale ndlela, uhulumeni uqale ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizimele ezikhungweni zobuciko bendawo. Lokhu kuyisizathu esibalulekile sokuthi amazwe ase-Afrika avumele iSivumelwano. Imakethe yaseTshwane iyindawo ehlukile lapho amanani ebekwe khona futhi lapho imifino nezithelo zithengiswa, kuzuza abakhiqizi, abathengi, nabathengisi. Njengoba sikhuluma, sibhekene nezinselelo zesikhashana, kodwa akukho okuzosivimba ekuthuthumeleni phambili ukuze sithole ikusasa elingcono, futhi simema abaqalayo ukuba basihambisane kulolu hambo. Izindawo ezisemngciphekweni ophakeme ohlelweni lwezizinda eziningi zizokhunjulwa futhi ziqashelwe, ukuze kuncishiswe isidingo somsebenzi wobunjiniyela ukuvikela izakhiwo noma abantu. Ngithanda ukwabelana nabameli ekugubheni bonke ababe khona eMhlanganweni, ikakhulukazi abamele abahlonishwayo abavela kwamanye amazwe ababe lapha. I-SABC ibhekene nezinkinga zezimali ezinzima, futhi isu lokubheka isikhathi somsebenzi bekukhona ngenhloso yokuhlola izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwenza kube nezimele nokukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ngendlela efanele. Abantu abasha abanezingqinamba zengqondo bangafaka isicelo sokungena ohlelweni lweziqeqesho ezingenamkhawulo. Ngaphandle kwemibandela engaphikiswa yokuba khona kwabo eNingizimu Afrika, kwenziwa uphenyo olukhulu. Kubalulekile, izikhungo zesayensi kufanele zibe nendima ebonakalayo ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe obusha nasekuvezeni imibono emisha phakathi kwentsha yethu. Inani labafundi lenyukile phakathi kwabafundi abamnyama, kodwa leli nani elikhulayo labafundi abamnyama alihambisani nezikhangiso ezazidingeka kulabo bafundi.

Uma kwenzeka le SIVUMELWANO siphela eva kwenyanga eyodwa uma kubalwa usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwale SIVUMELWANO (bheka isigaba 12 ngenhla), kuyosebenza inothisi kwenyanga eyodwa . Inqobo nje uma u-SAPS engakwazi, kwizimo ezithile ezixolelekayo, ukuthi emukele inothisi yesikhathi esifishane. Noma yiliphi iqembu kule SIVUMELWANO lingasinqamula le SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula ingxenye yale SIVUMELWANO: Inqobo uma lelo qembu lokuqala elishiwo lilinikezile leli elinye iqembu inothisi ebhalwe phansi maqondana nalokhu kwephula futhi lokho kwephula kuhlale kungalungisiwe kwaze kwaphela izinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela osukwini elithole ngalo inothisi leyo. Izihloko zezigaba kule SIVUMELWANO ziyizinkomba kuphela, ngakho azisiyona ingxenye futhi azithintene nokuhunyushwa kwesigaba nganomaiyiphi indlela. Ngaphandle uma kubonakala kunokushayisana noma kungahambisani nokuqukethwe, ubunye buzohlanganisa nobuningi kanti ubulili besilisa buhlanganisa nobesifazane, kanjalo noma kuphendukezelwe. Le SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelelele phakathi KWAMAQEMBU futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esike saba khona phakathi KWAMAQEMBU maqondana nokuqukethwe lapha. AMAQEMBU ayavumelana ngokuthi angeke kushintshwe, kwengezwe, noma kuvunyelwane ngokukhansela noma lutho kwakhiwe kabusha le SIVUMELWANO kukho konke noma iphuzu noma umbandela waso futhi noma kwenzeka angeke kube namphumela ekusebenzeni kwesivumelwan ngaphandle uma kubhalwa phansi futhi omabili amaqembu asayinde noma asayindelwe abawamele.

Uma bobabili bephakanyiswa ukuthi umshado wabo ungabi ngaphansi kokwabelana ngempahla, kufanele bangene esivumelwaneni ngaphambi kokushada esaziwa ngokuthi isivumelwano sokushada. Uma befisa ukushintsha lokhu ngemuva kokushada, kufanele bafake isicelo eNkantolo Ephakeme. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokwenziwa Kwezivumelwano Zomshado, umkakhe unamalungelo alinganayo nesimo njengomyeni ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nokuthi kwenzekeni kuphahla. Umkakhe oshadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko unelungelo lokungena esivumelwaneni ngaphandle kokusiza komyeni wakhe. Kwenzekani uma umyeni wami efuna ukushada omunye umkakhe? Umyeni kufanele angene esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe, esizokhombisa ukuthi kwenzekeni kuphahla, futhi umyeni kufanele futhi afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze wamukelwe lesi sivumelwano esibhaliwe. I-ndlu yesigaba kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo empahla wonke omakoti avikelwe. Kwenzekani uma sifuna ukungena emshadweni wezomthetho ngemuva kokuba seshadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko? Uma umyeni wakho engenayo eminye imakoti, ungashada ngaphansi komthetho wezomthetho kanye nasemthethweni wesiko. Nokho, noma wena noma yena ngeke nikwazi ukungena emshadweni wesiko nabanye abantu ngenkathi nisenemshado wezomthetho. Umyeni noma umkakhe bangabhalisa umshado ehhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Kunconywa ukuthi nobabili niye ndawonye ukubhalisa umshado ukuze kusheshiswe ukubhaliswa. Nokho, uma omunye wenu engavumi, ungabhalisa wedwa, kodwa ngokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obudingekayo.

Sebenzisa bese uhambisa ilivu yabagulayo ejwayelekile ngendlela enesibopho kanye nangokubuhlakani? Gwema ukusebenzisa ilivu yabagulayo uyisebenzisele ezinye izinto ngaphandle kokugula nokulimala ngokuba kungenzeka ukuthi ugcine usotakwini esikhathini esizayo sokuyingiliza kwelivu yabagulayo. Ukubheka nokukunikeza ilivu yabagulayo ngokwesicelo sakho. Ukuhlola nokuphenya izimo ezifanayo ezithile zokusetshenziswa ngokungafanele kwelivu ejwayelekile yabagulayo. Bese benza okuthile uma kunesidingo. Umqashi kungenzeka ukuthi kwezinye izimo acele isitifiketi sokwelashwa sezikhathi ezimfushane kunezinsuku ezi-3 uma kunezimo ezithile ezifanayo ezitholakele. Ukweluleka abaqashwa ngokusetshenziswa kwelivu yabagulayo ngokunomqondo. Ukufanelisa indawo yokusebenza noma izidingo zomsebenzi noma ukufuna omunye umsebenzi, njalo ezehlakalweni ezikudingayo loku. Ilivu yokungabi nezinsuku ezanele inzuzo ongafaka isicelo sayo uma seziphelile izinsuku zakho ezijwayelekile zelivu yabagulayo kukuyingiliza kweminyaka emithathu-3 yelivu yabagulayo. Faka isicelo emafomini adingekayo okufaka isicelo. Uyacelwa ukuba uqaphele ukuthi kumele ufake isicelo emafomini abekiwe elivu yokungabi nezinsuku ezanele emfushane nende ngokuhambisanayo. Akusafanele ukuba usebenzise ifomu le-Z1 ulisebenzisele loku. Uma wazi ngaphambi kwesikhathi ukuthi kuzomele uyokwenziwa inqubo ethize noma ulaliswe esibhedlela uma uzohlinzwa, faka isicelo bese ufaka ifomu lakho lokucela ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kodwa, uma uhlaselwa ukugula ungazelele noma uthola ukulimala, yazisa umphathi wakho ngokushesha uma uhluleka ukusebenza ngenxa yokugula noma ukulimala.

Lokhu kwakhonjiswa ngokucacile esontweni elandulela ukwethula inkulumo yikomidi. Emva nje kancane komdlalo, umqeqeshi waseBotswana uDH Motsheare wagcizelela umlingani wakhe waseSwazini u-Ernest Mavuso ukuthi abafana bakhe bayiqembu eliyizingane elisanda kuhlanganiswa. Ukugxila kumele kube sezixazululweni kwezinkinga ezivimbela isimo ukunezilungisa okonakele. Izingozi zokushayisana mahlanze: ukugijima kakhulu uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo kanye nokwedlula lapho kunolayini abaphikisa lokho noma ukuzohlangana nezimoto eziza ngakuwe. Sekubonakele ukuthi zombili izimoto zazintshontshwe ngesikhathi sokuphanga izindlu, kanti ziyahlobana nokuphanga izindlu eNorthclif kanye naseWinchester Hills. Kungaba uqonde uMnu George Stainton imenenja ehlezi emva kwami? Ukuphazamiseka kwezokuthutha eBluff ngoLwezi. Ukuvikela nokuqinisa izikole, ngokudweba ngendlela, ukufaka amapayipi kanye nokwakha kabusha, ukuze zimelane nezehlakalo zemvelo. Ukwengeza, ukungena kwezinyunyana emsebenzini kulezi zindawo kwakucindezelwe. Izindawo ezingatshaliwe kumele zenziwe ziqine ngezinto ezizokwenza ngcono ukuma kwazo hhayi ezizodala inkinga noma ezizozibeka engcupheni. Usizo ekugadeni ukuqhubeka nokuphepha kokuhamba kulandelwana emangcwabeni aseChris Hani nase-Oliver Tambo. Ukuthuthukiswa komhlaba okungalawulwa kungaba nezmiphumela emibi endaweni yemvelo, ezindaweni zamasiko kanjalo nakwikhwalithi yomoya namanzi. UCharles Zwane wangenelela wathi bayangethemba njengomqeqeshi nokuthi abakholwa ukuthi ngiyimpimpi. Ukwenyuka kwezinhlelo okudla imali nokuqalisa kabusha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kumele kugwenywe.

Umnyango Wezemfundo uveza ngokuqhakazile lesi simemezelo esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole sikazwelonke sezikole ezimaphakathi nezinga le-R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha kwalesi sikhathi akukaze kube umsebenzi olula. Kwesinye isikhathi, abantu ababephakathi kokuhumusha le misebenzi babephoqeleka ukuba bakhe amagama amasha kwezinye izindawo. Lezi zinkomba zithunyelwe kubachwepheshe bezilimi ukuze bahlolisise. Umnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zinkomba njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufunda ukuba asebenzise lezi zinkomba njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuhlolwa kwabafundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela kumigomo yokuhlola imfundo esekelwe kumiphumela, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze izibonelo zezindlela zokugcina amarekhodi. Okuqukethwe kwale ncwadi kuhlukaniswe ngezahluko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sikhuluma ngezinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo kanye noqeqesho jikelele - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, kanye nezinga eliphezulu. Isahluko ngalinye kulezi zinga liqukethe ingxenye yokwethula okufushane, izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga. Izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga zethulwa ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi inqubekela phambili yokufunda ibonakale. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola ezifanayo zazo zonke izinga ziqhathaniswa ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuqhathanisa inqubekela phambili yokufunda eminyakeni. Lokhu kudala izikhala kwezinye izindawo, njengoba hhayi zonke izindlela zokuhlola zifana kuzo zonke izigaba.

Uma uthinteka, amapolisa, abaphakanyisi, nabasebenzi bekhaya bazokwazi ukukwazisa, bakulungele, futhi bakuhlinzeke ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nalokho okungenzeka. Uma ufika enkantolo, ungathola izimpawu ezizokwenza ukwazi indlela yakho. Uma lezi zimpawu zingacacile futhi ungazi ukuthi iyiphi inkantolo okufanele uye kuyo, uma ikhona, buza etafuleni lolwazi ukuze uthole umhlahlandlela wokuthi iyiphi inkantolo ubufakazi bakho buzokwenziwa khona noma kuphi izindaba ezifanele. Ungaqonda futhi eqenjini labaphakanyisi, abazokwazi ukuphendula noma yimiphi imibuzo yakho mayelana nenqubo. Umphakathi ophatha icala lakho uzokwazi ukukutshela ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuthi unikeze ubufakazi. Umphakathi uzokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubizwa ukuba unikeze ubufakazi ngokushesha okukhulu. Umphakathi ohlangene necalalakho, lapho kudingeka, uzokhuluma nawe ngaphambi kokuthi ubizwe ukuba unikeze ubufakazi. Nokho, kwesinye isikhathi kungase kube nezikhathi zokulibazisa. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ukhona enkantolo ngesikhathi. Kufanele uqinisekise umphakathi uma uzobe ulahlekile noma uma ungakwazi ukuya enkantolo ngosuku lwecala. Uma kudingeka unikeze ubufakazi, kwesinye isikhathi cela umngane noma othile ophakathi kwecala ukuthi akuhambise enkantolo. Ngemuva kokunikeza ubufakazi bakho, uzokwazi ukukwazisa uma ungahamba. Ngokwesimo esithile, ungase unikeze ubufakazi wakho egumbini elivaliwe ngevidiyo (lokhu kusho ukuthi ngeke ube khona egumbini elifanayo nomsolwa, kodwa uzobe ungaphakathi kwezinye izindlu).

Ingabe wonke amasimu e-Bt corn anama-toxins? Kuya ngezimo. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezinqumayo ukuthi kuphumephi ama-delta endotoxins esitshalo: indlela akhiqizwa ngayo kanye nesimo esiqala inqubo yokukhiqiza. Izinkampani zezim seed zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukukhiqiza ama-delta endotoxins, ngakho izinhlobo zama-hybrids zizohluka. Okukhona kwenzeka lokhu: igene ye-Bt ifakwa ezinsizeni zemvelo (material genetic) zesitshalo. Lokhu kukhombisa indawo lapho igene ye-Bt ingena khona (yikuphi i-chromosome nokuthi ikuphi kulowo chromosome, njll.). Indawo lapho igene ifakwa khona esitshalo izokhombisa ukuthi kuphumephi ama-endotoxins nokuthi mangaki azokhiqizwa. Okwamanje, teknoloji ayivumeli ukuphathwa kwendawo lapho igene ye-Bt ingena khona, ngakho ukufakwa kwale gene kuyahluka futhi izitshalo ezahlukene zikhishwa ezikhiqiza ama-endotoxins ahlukene. Isimo esiqala le nqubo sifana neswishi esitshela igene ye-Bt ukuthi nini nendawo yokuthi iqale ukukhiqiza ama-endotoxins. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezingaqala le nqubo futhi zihluke ngendlela ezisebenza ngayo, ngakho isimo esithile sizokhiqiza ama-endotoxins endaweni ethile nangemali ethile, kuholele kuma-hybrids ahlukene. Zingaki izinhlobo ze-corn ezine-Bt? Kukhona ama-hybrids ahlukene ane-Bt, amanye angavimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo kanti amanye ahlasela imizi. Ingabe wonke ama-hybrids e-Bt asebenza ngendlela efanayo? Ukuphatha izinsongo ezithile kuhambisana nenani lezinto ezikhiqiza inqubo yokukhiqiza efakiwe kwi-hybrid ethile.

Akungavunyelwa muntu ukuqhubeke nomsebenzi ngaphambi kokuthatha zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha ezifanele akuthathwe izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ongaphansi komqashi ulandela uMthetho akuphoqelelwe indlela efanele yokugwema izingozi ngentshisekelo yokulandela umgomo wokuphepha nempilo enhle. Ukuqaphela ukuthi umsebenzi nomshini usetshenziswa ngumuntu ngaphansi kweso lalowo oqeqeshelwe lomsebenzi noma umshini ukuze aqonde kahle ngobungozi obuphathelene nomsebenzi noma lowomshini. Isisebenzi leso kumele siqikelele ukuthi imizamo yokunqanda iyalandelwa futhi iyagcinwa. Bonke abasebenzi banelungelo lokwaziswa. Abaqashi mabaqikelele ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayaziswa futhi baziqonda kahle izingozi ezimayelana nempilo kanye nokuphepha kulowo nalowo msebenzi abawenzayo, lokho okukhiqizwayo, okuphehlwayo, okulondoloziwe, okuphethwe noma okuthuthwayo kanye nemishini noma amathuluzi asetshenziswayo. Umqashi makanikeze ulwazi ngezinzame zokunqanda izingozi. Umqashi kumele azise labo abamele ingosi yempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini ngesaziso somhloli nabaphenyi ngokuvakasha abayokwenza emagcekeni omsebenzi. Umqashi kufanele abazise futhi labo abamele ingosi nokuphepha emsebenzini nganoma yisiphi isicelo esifakiwe sokuxolelwa noma ngokuxolelwa okunikwe umqashi ngaphansi koMthetho. Loluxolelo luchaza ukuxolelwa ngaphansi kwemibandela ethile yoMthetho, imigomo, isaziso noma imilayelo engaphansi koMthetho. Umqashi kumele azise abamele ingosi yempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini ngokushesha lapho kunengozi eyenzekile emsebenzini. Ingozi yisehlakalo esivela emsebenzini lapho kufa khona, kulimale noma kugule umuntu.

Bonke abaqashi abaqasha umuntu noma abaqasha mayelana nebhizinisi labo noma ezolimo badinga ukubhaliswa nokukhokha iminikelo yonyaka kuMfundisi Wokubuyiselwa. Lezi zinqwaba zingabuyiselwa kubaqashi. Ukubhaliswa kudingeka kunoma iyiphi igatsha lebhizinisi ngaphandle uma izivumelwano zenziwa zokubhaliswa ngokuhlanganyela. Imali engena kulolu mfundisi ikhiqizwa ikakhulu ngemali yokukhokha yonyaka evela kubaqashi ababhalisiwe ngokususelwa kumaphesenti noma esinqumweni somholo wanyaka okhokhelwa kubasebenzi babo. Nokho, umthetho unikeza ukuhlinzeka ngeminikelo engezansi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukukhokha akwehlisi ngaphansi kwezindleko zokuphatha. Ekupheleni kukaJanuwari unyaka ngamunye, amafomu athunyelwa kubo bonke abaqashi ababhalisiwe. La mafomu kumele agcwaliswe futhi abuyiswe ngaphambi kukaMashi 31. Unyaka wezezimali weMfundisi Wokubuyiselwa uqhubeka kusukela ngoMashi kuze kube sekupheleni kukaFebhuwari konyaka olandelayo. Lo Mfundisi uphinde uvikelwe ngezinhlinzeko ezivumela ukwehliswa kwezijeziso kubaqashi abahluleka ukukhokha, noma ukwenza ukubuyiselwa kwephesenti elingu-10 lenani lokukhokha. Ububanzi bokukhokha, okukhishwa kubaqashi, buxhomeke ohlotsheni lwezokusebenza zebhizinisi labaqashi. Ukuze kuhlukaniswe abaqashi, bahlukaniswa babe ngezigaba ezahlukene nezagatsha ngokususelwa ohlotsheni lwezenzo zabo. Ububanzi bokukhokha bu governed ngumthetho ophoqelela ukuthi imboni ngayinye kufanele ibeke izindleko zezingcuphe zayo futhi kubuyekezwa minyaka yonke. Noma yiziphi izinguquko zenziwa ngokususelwa endleleni ingcuphe ivela ngayo.

Ubhekilanga usitshalo sezimbewu zikawoyela esibalulekile kakhulu lapha eNingizimu Afrika, esikhathini eside sivama ukukhiqiza amathani angu-650,000 njalo ngonyaka. Izimbewu zikabhekilanga ezinenani likawoyela eliphakeme - 44% - ziyingxenye enkulu yomkhiqizo lapha kithi. Izimbewu zikabhekilanga ezinenani likawoyela elingaphansi - 25% kuya ku-38% - zisetshenziswa emsebenzini wokubhaka amakhekhe nokudla kwezinyoni. Ubhekilanga ungatshalwa ezindaweni eziningi ezweni lethu lapho inani lemvula lingaphezulu kwa-475 mm kuya ku-675 mm ngonyaka. Kodwa, noma nakuziphi izindawo, kufanele kukhiqizwe ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo. Intengiso kabhekilanga ikhuphuke kakhulu ngokwamanje, futhi sikholwa ukuthi izohlala khona unyaka wonke. Ikhwalithi ephezulu, izimbewu ezifanayo ezilingene nokungabi nezimbewu zokhula kufanele kubhekwe lapho ukhetha izinhlobo zezimbewu zokutshala ukuze umkhiqizo wakho ungavelelwa ingozi. Izimbewu zalo nyaka ezikhiqiza kakhulu, azikwazi ukutshalwa futhi ngonyaka ozayo. Lezi zimbewu zizomila zibe nezinhloko eziningi, lokhu kwenza kubenzima ukuvuna ngomshini futhi azikhiqizi izimbewu eziningi. Ukufika kokoma njalo ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi esisuka ngaphakathi kwaDisemba esiya ngaphakathi kwaJanuwari kufanele kubhekwe kahle ngoba kubalulekile lapho ukhetha isikhathi sokutshala. Isikhathi sokuhluma sezimbali zikabhekilanga sibalulekile ngoba ngaleso sikhathi izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi, futhi zingaphatheka kabi uma kufika ukoma. Ngakho-ke isikhathi sokutshala sifanele sikhethwe kahle ukuvimba ukuthi isikhathi sokoma sifike sihlangane nesikhathi izitshalo zihluma izimbali.

Okwamanje, amapulazi amaningi akhishwa ngamabhizinisi ezolimo, ngakho-ke abanye abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakwazi ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Lapho kukhona abalimi abangenazo izinsiza, kuthiwa bazokwazi ukwenza inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza. Kodwa lokhu akuphumeleli - inzuzo etholakala ekulimaleni kwezimpahla zokudla incane kakhulu, futhi abaqashi baphinde baphinde banciphise inzuzo. Bonke abasebenza emkhakheni wezolimo kufanele basebenzisane ukuze basize abalimi. Abalimi bafuna ukusebenza ngokwabo; abafuni ukuba balimelwe ngabanye. Nika umalimi ithuba lokuqala ukulima ngalokho abanako - ukuqala ngezimpahla ezincane endaweni encane akubeki engcupheni enkulu. (Khumbula ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukulima emhlabeni wabo usuphila kule ndawo. Uma bengakwazi ukwenza inzuzo encane kuphela ngaphezu kwalokho ababephila ngakho, kungabasiza kakhulu. Ngokusebenza kanzima, umalimi uzokhula ekulimaleni). Ungacindezeli umalimi ukuba aqashe umqashi; kungcono ukusiza ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yabo nemishini ukuze balime ngokwabo ngalokho abanako - mhlawumbe kungcono kubo ukuqasha amapulazi abangawaphatha. Ukusebenza nomuntu onolwazi (umeluleki) kuzobasiza kakhulu - kodwa umeluleki kufanele akhethwe ngokucophelela! Kufanele kube umuntu ozinikele ofuna ukusiza umalimi akhule - ozothatha isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono futhi abaxhase. Kufanele bahlangane futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye kahle. Hlinzeka abalimi ngemininingwane futhi ungathathi izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuhlangana nabo. Kuthiwa - asifuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu - futhi kufanele kube njalo lapha.
